Which meant I couldn't use them because the orange clashed with the color scheme of the event.  So they were donated to the candy bowl in my office.  Nothing was wrong with the candy, it just wasn't as pictured (which the product page does indeed say to not rely on the picture).
This candy is fantastic! I love root beer, so why not get the candy. You get a lot of candy! It's worth it.

This is one of the best Candies ever made if you like Root Beer,but how anyone can charge 7.60 or more is a joke for 1 bag considering you can buy a 1 lb. bag at Walmart for 98 cents.Trust me gang,take 3 dollars and buy 3 bags at walmart...they will last a long time.
I bought these for my son, who first tried them at a restaurant while we were on vacation. He absolutely loves them.  Good price, fast service.  Will order again :-)

This is a product my kids love, and I can feel good about giving them. We try to avoid High Fructose Corn Syrup, and it is tough to find kids drinks that aren't loaded with it.  Water is too boring for them, and I worry about them staying hydrated with sports etc.  This is a perfect fit for our family.

One of my two cats, Vladimir, recently got incredibly sick from Nutro food. It wasn't listed in the pet food recall, but several pet parents have had sick dogs and cats from this "premium" food. I spent $3,200 in vet's bills and had many anguished nights. The vet put him on a perscription food, but that one has also been recalled recently...arg! Fearful for their health, I fed them tuna (I know, not the best option), and though Vladi maintained his health, my house REEKED of fish. Praise the lord for Evolution! They love the taste of this, it smells good (and tastes good too...I tried a bit, and I'd totally eat it) and I'm not grossed out by touching it. I feel great that my cats are eating food that I like, both for it's nutrition and for its ethics. I'm going to be an Evolution costomer for life!

I decided to try and get my cats to eat this because of the horrors of factory farming. I was a bit nervous though about going 100% for my male cats and frankly I don't think they would go for it. I use it to supplement their food. Half (to 2/3) of this mixed in with half Pet Promise. Pet Promise uses NO factory farmed animals. They are now getting the ultimate healthy and animal friendly option I can give them. I just wish my local pet health food stores would carry this.

Although I like the idea of this product, my cats hated it. One is very picky, so no surprise there, but the other eats anything! He was meowing and excited but when I put the bowl down he sniffed it and reared his head back and completely snubbed it. I can't tell you how shocked I was by his reaction. I ordered it direct from the company, so it wasn't spoiled. I have to give it 1 star because neither of my cats would touch it.

column9: Evolution Diet Cat & Dog Food is the Best
column10: My pets (1 Dog and 2 Cats) have been on Evolution Diet for years. Both my cats love the food and have been on it since they were 4 months old. My younger cat was very sick when I brought her home and I was nervous about putting her on a vegei diet until she was well. My Vet uses this product and recommended that I switch right away because it's such a high quality food. Once I put her on Evolution she had a speedy recovery. Everyone that has had contact with my pets have made comments on how beautiful their fur is.

I was looking for a blueberry breakfast bar.  I bought these to compare against Kellogg's Nutragrain blueberry bars.  These are definitely better.  These are a bit sweeter and the grain portion is a bit drier, but I actually find that to be a positive (you'd think drier would be worse, but the texture actually works well with the flavor).  The Nutragrain bars are a little softer, but the flavor isn't as good.As another reviewer noted, the blueberry filling isn't quite as proportionally large as shown on the box cover, but I found it to be fine.  Smaller than shown, but not stingy.  And it actually tastes strongly of blueberry, too, which really is what counts.  Good buy.
I want to like these bars, but there is so much sugar in them I just can't reorder them.
These cereal bars were enjoyed by my 11 year old son...he liked the taste and felt it gave him energy.  We are going to now try the other flavors.
These are fairly tasty and much healthier overall than most in the grocery store.  Very decent.

column9: Health Valley Cobbler Cereal Bars, Blueberry
column10: I purchased these for my daughter's lunches.  she works in warehouses and drives tow motors.  they fit in the pocket, easy to open.  She in particular about her blueberry products and she has had nothing bad to say about these.

These bars kick fruit butt!  They really are one of the best "breakfast" bars that I have ever tasted, plus they appear to be somewhat healthy which is always good.  I can eat one of these for breakfast and be satisfied.

These are fairly sweet, but not bad.The pictures are misleading, it shows thin crust and thick filling, its excactly the opposite, very thin filling and thick crust, its not bad but i think I will look elsewhere for a breakfast bar.
My two year old loves these cereal bars. We call them cookies :)(And as a side note the boxes I received are in the new packaging!)

This bar and the other Strawberry bars are the staples of breakfast in our house.  A bar and a boiled egg with milk and vitamins set my girls up for sucsess at school.  Most importantly, they like it and will eat them with happiness and quickly.

I was surprised at how good these muffins were since they are fat free.  They were a little more moist (cakey) than I like muffins but still delicous.  I would definetly recommend adding some walnuts.  I tried to bake it in a bunt pan and it came out a bit small, use 2 boxes for a full size bunt cake.  For special occation, you could make a simple orange glaze to drizzle on top. :)

High quality, tasty muffins with moist cranberries. I grated some orange rind and added it to the batter because I like the extra flavour. You only have to add one cup of water...no eggs, milk or oil. So easy and so good.

and so easy to make! All you need is a cup of water, the box contains the dry muffin mix and a can of cranberries with orange peel (just drain and add to the mix). The baking directions says one box makes one loaf (8.5x4.5x2.5), 24 mini muffins, or 11 regular size, but I make the 12th one and they are just a smidge smaller. I spray the muffin tins rather than use baking cups (the box says you can do either) because with the papers too much of the muffin sticks and it just got wasted. Now I can savor every little crumb. They are a delicious breakfast or even a mid-afternoon snack to hold you until dinner. They make the kitchen smell really good too!

column9: Just Add Water for Great-Tasting, Surprisingly-Filling Muffins
column10: All of the Krusteaz muffin mixes are good, but the KRUSTEAZ CRANBERRY ORANGE MUFFIN MIX may be the best of all.  Why?  Because the muffins taste great, even though the only thing you need to add is one cup of water.  The muffins take just 16-18 minutes to bake, at 400 degrees Fahrenheit.  For nonfat muffins, they are surprisingly filling.If you want something fancier, the box has a recipe for "Sweet Apricot Coffee Cake" that adds apricot preserves, brown sugar, and cinnamon.  However, I think that the basic cranberry-orange muffins don't require anything extra.Another Krusteaz muffin mix that I really like is the Krusteaz Banana Nut Muffin Mix, 17.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12).  But the Banana Nut muffins require three eggs, in addition to the mix; and of course they aren't nonfat muffins.  I purchased my Krusteaz Cranberry Orange Muffin Mix (in a single-batch box) at a local chain grocery store.

column9: Super Easy to Make and Very Tasty
column10: If you like cranberry muffins these are a great choice! It comes with a can of moist cranberries to mix in (rather than dehydrated berries). This definitely makes a big difference in the final result. I also love that you don't need any eggs - very simple, fat free recipe.

column9: Krusteaz Cranberry Orange Supreme Miffin Mix
column10: This mix makes really tasty muffins;  fast, and very easy!  The quality of the final product surprised me, given that it is "fat free". A nice alternative to typical muffin flavors, too.
ive ordered these many times over, great to make when you're about to have company, really quick to prepare, makes the house smell wonderful... oh and they taste great too!!

column9: Finally something fat free that tastes good!
column10: I have recently had to go on an extremely low fat diet for health reasons. I love veges so no problem there. I was an avid carnivore, so let's not even talk about me having to give up meat. I may get so emotional I might not make it through this review. I have been trying so many fat free/low fat foods. Everything I have tried so far has tasted like crap! Most fat free foods have no flavor and they are just bland and gross. So I continue to search for recipes and packaged goods to enable me to have a diet full of fat free/low fat foods that I can really enjoy and are healthy for me.One food that I am having trouble finding is flavorful baked goods. I tried baking from scratch some fat free cookies and muffins and they were just ok still dry, bland and flavorless. I will keep experimenting with baking and trying new fat free packaged foods until I find things I can live with. The search for a flavorful fat free breakfast led me to this muffin Krusteaz Cranberry Orange Supreme Muffin Mix, Fat Free, 17.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)I saw these fat free muffins and thought I would give them a try. Man was I surprised! These tasted like real food, really good food. If someone had made these for me I would never have guessed that they were fat free. I am so glad I found something that actually tastes great. I have put these on the subscribe and save list and they will become my main breakfast food.These muffins are also super easy to make. One cup of water is all you need to add. The box comes with a small can of cranberries that you fold into the batter. The cranberries are really good and tart. I made them using a muffin pan that was sprayed with cooking spray and another pan lined with muffin baking cups. The muffins stuck to the baking cups and wasted a lot of the muffin so I will just use the spray from now on. Easy to make, delicious and fat free. I would recommend these to anyone.

column9: This is the best FAT FREE mix.

Yogi Teas are always potent and this one's especially bright with a wild, wonderful blend of licorice and mint.

:: Stash White Christmas White Tea ::Having read that white tea is even more healthful than green, more antioxidants, and also that its flavor tends towards the light and mellow, which would be good for my ice tea mixes ... I went on a hunt in AMZN's aisle for white teas. This type seemed to be generally a bump up in price compared to the general pop, like mostlly in the $18+ range. Then found this Stash blend at only $13, so for the savings, I figured that I could overlook the part about Christmas on the packaging.I was also happy about the choice of blend on this. White tea, ginger root, peppermint. Ginger is absolutely my favorite flavor for ice tea already. And a little peppermint in there sounded good, too.  Now that I have it, comment on the taste of the blend. The ginger in there is only very subtle. Which is fine, as I can add extra ginger tea bags to my ice tea batches -- and probably better as is for drinking just a cup of hot, straight tea.  The peppermint is distinctive. Overall, the taste of the blend is quite crisp and light, with an easy-going flavorful tinge from the peppermint and ginger.When I tried this tea, I was instantly pleased, and made a note to buy Stash brand again. (AMZN is running a promo on the brand this month, so that works well...)I am glad to have discovered Stash, and am eager to try a few more varieties. My previous experience in brands of teas what limited by what has been available at my grocery stores. Lipton, Celestial Seasonings, Yogi, Triple Leaf. Recently via AMZN shopping I've bought and tried three brands new to me.  o Bentley's. High quality green tea.  o Stash. White tea blend - very nice!  o Clipper. Blend of white tea + ginger. Tastes dry and messy and old.Glad that Clipper wasn't my only intro to white tea, since it was such a loser. The Stash got here the same week, and it, in contrast, was a very satisfying acquisition. I'm hoping for equally good results when this month I try out Stash in another variety, like probably a Green + ginseng. Or possibly a black, or even one of the chais ...

My sister decided to make her own peppermint patties. They came out great. Then she came up with the idea to try wintergreen flavor. I have made both a pumpkin and double crust apple pie using the Perfect Pie Crust for a holiday get together. column9: Something To Look Forward To During The Holidays

They are the perfect dessert, or in between !!!!!!!!!, they melt in your mouth and super delicious

Summer fun, trading baseball cards, jumping in the pool. My favorite flavor was always banana, but I wouldn't turn down a chocolate or a strawberry if that's what was left in the bin...

column9: Hard to Describe How Much Better These Are
column10: I'm not a huge fan of Vienna Sausages, but my mother is, so I found these on sale the other day and bought a couple of cases. I decided to try them and was blown away by how much better they are than regular Vienna Sausages. First the texture of the smoked sausages is quite different. They are firmer and the smoking process creates and almost "crust" like effect on the exterior of the individual pieces giving them a little desperately needed "bite". The smoke flavor is just what the normally bland sausages needed. It takes something that had very little flavor and adds just the note necessary to really perk them up. If you like Vienna Sausages give these a try. If you normally don't care for them, find a single can in the store and see what you think. These are great camping food, a lite lunch with a few crackers in the briefcase or a quick snack at home.
We have not eaten these yet but my husband and daughter have had them before and that is why I bought them in bulk or by the case.

I asked my wife when I started eating this variation of Vienna Sausage. She thought that it might have been in the 1960s, but I think it was some after that, maybe sometime in the 70s. At any rate, if someone told me that I had eaten 5000 cans of this stuff, I would not be surprised. Oh, yes, that might be an exaggeration, but not by much.Earlier on, these were made with pork and beef and that was much better than the current formula. The chicken meat adds a sort of rubbery texture to the little sausages and does nothing to improve the flavor. The smoke flavor improves Vienna Sausages a lot and the smoky liquor in which they are packed is drinkable on most lots, too.My only real beef with this product is what seems to be uneven flavor. Some lots are very smoky and some are not. Some lots are exceedingly salty and some are not. I have had an occasional can that was too salty to eat the sausage and the liquid was too salty to drink. On some lots, they have seemed to have a harsh texture and flavor, without very much richness, while others are rich and well integrated. Still, I keep coming back because when they are right, they are a very good canned meat product.I am very sure that if a reader would buy a couple of cans, he or she would like the product, especially if smoked meat is an otherwise favorite. Try them.

I was very happy with both the caviar and the company. The shipment arrived next day well packaged and with wonderfully reusable freezer packs. The caviar was fresh and extremely tasty. I would certainly order from them again.

column9: HORRIBLE doesn't begin to describe this product!  Very disappointed!

column9: Good Hot Chocolate - See Below for a Few Keurig Brewing Tips for Cocoa
column10: This is a pretty good cocoa for your Kuerig brewer, and has a nice and rich taste at the "small" setting of my Keurig: if you want a less-rich experience, just try the medium or the large setting as there will be more water vs. the flavoring than the small.  My son and I like it at the small setting, while my wife and daughter prefer the medium setting (none of us cared for the large setting).  Don't forget to add the marshmellows!One trick to getting a better experience for the hot chocolate in your Keurig is before you put the pod in the Keurig, make sure you shake the pod real well in order to break up the clumps of the cocoa powder: you need to do this as it tends to clump (no matter what brand of K-cup hot cocoa) and breaking the clumps up allows you to draw out more of the flavor vs. more of the hot water.  After all, you paid a lot for the cocoa!One thing I do after brewing each cup of cocoa is to run a medium setting of hot water in order to clean the Keurig by just raising and lowering the pod holder and closing it without a pod into it and then running a medium cup cycle: make sure you put an empty cup under the unit, and you will see what I mean as some of the cocoa powder gets in to the Keurig's lines.  Once you flush it out, just discard this dirty water (you'll be surprised). I highly recommend this as, for example, if the next thing you brew is coffee you don't want to have a hint of cocoa in your coffee.

If you're a Necco addict (you've tried 'em) this is a great deal for a whole lot of measured doses.

column9: Great Candy Favorite in Mini Snack Size!
column10: We LOVE Necco Wafers and enjoying them in the mini rolls keeps us from "over-indulging".  However, the "party box" is a misnomer.  They came in a plastic bag with a twist tie close.

column9: Best Japanese Rice I have eaten.
column10: This is some of the Best Japanese rice I have tasted, I usually by smaller 5 lbs bags at jewel-osco in the Asian section. But this is way more of a saving for my family of 4. I would recommended this stuff to anyone who like sushi and Japanese rice, I know they also have brown rice and my Wife is a firm believer in brown rice. So If I try it I'll update later.

column9: Great Rice & Great Price with Prime Shipping
column10: This rice has an excellent taste and is very versatile. A little more expensive that buying it locally, but even though I live in a medium sized city, it's still hard to find it in stock...Even then it's 45 min ride to other side of town and the place was closed.;-( So, very convenient to get it with Prime here on Amazon! We use it for all sorts of dishes, from sushi rice to making our own Spanish yellow rice. My kids have it for lunch along with nori, hard boiled eggs & a little soy sauce for a simple meal.

I was turned onto this rice seven years ago when I met my now husband (who is Filipino). I buy both the white and brown Botan Calrose rice at my local international foods mart, and they are both fantastic. When cooked according to the instructions on the bag they come out perfect. I've eaten the white rice for years but since we tried the brown, it's become my favorite (it's not quite as starchy and slightly chewier.) The white rice is a bit on the sticky side but great for using in any rice dish. I also love Botan's orange rice candy... try them all.

Reviewers who have complained about this rice being sticky are to blame for not knowing what they were ordering.  Rice that is described as "Great for sushi" in the product description is OF COURSE going to be sticky.This rice is delicious and perfect for sushi.  I do recommend rinsing a couple of times and then soaking for at least half an hour prior to cooking.  You'll find that the rice is even more delicious that way.

I normally buy Tamanishiki or Nishiki for sushi rice, but I thought I would try something new.I added 25 percent less water than it says on the cooking direction,and let it soaked in the water for 30 min before cooking. It turned out great.The rice goes perfectly with Mitsukan Sushi rice vinegar. Very yummy !

I love this rice.  This 20 pound bag lasted us about 10 months, for two people who eat it frequently.  It is hard to find a sticky rice in our grocery store, and I was overwhelmed by all the choices at our local Japanese market.  This rice is perfect, I use it as sticky rice or for sushi.  I like to put some in a bowl and top with sliced steak, ham, vegetables or hard boiled eggs and pour some sauce on top - I like to use a seasame ginger salad dressing.  I love eating it for lunch or dinner.There are no cooking instructions with this rice and cooking sticky rice can be confusing because there is a lot of information out there.  I do not rinse my rice, I do not find it to be necessary.  It would probably be more authentic if I did but I think it is fine without that extra step.  This is the recipe I use:1 cup dry rice1 1/4 cups waterCombine in a sauce pan with a well fitting lid and bring to a boil.  Turn down to low and simmer for 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and allow to sit another 20 minutes without lifting the lid.  For sushi rice add about 1-2 tablespoons seasoned rice vinegar and stir gently.I try to avoid stirring too much once it is cooked as that will make it less sticky.  For that reason I do not fluff it like I would with usual American rice.

Cooking with this rice is very simple. Not even the need of rice cooker. I get rid of the rice cooker. I used any cooking pot.One is to one which is one cup of water to one cup of rice. After it boils without cover (you don't want any spills), slow the flame, put the pot cover and let it cook for 15 minutes. That's it.
I cant command how much water should I use. Its harder to cook than all the rice I have cooked before. But I think if I could cook with a right volume of water, mayge it would taste good
The cooked rice rice ends up on the sticky side.  If you want the cooked rice fluffy and light, this is not the item you want.

I got this Dinner of the Month Club pasta meal as a gift from a very special person back in CT where I used to live--I believe they are one of the leading gourmet presents companies nationwide.The pasta is ready literally within 15 minutes--a quick meal is a good thing, especially for a single guy like me who doesn't have the time of day to cook complicated stuff--and not only that, it tastes excellent! (I added some parmesan cheese to the sauces that I got in my fridge and it made it even better). Honestly I wasn't expecting it to taste this good. As an Italian food fan, I was pretty satisfied with this gift. If you don't want to leave the house or what to stay home to watch the game, it's a perfect gift. Do I recommend their food and services? Absolutely! Giving gifts like these are a good idea for single people like me, so I am thinking returning the favor and sending these to some people I know for the upcoming holidays.

I recently joined the dinner of the month club and I am so glad I did! It may be the best gift I've ever given myself:) My entire family reaps the benefits because it is a treat for everyone, no matter age or gender. We always look forward to the arrival of a new and exciting pasta in the mail every month. We even have a tradition now in our house that we all cook dinner together on "pasta night" and enjoy a savory dish provided by the dinner club.It is so easy to make an impressive dinner with dinner club because they even send recipes to go along with their noodles and sauces! I recently received the Vegan Pumpkin pasta fettuccine paired with the Butternut Squash with Parmesan Cheese. I also got the Italian Spice Linguini with the Organic Roasted Garlic sauce. Even just boiling the noodles warms your home with a delicious fragrance. Everything I have ever received from Flying Noodle has always been of the highest quality. I have friends over to play dominoes every Tuesday night and I always brag about my Flying Noodle packages. They have tried most of my dishes and always want to know where they can get the noodles and sauces at our local grocery store. There is just nothing like it that you can buy from the store, I have since gotten all of my domino friends on Flying Noodle- dinner of the month club.I definitely know where to go to do my Christmas shopping this year! There is something for everyone and I know I can trust Flying Noodle to deliver the best quality of products to my loved ones.

column9: This is NOT the original Justin's Chocolate Hazelnut Butter !
column10: I hate to be the only one with 1 star review here, but I have to warn - I ordered Justin's Chocolate Hazelnut Butter because I loved the original. However, they recently (Sept. 2011) changed the formula which now includes almonds in addition to hazelnuts. The new label says "Justin's Chocolate Hazelnut Blend". The added word "blend" is tiny, but the taste difference is huge and and I don't like this new version. Justin's customer support team confirmed they changed the recipe and that they are now only making the "Blend" version.We'll see what other customers say about this new concoction. As for me - I'm not liking it. Justin, the original "Chocolate Hazelnut Butter" without almonds was WAAAAAAY better.

Ok, maybe not quite.  But that is the first thing that popped into my mind when I saw this at the store today.  I bought a little squeeze pack to try it and.... OH MY.  This is sooooooooooooo delicious.  It's a bit salty, a bit sweet, and really does make me think of Nutella.  A couple of things, though... this nut butter isn't completely smooth and it isn't really even close to being like Nutella.  BUT it so much more satisfying because it is a nut butter not just chocolatey sweetness like Nutella is.  I am so in love with this Chocolate Hazelnut butter that I am buying the three pack as soon as I am done typing this.  I bought a squeeze pack of the Chocolate Almond as well and I don't like it as much.  It is good, but the Hazelnut is totally out of this world.  And because it is a rich, satisfying food I will be less likely to eat the whole jar in two days like I do on the rare occasion that I allow myself to buy Nutella.  Thank you, for this product.... it allows me to think of my childhood in Germany without making me totally nuts with guilt over what I am putting in my mouth.  That's not to say that I will never buy Nutella again... because I will, but I don't think I'll feel the overwhelming urge quite as often with this stuff in my house.  Yum, yum.Before I sign off, though, I would like to emphasize once more (so I don't get hate comments on my review):  This is not a Nutella copycat, not even close... but if you love that and you love nut butters then you will be in chocolatey, nutty heaven with Justin's.UPDATE 10/09/2012:  Yes, yes the formula has changed. I'm guessing because Hazelnuts are expensive. That being said, I broke down and tried the new BLEND this morning... and you know what? It isn't anywhere near as bad as all of these 1 star reviews are making it out to be. Yes, the flavor of Hazelnut is not nearly as strong, but it IS there, and I still thought it was delicious. In fact, I found the blend to be just a little creamier than the original all-hazelnut version and I rather liked it. Did I prefer the pure Hazelnut? Yes. Do I like the new "Blend"? Yes. I liked it enough that I stand by my original five star rating.

column9: Original hazelnut butter vs new almond-hazelnut blend
column10: I have both original and new formula at home. They taste almost the same, but new formula separated after opening and has more oil IMHO. My child loves Nutella, we recently started on a dairy free diet, and this is an ok  substitute for our favorite Ferrero nutella spread. I personally didn't like justin's hazelnut butter taste, especially weird aftertaste, but, since new formula contains almonds, they should put almond picture on the label and the word "blend" should be the same size as brand name on the label. They should also lower the price.

Oh my God, this hazelnut butter is so addictive I have to hide it from myself! :)I originally got a couple of single packs at a local health food store because I didn't want to risk buying a whole jar of the 'unknown'. After I tried it, I RAN back to the store to stock up. :) The taste is out of this world and the ingredients are so simple, it's amazing. It really does taste a lot like Nutella, only in a more grown up way. :) It's also not as smooth as Nutella (it has a grainier texture) but I don't mind one bit. I actually prefer it to Nutella (even though I grew up eating Nutella and it used to be one of my all time favorite foods). I've also tried the almond butter and the maple almond flavors--both beyond delicious! Also, even though it doesn't say it on the jar, I'm pretty sure it's vegan too! I've signed up for email alerts from Amazon, so let's hope they bring it back soon.In case you're wondering: no, I don't work for the company and I have no idea who 'Justin' is, I'm just in love with their products! :)

This is not the original Justin's!!  It is a blend with mostly almonds!!  When I first saw and ordered, I thought I was getting the same product I have previously purchased at Whole Foods or at Target.  I thought this was a great deal since the product was often unavailable and cost $10/jar. My first impression was that I thought it looked odd that I had to stir the nut butter from amazon, something I never had to do with the store bought variety. It wasn't until I read another's review pointing out the word "Blend" that I went running to my kitchen only to discover my mistake in not noticing the difference. Thank goodness my daughter came to the rescue and picked up a jar from Target yesterday.  If you want the original and not the "blend"  you will have to go to the brick and mortar store or order direct from Justin's themselves.

I originally purchased this product from Amazon a few months ago, and was very satisfied. Shortly after, I bought it in a health food store and could not understand the difference! I have since realized that the second jar, which still sits half-full in my cupboard, is a new formula. They have changed the recipe to include a hazelnut-almond blend. Definitely not the same texture or taste as the original. Very disappointed!

column9: Old formula - a winner with my family; New formula - won't touch it
column10: The old formula, which doesn't contain almonds, is oustanding; I would put a very thin layer on a slice of bread and I could say it is like heaven. The new formula tastes different, looks different....and I would simply not buy it again. I would try to see if Target has any left in stock though the last jar I bought there had an expiration of May. It is truly dissapointing for the company to go the cheap route and change the formula without surveying its customers first. Market share is hard to gain and easy to lose. There are a couple of other brands of chocolate hazelnut butter on the market and I am willing to give the Italian one a shot.

Oh. My!  This hazelnut butter is DIVINE!!! Being the frugal, savvy shopper that I am, I balked in the store when I first saw how much this cost. "There is no way I am paying almost $10 for a bottle of NUT butter," I thought (but there was no dissuading my boyfriend). And, the second it hit my tongue, I was a convert. This stuff is SO worth the price tag.  I feel that before I continue I should mention that unlike so many others, I am not, nor have I ever been a fan of Nutella.  In fact, I only tasted it once (several months before sampling this treat), and while I found it tasty enough (with that much sugar, fat, and chocolate, how could it not be?), I wasn't thoroughly impressed. But, THIS.  THIS is absolute heaven.  As noted in my title, it tastes like Ferrero Rocher, and it is ADDICTIVE!!  **A NOTE about CONSISTENCY/TEXTURE**  As other reviewers noted, this is not an entirely smooth butter, but I'm not really bothered by that. (It's not CHUNKY, but, there are bits of what I can only imagine to be hazelnut in the spread that are the size of small grains of sand.)Let me note, though, that we first sampled this out of the squeeze pack, and after sitting in a pocket for a couple of hours, the butter oozed out in a gloriously creamy fashion, almost like a thick caramel sauce.  In fact, I don't recall detecting any of the "grit" or "grain" that is present at room temp. when we had it that way. . .So, try warming this up in a double boiler or other gentle heating method if you're really craving that smooth consistency.) Since this is so thick, sometimes it CAN be difficult to spread on softer breads; my boyfriend likes to eat this on challah (for some reason, the combo reminds me of a boston creme doughnut!!) but he likes to take a huge glob of it and smear it instead of gingerly spreading (I know, I know -- what guy "gingerly spreads"? :) so please take note of that.  I LOVE that the first ingredient in this is HAZELNUTS.  It IS vegan (though it doesn't say it on the container) so it doesn't contain any dairy.  No comparison can be made between this and Nutella (though it is obviously unavoidable as they are both a hazelnut chocolate spread) so please don't buy this hoping for something similar in taste (though I can't imagine even the staunchest of Nutella lovers being disappointed by this; my boyfriend is -- and HAS been for YEARS -- a Nutella diehard, and he, too, absolutely ADORES this). If you're looking for a delicious, decadent treat that will tantalize your taste buds :) and haunt your dreams, then, by all means, dig in!

column9: True Grit...and I'm not talkin' about the movie.
column10: Tried the 'blend' after having had their orig. recipe for quite a while. In my opinion it was a waste of time and money.First off: all I could taste was the salt. Salty start, a whiff of cocoa, the slightest whisper of 'generic nut flavour', then more salt. Very unsatisfying.2nd: the texture. I don't know if adding the almonds to their 'blend' is responsible for this, but the gritty texture in this new recipe was awful. I've had poorly cleaned mussels and poorly shelled walnuts before: that's what this texture reminded me of. I kept getting these brief moments of alarm when one particularly gritty mouthful made me think I was about to bite into an even bigger piece of grit then end up with a cracked tooth.I wasn't expecting smooth and creamy like Nutella, but something that didn't remind me of unpleasant grit would have been nice.I understand that hazelnuts are more $$ than almonds, but having virtually no taste of hazelnuts at all made for a very sad and depressing sandwich.If you only like the smell of almonds and don't care about texture, this might be for you. If you expecting anything else, look elsewhere.Hopefully Justin's will change their recipe again, 'cause this one's a dud.

column9: Warning, new formula put almonds in there
column10: one star because when i called the company to ask them how much was almonds now and how much is hazelnut, they refused to tell me!not as good as the original, which you might still find in the small 1 ounce snack sizes!

column9: Used to be much much better
column10: The original was much better than the blend.  Bought this, realized it tasted different, then looked at the jar. They added a little tiny blend to the labeling (it's not the same picture as shown).  I'm sure it was done to save money, but at $10 a jar I sincerely doubt they were losing cash on the product.  If I wanted chocolate almond butter, I would have simply bought it (they do sell it).  Disappointing that they changed the recipe then tried to slip it by everyone...

Reasons for not buying it (among others):- if you smell it, you will have to eat it- if you eat it, you will dive in for more- when the jar is empty, you will become very sad- if your partner likes it too, you will have to fight- if your children like it too (why wouldn't they?), you will have to be mean, take it from the top shelf, and eat it at night when they are not watchingSome reviewers say this shouldn't be compared with Nutella. I disagree: an hazelnut chocolate paste HAS to be compared to Nutella by definition.  Well, this evil Justin's paste is more nutty, more salty, more grainy than Nutella.  If you have had a chance to compare the hydrogenated American version of Nutella against the European version of Nutella, you will have noticed that the European one has more character, more taste, more of a nut taste, and less of a wishy-washy sugar taste not to mention that it is healthier. Well, this Justin's paste is just taking all of these traits one step further and the result is evily good.  Being a 30+ year Nutella fan, I wanted to write to Nutella and ask them to bring the European kind to the US. Now, I do not need to write to them anymore: I am a traitor who sold my sole to the enemy. Justin's forever till I need to lose weight!

I am deeply saddened by the new "blend" which includes almonds. It tastes nothing like the original if you ask me- way to gritty and I can barely taste hazelnut. I am hoping that enough complaints will spark their interest to go Back to the original recipe- which was outstanding! Wish I stocked up on some original jars a while back... I shall try and make my own that comes close so I can get my fix in I suppose...

I bought this because my family is pretty obsessed with the Justin's Maple Almond Butter and thought "hey maybe this is as good as Nutella". I could write a lot of words saying pretty much what all the other 5 star reviews say, but I'll keep it short and sweet:This is no reason for me to keep Nutella in the house ever again. This is yummier (WAY WAY yummier), and lower in sugar. Bye Nutella, it's been fun but something better (WAY WAY better) has come along and stolen my heart.

I am an aspiring natural bodybuilder, so am always trying to find good food choices. Compared to nutella, this blows it right out of the water, half the carbs and sugar and almost similar taste. However, this chocolate hazelnut butter has a salty like aftertaste. I'm afraid they use the sea salt so much (to prevent oil separation) that it messes up the potential of the flavor. I will try other Justin's butters and maybe I will find a tastier one, because this flavor wasn't certainly "all that". Worth a try, but don't expect it to be out of this world.

column9: Hazelnut Butter BLEND Now Includes Almonds
column10: ***UPDATE 2011:  100% Hazelnut Butter is no longer being made.  Justin's brand has changed the recipe to include almonds.  It is now called "Hazlenut Blend".  Ingredients: Dry Roasted Hazelnuts, Dry Roasted Almonds, Organic Evaporated Cane Sugar, Organic Cocoa, Organic Cocoa Butter, Organic Palm Fruit Oil, Natural Vanilla, Sea Salt.

Yummy, yummy, yummy!!!!!!!! It actually tastes like a nut spread instead of sugar. Highly recommend it to anyone who likes nuts, peanut butters, high-end chocolates - they would really enjoy it as I do.

After debating between nutella, this, and several other spreads, I finally picked this one up at a local store. A quick comparison of ingredients convinced me. Although I've never tried the original that everyone I praising, I absolutely loved this blend. It is clearly not the same as nutella - it is subtly sweet, has a grittier texture, but is absolutely divine.Since hazelnuts are the first ingredient, there are more hazelnuts in the product than almonds (or perhaps it's 50-50). However, this really doesn't bother me - it has the lovely taste of hazelnuts along with the nutritious benefits of almonds! This makes me a happy gal :) I only wish it cost a little less!

I stumbled upon this product a year ago while looking up prices for Nutella on Amazon.  After reading the glowing reviews, I saved it in my cart for a future purchase, but never ordered it.  Fast forward to yesterday, when I was looking for non-dairy dessert options for my family and saw the priced dropped a couple dollars.  However, there were so many 1 stars for the new formula, I decided to purchase one jar at Whole Foods to try it (at $10 a jar btw).  I do love Nutella, which is like eating decadent candy from a jar.  This isn't as creamy or quite as sweet, but definitely has a similar enough taste to satisfy me, and is much healthier.  I can only imagine how wonderful the original recipe was, and wish I had tried it earlier!  But this one is still good, so I don't understand the bad reviews.  I can clearly taste the hazelnut, not the almonds.  And I specifically paid attention to the salt level.  I have a moderate salt intake (not low, but I'm not a salt-aholic).  It did not taste salty to me, although I'll admit I tasted a tad bit of salt on my lips a few minutes later.  It didn't bother me though.  It has only 65mg sodium (less than half what peanut butter has), so if you can tolerate the salt in Jif, this is significantly less.  It has 12g carbs for those of you wondering, 3 of which are fiber and 7 sugars.  4g protein, and 15g fat.  180 calories total.  No partially hydrogenated oils.  I just ordered the 3 jar pack from Amazon, so it's good enough for me.

This stuff has 4 grams of protein per serving and tastes delicious with less than half the sugar in Nutella. Gave a jar of this to my mom for mother's day along with some other of their flavors and she loved this one the most!

read the ingredients! it has more almonds than hazelnuts .... and sooooo much chocolate that you can not taste anything but salt and chocolate...:(( will not buy ever again...and now im actually can not trust their other products....used to love the brand though...

column9: Maybe this is only for health 'nuts'??
column10: Today I decided to try Justins chocolate hazelnut butter since its organic and the first ingredient isn't sugar -like Nutella but it is seriously nasty. It tastes like burnt salt. I couldn't taste the hazelnuts or the cocoa over the sea salt. I am really glad I only purchased the sample size at my store. This stuff is terrible. If they had a salt free version I would try it though, because Nutella is too sweet.

I just tried this product, and wow! This tastes just like when you bite into a Ferrero Rocher hazelnut chocolate, as it is like Nutella but with a more hazelnut taste. It's delicious and a tiny bit less sweet and smooth than Nutella, which I consider a good thing.

column9: the squeeze packs aren's enough..bring on the jars!!!
column10: love the squeeze packs, love the jars even more!!! Great tasting healthy peanut butter is now a family staple in my kitchen. My family loves it and now my friends families love it also. Just shows how pure simple healthy ingredients can taste great and be good for you to.

column9: The new formula is not good
column10: I used to go through a whole jar of the old formula in no time. It was not too sweet, very chocolaty, and definitely full of hazelnuts. The new formula with the hazelnut-almond blend just isn't good, and the hazelnut flavor is barely there. I do hope they listen to their customers and go back to the original formula. If they do, I'll have to change this review to add two or three more stars.

This stuff is way too good.  I'm going to end up gaining too much weight if I don't watch it!But - I was looking for a more nutritious alternative to nutella after I realized that oil and sugar are nutella's main ingredients.  And even my VERY picky child likes this too.  (I did however keep nutella out for quite a while so he probably doesn't remember what it tastes like much).  This is not as smooth - more like natural PB than creamy Jif consistency. OH SO YUMMY though!

I bought this product as an alternative to nutella since it's dairy-free, and even the cashier said it was the same if not better tasting, but maybe she was talking about the original formula. This spread tastes kind of dry, and not too sweet. It's also really salty, so much that it burns the roof of my mouth. I would not recommend this product at all.

It is like eating a ferrero rocher for breakfast... yum! It is a staple in my diet now... hazelnuts have so many health benefits and it is amazing when you can get an organic product with amazing health benefits and chocolate combined.

column9: Pay for it but don't taste it
column10: You pay for no palm oil yet still get it AND you're still blessed with the oil slick atop the product. Next time I fork over a premium, I'd expect a superior taste or at least better ingredients.

column4: Laura Newton "It's a car wash ladies and gent...
column10: This stuff is delicious.  People are comparing it to Nutella, but it was far superior.. it has a fraction of the sugar and you can eat it without getting a sugar rush.  It actually tastes like HAZELNUTS and CHOCOLATE.  Best stuff ever.

I've not tasted the original version but the hazelnut blend is delicious. There was a bit of oil separation at the top but not as much as you get with most natural nut butters. I keep mine in the fridge and scoop it out one spoonful at a time.  Tastes like a hazelnut chocolate butter cup to me and I love the stiffer texture after being refrigerated.

I still love Nutella, but at 21g of sugar a serving I was looking for something a bit more guiltless. I saw the small packs at Target and decided to give it a try. I'm always a little skeptical, and have tried other chocolate spreads but once I tasted this one I knew I had found it. I do miss the creamy texture of Nutella, but the flavor is spot on, although more nutty/hazelnut than Nutella. This is a compromise for my health where I don't feel like I'm missing out. I don't even mind that it has less sugar - it's still plenty sweet to satisfy me. I'll probably still buy Nutella from time to time, but I think Justin's will be my staple!

column9: It's Nutella (stay with me now)... for grown-ups!
column10: Nutella, the seminal Chocolate Hazelnut spread, will always be the go-to comparison.  It's sweet and cocoa-y flavor is the stuff of legends, the golden standard for many.  Now, I don't know about you but while I'd love to eat that stuff for days, I simply can't.  It's immensely sweet and equally unhealthy. On a simple comparison, a serving of Justin's Hazelnut Blend contains only a third of the sugar with three times the fiber!As a food product, I approach Justin's Hazelnut Blend with four senses (because you can't hear something like this!).  Visually, it's more pleasant to me because it looks far less processed.  You can see that hazelnuts and almonds are in there, unlike Nutella's frosting appearance. And, when I give it a whiff, I don't get that "did I just get diabetes?" sensation but rather a pleasant and earthy smell from the cocoa and nuts.Eating it, Justin's just feels like how a nut spread should (again, unlike Nutella's heavy, frosting texture). Justin's Hazelnut Blend doesn't taste like Nutella and that's really why I love it. The cocoa and hazelnut flavor is more present and I thoroughly enjoy the almonds' richness.  I can actually taste the roasted flavor from the nuts and it pairs well with the subtler cocoa taste.Ultiimately, give this a try if you're looking for a healthier alternative to Nutella, or something that isn't just "sweet."

I love this spread on toast! I like that it isn't as sweet as Nutella and has much healthier ingredients in it. I've tried the chocolate peanut butter one, but like this chocolate hazelnut butter much better.

I have no idea what the original formula had in it or how it tasted, but I know that this stuff is ridiculously good. I love the consistency and the taste. You can get your sweet/chocolate fix at night with one spoonful. So much better than Nutella and way better for you.

I'm reviewing the new formulation (with almonds as well as Hazelnuts) that other reviewers have objected to. Not having tasted the original with only hazelnuts I can't compare, but I can see how it would be even better with just hazelnuts and no almonds. Nonetheless, it's far better than any other chocolate hazelnut paste I've been able to purchase. Way less sweet and more hazelnut flavor than Nutella. I've picked up a couple of smaller Italian brands at specialty groceries as well and while they have more hazelnut flavor than Nutella, they're still too sweet. This one is better.

When I opened the jar, there was a lot of oil on top. I understand this happens with natural nut butters, but its so hard. Is this what everyone has to go through with each bottle? My hand sure does hurt right now.
This stuff is not only tasty but also a healthy alternative to Nutella. It is a great product and I hope they continue to make it until the day I die!
great, but too salty. and there are hard weird bits in it like the hazelnut shell was ground up in the process

I love Nutella.  I was scared to try Justin's Nut Butter because I loved Nutella so much.  And the truth is, this does not taste like Nutella.  Nutella tastes like milk chocolate, I can't really taste the hazelnut in Nutella.  Justin's Nut Butter Chocolate Hazelnut Blend actually tastes like chocolate covered nuts that have been grinded into a spread.  There's no dairy in Justin's so it tastes more like semi-sweet chocolate.  Considering I like to melt semi-sweet chocolate chips and add various nuts, this spread is completely delicious to me.
This Chocolate Hazelnut Butter is soo much better than Nutella. I've been trying to keep my sugar intake low and I can feel better about my this indulgence with only 7g of sugar!

I heard praises about Justin's nutella so I decided to give it a try.  I've bought other nutella (expensive and coming directly from Italy) and they are OVERLY sweet like eating thick chocolate paste or chocolate cake frosting (where every second you need to reach for a gallon of water), but Justin's is not at all sweet but has good chocolate flavor and a very nutty taste (with its hazelnuts and almonds) and I think the sea salt gives it a unique flavor. After tasting it, I'd rather pack Justin's nutella on a long tiring trip rather than peanut butter!!

Only 7 ingredients and 7g of sugar for every 2tbsp (32g)!!!!!It is truly delicious. Not sugary, delicious hazelnut taste with a hint of chocolate. Much better than Nutella. Nutella is easier to get with a knife and spread on bread but Justin's is not only tastier but fresher. I have the feeling that is fresher - anyone feel the same??Justin's isn't made with hydrogenated oils which gets lots of points from me.

These packets of natural chocolate hazelnut butter contain delicious and healthy dark chocolate mixed with hazelnut nut butter in a handy two-tablespoon serving. They are perfect for travel to ensure you take in your healthy plant-based fats while on the go, and they are also a great aide for those counting calories or other dietary components, as the serving is already measured out for you!

While I've always liked the taste combination of Nutella, the overly sweet and almost marshmallow-creme texture were too much for me.  I saw the sample-pack size of Justin's Chocolate Hazelnut Butter at Whole Foods Market and decided to try it.  When I got home I was unhappy that I did not buy a larger size (the closest market is 1.5 hours from me)!  This nut-butter is thick and substantial, and not nearly as sweet as Nutella.  It's healthier, less sugar, and a perfect deepness of the chocolate balanced with the hazelnuts.  It's great on bananas, sandwiched between Trader Joe's Meyer Lemon Thins, on English muffins or toast, or my favorite - on a spoon!  I am sure I am missing dozens of wonderful combinations but will certainly use my creativity!  I highly recommend this, as well as the Maple Almond Butter - Justin's makes a fantastic product!

this is sooo delicious!!!! you will eat it pretty fast! the price is great too (subscribe and save was only 24$ for 3)! it's sweet and salty... perfect combo... and not overwhelming.. just perfect... it's super nice and creamy but you can still taste tiny pieces of hazelnuts.
This stuff is fantastic!  The subscribe and save price can't be beat!******Most importantly, I don't feel guilty about letting the kids eat it!
This tastes like the candy Toffifay without the carmel. Love to eat a spoonful of it right out of the jar.

I considered how dangerous this purchase might be, threw caution to the wind and completed the order.  If you have any issues with self control at all, I suggest you buy the individual serving squeeze packets instead.  This stuff is better than any candy bar and certainly better than Nutella.  In contrast to Nutella, it has a slightly grainy texture, is much less sweet (and has significantly less sugar) and has a darker chocolate flavor.  The only objectionable trait is the appearance.  It looks a little....recycled if you know what I mean.  But you quickly get over caring when you taste it.

column9: Tastiest and most healthful hazelnut butter on the market
column10: I have tried nearly 14 different brands of chocolate hazelnut butter (or nutella) originating from around the world. Justin's Chocolate Hazelnut butter wins hands down in the tastiest AND the most healthful category. It is not a cloying 75% sugar as regular nutella is, does not have shady ingredients and you can actually taste the chunky toasted hazelnuts in the butter. It is amazing on just about everything, toasted bread, Granny Smith chunks, peanuts, pretzels, pita bread and really, anything you can think of. Amazon's price for 3 1lb jars of Justin's Hazelnut butter is unbeatable. It is at least $3-$5 costlier at Target, Whole Foods and wherever else it's usually sold. Highly recommended for health-conscious and taste-conscious nutella lovers.

After browsing thru nut butters on Amazon, (and reading all the rave reviews) I decided to sign up for Justin's Chocolate Hazelnut subscribe and save.  Glad I did -- this stuff is good!  I don't like really sweet anything, tho I do use Nutella occasionally on whole wheat toast.  You can't even compare the two.  This is for grown-up taste,  great with a bananna or fresh strawberries, wonderful with pound cake, crackers, toast, the list goes on and on.After receiving my first subscription order I found this at a local farmer's market with a price tag of $10.49 per jar!
This is really delicious and the best thing, you can't eat it as much as Nutella :) It's real stuff.

I was lucky enough to find this on clearance at Target for less than $3. I bought one went home and tasted it. It was Divine! So the next day I went back and bought some for my family and a couple more jars for myself. I have no clue what I will do with it (eating out of the jar sounds good to me) but for that price I could not pass it up. It is way better than Nutella (which is yummy too but it does kind of taste like frosting). This tastes more real and not so sugary. You don't feel like you are going to go into a diabetic coma after eating some like you do with Nutella. Overall if you like Hazelnuts and you like chocolate it would be worth buying to indulge yourself. Very yummy!

column9: 4 yr old isnt as pleased as she is w/ nutella but....
column10: my 4 yr old was eating a jar of nutella until i read the label..bad momma i know...SUGAR! anyways i bought this stuff and she isnt aas pleased but she will eat it.  I forced her to the first few times and she got used to the difference.  It is not smooth, gritty, but is healthier than nutella which is why i bought this.  So far so good!
Justin's chocolate hazelnut butter is extremely tasty, and gluten free/healthy.  I eat it way to quickly, but it really is a happy treat on a gluten free diet.
Oh my god!! So good. I love that it's nowhere as sweet and gooey as Nutella. I can't really think of anything else to say than... oh my god so good.

This product is soooooo good!  I took it to work with some plain cookies (Marias) and it was a huge hit.  I love hazelnut and this definitely is hazelnutty.  Much better than that other chocolate hazelnut spread (in my opinion).

This hazelnut cocoa butter is so good. The uniform but gritty texture reminds you you are eating in fact, actual nuts.I bought because I had tried the peanut butter (BTW, good job marketing department for offering cheap squeeze packs to get hooked on your product) and found the ingredient list to be most appealing.Cane sugar (and not a terrible overdose), cocoa, hazelnuts, a little vanilla, and nothing I can't pronounce.I LOVED chocolate hazelnut spread as a kid but now with my own kids, I want them to have the same yumtasticness with-out the questionable additives.Something that some people might point out - it's expensive, but I bet every ounce of this hazelnut butter has higher concentration of nuts and cocoa than the cheaper kinds. A spoonful of this satisfies my sweet-tooth in a pinch, too.

This is great-it is not as smooth as others but the nurtional content is much higher with less sugar-I much prefer the taste as the nut taste is not masked by the sugar-an absolute delight and nutritious too.  Not often you can cover both bases.  I actually perfer the texture to the smoother brands.
The Chocolate Hazelnut Butter is SO awesome! It tastes similar to Nutella but is SO much yummier and healthier... I'm addicted to the stuff! Can't get enough of it...

we discovered justin's nut butter after buying it at whole foods.however other people must have caught on because they can barely keep the hazelnut butter in stock now.we bought it because it was a vegan alternative to Nutella- no milk in it. I can tell you, as a vegetarian that still allows milk and dairy into my diet, this is actually BETTER then nutella once you stir it and get it whipped into a frosting-like texture.it's a healthier, organic alternative to nutella or other products and just what you need for that chocolate fix, without the guilt. granted, you can still go overboard and eat more than is healthy! you may want to start or pace yourself with the small pouches (think serving size) that they may also offer.good stuff. addictive!

I can't get enough of this stuff! This is an amazing product and one that I can feel good about indulging in. Unlike its more popular counterpart, it has just 7g of sugar per serving rather than 21g. That's tremendous!But the even bigger pay off is the taste. Decadent, delicious, rich, and thoroughly satisfying. As others have mentioned, it's not as smooth as Nutella. It's more the consistency of natural creamy peanut butter. This made no difference to me.  I highly recommend this product.I also want to give kudos to Amazon.com for their customer service. This item was erroneously reported as delivered when it had not been. This is the third time that I've had this issue with UPS. Amazon promptly sent out a replacement and scheduled Saturday delivery. I was very impressed.

This is one of my favorite Justin's products! My house is constantly stocked with it and I make sure all my friends and family try it and then spread the word. Everyone I know loves Justin's and always wants more. I run out very fast but it is worth it!

It really pains me to give this product a bad review. It is such a good idea and I really wanted to like it.I purchased Justines Chocolate Hazelnut Butter Blend at Whole Foods - a total impulse purchase. I'd never heard of it. I am crazy about Nutella and don't trust myself to buy it more than once a year, as I eat it by the spoon and I'm lucky if it lasts 3 days !!!  This product sounded great and I saw the mostly good reviews.It just doesn't taste that good. It feels greasy and is pretty flavorless. I see from another review that Justine recently changed the formulation - that reviewer commented that  the "blend" isn't as tasty as the original. I wish W/F had had the little 99-cent sample so I could have tried this before dropping $10 (!!!) on the jar.Although it was a noble effort, this product is too caloric (and expensive) - I will stick with Nutella for my splurges!

The formula seems much healthier than Nutella, but some parts were too salty. Absolutely not satisfying as Nutella.Also, my package had some chocolate outside. Why? The package was sealed internally and the pot was not broken, so I don't know why there was chocolate on the outside part of the lid. Poor handling at the factory?Better would be something between this and Nutella.

column9: Does the new almond addition ruin the taste?
column10: I agree with the other review stating that the original version was better. It was. One thing I'd like to add however. In my opinion, it was better, but not "way better." I would be happy if they brought the older version back but this version is still very good. I really like it. Could be that the original version was 5 stars, but this one deserves 4, not one. I mean, they only added some almonds, the sugar is still the same, and hazelnuts are still the first ingredient. I think some people are just upset at the formula change that they went from five starts to one. Not me. I still like it.

I thought this would be wonderful because I love nuttela!  Let me tell you this is a terrible product.  I have never had a nut butter that was so bad.  Even the natural peanutbutter I tried wasn't this bad.  First let me say if your looking for a Nuttela like product, buy Nuttela.  This product tastes like they took peanut shells, added water, oil, and a pinch of poor quality chocolate put it in a blender and pulsed it twice.  The texture is gritty at best, I swear they used shells not nuts!  Horrible, thew it away immediately.

column9: If you haven't tried this -- WHY NOT???
column10: A normal, off the shelf pasta has about 220 calories per 2oz (dry, uncooked) serving.  Very few people actually eat JUST 2 ounces -- this is why pasta has gotten such a bad reputation in the quest to loose weight or maintain a healthy weight.  The wheat provides a small amount of protein, but unless you're eating whole wheat pasta (ik) it doesn't provide fiber.Enter Fiber Gourmet products!  That same 2oz dry serving has only 130 calories, plus it also has 18 (can you believe it?) grams of fiber.  And it isn't grainy like whole wheat pasta, or slimy like some of the low-carb things that hit the market a few years ago with the Adkins craze.  In fact, it tastes just like regular pasta.And they make it in several of the most popular shapes.  And if you go to the Fiber Gourmet site, they also make it in several popular flavors -- my favorites are the red/black pepper, the cajun, and the garlic/parsley.  They evidently also make tomato, but have been out of it every time I've gone looking.It's really good stuff.  :D  Hard to argue with 130 calories and 18g of fiber, now matter what kind of sauce or pesto you put on it!

I have been getting FiberGourmet pastas since I first heard about them - probably a few years ago? I, and my entire family, LOVE these pastas. I have since swapped them in for literally every pasta dish we've made with fantastic success. The lasagna makes perfect lasagna, the fettuccine (both unflavored short and flavored nested) can stand up to any sauce, and the penne is a great standby. I've even served friends who were initially hesitant but then had to go make their own order.Given that the average American doesn't eat nearly enough fiber, and that these offer so much - along with a great reduction in unnecessary calories - I think these are just marvelous. Some of my older family members, who are really cautious about their net carbs for metabolic/blood sugar reasons, say that these are the best way they can enjoy pasta without impacting their health.
These taste just as good as regular pasta, just better for you.  No brainer.  My new pasta brand.  You won't be disappointed.

column9: FiberGourmet Light Fettuccine, Short-Cut Love it!
column10: We discovered FibreGourmet pastas recently.  We have tried the Fettuccine, Rotini, Penne so far.  We love all of them.  You MUST cook them a little longer than directions say to. I'm not sure you can overcook them.  They seem to stay Al Dente, which we enjoy!  Love the high fiber, low calories.
Love this Pasta, good for you and tastes great.  I mix half of the FiberGourment with half regular pasta and it works out great. Will be ordering more.

Not enough words to say how much I/my family love their pastas.  I see no taste difference and by far the highest fiber content pasta on the market.  I have tried almost all their items and love them all.Thank you for making such a wonderful and healthy product Fiber Gourmet!

I ordered these as a Christmas gift for a Whopper-Loving neighbor. I liked the 15 individually sealed carton idea. I gave them to the neighbor at Christmas. Later I got a hesitant note from her stating that they had expired in May 2011. I ordered them on Dec 1, 2011. Embarrassing and disappointing. Of course I got a refund from Amazon with no problem. I hope it was a rotating mistake, because Whoppers are great and the packaging is a great idea. I gave it a 2-star, because the refund process was easy.

column9: Hard to find in our stores!
column10: My husband and I each loved this cake as children and have had a difficult time finding it in our local grocery stores.  I'm stocked up now and it is a yummy as we remember!

column9: Truly a honey of a honey!
column10: This Tuscan chestnut honey has a marvelously deep, rich flavor. Comparing it to supermarket honeys is like comparing a crusty Italian loaf to packaged white bread. It enriches any dish you add it to, but I like it best just spooned on to a slice of toast - or straight off the spoon.

column9: Very Special Honey with Unique Flavor
column10: This is a specialty item we ordered as we were tempted by the prospect of the chestnut flavor in the honey itself. It's a lovely honey--very flavorful with a beautiful scent, color, and taste. It goes best with a straightforward (non-flavored) tea such as English Breakfast. If you pair it with a flavored tea (mint, chamomile, Earl Grey, or such), the scent and taste of the chestnuts will be overwhelmed, so stick with what's simple and mild. This honey is also great on plain yogurt, and I'd imagine it would be super as an addition to mildly flavored baked loaves, such as lemon bread. We're glad we gave it a try.

Illy issimo caffè Italian espresso style coffee drink is a 6.8 fl. oz. (200 ml) blast of sweetened caffeine in a can.1930s Italy under the rule of Mussolini greatly contributed to the development of modern coffee culture, improved coffee-making, and new types of coffee-making equipment. The Horn of Africa (where coffee originated) was under Italian colonization and companies such as illy and Bialetti were founded.In that tradition, this drink is now made in Denmark under the issimo brand from illy and distributed in the U.S. by Coca-Cola.This canned cappuccino has a slightly bitter dark roast coffee taste with the right amount of sugar and a pleasant mouthfeel. It's not as good as freshly made espresso but it's not bad at all. I do prefer the illy issimo cappucino as a treat.
Splenda minis are great for the purse, brief case, or travel bag.  Each is about 1/2 of a splenda packet giving you better control of the level of sweetness.  So convenient!

Dr. Berstein, in his book Dr. Bernstein's Diabetes Solution (available on Amazon) recommends tablets over packets because packets include a filler that adds carbs. This is a great tablet in Coffee. I prefer NuStevia tablets in hot tea but Splenda minis are good in hot tea also. The package is great for on the go folks, have not had any dispenser malfunctions. Stores don't normally carry the tablets for some reason. I found this at my local Wegeman's, the only store near me that carries them, for 2.99 a pack. That is cheaper than this item on Prime. However, it took me awhile to find a store and then had to go get them so for a couple bucks more, Amazon might be the option for you.Overall, a very good alternative to packets for diabetics following Dr. Bernstein's advice. The package indicates one mini tablet equals 1/2 packet. Each package contains 100 mini tablets. I like the one-click dispenser, I never have to touch the tablet.

I was happy to find this item. I had a similar item for my Equal, but I have switched to Splenda because it doesn't lose its sweetness in hot beverages. This pocket dispenser is great, it dispenses one tablet with each press of the release button. The only reason for the 4 stars is that these tablets do NOT actually equate one tablet to a packet. It's more like 3 tablets are the equivalent of 2 Splenda packets. But all in all, I am happy with these dispensers for their convenience.

We simply cannot find Splenda tablets in brick-and-mortar grocery and pharmacy stores in our area (SF Bay Area peninsula) -- only the powder. Amazon has them, delivered them quickly, and in perfect condition. Thanks!

column9: Great and easy product to use
column10: I love these containers to deal out the small pills of Splendia. No messy spills with old packaging in your purse.I can't find them anywhere but here. Thanks Amazon once again for coming through with products that are hard to find in certain geographical locations of the USA. Cheaper too... I might add to order from you than most places.
THis is a great product for my husband's tea.  He loves the convenience of it.  Received it as promised.  Good service.
Came in handy while on vacation, the dispensor some times was difficult to use,some times had to try multiple of times to release the tablets.
I received the shipment on time. This is a way to carry Splenda in a nice, clean and convenient package. I have it in my purse and I gave some to family members who use this product.
I think the dispensers are great.  I like that they aren't bulky and always dispense just the right amount of sweetener time after time.  I'll be buying more when my supply is almost gone.

column9: Great Way To Carry Splenda - Highly Recommended
column10: Splenda Minis are a very convenient way to carry Splenda with you when traveling.I mostly use Splenda since the other non-sugar sweeteners have never tasted "right" to me, but not every restaurant or person I'm visiting serves it. I had started to carry the little packets (Splenda No Calorie Sweetener, Granular, Individual Packets, 700-Count Box) with me, but they get grungy if left in the pocket too long and do take up a good bit of space.The 200 Splenda Minis in the hard plastic dispenser are equal to 100 packets, so these will last a good long time. Note: Be sure to give the tablets time to dissolve and stir well.Highly Recommended!CFH
The splenda packages were exactly as described.  I received them within the time that was specified. I was very satisfied.

column9: Best idea in a long time
column10: I shared my order with my deployed grandson! I'm sure the military supplies our troops with everything they need but this is portable and can be carried in a pocket so he can sweeten what can be made in a foxhole even.  My working granddaughter also got one so she can keep it in her purse to have on hand in case the break room is out of packets-it's just that convenient!  Thank you Splenda for your initiative on these MINI DISOLVABLE TABLETS and thanks to Amazon for carrying this product!
I love this, just perfect for my purse. no spill and just the right to add to my tea or coffee on the go, no opening of packtets, just drop in hole for straw or sipping hole.

I have used Splenda for years mostly packets and mini's when they came on the market. Retailers use to sell them at food stores, then it stopped. Packets are a good option but can be messy if you are carrying them around. They become torn and a mess of powder. Not with the Splenda Mini'a they are like small mini suger cubes in a dispenser that fits into pocket, bag or drawer. They taste the same and you may need less since each mini packs flavor. I do not know why more stores do not carry them, since they great for tea, coffee and hot beverages. Retailers do not have to carry them. We are lucky we can get them from Amazon. I am enjoying my pack. :-)

These are practical since you can carry one pack in your pocket or store it at the office, they don't contain sugarlike the powdered kind but i do have to use more of them since each tablet equals 1/2 packet, that being said i might try equal tablets since they are cheaper.

column9: great !!! it has dissapear from supermarket
column10: good price, and really nice choice having a pack of 4 deal, some times is hard to find in supermarket in this presentation, you only see sachet

column9: Great for travel, except for one slight problem
column10: First off, this product is fantastic, I love it, and I love that Amazon carries it. No more exploding sweetener packets!I would also like to respond to a negatve review--the person said the dispenser gets stuck.  I have found that in high humidity, or a little dampness in your purse/pocket (caught in the rain, maybe?), etc., the tablets may get stuck.  There is a very simple solution; don't get the dispenser damp or wet. Yes, it has happened to me, but it was MY fault, not the product's!!
It is a very practical way of caring Splenda. It works as well as the powder one and it dissolves perfectly well.

Ok I dare you to find Splenda Tablets in the grocery store.  I did not even know that they make them.  So easy to carry around for those who like this product and dont want to carry the packets around.

Splenda is such a popular sweetener, I would think that most restaurants would know to carry it by now--I, at least, highly prefer it over any other artificial sweetener. In fact, it's the only one I'll use. I can't stand the taste of anything else, so if there's no Splenda on the table, I won't order iced tea. I'll drink water, and the restaurant will be out a few bucks on my beverage!I don't have that excuse anymore now, of course. I have a Splenda Minis pack in my purse, and all I have to do is pop it out and squeeze the trigger once... or twice... or six times... (I like my tea sweet!) to sweeten by beverage. If you've ever tried to keep Splenda packets on hand, you know what happens: eventually they get crumpled, and the edges start to tear, and before long you have Splenda in your wallet, your cell phone, your travel-sized hairbrush. ... Even keeping the packets in a plastic baggie doesn't help, because then you just have a plastic baggie full of leaked Splenda, and that's not very appetizing, now, is it?Spare yourself a purse full of Splenda--or, worse, having to use the pink packets in your tea. Buy these Minis. You won't regret it.

I always keep one of these in my purse because I never know when I'll be out and about and want to sweeten a drink. I need to avoid sugar because I'm dieting, I don't like saccharin, aspartame gives me headaches, and too many restaurants still don't offer sucralose in their artificial-sweetener-jar. Not to mention I might be at a friend's house! It doesn't get used extremely often - I'm not a perpetually-dining-out social butterfly - but I won't give it up!

I've been using Splenda for years.  I used the packets for a long time, and there are always little yellow bits of packages here and there.  Amazing the funny places these get to, and where they stick.I found one of these dispensers in my purse.  It's really old so I decided to use the Splenda up.  I really like just popping a little tab in my coffee, not messing around with the packets.  So convenient.  But I couldn't find any of these in my local stores, so I ordered them from Amazon.My order came quickly, and now I am fixed for Splenda tabs for a while!
So much easier than carrying around the individual packets of sweetner - just pop a dispenser in your pocket and you are ready to sweeten whenever and wherever you want. Great little product.
The title says it all.  The service was timely and great and this is a product that always comes in handy
they don't provide splenda at the office so i bought one to keep at my desk - the packaging malfunctioned and now i can't get my splenda tabs out!
Could no longer find Splenda tablets in grocery store, but naturally found at Amazon.  Great service, quick delivery.  Would buy again.

Love this item, it's a great way to keep your preferred sweetener accessible. Some places only stock sugar and Sweet 'n Low. I keep one of these in my purse to combat these issues. They last forever, AND they don't get all beat up and spill inside your purse the way packets do.

We are sooooo glad we found Splenda Tabs at Amazon!  They are in a tiny cute dispenser package of 100 that is easy to use and does not come apart in your purse or pocket like the little paper packets of sweetener do.  Not to add, I certainly can not imagine trying to cart 100 little paper packets around with me!!!The local stores all claimed these were not available but they were on Splenda's website as a regular item!  So I checked Amazon and as usual, Amazon had the item I was looking for!Amazon fulfilled the order so fast, it was amazing!!
After frustration with Equal dispensers I bought these. Not only a great sweetening product but a much more reliable dispenser.
Splenda mini tabs are impossible to find anymore in grocery stores,dept stores,or drug stores.  Thank you for providing these mini tabs.  I prefer splenda over the other artificial sweeteners.
This great product is easy to use and carry with you.  It is small in size, dispenses easily and fits well in pocket or purse.

very good product indeed!!  Convenient to carry in a purse or pocket; tastes the same as regular splenda in small packs.  I love them; I have one of these in few of my purses, so I don't have to remember to transfer them when I change purse.  Love them..........

I used to be able to buy this product in the markets, but I have found it is no longer available.  This is my sugarfree supplement of choice so I keep one in each of my purses so that when restaurants don't offer Splenda, I come prepared.  It's also good when you go to your friends' house so they don't have to scramble looking for a sugarfree supplement in their pantry.

column10: Great way to keep Splenda on hand even when traveling internationally.  You pay extra for the packaging, but the packaging is what counts when you're on travel.
This is one of the best places to order a gift basket. The gift basket was beautiful. The people that run this company are the best. They care about your wants and needs. High quality service.

I got this product at a timely manner and it was exactly what i thought it would be. The product was not damaged and it was exactly what I paid for.

I adore this relish, and have gotten my friends hooked on it too.Dresses up any meal, no artificial ingredients.Try it!Seller packaged box my glass jars poorly and 2 of the jars were leaky, but thankfully not broken when they arrived.Seller gets 3 stars!
This is a truly unique product... we've been taste-testing Indian pickle for years and this is the best you can get in a jar!  YUM!!! Go for it - if you like it HOT!!!!
There are better mates than Cruz de Malta in the world, but I haven't found any better-valued ones. Very drinkable, and very affordable.

The product was delivers properly and originally seemed fresh. Now it seems stale and weak. I never had this problem with other purchases of this product. All-in-all I would say the vendor did a good job.
it is very nice to be able to buy this product for my son because he cannot get it locally and lkes it very much. thank you very much
