This is an excellant finishing salt for those who wish to add that smokey flavor to any dish. This is not a lite smokey taste but rather robust, use it at the table.
I use a pinch an meats when I grill or broil. Love the alder wood taste of this salt, broil indoors and get a rick smoked flavor. A little goes a long way!

It taste great! It has a great smokey flavor and taste great on burgers,chicken,pork and fish.  And although the container is small, a little goes a long way. Great on lamb and on veggies also. column9: Certified gluten free as of November 2010
column10: My name is Annelies and I work for attune foods, the manufacturer of Erewhon Crispy Brown Rice- Gluten Free cereal. Our Erewhon certified gluten free cereals are made in a peanut-free, tree-nut free and dairy-free facility. They are run on a shared line with gluten and we abide by good manufacturing practices to help ensure against cross-contamination. This consists of the machinery being sanitized and thoroughly washed down before the cereal is made. Then after it is made, the cereal is tested to ensure it is less than 20 ppm of gluten. We sent the cereal to a separate facility last fall to double check the levels at which it tested and found it to be less than 5ppm of gluten. In November of 2010, our Erewhon gluten free cereals were certified gluten free by GIG. I hope this helps clarify our current practices as I realize there are reviews dating back many years on amazon.com and thought it would be helpful to update interested consumers of it on amazon.com.

I've been gluten free for ten years.  I'm o.k. enough that I can slip up a little and only get a little sick:  what that means is that if something isn't entirely gluten free, it will make me sick for hours, not days.  That's made me tolerant of food that isn't entirely gluten free--I'll eat the not-entirely-gluten-free food for a couple of days, and then start having a reaction, not realizing that is what is happening.This is only sort of gluten free.  You might be able to eat it a few times with only a little bit of distress, but then it will get worse.  If you are a celiac on a long-standing gluten free diet, you will slowly get sicker again.And, your risk of getting colon cancer later in life will go up dramatically, which is apparently what happens to celiacs who eat little bits of gluten throughout their lives.  Just because it's not really making you sick, doesn't mean it's not doing damage.Avoid this, and don't feed it to celiac kids.Edit:  On the gluten-free listservs there are discussions of people getting sick from this.  Erewhon has confirmed that they run oat cereals on some of the lines, so if you are a celiac who can't tolerate oats (which I am) this is bad stuff.Also, they make this in a facility that processes wheat, so it may be legally gluten free (20 ppm or less), but not actually gluten-free.  Mixed facilities can have 10 ppm wheat in the air alone.

This cereal has a healthy, nutty flavor very similar to that of puffed rice, but with more crisp. It is very low in calories, and it's true what the other reviewer mentioned about the low glycemic impact. It is not a sweet cereal by any means. I eat it with vanilla soymilk, and that makes it tasty enough for me. I personally I would not spring it on a child who is new to a gluten-free diet, because they'll likely turn their nose up at it if served as is. I agree with the other reviewer and would recommend the Envirokids line of cereals for GF kids (caution - a couple of them are *not* GF!).

This is a great tasting cereal, but it is NOT gluten free. It took me months to figure how my family kept getting gluten because I trusted the "family" owned Erewhon brand.  Guess what?  They are no longer family owned. The corporation who makes Skinner Raisin Brand owns them and processes raisin bran in the same plant as the supposedly gluten free Crispy Brown Rice cereal. If avoiding gluten is important to your family's health, then avoid this cereal. It is definitely cross contaminated with gluten.

column9: Ingredients listed on Amazon are incorrect!
column10: We have food allergies, so I carefully pay attention to what we buy and bought this specifically because of the ingredients listed.  When it came, we realized it has barley malt, and what the company sent us was not the same exact box as is listed on Amazon.  The box we have does not say gluten free, unlike the box photo displayed.  I am very disappointed.

I tried my first bowl tonight after ordering the bulk order from Amazon due to the reviews.  I thought they tasted a bit like a cardboard version of Rice Krispies - they were pretty tasteless.  I ended up adding a bit of sugar to it to make it more palatable.The cereal tastes like it would be decent with fruit, but I would probably add a few extra marshmallows if I were to make rice krispie treats out of it.Overall, I would say that there are other, tastier GF cereals out there -- the Envirokids brand is a pretty good one for instance.  However, if you're looking for something to replace Rice Krispies specifically, this is an okay substitute but by no means perfect.

column9: A safe and tasty cereal for Celiacs
column10: This cereal is not for you if you're used to sugary junk cereal. If you have Celiac's disease and multiple allergies, however, like me, or if you just want a pure and wholesome cereal without a lot of unhealthy additives, this is definitely for you. It is light and crispy, but filling and satisfying. I gave a box to my girlfriend who just found out that she is Celiac, and she thought it was great too. I'm so glad that Erewhon decided to make this cereal. It gives me something to eat for breakfast besides eggs, eggs and more eggs. It make breakfast seem like breakfast again! Caution: the unsalted type is not very tasty at all.

My 2-year old son takes VitaSpectrum per his pediatrician's advice.  That thing has a very awful taste!  I can't even hide it in his juice eventhough it's citrus-y.  Well, I put the vitamin in this cereal (no liquid) and he ate it just fine.  I was so shocked.  He's so picky I didn't even think that he'd be distracted by the krispiness of this cereal.My daughter, however, does not like the taste and refuses to eat it. :-(
I mix this cereal with gluten-free granola to cut the sweetness in the granola. By itself, this rice cereal is tasty but not very filling. Good with fruit.
I use this cereal for not only cereal, but also to make rice crispy treats. Yum!
It evens says "snap,crackle,pop." Not only is it delicious, but it is very filling. It satisfies my urge to crunch, and eliminates my problem with gluten products.I highly recommend this cereal.

Erewhon crispy brown rice cereal is good.I think it tastes just like Rice Krispy cereal.It snap, crackles and pops just like it, and has less than 1 gram of sugar per serving.I didn't think it was very filling, but it is a good cereal.

column9: Not a substitute for Rice Krispies unfortunately
column10: I'm a cereal fanatic, but I've got celiac so I have to choose gluten free cereals. I bought this as a substitute for Rice Krispies so that I could make my favorite cookies, which require that type of rice cereal. The pieces in this cereal are a bit bigger than Rice Krispies. I'm not sure if it was the sweetener or the brown rice, but the flavor just did not appeal to me at all. So I didn't even bother trying to make my cookies. I actually threw out most of the box, which I never do, because every time I tried eating it, it just didn't taste good. I tried it with regular milk and almond milk (I thought maybe the almond milk would flavor it better, nope). I did not have any sort of gluten-related reaction to it. I just didn't like it, and neither did my non-celiac husband.

We love this cereal - it crackles! My 2-year old adores the sound.  We love the taste - a GIANT improvement over the Rice Krispies of our childhoods.  We especially like the fact that it isn't too sweet, and is very low in sugar, but still has a cereal-y taste.  For you sweet-tooths, don't panic - it tastes great with an extra sprinkle or drizzle of something sweet on it.

I eat this cereal with unsweetened soy milk, strawberries, and bananas. In my opinion, it needs the fruit for sweetness. I also sprinkle flaxseed on it for a nutty flavor.You can also make a hot cereal version with it. With soy milk, apples, cinnamons in a saucepan... yum :)I have a digestive disease and this cereal does not bother me at all- it's a Godsend.

This is a tasty cereal without the all-too-common additives and preservatives.  It is very light and crunchy and even "talks" like a certain commercial white rice cereal!  Although it is organic and made from brown rice, it sadly lacks fiber.  If it had a reasonable amount of fiber, I would have rated it at five stars.

column9: Gluten Free Cereal that tastes good with fruit
column10: This cereal is like rice crispies and it taste good but better with fruit.  There is also a Erewhon Crispy Brown Rice Ceral with mixed berries that is much better for me although I have not been able to get it lately. I have used this cereal for several years in many recipes.  Crush the cereal and mix with spices for a delicious breading for chicken or pork chops.  Of course it works great in rice crispy treats and cookies.

column9: Does not Set Off Gluten Intolerance or Allergies
column10: I have been eating Erewhon Crispy Brown Rice day after day for months without any signs of gluten intolerance and without any slow development of allergies or a reaction.  The texture is ok but unexciting, the taste bland.

column9: Great Price & Taste, especially for GF & Rotation diets
column10: This is a great gluten-free version of "Rice Krispies". It's very low in sugar, so it's also good for diabetics & hypoglycemics. Since the ingredient list is short, it's good for food rotation diets for those with severe food allergies. It also does the snap, crackle, pop just like the original. If it needs flavor but not added sugar/calories, then add flavored liquid Stevia (comes in chocolate, strawberry, orange creme, etc.) to some plain rice or soy milk before mixing the milk with the cereal. My kids love this cereal. Originally, they added all kinds of flavored Stevia to it, but now they just eat it plain. You CAN get your children to eat less sugar - just reduce it slowly. Resist the premade foods with lots of added sugar or artificial sweeteners instead of sugar. Search for no sugar or sweetener-added products like plain yogurt & applesauce, and add sugar to your liking, then reduce over time (months). Make your own & reduce the sugar and add fruit or seasonings when you can; at least that will add nutrition. Over time, continue to reduce the amount of sugar you add and substitute with some Stevia. Voila! My kids eat much less sugar. In fact, my daughter once complained that my granola was TOO sweet!. (I had added more sugar than normal because it was for her scout troop. I was afraid no one would eat it since it wasn't very sweet to begin with.) Interestingly, the scouts & their adult leaders found it delicious & not overly sweet, which shows that probably everyone is overloaded with sugar. Ok, now back to our review...Amazon has the best price I've seen anywhere. My local stores are charging four dollars a box! If this GF version of rice 'krispies' isn't to your liking, try the Barbara's version. It is a little sweeter and still GF, but not so good for rotation diets because it uses 2-3 fruit juices for sweetening. If these cereals taste like cardboard, that's your sugar addiction/Standard American Diet stomach talking. Don't give in unless you want to die young. You can change your diet; it just takes some work & some time...
great cereal for people on gluten free diet and not on the diet. Its a healthier alternative especially when baking with Rice Krispies.

column9: Low in sugar and tastes great too:)

my kids love this! The sugar is very low so good for a diabetic diet, too. we add dried fruit to it, too.

This is a great cereal.  It tastes and looks like cornflakes, stays crisp when milk is poured on it and makes a great breakfast!  After having to eat the tasteless dry straw that passed for gluten-free cereal just a few years ago, this is really a great step forward for all celiacs who love their cereal.

column9: Tasty with a crackle and a pop!
column10: Tasty, this Gluten-free product is appealing to the eye too. The cereal is puffy, testifying to the fact that this food has not been over-proccessed. Kids might like it's crackle and pop sound. My guess is they'll like it without sugar, too. I do, in spite of my sweet tooth. Don't be concerned about ordering this item in bulk. Go for it!

This is a tasty cereal. It has a good crunchy texture. It is one of a few safe foods my daughter can eat. It has no extra preservatives, colors, gluten etc.. It has been a lifesaver for us to find a food that dose not have a lot of extra preservatives, dyes, etc that could make her ill. It has been a lifesaver as it is one of her main foods in food trialing. She can only eat rice at this point. We buy it by the case. Thank you Erewhon!! for making it and Amazon for supplying.

Organic and gluten free shouldn't have to taste like wall insulation!  I bought 12 boxes based on reviews HERE, and am regretting my purchase.  If you don't mind tasteless crispies with a cardboard texture, fine.  I prefer to rise above.  Now I'm stuck with 11 1/2 boxes!

The name of this product is not "Celiac's Cereal". It is Crispy Brown Rice Cereal.  The manufacturers have created a delicious cereal for all to eat, no where do they claim that this product is for Celiacs.The ingredients are heads above the rest in its category. #1 it's Organic #2 it's made from brown rice not white rice and #3 there is no high fructose corn syrup as sweetener. Can't say that about Rice Krispies.  Speaking of which, I called Kelloggs to ask where the rice comes from that they use in their cereal. I was told, "we don't know". Oh really?  Makes you wonder what conditions are that the rice is grown in. Clearly they don't care.  That concerned me which is why I started to look for an organic alternative.  I started off buying one box at Whole Foods to see how I liked it.  Very impressed with it's taste, texture, and ingredients I came to Amazon to order it in bulk to save money. I've just placed my second order, this time on the auto delivery plan with even more savings.UPDATE...We've just been told the product is now safe for Celiacs but it comes at a significant increase in price. I might as well go back to buying it from WF if I'm not going to get a sufficient discount purchasing in bulk from Amazon.  Time to reaccess whether I should continue with this plan.

column9: Really nice, healthier version of Rice Krispies, great for those avoiding gluten (though celiac disease folk may need to beware)
column10: I bought a box of this at Whole Foods and really liked it. I had it with organic milk, with almond milk, with added cocoa powder, all sorts of ways, and it was just a nice, sounder version of the Rice Krispies I had as a kid. I will note it is GRITTIER than R.K., but that's cause it's simpler (not a long list of ingredients) and uses brown rice. It doesn't stay crispy as long as traditional R.K., so only pour your milk/almond milk/soymilk/etc when you're ready to chow down.For folks avoiding gluten (but not low carb, obviously), this is a nice cereal for when one wants something other than eggs. I find it's really nice with a sprinkle of real cocoa powder (sans sugar).If you have celiac disease, heed the warnings you see here from others. I'm gluten sensitive (not celiac) and I didn't detect any issues after eating this.I will not that the only reason I didn't buy it here, from Amazon, is that 6 boxes is just too much. I have nowhere to store that much cereal, and I don't like cereal getting stale, laying around. I'm the only one in the house who eats this (hubby hates unsweetened cereal), so six boxes is excessive for me. If it were a two pack, yeah, I would have.

I love this product.  The problem with it, I can't stop eating it.  I don't find it soggy but then I consume it so fast, using Non Sweetened Almond Milk and putting Stevia on it, that it doesn't get the chance to.  I'm limiting myself to a box on the weekend, starting on Friday and I've usually finished it by Saturday. It really seems like the original rice crispies to me.  I've put bananas on it also. I ordered it on the subscribe and save and it came quickly. I would recommend this to anyone. It's tasty and crisp, gives me the crunch I need.
these rice krispies make for great ricekrispy treats made with almond butter, a little cinnamon, and agave syrup. Put them in the freezer to add to the crunch...
A very tasty, rice cereal.  I reccommend this cereal.  I'm allergic to corn, so it was nice to find a crisp rice cereal that I can eat.
I really like this cereal. It has more body than commercial cereals (Rice Krispies) and sticks to your ribs for a much longer time. We love several of the items this company makes.

My husband and I regularly eat crispy brown rice cereal.  Usually the stuff we buy has some kind of preservatives in it.  So when we found this we were excited and bought it on subscribe and save.  Unfortunately, it does not seem as crispy as the others.  Not sure if we are used to the preservative taste, but it was a bit disappointing.  I admit, I can't blame the cereal if that's the way its supposed to taste without preservatives.... but it also could be because Amazon sent us some old boxes.

column9: Erewhon Crispy Brown Rice Cereal (gluten free & organic) purchased at Amazon.com

It tastes better than other popular (gluten) cereals that I have had before my allergies were diagnosed.  It does not taste like someone puffed a lot of air in it or like a card board box. A regular serving of Erewhon's Gluten Free Brown Rice Cereal with some sliced fruit or chopped nuts can actually fill you up.Erewhon's Gluten Free Brown Rice Cereal is fresh and flavorful and does not get soggy when rice or almond milk are added (I would imagine it would be the same no matter what type of milk you used). The best part is you don't have to add sugar or anything else to it for it to taste good.Some of the favorite ways I enjoy eating Erewhon's Gluten Free Brown Rice Cereal are:  plain with rice or almond milk, adding sliced fresh fruit, chopped pecans or almonds or just straight out of the box as a snack. With young toddlers and children this is a great healthy snack to serve them that can also assist them with practicing their pincer grip. :-)If you are seeking a healthier and tasty cereal, then Erewhon's Gluten Free Brown Rice Cereal is for you. With only three ingredients: organic brown rice, organic brown rice syrup and sea salt; you can't go wrong. An added plus is the cost.  With today's rising food prices, Erewhon's Gluten Free Brown Rice Cereal is very competitive and in many cases less expensive than the popular cereal brands.  I highly recommend Erewhon's Gluten Free Brown Rice Cereal for you and your family.

It's all Organic and made from Whole Grains it doesn't Taste Stale and Funky like other Cereals loaded with sugar, ...EREWHON Cereals are all Good! Thank You

I love this cereal.  I can only eat grain cereals made from brown rice and this one fits the bill.  I have it most mornings with some fruit on top. It's tasty and nutritious.  I am very happy that I can get it thru Amazon, in bulk and at a better price than in the grocery store.

I am on a yeast cleanse and can't do wheat or gluten.  I love this cereal as a quick meal when I don't have time to cook.  I love it so much that I have reached the maximum allowed purchases on Amazon and now have to go to local grocery store and pay more per box  :((((

column4: R. Wilson "Book junkie from the age of 4"
column10: I loved the white crispy rice as a kid and love this brown crispy rice as well. 2 thumbs up!
Love this cereal! Great with sliced bananas in the morning or as a midnight snack! Definitely recommend for those with gluten allergies!

This is one of the only Gluten Free cereals that my children and I can eat and not feel like we are "missing out" on flavor.  I love this cereal because it is not only Gluten Free, for my son, but it isn't sweetened with sugar (sugar beets or cane sugar, both of which cause my daughter and me to have headaches.)  So for people with food allergies this is a great cereal!  My only complaint is that this cereal doesn't last long at our house! :)

This product is a good buy on Amazon, especially when subscribing to receive a pack of 6 for one month. I figure I save about $6.00, plus gas to drive to the health store.This cereal is really good in plain rice milk. I have a bowl of it every morning!

This is my kids' (3 and 6 yrs old) favorite breakfast. We are doing the gluten-free, casein-free (GFCF) and soy-free diet. They like it with Pacific Rice Milk [note: Rice Dream is NOT gluten-free!] or Living Harvest Hempmilk. You can also use the cereal to make bars or little balls of yumminess. I buy this in bulk here on Amazon...the kids love it![...]
I eat this almost every day or every other day along with the EnviroKids brand flakes. It's a great cereal a little dry unless you add some banana or a little sugar but otherwise great.

column4: Silvia Bridger "Publisher of The Truth About ...
column10: Enjoy it as cereal, or make rice crispies treats out of it.  Anyone who has to avoid glutens will enjoy this product.
My kids love it as cereal in the morning and I like to use it in homemade Rice Crispy treats.  Tastes not much different than rice crispies.  I eat it with a little sweetener.
This is a great crispy rice cereal.  We also use it in snack mix!
Good product, good taste.  I was able to make Rice Krispy treats for my allergic child.

column9: Easy, tasty, and just the like crispiness
column10: These taste just like Kellogg's® Rice Krispies® cereal. The obvious difference is that these are marketed gluten free! There are no gluten containing ingredients; let's hope there's also no cross contamination with US Mills' other products.These 10 ounce boxes don't last long, at least for me. Their small size does make this a convenient choice for traveling -- just add milk from the continental breakfast buffet at your hotel and you have a gluten free comfort food wherever you happen to be. :)

We started eating this cereal when one of my children had multiple allergies, including wheat and corn. It was one of the few processed foods he could eat. Tastes fine, works well by keeping me free from the little additives such as malt syrup etc.  Not salty as some products are.
This is a sweet cereal, almost too sweet. Could use some protein like almonds and flax seed.

column9: Erewhon Crispy Brown Rice Cereal...Better than Rice Krispies
column10: All you gluten intolerant folks out there...this is a must to enjoy with your breakfast. For a complete balanced breakfast, include 2 eggs and a fruit and you will have energy until lunch time. I love the fact I can order it on Amazon and it comes directly to my door. Try it!
Great cereal. Didn't think I would much like it, but with vanilla rice milk it is really good.

She was eating Kellogs cornflakes for about 20 years, once or twice a day, but quit because Kellogs could not confirm gluten free corn flakes (because they use the same equipment in processing whole grain products).After a few months of these her hair started falling out, probably because of a lack of folic acid and possibly some other essential vitamins or minerals. Cooks should be aware that these are ripe olives pickled in a vinegar-based brine, not the plain California-style black olives. The vinegar style is often hard to find in a sliced form, so these are great for highly flavored Mediterranean dishes (these make a good pasta sauce with the addition of only some snipped chives and a little cream, for example). For dishes where bland black olives canned without vinegar are needed, however, these are too biting in flavor to be useful. For example, they are unsuitable for many Mexican dishes. The olives aren't entirely sliced, either. The rings haven't been sorted after processing, making only about half the can's contents presentable as garnish; the other half of the can is filled with small chopped pieces, so these would be better described as salad olives than as rings. Sorting out the whole rings takes longer than it would require to slice whole olives into rings oneself.

column9: Warms you up on cold winter night!

It does have a nice light syrupy consistency that I like, but it's not so sweet that it's overwhelming. A few years back I tried Cointreau and I found it so disappointing as it was a bit too syrupy, almost medicinal.I enjoy the mild orange essence of Patrón Citronge. It's sweet but lacks the strong citrus bite of some triple secs. I definitely feel a slight burn on my initial sip. When it hits my palette the orange flavor comes through, before it finishes with a final burst of heat.Compared to Grand Marnier, it's much more subtle. That liqueur, since it's cognac based, literally clears up my entire sinus cavity. Not so with Patrón Citronge. It definitely is warming and a wonderful liqueur to sip on a cold day, but it's a bit more generic experience.

Is this cheap, "Heck, no."Is this good, "Yes!"Pu-erhs (ooo-air)are made into little (or big) cakes of tea, and then allowed to ferment (rot).  Bad Pu-erh tastes like tea left to rot.  This definitely does not.  It has a warm oak flavor.Pu-erhs are "double-fermented".  Tea makers let the tea oxidize like black tea, and then form the leaves into cakes.  Pu-erhs take awhile to ferment; they actually have vintages like wine and can be as old as 40 or 50 years.  Because of the longer processing time, pu-erhs are generally more expensive, so this isn't a bad price for pu-erh, although it is a little pricey for tea.This is good pu-erh for other reasons:  unless you have a tea diffuser, you can't make pu-erh teas--they're not generally sold in bags.  If you're not really into buying a lot of tea accoutrement, e.g., an American, these bags are a real find.Each one will more than handily make 3 or 4 cups of tea when steeped in a several cup teapot--or you can steep repeatedly for a different taste with each cup.

This product is NOT drinking chocolate.I realize that a lot of folks out there probably don't care about the distinction, however, COCOA POWDER is not DRINKING CHOCOLATE.  Drinking chocolate refers to a product that is some form of sweet, dark, or milk chocolate, shaved or ground, then added to hot milk and whisked or whipped over heat until the chocolate melts into the milk (or water as the Europeans do).  It is akin to a ganache where chocolate and cream are combined over a double boiler; it literally is drinking liquid chocolate.Cocoa powder is a different product.  Cocoa powder is produced solely from chocolate solids with no cocoa butter added, and although it is a chocolate tasting drink, it is not Drinking Chocolate.The Cadbury product is a fine cocoa powder, however it is MISLABLED and not what people looking for drinking chocolate are interested in.I will keep the product for when I want a glass of chocolate milk.

I was very happy with my order, it was just what I wanted and they were individually wrapped for freshness.  My dog is sooooo happy and I received them within a few days!!!

column9: Piggy Snouts - Not as Tasty as Some
column10: My dog likes these pig snouts.  They are huge.  And one of them will last him several days.  They say they are smoked, but apparently it is a "light" smoke.  I've found other smoked pig snouts that are a deep color and they have a "strong" smokey smell.  Bandit really loves these extra smokey ones so they only last about 20 minutes.  The extra smokey ones are smaller but much lower in price.  So Bandit says, "I want some of both."

column9: Very gross so of course my dog loves them.
column10: Like the picture shows there's only 6 in the bag.  Made in the USA so no worries about Chinese dog treats.  They last my dog Butters about 15 minutes.  If I had a saw I would cut them in half as they are a super treat.  Butters has gone crazy for them.  Will buy again.

Here is my review; I have tried many Jerkys and am always looking for new ones that could be my new favorite flavor. The Red Hot Lime and Chile isn't one of them. However, their Jim Beam Glazed Beef Strips are to die for. Go figure.
It's a really thick cut jerky with an odd flavor. A hint of chilli but more of a vinegary flavor rather then lime. I finished the bag but certainly wouldn't buy another.
Love the energy lift I get from this tea, without getting the horrible jitters as I used to from coffee,among the other horrible side effects I use to get. Love the strong flavor...I use two bags.

column9: Very Strong do not over steep.
column10: I have a habit of steeping my tea with the sun. This is not a good tea for that, too strong in flavor. I suggest a light steep (1-3 min) and perhaps mix with a mint tea to balance it out,
I like the tea, although it's not my favorite.  The flavor is a bit strong for me though, so take that into account.
this is not going to make anything strong unless it was strong anyway.but it is a nice tea, and you increase energy a little bit.

Possibly the smoothest full flavored coffee I've ever tasted.  It has a wonderful mouth filling quality with not even a hint of harshness.  It is NOT a weak or wimpy coffee, it's rich and very flavorful.  I just love this coffee in my thermos too because it's just wonderful black and holds well.

If you're looking at Monsooned Malabar, you probably like other Indonesian coffees. I consider this to be similar and superior to Sumatra Mandheling: rich heavy body and low acidity; the difference is in the smoothness of the Monsooned Malabar that makes it the better buy.
This is the second time I have ordered the Monsooned Malabar coffee from Coffe Bean Direct and it is very nice full flavored coffee! Deliveries are timely and everything I expect and more!

column9: Superb coffee at a great price!
column10: I have been using Starbucks Espresso coffee beans for the last few years and could never drink anything else (got addicted to it!). I took a chance on this coffee and boy, am I glad I did!We use a cheapo (but great) Capresso Capresso 303.01 4-Cup Espresso and Cappuccino Machine machine for coffee and one caveat with this coffee is that you need to use the right amount of water depending on your taste. It produces strong coffee at the beginning and gets a little watery towards the end of the cycle (this is normal for most coffees but more pronounced with this coffee).Resulting espresso is quite strong, smooth taste (not too bitter), medium acidity and great flavor! For me this coffee tastes better than the one I used before and so I am hooked on this coffee now!While India produces good coffee, you don't get to see Indian coffee in the US (partly because it is not exported much? and the shipping costs are more? don't know). This is the first time I got to see Indian coffee and I like it!While I am giving 5 stars for the coffee, should only give 3 stars for the shipping - Amazon is using Ontrac for shipping this and for whatever reason, they couldn't deliver on time and the package got delayed by 3 days.

We've been drinking Monsooned Malabar coffee from Coffee Bean Direct for about four years, first ordering 5 pounds monthly from the roaster and about a year ago switching the order to Amazon's subscription service. We've been disappointed with the decreasing quality of flavor and freshness of the coffee, not knowing whether it might be due to a greater delay from roasting to delivery or the manner in which Amazon stores it.To check our perceptions, we again ordered directly from the roaster, Coffee Bean Direct, and found its coffee to have the flavor of Monsooned Malabar we originally enjoyed. But it comes at a cost. With the higher price of the coffee itself plus shipping charges, we paid significantly more ($46.25 compared to $33.81 for the Amazon subscription).We're disappointed with the product we've gotten through Amazon lately, puzzled by the decline in quality, and debating how to proceed.
The coffee has a mild smooth flavor with decent body.  If you are used to drinking something darker like a french roast or expresso roast, then this really is not the coffee for you.

This is the first coffee that I have purchased from Coffee Bean Direct and I have to say that I am very pleased.  I fresh grind my coffee and drink it straight black.  This coffee is smooth with a very pleasant flavor and without the slightest hint of bitterness. Far better than Starbucks house blend!
Indian Monsooned Malabar is a smooth, rich, deeply mellow, but nicely strong coffee - it gives a nice caffeine buzz without the hype...really tasty.

Pleasant flavor....smooth and strong.This has become a staple in our household. I have it on subscribe and save - great deal. This is a wonderful everyday coffee. We freshly grind the beans as needed. I would recommend it.
This coffee is above average.  It has a mild to medium taste.  Smooth and not bitter.  It has a distinct earthy aroma.
Beans are quite dark; a good coffee taste, not a huge bold flavor but somewhere in the middle of flavors. Also not as acidic as some.

I had really high hopes for this coffee, it smelled really good in the bag and the description was very enticing, but it was so bitter and weak I can't even make it through a cup.  I am going to try different grinds, but so far, I am really disappointed.  Maybe it will work for you folks who like a light bitter coffee, but I am more of a smooth dark brew person.

column9: High coffee prices make this coffee the tops
column10: Coffee has gone sky high. While this coffee is not fresh roasted when you order and then shipped-it comes pretty close because the flavor is so good.My favorite coffee is now well over $57 a 5 lb bag, so I decided to try this and it was great-I like a low acid but very robust, dark cup ofcoffee and this fits the bill. What can I say-the price is right too
I love the smell of fresh ground whole bean coffee. Malabar has a strong smell, which I like. I've enjoyed it daily since ordering.
I bought this coffee for my husband and he just loves it.  It comes in a air sealed bag so its very fresh.  Its not to strong eitherGreat coffee will definitely buy more when we finish this one

column9: Very smooth and great for blending
column10: We discovered Indian Monsooned Malabar coffee while on a trip this past fall in Colorado.  A local roaster in the small town we visited produced the coffee and it was for sale at several local businesses.  We really liked it and have ordered this coffee online since returning home.  The other premium coffee bean sources are a bit expensive and, when the shipping is included, it makes for a pretty costly morning brew.  The Coffee Bean Direct beans from Amazon seemed to be a viable alternative and the shipping is free.I admit the beans were a bit of a disappointment at first.  The beans we had used previously were darker roasted and very oily.  The CBD beans are a lighter roast with only a bit of surface oil.  Upon grinding, the beans did not have the pungent aroma we were used to.  Brewing a pot showed the first impressions were pretty correct.  While the IMM flavor is there, it is very subtle, not as full-bodied as we remembered.  In fact, using our standard amount of ground coffee to water results the taste being somewaht thin.  I would call it Indian Monsooned Malabar Lite.  But, in full disclosure, both my wife and I like our coffee stronger than most of our friends.Since we mostly mix decaf and regular coffee (so we can drink more and shake less!), I tried the Monsooned Malabar mixed with CBD's own Dark Decaf Sumatra beans.  This is a most satisfactory blend since both coffees are very smooth and low in acid with the darker Sumatra roast adding a little more body and the IMM adding a subtle nuttiness.  I think someone who is more experienced in blending coffee beans than I am could come up with a truly great brew.On the whole, I like this coffee but it's not as flavorful as I've had from other Indian Monsooned Malabar.  Easily 4 stars, especially considering the bargain price.

column9: I normally like coffee bean direct just not monsoon malabar
column10: This has to be one of the worst whole coffee beans I've ordered.  I don't think it was due to coffee bean direct or that the beans were old.  I actually believe them to be pretty freshly roasted.  The coffee bean itself I think was subpar to begin with.  It was like someone took all of the beautiful aromatic notes out of the coffee and left me with an old balsam like note (Kind of like the smell of a cheap cigar).  The taste was bearable once I put some chicory in, but without it I didn't want to drink it.If you want to buy 5lbs of coffee please stick with one you can trust.  A sumatra, columbian, or even costa rica blend would be better than this.

I bought this for my kids that have oral motor issues. Well, the good part is that the kids love the taste, and the sour encourages them to close and pucker their mouths. The candy was also a big hit with my chewer, and he would prefer a spray of this to gnawing his shirt. However, the dispensers are very cheaply made. About a third of these broke on the first spray, or would never spray at all. I will be trying out a different brand of spray to see if I have better luck.
No matter what mustard you are currently using and enjoying once to try Nathan's you will never go back to your previous brand.  It may be a "man thing" but is is really special.
You can't find a better tasting mustard, Not only is great with Nathan's Hot Dogs but taste great with anything that you want to put mustard on.

column9: nathan's mustard is for passionate mustard cognoscentis everywhere
column10: this is by far the tastiest mustard i have ever had the pleasure of putting on... well, not just hot dogs... it's good in any dish requiring a mustard. nathan's is fantastic; it is vinegary and has just the right touch of spiciness. plus there are tiny grains of mustard seeds everywhere and it's honestly such a pleasure to put on a dog!!! you will never return to another brand once you try nathan's... they are famous for a reason!! along with their dogs, of course, this mustard ought to be legendary!!!
Excellent condiment for sandwiches and hot dogs. Tastes like no other. Extremely reasonable pricewise especially in the 12 pack. I use it daily.

I purchase this from Amazon every so often because you have to order such a large quantity.  However, that being said, this is the best mustard I have ever had.  I love the squeeze bottles too.  They are perfect for whatever I am using for.  Easy to measure from and put on food.  If not for having to get such a large quantity at once, this would have 5 stars.

As others have stated, this isn't a good price, but the sauce itself is amazing!  Best way I can describe it is simply a sweet version of soy sauce.My mom always bought this at Sam's when we were growing up, then for a while we couldn't find it available anywhere.  I bought every type of sauce I saw that looked like it could possibly be similar, but I never found any other sauce of this type...I especially love the sauce with rice.  Just a plain bowl of white rice tastes wonderful with some Yohida's Sauce on it :)

column9: Don't buy it here!!! $6.38 @ SAMS CLUB!!!
column10: yes this is a great sauce/marinade...but $26!! give me a break...its $6.38 at Sams, and I have purchased at costco too.

My bro-in-law grills chicken with this brand as the basting/marinade. First time I tasted it, I gave it two-thumbs up!  Wish I could find the Terriyaki flavored one though.  As that's fantastic!  But this is just as good!
This sauce is amazing! From dipping to marinating and everything in between. All the other sauces I have tried were too salty tasting...this is perfect!

Excellent marinade.  Shipping changes are over the top.  I wouldn't order it again on line unless I could find free or at least less expensive shipping.  Sometimes the shipping becomes more expensive then the actual product.  You can ask in your local supermarket for it to be ordered for the store.
This is the best sauce/marinade for pepper steak, grilling pork chops, etc.  I cannot be without it!  Was able to buy it with free shipping, which was quite a savings.

Mr. Yoshida's Original Gourmet cooking sauce is an excellent marinade while grilling pork chops and especially chicken, whole or in parts. Other sauces on the market primarily used in grilling or baking are, for my taste, too smokey, too heavy.
Taste is OK. But too sweet and too much sugar may keep me away from this sauce. Also won't recommend using it without cooking, since the oder seems raw.

This sauce/marinade is superior to others out there; it just has the perfect taste!  I tried an Iron Chef sauce that is supposed to be comparable, but it was too citrusy.  I really like to marinade salmon in this sauce for 20 minutes and that grill it on the BBQ.  It is so delicious!  I'm so glad that Amazon sells it because the Costco where I live no longer carries it.
If I am having a big group for dinner, I simply buy flank steak, marinade them for three days in Yoshida's and throw them on the grill. I always get rave reviews
The store I used to buy this from stopped carrying it for some reason.  SO glad I found it here and will never have to be without this yummy marinade/sauce again!

I use to purchase this product at Sams Club when they stocked it but found out the hard way that when I ran out they no longer carried it.  I looked everywhere for it to no avail.  I finally checked Amazon and to my surprise found it.  I marinade everything in this flavorful sauce and even introduced it to friends who really have enjoyed it.  The bottle lasts a long time and the flavor is great.  I LOVE IT!
came across Yoshida sauce in Sam's Club 2yrs ago.This is one amazing sauce.We marinate our chicken & beef and have great compliments from it.

I have been cooking with this sauce for many years! It is one of my favorite marinades. It has been hard to find it in stores and was delighted to find it on Amazon.com!! It is a must try marinade for chicken.

MMM...this is a terrific marinade that adds a great but not-too-strong flavor to any meat.  Consistency is important and this one may be brushed on with as thin or thick a layer as we choose...highly recommend.
I would recommend this to anyone...really a great tasting marinade..especially on Chicken kabobs...it has a sweet taste to it..and our family just loves it.
This is the best saute-ing sauce I've found. It's wonderful on salmon to be baked or grilled, and on many meats and other foods.Love it!

Love Yoshida! It is great for everything from grilling to baking to saute! We first learned about it in Alabama when my mother marinaded chicken in the product. We purchased it from Sam's Club and used it on everything! Even our kids liked it at a young age. When we moved to VA, we couldn't find it anywhere, then we started looking online. Thanks to Amazon, we have Yoshida back in our cooking regimen.
Mr. Yoshida's Original Gourmet Sweet and Savory Marinade  is verry good for cooking out steaks ribs if you have not try it you don't know what your missing.
Have used this marinade now for awhile.I love the flavor on pork and on baked  chicken dishes.It is more flavorable than just soy sauce.

I was introduced to Yoshida's Sauce on a camping trip when a friend used it to make meatballs.  She herself had gotten it from a warehouse store where they had been giving out food samples.  I can see why she was hooked.In its most basic form, this is soy sauce sweetened with syrup and it's delicious -- just the perfect combination of salty and sweet.  I love the versatility.  It tastes great on beef, fish, pork, chicken, and shrimp.  I've used it on the grill, in the oven, in a slow cooker, in a pot.  When all is said and done, you'd think I'd slaved all day.  Great stuff.  I keep a bottle in my fridge handy as a staple for whenever the mood strikes.

My husband and I been using his Teriyaki marinade for years now and when I seen this on sale at Amazon I had to purchase to compare.  Just like expected, it's delicious for half the cost.  We use it for BBQ, stir fry and much much more. I'm drooling just writing about it! Highly recommend...Enjoy!
What can I say about Mr. Yoshida's? Never enough! This is the best marinade for steaks, chicken, ribs and wonderful as a stir fry sauce. Don't know what I'd do without it!

We have loved Mr. Yoshida's sauce for many years. HardTo find & glad it is still available. There was a problem with the shipmentwhere the container leaked. I emailed the seller & responseWas quick! Totally satisfied with the outcome!!Will buy again & again. A±++++++++++++++++

Mr. Yoshida, sweet and Savory marinade has been a wonderful treat on my grill for many years.  Baste Mr. Yoshida on grilled Salmon during the last few minutes of cooking....MMMMmmmmm  It sure is good.....there is really no other product like Mr. Yoshida

column9: Killer chicken and salmon every time
column10: I used to buy this great sauce at Costco but don't have one close by any more, so I was happy to find it on Amazon. It does a brilliant job on slab salmon fillets, whether you use it as a pre- marinade (a half hour before you cook) or a cooking sauce. You don't need to use too much, either. The taste is very slightly Asian, but not unfriendly to any other food tastes you want to pair it with.
Mr. Yoshida's Original Gourmet is the best sauce i have ever had...I was told by a friend that it was great and so i did order him and me a bottle of the sauce and he was right.

I used to be able to buy this locally, but all of a sudden I haven't been able to find it. Just by chance I tried Amazon and lo and behold I found it. It came very quickly in the mail (three days). We use Yoshidas for everything from a marinade to seasoning for soup or stew. We have been very happy with other items from Amazon and Amazon Mom.
So happy I found this, it is awesome with all types of meats and stir fries. Took a little time to receive, but well worth the wait
OMG this stuff is the bomb!  Very expensive but I don't have a sams or cosco membership...and this stuff is hard to find.  It is REALLY good.
Used this product for years. My whole family loves this marinade.I truly recommend this marinade. Its great for chicken, fish, everything.

column9: I've Looked All Over for This
column10: Somewhere one of our local stores had this for a "taste" test and I bought some.  I found it one other time and then was unable to find the product in any of our local stores.  I decided on a whim to check out Amazon and lo and behold.  Now I have my favorite marinade and teriyaki sauce from a consistently reliable source.  It doesn't get much better.

Easy to order and came very well packed. Great grilling sauce. Also very useful as a marinade on all types of meats and vegetables.
I use this sauce on fish mostly and it's great.  I've also started using it on portabello mushrooms.  It really helps to make it taste meaty.  Enjoy.

Mr.Yoshida's Gourmet Sauce is a family favorite that we've enjoyed for years. Unfortunately, we're unable to obtain it locally anymore but fortunately we've been able to find it on-line and at a reasonable price! column9: This is by far the best Marinade on the market.
column10: I use this for chicken, beef and venison. I love to add it into any Chinese food we are having and the kids pour this out as dipping sauce for all kinds of foods. I only wish that my local grocery store would carry it so that I wouldn't have to wait for it to be delivered. Also, it is not a Prime product so that the savings you realize are put right back into the shipping. But that is an Amazon issue, and does not detract from the value of this product.

We have always used Yoshida's as it is truly the best teriyaki around. When we moved from Seattle to Chicago we were so disappointed that the Costco didn't carry our favorite nor did the grocery stores around us. I felt a little silly ordering it on Amazon but if that's the only way to get it then that's what I will continue to do!

Sams club quit carrying this sauce.  We love it so much that we had to order it online.  Delicious stir fry sauce.  Even better wing sauce.  I followed the recipe on the bottle for Thai wings to add a TBL of peanut butter to a half cup of sauce then took out upon myself to add a TBL of honey and buffalo sauce.  These wings are sooooo good I can't pull them out of the frier fast enough for family and friends.  Two thumbs up!
A great product I haven't found anything to replace it.I use it to make a special sauce to be used on things like rice, stir fry, fish, and other meats. It is the best by far.
We have lived in Hawaii and have eaten really good teriyaki. Yoshida's is the best that we have ever found on the market. It's a beautiful thing and I HIGHLY recommend it.

column9: One option when you can't find it locally
column10: I cannot always find this locally so I'm happy to see it here, even if the price is a bit over the top. The product works not only for Asian style food but as an interesting flavor profile for stew, soup and marinade..
Excellent product I just love this stuff. You can't go wrong with this as a marinade or stir fry

Mr. Yoshida's Original Gourmet Sweet and Savory Marinade and Cooking Sauce -Wow, what a long name, but is is highly descriptive of a truly marvelous product.  You can cook meatballs in this and they are amazing.  Using it as a marinade gives meats a unique asian slant with some sweetness added that will really "kick it up a notch".  It is especially good on pork tenderloins.We make chicken yakitori by marinading skinless, boneless chicken thighs in Yoshida's Sauce overnight, then cooking them on the barbeque grill.Serve them with a little fried rice and some stir-fried veggies, and just before serving, pour a little extra warmed sauce over the veggies and rice.  That is so good you will slap your Mama!

Yoshida's is great on any meat and most cooked vegetables.  I even like it on potatoes.  It is not in all Costco and Sam's, which is a crime.  I can get it in Columbus, OH and Honolulu but not KC?  Strange.  But it is my wife's "secret" ingredient in many dishes that get rave reviews at pot lucks.

Product would have been great if had actually received one of the orders I placed. Not amazons fault or the sauces fault. First order was damaged by UPS, second was the sourced companies fault.Amazon made it up to me by refunding and going further than needed to make sure I was happy.Will continue to by from amazon.. But I still want my sauce!!!!

This sauce is fine for small children to dip chicken nuggets in. It's basically Karo syrup with some soy sauce added. Nothing personal Mr. Yoshida, but this is just another reason that Americans are overweight. We love anything that's just too sweet.

column9: Earl Grey tea Pods for Tassimo

bad item.  not an amazon product, therefor shipping etc in different category. web site not clear. best to stay away.

I loved this vanilla flavoring, as I used it in my daughters goat milk to make it vanilla flavored. She loves it like that. I use to be able to get it at wal-mart for just under $5 a bottle. This syrup tastes great in my coffee.  It is reasonably priced and arrived in a timely manner.
Arrived on time with good packaging. Used syrup in my coffee, taste great!  Would recommend Da Vinci French Vanilla Syrup.!
I really enjoy my daily cup of coffee with this favor syrup. It eliminate the need for me to add sugar.

OMG, the soup this makes is just unbelievably delicious.  I found these packets of seasonings a week ago at Wal-Mart and prepared the soup yesterday.  It was so good, I totally pigged-out.At least, it was nutritious--besides chicken, there's beans, tomatoes, and fresh spinach.  Went back to Wal-Mart this morning for sole purpose of stocking up on this stuff--but couldn't find it again (typical of Wal-Mart!).  I don't mind ordering 12 at a time.  I know I will use them.  The price here is also comparable to Wal-Mart, as I recall.An easy-to-remove recipe card is included.  So you could easily make the soup again by buying everything separately.  But, honestly, it's SO convenient to have the spices pre-measured, plus I can't imagine you would save any money buying all these different spices...I am ordering this as soon as I have the money, which will be another week.  I may try it with shrimp, rather than chicken.  I am also looking forward to trying some of the other McCormick spice packs, also sold by Amazon.
i dont know why this drink is not more popular this is the best tasting green tea around.. my fav

This is a really good tea with a sweet clean green tea flavor and no weird tangy after taste like some other bottled teas. I regularly purchase the gallon size at the store but since I purchased this 12 pk from Amazon in June 2012 the price has more than doubled. I don't really know what's behind that but I always figured that purchasing in bulk should be cheaper than purchasing individually but at this price ($24 at the time of this review)it isn't. I'm giving this 4 stars for the fact that its a good product with one off for the price. I would purchase this again from amazon if the price came back down to something reasonable.

For some weird reason, the "powers that be" have decided that we poor folk here in Ohio are not allowed to have this available for purchase anymore.  Just as it became my absolute favorite, now it's gone!  We ARE allowed, however, to buy the raspberry so that's a great substitute!  Anyway, be SURE to try this if you can get it.  It's absolutely outstanding sweetened with honey!  Highly recommend!

column9: Best pre-packaged green tea I have ever tasted.
column10: I used to drink the Lipton pre-packaged Green Tea, then I tasted Tradewinds.Fresh, natural, rich, clean, taste, TRADEWINDS is the best !!

This tea is awesome. It's light and refreshing with just the right amount of sweetness just the way iced tea should be.  I've tried some of the regular tea with lemon and it's just too sweet & overpowering.  If you love green tea like I do give it a shot. The only downside is nobody sells it locally.

I've tried several brands of gluten-free pizza crusts, I bought the Ener-G as my latest product exploration.  Being a huge fan of many of Ener-G products, I thought this one would be a slam dunk hit.  How wrong I was.  The Ener-G pizza crusts are too thin, dense, and heavy, with very little taste.  You would think "thin" and "heavy" would be contradictory, but that's what I really mean to say.  By contrast, the Kinnikinnick pizza crusts are light and fluffy, with such an outstanding declicious flavor.  I would strongly suggest buying a single package of the Ener-G pizza crusts from your local health food store first.  I made a mistake trusting Ener-G on this product before I bought a whole case of it.  It was an expensive lesson.  But, nonetheless, a huge thanks to Amazon for offering so many gluten-free products.  Here in the US, we are just starting to become familiar with how many people are affected by gluten.

I like these.  They are quick and easy to make.  If you follow the directions they come out about half way between crispy and chewy.  Kinda remind me of the bisquik crusts my Mom used to make.  The only thing I don't like is that there is no edge, so you have to be careful piling on the ingredients...They have a tendency to fall off near the edge of the shell.  Overall these are good shells to keep on hand.
Like them alot but do find them subtler than other bitters, meaning need more dashes than others. (comparing to scrappys etc.)

I wanted to purchase this product based on what i read in a magazine on how its supposed to support liver function while drinking cocktails...i also just it in water. It tasted interesting...not bad persay, but very different so if you're not a person who walks on the wild side with funky tasting stuff this product wont be for you.

I usually dry my own orange peels and use them when baking and making chocolate tea.  This product is convenient, always ready to use and it smells great.  It will last quite a while, and I will reorder from this company.

Monin usually makes some great products. This is not one of them. My first experience with Monin was a bottle of their apricot syrup which I picked up at a gourmet market in NYC. It was bright, sweet and tasted like it was made from natural ingredients. I can't compare it to fresh apricot juice, but it made a nice soda.Their blood orange syrup does not meet the high bar they've set for other products. It tastes 100% artificial -- like it belongs in a Slurpee machine. It's tart, no doubt from the addition of copious amounts of citric acid. It has a very unnatural, neon orange color. column10: First off, the company sent me a HANDWRITTEN thank you note. When do you see that in the age of computer print outs. I thought it was an extra touch as far as customer service. I will be returning to this company again.The flavor is OMG. My best friend is Hawaii so I often use the red Hawaiian salt, this BEATS its. It has a subtle but GREAT flavor. I will buy again!
I love this salt. It tastes fantastic; I even find myself putting it on things I normally wouldn't salt. I've gotten my husband to buy me more of the sea salts, they are all equally delicious!

Just discovered this black salt and now a big fan.  While it does leak the color, the taste is worth it.  I rub it on pats of ice cold butter that I serve with good bread.  Everyone makes a comment about the stunning contrast and once they taste it on the bread with the butter - they become hooked.

column9: Very tasty and quite the find
column10: I like trying different salts, so when i saw this, i had to snag a jar for myself. It actually arrived early, which was nice.The taste is quite bright, and is a great finisher. I just tried it with chicken, and it really made the flavor pop. I plan to try it on a chocolate mousse next.An interesting by product is that since it is made in part from lava rock, it actually leaves a residue on your hands when you handle it.Anyway, pretty neat and quite inexpensive. As long as you arent copiously coating all your food with it, this jar should last a while.Update: I've been using this salt on a variety of things, including eggs, various meats, fresh tomatoes (from my garden), as well as the aforementioned chocolate mousse (which i had been planning when i wrote the review initially) and chicken. This is a wonderful large salt crystal that really adds color and flavor to any dish you would accent with salt. It does disolve quickly so use it just before serving.

I bought this salt for the first time a few months ago. Let me just say its the best salt for a ribeye steak. I don't use it as a finishing salt. I put the salt on the steak about 30 minutes before i'm ready to cook it..all you need is this salt, pepper, and a nice thick ribeye. I'm from Hawaii and was hesitant to get this product but of course, I had to try it as I like food and new interesting things for the kitchen. When I first received it, I thought I was looking at just black Lava Rock. I had a taste with my girl friend and was pleasantly surprised on the flavor of this salt. It is sort of salty, smokey, and just the right hint of bitters with a good crunch to it. I have tried it as a finishing to salmon and steak so far and they turned out fantastic. For the price it is good but I wouldn't use it everyday as it could prove to be expensive if you are on a budget like myself.

This salt tastes great. Yes, it's salty, but there's almost a hint of sweetness to it. The black coloring made me think it would be smoky or strong, but that's absolutely not the case. They crystals are fairly large, like pretzel salt, and you don't need a lot of it to dress up your food. One warning though: the color will come off on your fingers if they're wet (and other things, too), so don't get it on your clothes. I've managed to not wear any, so I don't know if it stains fabrics permanently, but take care. A little bit of this finishing salt goes a long way, so the price isn't as steep as it may seem. And the container is plastic with a plastic lid, so it won't rust from the salt.
Makes a nice presentation and has a nice flavor.  Large crystals are very versatile.
We love the black lava fiinishing salt.From eggs to pizza . Nice sized crystals. Good product.

I will definitely be keeping this in my collection, great salt and great vendor.  This shipped the morning after I ordered it and received it two days after that.  Had a free sample and a bamboo salt spoon in it too.
I love the taste of this salt, as another viewer did state the black coloring of the salt does spread. The salt crystals are a good size with out being over powering.
Good Product, arrived promptly as expected. Jar is plastic not glass, that's why I'm giving it 4 instead of 5 stars.

The best part about this product is it tastes great and isn't over-salty like some expensive salts tend to be.  Highly recommend this to anyone looking for a healthy way to spruce up dishes.

All salts are not created equal, and this product certainly proves it.  Obviously not to be used as a "cooking" salt, but rather as a sparingly applied finishing salt.  Just a few grains add a slightly earthy flavor and a wonderful crunch to meats and vegetables (cooked and raw).  Try it on pan seared fresh green beans or on cold sliced radishes.  Wonderful on fish.  A little goes a long way, since it's a bit saltier than table salt.  A container this size will last quite a long time.  Not only tasty, but a beautiful and eye-catching addition atop your favorite foods.
This has an unique taste to it. Has a hint of charcoal flavoring.  We use it on thin cut beef to eat with rice. Being black it does turn what you are cooking black also. But taste great!
Really nice salt but it did not last long. Hawaiian sea salts higher price is all that keeps me from getting it more often.

This is wonderful salt to rim Margarita glasses.  Vivo in Austin has an incredible cucumber margarita rimmed with Hawaiian sea salt, and it is incredible.

If you like really salty things, which is what most recipes using black salt are all about, then this is great salt. The product is just as it claims to be. Unfortunately it was too salty for me, but if you like that you will love this product. Otherwise I do not recommend it. I am on a whole foods plant based diet. Supposed to me make egg substitutes taste like "real eggs." I found it just made it really salty. But like I said, depending on what you are cooking that may be perfect.
in combination with red-pink and white sea salt-this salt is other addition to my healthy cousine and plus it looks attractive also

Despite what some reviewers think, "Black Lava Salt," while being "black" and being "salt" has nothing to do with lava. It is sea salt from any of many places around the world that is colored black with activated charcoal. Largely a decorative item. You could take Kosher salt and make this stuff yourself, I suppose. As a geologist, this current paroxysm about different salts seem inexplicable. NaCl is NaCl (or the mineral halite). Your taste buds are attuned to it in a very restrictive sense, regardless of the presence or absence of trace amounts of coloring stuff--it all tastes virtually the same--your tongue sees to that. Spend you gourmet $$ some more useful way!By the way, a pinkish-orange coloring in NaCl may be KCl (commercially, "nosalt"), known as the mineral silvite. It has a distinctively bitter bite. (Another tongue taste option.) Maybe some folks like their salt on the bitter side, but most gourmets would probably cringe at the thought of tossing bitter salt on good food.

I weighed it and the salt with the container is 193g (6 oz is equal to 170g) so it's definitely full. column9: One of the best K-Cup bold coffees
column10: Most of the K-Cup strong brews really aren't very strong when you compare them to Starbucks, and some of them are even rather weak. Smells great and makes a strong cup of coffee at the 7.5 oz size and would make a cup of German coffee at the 5 oz size.  My other favorites are Nantucket Blend and Midnight Magic Extra Bold.  The Midnight Magic will make something close to German coffee strength at 7.5 oz and will make a serious cup of German coffee at the 5 oz size.  The Vermont Country Blend is too weak at 7.5 oz in case you wanted to hear it from me.

column9: A dark, bold roast that is a welcome start to the day
column10: Noted as a "West Coast Favorite" this dark roast conjures up a scent of pine needles for me as it brews, a subliminal association perhaps tied more to the blend's name than the actual aromatics, which are pleasantly thick, sweet and strong enough to lift me from a groggy morning.I am still partial to Green Mountain Coffee Nantucket Blend, a recent purchase that knocked my socks off. Still, I would place Lake & Lodge a mere notch (star) beneath the Nantucket Blend. The Green Mountain website offers a fantastic description for Lake & Lodge: "This particular blend is very versatile, yet elegant. It makes a great espresso, partners well with cream, and is delicious iced. The flavors of this rich, darker roast blend reflect hearty West Coast style roasts. Dark roasted Indonesian coffees offer bountiful sweetness and syrupy notes. A touch of East African beans adds an element of berry-hued brightness to the blend's bold flavor foundations."I read that the blend's name has a peculiar history, first called "Tapestry Blend Dark" the blend was originally developed for a New York City shop called "The Coffee Station."Lake & Lodge is a better name, a blend that invokes ski resorts and campsites and sleepy mornings when a dark, bold roast is a welcome start to the day.Rating: Four stars.BTW: Here's my other recent K-cup coffee reviews for Amazon:5 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Nantucket Blend5 stars: Coffee People Donut Shop Medium Roast5 stars: Van Houtte Chocolate Raspberry Truffle4 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Vermont Country Blend4 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Wild Mountain Blueberry4 stars: Tully's Coffee Kona Blend4 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Dark Magic3 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Breakfast Blend3 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Fair Trade Gingerbread

I would like to try ALL the ITO EN TEAS!  Also, I use auto-ship which brings down the price more,and you can always change the frequency at which it's delivered.Ito En Teas' Tea Green White, Pure Roasted Green Tea, 16.9-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)

Great taste bought this as snack and both myself and my daughter just think its great

column9: Totally delicious. Some bites taste like cherry pie!
column10: It's pretty random for me to post an Amazon review, on a nut mix no less, but I'm sitting here at my desk at work eating this and love it.
