I found some swiss water processed low acid decaf beans (I always use bean and grind them before I make coffee.)  I can drinking coffee and not having stomach aches now.  It is just hard to find hazul nut flavored low acid swiss water processed coffee.  I have been searching the web trying to make my own hazulnut flavored coffee.  It said spray the coffee bean with hazulnut oil before toasting them.  I did not try to use it yet.  I will try sometime in the future when I have the mood.  I am just afraid this is not strong flavor to make the coffee.  Wonder if anyone tried.I read someone use this hazulnut oilto make salad dressing and cooking.  Since I love crumbled blue cheese for salad dressing.  Instead of using olive oil, I tried this halzul nut oil.  It taste great!  My acid stomach hates vinegar.  Most salad dressing has vinegar.  The hazulnut oil make the blue cheese more flavorable.  I will try it for cooking too.Oh, one thing.  The package came in perfect condition. The dent in the cans must happened before shipping.  It is possible the whole lot are dented.  I don't mind since I am using it myself.

This oil tasted good on arrival, but I was hoping to give it as gifts and the cans all arrived too badly dented for this use.  I don't know if I should store all of the unopened cans in the refrigerator to insure adequate shelf life.

I purchased this to electrify a section of fence that was separated from the rest of my fence plan. I took the first one, installed it on the post, inside a box. I hooked up the fence and the battery and.....nothing.  I unhooked the controller and used the tester and it only gave an extremely weak reading.  No big deal, every manufacturer is capable of putting out a dud.Being smarter this time around, I plugged the replacement into the wall and checked it with the tester before installation.  Guess what--very weak reading again. What are the chances of two of them being bad?  I figured maybe my tester was bad, so I bit the bullet and touched both prongs. My tester wasn't bad.  Either I got two duds, or they're just not strong enough to get the job done.Needless to say, I'm not trying a third unit.
WORKS, LASTS CAN'T SAY THAT FOR MANY PRODUCTS THESE DAYS. USED IT TO KEEP HOGS OUT OF MY FOOD PLOT AND GARDEN. 12V CAR BATTERY LASTS FOR WEEKS EVEN WITH OUT SOLAR CGE

column9: Excellent Chocolate Bars with AMAZING Buttery-Like Caramel...
column10: The Ghirardelli Caramel bars aren't my favorite, but the quality and consistency of the chocolate itself is good, plus the buttery-sweet, toffee-like caramel is a major plus in my book.  I bought at least 10 of these bars in local Walgreens when they were on sale and loved them so much that I had to buy them here on Amazon.com.  Well, after buying 10 more on Amazon and having eaten about 3 of them I can honestly say I am fresh out of " love " for these chocolate bars cos like the old Bryan Adams song says, " Thought I Died And Went To Heaven ", I INDEED WENT TO HEAVEN WITH THESE BARS ALL THE TIMES I BOUGHT THEM BUT NOW I WANT TO BE A BAD BOY AND GO EVERYWHERE ELSE ( like Meat Loaf says ), so I've been trying out other chocolate bars.  However, if you are a premium chocolate fan you owe it to yourself to try Ghirardelli Milk and Dark chocolate, and some of their other varieties too.  THESE ARE HEAVENLY, BUT BE FOREWARNED:  OVERLOAD IS IN YOUR FUTURE WITH THE QUALITY OF THIS CARAMEL CONCOCTION!

This is the best caramel/chocolate combination I have ever tasted. The caramel is liquid and complements the Ghiradelli chocolate perfectly. Do not try this brew if you are attempting to lose weight - you will end up an addict like me.  The Ghiradelli product is far better than the Caramello/Hershey product in every way. The Caramello chocolate lacks the refined taste of the Ghiradelli squares, and the Caramello caramel is harder and not as sublime in taste. Comparing the two is like comparing Warren Buffett to myself in terms of wealth. Unfortunately I am the Caramello bar in this regard.  At the very least try the Ghiradelli.
The chocolate is not very sweet, and I enjoy its strong flavor. But it's so hard to get a complete square chunk from the whole bar because the filling makes the chocolate soft.

column9: Chocolate H2O The wost thing I ever drank
column10: This is the worst cup of hot chocolate I ever tasted. I wrote a review a few days ago when I said basically the same thing Yet Amazon has sent be numerous email to buy it again. I would not drink it if it was free

column9: Not as good as in the can
column10: The packets aren't as good as the bulk mocha in the can. I was a bit disappointed. You'd think it would be the same stuff, but to me it tasted different; not as flavorable. The can or 32 serving container is so delicious; and I mix a serving-or a bit more actually into a medium size mug, with some cofeemate and some Target sugar free vanilla syrup and viola - soo yummy.

I received this as a Christmas gift. I am a low carber and I'm always looking for treats that can make me feel like I'm not on a diet. Each packet is 4 grams of carbohydrates.Even though it's partially sweetened with Splenda, it doesn't have that bitter Splenda aftertaste that so many sugar-free drinks do. The cappuccino isn't very sweet, though, so if you're like me, you might want to add a splash of a sugar-free syrup. I use sugar-free french vanilla.What's great about this coffee is that, even in cold liquid, everything mixes well.I like to pour about a quarter of a cup of heavy cream, a splash of sugar-free French Vanilla, some ice, and then the packet all into a blender and grind for about 30 seconds. The consistency is almost milkshake-like. If you want to be really decadent, put some whip cream on top and frost your glass ahead of time.
Pretty good but somewhat too bitter.  What happened to the Coconut Mocha they used to make - that was the best but it contained sugar.

The title pretty much says it all.  While the taste may not be as good as the offerings from you local espresso stand it isn't bad and doesn't seem to have the chemical aftertaste of some other sugar free drinks.  The powder dissolves pretty well although it will leave some noticeable residue if it isn't stirred a couple of times while you are drinking.  Throw a envelope or two in your briefcase and you won't have to drink the office coffee that was sitting on the  burner for the last 4 hours.
Got this for my dad for a gift. He said it was a little weak so he added another packet.. but knowing him - he probably put it in "too" large a mug.But I would definitely order it again.

I can't find many brands of decaffeinated coffee pods. Senseo's brand is satisfactory but it is nothing like the decaffeinated coffee I get in restaurants. Folger's brand of decaffeinated coffee pods is a little better than Senseo's.
I like the coffee and the convienance of ordering online- however, I have 2 coffee orders that I would like to have shipped together.

I guess I was expecting too much for a large company like Sara Lee...how could they just have 1 decaf coffee variety for pod machines!!!...this coffee is weak and insipid for an 8 oz measure...maybe the only way to make this good is to use 2 pods and keep my fingers crossed...for strong coffee lovers, this  is NOT the one for you!!!!

There seem to be fewer options for coffee pods that fit the Senseo. This probably is the result of the declining popularity of the Senseo and the increasing popularity of the Keurig. There are much better decaf coffee pods for the Senseo, but they are no longer available through Amazon.

column9: Yuck!  And if you are gluten intolerant, be wary!
column10: Okay, people.  I just don't get it!  How can this stuff be getting five stars from so many people?  Do they know what coffee is SUPPOSED to taste like?  Yuck, yuck, and double YUCK!  This is akin to drinking dirty water!  I've even doubled the pods to try to get a richer cup...to no avail.  What taste it has is horrible...not that there is much taste at all!  I will struggle through this case and never buy it again!  All I wanted was a cup of decaf in the afternoon or evening...a GOOD cup of decaf!  Is that too much to ask?  Apparently so!  I wouldn't recommend this stuff to my worst enemy!  Again, I say YUCK!Also, my tummy's reaction is such that I suspect there is gluten in the packaging of the pods...perhaps in the glue?  I contacted Senseo to ask about it and they wouldn't give me an answer to my question unless I filled out a questionaire that would give them tons of information about ME!  Forget it!  That made me even more suspect!I can't say for sure that there is gluten hiding somewhere.  It is only a suspicion created by an all too familiar IBS reaction.Buy this stuff at your own risk, or, if you enjoy drinking weak coffee that looks and tastes like dirty water.
The Senseo Douwe Egberts decaf coffee pods are a great deal and  we love them.  This is the best price thst we have found and have been buying them for years and will continue to do so.Mike & Mary
I use this in my Keurig machine (using a perfect pod holder) and it makes delicious and suprisingly strong coffee for a "medium" roast.
Makes an excellent cup of coffee.  I drink it hot or I let it cool for iced coffee.  Good full flavor, no bitterness.
The coffee was excellent and the price was the best available online as I can't seem to find it in the town I live. Package was well packed and came quickly.
The best tasting decaf pods on the market by far, but becoming hard to find on grocery shelves.

I have a hard time finding this item in stores so order online now. With my Senseo coffee maker, I get consistently good coffee that rivals upscale coffee outlets. The decaffeinated coffee is robust without the bitterness that sometimes accompanies stronger coffees.

column9: After dinner treat with no clean-up
column10: I like a cup of coffee in the evening - but I like to sleep, too.  The Senseo Decaffeinated coffee pod is the answer.  Easy to prepare and no messy clean-up.

Tried several non-drip coffee makers before settling on the Philips Senseo. All the others we tried produced medium to #@%&y quality coffee cups. I started thinking you need to spend well over $500 for a good espresso machine.Well, Senseo is still not espresso, but it's as close you can get for so little money.We liked the Dark Roast, Medium Roast, Columbian and Decaf. The Cappuccino sucks though... Don't go near it...Takes just over 1 minute to boil the water and brew a nice frothy cup. I love it!
This is the third time I have purchased through this seller.  The service has been great.  I always receive the product quickly and the price can't be beat.

We have a decaf drinker and a regular coffee drinker in the house, so we have preferred the pod brewers for some time.  Basically, we have been pleased with the Senseo coffee pods.  They make a quite good cup of coffee.  Only downside I see is that a full cup requires two pods where, for example, Melitta required only one.  Haven't worked it out but I think that makes a cup of coffee a bit more expensive with the Senseo machine and pods.  That's a small price to pay (no pun) given the fact that the machine for the Melitta pods repeatedly failed and had to be replaced quite often. *** Update - February 2012.  Last order had two bags with pods that were not correctly sealed and spewed coffee grounds throughout the bag.  To make it worse, in each bag there were at least three defective pods.  This increases the cost of a cup of coffee considerably (over 15%).

column9: Convenient To Use Decaf Coffee Pods
column10: I have been using Decaf Senseo Coffee Pods for about three years.  Since I drink one cup of coffee in the morning and no one else in my household drinks coffee, it is more economical to make one cup of coffee at a time.Each cup costs about $0.50 and it's less expensive to buy through Amazon than at the super market.
been using it for years ....cost much less than starbucks and you don't have to use your car or gasoline to get a cup

Even though Senseo states on each package these pods can be used on all pod coffee makers, this is false. These pods are made for 70 mm diameter pod coffee makers.  My coffee maker takes 50 mm diameter pods so the Senseo pods cannot be used on my machine.  The best pods that I can use are the ones made by Starbucks.Amazon will not allow these to be returned because I had to open one of the packages to find out the diameter was too large to be used in my pod coffeemaker. Nowhere in the description of the Sensio pods did it mention their diameter.On all of the coffee pod products, Amazon should require the diameter of the pods to be specified.

Senseo Douwe Egberts Medium Roast Coffee Pods, Decaffeinated, 18-Count 4.41 Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)These pods are one of the delicious coffee varieties Douwe Egberts brings on the market. You have no waste or long sudering left coffee in a pot, but a fresh, direct cup of delicious flavored coffee each time you put a pod in. I can highly recommend this make and way of making coffee

I I haven't had a bad cup of coffee yet.  So far, my favorites are the Decaf, Columbian, and Breakfast blend.  I only drink one cup of coffee a day, so this type of coffee maker is perfect for me.  Especially since I only like coffee when it's hot and fresh.  My guests love it too!

column9: not bad but not that good
column10: I wish it had more oomph to it.  I wish I just ordered the 4 pack instead of 6. Maybe there's better tasting decaf pods out there.  This one doesn't have a rich aroma.  But it's not bad tasting.  Just a regular cup of joe that taste as good a regular coffee and makes me forget that I'm drinking decaf.  I guess it's okay. But I like to swoon over my coffee and this one doesn't do that for me.
I used the auto ship for this item and it was so easy. My coffee arrived every month right on time.
Where r they? Bought the machine and can't find the pods anywhere and when I do find a store that supposedly carries them they r unavailable. Annoying!
Thanks for carrying Senseo decaf pods.  They are impossible to find in the stores.  This way I don't have to think about it for awhile.
Coffee is very good.  Price is a little high but that is the case on most single serving coffee products.

I could not find the Senseo coffee pods in any local grocery store, so I went on line to Amazon. Found the pods at a very reasonal price with no shipping charge. I will order again when I need the pods. I would recommend this to anyone that is looking for these pods. I don't know why they are so hard to find in the grocery stores.

column9: This is a delicious decaff coffee!!!
column10: I buy this on the subscribe & save program, which seems to be discontinued at this time. I have had about 4 shipments of 6 bags each. My sister and I enjoy this coffee everyday! I alternate a shipment to her and then to me. Perfect for moments when you are the only one drinking it, and don't want to waste coffee or time to fill up a regular coffeemaker. I use it at work, because I'm the only one who drinks decaff.
Senseo is very easy to use and the coffee is outstanding.It is my favorite blend of coffee; I use decaffeinated,but the other blends are wonderful too.

I have now had this coffee for 5 years and I did not need to talk my friends into buying a Senseo coffee maker they all went to buy one.The problem now is were to go and buy one if you do not have a computer.

Outstanding coffee in one cup biodegradable pods,  this product is excellent. Much easier to use than any other coffee machine. I have been using this system for years since it first came out and have no reason to change

After years of using Senseo Decaffeinated Coffee Pods I suddenly found it difficult to purchase them from several supermarkets where I shop. I decided to check this product out on Amazon and found a wonderful offer of automated shipments on a monthly basis or as per need.  I ordered six bags and paid no shipping fees!  What more can I ask for!  I was very pleased with this transaction!  :-)

I enjoy using the Senseo pods.  One pod contains the perfect amount of coffee, and is so easy to use.  Since the Dr. recommended decaf instead of regular coffee, I have been very pleased with the "real coffee taste" of the Senseo pod.

I really like my Senseo coffee pots and up until recently, I have been very pleased with Senseo coffee pods, too. I buy quite a few cases every year and have been for over 5 years.But, recently I have been receiving lots more packages with more than 1 pod improperly sealed so that there are lots of grounds in the bag that make all the other pods messier to use - and you are unable to use the mostly empty ones. When I finally reached someone at Senseo, (on my 3rd attempt), they were very apologetic, but I've yet to hear if there is any explanation or will be any efforts on Senseo's part to improve this.This is very discouraging, since it is a good product - but now I dread opening a new bag. I have purchased some Eco-pods to fill myself in case the situation with Senseo's coffee pods does not get corrected. These you just fill with bulk coffee that I'll buy in the grocery store.

This is a delicious coffee, very, very enjoyable. I enjoyed several packets of SENSEO decaf, regular & vanilla flavor. However, If you are a coffee addict, as I am, and start making and drinking 20 oz glasses of coffee, You will begin to develope four hour long deep seated headaches from this coffee. You cannot and will not function while enduring these headaches. I couldnt send the remaining coffee pods back, but I sent back the Senseo coffee maker.-----M.M.---I canceled my subscription to Senseo coffee.(Purchased through AMAZON)
It's the best coffee, especially when you have to drink decaf.  This product is too expensive though on amazon - cheaper at walmart.

My wife and I have enjoyed the Senseo coffees through the Douwe Egbert coffee machine for years.  Unfortunately the retail stores where we shop no longer carry the decaffeinated pods, so we have had to turn to Amazon as our source.  The coffee has consistently good flavor and quality.  Thanks Amazon for making it readily available.
This is the second time that I have received the shipment with the box not sealed properly; the flaps are open. Senseo needs to find a better adhesive.
I love the convenience of coffee pods and this coffee is delicious. I discovered it when it was sent as a sample with my Hamilton Beach pod coffee maker.

I absolutely love my senseo coffee maker, and all the varieties of coffee.  I usually don't like decaf, but this decaf tastes wonderful.  I usually crave coffee at night, and this makes it so that I can have some without having to stay up all night..

Better than the average decaf coffee. One pod is on the mild side, two pods gives a rich taste of coffee. I much prefer nondecaf coffee, but this is a good substitute late in the day. Does'nt mess with your sleep. I'll buy it again

We have owned a Senseo Coffee Maker since 2007 and positively love it!  Even though our family prefers the Dark Roast pods, the decaf is very good (we just keep it on hand for friends and family who can't drink the regular coffee.  Thank you for the large variety to choose from.  Respectfully, JoAnne O'Connor  P.S.  We purchase all of our pods from Amazon.com ONLY

The product itself is wonderful, however, after waiting a month for delivery, I had to call in to customer service. My order was "lost." The rep was wonderful and sent a replacement order the next day! However, the original offer was for four of these units, but at check out, it only listed one unit. So, although I THOUGHT I would be receiving four such units, I only received ONE. I could have purchased these at my local grocery store for the same price and saved the shipping costs. Signed, Not a Happy Camper.

The package of coffee came very quickly. I had not been able to get this product in any grocery store locally, so was delighted to find it at Amazon.com. The pods are so easy to use, and the coffee tastes excellent.
This is the best coffee but is a little pricey.  I have bought from the Senseo Store but the price is better on Amazon.
The Senseo coffee machine makes a great cup of coffee.  The decaf is great when you have to cut back on the caffein, only wish it were more like the dark roast (stronger).

I can never find the decaf at our local grocery stores.  Sometimes Target carries it, but it's chancy. This is a great alternative and as inexpensive as any sale I've seen so far, including with coupon savings.  The coffee is very good, the delivery is quick, and it's less pricey than through the Senseo "club" plan on the website.

column9: good coffee made fast and easy
column10: I was to to start drinking decaf coffee because of medical reasons. I tried Senseo decaf. It was the bestI have had that was home made. Plus it takes less than a minute to make.

column9: Is what it is at a great price
column10: Best price I have seen is $4.20 at Walmart, but havent seen it at Walmart lately. When you consider no taxes and no gas to get to Walmart price is equal or better.

I am just delighted to be able to buy the product. Two major food chain stores near me stopped carrying the product. I enjoy a cup of coffee each morning and can only drink decaf. I have 2 pod machines, one at home and one at work. Pods are better than wasting a pot of coffee.

column9: Excellent coffee for a good price.
column10: Since I bought my Senseo Coffee Machine, I don't miss the regular espresso anymore, because this device is very good. Of course, the coffee should be poured into small espresso white cups to be totally satisfactory. The Decaf is very good, and you wouldn't notice the difference with, e.g., the Medium. I recommend both the Senseo machine and the coffee in pods, for being very practical, efficient and taste approved.

column9: Great, fresh coffee with every cup!
column10: I love this coffee.  Gave a Senseo coffeemaker to my daughter for Christmas last year and plan to send one to my husband's aunt for Christmas this year; she loved the cups of this decaf that she had at our house when she was in town this fall.
Senseo Decaffeinated Coffee, 18-Count Pods (Pack of 6)These decaffeinated coffee pods deliver a full bodied coffee taste for a decaffeinated coffee.

Excellent decaf that can go toe-to-toe with some caffeinated coffees. Rich tasting with no bitterness. A must purchase if you have a Senseo and want to go decaf.I just wish they would offer more options for decaf, such as some different flavored coffees (hazelnut in particular). As it stands, this is the one and only decaf offering from Senseo. I have to make my own pods if I want something different (not hard to do, and cheaper, but I do like the convenience of the pre-made pods).
The coffee is delicious, just wish they would make more flavors of decaf.  Delivery was fast too!  Highly recommend.

column9: No more baristas and $5 dollar lattes for me!
column10: The Senseo coffee machine and pods continure to be the greatest coffee invention ever...great flavor in between a regular cup of coffee and an expresso, just perfect. And use an expresso or decaffeinated coffee pod along with a little pre-warmed creme and you have a latte to rival your neighborhood barista!
Excellent taste, convenient, I am satisfied with the purchase of Decaf Coffee pods for Senseo.

Decaffeinated Senseo pods are very difficult to find on grocer's shelves.  After several years of running around town searching for these pods and stockpiling them whenever I could find them, I no longer have to do this with scheduled supplies through Amazon.  It is also a better price than the grocery stores.

Senseo Decaf is the best affordable Decaf coffee pod and works well with, you guessed it, the Senseo Coffeemaker.  I highly recommend this pod and request Amazon diligently pursue other affordable options, including retaining the Halo decaf pods.

column9: Great Coffee Taste and It's Decaf
column10: My husband only drinks decaf coffee and I occasionally enjoy a cup of decaf in the evening.  The Senseo Decaffeinated Coffee Pod gives a full-bodied coffee taste and surprise it's decaf! The cup has a nice layer of froth on top when it has finished brewing.  Recommend it highly.

Want great decaf coffee that makes you forget its decaf? Look no further...Even my pregnant friend's couldn't believe how good it was and want to buy a machine just to get through the next few months! I'm generally not a fan of decaf, but this stuff is good. Certainly makes it easier to cut down on the caffeine when you can substitute 1 coffee a day with this!

Excellent product, fast delivery, excellent price (because of subscription: $23.66 for 6 bags of 18 pods). However, the current (June 2010) price ($3.94 per bag of 18 pods) needs to be reassessed because of dropping Euro (1Euro=$1.30). Local groceries sell bags for $5.75, with coupon $5.25. However, Target dropped its price to $4.24, only 30 cents from Amazon's price! Price review by Amazon is urgently needed.

I start almost every day with a cup of this Senseo coffee, even if later in the day I get some espresso or ordinary drip coffee. Considering how fast it is, it is a real quality cup. Likewise I often have a cup when I get home late and am not quite ready to go to bed. Good, quick, and easy.

If you're used to drinking coffee from beans that are somewhat freshly ground, then the coffee made from these pods will taste stale and flat to you. Also, the "crema" is beyond real creme--it's more foamy, and we don't enjoy it. After trying some gourmet pods that are marginally better, we've now ordered the refillable Ecopods so we can try using fresh coffee in the machine. We hope this works or its back to our expensive coffeehouse habit (double americano in a very small cup, please) for a while.
This product is too weak to really enjoy.  I would like a decaf with the flavor of the wonderful dark roast variety!

I find most of the Senseo coffee products to be tasteless, maybe watered down, but not full-bodied or delicious.  I have tried several different Senseo varieties, but none are noteworthy and I wouldn't recommend any of them.  I am going to try other pod brands.
Great coffee and shipped quickly except the box was not sealed very well and the post office had to tape it shut.

I just got my Grindmaster and ordered some Senseo coffees.I've only tried the medium blend and the decaf. I absolutely lovedthe medium blend. The decaf was sort of ok. I wish there were morevariety of decaf to choose from.

column9: Coffee pods are no substitute for a Starbucks
column10: I like the other coffees senseo makes. The decaf is not as full bodied as the medium caffinated brew. I got a bit spoiled by the dark brew.
Besides loving Senseo coffee (we use decaf) the convenience of subscribing and recieving product automatically is great. It couldn't be easier.

I tried the Senseo brand decaf because it was a great price on a Friday sale. Unfortunately, it turned out to be an expensive purchase because after trying two cups, I can't drink anymore of this coffee. It tastes horrible! Maybe it was just my batch but it had a very chemical taste to it.

The coffee itself was good, however to make a true "mug" of coffee you need to use at least 2 pods for each small mug.  If you are going to have one cup of coffee, or once in a while, it's just the thing.  Howevever, it gets expensive for coffee everyday at home.

column9: Makes a good cup of coffee
column10: My wife has one of the one cup coffee makers.  I used to make fun of her for the one cup thing but you know; sometimes I only want one cup too! The Senseo pods have good flavor.  I'd rate them a 5 star but if you use only one pod the coffee is a little bit weak for my taste. Unlike the french vanilla flavor it's fairly easy to find the decaff in the stores but buying them on Amazon in the pack of 6 was still cheaper, especially with the automatic re-order discount.

Good coffee.  I pair one pod of this with one of Senseo Dark Roast to make a cup of coffee that won't kill me, but still perks me up.  Senseo is one of the best uses for Amazon's Subscribe and Save feature.  Now if they could only tame the jack-in-the-box "out of stock" business, I'd be a happy coffee addict.

column9: The Senseo coffeepods are the very best
column10: Nothing could be better than a cup of Senseo in the morning.  The coffeepods are convenient, no mess and the coffee is delicious. The variety in the different types of coffee is amazing. Not to even speak of the ease with which it comes to the house.  On a monthly basis I automatically receive a box of 6 packages containing 18 pods in the mail by Amazon.  The price is great for the pods and the automatic delivery is so convenient. I have been drinking this coffee for many years and it is the best.Can't begin to tell what all I have ordered from Amazon. Packaging is always professional, never any dammage and promptly on time.
I've used this coffee for several years now and the price is less at Amazon than anywhere else I have found.
We love our one'on'one coffee pot, but the coffee pods are hard to locate.  We are so happy Amazon has them for us.

Coffee pods are not the cheapest way to make coffee and they are increasingly hard to find and can be expensive. We like them because we can make one or two cups at a time.  These Senseo pods are the best decafe coffee pods we have tried but still not as good a regular brewed cup of restaurant decafe coffee.  We buy and use the Senseo pods but have a Home Cafe double cup coffee machine. We don't have the Senseo machine.  The Home Cafe pods are next to imposable to find and more expensive.  The Senseo pods work fine, and as stated here make a decent cup of coffee.  In addition Amazon is the best place to buy these pods.  We checked a lot of on-line sources and no one we found beats their price. Plus they frequently offer free shipping when you buy them in the case quantity.  The other types of Senseo pods we tried, the regular and flavored coffees are good as well. We recommend that you try the Senseo brand pods, and purchase them from Amazon.
I have been using Senseo Coffee for over 7 years and I love the fresh taste. I highly recommend buying Senseo Coffee pods. They are the best and very reasonable in cost.
This is my favorite coffee. It has a great flavor and when bought through Amazon.com, it is cheaper than in the grocery store! Great taste, great price---excellent combination.

After years of basically having to give up morning coffee because it made no sense to brew a pot of coffee for one person (I hated rushing around, and then having to throw most of it away), I discovered the Senseo approach to single cup brewing. So I have joyfully returned to my morning cup of coffee. It's a great treat. Even on very busy mornings, there seems to be time for a cup of coffee. Love it!

column9: Senseo Douwe Egberts Coffee Pods Decaffeinated
column10: Excelent. I enjoy this coffee a lot. Smells so good that I have to drink another cup inmediately.

column9: Senseo Douwe Egberts at a Great Price
column10: This is very good coffee and the price can't be beat.  Very fast delivery.
I like the Senseo decaf coffee. It is not too strong or too weak. It is just hard to find.
Again, the Senseo decaf pods are a lifesaver at work, where modular food and drinkstuffs are a must.
The senseo makes a good cup of coffee with a frothy head on top. The Decaffinated has a wonderfully pleasant taste. Would recommend
Senseo Douwe Egberts Coffee Pods, Decaffeinated, 18-Count 4.41-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)great coffee - great price

I just love the Senseo coffee maker and pods. You practically don't have to be awake to brew a perfect cup of java every morning! I can make the fully leaded for myself and the decaf for my husband without dirtying pots, finding filters, and using anything but our coffee cups! And it's perfect every time. They are just great for that afternoon cup when you're on the go. Love my Pods!

I have to admit that I am a full caf coffee lover, but I can't drink caffeine after 3-4PM if I want to sleep.  This is a very good substitute, much much better tasting than other decaf's I've tried.  In fact for the past few mornings I've been drinking this instead AND enjoying it.
Arrived on time - it's less expensive at Amazon than in the gocery stors, assuming you can even find Seneo's decaffeinted coffee, which I usualy can't.
I could not believe that it has the full flavor of a medium roast coffee.
We love the consistency of the flavor, and the speed of preparation. Senseo is a cool thing... a little pricey, but worth it.

column9: The best coffee in the world!
column10: I have the pleasure of drinking this delicious coffee only a few times a year at our favorite restaurant in Pennsylvania.  I can't help but say "this is the best coffee in the world" with every sip!

Before ordering this from Amazon, I checked all my local sources for pods for my Senseo...Walmart, Target, local grocery.  Amazon's price was either equal to or below all the others, plus some sources didn't even have any decaf pods, which is the only kind I use.  When it's time to order again, I will come back to Amazon.  Quite satisfied with this purchase.
Pods work great. Quick delivery. Cheaper than the grocery store PLUs the grocery store did not have the decaf!

The last two shipments of Senseo have not worked in my Senseo Coffee Pot.  Comparing them with previous pods, I discovered that the paper material is too firm.  The water does not go through and the coffee pot stops.  I love my Senseo so this is very disappointing.

I ordered this product with the assumption that I would receive the coffee flavors pictured on the box. I only received the Jamaica me Crazy flavor. Not my choice of flavors in coffee with a hint of coconut. The coffee is okay but, not what I believed I was ordering. I would've ordered just the flavor I received if that was what I wanted... I kept the coffee, didn't feel like dealing with having to return it so I'm offering it to my friends when they visit. Disappointed with this delivery.

column9: Ragu Traditional Pasta Sauce is very good.
column10: Ragu Traditional Pasta Sauce is "very good". My family has been using Ragu Traditional Pasta Sauce for generations, simply because it is simple to prepare and we love the taste of the sauce !

These  Supreme Healthy Max dog treats are very small, but I still cut them in  half for our two yorkies.  Then I put them in a little tin bowl to harden a bit and leave them sitting on our counter. Our dogs absolutely love them. They will do anything to get them. I also buy the weight management ones and the hip and joint ones and do the same thing. They are good for them and what a wonder, they are made in the USA! With real meat and fish, no worry about contents they are good. Your dogs will love them.

column9: Weird.... Why so much Amazon? These are GOOD treats and you should SELL them correctly!
column10: These treats are my dogs favorites, its like stink bait for a fish! Too bad Amazon sells them for $11 when you can get them for a buck at the dollar store! Duh Amazon! They are great for my 8 lb dog and the ingreidients are good, made in USA so I feel they are safe and I wont have to read about it killing our pets on the news someday. And you dont have to spend a lot of cash for these! The best product I have found over the years.
Just a word of warning. . . I gave my Yorkie these treats and she started LOSING her coat.  Skin & Coat Dog Treats?  I think NOT.Buyer (and poor pets) BEWARE!

column9: Made in USA and apparently delicious!
column10: Our dogs (23lb and 8lb rescue mixes) LOVE these treats! I love them because they are made in our country and because I can easily break them into tiny pieces for clicker training and agility training.

It made it challenging when our beagle puppy did not take to liking biscuit treats very well when training her,so we grabbed these inexpensive treats to try. She LOVES them and has trained very well with them!  She loves the salmon ones the most. I love that they are sooo inexpensive and one bag can go a long way! I also like the reclosable bag they come in bc they are stinky. The little heart shape is such a perfect size, but we actually trained her by breaking them in half. They are of good substance and hearty enough that  just a few are of great satisfaction to her.
I don't buy anything for my dogs that has Propylene Glycol in it. There are so manyother treats on the market with healthy ingredients.

column9: Beautifully packaged as a gift item. And they asked for more!!
column10: I purchased this for a party as they looked beautifully presented and would enhance the appearance of our tables.Turns out that whoever ate them LOVED them and wanted to know where I purchased them so they could get some for themselves!!!

For Christmas gatherings, most family members expect tradition in the 'candy department' as well as "what we've always done" when it comes to decorations, carols & menus. Amazon.com can help in the hunt for the thinnest ribbon candy (B000CEA2CU), for nonpareils with sprinkles in holiday colors (B000AP7328), and for those chocolate coins in gold net bags (B0007TZVZI) so loved by kids. But how about 100% Vermont Maple Leaf candy, and Tully's (incomparable) Peanut Butter Fudge?To correctly celebrate the holidays, some insist on having today's version of the Droste (Dutch) chocolate apple: It is Terry's (made in England) sectioned orange, preferably dark chocolate. Lucky is the person chosen to give the solid ball a WHACK on the counter top while everyone watches it fall into slices! They are hard but,  OH, so delectable!Do you have memories of sprawling on the floor, playing "Candy Land"? Do you long for the marzipan or Turkish Delight of your "Christmas Past"?  OR other vaguely remembered delights? If you have lived long you may have experienced struggles with chocolate that now can be set aside upon learning that our favorite, tantalizing (dark) chocolate is beneficial for persons with high blood pressure! Start the New Year right with your very own "TERRY's ORANGE" - fav substitute for Vitamin D.mcHAIKU rejoices that CHOCOLATE  STILL  REIGNS !!

THE DESCRIPTION ON THE PRODUCT WAS 24/1.5 OZ BAGS. I THOUGHT THIS MEANT I WOULD GET A QUANTITY OF 24 BAGS OF M&M'S. IMAGINE MY SUPRISE TODAY WHEN I OPENED THE PACKAGE I PAID FOR TO FIND ONE BAG,YES ONE BAG!!!!OF MNMS. I AM VERY VERY UNHAPPY. YOU NEED TO SPECIFY THAT THIS WAS FOR ONE BAG OF MNMS. THIS IS HIGHWAY ROBBERY AND I WILL BE CONTACTING THE SELLER. RIDICULOUS!!!!
These m & m's really have the coconut flavor.  These should be in the marketsand available along with the others.

column9: Beware: Tastes great but most things with 400 calories taste great ....
column10: Beware of the fact that each bar has 2 servings.  Seems misleading to me.  Disappointed that a product that is geared towards people trying to be healthy would resort to such labeling tactics.

These Bars are great for hiking, packing, and general use.They are a good breakfast substitute or something to fill the belly that is healthy during a busy day.I love these Oat Bars!I've tried most all of them and they are all good.

Nothing aggravates me more when you pick up a quick snack at a health food store assuming it's healthy due to the nutrition facts, only to find out later this little bar is actually 2 servings - Hugely misleading packaging!  Are they good?  yes - so is an ice-cream sundae.

These are the best tasting of most of the oat bars I have eaten.  I have one for breakfast almost everyday.  Yes they are high calorie but less than the high sugar cereals a lot of people eat for breakfast.  I stay away from fast food, etc..at least Bobo bar are oat grain.  I do plan to compare the caloric count to fast foods (maybe I should have a Sonic egg burrito instead?).
Bobo's cinnamon raison bar rocks I think I may be addicted. I have one at least three times a week.

Cookies from Home is a great company because of their amazing customer service and their amazing, delicious gluten free cookies! I sent these cookies as a gift and my friend could not believe all the cookies I sent were gluten free! I recommend Cookies from Home for any occasion, or if you just want to send something to yourself. For me, as someone with celiac disease, I know I will be ordering a lot more from Cookies from Home in the future.Highly recommend this company and their baked goods :)
The couscous was very good.  Easy to follow directions on the container, and it turned out well.  The price is low too, which is a bonus.

column9: had better and meatier vienna sausages
column10: not good right out of the can like some other brands, and not as dense as some others ['meatiness']--but throw them in a stew or sauce of some kind and when heated are pretty good. all comes down to price and for the price I can't complain.

The only detriment to this truly delightful cup of joe is that the the price goes upeverytime  that I order. This just takes a tiny piece of flavor from my alreadyawakened and revived aroma/taste/reincarnated sensations in my mouth,gums,throat,gullet and stomach. Folgers Breakfast blend replenishes my brainwaves in some magical way!
We've tried all of the YummyEarth Organic Lollipop flavors and our whole family loves the Watermelon flavor the best. They're delicious!
I love these lollipops!  The watermelon and pomegranate are my favorites.  Everyone I share them with loves them and usually winds up ordering their own bags.

I bought these before picking up my 2 yr old from daycare.  He is used to having a snack in the car on the way home before naptime.  I usually bring crackers or a banana.  The boy really enjoyed these crackers.My own experience with these crackers is different, sadly.  The first bite was lovely.  But later bites were sadly lacking.  These crackers are like a lesser Cheez It.  There is a little bit (not enough) of cheese flavor, but the unique pretzel energy is lost.  It's best not to combine the modest pretzel with flashier snacks because it can't stand up.  It just winds up giving you a watered-down version of The Other Thing, in this case a Cheez It.I would say, stick with Cheez Its, OR, pretzels, but combining them  minimizes them both.

I received the FlipSide Cheddar Pretzel Crackers in a care package and was initially a bit skeptical about the concept being afraid that either taste might be over-powering.  Although the idea is a bit strange, Town House managed to make an interesting cracker with a unique flavor and texture.  The cheddar and pretzel flavor is well-balanced and the texture falls somewhere between a pretzel and a cracker.  The cheddar flavor is somewhat subdued and is more of a sharp cheddar flavor.The cracker stands well on its own and would make an excellent snack in and of itself.  The Cheddar/Pretzel mix would also make the cracker excellent with dips like smoked fish.

I got a yummy product and great service at a great price.  Couldn't be more pleased, except, there is even a bonus...  the company donates money for wildlife conservation with each purchase! I will re order!

Eating these almost 50 years now. Have tried many other brands and none compare. Really worth the time and effort to find them. I might not have moved off the east coast if I had known how hard these are to get in this region.

column9: They don't sell them here, but I need them badly!!
column10: I have always loved these cup cakes and so glad I can have them delivered to my stomach.  Boy, can't get enough of these!!!Black Kindle - African American Books on the Kindle Blog
I lived in Delaware and this is the only cake I like.  They don't sell them in Florida....PLEASE distribute to Florida!!! ;)
I've had these ever since I was a kid. They have never disappointed me. Deep rich chocolate topping with a medium moist chocolate sponge cake. Superb. Thier bluberry pies are equally as tasty.
one of my favorite flavors of bubbalicious, it used to be called twisted tornado, now called fruit twist either way i can't stop myself from eating its so flavorful =)

I swear this has to be the best barbeque sauce in the world. I eat it on everything, if u havent tried it go get it. I'd recommend u try the Honey Barbeque Sauce first that's my favorite. Right now im cooking some nice thick spare ribs and they should be done any minute now....

I love this sauce. It tastes great. I got it with the Original and I like this one more. The Original has a little more spice, and I'm not a fan of pepper. But this one has a sweeter taste. Great for ribs. One of the best, or the best, BBQ sauces out there.

I agree with what other reviewers have said.  This is probably my favorite barbecue sauce.  The Sweet Baby Ray's original sauce is good too but the Honey Barbecue flavor is something special.  In addition to the sweetness from the honey, there is a detectable molasses flavor which I really like.  I believe I would have a hard time making a better sauce from scratch.
Best BBQ Sauce out there.  Pick some up today!

Sweet Baby Ray's has got some of the best bottled BBQ sauces around. We have tried every flavor they make and can't really pick a favorite... I recommend trying this at your next BBQ or for pulled pork. However I would not buy it from amazon at this price. You can pick it up for 4 dollars less and no shipping at kroger, king soopers & city market... They just recently had their 10 for 10 sale and SBR's was one of the products for sale. We stocked up.
There is no doubt this sauce is excellent.  Only home-made sauces might beat it.  This is excellent on ribs, chicken, steaks anything.

column4: Paul Tognetti "The real world is so much more...
column9: Makes for some mighty fine eatin'!
column10: I don't know about you but it seems that is is becoming more and more expensive for my wife and I to eat out these days.  Here in Rhode Island you are looking at around $13.00 or $14.00 for a half a rack of ribs at national chains like Texas Roadhouse or at a local institution like Wes' Rib House.  Since my wife and I are not made of money we only go to places like these on special occasions or during a night out with friends.  Most of the time we choose to cook at home on our Weber grill.  If the menu calls for chicken or pork we always brush the meat with our favorite store bought sauce "Sweet Baby Ray's Honey Barbecue Sauce".  Frankly, we find that the meat turns out every bit as tender and flavorful at it does at a restaurant for about 1/4 to 1/3 the price.Since I am not particularly fond of hickory smoke flavor we never barbequed at home very much.  Years ago hickory smoke barbecue sauce was just about the only variety available at your local supermarket.  As I recall that all began to change with the introduction of the KC Masterpiece line of sauces in the mid 1980's.  Suddenly, exciting new flavors were bursting onto the scene.  I first became familiar with honey-flavored Bar-B-Que at a popular rib house in Montreal called Bar-B-Barn.  I just fell in love with the taste so when  "Sweet Baby Ray's Honey Barbecue Sauce" was introduced  I had to give it a try.  And I am happy to say that I was not disappointed.  I find that while I enjoy this stuff on chicken it is even better on pork.  See if you agree!  Very highly recommended!

This by far is the best barbecue sauce I have ever tasted. I'm eating some BBQ ribs right now as I'm typing. I'm getting sauce all over myself. I'm getting barbecue sauce on the keyboard. Holy smoke!  And this is just the regular flavor. I can't wait to try the honey flavored!

column9: Gelatinous and an Odd Sweet Flavor
column10: I understand that opinions vary greatly in these things, but I cannot for the life of me see how so many people like the Sweet Baby Ray's sauces.  I tried the original recipe and this.  The original was very ho hum but I thought this one was kind of gross.  The taste is slightly fake, as if its not made with sugar or honey but with some sort of chemical.  The texture is a bit gelatinous which contributes to the feeling of this being a synthetic product.  It reminds me of American cheese.  Its not awful, and on the right application actually tastes good, but it isn't really cheese and eating it makes me feel kind of yucky.I have since moved on and tried a few other sauces commonly found in grocery stores.  The one I landed on is "Cattlemen's Award Winning Kansas City Classic Barbecue Sauce".  So good you could just drink it.  Try that one out.

EW. This sauce tastes AWFUL. Has a weird aftertaste...kkind of like the one you get from diet soda or diet vitamin water. Never buying this again. Threw away the entire bottle. Sweet Baby Ray's Honey Barbecue Sauce 18 oz

I have been looking for this tea for several months and could not find it in the stores anymore. I had just about given up hope of ever enjoying it again,when my daughter-in-law suggested I look on line for it. And up popped Amazon with my favorite Lipton Green Citrus Tea. I cannot tell you how pleased I am to be able to enjoy my breafast with a lovely cup of my favorite tea. Thank you so much.I was so happy to have found it I ordered 6 boxes Horay for me.
I like brewing this for iced tea. I use the recommended amount of tea bags, add a little honey or without; either way it is a smooth flavorful refreshing light green tea.
Lipton Green Tea Citrus is an great tea to brew at home and be able to have the same great flavor that you get in the bottle version, but control the amount of sugar.
We purchased this product on line because we could not get it locally.  We are very pleased with the product and the amount of time it took for us  to receive it.

First had this bottled diet while on vacation.  Decided we would like to make it at home (without bottling additives) but couldn't find the tea bags in any local stores.  So we did what we always do when we can't find something in the stores....checked Amazon!  And the rest is history!  This is green tea & therefore somewhat bitter by nature but the citrus adds a nice subtle sweetness to it-not too strong.  Love being able to make this at home!
Certainly not worth purchasing by its lonesome. I came in not expecting the world from Lipton, and they gave me little reason to doubt my doubts.

These were the only sugar free gumballs i could find anywhere....i even had my mother searching for them in ny.....no luck.....i thought they were a lil pricey but when this is all u could find for the gumball machine.....beggars cant be choosers and my kids seem to like them too

We call it "magic sauce" because it simply goes well with any kind of food: meat, seafood or salad!! We even add a small spoon to our pasta (non-creamy type) sometimes. You need to shake it really hard before using just so all ingredients would mix completely.

I can't believe that this sauce is being sold for over $6 per can.  I can buy this at the grocery store in NJ for $2.  I will do without before I would give this company a dime.  Money grubbers is all I can say, may it rot on the shelves!  Buy the case sells it at less than half this price!

This is the best pizza sauce anywhere!!!  Don Pepino's flavor is unique and popular.  Our family has been using Don Pepino sauce for more than 20 years.  It really makes our pizza and pepperoni buns.  We are happy that Amazon offers it because it is hard to order elsewhere.  Also, Amazon has easy, safe ordering.

My mom recommended this tea to me after having it served at a restaurant.  She described it as "the best raspberry tea I've every had!"  I must agree.  It tastes like fresh raspberries and is somewhat sweet even without sugar.  I've gone through most of the box in the last 2 weeks and plan to order more.  Very yummy hot and cold!

column9: Love Nutramigen but DO NOT pay this Price
column10: I love Nutramigen for how it helped my daughter through some difficult times.  I used the concentrate cans quite frequently but NEVER paid this much for it.  If you can find a local retailer that does "can can" sales ;)you can find the same for half the price.  At least purchase directly through Enfamil.  This formula is expensive enough as is without this vendor trying to take you for a ride. For shame!

A warning dialogue box should come up asking if you want to spend $8 for shipping for a $6 product. It was shipped from someplace different from the rest of the order. The cake was good, but having to add 2 cups of sugar, 1 or 2 sticks of butter and 6 eggs made it too expensive.
I got the "chocolate chip cookies" flavor and they were so good! They really taste like the real deal - just like the typical normal chocolate chip cookies (except much healthier!).
Finally a dressing that tastes great only sweetened by fruit.  I bought this when I was trying to avoid sugar and corn syrup, but wanted a sweet dressing.  It fits the bill.

If you even like this product...the bottle design doesn't allow one to effectively shake up the ingredients before pouring therefore you get all oil right off the top. I suggest pouring it into a bowl and whisking. It contains xanthan gum but it wasn't effective as an emulsifier. No one flavor stood out but I could taste the canola oil. I like tart and this isn't. With the sweetness of the fig, a bit more acidity would have balanced it out. I found the flavor cloying and unpalatable. I even tried adding wine vinegar to it but it didn't help. It ended up sitting in my refrigerator for over 6 months. I finally used some to baste the top of a pork roast and poured the rest down the drain. I still can't figure out why they added caramel color when balsamic vinegar is already dark and so is fig paste. Also, I bought this on sale (it was a discontinued item) at my store. I asked one of the managers why it was was discontinued and he said usually it's because the product was not a good seller. I can see why.

column9: Very Good Meat Snack - Highly Recommended
column10: Jack Link's "X-Stick Original" snack sticks are very good tasting and far less greasy than other "meat sticks" (like Slim Jim). These are great snacks for diabetics (like me) since they have a negligible amount of Net Carbs.The Amazon "Product Features" incorrectly lists these as 160 Calories each, and neither the box or individual packaging list the Nutrition Facts, so I visited the Jack Links web site and found the following:Serving Size: .5 Oz (1 stick)Calories: 60 (45 from Fat)Total Fat: 5g (2g Saturated Fat)Cholesterol: 15mgSodium: 220mgTotal Carbohydrates: 0gProtein: 3gThese do contain MSG, which can cause "gastric distress" in some people (like my dad).Overall, these are great as a snacks between meals and they are so much better than the competition.Highly Recommended!CFH

These are along the line of Slim Jims but have a milder, less spicy, taste. The X-Sticks also have a much better texture than Slim Jims, these things actually look like they are made of real meat, NOT the 'mystery meat - goat hair/cardboard' texture of the modern Slim Jim.The X-Stick is 'not exactly' a health food snack. They have a fair amount of fat, a little over 5 grams (each stick, in this package, is 14 grams total mass). Sodium content is about 224 mg and, about 3.2 grams of protein and only 64 calories (about 47 calories from fat) per stick.What the X-Stick is, is a very satisfying snack. I sometimes have to miss a meal, due to my work. One or two of these take the hunger away and puts some energy back into me. I do try to limit my fat intake but do not feel guilty about snacking on these once in a while.Enjoy.Ken

These are so much better than Slim Jim's they don't have that weird fur texture when you bite it; and as far as biting goes you can actually bite these without fighting with it. They taste good, but have that typical meat stick flavor. These are also MUCH easier to open than a Slim Jim. Packed well, arrived quickly and fresh.

This review is for the 0.5 ounce X-Sticks box of 50.First I will comment on the taste.  The X-Sticks have a mild and pleasing flavor to them.  They taste similar to Slim Jims, just without the chemical spiciness and odd plastic texture of Slim Jims.  In a taste test, the X-Sticks would win without a problem.Next is the price.  The price for the box of 50 0.5 ounce X-Sticks tend to fluctuate on Amazon but it's still worth it, provided the price stays below $20 a box.  When you combine this with the Subscribe and Save discount, you can save even more!  The price of the same type of Slim Jims is almost $10 higher, so once again, the X-Sticks win.So my final thoughts are if you're looking for a meat snack that isn't going to repeat on you an hour later, these are the way to go.  Although they can't claim to be "All natural", they have more natural ingredients than the Slim Jim.  These also are composed of beef and pork (yum), whereas a Slim Jim is composed of beef and mechanically separated chicken...  (Eww).  Anyway, I was very happy with this purchase and I highly recommend them for you.

I can't really compare these to other similar products (Slim Jim,etc.), as I had never had jerky-type snacks before I got these.  I decided to take a long road trip (4500 miles round trip), and I have a tendency to get drowsy if I don't get enough protein.  I decided to carry these plus some string cheese in the car to tide me over between meal stops.I really like these.  The flavor is good, the texture is fine, and the "damage" from a diet standpoint is minimal (these are 60 cal apiece, based on the Jack Links site).  They're not too salty, either.  Having them on the trip from Bellingham, WA to St. Louis, MO and back was a huge help.  One or two of these provided just the right amount of tasty protein.  The size and packaging is handy, too, and easy to open when driving.I now keep them on hand for when I need a little pick-me-up.

column9: Best of all the beef sticks I have tried
column10: My son and I love these beef sticks! I purchased these and slim jims at the same time and was amazed how much better taste and tecture they have over slim jims. Infact I'm tempted to throw my slim jims in the trash! Perfect for your 72-hour kit.

This stuff is great for snacking, has a long shelf life, and convenient to pack for travel.  The taste and texture is awesome.  Buying on-line saves money and time.  I keep a box in my office and another at home.  It is a great way to enjoy group discussions and family time.  Eric D., Wanamingo, MN

column9: Easy snack sticks on the cheap
column10: I am a meat lover and this makes a perfect snack for the road.  Inexpensive.  Can't say the taste is outstanding but is certainly not yucky.  Will get another box when this one runs out.
After eating these you'll Never want another Slim JimThese are Awesome.

So these sticks taste ok, I mean, it's jerky, how do you mess that up? My issue is with the expiration date, which was a little less than one month from when I got my box. How am I supposed to eat 50 of these things in 25 some-odd days? That's just cheap trying to offload these so close to the expiration date. Never buying these again.

This was my second purchase. Watching carbs, I look for snacks that are high protein with low or no sugars. Tiring of nuts all the time I tired these a couple months ago. Very surprised, they taste good with a bit of spice kick. Recalling that most convenience store sticks were dry or greasy or blah tasting, it was nice to snack on these. They are not the long sticks but a nice size at about 6 inches. Wrapped individually and easy to open. Great item to grab when looking for a quick munch.

column9: Just okay -- not nearly a Slim Jim
column10: While certainly edible, I don't think Jack Links brings a realistic competitor here with their version of the Slim Jim.  Honestly, there are some bites I take which remind me of dog food.  I know we are talking about meat sticks here and not fine dining, but the texture of these is just not right, almost too granular.  I know Slim Jims have that greasy taste but these guys have a bit of it too and I have to admit I kind of enjoy it.  Overall, in my opinion, Slim Jims are much much better than these guys, but to each his/her own!
Just letting ya know that I bought a pack of these before..they were perfectly fine..this time? no. They were moldy, so I just threw them out, what a waste of money!!
The first time I got these, everything was great. The second time, however, the sticks tasted a bit off... then I notice the 3-months-expired date on them.
My husband has tried many links is his day and these stand out.  Would compare these to Fat Freddies.
I first bought these at my part-time work at Advance Auto and since I could buy them cheaper this way, I did it.Good flavor and a bit of a bite.

The product is exactly what we had been purchasing in the store.  I love the box to store them becuase they would fall behind things in the cabinet and now they are always easy to find.  The price was better than in the store.
my son has type 1 diabetes and needs to eat low carb snacks.  he loves the jack links small beef jerky.  we take them with us everywhere.
After eating these you'll Never want another Slim JimThese are Awesome.

column9: I'll never Have another slim Jim again
column10: This jerky is the greatest jerky ever it taste so good it comes with 50 links for only 15 bucks!!!! i bought this last month and i just finished them i'm buying more right now!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Have purchased this product several times and we are pleased. It is a good value for the money compared with the retail stores.
Better than thought theyd be  A+++++++.  Excellent choice for a great snack at work.  never got close to getting sick of them and will buy again.
Product is tastey but I would like some cheese to go along with it since the beef sticks alone don't taste as good after awhile.

column9: A bit on the greasy side, but the kids love them
column10: Some fairly improved ingredients vs a typical 'slim jim', at least its not made with jowls and pink slime.  The taste is good, salty, smoky, a bit on the greasy side.  If you've had the x-sticks, this is just small pieces of that in a bag, four times the weight of the stick.  In other words, excellent for sharing or a snack at school where eating a whole stick might be a problem.I also dump a package into a ziploc and can snack on it a piece at a time to boost my protein and fat intake a bit.A pack of 12 lasted my 7 year old and his friends about a week, which is way faster than most other meat snacks I've put on the snack counter.But even the 7-10 year olds say its a bit greasy, as they devour another package.

this will be the third time i bought this an enjoy it every time much better then slim jims  their tender an full of flavor i often want a snack at random times but don't want eat a lot or a full meal this ties me over an is worth the price

My kids love these beef sticks...... so this year I purchased these and stuffed lots of them in their Christmas stockings.  These were a much better replacement to all the Christmas candy they usually get.  Great item and great price!!!
Realy liked the taste, price and quality. Only downgrade would be that about 20% of the easy peel opening packages are not serrated and need to be cut with scissors. Only defect
I have ordered this item several times and am very pleased with it. Will order again. It is one of my favorite jack link products.

Having never had the X-Links before, I bought them based off some customer reviews I read here. Maybe I should have read more, but these are most comparable to a Slim Jim. While they are much better, they still fall into the same category, and I was looking for something a little more "real" tasting. These have a much better taste than Slim Jim does, although there is still a substantial "artificial" taste. Highly recommended as a Slim Jim upgrade, but don't buy these if you're looking for a more natural tasting product.
Very pleased with these. They had both a good taste and texture. The price was right for what you get. I would highly recommend.

column9: Very good, but not really EXTREME
column10: I like these sticks better than Slim Jims because they are less greasy and have a meatier flavor.  However, they could benefit from some more spice.  That's my only suggestion.
I love these sticks i have purchased 2 boxes from amazon and I have bought many from local stores. These are the best tasting sticks i have ever had just wish i could get them by the case yum yum.

The product is the same as what we had been purchasing in the store. I like keeping the box to store them becuase I dont lose track of where they are in the cabinet and now they are always easy to find. The price was better than in the store.

Very good snack sticks.  It does not feel greasy like Slim Jims and is easy to chew.  The size is perfect for a snack so I don't eat too many all at once. column9: Edward & Sons organic mashed potatoes are an excellent choice for those who want an organic and/or gluten free product ...
column10: Every time you reconstitute dehydrated foods such as this one, there is always a bit of change you might want to make before you get it to your own particular taste.  With this package of mashed potatoes you can either make two or four servings.  I'd suggest that you might want to prepare the two servings and think about how you'd like to individualize the "recipe."  For example, if you are going to be using a gravy, you might want to leave the recipe as is.  If you like yours whipped or creamy you may wish to add extra milk or a dollop of butter on the top.  Garlic fans may want to throw in some extra garlic powder as the taste is subtle.These organic mashed potatoes are definitely customizable. One suggestion that is offered is "for creamier potatoes, add more milk product (stir in 1 Tbsp at a time to read desired consistency.)  For firmer potatoes, let sit 2-3 minutes before serving."  These potatoes can be either made on the stovetop or in the microwave.  Either way you wish to prepare them you are looking at under five minutes.  Many people object to the palm oil as it is one of the ones we are ask to limit or avoid, but then again so is cocoa butter in chocolate.  In order for you to decide I'll list the ingredients and the basic nutrition facts listed on the box.INGREDIENTS:Organic Potato Flakes (organic potatoes, mono and di-glycerides from organic palm oil), Organic Onion Powder, Organic Roasted Garlic, Sea Salt, Organic Garlic Powder, Organic Black Pepper.NUTRITION FACTS:Serving Size 1/3 cup dry mix (25g)1/2 cup preparedServings Per Container:  4Calories  90Calories from fat  0Total Fat  0gSaturated Fat  0gTrans Frat  0gCholesterol  0mgSodium 180mg  7%Total Carbohydrate 20g  7%  Dietary Fiber 2g  7%  Sugars <1gProteins 2gI didn't include the nutritional facts with milk / soy milk / vegan spread or water as that would vary widely.  We do like these potatoes and I certainly like the last minute convenience factor if I don't have time to prepare fresh potatoes or am out of them.  There is a recipe from "Allison's Kitchen" for roasted garlic potato-broccoli soup that sounds delicious.  Edward & Sons organic mashed potatoes are an excellent choice for those who want an organic and/or gluten free product.

Joeseph's sugar free cookies are a ok option for a diabetic like myself.My only issue is the cookies are very hard and in my opinion are only good when dunked in a cup of coffee/tea.One needs to read the carb content and serving/portion size.I have not found any variety of this brand of sugar free cookies soft and easily chewable.Price wise there are a substanially more than Murray's but less than many of the other's found in Whole Foods or on line.

This is one of the prettiest tea tins I have and I collect some and sorry but lipton you are not even close it has four different pictures on each side of the red background.  Is just the right size to leave on the counter and not get in the way and the bonus is it comes with some delicious twenty five vacuum sealed bags of tea.  When you  are done you can refill it which is what I am doing since I love it on my counter but there is a slot in the top so if you want to make it into a bank you can do that, since it has a slot on top to put change in if you desire.I have purchased several and plan to give them as valentines gift to my many friends who are on diets not fattening and adorable.  A must have for all tea lovers
to you. great! taste is wonderful. well worth money spend! comes with nice tin. i wish they had. in green tea.
This is a wonderful gift and a must have!  The red can is just adorable. I am a big fan of Ahmad tea.  Must have my English Breakfast every morning with a little milk and honey.

My British Mum loved them. This could be split into 4 little gifts if needed. Cute stocking stuffer type idea. The top of the tin is slotted to use for change after the tea bags are gone, my Mum has them placed around her house now. Very Cute, and good tea.
Beautiful tin, excellent tea. I have gave this as a gift to a coworker, and it wa a great success.

This is a cute English Tin~~of course I love anything "red".  I didn't try the tea because these were for gifts for my friends.  But they said they loved it and they have all kept the Tin on the kitchen counter.  TJ

I bought the phone booths for gifts.  They are very functional, containing breakfast tea and then live a second life as a savings bank. The bank is very attractive, unfortunately as they are gifts I haven't tried the tea but I believe it is very very good.

column9: the best sauce ever for shishkabobs and much more
column10: most people think to have the best tasting shish ka bobs you must marinate over night. but with this sauce marinating is over. prepare meats and veggies and pineapple. skewer them how ever you like to stack your ka bobs. throw them on the grill and start basting with sweet n smokey. by the time the ka bobs are done the sweet n smokey sauce is so caramalized that you can not stop eating.there are so many uses for this sauce and it is so versatile. you can not go wrong in your purchase.

column9: Great taste and low in sugar
column10: We are finding Woody's in more and more stores all the time now. We love both sauces but use the Cookin Sauce the most because it tastes fantastic AND is low in sugar which is great for the diabetic (dad) in our family. It's the only BBQ sauce we have found that he can use with a clear conscience. We also discovered that because of the low sugar content, ribs etc. don't burn when you have them on the grill for a while.

Costco is a wonderful place to learn about food.  When I saw a woman putting a five pound package of baby back ribs in her cart, I asked her if she grilled them.  "Oh no" she replied, "I bake them in the oven."  Her recipe was to wrap them (sealing well) in heavy-duty foil, put them on a cookie sheet, and bake at 350 degrees for three hours - adding barbecue sauce the last half-hour.  The sauce her family preferred was Woody's, made in New Orleans.  At first, I was able to buy it in our local super market, but then came Katrina and it was (temporarily) discontinued. The super market has never begun stocking it again, so my daughter and I both order it. When I couldn't find it, I tried some others, but once you use Woody's, nothing else tastes as good.
A few grocery stores used to carry this sauce and then discontinued it - we have been searching for it ever since.When we found online we ordered a case of it because it is the best wing sauce ever!

Our family loves Woody's Sweet 'n' Sour sauce on ribs or just about any kind of meat, pork, or chicken.  We searched everywhere before we found it on Amazon.com.  The shipping was expensive, but so worth it when you taste it.  I would definitely buy it again, but I wish the shipping wasn't so expensive.

column9: You've got to keep this on hand!
column10: If you have a box of Lipton Soup Secrets in the house, you've got a meal in a pinch. Throw in veggies, leftover chicken, mini-meatballs, even a bit of tomato paste and extra seasonings and you'll chase away the chill with a satisfying bowl of "home-made" soup.When you are adding your own recipe ingredients to the mix, also add extra water and just a pinch of sugar. Yum!Add a bit of shredded cheese on top and it's pure perfection. Keep lots  on hand for those nights you just can't stand the thought of going out to the supermarket -- and, it can save you a lot of money on ordering out!
What can I say... it's great soup!  Add a little extra chicken bullion, some red pepper powder, extra noodles, and simmer.  YUM!

column9: It is what it is, and it's not what it's not
column10: For a quick cheap meal that stores well and requires very little effort, Lipton Noodle Soup is a pretty good choice.  It tastes like chicken noodle soup (well, sort of), which is what you'd expect, and is fairly good if you rate it against what it's supposed to be.  It has a good long shelf life, so you don't have to worry too much about tossing it in the pantry and pulling it out when you next find it.Great for camping, day trips, or just if you don't feel like anything complicated.  Time to mix it up?  Just add water.It's not gourmet (and it's not supposed to be).  The consistency is a little off, flavor different than you'd expect for fresh, and boy is this stuff salty.  But what did you expect?  It's soup in a box, and it serves its purpose.  If you wanted gourmet, you wouldn't be getting it from a box anyway.It does what it's supposed to do well, and that's what matters.

column9: just not as good as it used to be
column10: I don't mind the taste with the lower sodium, in fact am glad, but changing the distinctive square shaped noodles to round ones has in my mind ruined the texture and taste of the soup.  I'm using a generic brand now made by Safeway which still has the square noodles, typical of German noodles.  I think also the round noodles are just cut off angel hair pasta and don't have the nice flavor of real egg noodles.

column9: My favorite soup... But where is the low sodium option?
column10: this soup was always my preferred choice when I was sick or just in the mood for chicken noodle soup.My only problem now, is that sodium level is off the charts! If I eat 1 packet, I have eaten my entire day worth of sodium!

I'm not much of a soup person and I like salty things. Growing up (poor in Brooklyn), my mom made this for us on a regular basis and it's still my favorite. Now my 6 yr old loves it too. I like to put less water than recommended for a stronger taste. This also allows me to throw in some ice cubes to cool it down quick when I make it for my daughter. When I have a sore throat, this is my go-to therapy!

column9: Like eating noodles made of chauk
column10: Once years ago Lipton Noodle Soups was great. On late night shift, pull out the thermos and a packet of Lipton noodle soup, and your mouth watered just waiting for it to be ready. Now, most Lipton noodle soups you purchase today, has been sitting on a shelf too long. It a rarity to find one fairly fresh, and yet still there the hint of the feeling the noodles are made of chalk. It obvious they tried to safe a penny too many in regards to their noodle. Stay away from this product.

I sampled the product when I received it and was disappointed to say the least.  I threw the entire order in the trash. I lost about $80.00, but I learned that I should sample before I buy.  Ralph Rivera  Mesa, Az
I used them on top of cup cakes for my neighbors.  Since some of them have small children it was very nice they are edible.  Also it saved me time decorating.

These cookies are absolutely wonderful. They have a completely unexpected but pleasantly fresh and completely savory sweet flavor that is highly addictive! There will not be enough in one tin to get you through, order multiples. You will not be disappointed!

This is a tasty boxed pasta dinner. It tolerates additions well, so it's easy to dress up somewhat.I moved somewhere where no local store seems to carry this. I was delighted to find it on Amazon, and I will be subscribed to this until an outside force prevents it.

This is my favorite Pod Coffee variety.  The aroma is amazing!  I like it better than CafeJo's Vienna roast, and it is my favorite roast of the half-dozen or so Wolfgang Puck roasts I've tried.  It works great in the Senseo coffee maker I use at home (using the 'double' size pod holder), and works great in the Cuisinart Cup-O-Matic we have at my office.  It is also a great value at this price and stocking 3 at a time works well for me, keeping it fresh enough over the time it takes to go through them all since I only use my stock on the weekends.  Enjoy!

column9: Great tasting cappucino in a convenience can
column10: This is cappuccino in an 8.45 oz can, just a bit more than a regular 12 oz soda can. You won't get the, "You got milk mustache" or some cute latte art, but you can really taste a nice combination of strong coffee flavor and milk - tastes great. 100 calories.The milk comes from rBST free cows (I first had to Google it to know what it means), meaning no injection with artificial hormones to increase production of milk. RBST is already banned in Canada, Japan, New Zealand, etc., but not in the US yet.Not better than the hot cappuccino served with the traditional atmosphere, but if you need to run, you can just grab one and throw it in you bag.Product of Denmark.

Illy issimo cappuccino Italian espresso style coffee drink with lowfat milk and cocoa is a nice little 100 calorie treat in a 8.45 fl. oz. (250 ml) can.1930s Italy under the rule of Mussolini greatly contributed to the development of modern coffee culture, improved coffee-making, and new types of coffee-making equipment. The Horn of Africa (where coffee originated) was under Italian colonization and companies such as illy and Bialetti were founded.In that tradition, this drink is now made in Denmark under the issimo brand from illy and distributed in the U.S. by Coca-Cola.This canned cappuccino has a pleasant taste with a good balance of the coffee, milk, cocoa, and sugar with lots of visible solids. To be sure, it's not as good as freshly made cappuccino but it is what it is.

I really like this bulk form of agave. I do a lot of baking with agave, so this is perfect in the gallon size. I think it's great that it came at such a good price too. I would like to see some darker agave options, but I was happy to have found this product. It was light, and not too syrupy which is great for sweetening tea. It also worked well for baking fruit desserts like gallettes & cobblers.
I love using the natural product in my coffee!!! no strange taste like using honey can sometimes give.

I think Madhava Organic Light Agave Nectar is a great product.  The taste is sweet but mild and can be used as asugar replacement. I love it!  Amazon had the best price for Agave and I received my order promptly.Thanks Amazon you gave me everything I wanted without any problems.
AGAVE IS BETTER THAN HONEY, I KNOW SOME DIABETICS WHO USE THIS PRODUCT WITH GREAT RESULTS.IT MIXES  WELL WITH HOT OR COLD LIQUIDS.

Taste Great, no side effects, test your insulin known to raise as compared to an apple.  Looks like honey but has a mild flavor. I use to sweeten my fresh squeezed lemon aide, drizzle on strawberries, carrots, etc. I also use it to make home made candy i.e. almond butter cup with dark chocolate.  Be creative!
I use this product for every sweetening job in my household. No after taste, good for you easy to use sweetener,
