I watch my fat intake and PB2 is my DREAM food. I love it. However, I accidentally ordered this over-sweetened chocolate version. From now on, I will just be buying plain peanut flour or plain PB2. Great consistency, great peanut taste!
I usually add this to my oatmeal in the mornings. It's also perfect to add to pancake batter! I highly recommend it.

I bought this flavor along with just the Peanut Butter one.  I honestly cannot tell the difference between the two.  I will just stick with the Peanut Butter one and avoid this one.  I'm not a huge chocolate fan anyway, but, I bought just to see if I'd like it.

I got my bag today, I love this stuff, tastes like regular pb but without all the calories. I do wish it had a bit more of a chocolate flavor but that can be fixed with some extra cocoa powder. This will last me a while. I wish the bag was resealable. I emptied mine into a container so it will stay fresh longer.

Got this yesterday, have been like a mad scientist since...adding it to almost everything and thinking about more.  Last week got the newsletter from CSPI and PB2 chocolate and plain featured on the back.  CSPI trustworthy, so I went for it.  I normally get a jar of natural peanut butter, pour off the oil and then for several days put in paper towels to sop up the remaining oil.  Then I have maybe a teaspoon at a time - rarely more than a full tablespoon in a day.  We are in Easter Candy Season and the spectre of chocolate peanut butter eggs is everywhere.  Hard to be at peace with oneself when peanut butter - and especially combined with chocolate - is readily available.  Now this PB2 stuff is not especially chocolatey - but it is a wonder and my next order [soon] will be to try the basic version.  The contents of the one pound package will have to be transferred to an air tight container.  Note recipe on the side of the bag:  just plain weird for a "health food product" - a "MexiNut" dip involving an undiluted can of bean with bacon soup, canned tomatoes, velveeta, 1/2 cup of PB2 chocolate, and chilli powder.  As the soup, the tomatoes and the velveeta are sodium nightmares and the soup and velveeta heavy with fat, loaded with addditives, why would the company promote such a disasterous use of its "healthy" product?  Use your own good common sense and happy eating.

I used to love Peanut Butter, but it was always so fattening. Enter PB2 (with Chocolate). Completely delicious, great for storage, emergencies, travel, camping, and weight control ... this product rocks! If you are a "diet-er", get some.  If you love PB, get some and mix with standard to cut fat. This is great product!
Very good, easy to work with, many uses, very good dry on icecream, just sprinkle on top.The only drawback to this product is the cost.  This also covers the plain PB powder.

column9: Great tasting product with half the fat.
column10: I use this product in my whey protein drink. It has great taste and only a fraction of the fat. There are 220 calories in 2 TB of regular PB and only 45 in this version. I took the product with me camping. It mixed well with water for a great sandwich.

Currently on a low carb diet and my doctor recommended me PB2 as an alternative to regular PB. This Peanut Butter is SO GOOD that I think I would still buy it even after I am off the diet. I love how u get tiny chunks of chocolate, which makes me feel compensated from all the diet restrictions.Highly recommended!!!!!! Please note, I did not get it form this seller though, but I wanted to give a review on the peanut butter itself!
Any true peanut butter & chocolate fan will love this product!!! It taste wonderful just on it's own. I couldn't be more happy with my purchase.

unfortunately it was not a full 5 in my opinion cuz i found it was much better with a little truvia and u have to find ur perfect consistency it is absolutely perfect for a peanut butter addict its not completely the same but with the truvia it kinda is and it is AMAZING in baking my junk food bff tried healthy cocoa brownies i made with  it and she absolutely LOVED them so thats saying something!P.S. DO NOT BUY IF YOUR LOOKING FOR IT TO BE EXACTLY THE SAME AS REGULAR PB ITS AMAZING BUT ITSNT EXACTLY THE SAME AS THE REAL THING ON SANDWICHES
I was a huge fan of PB2 for quite some time, but the ingredients kind of irritate me. I wish they made a product without sugar and salt. Just plain defatted peanuts.
I mix mine with almond milk! It is delicious with apples or mixed into a protein shake. I mix it with less milk to make it nice and thick.

I made a chocolate peanut butter banana protein shake with this and OMG...they were amazing!  I used one cup of Unsweetened Vanilla Almond Milk (40 cal), one frozen banana, a scoop of vanilla protein powder (120 cal), 2T of the PB2 (85 cal) and some ice.  YUM!  Low calorie AND delicious!! This is my new favorite drink!!

I ordered PB2 because I absolutely love peanut butter, but I cannot help but eat the entire jar much too quickly every time I buy it. Not only is PB2 lower calorie than regular peanut butter (45 cal for 2 Tbs), it doesn't sit around totally ready to eat. The flavor is not quite the same as normal peanut butter, probably because of the low fat content, but it is still pretty darn good. This chocolate flavor is good, not as peanut buttery as the original flavor though. I will definitely purchase it again.
Love this! You don't have the calorie hit with regular peanut butter and you don't miss a thing in taste! It is honestly wonderful!!!
Easy to mix with water, tastes great. Unique in that you can make little PB truffles with it by reducing the water used! Cool!

This product has helped me break free from the peanut butter habit!!!  It tastes so good!!!  Thank you PB2!  I put it on yogurt and add it to my oatmeal.  It keeps me totally satisfied for hours.  I just ordered my second package with chocolate and regular.  It's a great way to get protein.  Wonderful product!!!

This stuff is ridiculously good. I mean, who would have thought that powdered peanut butter could taste so amazing?! Splendid.The chocolate...or the plain...I need a 55 gallon drum of it. My food of choice on a deserted island or when the US economy crashes.

I've bought this product ever since it came out and I have to say it is without a doubt, one of the most amazing food items ever created for the health nut. Bell Plantation hit the jackpot with this thing. I eat a gallon back per week and the price is reasonable. Would recommend to everybody.
all i can say is ymmmmmmmmmmmmm  Meeeeeeeeee.  Excellent tasting product with few calories, unlike regular peanut butter. Definately worth trying once. It will get you coming back for more.

A friend who is training for a marathon turned me onto PB2.  Since I couldn't find it in my local stores, I searched and found it through Amazon.  I have ordered both varities, regular and this chocolate peanut butter, twice.  I love both of them, but the chocolate peanut butter is probably my favorite because I feel like I'm having a resees cup.  The product is all natural, no added preservatives.  Just the oil has been extracted leaving the peanut butter in a powder form. I add 1 TBSP to my morning shake, and it's awesome.  I have also hydrated it with a little water, and it's just delicious.  200 calories for 2 TBSP of regular p-butter or 45 calories for 2 TBSP of PB2.  You know what I'm picking.  Try it you'll love it.

I use both types like it is going outta style!  I put it in my protein shakes and I use it as a 50 percent substitution in all my protein-related bars of regular peanut butter.  Being in powder formallows YOU to control the consistency.

Having committed to a weight loss plan, I have relied more frequently on healthy smoothies and protein shakes as a quick and easy way to stick to the diet plan. The Bell Plantation PB2 powder has made me look forward to drinking the shakes - absolutely amazing! Before, I just gulped the shake down like it was bad medicine. Now, I can see that it is a factor in sticking to the plan - healthy choices can be quite tasty and delicious.

Man this is good stuff. Put it in my post workout shakes and morning oats. The only difference from the regular appears to be the cocoa powder (thinking i could purchase the cocoa powder seperately and save $$) - just a thought. Regardless; good stuff.

The flavor is fantastic. I tend to like my peanut butter a little thicker, so I usually use a little less water. The richness of the oil which is no longer present in this product is certainly missed when the peanut butter is forced to compete with other flavors, such as in a sandwich... but as a light topping, this product is delicious.

column9: Perhaps My Favorite Food In The World!!
column10: I made a decision years ago to eat healthier, and one of the things that I gave up was peanut butter cups.  However, I was overjoyed when I found PB2 with Premium Chocolate in my local grocery store (I'm also a big fan of the original PB2, btw).  It is in essence peanut butter with 85% less fat.The premise is that they roast the peanuts and then press out the majority of the oil before making the peanut powder.  When you go to use PB2, you add water for moisture to create a much lower fat version of peanut butter.  I find that I need to add a little more water than what the instructions call for in order to make it spreadable.While regular PB2 is good for anything you would use peanut butter for, PB2 with Premium Chocolate is great for sweet treats.  My favorite thing to do is to mix some up and have it with frozen yogurt - either plain vanilla or dark chocolate.  With dark chocolate frozen yogurt, I get something that is very close in flavor to Dryer's Chocolate Ice Cream with Peanut Butter Cups; however it has less than half the calories and only 13 calories from fat!  You can't beat it.The tradeoff you make is having to mix it up.  For me it is worth the effort.  I love this stuff.  In addition to frozen yogurt, it is also good as a topping for energy bars from KIND.  Get creative.  It is low cal, low fat, and it is also filling.  What you mix up is very dense with the majority of the fat removed.  I can't recommend this enough to anyone he is looking for a healthy alternative to satisfy their peanut butter and chocolate cravings.
Sooo good!  It's a great low-fat alternative with lots of peanutty taste for peanut butter addicts like myself!  It's very similar in texture to natural-style peanut butter
Great PB substitute. I sprinkle it over my Yonana soft serve. You can easily mix it with a little water to create creamy and delicious, healthy peanut butter.

This is a great, sweeter alternative to regular PB2 (which I also absolutely adore). It is not very chocolatey, though, so don't go expecting anything near Nutella flavor. Still, for it's nutritional stats it's irreplaceable and the flavor is still quite delicious--it's not overwhelmingly "peanutty" either, so it makes a great middle-of-the-road compromise to satisfy cravings for something different while still being healthy. I've been using this and regular PB2 for about 4 years now and I'll never go back to regular nut butters! It's just too perfect to argue with. WONDERFUL for baking to infuse a chocolate-peanut flavor, and so easy to prepare, not to mention the shelf life is extended without adding hydrogenated oils like most churned peanut butters do!

I don't know who thought of this but it is amazing! i thought i would never be able to eat peanut butter again due to the high fat content but then i discovered this product. i didnt really like it with water added to it but it is delicious mixed in with sugar free vanilla or chocolate ice cream. it is also good in cream of wheat and oatmeal. i mixed it with some strawberry jam and put on toast and it was actually pretty good. my peanut butter craving is satisfied. i hope they never quit making this product!

column9: Where have you been all my life?!
column10: Until now, Weight Watchers has left me peanut butter deprived. Ok, so the texture is not exactly like peanut butter. What do you expect? It's 1 point per serving instead of 5! I am eating this twice a day! Got friends hooked on it, too. It tastes great, and I actually prefer it with apples over peanut butter as it's easier to dip into. Buy youself a Yonana to make "frozen yogurt" from frozen bananas, and stir in a little prepared PB2 with Chocolate for a guilt-free dessert.

This is a great way for me to send a good breakfast to work with hubby without a huge mess.. I toss it in dry form in a Tupperware container with oats and powdered milk and sugar my hubby can take it to work nuke the oats with a little water  and hes got a very good breakfast :) this is also a  great way to jazz up vanilla protein shakes :) I have not yet made a PB sandwich with it but I am sure that would be fantastic as well :) Great taste and a awesome way to get protein and curb your PB and chocolate craving  without all the extra fat :)

I received this product on date promised. Works great in my protein shakes without any lumps as regular peanut butter does. Don't need very much and the taste is perfect. I will purchase more of this PB2...
This is the best healthiest peanut butter I ever bought. It is a fraction of the calories but tremendous taste. I recommend this to everyone who likes peanut butter.

column9: Great low-fat alternative to peanut butter
column10: I was a little skeptical when I first heard about this product, but once you get used to the idea of mixing up your own peanut butter, it's really quite good. I have tried both the plain and the peanut/chocolate version, and I prefer the one with the chocolate for eating on rice cakes and such. However, I have been adding the plain to my chocolate protein shakes, and that works really well too. It's like drinking a candy bar. If I eat the plain one as peanut butter, I usually add some Truvia or honey, because it just doesn't seem sweet enough on it's own. If you order the peanut/chocolate version, I highly recommend sizing up, because it goes rather quickly, and you will wish you had more. You will also save on shipping.

column9: My Fave for Peanut Butter Cup Smoothies!
column10: As a low carber, I am always trying to find products which have a "to die for" taste and also fit nicely into my diet.  This PB2 with chocolate fills the bill to a T!  It's great for baking...(hint mixed with some coconut flour, eggs, sweetener, etc and you have yourself a lovely peanut butter cookie - low carb style)...and perfect for my protein smoothies.  I make a pitcher of my Peanut Butter Cup smoothie because other members of my family have claimed this to be their fave as well.  Using this PB2 with chocolate, Silk Light chocolate soymilk, ice & water, a little bit of sweetener (I have a serious sweet tooth!), a pinch of salt, chocolate protein powder, and a little bit of real peanut butter, I get about 2 quarts of smoothie for cents per serving!  What's more is it's only 110 calories & 10+ grams of protein per 8 ounces!  That's awesome in my book!

I've been doing Weight Watchers and PB2 is great for helping me stay on track.  I can enjoy peanut butter for 1/4 of the points and it's so much easier to use in my smoothies since it is a powder.  The chocolate flavor is great to use with celery as well.  I will never use regular peanut butter again!

I absolutely LOVE peanut butter and almond butter and lately I have been eating a ton of it. I attribute the 10 lbs that I gained over the past 2 month to my new love for nut butters... Then I discovered PB2 and was pretty skeptical of it at first, but it's really good! I eat it with apples, in my PBJs and by the spoonful. I also have been adding it to my Muscle Milk shakes and it adds a fabulous texture and taste to the chocolate MM. I buy it by the pound now :)

I heard about this product in my weight watchers meeting.  I ordered it from Amazon, not expecting much in the way of flavor.  Really, powdered peanut butter?  But a 2 tablespoon serving is only 45 calories (or 1 point in the world of WW), so I was willing to try it no matter how bad it tasted.  Well, I have gone through 4 jars (2 regular and 2 chocolate) and I just ordered the one-lb bag of chocolate.  The main thing I use it for is a Smoothie.  The middle of every afternoon I make a Smoothie with a banana, 2 TB of chocolate PB2, a half cup of fat free milk, and about 3/4 cup of ice.  Blend until smooth.  So, so good, and it is very filling and I don't get hungry again until dinner.  I also use it to make a dip for bananas and apple pieces. (Mix 2 TB with water until smooth.)  The regular flavor is good for this.  (I have used the regular flavor to make a peanut butter sandwich, but it does leave something to be desired used like that.)  I love love love this product.

column9: good, but doesn't taste exactly like peanut butter
column10: I suppose I shouldn't be surprised that powdered peanut butter made with water is not as creamy or smooth as peanut butter made with oil. This product is yummy, and I do eat it, but I've found I eat more than I would if I were eating regular peanut butter because it's not as satisfying. It's not as easy to spread on bread, though it's fine for my celery and peanut butter afternoon snack. I bought both the peanut butter and peanut butter with chocolate and have also found the chocolate taste very subtle. Haven't decided whether I will buy this again.

Now, I am going to be honest. I had gotten the powered peanut butter and honestly, I did not care for it that much. But, if you tried it and felt the same, I encourage you to try the peanut butter chocolate! It is really great! I can actually just make up a couple tablespoons (50 calories, 1 wwpoint!) and eat it straight for a quick sweet treat! It's that good! Want to try something even better? Make up about 4 tablespoons in a bowl, put it in the freezer and....yum! It is a frozen ice cream-like treat! Really, try this and I am sure you will as pleased as I am....! By the way, Amazon was great....this came quickly...as all my Amazon purchases have....they are great!

I love this powdered chocolate peanut butter. I use it to mix into my plain greek yogurt. The taste is soooo good. I am diabetic so the high carb content of flavored yogurts make them a poor choice but using this with the plain yogurt makes it tasty and healthy option.

I love the taste of peanut butter but I just don't want the added calories or points.  This product is great if you like the peanut butter flavor it is a must try for a low cost.  I use it when making a low point strawberry & peanut butter smoothie.  It is the best, great taste, only 1 points-plus for 2 TBSP, and guilt free!  My taste buds are dancing with pleasure.  For my smoothie I use 1 cup of frozen strawberries (in place of ice), 2 Tbsp of PB2 powder, and 1 cup low fat milk just blend for 1 minute and enjoy. Buy this product another way to use it like a spread on wheat crackers (just add water slowly making the consistency you like & stir). Also I have added it to a plain 6oz yogurt & 1 TBSP of PB2 and dipped a banana - if you're following a healthy eating plan you have got to try this as a new snack or even a breakfast.  I think my next experiment will be with adding it to sugar free frozen yogurt or sugar free vanilla ice cream.  Yummy  : )  Thanks for reading my comment.

column9: Low fat, low sodium, great for baking or smoothies
column10: I've used regular powdered peanut butter for baking in the past (not PB2 brand) and really liked it.  It stores well long-term without going rancid like the oils in regular peanut butter do.  It also adds a great peanuty flavor to cookies, cakes and pies.I was happy to find this chocolate flavor available here on Amazon.  It's a little expensive at $10.99 per pound, but with free SuperSaver shipping for orders over $25 I decided to try it.  And since most recipes would use 2-4 tablespoons of powder, a pound will last at least as long as a big jar of regular peanut butter.When my order arrived I was very happy to see that it is vacuum sealed in a thick mylar bag.  This keeps it fresh and dry for several years, if unopened.  I opened mine and followed the directions - 2 TBL powder, 1 TBL water, and mixed well.  It became a nice paste with a slightly grainy texture and delicious chocolate peanut flavor.  It was reminiscent of coffee, and not overly sweet.  It wouldn't be fair to compare it to full fat, mechanically mixed peanut butter, but I thought it was really tasty.The best thing about this product is the reduced fat and calories.  I compared labels from regular peanut butter and PB2 chocolate powdered peanut butter and these were the comparisons (regular PB on the left, PB2 on the right):Fat: 16 gm / 1 gmCalories: 190 / 45Carbs: 7 gm / 6 gmSodium: 150 mg / 70 mgProtein: 7 gm / 4 gmI'm very pleased with this product and will definitely buy it again!
If you have cravings for peanut butter, but you don't want the calories - this is for you.  This stuff is awesome!!  I love it on toast, in smoothies...any way possible.  It's great.

I bought the two pack with both flavors and I actually found that I like this one way more. It is almost like a peanut butter cup. The only downside is that it is pretty expensive. If there is ever a sale I would definitely stock up.
This is so good in smoothies and as a fruit dip. So much better than eating all the fat and sugar in regular peanut butter. I should have ordered two jars.

It's not often that I'm really impressed with a new product on the market.  In the world of nut butters, what could anyone expect that would really be new?  When I first heard about PB2 products on a food blog, I was skeptical to say the least.  When I showed it to my wife, she was even more skeptical.  But then I took a piece of freshly baked banana bread, reconstituted some chocolate PB2 and spread it on top.  We were both amazed.  While PB2 isn't exactly like peanut butter, it is plenty close for me.  The peanut flavor is true and tasty.  Considering the savings in calories, this is one of the best calorie saving products I've seen introduced in a very long time.  My only con is the cost.  The stuff is expensive.  As such, it will remain a product we don't indulge in as often as we like.  But when the mood strikes, it's good to know we can enjoy peanut butter and still manage to lose weight.  5 stars for product quality, flavor and ingenuity.  2 stars for price.  Perhaps that can improve as their customer base grows - I can only hope.  Regular PB2 and Chocolate PB2 both work great for me.  Some may not prefer the chocolate flavor, but that's as much personal taste as anything else.  The quality of the product is very good.

I stumbled upon this product while doing an Amazon search for Miracle Noodle, and luckily for me, that search found me my new favorite health food EVER. I was very skeptical when I saw the description, but I read the overwhelmingly positive reviews and decided to give it a shot. I absolutely LOVE this stuff. It's super easy to make too... just pour the powder, add water, and mix.  I would suggest adding the powder and mixing in the water bit by bit.  I haven't had peanut butter in years... I developed stomach issues and foods that are too heavy or very high in fat make my condition worse, but this takes me right back to the days I could eat peanut butter by the spoonful. I just ordered the 2 pack, and I can't wait for it to get here :)
This tastes great.  I love peanut butter, but not all the fat.  I mix this with my protein shake and it tastes great.

This is a wonderful product that allows you to spice up your smoothies or "mix-as-you-go" to create a great apple dip/spread.  IT IS peanutbutter, so it tastes like it.  They've just pressed out all of the fat. I prefer this to the plain PB2, but I'm a big chocoholic, so you can't go wrong by adding some cocoa. I like it so much, I haven't let the kids taste it, because I know they'll polish it off!
Try this on popcorn. It is very good! I bought mine direct from Bell Plantation.The price here is not right.I give it a four for flavor but take away 2 for costing twice what it should

This is truly as good -- if not better - than the real thing.  And a fraction of the fat grams.  At first, I thought powdered peanut butter would be discusting.  But it smells wonderful and tastes just as wonderful.  And great for travel.  Just add some water and you have peanut butter!  I keep a jar in my desk drawer for quick snacks.  Make it as thick or "thin" as you want. I am hooked!  And did I say a fraction of the fat grams..............

This product is fantastic.  I am a weight watcher and love peanut butter.  This way I can have all of the taste without all of the calories.  I use it all of the time.  It makes the best smoothies.  Thanks...
personally, i think this one with chocolate is purrrrrrrfect! just rightwill order again and againnow i wish we'd get almond, cashew and other nut "butters" like this

column9: Not Peanut Butter, Peanut Flavored Peanut Butter
column10: I ordered this at the asking of my wife because she is dieting. I was against it from the start, but I will make my review fair.The product is not peanut butter, if you expect peanut butter than you will be disappointed. It tastes like peanut butter. If I could compare it to something it is like eating a regular Oreo and a reduced fat Oreo. The reduced Oreo tastes like and Oreo, but really just leaves you wanting the real thing. This product is no different. If you mask it will jelly and bread, the off taste becomes less noticeable, but there in lies the problem. You have to add more calories back in to make this product taste better. There by negating the fact that you have cut calories. As I explained to my wife after we both decided this product was not for us. The problem with any peanut butter food is normally everything but the peanut butter. The fat is the healthiest part. You wouldn't eat omega free fish because it's lower in fat, why would you do the same to peanut butter?The only way I could recommend this is if you are doing a starvation sort of diet (i.e. you eating this with celery and water). If you are doing a healthy diet don't cut out the peanut butter of your PB&J, cut out the jelly first and then the grain. I eat again "regular" non-hydrogenated peanut butter will celery, now there is a healthy food.Pros+lower calorie+great price here on amazon+does taste similar to peanut butterCons-less nutritional value-doesn't taste like real peanut butterI will give it four stars if you are doing a starvation sort of diet, which I don't recommend, but it does taste alright for a lot less calories. For everyone else I give it one star as you should not be eating products like this and the product itself is not that good. Overall 2 stars, weighted towards everyone else.

As I said above, I LOVE this stuff. Yeah all capitals on love ;). I have been eating this product for almost a year now, and while I started with the regular peanut butter flavor, I tried the chocolate soon after and never looked back. I use this every morning in my homemade oatmeal. I use instant Quaker multigrain oats about 50 grams(much heartier & filling than regular quick oats), along with some dark brown sugar 6 grams, a sprinkle of Butter Buds season salt, a serving of Chocolate PB2, some kosher salt to taste don't know how much & about 11-12 grams of Ghirardelli 60% bittersweet chocolate chips (they're dark chocolate chips). Overall when I use 50g of instant oats,  it is about 295 calories according to My Fitness Pal calorie counting app on my phone. Using the serving size of 40g is about 262 calories. 40g is 1 serving according to the container I believe but I like just a little more.  I got the idea when I purchased the Quaker instant oatmeal in Chocolate Chip flavor for my kids. I was starting a diet and was eating as healthy as possible, and I thought hey, I can make this but in a healthier form. I have since been eating this and an apple daily for breakfast for about 9 months now and it's the only thing I look forward to eating every morning. That's amazing since I usually get sick of eating the same thing after awhile and need a break. Sometimes I never even crave that particular food again if I've really overeaten on it. I now often eat it as part of my dinner as well since I crave it so often. It's almost like a dessert when I use semi-sweet or milk chocolate chips. I have also used different types of chocolate chips (semi sweet, milk chocolate, Hershey's special dark choc, etc.) but usually go back to using the Ghirardelli due to the so called health benefits of eating small amounts of dark chocolate that is made of at least 60% cacoa. I have maintained my goal weight for the past 9 months and have not gained additional weight eating this, so for me it is not only healthy, but a somewhat guilt free indulgence at times when my body craves a sweet dessert. All good things in moderation though, if I ate this in larger quantities or more often in the day the carbs and sugar Would catch up to me and I would start to gain weight again, so just like everything else you need to be conscious of calories in and calories out if you want to add this to a healthy diet. Love it!!!

Actually this stuff is pretty good! There's a 'no calorie' peanut spread being sold on here that you should avoid. I bought and have tried this and the regular PBS (non chocolate) and like and recommend both!

I honestly couldn't taste even a hint of peanut butter or chocolate in this product.  Waste of money!  I'd rather not have peanut butter than attempt to substitute with an inferior product like this again.

I rate this 4 stars only because the chocolate flavor isn't as flavorful as it could be.  The chocolate could be more distinct.  That said, the PB2 product is wonderful.  The regular PB2 peanut butter is definitely a 5 star treat.  Quick and easy to mix and it blends well without clumping or lumping.  I've been using this product for the two years I've been on Weight Watchers and I don't miss regular peanut butter at all.

This was recommended by my nutritionist as I have a lap band & do not need extra fat & calories.  It has a great taste & satisfies my craving for desserts late at night.  I also put this in my yogurt breakfast shake with a banana.  Great treat & highly digestible.  Love this chocolate flavor & the regular peanut butter flavor. Very satisfied with price & fast delivery from Amazon.

column9: Great for what I needed it for!
column10: I use this for my breakfast shakes in the morning.  It adds peanut taste and protein without the fat!  I have also hydrated it and had it on toast and it is pretty good but I do miss the oil consistency a little bit.

I ordered both the PB2 plain, and the chocolate/peanut butter variety, and have been vastly pleased with both.  I have mixed both according to directions, eaten them with crackers, and mixed them with raisins and sunflower seeds.  My favorite use, however, is in the refrigerator porridge recipe.Enjoy!

column9: OK, but not for my taste
column10: I like the regular PB2, the taste of this product is strange, doesn't seem to be a discernable chocolate taste. I'm not a smoothie person so if it doesn't taste good by itself right out of the jar, then I'm not going to be a fan. Again, not bad, but not for me, I won't be buying again, but have ordered the regular PB2 again, I luv that!

To help me with my Weight Watchers diet, I have been searching for a healthy peanut butter.  I found PB2 on Amazon and gave the regular flavor a try.  It is perfect for my needs.  When I saw the chocolate I had to give it a try.  It is wonderful!! I mix the powder to a peanut butter consistancy and spread over toast.  I mix the power in milk for a wonderful milk shake.  And it fits perfectly within my Weight Watchers diet, giving me lots of flavor for a minimum of points (you WW's know what I'm talking about.)  My daughter loves it, as do most of the people who have tasted it.Because it is a powder, it does not contain fat.  People expecting a rich peanut butter/chocolate taste may be disappointed.  However, after a few tries I find I like this much better than traditional peanut butter.  I like it so much I have ordered it 3 times, and will continue to order this delicious treat.
I really liked this product. For me, there's not much need to have a dry powder regularly on-hand, but it does make good shakes, so I'm glad that I tried it.
This stuff is great! I love peanut butter, but can't afford the high calories and fat. This allows me to add a ton of peanut butter flavor to my protein shakes without all the calories or fat.

column9: Not as Flavorful as the regular PB2
column10: I bought both the PB2 & the Chocolate PB2.  I am pretty disappointed in the chocolate.  It has neither a strong chocolate nor a strong peanut butter flavor.  Not worth the money.

column9: Great Product if Jiff is Excluded from One's Diet
column10: In November of 2011, I downloaded the LiveStrong App and began making better choices in what I eat and began to control my caloric intake.  Limiting myself to 2,000 calories per day does not leave much room for peanut butter, or rather, sitting down in the living room in front of the television with a sleeve of crackers and my beloved jar of Jiff peanut butter and a butter knife.  Those days have long been over.  However, I still have the urges and I miss peanut butter badly.  I stumbled across PB2 when I was doing some research on a machine called Yonanas, a machine that turns frozen bananas into a creamy tasty soft serve.  I noticed in the machine reviews that some people were mixing chocolate PB2 with frozen bananas in their Yonanas machine.  I had to give this a try!  I ordered a regular PB2 and a chocolate PB2.  I must say that this stuff really really does taste wonderful considering its low calorie count.  I really love PB2.  It is giving me back something I have missed dearly.  The powder is very fine, but mixes pretty well and pretty quick.  I always start with a little less water than the directions say and work up to a little more if needed.  It is absolutely delicious to someone like me that has removed traditional peanut butter from his diet.  I highly recommend this product.  It is a pricy product, but worth every cent!  No regrets.

column9: not much, if any, chocolate flavor
column10: After trying -- and liking -- the regular PB2 product, I decided to try this variety with "premium chocolate" added.  Quite honestly, I have a hard time tasting the difference between this variety and the PB2 product without chocolate.  Maybe I could discern the difference during a side by side comparison, but by itself this product doesn't really taste like chocolate at all.  It just tastes like sweet peanut butter.The only reason I'm giving it three stars is that it still tastes okay and I like this product generally -- a good way to get some peanut flavor without all the calories.  But if you're looking for a chocolate/peanut product to replace your Reese's Peanut Butter Cup habit, this product isn't it.

This is the chocolate version of the normal PB2. While this product, like the original PB2, is mostly devoid of the healthy fats found in natural peanut butter, this product is a GREAT way to get that peanut butter flavor into baked goods, drinks, and so on without the added calories and fat!

This is a fantastic product. I promote this product with all of my Visalus customers to use in their shakes. 2scoops Vi shake, 1 tbsp PB2, 1 whole banana, 8oz milk. Delicious. Cost only thing keeping it from 5 star rating.
I love peanut butter. Losing weight didnotgowithmy consumption, this is an enjoyable low calorie way to eat peanut butter. I add a little Splenda, dip apple chunks and yum!

I heard about this product through a friend and decided to give it a try. Peanut butter without the fat, yes please! I found this product to be delicious and use it mainly in refrigerator oatmeal. It tastes just like peanut butter and mixes perfectly! Not to mention it lasts a while so you are definitely getting the bang for your buck. I can't wait to try this in smoothies and PB cookies! I am for sure recommending this to my friends! Give it a try!

I stumbled across the availability of this food article while recently perusing Amazon's staggeringly-enormous and virtually-endless catalog. It's incredible how much stuff is at your electronic fingertips on this website -- including this old-fashioned candy bar, which brings back memories from childhood.Another fondly-remembered candy bar from a more youthful era is a bar called "Zero". It's covered in white chocolate; and it, too, is a taste treat! And that particular sweet-tasting confection is also available to order here at Amazon.com as well. So stock up!"Oh Henry!" candy bars were always a favorite of mine from decades gone by, and it's nice to know that you can still buy these rather hard-to-locate chocolate goodies somewhere. I don't think I've seen this brand of candy available at supermarkets in many years. Maybe they are available in some areas, I don't know. But they're good hunks of candy, I know that for sure.There is also a "peanut butter" version of the "Oh Henry!" bar available too. I've never had the pleasure of consuming one of those however. But it, too, sounds good.Just don't buy too many at once, or you'll never stop eating 'em. :)Here are a few bits of info and trivia regarding the "Oh Henry!" candy brand...........The "Oh Henry!" candy bar was created in 1920 by the Williamson Candy Company of Chicago, Illinois. It came to Canada through The Lowney Company in 1924 and has been one of Canada's leading candy bars ever since. The "Oh Henry!" bar contains caramel, fudge, and peanuts, and is coated in a layer of milk chocolate. The bar was named after a boy who used to come into the Williamson Candy Company factory to flirt with the girls making the candy. Every time the girls needed something done, they would call "Oh Henry!"."Hershey Canada" acquired the Canadian rights to this bar from Nabisco on July 1, 1987. It is manufactured by Nestle in the U.S.A.The Oh Henry! bar is currently available in Canada in two flavors: Original and Peanut Butter. A limited-edition "Honey Roast" variety was also introduced in February 1999, and to huge success. The Oh Henry! bar consistently ranks as one of the Top 5 candy bars across Canada.Oh Henry! is the favorite bar of the Toronto Blue Jays baseball club. For the past 10 years, Oh Henry! has distributed 25,000 Blue Jays' baseball-card sets to lucky fans. Sets are also donated to fan clubs and charities across Canada.

By far one of the best tasting chocolate bars ever created.  Unfortunately I do not find it in most USA stores and when it is found it is usually the smaller version that is not as tasty.  The large Oh Henry bars can be found in abundance in The Bahamas

This product is awesome, it has a fresh smells that lasts for a couple of days on my 6 year old Golden Retreiver.  He requires a lot of grooming and I normally use this product right after bathing him so he smells fresh and clean and every 2 days when I brush him to freshen up his coat.  Also I use it after walks when he is really smelly as I live in a city apartment.  Everyone compliments him and I has stopped buying dog perfume or sprays as they dont serve a purpose and the smells fades right away.

Love this product. Discovered this after picking our dog up from a kennel years ago. Our dog smelled so good. I inquired about what she had used on our dog. She advised it was the fresh n clean line of shampoo's and sprays. I continue to use this great product between baths and recommend it to all dog owners.

I have been using Fresh n' Clean for 12 years now and still love it.It's great at making my Bichon Frise look as though she's just had a bathand grooming.Spray it on and brush it out.  One fluffy white ball is delivered.When working on a area that is crusty or gooey, like under the eyes from tearing, I spray it on a clean soft paper towel and apply it with my hand rather than spray her face and get it in her eyes or nose. I let it soak for a couple minutes and then remove the hard particles with my fingers and brush out the rest with a soft, small grooming slicker.If your dog is like mine and likes to mop up her bowl with her face, or stick her snout where it doesn't belong, this will save them a dreaded bath.I've used many other spray products over the years thinking they were all the same or because the local stores didn't carry Fresh n' Clean but none of them fluffed and whitened her up like this does.

column9: Extremely low quality bottle (it broke before it arrived!)
column10: I was never able to use the product because the courier notified me that the bottle arrived busted at Miami (that's where all my orders ship from).I've purchase other shampoo bottles, cleaners etc. from Amazon but I think these guys just didn't do a good enough job at the packaging.

I bought this item for my granddaughter's birthday.  Thought by the info that it would be more creative and crafty.  It turned out to be mostly candy.  Not worth the price at all.The box looked nice and attractive except for one corner being severly dented.  Consequently their packageing also needs some work.

This is a wonderful little gift box. Perfect for birthday gifts fora child between 2 and 6 years old. Some of the paint was a little cheap, but there is no way you could buy this stuff separately and get it any cheaper.

I got this as a gift for my niece who has a day care center.  This great basket was promptly delivered with a great variety of items for the children in her care - although I will say that she wanted to keep the coloring book for herself!  Very reasonable price for a reusable basket that will deliver hours of entertainment.

I have seven grand kids. 2 of them fell off a play ground equipment at the same time. one is in a leg cast, The other one hurt her back. They are 3 & 7. They loved it and it gave them alot to do. They put everything on the floor and sent me a picture. There certainly were overwhelmed.

Lamb chews seem a bit more oily than other types of chews and they wouldn't last long with an aggressive chewer. My dog liked them but they don't last long. She is a terrier so small/medium sized dog but she is a strong chewer and had them gone within a couple of minutes. They are rather pricey but made in the USA from free ranging sheep.

If you are from England you know there is no substitute for UK made HP Sauce and you also know that the US made version just doesn't cut it. This is the real thing. Having found this I will no longer have to buy a years worth of HP Sauce before I head for Heathrow on each visit. Now to enjoy the real flavor with my baked beans, cheese on toast and many other delicacies from the British Isles.

I love this sauce on beef, especially hamburgers and steak!  I tried it on chicken, but it didn't do much for me ... don't know if HP makes a sauce for chicken, pork or fish ... if not, sure wish they did!

To me, this sauce tastes like a combination of ketchup and worcestershire sauce. It is mild and goes perfectlywith steaks. I introduced this to my husband who normally eats ketchup on his steaks and he loved it. I thinkthis is better than most steak sauces I've tried.

On a 5 star scale I consider 2.5 starts as average. Since Amazon does not allow for half ratings, I put in 2, but consider this item a 2.5 star rating of average. Needless to say I purchased a bottle of HP Sauce and promptly tried it with a meal. It is sweeter and more one-note in flavor than I was expecting. It's neither catsup (sweet), nor Worchestershire (complex) nor A-1 (a bit of sweet and complex). It is somewhat sweet and vinegary, but the "complex" I was hoping for did not come through for me. For example when using Worchestershire or A1 the tongue picks up numerous levels of spice, sweet and savory that I did not get here. To be clear, HP Sauce is pretty good, but for me at least, it will not replace the aforementioned sauces.

column9: I just love this British steak sauce,it's so yummy on steak and burgers
column10: I first tried HP steak sauce when I lived in Florida,I became a fan,I still bought A1 Steak sauce,this sauce is just as good,it's also good on burgers,french fries,and fried egg sandwiches.A friend sent me three bottles for Christmas,and I can't wait to get some in my mouth,this sauce is so delicious,and I took steak out for tonights dinner.If you are an A1 fan,HP is a must try,it's right up there with A1,and no I will never give up my A1,but to be able to have HP on my steak tonight,I can't wait.

column9: World's Best Bar-B-Que Sauce -- on Amazon only!
column10: Our family, originally from Texas, considers this the best barbeque on the market.  Lately we cannot find it in our local stores, and even Costco is not carrying it.  But finding it onlne, I ordered a gallon and now we're set for the summer!  It is a wonderful sauce, smoky and not too sweet, with a little bit of tang.

We have not had Cattleman's Barbecue Sauce since moving from Oklahoma 22 years ago.  I decided to kook on the internet and found it.  We have used it three times and it is everybit as good as we remembered it.
This sausage was small but big on flavour , it's one of the best summer sausage I have ever tasted not overly salty or garlicy

column9: These Cups Go Over Well In Our House.
column10: I always liked fruit cocktail as a kid and I especially liked it because there was always a cherry or two in every can. Well, now I find these little cups of Dole Cherry Mixed Fruit and I have a little boy of 3.5 years. Well. first of all, I enjoy the cups. Plus I like the fact that it's packed in fruit juice with no added sugar. These things work well in our house.Gary Peterson

column9: JUICE SPILLS OUT WHEN YOU PULL OFF THE LID
column10: Just the right size for a snack any time. The lids are easy to remove and the bowl fits the hand. But you can't open it without the juice spilling out.

column9: Kids liked it, it was second favorite at a picnic
column10: A few weeks ago we had a picnic party where several couples had kids who did not like fresh fruit. We purchased Cherry mixed fruit cups (as well as Dole Mandarin Oranges Fruit Cup, 16-4 Oz. Cups) as an option for desert hoping to please them. I am happy to report they they liked the fruit cups!Mandarin Oranges was the favorite choice with both kids and adults, the kids seem to enjoy Cherry Mixed fruit as well. However, at the end of the day there were no Mandarin Orange cups left but a few Cherry fruit cups remained uneated. The fruit cups are 80 calories and 18 grams of sugar which is pretty good (a fresh apple, for comparison, is on average is 80 calories and 15 grams of sugar)I recommend these fruit caps as an option to a healthy desert!**NOTE**: at the time of writing this review the photo did not match the product. This is NOT Dole brand, this is Del Monte brand fruit cups.Ali Julia review
Purchased the 'Dole' fruit cups packed in fruit juice. Received the 'DelMonte' fruit cups packed in corn syrup. Still the wrong product, despite the title and photo!

I have a 10-month old Maine Coon who gets only very healthy canned foods with no wheat, no corn, no by-products and free feeds a variety of dry foods, same ingredient requirements.  A sample of these was in a basket at the vet's office, so I picked one up.  In spite of some of the less-than-health conscious ingredients, Dexter loves these things.  I figure he eats healthy all the time, so a few of these is like us having the occasional dessert.  He would give them 50 stars if he could.
My very picky cat loves Greenies, they are the only treat he will eat now. The vet said it's a great pick as well.

I've been buying Greenies for my cats for years and they simply love them. They are nothing like the dental chews for dogs and instead of being pliable, they are hard and crunchy.  I honestly don't know how good these are for their teeth, but I do know there isn't much tartar when I go for the yearlies with my pets and my Vet does recommend this product.  Plus, my cats like them!  I just mix them in with their food and I can tell they sometimes pick them out to eat - they like them as much as I do!

column9: your cat will love them, but they aren't a healthy snack.
column10: I got my Maine Coon from a breeder.. when I told her I was feeding him these, she about snapped on me. Her words:" Do not feed greenies! They contain bisulfite complex, which is synthetic Vit K. It is a carcinogen and causes kidney & liver problems. No upper end product uses it anymore. The FDA has banned it in human products. Do not feed anything with Menadione Sodium Bisulfite. They will often call it Mendadione, Mendadione Sodium, Bisulfite Complex or various combinations of the words. It was used because it was a cheap source of Vit K. "I trust what she says, she's been in the business for almost as long as I've been alive and her cats include several champions.
I have two DSH when they know that I have these treats out, they come running. very nice because it forces them to chew rather than just inhaling then in whole.

Best miso soup you'll get outside of A) home-cooked or B) a restaurant. Out of all the instant miso soup types on the market, this is the one you want.The only complaint about miso soup I hear from Westerners is that when they try to make it themselves, it turns out too watery. Japanese have miso in much smaller bowls than your average cereal bowl, so if you don't have the right type, just use a large mug. That keeps the water-to-miso ratio at the correct amount, so you'll be able to get the full, delicious flavor.Enjoy.

When I first opened this package I grabbed a packed & put it into a cup of hot water, too bland, needs seasoning.  Then I read the pkg.(DUH)  1 for seasoning & 1 for the tovu/seaweed. The printing on the envelopes are different colors - but they are all silver so did not stand out as separate packages. Not bad after I used both. Not as good as the package in the store (Lipton I think, perhaps Knorr) but for camping, quick traveling, they are just what I wanted. Will order again. Price is certainly great!

I really like having miso soup with my lunch at work.  I saw the Hikari Instant Miso Soup, 40 servings, and I thought that this would be a good deal. I like instant miso soup that has the paste and the packet of tofu and dried seaweed better than the powder mix so I was really looking forward to trying this.  Well, I was little disappointed.  The miso has a different taste to it compared to others that I have tasted. It was rather bland, too.  So, overall, this is just okay. I probably won't buy it again.

column9: Good tasting soup - "Instant" is a bit of a stretch.
column10: I thought the taste of this soup was very good.  Each serving comes in two packets.  One contains the dried seaweed, some spices I think, and the dry tofu.  The other packet - and here's the part that makes it less than "Instant" for me - the miso comes in a separate packet labeled "Miso Paste".  The miso paste is squishy and liquid, a little messy, and definitely not the powder form I was expecting.  I'm guessing that the paste form tastes better but I was hoping for something I could just dump into a cup of hot water and not have to wash my hands after.  And that isn't the case with this stuff.
This is as good as any DME I have used before. It fermented well and made some good light ale.

column9: Quality is good but be careful of shipping costs
column10: Product was good but I quickly discovered ordering something like malt (which is ordered by the pound) it would be cheaper to purchase this type item from your local supplier (even if the price is a little higher). Unless you don't have a home brew store within driving distance this is probably not the way to go.

If you like canned spinach, Del Monte Whole Leaf is for you! I tried another brand of chopped spinach (on the label, it has a famous cartoon sailor with one squint eye, unusually large forearms with an anchor tat, a pipe in his mouth ... and he is one of my childhood cartoon heroes) and it had a lot of water with some spinach in the can as opposed to Del Monte Whole Leaf which is largely spinach with some water. I like mine with a little salt and vinegar. It is a good value on the "subscribe and save" program otherwise the shipping is prohibitive. Low on strength? ... Eat your spinach for more "muss-culls"!

If you have ever "craved" spinach (I know -- I must seem odd), you will like this.  The first choice is of course fresh spinach but that is not always possible. Frozen is good too but may not be readily available either.  So if canned spinach is your remaining option, this is a superior brand.  I like to add it into dishes where it's not expected -- it brightens the final dish surprisingly.  I particularly like it in pasta dishes. And, of course, it has all sorts of goodness nutritionally!

column9: how can watermelon taste like licorice?
column10: I have purchased the cinnamon jelly beans from this company and they were fantastic so I tried the watermelon. They were delivered quickly and they were extremely fresh.  Unfortunately, they have a licorice aftertaste which I cannot understand.  It really disappointed me.
This is a smooth coffee that is roasted light.  So if you are the kind of person who likes starbucks coffee, you probably will not like this stuff.  Starbucks coffee is over roasted in my opinion.
I like Breakfast coffee and this is a good one. Unfortunately, this price keeps climbing (all coffe beans are too.).

The first time I ordered this coffee from Amazon, I thought it was excellent, it had a bold, rich taste.  The 2nd time I ordered it, it didn't seem to be the same coffee, lacked the bold, rich taste.  It was still a good cup of coffee, but not the same; maybe Cameron's changed the "formula" because the packaging was different.  Coffee is really a matter of personal taste, so don't take my comments as the definitive answer. I would still try it again! Thus, 4 out of 5 stars.  (Like I said earlier, coffee taste is a personal choice.  I'm still looking for the BEST tasting coffee available! Anybody?!  Until then, I'll keep trying!)

column9: very chocolatey and a good flavor of mint.
column10: Beside the fact that even a diabetic can possibly enjoy these, and they are a good energy bar without a sugar spike etc. They also taste quite yummy. the texture is somewhat like a cake brownie, and the mint is sort of mild like an Andes mint. Not real strong. The choco flavor is like a dark chocolate. I love the fact that it is supposed to help keep ones energy up and cravings down. Haven't eaten enough to vouch for this yet, but we went ahead and subscribed for this and the peanut flavor for the monthly shipments to gain the extra discount. Figured we couldn't go wrong.

column9: great tasting, low carb snack for diabetics and others
column10: I was so pleased when Amazon decided to carry as a subscribe and save item these wonderful-tasting, low carb bars.  This is a great product for Type 1, 2 and gestational diabetics as well as those looking to eat yummy food without worrying about the carbs or the chemicals that low-carb snacks are often made with.  These are great!

I am normally not over the moon about nutrition bars, but Solo GI has me there!  I love all the flavours, but this one tops them all - it reminds me of the Girl Scout Thin Mint Cookies... I look forward to my preworkout snack more and more these days, it tastes so good it must be sinful!

I love the Mint Mania SoLo Bar!  The low glycemic quality works well with my metabolism; I get an even energy that lasts.  Great for a quick breakfast, for an energy boost before a long workout, or anytime you're hungry and need something to hold you over before a meal.  I think the flavor of the Mint Mania SoLo bar is the best I've tasted; not too sweet,great chocolate, and perfectly minty.  And it has a pleasing mouth feel; smooth and satisfying.  This is by far the best energy bar I've ever tasted.  Try it!
The texture and flavor of these bars don't go well together.  The berry bliss and the chocolate charger are much much better.
These bars seemed to "hold back hunger" and kept me satisfied for a longer period of time than others I've tried.  The flavors are quite tasty.

column9: As tasty and decadent as a chocolate cake
column10: I love these carrot cakes. I order them here as well as straight from their website. It has this awesome glaze that reminds me of chocolate. It is fresh. Feel free to warm it in the oven.The only reason I rated it 4 stars instead of the 5 is the texture...it is very crumbly. It is a hit or miss for me to cut a slice without it falling apart. Now, this could be me not using the right utensils.Other than that: Taste, Freshness, Customer Service, Product Delivery - all 5 stars!

column9: Very good bread, tastes like homemade
column10: I've always liked quick breads, my mother does little baking these days so I thought I would try these out,,,,,,did the carrot, banana, and zuchini-all were very good, delivery was fast,,,,,,,unfortuately I have an egg allergy so I could only try a slice or two but my family is enjoying them.

These are the best panko breadcrumbs that I have used in the past 5 years.I like that they are all natural.and they help make the best baked fried chicken. They stand up to a lot of dipping.and are always crisp.They do a baked fried catfish justice. Super Panko!  Joe Griffin, North Port. Florida
Read about Panko in several cookbooks.  This was definitely the best buy out there--although I have enough to last me several years! Would recommend this product.

When a recipe calls for Panko Breadcrumbs there is no adequate substitute. I have tried several brands and this one is by far the best. It is very light and crunchy and bakes very well. They are a little coarse for some types of fish so try running them in a food processor if you prefer a finer texture. Very reasonably priced.

Got the 12 pack, husband suggested we open a restaurant with that much breadcrumbs. But I was surprised how fast we went through them, and we don't even use breadcrumbs that much. Anyway, this is the only brand I've tried so can't compare to anything else, but it works.
Ian's Panko (original) is great for breading and as an added ingredient.  There are no "goofy" ingredients.  I use it all the time.

column9: Good Quality and a Great Buy
column10: These panko bread crumbs are good and it's great having a supply on hand.  I bought them at Amazon because the price was better than the grocery store.

With the super hot summer we have had in Michigan, I was looking for a cost effective rehydration drink that wouldn't cost me $1 a serving.  This product sure delivers!  I don't mix 2.5 gallons at a time.  I did the math and figured out that I can mix 2.5 Tbsp of powder per 16-20 oz bottle of water and it avreages out to a NICKEL PER SERVING!  Try to find that deal with the other name brands!

column9: Ok - but not really pepper pot enough for me!
column10: Tried this out and it was just OK - nothing great or even close in flavor to Campbell's (former) pepper pot soup. Kind of tasted more like a cross between  Manhatten style clam chowder (75%) and pepper pot soup (25%). It had some spice to it, but not the bite that real pepper pot soup has. A pretty good deal from Amazon for 6 cans for $21 however.

column9: Was looking for a Campbell's Replacement - This ain't it
column10: So I am still lamenting that Campbells discontinued their Pepper Pot soup.  I found this on Amazon when looking for a replacement.  The soup is OK.  You can tell that they attempted a quality product.  However, it is expensive and it is nothing like Campbell's Pepper Pot.  I grew up on that soup and yearn for the flavor.  I would love to find some cans of it somewhere.  Anyway, this is not it and not worth the money.

I ordered a case of pepper pot soup since Campbell's was discontinued.I was hoping it was similar since I was a weekly purchased. To my dismay I was not satisfied with your product, it was not spicy and lacked flavor resulting in my cancelling the monthly purchase plan. If you can copy a version of Campbell's with tripe I would be a weekly buyer.

column9: Bookbinders Pepper Pot Soup from Amazon.com
column10: Great tasting soup!!  I used to regularly eat Campbell's Pepper Pot with tripe & loved it. This seafood version is even better!!

column9: If you like Campbells Pepper pot soup then don't buy this!
column10: Not at all like pepper pot soup, it is just a crab soup that has very little flavor and in no way should be called pepper pot.

column9: A gift for the Dad who has everything!
column10: I searched and searched for regular pepper pot soup to no avail.  My Dad fondly remembers having that soup with his Dad and I wanted to surprise him.  I settled for this seafood pepper pot soup as the 'next best thing' and am glad that I did so.  My Dad wanted to heat some up right away!  The soup is not as hot as he remembers but be forewarned he really likes HOT!

column9: Oh Yum! I had these as a child in England.
column10: I was a little reluctant to buy these Turkish Delights because I remembered that they were big and soft; I don't like soft candy, but I love firm chewy candy. Well, I got them in the mail and opened the box (which didn't match the picture, as the other reviewer noted), but the picture is not what I'm after! These Turkish Delights are cut into 1x1" cubes and they are perfect for just popping in your mouth. The sweet Rose flavor doesn't hit you at first, but then it gets stronger and smoother the more you chew. They are very firm and, boy, do you have to chew, since these have those lucious nuts in them. I am so pleased with these Turkish Delights that I've got to buy more, for my whole family! The only things I might comment on are: there are not very many nuts in the candies, no where close to what the picture shows, but they are very lovely candies anyway, and I hope these are stocked forever -- without the hugh hikes in prices I've been seeing.

I have sampled turkish delight all over Turkey and this is among the best I've had.  I was surprised that the candy is VERY fresh, and also delicious;  it is nearly (admittedly not quite!) as good as the Mustafa Hafiz brand, for example, which was my favorite in Istanbul.  For the price (less than $5 a box), you really can't beat this, especially given the high quality.  Also,  you can give this candy to vegans and vegetarians because the Turks typically don't use animal products in their candy (like gelatin)---Hazer Baba uses corn starch for their thickener, and the ingredients list is all natural.  I keep this on hand as an emergency gift and so have given this to many people, all of whom rave about it!

These do taste good.  However, the picture promises a sweet full of nuts in every bite.  The reality is that the manufacturer skimps on the nuts with some pieces having no nuts or one tiny sliver.  That's misleading.  Plus you can't see which is which until you bite into it, there's so much powdered sugar.Still good, but could be excellent.

Product was awesome we still have 2 boxes.  My mother loves this stuff and I bought it for her. The first 2 boxes disappeared in a flash! LOL! Shhh... don't tell anyone... I definitely recommend this to anyone.
This turkish delight is the same brand we brought back from the UK so we knew it was great tasting.  Much better than homemade! Fresh and moist, but not gummy. Great quality for the money.

column9: BETTER IF PURCHASED FROM YOUR LOCAL DELI
column10: In a pitch, these babies do the trick,,,but if you want real large fresh authentic turkish delight.....go to you local middle eastern deli.

The product picture indicates a lot of walnuts, almonds, etc. inside.  Actually, there are very few nuts inside, just the sweet translucent jelly.  MUCH lower quality than the Hazer Baba I bought in Turkey.

I was disappointed to see that this product had 2 food coloring chemicals.I wish this information had been available before I bought it.I would like to know if there are products without the chemicals.

This is a flavorful medley of dried fruit. While it is "fruity" it is not too sweet. I usually go heavy on the measuring spoon and long on the steeping. Some sweetener, a glass of ice, a delicious tea experience!

column9: Please offer this tea through Subscribe & Save!
column10: Delicious decaf tea!  Don't know how Good Earth did it, but they created a masterpiece in this tea. And one GREAT bonus: it doesn't stain your teeth like black tea and even green tea do.I wish Amazon would offer this decaf version through Subscribe & Save, to bring its price down.  Amazon sells very few decaf white teas, and this may be the only *flavored* decaf white tea on Amazon.  Why does it have to cost so much more than the caffeinated version of the same tea?I'm puzzled by the review stating this tastes like butterscotch.  I would HATE tea that tasted like butterscotch and have never noticed any hint of that flavor or scent in this tea.  Perhaps the box the reviewer received had been stored near some butterscotch and absorbed its scent??  It DOES have a lovely, delicate aroma of vanilla (not overpowering; it blends nicely with the other scents of this tea), so if you dislike vanilla, this would not be the tea for you.I love tea; our family owns and drinks many kinds. However, this is my favorite decaf white tea.  Its flavor is delicate yet refreshing.I bought mine at a local grocer and am so disappointed that they don't carry it any more. I haven't been able to find it lately at *any* stores. It's one of the few teas I'm willing to purchase by the case.

Good Earth is a great tasting decaf white tea, which is more healthy even than green tea.  It is very hard to find in health food or regular food stores, so glad to know it is availablethrough Amazon.

It is difficult to find decaffeinated white teas, so I don't have too much to compare it with, but it does have a nice taste.  I might prefer a tea with less vanilla in it.  This tea is for someone that really likes vanilla, the vanilla flavor is very apparent.

I love the flavor of this tea.  It is great hot or iced.  I especially like it iced with Splenda or Equal. Sometimes its hard to find in the store.  When I do see it, I stock up becuase I can't get enough of it.

column9: Great decaf option for green tea lovers!
column10: I recently had to stop drinking caffeinated beverages because they were making me jittery.  My favorite reasonably priced green tea was Yamamotoyama green tea.  I loved that tea because it tasted clean and refreshing, and it had a great color to it.I kept searching around for a decaf option and found this on sale at the grocery store.  I did not like this tea at first--since it was different.  The color is certainly not as pleasing to the eye (it's not such a bright green).  However, it has really grown on me.  It has a hint of lemon grass too, which took some getting used to.  However, now I drink it all day long at the office.And the best thing is, this tea doesn't bother my acid reflux or give me heartburn.  Sometimes, teas can also make me feel a little nauseated sometimes.  However, this one is gentle on my stomach as well.  A great product.

column9: This one is not for me.
column10: This one is not for me.  The fragrance is the first thing I noticed with this tea.  I thought maybe it was just my nose, I was having a sinus issue when I first tried the tea.  But, no, it was my tastebuds as well.  This tea smells and tastes like butterscotch, which is not for me.  I couldn't even pawn it off on any friends or relatives.  So, unfortunately it went into the trash.  While others may like it, this one just isn't for me.  Although, I will say this is the only tea I have tried thus far from Good Earth that I didn't care for.  As a whole Good Earth teas are my fave, I buy the Decaf Green Tea with Lemongrass by the case.

This product is delicious!  I got a bottle once at a little boutique store and sort of lost it in my fridge.  Well I found it again just recently after I had grilled pork chops.  Yum.  I had some with my pork chops AND on top of the baked potato.  I love the flavor and the texture.I've also had this with brie or cream cheese on crackers.  Yummmmm.  My bottle is now empty and I'm planning on looking at the grocery store tomorrow.  If they do NOT have it... I'll be back... probably buying 3 bottles.
If you expect to receive 3 bottles like the description states...you will only receive one. Other than that, they sent it in a timely fashion and it tastes great.
This stuff is awesome. There's really not much to it. I use it all the time; for grilling, marinating, in place of mustard on sandwiches, and on burgers. Absolutely amazing!
Bronco Bob's rasberry and chipotle sauce and marinade is great stuff, and I was equally pleased withthe packaging and delivery service of this supplier.

I used to purchase this at the world market by my home but the store has recently closed down. I'm so glad I found it here on Amazon even with the steep shipping price its still worth it. This sauce is so amazing on turkey and turkey burgers I can't even eat them any other way!

column4: M. M. Williams "Fan of Bob Newhart"
column10: Can't get enough of this sauce; I've probably bought over 30 bottles by now, I keep them in my pantry, use them all the time, and give them out as gifts. wonderful stuff. We use it with grilled pork and chicken, as well as pouring it over cream cheese.
Makes a lovely gift!  The flavor is is intoxicating and can be used for spicing up any kind of dish.

I use this on cream cheese, ribs, chicken, everything.  I cannot keep in in the house - it is gone as soon as I get it - everyone who has tried it just loves it - try it - you will really be surprised.  It is a smoky hot - not burning hot - smooth.  very very very good

Too sweet, and flavor seems pretty artificial--sugar is main ingredient, no mention of how many raspberries gave up the ghost for this bottle, but not more than a couple, I'm afraid.  Nowhere near as good as coffeemate raspberry-chocolate, which is almost impossible to find.
This has a moldy smell and taste.  Not much raspberry flavor, when added to ice tea.  I won't purchase this item again.
The pricing was fantastic, the product outstanding, the care in packing and the promptness of delivery were all wonderfull. Thank you so much for everything. It's been a pleasure dealing with you

For what this product is, it is great. I know what normal mac n cheese tastes like, but for medical reasons, I cannot eat any of the ingredients that go into it. I made this tonight with broccoli and enjoyed every bite. I used the so-delicious unsweetened coconut milk creamer as a liquid. I mixed the sauce mix and creamer really well in the pot with a whisk and cooked it until it was thick, then added back in the macaroni and broccoli, added a bit of water and cooked it a little more. I don't think it would have been as good if I followed the box instuctions exactly (not pre-cooking the sauce) or didn't use the creamer (I also used a bit of Herbamare and more nutritional yeast (about 1t.)). I am sad that the other two reviewers had bad results, but I LOVE this product and can't wait to get my hands on more.Yes, I am aware that this is a glowing review that sounds like I am associated with them somehow...but I'm not. If you've ever been in the situation I am in (craving "normal" foods but just cannot have them) and you find something half decent for a replacement, you'd understand the sheer joy! :) Happy eating!

column9: not really like mac and cheese, but now awful either
column10: I am a chosen vegan but I know what mac and cheese tastes like, so I am expecting a lot in a substitute I want it to taste like mac and cheese. Now that being said, no this product does not taste like mac and cheese. It actually has a kind of strange taste, like something funky, but not cheese :-) My daughter is 3 and she took one bite and refused to even eat that bite.I made it by using a hand mixer to really get the powder to emulsify into the almond milk i used, i also used a little avocado oil...is there a way to prepare it so it tastes better? maybe, i guess if you used cheese and butter, lol, I am just kidding. Its really hard to duplicate those flavors, so this product is trying its best to fill that need. And the company seems to be pretty stand up, but cheese just has some huge shoes to fill.
I can't believe I actually paid money for this stuff. It's gritty, tastes NOTHING like cheese in the least, and no one in our family of 4 ate more than one bite. Don't waste your money.

column9: wyler's instant bouillon chicken herb cubes
column10: JUST USED THE PRODUCT FOR THE FIRST TIME.  I HAVE USED WYLERS CHICKEN CUBES BEFORE BUT WITH THE HERBS NOT UNTIL TODAY.  IT HAS A VERY GOOD TASTE AND NOT BLAND LIKE REGULAR BOUILLON BROTH.  I WILL HAVE NO PROBLEM AT ALL JUST SIPPING ON A CUP.  I ALSO MADE SKINNY MASHED POTATOS WITH THE CUBES AND IT GAVE THE MASHED POTATOS A NICE BOOST AND I DIDNT HAVE TO ADD ANY OTHER SPICES TO IT.  1 BOUILLON CUBE PER CUP OF WATER....EASY

This is my favoriterice vinegar, and I have to mail order it since I can't get in the stores where I live. Its great for making healthy salad dressing.However, my last order was very poorly packed and half the bottles were broken.
I received these today. They are just as pictured, and maybe a little bit better then I expected. Packed in cute little plastic cases as well. Sweet! :)
This is a great product.  After ordering, I got notification that it was being sent right out.  I was surprised on how quickly I recieved the Goya sauce.

column9: NICE FLAVOR, MUCH BETTER THAN CONCENTRATE
column10: I BOIL THE SORREL AND ADD SPICE IN THE TRADITIONAL TRINBAGO STYLE.  SERVED AS PREPARED OR SPIKED WITH OVERPROOF ITS DELICIOUS.  SHIPPING IS PRICEY FOR SUCH A LIGHT WEIGHT ITEM BUT WHEN YOU CAN'T GET SORREL LOCALLY ITS WORTH ORDERING SEVERAL PACKAGES AT ONCE.  THE CONCENTRATED MIX IS OK BUT IT CANNOT COMPARE TO HOMEMADE SORREL.

I ordered the Jamaican Red Sorrel (Angel Brand) as I love drinking the juice it makes.  The product is perfect.  It tastes EXACTLY how my mother-in-law in Jamaica makes it.  I will continue to buy this product now that I know where to get it!  Thanks Amazon!

column9: Carol Moseley may be an ambassador of social justice...
column10: .. But she clearly isn't an ambassador of taste. I really wanted to like this tea, and had every reason to believe I would: it's organic, and organic foods tend, in the main, to taste better. The ambassador line of tea touts itself as "biodynamic" (a marketing term for sustainably produced) and is fair trade certified, which is wonderful. Sadly, it tastes slightly less good than, say, a dustbin of sweepings from a woodshop floor. As a connoisseur of tea, I have tasted somewhere in the vicinity of 4 or 500 varietals, and can't think of a single one more flavorless than this one. Into the compost pile goes this $20 worth of tea. Don't suffer for a good cause: buy another brand of tea, and if Moseley's mission is important to you, just donate directly.

Totally agreed with A. Dowd's comment/review.- This green tea tasted horrible and bitter. Bought a lot of pretty good whole leaf tea from China and been drank a lot of Ten Ren tea in the bay area. The Ambassador Organics Green Tea is nothing close and I am throwing them away after one cup. As a comparison, anything you can get from Saveway is better than this.- Also one of the tin boxes came in empty, totally empty and the other tin was dented. I had to believe either this was an used/open product or there was problem in the wearhouse. Glad Amazon resolved this issue for me, thanks!

I like this tea.  I am not the world's greatest green tea fan, but I have had it all over the world, and find this one to be as good as most and better than many.  Prince Charles did not associate his name with his organic cookies, no doubt out of concern that political brickbats would weigh down the product instead of allowing it to stand or fall on its own merits.  This tea is of fine quality.  I suppose there are those who prefer to rag on personalities, but I think the food ought to speak for itself.

column9: Safely Made in the USA, & my dogs favorite!
column10: My Boxer only likes peanut butter treats, and these are by far his favorite! These look & smell so good, my boyfriend got them out one night & nearly ate one before I caught him. He was amazed they were dog treats (& may have still tried one, had I not been around). Vet approved & made in the USA, you can happily give them to your dog knowing they are safe, unlike all the 'Made In China' treats always on recall for making dogs sick. Sized like a real cookie, they give a bigger dog something to chew a while, while also soft enough for a smaller dog to break apart. They also come in 2 separate sealed bags, so they stay fresh. Wonderful product - Cinco gives 2 paws up!

Do you love hamburgers? Do you feel guilty about the fat and cholesterol of beef patties? Here's a suggestion--try bison burgers.More and more farmers are raising bison for their meat.  It has less fat and cholesterol than beef, but it tastes pretty good!  When making bison burgers, the key thing to remember is that they are quite a bit leaner than beef burgers, so you can't cook it as long or it really dries out.That said, the end product tastes fine and is better for you. Bison burger over a bun with some thin onion slices, tomato, mustard, and cheese, and you have a tasty treat!
Was surprised at good taste and very lean cuts. Wish they were thicker,like meater buger. Cost was very good, will order more in future.
This Organic Rotini by DaVinci is great! It can't be beat.Try it and you will be hooked.
this is a wonderful healthy pasta without any added artificial vitamins.  taste very good, excellent texture.

I feel like I am taking crazy pills when I read the other reviews on these.  I did not like them at all.  To me they taste like a chewy brown-flavored center coated in sweet white wax.  The coating melts at anything above 60 degrees, so prepare to get fingers smeared if you open one from your purse.I was super bummed they didn't taste better, the nutritionals are decent and no sugar -- 2 stars and not 1 for that.I also discovered that I am one of those people who experience "gastric distress" from Malitol...30 minutes after I ate one before going grocery shopping.  They say, "never shop hungry," I advise never go ANYWHERE after you eat one of these before you know how your body will react. Delightful.Bummer for me, hope they work better for you :D

Changed recipe..not the same! I so enjoyed the original thinkThin BITES 100 Calorie Cookies and Cream...not anymore! The rich chocolate taste and texture has completely disappeared. The thinkThin BITES now have a disappointing fluffy texture instead of the rich creamy balance while the rich chocolate has become almost devoid, nonexistent !!!I will not buy this product...very disappointed!My question..why do company's have to change a good, tasty product? I have a few ideas..

I purchased this product based on previous items from ThinkThin and the picture on the box.  I was expecting this to be cookies not bars.  They are just too sweet.  My husband is diabetic and he likes them.
