I bought these cookies for my daughter who has Celiac Disease because I thought they were similar to Oreo cookies.  However, when they arrived, they were actually bars of chocolate coated with white chocolate.  She seems to like them enough, but I feel a bit misled from the name and picture online.

In my opinion, these are the best tasting bars of the Think Thin brand. The convenient "bites" are great for a quick snack on the go. I only wish they made full size bars of this flavor. The Peanut Butter bars are also good.

To me, these had a very strong peanut taste, which I did not like at all. Also the texture was very gummy. Would not buy this flavor again. Yukky. And yes, I also think the picture was misleading, they are not cookies and taste nothing like cookies!

I tried these at Whole Foods and began ordering them through Amazon recently.  My son is on a Gluten Free diet which is why I started buying these.  He likes the taste and it is a good snack for school.  I also enjoy taking them to work.  It satisfys my sweet tooth.
These bars are soft and chewy and taste great.  I would highly recommend them especially if you have a gluten allergy.  They are a great snack anytime of the day.

column9: Good Tast, Messy Hands - Still Recommended
column10: These thinkThin "100 Calorie Cookies and Cream Bites" are good tasting and are surprisingly filling, but they are also messy for your fingers. These are not like Oreo Cookies as pictured on the box, but are rather a soft chocolate cake with a white creamy coating that, sadly, becomes gooey at even room temperature (I am keeping these in the refrigerator). If you have to eat one warm, you can just open it up and use the wrapper to hold the cookie.The taste is better than most "diet" snacks and they are also diabetic friendly at less than 7 Net Carbs per bar and only 100 Calories. Like another reviewer pointed out, these do contain Maltitol and that can cause "gastric distress" that varies in severity from person to person, so you might want to see how these effect you before enjoying one of these and heading out to your weekly Book Club meeting.Recommended!CFH

These bite size treats are the best tasting low sugar snack I've ever had.I have been following a low glycemic eating lifestyle for about 5 years and I have tried many snack/ energy bars and none compare to this bar. I wish there were more in the box.I love these and you should try them too.
These are really good when you want a really chocolatey cookie but don't want a lot of sugar. Even my husband loves them.
These are good, just don't look at the picture on the box. The box makes them look like cakie Oreas. They are chocolate inside with white chocolate outside.
Will really come in hand for hiking and golfing snacks this summer.  Love them.
This is one great product. I have done away with soft drinks and drink just Propel. This product has helped me lose oer 50 pounds so far. Love the strawberry kiwi.
You dissolve sugar in water in a pan and, like magic, simple syrup appears. Then you bottle it and sell it to idiots for $32 per bottle.

I make my own simple syrup, so anything over a buck is too much for me. But I guess you guys did not noice that it's 6 twelve oz. bottles for $32, which comes to $5.32 each. Still way too much in my opinion, but not 6X as much. Just sayin'.

I'm a big fan of Syrian food, and decided to try this mix because it's not very easy (or cheap) to get all the ingredients to make my own falafel where I live. Well, I followed the instructions on the box (except for deep frying- I pan-fried mine and they turned out fine), and it's just about as good as my favourite Syrian restaurant!The mix also makes an interesting batter for other fried/baked finger foods- less carbs, and slightly nutty- a healthy yet still tasty crunch. Will definitely be buying this more regularly :D
This is the best of all the ones I have tried.  We like spicy foods and this one has the perfect touch of spice.
It was my first falafel preparation and I got this one from Stop n Shop. It comes with a very easy recipe. Very tasty and nutritious. Great for vegetarians!

I bought this mix just yesterday. The whole box makes about 8-10 nice size falafel patties. About the size of a slider. Very filling, spicy, and hearty. A cheap alternative to the standard going rate for getting a falafel at a restaurant, where I live, about $4-$5.

I bought this tea on a trip out of town and was very very pleased with it. I have since been searching for it in my local grocery stores but have not had much success. I have been trying to find a tea that can equal the flavor this one has and everything I try doesn't measure up. I am very happy to find it here on Amazon.

I really have to disagree with the other reviewer. I have had a lot of Jasmine Teas and this is one of the better ones. The Jasmine scent is much stronger than a lot of teas I've had before. It's true that the smell is stronger than the actual Jasmine flavor but it's still a good flavor.If you are looking for a highly perfumed tea then it's better to go with Jasmine Pearl Tea as that is scented several times with the Jasmine. And honestly, I would never recommend Bigelow tea over this. The quality of it doesn't compare.Besides, this is organic tea so there are many benefits to drinking this over standard tea.Try this tea! You'll be happy with it!

I purchased this at a local chain grocery store (Albertsons) for $2.79.  Unfortunately, the tea tastes like grass and nothing nearly like jasmine green tea.  Maybe it's me, but there wasn't a good balance between the jasmine and green tea.  As FYI, each tea bag is individually packaged, but not sealed.  However, the main box is sealed.So far, the best jasmine green tea bags I've tried are ones from Bigelow.  And those tea bags are individually sealed.  I strongly recommend Bigelow over Touch Organic for good jasmine green tea in a convenient, stay-fresh packaging.
I got this tea at my local store and really like the flavor. I add a little milk to it to get rid of the bitterness. Great combination. Will buy again

column9: Best tin of tuna you will ever have
column10: If you like tinned tuna you must try this. It has a light (almost white) colour, a distinctive whirled, flaky grain and  a delicate fresh taste. It is worth the extra few dollars over the supermarket brands (which, afterward, will seem like pet food). I especially like it as a quick meal on its own with a bit of fresh bread, some cracked pepper and a small drizzle of lemon-infused olive oil. Toss it through pasta or a salad or whatever else you like - just don't overdo it - the product speaks for itself.

I ordered two cans of this to follow a recipe for Mediterranean tuna casserole from Cooking Enthusiast [...]. I was very impressed with the dish anchored by the tuna. It seems expensive but I think of it like the difference between round steak and tenderloin. Not all tuna is created equal. It arrived promptly and I will order this again. Just do it.

Flavor is good, not excellent. I really like these but I have to stay accurate here with the review. They are very good but not the best. I guess there are some limits you get from staying healthy. As a health snack I'd give them 5 stars though.Secondly, they leave almost no oil residue in your mouth. So you don't have to wash them down with any strong soda to cut the film off of your tongue. And let's face it, a healthy snack is not healthy if you have to use some unhealthy drink to wash it down.All in all, these are one of my favorite healthy snacks. Very good.

These are THE original veggie stix.  If you go to to a major grocery chain store or Whole Foods, most have resorted to selling veggie "straws," which are like veggie stix but hollow, hard, and overly salty.  The Good Health veggie stix are a lighter snack and simply, just taste better in my opinion.I was happy to find the product on Amazon, but learned quickly that 10-7oz bags is a lot.  I bought the product in the beginning of Summer and it had an expiration date for August.  Unless you really love snacking on these things, it's probably more worth it to buy in the store if you can help it.

One of the things I really appreciate about these (good sized) three ounce bags of veggie sticks is the following:Servings per container: 3Calories per serving: 140They taste great and a one ounce serving is generous. They really are a good snack and a good value.

My husband and I love this snack food. Unfortunately, we love it so much that 12 bags can easily be consumed in a week or less. They are a terrific alternative to potato chips or fries as a side "dish" when serving hotdogs, hamburgers or a simple tuna sandwich.If you are in the market for a light, tasty, not-too-salty or oily snack food, this product is just the ticket. But be forewarned, it can be addictive!

I just got this product and the expire date is for March 2012!  That's crazy.  Not to mention how long the product took to get to me.  I ordered several other things on the same day and this order came more than a week after everything else. Will not buy again!

column9: Good value, not oily, crisp, fresh, but dominated by the potato variety
column10: Overall one of the better veggie stix I have tried. I liked that they have much less of an oil taste than other brands I have tried; very fresh tasting. Also better than store bought price especially if you use subscribe and save.I got these in late December and they had around a 3 month expiration date. The have the standard potato, tomato, and spinach flavors. And like most brands I have bought in store they are not evenly placed in the bag, the potato flavor dominates. But not more than other brands, and these taste better and better priced at Amazon. Recommended.

column9: Yummy.......and good for you (well, better than some other stuff)
column10: Trying to break the frito habit, I tried veggie chips.  Really yummy and no greasy aftertaste.  Buy them by the case and put on monthly auto-delivery.  You will always have something appropriate for late night snacks and those take-along snacks to the lake or golf course.  Each bag contains only 140 calories - with much better ingredients.  Unfortunately, I'm now addicted to Veggie Chips, and so are my five children and 12 grandchildren.  But I don't feel guilty.

I chose these to have as a light snack being that they are only 130cal/package, which is 1 oz. They do the job and they are quite filling but they are soo greasy. It feels as though they just sit in my stomach and make me feel icky!

I was grocery shopping two days ago at the local Wal-mart. My daughter went down the chip aisle looking, of course, for potato chips. Out of the corner of my eye I saw a bag that read Veggie Stix. I picked them up, glanced over them and said to myself "Naw, probably tastes like crap.",and walked away. I was trying to find a snack for myself and everything was high in sodium or contained additives. So, I went back and decided to try the Veggie Stix. That was the best purchase that I made in the store that day. I got them home, tried them and had to force myself to stop eating them. And the BEST part is that when I let my grandkids try them they LOVED them. That was the only bag that I saw in the store that day, but believe me I will be checking to find out if it is an item that Wal-mart regularly stocks. If not I will be ordering from Amazon.com. Very Good.
I am a feeding specialist whom gets many complaints about children not eating their vegetables. This is a great healthy alternative fun snack to veggies.  I recommend this product to parents weekly.
These taste great and are healthy for you, as well. Great alternativwe to chips. We give them to our 2 year old as a snack. It is a sneaky way to get some extra veggies in to her.

I liked the taste of the bags that were sealed good, but probably about half of the bags were not sealed properly.  The ones that were not sealed correctly tasted stale, so I was really disappointed with these.  I have had this brand in a larger bag, and really liked them, so I don't know what happened, but I do know that I won't be buying these smaller size bags anymore!  There were openings in a couple of the bags on the end, but most of them just did not have the air tight seal in the bag.

This package comes with 24 same bags of mixed chips.  When I say mixed, I mean green, yellow and orange chips.  They are supposed to be made from good vegetables like carrots, spinach, etc. but they all taste the same - yummy though!I buy these 2-3 times a year and have it delivered to my office where I enjoy them as a late afternoon snack once in a while.

I tasted it first time in Vancouver and I Loved the Taste!!Jenssens Orchard is best but too expensive.Send it regularly to Afghanistan and I think they got addicted.And the price is very good. 24 packs is quite fine.Right now I am frustrated because I cant get it delivered here.Another product I intend to stock as soon as I can.  It is like a meal.Children should replace doritos and the like with these. less harmful for health
I recieved a free sample of the Veggie Krinkle sticks and really was very impressed!  I am planning to purchase and be a customer as I think they are a healthy alternative to potato chips1
These are really good but, I feel, a bit pricey. I've not seen these anywhere else, but then I haven't been looking. Good snack but not as healthy, I believe, as one might think, Still very good!

column9: The best chip I've EVER had
column10: I'm not even going to lie, I learned about these delicious little snacks by snagging a couple from my roommate's bag.  I go to the store that is almost 10 miles away--on the bus--just to get a bag of these.As one commenter suggested, they can be a little bit greasy, but since I bring them to work in a paper towel and inside of a baggie, I don't have a problem at all.  I don't think they're too salty.  They're about as thick as fries from burger king and they taste EXACTLY like french fries.As has been mentioned, almost 40 straws is one serving and its only 130 kCals!  I've switched to eating these as a snack instead of any alternative and I don't even need to portion them out by serving size.  They're so filling, I usually don't even eat 25 at once.I hope these are sold all over the country because the prices here are pretty steep and I'd love to share Veggie Straws with my family back home.  I get them at the grocery store for about 3.50/7ounce bag.Happy snacking!

If you want a low-fat and low calorie natural snack, these veggie stix are tasty and have 55% lower fat than potato chips.  They are fun to munch on.  I was surprised, however, that they had no Vitamin A as some vegetable snacks do.No fiber, and only 1 g protein.  So, they are more healthy for what they don't have, than what they do offer.  And that's fine for a snack.  If you want snacks that offer some nutrition, popcorn chips offer fiber and sweet potato chips often have Vitamin A.  I'd get these for fun for a party for something different, but it would be great if they had a little more nutrition in them.

column9: Love this product/Glad Amazon sells this
column10: Most everybody loves chips, but don't want to feel guilty (at least I don't), about eating them. These chips are a good way for me to get the crunchy/salty flavor and satisfaction from eating "chips", yet these are healthier than just regular potato chips. I love the hint of salt and garlic. For those that are afraid of the "spinach", you really can't tell that you are eating spinach. I love the convenience of the size of these. Since it's just me , I can sit and eat a whole bag (bigger), without even thinking about it, but with this size, it's easier to control the portion. Since not all stores carry this product, it's great that I know that I can order from Amazon. I think the price is reasonable also.
I love love love these and would really like a bigger bag.  24 one ounce bags is ok, but would like to choose my own portion.  They came very fast and were in perfect condition.

I am hooked on these.  I am on a diet and they are healthy but still have calories, so I limit myself one a day as my treat, and ANYONE would like them.  Anyone that has tried then at my house do.  And, they come in two sizes.
I wanted a healthy alternative to chips for my 2 year old. These are it. He loves them and they actually taste great!
I love having these on hand to pack in lunches, or to satisfy the urge to crunch.  Probably not as healthy as a salad , but more nutritionally sound than regular potato chips.
NOT ONLY THE DELIVERY WAS EXTREMELY FAST BUT THE PRODUCT IS WORTH EVERY PENNY.  PRODUCT IS DIFFERENT, LESS GREASY, NOT TO HARD TO CHEW AND FUN TO OFFER IN PARTY TRAYS.  I LOVE IT.
I'm so happy with this purchase! Not only are the Veggie Stix great, but the portion control is so easy this way. AND the price is right, too. Adefinite win-win!
These chips are really great tasting especially for a healthy version.  These are the best tasting healthy chips I have ever had.  They are really addicting!  You save money by buying on Amazon too!

...but I love these!They're light and crunchy with a much more interesting flavor than plain ol' chips. Don't know anything about the nutrition of them, but I hope they're healthy since I just ate a whole bag of them.

column9: Was a good idea for school lunches...BUT!
column10: So, so not fresh; they were stale. Stale. Stale. Stale, so stale. Disappointingly stale. Stale! And oh yeah, all the bags were stale.

These had good flavor but not the texture.  I thought would be like a real vegetable chip or at least be like a real potato chip..you know, crisp, etc.  I really don't like the pringle like texture..if you do, you'll probably enjoy these

Ten bags were consumed in eight days. If you are worried about not eating enough vegetables, this product is GOOD.  The taste is great and as a snack or with soup or dip your guests will enjoy this vegetarian product.  There are other Vegetable Chips that contain more nutrients but they are more expensive.

I ordered the 10-bag product and only received 6 bags.  Do not order from this company as it does not fulfill it's obligations to their customers.  I could have tolerated the 10-day wait for the order to come in if it had been exactly what I ordered, but it wasn't.

I got these, thinking that they'd be a good healthy snack, and they do indeed taste pretty good. But they are way too oily. I expected them to be more like Veggie Chips, which I really like. But they aren't.Hey, they might be healthy but it doesn't matter. They leave a greasy residue in your mouth/throat after eating just a handful of them. Just as bad as french fries.

I would not buy this from Amazon because they have not provided the nutritional information on the package. I find it ironic that they provide disclaimers about reading the labels when they don't provide the information needed to make an informed choice.

column9: Awesome item but can't order in Alaska
column10: I loved this item, and wanted to order, but wasn't a option in my area. I would really like to order Good Health Veggie Stix, 7-Ounce Bags (Pack of 10) but says they cannot ship to my area. I gave bad review becuase they won't ship to my area. Alaska is a state. Its not like its out of America!!

column9: Baking with Whole Wheat Pastry Flour
column10: I've been using this flour for over two years now.  I've always loved Bob's Red Mill products so I knew I could trust this flour.  It has a very fine texture and produces a soft baked good.  I don't think its flavor is overpowering in any way when compared with all-purpose flour.  It smells good and tastes great in cakes, muffins and cookies.My most successful recipes using this flour are usually cakes and pound cakes:[...][...]I am definitely going to continue purchasing this Bob's Red Mill flour.  It has a great price tag too!
I bought this to make carrot cake and ended up using the recipe on the back of the bag. It turns out beautifully every time I make it! I'm going to look for more recipes to use it in.
i needed this flour for a recipe. the baker normally uses this stuff. seems to work great. using this type of flour seems to give the cookie a better consistency and texture.
I received the package and one of the bags was slightly open, so I contacted the company and they immediately sent me another package at no cost. Fantastic customer service.
My shih tzu Sassy love these breath freshening treats she gets one about every three days and she thinks it's candy and her breath does not smell like dog!!!!!!!!!!!!

My Peek A Poo really likes these! I brush her teeth, and then, give her one of these after for a "treat", and I do it all at bedtime, knowing that her teeth are great and clean!  She loves them! Great product!

I get tired of labels selectively enhancing numbers to mislead, so these get a star off for that.Big bolded letters it says: "10 bars" below, in smaller letters you'll see a small pack has 2 bars. At least they have the decency to call a serving (at the back on small letters: 2 bars).The bars are very small, so it's no surprise that this is the case.On a positive note, the oats are organic, as are a lot of the ingredients. The bars crumble a bit much, so you might lose a piece or two to the floor.Overall, given the quality of the ingredients, and the decent taste, these are a good choice. However, a lot of the time the cost per bar* (10 bars in a box, 2 per pack) is close to a dollar, an honestly, anything over 50 cents is way too much for the size of these, and you would be better off with any of the other products out there that fill you up even more (1 dollar protein bars come to mind - they weigh a lot more than 2 of these).

column9: Not a fan of granola bars, but the taste of these wowed me
column10: I don't typically buy or snack on granola bars. They are often more chewy than like a crisp cookie and taste of honey and artificial ingredients. In fact, I would never have tried these were there not a sample bowl of them at a local grocery store.I was more than shocked...it almost tasted like a homemade oatmeal cookie.  In fact it was so good I returned for seconds and bought 2 boxes of these and 3 other flavors as well. Although the chocolate chip is a close second, these are hands down the best in my opinion.Surprisingly the calorie count on the box is for TWO bars. While many manufacturers try to sneak in calories by doing things like saying there are 2 servings in soda can or 2 servings in a single frozen dinner so the calorie count looks smaller, they were more than generous. TWO bars of most of their flavors have only 160 calories and for a mega sweet fix that satisfies me plenty with just one bar, that wowed me.This is an organic bar and they are actually vegan. Not that they advertise this anywhere, I just read labels and was surprised to see no dairy or eggs listed. One servings gives you 40% of your daily recommended serving of whole grains yet it tastes like a cookie or dessert...and that also means a nice doce of fiber.While I wouldn't fool myself into thinking that I'm eating HEALTHY just because of the whole grains and organic ingredients...it is, afterall, sweet and has 11g of sugar (but that's for two bars, remember, and one is plenty filling for me so that's not so bad for a sweet snack.) I do feel I am eating healthier than most alternatives when I'm craving a sweet snack that I can tote in a purse or keep in my desk drawer. Most bow far deeper into the less healthy alternatives of preservatives to keep them shelf-stable, or far more sugar.Not to be confused with a protein bar or one packed with vitamins, of which it's not, it's still a healthy alternative to the afternoon candy bar or morning donut in the break room and in my opinion it tastes way better than either.

I'm not stupid. I have nearly a degree from a major university. I read this description over and over, and still it didn't make any sense. Ten bars! Pack of two! Two boxes! Forty-eight! Hike!Like me, you'll probably be surprised by the dearth of product. You get two boxes. Each contains five packets. Each packet has 2 bars, sure -- but the weight of each packet is 1.5 oz, which is less than two-thirds the weight of ONE regular Clif bar. These bars are maybe 1 1/2" wide, 4" long, and 1/4" thick. You'll be tempted to use them to file your nails. Why would Clif suddenly decide that humans can't take a granola bar that weighs more than .75 oz -- and package two of them together? Gosh, let's all think.Anyway, now you know. On the plus side, if you don't like these -- I'd give them a 5 out of 10 on taste -- just hold the box in your open palm, and a hefty breeze will take them away.
Awesome flavor, Awesome crunch. It almost melts in your mouth, could not ask for a better Granola bar.

saw this online as a deal. ordered some thinking I would receive 20 individually packed bars.  It was not the case.  You get two boxes and there are 5 individually wrapped bars inside.  they call it 20 because each wrapper has two thin bars inside. I fell for it. hope this helps someone not to make the same mistake I made.
This is not an accurate description for the product ordered.  I only received one box of ten bars.  The bars are great but since it is only one box it is not worth buying here.

Made the mistake of taking the picture at face value.  As other reviewers have stated, there are actually only 10 bars broken into two pieces.  The price is not $0.74/package, but actually $0.74/bite.
Product description says 2 boxes, only received one.  This is a huge ripoff, I paid $10 for one box of 5 bars yet they are counted as 10.  How do I go about getting my other box?
These are not original cliff bars, but the smaller lower quality Cliff crunch bars.  You can get these same bars in the same packaging at Walmart for 3 bucks for a box of 10.
They taste and look exactly like Nature Valley Bars. Also note the 10-count box is 5 packages of 2 thin bars. I would rather get the Nature Valley--they're cheaper and taste the same.
These are perfect for when you'd like to have that chocolate chip cookie and you know you shouldn't.  Its crunch, crispy with just the right amount of chocolate chips to satisfy your craving.

The Granola bars, with about a month left before being out of date, were stale, petrified and inedible.  I returned the product to the original seller.  Amazon charged double what the original merchant charged for the product.All in all, a very disappointing experience.  I have bought from Amazon many times in the past and was always pleased with the merchandise.  This was the first "FAIL" for me.

column9: Great taste, but not very filling
column10: I am a huge fan of Clif products, and consume them almost daily. My breakfast every single work day consists of a standard Clif Bar, and I also occasionally eat a Clif Builder's Bar after a strenuous workout. Happy with all previous Clif products, I purchased a couple boxes of these Clif Crunch Bars, in the Chocolate Chip flavor. Like other Clif products, the whole ingredients list consists of real, natural items; nothing on the list that you can't pronounce or identify.If this review were based on taste and taste alone, there is no doubt in my mind that these bars would deserve a full 5 stars. Given that the bars are relatively healthy, with a solid ingredients list, they taste wonderful; I wouldn't have them change a single thing. Unfortunately, the big downside to this product is the fact that they just aren't nearly as filling as other Clif products. Each pack contains two separate bars, and as far as satisfying hunger goes, I need to eat two complete packs of these Crunch Bars to get the same amount of satisfaction as a single normal Clif bar. Granted, these are lower in calories than the normal bar, but they just don't seem to cut it if I want a quick snack that will fill me up.Another product I have used that is about the same nutritional content as the Crunch Bar, but seems to satisfy my hunger better, are the standard Nature Valley Granola bars. I will keep buying Clif products, but these Clif Crunch Bars will likely not make it back onto my shopping list anytime soon.

column9: Overpriced! Not what you are expecting.
column10: My main beef with this product is with the labeling.The box is labeled very deceptively. This goes double when inspecting the packaging from the Web (as you are doing now). "10 bars" is prominently displayed on the box. Lo and behold, once you open the box, only five bars are present. Upon further inspection, you see that printed in mice-type on the box is "5 two count packages". The net weight of the entire box is 7.4 ounces. That's less than one cup of granola. That's when you realize you've been had.You can buy a mega-size box of Nature Valley granola bars from a warehouse club for less money than the "Pack of 2" you'll find here. I mention Nature Valley because in a blind taste test you won't be able to distinguish that brand from these Clif bars.Seriously, if they are selling them for this much on Amazon, I'd be shocked and chagrined to see what they go for at the camping stores which is their retailer of origin.I consider myself embarrassed to have been duped so badly on this one. Clif has seriously damaged their brand credibility. Live and learn.

These bars come two in a package (and two to a serving size!) and are absolutely delicious.  They are crunchy and rich. The peanut butter bars taste like they are made with actual peanut butter holding the grains together.  The white chocolate macadamia nut bars have little pieces of soy white chocolate in the bars and you can taste them when you bite in.  These bars can keep me full for a while and are a great snack.  Appropriate for a plant based diet.

I bought these not realizing that they were not the regular CLIF bars...I should have known because they are much too cheap the original ones, but I was pleasantly surprised with these... they come in packs of two, and they are like a regular granola bar as compared to the soft/chewy consistency of the original CLIF bars. I loved these though, and the white chocolate macadamia nut was so yummy! I would definitely buy these again! Great value. But very messy, so definitely not recommended for a breakfast while in the car! ha :)

Cliff Bar White Chocolate Macademia Nut Granola Bars are BY FAR the most delicious granola bars I have ever tasted.  I eat one (half a pack) right after a workout to help put some health sugar levels back in my body.  A couple grams of fiber, a couple grams of protein, a couple grams of fat = the PERFECT snack for health blood sugar levels for me.  Love them!
I love these bars.  They are lighter and crisper than the nature valley brand.  Being that they have protein as well they make it a better choice to stave off hunger.

I have been trying to eat better. And I have been going on photo walks. I find that I need something with me in case I get hungry. Fruit doesn't travel well. Granola bars do well in my bag. But chewy bars get too sticky. And most crunchy granola bars are so hard I am always worried I would lose a tooth or two. I saw these at Nutrition S'mart yesterday and picked them up. I tried one before I got home. They have a great crunch, not too hard, and a wonderful flavor. Now I want to try the other flavors but my local Nutrition S'mart only had 2.

OK, I've eaten a lot of granola bars that supposedly contain peanut butter but these are the first one that REALLY taste like peanut butter. Probably the finest compliment I can offer is that if I was going to make a crunchy peanut butter granola bar at home, I'm not sure I could make them better than these. Anyway, these are highly recommended if you want a delicious crunchy peanut butter granola bar that just happens to have all the nutrition we've come to expect from CLIF. Yum-O!

the best part was the white chocolate, but you can buy that anywhere for cheapthis crap crumbles into thousands of pieces when you take a bite, so you can't even anywhere with you. Gotta eat it over the kitchen sink as it is so messyavoid this at all costs. Buy the chewy counterpart instead
Why is the box of 10 $10 @ Amazon when I can buy this for $4 at the grocery store? Is there a pricing problem?
great snack, with a great price! I would recommend, I enjoy the cliff brand especially this flavor. It is neutral and not overwhelming.

These bars are awesome. The White Chocolate Macadamia is the only one I've tried, but it's goood. The only complaint is they break part too easily, but I can say, much better than Nature Valley. I hope these stay around for a while.
These bars are the perfect crunchiness.  I can eat both bars without my teeth hurting!  Great for breakfast or snack.

These taste great but they are small bars.  My biggest complaint is that I have to eat these while standing over a sink or trash to avoid making a mess.  I've gone through 6 or 7 boxes and not one package has had two completely intact bars.  Most of the time there are just lots of crumbles from the edges of the bars but occasionally you'll find a bar that was jostled around enough to be broken into three or more pieces.  Certainly, this is a combination of the composition of the granola bar and lack of completely protective packaging.  But be warned that you will have lots of crumbled Clif Crunch bars if you order this through Amazon.
Love, love, love these!  My husband first brought one of these home from the New York - Five Boro Tour, and I am hooked on them.

column9: a dark chocolate lovers' delight, a blueberry lover's disappointment
column10: "Cocoa" is the ingredient on the label of the chocolate peanut butter Clif crunch bars but I found these Clif Crunch snack bars less overly-sweet than many others.  They taste like they contain dark, as opposed to the easy-to-find milk, chocolate. I recommend them to dark chocolate lovers and ordered three more boxes, straight-away.On the other hand, the blueberry bars are a loser, in my opinion. There is only a faint blueberry flavor.  This blueberry-lover would just love one choc-full of dried blueberries, adding the appropriate blueberry flavor to these crunchy snack bars.
I really liked these bars. They are really good. Finished them in a week and would definitely order again. I wish I could find a coupon
I was expecting two packs of these like the description said, instead I only got one box.  It was a total rip off.

I came across these granola bars as part of the Subscribe & Save program.  Much to my dismay, the subscription service option was discontinued.  They are so good, however, I've continued to purchase them.  Even my children really like them and they usually only like granola bars if they are packed with so much sugar and covered in chocolate to the point you can't distinguish them from a candy bar.I like the Clif brand and what the company is trying to do, besides offering a more wholesome granola bar without compromising taste.The granola bars are certified organic by QAI and packaging is made from 100% recycled material.  Hey, every little bit helps when you're trying to reduce your carbon footprint.
I wasn't real confident that these were going to taste all that great, but my expectations were far exceeded! These bars are so very tasty! Easily the best crunchy bar I've ever had.

This crunch granola bar is on par with every other product from Clif.  It is, as the name would imply, very crunch and extremely delicious.  My favorite granola bar was Nature Valley, but this definitely took the cake.  Simply put, it's delicious.

I normally do not like "crunchy" bars because its a hit and miss proposition. Sometimes too hard, sometimes too soft (feel like Goldilocks). But the taste and texture gets a passing grade from me. Will buy more.
Love the peanut butter crunch bars.  Normally buy them at Walmart for 3.99 per box.  Walmart has been out so I looked here.  $15.75 is outrageous for 2 boxes.

I've tried a wide variety of granola bars and I have to say, these are some really great tasting bars. If you like peanut butter, you will love these. Each box comes with 5 packages of 2 bars a piece. These are a great snack for the middle of the day. I'm looking forward to trying out the other flavors. If you get it with S&S, the price is very low as well. Overall, this is a great granola bar at a great price!

I prefer these over comparable granola bars in both taste and texture, and the fact that Clif uses 'Organic' ingredients is an added bonus.  I am an avid hiker, and these have held up better than other brands on my hikes.

My daughter loves these bars.  The order came quickly.  No complaints whatsoever.  The only thing I would mention is that these bars are crumbly and do not "travel well" compared to the softer bars out there.  So I think we will have some softer bars for travel and these bars when travel is not an issue.  Hope that makes sense!

These snacks are perfect for the on the go exercise enthusiast.  They don't taste too sugary and are a great pick me up for when I need to replenish on the food front.  For the price I paid, I'm very satisfied.

I like Clif bars because they taste good but not great enough that you want to eat a whole lot of them. These crunch bars are no exception. I usually have clif bars in my school bag to stave off hunger during classes before succumbing to the call of a vending machine.The Chocolate Macadamia Nut flavor is a bit too sweet for my tastes which was a little surprising for a Clif bar (but it is chocolate). I like that each packet comes with two thin bars rather than one big granola bar - great for sharing or portioning.
Packaged well item tastes great can be messy when you attempt to eat that clif bar falls apart. However I want more of this product.

I like Clif products in general and this one is also pretty good.  It tastes good and it has better list of ingredients than the more processed ones from Nature's Valley, etc.  But the thing crumbles too much.  It doesn't hold together very well and from the moment you open the package, there's crumbs all over you.  Just be aware of it.  It's tasty and crunchy as they say on the package.
The bars taste good, but they are REALLY crunchy! It's almost impossible to eat them and not make a huge mess of crumbs--definitely not good for taking on the go to eat in the car!
There is a definite, crisp and crunchy texture to these bars. Some other bars have a slight chemical aftertaste. These are probably healthier then cereal.

My grandson, who is in special forces training in the Air Force requested these.  Needs a lot of protein for his training.  Asked me not to send cookies or junk food.  Wanted these instead.  Lots easier than cooking, packaging, and trips to the post office.He said his favorite is the Blueberry bars.

I love these things! Usually they go on sale on Amazon and I only buy them when they are about $6 - 7 for the pack of two. My favorite kind is the white chocolate macadamia nut. However, when I bought them I wasn't expecting them to be quite so messy. They are definitely crunchy, and you will get crumbs everywhere - so keep that in mind. Otherwise I love the things! I'm a college student so this is a good breakfast or snack on my walk to class.

I purchased 5 boxes of these. I really enjoy the taste and nutritional value of the bars. Great starter, mid day pick me up or evening snack (dip into milk). These are crunchy. Great price & excellent Amazon service!

The "healthiness" is great, as are most CLIF products.The price, even with subscribe and save is way too high.There is not much difference from just buying regular granola barsThere are only 5 packages in each box (with 2 smaller bars in each)I always wonder why they make such big boxes and only put a few items in the box....who only eats 5 granola bars?

column9: Taste just like Chocolate Chip Cookies!
column10: First off let me say that I've been a fan of Clif bars for a while now. So I saw these at my local grocery store and decided to give them a whirl.WOW! Just wow! These take exactly like crunchy chocolate chip cookies. They are absolutely delicious. I find myself craving these now instead of brownies or a candy bar. I was actually eating them in class one day and a few people tried them and now are also obsessed. Great product and completely yummy!

Great for on the go, I work in a job that I don't always got to eat lunch on time so grabbing a bar is a great way to eat. These are great, the only thing is that it comes in a 5 pack because 2 bars are in each pack. But it is still a great deal
Just as good as the other Clif bars, but dry and crunchy. Tasty, portable, and cheaper than the others. Perfect snack.
We love these granola bars. I didn't realize that they were crunchy when i ordered them and it was such a nice surprise. They have great flavor and I feel good about my family eating them.
This cliff bar is much more expensive than the nature valley products. But, it is not worth to be pricey.

This new product packs the perfect crunch into sweet bar. I love the bits of white chocolate. The only downside is that it crumbles incredibly easy so it's pretty messy to eat. But overall, it is a very satisfying bar!

column9: Decent granola bar, but the packaging is a bit misleading
column10: When I first opened the box I was surprised to find 5 packages of granola bars, each with 2 bars each, so a "10-pack" has 5 packages with 2 granola bars in each package (I never noticed it was normal to do that with granola bars), hence the serving size is 2 bars. The price for each packet is about the same as that of a normal clif bar, so I don't know if it's really worth it to me. You get about 60% more mass with a clif bar than with this for the same price.That being said, they taste decent and taste good broken into pieces with peanut butter and nutella.

These are so awesome. They have great crunch, without being really hard (like nature valley) and the little bits of chocolate throughout the bar are delightful. I would eat these for dessert instead of cake or brownies. Peanut butter is good too.
Figured I'd try these when Amazon lowered the price and glad I did!  My wife and I both enjoy these very tasty bars and it is a much healthier choice than a bag of chips!

These things are awesome!  I only ordered them because they were on a good sale on amazon, but now I'll gladly pay full price.They taste soo good!  No high fructose corn syrup, a big plus.  They do have "evaporated cane juice" as the sweetener.  I'm not familiar with it, but a quick google search shows it to be a healthier and better alternative to regular cane sugar.Great texture and crunch, and great flavor.  A perfect snack that is much much healthier than a lot of alternatives.I could not imagine a better granola bar.  Try these, you won't be disappointed!
My parents sent me some of these in care package while I was deployed and they are amazing.  So much better than nature vally bars.

column9: Pretty good break from other brand granola bars
column10: I got the white chocolate macadamia flavor of these.  They really aren't any different from any other granola bars.  The white chocolate flavor isn't as strong as it is in the regular Clif bars.  Overall, they're tasty and reasonably priced on Amazon.
Great crunch and taste.  Love the auto ship program with discount!  I can't find these in any stores in my area, was so happy to get them on Amazon.

I love these granola bars!  I can honestly say they are the best granola bars I've ever eaten.  They also have protein, and I love eating them just as a snack as well as if I'm on the go or post workout.  My only problem is they are hard to find in grocery stores...and I usually don't like to wait around to fill out a "please stock this item" form.

Love Cliff bars, but have only liked the Peanut Butter and Chocolate Chip Peanut Crunch flavors (maybe an occasional Blueberry).  The others are too sweet for my taste.  These are my new favorite.  Great taste combination.  Go Cliff Bars!
These are the best crunchy granola bars I've tasted. They are excellent alone or with a nice cup of coffee. Highly recommended!

Got these with a one-day shipping delay, but still very quickly with Amazon Prime.  The taste is quite good, perhaps a little on the sweet side - especially when you hit a pocket of white chocolate.  The big problem is the condition of the product when it arrives.  I opened my first 2-pack and the granola bars were crushed into nuggets and powder.  Strangely, the box wasn't in bad shape, just the bars.  A few days later, I opened the other box of granola bars, which was in better shape than the first one, and the first pack I tried again contained smashed fragments of granola bars.  These are no fun to eat, as you can't really open the pack and pour it into your mouth (I tried), and if you pick out the big chunks you get fragments and powder sticking to your fingers, and on your clothes (and in your beard).  I'll eat the rest, maybe out of a bowl with a spoon or something (with some fava beans and a nice chianti...), but I won't be ordering any more crunched Clif Crunch bars.
What looks like a great deal is actually a terrible one. This is ONE box of 5 packs of granola bars (packed like Nature Valley). So, instead of receiving 20 snacks, you get 5.

column9: Identical taste to Nature Valleys Granola bars
column10: I was hoping that the taste of these granola bars would different from Nature Valleys but it turns out they taste pretty much the same if not identical... maybe a little bit less sugary.Oh well, moving on... I just hate when companies deliberately trick consumers, the freaking box got 5 packs, just put that on the box.

These bars are tasty and delicious.  You get 20 bars for a decent price (depending if you do subscribe and save).  These bars are great for my little ones, they love them, and they are a good healthy alternative to candy or cookies.
The listing of the box describes as twice as many bars as there are servings.  Each foil pouch contains two very small bars, which together make one serving.  The 10 count is really a 5 count.
These granola bars are very similar to the Nature's Valley brand bars.  The Clif Crunch Bars are very messy.  They crumble.  The flavor is not as good as the flavors offered by Nature's Valley.
Item tasted plain and was crumbly. Did not taste at all like it is described. We were disappointed with product.

Just when you think you're eating healthier - you research to find out "Your NOT" with Clif Products. Theirs so much sugar, carbs & fats in these products that you might as well eat cookies or candy bars. They definitely taste better and you get the same sugar & calories.

Anyone who likes ramen can appreciate the Maggi noodle brand. The noodles taste the same, and the flavor packet makes for a very tasty soup. The tomato flavor one is the mildest, and the masala flavor is the spiciest, and thus the Curry one is pretty spicy. Rinse out some of the boiled water before adding the flavoring if you want a spicier soup, and add more water if you want a milder soup.Maggi is also really great for those who are pure vegetarians. Please be aware, most instant noodle packets contain beef stock, chicken stock, etc. in the flavoring. It may not be whole meat, but if you completely abstain from meat, I wouldn't recommend most of the instant noodles available in stores. Since one of Maggi 2-minute noodle's major target markets is the Indian population, and several Indians are pure vegetarians, Maggi's soup flavorings are 100% vegetarian.Instant soup is delicious when you're starving, but it's not very healthy, so I like it but don't love it. Also, I prefer the Indomie brand over this one.

I grew up in Malaysia and ate Maggi curry noodles when I was growing up. Things must have changed a lot because I don't remember seeing "Milk" as one of the ingredients. As I am lactose intolerant now, I was very disappointed with this. So for those of you who do not do dairy, please note.

I use to be able to buy this in town and when I couldn't find it anymore I was worried. It is the BEST ever and now I dont have to worry about running out. Thank you so much. Will be ordering again soon.

Unlike many Almond Butter reviewers, I'm not much of a fan of peanut butter. I love almonds, know that they are good for us, and thought I'd try BB to see if I'd enjoy having it with celery sticks and/or crackers.  I bought this size because I really wasn't sure."Super yummy", was my thought when I tried BB for the first time. It is a lot like the consistency of natural peanut butter with the oil at the top and the really solid part at the bottom, but not nearly as hard to stir thoroughly as PB.I love BB. I have gone through 2 of the 3 jar package I ordered in record time. It's the kind of snack that satisfies that sort of amorphous craving you get sometimes for some little thing to eat.  I even eat it on the spoon sometimes.I haven't tried other brands of Almond Butter and I probably won't, so I can't make a fair comparison of this brand to other brands. I can't imagine being happier with another product than I was with this one.  I highly recommend this product.

My son is allergic to peanuts, and I have been trying different products for the past 2 years looking for a substitute for the Jif I love and miss.  Sunbutter and soybutter do not cut it for me, but this is delicious.  Very smooth and creamy, with a look and taste very close to peanut butter.And from a peanut free facility. We will definitely buy this again.

I absolutely have always loved Barney Butter Almond Butter, and recently purchased the pack of 3. I was very dissappointed when my package arrived, the consistency of all 3 jars was extrememly watery. Unfortunately I am not able to return, or exchange the product. It's a shame that this type of customer service is attached to what I thought was an amazing product. I would recommend not ordering thru amazon, simply drive to the grocery store, which I wished I had done originally.

column9: Perfect snack in a perfect snacker size container
column10: Let me start off by stating that I myself do not have a peanut allergy, but I first bought this when I was going to be working at a site with someone with a severe peanut allergy. Years later I now continue to eat Barney Butter because of the great taste and for the health benefits of almonds!  I think that the creamy Barney Butter is better tasting than the popular peanut butter brands available and the consistency is almost on par with the "natural" peanut butters available at super markets. You DO have to stir Barney Butter though, and because of that I highly recommend going with this smaller size jar rather than the full size jar.  I've bought both the full size and this what I like to refer as a "snacker" size and it is much easier to stir to the bottom of this size jar.  When I was buying the full size jars, the last inch or so on the bottom would always wind up going to waste as it was too difficult to mix the oils with a knife or spoon down to that level.  I keep a jar of this at home as well as at work and it's the perfect addition to have with an apple or celery as a snack and it makes for a rocking Almond Butter & Jelly sandwich.  One of my favorite foods!

column9: It's Peanut Butter made with Almonds.
column10: So the Almond Butters that I've had and grown to love have an almond taste.  This is really just peanut butter.  As in if I gave you a spoon of this and a spoon of Jiff, you wouldn't be able to tell me which was which.  If you're allergic to peanuts but love PB&J's then this may be a heaven send.  If you're looking for almond butter... keep looking.So the above, would normally leave me with a 3-star review... but when the package arrived all three jars were really oily on the outside.  Like, I can't wash these clean and don't want to touch them oily or put them on my counter oily.  Additionally, when I opened one of them, I saw the small container was half full (I'd say close to 40% full).For $6 a jar this just isn't worth buying unless as I stated above you are allergic to peanuts and looking for your PB fix.  But if that's the case... I'd say get this for sure but be prepared to scoop the contents into another container.

This product is a great alternative to Peanut Butter for those that are not able to have peanut products. Great taste and the Smooth is so smooth !! I will be ordering the larger jars next time. I shared some with family and friends and they all love it.

I ordered this product as a substitute for peanut butter. I'm a long time runner and always looking for different fuel sources. I like the taste and nutrition value of this product. Would recommend this product to anyone.

Where have you been all my life Barney Butter? I'm so happy I found you! I have tried a few others, some of which were good, but this is by far the best nut butter/ peanut butter alternative I've tried. My boyfriend and I both love it. He can eat peanut butter but now prefers my Barney Butter. Just like peanut butter, only better!

column9: By far, the best almond butter I've ever had!
column10: By far, Barney's is the best almond butter I've ever tried, and I've tried many other brands.  Even though this one is a bit more expensive, it is totally worth it.

My daughter is allergic to peanuts, cashews, and pistachios. And she is also a picky fussy eater. Packing lunches for school was becoming a nightmare. She finally got the clearance to eat almonds from her allergist but they had to come from an almond only facility. Easier said then done! I was so happy to find this almond butter. No chance of cross contamination. Of course my daughter was hesitant at first because she never really had any nut product. But now she loves it! Great with Nutella. Her favorite breakfast is toast  with Barney butter and bananas. Yummy!
We have had this in our pantry for the past year. I love that there is minimal separation, it does not need to be refrigerated so it's always soft, smooth and spreadable. And it's delicious!

I originally was able to purchase this product at my local grocery store, but they stopped carrying it. I was a happy camper when I found it on Amazon. Obviously, I really like it. I mix it with almond mild equal parts & add a small amt. of real maple syrup. Delicious!!!
My Whole family loves this stuff. Great with apples, in sandwiches.. Etc. So glad we found it!  Very good almond butter and  not too badly priced! I definitely Recommend this product...

So far this is the best Almond Butter I have tried.  It is very creamy and smooth.  My only gripe is that the Jars are so small, but at least you get 3.  It is awesome on a wheat piece of toast topped with a cut banana.  I will buy again.

I was turned onto Almond Butter by my Crossfit trainer.  I went to the local grocery store and paid $7.99 for a non creamy tons of oil had to mix it type of almond butter.  After reading reviews about almond butter I decided to give Barney's a try.  Excellent product.  Tastes awesome was fresh and is just awesome.  I recommend this product to anyone.  I ordered the 3-Pack of 16oz Jars just a minute ago.For what it's worth I haven't ever been a peanut butter fan and I love almond butter great on bananas, apples, celery.Great product.

We thought we had found the best Almond Butter here in St. Louis, but we were WRONG!  "NOW" WE HAVE FOUND THE BEST ALMOND BUTTER!  BARNEY BUTTER CREAMY ALMOND BUTTER!!  We tried it for the first time and we are glad we did.  It is well worth trying and all the reviews were right!!  IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR ALMOND BUTTER, TRY BARNEY BUTTER CREAMY ALMOND BUTTER!!!

column9: Very yummy!! Great for peanut butter and soy alternative
column10: We have many food allergies in our family (mainly kids). We were sooooo excited to find this peanut free almond butter. It is expensive but worth the price when it's your only option (since we can't have peanut or soy products). It takes better than soy nut butter. It is very very tasty and spreads easily and doesn't separate.

column9: Almond Flour and Butter Helped Us with Thanksgiving!
column10: Almond flour makes delicious muffins and bread.  Haven't tried any other recipes.  We buy the flour in larger quantities now.The Almond Butter is delicious!  Made a sauce with it and Agave Nectar and pored it over Pumpkin Bread (made with almond flour) for Thanksgiving.  Yum!  Yum!

This is extremely tasty! I can easily sit down with a spoon and the jar and eat half of it before I even realize it!  It has amazingly creamy texture and taste!  Perfect on bread, in oatmeal, or direct from the jar! My toddler loves to eat it by the mouthful as well!

column9: Barney Butter- Best Almond Butter!! (For adults and toddlers)
column10: I have been looking for a peanut butter substitute since I was diagnosed with a serious peanut allergy 3 years ago.  Barney Butter is gluten free and made in a completely peanut free facility (Yay!).  No worries about cross-contamination anymore.  Many of the other almond butters or sunflower butters found at the health food store say "may contain traces of peanuts", which is not an option for our family.In addition, Barney Butter has both a smooth and a crunchy variety.  Barney Butter Crunchy Almond Butter, 10-Ounce Jars (Pack of 3)  This is the closest flavor to the "Jif" peanut butter or "Skippy" peanut butter I remember growing up with.  It is sweetened lightly with evaporated cane juice.  This is the almond butter I chose to use when introducing my toddler to "peanut butter" sandwiches.  I love almond butter as a peanut butter alternative for children- so much healthier and high in protein and not as common of an allergen.  Barney Butter also comes in little travel pouches- look for them on Amazon. Barney Butter Almond Butter 90 Calorie Snack Packs, 0.6-Ounce (Pack of 24)  We have used this smooth Barney Butter in peanut butter cookie recipes with great success, too!

Almond butter can be runny or smooth, this is smooth and spreads like peanut butter...but if you like to mix into apple sauce as a snack then not runny enough.  Packaging was great, part of amazon subscribe and save which is a good price

The taste was great and very fresh product too. It is low in sugar but I could not have any sugar in my diet even it is low in sugar other wise it is perfect for me. I think the price was great and shipping was fast at free shipping rate.

We have a child who is allergic to peanuts.  Over the years I have tried every kind of peanut butter subsititute under the sun (sunflower, soy, cashew etc).  Barney Butter is hands down the best option for a peanut butter subsitute.  It has the texutre and consistency of peanut butter and is similar in taste as well.  This is the only almond butter that I have found to be made in a peanut free facility as well.  Other almond and nut butters just do not come close to the quality and taste of Barney Butter.  Thanks to Jennifer Barney for coming up with this wonderful product!
Better than peanut butter!!!  'nuff said!  and i loooooooove peanut butter!!!  This almond butter is smooth, flavorful and just overall outstanding.  I can literally eat it by the spoonful.

I can sum up my review in just one word: yummy! Like Forrest Gump famously said, that's all I have to say about that ;)My favorite is to make a sandwich with wheat bread and slice half of a banana between them, plus this. It makes an awesome snack.

These chips, made from corn, are so tasty.They are tangy, spicy, and satisfying.I just can't stop eating them, they're that good.I bought them from amazon once, but do not anymore.These chips are great and certainlyworth the price though. So unique, withboth flavor and being made from corn.

I bought a bag of these on clearance for .75 locally. I'd never heard of them. They are basically round tortilla chips rolled up like a taquito and coated with a flavor powder. The flavor, hot chili pepper and lime, is as described. It tastes like hot chili pepper powder with a hint of lime. The heat is about on par with flamin' cheetos if you've had those. It's hot but it doesn't burn so much you can't taste. I can eat about 5 at one time before I'm overwhelmed. But for me these have too much flavoring on each chip. They are a dark orange color, and there is none of the corn chip color showing through. I like the amount of flavoring on Doritos or Pringles. It's obvious but not too much. The Takis is too much. Although it does make it easier to not eat too many of them. Also you should wear a bib when eating them, the flavoring drops off on your shirt and if you try to wipe it it stains a little. I lifted some off with a piece of tape that didn't get ground into the fabric though. But back to the chips. Crunchy. Very strong flavor. On the hot side as the "Fuego" would indicate. Not something I would probably buy again, though I might buy a bag for my friend who likes the flamin' cheetos. If you like the strong flavored spicy chips, and lime, you should like these.

These Takis have a great taste to them! Tried them about 3 weeks ago, and now I love them. The taste is great, they are very spicy and hot, but they are also very good. The crunchy, lime, hot taste they have is just one of the best.

i love this chip but,i didnt buy it from this seller. I got it from [...] this site has more options that Amazon> they're are a couple downside to the chip is 1.that its corn (my mom says i shouldn't eat corn)2. the stains on your fingers its worth red fingers, 3. after you eat them and go to the bathroom to have a #2 your butt BURNS bad.i would highly recommend for people who live for spice :)

I love this gum.  It's crisp and I can "crack" it in my mouth- not too soft in texture.  The flavor lasts a long time and even though it's a "chewing gum" I can blow bubbles with it.  I really don't know why Trident would want to discontinue it.

I purchased these treats on a whim for my dog a couple of years ago to assist with training.  She loved them and is well behaved! The grandkids sing a song and our dog will dance for a treat. My dog is eight years old and thanks to Dingo Treats, the vet says she has teeth like a two year old dog!  The only problem with the treats is that its extremely difficult to purchase in the store.  Thank goodness they are available on Amazon.
great choice for dogs, ours love 'em and look forward to them every other day or so.  would purchase again

Our two pugs, ages 4 and 14, love Denta Treats!  They get them as "dessert" at the end of each meal, and at special times (you know, when they go potty, at the end of play time, and just about any time they wag their tails)...  Unfortunately, stores like Pet Smart have stopped carrying them, and even Target stores don't keep their stock supplied.  Thank goodness for Amazon.com.  I can always count on them to come thru for me/the pugs....

column9: They may be good, but my dogs got upset stomachs!
column10: We tried these treats to help with plaque and tartar.  I have two dogs, a Siberian Husky and a Mini Schnauzer. Their vet told us that they should both have treats for their teeth that will help with tartar.  We can't really use big bones because the dogs get too aggressive with them.  Treats work better.  We bought these to try and they seemed okay, but the next day the dogs had very bad upset stomachs.  This was the only new thing introduced to their diet so that is why I feel that it was the culprit. They may work, but for my dogs they did not work.
Dingo Mini Denta-Treats, 24-Pack arrived on time as expected. Great product, my dog loves this treat!!!! I strongly recommend this brand and all the products.
I have a minature pinscher and he because he loves to chew (24/7 if he could) these work perfectly. They're not to hard but also not so soft that he could chew it in less than a minute.

My puppy absolutely LOVES these.  When i leave the house my puppy starts to whine.  I live in an apartment complex..so this becomes a problem for the neighbors.  Now i just give her one of these before i leave and she is occupied for a good 20 min (She doesn't whine when i am gone...just when she sees me leaving). I just got one package to try them out..i will definitely be buying more!

My vet commented on how clean my dog's teeth were and she asked if I brushed them. No, I give her one of these Dingo Mini Denta-Treats a day and they keep her breath and teeth clean. But they're hard to find in stores so I buy them now through Amazon!

I buy different types of treats for my dogs and keep them all in a large Rubbermaid container on top of the fridge.  The dogs go nuts every time I reach for that box.  I think they enjoy the variety because after I give them their treat they still look at me like "what else is she gonna give us" and sometimes I swear it's more like "but mom, I don't like that kind, I want the other one".I mix all kinds of mainly dental treats together in the box.  Rawhide sticks (all colors and flavors, not just green ones), Greenies, Dingos, CET and also use some rawhide bones.  These treats help scrape plaque from their teeth while chewing before tarter can form if given after meals or once a day.  My dogs do not get soft food or treats unless we are training.  Saving soft treats for training makes them want it all the more and the hard food is better for their teeth and digestion.I have a Miniature Pinscher and 2 Pomeranians that are prone to tooth loss so taking care of their teeth is very important to me.  My oldest Pomeranian is 6 years old and just had his first professional cleaning and that was mainly because it is hard for me to get his back teeth because his mouth is so tiny.They love when they see the bag of treats come out of the cupboard because they now it's the soft stuff or the small one bite treats and they are more receptive to training and their sessions go much faster.I would recommend these treats as part of a variety.  Mix it up so your dog doesn't get bored and use different shapes to get different angles on their teeth.[...]  Thanks!

my dogs have been eating these bones for several years now, and they adore them.  My chihuahua goes outside to potty, and sometimes she sniffs around too long and it can be annoying waiting on her.  But if I say, "want a bone?"  her head jerks up and she looks at me to make sure I mean it, and if I say it again she GALLOPS to me all excited for that bone.  After I give it to her she then has a game where she goes all over the house trying to decide where to bury it, (it really is hysterical to watch her dig around the pillows) but after she's held it in her mouth a while the juiciness of the bone gets to her, and she has to sit down and eat it.  It is a joy to watch her.Our dachie-poo has long since eaten her bone, and she is wondering, "why does sister have a bone and I don't?"Seriously, our dogs love these bones and consider them a great treat.  I've never noticed anything harmful about them, and our dogs have been eating them for about 3-4 years.  They are a treat, not a bone that will last very long like a rawhide chew, but they are safe and don't splinter.  The worst thing about them is that they are EXPENSIVE.  But our dogs love them, so we give them to them.  They do make our dog's breath better, that's a fact. Delicious olives, and lots of them, simply processed, without excess favorings. No hot peppers, no excess garlic.  Although many of the olives are ripe (brown and black), they are soft---not similar to "American" ripe black olives (which are slightly crisp and packaged in brine only). If preparing a mix for a luncheon, etc. a few "American" black olives mixed-in make a nice contrast.The similar "Byzantine Fresh Olive Antipasto"  Byzantine Fresh Olive Antipasto, 5-Pound Bag  is the same product but with tasty capers, a few garlic cloves and a few peices of bell peppers (for color), perhaps a slightly larger ratio of ripe olives, and perhaps saltier. I like the flavor of the "Byzantine Fresh Olive Antipasto" better, but it is a close call.The packaging (into a heavy plastic bag) apparently consisted of draining the olives and then coating them with olive oil. Amazon packages the bag (folded in half) in a standard ca 3" x 8" x 12" cardboard box. The packaging works well, however, shipment is hard some of the softer types of olives.The olives are salty. You may be tempted to soak them in plain water to reduce the salt content. Unless you plan to eat the olives in the next few hours, resist the temptation. First, you'll leach out too much salt and flavor. Second, the olives will rot in a few weeks. Really.I suggest gently rinsing the olives when you receive them (e.g., in your colander), and repackaging them in your own light brine and white vinegar mix (and jars), and refrigerate. The light brine will reduce the saltiness of the olives to an appropriate level in a day or two. It will take about 5 cups of water, about 1/4 cup (4 tbsp) of salt, and 1/3 cup (6 tbsp) of white vinegar to your taste. It is best to use "sea-salt" or pickling salt, because brine made from regular processed salt can get cloudy.Some of the olives are firm, some are soft---that's simply the nature of a true mix. Most Americans (like myself), raised on pimento-stuffed queen olives think that they don't like soft olives. Indeed, mushy queen olives are yucky. However, some types of olives are meant to be soft, and are best soft. It is an acquired taste, worth acquiring. The mix includes a large variety of olives, both firm and soft. It is said that the key to oriental cuisine is variety---a variety of colors, textures, and flavors. The same is true of an olive mix meant for snacking or as the basis of a light meal.Recommendation 1: A half-can of chick-peas, a diced tomato, a half-cup of these mixed olives, all mixed together with a little olive oil is a wonderful, tasty, health, lunch.Recommendation 2: There is a whole world of olives out their worth exploring. When I received this, I put some into a separate small plastic storage container with a lid for convenience using in the frig, and put the rest of the bag into the vegetable bin.  I noticed that the olives appeared to be continuing to ferment, as the lid on the storage container was being pushed up a little.  This happened for the first three times I filled the storage container (within a short period of time, as I have been eating a lot of the olives!).  What I found out is that this is good - it means that, like real yogurt, these olives are naturally fermented and have the "good probiotics" in them, which are very helpful to your digestive system.  Apparently, most pickled type foods sold in the U.S. are pasteurized which stops this process.  I read some research suggesting that it is very good to consume safely prepared and preserved pickled/fermented products, such as these olives appear to be, just as it is good to consume real yogurt with live cultures - the same kinds of health benefits from the good probiotics.

column9: They changed it and now it is AWFUL!!
column10: I've never reviewed anything before, but have relied on reviews for many purchases.  If this keeps anyone else from buying this new soup thinking it is the same as the old one, then it's worth it.I've purchased and eaten the old version of the Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Chicken Ramen Big Cup Soup for several years.  When I suddenly couldn't get the 2.1 oz soup cups, and this appeared (1.8 oz soup cup), I bought 3 boxes of 6.  I ate the first one a few days ago, and barely could choke it down.The broth in no way resembles chicken broth, it's brown and watery and has a slight trace of miso or soy flavor, with a bitter after taste.YUCK!  Don't buy this, unless or until they re-formulate it again to once again be edible and resemble chicken soup.

Beg to differ with previous reviewer. I really like this soup. Long organic ramen that's tasty but not fried and a nice chicken flavored broth. I agree that is different from the original Chicken Ramen. But, I like this one better.

Personally, I think this is a decent soup. I can see why people think it's a bit bland, but if you add just a little of your own touches, it's awesome. I think it's a great alternative for vegetarians and vegans or anyone who wants healthier ramen. And yes, it does boil over in the microwave, so you should probably just put it all in a bowl. I'm also used to odd tasting food being a vegetarian, so that could be why I think it's better than other people do. Not sure if I would buy it again or not, but I would eat it again.And if you follow the directions (other than putting it in your own bowl) it turns out perfectly. You heat in the microwave for 2 minutes, and let it set for 5 or so minutes to soften the noodles. If they're too firm, you're not waiting long enough.

I enjoy ramen noodles but not in the usual form of extremely high fat, carbs, and salt so this product is an improvement. My only complaint? The flavor is very bland to the point that I likely wouldnt buy it again or will always have to have some spices on hand for flavor. Vegan doesnt mean without flavor. Also let it set for a long time, the noodles take a long time to soften.

I use this soup as a base.  I use twice the amount of water or more, add 1 tsp applecider vinegar or any vinegar, the seasoning pack, throw in the ramen...cook it for a few minutes in a pan, then add plenty of beansprouts and spinach and cook for a another minute or so. You have a fantastic meal for around 200 calories and very filling. If desire, Add a piece of whole grain bread.

I didn't hate it, but I didn't like it. The noodles are a little too firm for "ramen". The broth was ok...again, didn't hate it, but didn't like it. It didn't all dissolve (I followed the instructions completely) and it got kind of grainy at the bottom. I will eat the rest but will definitely not order it again.

column9: Taste just like you cut open a real coconut!
column10: I grew up in the Caribbean (Trinidad) drinking coconut water often.  As a kid we'd look forward to going for a walk around the park where pickup trucks would be parked loaded with coconuts sitting on ice.  They'd slice off the top for you and give you a straw.  I now live in the US and thought I'd never taste that again.  That is... until I stumbled across A&B Coconut juice with pulp.Let me tell you... I've had all kinds of coconut juice in cans from the grocery store and online.  None of them ever really tasted like the real deal, but it was close enough to make me buy more every once in a while.BUT, A&B coconut juice with pulp IS the real deal people.  I swear the first time I opened a can, I stopped, looked at the can and said "OMG!  This tastes like a real coconut!"  Needless to say, I was hooked.  Got my fiance hooked.  Told him we need a separate A&B line item in the budget now.There's nothing like a cold A&B coconut juice with pulp after a workout in the morning.  Or with lunch.... or winding down for the night.  Hey, what can I say, I'm addicted.A&B, if you ever change the taste of this thing, I'll hunt you down!  LOL!  And folks, if you're looking for the real deal in coconut water (with NO sugar added!), I promise you THIS IS IT.  And I grew up in the Caribbean so I know when I hit the jackpot with the real coconut water taste.Now I do have to say that the one without pulp did not taste as much like a real coconut as the one with pulp did.  So get the one with pulp.  Caution - you may just get hooked.  Look for space in your budget to accommodate this new (and very healthy!!) habit.By the way, do an internet search for the nutritional value and benefits of coconut water. You won't be disappointed.  And to have it taste THIS good?  Wow!  I'd bet if you did a taste test between this and coconut juice straight out of a coconut, you won't be able to tell the difference.  I'm telling you, it's THAT good.I don't know how you pulled this off in a can A&B but THANK YOU!!

column9: The cat, the dog, nor the grackles would touch it
column10: I bought a can of this for the novelty of seeing how my cat would react to a can of cat food that cost almost a buck fifty.  He's normally not a picky eater and routinely eats canned Friskies or 9-Lives.  I opened the can and placed the contents into a clean feeding bowl and presented it to him in his normal feeding place on the counter (up away from the dog).  He took a sniff and recoiled from it.  I then offered him a can of his regular food that he happily ate.  Well, that didn't go well.  So I then offered it to our Lab/Golden mix, a dog that loves nothing more than snapping up the cat's food if it is left within her reach.  One sniff and she jerked her head back from it and walked away.  Next step was to fling it out into the back yard where the grackles (an omnivorous bird common to South Texas) scavenge for moldy bread, pizza bones, stale chips and pretty much anything else we toss out.  Nope, the grackles wouldn't touch it either.  But the fire ants love it.  They are all over it and within a few days it will be gone.

column9: None of the five cats will eat it
column10: I looked closley to see what the stars meant with one meaning "I hate it."
