I actually found Merci chocolates at a local store for a small fraction of what is being charged here. I really like them because they are so rich, creamy, and offer an assortment of flavors. They aren't too sweet either, at least for me. They are addictive though.
Recieved chocolates very quickly, in perfect condition. No issues with stickers etc. Will give as gifts. Found price competitive as well, especially if you qualify for free standard shipping.

Not sure when I discovered how succulent this chocolate was- either way back in the more-than-middish nineties, or way, way back in the endish eighties. Yes, that's how good they are, that one will remember them while exchanging vows, birthing, or cleaning the patio. Anyway, you can get them at Target and Wal-Mart, which suprised me when I discovered this fact, as I figured that my grandmother had brought them over direct from Europe. Which could be correct, but presently, they have been bestowed on us heathen Americans.The facts:-Flavors: Milk chocolate, coffee and cream, hazelnut-almond, hazelnut creme, dark creme, dark mousse, and praline creme. Twenty pieces; good luck with the math.-Has a printed expiration date and a guarantee.-Besides nuts and milk, has soy and wheat ingredients.-Taste-wise, definitely European.I am a chocolate fanantic; my preferences are sometimes peasant-like, sometimes grand (I would be fine with "Hershey's" if stranded, but "See's" chocolate has been digested by me). I am not a constant chocolate sampler, as I just go with what I know and adore. If you want to go continental, grab these suckers.
Very high quality chocolates. I had to ration them. Will buy again, and again, and again.... I was introduced to these as a gift, and now i give them as gifts. Great buy.

This chocolate assortment is delicious, rich, smooth and creamy as only European chocolates can be. Small sticks of chocolates are individually wrapped, each one with a creamy filling. I love to buy them and pass them out after dinner. Everyone enjoys choosing their favorite flavor and the small sticks are a satisfying low calorie treat.

I was given a box of these as a present. I never heard of them before, but WOW! When you open the box, they almost look like little cigars all wrapped up. But these are incredibly rich and you can tell they are made with the best ingredients. Godiva has nothing on these.I think my favorite is the coffee and creme... it tastes like a cappucino made from the best coffee. But I can't say I dislike any of the flavors... they are all rick, creamy and delicious. I highly recommend giving this as a gift.

this assortment of chocolates is awesome. Anyone that knows what good chocolate tastes like, this assortment will be a favorite for them. Growing up with this chocolate, it's for someone who can appreciate good chocolate. Enjoy!

I purchased this chocolate last night at Wal-mart. I had been walking past it and going for the Hershey's Pot of Gold for a while, but always wondered what this one tasted like. I tasted this chocolate and it was amazing! The chocolate is smooth and velvety and the flavor is strong. It's also not too sweet, and I love that because overly sweet chocolate makes my teeth hurt for some reason. I agree that the price is a little steep but I did not pay much less at Wal-mart. If this was the only outlet I had to get this brand then I would definitely purchase from this site. I think this item deserves higher marks than it has gotten because of the price. Purchase from Wal-mart if you can, you will not be sorry!

If you're pruchasing as a gift for yourself or someone who knows good chocolate, this is a good choice - definately better than "stovers", which I think tastes like wax. Also, Merci is "thank you" in french for those that didn't know.

I had to place it in the refrigerator and have had to keep the boxes there.  The individual wrapper is fused with the chocolate and it is therefore difficult to separate chocoate from the wrapper.

Honestly, I should stop my automatic one-stop-easy-shop addiction shopping at Amazon.  This is just another example of purchasing at Amazon a product that, after the fact, I find in several other places for a much lower price.  In fact, Amazon's "sale" of 2 boxes for $[...], is more than the regular price at several other stores.  Additionally, the packages came with big stickers "Ready for shipment," on them which were not easy to peel off (makes for tacky looking gifts).  Search elsewhere.  You'll find you'll save money.These are tasty, however.  We've had them before and enjoyed them.

The marketing campaign should have been the first clue.. "mercy" well--gosh sakes Homer...Save yourself the trouble and buy some stovers.  Go to an international candy site to furnish a European chocolate.

My dogs love them, even my 15 year old who is no longer interested in anything was up off the couch chewing away.

Too bad as almonds are so good for you and a bit of spice with the tamari would wake up the taste buds but drenched in too much tamari for me.

I must admit to being a total Twinings fan.  There are so many of their teas that I really enjoy, but I think that this one is my very favorite evening (non-caffeine) tea.  It is just so fruity and nice that you almost don't need sweetener (although I do use just a little).This particular tea has been named and renamed a number of times over the years ... used to be Four Fruits (or some-such) for one of the other names.  I wish they would pick a name and stick to it!  The current box is very pretty.  :)Highly recommended.TWININGS Herbal Tea, Wild Berries, 20-Count (Pack of 6)
This is an excellant finishing salt for those who wish to add that smokey flavor to any dish. This is not a lite smokey taste but rather robust, use it at the table.
I use a pinch an meats when I grill or broil. Love the alder wood taste of this salt, broil indoors and get a rick smoked flavor. A little goes a long way!

It taste great! It has a great smokey flavor and taste great on burgers,chicken,pork and fish.  And although the container is small, a little goes a long way. Great on lamb and on veggies also. a wonderful salt for almost anything. is really good to put on steaks and then tenderize. makes the meat very tender and hold in juices. My favorite cooking salt by far.

This is a perfect salt for dressing grilled items.  I use it with a Heuck 33004 Pre-Seasoned Cast Iron 17 Inch Reversible Griddle to make steaks that taste like they were grilled over charcoal, but without the mess and bother.
The product was as advertised.  A little coarser than I expected, but good non the less.  The company shipped it quickly.

column9: The ones that are supposed to be Mango taste terrible!
column10: Most of the flavors in the island pack are pretty bland--there's just not enough tartness to overcome the geletin/chewy texture.  And the mangos just taste terrible.  There are better flavor packs out there and I would personally recommend any of those.

There are a lot of chocolates in this bag. In fact there was too many Whoppers.  I recommend not ordering this item when hot temps are expected as all of the snacks were melted and deformed.  They were still good, just harder to get them out of the individual wrappers.

column9: Nice mix of the classics and favorites
column10: This is a good mix overall of all the favorite candy bars and classics. Kit Kats, Hershy Milk Chocolate, Reeses Cups, Almond Joy... The ONLY complaint is the overload of the Malt Ball things. WAAAAAY too many of those compared to the other varieties of candy in the bag.Also, you might not want to order this product before November or after March due to the melt factor with shipping.
This candy had been placed in a over heated place or in the sun, and clearly had melted. It was not usable for passing out for trick or treat, that is why I ordered it. Very dissapointed.

This obviously is a chocolate candy such as you might buy for Halloween treats.  However, I ordered it in late spring and the weather throughout the country was unseasonably warm this year.  The people that shipped it simply stuffed the bag in a box and mailed it to me in the 80 degree weather.  Needless to say, when it arrived, there was not one piece of the candy in it's original shape.  It was melted every which way and stuck to the wrappers.  The Reese's peanut butter cups were flattened as though someone had sat on them so had to be pealed from both the stability sheet, the wrapper and the paper cup.  The flavor was ok but each piece was a real challenge to eat.  Doesn't anybody use their head when they are shipping such things?  Where is that supervisor???  This should have been shipped with dry ice.  Capeech????

How disappointing to get this and find a bag full of melted candy.  I suppose it is still edible and can be passed out for Halloween, but I expected the quality to be better.  And I know it didn't melt here because it is Michigan in October - it's cold!
This provides a good mix of candy at a decent price - it provide variety to the office candy dish, much better than typical hard candy choices.
This is a great mix of classic candy at an awesome price. Loved every last piece and I will buy again soon, not a single complaint.
These must have been melted in transit or before. All of them were misshapen and smooshed. They taste good though..just wouldn't want to pass them out for Halloween.

All melted and as they were tightly packed in a box all squashed so not recoverable. If you live in a hot place dont order these. Looks like I am not the only who had this problem, hard to tell who was at fault, were they melted before or during the transit?

column9: WOW! Top of the line chocolates!

I bought this Raspberry syrup when Amazon was selling them on a 3 for sale.  I thought THREE bottles would last me forever!  My husband started adding a little to his iced tea and LOVES IT!  I'm already back to buy MORE!

column4: december75 "Electronic assault is a hate crim...
column10: I'm very disappointed in this product.  It has almost no taste, regardless of how much you put in.  I guess I will stick to cheaper brands as I'm not sure how they justify the $16 for this.

I read reviews preferring Da Vinci, so I gave it a try.  I prefer Torani.  Torani has fuller, truer flavor.  Da Vinci was very thin and had minimally higher sodium.  Can't really justify the price for Da Vinci.  Torani was strong enough to provide flavor and go a long way before needing to be restocked.  I am sorry I bought three bottles of Da Vinci.  But I am certain now, after my taste testing, that no matter what the flavor, Torani has a satisfactory rating with me, and Da Vinci has an unsatisfactory rating.

I reserve 5-stars for the best of the best.  We've gotten several brands of hemp protein powder over the years, and really liked Ruth's brand.  It's excellent, has a much better texture than some of the others, and we've stayed with it for at least a couple of years.  But with a good price on the Bob's Red Mill brand, I decided to try it out, even though there were four bags in the purchase.  It's at least as good as the Ruth's, and the price was better.  Texture is fine, there is not nearly as much of the distinctive taste of some other brands, and even what's there with the Bob's brand is not at all a problem - it just adds "character" to the fruit shakes in which it's mainly used.Suggestion: go to a warehouse club, buy the largest bag of frozen fruit they've got to save money (multi-variety, cut up, fresh frozen), put it in a good blender (we use a Vitamix), add some hemp protein powder, and some other powdered flavoring or other ingredient if desired, a little water, and you have a highly nutritious smoothie with good protein content, several servings of fruit, and whatever else you put in it.  We make these a meal once a day on most summer days.Bottom line, it looks like we've changed brands for the foreseeable future.  Great product.

I use this in all my baking. Replace 1/4 of your flour and with the Hemp Protein powder. Does not change the flavor, that I can tell. If you are baking something light colored, the powder may give it a slight greenish color. The powder is green in color. I love this stuff for the nutrient benefits.

Gritty texture, doesn't mix well, hemp bits get stuck in teeth. The package recommends adding it to yogurt but that turns the yogurt into a gritty inedible slop.  I'm afraid to use it in pancakes for fear it will result in grittiness. It's just a terrible excuse for "protein powder", I'm not sure it can called that.

And an important note about these is that the bags are about the size of something you would find in a vending machine. I opened it up and remember looking at the side naming how many of each kind were in , then i realized there we NO FRITOS AT ALL and ABOUT 26 bags of chips !? I dont get it ? But oh well , just letting some of you know .

column9: Organix Grain Free Adult Dry Dog Food,
column10: My dog loved this food. I know it has soybeans and I was concerned about that particular ingredient and I emailed the company, and I feel so much better after their reply and doing the research myself. I definitely will keep her on this food, she seems to be doing very well on it.Here is the reply from the company : Thank you for your question. I can understand why you ask as soybean has gotten something of a bad name but it is actually a very good protein source that compliments other proteins. Organic soybean contains a complete complement of amino acids, naturally complexed vitamins and chelated minerals; balanced and stabilized fatty acids; and lecithin which is an important brain and nerve component and helps increase immune response. The main concern people have is the possibility of digestive problems, this is mitigated in the cooking process, increasing the protein digestibility and helping reduce flatulence.This is about the ingredient poultry meal:The ingredient for the ORGANIX® Grain-Free formula states poultry meal, rather than chicken meal due to the organic certification regulations. The ORGANIX Grain-Free food is actually formulated with chicken meal, which is of the same high quality as our chicken meal in all of our ORGANIX diets.Our product is certified in the "made with organic" category and there are specific regulations about how to label or communicate to the customer which ingredients are organic.  We are allowed to list 3 specific organic ingredients or organic food groupings in the "made with organic" statement.  This is why the front of our bags call-out "made with organic chicken, peas, flaxseed". Part of the regulations also require that if the organic ingredient is a call-out on the packaging that all ingredients in that category are organic.Since our packaging references "made with organic chicken", it is required that all chicken ingredients in the ingredient dec are organic.  This seems like a simple problem to solve.  Just use organic chicken meal.  The problem is organic chicken meal does not currently exist.  There are multiple reasons why it is not available, but the main point is we cannot purchase organic chicken meal, yet our formulas were formulated to contain chicken meal in order to provide a wholesome balanced nutrition for our pets.  This is why chicken meal is listed as poultry meal in ORGANIX Grain-Free.

column9: A gift from the Goddess of Mercy.
column10: Like the famously smoky Lapsang Souchong, Oolong tea comes from mist-enshrouded Wuyi Mountains in the northwestern corner of China's Fujian Province (north of Guangdong [Canton] Province), whose greatest tourist draw besides its mountains is its coast line on the Taiwan Straits, and where tea has been grown at least since the Sung Dynasty (AD 960 - 1279).In terms of production, Oolong tea takes a middle position between the fully fermented black teas (Darjeeling, Assam, Ceylon, Kenya, Lapsang Souchong, etc.) and the unfermented green teas (Sencha, Maccha, Gyokuro, Hougicha/Hojicha, Gunpowder Green), in that it is part-fermented or "brown" tea. Its long, dark leaves' fermentation is stopped when they are about 30% red and 70% green, after which they are rubbed to promote their aroma and texture and then dried over charcoal.Ti Quan (Kuan) Yin Oolong takes its name from the Goddess of Mercy (Quan Yin), whose statues can often be found in front of Buddhist temples. Quan Yin is a bodhisattva, i.e. a person who has earned the right to leave this world of misery and enter nirvana, but who has volunteered to stay on earth and assist others in their quest for enlightenment. Legend has it that in a village whose temple was adorned by an iron ("ti") statue of the goddess, one night Quan Yin appeared in a local farmer's dream and guided him to a cave behind the temple. There, she told him, he would find a treasure he was to tend and share with others. The treasure he did find when he went to the cave the very next morning turned out to be a small tea plant, which he took home and nursed. When it had grown to its full size, its leaves produced this particularly aromatic tea with the delicate fragrance of fruits and spices and a rich, golden color. As he had been bidden by the goddess, the farmer shared it with his neighbors, and he also dedicated it to Quan Yin in grateful appreciation of her gift.Goddess of Mercy Oolong makes for a great refreshment at any time of day and also goes well with meals. It can be enjoyed with or without milk (or cream), and its leaves will even yield a second cup when re-infused.
