There is a reason this particular hot chocolate is so cheap.AWFUL!!!Stay with the Dark and Milk chocolate people and may the force be with you!!!!

Timothy's World Coffee K-cups White Hot Chocolate for Keurig Brewers, 22 Count (Pack of 2)Well I read some reviews and it sounded so good I ordered it, and I am very,very disappointed and now I have a whole  new box and one box missing 2 pods~I can't even give it away. It is like watered down skin milk with a very little rich white  chocolate taste.Since it is not returnable I am stuck with it and  one review said to mix it with another coffee and  try for a latte,ugh..  I guess it's live and let live, or drink and not drink. Other pods I ordered were good, guess you can't like them all.

column9: Yuck! I love hot chocolate but this is sickening!!!
column10: A coworker of mine asked me to purchase this for her for the office, but she told me it was a coffee. I searched and searched, then realized it was hot chocolate. She was clueless - all this time she thought she was drinking coffee, and this stuff is so sweet, thin, and the color is disgusting. She's 27, but she must have never drunk coffee before. So, when I tried it, I thought for sure it would have a bit of a bitter taste to it, and I would have to add sugar/creamer, but this stuff is so over-the-top sweet, it's just plain sickening. (When I drink hot chocolate, I like to put marshmallows in it, but there's no way with this one. I had to pour it out.) Would not recommend for traditional hot chocolate lovers.

The White Hot Chocolate by Timothy's was the cheapest item (~$0.50/cup) on amazon for some form of hot chocolate. I get sick of drinking coffee from my Keurig so I thought I'd give it a try. First thing I noticed was that the first ingredient was Coconut Oil (???). I know that this is prevalent in single-size non-refrigerated creamers but I would not expect it from hot chocolate. After all the different forms of sweetener and whey fillers, artificial flavoring is the 10th ingredient followed by "natural cream flavor". After 'brewing' my first cup, it fill my nostrils with a pleasant creamy, white chocolate aroma. First taste was OK, nothing special. Sweet initial flavor, followed by fake-creamy taste and then lastly that feeling in your mouth from the artificial sweeteners. Mixed it with my coffee and it tastes pretty good.
Unfortunately, I bought 2 boxes of Timothy's White Hot Chocolate and my family does not like it. It is way too sweet! And it looks very unappealing.

column9: very watery with no real flavor
column10: This is just awful! The color looks like soured milk and the taste is very watery. I will not buy this again!
If it weren't way too sweet, it might be good - not excellent, but a good change of pace.  If you are looking for a strong chocolate taste, this isn't it.
The hot white chocolate was great.  However, one of the two boxes was complete ruined.  There was white chocolate powder all over everything and not one K-cup survived in that box.

column9: crap do not buy this ever.
column10: this is the worst buy i ever made.i will not take any chances again.this is crap do not buy this read reviews always and hope for the best.yuk dont do it.

column9: Ummmm...white chocolate is NOT real chocolate....
column10: It cracks me up hearing people crying on here that the product "doesn't taste like hot chocolate".  Well duh, that's because it's hot WHITE chocolate which isn't actual chocolate, it is the cocoa butter that is produced when cocoa is made, then it is sweetened and made into whatever. The result is a creamier, sweeter and smoother taste which is NOTHING like actual chocolate, so unless you are a fan of white chocolate and are expecting this to taste like real chocolate you ARE going to be disappointed.  I am a a fan and love it and my K-cups, I have the platinum B-70 coffee maker so I can make a 6 ounce cup if I want it to be extra tasty or 8 ounce if I want it more mild.  I would suggest giving it a quick stir as all the flavor can somtimes settle.  It's delicious and for those of you who are giving this a bad review because it "doesn't taste like hot chocolate", it's not supposed to, stick to that gross Green Mountain Cocoa that tastes like choco-chalk water!

I was excited when these came out as I LOVE white chocolate! I ordered them immediately and was excited to get them. Unfortunately it didn't taste as good as I hoped. With the 8oz. brew (as recommended by the manufacturer) it tasted very watery and with the 6oz. brew (not recommended ~ by me!) it didn't brew the whole product and just clogged up. I brewed the 8oz. into a stronger cup of coffee and that didn't taste too bad, but I won't be buying this again.

I don't know how the product can be both too sweet and too watery, but it is!  I bought these on a whim, thinking they would be good for guests and the occasional time I wanted something a little different.  After trying them, I won't even offer these to a guest in my home.Let me preface a little.  I have the original Keurig, with only one cup size, which is about 7 ounces.The consistency is watery.  There is no richness, no creaminess.  At the same time, the resultant brew is extremely sweet.  It doesn't really taste like white chocolate, more like fake vanilla flavoring.  The only way I can describe this is: non-fat milk, mixed with a LOT of hot water and sugar, with a touch vanilla.I am normally a fan of the Timothy's products, but I definitely won't buy this again.  I hate to waste anything, so I've started mixing one cup of this with a cup of Extra Bold coffee.  That way, at least I'm saving some money on coffee creamer.
This sounds great but has a strange chemical taste. We threw the box away after two cups. A terrible product.

This is a good tasting product, but way too sweet to drink all the time.  Green Mountain Hot Coco  is better.7/22/08 Update:  Have to downgrade this product, The sweetness is just too much.  I have stoped using it.
Love the Keurig machine, love the regular hot chocolate but this one is AWFUL.  I have a large family and NO ONE would drink it!  tastes honestly like sweet white water.  Save your money

column9: Okay, this is just my fault for not believing the reviews
column10: I did read the 1 star reviews for this stuff. I really did. I just didn't believe them. My fault. Which is why I gave this product three stars. Two stars are for my own stupidity.  Otherwise, it would get 1 star.This is really vile stuff.I know that white chocolate isn't white hot chocolate. It's totally different and not really chocolate at all.  This is milk, coconut milk, with lots and lots and lots of sweetener. I like sweet things but I couldn't take it. Half a cup, that was it.  I'm now trying to figure out what to do with the rest of it.

I really like hot chocolate all year round but find that drinking more than one cup is just not a good idea in hot weather.  I had to literally force myself to drink the entire cup. The white chocolate, as well as the regular chocolate, had a funky taste to it. At first I just thought I was something about the white chocolate, since I don't usually drink white chocolate, but then the next day I tried the regular and the same taste was there.  I have made tea and coffee in my brewer, and the taste wasn't there.  I have also made other kids of hot chocolate without the taste, so I would have to say that it is just in this particular product.  I unfortunately cannot send this product back due to my location, but I know I will never by anything by this company again.

This one is cloyingly sweet.  I like white chocolate, and have had powdered white hot chocolate I have enjoyed before, but this is not it.  I think another reviewer summed it up with "sweet white water".Until another manufacturer makes a white chocolate k-cup (perhaps forthcoming from Cafe Escapes?), I'm using my Keurig for the hot water and sticking with powdered for my white hot chocolate fix.

column9: great tasting and fun for kids
column10: We have only had our Keurig for a few weeks but the kids have been begging to make their own drinks with it so we ordered this and it just arrived (really FAST too, thanks Amazon) and the kids LOVE it!  They think it tastes great and so do I and we had no problem with residue left in the kcup or clogging like some others said.  It dissolved the whole cup and they put it on the largest setting (for ours its 9 oz) and it is not watered down or too sweet either.  Also, they love to put ice in it and have a cold one.  We will continue buying!

I love white chocolate and this is nothing like it.  When made according to directions, this tastes like water with some sugar and a little powdered milk in it.  If you use less water in an attempt to make it more flavorful, it still tastes terrible and has a nasty aftertaste.  After looking at the ingredients I understood why - they include the artificial sweetener sucralose.  Now I have to figure out what to do with two boxes of this awful stuff since even my kids won't drink it.

This sounded like it would be soooo good so I bought 3 boxes. Man was I wrong. It tasted like artificially sweetened, watered down, fat free milk. I tried everything to salvage this purchase. I mixed it with real hot chocolate, coffee, tea; the only thing I accomplished was to spoil everything that I mixed it with. I finally, reluctantly, threw it all away.

I am an avid lover of white chocolate and love DD's white hot chocolate so I thought this would be a good alternative...boy was I wrong. It tasty waxy and chemically. It was not drinkable. My kids are garbage pails and eat/drink everything...they refused to drink it after 4 sips.

The flavor is definitely white chocolate. I found it to be too sweet. However, I was able to balance out the sweetness with milk. I used whole milk but I am sure that milk with lesser fat will do the job and save you calories.

column4: Rock'nRoll doctor "If it ain't Baroque, don't...
column9: Great as a Hot Toddy base
column10: Just like "White Chocolate", this is not real chocolate but rather sweetened cocoa butter.  My kids like it as-is cuz it IS very sweet.  I've found it also makes a wonderful hot toddy with two shots Kahlua and one shot Rum or a smoothe Bourbon like Gentleman Jack.  Really warms the cockels on a cold day.
Too sweet with no chocolate taste.  Tried by various family members and did not appeal to any.  Would definately not recommend.
I will be putting these boxes in the trash tonight! This is the first k cup product that I didn't like. It was like instant milk with sugar !!!

I can't drink this on it's own. Honestly Timothy's what were you thinking? I  make this up as a small cup then add rain forest expresso to it. A sort of Mocha - I like to think. So bottom line  - for me - If you want chocolate go with Green Mountain.

If you are considering purchasing this product, you need to know it has Splenda or the equivalent in it. I bought two boxes and have to give it away due to a bad reaction I  artificial sweeteners. also, it is not creamy like the Hershey brand. Overall, I can't drink it and if I could it tastes awful.

column9: Before going out  or  after coming in from the cold .
column10: This is a must  flor your sweet tooth and a significaant savings from going to Dunkin Donuts for one. No need to go out in thje cold  to get one.
I really enjoyed this k cup flavor!  Just a nice little pick me up for early in the morning or late at night!

I so enjoy this drink.  It tastes very indulgent.  I found the amazon site to cost less than the keurig site.  I ordered 4 boxes and received free shipping from amazon.  It was like getting one box free compared to the other site.  No expensive coffee shops for me.  (This drink is also good chilled).
Great hot white chocolate.  It's great mixing it with coffee, too!  Definitely on my reorder list!

I could not believe how very sweet this is. Made my teeth rattle. I have given it away to other users of K-cups.  I have not gotten a response as of yet. I guess it would be great for people that have a sweet tooth.
Drink tasted like water...no chocolate taste at all.  I am now stuck with over 40 cups of it.  I am having to add instant hot chocolate to it to drink it.
This was very sweet and I could not drink it.  My husband and best friend on the other hand LOVE it.

Our office purchases various Timothy's coffee products which are always excellent so we recently purchased the White Hot Chocolate. I find the taste awful and could not even drink it. It isn't sweet or chocolatly and tastes nothing like I expected it to. I would not recommend wasting your money!!!

This product had no real flavor! I had several people try it and nobody liked it. I ended up heating up a cup of milk and adding the powder from the K-Cup to it. It was the only way it was drinkable! Save your money, don't buy this!

When I was gagged by the sweetness of this drink, I went looking on the box for ingredients. They are listed in this order: coconut oil, corn syrup, fructose, dextrose, sugar - before it goes on to list other things. That's all sugars and oil!I fell it's important to point out that this particular product should NOT be taken as typical of Timothy's other offerings. We LOVE Timothy's Columbian de-caf as well as some of their tea offerings.
Forget the bad reviews.  This is very sweet and tastes great.  If you love white chocolate you will want to drink this.

This white hot chocolate has a great taste and richness.  I am a big fan of white chocolate ,so to me , this is really very good.  If you like regular hot chocolate , you may not like this but if you are a fan of white chocolate, like me, it is very good.

column9: Just open the top, add it to your keurig coffee.. Warning: has Splenda
column10: These are only good for adding to coffee to make a white mocha flavor. Just puncture a hole in the top of the k cup, then pour in the bottom of your cup. Brew your cofee on top, and stir, WARNING: contains Splenda.... I was disappointed that I have been unknowingly drinking these and they have this artificial sweetner in them that I generally refuse to even touch!
I bought a box and finished them in a week. Very rich and sweet. Concerned though that they are loaded with calories.

I agree with other reviews I've seen about this product...that it is very weak.  However, I have found that after the brewing stops, if you just open the foil top and empty the powder that remains in the K-Cup into your mug and mix it up it then tastes great.

This is a great buy and you get 2 boxes. The flavor reminds me of Duncan Donuts white hot chocolate which is one of my favorites. While its not as thick as D.D. it still has great flavor. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because there tends to be a little still left in the K-cup that didn't melt. I just pop the foil off and mix it in my mug.
This white hot cocoa is scrumptious!  I love it, as does my husband who is difficult to please, and my grandkids look forward to having it instead of regular cocoa.
Very rich and flavorful ...always sold out on Keurig site so its nice finding additional sellers and you can't beat this price. Definitely will be back :-)

I love the Timothy's White Hot Chocolate! Over Thanksgiving my house guests loved itway too much because they wiped me out and that is why I am here buying more.I first had the white hot chocolate at Starbucks and so when I saw it for my Kurig I was so happy.It went over well with the grandkids when the other k-cup hot chocolate was too strong for them.So it really is a matter of taste. The person that mentioned not sharing with her house guestsprobably cheated them out of a great drink! My husband can't quite past the fact that is is milky lookingbut I noticed he keeps brewing it up for himself.

This is the best k-cup cocoa ever created! I prefer the white to any other variety as it does not have caffeine. I brew this as a 6oz for a stronger flavor, using two k-cups per 12oz mug. The white chocolate flavor pops and is addictive! I do not drink coffee so this is my drink of choice, I buy these in bulk and am not willing to share normally! I challenge any cocoa conaseur to find a better tasting cup of cocoa!  White hot chocolate is #1! Thanks Timothy's for continuing to make it regardless of all the whinnying going on!!!!

column9: White Hot chocolate K-cups discounted from Amazon
column10: Received in record time and in good order.  Very happy with service.  White Hot Chocolate is an excellent K-cup product.

This is by far, the worst tasting K-Cup variety I have tried to date. Luckily for me, this was a gift and I did not fork over the money myself.  I am a HUGE white chocolate fan. Unfortunately, this had no white chocolate flavor whatsoever. What did it taste like? Watery milk, sugar, and a hint of vanilla. Everyone in my family tried this, everyone dumped their cup. I honestly don't understand how this could receive positive reviews.

The packets of white hot chocolate powder mix have been discontinued by Timothy's (per their customer service) so I purchased the K-cups this time around from Amazon for the great quantity and price deal.  Well, let me tell you, the K-cup formula tastes like chemicals and has a lousy aftertaste. They are horrible. The label on the box of K-cups says there is sucralose in them whereas the packets did not have sucralose. I still had one packet left to compare labels with and that is the main difference. I called Timothy's customer service to ask why they changed the formula & did I get a box of "sugar-free" or "diet" K-cups in a regular box in error. I was informed this is just the way they're formulated.  So, I will never buy them again & will have to find someone to take these 2 boxes of nasty tasting things off my hands.
THIS WAS DELICIOUS I LOVE HOT CHOCOLATE BUT THE WHITE HOT CHOCOLATE WAS OUT OF SIGHT.I WOULD RECOMMENT IT TO EVERYONE.
Just the smell of this stuff makes me want to hurl. It has a strange chemical type smell and terrible taste! What a waste of Money!

The Timothy's White Hot Chocolate is delicious.  I normally do not like white chocolate, however, I bought this for my daughter.  After smelling it brewing, I had to try it.  I am hooked.  It is smooth, creamy and light, perfect anytime of day, especially as a "before bedtime" treat.If you are looking for something that tastes like normal hot chocolate, this is not it.  It has its own unique flavor and quality, a definite must in our family.

Being relatively new to the Keurig, we are trying all types of coffees, teas and hot chocolates.  We stumbled upon the white hot chocolate after ordering a chocolate and nut variety pack, and it has become my husband and son's favorite.  They have a cup of this almost every evening even though it's summer!  They love it so much that I had to order 4 boxes the last time just to keep up.  We definitely recommend this, especially to hot chocolate lovers.
Wish I was able to return this item because it tastes like a**!Bad Bad Bad! Leaves a horrible taste in your mouth!
I love this white chocolate alone and as part of a mocha.  It is getting harder and harder to find it though.
It looks almost like milk coming out of the Keurig, but it is the best hot cocoa ever. Smooth and sweet, and what a great deal!

column9: Taste's nothing like White Hot Chocolate
column10: I am a fan of White Hot Chocolate, and this doesn't even come remotely close to the flavor. It is similar to 1% milk with some sugar added to it. My son wouldn't even touch the stuff, said it was horrible. I tried adding it to a cup of regular coffee, and it ruined a good cup of coffee. Those who gave this 5 starts obviously have no clue what good White Hot Chocolate tastes like! Gross, don't waste your money.

If you like white chocolate you'll love this!  It's not as creamy as a Cafe Escape's hot chocolate k-cup, but add a dash of milk (it's always needed to cool down your beverage anyways) and it's like drinking melted white chocolate!  If you haven't had white chocolate, go buy some and taste it first, it's very different then chocolate.  Based on other reviews I read for this product it seems to me that people bought this without knowing what to expect.But if you've always been a fan of white chocolate like I am, then this is amazing.  I recommend making a small white chocolate and then adding a k-cup of coffee to make a delicious white mocha like beverage.  Granted it not a white mocha, but it's close enough and probably lower in calories.
This hot chocolate is fairly good, however it is way too sweet for my taste.  Too much sugar taste and not enough chocolate.

Coming home from a rough day and need a soothing pick-me-up or coming in from the cold and tired of hot chocolate.  This is your drink!  Be sure to use the smaller setting (in my 2 cup machine)to avoid it being too weak.  If brewed strong enough, this is fabulously soothing and relaxing.  It tastes like a cross between a hot chocolate and a warm milk. Only reason I didn't give it 4 stars is that it wasn't strong enough on the larger setting so I feel like I don't get as much as I would like for my money.

I love hot white chocolate, and I do not care for traditional hot cocoa or hot chocolate. I am also a huge fan of K-cup coffee.  But, this one is all wrong and it tastes like chemicals. I can't drink it.
Received this today and was thrilled.  The price since I ordered it has almost doubled so I doubt we'll be ordering again anytime soon.

I almost wish they would stop making this because heaven forbid I should have to use my own will power in order to stop drinking this stuff. My husband and I love it. we have even been known to enjoy a cup on a hot summer night. I use it on the 10oz. setting and think it is perfect. My husband who likes thing a lot sweeter than I do either uses the 6oz. setting or mixes it with another powdered hot chocolate mix on the 10oz. setting. He has come up with some interesting combinations. I also use it with Starbuck's Via (columbian flavor) and melt in a candy cane and it tastes just like a white peppermint mocha from Starbuck's. YUM! The only problem is now I have to have at least one cup of the coffee mixture a day and the hot chocolate at the end of the day. I think my New Years resolution might have to be to limit my White hot chocolate intake. This stuff is going to put me in the poor house.

I was tentative ordering 44 kcups of this flavor but figured for $14.99 it was worth a try. I like these. For my taste they are not too sweet and I definitely am glad I got them. Not too watery even at the 8 oz setting. All in all, I like the flavor and am waiting for another deal. A little kalua is not bad at night either ;)
I love it.  Perfect for these chilly nights.  I have a large mug with whipped cream.

I made a 9.25 ounce cup and was very pleased so if I want it more concentrated I will make a smaller cup (part of the beauty of the B60 & B70). For me it was sweet enough, but I don't have an addiction to sugar so my taste buds are easily pleased. If you like high calorie, thick syrupy drinks then you will not like this. If you are conscious about your health then you might.

The Timothy's White Hot Chocolate tasted good to me.  It's a good alternative to coffee or tea.  I didn't think it tasted like weak sugar water at all which was the feedback left from several reviews.  I had no resediue issues, or need for stirring-but this may be because I have a newer model Keurig....no complaints here  There must have been some changes to this product over the past few years because I ordered the product, read the reviews, and was worried I'd wasted our money when I saw all of the negative comments.  But that wasn't the case.  The only drawback is that is costs me 2 Weight Watcher points, so I'll have to drink sparingly :)I'm giving it four stars because of the stiff competition from Chai Latte and Cafe Mocha that Cafe Escape K-Cups offers.  These two items are staples in my kitchen that my husband literally frowns upon when we run low or out of.

I am a big fan of Timothy's white hot chocolate.  My spouse on the other hand says there is to much of a coconut flavor that comes thru.  So mixed review The coconut undertones donot bother me so I recommend this product.

This actually tasted good with the exception that it was like drinking sweet water. I "brewed" it in my B40 @ the 7.25 mug size. Seems like nothing will replace milk as a base for any chocolate like drink. Kids may like it though. Next time I come across one of these I will put some half & half in it to see if that makes a difference

Didnt expect White Hot Chocolate to have coconut in it. YES,I SAID COCONUT! But it does. Had to read the ingredients twice to make sure,but thats what is in there. It adds a sweet flavor,but I dont like coconut in my cocoa!
Its a very sweet drink, wouldnt want to have a 2nd cup in the same day. It has a nice flavor, marshmallowy.  Very distant "diet-like" taste, but otherwise a hit.If i run out, I'd buy again
This product is very watery.  We disappointed since most Timothy K-cups we had tried were very good.  Would not recommend this white hot chocolate.
The taste is pretty good, but it looks like a cup of skim milk.  It needs just a bit of color.  I love white chocolate.
What's up with all the negative reviews? I have about twelve different K-Cups (coffees.....teas.......hot chocolates) and this is my favorite. I put a little 1% milk in it and it's fabulous.

I had been searching for white hot chocolate K-cups and found that this is the only one available.  Despite mixed reviews I decided to try them.  What a disappointment!  Even with a smaller cup size than I would usually use for coffee, the product was watery and tasteless.
This seems to have a bit of an aftertaste, but is still pretty good.  Haven't tried any of the other white hot chocolates, so I can't compare it to them.

This is the best hot chocolate so sweet and creamy. It is not weak like some hot chocolates are. It is my favorite everyday drink.  Just love it! Thanks Timothy for creating such a wonderful white hot chocolate.  Elizabeth

column9: Tastes good when you mix it w/ other coffees, but by itself...Um NO!
column10: I absolutely LOVE white chocolate so I was extremely happy to see this. That was until I actually tasted it. 2 words, WATERED DOWN! I have the platinum keurig, so I have a choice on the cup size, and even the smallest size is too watery. It helps to add some half & half or milk though. Or use it as a way to spruce up a coffe, then your coffee will have a semi white chocolate java feel going on.

column9: A drink that's unique and versatile
column10: Having tried this product yesterday, I can definitely recommend it.  First, as others have pointed out, white chocolate is not the same as regular chocolate, so if you are expecting this to be a cup of Nestle Hot Cocoa you will be disappointed.  It is a sweet drink, and looks like hot milk, but I found it very tasty and was quite pleased.  Second, it's great for mixing with other stuff:  I tried some with Baileys Irish Cream (YUM!).  I also put in a packet of instant hot cocoa with caramel in the mug first and then made this - my 11-yr old took the mug and wouldn't give it back!  I plan on experimenting with other combinations as well, but so far this has my stamp of approval.
Can't find this in too many places but thankful it's at Amazon. It's a great change from the regular hot chocolate. I reach for this before the dark chocolate.

To keep this short, like all K-cup cocoas I've seen available this one contains artificial sweetener (sucralose aka Splenda), presumably to offset the smaller portion vs. packets with a sweetener that's sweeter than sugar. Since I hate the taste of acesulfame potassium & sucralose I've disliked all the K-cup cocoa varieties. According to Timothy's website the standard packets of their White Hot Chocolate don't contain artificial sweeteners so that may be an option, but I'll stick with mixing cocoa powder & sugar in a cup and lose some convenience.
we bought it for the winter season and have tried it already and is good and so simple with the keurig.  wife mixed it with coffee too.
This tastes like a vanilla Power Bar. I didn't like it at all, but I suggest you sample it by buying the sample pack from [...]
The White hot Chocolate is amazing! It is a great delicate and sweet flavor, and has become absolutely my favorite! Everyone out there that does not liekt hem, send them to me!

At first glance, Timothy's White Hot Chocolate was not what I expected.  It is actually white, which may disturb some folks.  However, it is very good.  It is very sweet, and a good alternative for the non-coffee drinking crowd.  I personally like to make it on the small setting and then add a small setting portion of flavored coffee.  (Gloria Jean's Sleigh Ride and the white chocolate are awesome!)  I have hooked many of my co-workers on the half white chocolate/ half coffee concoction and they love it!

I had trouble deciding between 3 stars and 4 stars.  Some days when I drink this it is toooo sweet, but somedays it hits the right spot.  I also like to make it in a large mug that is about 1/3 full of coffee.  Voila - white chocolate mocha for much less than you can buy it at a coffee house.  The coffee helps tone down the sweetness.

I really enjoyed this. I bought it when it was on sale for $14 for two boxes!!! I don't drink, but I think this would make an excellent cocktail with rum, vodka or whiskey. I will say, though, it's very rich, I usually only drink a couple gulps. I'd like to try it with different syrups, like maybe raspberry syrup or put ice cream in it.
It might be personal taste, but these were pretty foul tasting as far as white chocolate goes...tasted more like pure sugar.

I know many reviewers thought this was too sweet, but I loved it.  It's not a milk chocolate drink, but a white chocolate drink.  It has a hot sweet milky taste that I love on the weekends when I don't want or need a caffeine fix.  It's great with brunch, donuts, popcorn and a dvd or even by itself as a late night comfort drink.  I love hot chocolate too, but this is a different taste and a wonderful yummy experience if you like something new.

I really love my Keurig and when I got a chance to get the White Hot Chocolate I jumped on it! It is wonderful. It isn't coffee, so it doesn't have the same kick or taste. It has a wonderful white chocolate flavor and aroma. I use the 8oz setting. You can try it many ways (just read the box for more suggestions) and enjoy it. The kids add stuff like whipped cream and sprinkles to it to make it fun. I add a little 1/2 and 1/2 to make make it sweet and creamy. It doesn't do for hot chocolate what it does for coffee, but it does brew it easier and the flavor of white chocolate is very unique and satisfying as an after dinner dessert. If you want hot chocolate then brew just a cup of hot water and add powder. If you want something a little more unique, then buy the White Hot Chocolate.

A sample came with my Keurig one cup brewer along with other hot chocolate k cups. I read the reviews of this white hot chocolate and was not prepared to like it. I have to tell you that a cup of this satisfies that craving you get for "chocolate". No it's not brown, doesn't come wrapped in foil nor does it float in the air but boy is it good! The other hot chocolate varieties were weak and watered down...not worth the money. Would be interesting if Giardelli made k cups but alas just packets.

column9: Not sweet enough or strong enough
column10: I knew the white hot chocolate by Timothy's was not going to be perfect because I have not found any k cup products to be as strong as I would like. However, because of the low price I thought I would try it anyway (it's a lot better than paying $2.00 apiece price at Dunkin Donuts). The white hot chocolate was not as strong or as sweet as I would have liked. I put a pack of sugar in it to make it sweeter. I still think it is a good value for an occassional "non Dunkie's" white hot chocolate. I can have 2 for a lower price and less calories than Dunkie's small size drink.
Not a chocolate lover at all but I love white chocolate so I thought I would taste this.  Now I know that white chocolate is much sweeter but the taste from this was just awful.

I live in an area where ALL of the Dunkin' Donut shops were closed and converted to local bakery/donut shops. This, of course, occurred after I got hooked on their white hot chocolate. I'm not a fan of regular hot chocolate, and Timothy's White Hot Chocolate is an EXCELLENT option - especially as it is cheaper than Dunkin' Donuts and I can have it whenever I want.

column9: As good a choice as you can find!
column10: Wanted hot chocolate available for guests, and this was a reasonable choice.  It threw them a bit when it was "white", but they liked it anyway!

My wife and I both think this is a delicious product.  We're happy because we think the product tastes sweet and creamy.  Plus, it's a good value since you get TWO boxes for $21 rather than ONE box for $13 at Keurig's website.  The other reviewer who said this is a worse deal is mistaken.  Try it, you'll probably like it.
I am not sure what I expected but this isn't it.  It is definately different.  I like it but it is nothing to write home about.
I've had this bottle, unopened in my refrigerator for quite sometime and finally gave it chance. WOW!!! Taste, Aroma, and Pungency were amazing.I highly recommend it.

column4: K. Soard "online shopping-the best way to shop"
column10: Strong garlic flavor. Cheaper than supermarket. Great for when I'm too lazy or rushed to use fresh garlic.

column4: Jacki Gunter "good movie or book lover"
column10: This is a very good garlic powder.  I use it in a lot of my casseroles, on meat, and on bread.  I would recommend it to all cooks who want a good but not overpowering garlic powder.

These where shipped in box with a thin bag that had no chance of making it across town much less a cross country!  Don't waste your time ordering these unless you like running to UPS to drop off the box when you return them.  Also they where hard and looked old to me!  I would look some other place!

I used to live in Seattle and have tasted nearly all the "best of the best" coffees.  Backcountry Coffee Roasters, Buck Mountain Blend is my current favorite coffee.  It has incredible flavor and smoothness.  I highly recommend it, you will not be disappointed.

Oh my gosh, I love this coffee.  There is only one problem with it, it tastes so good the cup is gone too fast.  The best cup is the one in the evening after work and this coffee seems to just evaporate from the cup.  I will have to learn better self control in order to enjoy the flavor.  The coffee is balanced while not too strong.  It doesn't leave you with that nausious or jitteryfeeling that some coffees do.

Backcountry Coffee Roasters Buck Mountain Blend is my favorite coffee.I used to live in Seattle and have experienced all the "great" coffees.  This blend stands alone.  I highly recommend this coffee.
I thought this coffee would be exceptional, but I guess my expectations were too high. I guess Coffee really is just coffee.  I like that it's Organic though. Taste is OK, It's coffee

This coffee has a smooth, balanced flavor.  No bitter taste.  I make it with my French press maker and so far this is best coffee.  By far better than grocery store coffees.  I like the fact that this is an organic product with a reasonable price.  I have other blends from BackCountry Coffee that I can't wait to try.

This coffee has kind of a burnt, stale taste to it.  It is not overly offensive but is certainly not enjoyable either.  Their "Mule" coffee tastes even worse than this.I use a Bunn BTX-B, so there is not much room for error on my part.

I accidentally ordered these bars from YesWeAre2%4Change and they were crunchy and crumbly. Literally every bar I opened had already fallen apart inside the wrapper. I will note they were due to expire withing 2 months. I will order these bars again from Nature's Bakery and hope they arrive more fresh. The flavor was fine.
Putting raspberry with fig makes for a great combination without being too sweet. You'll love these. Customer service is very helpful aw well!
THIS CUMIN IS DELISH AND MADE MY CHILI RECIPE EVEN BETTER. I COULD SMELL IT AS SOON AS I ADDED IT TO THE CHILI AND EVEN 3 HOURS LATER. NICE AROMA AND WILL BUY IT AGAIN.

column9: Better than Planter's, to the level of addiction.
column10: I have been a fan of these pistachios for a while so I am not going to go into how great they taste, that is obvious. I will go into the actual packaging since these pistachios usually come in larger bags that are hard to seal. The breakdown of the same amount of pistachios into 4 smaller bags is a stroke of brilliance. They are in my opinion the appropriate serving portion per bag and make it so much easier to keep the remainder freshly sealed. Give these pistachios a try and I promise you will be surprised at how much better they are compared to Planter's Pistachios.

The Jelly Belly people actually put real licorice in these jelly beans. There is usually only one of the licorice beans in a bag of assorted beans, so if you love licorice, you can buy them solo. These are authentic tasting and really good. You can't beat Jelly Belly for flavor.

column9: This is an amazing Jelly Bean
column10: I have met the creator/inventor of the Jelly Belly and I can report with full confidence, that this is one tasty Licorice Jelly Bean.  A Jelly Belly is smaller than Jelly Beans and that is why Ronald Reagan liked them so much.  My personal favorite flavor is Licorice.  5 STARS!

These jelly beans were very unusual when they showed up.  They came in a package without a jelly belly logo, the jelly beans themselves had no jelly belly logo, and I don't really know if they were actually jelly bellys.  I got them as a gift, so I didn't try any of them, but it was odd giving a gift where it didn't seem like they were anything special, like I'd bagged up some licorice jelly beans from the grocery store or something, big woop...so I was disappointed.  And because they were a gift I had no idea what they tasted like.  So were they really jelly bellys?  Who knows?  I felt silly giving them though.

Just because I sent an order of these jelly beansto my oldest son in Roswell, Georgia.  He travelsa lot and enjoys a snack while he is driving andhe loves licorice jelly beans.This would make a nice gift for any special personin your life.

column9: Great with ice cream or alone!
column10: This stuff is really yummy.  It took me a day or two to get used to it, but now I prefer it over the other fudge sauce that I was using. I generally don't keep chocolates in the house, so when the chocolate cravings hit, I head to the jar with my spoon!  It is a very rich flavor.  On the bitter side, which I really like.  I like it best when it is cold.

I ordered this 'bold roast' chocolate agave when Amazon ran out of the regular chocolate agave (made by the same company).This has a more intense chocolate flavor, with a hint of bitterness. Simply delicious. Note that since it has a higher cocoa to agave ratio the calories per serving (two tablespoons) is higher (20 calories more) than the regular chocagave.My strawberry consumption has gone way up! Indeed, I am using these products to increase my fruit consumption by drizzling a little on my fruit.Also check out the vanilla-flavored agave by the same company. Also excellent (I used it recently to make a fat-free vanilla ice cream).
OUr two cats, Thunder & Biscuit insist this is the best dry food on the market. They recommened it highly.

Yes, my cat loves this.  Unfortunately Purina has discontinued the Healthful Live.  I am very sad.  However, now they are charging $55 - $60 for 9lbs?  Really ? This is highway robbery !!  This is like  a ransom demand.  Too bad these greedy merchants can just have the food sitting in their warehouse forever.

Only 10 dollars its a good deal! But no bulk shipping?! Come on, if I wanna get em in the US the shipping is more than the cakes!I was this sweet sensation but until I can order a crate of them, I'll make do with the Crvenkas...

I am from the U.S(I'm 19), and after watching the yogscast I got curious about what jaffa cakes were. So I ordered them from here and they are seriously... these are the BEST cookies/biscuits/cakes I have ever tasted in my life. It's a shame they don't sell these in the U.S. This seller should sell these in Bulk. So then people like me from the U.S can save time and money. BUY THESE
These are the tastiest cookies I think I've ever had. Had to order my next 4 boxes. They are addictive.

Jaffa cakes arrived very fresh, and way ahead of schedule. Because of the hot weather, I will probably will not order these again until fall, as the chocolate melted the cakes together. No fault of the manufacturer or shipper. Also, the size package that I ordered was out of stock,so they sent the next bigger size at no charge.
They arrived before the expected time and were of fantastic quality. Would recommend to any one looking for a awesome treat

column9: Pretty Good, but a bit stale
column10: These cakes arrived quickly, they are very tasty but a bit stale. I'm very pleased with McVities.  I would order these again though.

Ordered for my son who is addicted to these biscuits. They were fresh upon arrival and tasty as expected. Our only complaint is that the shipping is SLOW. It took just over 3 weeks for delivery. Can't say I wouldn't order from here again, only wish they would ship a bit faster. Would be 5 stars otherwise.
I was expecting more chocolate and less spongy orange flavor. Not what I thought it would be. It was okay but not my thing.

I went through the math of figuring out the cost per oz of the many Bean noodles available.  At the time I purchased, this was the best price.  I even like the small package sizes, although I cook for a family of 9, I like being able to control the quantity that I cook.  The normal larger package sizes don't allow as much control.

There are always loose cans in the box, there are always dented cans, luckily there was only one delivery that I refused due to the cans open and the box soaked, falling apart. There has to be a better way...please try to find it.If you need help, let me know as I am available as an independant consultant.

column9: Buyer beware - pricing out of line
column10: Nespresso makes GREAT coffee and GREAT machines. I switched over to a Nespresso machine 7 years ago and have never looked back. I save a small fortune every year by making my lattes at home.That being said, the Nespresso capsule offers posted here are from a third party who is putting a large additional margin on their price.You can order the same products online from Nespresso for approx $0.55 each (half the price here) AND you can specify exactly what you want to buy rather than taking a mixture of items, some of which you may not like.

First off...gotta say I drink this tea as a substitute for tea I can't find anymore.  I love rosehip and hybiscus tea, and to me this tastes somewhat like that.  I think its the hybiscus that gives it that "tang" and the lovely red color.  This is quite yummy and I've been drinking this for years.

I "discovered" this tea while sitting in a doctors office and had to get some of my own after tasting how good it is! I searched all the stores in my area, only to find out this flavor isn't sold in stores. Bummer :(  This was an easy transaction and the product arrived as promised.

This flavor is impossible to find in the grocery stores in our area, but seems to be in every employer's sample pack coffee/tea station.  I got hooked on this flavor at work and it's tasty enough to resort to buying it online since we couldn't find it anywhere locally.  Really good stuff, not too sweet or bitter and has a wonderful aroma.
We have been using the Pink Himalayan Crystal Sea Salt for some time now, it was great to find it online for a great price.  Locally could only find small refill boxes, this is a great deal.
I so enjoy Himalayan salt (which, I understand, is very nutritious) and this salt is just the right size for the salt grinder.

column9: Good quality salt at a great price.
column10: I've been using Himalayan salt for cooking and bathing for several years but I had never tried the larger granules until now.  It can be used similarly to kosher salt in cooking or sprinkled on a steak but it's not really good for using as you would smaller granules.  However, it can be put in a grinder and ground to be the size that can be used at the table.  I think the flavor of Himalayan salt is superior to every other salt I've tried, even the French and Irish salts that are quite pricey.  One of the advantages of Himalayan salt is the abundance of minerals it contains and the lack of processing.  It is simply mined and packaged, not taken from the ocean, dried, adulterated to keep it from caking then packaged.  Much closer to nature.
I bought this Spearmint along with the Anise followed a recomendation from a co-worker. Both are great and I enjoy the teas.Thanks.
Came quickly and packaged beautifully - the tea is amazing!  It tastes so refreshing and is nice both iced and hot.
Galil Tea, Spearmint, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)Excellent product, impossible to find elsewhere.  Thanx.

The caviar which I got,was fresh lightly salted.The only issue I had the grains were too small.I am very disappointed in this seller.For the price I paid ,I expected to get a higher quality caviar.Oh,well.I shall return to my regular seller..

IF YOU WANT A HIGH ENERGY, AND GREAT TASTING (AND I MEAN THE VERY BEST)ENERGY DRINKS, THIS IS THE ONE FOR YOU! BEVNET.COM SAYS IT TASTES LIKE MOUNTAIN DEW, AND IT DOES! VOTED BEST TASTING! HAS JIFFY INGREDIENT THAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT CALLED D-RIBOSE, AND IT IS A SIMPLE SUGAR THAT IS GREAT FOR ATHLETES! NO BAD THINGS HERE. I HAD A BAD BATCH ONCE, BUT IT WAS A FLUKE.

column9: Description should state it is strictly for outdoor use
column10: Description should state it is strictly for outdoor use.  Packaging material states it can remain indoors for only 5 days.

The description on this item says it's 3 years old and 9 inches tall...the one that arrived is 5.5 inches at it's highest point (including the container). The tree itself is just under 3 inches tall. It is a pretty tree but not at all as described. I would return it except that I don't have time to get another in time for Christmas but I am very disappointed.

I ordered 2 bonsi trees.  I really like the look of each of them; small but nice.  What I was disappointed in was that they are for outside.  I didn't see that when I ordered them.  I live in the northwoods and if I were to leave them outside.. they would be buried in the snow so I have them in the garage for the winter... a place where I am unable to enjoy them.  Overall; I like them; just felt mislead.
Bonsai arrived very quickly with proper packaging.Although the plant was small as I expected, it is easy to maintain and good looking.

My boyfriend always want to have a small elegant bonsai and I got this for him. He absolutely love it! It came with careful wrap (actually, not quite easy to unwrap it ^^) and detail instruction about how to take care of it. The only thing frustrated us is the pot. One of the stand is shorter than the rest three so we have to add a foot-pad to adjust the height. Except that, we are very happy with the purchase.
Quick shipping, and a very nice little tree. Was a gift for my wife on our 6th (wood) anniversary. Well packed and in great shape.
THIS IS A VERY NICE TREE. IT WAS PACKED CAREFULLY AND INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO CARE FOR THE BONSAI. IT IS A LOVELY TREE.

I bought this as a gift for a friend and he LOVED it!!! I struggled with trying to find the right tree to order because I was  worried that the tree would be to small.  I ended up ordering this tree and I am glad I did because he loves it and it is a perfect size!!

My tree just arrived and it's in fantastic condition and looks great. The packaging was outstanding. Tree already has a bonsai look but there's plenty left to trim. Looks like the product picture if not better.
Looks like a small fir tree. I hope it gets bigger but not too big. The Juniper is a sweet little tree.

I was skeptical buying a tree online, but am pleased to say that my bonsai arrived in good health. The shipping was excellent, and the tree came securely enveloped in a nest of packing peanuts.As for the tree itself, I have christened him Mr.Miag-Tree, after that infamous sensei that introduced the world to these majestic miniature arbors. Sitting on my desk, it brings me peace, serenity, and balance and at times makes my humble cube feel like the ancient boreal forests of the Orient.This coniferous fellow is a source of extreme merriment and joy, a beacon of hope in an otherwise bleak backdrop of masonry and anguish. So long as my juniper persists in this the harshest of environs, then so too can I.

The tree is slightly smaller than the one pictured but is a good starter plant for the cheap price of $8. Mine was about 4 inches tall max, not 9" as described. This did not bother me, but keep it in mind when purchasing. The product came well packaged in a timely manner. I transplanted it to a bigger pot a week after it arrived. It's been a month now and the tree is still nice and green with fresh growth.
Came just ask expected and in very good health!  My brother loved this Christmas gift!  I definitely recommend this seller!

I sent this to my Mom as a gift and she called to gush about how cute it was.  Unfortunately, the box contained the bonsai tree and nothing else.  No details, no care instructions, nothing.  She doesn't know how much to water it or even whether or not to keep in indoors or outside.

column9: Small plant not even close to 9 inches
column10: This is a really small bonsai. Not worth the money I have spent including the shipping. This one is close to 5 inches including the pot. The plant itself is close to 2.5 inches.I want the money back on this item.If I could rate it with NO stars I would have.

column9: Yes it's tiny, but it's very nice
column10: Sure, this is a super tiny tree...mine is only like 2-3" tall, but for the price what else can you expect?  I was so surprised at how well this was packed in the box...lots of padding and plastic wrap to keep the dirt from flying around the box.  Tree seems to be doing well after 2 months.

column9: Product as described. Just love it.
column10: My Green Mound Juniper Bonsai Tree  arrived within three days and it's in fantastic condition and looks great. The packaging was outstanding. Tree already has a bonsai look but there's plenty left to trim. Looks like the product picture if not better. I would get another Bonsai from this seller. I had wonderful customer service. Answers emails promptly.

column9: Not what I expected, but acceptable.
column10: Well it could have been worse. The bonsai was in a healthy condition when it arrived(using standard 4-6 day shipping). However; it was all misshapen and contorted into a very un-bonsai state. The needle foliage was thin(Charlie Brown Christmas tree thin), but very green and vibrant. I know not every juniper bonsai will be the same, but this case is a little shameful to say the least.And at least put a "This side up" sticker on the box respectful to the bonsai's orientation, for Pete's sake.  If it's too much for you guys, I'll do it pro-bono. It's already bad enough the plant is subdued to stress in a dark, stuffy, box. You lose stars for that because now I have to train this juniper back to it's natural state--I could be wire training the older parts by now. How about getting familiar with a ruler before going on about 9" tall juniper in the description. This poor thing doesn't even reach 5" at best. The pot and the tree combined just make 7"I really hate to be mean, but this dishonors the respected Brussel's Bonsai name. I only bought this because of the Brussel's name-like most people. What I got can't be 3 years old either. Way too thin- almost a 1/3 of an inch. Thanks for the $20(shipping included) sapling+glazed pot and soil.I could have bought a juniper sapling for a few pennies on the dollar instead of one of these over-priced price pieces of feng shui.All my displeasure set aside- it arrived in good condition and quality(for a sapling). I was hoping for a natural, unpainted pot, but blue is nice. It arrived at a good time. And I'm looking forward to watching it grow over the years to come.One more thing please be honest in the description, thank you.
There was a lot of foliage on this tree and it arrived very healthy.  Pretty much exactly a sdescribed and for a good price though I do have Amazon Prime so shipping costs aren't an issue.
This is an adorable bonsai- the last one I got of Amazon didn't do well, but this one looks more sturdy, despite its small size. It was packaged very well...hopefully I don't kill it!

This plant was shipped on January 3rd.  It arrived at my house on Jan 9th.  I'd have bet anything this plant would be dead upon delivery because it was boxed up for so many days.  When I opened the packaging, which took me forever because of all the tape, it was still alive and still had plenly of moisture.  I've already named her Judy.  With luck she will be with me for many years to come.

We received this Bonsai Juniper as a gift after a bereavement.  It must be at least three years old and careful pruning and horticulture have created a lovely specimen.  The tree arrived extremely well packaged and healthy.  The soil was still very moist upon arrival with the tree looking as fresh as if we had picked it out at a plant store.  And the value for the price is extremely buyer-friendly.  Great experience with this seller.

The tree I received was almost exactly as pictured and it came with a little care guide. The only thing I wish the care guide mentioned was how often to water it in the winter (it says daily in spring, summer and fall).

Smaller than I expected. I got it as a gift for my brother who loved it, but I was less impressed. It looks less like a bonsai and more like a tiny bush. But my brother loves it, so that's all that matters

I was very pleased They have with my recent purchase of boiled peanuts through Amazon.com. I have ordered them numerous times and they've always been great.  Being from the South and living in the West I think I am a good judge of this hard to find item. Only a Southerner can truly appreciate the taste of a good boiled peanut.

As a distance runner finishing college, Gatorade can really hit the wallet hard. Luckily, I found NRC Sports on Amazon.com. It may seem like a lot to shell out for Gatorade at first, but when you realize you're getting Gatorade at $2.15 a gallon with shipping costs included, a smile begins to show.
Compared to the grocery store, its more than 50% off.  So what you have to mix it up, don't be a sissy. ;)

column4: John Abbott "I shoot people.  And they pay me...
column10: Good hydration that keeps in the fridge for a long time.I've had a cold for the past week, and it really helps to keep my electrolytes up.

column9: Delicious, practical and easy to use
column10: I had never cooked with fermented black beans before but I had seen them in several Thai and Chinese recipes.  For this price, I thought I'd give it a try.  Now I won't be without it.  It lasts forever, a little goes a long way, and combined with Sichuan peppercorns, really packs a flavor punch.  Highly recommend for stir fries.  Use your food processor to grind up a teaspoon or two then toss with garlic into your oiled wok before adding anything else.  Yum.

I miss the shrimp & lobster sauce I ordered at restaurants when I lived in Maryland.  Moving to NC, the first place I ordered shrimp & lobster sauce at, I was so disappointed with the lack of flavor, a white bland sauce they call what is supposed to be this delicious dish.  So I did an online search for my recipe.  I remember black specks in the food I bought in MD saw that it was fermented black beans.  I purchased these to re-create the dish I missed so much.  These beans made the dish.  What I cooked looked & tasted almost exactly like what I used to order and am so happy that I can now make my own shrimp & lobster sauce at home.

I love to cook Chinese food but find it difficult to find a reliable source of fermented black beans without visiting many local ethnic markets.  This is a wonderful source--easy and convenient and quick to get!

Coming from Chicago I was use to going to China Town to purchase this product. Now living in the SC, it was impossible to find. It is great product and can be used even when not cooking Chinese/Asian food. Easy to chop and blend into food.

column9: Exactly what I was looking for
column10: Use this in shrimp with lobster sauce and other Chinese recipes and the dishes are just what one would find in a Chinese restaurant. Very salty, so follow the directions to rinse the beans well. Also this package will last for years as very few are needed in each recipe.

column4: William D. Colburn "buys things on amazon far...
column10: I used to be able to buy a fermented black bean paste that I loved.  I can't find it anymore.  So I tried these.  I always see the beans in my favorite "house tofu" dish at my favorite Chinese restaurant, and so I just dumped them in when I tried making it myself.  That didn't work.  The next time I'll definitely mash half the beans into a paste and add them early, then finish with more beans at the end.The bag is quite large.  I hope I can use them all up someday.  As for taste, they taste fine.  I just needed to mash some I think.

I was having a craving for chicken in black bean sauce, but there isn't a Chinese grocery nearby and the local supermarkets don't carry odd ingredients like this.  They are overpriced at Amazon compared to what I'd pay in a big-city Chinese grocery, but it beats driving all over trying to find them.  And, the bag is big enough that it will last me years.

column9: Chinese Dow See fermented black beans
column10: Very happy with the quick delivery of the product  and the product itself was well packaged and fresh and very nice flavor. I'd recommend this to anyone looking for the same product.

I recently tried both the Peanut and Almond varieties of the Nature Valley Roasted Nut Crunch. These bars are amazing! Imagine the flavor and crunch of brittle, but with just enough of the syrup to hold the nuts together. Also the nuts are a little salty, so the contrast is nice. This bar is all nuts. With just 7 and 6 grams of sugar respectively per bar, the 7 grams of protein and 2g of fiber are really attractive.My daughter likes these as a snack before swimming because they give her an energy boost. I like the fact that they are more nutritionally balanced than most snack foods. They tend to crumble when you eat them, so eating them in bar form can be a challenge. I break them before I open the package, and pop the pieces in my mouth. Either way, they make a great snack.

I tried these based on other reviews.  When I received them I hadn't realized they were "gluten free" which doesn't matter to me.  Anyway, they are a great snack - not too much sugar and plenty of peanuts.  I will order them again.

I think these are great! The flavor is good...I love the combination of salty and sweet, and the sugar content is low compared to other bars I have eaten. They also have lots of protein and fiber. They are definitely a good alternative for those of us who are gluten free, especially since they are very affordable. The only criticism I have is that they are pretty hard, so I break them into little pieces so it's easier to eat.

These are great snacks with a peanut brittle like texture, and nutritious additions like sunflower seeds and almonds . The whole family loves them, not just the gluten free person and they are very affordable. I love that I can get them in the regular section of my supermarket as well as on Amazon and not pay the premium price that is usually charged for anything gluten free.

These are good, but beware.  It's roasted nuts, so it's about 60% fat.  That's good for active people, and would be awesome as trail food, sports snacks, or for my kids, but for those of us who sit on our duffs all day, these don't meet our dietary needs.Even so, these are very tasty.  They're not too sweet, and not too salty.  All told, I like the Almond Crunch much better.  Both have peanuts.  Both are the same amount of protein, fat and sugar.

column9: So Glad they are available online
column10: Because I am having trouble keeping my blood sugar levels steady, I always keep one of these bars in my purse.  They are tasty and high in protein.  I love these nut bars, but was having trouble finding them in the local stores.  I was very glad to find them online, and I use the automated shipping program so that I will always have a box in my pantry.

My husband and I enjoy the peanut crunch by Nature Valley. It is hard to find in stores; in my area, New Port Richey, Florida, all that is available is almond crunch. I am allergic to almonds. The only place I can get the peanut variety regularly is Amazon. Thanks Amazon!

This is a very nice nutbar to have on hand for those rushed days, as this and a cuppa tea will see you through a missed lunch. They used to be 7 g of protein and the bars were a tad bit larger, but they kept the same sized wrapper and shrank the contents, so it's now 6 g's. That notwithstanding, it's a great alternative for kids who might otherwise eat junk.

Chock full of peanuts and sunflower seeds, these suckers hit the spot.  The sugar that glues them together does a decent job of keeping them intact in transit without messing with the nut flavor.  You know I love them, I ordered 36 Bars at once.
This is a favorite of all of us in the house. They are so good and filling too. A  healthy snack to have on hand when you are hungry but want to eat something good for you and not junk food.

This is the most delicious prodluct of this type on the market. I have tried the almond but this one excedes the almond one. I love the crunchy nuts that are in this product and if you like peanuts this is the one for you
Nature Valley Gluten Free Roasted Nut crunch bars are the perfect snack on the go! They are low in sugar and taste Great! we all love them.

These are delicious! Nutty, sweet but not too sweet, just perfect. They aren't easily found in stores so I am stocking up. I like to keep a few in the car and one in my purse. The protein in the bars are a nice blend with the sweet. I never feel like I am eating junk. The ingredient list is minimal. No soy lecithin or partially hydronated oil. Okay, so they have 6 grams of sugar in them, but that is better than most snack bars or even yogurt.

I tried to find this for a long time, they only available at Target not at Sam's, Sam's sell those with the soft sugar coating. I like this crunchy one, I go to target only for this. Now, I able to get them from Amazon. I love it. The other one I like is Almond crunch which is not available from Amazon I got to order it separately from Alice.com.

column9: Great little bar - good pick me up for low calories & gluten free
column10: Gluten free, without any sacrifice in taste.  Easy to pack along and won't be compromised if not refrigerated as they hold up to warm weather well.  Crunchy and can be a bit crumbly when eaten.  I like the almond and peanut varieties equally.  The price on Amazon is terrific and makes these a perfect snack.  Low in calories but big on taste.

These are super-duper good.  They are very crunchy, but not too crunchy.  They are very sweet, but not too sweet.  Perfect for the killer-hungries at my desk at 3:30 p.m., and they are surprisingly filling and satisfying.  You can't go wrong with these.  Have fun!

I wasn't sure if I would like these when I bought them, but to my surprise, they taste really good!Another reviewer mentioned that they were like a peanut brittle and I tend to agree, only these aren't that hard and much easier to crumble and eat.  I love sunflower seeds, so was happy to see them in these.Even with being shipped across country, all the bars were in one piece and completely intact.  I will be buying them again, soon.

My husband and I like this snack because it's not too sweet and has some protein in it.  Our kids like it because it tastes great!  We've never had a problem with Amazon's packaging or shipping of this product.

In addition by buying in large volume, we wouldn't have to buy as often, which would translate into a shipping and handling savings as well. They could then pass some of that savings to us, the customer, making us happier.

My wife Maki and I recently vacationed in Salt Lake City and found there a small Japanese grocery store.  While perusing, we loaded up on candies and snacks for the long drive back to Montana the following day.  Included in our cache: seven bags of Flowers Kiss candies."Seven," I said.  "Do we really need this many?""Yes," she growled.  "And if they had more I'd buy them too.  Hand me your wallet."My wife, recently yoked from Japan and transplanted into the States under the muse of our civil union, had apparently been hiding from me a desire for the Flower's Kiss that rivaled anything she could have ever found in We.  Dumbfounded, I followed her to the cash register line and watched helplessly as she rapidly devolved from the soft spoken girl of my dreams into a rattled and aggressive junkie.She didn't wait to leave the building before violently opening one of the bags and candy flew everywhere.  There was a small eatery in the store full of what could previously be described as aloof Asians that were now ogling us from their chairs.  I looked down and my wife of one wonderful year was on her hands and knees cramming the candies into her mouth, wrappers on.  She was cursing and cackling and when the horrified business owner reached for his phone, I pulled her up off the floor, pushed her out the door, and then stuffed her into our car.  Restrained by the seat belt, she eventually crashed an hour later.  Her slackened, sticky lips moved wordlessly as she slid from consciousness and I could do nothing except punch the steering wheel.What was happening to her?In Japan they call it, "kisu" for kissing but when it shows up in the U.S., and it will, we'll call it an epidemic.  While she was passed out, I took the remaining bags and threw them away save one which I stored under the spare tire in our trunk.  I had the house to myself later that week, (she was still in hospital), and that's when I blasted off.The write up here on Amazon would have you believe that the flavor profile is of the apricot-plum variety but I will not stand behind that description.  They instead and more accurately taste of milky peach and are absolutely delicious.  Roughly the diameter of a quarter and maybe half of an inch thick, they're mostly smooth discs topped with a knobby exterior that creates a sort of grip for your tongue that I found completely necessary.When I took the candy, my glands responded immediately.  The combination of delightfully balanced sweetness with the sudden eruption of saliva orchestrated in my mouth a vibrant sensation of such overwhelming sensitivity that it dumped me on my rear where I wept openly for the first time in years.  How could I have ever condemned her for this?  She was strapped down in a hospital bed sad and misunderstood while I got my kicks from the very substance that put her there.  And I felt rotten about it."Flower's Kiss candies aren't BAD," I said to the nodding glitter wizard floating next to me.  "These are as far from bad as good has ever been.  My god, man, what have I done and why isn't she here doing this with me?  Maki comes home NOW."I stood to grab my car keys and that's the last thing I remember.  The next morning I woke up in the bath wearing only a memory foam cuirass and a set of besagews made of alarmingly moist cod pieces.  Bare from the waist down, my legs and groin were covered with cigarette burns and the glued on tufts of hair I'd apparently shaved off of a yak that was drinking quietly from a toilet full of what I thought was blood but ended up being melted Otter Pops.  Things couldn't have been worse.  I'd hit bottom.Thus, here I am writing this by blowing into a computer straw because the staff here won't let me use my hands.  And I get that - when the nurses walk in too fast I think they're wendigos and I throw things.But I'm healing now and so is Maki.  When we finally get back on our feet we're going to sue Kasugai for manufacturing what clearly must be the most dangerous candy in the world.And I thank you for listening.- t

column9: Curiosity got the better of me.
column10: I'm a chemist so I guess the test tubes caught my eye. I've been perfecting my cooking skills and figuring out what to fill my pantry with. I was prone to scoff at fancy sea salt admirers but my father did once have me taste one of his friend's salt company salt, dug up somewhere in Utah that contained lots of minerals besides sodium and it was indeed more complex and interesting than normal salt. And smoked salt? What is that?! Well, to find out, even in NYC would have involved buying lots of big bottles of the stuff, likely over time so I would lack a real sense of whether I was missing out on something special.That said, most of these taste about the same but may differ a bit in texture. Most are too coarse to imagine sprinkling on prepared food without grinding. The difference in coarseness makes wet finger dip comparisons imprecise. So I used a mortar to grind them for comparison. Most are not a harsh as normal table salt, but over half do translate to "just salt" after an initial second long delay as a slight mineral taste is noticed (perhaps!). I say perhaps, since no, few of the unsmoked ones taste noticeably different than normal salt. Even the pitch black unsmoked one (a great gimmick for a transparent table salt grinder at least). One tastes pleasantly "fishy".The smoked salts differ the most and are the most interesting by far and are quite different from each other. When ground in a mortar, you can tell it's just a surface coating, but they are much nicer than liquid smoke flavor, and the flavor survives just fine when ground. The most intense smoked one (Hickory) is now my favorite addition to bulky salad (olives, cheese, radish sprouts, sour cream, bamboo shoots, roast pepita seeds, horseradish, Worcestershire, sesame oil). It's an aftertaste, actually, that noticeably builds up, making each bite more dynamic. Their aroma is intense too and has its own dynamic. I'm delighted that I can buy hickory smoked salt in bulk now! It might be overkill for some dishes though.Alas, I have not in fact discovered a whole palette of flavors, just various textures and discolorations of salt, with much difficulty in figuring out which if any are favorites. Most are quite better than normal salt since for some reason when similarly ground, normal salt comes on way too fast. I can rule out about a third which translate to "just as harshly one dimensional as table salt". On scrambled eggs, it's a tough call. The serious division between "harsh" and "subtle" is stark, but I don't notice much variation of subtlety.Another big difference is between highly crystalline vs. "wet" samples. They may not actually be full of moisture but may just have more types of ingredients than just sodium chloride so have failed to crystallize as pure salt prior to being mined, but the "wet" ones would not work well in a table grinder at all. The bottles are labeled as to each samples uses (finishing, table, cooking).As a product, it would make a great gift, and in fact was packaged as a gift, with burlap sacks tied with twine. The labels are high quality bare paper. As an avid cook, I'd have been blown over had anybody given me this as a gift. I give it four stars since it did not come with what would have been most interesting off all: a brochure explaining the origin and rough mineral content of each sample. The "fishy" one has sulfur in the name, and the taste fits that description.Next step: after quickly discarding the obvious poseurs (merely pretty colored samples that lack any subtlety), a process of elimination! I don't intend to keep this kit, despite the social fun it might be, but to in fact toss one tube at a time until I'm down to only one or two smoked versions and only one table salt alternative, with the sulfur one needing separate consideration. I can't taste the sulfur one on eggs, for obvious reason that they are already sulfurous. It's way too hard to compare one to another, and crazy too, since A/B variations would number in the thousands, but quite easy to compare one at a time to normal salt, so that's why I'll do, to get rid of as many as possible. That last thing I'm interested in is fooling myself, so if half my salad or eggs or whatever routine meal I make doesn't taste truly superior with a given tube's contents, out it goes! I predict, after this second day of playing around that I will quickly eliminate a tube or two a day until it becomes more a consideration of texture and availability of a single normal salt alternative. I am almost completely convinced that normal salt really does pack too much punch due to lack of other ionic minerals in the product.My taste buds got too overwhelmed trying to solve the puzzle in one day. What fun, to do taste tests every day for days going on weeks!

For an everyday family cook, these are excellent salts!!!  The sampler looks so cool, I was reluctant to use it lol but the novice chef in me couldn't wait to try them in my meals.  Simply amazing!!  If you're an amateur like me, wanting to try something different than the ordinary stuff you usually cook, then these samplers are an awesome way to start!

I order this product all of the time as it smells like bluberry muffins baking in the morning and tastes delicious..

I originally tried Wild Mountain Blueberry in a sample package and was immediately hooked. I was so happy to find I could purchase and entire box of this smooth tasting, great smelling coffee. It's my entire families favorite flavor right now!

I thought Blueberry coffee sounded horrible...but curiosity got me to try it and WOW!!! WOW!!! WOW!!!! I love it! It is my new favorite!!!
this is the second time that I've ordered this coffee it is very tasty.  I will keep buying it.

Top it off with Italian Sweet creamer or vanilla creamer--winner combo!  I was so happy when I found the flavor in k cups!!  My husband and I now anticipate Sept 1 like Christmas because that's when we break out the blueberry!  Love, love, love it!!
I had bought these previously and was glad to find them again on Amazon.  Not too blueberry but just enough of a hint and true to flavor.
This is my husband's favorite flavor!  I didn't even want to try it (it just didn't sound good) - but it really is delicious!

Just FYI - This is a light roast coffee and has a pleasant taste to it. It is perfect for a relaxing morning as it does not caffeinate your bloodstream into overdrive but just keeps you mellow and for the afternoon cup of coffee this blend would serve well also.There is a subtle hint of blueberry flavoring - not too overwhelming. If you have it straight up you will enjoy it without any bitter taste. You do find the flavors of the coffee to be there. But then again every one has different taste buds and what I found to be enjoyable, you may find to be a unfavorable taste; but I don't think so. I know you will enjoy this light roasted coffee as it will bring a relative calmness over your soul.If you add a bit of cream (my choice is french vanilla cream), it will prove as a more satisfying taste. Overall a nice cup of coffee.

Terrible! Overwhelming fake, gross blueberry flavor. My wife bought a box of this for me to take to the shared Keurig machine in my office. Of the 18 cups, only 4 were tasted. None of those cups was finished. No one will use the remaining cups, even when desperate for coffee. Avoid.

some of the cups were opened ...the box was crashed ...most of them were dented ..it was not the way i excepted to get them shipped...the box was a mess .. when i opened the box the coffee went all over the place

The flavor is not strong, just a hint of bluberry!The smell when it is brewing is delightful!I encourage all people with a Keurig to try it once.  I am the pickiest eater I know and I love it!!!

I am absolutely shocked that I love this coffee. I do like some flavored coffees but I also like Extra Bold strong coffee, black. And I wouldn't even call myself a huge blueberry fan. Blueberry and coffee flavors don't immediately come to mind as the most compatible combo, but believe me, they we born to blend!  I highly recommend this coffee and it is definitely one of my all time favorite coffee flavors. However, since it is a milder brew, I wouldn't recommend it being brewed in the largest size.  Enjoy!

I am not a fan of strong coffee so I use the travel mug size to make this blueberry coffee. First I tried it black, thinking it may be sweet already but it is not and it was a weird sensation to taste blueberry with the normal bitterness of coffee. column9: You won't believe how much you like it
column10: I got some of these cups in a sampler pack and was like, "Meh, I can use them for company."  I never have liked blueberry flavored anything (except donuts because my God I'm only human), and am not that big into fruit-flavored coffee.  So these cups sat around my house for a while.  But wow - when I finally gave these a chance, I was hooked.  The aroma is absolutely heavenly.  And the flavor is the perfect hint of blueberry, it doesn't clash with the coffee like you think it would.  Because "on paper", who would put blueberry flavor and coffee flavor together?  It is not supposed to work but magically it does.There's something that happens psychologically too - you feel like you've eaten a blueberry donut after you've drank the coffee.  It's satisfying like you've really indulged for breakfast but without the calories of a muffin or pastry.  (I drink it with Equal and plain or vanilla creamer.)I served it to my parents over Christmas - real "black coffee only" folks - and they raved over it and for the first time ever asked for a second cup.  I've been disappointed in some Green Mountain flavors, but not this one.

It's delicious coffee with a mild hint of blueberry. The arouma is pleasant and the coffee is "real" for coffee drinkers like me. I defintely recommend it and especially to those who don't normally like fruit flavored coffees.

I think if we laid off of drinking it so much in the beginning, we might appreciate it more after all this time. hehe. If you haven't tried it, I do highly recommend that you do try it; just don't "overserve" yourself and get tired of it, like we did. We're going to back off and then drink some more in a few months. hehe. With that said.... the Only flavor that we have never gotten tired of is the Green Mountain Island Coconut!!! We have had the coconut just as long as the blueberry and had even more of it than the blueberry; but THAT COCONUT is the best one, by far, and I can't see us ever getting tired of it!
