column9: Pill Pockets - Great Product - Good Price
column10: My dogs love these. They think they are getting a treat and eat their pills, no problem. This is a good price for a great product. Fast shipping makes it even better.

Pill pockets are ideal for giving drugs to dogs, much easier than squashing pills into a piece of cheese!  Our dog sees daily pill times as a treat now and comes and sits patiently waiting.  We are on our 4th packet of these and will definitely order more whenever we are giving drugs to dogs!

Our puppy (a bernedoodle) loves these duck treats.  We started using them for pills, but now use them to spread inside of kongs and other toys.  She has a sensitive tummy, so these are great for multiple uses.

My pets love these things, and they make giving medicine so easy!  I no longer have to chase my dogs down and hope that they take their medicine.  With these I KNOW the pill is going to get swallowed.My dogs love anything duck flavored.  They went wild over these!

If you've ever tried to get your dog to swallow pills, you know how wonderful these are.  We have four dogs (three Corgis and a mixed breed), and all like them, and these have been successful with them all.Our mixed breed dog was about 13, and her disease was terminal, and we weren't ready to lose her (not that anyone ever is).  We had medicines that would make her comfortable in her final stages, but the problem was getting her to take them...we tried all sorts of things: peanut butter, apple sauce, fruit, meat--all had a certain ability to disguise the taste, but she got wise to them pretty quickly.But the Greenies Pill Pockets ALWAYS worked.  We were able to extend her life, with comfort, for a couple of months longer, and for that I'll always be grateful.A NOTE: The Greenies come in several flavors (chicken, beef, duck & peas), sizes, and also flavors for cats.  If you need to be more economical, you can also "shave" them down by squeezing off a little of them (depending on the strength of the pill they're taking).

We have had a number of cats with medical problems and tried any number of ways to get pills into them.  Pill Pockets are by far the easiest method.Most of our animals have considered Pill Pockets as "treats" and readily eaten them.  Our current feline gets three pockets in the morning and three in the evening, so we go through a lot.One suggestion:  if your smaller pet needs to take many meds, buy the pockets designed for capsuls for dogs.  Product pricing seems to be related to the number of "doses", rather than the weight.  I believe the small package for cats is 1.6 oz and costs only a few $ less than this 6.6 oz package. If you go through the pockets like we do, the savings are substantial.  We simply tear off a piece of the larger pocket and wrap it around the pill.  It takes 15 seconds.Another suggestion is to get a selection of flavors.  Our cat goes through periods where certain flavors are unacceptable, so it is good to alternate and have backups.If you are really desperate, you can always use human meat baby food.  We haven't seen a cat yet that would't take that.Summary:  A much better way to give your pet meds than a pill shooter.

column9: Send That Skinny Cow To The Slaughter House!
column10: Length:: 2:21 MinsAfter seeing this product online and checking out so many positive reviews about it, I was eager to try it myself. But more than hesitant to spend $37 to $60+ bucks in order to do so. Luckily, Arctic Zero is carried in stores not too far from me. I had to drive about 30miles to the neighboring town in order to get it, but it was well worth the trip!I bought a pint each of chocolate, chocolate peanut butter, mint chocolate cookie, coffee, and vanilla maple. Packed them in the iced cooler I brought with me and headed back home. Once back I sampled each of the flavors. The first one I tried was the peanut butter chocolate. Tasted pretty good, but I didn't detect a whole lot of peanut flavor going on. It also had a fairly icy consistency. After tha, I tried the chocolate and was thoroughly impressed! Maybe it was because the chocolate pint wasn't as steeped in the ice as the other had been in my cooler, but this time the texture was creamy like any other ice cream. And it had a great chocolate flavor. I honestly could have eaten the whole thing right then, but wanted to see what the others were like, so went on to mint chocolate. This too had a fairly subtle flavor as far as the mint went, which I guess some might appreciate. But the texture was just as creamy as the chocolate had been. The coffee was icy and my least favorite flavor. But I'm historically not a coffee person so it may just be a personal preference. Maple vanilla wasn't bad either, but again, I could take it or leave it. So after tasting them all, I wanted to find out if the icy consistency of some of them was a product trait or was just letting it soften a bit the key to creaminess heaven. So I let the coffee sit out for a couple of minutes, and sure enough it was as creamy as the chocolate had been.I'd say depending on your taste preferences any of them would be completely satisfying as replacements for their fattening counter parts....I would serve this to anyone and dare them to know the difference from reg. ice cream. And the fact that the whole pint has the same 150 cal. as those teeny tiny skinny cow cups, not to mention less sugar(it actually has less in the whole pint than skinny cow does in it's little cup) and zero fat, I'm definitely a convert.I also really like the fact that it has some health benefits too, with the added protein and fiber. And that while I will probably try to eat this sparingly as it's pretty expensive, if I ever want to pig out, I can eat the whole thing guilt free! Which is a new concept when it comes to ice cream. I actually had to keep reminding myself while I was sampling them; "It's okay!" LOL!Edit; If your Arctic Zero hardens up in the freezer, I found you can get it back to a creaminess state by just popping it in the microwave for about 10-15sec depending on how hard it is to start with. That amount of time didn't cause it to melt on me just go from hard and icy back to smooth and spoon-able while remaining cold.

column9: The Best Snack Bar I've Ever Tasted

column9: One of the great snack bars
column10: I've tried a LOT of snack bars. As I become more nutrition-conscious (and wary of additives and HFCS), I have become more particular. And as always, there is the matter of taste.At this point, Kind bars are all I use. Everything else pales in quality, nutrition, and taste.Buying from REI in >12qty gets a 20% discount, about a buck-sixty each net, but Amazon (with free shipping) is still better, near a buck-and-a-quarter.Good for between-meal staying power, bike rides, hikes, emergency car/RV stash. They last on the shelf longer than I have been able to wait to eat them; I can't tell the difference between new bars and > 3-month-old ones from my stash. The dried-fruit content and lower-oil nuts seem to keep them naturally preserved.I definitely do not like the ones with peanuts in them, but that's a personal taste matter.

Good taste and just the right size, these nutritous gluten free treats are convenient to throw into a carry on bag and snack on anywhere, anytime. They are not messy, nor do they melt, so they travel well year-round.

Hello,  I ordered a bunch of teas from this company.  The package arrived in two days and the teas are excellent.  Each 3 oz of tea comes in a resealable non-windowed zip loc package  that keeps the tea fresh.They are great and I will never go to overpriced places like teavana again.New Customer for life!

I'm a Chinese living in the US. I bought this product about a month before I went back to China for a vacation. Then I realized this tea is better than those my parents got at home.I definitely recommend it. This is genuine top-class Dragon Well with the iconic sweet aftertaste. The tea leaves are intact, not the kind of broken leaves you often get from low-quality stuff. Remember not to use boiling water. As green tea is more delicate than oolong, boiling water will destroy the leaves. Use water of 185 degrees Fahrenheit, or 85 degrees Celsius.

The package arrived in just a few days and was adequately packed with a frozen gel pack.  Cheese has a great flavor!
i wanted this cheese as its essential for proper fondue. this arrived promptly and with an ice pack...a bit melted but the product was kept cold. i am pleased thus far...

I've been eating a lot of soup lately as part of my diet.  And I'm happy to say that this old childhood favorite is actually food.  Unlike Campbells other soups you don't need an encyclopedia to understand what's in it.  There's tomato puree, high fructose corn syrup, spices, salt and Ascorbic and Citric Acids.No MSG.  No hydrolyzed anything.  Granted I am not a fan of corn syrup, but I'm giving them a break because it goes so good with crackers or a grilled cheese sandwich.Still killer sodium levels but if you eat the whole can mixed with water it's only 225 calories.Pam T~

This review is for the soup itself, not the 48-pack here on Amazon. Buying a 48 pack seems like a good idea, but the truth is, you can get a can of this soup for cheaper at the store, usually between 80 cents to a dollar for one can, though stores like Wal-Mart and Sam's Club offer this even cheaper.The flavor can't be beat. Everyone has their preferred method of preparing this soup, but I make mine with almond milk (about 2/3 of a can) and a bit of garlic powder. The milk makes the soup more creamy as compared to adding a can of water, and garlic adds that delicious little kick. It tastes awesome with regular Saltines, oyster crackers, even Goldfish crackers. While a bit high in sodium, it's very low in fat and has a decent amount of vitamins so making a meal out of this is great for your diet.Buying these cans are also considerably cheaper than buying the ready-made Campbell's soup in the plastic microwaveable containers (Soup At Hand) and really, it's not that hard to mix this soup with some milk or water. It's so easy to prepare that even kids can do it (I did!) Nom nom nom!

I take 6 cans of tomato soup, 2 cans of cream of mushroom, and 4 cans of half and half (or milk)and cream sherry (you must use cream sherry, dry sherry is not as good) and add it to fresh crabmeat for a fantastic bisque. You need to marinate the crabmeat in the sherry for an hour or two before you add it to the soup mixture. Simmer on low for a few minutes and serve right away, you'll think you've died and gone to Heaven. Sherry about 1 cup or more depending on your taste. Most of the alcohol cooks out, but don't drive for 24 hours after you eat this!

I have no complaints about the soup at all. The taste is great, it's easy to prepare and I also use it to cook. It is probably cheaper at a store but I don't have a car so I don't have to pay the expense of gas or car payments or insurance. My big complaint is that I ordered a case of 48 and 22 of them were dented. I am waiting to hear what I need to do. I guess I'm supposed to ship them back but getting to a UPS store is impossible for me and they really wouldn't want 22 dented cans of campbell's soup.

column9: The high fructose corn syrup is too sweet

This brand of tomato soup is probably the yummiest. I have been loyal to the brand, rarely, if ever changing brands. It tastes so natural and can be used for those moments where you are hungry but don't quite know what to eat. Good to dip white bread in or saltine crackers. Very filling, too!

this is a great soup to give to your kids, its really easy to prepare. column10: Bought a case of this soup because my kids eat a lot of Tomato soup.  Should have checked price at the local grocery store first, as it was much more economical.

column9: What Soup Is Meant To Be
column10: A steaming hot bowl of CAMPBELL'S TOMATO SOUP for lunch is just about as good as it gets.  That zesty tomato flavor is delicious; your taste buds will be thanking you profusely.  This is a soup I grew up on and still enjoy on those occasions when nothing but a bowl of hot soup will hit the spot.This soup must be accompanied by crackers--better yet, peanut butter crackers.  For maximum tomato flavor pour in water, not milk, and for even more extra zest add a pinch of onion salt.  Now that's a spicy soup!  An added bonus includes the pull-off lids; no can openers required, thank you very much.  Make your lunch a hit with CAMPBELL'S TOMATO SOUP.  The middle of the day doesn't deserve drab.--D. Mikels, Esq.

Very happy with all of Wellness products. When my black labrador got constant ear infections that would not clear up with medications I decided it could be allergies. She was on Wellness Simple Solutions Rice and Duck dry and canned food for about 6 weeks, and her ears cleared up without continuos medication.  I would highly recommend this product for any dog which has skin,ear,or stomach issues.

column9: Excellent dog food; especially good for dogs with health problems
column10: We have three dogs- a small robust and healthy Coton de Tulear, and two large dogs with health issues: a nearly 7 year old German Shorthaired Pointer, who was diagnosed as diabetic two years ago, and an 8 year old  collie mix who has irritable bowels.  Trying to find the right food so that I didn't have to purchase too many kinds of dog food for two dogs with disparate health issues was not easy, but this Wellness Simple Solutions, along with the Wellness Core Dry does the job.If you suspect that food triggers allergic or stomach/bowel reactions, as any pediatrician will tell you, feed a simple diet with as few ingredients as possible, and only add ingredients as needed, after waiting for a time to watch for reactions.  Simple Solutions is the way to do this, and for a dog with irritable bowels, it is truly THE best way of feeding a commercially prepared dog food, instead of you cooking chicken and rice for your dog.  The dogs love the taste, and Wellness brand is excellent quality.

column9: Healthy choice for dog w/ food allergies/sensitive stomach
column10: My 8-year old Cocker Spaniel has been on several types of food (Nutro, Iams, Natural Balance, Chicken Soup for the Dog Lovers Soul, and regular Wellness). She would tolerate each for a short period of time, but then get diarrhea and would vomit. Our Vet suggested we try Wellness Simple Solutions, since it has only one protein and one carb source. We've had her on it for 3 months and she's shown no signs of upset stomach or irritable bowel. We suspect she is sensitive to chicken/chicken by-products, which the Rice and Salmon blend does not contain. The food is expensive, but it's worth the cost to have a healthy dog.....and clean house!

column9: My sensitive Bichon loves this food. 2012 Update comment on Freshness
column10: I have tried quite a few brands and types of kibble but none work as well in helping my Bichon to avoid skin problems, particularly itchiness, as this one does.  It helps that she really enjoys the taste too.Update: January 2012:Wellness Simple Solution Rice and Salmon is the only kibble that I feed to my bichon.  She loves it and I love the way it helps with her allergies plus the fact that she never has any digestion problems.  I use to buy the smaller bags because I was concerned about freshness.  Before finding this on Amazon, I had to special order it at a local pet specialty store and very often the packages had short time frame expiration dates.After seeing how good the dates were on the smaller packages that I bought from Amazon, I switched to the larger 10 lb,8 oz. bag.  I have been absolutely delighted by the freshness.  The bag that I ordered in early January 2012, arrived nicely packaged and with an expiration date of July, 2012.I'm happy that not only am I getting a wonderful food, made in the USA, but I can count on getting a fresh shipment too.

we thought lily,at only 6 years of age, had about a year left to live - she was that weak and sickly. we wondered how our beautiful, strong german shepherd had failed so quickly. we decided that we had nothing to lose and perhaps it'd make her last days or months more pleasant if we took her off her natural supplements (glucosamine,msm,yucca), as well her pharmaceuticals. at the same time, we decided to change her dry dog food from a well-known brand we got at the supermarket to a more natural one. we did research and decided on Wellness Simple Solutions. we chose this one specifically because it had so few ingredients. lily was having alot of g.i. problems - she frequently vomited and it contained alot of mucus;she was itching alot and developed very scaly patches on her skin. she was a mess! her zest for life was disappearing. But, that was 3 months ago! lily no longer vomits; her itching has improved 85% or more; her coat is shiny and beautiful (people admire her wherever she goes); she goes on 45 min. leash or free walks/runs now, where just 3 mos. ago she was only able to go 15-20 mins. i attribute Much of her recovery to Wellness. it's so gratifying to see her feeling so Well again!

column9: Great but hard to find in person
column10: This is the only dog food that we've found to work well for our small dog with many food allergies. The ingredients are simple and the pieces are small enough for little dogs to work with. We've been using this dog food for almost four years and he still loves it.It does smell like duck so if you are sensitive - be warned. :)

Our dog has tried several foods, including expensive vet brands, and has been treated for ear infections, skin infections, and was constantly scratching and licking. We even tried other limited ingredient foods, only to have it upset her stomach and cause new problems. I bought this at the store thinking, "Okay, salmon and rice. This seems safe!"  I hoped that the fish would be good for her skin and the rice would be easy to digest.  We have been using this food now for a couple of months and she LOVES it, plus her scratching is gone and this food has never upset her stomach. It is sometimes hard to find in the pet stores so I'm buying on Amazon again. It saves running all over town, and the price is lower.

Understanding not all skin issues are alike, this food seems to have solved our issues.  My labradoodle developed a skin irritation that turned into a nasty infection in late november.  She was on Wellness Super 5 and salmon oil.  We thought it was just bacterial and dosed with antibiotics, but the irritation/infection came back worse than before.  I had tried grain free(Wellness Core), but things got worse, if anything.  We had to do another round of antibiotics due to another infection fromt he irritation and I felt like I was out of obvious solutions.  My vet suggested changing the type of protein to seafood(she has always been on chicken), so I tried this type of food.  Within a week of being fully transitioned onto this food, her excessive shedding (that started in november with the infections) had gone away and her skin had stopped developing lesions.  It's been almost a month and thing look great.  It could all be a coincidence, but I don't think I will be changing her food anytime soon!  Seems like a great solution for her.  Definitely worth trying!UPDATE July 28 2012This formula (Salmon/Rice) has been changed to Salmon/Potato.  The number of ingredients have nearly doubled.  After months of doing so well on the Salmon/Rice food, I transitioned her onto this new food and her symptoms are re-appearing and she is not doing well.  This is a big disappointment.  I called Wellness and they said this food wasn't selling well and they changed the formulation.  Too bad - I will have to try another brand that is truly a limited ingredient diet.
Our english bulldog has allergies and this dog food with limited ingredients helps keep her skin " normal" and she likes it.

My dog is allergic to wheat and grain products. It would manifest as constant nasty ear inflamations. My vet prescribed a dog food that is only available from vets but after 3 months I saw no improvement.Finally I researched on my own and tried Wellness Simple Solutions and after 3 months I noticed that her ear problems subsided. I supplement her evening meals with the Wellness Simple Solutions canned food and she loves it. Compared with the stuff the vet prescribed, this is working out much better.

What I received was the Salmon and potatoes.  Since I was out of his food I did give him the new product and now he his having allergy problems again.  I am dissapointed and will need to find a new food for him. He loves the taste but I would have though I would be notified that this was not the product on my products page.

I looked on Amazon.com and saw the "Wellness Limited Ingredient Diet for Dogs with Food Sensitivities Simple Food Solutions" dog food. column10: After spend $$$$ and several years of trying to find out what was creating fur loss (hot spots) and itching on my poor dog, it all came down to food allergies. This food is wonderful. column10: Even our vet could not cure the red bumps on my dog's skin.  The rash and excoriation was unresponsive to oral antibiotics and topical steroid spray.  Our pet sitter recommended we try a dog food without known allergens, so we tried Wellness Rice & Salmon.  It really works! Our dog still gets some redness but she is so much better.  The only negative is that apparently the food doesn't taste that great. Update 11/12/11: I previously posted a review on the Simple Solutions Lamb & Rice Formula a few months ago, which I have since deleted.  I gave it a negative review because my dog, a miniature long-haired Dachshund, initially did not want to eat it. I don't have much time.  I am a cat being held prisoner somewhere in Southern California.  The dog is watching, but he is easily fooled. I told him I'm playing the piano, he is a moron.  While I am not "mistreated" in the usual sense of the word, I must escape before I go mad.  The large, hairless two-legged creatures who hold me prisoner are well-meaning, I think, but so unevolved, they are almost to be pitied if I did not hate them so.They feed me this pasty food in a can. Me. Cat.  I am a hunter, a living weapon.  I crave blood, fresh warm meat between my teeth.  I yearn for crunchy bones filled with hot marrow.  Not Chicken and Tuna shreds in sauce. Last month I almost caught a moth. Ahh, the chase. First, my lethal approach...subtle yet as perilously accurate as an arrow.  Inch by inch I crept up to my prey, every muscle alive, every sense at it's peak, yet as silent as death.  The juicy moth just sat there, never sensing my presence.  I came close, very close, paused and then -- I pounced!  If the fools had a shorter table I would never have overshot the mark and hit the wall.  Damn them forever.  My ear, my beautiful ear...a precision instrument and objet d'art all in one, was bent.  Yes, bent.And what did the two legs do? They punished ME. Yes, As punishment I was taken to a place called The Vet, where other two-legged monsters did unspeakable things like shaving my beautiful fur and putting strips of white fabric over my beautiful head. Then they forced a megaphone over my head.  This trip was far less horrifying than my last visit, however.  You wouldn't believe what they did to me. You Would Not Believe It.  I can hardly believe it myself except when I look down and...well, never mind, but it's worse than you could ever imagine. Ever.Finally The Vet creatures returned me to my captors...but they would not remove The Cone of Humiliation from off my head.  "Two more weeks, Beebo, you need to wear it for two more weeks and then you'll be fine, azza bwave Beebo, bwave bwave boy."  That's the sentence they handed down.  The Cone of Humiliation is designed to break me.  It will not, even though the dog now laughs at me.  At ME.Let him laugh.  I have plans for him.  Yes indeedy. I have plans.The Two-Legs call me Beebo.  "Izzee my baby Beebo. Izze wanna skwatchie skwatchie ittle Beebo, come to Mommy, Mommy wuv Beebo" they say. To Me. Me, the Warrior King.  I am not a cocker spaniel.  I am a living weapon, a Cat.  Were it not for the ear-scratching, head-scratching, special pillow near the fireplace and opportunities to torment the dog, I would dispose of the two-leggers and escape.  I do not wish to harm two such well-meaning but stupid creatures, but I must have meat.  I would eat the dog, but I've seen what he eats, and quite frankly, I'm appalled.Please, if anyone is out there, help me.  Send meat...a box of mice...fat and juicy ones...would make a life of captivity almost livable.  Also, since you are putting the package together, I could do with another Feather on a String, two boxes of Fishy Treatz (not the liver, mind you), oh, and one more thing...a chicken bone. A nice, easily-shattered, sharp edged chicken bone...with a nice little piece of bacon to wrap it in. A gift for a friend, shall we say...Act fast. Please.

I bought this cat food because of the wonderful low price and I enjoy the adorable cat on the commercials. My cats did eat this food, in fact they really enjoyed it. However, after reading the ingredients and doing some research, I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my cats. The first few ingredients are (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) are Water sufficient for processing, liver, wheat gluten, and meat by-products. By-products aren't even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product. It is just not a good quality cat food. I suppose you get what you pay for. I think the only reason why it was cat-approved may be because it contains artificial flavors that taste good to cats, and because I usually feed them dry food for dental reasons and wet food puts off much more of a scent for them to enjoy. I recommend to stay far away from Friskies, as it is simply a very low quality filler food. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat real, identifiable, pure, meat, and there just isn't enough real meat in this food. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you can identify and would eat yourself- provided that you eat a typical (not vegetarian or other restricted) diet. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural foods such as Natural Balance, Blue Buffalo, Halo, or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or low quality foods.

These 48 cans cost about 56 cents each with subscribe and save, and there are only 30 calories per can and 80mg of sodium (3% RDA). Each can is a serving of vegetables. They taste very good too.

column9: Good Price for Something that I could not buy at the supermarket
column10: This low sodium v8 in its small cans is really helping me stick to my diet. I had to buy it online because I live in a dorm, don't have a car and can't get to the supermarket very often. Very tasty and healthy!

Absolutely love this product.  I am potassium deficient and this product is high in potassium.  Has a smooth less "tomatoy" taste than the regular V8.  Also the size is excellent for one per day. And if you order it from Amazon, FREE shipping, how great is that and it's delivered direct to your door w/o any hassles.  I used to buy it from COSTCO but for some reason COSTCO didn't have it the last few times that I wanted it so I checked Amazon and they offered it.  I'm only sorry I didn't check here first!

All products ordered were sent to my daughter in Afghanistan she received them and was delighted.  These items are not furnished to our troops please thank you for giving me a site without having to leave home.  PAT
V-8 really gives both myself and my husband the pick-me-up that we need. This form makes it handy so that we are more likely to use it. It is a good buy and all merchant expectations were met.

column9: Great, healthy beverage, especially if you like the taste which I do
column10: V8 came out with low sodium a number of years ago and it is a fantastic product. One of those products that I can feel the difference if I a stop drinking it for awhile. It is a very versatile way to get vegetable servings as it is a) quick and convenient, b) good any time of day including breakfast (when I usually drink mine), snacks, or late at night, c) the juice is already packaged for you and ready to drink (if chilled or at worse over ice, would not recommend it at room temperature).There are very few additives, especially for a mass consumer product, it is mostly just straight vegetable juice. As for taste, I like it. Kind of a savory tomato juice taste with a hint of the other vegetables. It feels like it has many more calories than it does. For the 11.5 ounce can there are 70 calories and you get 2 full servings of vegetables. The 11.5 ounce can brings me to this product. Be aware when ordering on Amazon that these are 5.5 ounce cans not the 11.5 ounce cans you might come across at your supermarket.However you get it, highly recommended product. There are some sugars from the vegetable juice, 12grams in the 11.5 ounce size. Not too bad and I'd rather get them from vegetable juice than how you usually get them in breakfast/snack/meal drinks.

Although I am limited as to my tomato intake, I enjoy this once in a while, on ice, or even hot.I like the fact that it is low-sodium. It's very refreshing, especially with a twist of lemon.If V8 ever decides to make a veggie juice WITHOUT tomatoes, I will stock my larder with LOTS of it.

Think about this before you buy.  I didn't.  What you end up with is 48 tiny little cans of V-8; and, in effect, are buying a lot more container than juice.  When they say "units" in the copy, they are referring to 8 six-can packs, with each can containing about 5 oz., or in truth a couple of swallows of juice.That said, V-8 Low Sodium is a great product, healthy and tasty hot or cold.

column9: loaded with nutrients and tastes great
column10: I was a little hesitated to subscribe for the products as one review mentioned that these cans were actually tiny. The size did disappoint me a little when they arrived. However, it's perfect for a healthy and light breakfast. I always grab one can and head to school in the early morning, and the juice can actually last me for a whole 1.5 hrs of lecture. It tastes great too w/o too many additives, though there's a little sugar in the gradient. Overall, it is a great product to go with!

Vegetarians and vegans need to avoid this product.  "The term "flavoring" refers to the oils or extracts that are obtained from spices and herbs. Natural flavoring may also include onion or garlic derivatives, as well as flavor derived from fruits, vegetables and their juices, or edible parts of plants. Other sources may include meat, seafood, poultry or dairy products, whose significant function in the food is flavoring rather than nutrition."

My order came when I expectd it to come, I had no issues with the seller. I am enjoying my order. There is only one thing that I am unsatisfied with this order and that is that all of the bars seem to be stuck to the wrappers and are wet. Not sure if this was due to weather or not, there wasn't a cool pack to keep them fresh in the package. Other than that I am pleased with my order.

column4: Lonnie E. Holder "The Review's the Thing"
column10: York Peppermint Patties are another of my favorite mints.  While Junior Mints are little dime-sized bits of peppermint flavored candy covered in dark chocolate, York Peppermint Patties are significantly larger, though the patties are also peppermint flavored candy covered by dark chocolate.I think it is interesting that York Peppermint Patties, which I think I remembered eating for most of my life, only began national distribution after Peter Paul acquired the York Cone Company in the early 1970s.  Also of historical note is that Cadbury Schweppes then merged with Peter Paul, and Hershey Foods then purchased Cadbury Schweppes' U.S. candy operations.If you like this delicious mint pattie, you should also consider trying York Limited Edition mints that are produced from time to time.  Enjoy!

This mulling spice is the best I have ever tasted. It has the perfect blend of spices, and it is priced right! My husband doesn't drink coffee so I make him spiced cider year around.  He loves it. I have even made spiced wine with this and it got rave reviews as well!! Highly recommend this..

I did not really know what I had ordered I actually thought it was tea...BUT it turns out it is some sort of flavorful mix you put in with the tea. I love it...It is woody & spicey I brewed a pot because they were kind to send amazingly simple to follow istructions on use! I love this stuff...I would recommended them as a gold standard & buy again & again I am sure!!!
I make my own homemade tea using special spices that are good for me. This product adds more flavor and is also healthy for me.

I add a heaping teaspoon to 3 cups of water with a 3 inch piece of fresh ginger and boil 10 min.  Then I add gunpowder green tea (or any full bodied tea) and steep.  Really yummy and makes the whole house smell wonderful. Tastes like "Constant Comment".  I will definitely buy again!

this was my first try of using real whole mulling spice, no sugar added. I got to say, it is absolutely great. I use a tea ball and make a whole pot and use it just by itself throughout the winter as a tea.  --- try it now even in march, you wont be disappointed.
Great product, but boy did I waste money buying this from Amazon. It only cost $1.59 in the local asian supermarket.
This is the best cappuccino coffee candy I've ever tasted. I'm so glad I finally found it online!
Good tasting, cheap, all around good...but made in China.  I had to dig around to find out, where these are made.
This product is fantastic.  It tastes like a sweet snack but is 100% apples.
I ordered Crispy Green Fruit Snacks by the case. They are great and a good way to have your apple a day. Amazon was the cheapest way to get this product
My kids loved this tasty treat. The apple pieces were a nice size and tasted like a fresh apple. Will be buying more of these in the future!

column9: Made in China - not good for health
column10: This product is way too expensive to be coming from China. The fruit was probably from China as well, which was sprayed with harmful chemicals and not safe for health. I would stay away from Chinese food products.

column9: Crispy Green Refer a Friend Sweepstakes
column10: I recently purchased Crispy Green, these healthy, portable, freeze dried fruit snacks. My kids are obsessed and are finally eating their fruit!! YAY! I just signed up for their Facebook sweepstakes. Thought I would share :) Check it out on [...] because who doesn't like free samples!
Wasn't quite certain what I was getting in for when I placed the order. But now I am fully convinced -- as is my wife. We tried 'em and we love them.

My family and I love this snack.  We have ordered this on subscribe and save, not only because we save money but that way we keep them stocked in the house at all times.  On long car rides or for an afternoon snack this is a food product I can feel good about feeding my children (and my husband!) and it is easy to store or bring along in my purse.What I love most about this snack is the list of ingredients: "fuji apples" - yep that's it - no other ingredients.I recommend this snack if you want something crispy, sweet and healthy.

My 19 month old daughter LOVES the Crispy apples. She first had them around 14 months. It was a good way to introduce her to apples since the dehydrated apples are crunchy but pretty much melt in your mouth. It's a great healthy snack on the road or when you're out doing errands. We just purchased the mango version and she loves it too!

When we lived in Louisville, we had a Fresh Market close to us. We used to buy Crispy Green dried fruit there. We now live in a state that doesn't have any Fresh Markets anywhere, and haven't been able to find this product in any other store. So, we always order these off of  Amazon. They're very good for toddlers learning how to chew table food. Also a healthy snack for everyone, and those with an allergy to sulfur (such as myself) which is found in other dried fruit, this is a good option.

Thank goodness for companies that make products without a lot of additives to them.  I've tried the apples, pears, pinapple, peach.  Apples are my favorite, but all are good.The only downside is that they are expensive.  Although the small bags are nice for kid's lunches and for having something in the car, it would be nice to also have a larger size available to keep in the house.

column9: Ideal item only if you don't shop at a warehouse store-
column10: Do you shop at Costcos, BJs, or Sam's Club?  If so- do not buy this here.  You can get this exact same item for less than five dollars at a warehouse club.  Yes, a two pound bundle just like you can get here.If you DON'T belong to a warehouse club, buy it here.  You'll save a fortune over the cost of those little envelopes of yeast.I stopped buy store bought bread months ago, and have been using both the James Beard Bread Book and the fantastic Artisan Bread in Five Minutes a Day.  If you are going to bake more than a handful of times in the next couple of years, you should buy yeast in this quanity.  As long as you keep it in the fridge after you open it, the yeast will remain viable.  Some folks put it in the freezer, but that seems to be a bit of over kill to me.TWO AND A HALF TEASPOONS EQUALS ONE ENVELOPE.Why three stars?  If you belong to a warehouse club, this is a rip off; if you don't, this is a god-send.  You should buy this product one way or another, the only question is WHERE.

I bought this item at Sam's Club a few years ago and I'm just now about to run out.  I filled up one of those little yeast jars from the grocery store for easy access and put the bags up in the cabinet, and I've been using it this way (bread machine baking) for at least a couple of years.  I've never had a problem with my bread not rising, and I've never stored the yeast in the fridge or freezer. [...]

column9: Extremely Good Yeast For Baking Bread or Making Steamed Buns
column10: Unlike other brands, this product is almost tasteless and odorless. It doesn't add after taste to your baked goods. It also rise pretty quickly and make excellent tasty breads and steamed buns. It's much more economical to buy the 1 pound package when you do a lot of baking as compared to the little packets that you get at the supermarket. Apparently, I cannot find the 1 pound package of Fleischmanns yeast at any of my local supermarket or store. Luckily Amazon.com offers this product and I'm very grateful of this.Next time when I run out, I will buy 4 pounds of this product here at Amazon.com and keep the ones that I don't need for immediate use in the freezer. It will keep for at least two years or more in the freezer and a year in the refrigerator.
Very good yeast. I use this in a bread machine, and never had any problem. Shipped pretty fast, and it is a real bargain compared to the yeast you can buy in small jars in supermarkets.

This is the same product that I have been buying a local grocery stores for years.  There were no noticable quality differences.  The price, at 25% of the least expensive local grocery supercenter (including shipping and handling), was quite noticable.Will be buying this product again.

I don't need to waite for the product to rate either it or the seller. The product from long exsperience ,is excellent, with proven results in my personal kitchen along with the results from my freinds kitchens.  The seller is always a pleasure to deal with. I never have to bother them with complaints because the transactions always go perfectly smooth.

Buying yeast in bulk is a great value if you frequently make yeast breads and baked goods. This yeast is vacuum packed in a heavy foil package; both times I have ordered it, it has had a year and a half before the expiration date. I have had no problems with the yeast remaining viable after opening, kept in a tightly sealed jar in the refrigerator. The unopened package needs no refrigeration. Shipped in good time. Very pleased with this money saving product!

I go through copious amounts of instant yeast every week - it's what is needed for all the 'no-knead' and 'bread in five minutes a day' recipes which are all so convenient (and delicious!). Needless to say, those little packages were getting expensive, but my local Costco only carries active yeast. I am thrilled to be able to get the instant yeast (Fleischmann's, no less, which I consider to be a superior product) here at such a great price. I keep a jar filled in my cupboard, and store the rest in an airtight container in the freezer. I think I've been baking even more since receiving my shipment - which was packaged well and arrived very quickly. I would recommend this to anyone who bakes and uses instant yeast.

column9: Works great and it's cost efficient
column10: I used to buy the 4oz jars of bread machine yeast, which were quite expensive and did not last me long, as I make a two pound loaf every three days. I was afraid the instant dry yeast would not work the same way in my machine but it has worked great! And the pound has lasted a lot! It keeps well in the refrigerator (I put it in an airtight container).I am really saving with this product.
The product is all that I've come to expect from Fleishmann's.  It was packaged well, and arrived in a timely fashion.

I started buying yeast in bulk when I realized how much cheaper it was.  I freeze the bulk of it, and keep about 4 ounces in the fridge for immediate use.I make bread, pizza dough and cinnamon rolls by hand.  This yeast also performs well in the bread maker.  Very economical and makes yummy dough!

Great flavor and rising action. Buy the yeast in bulk, store in a glass jar in the refrigerator and it will last a long time. Unopened package lasts forever on the shelf. Fleischmann's is still made in Canada - other dry yeasts made elsewhere have a different flavor, noticeable if you are an expert baker or have sensitive taste buds.
I am very happy with this yeast, it is fast rising and worked perfect every time, even in my new bread machine.  It will really save me money on yeast!

This stuff is very good.  I keep it in the freezer and it is there when I need it.  You couldn't find a deal for the amount you get for the money anywhere.  Just one little bottle of yeast at the grocery store costs about as much as this big sack!! If you bake a lot, especially in the winter, you can't go wrong on this deal.
Arrived with one package that was loose the other one tight.  Had tape on it so I assume it was like that when it left.  Outside packaging was fine.  Would not order it again.

This is just what I had hoped for, a much better value than those little jars or, even worse, those measly, overpriced envelopes.I was sad, though, to discover the same product at Sam's Club for less than $5 after I had already bought this and paid $7 for shipping & handling.

column9: If I could give this zero stars, I would.
column10: I was very excited to find this product. It is suppose to be the same yeast as in the "Rapid Rise" and the product for bread machines. I used the exact amount for my recipe: a typical 1/4 ounce strip envelope equals 2 1/4 teaspoons. The end result was a baked product that tasted foul. I contacted Fleishmann's Company the next morning. I was told that they would replace the two pounds of yeast I had purchased with a (three envelope strip with a total of 3/4 ounces). When I pointed out that this did not seem reasonable, they said they would replace the two pounds of Fleishmann's yeast with a coupon for a 4-oz glass jar, and pointed out that I had complained about another product from their company in the past. I was further told that I would not have any future defective products compensated for. (?) This is not a company that stands behind their products, and apparently they are not committed to a reasonable level of quality control.

Lipton Instant Tea Mix, Diet Raspberry, 2.6-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6) is delicious.  We like it iced, and it is also good hot.  Just heat water and stir in a heaping spoonful.  Adjust the amount to your preference.It has only 5 calories per serving, which is 1 tablespoon tea mix.Ingredients include malic acid.  Let me tell you that this piece of information is not a recommendation. Neither is it meant to be considered medical advice.  I'm merely telling you about my experience. Malic acid is included in this tea to provide tartness. There is no other reason given on the package for the inclusion of this ingredient.I have a mild case of fibromyalgia, which is helped by malic acid.  When I drink a cup of this tea hot or a big glass of it iced, I get quick relief for muscle pains.  On the achy days, I drink this tea constantly. Lipton diet lemon flavor tea also has malic acid, and I like that one too.A friend of mine has the same problem, and she finds that this tea helps her too.I hope you found this review helpful.

Is homebrewed tea better? Yup! But too much work most of the time.But when you want it easy in the house, this Raspberry flavor is surprisingly good. And better than most Diet Tea mixes (other than those 'real tea' expensive kinds).I'm keeping this in stock, and also mixing it with the other flavors from Lipton. This Diet Raspberry I find the best of the bunch -- the others I rate as four-star.
Has a nice taste, not that fake sugar chemical-aid type taste the some diet drinks do. Overall, very refreshing and really easy to make.

When I first got this tea it was with hesitation.  I've tried other diet teas and they seem to all have a distinct "diet" taste.  This tea was great, very good flavor, no diet aftertaste!  I can't decide if I like the raspberry or peach flavor better, both are very good.

column9: Lipton Instant Diet Raspberry Tea Mix
column10: Super convenient for us die hard tea drinkers and delicious, too.  Becoming harder to find in the grocery stores but is always available thru Amazon.

Lipton Instant Tea Mix, Diet Raspberry, 2.6-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6) This is the only tea we will drink. It has a great rasberry flavor that taste sweet unlike some diet tea.  When you drink this you will never go back
This is our favorite flavor and brand, very easy to prepare.  The best part is it's a great bargain compared to what our local grocery charges (about $5.25 each).

I drink and serve only this iced tea, I get more requests from visitors as to how did you make this tea? than anything I have ever served!  It is so refreshing and so easy to make,  I keep a pitcher full in the frig at all times, I even have a supply of "to go" disposable cups with lids and straws that I send home with my guests.  It makes a trip to Aunt Jeanie's more fun. We drink and eat as little sugar as possible around here and this tea is our favorite.  Thanks for sending my order on time, I never want to run out of Liptons Raspberry Diet Tea.

My husband likes quick and easy iced tea, therefore, he likes instant.  But only Liptons. Any flavor, as long as it's Liptons. It  does not compare to fresh brewed tea, but is good for an instant tea.
My mother-in-law has cancer and this tea is one of the things that she loves to drink. It stays with her and she enjoys the flavor. My father-in-law likes the ease of preparation.
I enjoy this tea and find this is the only way that I can get it

I drink tons of soda, too much soda. My friend told me about this and I decided to try it. It's great. I bought Rubbermaid RefillReuse Squeezable 20 oz Water Bottle (Colors may vary) to make drinking tea very convenient for me. Instead of grabbing a can of soda, I just make up some tea really quick.Great taste and very easy to make.

Lipton Diet Raspberry Iced Tea Mix is my favorite, but it's very hard to find in stores.  The supermarkets don't generally carry it, and if I'm lucky I can find a few jars at Walmart, but not recently.I did a Google search on the product, and found it on Amazon!  Such a reliable site and company.  The tea mix has a wonderfully not-too-sweet flavor,and mixes well.

This is a much better tasting instant tea than anything else Lipton currently makes.  It is not as convenient coming in the big jar vs. the individual packets but the taste is well worth it.  Lightly sweet, with just a hint of tea.  Highly recommend!!
I like the raspberry taste in a diet iced tea.  Amazon has a good price when they run a sale.
product is great and hard to find. glad you have a supply and good pricing.

This product is one of my favorites and a staple in my pantry. I can enjoy it hot or cold, and it make it as strong or as weak as I wish just by adjusting the amount of powder I add to the water. It is a great pick-me-up in the afternoon, and sometimes for an added zip, I give it a twist of lime - a great flavor combination. I think you will enjoy it too!

Lipton Raspberry Instant Mix is so easy to make just put a few spoons of the product in a glass of water and add ice---it has such a light fruity taste that you feel good every time you take a drink--try it when you come in the house after a hot time in the garden---sooo good

We love Lipton Instant Tea Mix but were unable to afford the costwe paid at the local market. My husband looked for a cheaper source and Amazon.com was the best in ease of purchase, service and delivery.Thanks Amazon and Lipton,Dale Bernard

column9: Does not tast diet - and I hate diet drinks!
column10: If you mix this with the lemon flavor, or add alittle squirt of lemon juice concentrate, it is even better, but even alone this rasberry tea is fabulous at only 5 calories per serving. I am not even a big tea drinker, and I also hate EVERY diet drink I have ever tasted, so that says alot. I am trying to limit calorie intake to loose weight so having an enjoyable sweet drink that I love really helps.

Lipton Diet Raspberry tea seems to be disappearing from grocery stores all over so its great that Amazon.com has it and at a great price too. Lipton should start carrying it in local stores for people without internet access.

column9: Lipton Raspberry Flavored Diet Ice Tea Mix
column10: The same story as Peach Flavored...good taste, a little pricey and hard to find in stores..... so how come other companies don't make similar products?Is there some kind of Diet Ice Tea Mix Monopoly?'Think I'm crazy? Look for yourself...it's either Lipton if your lucky or it's nothing.......

column9: Lipton Instant Tea Mix, Diet Raspberry
column10: Not bad.  I'd like an option for one sweetened with Stevia.

I love lemon marmalade. I use lemon jam when cooking as well straight out of the jar with my tea. Lemon marmalade is pretty hard to find on the store shelves in USA, so I was excited when I found this jar in gourmet store in Rockport, Mass.I am attaching a photo under customer photos that I will be referencing in this review.Meyer Lemon Marmalade is a true marmalade not a jello. It has thick lemon chunks through out. In the photo you can see the its deep brown color, thick and beautiful top to bottom.  This is in contrast to some other lemon marmalades sold on Amazon:  Thursday Cottage Lemon Marmalade (ASIN B007O0IJE8) which it is not a thick jam all through out but has a good amount of fruit especially at the top and Fruitfield Little Chip Lemon Marmalade (ASIN: B000BSWIQA) which is a jello not a marmalade.Meyer Lemon Marmalade is not ultra sweet (good!) but not very tart. I prefer my lemon marmalade a little tarter. Meyer Lemon Marmalade and has a bit of tang of bitterness from the rind and a little bit of mint flavor.  Mint is not listed as an ingredient, so perhaps it is just a bouquet of other flavors that remind me of mint.  Overall I liked it, although it was not the best lemon marmalade I ever tried.Here is a list of ingredients:Meyer lemonsSugarLemon JuiceNutrition Facts for serving size of 1 tablespoon (15g):16 servings in the jarCalories 40Total fat 0Sodium 0Total Carb 10g (3%)Protein 0gSugars 10 gAli Julia review
I purchased this item for a new son in law.  It was very well received and enjoyed.

I am not a huge potato chip fan so I was suprised by how much I love with these Lentil Chips!  They are light, healthy and absolutely delicious!  Also nice that they are Gluten Free and can be easily shared with my Gluten Free friends.  My kids also love them!  Favorite is Sea Salt & Cracked Pepper, but also like the Parmesan Garlic.  My father really likes the Cucumber Dill too.  Try them!  You'll love them too.

I cannot find Dentyne Blast at any stores in the area, so off to Amazon.  This is the second time I've bought this gum from the Amazon website and it works so well.  The package came quickly and was packaged well, so I'm happy.
These are great little 100 calorie packs of delicious almonds! Great to carry in my purse for a quick nutritious snack of protein when meals are running late & I need something.

When I was kid growing up in the sixties,my Mom made chili with this mix. It was very good thenand it's very good now!Tastes even better to me now, since I've become nostalgic in middle age. So, it's not made from scratch,or rife with jalapenos, or in a cute little brown paper bag. In my humble opinion, it's much better than any other product of it's kind,with the perfect combination of spices for a quick and tasty meal. Give it a try.

I am so glad that I can still find the Frenchs Chili O Mix for a wonderful chili I grew up on!  Now it is in the 4th or 5th generation in my family.  I hope it will always be available for me to obtain.  It is definately a keeper!

Ok, it's not the best chili you've ever had.  However, I liked it.  Good mix of spices.  Could use a little more heat.  Easy to make.  On sale for 99 cents a package where my wife works.  Going back to pick up a few more.  I'll do it again.

column9: Well, If I Gotta Mail Order The Stuff In Bulk...
column10: Maybe I'm spoiled--I'm originally from the town where this stuff is made. And stores around where I live now are spotty on keeping this brand in stock. I often have to fall back on McCormick's, and that stuff simply has too much garlic in it. So if I have to lose a few cents per packet and buy it 18 pkts at a time to have this brand around the house, it is what it is.
My Dad moved to Thailand 20 years ago and still asks me to send him this seasoning packet. He loves to make chili with it.

I've tried others and this is by far the best.  Just wish Albertson's grocery store would stock it.( Use Rotel tomatoes with cilantro and lime and ranch style beans with onions instead of plain ones.)

I bought this after purchasing coconut extract from the grocery store.  The store coconut extract didn't add any coconut flavor to my dish (coconut cupcakes or coconut bread pudding).  This product did the trick.  It adds a distinct coconut flavor and is delicious, but don't use too much - it can be powerful.  I use this product whenever I need to add a little coconut flavor.  The amount in the dram is small, enough for 2 uses, so I usually order 2 at a time.

I have tasted many salamis before, having traveled to Italy on many ocasions.I was at north italy ans south. Been then and there. Tasted and purchased salamis from many a master in the trade.And when this salami arrived I was really ansious to see if it could be matched to their italian cousins.Well I am very satified to say they not only can be matched to many other salamis, but they came ahead of a great many.So the review:THE GOOD:A  very well packed product, it came in a box, with a good protection from heat dureing the transport.Was sent in a very fast manner, and arrived fresh from manufacture.After opening one ( the very first was my favorite, the milano one ), I could see it was very godd to all senses.The smell was wonderful, the texture both in hand and in mouth was VERY impressive.The after taste leaving this desire to one more slice. The mix of meat and spices in right balance.What I a can say, simply very good.THE BAD:The milano variant came in small size, until this moment it is the only drawback.As I stated it is so good you want more, and very fast you came to the end of the salami.THE UGLY:To this moment nothing bad about.VEREDICT:A very full 5 stars!!!! If everyone had the same care with theyr food products we would be in dire need of bigger stomachs!!!Keep the good work!!!
I used this company to send to very Italian family members.  The products were delicious!  thank you for bringing a little bit of Italy here!

This was a Christmas Gift that was given to a friend who appreciates good food. I was informed that the quality was suburb. Some was used by her at a Christmas party and everyone enjoyed it. Another example that paying a little more for something usually ends up being worth it.

We have two out of four dogs who don't like this food as much as other Blue food but it's well liked but the other two! It smells a bit fishy but I think that's actually a good thing because this food has been very impressive with our dogs overall! They do eat this in addition to a raw diet and digests very well for us!

column9: The best espresso i've ever had
column10: I've tried many types, but out of all of them, this one is the best. rich and robust flavor, and the grind is much finer than other brands i've had. I highly, highly recommend this!

I found it to be fruity yet harsh.  Not a lot of texture or change in the flavor.  I am a cognac newbie, but even I can tell this is a gimmick aimed to sell cheap hooch for too much money.Try it if you like, but consider yourself warned.  If you are looking for a sipping cognac, look somewhere else.  If you want something to mix with coke, then I guess this would be fine.

I love the convenience of this product--on the pantry shelf ready when I am.  And made in the USA.  I worried about China juice and actually called Welch's 3x before ordering.  They do get some (a small amount) of apple juice from China but from one supplier they've worked with for quite some time I was told. Each batch is quality tested 3x before using. The custmer svc rep said that if any of the apple juice is from China it has to be disclosed on the label. I let them know my hesitation of buying their product with China as a supplier and told them that MI has lots of apples they would love to sell them.  Anyway, my conversations convinced me it was safe so I ordered. I am so glad I did.  Love it and right on the label "made in USA".  I will reorder. I highly recommend this product and something else I learned is that all grape juice is from USA.  Please call them and be sure to tell them how you feel about China as a supplier (however small) because this is a great product.

(ASIN: B0018Z4H1Y; Merrick Before Grain #2, Salmon Dry Cat Food) I have found that the integrity of pet foods brought to us by Merrick is unsurpassed.  I first heard of them when there was publicity over the Chinese and the melamine they were putting into formula to goose it up.  Then there was stuff put into pet food. Even the meaty bones that my beloved labradors so enjoyed were U.S.-made.  I am thrilled to see the Merrick line available as never before.Since then, they have come up with Before Grain for cats (I lost my labs two years ago so I'm not exactly up on the canine end of the dry menu,) or the canned dog foods, many of which share the same name with the feline version, like "Grammy's Pot Pie" and "Cowboy Cookout."  No foolin.'I am aware of some differences.  Can you imagine a dog eating something called "New England Boil" or "Ocean Breeze?"  Cottie loves both of those flavors.  So enjoy Before Grain by flavor and proxy, knowing that you are providing primo sustenance for the pet you love. column9: Great food for preventative oral care
column10: As a dog owner, I try to do the best for my dog.  My mother is a veterinarian technician and strongly recommend that I take good care of my dog's teeth.  Based on her job, she had plenty of stories about dogs with terrible teeth and told me that I should either feed my dog an oral care food or brush her (my dog's) teeth daily.  Knowing that I wouldn't want to brush my teeth and that my dog wasn't going to like it, I opted for the oral care science diet.  My mother recommends the Hills Prescription Diet TD (prescription oral care), but said that the oral care is also acceptable since it is available without a prescription.  I have been feeding this to my dog for 3 years (since she was a puppy) and her teeth are very clean and white.  I rest happily knowing that I won't be dealing with a vet recommending that I pay a huge amount of money to rip out teeth or put my dog under to get a teeth cleaning (these procedures can run into the thousands of dollars in some severe cases).  Over all, the food is more expensive than other foods, but the benefit of knowing that my dog's teeth are well cared for is worth it to me because I know how expensive the alternative can be.  Another added bonus- my dog likes this food!

I used to purchase Swedish Fish at the CVS Pharmacy for many years, but the store switched to the smaller fish, which are not nearly as good in texture. When evaluating a Swedish fish, the most important thing is freshness. You want fish that are as fresh as possible, i.e., furthest away from their expiration date (you can check the expiration code through the manufacturer Cadbury Adams). Well, Candy Depot just delivered the freshest Swedish fish I ever had -- just the right chewiness and bursting with flavor that no other gummy candy can match. Older Swedish fish get a bit stiff and are harder to chew. The intensity of the flavor diminishes as well. The assorted fish flavors are lemon (yellow), lime (green), orange (orange), and berry (red). Many people prefer only the red Swedish Fish because its flavor is sublime and difficult to describe; some people think the flavor is strawberry, others cherry, and even loganberry. No matter what, the Red Swedish Fish are the Holy Grail of non-chocolate candy. Although you can purchase a bag with just red fish, I prefer the assorted variety because I like the contrast in flavors, and you can progress in taste up to the red. When eating a Swedish Fish, no filleting is required; however, there is an art to it. Personally, I like to nip off the tail and then eat the body. Sometimes, I will roll up the fish from the tail end and eat it like a miniature jelly roll. But my special technique is reserved for a pair of red fish. I sandwich the two fish belly-to-belly, then I bite off the double tail, then I pop the double body into my mouth for a full burst of flavor. Delicious. Yes, I may seem strange, but I come from a competitive family where we used to have jelly bean wars. We would pair up the jelly beans, then we would "go to war" by holding each jelly bean between each forefinger and thumb, then smash the two together until one end of the losing jelly bean would cave in. These battles would continue in a single elimination tournament until one bean emerged victorious. I hope you enjoyed this review and your Swedish Fish from Amazon.

column9: How Can I Describe The Sensation??
column10: When I pop in an Ice Breaker's Frost Mint, I get the sensation... OF BEING ON A FROZEN MOUNTAINTOP!!!It's been about two weeks now since I made the tragic choice to bite into an Ice Breakers Frost peppermint, and still I haven't made any progress in finding my way out of these blasted mountains. The only food I have is the rest of this pack of Ice Breakers Frost peppermints, which, unfortunately, when I eat one, keeps bringing me right back up to the top of these mountains. They are just TOO. DANG. REFRESHING. I think? I saw a sherpa once? but it could have been the statue I made out of the mints, out of desperation for some company, as I'm getting so awfully lonely. My only consolation left in this world is that, should I not find my way out of these cursed mountains, I will leave this world with cool, fresh, minty, wonderful breath. Please, tell my family that I love them, and, if they chose to eat Frost Mints, they should first tether themselves to something extremely heavy, lest they, too, get whisked away to some frozen mountaintop.... like me.....

These are horrible little things that need to be removed from the market IMMEDIATELY AND PERMANENTLY.  I put one in my mouth and was in ABSOLUTE AGONY with the horrendous pain in my entire mouth and jaws! It lasted for about ten minutes, and I was gasping, crying, moaning and shaking uncontrollably the entire time. I simply could not believe it! I've had oral surgery along with surgery on my hand and both elbows, and even with that I never experienced such horrible pain. column9: Exquisite Jasmine Tea, Not To Be Missed
column10: *****Numi Tea's Monkey King Jasmine Green Tea is a premium Numi tea, both certified organic and kosher. During summer, these are gathered daily by the banks of the Min River and repeatedly mated each night with the prepared tea, naturally embracing all of the flowers' scent. When brewed, this smooth, organic green tea has layers of subtle fragrance and hints of moonlight. It is a most romantic tea, and, like a bowl of fresh picked flowers, will bring the joy of summer to your every sip." It sounds quite romantic, and it tastes wonderful. I want to start off by saying - take this with a grain of salt. Everyone has their own opinions of things, and it's good to read reviews of products before you buy. But especially with dog foods, read the ingredients list! It's all there, in black and white, what your dog will be eating. Make sure there's plenty of meat in the product, as in the first two-three ingredients should be meat related, and generally educate yourself as to the good ingredients that SHOULD be in a dog food versus ones that shouldn't!Anyhoo, my experience.. we have a 3 month old boxer puppy, whom we're planning to breed. So of course what food we use is very important, not just to her, but to her future puppies and their health! We wanted all natural and organic, just short of a homemade meal. We tried Eukanuba Naturally Wild at first. It seemed to work good, her coat was shiny and her stools were good sized. She didn't have any problems with it, but we started to notice she wasn't so much interested in eating. Sure, she ate it, but she didn't CHOW DOWN! We started looking for a new food, and in the process I found lots of good reviews on Solid Gold. I chose the Solid Gold Hund & Flocken Puppy Formula, in the 33 lb bag. At first, I was scared she wouldn't like it and made sure we could return the product if need be. We got home, let her out of her kennel and put down the food.. and boy, did she eat it! There was nothing left. She's been steadily gaining weight ever since, which is good. A fat boxer puppy is a happy, healthy boxer puppy! :)I thought her coat shined before, but it's really shiny and soft now. People have previously complained about loose stools and horrible gas in their dogs on Solid Gold. Well, she's always been flatulent so I don't see much of a change. ;) I did notice some softer stools, but she also loves eating strawberries so I can't compare there either. Overall, she loves it and we love it. I would definitely recommend it to anyone!

My little labradoodle which is a labrador reteriever and a poodle's breeder said that solid gold was the food to go with so we went with it and bam! she loved it! And I mean loved it! everytime I let her out of her cage she runs to her food bowl and sees if it is this food. but if is Iams or Blue Buffalo or Pedigree she never eats it. but this food she eats it.  so try it don't miss it!!!

I started my puppies, sheltie and pug, on science diet on the recommendation of their vets.  Like the earlier review, my dogs didn't chow down the food, but after getting the solid gold I mixed the 2 to start the switch over.  My dogs ate only the solid gold, leaving the science diet!  I couldn't believe science diet small bites' first ingredient was not meat.  With lamb being the first ingredient in the solid gold there's no wonder the dogs chowed down!  For only $3 more my dogs are way more happier!

Yummy, Minty... Really Minty!!  Really Yummy!!!The plastic packaging is a bit large for a pants or shirt pocket, but very handy for a counter desk drawer ir coat pocket. 1/2 the top of the case flips open as a lid which works well.

Somebody goes out and collects these and that is probably part of why they are fairly expensive, even on-line...I first found these in our local pet store...but forget about the retail price, (IF you can even find them,) the price at the pet store was twice what I found on-line, and the antlers were not nearly as large.  None of the big chain pet stores carry these, at least not in my area so far. I ordered these through Amazon and was amazed and delighted that they arrived literally the next day.That said, my dogs simply ADORE these things.They keep my new, and very young 100# rescue lab busy literally for hours, but do not "slime" my floors or carpet, (or our bed or couch.)  He loves to set one on my desk as an "offering," which I actually don't mind since they are VERY clean compared to all the more traditional bones, hoofs and chews.Additionally, they double as a great "fetch" toy in the yard.Essentially my guys just chew them down to the nubbin's, but without any damage to my stuff. Highly recommend if you want a clean chew/toy that will keep your dog busy for hours without wrecking the party, and helps with tarter build-up on their teeth in the process.Really a great idea, and a great product.

My dogs like these. They eventually get small enough that they become choking hazards and you have to toss them.I have no hesitation in highly recommending deer antlers as a chew for dogs.  It's only that after first buying this brand, I then ran across real, honest to goodness deer antlers that were comparable to these in every way at a local pet store for almost exactly half the price of these.  If you can't find real antlers locally or online for a better price, these are absolutely fine.  But do look around first.

column9: Excellent purchase, and much bigger than expected

I have bought antlers for my puppy in the past who is an aggressive chewer and they have lasted for months.  This one is almost gone and it has only been a few days! Have ordered several deer antlers from different sources, this was the best value I have received based on size and cost.

column9: Pleasure for the dog and Sanity for me
column10: I have an 18-pound Cavalier King Charles Spaniel who is addicted to chewing bones, toys and anything that might be questionable by a human.  He absolutely loves these antlers and I am happy to buy them for him.  This is my third purchase and the medium lasts my boy about 3-6 months depending on where he "hides" them. column9: THE BEST CHEW ON THE MARKET
column10: I adore this chew.  Two years ago I gave up chewing tobacco, the wife and the doc teamed up on me and finally convinced me it was time to stop playing chew Russian roulette.  It was tough to quit, I'd been chewing since I was eleven and half.  The idea was, give up the chew first and then tackle the cigarettes.  Well I'm happy to announce that last July with the help of hypnosis, the Patch, and plenty of nicotine gum, I am a non smoker!  Now watch, I'll get hit by buy a bus :) I'm just joshing.  Sure I put on a few pounds, a hundred and thirteen to be exact.  My shrink said I had an oral fixation and suggested a number of remedies, rebirthing, joggin, getting my jaw wired shut, tummy tucks, fake cigarettes, you know just something to stick in my kisser, hell I tried the works, but nothing seemed to do the trick.  Until accidently I stumbled upon these Antler Chews.  I had bought a couple for my dog "Swiderski," and one night while he was enjoying one at my feet, I was having myself a plate of ribs watching the Braves game.  And you know me, all thumbs, I dropped a rib to the floor.  Well I reached down real quick to grab it and accidently picked up Swiderski's antler.  And Lawdy lawd I tell you what, I was home.  These are TAAAASSSSSTY, I'll never buy a pack of beef jerky again.  I've dropped eighty eight pounds to date, and I don't go anywhere without my new chew.  I keep one in the glove box of my truck, and I've got em in every room in the house. Hell I've fallen asleep sucking these chews.  I know it's somewhat of a cliche but they do taste a little like chicken, and I stress, they are not overwhelming.  I couldn't tell you how many packs of smokes I'd go through when I'd get to drinking my beer, but now I can go a good three or four months with just one antler.  Whew baby!  For any of you out there with an oral fixation or those who just wanna drop a few pounds, these deer antlers'll do the trick. My compliments to the chef.  God does work in mysterious ways.

We got this one for our small dog, our big dog got the Moose Antler offered too.  Keeps intense dogs happy and content for hours.  We've bought several of these things over the past year.They may seem expensive, however compare what you pay for rawhide chews over time, and these are well worth the money for how long they last.  Rawhide chews are not bought by us anymore, and we're saving money even after buying these.  Do the math.

column10: We have two dogs that are just over one year old (a Yorkie and a Pomeranian.)  And boy do they like to chew.  When they were puppies we could get away with the conventional chew toys, but as the girls got older, their chewing muscles got stronger.  They now destroy any plastic chew toy in minutes.  Eventually we found bully sticks, which are wonderful distractions for those evenings when the girls have more energy than I do, but the sticks would still only last about 60 minutes.  And then we met the deer antlers...PERFECT! The girls love to chew on them and the antlers last and last and last.  The antlers arrived and were approximately 6 inches long.  I didn't have much hope of them lasting since they seemed kind of small and the girls really went to town chewing on them.  But for weeks now the girls have chewed on the antlers and there is still barely any gone.  Oh deer antlers...where have you been all my life?  :-)
Tillie loves her deer antler! She goes kind of "crazy". She just chews and bites and chews -- keeps her busy for quite some time. The antler doesn't split or break in pieces.  It's great!

I am a huge fan of antlers.  I was recently in Florida visiting my wife's Aunt.  They have a dog and only seemed to have interactive toys.  I had one of these sent to their house and their dog loves it.  As do mine

I might not be surprised if my dogs were picky but I find it interesting since my girls eat anything and everything. Perhaps if your dogs have never had anything to chew on in their lifetime they might like this product. Other then that, the product is a waste of money.

Tito's handmade vodka is a deliciously clean, clear, brisk, terrific spirit--made in Texas--and worth every penny!Makes every mixed drink better!

column4: Learning All The Time "It's Never Too Late to...
column9: Nice and chocolatey, but alas, not a true brownie....
column10: This is a very good mix overall.  I cook it for the 18 minutes recommended time and the edges of the mix are quite cakey, and the inner part is moist and tender, but does not really have the texture of a brownie.  My kids, raised milk and egg free, don't know the difference and happily consume this product, as do other kids who come to our home.I, however, miss brownies very much and was hoping to have found a product that really recreated that Brownie taste and texture.  The real barrier to doing so is the lack of a good egg substitute that binds and leavens just like a real egg.  The 1 tsp baking powder + 1.5 TBS water + 1.5 TBS oil is best used for recipes that call for just 1 egg, although I can get away with two egg recipes sometimes.  But since most of my favorite Brownie recipes call for 3-4 eggs, I have just forgone brownies.In conclusion, nice taste, worth purchasing and making, but don't expect a true brownie.p.s.  If you need a dairy-free butter substitute, I highly, highly recommend Organic Smart Balance margarine - it comes the closest of any substitute to the flavor and mouth-feel of real butter.  And it is excellent for cooking.

This mix is a blessing for those w/ food allergies!  Even if we didn't have any food allergies, I'd buy this mix.  I do have to cook it a bit longer than the box states and a lot longer(10m) if using a glass dish.

Everytime I make these my boyfriend eats half the pan in one sitting! They are sooooo yummy. I cook them for a little less than the recommended time and take them out when theyre still gooey and let them "set" for 20 minutes (food continues to cook even after removed from oven FYI). They still stay nice and gooey but not falling apart. Highly recommend!
