A True Organic Japanese Sencha Green Tea with High Quality in Flavor and Well-Packaged, as well as a Great Value in the 16-box configuration.  Quick Delivery.
Very mellow tase. If you like not strong body tea - you will like Sencha.For me this tea little dit too soft and tasteless.

This tea is described as replacing "Bancha", also by Eden. It is good, a little more colorful in the cup, but less delicate as I remember Bancha. I have found that letting the water sit for 2 minutes after boiling, and steeping for no more than 4 minutes makes a great cup! Will buy more.

I've tried many green teas and this is one of my favorite... and probably the best bang-for-buck teas I've tried. The flavor is excellent and the price is good compared to many I've tried. I still keep this one in my tea drawer along with much more expensive choices - but still drink it regularly. Highly recommended as a great tea for the price!

The best I have ever consumed. Studies advice that this japanese tea contains three times the benefits of green tea than in comparison to the chinese version. I love doing this type of research for personal reasons and like feeling I'm doing all I can in regards to medical prevention. I love it!!! Buying it in this size has been great as it costs more for an individual box at the health store.

I have tried many different green teas in bags, and this brand is the smoothest and most pleasant green tea.  And when I forgetfully leave the bag in the water for too long, it doesn't ruin the flavor by getting very strong.  I definitely recommend it.

column9: Good flavor, one of my favorites
column10: In my original review of this tea, I was not so enthusiastic, then I changed my opinion. I first thought it was not as good as the Yamamotoyama Sushi Bar Style or Kirtland Signature Ito En Matcha Blend, but it is comparable.  My co-worker even prefers it.  However, though the flavor is good, it is much weaker than the others.  There are shipping charges with the Yama and Kirtland teas, but I'll probably stick with them in the future (esp. the Yama brand for it's pricing and paper bags, as opposed to Kirtland's nylon bags).

I love my little bonsai!  My only complaint would be that it hasn't yet flowered, and I've had it for 6 months.  Oh, and it ships in an unusual way - wrapped in bubble wrap and in a box with packing peanuts.

I purchased this as a gift and couldn't be happier if I had seen it in a store. When I opened the box, the room smelled of jasmine, I loved it. The base of the plant was securely bubble wrapped and the remaining plant was cushioned by popcorn so not to crush the leaves and flowers. It was already flowering when it was delivered and has been flowering since. My son loves his new bonsai and I will definitely buy form Bonsai Boy (through Amazon.com, of course) again.

column9: Better left indoors, but overall a great plant!
column10: I received my plant promptly and when I did it was already covered in buds so I knew it was going to be a pretty bloom! My buds opened up into beautiful jasmine flowers within a week and a half, and if it wasn't for the Texas heat they wouldn't have shriveled up and fell off the plant. That being said, if you live in a very hot or a very cold climate, keep this inside by a sunny window and there it will thrive. Mine sure looks great on my desk at the office :) *But if you keep in in the air conditioning, remember to put a tray of water under it to keep the air around the plant humid! Otherwise it may dry out and start to look poor.* I remember reading somewhere to keep these plants in temperatures ranging from 70-90 degrees, so that may be some good guidelines on whether you put the plant indoors or outdoors. The only complaint I have with the actual seller is that they shipped the plant wrapped in plastic. My plant was not damaged or suffocated when I received it, but that still just seems odd to me...

The communication with this vendor was not friendly. The Amazon description says that this is indoor plant and that it blooms in summar and all year around in warm climate. It does not say that you need to keep it outside for it to bloom. However, this vendor says that you need to keep it outside for it to bloom. There is no option to buy humidity tray with order.Vendor gives cut and dry resposes. No effort is being made to accommodate customers expectation.

I've had this plant for about eight months now. I ordered it in the middle of winter, when I was, strangely enough, just getting into plants. Plants fill my windowsills now, but this bonsai was one of my very first plants.It came very carefully packed with packing peanuts, if I recall correctly, and it had dark green, glossy leaves and a beautiful pot; shipping did not appear to have impacted it at all, and it came with a sheet of paper instructing me how to care for it. (This can also be found on the bonsaiboy website.) It didn't grow in the winter, obviously, but when spring and summer rolled around this year, I saw two bursts of growth and a single flower. The single flower is my fault; because I love this bonsai so much, I'm too afraid to put it outside!It's one of my hardiest plants, and has never given me any trouble but a bout with spider mites that I understand is probably due to my not washing the leaves often enough. The only plant I have more trouble free is probably my phal!

Stubb's BBQ is great thick sauce, perfect for any summer BBQ purpose.I loved the flavor before I went on a low carb diet and was pleasantly surprised to find out it has only about 10 carbs per serving about half of most brands. I like a lot of the Stubbs products including their rubs which work great on pork tenderloin

This sauce is much less sweet than most brands and is a slightly thinner consistency.  The flavor is dominated by tomato, vinegar, and spices.  Overall I like it a lot, but if you're looking for a thick, sweet sauce you will be disappointed.
These onions do spice up a cocktail and are a good value. Delivery was fast and quality remains excellent. I will continue to buy and enjoy each evening.

column9: What I ordered isn't exactly what I got, but that was ok
column10: I was bereft (as were my martinis) when we'd finished our first jar of exceedingly sublime Tanquerey Cocktail Onions. Imagine my great delight to find same on Amazon. So I ordered 6 jars. My order arrived. The piece of paper said Tanquerey onions. In the box were 6 jars of Saucy Mamma onions. A very nice lady at Amazon apologized and promised to send me what I'd actually ordered. Within two days, another box arrived, and I had received 6 more jars of Saucy Mamma onions. Now let me just say that they are equally delicious. Briny, not overly salty, crisp, and quite a perky addition to a gin beverage. It didn't seem worth complaining again because I could easily and happily live with the mistake. But I never did get those Tanquerey onions. Alas.
Barhyte has now discontinued the branding arrangement, but the "Mama Mia" brand has replaced it.  Absolutely the BEST cocktail onions for gibsons!

Our family LOVES peanut butter.  This is another great addition, or alternative, to standard peanut butter.  Very tasty...our kids love it, too!  No trans fats and you don't have to keep it in the fridge!

This soy butter has a wonderful texture and taste, with no sweeteners whatsoever.  It is also a good source of protein and fiber.  The price on Amazon is better than I could get at the store or through the manufacturer.

I.M. Healthy Chunky soynut butter is by far the best soynut butter I have tried.  The oil DOESN'T float to the top which is the only soynut butter that I have found for this to be true.  It's yummy and now my favorite, over any peanut butter.

I tried the unsweetened soybutter about 3 years ago.  I gagged!  Then a year after that, my young son was diagnosed with peanut allergy.  So, we have lots of this in our house.  I just bought the unsweetened version for myself, everyone else in the family likes the sweet ones.  I put about a tablespoon with jam on bread and you have the perfect peanut butter replacement.  I do not notice the lack of sugar.  I also have the Clown Gysin soy butter too.  It has a good flavor as well.  I think they put more oil in theirs since that version has more fat in it than the IM Healthy.  That is what makes the Clown Gysin version more peanut buttery sweetened than the IM Healthy.  Right now this is my favorite.

It's  not too sweet so it tastes great.  I don't like any nut butter that is sweetened with sugar.  Plus, this has more fiber than peanut butter so it's a great alternative for you Carb counters out there.  I use it in place of peanut butter for everything.  Just try it and you will see what I am talking about.

Im Healthy soy butter is wonderful.  My husband is alergic to peanuts but can eat soy butter.  It tastes just like peanut butter.  It is not like almomd butter where the oil separates and you have to keep it in the refrigerator.  It does not have to be stirred all the time and does not have to be refrigerated.  It is great.I was so happy to find this on AMAZON.COM.  I used to buy it at Sprouts but they stopped carrying it and Trader Joe's did not have it either.  Amazon.com was great.  I had tried to order direct from the company but was unable to so this was the only way I could get the soy butter.
Ordering on Amazon was cheaper than the grocery store.  My husband espcially likes this product for a low-calore/low-fat substitute for peanut butter.

Soynut butter does not taste like peanut butter but is pretty good in its own right. We are a peanut free home due to allergies,and soy nut butter is a good alternative. This brand is high quality. No added sugars and great crunch. Tastes great on apples. Also one gets the great properties that soy contains.

I just received my order and love it. I did research and tried to find a sweetner that I could use with no aftertaste or chemical taste. This liquid sweetner to me is better than splenda because splenda leaves an after taste and I just don't like it at all. I do have to use a few more drops than in the directions but I am very pleased with this product. This will be my new sweetner because it's the closest thing to real sugar and I am a very happy camper!

This is a product my husband and I have searched for for some time.  We wanted sucralose without the addition of sugar that is used to make the powder form.  In small quantities the sugar is negligible, but my husband likes fresh lemonade in the summertime and used a large amount of Splenda in the past.  The EZ-Sweetz seems smoother than Splenda without any foam or aftertaste and no sugar.

I am on the Atkins diet and these drops work perfectly! If i use a pack of splenda, thats 1 carb and these are no carbs plus it doesnt leave the nasty after taste. I bought the 3 pack so that i could keep one in my purse, at work and give one to a friend who is also watching their carb intake. All it takes is two little drops in my medium coffee and it is the perfect amount of sweetness! I used to use 1 and 1/2 packs of splenda and it would get powder all over the place but not with this. i was super skeptical when i ordered it but not anymore. Buy them, you wont regret it!
Again available after an absence of 40 years! or is it 50? No carbs, no calories and no after taste! What more could I want Also available in several sizes. This one is perfect for pocket or purse!

My office manager turned me on to this product a few months ago. It's incredible. Just add a drop or two into your beverage. I use it in my coffee every morning. It has a natural sugar taste with no carbs. You will not believe how sweet 2 drops tastes. I love it!

column9: Seeds of misfortune, heartache and triumph
column10: Though the package was shockingly tiny, ConAgra's David seed have no rival.You will enjoy bag after bag.

Can you hear me scream from there?  That is because there was NO picture when I bought this item and NOWHERE did it indicate that there was a price on it.  When it arrived, all of the little packs are marked 30 cents!  Now I have to stock my entire concession stand with nickels and dimes and all of a sudden the flunkies I have working for me are going to have to count out real change and do real math to sell the merchandise when I had everything in multiples of a quarter.  I had actually planned to sell these for 50 cents, because people expect a certain markup, but they ARE very small.  They are good, and my ballplayers literally demand them, but I can't wait until they sell out.  Personally, I think if you sell pre-priced merchandise, you should so indicate.

The description does not mention the product contains mint, and it is not something you would expect in an Earl Grey product or even think to ask about. Mint makes me gag, and I smelled it as soon as I opened it. Needless to say I was extremely disappointed.

A bit of background: I had a mind-blowing, amazing, world-changing earl grey green by "The Teaman" on Etsy. SO. GOOD. The Bigelow Earl Grey Green was good, but The Teaman's stuff was a portal to another world.*I more or less vibrated because I couldn't stop drinking all the caffeinated deliciousness, so the hunt to find a decaf version began.This tea isn't bad, but I think you get the idea that I'm stacking it against a rather compelling competitor. I didn't mind the mint, as another reviewer did, and felt it blended well with the other flavors present. The trouble for me was that this tastes like run-of-the-mill black tea, albeit with some additional flavors and complexity. Big kudos for harmony: all the flavors work well together. They just really, really aren't my thing.The main flavor seems to be the Breakfast Tea flavor. Yeah, they took Earl Grey Green and flavored it with black tea extract. I have no idea why. Black tea is a dime a dozen if you're into that kind of thing, and I'm not. I think my mother would adore this tea: she eschews most flavored tea and sticks to your basic blacks, though she does like Earl Grey.I will continue my hunt for an excellent decaf earl grey green. I suspect this one is for black tea lovers who want the health benefits of a green tea.*lest you think I'm a shill, I didn't care for the majority of his teas, but the earl grey green! Oh, heaven!!

column9: Pretty good and quick to fix
column10: This tastes like a Japanese side would.  I like the noodles.  It only takes about 7 minutes in a skillet.  Quick fixin's after a day at work.

I first experienced these at the school where I work; it's part of the kids' lunch menu some days.  They are crunchy and sooo delicious.  They are only 140 calories per 1.1 oz. bag.  I tried to find them at neighborhood stores such as Target and Walmart with no success.  Thrilled to find it here on amazon.com.

I tried these for the first time on a Jetblue flight and loved it.  It tastes exactly like popcorn, but shaped like a chip.  The white cheddar taste is not too strong and just about right.  Great snack.  SOOO happy amazon sells this and for a great price.

column9: WOW! Like corn chips, smartfood, and popcorn all rolled into one!
column10: Wow, are these good! They are crispy and crunchy, light and flaky, and still have a bit of texture and depth to them. Sometimes with "healthier" chips I feel like they are almost too light, but these feel like a REAL snack food.Their taste reminds me of SmartFood (which turned out not to be so smart) with a mixture of whole grain chips- there's a nice tang to the crunch.I'm a big corn chips fan- Fritos, tortilla chips, etc. I also love anything cheddar (Smartfood, Pirate's Booty, Cheez-It) so these were a GREAT find for me.The only downfall is 6 grams of fat per small snack-size bag. But at 140 calories, and the amount of flavor, it's well worth it. My entire family LOVES these chips and they are our new obsession.A NOTE ON SHIPPING FROM AMAZON: Almost every time I ordered these they said 3-5 weeks until shipment and wound up shipping just a few days after my order. So I think there's a glitch in the inventory system with this. Just a heads up so you don't order for more from another vendor.

column9: No more powdery, cheesy fingers from popcorn!
column10: I, too, first had these on a JetBlue flight and now I'm hooked! I've had both the white cheddar and sea salt versions and while both were tasty, I think the white cheddar had better flavor. The triangle shape makes them easy to eat and the 1.1-ounce portion sizes are just right. If you're a popcorn fan but hate the powdery fingers you get from kernels, these are definitely for you!

Super nice texture for a chip, like they say, almost like popcorn! This snack is low in salt and doesn't have a crazy amount of fat, though it still has a fair amount.For a crazy amazing snack, order Urbani White Truffle Infused Oil, 1.8-Ounces Bottles (Pack of 2) and drizzle some in the chip bag, then hold it shut and shake. Most amazing snack ever and will delight even the more picky or yuppy tongues who demand complex flavor from their snacks.

column9: Once you popcorners you can't stop
column10: I bought this because I was looking for gluten free alternatives to the junk they sell at the school cafeteria. I bought the 40 pack hoping to have it last me the semester only to have everyone in my family eating them. They went over really well here.

The white chedder Popcorners are the best flavor they have by far! I love the taste of them so much I had to order some on amazon. They are almost always sold out at my local Whole Foods store. If you love white chedder and you love chips, buy some!!

column9: So good...must've gotten a bad batch
column10: I absolutely love these chips!!  But unfortunately my most recent order was very stale.  I will buy them again, but it stinks that I wasted money on this batch.  Otherwise I would recommend them.

I, too, think they taste a little strange-kind of sour-ish. They have a very unpleasant smell when a bag is first opened, but I think this is from the bleu cheese powder. After a few chips, the taste sort of grows on you, if you can ignore the almost-like-dirty-socks-smell. I probably will not order this brand again. I think Popchips taste much better, but I tried these because Popchips were more expensive. Sometimes you do get what you pay for. Not terrible, not great-just so-so.

column9: Enough Chips per Bag to be Nicely Filling
column10: Still not sure how much I like the flavor (white cheddar) or the texture (crunchy but not crispy?), but liked enough to eat whole bag, which has enough chips to be filling (unlike SmartFood White cheddar and a few other similar).

Delicous, light, just the right amount of cheesy and a little salty.  These yummy chips have the airiness of popcorn but they're filling like chips.  I love them, they're addictive!  My new fave chip.

I got these chips and they are pretty tasty! I sometimes will sprinkle some truffle salt on top for an extra zing.  I have also gotten the kettle corn which are also good. I sometimes will eat them alternating salty and sweet, great combo!

Yum... The white cheddar taste reminded me of smart food, but in a light, crunchy chip form.  These make a light and satisfying snack.  Appreciate that they are gluten free, will be buying these again!

These popcorn chips are AMAZING! I tried them one day when I saw that the 1.1 oz bags were only $0.89 at my college campus bookstore. I immediately fell in love. I love how they have the crunch of a chip, but the air popped taste of popcorn. I like how they are healthier for you than your average potato chip and I am delighted that these are gluten free. I wish that every store near me sold them, but only BJ's Warehouse Stores do, and only in the Sea Salt flavor. So far my favorites are the White Cheddar and the Sea Salt. White Cheddar is a great alternative to smart food!
I love these chips! The white cheddar flavor is thin and mild (not like a Smartfood) and they taste great!

For a healthier snack than potato chips, these snacks really have a lot of flavor! But they're also cheaper compared to some other healthier snacks that I've bought from here. The taste is just like the title: corny with a light cheddar taste. These were so good I would be inclined to try the Sea Salt flavor because I liked the taste of the corn chips. For 140 calories you get something like 14 chips, a small amount of saturated fat and not a lot of sodium compared to other snacks. The only problem I found was when I got done with one bag I wanted to open another!

These chips are delicious and low in calories.  They satisfy my cravings for other less healthy chips.  The only problem is that sometimes, many of the chips in the bag are hard and seem unpopped. These are really inedible. If the chips in the bag were more evenly cooked I would rate these 5 stars. Also, the sea salt are very good,the popcorn flavor is good, but a little too salty for me. As you can tell I am a fan of these and have purchased lots of them. I wish Amazon would offer a subscribe and save on them.
I am hooked on these and this is the only place I have been able to find them other than our vending machine at work.  Great snack.

As far as healthy chips go, this is the BEST chip I have ever eaten! Medora popcorners, plain are also good. However, after trying the white cheddar, I was hooked! I like them so much I may put them on the every-other-month auto shipment! You may get a few that didn't pop right, but for the most part, these are fantastic! I highly recommend.
This is a great alternative to chips! The white cheddar flavor is delish! Can't wait to try the other flavors.

The BEST chips ever. EVER!! I ordered a box and they were sooo goood. I was hooked. Then I got my roommate hooked and I think she ordered the monthly one! They are crisp and have a great soft crunch. Nice and cheesy. Can become addicted, so be prepared to support this habit :)

column9: Great Snack you can buy on Amazon.com!
column10: I originally bought Medora Popcorners White Cheddar snacks from Amazon.com for my sons lunch, however it is hard for my other son or even me to keep our hands off of them.  It's a cross between popcorn and a chip and it is DELICIOUS!  Give it a try, you will be glad you did.

I bought these when they were one of my "picks" on the gold box page and I love them. I read the reviews as I have so many things that "sound good" but taste awful!! There sound good and taste GREAT!! They are 4 weight watcher points and it is a good size bag. I will be buying them again as they are a great value and low in points.

My kids and I adore these popcorners.  We are on our second box of them, they are that good.  I prefer these individual size packs over the larger 6 oz bags Amazon also sells.  Way too easy to eat the whole big bag.  Portions are easier to control for the boys as well.  Highly recommend these.

I took a chance and ordered these, the  price was was too good to pass up.They are light and not salty at all! As stated by the other reviewer, "They taste like popcorn, and are shaped like a chip" Even better my husband loves them too, and he is picky aout his chips. I WILL be buying these again

I love white cheddar, but these taste kind of bad. I expected something like Smartfood, but instead got a thick sour taste on top of the cheddar. It reminds me of vomit, and I'm not saying that to be gross. It really does. It's not a particular shipment I received either--they all taste like this, and I can only eat about four chips before I'm just totally turned off from eating more.BUT, it looks like others love this stuff, so maybe it's me.
Where is the white cheddar???  As a plain corn chip I guess I have no complaint, however, the white cheddar flavor is missing entirely.  Now I am stuck with 39 more bags.  Can I send YOU one?

column9: Great Taste! Finicky Eater Loves IT!!!
column10: Ok, my kid is VERY finicky. Things have to be made a certain way, etc. She also has food allergies, which in turn exacerbate her eczema, as well as seriously limiting what she can eat, even healthy stuff. Flax is good for eczema, but she doesn't like it added to cereal, won't do the oil, even when mixed w/maple syrup, etc. Enter these WONDERFUL crackers. Dehydrated at low temps to preserve the oil (& thus all the nutritional benefits), with no artificial colors or flavors, no gluten or other common allergens, etc., so it's the best flax cracker on the market (my opinion). We got some from a local health food store & gave 'em a try. She LOVES them!!! The only thing I don't like is the price, which is why I buy in bulk here @ Amazon. They keep for a long time! We plan to try all the flavors. She doesn't like the Onion n Garlic one (no one does but me - they say too spicy/hot), but I'm betting the Maple Cinnamon will be a hit. Ditto for the 'regular' flavor. Thanks, Amazon, for the great price!

This is my first Foods Alive product. I like them, but don't like them a lot. My biggest problem is that if you eat more then two or three crackers they coat your teeth and you spend the next half hour trying to get it off with your tongue! I will buy more and will try different flavors and varities. They are better with some kind of dip or cheese then just plain in my opinion.

I am experimenting with raw food.  This is o.k.  we don't like the slippery "seed" texture of it.  It just sort of melts back into seeds in your mouth.  If your real hard core raw vegan, then try it.  Other wise,  I would pass.

I like these because they deliver good protein, good fat and not a lot of carbs.  Subtract the fiber from the carbs and you got a negligible amount of carbs.  Theres no junk in these like other flax crackers, that often have some type of grain flour added.  These are pretty much as flaxy as you can get without making them yourself.  The italian zest is my 2nd favorite flavor of this product line, right behind the mexican harvest.
If you like sardines you will love these little sardines from Galicia! Incredibly delicious! I enjoyed them so much! I will definitely purchase more when I'm out.

The delivery was great and so was the packaging. Was here right when it said it would be...I can say that I like to try new things and normally like new stuff but I think these need a aquired liking lol, alot of my extended family loves boiled peanuts so guess what they are getting for christmas lol!

column4: Kenneth L. Blair "I see what I see"
column10: I tried these about 2 weeks and fell in love with them.  Now I can't quit eating them.My only complaint is that the only place I have found these is at Wal-Mart, and most of the time I go looking for them (I could eat a can a day!) the shelves are empty.  There are plenty of the regular kind though, but that is not what I want.

Delightfully fragrant after infusing in hot water. Delicate taste -- somewhat sweet and fruity, but the hint of ginger lingers (pleasantly) after the cup of tea is consumed.I first tried this particular flavour in a Tea Forte sampler gift, and I'm glad I got the loose leaf tea in this form. I won't say that this is great value for 50 servings, but the uniqueness of this blend redeems this purchase.

column9: Great as an iced tea too
column10: I've had this tea several times at a local coffee shop, but they ran out. So I found it online.I love it iced and it doesn't need a sweetener.

At first I have to say that I love tea, but especially black teas so I'm no expert in white teas. This one is definitely of good quality, but I don't like the taste at all. Too sweet for my understanding, and although I like fruity drinks, this tea seems to be close to pear juice, but still it is not.It is worth a try if you're really into pear (I actually miss the strong ginger taste).

I am not a fan of coffee.  Sure, I'll admit that it tastes great.  Unfortunately, the way I feel afterwards isn't worth that flavor.  Coffee leaves me feeling anxious; my stomach feels like it's in knots.  My solution?  Tea.  This product, in particular, is a wonderful mid-day pick-me-up.  It leaves me feeling refreshed and energized without any funky side effects.  I'm not interested in most flavored teas, as they are usually sickly sweet.  This unsweetened tea has a wonderfully robust taste that you will find yourself craving.

This sweet and sour tamarind product is NOT a true tamarind taste. Also, it is overly coated with sugar. The taste itself is awful, the package is very small and not worth the price, don't waste your money!

I have been drinking French Roast coffee for over 20 years.  I was a little unsure about ordering 5lbs of coffee without trying it.  I was concerned about people who commented that it was not a true French Roast - well it is!Occasionally I drink Vienna roast which is the lightest of the dark roasts - not as dark as French.  I don't like the burnt smokey taste of Italian roast.  So it's French roast for me.I knew this coffee was good just by the slight aroma without even opening the bag.  The beans are the right color for a French Roast and slightly oily, as should be.I boil the water and use a filter cone to make the coffee.  This coffee is rich just like a French Roast should be.  This is the French Roast for me from now on.May 2012(Follow-up review.  My third bag was a lighter roast - more like a Vienna roast - but still very good quality.

We go through coffee at an alarmingly fast rate.  This French Roast is great.  We think the price and the beans are terrific.  Good coffee, good value.The beans are dark and oily.  Coffee tastes fresh, rich, dark

I'm a fairly awful and dedicated coffee snob but I go through so much coffee I thought it was worth giving a product that doesn't start with an "S" a try just to give my wallet a little relief (granted, if I'm going to unnecessarily spend money on anything, it will be good coffee).  I do have a strong preference for thick and smokey French roast flavors in the morning that linger with me and I grind the whole beans like I'm making Expresso.  Anyway, short story is that I'm on my fourth five pound bag.  For me, that's an very favorable review.
Economical and flavorful!  I am a bit of a coffee snob and we enjoy making a full pot every morning, highly recommend it!

This is decent coffee but not what I'd call a true French Roast.  I've tried the Italian Roast as well and neither has that dark, rich, smokey flavor that I associate with a quality dark roasted coffee.  The beans are irregular in size and not uniform insofar as the surface oil is concerned.  Of course it is inexpensive so I suppose you get what you pay for...

Bought to replace the ever increasingly expensive StrBks brand french roast. We brew with a drip pot, french press and a single espresso maker. Tastes just as good as the overpriced brands, especially when you count the savings from buying in bulk and the delivery subscription discount. Highly recommended!

Found this to be a very good coffee bean product.  The coffee brewed to a full, rich flavor without bitterness.  We ground this daily to make our coffee and the bag has a stay fresh one way valve which helped the first cup taste as good as the last cup.

column9: Great Coffee! - A LOT of it!
column10: I almost didn't order this coffee because of some of the reviews that said it was not a true French Roast, but I am happy that they were wrong.  I have been using a French Roast from a local high end roaster that charges a premium price of their product.  This product is just as good as theirs, at half the cost.  My only concern is that since it is a five pound bag which is about a two months supply for me.  After researching the net, I found that if you can't use it up in 10 days to 2 weeks, that you should freeze it (once).  So I divided it up into ten day portions and am experimenting on the best method for freezing it.  Any recommendations?

column9: The Best Coffee Bean Direct coffee so far!
column10: I have tried the whole bean Costa Rica and Brazil whole bean varieties by Coffee Bean Direct and so for for me this is the best flavor. What more can I say, it's good stuff!
The coffee is very tasty. We have found that to brew to our taste, we follow the recipe on the package, plus a scoop for the pot. We plan to order more in the future.

column9: yummy, but I would not call it a french roast
column10: While I think this coffee is delicious and rich tasting, I would not call it a french roast.  I know many places that would not even call it a full-city roast.  The beans are medium brown, with a little bit of oil.  I would have expected much darker, oilier beans from a french roast.  There is no smoky or burnt flavor to it at all.  I really do like it, but I would have called it a breakfast blend, not a french roast.
This was a great buy ! We love the rich taste and it comes at a very fair price. Delivery was fast and the packaging was good. Subscribe & Save makes it easy to get my new favorite coffee.

column9: A fine coffee at a good price
column10: I buy coffee from these folks regularly, but rarely the same flavor twice. They sell so many its fun to mix it up. This is a fine coffee, the equal to most of the brands in the stores for three or four dollars more per pound.

column9: The best coffee I've had in a long time.
column10: The best coffee I've had in a long time. I would highly recommend it. The only problem is I can't stop drinking it.

This is good value for the $, but doesn't really qualify as a true French Roast, in my opinion. It has a nice flavor (though a bit too "winey" for my liking) and delivers a decent Espresso, but just doesn't quite hit the mark. Some have compared it to Starbucks French Roast, regarding it as comparable, but I disagree; the Starbucks, which has been my dark roast of choice for the past 2 years, is superior. It depends how choosy you are about your coffee, really. I'm sure many people will find this more than satisfactory. Just don't expect this to be a really DARK roast; its not.

column9: Coffee fit for a coffee snob!
column10: I searched the internet trying to find a good, whole bean coffee at a reasonable price. Even with coffee prices rising I could not bring myself to buy the cheaper brands. Being from the Northwest I was skeptical about a roasterie from the east coast.  I was pleasantly surprised and have signed up for the automatic shipment option! This is a smooth, medium roast coffee that makes me happy!
Wonderful coffee at an excellent price. Better than most dark roast I have tried. I will definitely purchase again,
The coffee is fresh. The Quality is high. Makes a good cup of coffee if you have a good quality coffee maker and filtered water.

column9: Not as good as the reviews stated
column10: I decided to try this product based on the reviews. Taste is subjective, I realize. But I was not  pleased. The coffee had a good enough flavor but it left a chalky after feel and slightly bitter. I was disappointed.
The beans smell rich and bold.  They are not dried out and old.  And, the cup of coffee is divine!  Better than any coffeehouse cup of Joe.  Totally over the moon on this product.

I've bought this before it's one of my favorite coffee . There's so many to choose from. I also like the dark house blend  I have a bloomfield coffee maker and Breville grinder. This coffee maker and grinder makes excellent coffee .

This is the 3rd time i've ordered this coffee and I have to say it's as good as the Starbucks roast.  I'm not a huge coffee drinker and definitely not a connoisseur of fine coffees but for the price and flavor this is a good buy.

This French Roast coffee is very good.. You cannot beat the price when you subscribe.. 5 Lbs is quite enough for a month making a 12 cup pot once a day.. What a relief not to have to look for sale prices in the store. Buy this coffee NOW!!

column9: Good coffee but not perfect for me.
column10: We're just finishing the French Roast 5lb bag up.  This is our second 5lb bag from Coffee Bean Direct.  The first was the Dark Brazilian Santos, Whole Bean Coffee, 5 Pound Bag which was good with a nice nuttiness and pretty full body. We like our coffee dark, bold and full bodied. I found this French Roast to not quite meet my expectation as a dark and full bodied coffee. That being said, it is fine coffee that has been my daily cup at home and been served to a multitude of house guests.So, I'm about to order another 5lb bag.  I'm probably going to give the Italian roast a try or may return to the Dark Brazilian Santos. Either way, we've weened ourself off $18 / lb specialty coffee roasters and have found a solid source of good coffee at a very reasonable price.
I tried this brand and now plan to be a regular buyer. The fresh roasted bean makes all the difference.

I tried this product based on the majority of the recommendations being positive, and that some people even thought it was a rich coffee.  Another reason I tried it was a purchase of a different brand of French Roast coffee elsewhere which was plenty strong for my brewing method.  However, after receiving and drinking the coffee made from these beans, I can only agree with those who felt the coffee was weak in flavor; therefore I'll not be purchasing this coffee in the future.  A three star rating indicates, "It's OK", and I'll give it that much, but no more for my taste, and peoples' tastes vary widely.  One important factor is the preparation method, which undoubtedly varies between people offering reviews of this product.  I'm basing this on my preferred method of making coffee in a Keurig type coffee brewer using a My K-Cup insert.  Using that combination and various amounts of water with a grind size that has been good with other coffees I was unable to make a cup of coffee that satisfied me.  Staying in theme of the coffee's name, I may give my "French" press a try next.  I hope this helps you in making your decision.  Thanks for reading.

This order was returned and refunded after I waited nearly thirty days.  I reordered again and we are waiting patiently.  I have received your products and items to military POs before using an FPO (USMC.)  Now, the APO AE address I have provided was not accepted.  The refund went through right away to my credit card.  So, not only are we disappointed, we are without coffee.  I ordered three five pound bags.  We love the French Roast and Italian Roast both and we are now trying Brazilian Santos.  I have also enjoyed the chocolate before.  All are great products, well packaged and at a reasonable price.  I would hope the orders can be filled by adapting your order form for military postal deliveries.
it was great,it was and had a great nutty tast i would and am going to proceed to buy this coffee for now on it really was great and so was the PRICE...........
This is the best coffee to have for everyday morning or night!! Delicious Thanks!!Not bitter a very smooth cup of coffee.

I was worried about ordering such a large bag without ever having tried this brand before.  It turned out I worried for nothing.  It's a tasty coffee at a fantastic price, and I'm happy to recommend it!  If you're a true coffee snob this might fall slightly short, but it ranks up there with the rest of the whole bean coffees available at my grocery store.  The only time I've tasted better was at one of those high end coffee shops with artisan beans.
I have never tried this brand before, but after hearing the reviews I had to buy some! Best coffee I have ever had!

Not really a french roast. If you've ever bought french roast coffee at the grocery store when you open the bag the grounds are nearly (if not actually) black. This is NOT the case with this coffee. When I grind these beans then look no darker than a medium roast. That doesn't mean the coffee tastes horrible, it doesn't. But it does taste very "Meh" and it's not what I was intending to get. That's disappointing. I also have to wonder.... the write up from Coffee Bean Direct says this contains a blend of African and South American beans. You can certainly tell its a blend from looking at the beans, but I wonder if it's an actual recipe they have or if they just toss whatever they have lying around in the hopper.Overall: Not horrible, not french, not great.

I've bought Coffee Bean Direct coffee before (i.e. Dark Brazilian Santos) and the other varieties were good, but I prefer a stronger roast. When I ran across their French Roast I thought, great ... and bought a bag. I was so pleased I've now set up a subscription so I don't have to remember to order coffee anymore.

I just received it Friday.  5 lbs is a hell of a lot of coffee, but worth it at this price (with subscribe and save).  At first I didn't like the way it smelled, not used to dark roast, but it tastes amazing.  Also dark roast has a little less caffeine than a lighter roast like Colombian because it's cooked longer, fyi.  This is darn good coffee, highly recommended.

column9: Says Espresso and came as regular beans
column10: The image of the product says FRENCH ROAST ESPRESSO. However, when it arrived, it did not and it is standard whole bean coffee.  It's great coffee, but it's not espresso and it's not what I ordered.  BE VERY CAREFUL and DO NOT rely on images as they are not always accurate and you have NO recourse in this issue if you rely on images.

We use this for espresso machine from bevelle or something like that called. We use on the machine grinder and grind it just before getting double shot portion from the machine. Makes it easy and handy to put more into the grinder's container from this big bag and we keep it sealed inside a larger air lock container. Keeps it fresh. 5 lb bag makes sense to buy it in bulk. Rich in flavor I think. I am not a big bean counter, but, this does the job. Makes me buy less starbucks but lets me enjoy my own coffee and latte at home. This is like the one I get from Starbucks.

French roast espresso is a full bodied coffee.I was very pleased with it.I have also tried papau new guinea delicious! I am onto brazilian dark roast next. So far every coffee from direct bean has been amazing and reasonable.I was a weekly starbucks buyer now I have more money and still have great coffee.
I had high hopes this could be a money-saving alternative, but the quality just isn't there.  Put me down for "eh."

The 5 lbs. is a great price..but the beans start to dry out before I'm done with the  5 LBS. bag..I'm sorry to say.. I rec: a Keurig coffee maker.. So I will be cancelling the Coffee order..sorry.. The Doc. said I had to back off on coffee . 4-6 cups a weeks ......."blood presure" issues..

I was swayed by high reviews to try this roaster with a subscription order. A mistake that will take a long time to finish if ever. The beans are NOT a uniformly dark French Roast as expected, but a mix of multi-brown and reddish beans; it is what is considered a medium blend roast. When ground, it is actually reddish brown. It does NOT smell nor taste anything like French or dark roast. If you like medium (it is a notch about supermarket variety commerically roasted coffee such as Folgers or Maxwell House or whatever) it's fine, you'll find this palatable and to your liking. I question whether Coffee Bean Direct is roast house credible and whether some of the 5-star reviewers here aren't members of the company, or I got a mislabeled bag. IF it is NOT a French Roast, do NOT call it as such. To put it mildly, I am extremely angry that I'm stuck with five pounds of it. An expensive mistake. I have canceled my Coffee Bean Direct coffee subscription order.

This comes to a tad over $6 / lb.  Dark Roasted shiny beans make for a great cup of coffee.  I'm a French Roast or Sumatra drinker - this French Roast is great,  My coffee maker will make a regular or darker brew and the darker brew comes out very Espresso.  Very happy with this and the price.....
Nice tasting whole bean coffee at a very good price.Great brew and saved money, I'll be back for more.

Product arrived on time and as shown, until you unwrap the chocolate bunnies.  They were so old that they had a white film covering them.  As these were party favors, I was embarrassed when I saw people spitting then out into their napkins.  Totally disappointed.

Great service and Great Plant!!!!!Hard to find both these days...Had alittle problem with order and Sheryl corrected it within 5 days..Beleive me I have spent thousands online and this by far has beenthe best response of personal service and product I have received fromanyone..It's nice to know there are HONEST and Respectfull people stillaround,You won't regret buying from SHERYL'S SHOP!!!!BEAUTIFUL PLANT!!

column9: At Least the Crisp is There
column10: Evaluations of food items, including snacks, are a matter of personal preference, personal taste. That's why so many flavors and varieties of food items are available from which to choose. The following is one Potato Head's opinion of Pepperidge Farm Cheese Crisps, Four Cheese Medley.When I saw the already opened box of Baked Naturals on my night stand, I was suspicious because Mrs. Spudman is not always generous with her snacks. On the box are all the gushy, feel good words: natural, No preservatives, Real ingredients, Always baked, Real cheese. I like natural and real, so I expected to like this hand-me-down snack.From the first crispy bite I was disappointed. Crispy, yes. Tasty, no. There may be four cheeses in there, but intense cheesy taste there is not. In fact the flavor is about as robust as that of the bland, Pepperidge Farm gold fish. One good thing about the lack of intensive flavor is that it's easy to exercise self control and not overeat this snack. I do share them with our two dogs who seem to like the crunch factor if not the taste. With their heightened senses, they may experience the cheese in a heightened plane.On the good side, the crisps aren't overly salty and when done my fingers aren't covered with that must-wash-hands residue left behind by other snacks, like delicious, cheesy cheese puffs, for example. Another positive is that buried in the extensive ingredient list I spied dehydrated POTATOES!A serving size of  pieces has  140 calories. Not bad. Before buying a four pack of this snack, perhaps buy a single box locally to make sure you like them.This has been one Potato Head's opinion of Pepperidge Farm Baked Naturals Cheese Crisps.
I was not happy with the 12 Vermont Brownies I purchased at such an expensive price.  My brownies from a box taste much better.  Some were dry and lackluster in flavor. No more buys from me.
these taste just delicious hard to have just one. reminds me of when i lived in paris and lived off of these!
I bought this with my hestitationhowever, it tastes good. it has a very butterly taste and sweet as wellonly 8 pieces not so many:(

Milo's Kitchen chicken meatballs have become one of our dogs' favorite treats and have been a big hit with them from the very first bite. The snacks actually look like little meatballs, and though I haven't actually tasted one myself, they do seem to be delicious to dogs.I like that the first ingredient in these treats is chicken. I also like the absence of artificial colors, artificial flavors, and fillers. Though I'm not crazy about the inclusion of BHA as a preservative, it is also used in human processed foods. Also not desirable is sugar high up in the ingredient list.The flat bottomed bag stands tall is is resealable. For those who prefer to break snacks into pieces, these can be broken by hand, or as Mrs. Spudman does, with a knife or kitchen scissors. Gabby and Piper, our two furry girls, highly recommend the Milo's Kitchen dog treats.

column9: MY DOGS ARE CRAZY FOR MILO'S!!!
column10: This is a short review because what's not to love about Milo's Meatballs!  I only wish they made them for humans!  My dogs love them and they smell tasty--never tried one myself, but they must be good...who knows, I might try one!  (Just kidding!)

My dog just loves them. Picked them up at Sam's Club and now I'm forced to purchase them again online to keep my buddy happy. Well worth the price as they last a long time giving him just a few per day.

column9: Convenient for us and the dogs love them
column10: We travel a lot and wanted some kind of meat to add to our 2 minpin's food that didn't have to be refrigerated.  After trying several other products, we found Milo's Meatballs and these fit our needs perfectly.They can be easily crumbled up and mixed into their food, and they love them.  We also occasionally use them for treats.I love that the bag is resealable and stands up, and that they offer large bags of the meatballs, saving us from having to constantly run to the store to find small bags of treats, as we did with some other products.

My dog Xena loves the meatballs, they're in the kitchen on a table w/ the other item I bought which is the chicken jerky.  We bought the jerky to try at PETCO for 19 something where as they're about 26.00.  Xena just loves them so thought I could find them cheaper online, it sort of evens out for what the s&h + tax versus the price of gas it seems like we got the better deal.  Now when she wants them she goes right over to the table letting us know that she wants a treat.  I'm reviewing both of Milo's items I bought in one review, just to reiterate that our dog Xena loves these treats!

I planted 6 rose bushes (including one climber) last summer. One of them immediately started showing black spots and yellowing of leaves. Being a novice gardener I did not realize it was the black spot disease. This year after a wonderful bloom in early summer, I saw that the yellow leaves/ black spot had spread to 3 more of my bushes and by mid-june all four bushes shed all their leaves and this is when i tried to look up on the net and came to know of black spot and yes other wrong things done my end - not sunny location, bushes planted too close etc. After much search, I bought the Ortho product and sprayed my bushes every weekend. I also cleared all dead leaves, applied cornmeal on the soil, used rose fertilizer and must say now, after a month, my bushes have sprung back to life with beautiful blooms. Really like the ortho product. On the info side - this product does not seem to clear existing black spots on leaves. I pruned and removed all affected leaves and sprayed on the new growth and now they look BS free.
I did not find the product effective in preventing yellow and spotted leaves on my rose bushes.  I will not use it again.

I use this product as part of an effective IPM program in our gardens for roses.  It comes as a concentrate and must be diluted according to instructions.  It is very good against aphids and mites.Dr. Brian KlingeSanta Barbara, Calif.

column9: Watch out for the first 5 star review by Brian
column10: His review caused me to buy the wrong product.Its not an insecticide....only a disease preventive (fungicide, I think) Look elsewhere for a combined product.

column9: Try Rose Pride Insect, Disease and Mite Control also
column10: Actually I haven't used this version, I use Rose Pride Aerosol and the organic RX 3 in 1, which don't need to be mixed and can be sprayed directly from the can.  I rated this 4 stars instead of 5 because acting like a backyard chemist and having to mix toxic liquids scares me.  However, the premixed version "Rose Pride Aerosol" is 5 star, so take a look at my review for that and see if that meets your needs.Get the Rose Pride that has the rose on the front and is called "Insect, Disease and Mide Control" not the other one that does not have the fungicide.It's hard to find, but worth it.

This is an excellent product for those who wish to protect their plants from fungus diseases.  I use it on my roses and other flowers and it stops disease, even fungus disease.  Highly recommend this product.

I have used Ortho Rose Care on my roses for many years. It is the best product I have found to prevent rose disease. This year I was not able to find it anywhere localy, fortunately I found it online. A BIG thanks!

This is a great product for your roses. Keeps them disease free. Which here on the Gulf Coast isn't easy. Its unfortunate that this leaked out of the bottles before it arrived here. Hopefully I will get more soon .

column9: Delicious treat that is not just sugar
column10: These are great. Very chewy so it takes a while to eat, but not the soft chewy that gets caught in your teeth. I love the initial orange flavor then the ginger heat kick at the end. This 5 lb bag is a LOT of chews!

The orange is real orange taste, great combination.  The best of the Chimes ginger chews.  I bought their sampler bag with all of the flavours in it, and this one really stands out.  The peanut butter and the peppermint were good, too, but not up there with the orange.  I didn't care for the mango so much, but I wouldn't turn any of them down.  :)

These are the best ginger chews on the planet!  The sweetness and the flavor of the orange pairs perfectly with the spicy ginger.  These are so good to suck the orange flavor while the spice of the ginger creeps in.  It's hard not to just chew them up, though, because they are so tasty.  I, admittedly, ate 3/4 of a 5 oz bag in one sitting, which is why I purchased this 5 lb box.  I've tried the mango, peanut butter and peppermint flavors, too, and the orange blows them out of the water.  Be forewarned that these are incredibly addicting.
I would highly recommend this product.  I bought them previously from a store in my neighborhood but was pleasantly surprised that I found them on amazon.com.

column9: balanced flavor, can help calm upset stomach perfect candy
column10: Ginger has many proven and documented health benefits. I first tried these when I had an upset stomach and could not find ginger ale or pink junk to help. Not only did they help they also taste great. I then had to order the giant box of them to always ensure I have a supply. Also turns out my American bulldog loves them and it helps reduce his gas and saves my sense of smell (and appetite)as well as acts like n anti-inflammatory when he gets sore.The flavor is refreshing in almost any condition. It is what I turn to for almost any and everything. If I am nauseous it helps quell that, if I am tired keeps me awake.
We eat these for our own health, but my 3 year old daughter also LOVES them and it makes for a nice treat for her.  Great price for the 5lb box as well - about half the price you'd pay at the store.

column4: Baron Von Cool "Do or do not, there is no try."
column9: Perfect chewy little treats are allergen-free!
column10: Love these treats! They're chewy enough to take about 30 seconds to a minute to eat per piece, and have a great zesty orange flavor with a fiery ginger kick at the end that really stays with you (like ten minutes of slowly diminishing pleasant heat on your tongue from eating just one or two pieces). They don't get stuck in your teeth like some chewy candy does. And they're allergen-free (but made in a facility that also processes peanuts). No corn, no dairy, no soy, no gluten! They come individually wrapped, so there's no need to worry about eating them all fast once you open the bag.If you're looking for more awesome, allergen-free candy, try Surf Sweets Gummy Worms, 2.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12). Not only are they delicious, but they even have Vitamin C in them! They also make Surf Sweets Gummy Bears, 0.9-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24) and Surf Sweets Organic Fruity Bears, 2.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12), which are sugar-crusted and chewier--in other words, they're basically gummy bear-shaped gumdrops. They're all great!

I first found these delicious little chews in a TJ Maxx and after tasting one, I am hooked! Not only are they sweet and spicy, they really help with motion sickness. Now I've found they are a perfect solution to my morning sickness as well. If you love ginger, I'd definitely recommend giving Chimes Ginger Chews a try. The orange and mango flavors are the only 2 I've tried so far, and both are fantastic!
I love these Orange Ginger chews...they get me over the hump, with just the right sweetness and touch of ginger at the end...the combination is amazing '
If you like ginger candy I think you'll love these. Nice and chewy! Great flavor with an nice kick. Great value.

I first found this amazing, delicious product while on vacation in San Diego. Upon returning to my home in Florida I began a quest for Chimes Orange Ginger Chews. Unable to find them within my area, I ordered a five pound box from Amazon. All I have to say is Thank You Amazon!

The combo of fruits is really yummy.  My favorite are the tart green mangoes.  Everything is soft and chewy and I don't feel like I'm about to rip out my teeth like when biting fruit leather.  I have kept bags of Mangoes & Berries in my office so I can have a little midday snack to hold me til lunch or til I get home.  I also like taking a bag to the beach or on road trips because it doesn't need refrigeration and doesn't get sticky when left in the hot sun like other dried fruit.  Yes, there is lots of sugar added (so keep a toothbrush handy) so I try limit myself to a small handful but it's pretty addicting. I'm not sure about the shelf life but I will demolish a bag before it reaches that point.  I'm not sure if the price is decent because I don't have a Costco membership card because I don't have much storage for bulk items.  So if I factor in gas and cost of a Costco membership and the fact that I didn't pay for shipping on my last order of Mangoes and Berries, I'd say it's pretty fair.  Enjoy
Not a fan of the blueberries - felt they sort of changed the flavor of everything in the bag.  I love Kirkland products and will continue to buy them, just not this product.

column9: wow i waited 4 weeks for this
column10: so I purchased this item about 4 weeks ago to find out that it never shipped then when it did it got here i opened it to find out that its not even the right product and i cant what i got because it has cherries in it....thanks alot for letting a soldier down appreciate very much

Naturally, they're about 2/3 of the price @ Costco, but seem to have shorter shelf lives than most dried fruit assortments. A nice mix but make sure you shake the bag around before reaching in or you'll miss all the berries 'til the end. Some of the mango pieces can be a bit tough for my liking. Not sure I'd buy again, especially given the superior value of their Fruit & Nut medley.

column9: As advertised! Good for the price.
column10: The coffee is very good compared to Maxwell drip and reasonably good compared to other Tassimo brands. This is my standard morning coffee. No complaints for the cost!

I have purchased these T discs many times and there is something wrong with this last order.  Does anyone else have the problem of the discs only making 3/4 of a cup?  It's not my machine because any other brand turns out fine.  I bought another package from a retail store and the same thing is happening!  For the money that these discs cost, this is unacceptable.  I bought a whole case!!!

the coffee is good. but I've been trying to cancel the auto shipments but its impossible to find any way for customer service to help. therefore they continue sending it and I have to keep sending it back.

column4: coffee drinker in PA "coffee drinker in PA"
column10: This is still good coffee but they have DOUBLED the cost.  Half the price at BBB with a 20 percent coupon.  Also available half what Amazon is now charging @ Target & Walmart (at least it was available there a couple month ago)

column9: Exactly what it aims to be
column10: For anyone who simply wants a basic, American-style cup of coffee, this is perfectly fine. No, it's not as full-flavored or (arguably) as good as most of the higher priced Tassimo offerings, but it isn't intended to be. This is a simple, inexpensive cup for everyday use.That said, I knocked off a star due to Amazon's current pricing. The unit price for the "Friday Sale" is roughly the same as the individual retail price at many stores. That's not a deal -- and certainly doesn't represent the sort of discount one would expect to receive when buying a 5-pack.

The coffee is excellent the price great. After my K cup took a dive I gave the T-disc a try Wow. It was better than any of the K-cup brands I had. The only unfortunate draw back is you can't seem to get the T-disc in stores. Good thing Amazon has them at a good price.
I enjoy this coffee.  Biggest problem is that it overfills my mugs so that I have to watch it so as not to overflow. I don't understand why some brands overflow and some do not fill the cup.
I was surprised at the pleasant flavor of this coffee. Robust enough to satisfy, with a great smooth, full taste. One of my regular favorites for the Tassimo.
This coffee is just the right strength for me.  It has no bitter aftertaste.  I love it! Great price with the save & subscribe feature and it comes right to you.

When I come down the stairs in the morning, and the kids are "making coffee" I smell the great aroma of the original Maxwell House coffee that I grew up with. When I get to the kitchen, I have a great cup of coffee, with no mess and no waste. The coffee disc's are expensive, but there is no "day old" coffee left sitting in the pot. This coffee is nothing fancy, not too strong, and taste good every time I fix a cup.
These discs and the Tassimo coffee machine are incredibly easy to use and Amazon ships the discs in record time.

There is nothing really special about these t-discs coffee. It's not very strong, but it does radiate a fresh roasty flavor when brewed. This is definitely the most convenient way for me to brew coffee while in the office where I don't want to deal with the mess of coffee beans.
This is a great tasting product and it is much cheaper than others. You can't beat it in any way. I drank many other coffees including Starbucks and found this to be quite satisfactory.

column9: This Coffee is so smooth it's the choice at our house!
column10: This Tassimo Maxwell coffee  from the Maxwell Cafe collectionis the choice at our house no matter who is choosing! Finallya coffee that My husband, Kids & friends love! This price can't be Beat!
Great cafe and a good product.. The most you can get for what you pay for love it . thx

This is great-tasting coffee.  So convenient in the T-Disk format.  When you want just one cup of coffee, just pop one of the T-Disks in your Tassimo and out comes a very good cup.  Maxwell House should be proud.

As the title says, this is a good basic cup of coffee.  We feel a little frustrated by the 6 ounce default pour - does anyone still drink coffee in these lilliputian quantities? Still, with a little time spent pressing the "give me more" button, we can get a nice full cup of medium bodied coffee. We generally alternate cups between this and Gevalia Vanilla Hazelnut on the weekends.
The brand of coffee is a nice medium brew.  I don't like coffee that is too bold or strong and this fits the bill.

Do you remember what it smells like to add water to an ashtray full of cigarettes? That's how this coffee tastes. I added a caramel, some hazelnut flavoring, a packet of hot chocolate with miniature marshmellows, and Coffeemate vanilla chai creamer too it. It still tasted bitter, like wet cigarettes and metallic. I think the metallic flavor comes from the t-disc packaging. It doesn't make sense to buy a $100 coffee maker and drink trashy coffee. Especially when you can take that same amount of cash and buy some good coffee. I ignored the bad ratings of other reviewers because I believed the positive reviews. The only redeeming factors are that it is cheaper (less than $7 at Walmart), and that you can make a single cup of coffee. If it were allowed, I'd give it a -5 rating (or <-> -,  for infinitly horrible).

My dogs love these treats.  They are small and very low in calories, perfect for my dogs that are trying to lose weight.  They are also low in fat, so my dog that has had pancreatitis can eat them safely.
These are the same treats that my vet sells, but they are cheaper on-line.  The delivery was fast and ordering was easy.  Dog loves them.
Fabulous treats and soft enough to hide pills inside.My chubby girls love these and they are cheaper than at the vet's office.Good delivery service, too!

column9: My dog loves these AND...they're lean!
column10: I bought the first bag of these at my vet's office.  He's not a big treat fan so I was intrigued with anything he would reccommend. The man actually sugggested I give my dog an ice cube as a treat.  I don't know about your dog, but an ice cube doesn't even appear on my dog's radar scope as a treat. I have a dachshund (pray for me), so he isn't a huge dog...yet.  I cut the treats up into four pieces to get more mileage out of them.  I would've given them 5 stars, but they stink. I am glad Amazon can ship them to me as none of my small town grocers carry it. I understand some larger stores do carry the corn thins as do Whole foods stores.Since I live in rural NC, I order much of my gluten free needs from Amazon with free shipping

I love these corn thins. They totally fill that "crispy-munchy craving."  My 2 year old daughter and I can polish off a bag in 2 days! But at 22 calories a slice, who cares? Especially since it is made with all whole grains. And this price on Amazon is $1 per bag cheaper than in the market.  Try the "sesame"Real Foods Organic Corn Thins, Sesame Flavor, Gluten Free Wheat Free, 5.3-Ounce Bag (Pack of 12) and the "soy & flax" too. Real Foods Organic Corn Thins, Flax & Soy, Gluten Free, 5.3-Ounce Bag (Pack of 12)

I ordered these hoping to get a little variety from rice cakes.  I really love these corn thins.  They are very good and gluten free.  You can do so many things with them.  Even make little sandwhiches.  I eat them with a little butter spread on the top every day.  Personally I would rather eat these than bread.  I can't find anything that I don't like about these.

column9: OK but not as good as the regular Cinnamon Spice tea
column10: I really love the original Harney and Sons Hot Cinnamon Spice Tea so I decided to try the herbal tea. It does "resemble" the original but is not nearly as flavorful and full-bodied. I'm ok with it because I keep reminding myself that, while I'm not getting the wonderful taste of the original, I'm also not getting the kick of caffeine that comes with the original spice tea. It helps to give it plenty of steeping time and make sure the water is hot enough.
I opened this rice to find it infested with small black bugs. Worse yet, they were alive! I won't be buying this brand again!

I'm not married to any particular merchant or brand of basmati rice -- I just figure out the price per pound including shipping. This time around, Laziz had the lowest price at $1.692 per pound, using Amazon Prime free shipping. I buy 20 to 25 lbs at a time, which really cuts the price down.As for basmati rice in general, it's a great rice -- holds its shape, and has a wonderful delicate nutty flavor and aroma. Once you've had basmati rice, you'll never buy the crap they sell in the grocery store again. It improves everything you eat rice with.
Just not as flavorful as other Basmatis I have tried. I'm hoping to have rice delivered via Amazon's subscribe-and-save so I'll try a different brand when this bag runs out.

This Basmati Rice was delecious with excellent nutty flavor. A nice compliment to any main course or Indian Curry dish. One recommendation - do not over cook the rice and just use twice the amount of water as Rice. Laziz Basmati Rice, 10-lbs Bag
The rice arrived in a paper bag and has strange smell even after I washed it. I found the same Basmati rice at Same club was $10 for 15 pounds.

I ORDERED THIS 2-4WKS AGO AND YESTERDAY OPENED AND WHEN I SCOOPED UP A CUP OF RICE TO COOK IT HAD BUGS IN THE RICE...MORE BUGS IN BAG!!HORRIFIED AND DISAPPOINTED!! WONT BE BUYING THIS BRAND EVER AGAIN!! GREAT PRICE BUT NOT FOR THE "EXTRAS"!!!

OK, I'm a fried rice fanatic and in my opinion, this is the best rice to use.  At first, I cooked it in the standard 2:1 ratio of water to rice; it was too sticky.  So I decided to follow the directions on the package (duh) and used only 1.5 cups liquid to 1 cup of rice.  Perfectly cooked in about 15 minutes, each grain separate and ready for stir-fry.  With conventional rice, I had to chill it before it could be fried; this rice doesn't require that step.  I will definitely purchase this again !
This is such a great product!  Delicious flavor and we love the way it cooks fluffy every time;quick cooking with so many different ways to prepare it. A rice lovers delight!
This rice has a wonderful flavor and cooks up beautifully. It's also perfect for fried rice the next day. Really glad I found it! Almost forgot, you can't beat the price!
We LOVE this rice!  It's a good price & so much better than the last bulk bag we bought somewhere (maybe SAMS Club?).  We put this on auto-order to get the discount.

These cookies are delicious. No one would EVER know they're gluten-free. I'm used to giving up taste, texture or both when I buy or make gluten-free foods, but these are as good as any packaged chocolate chip cookie. In fact, they're better than most I've tried. They're not dry and hard like a lot of packaged cookies. I highly recommend them.

column9: These cookies make going gluten free a bit easier.
column10: I am at the beginning of my gluten free journey and have largely been dismayed by the taste of most gluten free foods purchased to date. But these cookies are AWESOME!  I love the strong gingery flavor and while they feel quite hard to the touch, once you put them  in your mouth and chew, they break apart very easily and practically melt in your mouth. I wanted to eat the whole bag during the first sitting and enjoyed them so much that I nibbled on them throughout the day until the bag was empty.  YUMMY!I didn't order these through Amazon, I purchased them at my local supermarket.  I always worry about the age of mail-ordered food and the conditions in which they were stored.  Plus, I can see that given the hardness of these cookies, if shipped they probably would be mostly crumbs upon arrival.
For gluten free they are pretty good. They are a bit dry but that seems to be a problem with gluten free in general. I like the Simplebites line but I wish there were more varieties.

column9: These don't really resemble chocolate chip cookies
column10: I know allowances need to be made for being gluten free, since it's hard to get good texture and taste from gluten-free, but these chocolate chip cookies don't compare at all well with their namesakes.  There's a weird flavor that overwhelms everything else--not sure if it's the rice syrup or what, but whatever it is, that plus the texture which is pretty gritty and chalky at the end makes these cookies a one-time purchase.  They're so bad I'm throwing them out instead of eating them.  The gingersnaps are tolerable.  Not great, but definitely more edible than the chocolate chips.
These are my mom's favorite gluten free cookies and ordering them from Amazon is the most economical way to purchase them.

I use Pamela's pancake mix and my family loves it, so I was eager to try her ready-made cookies as well. Have to be honest and say that I don't really care much for the Simplebites Ginger Mini Snapz. They are so HARD! Way beyond "crispy". I think part of the problem is they're just too thick. A thinner, wider cookie would have been better. On the plus side, though, they are very gingery.I'm going to try to soften them up a bit. And perhaps they'll be good as a pie or cheesecake crust, but just for snacking, no, I wouldn't recommend them. Now to think of what to do with the other 5 bags. :/
I'm a big fan of dark chocolate and really like the Extreme Chocolate Mini Cookies.  I've also had Pamela's Products Ginger Cookies and they are very good as well, however the chocolate are the best!
For those of us who can't eat wheat, having a cookie, and a good cookie, can be a rare treat. These cookies are delicious. Wonderful! Yummy! Even our friends who eat wheat love them.

column9: The best store bought cookies ever!
column10: These cookies are awesome in flavor, texture, size and price. The best store bought GFDF cookies ever.

Great cookies! Being newly diagnosed with celiac disease (gluten intolerance), I was very upset that I wouldn't get to enjoy my favorite foods any longer. One bite of these cookies and I was sold----I would eat them even if I didn't have celiac disease. Very tasty and light. You won't miss the gluten.

I got these on sale during celiac awareness month, I chose the chocolate chip. I thought they were pretty gross, and to me they had a funny chemical after taste, which I don't know what it could have been from since it's all organic ingredients. Ick. I wouldn't buy these for .25 cents a bag.
These cookies are better than any cookies i have tasted. I am very particular about low fat, gulten free items because they do not taste as they should, but these are very GOOD.
THANK YOU PAMELA!!! Finally a gluten free cookie that is actually GOOD!  A Celiac's dream come true.

column9: IT is okay but I like the chocolate chip better
column10: This is coming from a chocolate lover.  I ordered the "extreme chocolate" cookies thinking I was up for a challenge.  Well, they are good but not great.  I can't believe I'm saying this but the chocolate is actually overwhelming.  I'm saving the rest of the bags to make a chocolate crust for my cheesecake but I won't order this type again.  I do agree that it almost tastes like the top part of an oreo but with more intense taste.  My husband hated them and my 3 year old wasn't fond of it.  On the other hand, I have been ordering the chocolate chip flavored ones.  They are awesome!  It has a perfect balance and a hint of vanilla.  My family loves it and even my co-workers too!

A bit too sweet for me (I prefer Mother's mini chocolate chip cookies), but they're my girlfriend's favorite. And since I just proposed a month ago & she said 'yes', I gotta learn to compromise, right? --I bought both brands

I've been struggling with food intolerance lately, and by far the worst offender is sugar. Be that as it may, for some reason I don't have a problem with these cookies although they do contain sugar in the form of evaporated cane. They taste wonderful with just the right amount of spice and taste great dipped in coffee or milk if you can have that. I'd never know I was eating wheat-free gluten-free, or as my husband calls it, a "cookie-free cookie," had I not read the package first. I like ginger snaps to begin with, and these taste great. They are a bit larger than a quarter, are crisp rather than soft, and have 130 calories per 4-cookie serving. No trans fats; 10g sugar.

My 5-year-old son has multiple food allergies.  He LOVES these cookies!  It is great for him to be able to take snacks to school that he can enjoy!  I have eaten them, too.  And they are actually good!  I was feeling a little nauseous, and it only took a few to settle the feeling. I am glad we have found these great treats!
These cookies are DELICIOUS!  I get them for my son who cannot have gluten or casein or soy and he really likes them.  Actually, everyone in our house likes them!

column9: These are awesome for being GF!
column10: My kids and I love these, they are the perfect size.  I love just about everything Pamela's makes.  I send these to school with my kids for snacks when other kids bring their birthday treats that aren't GF.

Very good!!! Spendy but worth it, Not soft Not too hard just right!!! I think these would make a GREAT crust for cheescake or some other type of topping like the other person mentioned!!! I will recommend them and will buy them again. THE only issue I had BUT this seams to be not only these might be an ingredient I am just not used to yet seems to give me heartburn bad after eating them, might just be me though and not the product.
I have only had one other ginger cookie that was better than this and I cant find them and dont know the name so I guess  that means this may be my best pick.

column9: great for kids of all ages
column10: My kids love these cookies, even the one without gluten issues.  They are small enough that I can give three cookies to my 2 year old without feeling guilty, and he thinks he scored!  They are not overly sweet like some GF cookies are, which makes them a great snack for me as well.

column9: Really good and hard to find
column10: These cookies are very good, as are all of the simple bite cookies by Pamela

I have recently been put on a gluten free diet and have been nosing around at my local health food store for cookies that I could eat which did not contain wheat/gluten nor nuts/seeds.  I happened upon this bag of ginger snaps and was leary - I have not had much success in finding comparable substitutes for the real thing.These cookies blew me away!  They are crunchy, spicy, sweet and all around as close to "the real thing" as I have encountered in a long while!  I would recommend that you try just one bag first from your local health food store to see if it will work for you before committing to a case - but I LOVE them!

these cookies- and all of the Pamelas simplebites products - are truly amazing. I have been searching FOREVER for even a decent tasting gluten-free cookie and these are incredible!!!!!!!!! Possibly even better than regular cookies! You will not be let down. And do not be fooled by the regular sized pamelas cookies, I didn't like those so much but love these.
I had no problems with them being broken as others have mentioned. They taste great.  I have yet to dislike a product from Pamela's.

I recently began a gluten-free diet and have tried about 10 different types of cookies and bars, i even attempted to make some from scratch which ended in the garbage leaving me very frustrated. I couldn't handle the texture and taste of the rice flour or the mixes i purchased. I was about to give up on finding a good wheat cookie substitute and decided to try these, even though the packaging did not make them look appetizing at all.  To my surprise these cookies tasted like the real thing.  I am very happy and will continue purchasing these from now on whenever i feel like i need a treat and will not feel sorry for myself any more. Thanks Pamela!!

THESE GINGERSNAPS ARE TRULY GINGERSNAPS.  I LIKE THE CRISPY, HARD TEXTURE, THEY HOLD UP IN DUNKING IN HOT LIQUID.  I ALSO LOVE THE CHOCOLATE CHIP BITES TOO!  THIS ALSO SATIFIES MY COOKIE CRAVING.  SINCE THERE IS NO GLUTEN IN THE FLOURS I USE TO MAKE COOKIES, THEY FALL APART, TOO TENDER!  BUT THESE ARE JUST RIGHT FOR ME.  THIS CUTS DOWN ON THE NEED TO TAKE SO MUCH TIME TO MAKE MY OWN COOKIES.  SO, WHAT CAN I SAY, THANK YOU FOR THESE GLUTEN FREE COOKIES.

Pamela's Chocolate Chip Mini Cookies are wonderful to keep on hand. I am working a lot of over time and don't have time to bake. I take 2 or 3 of these in my lunch and/or dinner. I get my "chocolate" and "sugar fix" with no work and no fuss. When I have time, I love to bake my own cookies, but Pamela's fits the bill for me at this time.
love them with coffee!  Also good when crumbled in several desserts I make.  very tasty!

If you like a fairly strong ginger cookies, these are great.  They snap, they are spicy.  They are a tad sweet, and I find that of Pamela's  Simplebites line, judging on mouth feel alone, these are the most obviously gluten-free.  They aren't silty like some gluten-free products, but they do leave behind a slightly chalky residue.
