The texture is so "meat-like" you will question yourself and re-read the ingredients to be sure is isn't made from animal flesh. I bought a case of the Texas BBQ and a case of the Hickory Smoked.  They are both fantastic, and the Texas BBQ has a nice spicy kick! I think you'll really enjoy this product. I do. Primal Spirit Vegan Meat Alternative Jerky, Texas Barbecue Flavor, 1-Ounce Pouch  (Pack of 24)

column9: Tasty but with a big drawback
column10: Having tried just about every other vegan jerky item on the market I was excited to find one that is completely gluten-based, offering a very reasonable protein-to-calories ratio (~10%), a reasonable price-per-ounce, plus great reviews to boot.  Got the product and discovered to my great chagrin that it requires refrigeration after opening!!  Not only does that fly in the face of what jerky is supposed to be, it is not disclosed anywhere in the Amazon product description.  Ouch!  So much for taking these 4oz packages on the trail, or anywhere else for that matter.Also, be aware that the product -- unlike several competitive vegan jerky products -- is made in Taiwan which could mean it uses Chinese gluten.  That's a source I personally try to avoid because of significant food safety issues in the past.  However, I contacted the manufacturer and was told that their gluten is "imported from either Australia, Western Europe or the USA......most all our ingredients are from these sources.  We manufacture in Taiwan because they have ways of cooking with soy and wheat gluten that are not found in the west."All that said, taste is pretty good and the "wet" packaging gives it a softer texture than competitive products (which I personally still prefer).

I ate beef jerky every single day at my school cafeteria when I was growing up. I loved the stuff. And then I became a vegetarian and, alas, I thought my beef jerky days were done for. Until I discovered this. It is very convincing - the texture isn't gross or suspect like many fake meat products. It isn't too tough, is a bit moist, and has a nice flavor. It is much softer than Tofuky Jerky beef jerky replacement, so the texture is easier to deal with, but this flavor is more sweet than the spicy Tofuky Jerky version. I'm excited to taste other flavors to see if there is something a bit on the spicy barbecue side rather than sweet barbecue side, but in general, I really like this and it might convince even the most skeptical meat eater. My dad even liked it, which is saying a lot - he is an old school eater who was very skeptical of anything vegetarian.

Vegan or not, teriyaki primal strips are utterly delicious.  I cannot get enough of them.  The flavor is unimaginable.  The texture is incredible.  Everyone I have given samples to has been amazed.  They are expensive, as far as that goes.  But you cannot go wrong on flavor and texture.  These are so darn great that I have't tried any of the other flavors or textures so far.

column9: Even a snack a meat eater would like
column10: I am not by any means a vegetarian (I eat my steaks rare), but I do try to eat healthy.  Beef jerky is a great snack if you are on the go (I travel a lot), but the constant intake of red meat is not good for you.  So, I tried the Primal Strip vegan strips.  I have had every one that they make.....and they are all good.  The Thai Satian Peanut is by far my favorite (the hot and spicy shiitake mushroom jerky is my second favorite).  I have recommended this snack to even the most devout meat eaters and they even like it.  I give it 5 stars - but just like everything - they are not for everyone.  I recommend buying them individually first, and if you love it then come back to amazon and get a box (amazon is the cheapest for the boxes).

This Hickory Smoked flavor is my favorite of the Primal Strips lot. The strips are moist, tender, unusually flavorful, and just the right size. Even my carnivorous relatives in Wisconsin took to these Strips. My only outstanding concern is that Primal Strips are manufactured in Taiwan, which  means their production is outside the domain of US food safety and inspection. However, having consumed over two dozen of these strips in the past month, I remain happy and healthy.

This is a great tasting product.  The texture is just tough enough.  Great to have on hand for a quick pick-me-up.  It's a bit peppery so it does have a little kick to it if you hit a peppercorn.Highly reccommended.  I love it.  Just bought myself a pack of 24.

I was looking for an alternative meat source for a backpacking trip my husband and I are taking soon and discovered this great tasting vegan meat jerky. It tastes great, but is a bit to salty for my tastebuds

column9: I'm torn...but I'm still eating them.
column10: I'm torn. I love these strips. They feel like the real thing and they taste great (even my dog loves it...he doesn't care if it's veggie), but they're so moist. They're marinating inside the package, and I understand that it probably needs to stay that way to keep the flavor, but it just doesn't feel like real beef jerky because it isn't dry. I've had thoughts about buying a dehydrator and laying these things inside for a few minutes. I've laid them out on napkins to dry them out, and that worked fine, but...bits of napkin get left behind and they aren't as tasty.I'm giving these 3 stars because they're good, and I do like them, but I really feel like they're just too moist to be considered jerky.

column9: I wanted so much to like it!
column10: First, I expected this to be like dry jerky.  This was wet and soggy with a spongy texture.  There is something so off putting about the flavor, it's like wet dog food.  The first bite seemed okay, but I could not finish it even though it was small.  Regretfully, I decided to buy this anyway based on the reviews... I read all the one star reviews and thought "Heyyyy now, it can't be that bad! These people must be clueless. they must be expecting it to taste like real jerky, of course it's not!"  I was soooo wrong.

Wonderful! I have a busy job that keeps me occupied with little time to take meal breaks. I take a couple pieces of this and some fruit and veggies, and I get to have healthful snacks instead of relying on fast food or candy bars. Helped me lose 20 (and counting) pounds!

I cannot give high enough praise for these incredibly delicious and protein packed little snacks. Even my very food fussy 5 year old likes them. They are the perfect light lunch or snack to throw in your purse for a busy afternoon. The flavour is delicious, sweet and smokey. At under 100 calories and packed with 10 grams of protein, you can't go wrong. I HIGHLY recommend these snacks, they are worth every penny.

The flavor is robust and tangy, and the texture is very pleasing and moderately chewy - not enough to hurt your teeth, just enough to satisfy! Also, they're not salty-tasting at all. The "jerky" flavoring is moist enough to make a little mess on your fingertips, but you can suck it right off. :)I have bought these in single-serving sizes in our local grocery store as well. I buy them every week and carry them with me for emergency sustenance.

i've searched high and low for a delicious, healthy, meatless jerky product.  i'm a pescatarian, so tuna/salmon/halibut jerky is great, but super expensive and often incredibly high in sodium.  i found these in the aisles of pcc and absolutely fell in love.  first thing i did was search amazon for them, and here they were!  the price is better, and i knew i would eat these every day.  i take two to work and have at least one at home.  i would recommend these to anyone, carnivore or vegan, looking for a delicious, healthy source of protein.  wow!

I have searched for a good vegetarian jerky for several years.  There have been some hits but more misses.  This is one of the best; a great BBQ flavor and a consistency similar to real jerky.  Definitely worth trying.

I absolutely love this stuff -- the mesquite lime flavor is sweet, spicy and tangy, and the consistency of the jerky is chewy yet moist. At 74 calories and 10 grams of cholesterol-free meatless protein, you can't beat it as a snack.

column9: Great snack and 10g of protein in 74 calories!
column10: This is my favorite flavor from Primal Strips.  I like the others but ordered this one last since it sounded weird, but it's great.  The lime flavor is strong and their texture is very good (moist and chewy).  Lowest calories (same as Thai Peanut) from their line.  An excellent no-guilt snack!
Excellant! Texture is close to real jerky! The spices are just right! I've told several of my vegetarian friends and they are ordering some as well!

Disgusting, slimy, stinky!  I love jerky but have a weak jaw and have trouble chewing it. A diet website recommended this meatless jerky, so I ordered it to try it.  Absolutely horrible!  I recently gave the entire order (except for a small bite I tasted) to a friend to be donated to feed the homeless.  I hope someone may like it.  It comes from the package wet and slimy and has a clove-like odor.  That's about all I can remember about it.

Just be forewarned it is a bit "moist."  Have plenty of papertowels/napkins around when eating it.However for vegan jerky, this has by far the best texture. You will be picking it out of your teeth for hours! And for me, that is a good thing!My fav is the BBQ flavor, however their other flavors are very tasty as well :-)

column9: Try every flavor in singles before buying in bulk.
column10: I've tried almost all the flavors, and my favorites are Teriyaki and Thai Peanut (both are sweet and savory).  For about 100 calories and 10 grams of protein, this makes a great snack.  I hadn't eaten these in a couple of years, but when I got pregnant I started craving the Teriyaki again so I was thrilled to find them on Amazon in bulk.

I'm an avowed omnivore.  I love me some jerky, too.  Meat in all forms, really.  An exchange with an old girlfriend summed it up quite well... "You know, you don't have to eat meat every day," she said. My response was stunned silence.  The point?  These are darned tasty to a meat-lover like myself.  Not just these, but the entire line (that I've tried so far).No, you're not likely to be fooled into thinking it once had parents.  The texture of seitan is not all that meat-like, despite what the vegans say (what do THEY know about it, anyway?!).  However, it does have a satisfying chew, and unlike real jerky, you could actually eat a couple Primal Strips products and still have some jaw muscle left.  Also unlike real jerky, these are moist.  Because it's not dehydrated flesh, they're able to have moisture in the flavoring.  And they do a pretty good job on the flavoring, too!Bottom line: it ain't meat, but it's amazing for a plant!

The teriyaki seitan strips have great smoky/sweet barbecue taste and a nice stringy, "pulled" texture. They're full of protein and 100 calories each (I wish it were even a little less), which makes for a great snack. They dont't taste like beef jerky, but it's not supposed to. They're isolated soy-free (there's a little soy from the soy sauce in it), as the base is vital wheat gluten. I carry one in my purse all the time just in case I get hungry.

I didn't read the ingredients carefully enough to see that these are gluten-free. Wheat gluten adds a jerky-like texture to vegetarian jerky, which is missing here.The strips are wet -- not moist -- but wet. Additionally, the Hickory Smoked Soy flavor was waaaaay too sweet and reviewers have said that about other flavors as well.I'll finish the box I purchased, but I probably won't buy more.

This is just simply delicious! I have so far tried the Texas BBQ and the Mesquite Lime and I can't describe how tasty it is! I've never had real beef jerky before so the only way I could see someone giving this a bad review, is if it doesn't taste how someone would expect but whatever it taste like believe me, it's delicious! The jerky is not dry, because they seal in the perfect amount of sauce so its not wet, but moist!The particular packages I tried however looked different than the picture amazon has here so I'm not sure if Primal Spirit has changed their marketing recently and these are old pictures, or if when you order it, it will actually look like the picture shown. If you go to their website, the pictures on the website are exactly what I purchased from Whole Foods. I'd love to buy them online for the convenience but, I'd like to be sure they are the same packaging and not an older versionAnyway, great product! Hope to try all the flavors soon!

I was looking for protein sources when I went vegan.  these are yummy and great for camping, snacks at work and a great quick bit when you are starving! so much healthier than regular jerky, even if you are not vegan or vegetarian!

column9: Great snack for on the go moms!
column10: I loved this!  I am a vegetarian and a mom that loves to have something in her purse for weak moments!  This totally fits the bill.  I looked on the Primal Spirit website before ordering to see the differences in nutritional content between all of the flavors and I was surprised that there was quite a difference.  I ended up choosing the Texas Barbecue because it equaled 2 Weight Watchers points and was the lowest in calories.  They are definitely pricey but in my mind totally worth it.  A lot come in a box and they are a great snack to carry with you!

Have tried most of the flavors and can't say anything bad about any I've tasted. The Teriyaki and Hickory Smoked are my personal favorites. For 99 calories you get 11 Gms. of protein and great taste. Add an apple and/or salad and you've got a full, small meal. Price is good, too.

I bought my first Primal Strips seitan jerky at the gym after a workout one day and since then I've been hooked. The mesquite lime is my favorite flavor. Super yummy and only 74 calories. It's a great non-soy protein-filled meatless snack. Plus it's totally portable so you can keep one in your desk drawer or your handbag for when you're stuck for a snack.

column9: Very good, but a little bland
column10: I like most varieties of Primal Strips. They are a fantastic snack for active vegetarians (11g protein, 3g unsaturated fat, 7g carbs.). The Teriyaki variety is a little bland in comparison to some of the other flavors. This may be exactly what some people are looking for. I prefer a little more kick.

I've eaten these for a long time, and they are totally awesome, though not always easy to get hold of (they run out).  Great protein source for a busy vegan like me, plus I am a fitness trainer and workout a lot, so I need the convenient protein. Personally I think mesquite lime is the best, flavor wise, of all the Primal Strips, but they are all good.  My hubby loves the barbecue ones.

This product is a must have because it is a way for vegetarians to be able to have protein while on the go, and also for anyone whose physician has recommended additional protein intake, especially throughout the day.  The convenience is great and the flavor of this product is super.  I really enjoy it.

I love Primal Spirit Jerky.  I've tried several different flavors and some appealed more than others but, as a previous reviewer noted, that was more personal taste than because of any deficiency in product.  This is a very tasty snack that you can really sink your teeth into.  My sister used to buy me these at the end of a long day teaching middle schoolers and even on those days when I had skipped lunch (and breakfast) these snacks were very satisfying and so delicious that I was always happy to eat them.  Some of them are made from soy and some are made from seitan which is somewhat more chewy and stringy a food.  My preference is for seitan but surprisingly the soy was also very chewy and certainly very good.  I'm really glad the hikers who founded Primal Spirit went ahead with developing this product and I agree with them wholeheartedly that the meat-alternative foods outside the United States are generally much better and more varied and their product has benefited from that history of good vegetarian food in Asia.  Definitely going to order some of these now...Yum!
This is very delicious jerky.I eat this jerky often as a snack and I take it on hikes too.  Great tasting, low-fat and packed with protein.

I was happy to see that I could purchase this on Amazon. Previously had to go to our local health food store. Price is about the same, more convenient to come to the house. High protein, low fat, tasty and give a energy boost on intense bike rides or anytime snack when you don't want a carb rush! :)

I too think these strips are a bit too sweet - but this one has 10 grams of protein. Now the that prices have gone up, it's close to what I would pay in the one store in my town that sells them. It also took weeks to get them with the free shipping.  So hmm...

column9: No Reason to Kill Innocent Animals for Jerky!
column10: Primal Strips are delicious as well as cruelty free.  No sentient life was taken to produce them, and they're ultra low in fat and calories as well as high in protein.  Save an animal and help your own health at the same time.

column9: Really terrible! Try another flavor. Don't waste your money!
column10: I am a big fan of Primal Strips. In fact, I loved the first flavor so much (Texas BBQ) I decided to buy others and really enjoyed it all with the exception of Mesquite Lime. Luckily, this was the last flavor I purchased and I was displeasantly surprised. I had a rough time even swallowing my first bite! Yes, it was that bad. The "lime" in this was horridly instense, very vinegar like. It is really all you can taste. So... if you like biting into a meaty-textured product with an overbearing flavor of vinegar, you may probably enjoy this flavor. Otherwise, if you are like me, stick to the other enjoyable, tasty flavors this wonderful vegan product has to offer.

column9: Love, but is the plastic BPA-free?
column10: I love this product as a way to get protein into vegans.  But...is the plastic that holds the product BPA free?  I called the manufacturer, and he said that he thought that it was.  I asked him for verification of this fact, because I give it to my kids.  He also mentioned that it is put in the plastic while hot, which is of concern to me, because bpa leaches into food when it is hot.  Love love love this product with this one caveat.  Please verify, Primal Spirit!

column9: Hard to open and messy, but good..........
column10: This is the only veggie jerquee my local grocery store carries and is a good substitute for when I don't feel like ordering my favorite(stonewalls) online.I like the flavor and the texture but I always need scissors to open the package and I hate the thought of my germy scissors touching my food.Once you finally open it, it's hard to really get a good bite because it is very stringy and full of sauce, you usually end up with half the product in one bite just so you don't get sauce all over your hands and mouth.I often get it stuck in my teeth too, which is annoying when I'm at work without dental floss.I think they are redesigning the package so hopefully it will be easier to eat soon. They could work on the price too, $1.29 at the store for 2 bites is a bit ridiculous!

column9: Good flavor, but a wet mess
column10: I got the teriyaki flavor and, while the flavor is good and the texture is also good once you get it into your mouth, it can be a mess getting it there.  As other reviewers have noted, this is not like your typical dry jerky.  It seems more like something that would be created by the company that makes SlimJims or something - it's moist and chewy.  The individual packets don't tear easily, either, despite being notched at the end.  You know how sometimes plastic can tear very cleanly, but sometimes it turns into a ragged edge and becomes a struggle?  That's what happens with these 8 times out of 10.  So if you're out and about (not near a sink) and you try to open it and the tear doesn't work perfectly, you potentially have liquid dripping out onto you, certainly on your fingers as you're trying to get the jerky out of the package and into your mouth.  And the liquid dries sticky.Anyway, as I said, the flavor is good and I've now eaten most of mine, but I have taken to opening the package with scissors and eating them only at home so I can wash my hands afterward.

column9: Very tasty and healthy jerky snack!
column10: Hi! I could eat a box of this vegan jerky at one sitting. Delicious! The hickory smoke flavor is mildly hot without burning. There's to be a hint of maple syrup or similar tasting spice in the flavor. Texture seems right. Chewy but soft enough. The strips came in an outer paper box. Easy enough to open. The individual wrappings are easy to open with scissors. Tougher to open by hand. Individual wrapping has a cut at top for peeling open. I had no luck that way. For taking these on a hike it's a good idea to bring scissors. I recommend this jerky for a great snacking experience. I hope to buy other flavors in future orders.
Messy but it does taste like jerky! Definitely worth trying if you need some vegan convenience foods. The texture and the taste were almost too meat-like.

My son really wanted these as he loves the other flavors. But They are DISGUSTING!!! Too much lime :(  So bummed I bought a case and can't return the unopened 23 we didn't touch and do not plan on touching.

column9: Texas Barbecue is the only good one IMHO
column10: My wife and I really didn't like any of these flavors, with the exception of the Texas BBQ.  It is a sweet barbecue, which I normally don't like.  Our kids selected the Texas BBQ as a trail snack for camping combined with some round crackers and ooh baby did it hit the spot.  That said, I think all the spicy Stonewall's jerky varieties and peppered Tofurky Jerky are a superior jerky.
...and good for you. I like having a snack that's more protein than carb and at or under 100 calories (depending on the flavor). These strips are amazing!

column9: a little getting used to but good
column10: I am a long time veg occasional vegan.  I have been looking for a vegan jerky product for a while.  I forgot that I ordered the seitan not soy jerky.  Service was excellent - my order arrived within three days of ordering - and I live in AZ! I was a bit taken aback by the texture -  but after trying one I really liked it.  good taste very digestible and satisfying.Flavor is not as strong as you might expect for teryiaki but it is pleasing.  I will definitely try other flavors.
THIS one is great, good BBQ flavor, moist, chewy is a GOOD way!  A definite renewal purchase in the future!
Love this.  Even shared it with meat eaters who liked it. A little messy but still great on the go for a tasty protein snack.

column9: The Best I've Found So Far
column10: Okay, these are pretty darn tasty.  I have tried several different brands of veggie jerky, and so far, these are my faves.  I've tried several different flavors (Texas Barbecue ranks at the top of my list), and they're all pretty good.They are pretty moist, almost to the point of being a little saucy.  They can be just a bit messy to eat, but the benefit is that they are GREAT to eat on a sandwich!  Terrific by themselves and amazing on bread... makes me smile.The packaging can get a little frustrating.  They are serrated at the top, so in theory, you should be able to tear the edge and open the entire package along the side of the strip.  Unfortunately, it doesn't exactly work that well.  A lot of times it will rip off and make it difficult to get the strip out of the package.  I just use scissors now.  Just a minor complaint.But seriously, these things are delicious.  Even my carnivorous friends like them (and it's usually impossible to get them to touch a substitute).  Definitely recommend!

SO GOOD.Just in case anyone was wondering. I know every vegan/vegetarian says this, but even my carnivorous brother liked it. He's the crazy outdoors type though- savage all the way, carving things out of wood, building shelters in the woods, survival stuff. So I trust his meat-comparison ratings. Most veggie people, when it comes to fake meat, tend to say "it's all about the sauce". While this is true, this also has the texture. It's more of the soft slim-jim texture I remember (though we can argue- is that really meat? hah)- moist and moderately chewy. I'm curious if sticking these in a dehydrator will make them more jerky like. Anyway I like the mesquite lime. It's not too sweet, tangy and just delicious. I recommend!
We were pleasantly surprised at how good these tasted.  The %DV for sodium is 15, so while not excessive, we limit ourselves to "one at a time."

Not a good flavor overall. I have only tried the TERIYAKI flavored strips, and hate them. The texture and the sweetness is just gross together. I'm going to try a different flavor before writing this off, but yuck. I'm a vegan by the way, and I've had some amazingly delicious fake-feet products: this is not one of them.
Absolutely delicious! The 4-ounce size is great, although there is kind of a lot of packaging. I like to enjoy some with a nice cold beer.

Hickory Smoked Primal Jerky is awesome! Jerky is one of the few things I have really missed since becoming a vegetarian, this stuff is a fantastic replacement though. The flavor is great, not exactly the same as meat but still sweet and tangy like hickory smoked jerky should be. The texture is also excellent; not quite as tough as the real thing but close. Its fairly healthy too so I keep a few in my backpack as a quick awesome snack.

Before I was vegetarian, there were few meat products that I even liked. Jerky was one of them, and I have had no luck finding a replacement.This is NOTHING like real jerky. It is very chewy in a SOFT way, and the flavoring was overpowering to the point that I ended up with a stomachache.It is OK. I wouldn't buy it again, but it's not disgustingly bad or anything. Just know if you're looking for an alternative to jerky that this fails both the taste and texture test.

The package arrived promptly and all contents in excellent condition. The product is very tasty, though it is a slight bit too peppery for my taste. I have tried all their varieties, and I like this one and Texas BBQ best. The mesquite is also good, and much milder. They have the texture just right--you wouldn't know it wasn't meat if it were a blind taste test. It is a little wet as a jerky, which makes it a tad messy. Each packet contains a whopping 10 grams of protein! A lot of nutrition in a small, lightweight packet. Ideal for camping, keeping in the car glovebox,in a briefcase or bag, etc. for those times when you need a boost. But for the pepper, I would have given 5 stars, so I rate this 4 stars. Enjoy!

My husband, who is definitely not a vegan, loves these.  They make a great snack for him when he is on the way home from work and stuck in traffic. I would recommend these to anyone who likes jerky, it's a simple change to something just a shade healthier than normal beef jerky.

column9: Mesquite Lime flavor is the bomb diggity
column10: As an omnivore, I loved beef jerky. My family would eat it all the time. As a vegan, I don't really feel the need to mimic the experience of eating beef jerky so I'm not really inclined to try out the various soy jerkys and what have you that are available. However, the mesquite lime (green packaging) is so good that it makes me say phrases that I never say (bomb diggity) and praise its deliciousness here so that all may come to know the little bit of tongue heaven that it is. Strong, bold flavor and perfect chewy texture. The only down side is that once you're done, you want more. Hence, get the pack of 24. The mesquite lime flavor is so good that I dare not try the other flavors any time soon and taint my Primal Strip food-gasmic journey.

Bought one stick of this at a health food store and loved it!  I often crave a jerky like food.  This completely satisfied my craving.  The health food store was selling them for 2bucks each so it was a no brainer to just order a box.  I got the hickory smoked.I have also tried the Teriyaki flavor, but didn't like it much.

I haven't tried the other flavors because they don't sound as appealing as Thai Peanut, which my whole family loves.  I don't know if "jerky" is quite the word, as it obviously throws off some people who only call the hard, dry stuff jerky. But this is a yummy, flavorful snack with a nice, chewy texture and just a touch of that tough-to-bite-off feel.  A great toss-in-the-bag snack for when we go out that satisfies the craving for something savory.
This is the best brand for vegan jerky. I love all flavors of Primal Strips, and Thai Peanut and Lime are my favorite. I'll definitely buy it again.

I ordered a box of the Mesquite Lime after finding the Texas BBQ at my local organic grocery store. I love both flavors but am glad I got a bulk of the lime. It's delicious! I love that its only 75 calories and yet so high in protein. It's hard for me (as a vegetarian) to get enough protein while still keeping my carbs low. The standard protein bar usually has way too much sugar for my liking. These are a great afternoon snack and perfect after an intense workout.

I'm not a vegetarian, but I have trouble finding decent jerky and decided to try the Texas BBQ flavor. I did like the fact that it has a meaty texture, but not a hard leather texture that I tend to avoid in jerky. It was hard enough so that I had to floss my teeth to avoid irritation to my gums, but that's true with all meat. Besides texture, it also tasted like meat. However, it also tasted like someone was trying to make a BBQ flavored candy bar. Way too sweet, and just an overall bad taste. My dog goes nuts for them though, so they're not completely wasted.

I am vegan and just came across this product not too long ago. It is the BEST snack. I've tried different flavors and I tend to like the Texas BBQ ones the best. The texture is just like meat and its healthier for you.

And it's a good surprise!  I was cautious, expecting either something with no resemblance to meat, or something so rubbery as to be inedible.  Sure, the texture is not EXACTLY like real jerky, it's a bit liquidy for that.  But for a vegan product, outstanding!  It's chewy without being rubbery, far juicier than real jerky(which is a good thing), and tastes spot on.  Granted, the Texas BBQ doesn't taste the way I'd thought it would(I was expecting a tomato-y BBQ sauce flavor), but it's very good, with just the right amount of smoke.  I can't wait to try more flavors!

I've been a vegetarian for 10 years (all of my 20s) and absolutely love it!  Lately I've been really looking for good healthy protein sources that I actually like to eat, and these Primal Strips are excellent!  These things scare me because they are so realistically meat-like.I've tried 3 flavors of them so far, and there was only 1 that I thought wasn't great.  It was completely edible, but the texture was just not as good as the others.  I think it was the Teriyaki that I didn't like so much, but I really liked the Texas Barbecue and the Hickory Smoked flavors.These are excellent low-calorie, low-fat, convenient, tasty snacks with high amounts of protein.  You can take them anywhere, keep them in your desk at work or in your purse!The only complaint I have about these is that I wish there were versions with lower sodium.  To me, as someone who loves a good salty snack, but knows that too much salt is not good and tries to avoid it, these taste too salty.  And 300+ mg of sodium per strip seems high.But in the end I am overlooking the sodium and am purchasing these in bulk now!  I just bought the Thai Peanut flavor because I love spicy foods, and I love Thai food!  I'll update this review with my thoughts on this flavor after I receive them.UPDATE: I received the Thai Peanut flavor and LOVE them!  They have a great chewy texture, good flavor, and a good amount of spice.  All for only 74 calories each, but 10g protein!  I definitely recommend these!
All the flavors are great! I wish they were bigger portions and a bit cheaper tho.But a great alt to real jerky!

I just wanted to say that I picked up my first single serving of Primal Spirit Texas BBQ Meatless Vegan Jerky today at my local Home Economist while searching for Gluten Free products (I'm new at this so its an adventure everytime I go into the store!).Now, I am going to say that I am 100% Carnivore!! And I am a absoulte jerky fanatic as I've had it made out of Beef, Deer, Rabbit, Fish, Bison, Buffalo, and even Turkey Jerky!But I can honestly say, this was fantastic! It had a nice stringy texture, like actual meat. Was flavored nicely, a little mosit, and it left me wanting more!I'm glad I bought only one as I think I could have eaten several :)Also, love the fact its only 81 Calories, with 1g of Fat but still has 10g's of Protein!!

I have bought two boxes of these now and love them.  My first box came from a local health food store and the second came from Amazon.  Yum Yum.  As a Vegan I never heard of these, but I have seen them on the shelf at my local health food store.  So one day I bought two packs.  I loved them.  Went back and bought the rest of the box.  That store could not get them in fast enough so I bought from Amazon.  I really like them.  The lime flavor is the one that I have tried.  I will try the other flavors soon.
I absolutely love these! We have very few vegetarian products in this small town so it was great to find these. Now if only they were not so expensive!

My husband loves these.  They are pretty good.  They are moist so they are not like "real" jerky in that sense but otherwise the texture is very similar.  I wish they had a variety that wasn't so sweet but I definitely recommend trying some before getting an entire package - luckily I got to try each of them, which are all good.
This brand is the best of all the faux jerkies. Even meat eaters enjoy it. This is my second favorite flavor. Hickory Smoked is my favorite flavor.

This jerky really is delicious! I am a vegetarian, I am always getting picked on for eating my "rabbit food," but everyone I have got to taste this couldn't believe it wasn't meat, and they loved it too.

I ordered the hickory smoked soy jerky, and was very impressed. It had some type of sauce on it that surprised me (don't know if this is typical of all flavors), but was delicious. I have in the last few months purchased the Vegan Dreams variety pack...a drier, thinner and chewier product, but not necessarily less tasty. The sauciness on my Primal hickory smoked might lend itself to heating it up for different vegan meals, as it is more juicy. I look forward to trying the other varieties.I just tried the Texas Bar-b-que, and I really like this flavor as well. This version seems to be a bit less "saucy", but just as moist and delicious. It does have a "stringy" texture to it that makes dental floss a must! In the search for a good veggie jerky, I am leaning towards the Primal line.

column9: Bought by accident, bought again on purpose
column10: I bought this product by accident one morning at a local deli, and I was very surprised when I first ate it.  Granted, you can easily tell (and I was scared because I was expecting beef jerky when I first bit it) that it is not meat.  But, as an alternative, it is very tasty, and I did end up buying it again.

I like most varieties of Primal Strips. They are a fantastic snack for active vegetarians (10g protein, 3g fat, 8g carbs.). The Hickory Smoked variety is very flavorful with a little bit of a spicy kick. The texture is somewhat firm, which I enjoy, but it often gets stuck between my teeth so I always need to have some dental floss handy. I would say that of all the varieties of Primal Strips, this is currently my favorite.

I like most varieties of Primal Strips. They are a fantastic snack for active vegetarians (10g protein, 2g fat, 8g carbs.). The Thai Peanut variety is very tasty with a little bit of a kick. The texture is firm, which I enjoy, but it typically gets stuck between my teeth so I always need to have some dental floss handy.

column9: Primal Spirit Vegan Jerky Texas BBQ
column10: Have tasted these in CA and wanted them here in MA!  So I chose to look on good ole Amazon and here they are!  Tasty, not too hot, low fat, a bit high in sodium, but satisfying when I am out and about and needing a snack!

First had these delicious Vegan treats when I was visiting my sister in CA and couldn't find them in MA!  Now I can always find them on Amazon!  They are tasty low fat, hight protein, a bit high in sodium, portable and easy to take with me where ever I go!

I've tried all flavors of Primal Spirit Vegan Jerky and the Mesquite Lime is my personal favorite, but it depends on your taste. If you're a fan of limes as I am, you'll love this flavor. Its a bit tart. It is also a very tender texture as compared with the others. The Hot and Spicy flavor is my second favorite. It has the toughest texture which is closest to regular jerky and is the only one made from mostly mushrooms. It is a bit spicy if you never eat spicy foods!
As a vegetarian this item fulfilled my need for protein and also for something that resembles meat.  It's a great snack.

WOW! This product is simply delicious. Nice texture, almost like shredded beef(better than beef jerky in my opinion) and the spices for this flavor is just right! A combination of smokey, salty and sweet. The only problem I have with it is trying to stop eating it! I know it is packed with protein, low in fat and only 81 calories, but the carb content (11 grams per serving)seems pretty high for just one strip. Just have to watch my consumption :oD Although, I have replaced a meal with two primal strips and lost about 5 pounds this week. All in all, this is an exceptional meat alternative snack.

This is a pretty good snack food.  I don't miss meat, but i do miss the seasonings put on it.  This is very tasty and has a nice texture.  A packet is 4 servings, and 100 calories per serving, pretty much equal protein and carbs, so it's a high protein food for most people.Problems: the inner packaging isn't that easy to deal with, a knife is needed to cut it open.  So not a great on-the-go food.  Also, there is not a lot of volume for the 400 calories, so it's not a good food if you are watching your weight.

This is a great product, and the mushroom one, the Seitan ones and the Soy ones do, as mentioned, have their individual flavors and textures.  Each is a great treat during a long day at the office when I want something healthy and reasonably low-calorie (these come in at about 75 calories for an ounce.)  I've tried and enjoyed all varieties.  Highly recommended.
So delicious! This was a very cute gift. There is a lot of chocolate in the bag, definitely more than it seems from the picture. I bought a few of these as stocking stuffers/small santa gifts.
This extract really works well. I used two tablespoons to make a half gallon of excellent eggnog flavored yoghurt. Most extracts (e.g., vanilla) do not work well for this application.

column9: is this really supposed to be eggnog?
column10: I ordered this because of strongly positive reviews, but I think it must have been a long time since those reviewers drank real eggnog!  Also a problem that it doesn't come with measurement recommendations.
I find it deceptive as well as confusing when you seem to offer free shipping and then I am charged for it. This is how you lose any future orders.Ed Woodard

My sister sent me one package of this Martha White "Sweet Yellow Cornbread and Muffin Mix". I did not cook it for several months but finally got around to it. I found the mix to be easy to prepare and the results were very good. I was concerned that the results might be too smooth (for the lack of a better description). Actually, the results are porous. This is good since it allows for the mix to absorb butter or syrup, etc easily. I cooked the single package (7 ounce) in a 5x9 inch pan. This worked out good and the end result was a loaf about 1-1/2 inches high. The bottom was beginning to brown and should not have been cooked longer. I ended up cooking the mix 20 minutes and the results were perfect. I did not eat all of the mix the first day. The next day I cut the cornbread into one inch squares. Then, I put butter on the squares and warmed them about 18 seconds in the microwave. I enjoyed them with cheese on the side and put a bit of syrup on the squares of cornbread. It was really a treat and tasted more like a desert than just a serving of cornbread. Also, I did not use regular sweet milk. I use undiluted Carnation Evaporated Milk. I wondered how this might work (since I did not dilute the milk) but found it to work very well. I recommend this product.Next time I'll cook two packages at one time and I plan to use a 9x9 inch pan to keep the end results being about 1-1/2 inches thick. This way the bottom will not get too brown (in my off-hand opinion since I have not tried this yet).
I cook pasta a lot and have pasta handy all the time is really convenient. These can be made to al dente in just 8 minutes. Love the texture.

column9: Excellent pasta. DeCecco is the best
column10: I enjoy Fettucine. I've tried most of the major brands, and some are pretty good as far as flavor and consistency, but DeCecco is the best, especially if you prefer your pasta 'al dente,' or slightly firm. Cooked this way the noodles really shine, with a even consistency and delicious flavor.You do need to make sure that you stir the pasta as it cooks as the noodles tend to stick together for the first 5 minutes or so in the boiling water. I find that adding a tablespoon of olive oil helps out immensely.These go really well with homemade Alfredo sauce, as well as simply garlic, olive oil, and your favorite vegetables tossed together.
I was at a local toys r us and bought 25 cents worth of bonez and out came the bonez but i found an orange skull with them!!! wow weird? i didn't eat it :P

First let me say my personal taste is for light roast coffee. Starbucks and other dark roast coffee just taste burn to me.I always buy a new instant when I see it hoping to find one that is palatable. I will drink Taster's Choice if there is nothing else to drink. Like all instant it has a funny solvent or chemical taste to me.Tchibo has actual hints of a nutty complex coffee taste and NO chemical taste. I did a blind taste test for my wife which is a game we often enjoy playing and she liked the Tchibo better too.Properly brewed fresh roast Kona is still better. But this is good for camping and the emergency pantry. Not just tolerable. I've also found that a small amount of water soluble fiber (the sort that mix to a clear liquid) added to the instant improves the flavor. I suspect some of the undesirable flavors bind to it in the hot cup.

I've used and loved this product for a long time.  It's a great pick-me-up for the afternoon!  But the shipping price--not so nice.  I've found another resource where I can buy multiple items from Germany, including the coffee, and the shipping rarely exceeds $20 for a large box of goodies because the company packs everything and then weighs.  It doesn't charge by the item.
I first tried this last year at starbucks. Now I am hooked. I really love this milk and I think its the best milk I ever had.

I can't really judge the quality of this paste versus others since it ends up in sauces, stews etc, but it seems ok . I bought it because it seemed to be the best value among the tube pastes and I was tired of opening a can for a tbs or 2, then watching the rest of the can go bad in the fridge. Glad I bought this and will buy again.

This product is extremely useful.  No more unused portions in the back of the refrigerater.  Keep a tube in the door and take it out when you need a a couple of teaspoons or tablespoons or just a squirt. No waste. Saves time and money.  Great to take for camping or the cabin.
I keep this on hand always.  Flavor is bright and fresh tomato, no tin can sharpness.  Packaging is super handy and allows for using only what is needed without wasting product.  Bellisimo.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column9: very best tomato paste, very little waste
column10: I always keep a few tubes of this Mutti Tomato paste in my pantry. The flavor is a very fresh tasting robust tomato taste; it helps thicken and adds wonderful flavor to my soups and sauces.The label has lots of useful information, including -* ingredients: Italian tomatoes, salt.* the recommendation refrigerate after opening and discard the unused portion after 20 days.* a serving size is 2T and a 4.5oz tube has approximately 7 servings.* processed using a dehydration method that results in 28% dry extract of the tomatoes* certified as using environmentally friendly cultivation methodsIf it could be stored longer than 20 days (like ketchup) I would give it a fifth star but I often either store it longer than the recommended date and worry about food safety or I wind up throwing out the unused portion which is not particularly cost effective.Still, a far superior taste than any canned paste I have tried so I'll continue to buy and enjoy it.

Lovely,concentrated and great tasting. Tried this one because Amazon has so many wonderful choices. Worth the try. Tomato paste in a tube couldn't be more convenient. Will buy Mutti again. The tubes are a generous size, are dated way ahead. Keep them in a cool dry place until use. Pop in the refrigerator once opened. I haven't bought tomato paste any other way for several years now. You only use what you need. You don't need much as this is brimming with rich tomato flavor. Great price too for six tubes.

column9: LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS TOMATO PASTE!
column10: This is undoubtedly the finest tomato paste I have ever used!  Great over fish and in potato salads andgreat with eggs and pasta.....used alone by itself without any fanfare!  Get yourself some magic in a tube.  Makes all other pastes fade away.
Excellent tomato paste.  Works with everything. Great flavor and color. Product stores for quite a while so don't be afraid to buy the six tubes.

This paste is very convenient to have on hand and the tubes take up minimal storage space. Now you can squeeze out just the amount you need and not have to toss the rest of the small cans most people buy. The paste itself has a bright fresh taste and nice thick texture. I sometimes rub it all over short ribs before I braise them, it adds a great depth of flavor to the meat and the finished sauce.

These are great for a quick lunch! Just use one soup with any bottleless hot water side of a bottleless cooler and you are set to go! Tasty, filling and a slight bit of spice kick to it! I believe in being healthy and all, but sometimes ya gotta go for a tasty soup! I average about 1-2 per week of these soups! Definitely cheaper on Amazon than in the stores here! Go for these soups! Quick, fast and easy! Tasty!

This is just absolutely fantastic tea!  The mint flavor is so pure and refreshing and there is not much sugar in the drink.  It's also completely USDA Organic, QAI Organic,Halal, and Kosher & Pareve - this is a drink that is truly good for you.  For one 12oz bottle there are 60 calories, 5mg sodium, 0 fat, 15g carbs, 14g sugar, and 0g protein.  Numi also donates 1% of net profits to benefit social, environmental & sustainable causes.  I highly recommend this, along with the rest of Numi's Puerh line of bottled teas.
Terrific product but when ordering in case size be prepared for the occasional loose seal which will make the bottom of the box a mess.  Too bad - would otherwise be 5 star review

These taste just like their refrigerated counterparts.  They usually ship well.  My second shipment had several that were completely or partially crushed.  To be fair they shipped to my ship in the middle of the Arabian Gulf.  That is a trip that can be difficult on any package!

I absolutely LOVE international delight creamers, so to get the single-serve packages that last for months and months was an absolute MUST for me.  I have no problems with the product and I think that the price is great, however my major issue was with the product upon arrival.When I received my product, the bottom of the box was partially soaked through, due to some handling issues, or poor packaging, I assume.  Several of the packages were open and had spilled all over the box and other creamers.  Since it was such a small problem, I saw no point in returning it, but it was a real pain having to go through each creamer and clean them of the stickiness.  This is the only reason why I can't give it a full 5/5 stars.  Other than that, great product!

There's nothing wrong with the product itself. I've been using the French Vanilla creamer for some time now and am very happy with it. However, this bulk option may not be the best approach. It comes as one big box full of the individual creamers and during transit several had burst. The result is that you have to wash each individual creamer to remove the sticky residue. I found 4 damaged ones (not a huge loss among 288) but every creamer was sticky. I think I'll go with the multi-packs next time rather than bulk. Be warned.
product is worth the money but expect a few to be damaged which makes it a bit messy you will have to rinse them all off.but good product bad packaging

I really like this liquid creamer. I have had no problems with them spilling open in the carton. They are packed loosely in the box, but then placed into another box for shipping. These single count creamers makes it better for me because I don't have to worry about refrigeration only to keep the box in a cool area. I like the fact that this creamer has milk and cream in the ingredients rather than non dairy products as some of the other creamers have. This is my favorite flavor, but ID makes many very good flavors.

column9: Vanilla, it's the finest of the flavors
column10: I bring trays of 7 flavors of individual serving creamers to a group every week and this is the second most popular flavor, just behind hazelnut.
Best buy for your money, smaller boxes of this item is just too expensive.  Lasts for months with no complaints,.
Great price for a lot of creamer. Just a bit at a loss of what to do with a giant box of creamers! Was hoping they'd come packed a little differently, but it's not a big deal.
International Delight French Vanilla Liquid Creamer, 192-Count Single-Serve Packages This is a wonderful product.  It is a smooth and taste great.
This is just as good as what you find in a restaurant, and you can store it in your pantry without refrigeration.
My hairdresser has an in house salon and serves coffee to all of us.  She always uses the French Vanilla creamer and was delighted when I brought her this huge container of cream.

The product listing is a little strange - there's no 12 anything (12 count sounds like 12 items). What you will actually receive is six 16 oz packages. Maybe the 12 refers to servings, if you made two meals out of one pouch at one cup per serving.The chili itself is just OK, it's very soupy, heavy on the tomato base, with just a hint of spice. I wouldn't exactly break this out to serve to guests, but for my intended purposes of packing it along on the Trans-Siberian, it will do just fine. The package can be ripped open, so no need for scissors or a knife. I think that after I have used up this order, I will be unlikely to re-purchase. It's not that it's bad, it's just not that good - but it will make a nice break from cup-o-noodles.
Easy to heat and eat. Expensive but convenient and healthy.  A good, tasty and meatless meal that is nutrious for you!

WHAT CAN I SAY. I COULD NO LONGER LOCATE THIS PRODUCT ANYWHERE SO I GAVE IT A SHOT AND FOUND IT HERE ON AMAZON.IF YOU LOVE TO COOK AND NEED TO USE A LOT OF SPICES...WELL SYLVIA'SSECRET SEASONING IS THE PERFECT ONE!I HAVE NO IDEA WHAT MAKES IN WORK BUT IT MAKES THINGS TASTE AWESOME. NO MORE WORRYING ABOUT "IT STILL DOESN'T TASTE RIGHT..IT NEEDS A LITTLE MORE SEASONING..WHICH SHOULD I USE"SYLVIA'S IS IT!

column9: Sylvia's Secret Seasoning is from the Heavens
column10: My wife and I are vegetarians [we occasionally partake of salmon and other select seafood]; we use non-salt seasonings in all meal preparations.  Sylvia's Secret seasoning is an exceptional complement for enhancing the presentation of our entrees.  We were also elated to see our Sylvia's shipment arrive sooner than expected from Amazon.com

I use to buy this product at whole foods market but they stop carring it, and I was not able to find it anywhere until I went online and Amazon had it. I have ordered two cases over the last two years. What I like about it is it does not have MSG, and the many spices that make up the total seasoning is usually enough for most things I cook though for garlic lovers you will need to add it.

I used to get this from local grocery stores.  More recently, like the other reviewer says, I couldn't locate it anywhere. Oneday, I just gave it a shot in Amazon and amazingly they had it (and they still do as of this writing).  I pretty much use this seasoning on everything from grilling to baking and it goes well with any kind of meat, poulty or sea food.  If you like it spicy, try this; you will love it.  It is not terribly hot, mild but loaded with good spicy flavor.

READ ALL THE REVIEWS >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>> Then just buy it !Great stuff, I use it on any thing that needs an herb kick....from meats (pre-season before cooking so the flavors get into the surface)to vegetables and everything in between.  Have used it for years.I like to cook and this is handy and a real timesaver.

column9: No Secret.......It's great for all dishes!
column10: I have used Sylvia's Secret Seasoning for years. I originally wanted a good blend of herbs and spices WITHOUT salt so I did not have to keep 6 or 7 spice jars around. Sylvia's Seasoning provides just that and is great on meats, vegetables, soups, stews, casseroles, etc. I disregard the recipe's instructions for a specific item and add the equivalent of Sylvia's. I have never been disappointed. It is especially good for spaghetti and really brings flavor to slow cooked foods. I have given jars of this seasoning to friends and family and all just love it. Thanks! Large quantity purchase is good for gifts!

This is a favorite in this house, by the pickiest one of them all!  He goes crazy for this variety and really gobbles it up quickly.  Great protein in it too, smells great and well, you can get it cheaper elsewhere too, which is surprising to me since amazon is usually cheaper than anyone.  Anyway, highly recommend!

column9: Our six cats vote for Fancy Feast
column10: We have four, and are feeding two feral cats who live somewhere in the forest here.  I'm ashamed to admit that I feed what my other cats don't finish, to the feral cats, but they are all very happy, and there is no waste.I'm so happy with the ones I get every month, through subscriptions.  They are cheaper, have free shipping, and it's so nice not to have to remember, when I drive the fifty miles round trip to the nearest grocery store, to get cat food.The only other wet food my cats eat is Tiki Cat.  They also like A Taste Of The Wild dry food, in the venison and salmon flavor only.
This is food my cats love and you just can't get it in the store for the price it is here! Thanks Amazon!

As my cat ages she has become very fussy with foods. She has always loved tuna and I have tried various "healthy" tuna wet foods such as wellness and other brands. She likes them for a few days then refuses them. I tried this cheaper food and she gobbles it up. Loves it! This one is much cheaper as well.

column9: Perfect Feast for an older kitty
column10: My 15-yr-old cat can no longer chew the shredded varieties of Fancy Feast she used to love.  This "Classic" variety of Fancy Feast Ocean Whitefish & Tuna is the perfect consistency and, unlike the "grilled" formulas, blends well with warm water so I can make a nice "kitty soup" for her.I also greatly appreciate being able to purchase this product by the case via Amazon subscription, as the cost per can is almost double at stores up here in the mountains of Northern CA.

column9: Cat loves food, but subscription service is unreliable.
column10: All five of the Fancy Feast subscriptions I signed up for have been unreliable.  Im October, I signed up for delivery every two months and received shipments only in October and December (it's now March 18, but I canceled all of my subscriptions yesterday).  What was supposed to be 48-can cases Amazon turned into 24-can cases, with one flavor being canceled entirely.  I was notified by Amazon that shipments would be sent in mi-February, but they never arrived.

I have started to add turmeric root powder to my diet for its anti-inflammatory properties. I wanted to increase the quantity and needed to find a bulk supplier. The Indus Organic Turmeric powder has exceeded my expectations. It is more aromatic than what I had been using and it feels like it is more effective, but that may be my imagination.Suggested uses:- Added to my vegetarian, organic protein drink, it actually improves the flavor! It tasted good before adding the turmeric, I did not expect the flavor to improve. I add one teaspoon of turmeric powder to my protein drink that uses a fruit juice base. I use a Whole Foods organic fruit juice blend of pineapple, orange and banana. The protein powders are from Vibrant Health: Pure Green Protein (vanilla flavor), Green Vibrance and Rainbow Vibrance.- Added to soups. I have tried this with various lentil soups and a chunky tomato soup. All very successful improvements in flavor, in addition to getting the health benefits. The brand of soup I prefer is Amy's.The product is packaged well and arrived when promised. I will be a regular customer!
I use it for cooking my meals and for my dogs food for helping with his arthritis and inflammation.I am very happy with the quality of this product and will be purchasing it in the future as well.
Indus Organic Tumeric came in a perfect storage container and was fresh and tasty. I will order again for sure!! The price was right too. -- barbara

I bought this product in bulk as I use turmeric in my Nutribullet for its anti-inflammatory quality.  It is a lot better bang for your buck.  The color is brighter than the turmeric I buy in the store and it was packaged well.
Very happy with my purchase.  Quality is comparable with premium priced products at supermarket, and the price is very reasonable. Amazon service is, as always, first class. Highly recommended.
Very good product. I didn't realize I was getting 2lbs. To me, it sounded like I was getting 1lb in 2 separate jars. This product had a safety seal unlike the cinnamon I bought from the same company.

In my reserch for the best for your health olive oil, I found this one to be the best.  Not only is it good for you(like a lot of other extra virgin olive oils), I look for one that is cold press (uses no heat in their process).  Heat cuases chemical changes to the oil.  Cold press olive oils can still create some natural heat in its process, and cause some change to the oil, but my understanding is that Bariani is  specially careful to not create any heat in their cold press process.  I trust the company and use the oil regularly.  [...]
This olive oil has a wonderful and rich taste.  I have actually not tasted anything like it.  It was recommended to us by a friend whose cardiologist told her about it.

We buy this EVOO regularly.  Healthy rich and delicious.  I do not think it has a bitter after taste.  Its great as a sauce on top of ravioli or a dip for bread... I'm not sure if it's quite worth what you pay but it is very tasty!

I chose to try this oil after reading the many good reviews.I've enjoyed other brands of California olive oil and am more confidant that I'm getting what I've payed for-with the claims on the label matching the contents in the bottle with the California brands.News stories and reviews recently have cast doubt on the quality and purity of European olive oils.Extra virgin olive oil should taste great-period.Different oils have various flavor profiles that are enjoyed for their many uses.Not everyone will enjoy every olive oil.This Bariani EVOO (harvest date-Fall 11,Bottling date-2-8-12)talks a good game but quite simply has a bitter and unpleasant finish in the back of the throat.Not a peppery finish-just bitter.A nice resume does not always equal great taste.Such is the case here.

I lived in Spain and for years would only eat with spanish olive oil or good stuff from Italy or occasionally from Greece. Someone gave me a bottle of this oil and I was really really impressed. It tastes as good as the best oils from Europe. To be eaten raw. Highly recommended
Unfortunately many olive oils are mixed with other oils. Bariana is pure olive oil. We love it.
This is a great value!  And Wheat Thins are just so darned versatile! Dip 'em or serve them up with cheese, or even just plain.  This is a better value than our local store can offer!

My family and I enjoy Wheat Thins and compared to the price in the grocery stores this is a great buy. I automatically get 6 boxes every 3 months and if we haven't gone through all of them it is very easy for me to cancel the next shipment as Amazon sends a reminder that a shipment is due. I love the price and the convenience of delivery (no shipping costs).
Price is better than Wal-Mart and these wheat thins are healthier than regular wheat thins.  These are made with whole wheat and not enriched wheat.

Low-fat Wheat Thins taste nearly as good as the original. There's a bit less oil, but I can't really complain about the flavor, and it tastes great with lots of stuff - hummus, cheese, tofu slices, vegetables, whatever. It has a nice crunch to it too,

These tasty crackers are a staple in our snack cupboard. You won't miss the fat in the reduced fat variety. They are great with cheese or spreads or plain out of the box. Purchased using the subscription service, these are a great value too.

column9: Taste almost as good as Orignal
column10: These taste almost as good as Original Wheat Thins, close enough that I don't even notice it unless I have them back to back. I like the size of the package as well, a normal size box is not enough for me, and I go through this size before they get stale.
Good value if subscribe with Amazon.com. Lower fat than traditional wheat thins but still tastes good.

column9: This makes that margarita that you have been looking for!
column10: If you have ever had one of those "to die for" margaritas when out, then this is probably what was used.  This is one of the very best mixes I have tasted.  And being from Texas, I have drank some margaritas!  You can't go wrong with this mix, just buy it!  You'll see.

I was so exicted about this product when I found it on line and bought it with my new Coffee maker, then over the next weekend saw the EXACT same product in Bed, Bath and Beyond for $20 cheaper.  And when mine came in it was missing the Hot Chocolate.  I have never been disappointed in AMAZON before, but I really will look at my purchases MUCH more in the future.

I have just bought at BJ's a box of 80 K-cups (Green Mountain 100% Colombian dark roast extra bold)for $37 (that is 46.25 cents per cup). I found it similarly priced at Sam's. Do the math and compare. The moral of this comparison is that not everything is cheaper at Amazon specially when Amazon is only the middle man, so to speak.
Wayyyyy overpriced! K cups should average you around .50 cents a cup ! ! !
I found and bought this product at Bed, Bath and Beyond for $29.99.  It is a great sampler to test ten different  coffees (plus one tea and one cocoa) but at almost half the price.

I thought this was a poor assortment as I was looking for coffee, not tea or hot chocolate.  Perhaps I should have read the details a little closer.  However, this assortment is way over priced.  You can get 4 boxes of 24 count K Cups from Green Mountain for $45.00 +/-.  Perhaps it is a good assortment to get started but I was disappointed in the mix.
Not much variety. There are about 5 or 6 of the same kind so you don't get to try out may different kinds. Plus, you are stuck with a lot of flavors you don't care for.

This coffee is un-drinkable. I am so upset that I just spend $50 on all of these coffee cups and I have to actually throw them out! I am not a coffee snob my any means. But I am able to detect a disgusting plastic and stale aftertaste. I am so disappointed! After taking my first sip, I looked at the expiration date on all of the cups. They expired either 10 days ago or are about to expire next week. What a waste!

column9: Love the different flavors you get.
column10: I'm sorry I didn't say so sooner. I love my Keurig coffee maker that I received as a gift. We don't use it on a daily basis only because my husband likes to have a pot. Set in his ways I guess, but with only the two of us I do understand his view, with that said - when we have company come over - that's when this is put to good use. I loved all the varieties in the box. Sincerely, Kelly M

This is a nice variety for a new K-cup owner who's not sure of what flavors are best for them, it give you a few of many different types to try out before you buy a large case full of just one type and then not really like the flavor.
Makes a variety available at low cost. Compared with having to purchase coffee by the "pound" to try different flavors.

This is a great starter kit.  After using the Kcups provided, I decided which flavors I like the best.  So, I do not see myself ordering this bundle more than once a year, as I will be purchasing my favorites.

I bought a Keurig for the Holidays and I love it.  When I read that it only came with a handful of K-cups, I searched this variety pack up and I wasn't disappointed.  It comes with a great sampling of coffees.  The only downside was that I thought it came with a few to many decaf K-cups however, as it turned out, I had some relatives over that only drink decaf.  If you're new to Keurig and K-cups, this is a great starter kit.  Enjoy!
Although expensive, I like the idea of being able to try products from different companies.  In the future I will order only those I liked from this variety pack.
This pack has a lot of the extra bold in it. I was hoping for a better variety then this pack. Not impressed.
i love these coffee....i was never a coffee lover but since i brought these coffees......i love it .....u can go to www.justone cup.com and brought alot of coffee
excellent selection of coffee; it will help you decide which type or flavor that you will enjoy on a daily basis.

column9: Good option to get you started
column10: This box has a nice variety of kcups inside.  It's a great option to get you STARTED in figuring out which flavors you like.  From there, graduate to the variety boxes by the individual companies and then you should have a great grasps on what to buy in the future.
New item for me but  enjoy the product.  Neighbor had one and said how great the product is so thought we'd try it ourselves.
Well pleased with the coffee. Like the variety of flavors and the convenience of the individual little cups.Would definitely recommend.  Delivery was great even with the Christmas rush.
Item received ahead of schedule and as advertised. Ordering via Amazon has become the preferred method of shopping for my household.

column9: So many choices, so little time
column10: Picked up this pack so that we could try them out with the new B-60.  I would say that maybe the smaller pack would work as well, but really wanted to find what we liked before we ordered a whole lot.

column9: Nice gift for daughter away from home!
column10: This is the second of these that we have sent to our daughter who is away from home.  Just wish they would provide a half size package or charge a little less for this one.  Otherwise, she loves having it available.PS  I think that Amazon.com is the only place where this nice gift is available and I intend to keep getting it for her.

Pricey yet convenient. Variety is nice for the new customer to sample. Occasional undesireable results do to clogging. May be a result of the bottled water that we are restricted to in a forward deployed unit in Afghanistan or the frequent use of the Keurig by multiple users.

A trip with my partner to Rehoboth gave me my first experience using a Keurig coffee maker, which prompted my purchasing a machine upon my arrival home. While I was pleased with the selection of the coffees and teas offered in this set, and was impressed with the promptness of the delivery, I was disappointed that, after ordering this set, I was able to find the same item at a local retailer for less money.This comes as a surprise to me, as Amazon usually has the best prices anywhere. I hope to have a better experience in the future. While Amazon Prime was very convenient for speedy free delivery, I could not cancel the order when I found it cheaper; I had ordered it on Saturday night and by ten o'clock on Sunday morning, I could not cancel the order.I rely on Amazon for great selection and the best prices; I will not be doing so again for coffee.
Do you like your coffee strong or weak or medium? This has all of them. Some are not appropriate. It would help to have an opportunity to choose.

column9: Price issues aside, a nice variety
column10: Got this pack with my new Cuisinart.  Seems like a good variety of different brands of coffees and teas.  So far have like most things, but some things to note:There's only one type of decaf coffee.  So if you're a big decaf drinker, you may not like this pack.Most of the coffees aren't "extra bold" so taste a little weak to me on the 8 oz setting.  If you like your coffee strong, use the 6 oz setting on your machine if it's not "extra bold".Tea is good, but also not as strong as I like it.Hot chocolate is just ok.  Be sure to rinse out your machine after you use it.
The coffee variety pack is just what I expected.  What I didn't expect was to find the same thing at Bed, Bath and Beyond for less money.

Amazon have several flavors of coffee and tea you can purchase for your Keurig Brewers and I was not sure which flavor of coffee to order, so I bought the variety pack to help me and I liked each one...I like the idea that I taste a different flavor coffee each day and those I liked most, I now order more of.
Hey!I wish if you could add the Expiry date on those kind of products, in the description sections or so!Thanks
This variety pack has a nice selection of coffees, teas and hot chocolate to sample from to decide which types you prefer, and/or to keep a varied selection on hand for guests.
This variety pack has a great selection of coffees! Having a sample pack has really helped me figure out which brands and flavors I prefer.

column9: Costco has it cheaper per item,,,,
column10: Costco has a similar item, except it has 80 K cups and costs $34.99, which is $.44 a cup. Not a bad deal!

When something is called a "flavored" variety pack, wouldn't you think it contained all flavored coffee?  It doesn't.  I should have read the description of what's actually contained in this variety pack more closely.  There are very few flavored coffee Kcups.  The whole thing is almost all a variety of different non-flavored coffee.  What a disappointment.

After much web research, I found this to be a very economical way to test a variety of Kcups on our new Keurig.  This supplier had a good price and provided very quick shipment.  I am very pleased with their service.  -Larry from Hendersonville, NC
Item arrived promptly and as advertised.  Very pleased.  Used to only drink coffee when I dined out - now I have it every day.

All these flavor variety packages contain several units of tea.  If I want tea I will buy tea.  I want a package with a flavor variety of coffees only.  Where can I get a decent assortment of flavored K-cup coffee?
We bought this for our company's office and it works as advertised. I'm not a coffee drinker but everyone seems happy with it. Very easy to use.

column9: Good to figure out what you like...
column10: Price is fair comparatively... it's a good way to decide which ones you like and for the ones that are not so much for you there aren't too many that you'll have to deal with them for too long...

I hate this coffee maker.It takes a long time to clean it.The coffee cartridges are expensive.The machine runs hot all the time. It's like leaving one of the stove burners turned on all the time.Don't buy this lemon. Let them work the bugs out first.The machine will makes a nice item for my next garage sale.

I purchased the B77 on December 27, 2009 and returned it back to BJs Wholesale Club.1)  The K-Cups have very little coffee inside them.2)  If you want a large cup 10 oz. cup of coffee, forget it.  The size is small and the coffee is Watered Down.3)  Same thing with the 8 oz. size.4)  If you want an Espresso, buy something under $40.00.  Keurig screwed up with this line.5)  I called Customer Service, no one picks of the phone, and you can not leave a message either.Final Item:  Go to [...] for more information.

I've purchased just about every lemon pepper seasoning on the market and this is by far the best out there.I use it on fish at least once a week.When I purchased it from the store I would clear the shelf. You will not be disappointed with this purchase.

What really can be said about this product....It's basically a highly acidic/sweet product that goes well on various fruits and vegetables to give them a bite and a pucker :)Certainly a product to be used in limited quantities due to the acidity and salt content.
I like them, but they did not strike me as being remarkably different or more smoky than more readily procurable brands. I would only get them again if the shipping were less expensive.
I love to put this in my vanilla yogurt. It has a good flavor and it's good for you.  We can't find it in any local store, so I'm glad Amazon sells it.

column9: Wheat Germ with Cinnamon and Flaxseed
column10: Love this product! I use it all the time in my muffin and bread mixes and it doesn't change the taste or texture. Plus, it adds extra health benefits like fiber and antioxidants. Hope they don't stop making it!
THESE TASTE GREAT.. ANOTHER ITEM I BOUGHT FOR AN EX BOYFRIEND NOW SO I ASSUME ALL IS GOOD SINCE I DON'T HEAR ABOUT IT.

column9: Good source of great healthy products for a quick energy boost!
column10: I was a little skeptical but I ordered anyway and you know what?  I was pretty impressed by the product contained within the slick packaging. First was the taste which was very good and tasty subduing my appetite for anything at that time and second the psychological boost of consuming what is assumed to be good for my body. I'm no clinical scientist or nutritional specialist so I can't give analytic proof that this stuff does what it says but all I know is that it's easy to carry with you on the go to fuel your body for energy while performing anything physical.  The packaging is also great to use afterwards for storing knickknacks!!!

column9: Not very much neem per capsule
column10: Took a chance ordering this brand when there was no indication how much neem there was per capsule in their online description.  It turns out there is only 100mg of extract + 25mg of powder, far far less than all the other brands, and its not even organic to boot.  That's what I get for making my decision based on it being eligible for free "super saver" shipping.

column9: The BEST Pepper I have ever found.
column10: I grew up watching the Watkins man coming to my grandfathers farm every once in a while and of course in the country those were the days that everyone swore that Watkins could not be beat and for the most part they were right.  Through the years, I tried many peppers including grinding several types on my own and although I ran into some good pepper, none of them had that pizazz that I lie in pepper.One day several years ago I was at one of our little country stores when I saw this on the shelf and sad to say, it was not selling simply because it had a picture of a beautiful black lady on the label.  That kind of thing irritates me and because of that and because the price had been reduced I bought one and the next day I went back and bought the rest and when those ran out I found these online here at Amazon and bought a case and even gave some to family and friends and they all agree.......This is the BEST Black pepper I have ever found............

I have used Sylvia's "Coarse" Grind Pepper in the past & loved it - really spicy & flavorful.  That is not what this product is even though the bottle packaging clearly states "Coarse" grind and the Amazon description says it is "Coarse" Grind Pepper as well.  What I received is a finely ground pepper that tastes no different than any cheap brand pepper you can get at your local grocery store.  I should have listened to one of the other reviews that stated they received a finely ground pepper too.  I feel like a complete idiot for purchasing (12) bottles of this and paying almost $20 for pepper that tastes no different than the Walmart store brand pepper.

column9: I prefer Sylvia's coarser black pepper to this fine one.
column10: I was disappointed with this FINE black pepper because Sylvia's coarser one had a significantly higher pepper flavor.  This one is bland.  It almost just disapppears on whatever food you put it on.  I have to use about a teaspoon on each chicken breast just to get that peppery taste.  I will be buying the coarser black pepper but not this one.  It's like it was ground up too fine and left to lose it's flavor into the air before being bottled. I have to use so much of it during each meal just to get some peppery flavor that the case I purchased is almost gone already.  That's not at all cost effective. Give Sylvia's Coarse ground black pepper a try...that's tasty but forget this one.

Supermarket canned black pepper is so powdery and bland.  I wanted an old-fashioned pepper that I could taste.  Sylvia's pepper fills the bill.  It is pungent and flaky, the way black pepper should be.  I am sprinkling more black pepper on my food than I ever did before.  Sylvia's pepper seems to enhance every food, and the taste just gets better and better.  I really think this is black pepper #1!

We were sooooo happy to find these available on Amazon. We had been purchasing them in our grocery store and then all of a sudden they stopped carrying them. Our Boston, Bullwinkle, loves them and we just didn't know what we were going to do to replace them. They are easy for him to digest because they break into small pieces and we don't have to worry about him swallowing one of those huge pieces of rawhide that causes so many issues with the digestive tract. Thanks for having them available in this large quantity.
Would have liked to know the package contained 100 chew sticks rather than the packages of 20 I received in the past!

This coffee has a rich flavor without any bitterness.  I usually do not like coffee made with dark beans because they are too strong for my taste but this coffee is great tasting.
