column10: I'm not sure I can detect any spiciness to this sauce, but it has a nice taste that goes well as a veggie dip or as topping for a serving of salad on a plate of Mexican style food. I've tried two of the new Taco Bell sauces and prefer the Taco Bell Jalapeno Sauce, 8-Ounce (Pack of 6), as it has a bit more of a kick to it, but I alternate the two as salad dressings and enjoy them both.

column9: Almost as bad as fast food
column10: You'd expect an at-home product to be better, but it's not. It's got enough fat in it to be mayonaisse. Unlike the recommendation on the bottle, I would not use this in a salad. It has too much fat. Don't get me wrong, it tastes good. But, it's way too many calories per tablespoon.

My kids got ahold of this and took it all before I ever got the chance to taste it. They took it to their apartment. I had to take their word for it when they told it was "awesome sauce." They say they put it on everything. So you'll have to take their word for it. But I never got to try it.

column9: a new favorite Taco Bell sauce
column10: I have tried all three flavors and Spicy Ranchero is by far my favorite.  It's best on beef but I like it on chicken as well.  It's worked out really well for getting Taco Bell drive through tacos, which is mainly what I've used it for.  I've also used it mixed with a little fat free sour cream for a taco salad topping.  The taste reminds me a lot of the sauce on Taco Bell chalupas.  The serving size is huge, you can use a lot less than 1 ounce -- more like 4-5 drops per taco.  If you want to try a Taco Bell sauce, I recommend trying this one first, it's the most delicious and very versatile.

column9: Not what I expected but good
column10: I was excited to see these Taco Bell brand sauces because I was hoping they'd be like the Baja sauce I loved on the grilled stuffed burritos and whatever is in the chicken quesadillas.  This sauce  wasn't it, but it's still okay.  Don't think I'd buy it, though.

This tastes like a sauce or dressing from a restaurant! One of our favorite Mexican restaurants serves a giant grilled taco salad with a dressing that tastes identical to this. I wish the bottle were larger, due to the popularity of this sauce in our household.It's creamy, tastes mayo-based with a little Ranch/cumin zip, yet is not heavy. (The cumin taste comes through very aggressively so a cumin-hater probably will not like this!) It has a little kick but it's not too hot for folks who dislike spicy food.So far we've used this as a salad dressing, on wrap sandwiches, and it made a delicious chicken pasta salad! It even made a great dipper for french fries and sweet potato fries. We'll be using this for taco night and on tostadas, and as a dip for grilled meats and veggies. I think a burger with avocado slices would just love this sauce! So far this is one of my favorite Taco Bell sauces!Serving Size is 2 Tablespoons; it has 110 calories, 11 grams of fat, and 3 carbs. 1 gram of that is sugar. Thisis made with sugar and corn syrup, for those who like to avoid either or both.

Out of the three new sauces from Taco Bell, I picked this one to try figuring that I would like it the best. It's not bad but there is nothing outstanding about it either. Tastes like cheese with come chili powder in it. My son (who eats and loves everything) said it was only okay as well. I found this surprising coming from an avid Taco Bell lover.  Prefer a sauce that is a bit tangy and not so bland. Don't see myself purchasing it in the future.

Taco Bell's Bold and Creamy Spicy Ranchero sauce makes a great addition to most any Mexican food. Think of it as a ranch sauce with taco seasonings mixed in. It adds zip to tacos, tortillas, quesadillas, nachos, burritos, salads, or even on your sandwiches, wraps, or burgers. It's spicy without being too hot or overpowering.We used it on a taco casserole and absolutely loved it. It also works great mixed into a taco salad. If you're looking for something to give your meal a little added zip and Mexican spice, the Spicy Ranchero sauce is it. You'll find that the 8 oz. bottle goes fast, especially if you're sharing it with your family.

column9: A good sauce for non-mexican food as well!
column10: Timing is everything in this world! When the bottle of Taco Bell Bold & Creamy, Spicy Ranchero Sauce (gee, do you think they could have added a few more descriptive words to the label?) arrived we were having burger night at the house, including fries and a small salad. So, needless to say, we got to use the sauce immediately on a non-Mexican food menu. Our thoughts: the sauce added a bit of zest as a salad dressing. As a dipping sauce for the fries it wasn't a real good combo. It might be due to the addition of salt to the mix. But when added to a hamburger in place of ketchup I found it a great change of pace. Throw a few onions on it as well and I really enjoyed the burger (in fact I had two which I really not suppose to do on my diet).As for the accuracy of the label description, it is not what I would call BOLD, definitely not overpowering a taste. It is a very creamy sauce with a good consistency to it. But it is not very spicy in my opinion which I feel is ok. A lot of the time I find that increasing the heat of a sauce is at the expense of the taste. I think this could have been a wee bit hotter but since I find the flavor enjoyable it's not a problem.Overall I enjoyed the taste. It is something that I will purchase for many different types of food. In fact I'm kind of wondering how it would be mixed into a meatloaf. Hmm, that may be my next menu for it.

Who doesn't love Taco Bell?  I tried this yesterday with homemade soft shelled chorizo tacos.  Upon opening, I could smell the ranch seasoning.  I used about 1/2 tablespoon on each taco. There are 110 calories per 2 tablespoon serving. The sauce was very ranch-y.  It seems to me that they took a ranch dressing and mixed it with their own blend of Taco Bell spices.  It was bold tasting, but overwhelmingly ranch.  Also, it was not very spicy, just seasoned.  It wasn't a bad flavor at all, but not what I was expecting.  The other suggested uses are for wraps and sandwiches.  I think it would work well on certain types of sandwiches, but for tacos, it was not quite what I was looking for.

I was hoping that this sauce would be a little more consistent and thick that it is.  The taste is a bit sharp and perhaps it's just not in my palette, but I'll stick with a homeade ranchero until I find one that is a quick retail replacement.

column9: Very tasty sauce for tacos and more!
column10: This sauce is very good. I liked it with tacos and I also used it on salads. I even used it as just a regular dip with Fritos or tortilla chips. This sauce has a nice bold ranch flavor that is spicy, but not so much as to burn your mouth. It adds a good kick to anything that you put it on. I wish the bottle was a little bigger because it seems to go very fast (maybe because I liked it). It is like a ranch-flavored chipotle sauce, so use it anywhere you want that flavor. I think this was a very good thing for Taco Bell to come up with. Use this to give any meal a little southwest style.

column9: Good in small doses, great for snacks
column10: Even though I'm Mexican, I do like to go eat at taco bell once in a while (Chalupas mostly) anyway, when I saw this up for review I though it would be nice to have this around.The flavor was really good, my brother and I liked it so much at first that we even used this sauce with tortilla chips, doritos etc as snacks, we used it up in about 1 week, but oh man, this sauce caused us a bit of stomach sickness, not because of spice or anything, (its not spicy at all) but because it seems we abused of consuming this product. hence I warn any buyer to not abuse of this product.I cant really describe the flavor, it was spicy (not in a hot way) and even felt it had a bit of bacon flavor to it, when I first tasted it it was love at first taste, I highly recommend it if not for tacos, at least for sauce on other snacks.

I took a while to review this product because frankly, at first, I didn't like it. I tasted it alone and thought there was no way it could work with anything. So I put it in the refrigerator and forgot about it.Then one day I decided to actually try it on something. First attempt: Turkey burgers. Result: Deliciousness. I could not believe how much better the burger tasted than normal, nor could I believe how much better the sauce tasted than when I tried it alone. I suppose it is like wine paired with food, or perhaps more accurately, any ingredient that tastes better when paired with something else.Since that time I have tried it on numerous other foods. Same result ... it very much complements the flavor of foods, especially meats.It's not just for tacos!

This is the third Taco Bell sauce I've tried and I'm not disappointed in its claim of boldness.  I think the dominant spice is cumin so it packs quite a wallop. But it's not spicy to a point that it's hard to eat.  I ate it with some fried chicken and fresh carrots and it made the meal more interesting.  Then I thought I'd mix some honey in and it tasted quite amazing.  I am definitely a fan of this sauce and other than using it on its own, I think I can mix it with mayo and have a Mexican flavored salad dressing.  Or stir it in a bowl of chili.  Or give soup a little kick.  It probably will taste good brushed on grilled meat as well.  Very versatile flavor.  I wish Taco Bell had these sauces available at their restaurants.

2.75 starsThis dressing/sauce is pretty good. The ranch flavor isn't very pronounced, but it has a slightly spicy kick to it. I don't think I would use it regularly because it had an artificial taste. However, it's not horrible and I could see those who are tired of the same old ranch dressing giving this a try.

While it's been ages since I've eaten Taco Bell, it did at one point form a substantial portion of my diet. Those days are over, but when ths sauce was offered in the Vine program,I decided to give it a whirl for old time's sake.It tastes exactly like Taco Bell, which is to say: gross if you're not a Taco Bell fan, but I suspect familiar and tasty if you are.Personally, I was a little horrified to find my home-cooked tacos tasting like Taco Bell.So while I'd never buy or eat this myself, I'm also unlikely to deliberately eat Taco Bell, while anyone buying a Taco Bell condiment clearly favors Taco Bell flavors. So I'm giving it 3 stars. While I personally find it yucky and synthetic-tasting, it really truly tastes exactly like what you think when you think Taco Bell. Based on that, it lives up to expectations and would probably rate 5 stars if all food was graded only on the merits of its Taco Bellness. But we live in a world with other condiments, and this is pretty terrible by objective standards--something of an unholy union between that awful Taco Bell mild sauce and cheap bottled Ranch Dressing.However, given that only a numbskull would expect bright gourmet flavors from Taco Bell brand, it deserves 3 stars. If Taco Bell is what you seek, you'll find it here.

This is a decent sauce but it isn't spicy or bold enough for me. It is fine as a veggie dip, can be used with quesadillas, and even as a salad dressing, but if you love really spicy sauces, this may have you reaching for hot pepper sauce to kick it up a notch.  My kids, however, think it is plenty spicy.
I love spicy ranch flavored stuff and this fits the bill dead on!  I love this and it works great on tacos.

column9: I love Taco Bell but this isn't up to snuff
column10: I don't go a week without wanting a good Taco Bell fix, so I was excited to try this out, help keep the cravings at bay from time to time.  Unfortunately it's pretty weak, the flavor is alright but it's got a strange aftertaste and is anything but "bold".

First, I'm not a fan of Taco Bell food. It's relatively cheap, it's relatively bland, and it bears only passing resemblance to actual Mexican food. I eat it, but it's the McDonald's of Mexican food. I love spicy sauces, though, so I thought I'd give this "Taco Bell Bold & Creamy Spicy Ranchero" a try.The description makes this sound exciting and interesting. When I unscrewed the cap, the sauce smelled tempting. Then I paired it with food, and it just went downhill.Meats? Nope, too conflicting. Vegetables? Nope, too overwhelming. Fruit? (Didn't go there.) Chips? Yeah, that was okay, but nothing that made me want to do it again. Out of a desire to use up the bottle, I threw some on a hot dog wrapped in a flour tortilla - and it tasted so bad that I had to throw it out.I give this two stars because I used the sauce with some chicken breasts and melted shredded cheddar cheese, and that was actually pretty good. However, I can't wholeheartedly recommend a sauce that tastes "pretty good" on only one kind of food. If you like the Taco Bell brand (which is actually misleading, because I don't think I've ever tasted this exact flavor on anything I've eaten at Taco Bell), and you enjoy specialty sauces with your chips, this might be for you. If you're looking for a versatile sauce that will add a fun zing to your cooking, however, steer clear of this. It doesn't play well with most foods.

I liked this just fine.  The name is a little misleading:  It's really not very spicy at all.  It does have a lot of flavor, however.  I've tried it on sandwiches (very good), and on tacos of various types.  I liked it best on fish tacos, with shredded lettuce and chopped tomato.  It also works well on chicken tacos and burritos.  I also liked it as a salad dressing for a "southwestern" salad (romaine, corn/black bean salsa, chopped tomato, a few ounces of chopped cooked chicken, mixed colby/jack cheese (or pepper jack), a few sliced black olives, and a couple of tablespoons of this sauce.  Amazon's price is quite good compared to my local grocery stores.

column9: Best of the Taco Bell sauces
column10: This is by far the very best tasting of all of the Tack Bell Sauces. While it doesn't really give you that from a Tack Bell stand taste, it has a very smooth and balanced flavor that enhances rather than overpowers what you put it on. I particularly like it on scrambled eggs, soy cheese, green onions & lettuce, wrapped in a whole wheat flour tortilla. While I haven't been a fan of the other Taco Bell sauces, they hit a home run with this one. I'm now a loyal fan of the Taco Bell Bold & Creamy Spicy Ranchero Sauce. ENJOY!

I'm not sure what you might want to try this for.  I know it's not much good on leftover holiday turkey, and it's only so-so in tacos & burritos.  YMMV, but plain salsa, taco sauce, or Taco Bell's own Chipotle sauce are all much better for my taste.

I was expecting this to taste like Taco Bell's Ranchero Sauce, this does NOT!  I realize it's probably more like a traditional Ranchero Sauce, but when labeled by 'Taco Bell' you expect it to taste like theirs! Highly DISAPPOINTED!  This has a bland chili powder taste...don't waste your money on this one.

column4: Laurence T. Baxter "Step Up to the Call"
column10: The sauce was strictly "ok." Rather than a flavorful southwest sauce it's more of a modest psuedo-cheese half-ranch sauce with just the slightest bit of spice. It wasn't bad, just failed to deliver a bold spicy ranchero flavor. Best use is probably for the kids to dip their veggies in :)

This is kind of a "funny" "sauce".  Quite honestly, I don't know what it's really supposed to be used for.  I've tried it as a veggie dip. . . . on quesadillas.  .. . burritos. . . . and it's all fine.  But in the end. .  .I think I would have been just as happy without it, or using something els.e

column9: I like it better than mayo...
column10: I have to admit I like the other flavors (Jalapeno and Chipotle) better but this flavor it pretty good too.First off, I am not a TB retail fan at all.  That said, this product is actually pretty tasty.  I use it as a mayonnaise substitute and like the results.  For example, on a turkey and Swiss sandwich, it added a nice taste that complimented the ingredients.Let's face it... This product is not health food but in moderation it has it's place.  Strangely, the only place I din't like it was on a taco - Go figure!
This tasted like a mildly spicy, generic Mexican salad dressing to me.  Not really bold or spicy.  Might help kids eat their veggies, though, of they tend to like Catalina dressing.

I use spicy ranch in several of my favorite recipe's so I was excited to see this product available.  The problem was taste, it just didn't do it for me.  I like a chile-spice pop to go with the ranch dressing taste and what I got was an overwhelming flavor of too many spices.  I'll grant that I am not a Taco Bell aficionado, so my taste buds may be a little underdeveloped here...but if your food has plenty of flavor this dressing may be too much.On a plain beef taco with cheese, the kids gave it a thumbs up, so it will get used.Bottom line, use it on plain dishes and you will get something more.  Use it on complex dishes and it will be too much.

column9: Good for more than just tacos
column10: Sick of the standard red sauces that typically come with your taco kits?  Well add a little zing with Taco Bell's Spicy Ranchero Sauce.  It has the creaminess of ranch mixed with the bite of chili spices.  Don't just stop with your tacos.  Add to chicken, hamburgers, and my personal favorite steak.

column9: Small bottle, flavor less bold than advertised
column10: I tried this sauce with some friends of mine when we got together and made burritos. We all seemed to agree that the sauce tastes fine, but it's probably not worth buying. For a "bold and creamy spicy ranchero sauce," I was expecting something a bit bolder and spicier. It was definitely creamy, but the flavor wasn't very memorable. The spice level was comparable to medium salsa, maybe even a bit milder than that. One friend summed it up pretty nicely by saying it didn't taste very "ranchero-y" to her.In addition to the rather underwhelming flavor, this sauce comes in an extremely small bottle. It's shaped in a somewhat deceptive manner that maximizes its surface area, but the reality is that the sauce inside will fill a soda can two-thirds of the way to the top. This stuff tastes fine, but there have to be better-tasting sauces out there that are cheaper besides.

I honestly didn't really have high hopes for a taco bell sauce sold in bottles, but I was pleasantly surprised by this sauce. It is by no means gormet, but it does go well with most tacos an burritos I have tried it on, even those which were homemade. I'm not completely sure I would recommend it, but I also don't regret having it available in my fridge.

I really enjoyed the Chipotle sauce and the Jalapeno sauce, but the Spicy Ranchero is just not very appetizing. I'm not sure exactly what flavor they are going for in this sauce - it is a little spicy, but is not nearly as good as other Ranch sauces I have tried. Do yourself a favor and skip this sauce - go for the Chipotle instead!

column9: Depends on what it is put on
column10: Initially I really liked this.  I used it on a cheese Quesada.  It added nice flavor and mild heat.  However when tried on burritos did not seem to complicate it more.  The two twenty-somethings in the house gave it a complete thumbs down.So I guess this is my short and long:For things with few ingredients it add a nice zing.For more complex dished (even salads) stick to a salsa or traditional taco sauce.

My family likes Taco Bell and we like this Spicy Ranchero Sauce okay. We eat Mexican-ish style dishes quite a bit at home, so it's nice to have a bottled sauce for a little extra kick. My daughter especially liked the flavor in this particular sauce, but of course, not everyone has the same tastes. I also liked that it comes in a squeeze bottle with a flip lid with a small hole, rather than having to try to pour it out of the larger opening. That makes it convenient for adding just the amount you want. It can be used as a salad dressing, if you like thick dressings... or as a dipping sauce for tortilla chips, or on tacos, burritos, what-have-you.
Taco Bell Bold & Creamy Spicy Ranchero Sauce has a very bold rich and spicy flavor. Goes great on Tacos and Fajitas or any food you might want to add kick to.

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column9: Rich, thick, creamy, and spicy; put it on anything but dessert!
column10: Taco Bell Bold & Creamy Spicy Ranchero Sauce has a nice balance of spice, cumin and rich creaminess. It's too high in calories to slather all over everything, but a little slather adds a lot of taste. It seems particularly well suited for sandwiches and wraps, but it would also make a dynamite chicken salad. Oh, just put it on everything - except ice cream, ok?

column9: spicier than the other two Taco Bell sauces
column10: My 14-year-old takes after his father and loves anything spicy. He'd already tried the other two flavors, Chipotle and Jalapeno, so of course we had to get the Spicy Ranchero too. My son says it's spicier than the other two but still not as spicy as other sauces he uses. But he loves all three and dips a wide variety of foods in them....and then licks the plate! These seem nearly impossible to find locally, so I am thrilled we can get them here! You might be disappointed if you want really spicy, but overall the flavors are apparently really good (I am allergic to pepper but I trust my 14-year-old's palate!), so give them a try.

column9: Not Sure What I Expected, But...
column10: ..we really did NOT like the flavor of this sauce.  I haven't tried any of the other flavors, but this sauce (to us) has a very artificial, unappealing taste - enough so that we pitched the bottle after it failed our first two taste tests with tacos and steak & cheese quesadillas.  Definitely would not spend money to purchase this sauce again.

column4: M. Jobbagy "Follow Your Bliss - Joseph Cambell"
column10: I enjoyed this spicy ranchero sauce from Taco Bell. As it says in it's name, it IS Bold and Spicy, so beware if your not into spicy foods or tastes. I used it on different tacos and burritos. It went well with fish tacos as well as chicken tacos, and some steak burritos. It's flavor always enhanced the food, didn't even overpower the fish tacos in my opinion.I made some frozen taquitos and ran out of guacamole, so I used some of this on them, and was not disappointed.So if you like it hot n spicy, this will float your boat all the way to the mexican border and back!

. . . noting really special here.Our family has tried all three of these new Taco Bell sauces -- two for the VINE program and one on our own.As said in an earlier review, reviewing food products can be difficult as tastes vary greatly.  But least for our family, this was "so-so".  It was creamy, yes.  Bold?  Maybe not so much.Not bad, but certainly nothing special.

When I received the Taco Bell Bold and Creamy Spicy Ranchero Sauce from amazons vine program I was excited.  We are taco lovers (have Taco Tuesday every week) and thought this would be a great addition.I tried it and put a little on each of my kids plates for them to try (ages 5 and 6  I thought it was just okay.  It was not very Bold or Spicy in my opinion.  I wasn't really thrilled with the taste either.  Neither one of my kids liked it at all.My husband, however, did like it alot.  He used it on all of his tacos and seemed to really enjoy the taste.

This is a great Taco Bell sauce for sandwiches, tacos, gorditos, chalupas, and even burritos. While the manufacturer likens it to a ranch dressing, it is not a great dressing for your standard salad -- unless it's a taco salad. In my opinion, the ranch flavor is a bit mild and the spices could use a little more of a kick. I still like it though, and I think adding it to the aforementioned foods gives them that little bit extra. I put some on a meatloaf sandwich I made today, and the flavor reminded me of eating a taco. I wish it didn't have so many additives and unnecessary ingredients though.Bold & Creamy is a fun addition to condiments for a Mexican themed meal. It has a creamy Taco Bell flavor reminiscent of their fast food that you either like or don't. How it works with other culinary styles will depend on the dish you are making, though I found it to play nice with chicken dishes. The bottom line though is that you can make a much healthier and fresher tasting version of your own, given a little extra time and the right ingredients. For a quick fix though, Bold & Creamy isn't bad.~ Kort

It's okay, but not my favorite. It has a more vinegary taste than the chipotle version. As I said in the review on the chipotle sauce, I couldn't find MSG listed in the ingredients unless they've hidden it with another name I'm not familiar with.

When I closed my review about the Bold & Creamy Jalapeno Sauce from Taco Bell, I said that I thought they could really kick it up a notch. I didn't know about Bold and Creamy Spicy Ranchero. The heat lingers just a  bit longer in the mouth than the Jalapeno and Chipotle sauces. It never becomes too intense or makes you regret putting a little extra on your tacos, or wraps. Rest assured, that if you run out they will just make more. So go ahead, be bold, put on a little extra. Your taste buds with thank you and your stomach won't regret it.This pale orange sauce is about the color of good Thousand Island Dressing. But trust me when I tell you, if you put this on someone's salad by mistake, they are going to sit up and take notice. It's the right combination of spicy and creamy and a bottle of this stuff doesn't last long at my house. It goes on our breakfast wraps in the morning and I am always dreaming up new ways to use it. If you like spicy you definitely want to give this one a try.

This sauce is pretty good. It's 55 calories per tablespoon. I tried this sauce with chicken and really liked it. It's not too spicy at all. I don't usually eat spicy food and am very sensitive to even small amounts of heat in my food. This sauce hardly had any heat at all.

column9: I like it... my wife, not so much...
column10: I am a condiment lover.  Makes my wife crazy.  Unless I'm just eating jello, I have to add catsup...or soy sauce... or ranch dressing... or... well, you get the idea.  I like this Ranchero sauce, and used it on my salad.  Also on some meatloaf.  Oh, and I dumped it on my tacos, along with salsa and sour cream.  Yup, I can use this sauce on just about anything.  My wife?  Well she put a smidge on her taco, and said it was good.  Not great, but good.  Gee, I don't know she could even taste it, with only that little bitty dab.....

I really enjoyed this infact it is Taco tuesday today and the family and I will be using this tasty sauce. It is also great for` a dipping, it is a bit spicy which we all love but some little ones may not all in all YUMMY sauce. We think its better than the other Taco Bell sauces.

column9: What are the ingredients in Taco Bell Bold & Creamy Spicy Ranchero Sauce?
column10: Ranchero sauce is traditionally tomato-based, similar to the salsa brought to the table with tortilla chips in "Mexican" restaurants.I compared the ingredients of this sauce to a jar of commercial mayonnaise.  The primary difference is the substitution of whey for some of the egg plus the addition of flavorings, colorings, preservatives, and chemicals to adjust the texture and thickness.The resulting mildly spicy sauce has the appearance and consistency of Thousand Island dressing with tiny specks in it but with a very unpleasant chemical smell and taste.You can easily make a much better-tasting and less expensive substitute for this sauce by adding  a tablespoon of salsa or ketchup, a teaspoon of chili powder, and a half-teaspoon each of garlic powder and sugar to a cup of mayonnaise, with vinegar-based hot sauce to taste.Ingredients:Soybean Oil, Water, Whey (from Milk), Vinegar, Buttermilk*, Salt, Egg Yolks, Sugar.Contains less than 2% of Spice, Tomato*, Modified Food Starch, Garlic*, Garlic Juice, Onions*, Xanthan Gum, Citric Acid, Yeast Extract, Phosphoric Acid, Gum Arabic, Corn Syrup, Disodium Inosinate and Disodium Guanylate, Natural Flavor, Artificial Color, with Sorbic Acid and Calcium Disodium EDTA as preservatives.*Dried. Contains: Milk, Egg.Nutrition:Serving size: 2 Tablespoons 29gServings - 8Amount per serving:Calories - 110Total fat - 11gSaturated fat - 1.5gTrans fat - 0gCholesterol - 10mgSodium - 310mgTotal Carbohydrates - 3gFiber - 0gSugars - 1gProtein - <1gVitamin A - 2% DVVitamin C - 0% DVCalcium - 0% DVIron 0% - DV*** Note that although the bottle looks exactly like a regular Kraft salad dressing bottle, it is only 8 ounces instead of the usual 16 ounces.

This is probably the best of the available Taco Bell Sauces, but that's not really saying much. I doubt I'd use ANY of them again, but if I absolutely HAD to, it'd probably be this one. The taste is a weird cross between Ranch and a Mayo-diluted jar of Taco Bell's Fire Sauce. The spice totally overwhelms the Ranch, and while I'm generally in favor of extra spice, the flavors just do not mix well. I'll stick with the little packets of Fire Sauce that you get in the restaurant, thanks.
This is spicy, but not so much as to overpower a leafy side salad. I enjoyed it in place of mayonnaise on a sandwich with spicy chicken and cheese. It's a nice compliment to any spicy meal.

the taste of this sauce isn't anything earth-shattering, but it's good.had it on my lunch turkey wraps for a few weeks and four dabs went a long way for flavor.not spicy at all,creamy,and just the right zip to spice up something a tad without the hotness or watery consistency of salsa.

I did not like this product.  It has a VERY strong amount of pepper.  It does not have much of a ranch taste or a spicy-chili type taste.  It is also very thick--too thick for salad dressing or tacos, I think.  I would not recommend it.

I got this sauce thinking it would be something good! Wrong!!  This sauce has no flavor, to me it is like thinned out mayo!  I cannot taste any spice in the sauce.  I wouldn't even rate this as mild, it is just colored mayo!  Did not like, did not taste good, and will not buy again!

This sauce is very good. I gave it 5 stars because it didn't seem fair to only give it 4, and it does exactly what it is designed to do... and that it spice up burgers, tacos, enchiladas, etc. Not sure how much it would cost at the supermarket, but if it is reasonable, then it is worth having in your fridge.

column9: Better as a Dipping Sauce, Still Not that Good
column10: This sauce has a very spicy kick to it in heat and a little more tanginess than I prefer.  It isn't bad but am not sure it works that great with tacos.  I think it better as a dipping sauce for fried foods or veggies.  Even that is a bit of a stretch.  I wouldn't be a buyer.

column9: Good as a chicken dip, prefer Chipotle Flavor
column10: I enjoyed it as a chicken dip for roasted chicken.  Very nice, a little spicy and good flavor.  I tried 2 flavors.  Second was Chipotle, which I preferred to this one.

column9: Singed Phoenix's Review: Taco Bell Bold & Creamy Spicy Ranchero Sauce
column10: While I enjoyed the chipotle flavored sauce that is offered by the Taco bell brand, I didn't have the same level of excitement for the Ranchero flavor. To me, it just seemed somewhat bland, with no real zeal or kick to it. Personally, I like my Mexican food or even Tex-Mex dishes to have some spice to it, and this sauce just seems to temper it. Again, I loved the chipotle flavored Taco Bell sauce, as it has now replaced sour cream as my usually topping for nachos; however, I can't muster up the same level of excitement for the ranchero flavor.

I reviewed another flavor (jalapeno) and once again I cannot possibly give this product higher than a one star because I truly HATE it.  As the other bottle had arrived well past it's :best if used by date:, so did this bottle.  I still gave it a shot because it didn't necessarily scream EXPIRES BY.  The Spicy Ranchero was once again not spicy but more ranchy with a very weird sweet tang.  This could have possibly been because it was past it's prime.  I hope that others' experience was more enjoyable because my husband and myself just couldn't get past the first taste.  He doesn't like spicy anything while I will pour tabasco sauce on certain things.  There isn't a happier medium to have tried out this product; we both hated it!  I can't put my taste bud on it but this isn't something that I would ever like.Do not recommend and thoroughly disappointed in Amazon's decision to ship out any product past their shelf life.  Hopefully that hasn't dinged this new line of sauces from Taco Bell.  I do know that I will not be purchasing.  As my previous review stated, I love Taco Bells' sauce packets and was hoping that these sauces were along the same flavor profile.  Color me disappointed...

column9: Tastes good, can use in a variety of recipes even on your sandwich (if you like spicy food)
column10: This 'Bold & Creamy' ranchero sauce is fairly spicy. It tastes good (creamy and spicy) in salads, as sandwich spread (very moderate amounts) as well as in some cooked foods (see below). If you cannot stand too much spice, use in moderation. Here is what I tried.1. Made a simple salad with chopped spinach, tomatoes, black beans and potatoes. Adding a little bit of the sauce made it very tasty2. Used as a spread in a mesquite turkey deli sandwich.3. Made a potato/taco filling: stir fry one chopped onion, mix in some black beans and corn (half can ea), add the sauce (~2-3tbsp) and stir - finally add chopped tomatoes and mix well. set aside. Use this filling either in taco shells or as topping on potato slices - cut potato in to 1/4inch thick slices. coat with a mixture of olive oil, paprika and little bit of salt. Place slices on a cookie sheet and bake for 15' @ 350 deg. Remove from oven, place ~2tbsp topping mix on top of each potato slice, add some grated cheddar cheese and bake for another 5' until the cheese melts.All of these tasted very good and I liked the added spicy taste.

column9: Not Too Bold, Not Too Spicy
column10: The bottle may make you think this is a salad dressing. It's not. It's a smooth, medium consistency, tangy sauce. It is a little spicy, but not overly so. I haven't tasted anything similar to it at a Taco Bell fast food restaurant. I first tried it on chicken tacos and it was pretty good. Where it really shined, though, was as part of a dip. I added a bit of sour cream, cilantro and finely chopped tomatoes. It was quite good. I would definitely serve it to guests.

This sauce is spicy enough..just doesn't really taste that good.  The texture is creamy as advertised, but I wouldn't pour it on my taco or tortilla chips..ever.  Might be good as a sauce over boneless skinless chicken.  Somewhere in the taste, it makes me feel like mayo has been added..or something I can't identify exactly.  Make yr own salsa, you would be better off.

Smooth and creamy sauce, with a little kick.  Great for nachos, tacos, or any dipping sauce.  I think this sauce would even be good on a burger.  If you are a fan of taco bell, you will enjoy this sauce.  Nice to have the taste of taco bell in your own home.  Spice up any dish with this bold, creamy, spicy ranchero sauce.

I hate to do this but I can not fully review the product.  It arrived already expired and while I know most products are fine for a while past the expiration date (it's usually just a guideline) I am leary of eating an expired product that also traveled via the postal service and spent some time in my hot mail box.  I do see that the average score for this product is 3 1/2 stars so most people seem to like it some.  So instead of blasting a 1 star I'll stick with a more average 2 stars but only because I'm nice ;-)

I enjoyed Taco Bell Bold & Creamy, Spicy Ranchero Sauce,  8-Ounce (Pack of 6) more than their Chipotle sauce. To me it seemed kind of tangy, and as someone else said, a little bit goes a long ways. We had soft tacos the other night and this was a nice complement to the spicy flavor of the (vegetarian) meat.

column9: Spicy but lacks a good flavor
column10: I was very interested in trying this since about once a week I made hard tacos, soft tacos, or a taco salad.As another reviewer stated I received my bottle in October and the bottle stated "Best if used by 30SEP2011".  I would be nervous to buy the product fearing they might be expired. I went ahead and used it and I cannot put my finger on the flavor other than I did not like it. I am not one that likes really spicy sauces. I usually buy mild or medium taco sauce. I used the bold and creamy on a chicken taco wraps and the taste was overpowering, not in a good way. It has a heavy and spicy taste to it that just is not pleasant. I even tried to use it as a dip but still did not like it.It seems reviewers either love it or dislike it, I think you would have to put me in the dislike group. I had high hopes this would compliment the food I make at home but so far it seems to almost ruin the food you use it on. I will say it was spicier than I thought it would be. Again, I do not eat really spicy food but it had a kick to it but not a good flavor. I think there is a lot of room for improvement and what seemed like a good idea Taco Bell seemed to mess up. I would not buy this nor suggest it. I had a friend try it on one of my wraps and he disliked it and he loves spicy foods. He said it was heavy tasting and nasty. I would have to agree.
This sauce has a unique and interesting flavor. It makes a great salad dressing as well. Overall, I recommend and like the fact there are are few ingredients. Enjoy.

This has a slightly sweet, chipotle spice type of flavor, nothing like what I expected. I thought it would taste just like the sauce they use on their tacos but its not. It really didn't add much to the flavor of my taco, it more distracted from the real taco flavors. I didn't care for it but my kids did put it on their tacos and not complain, hence the 3 stars. For me it was just extra calories as it did absolutely nothing for my taco, except make it more creamy.

column4: Elaine Littau "author of Nan's Journey, Elk's...
column10: I didn't know what ranchero sauce was but I thought it was worth a try. Taco Bell Bold and Creamy, Spicy Ranchero Sauce is really good. The taste is spicy, but not overbearing. I enjoyed the smooth creamy elements of the sauce. I think people who love Tex-Mex food will love this product.

I'm so glad Taco Bell decided to market their unique sauces. This gives an unbelievable kick to some lettuce and tomatoes ! Also have spread some on the inside of a toasted cheese sandwich that resulted in an equally bold taste.

I ordered this thru the Vine program because I recently tried another Taco Bell dressing and was pleasantly surprised. I never buy Taco Bell products, and I didn't realize that the dip I was eating was Taco Bell Jalapeno flavor when I tried it at a friend's house. I was excited to see this available on vine, but unfortunately, I found this to taste fake, processed, and not very spicy. I thought my kids may like it with tacos as it wasn't very spicy but they didn't think it tasted good, either.

I thought that Taco Bell Bold and Creamy Spicy Ranchero Sauce had a lot of potential. After all, a number of Taco Bell restaurant menu offerings are quite good, even if not necessarily exceptional.Alas, I was disappointed; sorely disappointed, in fact. Let's start with nutritional information. A two tablespoon serving--- a fairly large serving, actually--- is 110 calories. That's quite a bit, but a smaller serving could control this. The issue is that of these 110 calories, a whopping 100 of them are from fat. That's hardly a healthy makeup.What about flavor? The sauce was creamy in consistency, but it was not creamy in taste; for that matter, neither was it bold or spicy. Our daughter described it as "taco seasoning mixed with lard." That is perhaps a bit harsh as there is no lard in the product, but nevertheless the sauce does have a fatty mouth feel and very little flavor. We tried it on a mixed salad (with onions, etc., to ensure that it would not be over-powered); we also tried it on tortilla chips and cooked ground beef. The results were all the same. There was little flavor and the sauce made the food taste and feel fatty.Though I wanted to like the sauce, I have to say that based on our experience with it, I definitely can't recommend it. It is unhealthy and lacking in flavor, and generally detracts from the food it was intended to enhance.Full disclosure: I really have to point out that the review sample I received was a few days beyond the "best used by" date. Although this wasn't exactly clever marketing to send your expired stock to your reviewers, I doubt if the product had deteriorated much if at all. Still, I mention this because it could have conceivably had an effect, and if you choose to buy the product, by all means be sure you have fresh stock.

This oil is great for adding a little nutty flavor to your dishes along with some great nutrition. Be sure not to cook with it as heating will negate the nutritional properties & refrigerate to prevent the oil from turning rancid. Your friends & family will wonder what is that little something extra in your dishes that makes them taste so good.

column9: Long lasting, and safer in my experience.
column10: My dogs, and many of my client's dogs, inhale regular rawhides.  I was always worried about them swallowing big chunks.And I really hate flavored plastic bones, as well as veggie bones, since I've seen chunks of those being swallowed whole right in front of me a number of times.These have been by far the best solution for me.  It takes the dogs much longer to chew them, and they really have to work at it.  For all my medium to heavy chewers, these are my first choice.Having said that, nothing is 100% safe.  After chewing up most of the bone, a very food motivated chewer could the remaining hard chunk - which could be a serious problem.  That's why I tend to choose the bigger sizes (8" or 10") over the little ones (4"), and take the bone away when it gets to a swallow-able size.  I buy these in bulk.  The value compared to other types of rawhides is huge, even without a bulk discount.These come in flavors also.  This plain style, as well as the the chicken flavored ones, have not been messy at all.  The beef ones are not quite as tidy.

column4: B. Smith "The giant on whoms shoulders your c...
column10: My 6 mo. old large breed puppy really likes these. Its definitely better than a regular rawhide and apparently safer for puppies too. So better value, lasts longer, and safer for your dog. Worth buying.

These bones are amazing and my dogs love them. I have two vigorous chewers so these bones are a much better option than regular rawhides or other treats. They are much more expensive at retailers though, so I love being able to save some money by purchasing them online.

I'm so glad we found out about these. Our 6 month old puppy was going through a bag of chew sticks a day. He is on hour 3 of one of these bones and is only about halfway through it. He has been chewing on it non stop for those 3 hours, too. Off to order some more!

For around thirty bucks I was greeted at the door with a box so full of popcorn kernels, butter salt, and coconut oil that I could barely lift it. The delivery guy sure was confused when I told him "just popcorn stuff" was inside it. Needless to say, the bang-for-buck value of this purchase is not in doubt.Opening it, I was happy to find literally dozens of individual plastic packets of the kernels, oil, and salt, each packet of which containing one serving of each item. The instructions may tell you do dump one entire full packet into your popcorn popper, but that's only if you have HUGE industrial strength machine. I cut servings into thirds.While I'm overjoyed at how much pure product you get, the packets themselves are a bit of a hassle. All the butter salt is stored together within the kernel section of the packet, and it's all mashed at the bottom, almost impossible to get out-- though it's absolutely delicious if you finally manage to. The coconut oil is stored on the other side of the packet, and it pours out easily and conveniently, though I wish it had a seal for easy (and less messy!) storage. Regardless, coconut oil (and this one in particular) absolutely MAKE your popcorn "movie theater grade" popcorn. It's an exact duplicate. The smell alone will transport your senses to your local cineplex.All in all, a very worthy purchase for popcorn fans, movie buffs, and salty treat enthusiasts of all ages, the world over. Quite recommended.

This popcorn is incredible. This is about as close as you can get to the movie theatre. the only downfall is...I can't stop eating it.. Just open the bag and pour everything into the popcorn machine, and wait for it to finish poping....Then you have a perfect batch of popcorn....
The batch we ordered this time was even better than the first batch.  We use it in our Great Northern Lincoln popcorn machine.  It workds great.
The only problem with the popcorn, is that it tasted (or was) stale.  The package is nice since you don't have to measure.
great popcorn!! Will pop better if oil is good & hot steaming hot. Still some old maid's but my popcorn machine has hole's to let them fall thru. Love the pk's all in one container no mess no fuss.
This makes popping popcorn easy - everything's premeasured and the popcorn tastes just like what you get in the theater

The popcorn is nothing special.  It takes longer to pop than regular store bought popcorn.  It didn't pop evenly, leaving a good amount of unpoped kernals as it started to burn the others.  The poped corn dosen't have a great flavor.  We could have saved a lot by simply buying store brand popcorn.  We will not buy this again.

If you want popcorn that is just like the theater and don't want to fool around with measuring cups and oil, then this is the product for you.  Absolutely love the flavor and ease of use.  Was a little concerned about the appearance of the oil (was solidified), but works great.  With my larger 16oz popper, I can feed the entire crowd at one time.  And....you can't beat the price through Amazon.....

column4: G. Michael "What a guy, you know?"
column10: Very tasty popcorn and very simple. Just cut open, dump in a pot and shake and wait. But I will warn you, this much popcorn is hard to get completely popped on the stove-top. I have lots of unpopped kernels every time. I would suggest you buy the smaller bags for stove-top popping. If you have a larger theater-style kettle popper, this is perfect.
Excellent mint tea with great flavor. It's perfect for the holidays. My mother & I got hooked on this when we lived in Germany. I am so happy to find it!

column9: Cream of wheat dumpling soup or Knedle soup
column10: Excellent European taste Dumpling soup for last minute fix up. It takes only ten minutes of boiling time. It's enough for 2 people or as appetizer for 4 people. I usually add my own fresh made dumplings to the soup (mix cream of wheat with egg and some minced parsley and add teaspoonfuls to boiling water); that makes for richer soup.

We've tried so many GF pastas, including making our own. Riso Bello has been the best thus far. Yes, it is a little bit expensive. But, the texture is right, and it holds up as leftovers. One other popular brand I tried had a similar texture, and held sauce well, but no one ever finished an entire bowl - because it had zero taste. Riso Bello has no weird after taste, and while it isn't perfect, it is very good. In fact, I used it to make homemade macaroni and cheese and it was heavenly!
This pasta has all the taste of regular pasta, but none of the gluten.  A person wouldn't be able to tell that it isn't regular pasta upon eating it, and that's really the most important part.
The tea has a great taste and some health benefits, but it is not all that you get from it. It can be a nice entertaiment itself to you and your guests.
Product arrived promptly.  It was given as a gift and my friend liked it.

I was impressed with the speed at which the tea arrived on my doorstep and it was quite flavorful, but the picture shows the "display tea" with a glass tea cup so I mistakenly thought it came with the "display cup."  Upon reading the description closer I see the cup is not mentioned, but I still found the picture itself misleading.  Other than that, it was just what I was looking for and makes a great gift.

The product was cloudy and pale, not dark and clear like true sorghum syrup. The taste and mouthfeel was more reminiscent of gum acacia or gelatin. I was very dissapointed and discarded the material as unappetizing at best. I found another supplier who is a member of the sorghum syrup producers association and displays their logo.

I found Barry farms through amazon and ordered 46 oz of sorghum from their website on 6/25.  After my third email requesting a tracking no. I received an email from postal service stating that the product was being mailed on 7/2.  No responses directly from Barry farms.  I received my order and it was 32 oz quart jar and my invoice states 46 oz. I emailed them again.

I am disappointed with the sorgham from Barry Farms! It has very little sorgham flavor to it. In fact, my daughter said that it tastes more like syrup that you would buy at the grocery store and I tend to agree. Sorgham has a dark brown color and you can't see through it even when you only have a teaspoon full of it. The Barry Farm product is clear enough that you can see through it when you pour it into a pint bottle....Won't be buying any more....M. RobertsLoveland, Co

I searched for a long time yo find sorghum syrup.  After receiving my JUG of Barry Farm  sorghum syrup, I still have not found it!!  It was totally tasteless and goopy.  I spent nearly fifty plus years in the food and food relatedindustry, I've experienced the very best and a good deal of the worst, this product belongs to the latter...enough said!

I was really disappointed with the Sorghum we purchased.  We have been users of it for over 50 years, and have previously had bought it from other vendors, usually from Indiana.  This product, though sweet, did not have the expected molasses taste. It was just too bland.Walter C. Daniels

I ordered a quart of "pure sorghum syrup" and it was delivered in good condition, packaged well, and arrived quickly to my doorstep.  That is where the compliments end.  This was not sorghum.  It was pale and sweet with a weird aftertaste, and had a taste more like karo corn syrup than anything that is like sorghum molasses.  I was very disappointed and had to throw it out since no one would eat it.  If you like karo corn syrup on your pancakes this is for you.  Sadly not for me.

The sorghum syrup arrived promptly, and was also well-packaged. The flavor, however, was far from what I had in mind. My last sample of sorghum was from a farm in Mississippi. But they don't ship. Anywhere. Cash and carry at the mill. Too far from here. This didn't have the texture and appearance I was expecting; it was pale and cloudy and certainly didn't have the flavor. It's hard to taste a product over the internet! But when you pour it over a fresh biscuit, it's flavor improves greatly!

The sorghum was delivered in a timely fashion and well packaged against breakage.  This pure full flavored syrup is old fashioned comfort food, a true taste of Americana.  The only folks I've found that know about sorghum also share my southern heritage.  Nothing goes better on fresh baked bisquits!!!

I haven't had sorghum since I was a child when my grandmother would make pancakes and put sorghum on it. So you can imagine that my memory of the taste carries an emotional attachment. When I tasted this product, it was everything I remembered. It is the highest quality sorghum with the authentic, original taste. For anyone looking for good old fashioned sorghum, look no further. I would not hesitate to order this again.
Barry Farms was very prompt in sending my order of sorghum syrup.  They give very good service and the product is excellent.
This is like down home, forget the molasses and pancake syrup. Sadly, cannot find in San Francisco.
It is very mild and a bit disappointing from the sorghums that I remember from years past.  I will not purchase this brand again.

The packaging for this product proudly proclaims they're organic, dairy-free, gluten-free, vegetarian and "manufactured" with renewable energy. Please note the photo and description of the product does not indicate that the apricots are really organic.  The only reference to organic is in the title of the item.

It ripped in several places that could not be fixed. I had to use it because I did not have a back-up plan.It did not look good. Thankfully my cake and frosting were delicious, so nobody complained about the ripped image. I will probaly not buy another one of the edible images. Sorry! It's such a good idea.
I keep these with me at all times!  They refresh your breath, and aid with digestion, or indigestion.  A must for everyone

When I first began looking for an all natural cat food and found this brand, I chose 3 different flavors with this one being one of them.  My 16-year-old male cat just devours this one in one setting.  The others he always leaves some uneaten but not this one!  I have noticed too that the dry flaky skin he had is no more which is so nice on a black coat.  I think I am leaning towards giving him just this one flavor because he loves it so much and won't shut up until I fill his plate every morning.  Thank you Natural Value for such a great product for our pets!
I've got two cats--one who prefers wet food, and one who prefers dry. Both eat it and like it, and it's gone before it's time for the next feeding.

My cats love this food.  I was disappointed to see the serving size go down to the smallest (3 ounce size).  The first time I ordered it was the larger can for the same price as the 3 ounce.  The service is great.  Great product.

column9: My Picky Eater Likes This Cat Food
column10: Who would have guessed that my picky eater would love this cat food! I bought a few cans while I was on vacation earlier this summer. Now he complains if I serve him anything else. He really seems to like the combination of tuna and chicken with a chicken broth 'jelly' on top.  I like it because I can open a fresh 3 ounce can for each feeding, rather than putting the rest of a bigger 6 once can in the refrigerator for later, where it often gets stale under a snap on lid. Besides, my cat hates cold food. If your feline also is a picky eater - give this cat food a try. In addition, I like the convenience of ordering through Amazon, because my local stores don't carry this cat food.

If I had known this cat food was manufactured in Thailand I would not have ordered it. I can't imagine there's much oversight of pet food production there. There is no mention of Thailand in Amazon's description, but it's stamped in big red letters on the box.I fed one can without knowing - it made my cat sick and there were whole fish vertebra in the vomit.

This is the overwhelmingly the BEST value for this type of canned cat food. All 3 of my cats love it and would easily inhale a can a piece if I'd let them. It finally dawned on me I could purchase human grade canned tuna and chicken, mix them up and it would be considerably less expensive. Alas the convenience factor is the reason I keep this brand on hand. When I'm not in a hurry or feeling lazy I open the human cans and mix. Oh and as a reminder, cats should sparingly be fed tuna due to mercury content. I use one 6 oz canned tuna to a lg. can of chicken.
THe plant did not survive more than a week. Searched the net to explore how to take care of it but to no avail. Not going to buy plants online. disappointed.
I bought this for my friend for his birthday. He was very pleased with the condition it arrived in.  And he has placed it on his desk and it seems to be thrieving quite well.

Our tree lost its leaves and died not long after we purchased it. This could be due to user error or our geographical location (NE PA) but we have other plants and they are fine. It was very cute though while we had it!

I got this almonds for my daughters wedding candy buffet and they look as beautiful as in the picture and they taste so good, there pricey but they are worth it I mixed them with ivory color almonds and it looks just stunning .Now you have to be careful with what almonds you order this are eatable theres some that they been sold cheaper and they are not eatable so be careful . There is plenty of it, but it is not as fragrant or strong as others I've had.  Went for a more economical price; sorry now!
these are real non-pareils, excellent price, arrived in excellent condition, this is bakery quality decorations
This is nice for making the broccoli tops in my Chinese take out cupcakes.  The greens are different shades of dark green.

I paid over $10.00 for a single 4 oz container. I was looking to buy bulk, and mistakenly assumed that for ten dollars, I would receive a 4 pk of non pareils. I know these are sold (online and in stores) for much (much!!) less, so I would suggest checking other vendors on Amazon or elsewhere before purchasing.

I must've missed where it said that these nonpareils came in a pack of SIX. This is way more than I wanted, but I guess you do get a lot for what you pay for. Arrived promptly, no complaints about the product.

The color on these was bright and they stuck well to my buttercream without bleeding.  One cupcake I still had after 6 days did have some bleeding on the red ones but in my experience, cupcakes usually don't last that long!

column9: blue is not true to color!
column10: I ordered the blue non pareils, and they were not the same shade of blue shown in the picture.  The real color is a bit lighter and maybe more "aqua."  When sprinkled on white frosting, they did look a bit darker.  So, they worked for what I need, but the color was still disappointing...
These non pareils are wonderful!  They come in a variety of colors and were exactly what I was looking for.  If you are an Amazon Prime member, they are shipped free!  Quality and Value!

Never received product. Contacted seller asking where my item was and never got a reply back. I had to file a complaint with Amazon to get it investigated and eventually, get my money back. I will never buy from this seller again.
I use this in my espresso maker, mixed with an organic decaf and the flavor combination is my favorite!  Very rich and smooth; I've found no better cups of coffee in any of the coffee shops.

My cat is 8 years old.  She has eaten dry food all of her life.  The past few years she was having more hairballs.  At least once a week she would cough one up.  So, I did some investigating and I decided to switch her over to canned to see if it helped because I was so tired of cleaning them up.  It has helped tremendously!  She doesn't have hairballs anymore and she has put on a little weight.  I think she is much happier with this food as well, she really likes it.  It costs a little more than feeding her dry but it is well worth it!

Before I purchased this product, I have heard that Fox's Glacier Fruits are amazing in that they contain only real fruit juices. Frankly, I thought that this was just an AD designed to entice buyers, but when I ordered it and had a piece of fruit glacier myself, I can certainly understand why so many people are looking for it and raving about it. Unlike other fruit candies whose 'fruit juice' is only about 001% and the rest are just fructose corn syrup, Fox's Glacier Fruits use fruit juice concentrates . As you put one in your mouth, you can certainly taste the wonderful flavors of lemon, strawberry, etc compared to the other candies flavored with 'unnatural flavor ' that mimics the taste of fruits. Try one and see for yourself.

I was very disappointed with this tea, it didn't taste fresh.  It was not delivered in an air tight container and the leaves have very low fragrance and the brewed tea has a poor weak taste.  I felt the decaf teas from Taylor's of Harrogate and Clipper were significantly better.

column9: Do you miss Roman Meal Cream of Rye?  This is close.
column10: Until a couple of years ago, the Roman Meal company distributed a flaked rye cereal called Cream of Rye.  I liked it a lot, and it was a nice break from oatmeal.  It disappeared from stores.This product is pretty close, but not quite there.  The flakes are not as fine as Cream of Rye, and perhaps there was some extra treatment for the Cream of Rye.But if you grind this for a moment or two in a spice grinder, you have something that will do until they bring back Cream of Rye.
The caramel ones tastes great with just hot water!I haven't tried it yet...it may even be better with hot milk...
A cup of this with a dollop of whipped cream is heaven on a cold, damp or snowy, winter evening.  Heaven!

column4: Venus Starlee "Mom of 1 and a bun"
column10: I've gotten the Land O Lakes mint hot chocolate in the variety packs before and this is my favorite flavor, so I thought why not just drink the one I like best.  Actually, I mentioned it to my best friend and she ordered me a case last year for Christmas and I LOVED it!!!

We've had the Land-O-Lakes Supreme, French Vanilla and Graham and all have been excellent.  With numerous others as comparison (Swiss Miss, Nestle, Ghiradelli etc) Land-O-Lakes is the best I've had to date.

This is great hot cocoa!  The cinnamon is probably my favorite, but all the LOL hot cocoa flavors are good.  You can't beat the Amazon price either.  I can buy these at my local grocery store but they're .59 per packet.  Ouch.  A box of 72 lasts quite a while...unless you share, of course :)

column9: Tastes great, wish it were healthier!
column10: "Corn Syrup Solids, Partially Hydrogenated Soybean Oil, Polysorbate 60"It's really good cocoa, and I make it every morning for my husband (he won't drink coffee); we even bring it along on vacation so he can have it. I just wish that list of poisons above weren't included.  I've suggested to Land-o-Lakes that they make a ... "Sweet Nothings" version or whatever they want to call it:  a *totally* unsweetened version, so we can add whatever sweetener we wish to add.The corn syrup is unhealthy in the extreme; the 'partially hydrogenated' means trans fats (and soy is *not* healthy, contrary to the "common" "wisdom"), and the polysorbate has been shown in cosmetics to cause problems (and why is a cosmetics ingredient in a food item?!).That said (er... written), until someone comes up with a healthy product that tastes as good as this stuff does, he's gonna keep drinking these poisons every morning. {sigh}

column9: Supreme Chocolate Makes My Heart Sing!
column10: Instead of creamer and sugar, I add a packet of this to my eight ounces of freshly ground coffee each morning! For a mere 140 calories, I enter bliss! Comparable, both in yummy-ness and nutritionally, to a whole milk Starbucks Mocha Frappuccino®, this Supreme Chocolate mix comes in at 3 grams of saturated fat (30 calories, 14% DV, from hydrogenated soybean oil and coconut oil), 0 trans fat, and 24 grams of sugars (sugar and corn syrup solids). As for price, since I live three hours from the nearest Wal-Mart, the shipped price is actually a little better than I would pay locally, and it arrives practically overnight. The entire box of 72 packets is only 7"x7"x18", and consists of six smaller display type boxes of twelve packets each. These 6"x7"x3.5" display boxes will tuck neatly into the smallest kitchen upper cabinets, and will maintain the individually wrapped single serving packets in a neat upright position. All in all, this is a big luxury for a little price, which is something that makes my heart sing!
Walmart sells these at $0.47 each and these are priced at nearly $0.62 each. Enough said.

column9: This product really calls for 10 stars
column10: This the best hot chocolate I have ever had.  I love this flavor.  I introduced it my niece and she now loves it as well.
I love this flavor, It is the same price as Walmart, but this is easier, plus you get 72, hard to find 72 at walmart all one flavor

column9: An Excellent Cup of Hot Chocolate!!
column10: Being a hot cocoa lover as I am, it's hard to believe I've never tried Land O Lakes Supreme Hot Chocolate until I received it as part of a gift basket. I must say, it was one of the best cups of hot chocolate I've had in a long time.I've tried soooo many different brands....from the most expensive to the least expensive. This ranks up in my top 3...which is a hard place to get to in my eyes (or taste buds?).At approximately $0.40 a serving, this is a great deal.You'll find this hot cocoa rich in taste and quite creamy as well...even though it's simply made with hot water.Make sure you follow the instructions on the packet....6 oz. of water per packet.Go ahead...try it...you won't be disappointed!

On cold winter evening my husband and I enjoy drinking hot chocolate while sitting in front of the fire watching a good movie. This is the best hot cocoa mix we have tried yet ... it is delicious! Of course we also like to add a bit of Bailey's Irish Cream, which makes it even better. YUM!
This french vanilla delight is warm and soothing on a cold winter day, or even a not so cold day.  I first received a few packs as a Christmas gift and was delighted to see it available from Amazon.
i ordered mint chocolate and got supreme. i am very unhappy, becouse you cant return it..

This cocoa is rich and flavorful, nicely chocolately! I only wish I could get the flavors in individual boxes. I love most flavors offered, but would love to be able to get my favorites on their own! I like to give packets as Christmas gifts to people I work with done up with a cute package and winter poem. Everyone seems to love it!

I never get tired of mint chocolate cocoa! Can be pricey, try to catch when on sale or shop around Amazon's vendors for the lowest price. Quick turnaround when ordering, never been disappointed and I order ALOT!

I'm not a huge hot chocolate fan. They all seem to taste alike to me no matter the brand. I happened to get this kind in a mug as a gift. I tried it one night and I love it, love it, love it! It is ssooo good. I have never heard a bad thing about it!

This is the best hot chocolate I've ever had.  It's all my family drinks.  I give packets to people all the time to try and they always LOVE it.  BUT you have to mix it with milk to get the full deliciousness.  I'm never without a stash of this hot chocolate.  I buy it in volume because we drink so much.
Love this hot chocolate and I feel it I got this product at a very good price.People should try it it is delicious and so great to have on a cold winter day or anytime is a good time.

This cocoa dissolves in a nice way without a lot of chocolate clumps at the bottom of the mug. The cinnamon flavor has a 'cozy' aroma/taste. There are several other delicious Land O Lakes cocoa flavors including French Vanilla, Supreme, and Caramel. It's yummo in my tummo ( I find myself saying this a lot when I'm drinking it!). Several months a year the elementary school fundraising company called Market Day features a large box of Land O Lakes cocoa (assortment of flavors) for a much lower cost than in most grocery stores.

Even though sugar free, these candies taste as good as the sugared variety. Good mix of flavors in small packages.

column9: Great product, wish I'd bought this sooner
column10: I've had a recipe for Fattoush Salad for years.  Every once in a while, usually after making a batch of pita bread I'd think about Fattoush and wonder where I could find Sumac (one of the essential and authentic ingredients).  Finally, it occurred to me that I could order it, online!  Duh!  Sometimes I'm slow, so then I looked around, a lot of the other vendors on here were offering truly hugemongous amounts of Sumac and my recipe calls for just one teaspoon, what would I do with a pound?Also, I wasn't sure if I would like the taste of sumac.  The descriptions I read for it said it was 'lemon-y, but not bitter, sherbet-y (sherbet flavored herbs??) anyways, I just couldn't be sure if it would be tasty to me and I wasn't willing to risk much on a bottle of herbs that I might end up tossing.Well, from the moment I opened the bottle, I knew I liked sumac.  It is a little citrus-y smelling, but I also recognized the smell, it is mouth puckeringly familiar, it smells like A-1 Steak Sauce to me, or rather, the one ingredient I could never completely identify, tart, savory with a fruity punch.  I don't mean to go all smarmy-foodie about this, but I am feeling rather enthusiastic about this, new-to-me, spice.Okay, so onto product packaging. my spice came in a plastic bottle, not a resealable bag.  The bottle was sealed and the seal was unbroken.

column9: A divine little berry, for every kitchen
column10: I was unfamiliar with Sumac until I started experimenting with Middle Eastern cuisine. I didn't even know that it is actually a ground berry, or how popular it is as a spice. I stumbled upon a tempting recipe for Fattoush. I knew I had to give it a try, but success depended on the integral ingredient --- ground Sumac. I began my search locally, to no avail, but Amazon's gourmet pantry came to the rescue.I know how much 4 oz is, but I was surprised at the nice quantity of product I received. It was plenty for me to begin to play with and complete many dishes. But, I was unsure of what I was getting myself into.  Would I like it?  First I had to taste a little dab on my finger.  I immediately recognized the taste sensation from some of my dining out experiences, because of the uniqueness of the flavor --- one hard to describe, but very pleasing. I was glad to finally have identified just what that flavor was.Totally enthused, I immediately gathered items to prepare Fattoush. It was simply prepared and just as fantastic as I had hoped. Afterward, I began experimenting with multiple food items. This is a spice that can go cross-cultural.  It kicks popcorn up a notch, and is even delicious on a baked potato, or sprinkled on deviled-eggs for a twist, instead of typical Paprika. And, be prepared, it might be a conversation starter with friends and family who have never experienced the flavor.I can see Sumac becoming my go-to spice, for taste enhancement of many foods.  And, you don't need to have all the fixings for Fattoush, to have a delectable salad.  Just use your favorite salad ingredients, drizzle with a little quality olive oil, a squeeze of lemon, and sprinkle with Sumac. Perfect! The Sumac just seems to enhance all the other flavors.  And, it's sure healthier than drowning that salad in a quarter cup of Ranch dressing.  Yes, it's a spice that every kitchen, and diet, could benefit from. Give it a try, and enjoy.
i bought sumac to make the fattouch salad I was making for authentic,wouldnt have been the same without it,gives it a nice sweet flavor,especially the dressing,now Im looking for other ways to use it

This spring has been unusually warm and it appears that the dogs may have fleas.After vaccuuming, applying flea protection to the dogs, and spraying the carpet and furniture with Mycodex, the fleas seem to be gone.  One can did cover the square footage that was listed on the can.Time will tell how effective everything has worked but the itching and scratching are gone and everyone seems much healthier!

You can purchase this online at a very resonable price.  It is VERY effective against fleas in the home. I generally use it once a year in the Spring and have NEVER had fleas in my home.  Minimal odor and safe on all fabrics I have sprayed it on.

I used the Mycodex Plus on furniture and baseboards for a dog and cat flea infestation.  One of the items I sprayed was a 6 foot tall cat tower with 5 perches.  The cat won't go on it now. column9: Mycodex Plus Environmental Control Aerosol Household Spray
column10: Very effective at getting rid of indoor flea problem (moderate severity) in the Midwest.  Light smell - less intense & less chemically smell than Raid Flea Killer Plus Room & Carpet Spray.  Do not yet know how well this product works on eliminating fleas long term as it's only been a couple of weeks.  Dog had no problem using his dog bed after his bed was sprayed & aired.If you need a fine mist & are covering a small area (e.g., just pet bed/furniture), this spray nozzle could be better (Raid Flea Killer Plus nozzle allows for more even mist as per instructions).  The sprayer of my first can was defective squirting splatters/gobs of foam randomly rather than a mist (e.g., splattering foam gobs onto the walls 10 inches away rather than the carpet even while can was pointed down at the ground).  Had to get a 2nd can (the seller sent new can right away at no charge).  I prefer the flea spray for covering carpets, rooms & pet furniture to the flea powder/granules as some people experience breathing issues from the fine airborne particles of the powder/granules long after vacuuming.

Mycodex Plus Environmental Control Aerosol Household Spray is amazing.The basement was full of fleas this year. One can sprayed onto the basement floor took care of the problem. Other products have been tried, as well as flea bombs having been set off. Nothing else seemed to work. This stuff is A Plus. Would definitely use again if ever there was a need.

Here it is 2 months later and I still got fleas hopping around my place....nothing seems to be really working...I used this first so I wouldn't have to bomb the joint but I ended up still having to bomb the place..I've bought/used everything I could think of...and they just won't die...I'm ready to call in the air force to drop a real bomb on the joint....smdh!!!

column9: Absolutely the Best Tea for colds
column10: This is the BEST tea for colds. The blend of herbs (peppermint, chamomile, fennel, thyme, Iceland moss, licorice root, lungwort, star anise, marigold, yarrow root, elder flowers, lime leaves, cyani flowers, cowslip, mullein flowers, malva flowers) and oils (Peppermint and Eucalyptus) is soothing and comforting.
