I actually found myself liking it and think I will continue to buy it...  I use this in my Keurig My K-cup (with an added grommet to help the seal) and it is as good if not better than many of the Keurig extra bold coffees at a much reduced cost... Definitely worth your giving it a try...Update:  I am on my second bag and this coffee has really grown on me - I find I now prefer it to Starbucks and actually everything else I've tried.  I will continue to buy it through the "subscribe and save" option: great price - free shipping - great coffee - what more could you want...

I can't tell the difference from Starbucks french roast. My wife likes it too and she's a little high-maintenance in the coffee department, although she puts so much cream in it I don't know how she can tell. Good price and fast delivery with Subscribe and Save.Update 9-19-2012: Change to Subscribe and Save makes this option less convenient. Now you need to wait until your monthly shipping date to get delivery or else pay shipping and lose your discount if you want it sooner.

I have a capresso machine and love french roast coffee.  Cameron's organic is good, but not nearly as good as Starbucks French Roast.  The best beans I have tried are the French Roast from Steaming Bean Coffee Company in Colorado.

column9: Average coffee not worth the price
column10: Coffee is fairly bland, beans are medium roasted and not very oily.  Store brands at places like Costco and Sams are superior for a little more than half the price.

column9: Great Coffee and WAY cheaper than Starbucks!
column10: My husband and I both drink plenty of coffee and we like it strong.  Starbucks coffee is so expensive so being the bargain hunter I am, I decided to try this one.  I was pleasantly surprised ... it is good, strong coffee for a fraction of the price, especially w/ Amazon's subscribe and save program!  Highly recommended!

Another homerun for Cameron's. This Whole Bean Intense French Coffee was more than I expected. By that I mean the taste was intensly good!I really enjoy being able to grind my own coffee beans. The first things I noticed with Cameron's was just how fresh they tasted.I will be back for more that's for sure.
Pretty good stuff. It's a French Roast, but not as strong as "Dark French Roast". Don't be afraid to try it.

Being a "gourmet" coffee lover since the mid-80's, my two favorite roasts were French and Kenya AA.  Recently, as brands have changed I've been unable to find one that recaptures the aroma and flavor of those early favorites.  In the case of French Roast, my search is over. Cameron's Intense French is just what 'normal' French used to be.  If you like bold flavored French Roast, you won't be disappointed.

WHAT A GREAT CUP OF COFFEE. WE GRIND OUR OWN EACH MORNING, AND THIS FRENCH ROAST IS THE BEST WE HAVE TRIED. VERY DARK, RICH AND FLAVORFUL WITHOUT THE BITTERNESS. THANK YOU AMAZON FOR OFFERING THIS COFFEE AT A AFFORDABLE PRICE. WHAT A WAY TO WAKE UP!
Price and quality are always good.  Hearty, rich coffee flavor without over- or undertones.  Consistent.  Recommended for first cup of the morning - save the subtlety for later.
we have buying our coffee here for over a year. it comes quicly. there have been no problems. more impotant i still have the morning coffee. thanks

column4: Big Ben "There's more to living then making one."
column10: If you add anything but your lips to this coffee you should not have it. You'll just ruin the greatest tasting coffee I have ever tried. Cameron's Intense French Whole Bean Coffee, 32-Ounce Bag

I'm still trying to find a replacement for First Colony French Roast coffee which hopefully will again be available on Amazon.  In the meantime, the Cameron's Intense was one of the 5 different coffees I've purchased in the last couple of months.  It's okay, but not great which means I'm in the minority of the reviewers on Amazon.

Cameron's "Intense French" is definietly richer than their regular French Roast.  It can be brewed strong--the way we like it--in our drip coffee maker without becoming bitter.  Perhaps not the most complex of flavors, however, it is an excellent product for the price.  We will order again.

Great,great,great! Cameron's Intense French is one of the best dark roast coffee's I've ever tried. I prefer dark roast coffee's because I like a stronger more full bodied cup of coffee. Cameron's score high marks for taste,richness and smoothness. This is a full bodied cup of coffee that's good any time of day. At fifteen dollars for a 32 oz bag this an outstanding value. This one will be high on my list of preferences. This is one reason I continue to make the majority of coffee purchases from Amazon.

I generally purchase Jeremiah's Fogbuster for a strong and rich French Roast coffee however I wanted to check out this brand and see whether it was any good (the price was right).  I'm pretty disappointed.  While the coffee is strong, it lacks depth and richness.  Unlike Jeremiah's, I found it lacking in flavor.  I would not buy this coffee again.

column9: The Perfect Green Tea and No Caffeine Either
column10: *****This Simply Decaf Green Tea from Yogi Tea is a plain, but far from ordinary green tea. The taste is incredible. It is definitely the best green tea I have ever tasted---green tea as it always should be---full of flavor and freshness!I am definitely impressed with this tea and with Yogi Teas in general. Simply Decaf Green Tea comes with an expiration date (a good thing, because it's not full of preservatives, plus you can tell if it is fresh). Yogi Tea seems to be another company (like Numi, Aspen, Traditional Medicinals) that values sustainable and healthy practices. Their web site, yogitea.com, is beautifully designed, with info about each tea they make.According to Yogi Tea, this tea is 100% organic and is intended to enhance the immune system and to fight fatigue by providing antioxidants. Note that Yogi makes a Simply Green Tea, too, that contains 58mg of caffeine (compared to 90mg in an 8oz cup of coffee).Highly recommended. In the case of this tea, simplicity is bliss!*****
This is a wonderful tea.  Even when I steeped it longer than the recommended 3 minutes (more like 6-7), it did not taste bitter.I really need a decaf tea so this is why I chose it.Highly recommended!

*****This Simply Decaf Green Tea from Yogi Tea is a plain and simple, but far from ordinary green tea. The taste is incredible! It is definitely the best green tea I have ever tasted---green tea as it always should be---full of flavor and freshness! It is hard to believe there is no caffeine, as this tea tastes so pure and flavorful.I am definitely impressed with this tea and with Yogi Teas in general. Simply Decaf Green Tea comes with an expiration date (a good thing, because it's not full of preservatives, plus you can tell if it is fresh). Yogi Tea seems to be another company (like Numi, Aspen, Traditional Medicinals) that values sustainable and healthy practices. Their web site, yogitea.com, is beautifully designed, with info about each tea they make.This tea is 100% organic and is intended to enhance the immune system and to fight fatigue by providing antioxidants, according to Yogi Tea. Note that Yogi makes a Simply Green Tea, too, that contains 58mg of caffeine (compared to 90mg in an 8oz cup of coffee), if you are open to caffeine. Either way, you can't go wrong.Highly recommended. In the case of this tea, simplicity is bliss!*****
My husband has talked about how this was his favorite ceral growing up. Needless to say how excited I was to find it on Amazon. He literally went gaga over me when he saw that this was his gift.
I loved this cereal growing up and still eat and enjoy it to this day,Good stuff, and good price! Can't find it locally anymore,Thanks Amazon

This isn't a bad deal for 4 boxes under 10 bucks. It tastes just the same as it always has since the 70's. At least to me anyway, and I grew up with it. It is still available in stores like Jewel but its seasonal. So if you can't find it in your area you can order here on amazon. I never had an issue with the expiration dates, but its always good to check in advance just in case.Its almost October and Halloween, so this is a must for the kids to have a little fun and get in the holiday spirit.

We got all three on subscribe and save (about 2 dollars a box). Of course the kids twin 3 yr olds love them all, mommy likes Chocula, I am split between Boo and Franken. Dates on the box expire April 2012. These will last a long time as we do not normally eat sugary cereals.

been eating this since i was a kid and can not get enough of it. it is sad that amazon and some other sites gouge you when it gets out of season. one joker here on amazon is charging $55 for 12 boxes. should be ashamed of themselves
This was my FAVORITE cereal growing up and now I can't find it in the stores anywhere, Thank Heavens for Amazon.

Part of a balanced breakfast, Frankenberry is a delicious addition to any morning.  Or have it as a random treat throughout the day.  Sneak a box into the movie theater, its a great substitute for movie candy.  All around, Frankenberry is a fantastically delectable concoction.

I absolutely LOVE these two cereals, but was highly disappointed that when I received them to see the expiration date is 8/25/12. That's only a few weeks away. I bought 8 boxes total- 4frankenberry & 4booberry. I opened one of each & I can tell the flavor is off, considering its old. How would I go through 8 boxes before they expire? If would have been nice to know that up front.
Guess I don't understand how i could get 12 boxes earlier for the same price as 4 boxes now? Was shipped in a timely manner, arrived by date they gave. Great service.
I'm having trouble detecting any berry flavor. I believe flavorists have gotten better since the 1970's. Unfortunately this cereal has not.

column9: Kinda cloying (which I expected, but normally enjoy).
column10: Maybe it's since I didn't grow up with (or even aware of) the stuff, but I couldn't really get behind it. Happy I went S&S with it during the Monster Cereal 'season', but ended up gifting most of the shipment to others.Ultimately: Berry Kix with 'mallows.

Introduced to the tea by South African expatriates, I was immediately impressed.  It's not a novelty, though, but has staying power:  I've brought this tea to work in a thermos every day this year and loved it every day, and throughout the day.  Smooth and flavorful and not bitter, it is easily sweetened and stays delicious in a good thermos all day.

I had this tea while on safari in Africa and loved it.  Searched all over to find it and thought it was the same tea, but flavor was bland...and didn't live up to my memories.  Adding a second tea bag helped slightly, but still fell short in flavor.  I'm not sure if it's the same manufacturer or if it's a lesser quality maker than what I had in South Africa.  Wouldn't buy it again....

I discovered this tea on travels to southern Africa.  It is wonderful, naturally sweet, never bitter even if you forget the tea bag in the pot. It makes super ice tea.  I just wish this was more available in stores in the US.

column4: Matulich, S. L. "Nduna, Inkozosana and Cheyen...
column10: This is the only tea I drink.  I have tried all these fancy fruit, lipton's, Indian teas, and what-nots.  Total waste of taste bud use.  5 Roses - it is smooth, soothing and has a delightful taste.
Really recommend this tea.  Fragrant jasmine and quality organic green tea. One of my favorite brands!
Big pieces, very consistent quality. It baked up well. Not too much juice. Good flavor and consistency. Would buy again.

My doctor suggested I use this instead of sugar or honey whereever I would use them.  I have now used this from my tea in the morning to baking.  Add to homemade icetea and homemade applesauce and cookies.  It's WAY better for you, very sweet (like honey) and buying thru Amazon made it cost effective.  Will NEVER go back to sugar!~

I like the taste of agave, it has a maple/honey combo taste to it. Great on cereals, fruit, frozen yogurt, etc. Better than syrups that are overly sugary and too sweet. Agave has a good balance of sweetness and taste.
Received the desert rose rather quickly. Nicely packed and was quite larger than I expected. Is growing quickly and am anxious for it to bloom.

I bought this as a gift for my father because he loves Hot Dog bubble gum, but when I got them they were not the original flavor that I ordered as it says in the description. Instead I got cinnamon flavor which is not as good as the original gum. I was very dissapointed and the packaging was really crappy. Had it been the original bubble gum I order as it said in the description it would have been fine. Also I tryed to contact the sellers and could not get in touch with them. I sent emails to them about my problem as well and never got a reply. Never ordering again!! Sad deal.

Despite Amazon sending me a replacement order for these, they still came broken (I can only guess that the manufacturer sends them already broken and it's not Amazon's fault).Also, these are NOT spring rolls but rice crackers that you either bake, microwave or fry (they puff up and it's fun to watch them turn into puffy crackers from flat rice paper). One rice cracker round takes about 2 minutes on high in the microwave to puff into a big rice cracker. Children would definitely get a kick out of watching these magically morph into funky rice bonnets (they look like Amish hats to me once they transform).Unfortunately, these were a little on the stale tasting side but still edible with some dips or fillings.I'm curious to try the shrimp ones as my Korean friend told me that those actually have the best flavor.
Truly wonderful Genmaicha tea. Perfect balance of rice and tea. Smooth and totally addictive. Great price, too.

I love genmaicha tea, so I was happy to find some in tea bags for drinking at the office. Unfortunately, the roasted rice flavor in this tea is very mild. I find myself using two tea bags to get a decent mug of tea.Even worse, the bags are not great. Most of them have small holes in them, allowing the tea to leak out. I've taken to grabbing my trusty office stapler, locating the hole, and stapling it closed before brewing the tea. Because of this, I will not be repurchasing.

column9: Quite tasty with a decent nutritional profile
column10: I tend to have quick breakfasts on the run before work in the mornings, so I often rely on quick, easy foods like bars.  However, I avoid traditional breakfast bars, which tend to be high in sugar and have little-to-no protein.  Rather, I want something that is going to start my day with a better nutritional value AND contain a decent amount of protein to keep me feeling full longer.  The other problem is that it's breakfast--I don't want chocolate!  Maybe true chocoholics eat chocolate at any time of the day, but I prefer something a bit more appropriate to the morning hours.So, after Slim-Fast changed their bars on me (loved their old Oatmeal Raisin Optima bars, but really don't like the new version), I decided to try these meal replacement bars by Special K in Honey Almond.  First of all, when I checked out the box, these bars met my nutritional requirements.  They have 10 grams of protein, which is almost as much as some bars specifically billed as protein/energy bars.  They are a good source of fiber as well, with 5 grams.  Also, the sugar is relatively low at 12 grams (just over 2 teaspoons).  Finally, although the fat content is a bit higher than I would have liked (6 grams), these bars contain only 2.5 grams saturated fat (no trans fat), so most of the fat is probably healthy fats from the almonds.Of course, the final test of these bars is the taste:  they are yummy!  They are chewy, with a pleasant almond-y flavor that is not too sweet (an unfortunately problem that I've found with so many bars I have tried).  These have become one of my new breakfast staples, and I definitely recommend them.

This is a great grab and go product for meal replacement. Very tasty! I carry one in my purse for those times when I can't stop for a meal. I also eat them for breakfast quite a bit.I've tried most of the meal replacement bars out there and Special K's versions are, hands down, the best.  This one is one of their best efforts to date. Goes great with a cup of coffee! :)

These bars are slightly less calories than slim-fasts bars and typically provide a bit more protein.  I use them in combination with some fruit or dairy for breakfast or as a larger snack mid-morning or mid-afternoon.  The yogurt covering adds to the good taste and makes the bar filling and satisfying.  Subscribe and save to make the price very reasonable and shipping convenient.

column9: Love, Love these meal replacement bars
column10: I have lost a total of 63 pounds since June of 2010.  I have used the meal replacement bars for two meals a day and then a regular meal at night.  I have tried all of the favors and the only one that I do not particulary care for is the strawberry.  Since I have a sweet tooth and I love chocolate, the others are all very tasty.  I have not gotten tired of the meal replacement bars at all.I would recommend these bars to anyone trying to follow a diet.

I am a guy who had surgery, requiring me to have at least 80 grams of protein a day, which is a ton! These bars are a god send! They taste great, fill you up, and not too terrible with the other nutrition marks. The Almond and Choc. Chip are my two absolute favorates!

My husband and I both love these. They're great as a meal replacement or a snack, and they taste wonderful! Hubby has been using these along with protein shakes and has lost over 100lbs! We also like the Chocolate Peanut Butter flavor a lot.

Great for on the go! I usually keep 1 or 2 in my purse.  My 12 year old son eats them on his way to school or before basketball practice.  They are very tasty and it's hard to find a bar with this much protein. I buy 6 boxes at a time.
THIS BAR DID NOT MEET MY EXPECTATIONS.  IT HAS A SLIGHT BITTER TASTE.  I WOULD NOT BUY IT AGAINI DO NOT RECOMMEND IT TO ANYONE THAT IS EXPECTING A GOOD TASTING ALMOND BAR,

I love these bars for breakfast. So happy that Special K makes something not covered in chocolate. I don't want a lot of sugar in my breakfast, and I am not a chocoholic. These are perfect. They don't taste "protein-y" like many of the bars on the market.

I grab one of these every morning with my coffee. The peanut butter ones are good too but these are my favorite. I have even used them as a lunch substitute when I haven't had time to fix myself something. They taste great! :)

column9: It's good, the bars are good
column10: It's good, it's pretty good, the wife loves them, my kids love them.  But chocolate Peanut butter is cheaper and tastes better.

These are one of the best special k bars we have tasted.  These are loaded with about 12-15g of protein which is great for everyones diet.  They are large enough to be a meal replacement while on a reduced calorie diet.

column9: Not the best of the Special K line
column10: These bars are OK.  They are better than many diet bars, but not as good as most in the Special line.  The picture on the box is deceiving.  There is no white layer on the bottom of the bar.  It is just made up of what is on pictured as the top layer- with a thin milky honey-like coating on the bottom and drizzled over the top.  I do not find them as satisfying as the chocolate peanut butter bars.

My grandfather emigrated here from Italy in 1925 he worked in a Italian store making salami's. The Columbus hot calabrese salami is authentic Italian salami, it is if not the best tasting salami in America today.

I loved the flavor and strength of the Green Mountain Breakfast Blend.  Since the fully caffinated Breakfast Blend was not available on Amazon, I shopped for the next best thing.  I thought it would be a great idea to purchase the 1/2 caff, and perhaps I would get the same great flavor, same milder coffee and quality as the regular Green Mountain I was used to (with half the caffine).  WRONG.  Although still a perfectly drinkable coffee, the 1/2 caff seems to be a darker roast and not nearly as mild as the fully caffinated Breakfast Blend. Actually tasted bitter, as compared to it's fully caffinated counterpart. Priced well and free shipping as an Amazon Prime member, so that's a plus. I won't throw it out, but did go right out shopping for the Breakfast Blend I was used to.  This box of Half-Caff will be for "emergency" use for me.
I am trying to decrease my caffeine intake and this coffee is perfect for it...it tastes great and still has a good amount of caffeine but not too much

column9: Green Mountain Half Caff  K Cups
column10: Since we switched our coffee maker to the Krieg K Cup system recently, we have tried almost all the K Cups that are offered and my wife keeps coming back to the Green Mountain Half Caff K Cups.  Its her favorite, so thats what we will keep ordering.  Thanks Amazon, for the great service.

I needed a half-caff coffee to use in my Keurig to get me thru the afternoon (but not keep me up all night).  This coffee does do the job.The only negative is a matter of my own taste.  I MUCH prefer dark roasted coffee, and this is definitely light-to-medium.  Tastes like Denny's coffee.  Just fine, not earth-shattering...My very favorite K-cup coffee is Obsidian (by Caribou) - to get a sense of what I wished it tasted like!

I've been percolating coffee for 30+ years. To me, there is nothing like a percolator for a really good, HOT cup of coffee. However, even though I only drank two cups per day, if I missed my morning java, I would get one of those 'caffeine headaches;' not very pleasant. So, about 10 years ago, I started mixing equal parts of regular and decaffeinated coffee, thus solving my problem; I could still get a little caffeine boost without the withdrawal. Then we got a Keurig at work, and while I really liked the convenience, I didn't want to go back to 100% caffeineated coffee. I tried two different decaf K-Cup flavors and they were terrible. Then I heard about Half-Caff. It's delicious; a perfect blend of caffeine & decaf, and dare I say, just as good as my percolated coffee, which I never imagined. Actually, I have to say its better because of the convenience. In short, because of Half-Caff, I bought a Keurig for my house, and Half-Caff is the only flavor K-Cup I use (I don't like flavored coffee) Highly recommended! Well, gotta go have my coffee now...
This coffee is ok, but I wish they could make a decaf and half caf that had the flavor of regular coffee. It sort of has a slight maple taste to it.

I am very pleased with my purchase of the Green Mountain coffee Half-Caff K- cups. They arrived in a very timely manner and the packaging was excellent. These K-Cups are a great alternative to caffeine free coffee. It has much more flavor, still not as good as regular coffee but now I can drink coffee in the evening and not worry about falling asleep when I go to bed. Great!
Good cup of coffee and less caffeine.finally found one that I like and my guests like as well.The price was also very good.
A good 8oz cup of coffee.  Rich and satisfying with only half the caffine.  An option not particularly easy to find in retail stores.
This is the best way to buy coffee for my office. Least expensive way to buy convenience with harder to find flavor and brand.  I also buy this way for home.
Great coffee!  Love all Green Mountain coffee and all the wonderful flavors.  Would and do recommend this coffee to all my friends.
If you must cut down on caffeine as I did, you will enjoy the wonderful full flavor of Green Mountain Half Cafe
I like this product. Half Caff fixes the dilemma of too much caffeine with great taste. Product came in a timely manner and in excellent condition.
This is a wonderful cup of coffee.  I usually drink my favorite full-bodied blend in the am, but I have a cup of this as a follow up, to get some great flavor but less caffeine.  Love it!
Flavor is fairly good. I got this because sometimes full caf, regular coffee is too much. This works great and I don't get the over-caffinated feeling.  Will definately buy again.

I recently purchased the Caribou k-cups and this coffee came along with it. While I don't like it as well as the Caribou, it's not a bad tasting coffee. It's a very smooth coffee with no bitter aftertaste. And surprisingly I cannot tell that it only has half the caffeine. I usually get a headache if I don't get enough caffeine in the morning. I got no headache or any other side-effects from caffeine withdrawal. I will probably purchase this in the future.

I have no choice but to drink "half caff" since my stomach does not deal well with full caff anymore.  So this is the only half caff product I could find.  Honestly, it tastes very watered down.  I don't like it but have no choice.  It's either this, or no coffee at all.  Please make it stronger.  Thank you.

I normally drink half-caff and am very pleased with it, but after trying a sample of the Tully's French Roast decaf that came in a variety pack, I was truly AMAZED at the flavor.  I anticipated it being bland, not much taste but I was sooo wrong.  The flavor is so rich and robust that a couple times I checked the box to confirm it was actually decaffinated! Although I will continue to drink the half-caf, this product has taken the #1 spot on my coffee list!
Love the half caff k cups. I like the auto delivery plan. This way I never run out of them
This is our Keurig coffee 'go to' blend for most mugs of coffee. That's why we ordered the 50 count box. It's flavor is balanced enough to enjoy hot or over ice.

column9: Hard to find but worth it
column10: I see K-cups everywhere but not these. Found them once a while ago and haven't been able to replenish till now. I love these because although i am a coffee fiend (they did a blood test a while ago and found 90% coffee) I want to have these when I only need one cup and really don't want to be anything more than semi-concious. They are great for people who get the shakes from coffee also. I prefer really brewed pots of coffee but these are a great substitute when I only have time for a cup and really need to get back to sleep in a couple of hours. Great taste, expensive like all K cups but not bad if you only drink a couple of cups. Well worth keeping on hand.
Half caff makes a great cup of coffee at home in our Keurig - it is somewhat expensive for making coffee at home.  The consistency makes it worthwhile.

I will only buy coffe for my Kurig from Amazon.The product is always consistent in quality and taste.  I have bought k-cup coffe through Amazon.  You can not beat the price nor the efficiency in delivery.

Got for my fiance and she loves the taste, and the half calf is much easier for her to handle than a full caff, and it doesn't make her fall back to sleep like the decaf does.Before switching to half caff she was drinking Dark Magic, so if you want so switch to half caff from that, this might be a good one to try.
This coffee is perfect for those that was some decaf and some regular coffee and is popular with friends and a good item to have ready to serve guests

So glad to see this at a decent price at Amazon. Not easy to find Half Caff. I would even buy this in a larger quantity box.  Plus shipping was FREE. What more can you ask for. Green Mountain is my favorite and Amazon makes i happen.
Excellent coffee that provides the best of both worlds! Very smooth, and medium bodied! Great cup of coffee when you only need or want half of the caffeine shot!
I love these little 1/2 caff cups.  Great flavor as I had in my drip machine, shopped around for best price, and am happy with my purchase.

column9: Tastes good and the caffeine content serves a purpose...
column10: I've been drinking this coffee for a few months now and it's not my first choice in terms of taste but it still tastes good and it's helped lower my caffeine intake which is what I am mainly concerned with.  I switched to this coffee after I found out I was pregnant and was told to have no more than 200mg of caffeine a day.  I emailed the company directly at the time and was told that "The relative caffeine content in a 6oz brewed cup of Half Caff is 48-53mg" so it met my needs perfectly! I would recommend this product if you're not looking to give up coffee altogether but still want to reduce your intake.
This is a very good tasting coffee for being half-caf. I like this because I have to watch caffine because of my stomach. I will be ordering more, the taste is very good.
The product was over priced. You can buy it at a number of discount stores at a better price. And they are over priced.If you do the math, it cost over $10 a pound.
Coffee is ok but don't know whether I will reorder or not.  Rather weak but if your machine has the water level setting, I would suggest that you use one of the smaller cups.

We really enjoy Green Mountain coffee and their fair trade practices.  Our coffee of choice in the morning is a half caffeine type and we have found Green Mountain's Half-Caff to be THE BEST.  When you can get free shipping then this really becomes a good deal and well worth trying if you have not yet.  Highly recommend Green Mountain Coffee Half-Caff.

column9: Great Buy and the Price is Right!
column10: we've been devout Folgers coffee drinkers for over 35 years and never thought we'd switch brands. after my husband had a bout of heart problems, he was told to go to decaf coffee or stop drinking it, which wasn't an option. we started buying the Folgers half caff and he cut back to 2 cups a day. when i bought the keurig coffee maker Keurig B70 Platinum Brewing System i switched to the Green Mountain Breakfast Blend Green Mountain Coffee Breakfast Blend, 24-Count K-Cup for Keurig Brewers (love it) and bought the ekobrew refillable k-cup Ekobrew Cup,Refillable K-Cup For Keurig K-Cup Brewers 2-Pack - BROWN $ GREEN for him and his Folgers half-caff.on a whim, i decided to buy a small box of the Green Mountain half-caff k cups for him to try. i was very nervous about it because he's such a die-hard Folgers kind of guy. since i don't care for decaff coffee i didn't want to have to drink it if he didn't like it. he took a couple big drinks of the coffee and i finally asked him how he liked it. he said he liked it a lot, and thought it was much better than the Folgers half-caff, it seemed to have a lot more flavor. phew!in fairness to Folgers half-caff ground coffee, the reason he may think the Green Mountain half-caff has more flavor could be because of how much of the Folgers he used to make a cup. with these refillable k-cups it doesn't seem to be an exact science, so one cup could be a bit stronger or weaker than the next. i think this is what he was saying. because the Green Mountain k-cups are accurately pre-measured, you get the same taste in every cup.the bottom line is, he loves the Green Mountain half-caff coffee, and we will definitely be buying more of it. i asked him if he wanted to try the Folgers half-caff keurig coffee and he said, "ummm, i don't know". for a hard-core coffee drinker to be ok with that kind of change says a lot about the GM half-caff coffee. as least it speaks to me of how great this coffee is.

I have a sensitive stomach and can't take those fire-blasted, carbonized roastings that a lot of coffee has been subjected to, so when I saw a medium roast, I wondered if it would be a true, flavorful medium roast or charred beans with a toasted outside.  I also am trying to cut back on caffeine.  So it seems that this coffee is tailor made for me!I have a cup of this every morning and I love it!  Great flavor, not much acid, clean aftertaste and enough of a jolt to get going without so much caffeine I get the jitters.I'll definitely be ordering this in the 50-pack boxes!
This coffee tastes so good we have completely given up going out for coffee.  Love the ease of the product and Amazons fast shipping with Prime

This is a great tasting coffee.  By the taste alone, it would be difficult, if not impossible to tell that it has only half of the caffeine of their other great tasting coffee.  While in the brewing process, the aroma fills the air leading a person to anticipate the reward at the end of the brewing cycle.  If a person does not want the caffeine, this is the coffee for them.

You actually have me listed as purchasing a different item.  I purchased the 72 count not the 24count, which is a much better deal.  Hope that you offer the larger quantities more often.  Love the half/caff - just enough kick and great tasting.
It's really nice to find a half caff in the k-cups.  This is a nice balance with great flavor would highly recommend.
I have made my husband happy with the Green Mountain Coffee Half-caff. It sure makes my life a whole loteasier!
A very good coffee.  Great taste, great flavor for only having half the caffiene - husband loves.  Keep up the fantastic job of adding new items Amazon!!

column9: Great smooth cofffe, not too much caffeine.
column10: I am not allowed to have too much caffeine as it sets my heart arrythmias off . However, no matter what decaf I tried I hated the taste. I have been using this for a month now, and not only is it fantastic tasting, there are no jitters or no caffeine effects like with pure coffee. This tastes so delicious and I can have several cups in the morning. Also Amazons price cannot be beat.
Not too dark, not too light, not too harsh and not to caffeinated.Makes the perfect cup of coffee. Bought from Amazon and received in 2 days with Prime. Great price too.

This is going to be a staple in my house from now on- good flavor, less jitters, makes a great 'anytime' coffee. Decaf can be so uninspiring.I wish they would make flavored half caf....are you listening, Green Mountain..
I am a coffee person and had to cut back on the caff- when I found that the K-Cups had half the Caff I Tried it and it is great. Thank you
I am cutting back on the jitters, so this Half-Caff satisfies with a wonderful robust flavor!Will definitely order again.  Great price at Amazon.com!

Love this coffee, most k-cups are stronger than we are used to having with a regular coffee pot. So this is perfect. Can even get a couple of extra uses out of it for other cups of coffee. Good prices on Amazon for k-cups!
It is hard to find this type of K-cups..  It is very convenient to have these delivered to our door.  Great taste too!
When I want a second cup of coffee I love the half-caff! It's just the right amount of caffeine for me without the jitters.

column9: Less caffeine and still tastes good.
column10: For a while when I first got my Keurig I tried all sorts of K-cups and a lot of them are too strong.  I can handle a kick now and then but for every day the half caff is perfect and doesn't make me as jittery.

I wish I hadn't ordered so many, they aren't the same bold flavor as the Nantucket Blend. It's like making a cup of coffee and you didn't put enough grounds in, kind of watered down. I will try adding a little instant with every cup.

I received a smashed box that was barely taped shut. Upon opening, instead of receiving the usual, expected k- cups in wrapped boxes of 2 or 3 containing the individual k-cups, there were 50 individual servings thrown in the box. I counted them, so I did receive the amount ordered. But these cups look like they were discarded samples, all of them wrinkled, twisted, some with top punctured. Would you drink any of these? Highly disappointed, will not do further business with this vendor again. Time to order direct from Keurig.

column9: Not up to my coffee standards
column10: This is only a little better than bad restaurant coffee. I'm very disapointed. I drink alot of coffee and have not found anything better than GM Double Black Diamond. Of course, that is fully cafinated.

Like all the coffee I've tasted for the Keurig this is pretty weak.  Actually, this is some of the weakest.  I suppose one could be polite and call it "subtle" but I'm not that person.  It does provide just the right amount of caffeine I need for a late afternoon boost and still let me sleep at night so it does serve its purpose.Is there any strong and complex coffee for this machine?

Its a personal taste but I like a darker brew. It tastes more like a restaurant coffee.  I make it on the shorter cup setting but it's really the darkness of the roast and not the coffee itself.  If I had read a review that said this I would not have purchased it.

Eh, just nothing exciting about these for the price. It is a mildly carbonated juice. Our kids really like some of the Switch and Izze flavors so thought we'd try these. These do NOT taste bad, but I think I can buy cheaper 60% juice products. Everyone may have just been disappointed, assuming these would have lots of carbonation like the Switch or Izze products. (By the way - not promoting all the Izze or Switch juices - I've rated some of them poorly for horrible taste.) Not sure how to rate these with stars - taste is pretty good for what it is, but I'm not buying them again since the kids don't like them.

There are some plus sides to this drink, its all natural and no added sugar.  I love my drinks to have a kick to them, and what I mean by that is I need my drink to have lots of fizz, in that department this drink is seriously lacking.  Its more of a weak tasting juice then a sparkling fruit juice in my opinion.  It is not worth the price, I rather stick to izze sparkling juices, they have so much more kick to them, strong flavor, and lots of fizz.  Each one contains two servings of fruit, which is awesome.  So this is ok, but I wouldnt waste my money on it again.  To be honest with you, it tastes like a sweet version of V8 juice :D lol

column9: This drink helped me kick Coke
column10: I was a 2 can a day Coke drinker.  Knowing how unhealthy that was, the only beverage that enabled me to kick that bad habit was this [[ASIN:B003D4MIE6 R.W. Knudsen Spritzer, Red Raspberry, 10.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24).  Enough fizz in this drink to compare to the unhealthy colas yet all organic, no phosphates, corn syrup, sodium or artificial coloring.  Helped me keep my weight down too!

Chewy Lemonhead and Friends is a great candy. My wife who is not a big candy eater, even loves them. Keep them in the fridge and they are even better. My kick is boxes are clearly marked "25 cents." There are 24 individual boxes in the item shown. do the math, .25 X 24 = 6.00. Ok that is the cost of the box. No discount, nothing! Then you add $6 for shipping and you are paying .50 / box. That is double the price. I just go the my local, high priced, convenience store and buy them for .25 a box plus 3 cents tax. 50 cents a box or 28 cents a box, you decide. I go in and get the entire box of 24 and my cost is 6.60 including tax. Better than $12.00 and waiting for it to arrive. Great candy but you are better off paying full retail and tax than the outrageous shipping.

Bite into one of these; first it's sour. Very sour. Then you taste the sweet, and then the sour takes over again. These chewy morsels are worth every penny you pay, and you'd better stock up. Every time I go to replenish the pantry with them, they're either sold out or there are only two boxes left, which I buy.

Being from such a small town, most of my gluten free products are limited.  I have tried another brand of chips that tasted like cardboard.  These taste like chocolate!!!  They melt so easy.  Awesome.
I ordered these a while ago for work lunches. I didn't really care for the taste so I still have most of them left.

column9: Good on Its Own; Best with Hot Sauce!
column10: I like this well enough, but I soon get sick of the somewhat plain taste so I need to spice it up with at least a few packets of black or white pepper!  Even better is hot sauce, such as Tabasco or some such thing.  Unfortunately, ten ounces just ain't enough for me: I need at least two of these bowls for a meal!

I bought this product for my husband before reading the reviews and was so happy to hear that he found it to be tasty.  I bought other varieties and he said the same thing about them -- that they taste great too!
I've been trying a bunch of different flavors of the compleats meals and while this isn't a 'top five' for me it is still a good meal for what it is and I will likely buy more.
i have ordered it 5 times and will order it again and wishing it s low in sodium.

column9: Hormel Compleats Beef Steak Tips with Mashed Potatoes
column10: The description was accurate and the shipping was quick.  These Compleats are great for lunches and need no refrigeration, just a microwave for heating in 90 seconds.

column9: WOOO-WOOO! All aboard the Fail Train!
column10: Have you ever served up a can of Pedigree wet dog food for your furry little friend and felt secretly jealous as you watch him tear into the vaccuum packed ration like a lion tackling a zebra? If only it were possible for humans to survive on such simple yet delicious means.  If only there existed small, convenient meals of comparable taste and price made just for us folks at the top of the food chain.  Well, if you're still pondering a suitable solution then look no further than Hormel Compleats.  The beef steak tips with mashed potatoes in particular are sure to delight even the most sophisticated palette. In this meal we find overwhelmingly grainy mashed potatoes paired up with bland steak cutlets swimming in an even blander sauce that I can only assume to be some kind of gravy. With this kind of savory goodness you honestly can't go wrong at this price range. To top it all off, the meat appears to be 100% free of any type of seasoning or flavor enhancement in general, so don't hesitate to pile on some of your own sauces and spices to improvise. Not since the US Army's MREs (Meals Rejected by Ethiopians) have we seen such sublime culinary innovation.  In other words, it's the best of the best! Pick some up tonight for the whole family and keep the Pepto ready my friends, because believe me when I say this is one meal that just won't stay down on its own!

column9: Comparable smell and taste to dog food, and I eat lots of unhealthy foods
column10: It's obvious this isn't a healthy meal, but rather the cheapest thing Hormel can put together for a "budget" meal. I knew this and did not care because I was tight on cash and was willing to risk the new experience with these microwave hormal meals.....While thrift shopping when I was broke a few months back, I picked up the usual 1-3 budget buck items like chef boyardee raviolis and such. I saw these hormal meals at the local grocery store and the price was definitely cheap and fit my budget. Most of them looked really good too. I chose this flavor as it seemed the most protein packed and the most delicious flavor (beef and potatoes, how can they mess that up? Its always good..........right?)Plus for the price, I could just tack it off as a bad "meh" meal if I did not like it. Under 3 bucks a piece for a small lunch type of meal is a good price.**CONCLUSION** - After tring this meat & potatoes meal, it looks good but it smells and tastes similar to opening up a can of wet dog food from Pedigree. I am being honest and I eat junky microwave meals A LOT so you know I am not a picky health nut writing bad reviews online. The other flavors seem to get higher ratings which is not surprising to me....  but this flavor, while appearing so good, is just horrible and almost unedible. If someone gave me this to take home, I would honestly put it in the pile of crappy canned foods I give to the homeless shelter (like lima beans, or kindey beans... yeah its that bad)

column9: Hormel compleats Beef Steak Tips/mash potatoes, 6 @ 10-oz microwaveable bowls
column10: I like to keep Hormel's microwavable bowls on hand, since they can be stored at room temperature and are easily heated, for a very fast entree.  This particular dinner was not as good as others I've tried.  Hormel's Roast Beef and mash potatoes, and their chicken and dressing dinners are both tastier, I think.  Given the relative lack of variety available in this general product category, I rate Beef Steak Tips with Mash Potatoes well.
I also had ordered for back up food storage.  They taste like chemicals.  Hope I never HAVE to eat them.

column9: Get's First Place among Hormel Compleats
column10: I used to buy from Schwan's, but I no longer like what I used to get. Trying these very inexpensive meals was just for future selection purposes. But I decided to stick with these for a while. Had Swedish Meatballs - nope. Salsbury Steak - not so very. But this, actually good.I microwave it for 2 minutes, after lifting up the plastic from both sides to a point in the middle. For the taste to really develop, it must be blistering hot. Then I add some sage Simply Organic Organic Ground Sage ( 1x1.80 OZ) and Habanero powder Habanero Powder, Pure - 16 Oz Jar Each on top. After trying several other compleats, this is the one I really prefer. The mashed potatoes are fluffy, the taste is like from a large family cook pot, and the portion just enough for a good meal. With it, I have a glass of chilled water with drops of Lime Juice Realime 100% Lime Juice, 15-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6) and sweetener Splenda No Calorie Sweetener Granular, Individual Packets, 200 Count Package (Pack of 3).Amazon has all the ingredients of making me a happy camper!

column9: Not Bad/Acually a wuick decent meal
column10: The food is actually quick and decent.  Great for keeping on hand in an emergency or for a quick lunch.  The food actually tasted ok and is priced right as well.
Not very good, use it rather as a last resort when you seriously about to die of starvation, not worth it and very small portions.

column9: Not one of the better ones
column10: The beef steak tips with mash potatoes is on the lower end of the Hormel line. The gravy, for once, is surprisingly not too salty but I've always suspected that if you take the salt away, all that would be left is blandness and that is exactly what happened here. I also really wish Hormel would stay away from the mashed potatoes. Sliced potatoes is fine because they tend to have texture if not taste but mashed potatoes really don't add anything to their dishes besides something mushy and tasteless to quickly fill your stomach. And the tiny bits of meat in here try their best to overcome the mountain of mashed potatoes but unfortunately aren't up for the job. It's not that this one is bad, per say, but it's just one of those meals that blends into all the rest without ever being noticeable.For what this is -- a non-perishable prepared food that is fairly cheap -- it's pretty good. It will fill you up quickly at very low effort and cost, but if you are going to compare it to something you can make yourself, well, there really isn't any comparison.
I purchased these products as an emergency backup for non-parishable foods but they taste so bad, I would need to be starving before I could eat them.
Many of the Hormel meals are either too salty, too sweet, or too spicy. This one is is none of those. This is one of the better tasting meals. This is one I have on the subscribe and save plan.

I did not buy these from Amazon because I wanted to try them before committing to 6 of them. I'm so glad I did.I don't mind the Chicken and dressing one, it's passable if one adds some salt, but this one is truly horrid.The beef wasn't ever 'steak'. It seems as though it probably is a round cut, therefore once stewed, it was tough, dry and tasteless. They would have been well-advised to have used chuck in an application like this. It was most certainly not 'tips' of anything of a true steak grade beef.The mashed potatoes were from powder originally and they were bland and sticky.The gravy was awful; pasty, tasteless and there was no beef flavor to it whatsoever.Having tried the other flavor once and having found it not too bad, I had high hopes that Hormel had finally improved on this line. I have been living with several roommates and food theft from the refrigerator has become rampant, ergo the need for something shelf-stable.Unfortunately, this isn't going to become one of my staples. I cannot recommend this for anyone with intact taste buds.
This is an excellent choice.  Real "comfort food", tastes just like Mom's Sunday dinner. I recommend it. I live alone and find this dish so easy to fix and very satisfying to eat.

Very Bitter Taste - Not sweet at all!!! Do not recommend!! Do not buy!!! I took a chance on this product and I've learned my lesson!!  Stick to the products you have experience with.  Now I want a full refund given the exceptionally poor quality of these nuts.

I came across this website while looking for Gluten Free Candy - I have Celiac Disease.  This candy is very fresh and very nummy!!  The company did an awesome job of getting our candy to us by Valentine's Day when it was accidentally shipped to a wrong address.  The caramels, pecan clusters, salt water taffy and chocolate covered marshmallows are all to die for!  You won't go wrong with Sweet Pete's Candy!

Having been told of the beneficial effects of apple cider vinegar by a beloved 80-yr old naturopath/ chiropractor in the 1980's, it certainly took me long enough (the last 2 years)to develop the fond habit of regular ingestion: 1-2 oz in 6-8 oz water (You can play with the dilution factors to find your own balance between the bitter and the sweet, much like life itself!). It is now my "with meals" and evening drink (iced), replacing sodas, sweetened drinks, even my old favorite lime water,and I appreciate this particular product with its unapologetic flavor of apple.1-2 glasses daily have replaced my need for pills and antiacids.The tradition of drinking vinegar water extends back for centuries: Revolutionary soldiers at Valley Forge and in the Carolinas, Roman Centurians, (not to mention Jesus on the Cross, per the Biblical story), and likely even earlier in history.Modern benefits (check out Edgar Cayce)include relief of acid stomach and reflux symptoms, which I deeply appreciate.If I were soaking a body part in cider vinegar, I'd buy a cheaper, by the gallon product, but Braggs in in my opinion, is the only version I'd use for regular ingestion.

For years I've suffered from almost daily headaches. I have chronic sinusitis. I began using this vinegar 3 months back and now I rarely have a headache. I was able to discontinue the prescription nasal spray. This is a huge savings to me plus the prescription drug had some scary side effects. This was a complete surprise to me as I was using this vinegar for improvements in skin and other things that I had read about. I am ecstatic about this stuff. Use this if you suffer from constant headaches.
I recieved this product on time and in good shape, it's a good thing too because it came in 12 glass bottles.

column9: This venegar ruined a perfectly good recipe.
column10: I used this in one of my favorite recipes last week with disasterous results. It completely over powered all other ingedients and flavor elements in the dish and left my kitchen with the string, unmistakable aroma of vinegar. I could barely finish a small serving and sent the left-overs straight to the garbage disposal. Yuck.I gave it to my mohter who frequently drinks vinegar for medicinal purposes. For direct ingestion, she thought it was much more palatable than other vinegars she has tried.Rather a tale of two cities on this one. I guess one's opinoin of this product simply comes down to the capacity in which one plans to use it. It appears that this is good to drink. I will, however, never cook with it again.

column9: One of the only types of food my cat will eat
column10: My cat like all is very picky and I have tried her on all cat food and this is one of the few she will eat.
I was disappointed with the quality of the cakes.  They were stale and had an odd underlying taste.  They all had a strange fruit flavor which was gross.

column9: Nephew and his family loved these
column10: My nephew's little girls loved these pretty cakes. They arrived just after Christmas, which was an extra treat for the family.
This looked AMAZING on my son's cake!! He absolutely loved it! Super easy to put on and looks so cool!

This is really good maple syrup.  We've taken to using maple syrup in place of sugar in a lot of our cooking so we go through a lot of it.  I've had a chance to try a lot of brands and this is one of my favorites.  It's a medium amber so it's got a mild flavor that doesn't overwhelm whatever your using it in or on (if you like yours strong go with a Grade B from Highland Sugarworks).  When I can't get this I usually buy the "Shady Maple Farms" brand which is as good but usually more expensive.  Plus many years ago I was in the Army with a Sergeant Coombs who was from New England and I thought, who knows?  Maybe it's his family?  Okay probably not, but it's an entertaining thought.

We bought 2 jugs of the Coombs Family Farms Organic Grade A Medium Amber Syrup and think it is probably the best tasting we have ever tried. Rich Maple flavor, but yet not too 'syrupy" or overwhelming. Very high quality product. We will buy again!!
Great, real maple syrup. Organic. Delivered to my door. Can't ask for more than that. Flavor beats any maple syrup I get at the market [...].

column9: Good syrup, but a bit runny
column10: This can be had for a great bargain on occasion when it is put on sale. Works out to be significantly cheaper than the grocery store.Once you try real 100% pure organic maple syrup, you will never go back to the 2% Maple Syrups that you buy from the big names in the grocery store. There is NO comparison in taste quality.My only complaint with the Coombs is that it tends to be a bit runnier than some of the other brands out there. Which means you tend to use more of it, than what you would with a thicker syrup.

column9: Very thin ---- we expected a stronger maple flavor
column10: We've bought grade A maple syrup in Vermont and it was a much thicker and sweeter product than this.This syrup is  very thin and runny. Perhaps it is just personal preference ----- but we like a thicker syrup.

I had expected this to taste better than the cheap store brands (e.g. Aunt Jemima).  On pancakes and waffles it tastes more like sugar with a hint of maple flavor.  Also, it is runny at room temperature compared to store brands.I would be better off trying samplers from this company to determine which I like, especially considering the cost.

column9: Faint Maple Taste and A Little Runny
column10: I have always purchased Grade A dark amber Maple syrup from local Kroger and have really come to love the taste of it. However that brand is relatively expensive and I was thinking this organic version would taste as good but I was wrong. This version is thin and watery and does not have much of Maple taste to it.Since my supply ran out I have have gone back to purchasing the Kroger version pending when I will find alternative in the amazon subscribe & Save store. In the mean time I will try the 'Coombs Grade A Dark Amber' for comparison. I use it in my breakfast oatmeal and Green Tea.

I selected the Grade A medium Amber for my maple Syrup this time. I wanted it to  get through my pancakes and waffles more quickly. ...and this was perfect !It allows me more control of the amount of syrup thats going on my plate. The thicker one is just as good --but I wanted a quicker delivery !Maple taste is still great---though thinner !The plastic container is so sanitary and safe from breakage. Its easy to clean up as well...a quick wipe will take care of everything.I have nothing to give this a negative on ---so I have given it top ratings !
I have tried several different brands of pure maple syrup, but this one is my favorite.  It smells and tastes heavenly.  We don't use lots of it, but it keeps in the refrigerator for months.

We have purchased this Coombs Grade A Medium maple syrup several times through Amazon and have never been disappointed. We love  the flavor and think it's a good price for what you get. We tend to like fresh, natural organic products and we use this on our baked pancakes and in baked goods. It makes the most amazing pumpkin pie!!
I love the taste of the Coombs Family Maple syrup. I use it in baking all the time and my 3 yr old grandson loves it on his waffles
I have used this maple syrup for 10 years at our bed and breakfast. It is consistently good. I like the 32 ounce jug because it stays fresh.

column9: Coombs Family Farms 100% Pure Organic Maple Syrup, Grade A
column10: As expected, this product is superb. It costs 50% less than in my local health food store.  I'm very happy I found it here at Amazon.  It will be a regular purchase now!
Syrup has a wonderful flavor and texture.  Works well on lots of different foods and in baking.  Try it you will definately like it.
This is a really good maple syrup of great quality.  In comparison with what stores offer in comparison for real maple syrups this is a really good value

This is delicious maple syrup. It is much thinner than the traditional syrup, however, organic and pure. We appreciate the organic, natural syrup as opposed to syrups you see in the grocery stores. Kids love it. We are completely satisfied.
We really like what's in the bottle. My kids sometimes balk at the taste of 100% maple - not with this syrup they didn't even notice :).

Taste fantastic! First time buying maple syrup online and it taste just like the grade A maple syrup I purchase from the grocery store. What made me buy this product was its organic and a cheaper deal. Made french toast from scratch for some friends and they enjoyed it with this syrup. So 5 stars for me!!
I only buy this brand now.  It is the best and tastiest and a good deal.  Great flavor and great for cooking and baking too.

column9: Gifts for our children and grandchildren
column10: We just distributed one each to a dozen of our children and married grandchildren.  They love it!  If I were not diabetic, I would be enjoying it with them too.
Medium amber is hard to find and this one tastes great!!  Delivered right to your door with free shipping - it just can't be beat.
I love this maple syrup... delicious on whole wheat waffles.  A real treat in the morning or any time.

We really enjoyed the Coombs Family Farms 100% maple syrup. The taste of real maple syrup is different from your store name-branded maple "flavored" syrups and some may not enjoy the difference in taste. Our children prefer the store bought maple flavored syrups.This was a mild flavored syrup, but very tasty on our sourdough pancakes and waffles. I only wish the container was larger and lasted longer!

We work so hard and have fun at eating healthy.  The Coombs Family syrup is a great syrup on buckwheat cakes, whole wheat crepes and we use it in baking.  A little goes a long way because it is so pure.

I have enjoyed maple syrup (the real thing) for decades.  A year or more ago the syrup went crazy in price.  It's very expensive, but if you have to have a high quality product, this one works.  It is flavorful, tasty, and deliciously sweet (and no, I'm  not a slurpy sweet person with words).  It's a good product, nay, maybe even great.

column9: OK if you like a very mild flavor
column10: We were disappointed with the light, mild flavor and the thin liquidy syrup.  For a premium priced product, we expected something better than we bought at Costco, but this was not to our taste.  Sorry.
I have tried more amber(darker) syrup before and have found that I like this milder flavor more.  Great product will purchase again.
Thanks for the speedy shipping, got the products right on time. Very high quality Maple syrup, I will definitely buy Coombs brand Maple syrup from Amazon again.

column9: Best Maple Syrup I have ever tasted!
column10: This is the Best Maple Syrup I have ever tasted and the best deal around with the 50% off sale going on Oct 09! I should order much more! I love its lighter texture than many other maple syrups, and it obviously beats any of the non-maple syrups. From placing the order to receiving the product the service couldn't have been better. And you paid the freight. The syrup itself is excellent. What else can I say?  Keep up the good work.

I purchased the Coombs Family Farm's Maple Syrup like I always have done.  However when I opened it, the  top was covered in  green mold.  I used this time to educate my son on famous molds.  One in particular was mold that makes penicillin.  Penicillin had been discovered years before, but when WWII came it became very urgent to find a mold that produced penicillin in a very high concentration.  So the research was being done In Peoria, Illinois and all the housewives in Peoria were instructed to bring all there moldy food to the lab. It was moldy cantaloup where the important mold was found.  I don't think the syrup was growing a mold that produced penicillin-no it was just plain gross.  The syrup was not that old so maybe I will look at other syrup.

We froze the boxes upon delivery and heat as needed in our conventional oven for about 5 minutes after 10 minute pre-heat at 400 degrees, but we also heat up individual pieces in the microwave as it gets hot in our home in the summer. The naan come out delicious every time and taste fresh. 3 breads to a box. It's expensive but a real treat for us. We have re-ordered. Usually rotis or naans are mixed with whole wheat flour to give it texture and more of a nutty flavor to enhance dishes that are masala-based or that contain cashew and spices.  This roti is a bit bland, and it is about as nutritious as Wonder Bread.  But I will say that if you cover it in butter or oil, it can be very tasty and a real crowd-pleaser.
This product is delivered in dry ice (nicely packaged).  The nan breads are easy to heat in atoaster oven and tastes great.

Oh my! This Naan is so good. I love that it cooks up easily in the oven - no need to even thaw - just grab out the freezer and into the oven. The bread comes out hot, chewy, and delicious. I can eat it plain, but have had some amazing Indian themed dinners with other Tandoor Chef ingredients and rice. Just yummy and I will continue to purchase. I use these primarily to make pizza -- they're a great size for (smaller) individual pies and provide a deliciously chewy crust. (My trick is to top and bake them while they're still frozen, since if they thaw before they're baked when used for pizza, they can get a bit overdone as the cheese turns golden.) Great naan, and I don't have to make the trek to Whole Foods to get them, which is great since the WF nearby has a tendency to run out!

I like the flavor and enjoy this type of bread. This was my 3rd order and it can be eaten with many different dishes. Also, by adding sauce, cheese and other ingredents, it makes a great base for making a chrispy pizza.

column9: Thoughts from a virgin mate drinker
column10: This is the first brand of yerba mate I have tried. I found it really pleasant and will definitely buy it again. I was hesitant that it might be too bitter or overpowering, but it wasn't at all. Just make sure to use hot, not boiling water, to steep it. I love sweet drinks, so I added a little honey and YUM! I drink it every morning, and after about a week of doing this, I really have noticed that I am more clear headed and have more energy throughout the day. It also cuts my appetite! I never used to drink caffeinated drinks because they usually make me anxious and jittery (1 soda would do this to me) but this mate is great. I have had no 'crashes' or jitters or anxiety at all. So, if you are new to this drink and want to give it a try, start with the Rosamonte brand.
Really great quality for little price. The tea is a bit strong at first but after a few drinks it has a great mild taste.

I really liked this particular mate. I have been a mate drinker for over 10 years and this one ranks toward the top with a solid, smooth taste.. The only reason that I didn't give them 5 stars was because I think that they should give you the 1 kilo bag for the price.

I'm no connoisseur of fine Mattes. I've only tried a few brands, but Rosamonte is my favorite so far. I think the flavor is stronger than others and the loose leaf mix is just the right grade: not too dusty and fine and its not like, straight up leaves either. This is exactly what I was looking forward to! Best Mate I've had yet. It's a great size, and it's even better the second and third steeping. Thank you so much!

Good mate'.  Not my absolute favorite, but good.  I just bought this same sized bag of this same brand at a local international market for $4.50 (the most expensive brand they had. They had some for $3.50/500g).  This offering is overpriced.
Good yerba-mate.  Different quality for different people but it's good overall and at a good price.

my wife loves french vanilla flavored coffee. we normally get gloria jeans brand, but this is probably the same stuff since it comes from same manufacturer. decent price. we can't wait till pattent runs out and green mountain no longer controls k cup suppliers.

Ever morning, my grandmother would make a bowl of Quaker grits to go along with my scrambled egg, toast and milk. Even though they are not ordinary grits, they still have the flavor and mouth feel that brings back the memories of those mornings, sitting in the kitchen, watching my grandmother making breakfast.They can be made as creamy or stiffer as you like by adding more or less water. I always keep a box or two of the instant grits, along with the regular grits, in my pantry.Thank you, Quaker, for bringing back so many wonderful memories of my early days!!

I almost always have a roll of mints of some sort in my purse.  After a meal I always reach for something to freshen my breath.  I don't really care for chewing gum -- don't like how people look when chomping away on it and I never quite know how to dispose of it when finished -- therefore mints are the solution.Over the years, I have tried many varieties and some I have liked better than others but these are the best!  I love the combination of the harder outer shell with the soft, chewy insides.  The flavor is powerful enough to do the job and I actually really like the taste.  I am not the only fan in my family.  My teenage daughter has them stashed in her car and her backpack.  When she runs out, she jokes she is having a "Mentos crisis".  We love them and friends I have shared them with also seem to like them.

When they are fresh they can not be beat. When they are a little past their prime they are still very good. They have a strong mint presence and it leaves the mouth feeling somewhat refreshed and with a minty taste. Do not know if they could alternatively help with the occasional bad breath problem that afflicts anyone at one time or the other. They certainly feel strong enough to convey security in that department and if Mentos wanted to corner the market they should make sure it can also combat the annoying and always irritating (to the ones in the other end) episodes of an unkempt mouth, which is not to say that in some cases is unavoidable and soon enough remedied by the conscientious bearer.Mentos Mint Candy, 1.32 Ounce Rolls (Pack of 30) was the best deal in terms of quantity versus value. What at first might appear as over doing it in the numbers ends up being just right. Enough to say that the fresher the shipment the better because that is the time when the flavor is at its peak. This is the one flavor by mentos that delivers a flavor full of fresh mint and it last right until it is gone. Imagine, if only for a minute, if besides helping to kill the germs that cause bad breath they could also be healthy to the teeth by adding Xylitol which has been proven to greatly reduce cavities and preserve teeth in general. I am probably dreaming but I see Mentos Mint like powerhouses in their own right.4.5 Stars for these mints!

column9: Probably the best crunchy peanut butter I've ever had
column10: I don't consume peanut butter very often, but when I do, I usually buy the crunchy kind.  I decided to try Jif Natural Crunchy and I'm not disappointed.The ingredients are as follows:  Peanuts, sugar, palm oil, with 2% or less of salt and molasses.Nutrition information:2 tablespoons - 190 calories, 130 calories from fat.  Total fat 16 g, saturated fat 3 g, trans fat 0 g, cholesterol 0 mg, sodium 65 mg, total carbohydrates 8 g, fiber 2 g, sugars 3 g, protein 7 g.Vitamin A 0%, vitamin E 10%, vitamin C 0%, riboflavin 2%, calcium 2%, niacin 20%, iron 4%.I recommend this product.

The PB has a great taste, smooth, creamy and very crunchy and more roasted taste compared to Skippy or Peter Pan Natural PB spreads. AT $1.90 1/2 PER jar not store can come close. On average it is $3.50-$4.50 a jar in most grocery stores and even the evil Walmart/Target can't compeat here.For all of you reviewers that gave it one star...... Did you return it?  As you have 30 days to return products to Amazon for a refund, if you didn't open any of the jars you could have easily done so.JIF as well as SKIPPY and other non-stir Natural Peanut Butters clearly state they are spreads and that they do not contain trans-fats.  It is better than regular PB yes, is the healiest; NO but still better than the regular and ingredients clerly listed. As for expiration, why would you buy a case of any food and not expect to use it in a relatively short period of time?When I bought cases I used them to make cookies for the holiday, other desserts as well as the old stand by of PBJ and I am one person.  Even if I hadn't baked with many of the jars as I did the small 18oz containers (6 per case) would easily be used in 3-4 months max.Lastly why would you not also check out in your local store to read the ingredients, look at average expiration dates as well as know your own use of a product.  Meaning on average you use 1 18oz jar of PB in 2 weeks, or 2 months.....As for the Palm Oil and the actual location that JIF buys that or tracing it back to what one reviewer said I can not comment. If it were true that is awful and yes, things need to change to protect many natural environments around the globe but that would include dozens upon dozens of firms globally that use Palm Oil to act. Not buying this isn't the strongest message that reviewer should be using social media and actual letters to JIF to help change actually happen.Do your homework when you buy things, regardless if it is food or electronics.... Amazon has just about the best return policy online or in a store and they always listen and or work with you to come to best outcome/satisfaction.  For all you complainers you have no one to blame but yourselves.
Need I say more?  Nice and crunchy with lots of pieces.  Nice flavour too.  Does not taste "healthy."I would and will buy again.  Good price too.

I got this as a subscribe and save a few months ago.  Best tasting peanut butter I've had in a while.  The fact it's low in hydrogenated oil is great too.  It's too bad that Amazon raised the subscribe and save price.  It used to be $12.66 for the 6 which made it worth it because it totalled less than at the store.  Now, at $14 for 6 it's actually more than the grocery store price even with tax!  If the price goes down again I'll certainly buy it from Amazon.  Until then...

This stuff is awesome. My husband was talking to someone at work about how we had given up on "natural" peanut butter because it was a pain to stir and didn't taste as good... and they bought him one of these. I never thought I'd review peanut butter, but honestly this is the best peanut butter I've ever had. And I didn't even think I liked crunchy peanut butter.Checked the label, looks like they replaced the standard trans fats (or in the case of other natural peanut butters, unsaturated fats, which is why you have to stir) with palm oil, which is solid at room temp.

I bought this a few weeks ago when it was on sale. I guess we haven't had crunchy peanut butter for awhile because the first thing I thought when I tried it was how many peanut pieces are in it. It is harder to spread but tastes great.  It really is crunchy. I have had problems with the Skippy Natural separating and the Jiff hasn't. I also like the fact that it doesn't have the lip on the bottom like Skippy does that makes it hard to get out every last drop. And with peanut butter prices sky high, I want every drop out.

"Natural" peanut butters are an interesting trend, especially since the nutrition facts on the label are generally identical to traditional peanut butter, but since I'm making an effort lately to feed my kids more foods that come from a farm and fewer that come from a lab I thought I'd give it a try.There is a pretty big difference in taste and texture between this natural and "regular" peanut butter. Though the label is fairly unconvincing (it still contains sugar, palm oil, salt and molasses as well as peanuts) you can tell that something major changed. This is thicker and a bit trickier to spread, especially the chunky variety (natural creamy is also thicker, but not as difficult to spread) the peanuts stick and it's pretty tough to make an even layer on bread unless you really use a lot.The flavor is much more like real peanuts, I like it better but you may have to get used to it if you're really into "regular" peanut butter.There is also a little oil separation, but not enough to be a problem.Overall, I'm a fan. It seems like traditional peanut butter contains more sugar and oil, which is basically frosting, and even though the fat content is the same or very close, I still suspect the fat and calories coming from real peanuts are more healthy, and the taste is definitely more authentic. However, I don't imagine this is going to appeal to everyone, especially those used to the taste and consistency of regular peanut butter, or those who don't want to pay the extra cost. I prefer natural, but I'm not giving up regular peanut butter completely.
This is very good peanut butter. It was on a special price, which was the reason I decided to try it. I usually buy the jif regular creamy peanut butter.
I have always been a Jif fan but this new, natural, low sodium offering by Jif is a winner. Really, really chunky ~

column9: Cheerios are still the best cereal!
column10: When it comes to breakfast cereal, I can't think of any type that I enjoy more than Cheerios.  They have a delicious taste, I never seem to get tired of eating them, and best of all, they are fairly healthy as well.  The crunchy, slightly powdery taste of Cheerios has a certain quality that can't be described except to say it is delicious, and when one looks at the vast array of sugar-overload cereals available now, Cheerios remain a steadfastly healthy way to start a day.  Healthy for your heart, your diet, your well-being; what more can you ask?  Also, they make a great snack at any time of the day. Cheerios are the first breakfast cereal I can remember eating.  Other than Grapenuts, it is the only one I still eat.  As my memory of these go back to just after the war (WWII) that is a lot of Cheerios over the years.  This is one of the few products that I know of that they have not messed around with and as far as I can tell, they taste the same to day as they did when I had my first bowl.These things are cholesterol free with no saturated fats.  There are no added colorings or flavor.  They are just about perfect as such things go.  In addition to being a breakfast staple, they are also almost always my "going to bed snack"...a habit I have had for years.These are also one of my favorite munching foods.  When reading I normally have a box next to my reading chair which to be honest, beats the heck out of pork rinds, potato chips or Moon Pies. The dogs seem to enjoy them as much as I do.  I also do a lot of traveling via automobile and I always have a box or two of these with me to eat right out of the box.  They tend to keep me from turning into every fast food place I encounter and they are great for keeping you awake during long trips, in particular at night.These are a wonderful and traditional cereal and I do hope they stay around for a long, long time.Don BlankenshipThe Ozarks

column9: My go-to cereal for fixing any other cereal that is too sweet

This allows me to have a variety of morning cereals that otherwise would taste too sweet to me so I would not be able to enjoy them.Nutrion facts for 1 cup (28 grams)Calories: 100 (15 from fat)Total Fat 2 gCholesterol 0 mgSodium 160 mgPotassim 170 mgTotal Carbohydrate 20gSugars 1gProtein 3gA small fun factoid is that Cheerios was the first oat-based ready-to-eat cold cereal (introduced on May 1, 1941 by General Mills).If you never tried cereal mixing I recommend you give a try!
