If you want sweetness just add strawberries or some banana slices to the bowl and you don't sacrifice the healthiness of the cereal. If you must have sweet you can always upgrade to honey nut cheerios. Keep in mind this is still made with processed grains, so it isn't super healthy but is still a likely upgrade over whatever you eating habits are now.
And they are delicious with bananas ... unfortunately amazon doesn't offer fresh bananas to go with the cheerios so I needed to get those in advance to enjoy them to the fullest.

column9: Much Better Price Than Giant, Walmart, or Target
column10: I stopped buying Cheerios at stores and only at Amazon once I found this deal! Cheerios taste great and are very healthy.  It has one of the lowest sugar content among all cereals.

I eat Cheerios with blueberries and raspberries everyday. That's right it's a great breakfast full of heart good Cheerios and antoxidant fruit. Having them on hand at this great price is wonderful. I always take a couple boxes to our church food bank too.

column9: So you've never had a Cheerio?
column10: Why else would you read a Cheerios review? :) Cheerios are loved by both my husband and my 13-month-old son. What I'm really here to review is "Subscribe & Save." This feature keeps me from having to constantly go out and buy Cheerios since between my two guys they go through a box every week. It's cheaper than at the store, too, and I can ask for a sooner shipment for the monthly occurrence when our dog gets into a box and we need or next shipment to come faster! ;)ETA- since I originally wrote my review back in December, the price of these here has almost doubled. I've since canceled my subscription. Bummer.
I like this cereal.  I don't add sugar; like it just the way it is.  I like the subscribe and save, it is reasonable priced and arrives quickly at the time its suppose to.
I never have to worry about runnijng out of my favorite cereal.  This is great!

Love Cheerios, always have because of their oaty goodness and lack of sugar, but now General Mills doesn't keep the production line clear of nut byproducts and regular Cheerios are frequently contaminated (see the warning on the side of the box).  It's unfortunately because this is otherwise a good product.I still buy Cheerios for the family but I can't eat them any longer because I'm allergic to peanuts.  They aren't even allowed at the children's school anymore for the same reason.  Severe nut allergies can be life threatening, so please be careful offering them to others.Pam T~

column9: C L A S S I C,......Y U M M Y......C E R E A L......F O R.....Y O U N G.....A N D.....O L D...!
column10: CLASSIC, ORIGINAL "CHEERIOS" CEREAL has been around for a long time.  It has truly earned a place as one of the best cereals around, and appears near the top of the recommended cereals in the"EAT THIS, NOT THAT -- Best and Worst Foods In America", by David Zinczenco and Matt Goulding.  Classic, original "Cheerios" is VERY tasty, has many vitamins and minerals, much nutrition, and has relatively few artificial ingredients.  It's good for any human, of any age.  And any human, of any age, (or at least the great majority of humans...and who knows, maybe ETs, too!), will find it quite delicious and good for their health!Like any cereal, however -- no matter how tasty and/or nutritious -- Classic, Original "Cheerios" DOES get a bit boring if you have it for breakfast EVERY day for seveal weeks.  So -- put a little sugar and/or cinnamon, or other topping on it, etc.  Use your imagination!But the great thing about Classic, Original "Cheeerios" is, even if you get bored with it, and, instead of using different toppings, you switch to a different cereal for a week or two, when you DO come back to eating original, classic Cheerios, it will be as tasty and yummy s ever!The only thing I DON'T like about classic, regular "Cheerios" cereal is that, if you have it alone, as a snack, and not as a breakfast cereal, surrounded by milk, you DO take a chance of having some of these delectable, "O"-shaped little morsels fall on the floor.  I guess this can be said of any breakfast cereal used as a snack -- but I can't help wishing that classic "Cheerios" also came in a larger, snacking size, so that this wouldn't happen as much.  Guess I like snacking on Cheerios!  I think many other people do too!

I love cereal. In fact I love it so much I like keeping anywhere from 10-20 boxes of different kinds in the house. When I find a good deal I stock up. For me regular Cheerios is just OK - it's not one of my favorites. To me it's kind of boring and doesn't have much taste to it. It's also not that sweet and I like my cereal a little sweet. The Honey Nut variety of cheerios is better.

This is the best bargain around for this breakfast cereal.  Now I can have the name brand, which has fewer carbs and less sugar at the generic brand prices.  Plus, it is delivered directly to my door, for free!  Hats off to Amazon.

column9: Not even close to a good deal
column10: We eat Cheerios by the case load and there are a bunch of foods that we buy from Amazon on subscribe and save, but never breakfast cereal.  Even without a sale my local store has 18 oz boxes of Cheerios for $3.77.Even when I figure in gas and time, this does not make sense.

Thanks a lot. Deliver took about 3 weeks to Finland, Helsinki but it was worth of waiting. In Finland shops are only selling couple of products and here are only 2 different food shop chain. So they re products are very abridged.

I love every ARCTIC ZERO chocolate-based flavor.  These are amazing and guilt-less confections.  Guilt-free for calories; not guilt-free for cost.  To minimize expenses, I try to eat one pint every two days, and, sometimes, I can eat a half-pint per day. Usually, though, I can't stop once I start. I was on the CHOCOLATE wagon for several years. Now, with ARCTIC ZERO, I'm definitely off the wagon.  Today's my off-day, and I'm sweating it (just kidding).  Here's my warning: Don't start down the ARCTIC ZERO road unless you're ready to embrace the addiction.

I would give this 10 stars if I could!  This is my new FAVORITE flavor!  I hope Arctic Zero keeps this flavor as a part of their permanent line up. Trying not to eat an entire pint is hard; it's just so dang good!  Eating a whole pint won't hurt at all as far as calories are concerned, so go ahead and indulge!  The only problem is that it's so expensive I have to ration my supply!  I've tried all their flavors, and if you're having a hard time deciding what to order, go for this one!My flavor ranking:1.Mint Chocolate Cookie2.Chocolate3.Chocolate Peanut Butter4.Pumpkin5.Strawberry Banana6.Vanilla

Arctic Zero's "Mint Chocolate Cookie" flavor is excellent for what it is, but it might not be what you think.  I thought that it would be a white/mint ice-cream with chocolate cookies, but it's a CHOCOATE ice-cream with mint flavoring. There are no cookies involved.  So, as long as you know what you're getting, it's still very good.  Personally, I'd like it if they came out with a traditional "mint-chip" flavor though.

This is my favorite flavor of arctic zero, and I'm a big fan of the stuff in general.  I hound the guys who work at the company day and night.  They really are super nice and it's a small company.  You got to appreciate businesses like that!  They do everything themselves which really allows for top notch shipping and customer service!  Anyway, this flavor is the best if you like chocolaty mint, like a thin mint cookie or a peppermint paddy, or even chocolate chip mint ice cream, or perhaps(I've never had one) a Junior Mint, because, if I go through those old Seinfeld quotes I've got indexed in my memory, I believe it was Kramer who said "Who's gonna turn down a Junior Mint? It's chocolate, it's peppermint-- it's *delicious*!"

Given the nutritionals, it is delicious! Like another reviewer stated, this is chocolate ice cream flavored with mint, so don't expect a mint chocolate chip type of ice cream. I was worried about it melting since it was delivered on a hot day, but it was packaged on dry ice in an insulated box and was rock hard when I opened it. I can't wait to try other flavors!

Arctic Zero is the next BEST thing to ice cream. It tastes like a chocolate/mint sorbet, and satisfies that craving for ice cream. I did not detect any after taste. Others may if they are sensitive to sugar free products (I usually am). I have had only the Mint Chocolate Cookie, and it seems like a miracle that such a product exists for those who love ice cream.

I d enjoy the Arctic Zero Frozen Desserts, but so far this is my favorite. It has a true chocolate mint cookie flavor. Although the desserts are not creamy like ice cream, I enjoy the frozen, icy texture. Knowing the low calorie count makes it even better!  It would be perfect if it wasn't so expensive.

I love the chocolate mint Arctic Zero.  It doesn't taste like diet food.  It is creamier than a sorbet but not as rich as regular ice cream.  No funny after taste either.  I would definitely get this again and am going to gift it to a friend who is gluten free and also watching her weight.  I think she will love this.  I took one start off for the price.  This stuff is so expensive!!!!

This is one of Arctic Zero's best flavors.  It really tastes like a Girl Scout Thin Mint Cookie.  Would definitely buy again.  I would eat this every day, except I couldn't afford it.  It is a special treat!

I was so excited to finally find this in a store near me.  I ran in, paid my $6.99 for a pint and dug in with a spoon while sitting in the car.  All I can say is I was seriously disappointed.  This is chocolate flavored water ice.  The chocolate flavor isn't enough to satisfy any type of chocolate craving.  Even at 32 calories a serving I thought it was a waste of the calories. I had a few bites then put it down to try and let it melt to get a little more flavor. It wasn't any better.  I pitched this in the garbage, having probably eaten only a dollar of my seven dollars.  Here is what I learned from this experience: if it sounds to good to be true, it probably is. Don't waste your time or your money.

This stuff is simply amazing.  At first bite, it seems a bit bland, but after eating a little bit I forgot it wasn't regular ice cream.  If you try to eat it without letting it melt a little, it's rock hard and the texture is almost reminiscent of gelatin,but after a little melting it's just like any ice cream.  I really like this flavor, but putting the word cookie in it is a bit misleading.  It's mint chocolate flavored all the way through with no "cookie" bits in it at all. Great product!  I would recommend looking for it in stores before ordering online though, as it gets pretty expensive.

column9: Used to be GREAT stuff... what happened?
column10: I first purchased this product a few years ago (in a local shop, not on Amazon). I remember it being delicious--creamy with a nice chocolate mint flavor. It became a regular item on my grocery list.However, a few months after I first discovered Arctic Zero, I picked up a pint from the same store and I noticed that the product tasted watered-down, freezer burnt, and devoid of flavor. I had initially thought I'd just chosen a pint from a bad batch or that it had been stored improperly, but after purchasing different flavors from different stores, I can only assume that something has changed with the way the product is made. Every flavor now tastes like frozen water and it no longer has the creamy consistency it used to.I recently saw the mint flavor once again at another store after moving out of state. Considering it had been months since I stopped buying Arctic Zero, I thought I'd give it one last shot. Needless to say, I was met with the same disappointment as with my previous purchases. I will no longer be wasting money on this product. You'd be better off with low-fat frozen yogurt if you're looking for a healthier alternative to ice cream.

I found Arctic Zero Mint at Sunflower Market by accident and decided to try it. I was a little disappointed at first because it didn't have the texture of ice cream and was too hard to dish it out of the container. I decided to try it a few more times before giving up...  as real ice cream had packed on the pounds. One day I left a container out on the counter for about 15 minutes before opening it and surprise, surprise.... the texture was incredible! All it needed to do was melt a little bit. It was like eating the real thing plus the flavor were enhanced.  I give this flavor a 10+. I am eager to try the pumpkin and will probably order it in the near future. I've tried the other flavors but found this one to be the best. Although they all are good for some variety. It is pricey so you need to know that up front. But for me... as long as I can get them without going broke I will. I used to spend so much more money on binge foods so this is really not that bad. I do try to not eat a pint everyday but once I open one it's hard to stop. It satisfies craving for something cold and sweet. Plus...  it's zero in fat, 8 grams of fiber, over 12 grams of protein, and 150 calories for the entire pint. It's like having a frozen protein shake that actually has the texture of ice cream! Now that is terrific. I just found out that they make ice cream bars. I can't wait to try them all!

This is a great flavor of Arctic Zero! I always love chocolate and mint together. My husband thinks it is great too and he is picky. I like to scoop it into a small bowl, put a light whipped topping on it, and chocolate whey crisps. It tastes decadent  and goes farther. They whey crisps add protein and crunch.

column9: Good but don't expect chocolatey flavor
column10: My taste buds were a little bored with the flat flavor so I took 1/2 cup of Arctic Zero (75cal) + 2 TB Light Hershey's Chocolate Syrup (35cal) + 1TB Sprinkles (25cal). Not bad for 135 calories. HOWEVER for 15 more calories I could eat a Chocolate Skinny Cow Ice Cream Cone with Fudge. Truly, Arctic Zero is something you have to try if you are like me and like to taste anything new on the market. Unfortunately the novelty for my husband and I wore off after the first pint.

For nearly a year now I'd been reading rave reviews of this product on the interwebs.  I'd check my local groceries stores, search online to see where the nearest place to try some was.  So when it popped up on Amazon, I grabbed some -- despite the significant price.And it's okay.  If you're dieting, it beats the bejesus out of celery.  As a low-calorie treat, I'd put it on par with yogurt -- AND by volume, lower calorie than even yogurt.  So after the hype I was a little let down, but it's not terrible.  It's just not a magical low calories replacement for ice cream.

column9: Absolutely Amazing!  Thank you Artic Zero!
column10: This is the most yummy, yummy flavor ever from Artic Zero!  Thank you for my addiction to the Mint Chocolate Cookie!  If only the people in my local area thought different, I could find it easier on the shelf.  They are always sold out at Sprouts, Henry's Whole Food's and Mother's....I now have to order it by the case and put my name down....otherwise when it comes it, other people try to take my case!Sometimes, I add a little Walden Farms Calorie Free Chocolate Syrup and pretend I'm eating a sundae!Walden Farms Calorie Free Chocolate Syrup

column9: Arctic Zero Mint Chocolate Cookie Frozen Dessert
column10: I am sensitive to all sugar free product. This one is really good. Maybe because it has the real thing instead of the artificial stuff?
love this product - for only 128 calories for the entire container and it tastes great too!!  Wish it was sold in our local grocery stores.

This is probably tied in first place with the chocolate flavor! I love the minty chocolate. Once the dessert melts a bit in the carton, the bites of mint are heavenly! You will be hooked at the first spoonful!
This is really good!! It's definately a toss up between this and the regular chocolate.  Both are great!

I REALLY LOVE THIS STUFF!!!! Such a sweet, creamy indulgence that I can enjoy without guilt!My favorite was the Chocolate Peanut Butter until the Chocolate Mint Cookie became available!!Chocolate Mint Cookie is YUMMMMY!!!! I like to mix it with blueberries or some plain nonfat greek yogurt and sprinkle some ginger on top! YUM!!!Arctic Zone doesn't increase my desire for more sweets like some frozen desserts can! I like that I can indulge almost daily and not worry about weight gain!!Its also perfect for those times you want a lil something sweet throughout the day, even a spoonful goes a looong way for my tastebuds!!I love that there's 4 grams of protein in each serving and that it has 2 grams of fiber! I've never heard of a frozen dessert with fiber?! Way to go Arctic Zone peeps!!I can't eat an entire pint in one sitting, but sometimes can in a day, but, thats only if Im home all day...lol... a little goes a long way and I love that! When I used to get frozen yogurt with Splenda (can't believe I used to do that) in it (low-carb fro yo), whenever I had some, I always wanted more. With Artic Zone, I am satiated with just a serving or two.I am sooo grateful they came out with this! I would love a coconut flavor if possible??? or Banana cream pie??? Price is cheaper than indulging in fro-yo each day and much more friendly to your curves!!! :) I plan to take a few pints to the family's Thanksgiving Feast for family to try.

Dear Artic Zero,I was so excited when I saw you at a health market today. Bought you even though it was pretty expensive....I couldn't wait to try it so then I had it outside of the market and right then I wanted to go back in to return it. But I didn't want to do something like that.So I gave it another try and took another bite, hoping that it would change my mind. Nope.I gave it another try hoping that it was something that would grow on me and once again, NOPE.After a couple of minutes the side started to melt a bit and I gave that part a try, hoping it might taste better. Well, guess I got too hopeful cause it didn't.So what did it taste like? Diluted something. I could not taste the chocolate nor could I taste the mint. At first it tasted like nothing/diluted something. Then after a few bites of it tasted unpleasant, I was tempted to just toss it out.-Unsatisfied Customer
This tastes like mint-flavored frozen water, and I mean that in the worst way possible. How is this company in business? Stupidest impulse buy I've made in months.

column9: will NEVER get this on time This is NOT a prime shipping item!!! My shipment has not shipped and they will not let me Cancel
column10: The worst customer service!The rep would not put the supervisor on the phone and I was told even though it hasn't shipped and I will not receive my shipment for another 10-12 days they can't cancel the shipment but don't know why "the just can't" I Will Cancel my prime!! Beware.. will NEVER get this on time This is NOT a prime shipping item!!! My shipment has not shipped and they will not let me Cancel. This is a perishable food item and I will not be available to receive the shipment 10-12 days from now!
I bought this for the office and everyone was very receptive and appreciative.  The 80 cups went FAST!  I would recommend this to anyone for its value and quality.
Awesome juice, a shame that it has not been available since my purchase and will not be available unlit the 1st of November! Sure miss my juice!

I was recently suffering from painful diverticulitus. I saw this aloe vera drink at a 7-11 store and thought I'd give it a try. I was shocked at my first sip when I felt the chunks of fruit in my mouth. They are virtually invisible in the bottle unless you really look for them. Once I got past the shock, I was pleasantly surprised by the mild, sweet flavor. Most other aloe vera drink brands that I have tried are pretty nasty tasting, but I actually enjoyed the taste of this product, and it did a good job soothing my stomach.
The flavor of TropiKing is sweet but not too sweet, tastes refreshing with no perfumy after taste like other brands.I also like that its natural too.

This aloe juice product is very sweet and watered down compared to the ALO brand. The aloe chunks are very thin and not very flavorful. I would avoid this brand and try the ALO or Aloe Vera King (OKF) brands instead.

column9: Fresh product from a trusted brand, and the price is right.
column10: In general I have always found NOW foods to be a company that takes quality seriously.  I have bought flax seed from other sources before, only to find it rancid when I opened the bag.  This product was fresh as can be, and has stored well for me since I bought it a few months ago.  Not only does NOW sell a fresh product, but Amazon must store it properly or have a very high turnover rate, because the product I received was very fresh.  Storage makes a difference with flax.The price for 6 bags was lower than I've seen elsewhere.  I store one open bag at a time in my refrigerator and keep the rest in the freezer.  They have kept well for me.I use milled flax seed to make a variety of foods, mostly homemade granola and low-carbohydrate, high-fiber baked goods.  It serves as a good flour replacer in some recipes.

She's a picky eater when it comes to snacks and I wanted something natural, without chemicals and these are great. The ingredients are simple and there's no chemical soup.The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is the shipping cost! The product itself is 5 star ++++.
i add this to many dishes i cook, love it and good to know i can find it here! will deffinately be buying more.

The Mussini Balsamic Glazes are great products and I will have them in my inventory for years to come as long as they are provided for the reasonable price.  If you like to use squirt bottles, this is your product.  It comes in a squirt bottle so you can decorate as well as add a nice flavor.

I bought this set for my 3-year old. The set looked good because it was a combination of different items but the set was just too cheaply made and parts did not last past the first day.  It was cheap, but it would have been better to invest in a die cast single set for the same price.
great flavor and they were nice and fresh , no hint of staleness. They got banged up a bit in shipping but it potato chips some breakage must be expected.Only wish the cans were a bit bigger .
perfect thing to take as a snack for work or to give out during halloween. something different from candy and other standard treats.

I bet this is the smallest package of chips that you can ever receive. Do NOT be deceived by the images that the seller shows you because the chips can is half the size of your hand! The chips taste OK, not too good.

I was not aware of this product in the first place then I stumbeled upon it and just had to give it a try, I am really glad I did. I never imagined how many items I could find and purchase from amazon.com
What is with AMZ?  Despite NUMEROUS REQUESTS AND THE LAW, they IGNORE the customer's NEED to know ingredients in ALL food products they offer.  PLEASE do us this ONE HUGE favor AMZ!!!
Hong Kong Style Almond Poweder is good to add to all kinds of food to give them a healthy boost and flavor

I finally got to a point in my life where I could sell my business and mortgage my house and order a box of these, and it was well worth the wait.  My wife doesn't understand, but that's what happens when you marry someone who isn't a true gourmand.  Well worth every penny of the 1.8 million dollar purchase price, although I thought $5.95 for shipping was a little steep.

I used to eat these years ago when I had family in the Philly area. Truly a wonderful snack. Taste is fresh like a bakery not some over processed junk. It is junk food, but they're certainly worth it.

This seller kinda amazed me.  I had previously purchased this item from a seller on Ebay and it took about a week or so to get them and they were close datred due to this.I purchased these from Lil-Big Shots and it arrived in 2 business days, in far better condition and with plenty of date left on the product.If you have a sweet tooth for Tastykake products  I would Highly reccommend these guys, the are timely and make sure your product arrives in a condition you can actually enjoy it.

I'm a left-coaster and we don't see Tastykake products, nor being a near vegan do I indulge normally.  Anyway, the appearance of the product was too compelling and I splurged on an order of these.The picture here, for those fellow un-initiates, is misleading.  It is not like a Hostess pie or a turnover, it's an actual little pie in it's own tiny aluminum pie pan!  The crust is a bit salty, and naturally is not crisp or flaky after being in contact with the filling in a small box all that time, but it is very tasty.  The filling is also not overflowing the casing, like the picture, at best it at least fills the lower crust, but sometimes not.That's just so you have the proper expectations, not meant as a criticism really, because this nasty little devil is great, really excellent.  Miles and miles above the Hostess pies (although it's been twenty years since I tried one), really no comparison at all.  If you're in the mood for something special, check it out.  Shipping was super fast, despite the conservative Azon estimates, so gratification in the near term is guaranteed.If someone franchised this product and got it into supermarkets with the neat little boxes in a rack near the checkout line (to compete with candy bars), they'd sell MILLIONS of these puppies.

column9: THE TASTE IS WHAT I WANT...
column10: I have ordered this rice twice from you nice people.  Sorry, I couldn't stopthe rhyming...  Keep shelving this for all of Usins (cousins)...

column9: Think Slim Jim is vile? Try this.
column10: I am not a beef-stick fan. Maybe this is a cultural thing, but I think they taste ghastly, dry, vinegary, sawdusty and salty. This was juicy, moist, with just a bit of snap for texture with a really tangy flavor thing going on. It is not the hot sauce kind of acrid vinegary spicy like so many beef-sticks tend to be.  I'd describe the flavor as more a robust, full flavored "zest" with dominant elements of garlic and black pepper. I consider it more flavorful than spicy, but your mileage may vary.It is about the size of the Ostrim stick (*gag* hate Ostrim).  Each stick is about 93 calories with 8gm of protein, 240mg of sodium (not the best but it is a beef-stick), 5 g of fat, and 4g of carbs. But this is not just the best tasting beef-stick I have ever had, it is the *only* beef-stick I would conceivably classify as tasty.  I am not the only one who thinks so because if I buy a case with the intention of storing it as an emergency snack, even if I wait a day, my friends and family would have finished off everything. Find a good hiding spot.This is also a...er...pungent smelling snack, so don't whip it out during a date or anything.

I love Arizona Green Tea and was excited to find it sold here in large quantities to save trips to the store.  When I received the case of bottles, I was surprised to discover that all of them had a yellowish tint to the cover and upon opening two of them discovered they had fermented.  I didn't know such a thing could happen!  I called the supplier and they immediately shipped a new case free of charge.  That one turned out to be very good.  I would definately buy this product again.

The Strawberry Kool-aid mix makes a very delicious punch that I use for Christmas parties, showers and family gatherings.  I purchased this item through Amazon because it could not be found in our local grocery stores.

Our family loves this strawberry flavor of Kool-Aid but it is difficult to find in area grocery stores.  I got tired of not being able to find it or having it intermittently.  Loved the convenience of ordering in bulk from Amazon.  This is a staple in our house and a great alternative to soda pop.  Thanks Kraft Foods!!!

This sweetened Kool-Aid drink mix is great because having the sugar already added makes sure that no one will add too much sugar.  The taste is just as wonderful as the regular Kool-Aid.  Being able to save using the Subscribe & Save program was also a HUGE plus.  I actually sent an order to a college student as a gift.  They love to get care packages in the mail.  Amazon makes sending plenty of care packages easy with these excellent deals!

column9: ALL of my cats LOVE this food
column10: We have four cats and each and every one of them love this food.  In fact, one of our cats would never touch canned food of ANY kind until I tried this.  She LOVES it!!!  We couldn't believe it.

column9: Smells bad and cats consistently vomitted while on this food
column10: We were using the Weruva brand Weruva Cat Food, Paw Lickin' Chicken, 5.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24) but decided to try this cheaper brand from the same company to save some money.First, this food smells very bad. There is almost no chicken in it, and the tuna is very dark brown for some reason.After a few days on this food we noticed the cats started vomiting every day. I also noticed that they started shedding considerably more than normal. I believe the excess shedding was causing them hairballs, which was then causing them to vomit.After a few weeks we decided to switch back to the Weruva brand just to see if there was a difference. Within days they stopped vomiting and were barely shedding.I can't say with certainty that this food was causing the problem, but I believe it might have. Would not recommend.

Our 6 cats are very fussy. They are not pampered pedigreed felines but they act like royalty. We only buy the best for them & usually they tire of it rather quickly. I have placed a second order for this product since it is a big hit.

Our cat tends to really like variety, so whenever I try a new brand of food she really loves it but then the newness wears off and it is just ok. This particular tuna and chicken really gets her excited still and it has been a couple of weeks. Time will tell, but so far it has been her enthusiastic favorite.Oddly, our cat doesn't seem to like fish all that much and prefers poultry centered products. I took a chance with this mixture and it worked. Anyone know the difference between this tuna and chicken 4Eva and the tuna and chicken chuckles from the same company?

I read a review of this product in another size (the 3oz) which said her FancyFeast-addicted cats liked this food. My cat has snubbed EVERY healthy canned cat food that I've tried. I didn't believe the review I read, but I figured I'd try this particular flavor.My pickypicky princess of a cat LOVES IT. What's also nice about this particular food is that it comes in shredded strips and large ~1cm round chunks with a thick non-gelatinous gravy.I was worried my cat would eat it too quickly and puke it, which she does with chunky FancyFeast, but it has yet to happen with this food.I'm very excited about this brand. It's not even that expensive. I can't really afford more than 54c/can of FancyFeast (Wal-Mart price) but I was able to get this brand for almost the same price per ounce as FF. Very happy about that and pleased with Amazon.
Irregardless of the food, the cans are just hard to open and I almost cut myself trying. The lids are too thick. As for the food, it seemed watery and my cats were not too impressed.

Ever since Lulu stopped eating Wellness Core Chicken formula (even when I thoroughly mixed it in with her favorite foods she picks around it and leaves it in her dish), I have been searching for a wet grain-free protein staple for her diet.I bought one can of this to try.  She LOVED it and ate it right up.  But then, later that night, she vomited...It was clear so I thought maybe it was unrelated, so I fed a little bit to her again in the morning.  She threw up almost immediately after eating it =-(  I know it is slightly higher in protein than her other foods, but I thought since she was already acclimated to other Wellness foods and high-protein options that she'd be fine.  Sadly I was wrong.  I won't be trying to feed her this food anymore.I didn't give this food one star because I still believe this might be a high-quality food, even if it didn't agree with my cat's stomach.  There's also a chance I might be wrong about what's causing her to vomit: if that ends up being the case after speaking with the vet, I'll be sure to update this review.UPDATE 10/18: My cat was suffering from acid reflux post-surgery, like some humans do.  I will still not be purchasing this food because it was just too rich for her and caused each flare up.  She thought it was delicious, though, so it may be awesome for a different cat.

Ok, so product description on purchase page specifically states this product is made in, (pardon me, created in) the USA.  Pretty tricky wording.  Del Monte is company that is also producing other MILO products (eg, chicken jerky and grilled chicken) that don't say either way.  Well, I ordered three products, this and other two chicken.  Immediately noticed that the Chicken Jerky and Grilled Chicken were in package printed "MADE IN CHINA" ?!! I have chosen to not feed my dog anything Made In China, since all the problems with pet foods using products from there.  I am a bit concerned that some are and some claim to not be.  Not sure I understand Del Monte option to put out a product line that any of the line is made in china and then advertise that the product are created in USA.  Very confusing and now I don't trust the packaging that states USA.  Hmmm, a real shame as the dogs LOVE these brand treats... but not going to use any longer as concern for their health.

column9: Tasty Healthy Treats Made in the USA
column10: My goal is to find healthy treats maade in the USA.  I've learned from experience with our dog (14 years) in the treat department to NO LONGER buy treats or food made in China or other countries due to increased risk of disease; in our dog's case, kidney issues.  Go to dogaware.com (dog experts with credentials) for information about the dangers of giving your pet treats made in China.Our Bichon loves these treats.  We break them up into smaller pieces and he really enjoys them which is great because he's so picky.  Especially appreciate that there are no artificial flavors, colors or fillers.

Not only is this particular configuration a great deal (versus the 5 or 10 flavor options), the product was well-packaged and arrived very quickly.  The flavoring oils are quite strong and smell/taste wonderful. For some of them, I need only one drop to flavor my entire 12oz smoothie, other flavors need a few drops, but it's still phenomenal to have such a palette at my command. I'm looking forward to mixing banana cream with a tiny bit of black walnut for a "banana bread" protein smoothie.  I also bought flavors to play with my soda stream carbonator; zero calorie sarsaparilla will be mine!While plenty of candy recipes call for using the entire contents of these little bottles, I'm using them for single drop applications (drinks, mostly), so portion control is a little trickier.  I opted to get tiny plastic droppers, like these: Cosmos ® 0.2 ml Plastic Transfer Pipette, Pack of 100 + Cosmos Cable Tie so not only am I able to perfectly control how much flavoring I'm using, I also get to feel like a mad scientist in my kitchen.

Received my order (24 dram-size bottles) today and was very satisfied.  They are just as described.  Original LorAnn bottles and sealed (not re-bottled or re-labeled). I was happy none of them broke or leaked also. I did get one wrong flavoring but oh well that's no big deal;  I would order these again.  I ordered the cotton candy in the one ounce size also and it was great too. LorAnn flavorings are a very concentrated oil-based flavoring unlike the ones you normally find which are alcohol or water based. I hope these continue to be available here on Amazon because I will be ordering again for sure if so.  I wanted these mainly for the purpose of DIY e-liquid (e-cigarette liquid) but these would be a great addition to anyone's kitchen just to have on hand;  and the little bottles are cute!  I will be telling lots of people about these and where to get them (I have lots of vaping buddies lol) It isn't easy to find good flavoring products out there that someone hasn't repackaged/re-bottled and relabeled.  Its All Sweet!!!

I was very happy with this product!!..it cost me less to buy this lot than one by one in Hawaii stores!..I will definitely purchase this item again!!..thank you!!..loced that you could choose your flavors too..that was a big reason to buy it as well..
These pops are a big hit with the grandchildren.  They do not know that they do not contain sugar and they love them.  The price is also great.
This suckers really didn't offer alot of flavor. I would buy them again! This complay offers a different sucker that is a solid lollipop and is much better.

After years of consumption of regular sugar, a recent diagnosis of prediabetes has led me on the search for sweeteners that will not affect my insulin levels. While I do not yet have Type 2 diabetes, I am confident in saying I don't want to get it. I have relatives that do have it, and I don't really want to join their ranks.I have tried many of the sweets (candy, gum, chocolates) that contain this sweetener, and I must say, I was quite surprised. There is a bit of a cooling sensation to this sweetener, an almost mintish sensation, but I do like it. These lollipops are the perfect choice when a sweet craving hits. Xylitol is a healthy alternative to regular sugar, and much safer than the artificial sweeteners out there. Given a choice of having no sugar in my life, this was a godsend.

I actually like these lollipops a lot, but some are better than others (I like the grape flavor!) The xylitol candy was recommended for my mom, who was recently diagnosed with shogrins. The doctors told her the xylitol would help her "dry mouth" produce saliva and reduce dental decay. She enjoys them, and they do help. The only problem is they become very sharp, and she has to be careful with her already painful tongue.
What is the point of using xylitol if you are going to put nasty toxic crap like artificial colors in here??!! very annoying!

I bought these for a special diet I was on that only allowed a certain sweetner.  Well, I just love my sweets and I ended up throwing these away. I tried every flavor hoping to find one that might be tolerable.  I read a review where a woman gave it to kids. Well, sure, kids will eat anything that looks like candy.  These are awful.

column9: My Favorite Snack!  And so healthy too...
column10: These individual packets of almonds are the perfect snack or mini-meal if you're trying to do the six-a-day small meals instead of three larger ones.Each package holds 1 oz. which represents 160 calories; 14g fat (the very good kind - almonds are heart healthy); 10mg sodium (when do you ever see such a low salt content - and this is natural sodium in the almonds, not salted nuts); 190mg potassium (having leg cramps?); 5g carbs; and 2g fiber (subtract from the carbs for an ECC of only 3 grams of carbs per serving; ECC = effective carbohydrate count).I do have to say that there is the occasional stale, chewy nut in the bunch but I haven't been able to find any almonds from any supplier or in any form that doesn't have them.  Can't really say why because some nuts are fresh & crunchy but a few just aren't.I won't deduct a star for that simply because it seems to be the nature of the food...large cans, large or small bags, they all have some "chewy" ones.The individual packaging helps me monitor just how many I eat, too, because I could just sit down with a party can of almonds and have a party by myself...until they were all gone in one fell swoop.If you like flavored nuts, you could add your own seasonings such as GARLIC SALT FRESHLY PACKED IN LARGE JARS, spices, herbs, seasonings if you want something with a little more punch.

column9: Finally, small packages for GOOD snacks
column10: Great way to have a snack on the go. These almonds are awesome - they're raw and fresh, full of flavor and snap.I love the small size - saves me from having to buy small snack sized plastic bags. They're pricey but if you wait for Amazon to have a sale and combine it with a subscribe and save subscription, they end up being cheaper per ounce than if you get them at Trader Joe's or CVS on sale (both I think are $4.99/lb for raw almonds.)

I really like these almonds, they are raw and have about 6 grams of protein per 1 oz bag.  These were less per ounce with Subscribe & Save than a lot of the other raw almonds on Amazon (when you include their shipping costs) and with the 10% additional savings from the mastercard promotion that ends 10/31/2012.  I decided that the individual packaging is worth the small amount extra I paid.  If this experiment in portion control goes well, I may order another brand and bag them myself.  Now that I have Amazon Prime, some of the other brands will be quite a bit less expensive per ounce with free shipping.  I do like that this company has been family run for generations and that these are Nonpareil Almonds, so will take that into consideration.  The almonds are packaged in 2 boxes with 24 bags in each box.  They arrived very quickly and in good condition.

I am so sad that Stride changed their gum. The nonstop mint used to last me all day with just one piece, the new 2.0 version tastes different and doesn't last long at all, maybe an hour per piece. I went by the picture and thought I was getting 1.0 Stride. I am dissapointed the product I received is not the product pictured.The shipping was super fast though and the price is great.
This is my favorite flavor gum.  It shipped quick and what a deal over buying it at a gas station!

Received the almonds today and was disappointed as soon as I opened the package because the bag was ripped and a bunch of the almond shells were cracked.  Which means, I will have less almonds for the baby shower favors. Too bad because the color is beautiful. I would return it, but I don't have much time left until the shower. =(

BE AWARE that you only receive 1 jar of sauce, not 4.  The picture of 4 jars is very misleading.  I received my order today and paid a premium price plus shipping for 5 various jars of products.  Will let you know if it's worth the price after I try it.

This is the most incredibly delicious, robust - yet delicate - tomato sauce you will ever experience.  Once you have had the pleasure of dining on a plate of Martelli's penne topped with this tomato sauce warmed and topped with a fresh grinding of good parmesiana, you will never be the same!  It is truly a meal to be savored with every bite!!!
Taste really good. It has a nice nutty and smooth chocolate taste.  The best.
This is not even close to foie gras so dont waste your money.  You might get a 3 second tast but not sure if thats foie gras.  This could be used more as a joke.  Thats what i used it for.
I purchased this as a gift for a chef.  It was very well recieved.  The packaging was very attractive, I can't attest to the taste as I haven't tried it.  It was a fun gift to give.
BE AWARE that you will receive only 1 jar, not 2, if you order this item.  The picture showing 2 jars is misleading.
I was hesitant to try Amber Lyn's sugar free chocolate, but I can honestly say if I didn't know ahead of time this was sugar free I wouldn't have guessed.

AmberLyn chocolates taste like the real thing because they ARE the real thing!!! I am not eating sugar and am on a low carb way-of-eating, and I am addicted to them. I also recommend them to my diabetic patients who crave chocolate. You will not regret buying these!!!!!

My husband and I have successfully dropped considerable weight by reducing our carb intake. The single thing I missed the most, however, was chocolate. And despite all the press about the benefits of dark chocolate, my favorite is still a good European style milk chocolate. These bars are creamy deliciousness! I'm not saying they are diet food, just that for us, we appreciate less sugar in any treat this tasty. Yum!

column9: Since it doesn't make good bread -- some ideas to use the remaing 20 pounds!
column10: Like another reviewer, we only have home-made bread in our house and have not bought a loaf of bread in 30 years. So, I am an experienced bread maker.My first loaf of bread, made with a favorite recipe failed. While it did rise, the texture was similar to a "quick" bread made with baking powder. (I use my KitchenAid to kneed for about 8 minutes, then do a final 5 or 6 minute hand kneed to check for "feel" of the dough.) We made two sandwiches from it, then fed the rest to the goats.I went to the Great River Organic Milling web-site to look at their recipes and made one using my KitchenAid rather than a bread machine. Once again, the texture was unacceptable. Finally, I made a honey/butter french bread from a recipe we have been using for years. While the dough rose during the pre-shaping rise, after shaping it went to sleep. When it was finally double in bulk I baked it -- and once again -- good taste, but quick bread texture.An other reviewer has had similar problems.So, what to do with the 20 pound of flour you have left? I have found that the flour makes great crackers --olive oil, flour water and what ever seasonings and flavors you want. (My recipe comes from Fine Cooking, but there are many on the web.) The Great River Bread flour can also be used in several of the recipes in "Simply Great BreadsSimply Great Breads: Sweet and Savory Yeasted Treats from America's Premier Artisan BakerIt works in the crescent rolls (pg 58) and in the flatbreads beginning on page 75.I hope this comment helps other like me that have a great deal of bread flour that they do not wish to use in "regular" bread. I'm down to 15 pounds left to go!

column9: Awesome organic flour at an even better price!
column10: This flour makes the most delicious wheat bread.  I ordered it expecting it to be more white than wheat but it actually has a very wheaty color.  However, after reading about it on the Great River Milling website, I learned that it is in fact wheat but has had 80% of the bran removed.  It bakes up nicely and does not have that sour taste that I have often associated with whole wheat bread.  So, if you are looking for organic white bread flour, keep looking but for a light wheat alternative, this is perfect.  I would also suggest checking out the company website for info on all their different flours.  You can also order individual bags there if you don't want to get 20lbs of something when you aren't quite sure you are going to like it.  Amazon rocks for bulk purchase and the free shipping and discount through subscribe and save is awesome!!!  I'll definitely continue to use Amazon every chance I get!!!

I ONLY HAVE A HOMEMADE BREAD IN MY HOME AND HAVE TRIED A NUMBER OF DIFFERENT FLOURS. THIS ONE IS ONE OF THE BEST. I WILL NOT EVEN MIX IT WITH WHITE FLOUR FOR MY BREAD.IT'S GOOD BY ITSELF.2 months later:I ordered the same flour. It's not as good as the first pack. It's my first unsuccessful baking of bread.Terrible texture. I'm also seeing some white stuff in the flour.I hope it's not worm's eggs. I will not order this again because I don't know what I'm going to get the 3rd time.

This product had a lot of great reviews, so it was a big surprise to find it really was not a good product for me.Although the baked goods made with this flour tasted good, with a nice flavor, it did not knead well, and refused to rise well.So the bread it made was good-tasting, but with terrible texture.I tried more than one thing to make it work, and more than one recipe. All failed, and the common element was this flour. I used it in a bread machine, and it didn't work. The dough did not come together into a ball, but remained crumbly, almost like cookie dough. Everything was right, and the recipe was a proven one. All ingredients were measured correctly, the proper yeast (fresh and in perfect condition) was used, and used correctly, but the dough would not come together well, nor would it rise well.My wife also tried to use it in homemade recipes, using our big stand mixer to knead the bread, but that bread also failed. Again, she used proven recipes, but with this flour, had poor results.Finally, we tried mixing it into better-for-bread flour that had proven its worth many times... but even 1 cup (1 cup out of 4) caused the same problems... poor cohesiveness in the dough (where usually when the best-for-bread flour is used, you get a nice velvety ball), and a low flat loaf.The results were consistently bad... no matter where or how (even only mixed in a little into some better flour) or how we used it our breads failed.

I use this wheat bread flour when I make the basic recipe from the book "Artisan Bread in 5 Minutes a Day". Because of the higher protein content of this flour, I have had to increase the amount of water from 3 cups to 3 1/2 cups (more if necessary). In the Artisan recipe you are looking for a very wet dough.  For a really great crust and crumb, bake the bread in a covered enameled cast iron skillet or dutch oven on heat tolerant parchment paper at 450 F for 30 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered. This flour has a sweet, nutlike flavor that I really enjoy.

I have been trialing various wheat flours to the end of building fine artisan sourdough bread. I have finally found one which is up to my standards and which makes a truly fine loaf of sourdough bread. This unbleached flour is made of red wheat, so the color is beautiful and makes a rich light brown loaf. The grain is uniform and fine and it is delicious. So many flours today are completely lacking in flavor so that even with sourdough they come out tasting like cardboard, but this makes a full-some and hearty bread. My strongest recommendation.

column9: Great bread flour, but not fully "whole wheat"
column10: I ordered this by mistake (I wanted their whole wheat pastry flour, which is also excellent).  It didn't make sense to ship it back, so I decided to try getting back into bread baking.  This flour is something between white flour and "genuine" whole-wheat bread flour.  It has all of the wheat germ, but about 80% of the bran has been removed.  Amazon should probably include better info on the great river flours; you can find a lot more at the greatrivermilling.com web site.  Click the "bread flours" link under the "products" tab to see a full description of this and their other bread flours.This flour makes great bread for me, somewhat lighter than a full whole wheat, but still very healthy and delicious.  I haven't had any of the problems with texture or rising that some other reviewers mention.  I use a very simple recipe: just flour, water, yeast, salt, and a bit of brown sugar and oil (2 Tbs of each for two loaves).  A really big factor for me is that my kids actually love the bread it makes, so I can get them eating something better than store-bought bread.

column9: treat as you would white whole wheat flour not white
column10: I purchased this flour to use as unbleached white but it is identical in color to my white whole wheat flour. I found that it works fine for bread but only with the addition of 1/2 cup wheat gluten per 6 cups of this flour which is how I treat whole wheat flour, (otherwise it results in a useable but flatish loaf).  I used it for pie crust, tortillas, and biscuits as well and it works great for these. I haven't tried it for pasta yet but I think it work no problem. My friend that I spilt this order with tried this flour in her bread machine and it did not work (with no added gluten). Overall, this is a great value. This is less expensive than I can get organic flour from the health food store or Whole Foods. I will be buying this again but am also continuing to search for inexpensive unbleached white organic flour.
This is the best flour I've ever used.  Everything you make with it comes out great.  You can even overwork your dough and still have fantastic results.

column9: Great bread flour - use it all the time
column10: I bake bread every week with this flour and I am very pleased with it. I first got the Great River gift pack and when I ran out of this flour, I ordered more.  I haven't had a bad loaf yet.  :)

Wonderful flour. Right choice for those who are seeking organic baking products, but don't want to pay hundreds of dollars for it. Flour is really good for making breads, pancakes, waffles, quick breads. I used it in pies, tarts - and it worked out delicious and nutritious.

Good price for organic -- excellent results with it.  Bag does not say "bread flour" but company spokesman assured me that gluten content was appropriate for bread.  They also make pastry flour and specialty mixes.
A million thanks for carring this product, my long time childhood favorite.  Easy to order arrives as promised and in perfect packging, fresh and at a truly decent price.

Came across this entry - on HeyLoki's recommendation (thank you), I've tried them and shared them. Each package is a row of little hard tablets, like mints (they're called mints) but flavored not with mint. The ingredients do not list violet. They are pleasant to taste, but not the norm of candy, not today's candy. One coworker likes how they smell, but doesn't like EATING the smell, having the scent right there on the palate.  I like them, but I don't like how the room smells if I don't seal up the uneaten ones. This is a mixed review, sorry. 4 of 5 stars - good candy, just odd.

Some of my friends who I have offered these to say they taste like SOAP.And even I have to admit they have a very unusual taste, but that is what I love about them!AND they leave your breath smelling wonderful for a really long time afterwards.I first purchased these at World Market, but here I got them at less than half of what they sell them for each there.Live on the edge, try Violet candy today!I wish they also made them in Lavendar flavor too.

A friend bought me these. I used to get them at Vermont Country Store, but they no longer carry them. I love the way they smell and taste. It's exactly as I remember them. It is a bummer when they get broken, but that used to happen to me with the other places I bought them, too. I think they are just fragile by nature. Not everyone is into them by any means, but the people who love them REALLY love them.
Same great candy I remember from my youth, but I was disappointed when I opened it and found it to be stale with most pieces broken.

column9: Not packed properly. Arrived crumbled. Still taste good though.
column10: I really like these candies. was excited to find them at Amazon rather than scouring drugstores for them. Unfortunately they are not packed well, or protected in anyway so they arrived crumbled. All of them. Still taste good though.

I was quite hopeful about this candy, as I love the flavour of violet and having an inexpensive bulk supply would be quite nice.Unfortunately, rather than using a natural violet flavour, this candy uses an artificial one.  This makes it take on a rather flat and overpowering floral note, without any of the more interesting characteristics of violet (real violet flavouring always had a spicy undertone that reminded me of celery seed.)Additionally, the artificial colouring gives it a bitter note on the back of the tongue.  The flavour of the violet candy put out by L'Anis de Flavigny is much superior (and also available from Amazon.)

column9: oh I didn't know these were still around
column10: My grandmother often got care packages from Ireland (these couldn't be found in the midwest in the 70's can't be found now either!) and there wouldn't be packages of these tucked into corners. I didn't know they were originally an American product until I found them here, I thought they were European. They are really unusually because they are such a very floral tasting candy, at first as a child I didn't care for them, I think because I initially ate one expecting it to be mint tasting, but when I tried them a second time I found I really enjoyed them. You find you can't eat several of them at once, but one or two here or there and they are really enjoyable.
Item is hard to get in stores. My cousin loves these candies and was thrilled to get them  Item arrived in excellent condition, and very quickly. Very pleased with the service.

I LOVE these violet candies, but have yet to find another person who can tolerate them! My husband will not kiss me after I have eaten these.  I walk into a room and my kids groan and tell me to stop eating the violet things!  They remind me of perfume candiesthat my grandma sent us when we were kids.  I think that anyone who likes Sen Sen would like these.  No, they are not the same flavor--but they are equally odd!  I have to stop myself after eating two packs in a row.  They give a tummy ache by the third pack!
I finally found them!!  After searching high and low for violet candies, here they are on Amazon!!  And they don't disappoint - the flavor is just as delicious as when I was younger.

This tastes like soap. And it sticks with you forever; drinking water doesn't help remove it.  I recommend this for anyone who needs to wash someone's mouth out with soap - much less messy.I bought a pack at World Market because it was unique and out of the 10 people or so I've given a piece - only one likes it. So there is a market for this.Also the smell comes thru the package and if you hold the package too long,your hand starts smelling like it.

I am sure this is a good quality product and it has surely endured for many years.  I enjoy many floral candies and teas and thought this would be a no-brainer.  Nope, it tastes too bitter and soapy for me.

To know C Howards Violets is to love them.  that is how it is - people either love them or hate them.  they are especially good for smokers, even though i am not one - really gets rid of the odor.  and my few latin friends say they remind them of the violet scented water their mothers used to use when they were little.  These are definitely an acquired taste and not for the uneducated.

I order 4 boxes everytime i have a backyard bbq or an in house gathering. Just in case someone gets pulled over. They wont smell alcohol on their breath and just maybe, they wont get the breathalyzer test. The first defense for getting pulled over.... Dont drink and drive....But they do work..

These brownies are just terrific.  They taste the same as the Little Debbie regular iced brownies do, but they're in the shape of a bat.  Very, very cute, particularly if you have children that are fond of the little guys, but they taste very, very good.  These are particularly nice as well for the chocoaholic in the family - the icing is all chocolate and without the sprinkles.  They also make their regular Cosmic brownies in fall colors, if you'd rather have those instead of the bats.  Just a great brownie, a house favorite.  Highly recommend!

column9: $200 do I get Little Debbie with my order?
column10: I love little debbie products and generally I consider them a great value. But $200 seems  a wee bit steep.

So I ordered this product maybe over a month ago and I tried it out, I don't think I lost any weight. Perhaps it's because I stopped taking the pills due to the effect it was having on my stomach, I thought I ordered the original Green Tea but I didn't. I'm not saying that just because I've has this type of reaction, no one should purchase the suppliment. Just do your research on Hoodia before you do, good luck on your weight lose journey guys. ;-)
These nuts have a great taste!  I shared with friends and we all liked them a lot. Will buy this brand again.

column9: A few hard nuts to crack
column10: I have purchased pistachios from the Bergin nut company a few times so I figured I should get an action shot and post it.  Well as I went to look for the camera I got hungry and I figured I had two bags so what would it hurt to open one. Needless to say I never found that camera and I ate both bags.I won't say that they are the greatest pistachios but they are damn tasty for something that shows up in the mail.  The bag is easy to open and I would say 98% of the nuts can be opened with your hand (I used a pair of pliers to open the rest). I had maybe 3 shells minus the nut and 2 just plain nasty nuts in the last four bags that I have eaten.Overall if you are looking for perfection go to a gourmet store and hand pick a bag out of the bin but if you want pretty good quality delivered to your front took then this is the right one for you.
Totally yummy, a little pricey, but worth every penny!!! Nom Nom Nom Nom, plenty of good munching. But be careful, they are very addicting.
Revived my nuts was greatly diapointed the nuts were stale and nothing special could of picked up better nuts at walgreens but on the plus side most of the nuts were opened

These are the greatest pistachios that I have ever bought or eaten!! Great taste and just the right amount of salt. Gave them as gifts last year and people raved about the taste. They could not get enough of them!! Never quit selling them at Amazon.com!
if you're a pistachio consumer, you know how 1 bad nut kills the flavor enjoyment! well with this product, finding a good 1 was next to impossible and that's not a typo! yours truly tjdon.

column9: Not Sure Yet... The FDA Still Worried About All Nuts
column10: Arrived just as promised.  I haven't tried them yet until I get word from the manufacturer that they are OK to eat.

column9: Woodhouse Chocolates Are the Best In the Nation
column10: When I lived about 45 minutes southeast of St. Helena, I would be sure to drive there to Woodhouse Chocolates, at least once per month, and indulge in the best, hand-made chocolates, made on site, that I have ever had.The Chocolatier is gifted with such a palette that ever friend in the US that would come to visit me would appreciate her chocolates more than any other.I eventually learned to pay the $6 in next-day shipping to the east bay area and not drive there :)Do know that preservatives are not used; the chocolates are perishable after 2 weeks.You will NOT be disappointed!FYI, buy more than you think you should....here is why...standing within the shop, while ordering, I would usually "down" about 10-12 chocolates, eat more in the car later in the day, and try my best to hang on to a few chocolates for a day or two out. IMPOSSIBLE!Now, I live in Nashville, and one can only be shipped these gems during cooler temperatures. These are priceless.Enjoy!
Do not waste your money!! I followed instructions explicitly - with NO RESULTS!!!Wished I knew where to get refund!

Slow to start, very little sprouting, however, the sprouting is definitely occuring, had 3 sprouts since christmas, 2 died, currently 1 strong sprout and looks like maybe 1 more coming soon...so not 'ground cover' style sprouting as described but still pretty cool.  Think of this as Chia-Pet meets soda can.

column9: Sesitive plants can invade and harm.
column10: Mimosa pudica, while fun, is an invasive alien in many countries and toxic to wildlife and grazing animals. Mimosa trees have been banned in Florida. Mimosa trees are banned in many areas because of short lives, branches breaking easily, tendencies to invade and harm native species.The Patent Magic Plant- Mimosa Tree

column9: Bear Creek Vegetable Beef soup mix.
column10: This mix produces a huge pot of vegetable beef soup with lots of body and flavor. It's not even necessary to add extra ingredients to make it more complete, and that includes the optional tomato sauce suggested on the package. (It's better minus the tomato sauce.) The only reason I'm not awarding five stars is because the recommended 10-minute cooking time isn't nearly enough for the dehydrated peas, which are rock-hard. (Try 30 minutes instead.)

column9: Great soup for 23 dollars but not for 41
column10: I purchased this 6 pack of soup for about 23 bucks a few weeks ago and we really enjoy it...good flavor and like all Bear Creek soups it accepts additional ingredients/meats very well.  Came to write my review today and saw that the price is now about $41  for the 6 packs...gimme a break!Will continue to be on the look out for when/if the price drops again....what is going on with these soups and the widely fluctuating prices...a good product but seriously...

column4: Warrenette Dailey "Warry Dailey - Lover of Life"
column9: Bear Creek Vegetable Beef Soup Mix
column10: This soup as well as others was great.  This one especially can be supplemented or mixed with homemade.

A good hearty veggie beef soup has always been one of my favorite meals.  Especially on a cold winter day when I make it in a crock pot.  Although I enjoy making soup from scratch when I have the time, I often use various mixes that add all the spices and ingredients for you.  As you may expect, some mixes are much better than others.  I decided to try the Bear Creek brand when I saw it here for I have never seen it in any stores.  Take it from me, it makes really great soup that is rich and spicy, but not with too much of anything added to make it overpowering.  Its also the kind of mix that takes kindly to anything extra that you may enjoy adding to it like other reviewers have suggested. I recommend it for its price is very reasonable, and even more for its delicious....Bon Appetite!

Excellent soup mix! I like to keep on hand because it makes a hearty and delicious meal in under 15 minutes. I usually add a can of seasoned, stewed tomatoes in lieu of the tomato sauce and serve with hot cornbread. Highly recommended, as is the creamy potato and chili mixes by Bear Creek. Give it a try!

I have used this soup mix for years. I add 1# of cooked ground beef and the 8 ounces of tomato sauce suggested. I also often add either frozen green beans or okra for even more vegetables. Good last minute winter dinner idea, even for kids and/or company.

column9: Vegetable Beef soup-didn't like the flavor
column10: I am a huge fan of Beer Creek's Chicken Noodle Soup. The soup is delicious and I buy it by the case.  I decided to try the Vegetable Beef.  Bought a case and ended up not liking it at all.  It just seems to have a horrible taste -no vegetable or beef flavor at all.  So if you happen to try this one FIRST, don't use it as an example......it's just a matter of personal taste because the Chicken Noodle is a 10-star soup!!

This is a high quality saffron for a very reasonable price.  As advertised, it is all Stigma (no Style).  It has an appropriately stunning aroma, and gives a deep rich flavor to dishes in which it is used.  HINTs for those new to Saffron.  The flavor is slow to extract.  Powder the Stigmas just before use in a small mortal and pestle, etc.  Use the correct amount and weigh your Saffron:  1 gram for a large Paella (containing 1600 g. mixed seafood, chorizo and other meats) or 0.5 gram for a simple Seafood with Saffron sauce (containing 900 g. seafood).  Store unused Saffron in your freezer in an airtight container!

Beautiful deep red stigmas. Nice mild aroma and strong coloring properties. It is on the milder side when it comes to saffron taste and a lot of it was required to prepare a medium size "paella", due to its milder saffron taste. I would certainly recommend this product for great soups and sauces. For a paella I would rather use "MANCHA" DO(Denominacion de Origen) saffron or indian baby saffron. I still recommend this product without reservations.

This saffron is high quality product,so it is a bit pricey compared to the other brands. However, if the saffron is needed for some medical purpose this product is definitely reccommended. On the other hand if it's just to use it occassionaly for culinary purpose try some other brand which happens to be cheaper.

Many many yrs ago spent some time in Calabria. The peppers were ground and on the dining table in the resturant. I was told not to use too much as they are hot but actually have some flavor as well. These are excellent. Every time I sprinkle some on my pasta, it brings back some wonderful memories from my time in Cantanzaro.

Perfectly braided peppers - you can hang them in your kitchen. There are a lot of peppers, the picture does not due the braid size justice. The peppers are about 2" long.Individual peppers pull off the braid easily, yet the braid stays in tact. You use the amount you need and the rest stay "fresh."These are peperocino from the Calabria region so they are spicy yet not overbearing as a Thai bird pepper might be. You can adjust the "heat" by crushing them, leaving them whole and/or adjusting the quantity used.A concern I had was that the peppers might be dried out and old - they are not.Overall the product is exactly as described and worth buying. I'll be reordering.

column9: Great tasting curry powder to compliment your red meat
column10: I've been googling curry powders for a few days. I had a craving for lamb curry masala just like how the local restaurant makes it. After choosing a paste made by a different company I asked the clerk in the store and she suggested this powder mix.Essentially this powder is all the herbs you need less the fresh ingredients. I grinded ginger and garlic and sauteed it with onions and then browned the meat.  I used sirloin chunks as I couldn't find bone-in lamb anywhere. Added water and simmered for an hour.This mix tasted great! My wife agreed. It's worth trying if you're into curry masala.  It's a bit spicy but we like it like that.

column9: The only flavor we both don't like...
column10: Love the Coffee Masters coffee but this is the only flavor that both my husband and myself dislike.  Doesn't mean it isn't any good or that other's won't like it.I have purchased many different flavors of the Coffee Masters ground coffee.  They are the best I have ever found.  Also discovered that they make a really awesome iced coffee on a hot day.  I just make a pot, let it cool and put it in the fridge.  Just throw some ice in a glass and add sugar and cream to taste.  Everyone has a favorite flavor and that is just a matter of personal preference.

Perfect potful packets are a great way to go ... each package is pre-measured to make one full pot of coffee.  No guesswork on how much or little to use.  Creme Brule is an excellent choice and makes a very smooth and delicious drink

I have been using Olewo carrots and beets for about a year now. The difference in my dogs is like day and night! Their coats are now shiny, luxurious and soft. Color and pigment are vibrant. I love the deep reds and dark blacks on my German Shepherds. Olewo also helps regulate the digestive system and their stools are better than ever. No more anal gland or digestive issues. Very simple to prepare and extremely cost effective as well. To top it all off, Olewo is very palatable and the dogs LOVE the taste. Bowls are licked clean after Olewo!

Olewo Dehydrated Carrots Dog Food Supplement, 5-1/2-PoundI have now used Olewo Carrots on all my dogs for about 10 years! I depend on the product to add fiber to their diet and shine to their coats. We have 4 breeds in our home (Boston Terrier, Lab, Great Dane and 2 Greater Swiss Mountain Dogs) and they have all seen the benefit of using the Olewo Carrots. I have mentioned this product to numerous breeders and all agree that there is nothing else like it on the market! With litters on the ground, I love sharing my Olewo Carrot product with the new puppy buyers! Thank you for making this great product available.

My wife and I have included Olewo carrots and beets in our Bearded Collie's diets for over six years. All three have beautiful coats and virtually never have digestive issues. They love the taste and wait patiently for each meal. I know of many friends that started their dogs on these products and feel the same as I do about their value. I like the products so much that I order extra so I never worry about running out.

As a breeder and exhibitor of Great Danes, our dogs are always on the go. Utilizing Olewo Carrots, our dogs have firmer stools, easily handle stress of traveling & showing weekly, and are rarely ill despite the multitude of dogs they come in contact with. They have amazing shiny coats which require no additional products. We wean our puppies adding in Olewo Carrots to their kibble to aid in digestion, boost immunity and to naturally worm. We share the benefits of Olewo Carrots with everyone we can and believe every pet owner should add it to their pet's diet.
My dog loves this stuff. It is very easy to prepare and store. I feel good feeding my show/working dog this because he needs the extra vitamins and he thinks it's a treat!

As a breeder and exhibitor of Great Danes, I am thrilled with the results I am seeing with adding the carrots and beets to my dogs food. I am seeing shinier, softer coats, and the 2 that I have with some skin irritation have improved as well in just 2 weeks. Stools are also firmer and my picky eaters love the carrots. With traveling alot and being around many different dogs I am happy that the products also help boost their immune system.  So many benefits of adding just a couple Tablespoons a day.

I have 2 dogs of my own that I use to feed dry food only.  A friend of mine recommended adding in Olewo supplements to my dog's food. I hadn't really heard of supplements for pets but I did a little research and liked what I found. My dogs love to carrot supplements in their food! I have a smaller dog who is a picky eater and would refuse food sometime. After adding in the carrots to her food she went crazy and finished every bite.
