very good lime taste,great size cookie for a snack,it got 4 stars because they crumble very easily.

column9: Lemon Divine would  be more accurate--they're from heaven!
column10: These cookies are simply scrumptious! I gave my mother some as a gift, since she loves lemon flavored desserts. What a hit! They became her instant favorites, and she begged me to get her some more. I spent $26.00 dollares for a tiny box of cookies and some 2 pc samples.This is the biggest rip off.

Now, I'm a Southern girl through and through, but I'm going to let you in on a little secret...I was born a Yankee. Yup, born in South Bend, Indiana and raised in Michigan until I was ten, when we moved to Tennessee. As a Michigander, I can say with complete confidence that Michigan blueberries are the best blueberries in the entire world. Blueberry season comes around and the state explodes into a world of deliciousness. You can stop at just about any roadside stand and get a ten pound box of blueberries, or you can head out to one of those you-pick places, if you're feeling particularly energetic (or you've got young kids...I'm looking at you, Mom!). Blueberries played a huge role in my childhood. We would snatch up all the blueberries we could during the season and freeze them. Blueberry pancakes, muffins, and cobblers were served all year round, but my favorite blueberry dish was blueberry ice cream. It's a real complicated recipe, y'all ready? You take frozen blueberries and pour cold milk over them. Yup. We're a simple folk.But my love of blueberries has come with me through my travels and life path. So when I spotted a blueberry matcha, my immediate reaction was one of "Um, heck yes, please!" The scent when I open the package is to die for. Oh my goodness, blueberry. In your face, juicy, sweet blueberry. My mouth is watering already.The taste? Oh my. No, no, let me rephrase that. Imagine that I'm George Takei. Oh myyyyyy. Yep, it's that good. George Takei "Oh myyy" inducing good. You know when you go into one of those bath and body stores, and you pick something blueberry up, smell it, and immediately tell your wife you wish you had something that tastes as good as it smells and then you lick it and it just plain doesn't taste as good as you want it to? No? Just me? Well, this matcha tastes the way those soaps smell. Intensely blueberry and incredibly delicious. Juicy is just the word that comes to mind with every sip...it's incredible. I have a few blueberry fans among my friends who will go ape over this.This review brought to you by the letter M and the number 2, which is the number of cups of matcha I've had this morning in an effort to taste them all and get my reviews written...and it's only nine o'clock. Pray for my wife, folks, she's in for a crazy morning.

Yummeh. Blueberries are not my favorite fruit, but when I opened my package I knew I was going to love this just as much as the mango. The scent was strong blueberry! It reminded me of fruit leather, deep purple, chewy, yummy homemade fruit leather by the hippie auntie I used to have. Ah sense memory, I love it so.So I whisked up this delight with the plan to make a couple little lattes - one with soymilk, one with almond and one with regular. I don't know, I just wanted to taste the nuances and find my favorite pairing I guess! Also to see which milk went best with fruit flavoured matcha.Honestly though, I really enjoyed this one sans milk - just with some sugar. (I also experimented with sweetener, and found I prefer sugar over agave for my matcha).The froth! I got a crazy amount of froth with no clumps in this batch. I definitely credit the quality of the matcha for that, because my whisk skills are shoddy at best. That's when I knew I was in for a treat today. This blueberry matcha in particular was very smooth. The berry taste fluctuated from sip to sip - one sip it was a tart not quite ripe berry, the second it was an overly plump, huge juicy ripe berry. The aftertaste was definitely the latter. The flavouring felt more strong in this batch than I expected, but I loved that very much. What a deal :D Again, I love that this company uses natural flavouring - it really shows in the quality of this matcha that it tastes like the berries, not like a candy.With almond milk, the matcha latte tastes almost like a baked good - a blueberry matcha scone or shortbread. The soymilk tasted, well, like soymilk (I think it was my least favorite of the 3). With hot frothed 2% milk it was very sweet. I find hot milk to be naturally sweet, so that probably accounts for it!Last, but certainly not least, I had it as an iced latte. (If you're wondering, with all this crazy matcha energy - I'm learning the ukulele!) I HIGHLY recommend enjoying these fruit flavour matchas from Red Leaf Tea as iced lattes. Oh my goodness! The fruit flavour just comes alive and honestly tasted like a blended real fruit smoothie. Of course, once I get a blended I will be making blended iced drinks 100% - but until then, the ice cubes will suffice.

Each sip of this Matcha was smooth and sweet, even though no sweetener was added. Its thickness made me imagine a sip of blueberry smoothie in my mouth, it even made me feel full after finishing the cup! It is a delightful experience. I also tried it iced which was delicious and refreshing.This Matcha is now permanently invited to live in my tea cabinet. It is a staple that I can't imagine living without now that I have tried it!

In the tea base and flavoring itself, is that the green matcha really nicely stands out even more so than in some of the other flavors I have bought. You know, the more I drink this the more I am loving it for that very reason. You lose none of the blueberry flavor mixing it with a shake, latte, smoothie, whatever... and the green matcha base comes out even MORE! Its like some magical blueberry matcha gnomes came in while I was not looking and sprinkled some mojo on it! Mmmmmm. Such an interesting flavor, as I continue to drink I seem to pick up different subtle nuisances in this tea mixture. I mean I am used to that in non matcha teas, but I have to say this is the first matcha, let alone a flavored matcha I have tasted something slightly different each and every time! Sometimes its just really fresh and refreshING, other sips I get more sweet, some sips I am getting far more of the matcha base with that vegetal buttery sensation, other times I get peppery note even! Its strange, and enjoyable.

This is my new favorite pasta sauce. I got a sample at Costco one day and decided to buy some.It's veggie and not oily at all. Very fresh tasting. Very full flavored so that you can eat it very plain. I love it best with the 5 cheese tortellini that they were giving out as samples. Just great!

Dave's Gourmet is known for its punchy hot sauces, but its pasta sauces are underrated... especially this one. Made in San Francisco from butternut squash harvested in Oregon's Willamette Valley, it's at once savory and sweet. It has such a filling flavor that even Parmesan cheese is beside the point. It's a great topping for gnocchi,pasta,etc. It's a wonderfully autumnal sauce. Bon appetit!

If you are looking for a change of pace from regular tomato based sauce, you will be pleasantly surprised. I purchased this at Costco, I am not sure of any other stores that sell this. It is amazing. Very fresh tasting. A little, but not too, sweet. I cannot recommend it highly enough, especially for a gluten free offering.

column4: Joy A. Lewis "Joy at the shore"
column9: the BEST sauce I ever had!!!
column10: I have never written a review before...that's how much I LOVE LOVE LOVE this sauce! I have never liked red tomato sauces of any kind and I've tried many. I usually make a white alfredo sauce for my pasta which is not exactly low fat and not the best choice for my slim down program. I was excited to find and try this sauce because I really like the taste of butternut squash. I didn't tell my husband what is was before he ate it because he's not a vegetable kind of guy and hesitates to try anything new. After I knew he liked it I told him. This is a great way to eat healthy (only 4 grams of fat per serving) and sooooooo tasty with just the right amount of sweetnesss. Amazon also has the best price on this sauce. Don't hesitate to try it...you won't be sorry. It's really a treat for me when I find a new food product I like. I purchased this on a whim after eating a butternut squash pasta dish at a very nice restaurant. When I first saw this sitting on a store shelf, my initial thought was, "what a great idea!"...After reading the (short & simple) list of ingredients, my next thought was something along the lines of, "what a welcome surprise - none of the non-food chemical smoke & mirror -like ick otherwise found in so many food products"...After opening the jar, I thought, "it looks 'real', & looks fresh"...After tasting it the first time, I thought, "WOW - this stuff is FANTASTIC!" - & then my mind & tastebuds were 'off to the races', as I pondered what other ways the sauce could be used - it would rock more than just pasta... this stuff is the kind of wondrous food product that upon discovery, launches one into a kind of, 'I've got to tell ___ about this' bit of excited celebration... you want to share the news with others, & honestly, a part of me was practically skipping inside (the part that 'cheerleads' transformative outcomes which render vegetables-that-get-a-bad-rap into a form of taste heaven, let alone versions of such that one could previously only dream of)...The taste of this sauce is such a pleasant surprise - don't let the 'looks like solid squash' aspect fool ya - there's a wonderful dance that all of the ingredients participate in, & the reaction I have with practically every taste of it is one of renewed surprise at how incredibly flavorful this sauce is (& consistent with another person's comments in a recent review, I found myself wondering about the potential of eating the sauce as a 'soup').Whoever was involved with creating, & ultimately fine-tuning, this delightful combination of ingredients (let alone having it turn out so darn pretty), deserves every accolade in whatever categories this sauce might ever qualify in, when it comes to the official 'food world' recognizing the achievement... the accolades emanating from blown away customers who taste it will be ongoing...
Simply divine! I love this sauce. I will go back to costco and get several more to stock up -- this seems like something they may not carry year round. 2 jars for under $7 at costco.

column9: Best pasta sauce I've ever had
column10: I do most of the cooking in our house, and most of the dishes as well, so most dinners involve only one or two pots.  Consequently, pasta is a staple.  I like red sauces because of their lower calorie content, and my wife and son prefer white and cheese sauces.  Pasta night regularly involves the wrinkling of noses.Lately, my wife has been on a winter squash kick.  While shopping at a local grocery store, we bought a jar of 'Dave's Gourmet Butternut Squash Pasta Sauce' on Saturday on a whim since my wife really like's winter squash.Sunday, for lunch, we had it over ravioli. My son, who puts cheese on everything, added none to his bowl of ravioli and sauce.  This sauce is fabulous.  It's sweet, but just sweet enough. It's spicy, but just spicy enough.  The sauce immediately became our favorite pasta sauce, bar none.Today, we picked up four more jars. If it's still in stock in early December, I will probably give it as Christmas gifts.Yum!

column9: Good enough to be served as a soup
column10: I found this sauce in our neighborhood Marshall's...lol, yup.  I don't normally shop there but I was bored one day and since it just opened, I wanted to check it out.  Since I was bored, I was "digging" for a good deal and taking my time looking through their stuff. Man, why haven't I heard of it before? Well, needless to say, I've gone back and purchase their entire stock of the stuff and plan to go back and get their other sauces too. Hope this helps, enjoy!

I've always been a fan of squash raviolis, but I had never heard of squash pasta sauce until I saw Dave's Gourmet Butternut Squash Pasta Sauce - 25.5 Ounces at Costco. It's hailed as the first of its kind-- "all-natural butternut-squash pasta sauce...made with squash ripened in Oregon's Willamette Valley." The product is manufactured in San Francisco, CA and is made of the highest quality ingredients (order of the ingredients on the label):* Butternut Squash* Water* Tomato Paste* Red Bell Peppers* Evaporated Cane Juice* Butter* Celery* Onion* Garlic* Sea Salt* Citric Acid* Black PepperIt does contain dairy, so if you are lactose intolerance or a vegan, you should avoid this pasta sauce. Still, I'm happy to report that the pasta sauce is gluten-free.As for the taste, the biggest criticism I have is that it's one of the sweetest pasta sauces I've ever eaten. It's not sweet as in "candy sweet." It's what I would call "savory-sweet." The ingredients that hit your taste buds the most are butternut squash and red bell peppers. Because butternut squash is one of the sweetest squashes out there, it's expected that this sauce would exemplify that flavor. If the sweetness bothers you, there is a way to rectify that issue. For myself, I simply add more black pepper to it, preferably freshly cracked peppercorn. The pepper transforms it to more of a traditional savory taste. If you're a garlic lover, adding some more of this spice also helps.As for the texture, the sauce is a good consistency when you first open it, not too watery and not too thick. However, if you don't use up all the sauce with your first batch of cooking, it will thicken inside the fridge. It tastes good fresh or after being stored in the refrigerator for a little bit. The only problem with letting it sit in the fridge is that the sauce gets more difficult to pour out from the bottle because of its thickness. A little bit of water added to the remaining sauce will allow you to maximize the amount of leftover sauce.There are many products you can use this pasta sauce with. Of course, there is traditional plain pasta. I paired the sauce with Barilla Plus Penne Pasta, and I was very happy with the overall taste and flavor of the meal. I've also used the butternut squash on polenta and cheese raviolis, again wonderful pairings. I did add aged Parmesan Cheese, pepper, garlic, and salt to all of these dishes to help tone down the sweetness of the sauce. The label also suggests using the sauce with tortellinis and lasagna. Basically, you can use this pasta sauce with any type of pasta dish and be assured that you will have "a delicious change of pace" to your meal.While doing some additional research about this pasta sauce, I discovered that it's an award-winning recipe. In 2009, Dave won a Gold Award for Outstanding Pasta Sauce (N.A.S.F.T.) for his Butternut Squash recipe. In fact, Dave's been winning awards for his tasty gourmet creations since 1994 when his Salute Dressing won the Outstanding Healthy/Nutritious Product (N.A.S.F.T). I'm very impressed at the amount of awards he's won, and I would be willing to try any of his other amazing products, especially Dave's Gourmet Organic Spicy Heirloom Marinara Pasta Sauce - 26 Ounces. I highly suggest readers and potential consumers view all of Dave's award winning food products ([...]).Overall, I'm very happy with this product. It's so good, I'm not ashamed to say that I like eating the sauce directly from the bottle (in small doses of course). I'm very happy that I visited Costco the day it was being featured. I wish that more non-bulk grocery stores offered samples because then I would have additional chances of discovering some fantastic products like Dave's Gourmet Butternut Squash Pasta Sauce - 25.5 Ounces.

But after tasting it, I realized indeed what a great gift it was! I love it with raviloi, chicken ravioli to be exact (although it's great with cheese ravioli, too). I was so happy to find it at our local Costco recently! MmmmMmmm, taste is great. Highly recommended :)
This is so good.  Love this sauce.  Served over pasta with parmesan cheese. Lots of uses --- soup base, vegitarian lasagna, excited to come up with ways to use it. Will definately serve again...

If you prefer a more savory sauce just cut it with vegetable stock. I will definitely buy this again. Oh yeah, I found this cheaper in my local grocery store.

Well, its been at our Cosco for over 3 months now-I hope it's not seasonal anymore. We love this sauce. This has got to be the BEST pasta sauce. It has it all, tons of flavor and not spicy. A must try!

Instead, the predominate taste was that of the red bell peppers included in the sauce. I topped it with some parmesan, and it was just ok. I doubt that I'll serve this again.

column9: Best Hot Sauce in the World
column10: I first tried Baron's West Indian Hot Sauce on my honeymoon in St. Lucia.  It added so much to my dining pleasure that I brought back a few bottles in my suitcase.  The scotch bonnet is a type of habenero.  What is unique about it is that it has a very fruity flavor along with the heat, and the mustard adds complexity.  The combination of fruit, heat, and spice is truly extraordinary.  I like it on fish, chicken, burgers, steaks, turkey sandwiches, egg sandwiches, french fries, and fruit, yes! Fruit!  If you want to completely blow your mind, try it on a wedge of drippy ripe mango.  It it is dynomite with omlettes and any egg dish at breakfast, no better way to start the day.  Just be careful who and where you kiss after eating this hot sauce.  I have also tried Glady's of St. Thomas, which is also excellent, I am a big fan.  Compared to Glady's I found that Baron's is more fruity, more consistant, and keeps better over long periods.

column9: fantastic product and even better seller!!
column10: We first had this hot sauce on our honeymoon in St. Lucia and we were bummed that we couldnt bring any back with us.  However, we were able to find it here on Amazon.  I mistakenly had the shipping address incorrect (never changed to the new address) and once I noticed it and contacted Amazon and the seller, they were able to re-rout it after it had already been shipped.  I cant thank both the seller and Amazon for great customer service.  And the sauce is awesome, delicious and of course, HOT. Order a bottle and you wont be disappointed....unless you dont like spicy stuff!

Habe diese Sauce mehr per Zufall mal in einem Asia-Supermarkt mitgehen lassen. Ich war sehr überrascht, da ich bisher nur die Tabasco-ähnlichen Essigbasierten Hot-Sauces gewohnt war. Eines vorweg: Die Sauce ist sehr scharf, dh für den normalen mitteleuropäischen Geschmack (Für Chilli-Fanatiker wahrscheinlich eher im oberen Mittelfeld). Daneben, und das ist das besondere, hat sie auch einen vollen (sie enthält auch Senf), in Anklängen sehr fruchtigen Geschmack (das macht die verwendete Chilli-Sorte). Daher eignet sie sich für eine Vielzahl von Gerichten, denen sie den letzten Geschmacks- und Schärfekick zu geben vermag. Ich verwende sie zum Marinieren von Fleisch, in Saucen und Currys, aber auch in Suppen.Auch nicht unwichtig: Ich habe keine "bösen" Inhaltstoffe finden können.Sofern man sie nicht eintrocken lässt, hält sie sich auch sehr lange und hat daher einen Stammplatz in meinem Kühlschrank.

column9: H O T sauce with FLAVOR
column10: Like most others in the reviews, I discovered this wonderful HOT sauce while on vacation in Saint Lucia. This is not your ordinary, run of the mill, so called hot sauce. It has a nice yellowish color, with red specks of goodness, (peppers) and is somewhat thick in consistency, as opposed to what you would expect to find in your typical hot sauce (Tabasco, Franks, Etc.)  This HOT sauce is H O T and has a LOT of flavor and character that seriously sets it apart from the afore mentioned sauces, no disrespect to them intended, I still love and use my Franks/Tabasco! BUT; Barons West Indian HOT Sauce is completely different: it is rather thick,(reminiscent of cheese dip) super tasty, and SUPER HOT! A little bit goes a  long  way! If you want just a touch of heat that is different from 'the red stuff', try Barons. If you don't like heat at all....STAY AWAY! If you don't mind some heat and are looking for something new to flavor your: tuna salad, cheese dip, pasta salad, mac & cheese, pizza, spaghetti, eggs, and the list goes on and on..... Barons West Indian hot sauce is woooooo....H O T.... but so good.

column9: Full of flavor and a variety of uses
column10: Just got back from St. Lucia and purchased as much as I could of this Hot Sauce.  My first experience with it was on "Deviled Garlic Cheese Bread" at an upscale steakhouse in Rodney Bay, St. Lucia, West Indies.  When we tried this bread, which was mozzarella cheese and garlic on top of bread brushed with this hot sauce, we had no idea that we would experience so much flavor.  We ordered this bread about 4 more times during our stay there and ended up insisting that we know the secret.Since then, I've used this with a variety of other meals.  I've been known to pick up the Tabasco from time to time just because I want an interesting taste.  This Barron Hot Sauce is in a different league.I highly recommend it.  Also great as a gift for hot sauce lovers.

We went to St. Lucia on our honeymoon and stayed at Sandals resort.  The burger shack had a huge vat of this, and when I asked what it was they said it was the locally made hot sauce and warned me that it was super hot.  I tried it and instantly fell in love.  It is a mustard based hot sauce made with scotch bonnet peppers.  I have trouble finding very hot sauce that actually tastes good, and this really delivers.  I took home several bottles from St. Lucia and just recently ordered a couple off of Amazon.  As long as you like it hot and tasty, you will not be disappointed!  My favorite hot sauce and condiment bar none.

column9: The Best There Is - Bar None
column10: This isn't just hot or "vinegary." It's hot and tasty. We use it on and in a wide variety of foods ranging from hamburgers to tuna salad. Quite simply, it's the best there is, bar none.

I brought a bottle of this back from St. Lucia.  They had it at the Sandals resort we stayed at and I fell in love instantly.  This is one hot and tasty sauce.  Not for the faint of heart.  It packs some major heat.  I LOVE IT!!

After having this hot sauce at a restaurant I tracked it down to order some for my personal stash.  It's very good, and unlike any other hot sauce I've tried.  It's very hot, so if you like things mild it's not for you.  But it also has a great flavor.  Shipping is expensive as it's coming from quite a ways away, but that's ok, it's not something I'm going to be doing every week.

This is the best Hot Sauce that I have EVER had.  It is also quite the spiciest, so you only need a little bit.  It was given to me as a gift, and I just love it.  This is a sauce for true hot sauce lovers that desire a wonderful blend of hot spices.

This is the best hot sauce I have tasted short of Gladys's from St. Croix (which doesn't ship their product)!  Thus, definitely worth a try, especially if you have never had the West Indian style from the Caribbean.  Warning -- it is VERY hot!

column9: Baron's hot sauce. A must for hot sauce lovers!
column10: I am a native-born saint Lucian.  Baron's is the hot sauce served on our Island.  Saint Lucians as well as vacationers love it.  I gave some as gifts last year and everyone wants more! Even my friends who usually do not like hot sauce fell in love with this fantastic sauce. If you love hot sauce you are in for a treat.  Baron's Saint Luican hot sauce is full of flavor and quite spicy and a little goes a long way. Great to cook with or sprinkle on your favorite dish.  Try it.  You will not be sorry.

Barons West Indian Hot Sauce has the perfect balance of flavor and heat rarely found in commercial sauces. The blending of Scotch Bonnet peppers and mustard offers an unique flavor addition to most meat and fish dishes. Barons hot sauce is a welcome addition to my hot sauce pantry.

I've always been a fan of Bumble Bee tuna and easy meals on the go. But this is just brilliant. The tuna salad is great alone. The peaches and cookie are a nice touch to round out the meal. I've been looking for these for a while and have been difficult to track down. This is a good price compared to other sites. A meal to go under $3.00 is a good bargain. Delicious!

column9: This Ready to Eat Meal Tastes Good
column10: When hurricane season approaches, this is what we pick up for our emergency food rations.  The tuna salad is already mixed so there is no mess.  No can opener required.  This kit includes:2.9 oz. can of tuna salad4.0 oz. snack cup of diced peaches  foil wrapped pack of 6 crisp crackers  chocolate chip cookie  plastic fork/spoonIt provides 500 calories.  I can assure you, having a chocolate chip cookie (even when it is dry) is a great comfort when your property is being shredded by howling winds.  These kits are packed well enough and light for travel, but not crush proof.  The soft lids peel right off without cutting fingers.I tried some MRE dehydrated hiking/hunting food.  Ugh!  I much prefer having my eggs in this tuna salad.  They are mixed with mayonaise, water chestnuts, carrots and celery.  The shelf life is one year if you can refrain from eating them that long.We enjoy eating these good tasting snacks when there are no emergencies.  We love premium quality Bumble Bee tuna.  It is Dolphin Safe.

I love having something in my desk that I can just dig into at lunch without even having to go stand in line for the microwave in the breakroom. But finding something really satisfying and tasty, and for under $3, is amazing! I've always loved Bumblee Bee tuna anyway, and their tuna salad mix is fantastic. The peaches and cookie both taste great, and the whole thing makes for a really satisfying lunch...and perfect for at work.

column9: Great tasting tuna kit! Cookie, not so good.
column10: This tuna kit is the best.  I've had the starkist brand a lot, but that one is so messy and hard to make.  With this one, all you do is pop the can open and enjoy delicious tuna on crackers! Speaking of which, there are never enough crackers in these kits to go with the amount of tuna, unless you heap the tuna on.  I like to keep an extra sleeve of crackers in my drawer at work to finish off the tuna.The tuna can looks small, but it is plenty for me.  The included peach cup is a nice touch to round out the lunch.The cookie on the other hand is bland, dry, brittle, and tasteless.  I'd almost prefer no cookie than what they have included in this kit.  They either need to drop the cookie all together or replace it with something a little better tasting.Despite the cookie, this kit is awesome, I will buy many more!

I've tried this lunch kit before, seeing it on sale in the grocery store. It's a great concept, a "lunchable" for adults that doesn't need to be refrigerated. For $2.50/kit, it's also a great deal (especially with free shipping!). 500 calories for lunch isn't bad and the cookie can always be kept for later or given to someone else to cut calories further. I wouldn't recommend eating this everyday, as other reviewers have mentioned. Tuna has a high level of mercury, so you really want to limit yourself to eating 1 - 2 servings per week. I usually see the kits on sale for around $3, so it's not that great of a deal. However, it's really nice to have a case of 8 in the pantry. It's also something that can be used in food storage for emergencies.

I have a Koolatron KWC-4 Coca-Cola Personal 6-Can Mini Fridge at work and bring these to work to eat. I like my tuna and peaches cold, always have for some reason. I have one in the mini fridge, for when I get in my office in the morning; and bring an extra to put in for tomorrow. I love these along with a small juice pouch.I like the whole set: the tuna salad in the can with an easy open lid, the sweet juicy peaches, crackers for the tuna, and a cookie to top it off with. Yum! They go great with juice. This kit helps me avoid the community fridge, so I don't have to worry about the sorry excuse "I thought this was anybodys food in this fridge" when my tuna ends up missing.Luckily enough, I can shove the kit and pouch in the tiny Coke fridge of mine. For the price of this kit it's awesome! Plus it keeps me from the community fridge, it pays for itself right there!Yeah, this tuna deserves 5 stars! For the price and convienence, it's a steal. All the food is very good and full on flavor. I recommend this to anyone who loves tuna. Unfortunately Amazon no longer ships these 8 packs. I wish they would, cause it's a great combo.I also have a comment about one user complaining about it coming with some peaches; is it really that hard to toss those away? Plus, deduct 2 stars from a 5 star product just beause it gave extra accessories? I mean really, come on.

column9: Great lunch to have in a hurry
column10: I keep buying these because I am often running late in the morning and dont have time to pack a lunch. Since you dont have to refridgerate, I just keep these in my office so I dont have to take a "lunch break" to go get fast food or something.
The tuna mix is some of the best I have ever tasted, and with the crackers, it makes a great lunch on the go or snack. And the fruit and cookie only finish it off delightfully.

Our local stores quit stocking Lunch on the Run. I couldn't find it locally. By chance I checked on Amazon and ended up buying two cases. And the price was a real deal to what I was paying at the store. I drive locally and they are great to carry in the truck. When you don't have time to stop or able to park, these are great. Sure glad I found them on Amazon. And the service was great.
Not sure why, but I really do love these.  Except the cookie.  The cookies are no good but who needs a cookie anyway?  Crackers, tuna & peaches are yummy!
This is a perfect lunch.  If they could figure out how to add a drink, like apple juice, that'd be awesome!!!

I bought some of these to have in my emergency kit during the tornado season.  Now that the danger in my area has passed and being hungry and not wanting to cook, I cracked one of these open.  The tuna-to-cracker ratio is perfect.  The tuna salad is great and the peaches and cookie were also yummy.  Perfect portions for a quick light lunch.  It's the rare "kit" that tastes this good for such a good price.  A+, Bumble Bee.

This meal is a much better deal than the more expensive Starkist "lunch to go" as it includes not only tuna and crackers but also peaches and a cookie. As the other reviewers said, all of the included items are very tasty. This is a great value and very convenient for me to carry to work each day. It's nice to get two boxes at a time and save on shipping as well.

I don't know if I received a bad batch, but the tuna in the can tasted sour, as if it had gone bad. I think it may have been sitting in the warehouse for too long? In addition, the cookie was rock hard and inedible.

column9: Tuna Salad & crackers are nice, but I don't care for the peaches
column10: I ordered this without looking at the reviews - I wish I had; the tuna salad and crackers are just fine, but I don't care for peaches . . . if I had known the package included a cup of peaches, I wouldn't have ordered the item.  I know now that all three reviews in existence on May 11, 2011 mentioned the peaches, but I feel I shouldn't have to look at the reviews in order to know what the contents of the package I'm ordering are going to be.
Surups are syrups, no? Good stuff I've bought a few times already, I use it for some many things that I might try and get as a monthly refill like they do for supplements... lol

Now, I'm a Southern girl through and through, but I'm going to let you in on a little secret...I was born a Yankee. Yup, born in South Bend, Indiana and raised in Michigan until I was ten, when we moved to Tennessee. As a Michigander, I can say with complete confidence that Michigan blueberries are the best blueberries in the entire world. Blueberry season comes around and the state explodes into a world of deliciousness. You can stop at just about any roadside stand and get a ten pound box of blueberries, or you can head out to one of those you-pick places, if you're feeling particularly energetic (or you've got young kids...I'm looking at you, Mom!). Blueberries played a huge role in my childhood. We would snatch up all the blueberries we could during the season and freeze them. Blueberry pancakes, muffins, and cobblers were served all year round, but my favorite blueberry dish was blueberry ice cream. It's a real complicated recipe, y'all ready? You take frozen blueberries and pour cold milk over them. Yup. We're a simple folk.But my love of blueberries has come with me through my travels and life path. So when I spotted a blueberry matcha, my immediate reaction was one of "Um, heck yes, please!" The scent when I open the package is to die for. Oh my goodness, blueberry. In your face, juicy, sweet blueberry. My mouth is watering already.The taste? Oh my. No, no, let me rephrase that. Imagine that I'm George Takei. Oh myyyyyy. Yep, it's that good. George Takei "Oh myyy" inducing good. You know when you go into one of those bath and body stores, and you pick something blueberry up, smell it, and immediately tell your wife you wish you had something that tastes as good as it smells and then you lick it and it just plain doesn't taste as good as you want it to? No? Just me? Well, this matcha tastes the way those soaps smell. Intensely blueberry and incredibly delicious. Juicy is just the word that comes to mind with every sip...it's incredible. I have a few blueberry fans among my friends who will go ape over this.This review brought to you by the letter M and the number 2, which is the number of cups of matcha I've had this morning in an effort to taste them all and get my reviews written...and it's only nine o'clock. Pray for my wife, folks, she's in for a crazy morning.

Yummeh. Blueberries are not my favorite fruit, but when I opened my package I knew I was going to love this just as much as the mango. The scent was strong blueberry! It reminded me of fruit leather, deep purple, chewy, yummy homemade fruit leather by the hippie auntie I used to have. Ah sense memory, I love it so.So I whisked up this delight with the plan to make a couple little lattes - one with soymilk, one with almond and one with regular. I don't know, I just wanted to taste the nuances and find my favorite pairing I guess! Also to see which milk went best with fruit flavoured matcha.Honestly though, I really enjoyed this one sans milk - just with some sugar. (I also experimented with sweetener, and found I prefer sugar over agave for my matcha).The froth! I got a crazy amount of froth with no clumps in this batch. I definitely credit the quality of the matcha for that, because my whisk skills are shoddy at best. That's when I knew I was in for a treat today. This blueberry matcha in particular was very smooth. The berry taste fluctuated from sip to sip - one sip it was a tart not quite ripe berry, the second it was an overly plump, huge juicy ripe berry. The aftertaste was definitely the latter. The flavouring felt more strong in this batch than I expected, but I loved that very much. What a deal :D Again, I love that this company uses natural flavouring - it really shows in the quality of this matcha that it tastes like the berries, not like a candy.With almond milk, the matcha latte tastes almost like a baked good - a blueberry matcha scone or shortbread. The soymilk tasted, well, like soymilk (I think it was my least favorite of the 3). With hot frothed 2% milk it was very sweet. I find hot milk to be naturally sweet, so that probably accounts for it!Last, but certainly not least, I had it as an iced latte. (If you're wondering, with all this crazy matcha energy - I'm learning the ukulele!) I HIGHLY recommend enjoying these fruit flavour matchas from Red Leaf Tea as iced lattes. Oh my goodness! The fruit flavour just comes alive and honestly tasted like a blended real fruit smoothie. Of course, once I get a blended I will be making blended iced drinks 100% - but until then, the ice cubes will suffice.

Each sip of this Matcha was smooth and sweet, even though no sweetener was added. Its thickness made me imagine a sip of blueberry smoothie in my mouth, it even made me feel full after finishing the cup! It is a delightful experience. I also tried it iced which was delicious and refreshing.This Matcha is now permanently invited to live in my tea cabinet. It is a staple that I can't imagine living without now that I have tried it!

In the tea base and flavoring itself, is that the green matcha really nicely stands out even more so than in some of the other flavors I have bought. You know, the more I drink this the more I am loving it for that very reason. You lose none of the blueberry flavor mixing it with a shake, latte, smoothie, whatever... and the green matcha base comes out even MORE! Its like some magical blueberry matcha gnomes came in while I was not looking and sprinkled some mojo on it! Mmmmmm. Such an interesting flavor, as I continue to drink I seem to pick up different subtle nuisances in this tea mixture. I mean I am used to that in non matcha teas, but I have to say this is the first matcha, let alone a flavored matcha I have tasted something slightly different each and every time! Sometimes its just really fresh and refreshING, other sips I get more sweet, some sips I am getting far more of the matcha base with that vegetal buttery sensation, other times I get peppery note even! Its strange, and enjoyable.

I am very happy with these wonderful tasting shredded fillo. My company and I enjoyed them with coffee. Will buy them again.
This Kataifi was good, but I heated it in oven a few minutes to get it a little crunchy.
I found this coffee to be strong like i like it but without the bitter taste.  I wound recommend this for any coffer lover.

I loved the Breakfast Blend (NOT the new Medium) before Starbucks dropped it completely.  I've been looking for a replacement, which is very hard to do, but heard that this Seattle's Best Level 3 was not bad.  I first tasted it at a local Subway, of all places, and it was incredibly good.  I ordered three from Amazon and continue to drink it, though it has yet to meet my preference for the old Breakfast Blend.  It does, however, if brewed a bit stronger than usual, have a very nice taste that I might just get used to.  It's not quite as sweet or smooth as the old B Blend, but it's fairly good overall.

I ordered Seattle's Best Ground Blend Coffee, 12-Ounce (Pack of 2) and have brewed several pots with several changes in the amount of coffee used. I have yet to get a 'good' pot out of this. To be fair, what I expected from this was good flavor and strength. The coffee is weak, in my opinion. I also feel it lacks appealing flavor or flavor at all in some cases. I feel the taste is equal to making coffee from a bargain brand, which this is not. I would not re-order or recommend this coffee. Note that I love, however, the decaf version of this, which is very good- tasty and robust.

column10: it seemed to have more caffeen than usual if that's even possiable.. aNd has a weird smell that everyone else could smell, but I could not. column9: Great wasabi flaovr not not pure wasabi
column10: Wasabi can be a tricky thing to buy, as some sources coarse-gring the horseradish, and a lot comes as a paste.  This wasabi comes finely ground in a double sealed can to retain freshness.  It is easy to use in recipes and make into a paste, on an as-you-need basis, allowing you to always have wasabi on hand without the fear of it going bad or losing potency.  I would have given the wasabi 5-stars if it weren't for the fact that wasabi is actually the LAST ingredient in the product, with horseradish (i assume non-wasabi), mustard and tapioca starch preceeding wasabi on the list.  This would indicate that wasabi is actually less than 25% of the product content.  It does not affect the overall flavor but it is deceptive.
I must say, this is one of the BEST yogurt I've had in YEARS!THANKS!!
I gave this gift to my supervisor for Christmas and anyone who "loves" spicy will definitely adore this gift.  The tabasco pail will be very useful after the goodies have long since been eaten.
Herb Tea, Bengal Spice, 20 ct ( Value Bulk Multi-pack).It was fine.I really enjoyed the tea it was so good. I don't like being forced into 20 words for a review

I like that this product is very natural and I understand what all the ingredients are.  My cat loves the food too.  My only complaint is that I can't find it in my area so I have to order it off the internet.  The shipping really adds to the price.

column9: If you can't go raw, go with this!
column10: The food this company makes is the closest I can find to raw until I actually get to feed mine raw more often. The value is amazing... actually because it is so dense with nutrients, my cats eat less and I spend less feeding them this brand of food than the other premium brands I was feeding them before.The canned is a dense pate style that needs to be mashed down. My cats had not been fond of pate textures of other brands of foods in the past. It took about 4 days for one of my cats to recognize it as her new food. She had to be enticed but it ends up she is loving it! (Patience pays off!) There was no problem getting my other cat to eat it after having it for a meal for the first time. The both now eat all 3 available flavors and seem to love the rabbit the best.Their coats are magnificent! Their stools are small and odorless, similar to what it would look like if they were on a raw diet. My oldest cat who had mild digestive issues doesn't have them anymore. Hooray! I also noticed that while on this brand of food, the crusty sleepies in their eyes are just about non-existent. I hardly have to groom their faces anymore. And they are so active I can hardly believe they have that much energy for their ages.I honestly believe that having no synthesized vitamins makes a world of difference. I had to go back to my old brand of kibble for a short time because I was waiting for my next Nature's Logic order to arrive. On their old brand the cats were producing so much extra waste and it wasn't nearly as healthy-looking. The difference really is amazing.There is no doubt to me the Nature's Logic foods are truly easy to digest and the nutrients are absorbed and used! I hope they continue to grow and the product becomes more well known and available. I recommend it to everyone with cats!Pros : Improves Coat, Increased Activity, Good Value, Likes It, All Natural, Good Taste, Nutritional, Easy To Digest, Odorless StoolsCons : Few Flavor Selections

This is one of the few chicken cat foods that don't contain some kind of fish and my cat loves it.  One of my 3 has allergies to fish so I have had somewhat of a challenge finding food without any type of fish protein.  She can also have lamb, which does help as far as alternating and giving her variety.  This one is just wonderful in that it doesn't contain any synthetic vitamins.  A great approach and well received in my home.  One of my other cats has a longer allergy list and is currently on rabbit, which is even harder to find.  She is on the top 3 brands that offer rabbit, including this one.  She loves it, so I thought I would try the chicken flavor for my little fish-less one and it turned out to be a rewarding venture.  I find the price competitive with this type of food and will keep it in their rotations.  It is drier than other brands, but I just cut it up and add about a tablespoon of water on top.  They lick it off like gravy.  Good deal.

column9: Makes a cup of coffee taste like a candy bar, without the calories
column10: If you haven't tried this product you really should buy a bottle and experience it for yourself.  I think that it is good enough that you won't miss the sugar.Water is so good for us, but so boring.  If you are trying to increase your consumption of water, try a little of this in the water.This product can also be used to make an Italian soda (a little syrup, a little cream, and some sparkling water).  Another yummy treat, if only they made a fat free cream it would be perfect.My husband and I have been buying this brand of sugar free syrup for years.  A pump of this syrup into your coffee changes it from a standard morning beverage into a liquid candy bar in a mug.  I recently switched from half and half to soy milk in my coffee.  With this syrup in my coffee the switch to soy milk was very easy.The ingredients in this product (listed in order) are as follows:Purified waterNatural flavorsCaramel colorPotassium sorbate and sodium benzoate (to preserve freshness)Citric acidXantham gumSucralose (splenda brand)Acesulfame potassiumNutrition Facts label reads as follows:Serving Size:  1 oz.Servings per Package:  25.4Calories:  0Calories from fat:  0Total Fat:  0 gSodium:  15 mgTotal Carbohydrate:  0 gSugars:  0 gProtein:  0gIf you find that you like this product I would suggest that you order a pump for the bottle.  It allows you to dispense the same amount into your coffee without having to tediously measure.

So, I'll buy a cafe latte or cappuccino instead and add this to it and it tastes the same! (grrr.)

i mean it's....no miracle but it gets the job done. The taste overall is pretty good. i ordered the vanilla (kinda bitter but has a full bodied flavor that i like) and chocolate........and i like the chocolate more which is surprisng bc im not a huge fan of chocolate stuff but i wanted something to give my coffee and black teas that xtra non-caloric oompf...(plus, opening splenda packets can be a hassle...ya kno when that hot steam liqufies the powder b4 it comes out of the package...maybe thats just my pet peeve) anyways. i might try other flavors in the future...perhaps the fruity ones to add to my herbal/fruit teas.

Mc Cormick Recipe-Inspirations Garlic Lime Fajitas .32ozThis is a hit with my family and when I needed something recently for unexpected guests.The package contains:1 tsp McCormick minced garlic1 tsp McCormick minced onions3/4 tsp McCormick ground cumin3/4 tsp McCormick oregano leaves1/2 tsp McCormick cilantro leaves1/2 tsp McCormick coarse ground black pepper (I love that they specified "McCormick" on each spice.)Add:1/4 cup each lime and orange juices (fresh is best)2 tbsp olive oil1/2 tsp salt (I generally reduce this and it's fine)1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts cut into thin strips (I usually use two pounds; we're big on leftovers)1 each bell pepper and onion thinly sliced (again, I use 2 each)flour tortillasThe back peels off to make a perfect little recipe card complete with a picture and nutrition information, and each individual package of spice pops out labeled and sealedNo MSG, no silicon whatever for anti-caking, or anything else questionable.The package contains a best by date, so you know if you've received old stock.I love that I can determine the amount of salt! I've had hypertension since my early twenties and packaged spice mixes are often sodium landmines.As I'm planning an upcoming car camping trip, this is definitely one of the meals we'll have. I don't need to take 6 bottles of spices. We always have salt and oil. I'll cut the chicken breasts into strips at home and freeze them in a big Ziploc bag as flat as possible for easy thawing at the campsite, but they'll also help with temp management for the "meat and dairy" cooler in the meantime. The big Ziploc bag will also be my marinating container. Throw a couple limes, an orange, two bell peppers, a huge vidalia sweet onion, and a package of tortillas in the "fruit, veggie and bread" cooler. Add a bag of shredded cheese to the "meat and dairy cooler." I'll pre-slice the bell peppers and onion at home and pack them together in another big Ziploc bag for space management. It's a one dish meal, absolutely a camping requirement. It's great without the tortillas for the low-carb set. And the directions are right there, so maybe I can get a night off from camp kitchen duties!If I'm really ambitious, I will make pico de gallo at home: a couple or three fresh tomatoes diced and drained for a bit, another vidalia sweet onion diced fine, one or two serrano peppers finely minced, chopped cilantro to taste and lime juice. This is best within a day or two of being made and will keep longer if the tomatoes are more drained than not. I prefer Lock & Lock Shrink-wrap 3.7 Cup Square Value 2 Pack Storage to store this in for freshness and to ensure absolutely NO leakage. I'll put this in the "fruit, veggie and bread" cooler. The colder "meat and dairy" cooler would ruin the tomatoes. I make lots because some people love this with chips too.Obviously, with the exact amount of each spice specified on the package, you can buy each spice in bulk and replicate this combination far more cheaply, but sometimes convenience trumps frugality.Don't forget the Cholula. Some like it hot!

This is the first time I've had Freekeh and it was excellent! I will now stock my pantry with it as a staple. It's low in calories, high in fiber and high in protein -- and also high in flavor. The Risotto I made with the Freekeh was low-cal and low-fat but tasted amazing and kept me full for a very long time. That's a winning combination in my book.Low Cal Freekeh Risotto------------------------1 Tblsp Olive Oil1 Large Onion, course chopped1 tsp Dried Ground Sage2 cups Freekeh1/2 Cup White White (Pinot Grigio is excellent)1 (standard large size) Box of Low Sodium Chicken Broth (or Vegetable Broth if you're a vegan.)1/2 Cup Fresh Shredded Parmesan2 Tblsp Fat Free Cream Cheese15 Spritzes of spray butter substitute2 Cups Cubed, Cooked Butternut Squash (to keep this simple you can buy the pre-cubed stuff at the grocery store)1 Cup Frozen Sweet Peas (thawed)In a very large skillet, over medium heat, cook onions in the olive oil until tender (cook longer if you'd like them caramelized.) Add the Freekeh and Sage to the pan and "toast" the Freekeh with the cooked onions for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Add white wine and stir until the wine has been completely absorbed. Add enough broth to completely cover the Freekeh. Stir and allow to simmer until the broth has been mostly absorbed. Add about another cup of broth, stir, simmmer...continue this process, adding about a cup of broth at a time, until the Freekeh begins to release its starches and looks creamy. This will take about an hour. (If you run out of broth before the desired consistency has been achieved, start using warm water instead of broth.) Turn off heat. Immediately add Parmesan, cream cheese and spray butter. Mix in thoroughly until cream cheese has melted. Now gently fold in your vegetables and allow to sit for a minute or so to bring veggies up to temperature. Makes 6 servings.

column9: Does this product really deserve another 1-star review? Yes it does.
column10: Believe everything you read here, folks. This stuff really IS that bad. The product smelled rancid from the moment it was opened and did not taste any better. "Yeast Extract" is listed as an ingredient. Sounds harmless, right? Specifically, these chips contain autolyzed yeast extract, which is, on a chemical level, monosodium glutamate. It's just derived from a different source, but it has all the same toxic properties. Kettle still advertises their products as containing "No MSG" while they acknowledge that their chips are not safe for people with MSG sensitivities.

I was not sure what to expect from this bar.  The wrapper looks quite unassuming and banana/cranberry seems to be an unlikely combination, but I decided to give this bar a try.  It essentially only has 3 ingredients - dried banana, dried cranberries and chocolate (which of course contains multiple ingredients, but is German made, so good stuff and no GMOs).  The center of the bar is banana/cranberry and then the bar is dipped in chocolate.  The banana and cranberries are ground up/mushed together, so there are no large pieces, and the bar is very moist and soft inside (when I think of dried banana, I think crunchy, but that is not the case).  The banana/cranberry part is also flavorful, and tastes of fresh banana with a hint of tartness.  The chocolate is also good and not too "crisp"/hard and not too melty and is just the right coating thickness.One thing I love about this bar and other Seitenbacher bars is that the package contains 2 individual pieces (not one big bar).  I often just want to eat 1/2 of an energy bar (or even 1/4), so having it already portioned is a huge benefit for me.  I also found it to be fairly filling and satisfying, even for the 80cal 1/2 portion.Nutrition facts: 160cal (15 from fat), 5mg sodium, 37g carbs, 3g fiber, 32g sugar, 2g protein.  Not the healthiest product (depending on what you are comparing to), but it is a decent source of fiber, all natural (no preservatives) and minimally processed (cold processed).  It does not contain any "fake fiber" that is becoming common in so many bars.  The label says that is is a raw food and is gluten-free (but the viewpoint for my review is in comparison to all products, not just those gluten free).I recommend this bar as a smart alternative to candy and as a nice treat (it is chocolate-covered, after all).

column9: Green stuff floating in every bottle!!!  Yuck!
column10: I absolutely ADORE the Original Flavor of Zola Acai Drinks and I've had a standing subscription order for a couple of years - for both the smaller, 12 oz bottles and the larger 32 oz size.  But the last three months of the 32 oz size have been UNDRINKABLE! Weirdly enough, the 12-oz bottles in my order have been fine. The first time my order was like that, I shrugged it off and thought that maybe I had let 1-2 bottles sit outside in my car in the Florida summer heat, but every single bottle had green junk floating all through it, and I know that I did not even take 6-7 bottles in my car or any other place where it could have gotten contaminated.The second month/order it happened, I saved the receipt, took photos of the green stuff, and tried to contact the seller and Amazon. Unfortunately they do not accept returns! At the time I was so busy I forgot to cancel my standing order of the 32 oz bottles and so they shipped a third month of the 32-oz bottles and they too had the same problem. Each month I have also received my standing order of 2 boxes of 12-oz drinks and they have been FINE - no green gunk. But I've been stuck having to pour out each of the 32-oz bottles, and at a cost of close to $50 each time, that has been a HUGE waste of $$ for me.I don't know whether the problem has been only with bottles shipped from my seller (?) or if it is affecting everyone's orders. I have noticed that some other distributors online do accept returns, but I am not willing to risk going through this again with someone different. Maybe some purchasers actually drink the tall bottles with the green gunk, and maybe it wouldn't harm me or my kids, but it makes me queasy to see that in a glass when I pour a drink...and it tastes a little funky - so down the drain they go. In the 2-3 years I've been buying Zola drinks, I've never had this problem, so maybe it's temporary or maybe there's a logical explanation that I'm just not aware of. Good luck if you try the tall bottles.

column9: It works. Period. Arm & Hammer "Fridge-N-Freezer" saved my car's interior.
column10: In one overnight application, this product saved my car's interior.Almost a year ago, my car lease ended and I bought a new car. The old car was a luxury sedan with full leather seats. The new car is a compact hatchback with cloth seats. (I can't afford luxury anymore.) Both cars had a carpeted trunk.Whether because of the difference in the cars' interior materials and/or because of a change in my use patterns, a few months ago the new car's interior developed an unpleasant, sharp chemical odor. I could not remember the old car ever having this problem. It got so bad that my girlfriend commented that the odor was affecting some of my outwear. Though I think that certain materials were more affected than others, the problem was undeniable.I looked for a livable solution: something inexpensive, Earth-friendly, and easy to use. Baking soda is the classic natural odor remover, so yesterday I checked the supermarket and found that "Fridge-N-Freezer" seemed to be my best bet. On sale at 99 cents a box, I gave it a try.Last evening, I activated two 16 oz. boxes of "Fridge-N-Freezer" (peeled off the perforated sections on their outer cardboard case, front and back, to reveal the inner spill-proof, breathable cloth panels.) Then I placed one box in my car's trunk and one in its cabin. I closed the car's windows, doors and trunk, then waited.This afternoon, I checked the car's interior. The air in there was sweet and clear. There was no trace of the chemical odor. Amazing.Anyone would have noticed the chemical odor in my car. But I am very sensitive to scents (I collect perfume; I like coffee, wine and distillates for their aromas; etc.), so the problem was making me nuts.At two dollars a month, and since it is so easy to use and is ecological, Arm & Hammer "Fridge-N-Freezer" is a perfect solution for me. I give it my highest recommendation.

This will be our dog shampoo from now on. High quality product that does just what it says.
We have been useing Tropiclean Pet Shampoo for the past couple of years on our dogs and like the product very much. It lathers nicely and rinses out very well. We would recommend this product.

I must say, I love the smell of this shampoo.  It says that it's soap-free, so I was worried that it wouldn't get sudsy, but it does!  It has reduced my dogs dander (his breed is known for dry skin), leaves his fur super soft too!

column9: I'd Give This Ten Stars if I Could!!!
column10: What caught my attention to this shampoo was where one of the reviewers said that she could get by with using less of it when bathing her Yellow Lab. I was hesitant to buy it because of the price. I thought that it may just be cheap shampoo in a fancy bottle. It turns out I was wrong and she was exactly right. You really can use less soap.My dachshund has sensitive skin along with an allergy to fleas.  We use a Frontline type flea treatment but she still gets the occasional flea bite. The hot dry weather here was wonderful for producing a bumper crop of fleas. It also caused my poor little dog's skin to be extra dry. She was constantly scratching, even losing sleep because she'd wake up and have to scratch.We used the Tropiclean shampoo today. We followed the instructions to the letter making sure we left the soap on for 5 to 10 minutes. Our Doxie does not like being wet so like always she fought us and tried to escape. Then a funny thing happened. She quit fighting and raised her head up in her "Oh this feels so good." manner. She stood and let us wash her with no problem. Like the reviewer with the Yellow Lab said we used less soap than with other brands. My former brand was the Petco generic brand soap. As soon as i got it on my hands I could even feel the difference in quality. This soap had a thicker, richer, finer feel to it. It also had a good smell.The Tropiclean had an immediate effect on my dog. It was three hours ago that I washed her and she has not scratched yet. In fact after we were done she had a lot of energy. Watching her frolic was well worth the money I paid for this shampoo. One last thing... Before the bath I could scratch her back and she would raise her back paw involuntarily and scratch like dogs do when you scratch just right. After the bath she quit doing that. Try as I might I could not get her to do that.  That proved to me the shampoo did it's job very well.We have used oatmeal based shampoo before but the Tropiclean has a form of tea in it and apparently that boosts the effect of the oatmeal. Whatever is in it it is absolutely the best dog shampoo I have ever used. Just be sure and follow those instructions. I also found out that the company that sells this stuff is located not very far from where I live. The next time I am in that town I'll be stocking up.

I was a bit sceptical about this shampoo due to the name.  I was worried it would be too tropical scented.  The shampoo lathered nicely.  The scent is very mild.  Best of all, it relieved my dog's itchy skin.  I use no more than half as much of this shampoo as other, less expensive brands.  I am really sensitive to sulfates.  This one doesn't have any so it didn't bother my skin bathing three dogs twice a week.  I would definitely recommend this to others!
I really like this shampoo.  It does a wonderful job on my goldendoodle and German shepherd mix.
Pros:I liked this product because it has no harsh chemicals or drying agents, and the scent is wonderful.Cons: A lot of product is required to get the desired lather amount.

One of the best shampoos on the market due to the fact that it's properties are predominately natural composing of oatmeal and tea tree oil. Tea Tree Oil is known internationally for it's tremendous healing properties and skin conditioning capabilities. I highly recommend this product to anyone.

I first purchased this product at BJ's wholesale club. This is the best flavored carbonated water I've ever had. Like other reviewers, BJ's discontinued in favor of another product, what a mistake! I wrote to Talking Rain and their new president requesting this product have an online outlet...and it seems they delivered. Yes, it is more expensive, but with super saver shipping and subscription service (15%) savings, I'm in for a few cases each month. Try it, you will love it.

I saw this in the grocery store and I knew I had never tried it.  I do get tired of drinking plain water all the time so I bought several flavors to try.  Wow, I loved it.  I tried most of the flavors and they were all great.  They are slightly carbonated and I really like that.  I've never had one bubble over when I opened it.  Once open it will stay good for several days if you keep the top on tight.  I definitely give it 5 stars.  Give it a try you will be plesantly surprised.

I really liked this drink. It's slightly carbonated and the flavors are much stronger than your typical "water" drink, almost too sweet! I wish there had been a bit more variety in the package, but oh well. I liked the orange the best, and I'm not a big orange soda drinker - it had a bit more bite, more of a "tangerine" flavor. The black raspberry was also good and pomegranate berry was the sweetest one. They're sugar free, zero carbs, have B vitamins and green tea extract in them, so they are sort of like an energy drink, but not so heavy on caffeine that you get jittery. Very nice ice cold on a hot day.

I bought this Sparkling Lemon Lime Drink, the other day.  It said zero calories.  I am sure there is some type of sweetener in it.  Anyway, i loved the taste of this carbonated drink.  I will replace "pop" with this drink.  At least it is not full of sugars.
I've become addicted to these delicious, refreshing and healthy drinks. Highly recommended. I like having the variety of flavors and the ease of having them on automatic reorder.

column9: Amazing Carbonated Beverage (At Costco San Diego)
column10: A friend and I were walking through Costco (San Diego) and they had a Sparkling Ice tasting table - she tried it and loved the taste.  I agree, it's the best sparkling water I have found to date and it's fortified with vitamins and green tea and it's sweetened with Sucralose (not Aspartame).  An 18 pack was purchased for only $9.99.  Went back the next day and it was sold out.  It's been restocked and now I purchase a few cases each time I shop.  I've told many of my friends about this beverage and now they are all drinking it.  Yes all of them - Hoping San Diego Costco(s) keep Sparkling Ice in stock.  You cannot beat their price.

column9: Great product - No longer available in N. Texas at Costco
column10: Wonderful product - great taste and no calories.  18 count variety pack at Costco was $9.99.  Purchased for months and then discountinued - no reason why, even went to management.  Talking Rain says available at Central Market, Sams Club.  Sorry not true - they have no clue as to what this is.  To bad a great product can be purchased but you can buy it from Amazon at a higher price.  LOL - not gonna happen!

column9: Good product but pack of 18 is $9.99 at Costco
column10: Good product but pack of 18 is $9.99 at Costco.  This is not a good deal at all and if you have a Costco nearby go there for ~$.50 per bottle.  Even Giants sell for $1/bottle

I didn't realize that these had artificial sweeteners in them. When I tried one, I knew right away because it left that nasty after taste like artificial sweeteners do. I didn't really like the flavors too much either. They were too bold and unnaturally sweet for me. I wouldn't buy these again.

column9: Love it! But go to Costco, it's WAY overpriced here
column10: I bought this in Costco for 9.99.  Same amount of bottles and ounces and flavors.  This is a great alternative to soda or fruit juice.  I love the flavors, they are great and I feel that the carbonated water isn't as strong as soda making it easier for me to drink.
I am enjoying this flavored water soo much!  Each flavor taste so good and I find myself drinking it rather than soda.  I recommend this water for a replacement for soda any day.

I also had a problem with it bursting all over.  I thought it had an artificial flavor and left an aftertaste.  I had big expectations based on the reviews but was very disappointed and cancelled my auto shipping.
You can buy this at the grocery store much more cheaply!  Some places 99 cents each. I got this same package at Costco for $10.

column9: EXCELLENT product, but this price is excessive
column10: Cascade Sparkling Ice is fantastic!  It has zero calories and zero salt.  In fact, the only thing it has is a ton of flavor (people have "taste", food has "flavor").  I detect no after taste at all.However, you can buy this exact same variety pack at Cosco for about $11.00...and no shipping. Supermarkets in my area frequently have it on sale for .88 a bottle and, a couple of weeks ago, as low as .67 a bottle. That makes 18 = $12.67.
Tis product is YUMMY..But I pay 1.00 a bottle in my local grocery store , why is this price so EXPENSIVE??

I was buying IZZE at BJ's, but they stopped selling it.  I found ICE at the grocery store and decided to find my replacement for IZZE....I loved it.  Light, refreshing, not sweet, no aftertaste and I like the Black Raspberry, Lemon-Lime,  Grapefruit, and Orange Mango.  Added bonus - no calories. I love the carbonation.  As with any carbonated drink, I take caution in opening; so far no problem.  They are a little pricey in the grocery store at .99 each, but BJ's have them for $9.99 a case which includes the variety above (except for Grapefruit).
I love soda because of the bubbles... but don't like gaining weight because i like bubbles. this is a great product to cure my bubble need and tastes pretty good as well! you really cant go wrong.

A couple weeks ago I went over to my mom's house and she offered me one of these ICE drinks. I was surprised how good they were and instantly went on Amazon to look for them. I was able to get the box for $15 (now finding our local Costco sells them for $10) and have been periodically drinking them. All of the flavors are actually pretty good and typically I don't like drinks like lemon lime or any sort of apple just because it seems almost tart to me but this one was surprisingly good. I think it's because it doesn't have carbonation that it tastes quite good. Anyways, long story short, they are very good drinks and the fact that they have 0 calories and pretty much no harmful stuff in them means that I can drink a tasty drink without feeling bad.In fact, I am a HUGE dr. pepper fan and have been substituting that on a regular basis. Pretty good!
My Girlfriend and I Love the Sparkling Ice. Full of vitimans and not any filler garbage or caffine like other drinks..

column9: Wish they would sell this in Metro Atlanta
column10: I love this beverage and wish that they would sell this in metro-Atlanta. But they don't so I have to order it thru Amazon.

column9: Product is wonderful, cheaper at 7-11, amazon overcharges
column10: I love this product, one of the better tasting diet products. However amazon overcharges for them. They are .99 cents at 7-11.
I found this product in Ca while visiting my son.  Was disappointed when I could buy it in N.Y.  Was very glad to find you were carring it.  I drink it instead of soft drinks.

column9: Refreshing, Light, No Sodium and Zero Calories
column10: Tried this product one day along with a purchase of a slice of pizza and loved it!When I found that Amazon sold it in quantity I jumped on the chance of subscribing to it each month.My favorite flavor is Blackberry so now instead of forking over $2.50 for it I can always reach for one from home.Better than Izze, although if you prefer more fizz --- then stick with what's best for you!

Sparkling ICE Spring Water:My husband came home with a bottle of Sparkling ICE water (Mango flavor) and "really liked it" but never heard of this product before.  So with a little of research found that it could be purchased on Amazon.com. so within a few days I had a case for my husband. We have shared this with a family and friends and I heard they have ordered it too (Through Amazon!)Amazon.com is the BEST way to get most if not, all of your wants and needs!

column9: Like this product, but can not get it in stores here. Good product and deivery.
column10: Like this product, but can not get it in stores here. Variety offers good slection of flavors. Good product and deivery.

I was very bummed when my grocery store stopped carrying this product, so was extremely happy to find it on Amazon.com!  This is the best sparkling water I have ever tried.  The flavors are light and fresh, not overwhelming and not too sweet.  Love that there's antioxidants and vitamins in them, too! Great price.  And with free shipping and auto shipments from Amazon, perfect combination. Love, love, love it!

My husband and I are water drinkers and this is by far the best carbonated water you can buy.  It used to be sold in our area but has been discontinued. The price is a bit high compared to the $10.00 per case we had been paying. It is a great product! Doesn't taste surgary or sicky sweet.

I bought this believing it was an all natural product.  When I took my first sip I thought it tasted artificial and after researching discovered that it contained sucralose. It is deceptive  not to include this information prominently on the packaging when claiming all natural flavoring. In fact I did not see it mentioned anywhere unless you read the ingredient list, where it is easy to confuse the 'sucralose' with 'sucrose' -a natural sugar.The advertising on the package claims to be unsweetened.  Not true, it is sweetened with an artificial sweetner.This is the product description on Amazon:  "We start with pure, natural water, add carbonation and 100% fruit essences to create 10 distinctly thirst-quenching flavors." Very misleading.

column9: A Great Grocery Product From Canada
column10: YUP-these are made in Canada. The company web site says they're based in Preston, Washington in the foothills of the Cascade mountains. All of the ones I've purchased say Made in Canada. So be it.I saw these in my local grocery store. Being naturally curious, I read the ingredients and was elated to find that they use sucrolose, otherwise known as SPLENDA, as their sweetener, not aspartame, which leaves a horrible aftertaste and NO SUGAR ADDED and no carbs or calories. I took a few home and really like these. They are a nice alternative to regular water and the other things I normally drink. They also add a little extra to the meal, being 17 ounces instead of the popular 12 or 16 ounce drinks.Because they are no sugar, no calorie and nicely flavored, I recommend these to anyone who wants a little variety in what they drink without worrying about the sugar. Be sure and check the web-prices are all over the place. I reported to Amazon a cheaper price on another web site and they lowered the price within a few weeks. They also come in 12 and 18 packs AND in single- and variety-packs. My preference is the orange mango, black raspberry and kiwi strawberry. I have so far been unable to find the coconut pineapple, lemonade and lemon lime flavors but am still looking.

I purchased this on a whim based on a co-worker's comment about how much they like this brand.  It's not the best value at $1.25 each on subscribe & save but I was interested enough to give it a shot.  I'm glad I did!  All three flavors were great and each time I picked one up I was saying, "This is definitely my favorite flavor" but then I'd say the same on the next one and let's just call it a vicious circle!I did want to point out, and why I deducted 1 star, the picture of the product listed shows "Pomegranate Berry, Orange Mango and Black Raspberry".  However, the package that was received had Lemon Lime in place of Pomegranate Berry.  While it was a great flavor, I was looking forward to trying the Pomegranate Berry.  I'm hoping maybe my next shipment is what is shown on the picture.
This drink is not diabetic friendly even though the label says zero calorie, zero carbs and zero sugars.  It will spike your sugar beyond belief!

It says all natural but it tastes like it has an artificial sweetener. It leaves that horrible after taste. I am not a fan of plain water and was looking for something. I was very disappointed with the flavor of this drink.

column4: Lingering Lethal Poisonous Lene of Death
column10: I purchased the Orange Mango flavour on a Lightning Deal and liked it. So when I saw they had lots of different flavours, I wanted to try them. There aren't any places locally to buy it, so when I saw variety pack, I though that was a great way to try them all.When I opened the box, I was very disappointed. There are only three flavours in this pack: Orange Mango, Black Raspberry and Lemon Lime. I quickly put them in the fridge, because while they are OK at room temperature, they are better cold. So I tried them out. They all have a fresh taste, and it pretty good while you are drinking them. However, the taste last for hours after. This is actually not very pleasant, and made me feel reluctant drinking these. I cancelled my subscription, and will go back to buying water from my local stores, they are cheaper and taste better.

I understand that Ice tastes wonderful, however, it does contain "green tea extract" of which one of the main components is caffeine.  The product should contain an alert that it does contain caffeine -- many people, including myself, have an allergy to caffeine.
Sparking ice water doesn't taste like real grapefruit I dont like how it's artificial flavoredHonestly it tasted Like splenda ! Some of you may disagree but thats my opinion

My wife introduced me to this drink.  My favorite are lime and black raspberry flavors.  We bought them at Sam's Club and enjoyed them a lot.  However after about a week consuming 2 per day I noticed that I had begun to feel very depressed and had suicidal thoughts.  I do not take any medication at all and I started to see what is it that I have been consuming lately outside of my routine.  The only thing different was the Sparkling Ice drink.  So, I did not share this with my wife but I stopped consuming it to see if these feeling would go away.  WOW. They stopped.  I have not had another since.  It has been 2 months and no depression here.  I feel great.  So, out of the blue I shared with the wife about my weird feelings.  To my surprise she told me that she has been feeling the same since she started to drink this beverage.  I feel weird about sharing, but I wanted to see if any other people felt the same.  My wife cannot quit them.  They are good indeed however for me did not work right.  I shared my story with a local distributor and he laughed at me.  Okay maybe I am crazy.

When I started drinking Sparkling Ice, I was really excited, I told all my friends about this new found jewel. Well my excitement was short lived. This drink, sparkles all over the place...uhhh. What i'm saying is that it is so carbonated that you have to make sure you open the same bottle with caution everytime you want to drink it, otherwise it will explode all over your clothes, books etc, which I experienced. I was so mad I thought I may like the taste but lm not going to be on the edge each time I want to open a bottle I have already been drinking from. Its like you cannot afford to be distracted if you want to drink Sparkling Ice that's for sure....

We tried these "candy bars" in Hawaii.  They are about as healthy as a candy bar can get. They do not have any refined sugar in them.  They are not really sweet, but they are satisfying.  My wife and I would share one (they are pretty big) and be satisfied.  They are really tasty.  Coming back to the main land we have not been able to find them. So we are excited to find them on Amazon.

column9: Amazing, if you can handle it.
column10: This sauce is made with the hottest pepper in the world. It's named the Naga Jolokia but its' nickname is the Indian Ghost Pepper. I love spicy and I can handle things pretty hot but this sauce really surprised me. The taste is amazing. It's a very unique, heavy flavor that expands and keeps developing and changing in your mouth. Its just delicious. But the heat expands too. I've been putting a minuscule dash on my burgers and other things just to warm things up. So good but really, really, really, really hot.

I try new hot sauces as often as possible and Melinda's has done it again with this particular sauce. It probably goes without saying that this is extremely hot, but what is impressive is that there is an equal amount of flavor. As other reviewers have pointed out, there is a significant difference between a sauce that is just simply chemically hot with extracts and concentrations of capsaicin and one that is naturally hot without the chemical bitter taste you get with some other sauces.Long story short, this sauce is packed with flavor and certainly packed with heat, it isn't the 'hottest in the world' but if the novelty of insane sauce heat has worn off and you're looking for a flavorful heat, this is for you.

Melinda's hot sauces are the best out there. Very flavorful and reasonably priced. I eat allot of hot sauces and got to tell you all this is one HOT sauce. What is amazing is that there are no "hot pepper extracts" in this. All natural ingredients. There are some flavors that remind me of the Habanero pepper, but this sauce is in another galaxy as far as heat is concerned. I will need to dilute it down or mix it in some BBQ sauce or something, it is that hot. Putting a dime sized drop on a sandwich was tasty at first then the heat comes, and keeps coming. My mouth and tounge hurt for many minutes afterwards, then came the endorphin rush and all was well. Bottom line, if your looking for an all natural hot sauce that is truely hot, look no further.
