I bought this to use to make mango tea.  Chillies restaurant servesMango Tea.  I liked it so much I decided to try and make it for myself.IM happy to say, I succeeded using the Mango syrup.  I also purchasedBlackberry syrup to make tea and it worked just as well.Best of all it's sugar free, IM diabetic.V/r M.J. Layton
I absolutely enjoy this flavor in my morning cup of coffee! also enjoy adding it a cup of water or tea

Other than the home made soup I make, this is pretty good. Just wish it had bigger chunks of bacon. I put big pieces in my own home made soup. Like to have some set aside in my emergency food supplies (it's good cold also), as it keeps for a long time. Great commercial canned soup.

I first had these while subbing in a classroom because there was a student in there who only ate gluten free.  I had tried the other gluten free pretzels and while I did not think they were bad, they did not have the same texture as regular pretzels.  You would never know Snyders gluten free pretzels were gluten free because they taste just like regular pretzels and they have 98% the same texture as normal pretzels.  I have not been able to find them in stores so I order the 12 8oz packs off of amazon.  I highly recommend these!  My daughter has trouble eating other glten free pretzels but she will eat these!

Excellent! I wouldn't know these pretzels were gluten-free in a blind taste test. They taste like good, regular pretzels from a bag. My boyfriend ate some without knowing in advance that they were gluten-free, and when I asked him if he liked the new GF pretzels, he said he was going to eat the whole bag. The other nice thing about them is that the ingredients list what's in the baking powder too. Some baking powder contains aluminum because it's cheap, but this doesn't. So you can feel healthy about that also.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: I am lucky that I am *not* gluten intolerant but for health reasons I'm trying to limit my gluten intake. This means I can choose snacks from either side of the fence so to speak. I've tried and like Snyder's non-GF pretzels in many of the different varieties like Butter Snaps, Pumpernickle, and regular Sticks and Twists.Of ALL the pretzels I've tied , these are the BEST.They are crispy and a little harder than the regular sticks; they are a little less salty than the regular kinds as well with just a bare hint of sweetness. They taste what I'd call very homemade in a way I can't exactly put my finger on, but definitely not a run of the mill taste.For comparison, I've tried the Glutino GF Pretzels which are also VERY good but at generally a much higher price per bag. They are pretty much on par with quality of flavor even though the tastes are very different. The Synder's brand is definitely something special.Highly recommended!

I really missed the taste and crunch of pretzels since having to go gluten free a few years ago. These pretzels are just as I remembered regular pretzels to be in every way!However, I do have to get them from a local store, because of the shipping costs here. It would be great to have these on the Subscribe and Save list.
These pretzel sticks have a good flavor but they are very crunchy and quite frankly pretty hard. I tried this brand just to see the difference but I have to say that we prefer the Glutino brand.
The extra star is from me.  I have a very picky kitten who walks away from most cat food.  Not this one.  I think he would open the cans himself but hasn't figured out how YET.

I didn't know what to expect from this product.  I have recipes that call for grand marnier.  I have not figured out what ratio to use this.  it believe it is concentrated, but i can't figure out exactly how to use in my recipe.  It doesn't smell like I expected.  Not a fair review to the product I am afraid.  I will try to remember to come back and update my review after trying it.
I really liked this coffee and must say it didn't last long in the office. Two bags of this coffee was gone within a week and a half. I plan to order more soon.

I got the Mystic Morning flavor, and if this is what a medium roast from this brand tastes like, I wonder how deep their dark roasts go. It's a bracing flavor profile in the morning, the kind of coffee that'll put hair on your chest. If you want your coffee strong enough to get up and walk away on its own, this is for you. Bear in mind though that an 8 oz pack will not go very far.
I am not a coffee snob but craved coffee when I am pregnant, so I ordered some decaf.  I have to say i never touched again and its not worth the trouble ( not much of course) of making it
Marley Coffee is, in my opinion, the BEST! Strong, Bold, Satisfying...tastes clean and free of non-organic contaminants...I LIKE it very much!

...one of my favorite pleasures in life and I decided to try this brand once it was on sale for under $6. A bit lighter coffee then I'm used to but it was smooth and well rounded with just the right amount of nutty after taste. I'll be watching for the whole bean since I'm sure it will heighten the flavor. Actually bought some interest in the company (JAMN) since i think Mr. Marley has a winning product. Sure would be fun to sit down with him and listen to stories about his father over a cup of this Joe!

column9: Organic Mystic Morning Ground Coffee, 8 Ounce
column10: Price first purchased was $4.95 then jumped to over $7.  I stopped buying it at that price - coffee good, but not that good.

Big fat beans roasted just right....easy to get out of bed for a mug of this coffee.Much preferred to the Lively Up, the only other Marley Coffee I tried.My friend who is a coffee snob even likes it.Ordered the whole beans and I use my Aero Press to make it.Have already reordered.
I was disappointed since i had been drinking another brand which had a bolder taste but this was good coffee.

column9: I love it!  It's now my favorite!
column10: My home brew beats Starbucks now with the "Organic One Love, Ethiopian YirgaCheffe Whole Bean Coffe, 8 Ounce!"  Definitely a recommend!  Marley Coffee One Love Organic Gourmet Coffee 2 Lb Bag Whole Bean
We really enjoy this coffee and have gotten hooked on it.  It is strong and has a clean taste, no bitter after taste like some coffees and it's a great way to start the morning.
This stuff is really smelly and disgusting looking. Of course, my cat loves it. If you are sensitive to smells you might want to stay away. It looks as bad as it smells.

column9: FAST shipping and freh, no old and hard or stale. GREAT buy!!
column10: I was very pleasantly surprised at how fast these were shipped and how fresh they were. My husband is going through a hot tamale addiction and he could not believe how good they were. LOL I would definitely highly recommend this seller.

I don't usually chew gum, but I found out it has xylitol in it, which is good for your teeth, because it kills the hamful bacteria. I bought it for when I go on vacation for those times I cannot brush my teeth. I expected it to taste minty, but even though it has a fresh taste, it has a flavor I cannot describe, I really like it, but only occasionally, so it will last a long time. I was really busy recently, painting the outside of the house. I didn't have time for breaks, so I put three of the small pieces in my mouth and enjoyed chewing them most of the day, the fresh taste lasted a long time.

What can I say. It's gum... I haven't done extensive tests but I enjoyed the three pieces I've chewed and I feel good about having ordered a 12-pack.Planted them around my abode and in my satchels and car. I am now ready for any situation that requires gum.Thanks Trident! Thanks Amazon!

Trident gum is good for your teeth...sugarless with xylitol (natural sugar alcohol) which kills germs and actually helps teeth remineralize. This is my favorite flavor (original) with a more "crisp" minty taste. The flavor lasts too! 5 stars!One star lacking because the cost for this bulk package is only slightly less than buying individually.Overall, a very good purchase delivered right to my door.

column9: original flavor??? NOT - tastes like cinnamon for sure
column10: very strange - tastes like cinnamon.  Not the taste I was anticipating nor advertized, so I cant rate it very well.  I think i will call amazon about it and see what they say.
When I chew gum I want it to last for at least a few hours.  This does just that! And the xylitol is supposed to be good for your teeth as opposed to regular gum or even sugar free gum. :)

While not exceptionally strong this gum does give you a refreshing peppermint taste.  The flavor does last longer than other gums that I have tried, and is relatively consistent throughout the time you are chewing it.  It does stay fresh in the package for several months, with the foil-type wrapper keeping it fresh.  It is currently my favorite flavor of gum.The only complaints I have: the pieces are slightly smaller than what I find to be ideal, but they are too large to use two at a time, and the package doesn't stay closed very well in my purse.
I got it immediately right after ordering it. Highly recommend for anyone want to chew gum.  You will like it.
I think I purchased this product a month ago. 12 whole packs! I'm down to 2! Smh Once your friends and family find out that you have some its going to disappear quickly.
Great product! I would highly recommend this to others looking for a similar item.  Item was exactly as described in the product info portion of the listing!
I have dry mouth and need to chew sugarless gum. Trident is tasty and the flavor lasts quite a while.
Such a great price for this really good gum!!  I will def. be back for more when we run out!!  what a deal!!!!
Cheaper at the stores. Would prefer to spend less than I would have to spend at the store, so go to the store and buy it.
It's gum.  It's chewy and it's sweet.  Just store it in a dry place.  Although it retains its integrity more than other gum in heat and humidity it is still an unpleasant experience.

Average is not bad, is just not great. Over the years I have tried many Stir Fry Sauces and this one is just one more on a long line of choices. More like a 3.5 but, so sory, not 4. They do come in handy one time or another when a little variety is needed to liven up fish, chicken, shrimp, et.
makes a wonderful pot of spaghetti&marinara sauce with cento tomatoes that I also buy from amazon.  fast shipping and a good value too, much cheaper than the grocery stores.
Davinci Pasta, Long Cuts, Linguine, 16 Ounce Bags (Pack of 20) Very good, better then expected.

The listing says "Milk Chocolate Covered...", however; I received Dark Chocolate covered peanuts. I really don't like dark chocolate that much, so I ended up giving these away for the most part, I ate a few, they're alright. But not what was listed.

I lo-o-o-ve the milk chocolate covered peanuts from Brach's but wanted to try a low-sugar alternative.  These are pretty good.  They're sweetened with maltilol.  I'll include the nutrition information for a 21-piece serving: 190 calories, 16 gm total fat, 6 gm saturated fat, 0 gm trans fat, 13 gm total carbohydrate, 2 gm fiber, 1 gm sugar, 5 gm protein.They are a little pricey especially with the shipping fee.  I wish they were Prime eligible.

column9: This is a must buy hot sauce
column10: I heard about this sauce from my friend who works at a local market. I gave it a try and it's delicious. It's more sweet that hot but it has a kick at the end. I would definitely recommend getting this, it's delicious on chicken.
Packaging was a little flimsy but it did not affect the integrity of the product.  I will not hesitate to purchase this product in the future.

I tried this because it was on sale.  I am so glad I did.  Carbonation is not overwhelming and you get a hint of cucumber.  This drink is very refreshing.  Love this and will order again.  You have to love cucumber because you have the hint of it.  This quenches your thirst quite quickly.

I really love the cucumber flavor.  This sparkling water is only slightly sparkling which makes it even more enjoyable in my opinion.  It doesn't make you feel gassy or like your tongue is on fire.  It's very mellow and the cucumber flavor tastes just like fresh cucumbers. My husband says it would be an excellent drink for summer but I drink it anytime because it's so hydrating ( no salty aftertaste either) and it's not as boring as plain water.  I'm going to order some more of this flavor and try another one too.The only con I can think of is that the cans are smaller/slimmer than a typical soda pop can- so you don't get as much.  Even so, I think it's worth the price.

I can't wait for this to be available from Amazon! If you're tired of plain fizzy water or overly flavored fizzy waters, you will likely love this. It's well carbonated, and the cucumber essence is just enough to add some flavor without adding any stickiness or texture to the water--very refreshing when chilled, and doesn't leave an annoying aftertaste.

First can I tried I was thrown off by the cucumber flavor. I grew up in Mexico so I'm not scared of cucumbers at all, we used to have cucumber-ade quite often, it was actually the lack of sweetness that threw me off; I'm used to drinking sweetened cucumber-ade, so I have to admit I hated the taste of these at first. However, I grabbed a second can a couple days later and must say I've now grown fond of the taste, it is just SO refreshing and light.Too bad these are so expensive because they're a great alternative to soda's or fake sugar based soft drinks.

I ordered this cucumber sparkling water expecting it to be OK, and I was happily surprised when it exceeded those expectations. The bubbles are tinier and more delicate than some canned seltzers we buy from the grocery store, and the cucumber flavor tasted more natural and was not overpowering. I was also glad the cucumber comes from organic flavoring. Seems like a lovely spa drink. Knudsen brand has been around a long time and the quality is as good as I remembered it from 20 years ago. I bought this drink during the winter but could really picture this as a great summer drink. The can holds slightly less than some sodas, which is just the right amount for me. The slim can fits inside the fridge door conveniently without taking up shelf room. I plan to try the other flavors as well. Very nice product that I would recommend to anyone wanting to try a different style of seltzer water.
I would see it's taste is really weired, I can not describe the taste, which is really different from any drink I've had before.Someone may like it, but I really don't.

Vegan. Organic. Kosher. Beautiful fire-roasted tomato flavor. Well-balanced and mild. Not sweet or with too much tang. Medium thick puree base with nicely-sized crushed pieces. Great with organic pasta or mixed with your favorite organic veggies over rice. Also available in smaller size cans Muir Glen Organic Crushed Tomatoes, Fire Roasted, 14.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12). This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" in Listmania. Your "helpful" votes count and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

Muir Glen cans are lined in plastic and leach Bisphenol A. Too bad because this was a great product and was a standard in my household. My initial conversations with them they contradicted this fact, which to me was misleading. General Mills owns Cascadian Farms as well and now I don't buy there either.Now we use BioNature in jars or Pomi products in Tetra Pak cartons. All canned tomato products use BPA and so do many of the lids of jars used in food containment.Now I also just make from scratch which is made simple by chef Andrew Carmellini in Urban Italian. Lydia Bastianich is another favorite chef that deserves mention for simple yet big flavors.Boil, peel, freeze and store. Can manufacturing companies that I corresponded with said they were working on a solution for later this year or next year.
These are the only one i use...we make a lot of tomato sause...and no other can can match the flavor!
Great tomatoes.  Muir Glen has discontinued BPA plastic linings and now uses white-enamel lining, no doubt in response to public demand.  Yay!!!!

column9: My Favorite, But Not Carb Free
column10: I love Muir Glen. Their fire roasted crushed tomatoes even won a taste test on America's Test Kitchen. I will say this, however. The current product description states "carbohydrates free." A 28 ounce can has about twelve 65-gram servings at 4 grams of carbs per serving (with 1 gram of fiber for 3 net carbs if you count that way). Since 65 grams of all-purpose flour will have around 48 grams of carbs and 1 gram of fiber, you can consider them low-carb, but they're not carb free.

This product is amazing...the tomatoes taste so fresh, and the fire roasted flavor adds so much!  It's a nice mild mild sauce; definitely not hot. The online price is much better than the grocery story, especially with free shipping.  That said, I have now TWICE ordered the item and TWICE received DICED, not crushed tomatoes.  Further, most of the cans were severely dented despite the Amazon box arriving in pristine condition and with inside insulation from damage.  This suggests they were packaged that way.I wouldn't typically put this in the product review (and my rating reflects the advertised product, not my experience), but there seems to be something with this vendor not sending the correct item.  It's not a deal if you never receive what you ordered!!Also for the record, Amazon customer service has been wonderful.  I just reported the second arrival of non-ordered goods, so we'll see what happens!************Update: Within a week following the incident described above, Amazon posted a notice on this site that Amazon was looking into complaints regarding this product when shipped from Amazon.com. I just noticed that amazon.com currently no longer offers the product.  So to be perfectly clear, my purchase (wrong order and dented cans, twice) was with Prime-eligible, free shipping, amazon.com, and NOT the private vendor currently noted.  Couldn't be happier with customer service and, again, this product is amazing!

column9: I believe it's BPA free can now.
column10: I purchased these during the month of June, and called the customer service line of the company to see if these are BPA free. They said the new BPA free can has copper color inside instead of the familiar white lining. I opened my first can today, and it was copper colored inside. I uploaded a picture of it on the product page. I'm so happy that they started to use BPA free cans as I love their organic canned tomatoes!

Muir Glen Fire Roasted Crushed Tomatoes are very rich and full of flavor.  Some crushed tomatoes are thin, more like a puree.  These are more chunky, but still have enough crushed tomato sauce to make them perfect.  I actually prefer these over imported Italian tomatoes.  I recently made a tomato and cheese lasagna for a dinner party and used the Muir Glen Fire Roasted Crushed Tomatoes just as they came from the can, without adding any seasoning.  The only other ingredients were 4 cheeses and the pasta.  It was phenomenal! Everyone raved and were very surprised when I told them how I made it. Everything I use them in turns out well.  Get them by the case :)
As an Italian man who loves to cook, I have found these as some of the Best.You can eat them right out of the can!  Delicious!

column4: Jacki Gunter "good movie or book lover"
column10: I use these for making my tomato sauce when cooking chili or spaghetti.  These are a very flavorful tomato to use.  Occasional dented can.

Muir Glen Organic Fire Roasted Tomato products are exceptional. The depth of flavor makes these roasted tomatoes delicious. I use them to make my pasta sauce and just about everything else.I found these (I use crushed, diced, diced w/jalapenos) over a year ago. I had to do some traveling as the store that I found them in is no longer on my usual travel route. I have since found them in a couple of other places. The pricing varied but no store had all the varities I liked.The prices here good, I can stock up, and I don't have to travel. With the price of gas now that's an important factor.Bottom line: Because of the great flavor (am a foodie)I would buy these Fire Roasted Tomatoes. The price and convenience are a bonus.
with the free shipping and half off, you really can not beat this deal. I dont see how they do it, but you should just buy it and eat healthy for  a change, ok

Just spoke to Muir Glen customer service (12-21-2011) and they advised that if the "Exp Date" on a can of their tomatoes is dated March 2013 or later, the inside can liner is probably going to be copper-colored, which means the liner is BPA free.  If the Exp Date is earlier than March 2013, and/or the liner is white/clear, that liner is not BPA free.  But there could be cans out there "Exp Dated" earlier than March 2013, which are also copper-colored/BPA free.  If you're buying from a retail store that does not turn over products quickly, note that Exp Date.  If it's somewhere in 2012, you may have a white-lined/BPA leaching can.  I think it must be understood that Amazon may not receive these directly from the processing plant, thus Amazon may not control which product they receive.  However, I received 12 28 oz cans MG Fire Roasted Crushed from an Amazon MidWest Dist Ctr 2-3 months ago, and all of my 12 cans had the good/copper liner.  Regarding damaged/dented cans; I suspect that if you get any cans from Amazon that are dented, they were not dented from Amazon to you.  I suspect the cans were dented from the distributor to Amazon.  Also, MG customer service told me that Muir Glen will NOT label their cans BPA Free until they are sure there are NO white-lined cans out there - could be another year or so.  When they are sure all the cans of MG products are BPA free, then they will label their products "BPA Free", as this will obviously be a very positive selling point.Regarding rating these tomatoes, they are surely a 5 star if anything ever was.  How could you beat organic in a safe container and great tasting?  Muir Glen is to be commended for their approach to serving their customers with intelligence, honesty, and in a manner which encourages and promotes good health.

My only previous experience with Honeybush tea was the Stash brand so I'm far from an expert on how it should taste but I didn't like the taste of this one nearly as much.  It has a really strong spiciness that I found a little overbearing when compared to the lighter, sweeter taste of the other brand.  The packaging is just a box containing a ziplock bag with small tea bags/no strings.  Won't be re-ordering this brand.

column4: Kelly G. Burgess "Homeschool Teacher in VA"
column10: This has become my go-to herbal tea.  It's so soothing and delicious.  It's perfect sweetened with a little honey instead of sugar and just a dash of milk.  Yum!  I drink it all day long.  My husband, who is a coffee drinker, even likes this.  I had a terrible cold/flu recently, and my throat was so sore.  This soothed my sore throat every time!  Love it!  It's definitely a keeper, and it's priced much better than the fancy boxes I find in the high-end grocery stores around here, which is the only way I can find African Honeybush tea here.

I LOVE honeybush tea.  However, this is too strong and a little bitter.  So far my favorite brands are Stash & Numi.  If you get Stash, make sure to get the tea bag and not the lose tea.  Their lose tea have a lot of sediments due to fine tea leafs.  I heard that Numi lose tea is bigger but haven't tried it yet.  Anyhow, I would not purchase this again.
I have had Honeybush tea bought in South Africa. This stuff is horrid with no flavor. Will not buy again. My fault for seeing a deal, more like a steal of my money.
Absolutely excellent tea! We receive this once every three months on subscription and are never disappointed in the taste or quality.

column9: Good Product, But Not What I Was Looking For
column10: The tea was good, but I was hoping to find the perfect substitute for Trader Joe's Honeybush Tea. Honeybush tea helps to soothe my throat, especially when singing with the choir. I have also found that honeybush tea doesn't give me that dried out feeling in my mouth that most other teas do. I know you have plenty of fans out there and I do thank you for the close second!

This is great rooibos tea at an excellent price. We've drunk our way through several boxes of the tea and love it with a bit of cream and sweetener. It almost makes you think you're sitting in the Ladies Number 1 Detective Agency and drinking with Mma Ramotswe.

This is some good Rooibos.  It comes in a ziploc bag inside the carboard box.  This is not fancy, but it is handy, because it allows all the tea to be re-sealed.The flavor of the tea is rich and intense - in a manner that is very pleasing.
This is very good rooibos, makes me feel like I am back at home. Will definitely be a repetitive customer.

This brand does great honeybush as well as rooibos teas. I've been buying Numi brand at the health food stores for a long time. Davidson's is over 5 times the quantity and only costs twice the amount of 1 little box of Numi. And there are no tea bag wrappers to deal with - less waste on packaging and less hassle. The bags are just packaged in one zip lock bag which keeps them plenty fresh. Highly highly recommend this product.

This has become my favorite drink. Add some honey and Stevia to sweeten and to enhance the honey flavor, refrigerate, and you've got a quart of awesomeness with no caffeine and nearly no calories (only what the honey provides).

This is a nice tea, and it's good to be able to find an organic honeybush. The flavor is not as intense or pleasing as the one I used to get from Trader Joe's, but since that one's no longer available, this will do.

column9: shipping really high - buy at Wegman's
column10: This product tastes good, but you can buy a container of each type for $9 at Wegman's. If you get it from this place, you pay $26 (TWENTY SIX!) for shipping and handling. Why? When we received the product, we found it labeled "specially selected for Wegman's." Sure enough, next time we went, there it was. In addition, two of the containers had an expiration in two weeks! The taste and quality of the pumpkin itself seem fine but this stuff is way runnier than normal pumpkin puree.  I've been making pumpkin pies for years using all sorts of canned puree's and have never had a problem, now with this stuff my thanksgiving pies are like soup.  Luckily I still have tomorrow morning to go buy a different brand and redo the pies.  I guess there is just more water and less pumpkin than most products :(If you have the misfortune of having this product, be sure to be very cautious of the amount of liquid you add.

column9: RATING THE SELLER, NOT the item
column10: Similac organic is a wonderful product. My child thrives on it. Sellers taking advantage of infant product shortage by selling beyond the MRP are unscrupulous and should not be patronized.

When somebody sells something for three times more than you can get it at a brick and mortar store, it is outrageous.  The only problem at the moment is that Similac had a recall on several of their products and they are currently in short supply.We have tried 5 different formulas and our daughter refuses to eat anything but this formula, so I'm not knocking the formula, just the quick buck artist selling it at such a high price.  Put it this way, our 3 month old drinks a whole bottle (quart size) of this formula per day, so the six bottles being sold here for $102 means you'd be paying over $400 a month for baby formula.  Outrageous.
I agree with all other reviews, this item is way over priced! In my area I have only found a good stock of the organic Similac at Target and it's far less expensive!
the item is awesome, but the 6 pack is about $30 at babies r us, this is a rip-off

column10: The MSRP for this product is $24.72.  Due to the recall of all powder formula, you may be in desperate need of this product.  However, pay close attention to how long it takes to ship. For some reason, New England clam chowder is readily available. Manhattan Style (red) is much harder to find. The only place I could locate this in about fifteen states was through Amazon. Although not as good as some restaurant offerings, it is reliable and satisfies the craving for Manhattan clam chowder. I recommend it if you like Manhattan and can't find anything better at a local restaurant or grocery.
service and price was ,as always, consistent fast and good. the product was not as tasty as the non-chunky manhattan clam chowder.
Rare to see a spelling error like this in an Amazon listing.The soup is hearty and pretty good, though a tad salty for my taste.

I order the soup throughout the year for my son who lives in Chicago.  He is a vegetarian, and being a Mom who places high value on nutritional foods, I say, "Who doesn't need a good hearty soup year round?" and, especially in cold Chicago.  His words are that it's "tasty and filling".  Get a nutritious whole wheat grain roll, this "price is right" soup, and you have a good healthy inexpensive meal.
Appears to be older stock - dented cans with a bit of rust.  Expiration date about 9 months out.  Flavor is fine, nothing to write home about. 3.5 stars.

column9: Can't get this on the West Coast
column10: Moving cross country, you realize there are favorite foods you will not have and new foods that will become favorites.  This clam chowder brings back the taste I missed, is easy to use and quick to prepare.
I bought this for my Aunt Mary who lives in Southern Ohio and she absolutely loved it.

column9: NOT WHAT I THOUGHT IT WOULD BE
column10: I THOUGHT IT WOULD BE A CONDENSED VERSION NOT READY TO EAT AS I LIKE TO MIX CONDENSED VERSION WITH FRENCH CUT GREEN BEANS.

I adore watermelon, but things flavored with it tend to be artificial and icky, nothing like the perfect juicy fruit I love. However, I trust Red Leaf to deliver on authentic, juicy flavor, and boy did they ever! Though it smells kind of like a Jolly Rancher in the bag, the tea itself tastes nothing like "watermelon" flavored candy. This watermelon matcha is perfectly fresh and it seriously tastes like matcha made with watermelon juice! The grassy, almost creamy matcha is a perfect base for the lip-smackingly tasty watermelon flavor. It's great straight, as a latte, iced, even as a smoothie with real watermelon and a splash of milk!

Sometimes I think mangos are my favourite fruit. Then I remember watermelon! Sweet, juicy watermelon - oh yes! Both of these fruits can share the spotlight - but only when they are ripe, juicy and flavourful! Why did I pick some of the messiest fruits to be my favourite?Luckily, the only thing that gets messy when I whip up a cup of this matcha is my cup and whisk! (...and my white shirt. That's a story for another time) But hey! Virtually mess free! At least it's not all over my face... although this matcha is delicious enough that I wouldn't mind sticking my face into a huge bowl of it. Oh yes, can you tell that I am happy with this matcha? So happy! The flavour is sweet and true watermelon flavour! I like watermelon candies, but I hate watermelon jolly ranchers (too chemically), so I was very happy that this flavour lies between a watermelon flavouring and a real watermelon. That doesn't really make sense, but I guess you'll have to take my word for it lol.Making this hot with a sprinkle of sugar takes it into treat territory! Seriously delicious matcha that has me drooling just thinking about it! Another great summer treat. Chopping up some watermelon to make a watermelon puree to go with this matcha (and a splash of vodka) is definitely on my to-do list.I prefer my watermelon fruit straight from the fridge and icy cold, so it goes without saying that my favourite way to prepare this drink is ICED. I still haven't gotten into the habit of just mixing matcha with cold water - so I mix it up double strong with 170 F water, add ice cubes and top with more water. This gives me a perfect result every time - no clumps (if I drink it right away!) and smooth as the rind of an in season watermelon. Oh yes, I went there.For an extra treat, I experimented with cream and tried a "watermelon and cream" dessert tea. It was delicious! Let it be known - any fruit + cream = wonder! Too bad most flavours stick to strawberries&cream or peaches&cream, because I think I'm on to something here ;)This also went well with vanilla soy milk and plain almond milk! I'm not picky - I always buy almond milk when it's on sale because it's so delish, creamy, and doesn't affect my acid reflux! That's the joy of these flavoured matchas - delicious flavour minus the calories! They don't need milk and sugar to tantalize my tastebuds - even the basic matcha is smooth, grassy and even creamy!

I am LOVING this... I finished my first bowlful really fast and am contemplating making another, and I probably would if were not 9:18 pm, and I wasn't worried about it keeping me awake all night!  (Matcha does give a serious boost of energy!)The flavor of the watermelon is perfect:  sweet and very true to the fruit.  It tastes like watermelon.  But it also tastes like Matcha.  The watermelon does not overwhelm the Matcha, which is vegetative, creamy and sweet.  It feels so rich and smooth on the palate.I've tried a lot of tea - a lot of Matcha, for that matter - and even quite a few flavored Matcha... this is one of the very best I've tried.  If you like watermelon and Matcha... putting this in your cart is a no-brainer.  You'll love it.

column9: One of the best watermelon flavored drinks
column10: I love watermelon, and I love tea. Needless to say, I've tried just about every watermelon tea I've seen. This one blows them all out of the water. It's best made with a lower water temperature, though you'll probably be drinking it cold so it doesn't matter. A touch of cream brings out the fruit flavor even more.This matcha is also amazing added to a puree of watermelon and mint. It keeps the mint from overpowering the fruit, while adding a nice green tea flavor. And if you want something unique and different, give it a try rubbed onto a slice of watermelon. There are no words to even describe how good it is!

There are few things in this world that scream "summer" to me like watermelon. Unfortunately, they're one of those rare treats as my father is allergic to it, so I only had it at other people's parties when growing up. Now, my wife doesn't like it, so it's rare I can convince myself to lug a watermelon home and slice it up, just for myself. But the local grocery store now has mini seedless watermelons for a good price, so I've already had two so far this summer and plan on going back for another on Friday. So much love for watermelon in my heart. It's just juicy and delicious and amazing. I'm just curious, did anyone out there grow up salting their watermelon? Until I was 10, we lived in Michigan and I'd never even heard of it, but when we moved to Tennessee, everyone did it. It does bring out the juiciness of it, but it's also, you know, terrible for you.Now, I know watermelon can be a tough flavor for tea. Many people have tried (two come to mind in 52teas' watermelon iced tea and DavidsTea's Luscious Watermelon), but I have to say I wasn't horribly impressed with those I've tried. So while I had to try it, I just had to, I wasn't holding out a lot of high hopes for this watermelon matcha. When I opened the package, I got juicy watermelon...but a hint of metallic or whatever it was that made the lemon, peach, and mango teas so bitter. But since warm weather has moved in, I've gotten into the habit of mixing my tea with room temperature or cold water, and it definitely paid off this time. I get juicy, creamy watermelon and absolutely no bitterness. Mmmm, this is good. This is really good. It's light and refreshing and utterly perfect for these coming summer months...it's gonna be a scorcher. This is the watermelon I've been searching for and I can't wait to try it blended up with some fresh melon. This kind of tastes like a watermelon bubble tea, but without the overwhelming sweetness. Maybe I need to find some tapioca pearls. It reminds me of the Ten Ren watermelon oolong blended with fresh melon, not Freshly Squeezed's idea of a bubble tea. I'm only a little bitter, I promise. But this is a definite restock for me, and one I will definitely be sharing with friends and family.

This is a wonderful example of how a responsible company can put out a very good product while practicing a thoughtful fair trade policy at the same time. I would implore everyone to support the Endangered Species brand. While the Tiger is exceptional, even better is the Panther, the darkest of the chocolates the company offers. It is 88% cocoa, and simply a delight for anyone who enjoys a more daring taste in a candy bar.On top of all that, the sale of each bar results in a donation to wildlife conservation.

column9: Delicious Treat, Antioxidants with a slight Buzz!
column10: The perfect mix of dark chocolate and espresso beans, you cant go wrong with this bar, they are organic as well and i love the fact that they believe in helping the endangered animals on this planet, you wont regret giving this chocolate bar a chance!

column9: Good for cats - Loved by cats
column10: Approximately 20 years ago, I began to exclusively feed our cats Iams or Science Diet.  Those brands were recommended by our Veterinarian after our first cat showed signs of Feline Urinary Syndrome (FUS).  I had previously fed the cats the typical brands such as 9 Lives, Purina and Friskies.I continued with IAMS and Science Diet, because the other brands caused FUS, caused other digestive problems and the good reputation of IAMS and Science Diet.Then last year, one of our cats developed bladder disease and died.Not long afterward, the pet food scandal broke. Cat and dog food from nearly every pet food company, including premium foods like IAMS and Science, were tainted by melamine.  More than 150 brands of cat and dog food were recalled.  IAMS and Science Diet were two of the recalled brands, as was natural sounding brands such as Nutro.I vowed to never again purchase pet food from the brands that had betrayed my trust.  I began searching for pet food that was all natural and organic.  Newman's Own is both natural and organic.  It was also one of the few brands not recalled. Although it was difficult to find a local source, I finally found a few, including Amazon.My cats love Newman's Own canned and dry food.  They also love Innova EVO.  I love it because I don't have to worry about tainted food poisoning my cats.Pros:1. Peace of mind2. Does not cause FUS, as did Purina and other similar brands3. Much less likely to be tainted by lethal contaminants4. The cats love it5. Does not cause the other digestive problems.Cons:1. It is more expensive than the non-premium brands2. It can be difficult to find a nearby store that sells Newman's Own.Overall, the pros outweigh the cons.  And I can now add Amazon to my list of sources for the food.

I bought Newman's Own after the cat chow scare as well but was surprised at the change in my cat's behavior and activity level within the first month of the switch. I wish it were available nearby but I'm signing up for the auto ship which gives you free shipping and a lower price. My cats love the flavor and respond well to the nutrition and absence of processing in their food. I know how lethargic I feel when I get busy and eat too much processed food-why would they react any differently? It's well worth the money-I've tried cat chow naturals and while it is better than regular it does not produce the level of improvement that PN does so I'm sticking with the good stuff!

...and he hates everything. I fed my cat Iam's for years, because his vet reccomended it and therefore I figured it must be the best for him, but after the cat food scare, I wanted to get out of all the traditional brands. The vet reccomended another brand, which I cannot think of the name right now... that you can buy at PetSmart. It was pretty pricey - about $28 for a 64 oz bag. My cat hated it, he refused to eat it, and it looked wooden.But I took him to a playdate at a friends and he has this habit of eating out everyone's bowl and came across Newman's Own in his friend's food bowl. He loved it! My friend sent me home with enough to transition him and I ordered a bag instantly from Amazon. And if you are looking to go organic with your kitty, comparatively, the price for Newman's Own is right. Much cheaper than those in the same class.

column9: Great for cats with corn allergies--meat #1 ingredient
column10: I have 2 cats.  One is fluffy and finicky and won't eat anything but wet food and human meat.  The other one is athletic, lively and will eat only dried "crap" food.Well, the athletic one started having terrible eye problems (red and weepy) and she constantly scratched at them.  We tried oral Lysine, Terramycin antibiotics, and swapping out the plastic dish for ceramic.  Still she had eye problems.  So, guessing it might be a food allergy, I bought her Newman's because it doesn't have corn gluten, the primary ingredient of almost all dry cat foods. Newman's #1 and #2 ingredients are MEAT.She ate it immediately. Within 2 days her eye problems disappeared, so I am assuming she had developed allergies to the corn product in the dry food (and by the way, what felines eat corn in the wild?).But what really amazed me is that fluffy and finicky passed over her usual wet food and went right for the dry Newman's.  I just about wet my knickers!There you have it, 5 stars.

I tried this out on sale. Poured it into the bowl. Cat took one taste and then shoved her whole face into the bowl. She was shoveling up the food with her mouth wide open, spilling food everywhere. It was hilarious. It passes the taste test for sure. Very expensive though. I'll buy it when I can find an affordable price. (Five stars for ingredients and taste, one star docked for affordability.)
My wife has a male cat who throws up EVERYTHING EXCEPT this food.  The cats prefer this food over the wet food we have tried also.Great Quality, good price.

I purchased this food because I have 6 cats, and they were throwing up a lot.  I went from Purina, to Purina One to Whiskas to Iams and I knew there was something bad in the food.  After buying Newman's the throwing up stopped.  GOOD NEWS!  Except they don't like the food. I had 2 different flavors and they didn't like either one. I had a leftover bag of Iams and they broke into it.  I mixed it with Newmans and they picked it out.  I have now switched to California Natural and they don't throw up and they love the taste. After reading some reviews about Newman's Own Organic pet food, and spending a few minutes on their website checking out the ingredients I was confident the quality was high.The bag is a great size for the 10lb automatic feeder, fills about half the tub. I have one medium sized cat so this lasts for a couple of months. I placed the cat food on subscription, using amazon prime, so I got it for a great price as well.My cat seems to be enjoying it and eating her two potions a day. Trust me, sooner or later they will learn to love it. I think this policy has meant she is pretty good at trying new food and enjoying it.As much as I can review cat food without eating it, I'd say this is a good buy. I checked out the price of some bags of organic cat food at my supermarket and its competitively priced.

We have sphynx cats.  The breed often has skin problems, and ours were no exception.  We had tried everything.  Also, one had to be on prescription food because of digestive problems.  Well, we wised up and switched them to organic food.  If we were eating all organic, why wouldn't it help them?  And within 2 weeks of the switch, NO more digestive trouble and NO more skin issues.  It's been 6 months and we'll never go back.  Excellent product and they love it!

My cat started throwing up while I was on a business trip. I used amazon prime to overnight this to the friend that was taking care of her. normally my cats will not eat healthy cat food .. and normally they cry for wet food but since i started with the newman's dry food we have no problems  they even turn their noses up at wet food now

Newmans cat foods are among the finest and tastiest (according to my four furry friends) canned food available.  Haven't found any of the varieties which they didn't thoroughly enjoy and finish every morsel.  Thanks Paul !!!

column9: Switched to Newman's Own Organic and all 3 cats stopped vomiting
column10: Our three cats throw up every day and have been doing this for years. I am not talking about hairballs but vomiting up undigested food. The vet says they are very healthy but "cats do this".Last week we switched from "Purina One" to "Newman's Own Organics Adult Formula Dry Cat Food" and low and behold the vomiting completely stopped -OVERNIGHT!Prior to "Purina One - Urinary Track Health Formula" we fed them "Prescription Diet c/d" with the same vomiting.One caveat -the chicken in this Newman's Organic dry cat food is "Natural" and not "Organic" so I contacted Newman's Own to ask them what they feed their "Natural" chickens. We received a quick response from L.Phillips Brown, DVM, confirmed that even though they are not Organic chickens, they do NOT feed these free-range chickens GMO grains.We recently learned that since the mid-90s, food companies have been slipping GMOs into human and animal food, without our knowledge or approval, even though studies say these are quite harmful (causing damage to internal organs). The Europeans are smart enough to ban GMOs but not us "dumb Americans". So unless it is organic you are best to avoid all non-Organic meat, poultry, and "farm raised" fish (they are all fed GMOs) and non-Organic corn, soy, cottonseed, Canola products (these are GMO).Perhaps this cat food stopped the vomiting issue because Newman's Own has no GMOs or perhaps it is because there are no grains. In either event, it works. And this is nothing short of a miracle! We are astonished that the change was so immediate.All three cats love this food. The cats have not vomited once since we switched. Also, the cats seem calmer and their food cravings - to have their bowls constantly filled - have gone away.We really lucked on to something here. What a great cat food!

A little too expensive for me as I have 4 cats.  But I have read the ingredients,  and being familiar with most of the higher end brands this one is right up there with them.  It is good for cats that have sensitive tummies.

I've been feeding my cat this food for the past year and she loves it. She hasn't gotten sick from it or shows any signs of being sick. A few weeks ago she got a clean bill of health from the vet, so I know there is nothing in this food that is potentially harmful. I really like this food, and the fact that is doesn't have any animal by-products is a plus. I would recommend Newman's Own Dry Cat Food.
This is the best cat food I gae ever tried on my cat,  She loves it, it smells all natural and is good for her.

My kitties crave this food...That's honestly the best cat food out there...We've tried a dozen different brands but my kitties had their final "meow". They love this food .They are super healthy cats ( rescued animals are blessed) and they never had any health issues since i started them on Newman's Own ( about 2 years ago). column9: This is very high quality food and my cat goes crazy for it.
column10: Wow, I was surprised to read the other reviews here.  After doing extensive research on this and other dry and wet foods, I found Newman's Organic to be one of the highest quality available.I was disturbed over the number of cancer deaths in both dogs and cats occurring each year.  The numbers keep going up and I figured it must be related to their diets.  This food uses human grade natural chicken (no hormones, antibiotics, pesticides) in both their canned and dry food.I wish this listing had the Nutrition Facts, but if you go to newmansownorganics dot com and read the FAQs you will learn a great deal about pet nutrition. They tried for about an hour to no avail.I don't know if it was the size of the food or what.  They didn't seem to dislike the taste, they just could not eat it.

Love the product with no corn, but my cat was not too thrilled with it.  However, not given a choice he finally came around and now eats it just fine. It would be nice if there weren't as many veggies in it, but I'll take that over corn any day.

column9: My Cats Savor Newman's Own Organics
column10: It took some time, but I finally got my cats to savor Newman's Own Organics Adult Cat Dry Formula. (The green labeled bag is just as good). My red tabby male had a penchant for upchucking his food and this has put a stop to that. The pellets are small and hard and they seem to love crunching on them. column9: Kitty and I both love it!
column10: Our 6 year old cat has been eating this food exclusively since we transitioned him from the Science Diet kitten food he was eating at the shelter before we got him.  We simply leave food out for him at all times, and this food makes up 99% of his diet (outside of a few bites of bacon here and there). Couldn't be happier!!

column9: Saved a lot of $$$ at the vet--be patient, though, it might take some time!
column10: I bought this food based upon other reviews from people who said that it helped their cats who had been licking off their fur. For a long time our cat had been licking the fur off of her back legs. The vet said it was possibly an allergy and that we could spend all the money for allergy testing but might not find anything. She also said that we could consider giving the cat Benadryl to see if that helped (but didn't necessarily see the need to do either at that point).Eventually, though, the cat got to the point where she was pretty much licking off all of the fur she could reach--we literally had a half naked cat! She also had lots of small "scabs" (which she'd gotten before, but not to this extent), which was probably at least partly why she was licking the fur off. We figured the vet, if she saw the cat at that point, would recommend allergy testing. I decided to give this food a try first.I'm very happy to report that it worked! Some other reviewers said that it worked for their cats in a couple of weeks. With our cat it took at least 4-6 weeks. At this point she's grown all of her fur back and the scabs are gone, too.And she has loved the food from the very beginning--no problems eating it (as at least one reviewer mentioned), even though it is in very small pieces.So if your cat is licking off his or her fur, consider trying this before spending all of the money for allergy testing (unless, of course, your cat is having other medical issues, too, that you're worried about). Great stuff!

I like Newman's Own for my family due to its consistent quality and good ingredients; I like have the opportunity to provide the same quality products to my animals.  Amazon makes it convenient to get multiple bags in manageable sizes that appear on my front porch according to my schedule.  I got the two three-pound bags.  Even better: they are resealable!

I've been feeding my six cats Newman's Own organic food for years. Their coats are sleek and healthy. They are healthy. This is certified organic food, not that phony 'all natural' stuff. column9: My cats wanted nothing to do with it

I use Newman's brand of Cat and Dog food exclusively. The product exceeds every brand out there! I've bought them all, from Hill's Science Diet to every gourmet/high priced label out there. column9: Delighted that Amazon has my brand!

column9: may be healthy but my "eat anything" cat won't touch it
column10: I tried this in place of Iams.  My hefty maine coon won't touch it.  He is not a picky eater either (he was adopted at 5 and his previous family fed him some grocery store brands).  He eats around it and would rather sit at the pantry door meowing for new food then to go eat a full bowl of this.  The feral cats outside won't eat it either!  The only ones who seem to like it are the raccoons and possums and I try to not feed them.  We give this a two, two thumbs down.

What a wonderful thought that Newman's Own makes cat food. Organic cat food. I would love to support this product and feed it to my big fluffy girl... she's really not a kitty anymore, and she's usually not picky with her dry food. However, she hates this food and literally turns her nose up at it. I've tried fooling her by mixing it in with her other dry food... since I had to go out and buy a bag of her old stuff, that is. She's good at leaving this stuff in the bowl and sorting out the food she likes. So I am about to toss this food in the garbage, and I hate to waste food. I wonder if there are too many veggies in this food? Cats and dogs are carnivores after all. Carrots and oats and peas are not really good for them. I'm at my computer right now, away from the ingredients list, but I recall this food is heavy on the veggie, non-meat ingredients. Sadly, I will not be buying this great-sounding product again. I think it would benefit from some steak juice at least... or some really stinky fish bi-product.
This is a really great cat food, my guys are crazy about it.  A little pricey, but it delivers.

I have four rescued cats...I give them IAMS...this said organic so I thought I would give it a try...ALL 4 turned up their noses and wouldn't even try it...mixed it with IAMS and eat around it or spit it out...had to cancel my subscribe and save subscription to it...was looking forward to not having run out of cat food but didn't work out.  :(

Did the company that makes this product bother offering it to cats first to see if they would even eat it?  My cat won't eat it.  Pixie gives it two paws down. I tried offering it to the starving feral cats outside, and they won't eat it either.  I bought two bags of it for nothing.  My cat actually did try it once, and promptly threw up.  No fur balls came up any time after that, either, so I know she wasn't sick at the time.  She still refuses to eat any more of it.  It might be great from both nutritional analysis and organic points of view, but it's not any good if cats won't actually want to eat it.  I'm going back to Purina when I feed kibbles to the cat because I know from information that I've seen on TV that Purina actually taste-tests their products.  My same cat will eat the Newman's Own canned cat food with the same degree of enthusiasm that she eats Purina, but the same is not true for the kibble.

I was right... and the taste is delish! The only problem is that if I am using them to satisfy a sweets craving I have to really watch it or 1 bar turns into 2 bars... and well... I know it is more a self-control issue than a product issue. It is just that they are really that good. I'd take one of these bars over a snickers ANY day!.

I bought these on a whim and have found that my whole family just loves them!!  They are a great snack when you have the munchies, or can fill in for a light meal. My daughter describes them as a "healthy" rice krispies treat.
These are a great way to get fiber, vitimins, and a chocolate fix, without blowing your diet!

column9: Marvelous option to crush a hunger attack
column10: I'm trying to get more fiber in my diet, and these are terrific. Real food, great taste (better than chocolate caramel variety of these bars which have a few kernels of embedded popcorn which are really inedible). I'm changing my subscribe & save to switch these for the chocolate caramel which I thought were good until I found these.

column9: Great as a substitute for a cookie or other sweet, unhealthy snack!
column10: I can't imagine eating one of these bars for breakfast. First of all, they are definitely not filling enough to replace a meal. And second of all, they are pretty sweet! In fact, there are 14 grams of sugar in each little bar.I would definitely buy these as a healthier, more nutritious replacement for a cookie or candy bar when I wanted something sweet and chewy.
I LOVE these! Big, chewy, sweet, and only 170 calories. Good stuff in them too.

My husband and I have used this product for a few years.  Not only is it a tasty and convenient breakfast bar but our doctors and nutritionist have recommended it as well.  Works particuarly well when eaten before exercise because it is easily digested and provides steady flow of energy for a couple of years

I am not a fan of most bars---and I hate that soy aftertaste but these Kashi Chocolate Almond bars are great and they hold me for a quick lunch.Usually I eat a yogurt and one bar. They hold me better than "FULL BARS". (cheaper too!)

column9: super tasty beats Clif any day and sticks with ya
column10: Yum.  This chewy bar is better than Clif and is a perfect meal on the go.

This a great energy bar.  The bar has a great chocolate/peanut butter taste, but it's not too sweet.  The bar has 210 calories so its better to snack on this than a bag of chips.  This has the texture of a rice crispy treat.
I love bringing these to work for a snack. Of the Kashi Go Lean! snacks, this flavor is my favorite. They're filling and satisfy both salt & sugar cravings, and I feel satisfied for a long time. Yum!

I'm always after having more daily Fiber, and found it in these bars.  They are great. Not only do they taste good; if you're a chocolate lover, these will fill the bill in addition to giving you your much needed fiber, they also quench hunger pangs.

column9: We'll buy it again and again!
column10: These are great!  Low calorie, light, crispy, great taste, and satisfying.  This is a staple snack item in my house!  Tons of dietary fiber and they taste great.  I recommend this to anyone who would like to replace the typical office bagel or donut.  Healthy and delicious.

I keep a carton of these in the fridge for "time-crunch" occasions.  When one of us has an early morning doctor's appointment, for example, we grab a bar to eat in the car or after the doc's visit.  A crunchy, nutty, nutritious, energy bar at 170 calories that tastes good is definitely something I'll keep buying.  Until I found them on Amazon.com, it was touch and go as to whether or not I could get them at all.  Very few places carry Kashi bars.  [...]
they're a quick fix and they taste incredible. best protein bar around!

Love the taste! They are filling, chewy, and have a slight salty/sweet thing going. Being on Weight Watchers for 7 months, they are always around my home at only 2 points per bar!! Also, the deal on Amazon buying them in bulk is the best I've found price wise.
This is one of the best tasting protein bars I've tried.  I've tried many!  Kashi has a great line of soy protein products .. especially the cereals.

I love this bars and eat them whenever I crave sweets. In fact, these are not too sweet, very tasty and satisfying.Kashi GOLEAN Bars do not have that unpleasant complex taste, which is so common for energy bars and which makes it hard to guess the ingredients.Admittedly, I am a big fun of many Kashi products for their excellent taste and healthy contents.
Good snack. More filling than other bars. Very nutritious. The flavors are very complementary. Still on the expensive side even though ordered in bulk.

These bars are the best low carb, low sugar, high protein and fiber.  The bonus is that they're really good tasting.  The price is about the same as you pay in stores but they're not always available so having a supply is definitely a convenience.
Good flavor, certainly not a Snickers :-), but good taste, fair consistency, travels well and certainly helps when you need some progein.

These bars are a great substitute for breakfast.  They keep you full until lunch or will hold you over til dinner and they taste great.  They are full of protein and fiber and are only two points on the Weight Watchers diet!

column9: great to have in car or at office
column10: appeals to me for nutritious value and easy of storing in my car or at my office.  Often substitute a bar for breakfast while driving to the gym at 6:30am.  Disappointed that Amazon has been out of product for weeks.

column9: Good food for anyone on the go!
column10: I so far am delighted with all the products I have tried from Kashi.  This one is a good twist of peanut butter and chocolate and krispiness!

I'm new to the Kashi brand of products but stumbled upon the chocolate peanut bars at my local Wegman's market.  I've tried a number of nutrition/energy bars, including Clif, Pria, Powerbar, etc. and the Kashi bars are by far the best.  They do not taste artificial like most of the other bars I've tried.  The chocolate satisfies your sweet tooth, and the peanut butter flavor is great too.  I'm a fan of granola so these are really the perfect snack for me.  They're very crunchy and are a decent size too, so by the time you're done you feel like you've actually eaten something substantial.  Now that I've tried these I won't be buying any of the other bars on the market.

column9: 250MG of salt and 13 grams of sugar????
column10: Holy poop!! wish I would have checked that before I ordered them!! How exactly does adding 13 grams of sugar help your blood sugar level?? I checked that AFTER I tasted one because they taste like what I would imagine heavily salted wood chips to taste like!! What a hoax!!! I am found this HEALYH FOOD to be counter productive to blood sugar and high blood pressure..I threw them out!!!

The product arrived on time but was stale.  I have purchased this product from Kashi at other times and it just did not meet the standard.  It is not close to the expiration date, but I almost lost a tooth trying to eat it.  Good product, but it is not a good idea to purchase it through Amazon.
I like these, but the almond ones are better. The peanut ones are a little bland. Still a lot of bang for your calorie buck, though.
I liked this bar.  It had a good balance of flavor and wasn't overly sweet.  I would have preferred that there was a bit more protein in it, but it works as a "snack" bar.

I am one hardly to ever leave product reviews, and as much as I buy online, I should work on that. But, after trying the various Kashi products, these bars are by far the best and I feel the need to leave a review! I started off eating the Kashi Honey Almond Flax granola bars, which are very good, but definitley not as sweet as these (not a good OR bad thing, just a comparison). However, you will still get the protein, fiber and omega-3s if that's what you're looking for. If you love chocolate and almonds and are looking for a protein/fiber bar that tastes good and is more on the sweet side, this is definitely one to try!!! Whether you use them as a meal replacement or as a snack, they are absolutley amazing and I will definitely be a repeat customer.

These were a little more difficult to eat than I expected. They are bulky which is good but some of the grain is a little tough. They are somewhat tasty but I'm looking for a better product than this.

And by tasty I mean, they taste like sawdust with a layer of chocolate. These are horrid. I'd rather head to my local beach and stick a fistfull of sand into my mouth then ever eat these things again.The first few chews aren't that bad. But as soon as the chocolate wears out it's really like you're eating sawdust. The after taste is horrid, the texture is terrible. Who ever thinks these taste better then rice crispy treats really need to go back and eat some much better rice crispy treats because they don't.
Looks like Amazon is selling old stuff. Kashi makes great Bars but just don't buy them from Amazon

column9: I broke off a tooth on one of these bars
column10: Into the second bite, one of my teeth broke off.  That was enough to turn me off.  Careful how you chew!
My preference would be for a bit more "toasted" / crunchy (not hard though) and a bit more salty (cause I like em salty).  Otherwise very good.

column9: Good, but NUTRITIONAL INFORMATION IS INCORRECT
column10: These soy nuts taste good, but the nutritional information listed in not accurate. These nuts contain more calories and fat, and less fiber than listed. In fact, there are only 2 grams of fiber per serving according to the product packaging.
On sale, these are $1.99 for a pouch.  They are okay and forestall my jones for hard crunchy food.  They are better than Terra chips for that but the taste is okay but nothing to write about.

I thought I'd try these out after reading an article about Tony Packo's and I was not disappointed. These are awesome! The pickles and peppers have just the right amount of sweet and tart. Almost like eating dill and sweet pickles at the same time and then throwing in a little spice for good measure. I usually only eat pickles or relish on a hot dog but I put this on everything: hot dogs, sandwiches, hamburgers, side dish or just as a treat. They're almost addictive. I've been out for a few weeks and still think of them fondly. As a matter of fact, I'm going to finish writing this and go buy a couple of more before I forget!

I love pickles. I usually go for the kosher type. Love spicy things too. I was caught off guard by these. Very sweet with a good spicy kick, not too hot at all but, Wow! I can't stop sneaking over to the fridge and getting more. I am not telling my wife about them until they are almost gone. Get the big jar for only a couple of extra dollars. Do not waste your time with the small jar. I am a Chicago boy who grew up next to a wonderful pickle shop. I feel like a trader, but these are so good! I will be trying more of the flavors but the Sweet and Spicy rock.
At a recent dinner party, someone opened a jar of these pickles andput them out with a few appetizers.  The jar was gone in seconds.Just the right combination and I can say you won't be disappointed.

These are the best pickles I ever tasted. Well, next to real Deli New Dills. The two are obviously very different. But in my book they tie for first place. Love the image on the label too. You won't be disappointed. [...]

I recently purchased and used this product and found it very good. I have used Williams Sonoma demi for years and this product is as good or better and a much better value. It seems less salty than Williams-Sonoma.

If you are tired of overly strong mints like Altoids these mints are a refreshing change. They are only mildly minty with a subtle vanilla flavor. Each mint is only five calories and is made with sorbitol not aspartame. These mints also do not contain any animal ingredients so they are fine for vegetarians.~The Rebecca Review
We live in Hawaii and still order our coffee from the Dominican Republic... It's preferred over our Kona coffees available here!

column9: Not easy getting good beans in the US
column10: Not sure if this is 100% true, but usually the beans you get in the US are 3rd tier or worse beans from coffee bean producing countries.  This bag of beans is actually commonly found in normal grocery stores in the Dominican Republic.  Despite so, it is still much better than most coffee beans that you can get from your usual coffee stores.  I am a fan of Joe's art of coffee store in NYC, and I usually only use their beans, but now, I would only use their beans when I am running low on these beans and the new order has not arrived yet.Taste: Goes down smooth and does not taste sour.

I love my Galangal powder from Whole Spice, use it in many recipes instead of black pepper since I cannot have black pepper. I like the economic bulk package from Whole Spice.  I keep a glass jar of the powder handy for cooking and refill it from the bag, as needed.  I do keep the open bag and the jar in the fridge but you may not have to do that.

I have vivid memories from my childhood of filling both Ritz crackers and Wheat Thins with spiraling cords of rich and cheesy goo. I, myself, prefer filling the top of one cracker with cheese and then putting another cracker on top to form a cheesy sandwich, not unlike an Oreo. But, I have on occasion been known to spray the can directly into my pie-hole(only if I know no one will use the can after me). And who doesn't love when the can starts to run low and the aerosol spits cheese shrapnel all over the place?Of course highly processed cheese in a can is not the best choice if you are either watching your weight and/or trying to maintain healthy consumption practices. So lets break down the nutri-facts according to the label.(as of 4/11/12)Based on 2,000 calorie diet. Serving size two tablespoons. Seven servings per can.Total Fat: 6 gramsSaturated - 2 gramsTrans - 0 gramsCholesterol: 15 gramsSodium: 430 milligramsTotal Carbohydrate: 2 gramsDietary Fiber - 0 gramsSugars - 2 gramsProtein: 4 gramsVitamin A: 8%, Vitamin C: 0%, Calcium: 20%, Iron: 0%Ingredients: Whey, Cheddar Cheese,(milk, cheese culture, salt, enzymes), Canola oil, Milk Protein Concentrate, Milk, Whey Protein Concentrate, Contains less than 2% of Sodium Citrate, Sodium Phosphate, Calcium Phosphate, Salt, Lactic Acid, Sodium Alginate, Sorbic Acid as a preservative, Apocarotenal(color), Annatto(color), Enzymes, Cheese Culture.CONTAINS MILK.

These days gourmet cheese is a luxury few can afford. I know I'm not the only one eyeing a block of sharp cheddar cheese, imagining how good it'd taste while gasping at the price. But pinching pennies shouldn't mean sacrificing taste.Enter Kraft Easy Cheese.Kraft Easy Cheese is an affordable topping for your Saturday Night crackers. Simply grab a box of your favorite salted snack, Ryder a cheesy movie (pun intended), and squeeze away.'Cheese in a can? Please.'Oh I'm sorry, did a bill collector just call?'I prefer Camembert.'Who doesn't? But more importantly, who doesn't want to pay the rent on time?You don't have to take my word for it, though. Order a six-pack today, and for once pay your credit card on time.Kraft Easy Cheese: saving you money without sacrificing taste.

column9: Aunt Sally's Pralines are the very best!!!
column10: There are a lot of places that sell pralines, or what they advertise as pralines.  However, the original sugary (not creamy) pralines that Aunt Sally's sells are the only authentic ones.  I am from Louisiana, and have been eating Aunt Sally's for probably 50 years!  You cannot find a better praline than this one.  Don't even think you are getting a good praline when you see them in Mexican restaurants or other places.  This is the one and only kind - it should be sugary, thin, and full of pecans.  Actually it's a very simple delicacy, but apparently they are not as easy to make because there are too many out there that just don't come close.  If you want a real taste of a good New Orleans praline, you simple must get Aunt Sally's Original Creole Pralines.
I purchased this product after a bad experience with another flavor. This was a better selection. This is what the 'original pralines' should taste like.
Still the greatest pralines in New Orleans.  Good CustomerService too !!
The next time I order this item, I would go to Aunt Sally's direct.  There was a delay in ordering from Amazon thereby making the delivery late for Christmas.
Enjoyed this product immensely!!! Ate them all the time when I lived in NOLA and now excited that I can order them on-line! Thank You!
A classic after dinner tea.  You can skip dessert and the calories, just sit back and enjoy the citrus aromaAnd the chocolate hint.

good moist satisfying cookie. I like these cookies because they are natural but still taste good and have enough mass to be satisfying.I also like that they do not crumble and make a mess when I eat them in my office.

this is my second trial of nana's cookie collection.first one was the sun flower.i realli liked this cookie. it had a good combination.sweetness and junkieness from the chocolate chip and the whole grainy healthy taste from the dough. but because i don't have such a sweet tooth, i would've liked it better if it had less chocolate chips.

I like orange but do find this a little bit too much.  I am ok with the texture which is a little off because of the crisps but the orange is a bitter orange which seems a bit too strong to me.  I can eats these but will not reorder them.  The other Nana's I have tried were much better.

One of the things that I missed the most when I went gluten-free was a good, spicy molasses cookie.  This offering from Nana's definitely fits the bill.  I took off one star simply because it is pricey.  On the plus side, the cookies are quite big and it is nice to have an option for vegan treats.  I have tried to make gluten-free cookies of my own and have failed miserably because I try to make them healthy.  I appreciate Amazon for offering these because the company offers low prices, free shipping, and excellent customer service.

These cookies are terrific. I cannot eat refined sugar and this is the first cookie that I have really enjoyed in this category. Other cookies that are sugar free are often too powdery or hard as rocks. Nan's Chocolate Chip were moist and delicious. Way to go Nana!

I ordered these off of amazon after reading several reviews.  I discovered I have multiple food allergies and this is the only "treat" I have found that I am able to have.  I think these cookies are great.  Good texture, if a little dense (aren't all gluten free products?), with a nice lemon flavor.  The cookies are also big, so if you want to eat just one serving, which is half the cookie, it is satisfying.  I have also tried warming them up and dipping them in a bit of rice milk, yum!  Liked them so much that I have ordered these again and have also decided to try the ginger ones too.

column9: Better than I expected for no-sugar, but I expected sugar!
column10: Better than I expected for no-sugar, but I expected sugar!  I was surprised the description didn't make more of the no-sugar content, I was hoping for more sinful deliciousness!  But it was decent enough for healthy food.

Nana's cookies are the best. I have tried them all. I cannot eat anything with white refined sugar in it. It makes me very ill. I have a Nana's cookie and no after effects. Some times for breakfast I put the cookie in the micro wave for 25 seconds and put peanut butter on it. I feel like I have broken all my diet rules, (no after effect) but this is the one product that I have found that IS to good to be true. Thany you Nana.

column9: Delicious cookies for everyone, can't beat these!
column10: My mother loves oatmeal raisin cookies but she is hard to please.  I like healthy foods,,,we found the perfect combination of both with these,,,,they are super for people with food allergies, no eggs, no corn, no refined sugar,,,,but are absolutely moist and scrumptious,,,it's rare that my mother and I can find something like this that we both agree on,,,but these hit the mark,,,,,,,,try them, you won't be disappointed!

I love these cookies so much, and I've never been a fan of lemon cake or pastries. They are so soft and I think I may be addicted now! All 3 of my kids love them, as well as the NO GLUTEN GINGER ones. Even my gluten eating husband loved them. I only wish they weren't so expensive...
I order from Nanas regulary. I love the coconut choco chip. So coconuty and just enough chips. Sunflower good also. They just taste good.
Some find the orange taste too strong. I don't. They are a bit pricey for cookies, but the Amazon price is good. Not for compulsive eaters, though--half a cookie is 130 calories.

Nana's Chocolate and chocolate Chip cookies are very tasty. They have no dairy and have all natural sugar (fruit juice) and no trans fat. I like they way they each have their own package so they stay fresher longer.These are the kind of cookies that make you feel like you are eating healthier.

I bit into this cookie for the first time ready to proclaim that it was not as good as the Alternative Baking Company's Double Chocolate Vegan Cookie, but I was wrong. It was way better. It has the addition of nuts, and the chips don't have that barley malt after taste that the ABC cookies have. I am eager to order more flavors of this cookie to try and compare, as these are much cheaper than the ABC brand, which is not currently available at amazon.

Taste's great and for someone that can not have refined sugar, what a great treat. I take them with me when I travel. I have tried other Nana's flavor's and they are good, but Double Chocolate is my NUMBER 1.DNLEWIS

These cookies are high in fiber and make a great holdover snack in-between meals. Like Nana's other cookies, these are not very sweet. The part I like best are the walnuts that are mixed providing a sublte crunch in these otherwise soft cookie.
I was surprised at the intensity of the chocolate flavor in this cookie.It is slightly drier than some of the other Nana's cookies I've tried. Probably because it's loaded with cocoa powder!

column9: The best cookie and a great breakfast treat.
column10: This big, delicious, moist and chewy cookie fits the bill for a great on-the-go breakfast or travel meal. Note that one serving is half a cookie, which would be plenty as a dessert or snack. But a whole cookie makes a meal, and is very filling.Read the ingredient list carefully and you will see one *important* difference between this brand and other "healthy" cookie or pastry-bar type treats: (organic) WHOLE wheat flour. Not "wheat flour", which is the same as white flour, and has no nutritional value.Another plus is that even the chocolate chips in the cookie are sweetened with low-glycemic malted barley, not cane sugar.I'm looking forward to trying more varieties of Nana's cookies.

As a newly converted vegan, there's not a lotta sweet food items I can eat that doesn't have milk or some type of milk product or animal product in it (not to mention refined sugars and bleached flours etc). I've tried Alternative Baking Company's double chocolate cookie, which I loved, but per cookie they charge $2 a piece. I searched for another company that makes a similar cookie, and found this company (Nana's). The cookie is every bit as good as  the ABC's cookie, and a lot cheaper at that. Hands down the best cookie I've ever eaten. For any vegans or anyone looking to decrease their sugar intake, this is definitely worth trying.
What a delicious and nutritious cookie. They are so moist and they melt in your mouth. So glad I found out about these tasty treats!!!
One of the best store-bought cookies I've ever tasted ... and I'm a very choosy chocolate lover.

column9: NOTE that WHEAT-FREE does NOT equal GLUTEN-FREE
column10: Nana's No Wheat - No Refined Sugar - Chocolate Chip Cookie, 3.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)  I have tried several of Nana's products and they are VERY, VERY tasty for the occasional snack or special occasion. With my gluten-free diet (and expecting family members with dietary restrictions), I ordered a box of these renowned Chocolate Chip Cookies for inclusion on the dessert table at my son's graduation BBQ.PLEASE NOTE: these "No Wheat" cookies DO CONTAIN GLUTEN--in the form of barley flour and malted barley.
