I've been buying these bars, singly, for years and years at the grocery store.  They were out of the black ones, for some reason, so I finally ordered an entire box.This is my favorite chocolate.  It's nice and dark and flavorful without being bitter or waxy.  It is the only bar of this richness that I have tried that melts well on the tongue.  Everything else this dark seems to just chip, which isn't any good.  Chocolove makes the winningest chocolate that I've tried, and their black bar is my old standby.The gold bar has good flavor, but doesn't melt well.  Some of the flavored bars are good.  The best is the peppermint (blue).  My other favorite is the ginger (green).  Can you tell I prefer dark to milk?If you're interested, it turns out you can send any of these chocolate bars through the mail with only a "forever" and a postcard stamp.  They were my valentines this year, wrapped up in colorful paper.  These are particularly appropriate for valentines because there is always a love poem on the inside of the paper. I tend to skip the poem and go straight for the treat.  Yum!
Yes, what a deal!  Delicious chocolate that is good for you!  Also, this IS the best price you can find for it, even better than directly from Chocolove!!!  Maybe I shouldn't let them know that!

column9: Chocolove Premium Chocolate Bars, Belgian Chocolate, Strong Dark (70%)
column10: I love many of the chocolove bars, they are all wonderful and full of flavor.  This one is a very simple suttle dark chocolate, not too strong but not lacking in flavor either. If you are a fan of dark chocolate I would give this one a try, its very smooth and coats the mouth in a wonderful soft dark chocolate.  Not sickly sweet at all, but just a touch of sweetness.  The cocoa flavor is perfect here.  Its not my most favorite dark chocolate but it is a nice treat to have to change things up a bit.

column9: Great Chocolate, but not in the summer!
column10: This is my favorite dark chocolate...just don't order it in the summer!  It does not travel well, and has a tendency to melt or become discolored in the heat.  (Luckily, Nutricity is fabulous about refunds).

The chocolate bars arrived on time packed with an icebag and in a nice box which makes it easily accessible to get one at a time.  It is delicious 70% chocolate which I have had before and am enjoying again.  It is a good choice.Chocolove Premium Chocolate Bars, Belgian Chocolate, Strong Dark (70%), 3.2-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)

column9: The best chocolate I've ever had!
column10: This chocolate is high-quality chocolate. It isn't too sweet, and the taste is extraordinary. It is by far the best I've ever had (and I've had a lot)!
I love this chocolate!  I usually buy it at Whole Foods, but they were out for a couple of weeks so found it here.  It was quite a bit cheaper on Amazon.

Sent these bars to both of my older kids as birthday presents with a note that this chocolate, eaten in moderation, could be consumed without guilt because dark chocolate is actually good for you!  Both kids loved the bars so now I guess I need to send some to myself!
I bought this as a Christmas gift for my boyfriend's mother. Not only was she quite pleased with the taste, but I was also surprised at the amount that was there. I would definitely recommend.

column9: Very lushous and great quality and price
column10: Singing the praises of healthy DARK CHOCOLATE, with in moderation of course, is good for a person.....Get away from the unhealthy milk chocolate and try this..... I'm hooked!
This product is very high quality, the chocolate flavor is consistent, and it is smooth all the way through swallowing, without any bitter after taste whatsoever!

These taste awesome. And I'm not a nutrition expert but they seem pretty healthy too, pretty low in sugar etc. I give this when I have women over (I'm a single bachelor) and they love it. It looks far more expensive than it is, and the poem on the inside of the label is a nice touch. I'll definitely be getting more when my current supply runs out (which will be soon at the rate I pick up women lately... haha).

I bought this because of the supposed health benefits.  Was concerned that the 70% cocoa would have a bitter taste.Not so.  Very smooth and delicious. Great that something that tastes this good is healthy too!

While the chocolates from Chocolove may be tasty, their treatment of folks they do business with is anything but. I shop and support small business because I believe them to be responsible to other small businesses they work with. When the management of Chocolove refused to pay for work done for them by friends of mine (also in Boulder), I can no longer buy their chocolate. There are many other small chocolate companies around and from now on my money will go to folks who do the right thing.

If you are purchasing a box of Norman Love "chocolates" because they are pretty and artistic, you will probably get a box of creams.  They are NOT chocolates.  They have a thin candy coating that has a far-distant vague taste of chocolate, but it is overcome by the fruity cream in the middle. They may sell chocolate "bars" but I will never find out because their customer service is hateful and demeaning.  If you want a REAL artisan chocolate experience, order Christopher Elbow instead.

I just bought the toffee and almond bar.  It was the worst chocolate I've ever eaten in my life.  It tasted waxy.  The toffee was basically non-existent. I searched the bar for almonds and found a couple of tiny pieces.  I threw it away after only eating 2 small squares.  What a waste of money.  And my taste buds are very disappointed.  Maybe the dark chocolate is better but I definitely do not recommend this one.

column9: Puroast low acid organic house blend coffee
column10: Order took 14 days to arrive, it is so dry it looks like it has been sitting in the sun for days, it tastes like cardboard(if you ever made "spitballs" from paper when you were a kid then you know that taste). I made two pots, adding more coffee to the second pot but ended up throwing the coffee in the trash. I'm glad I only ordered a 12oz sample. I can't say weather the low acid claim is valid but they sure have the low flavor perfected. Don't waste your money. Not worth the money and effort to return it.  Joe in Oregon

I agree with all of the other reviewers...this stuff is really good for what it is - a cocoa granola.  It has a great cocoa taste (I wouldn't describe the taste as chocolate, really, although it has 63% chocolate chips in it as well), and is sweet enough without being too sweet.  And, as far as granola is concerned, it is really healthy...only 35mg sodium, 1g saturated fat, 8g sugar.  The only minor issue I have is that I like my granola "clustered" a little more...you know, little granola bunches.  It has "Clusters" in the title, but I am not sure it actually comes that way.  However, my shipment seemed to get crushed enroute, so...
This is the most delicious granola I have ever tasted. A must buy! Buy ten bags or you will run out.

column9: WOW! Huge Chocolate Flavor, Not too Sweet, Perfect!
column10: I tried this chocolate flavor after having already tasted the other flavors that Love Grown makes (and loving them).This chocolate one has slightly more sugar than the other flavors, so I was worried maybe it would be too sweet. I was wrong, it's perfectly balanced. Love Grown managed to get the perfect balance of bold chocolate flavor, that wonderful hit of bitterness form the cocoa, and just the right amount of sweetness.This stuff is super yummy and is a treat with milk, with yogurt, or just plan by itself dry as a snack.I have tasted at least a dozen other brands of healthy granola recently and Love Grown is without a doubt the best tasting brand I have found. As it happens it is also probably one of the healthiest.If you are a fan of dark chocolate and you don't like things that are too sweet, you will be amazed how well balanced and delicious this granola is.

I previously found this at Marshall's and then went on the search online.  Thanks Amazon for stocking this item. This is by far one of my favorite granolas - the nutritional values are just what a Watching Your Weight Sista needs.The taste is incredible and very good for the health conscious.

This is really really good perfect combination. Its my first try of this company's  products and I'm very impressed ...I have a strict diet and read so many  labels . I'm a picky eater on top of my gluten vegan non dairy diet. It has to taste good or I won't eat it .. this passed with flying colors Yuuummm!!!!
When I die and am cremated I want a package of this stuff mixed in with my ashes and placed in the urn!  You know it's a Portlandia thing.

column9: If I die tomorrow, it'll be okay as I've experienced eating this granola
column10: If you can manage to get beyond just eating this out of the bag, a bowl topped with fresh raspberries & yogurt is awesome.

Having tried chocolate granolas from Bear Naked, Erin Baker's, Back to Nature, KIND, Lizi's, Cascadian Farm, Breadshop (mocha, discontinued), and Nature's Path Love Crunch, I find Love Grown's the dark-chocolatey-est.

Really good taste as it is not too sweet but has a great chocolate flavor.  My husband and I both ate it out of the bag plus had a bowl of it with some almond milk.  Very good!!!  I will order more...

If you haven't had this most heavenly cocoa goodness you are really missing out! My favorite afternoon pick-me-up is to add a little Cocoa Goodness to Brown Cow Coffee yogurt Love Grown Foods Oat Clusters and Love, Cocoa Goodness, 12-Ounce (Pack of 3) .... FABULOUS:> Gives you great energy to get you through the day.

column9: IM STILL WATEING FOR IT THEY SENT THE WRONG ONE
column10: they sent the wrong one i'm still wateing for it i hope they send me the right one soon i keep wateing for it

This instant drink mix is already sweetened. I use it to add flavor to bottled water as well as making a pitcher full to leave in the refrigerator. I've found Zuko Instant Drink products on Warehouse Deals for sale prices and have tried many of their flavors which ALL have been good with nice tropical flair and taste.

I just received the Salmon, the Duck and the Chicken strips.Our JRT is very fussy and horribly spoiled.She turns up her nose and walks away from many treats I've tried.Most of the "organic" or "healthy" treats I've tried haven't won her over.She just had one each of the Salmon, Duck and Chicken and LOVED all of them!I'm thrilled that they are made in the US and contain ingredients I approve of.Thank you Plato and Amazon!

column9: Healthy, Yummy, and Made in the USA
column10: I am always looking for healthy treats for my Wheaten and the fewer ingredients the better. I thought I found the best product when I found Waggin Train Chicken Jerky at Costco. Then I read the reviews on Amazon and, well, it scared the crap out of me. So now, I look for healthy treats with few ingredients, that are made in the US. I feel comfortable giving my dog these treats because I know the ingredients used are regulated. My dog LOVES these and so do I.

column9: If the dogs love them, what more is there to say?
column10: Well I've never tasted them but both my collie and mini-dh love these things. Some treats are hit or miss but they line up at the drawer waiting for these so they get 5 stars from us.

I read about the most recent scare with chicken jerky made in China and promptly returned $55 worth of jerky strips and wrapped rawhide sticks back to Petco.  These Plato organic strips were my next test before making my own - and one bag of each flavor was cheaper than the Chinese jerky I purchased!  We haven't received the salmon flavor yet but my dog seems to like both the chicken and duck flavors very much.  I was a little surprised at the product itself, given it is called a "strip," but looks more like a cookie than anything else.  Still, it's nice to find something made in the USA, with no corn, soy, or wheat gluten.  I will continue to buy these if my dog continues to eat them.

column9: Great Treat, Alternative of Chicken Jerky
column10: I used to feed my then two month old puppy chicken jerky treats from Sams. It was cheap and he LOVED it. However, he started getting bloody diarrhea. This happened twice before I finally realized it was the jerky by researching this online. Since my puppy was also eating Greenies, Zuke's chicken treats, Milk Bones, Milk Bones Trail Mix, Iams Puppy dog food, Royal Canin food (digestion formula), puppy vitamins, Platos chicken treats, Natures Recipe food and treats, his puppy trainer's treats, and Benadryl (he has dermatitis), it was hard to pinpoint what the cause was. But once I figured it out, I stopped the Waggin Train and switched to Platos. Although these treats are more expensive and contain preservatives, it does seem a better alternative to liver failure or sudden death some pet owners were experiencing with chicken jerky treats.As for the seemingly biased reviews against jerky treats coming from China, I am a first generation Chinese immigrant with family back East, and I love them and where I am from, but shady practices are abound in China. So no xenophobia driven bias here, I have seen the damage done to my pup by Chinese treats, and these Platos treats are definitely a safer bet.The FDA statement regarding Chinese chicken treats can be found here:[...]

column9: USA and organic and yummy-- what more could you want?
column10: My husky loves these treats.  I used to buy the chicken strips for her but they are not a USA made product so when I could we tried these snacks.  She absolutely loves them.  I break them up into smaller bits for training.  A winner.Coming back for more chicken and going to give the duck ones a try--- she is, that is.

column9: Made in USA and the new favorite treat!
column10: I too am boycotting dog chews and treats not made in the US, so was nervous about ordering these.  Amazon needs to be very specific about this info in its descriptions, and not dance around the issue by leaving it out.  Country of origin should not be "optional" in terms of the descriptive information provided!That being said, these are a huge hit with our big guys.  They are a crunchy bisquit - not jerky - about 1 1/2" long by maybe 3/4" wide, but the first ingredient is organic chicken (package specifies "over 90% organic chicken"), followed by organic brown rice; the product is certified USDA Organic.  [I am of the camp that "organic" means anything containing a carbon atom, and that aspect is not a big selling point for ME, but may be desirable info for some.]  They are not inexpensive, but for a product made in the US AND mostly chicken, I think it's in line with other pet treats, or less.  I use them in combination with other, more grain-containing treats, since TOO much protein can put a lot of strain on the kidneys, especially in older dogs.Bottom line - great product...this doggy Mom approves!

column9: Great treat made in the U.S.
column10: My dog absolutely loves these treats!  Size of the treat is great for my dog.  He weighs 35 pounds.  I highly recommend this treat, very few ingredients and most importantly they are made in the U.S.A.

I have an English Bulldog puppy and my Brussels Griffen dog both go crazy over these treats. With English Bulldog you have to watch what you feed them because they get gas :) so easy and I don't find him to be gassy from these treats! Love Plato treats!

I have the pickiest dog when it comes to treats and non-human food and he absolutely loves these treats. They are great for a reward system or just having something to snack on in-between meals.These treats are the best that I have found and they are worth every penny. I no longer waste my money on treats that have tons of chemicals or non-food parts.... These are Organic and honestly, I feel better as a parent when I give the treats to my fur kid.These are a must buy if you want a healthy treat for your pet.
My dogs love this treat. Great price for a 16-qunce bag. The product is made of organic chicken. My dogs seem to have more energy after I changed to this brand.

Sad that this company would not not take 10 sec. too look at the merchandise. The treats were green with moldy. I got so sick when I opened. Won't buy again, and have already found  substitute at Petsmart.

My little chihuahua, Snoopy, absolutely loves these treats. His excitement level is over the top when he knows he is about to get a plato chicken treat. If snoop had his way he would eat these treats for his meals.

Plato Chicken Treats are a favorite with my three dogs.Each dog has their individual likes and dislikes; this treat isloved by all three!I have bought 5 bags so far and will buy more.The treat is not super dry either.  I have an 11 year old Lab,9 year old Chinese Crested, and a 3 year old Chinese Crested;all three dogs are able to chew/bite the treat with no problem.The treat is also easily broken in half...to share...awww...
My Rottie and my Lab mix love these treats and they smell like real chicken.  I also give them other treats by Plato and they wolf them down.  Made in USA which is a big plus!

column9: My kids look forward to one every night.
column10: Good, natural, USA made product. My Golden Retrievers love them. Price is right if you take advantage of the free supersaver shipping. A little high in fat content, 30%, but they are not big pieces, so it shouldn't be a problem if you give only once or twice a day. If you have a small dog, they are easily breakable into smaller bitesize pieces. I recommend this product.

With the big scare out there about the chicken from China causing health issues in pets, I was on the hunt for something healthy, that my Furkids would love. They LOVE these...Thank you for a GREAT product..  :)

My dogs love these and its great to finally find something made in the USA and not in China. You get a whole pound for what you pay for a tiny 3-6 oz bag in the store for a comparable item. I've bought two bags already and will be back for more.

Normally, these treats are moist & chewy, but these are dry, hard, and stale.  These are the only type of treat my golden can eat because he has allergies. I guess we'll have to return to purchasing them locally.

Got a bag of these for my Old English Sheepdog at a local "Pet Health Food" store. Nice enough store but a bit too "New Age, Alternative Health, BS" with prices to match.OTOH, the treats are great and he loves them so I was glad to find them much cheaper and Amazon Prime as well. I have ordered a couple more bags.

column9: Organic and healthy treat for my German Shepherd
column10: I have purchased these (more than 8) from Amazon (directly and from their merchants) in the past and it has been the best treat for my German Shepherd.  The size is perfect for a large dog. It is organic and only get them when the price is right.

Plato Organic Chicken Strips Smart Dog Treats  Ordered these on Friday 6-3 and they arrived in my mailbox on 6-6.  Unbelievable!!  My little dog has seizures so I am very careful about what I feed her both food and treats.  She loved these and I am hoping no negative reactions.  I can't imagine that happening with the ingredients listed.

column9: My pup loves em.  Good enough for me.
column10: At first, my dog (a 10lb Maltese-ish mutt) didn't seem to interested in these.  I've since decided it was because before these I was essentially handing him fully artificial crap.  I think it just took him a week or two to get used to the good stuff.Now, he sprints to his kennel whenever he hears me opening the bag!!Just ordered my second bag.  I do wish the other flavors came in individual packages, though.  It feels terrible to me to pay $50 on dog treats even if it is a bulk buy.  But that's certainly not a knock on the product!

This is an easy review because the judgement was made by our two papillons. They live for their treats and are NOT especially picky about treats. These items are dried, uniform in size, and although they may be "organic" they smell bad and my dogs would have nothing to do with them. I threw them out and wanted to share the expensive experience with others so they would not waste their money.

column9: cookies, not jerky -- and the dogs are not pleased
column10: I was searching for USA-made chicken jerky for my two chows and the Plato line came up. My goof not to realize these 'strips' are baked cookies, not dried chicken meat strips, and the dogs have made it very clear -- they definitely prefer real jerky. They don't seem to like the (sort of dry-fudgy) texture of these treats, but will 'accept' the chicken and the salmon, while simply rejecting the duck version. Broken up as training bits for the puppy these will probably be usable, which is good since they aren't cheap.Later I found Bellyrubs brand chicken jerky (at about half the price of Plato) at a feed store, and I am back in the dogs' good graces.
This is a good product. Our dogs love it. It has become a staple in our household. I recommend buying it.

column9: My morkie won't eat anything just like Mikey
column10: My morkie is soooo fussy - he hates everything ever since he got a combo booster rabies/distemper shot!!!  He loves these.  They smell good to me even.  They seem to be top quality.  If Rexie likes them they must be OK.

I bought these two months ago in a relentless search of made in the USA chicken jerky treats.  They are not jerky, but two inch formed pieces.  Also in the two months since I purchased them the price has increased 30%.  I feel that consumers looking for jerky that is made in the USA are being taken advantage of.  Also, my dogs agree, this is not jerky.  I love organic, but I will keep looking.

My dog loved these, and he's picky as can be about his treats. I would break them in two or three pieces and give him one every time he did his business or during training. You could tell he liked them because he'd ring the bell to go outside just so he could take a fake leak and come in for another treat.
Great product, great price and what's most important, great service.  Second order with this company and getting ready to use again. Highly recommend.

I first tried these when I saw they are USA made.  My two Shih Tzu LOVE these.  It's one of the few treats I have tried they never get tired of.  It's also reassuring to know they are full of good ingredients. They are smaller in size and there are a lot in the bag, so they last a lot long time and they are reasonably priced. Great product!

column9: Not quite what I was looking for
column10: My dog loves dried chicken jerky treats, but almost all are from China which concerns me.  Trying to find a safer alternative, I stumbled on these.  If you're looking for whole chicken breasts which have been dehydrated, these aren't the same.  They are pieces & parts molded together and almost look like cardboard.  My dog likes them, but they don't seem like anything special to me.  They do say organic, so hopefully are safer, but I'm not really impressed.

column9: Wow, these smell great & Brownie loves it!
column10: OMG These smell sooooo good that I wanted to eat it myself! That's saying a lot, I usually hate the smell of Brownie's treats. Brownie loves it so much, he didn't want to follow me outside because he was still trying to find crumbs! LOL  They're also very healthy and cheap. These are way better than other expensive brands because they smell better, taste better and cost less.  This is bang for your buck. love it, love it, love it!

Firstly, these are a really great price compared to the Milo's Kitchen treats we normally buy. The only problem is our Pomeranian is pretty underwhelmed by them. When he gets his regular treats he is really excited and does his little "doggy dance". When I first gave him one the Plato treats he ignored it and our cat tried to eat it, I broke it up into pieces so kitty did get to eat it. The next day I left two on the floor and withheld his usual Milo's Kitchen Chicken Grillers. After awhile he finally ate both of them! So he will eat them but isn't too excited about them.

column9: The only biscuit my dogs will eat
column10: I have two fussy dogs (Yorkshire Terrier/Poodle mixes), who reject any kind of hard biscuit after trying them for a few times. I've lost count of the number of bags and boxes of biscuits I've tried and then sent to my sister's dog, who'll eat anything.The Plato Organic Chicken biscuits are the only exception for my girls. When I offer them, they grab them and run to their favorite spot to crunch them right up. A little pricey, but worth it. I've finally given up trying anything else.

We are always looking for a special and nutritious treat for our Boy.  We have tried various chicken jerky products but upon closer look, we note they are sourced from China. We tried these because they are organic and made in the US, and they are a hit.These treats are hard and a bit difficult to break up, but they are our Scottie's favorite treats, and one of the only ones that elicit an automatic "sit"!This is a good product and very reasonably priced.

column9: Made in the U.S.A. and my dog loves them!
column10: I had been looking for a reasonably priced dog treat that was mad in the U.S.A. because I read read to many stories of animals getting sick and dying from eating treats made in China.  I stumbled across these about a year ago on amazon and decided to give them a try.  My dog loves all the flavors that Plato offers and I love them because they are good for him and are produced right here in the U.S.  The price is very good compared to some other made in the U.S. treats I had tried before these.  I highly recommend these for your four legged family members!

Our little Mini Schnauzer is very picky about her food.  These treats got a paws up!  There are like little baked cookies and must taste great, although I have not tried them.  Organic and made in the USA!
I put 2 of these in a large Kong Extreme and it kept my 8 month old German Shepherd busy for hours. Life saver! Seriously.

These treats are my 18 month old Boston Terrier's favorite treat by far. We give him only natural treats with no wheat or tons of added fillers. He knows when we have some of these in the house and isn't happy if we give him something else.

I used to feed my dogs the "made in China" chicken fillets and they all loved them but the more info I gathered about them the more I questioned feeding them to my dogs.  I switched to beef jerky but with 2 large dogs and 2 small dogs that became very pricy.  I found these by doing a search on Amazon for chichen treats made in the USA with free shipping.  All four of the dogs love them and I feel much better about feeding these to them and while they are not cheap they are a lot cheaper than beef jerky.

This is the favorite treat of my miniature australian shepherd. I am unaware of similar treats that are currently produced by other manufacturers. I order the Plato treats online. They are unavailable in all of the "big box" pet stores in my area.

My everlasting quest to find cheap and healthy dog treats has eventually lead me to this brand.  I have yet to find any healthy treats cheaper than this when looking at a cost/ounce comparison.  It's made in the USA, which is a necessity.  I refuse to buy any dog treats from China, and so should you.  I used to buy the Waggin Train brand until I researched it.  Please research your dog treats!I would say these fall somewhere between a hard and soft treat.  They are not chewy, but will not crumble when you break them.  I usually break them in half so the bag lasts longer.  My Lab likes them, but I wouldn't say they are his favorite.  He will sometimes turn these down if he has a more desirable toy in his mouth.  This is the only reason I'm giving these 4 stars instead of 5.  I do plan to try the other flavors to see if he likes them better.

Dogs love this treat.  They are very easy to chew no matter how old the dog is.  This treat should come in a chicken strip size.  The treats are reasonably priced and I will continue to buy them as long as the price stays reasonable.

Dogs love it. It smells like chicken. I have bought the slamon and duck so far and my dogs enjoyed every one of them. I will be buying these treats forever, price is right and is currently the local retailer (online) to purchase it too. Nothing has compared to this without any complications.

I ordered this for my mom's Chihuahua as an ongoing present. I truly believe that dogs shouldn't be eating grains (corn is a grain too, folks!) - this is why our animals are getting obese just like their owners! This comes with organic chicken meat, no grains, and still fills that desire for the "convenience of modern convenience."
This is a great product with healthy ingredients for dogs.  No soy, wheat or glycerin that is known to cause problems for dogs.Easy to chew for senior dogs or dogs with problem teeth.

I have been trying to keep my dogs on products made in the USA (who would have thought that would be so hard).  Having three dogs it is hard to find someting they all like and I was a little apprehensive about these being "cookies" vs "jerky".  However, the treats are soft and chewy and all my dogs love them. I am happy because they are made in the USA and my dogs are happy so these are definitely a keeper.

My dogs love these treats. More importantly to me, I can feel good about feeding them these treats.  With all the questionable and even toxic ingredients going into many of our pet foods, it is nice to know that I can get a safe product for my dogs. Chicken and Beef meats have a lot of antibiotics and other undesirable stuff.  I always look for organic chicken and beef products. My dogs are are family - I want them to have healthy lives.
This item is made in the USA, uses free range organic chicken, no crazy fillers or by-products. My dogs go crazy over these. A must have for doggie bedtime ritual at our house. Great shipping!!!
Both my dogs love these healthy dog treats. I have been buying these for several years now. Wish they made a beef treat too!

column9: Great treats!! (and made in the USA!)
column10: I have two Jack Russell Terriers - properly spoiled and very picky.  I will not give them any food or treats not made in the United States and I also try to avoid giving them things containing grains.  The Plato Organic Chicken treats met my criteria for a healthy, safe USA-made treat and BOTH of my dogs LOVE them.  I would HIGHLY reccommend these!
These are hopefully better treats than the ones with artificial color added.. The dogs all do great tricks to get them...:)) And made in the USA is a BIG plus for me...
Dogs love them.  Even though they are kind of expensive, they don't have a bunch of fillers.

column9: My Dog Boo Loves This Treat
column10: I liked the price of the product and my dog Boo surley loves it! I think that the cost of the shipping and handling were way too high, quite a lot more than I paid for the product, which did not make it as good a value as I was hopping. According to the alert I recieved tellling me of the price!I would diffinetly order it again if the price and shipping cost were fair. As I said earlier my dog Boo really loves his chicken treats especially Jerky, but he was real keen on the Plato treats as well!

column9: Dodgs did not like these at all....
column10: A very strange treat.. dogs did not like any of the varieties we tried and I ordered three different varieties.Not a 'strip' but a baked 'cookie' that was really very hard and more of a chunk of something backed, not meat looking or smelling.Just really weird and I would never buy them again! save your money and buy the Chicken Jerky treats at WalGreens that are a bone fide strip of chicken and dogs love them! these are chunks of mystery material and not at all appetizing.

I buy a lot of generic, store brands.  The quality is usually just as good, or at least so close it's an easy decision with the price difference.  There are a few exceptions.  A-1 is a big one.  No generic steak sauce, or any steak sauce, compares.  My only quibble is the garlic level.  It makes it hard to combine A-1 with other steak accentuators with garlic in them or on meats other than beef.

I am a soda conniseur and I like to try new sodas all the time. This is a favorite, a delicious grapefruit soda from Mexico that is commonly sold in mexican groceries and bakeries in the U.S. It is my favorite flavor from the 10 or so different varieties from the Jarritos company. It tastes kind of like Squirt or other citrus sodas, but lighter with no afterbite. The sugar tastes more authentic and light as they use the more expensive cane sugar instead of the cheap frutose sweetener most soda companies use on us now. The carbonation is a bit lighter as well and not overpowering.Jarritos is now the best selling Mexican soft drink brand in the U.S. The single servings are still sold in glass bottles,  also available here at at Amazon. This offer is for a 2 liter plastic bottle. Try some!
Tastes just like the Squirt soda I used to drink when I was a child. Jarritos is a great brand of Soda!

column9: One bite and you too could be addicted.
column10: Lord help me Jesus this could be my undoing! I can't make a jar last more than 3 days. I like it cold, straight up, on a spoon, no bread. I make myself put it back on the shelf at the grocery store, I try to avoid that isle, I win the battle 2 maybe 3 times and then I relapse. I console myself by noting that it has less sugar and fat than regular peanut butter, no hydrogenated oils. And doesn't dark chocolate have antioxidants in it? Everybody does it once in a while, right?

column9: Video review for Dark Chocolate Dreams
column10: Length:: 2:01 MinsPeanut butter plus Nutella is the best way to describe this product.

I have to admit to thinking this was going to be better than I find it to be now that I've tried it. Yet I still give it 4 stars. What's the quibble? I actually wanted a bit more overt chocolate flavor. I expect dark choc to really stand up for itself and in this, it sort of resides behind the peanut butter flavor.My expectations aside, I'd gladly recommend this to anyone. The texture is excellent - silky really. The flavor profile is actually very good (note that I called my missing the choc flavor a *quibble,* not a criticism). The package says, "try with bananas" (or something like that) which I haven't done yet but I'm absolutely going to do so as I bet that would be an incredible combination. A sandwich of this with banana might just be my favorite over a traditional PB&J.If you're considering trying this PB blend, definitely do. I'm willing to bet you'll like it.

This was really good! It does taste like a Resse cup! Great for dipping pretzels and I could imagine using it as frosting on a chocolate cake! I love it has all natural ingrediants, but still has a long shelf life (about 2 years is my expiration date if stored in a cool dark place).This is a definite treat for myself as well as the kids and I will be purchasing additional flavors to try as well.

This stuff is great! And since Nutella is claiming to be such a "healthy" breakfast choice  I'll compare nutritional info between the two products.DCD (Dark Chocolate Dreams) first ingredient is PEANUTS, Nutella's first ingredient is SUGAR!DCD Total fat 13g, only 2.5 is saturated (remember that peanut is a healthy fat - the lower the saturated ratio the better). Nutella has 11g fat, but 3.5g of that is saturated fat.DCD has 6g of protein per serving, and Nutella only has 3g.DCD has 12g of carbohydrates per serving, and Nutella has 22g (carbs = FAT ON OUR BODIES!, these are the sugars at work)Now to talk about the taste differences.I've had Nutella and right away you can tell that it is actually BAD for you, like if you think spreading chocolate frosting on your toast in the morning is going to be healthy you are sorely mistaken.  A good use for Nutella? Spread it on top of cake to make it more nutritious, use it instead of frosting. Now there is a good idea.The DCD is still peanut butter, but it is CHOCOLATY peanut butter and it is amazing on toast and bread.  Good good stuff!For these reasons I will be using this product from now on instead of Nutella.

Like a Reese's Peanut Butter Cup.  No high fructose corn syrup--way less sticky sweet than Nutella.  Don't get me wrong, I love Nutella.  But I feel much better about my son eating this than almost any other sweet treat.FANTASTIC flavor.  A few tiny pieces of nuts or chocolate or something, but generally very smooth and creamy.I am going to order other flavors!

column9: takes peanut butter & 'nana sandwices to a whole new level
column10: Spread on Dave's Killer Bread with banana slices and mmmmm... heaven.  I can imagine that if one really wants to let out their inner Elvis, they'd be good fried; but you didn't hear that from me.

I heard of this chocolate pb through a friend who raved about it. So I decided to give it a go. I wasn't exactly crazy about it at first, and wasn't too sure what to make of it. This PB is a grower.  The more you eat it, the more delicious it is. It has a wonderful balance of chocolate and PB and the plus is it's all natural. No hydrogenated oils like most commercial PB brands. My husband can't get enough of it. Amazon has the best price around. It goes for almost $6 a jar in NYC. It's a must have for us now.

column9: Exceptionally delicious -- and nutritious, to boot!
column10: This is similar to Nutella in concept, but SO much better - more protein, more flavonoids (antioxidants from the cocoa) less sugar, more flavor. I've yet to share with someone who hasn't become a big fan. You must try it.

I'm not sure whether I appreciate the organic peanut butter or the vegan chocolate more, but it is a great combination.  After buying Dark Chocolate Dreams I'm starting to realize that almost anything that I use peanut butter for tastes better with chocolate too.  Great for dipping pretzels, or on a PB&J, or bananas, or just about anything I've tried so far!

Purchased Dark Chocolate Dreams after searching "dark chocolate" and reading the reviews for this peanut butter.  I dip my spoon in the jar and eat as is - best, most satisfying snack I could wish for.  I've never had it on bread, seems too odd, but might try it someday.

OH.MY.GOD. I AM OFFICIALLY ADDICTED! I just bought a jar of this heavenly yumminess and I am a peanut butter convert! (as in I've officially converted to peanut butter for life) could this be any yummier? this is seriously like dessert that i could shovel in my mouth forEVER! can i just say that i have eaten well over three servings of this stuff? BE WARNED scoop out a well-proportioned chunk of this stuff or you will not be able to fit into those jeans the next day. oh who am i kidding, i'd just eat 3 more of those servings. I also think I'm on a slight sugar rush. *swoon*
Great peanut butters!  I love the Chocolate and the Cinnimon Raisin Swirl and will be trying the White Chocolate soon.  I may have to share with my grandkids if they ever find the hiding place!

While this product is labeled as dark chocolate, the OU (Orthodox Union) has designated this product as Kosher, Parve, meaning there is no meat or dairy in this product.  Those looking for a chocolate taste will experience instead a cocoa taste, thus lacking the flavor of dairy.  It should have been labeled as Dark Cocoa Dreams but in any case it's delicious.

Spare yourself the heart ache of this product unless you have complete control over your will power. If your the kinda person that can eat just one potato chip then go for it. Two of my favorite things in one jar. Gave a neighbor a jar this morning and he already called to see where he can get some more. He's already got the monkey on his back.

column9: One jar, one family, one day.
column10: Yes, my family, despite not being as numerous as the Duggers nor as prone to indulgence as some, still managed to finish off a jar of this stuff within 24 hours.To think, I was worried about ordering 6 at once (the expiry was set 21 months in the future, though the individual jars are best before 6 months after they are opened).The taste is heavy on the (good quality and nutty) peanut flavor, with the dark chocolate playing a present-but-secondary role.Things heard around my house in the 24 hours since first taste(s):"Mmmmm, okay, I'll have a second spoonful!""I know I have a toothache and it's made worse with sugar, but I'll live with the pain later. GIVE ME THE JAR!""Mama, I remembered to use the potty. May I have some chocolatepeanutbutter pweeeeeeeeeease?!""Mmmm, okay, I'll stop after spoonful number 5 I promise...""Mama! IWANTMOREPEANUTBUTTER!" [followed by a single tear and a sorrowful "pweeeeeeease?"]"Hmm, I think I'll have a chocolate pb sandwich for lunch...""Do we have bananas anywhere? I need to try this with bananas and whipped cream!""OMG TRY THIS WITH BANANAS AND WHIPPED CREAM!!""So how long until Subscribe & Save sends us more? It's easy to make that sooner, right?"I'm going to be getting a few other kinds from this company and giving out 3-packs for birthdays/Christmas. This will also be ever-present in our house from this point forward, though we are going to need to learn moderation in the face of temptation like we've never known. Yum!
I bought this yesterday, and I tried it last night. It's delicious. More peanut buttery than Nutella. No Hazelnut. I will definitely continue to buy it.

This tastes great on just use for regular peanut butter...it is especially nice on celery...but if you want to taste heaven-on-earth then you must use this with Marshmallow Fluff on thick, soft white bread. I suggest you sit down before you taste the sandwich as it has been known to weaken the knees.
This is very very good. I normally eat organic peanut butter but this is an exception. A great chocolate taste that doesn't over power the peanut taste. I love this product

column9: Perfect product for a blind taste test
column10: I love chocolate and peanut butter and having them combined in one product is fabulous.  I think my taste expectations for the product came from seeing how dark and rich it looked and how it spread like chocolate frosting.  My eyes led my brain and taste buds to expect that chocolate would be the dominant flavor when it really is secondary as should be obvious from the list of ingredients.I really do like this peanut butter since it is a good nutritious vegan product even though I would have preferred a stronger chocolate taste. I'm glad it is available on subscribe and save :)

This PB is amazing. My friend kept telling me about it and my local store finally started selling it. And now I find out that Amazon sells it in packs of 6 for much cheaper than my store....oh boy......

this has to be tasted to be understood, i have heard about this before and thought well, it's just like a nutella.....WRONG!,where nutella is good , but has a candy quality about it, plus being quite oily, this a very high quality peanut butter with chocolate flavor,to enhance the peanut taste, not cover it.a very fine product, without a guilt factor (if u have self control)

I have hated peanut butter my whole life...and then, i discovered this stuff....it is nothing short of amazing!Schmeared on whole wheat toast with some banana...it is a healthy, filling meal...great in smoothies....or all by itself.And now that i found it on amazon, i am saving quite a bit vs purchasing at my local super store...yay!

No hydrogenated oils, no transfat - and tastes BETTER than regular peanut butter.  Stays smooth, the oil does not separate either.  And oh so chocolatey!  YUM!  My kids love this, and I don't feel at all guilty giving it to them.

This is the best tasting peanut butter ever created!  My picky 4-year-old niece calls it the "cookie" peanut-butter and eats it right up. It tastes similar to Nutella, but has 1/2 the sugar and more flavor.  I put it on waffles, eat in sandwiches and melt it over ice-cream. I am an addict!!I have been picking it up when it happens to go on sale at my local grocery store.  $6.00 a jar is a bit steep, so when I found this product on Amazon and saw it could be shipped in bulk I was thrilled! Paying closer to $3.50-$4.00/jar is much easier on the wallet.If you love chocolate and peanut butter, "Dark Chocolate Dreams" really is a dream!

I bought this never having tried it before and man I am glad I took the risk.  This is the best peanut butter I have ever had.  It is just the right amount of everything.  With a little chocolate task and peanut butter taste making it just right.  The texture is just the right amount of creamy.  If you are anything like me you will find yourself eating it right from the jar it's that good.

I love this stuff! Most of the time, I eat this straight out of the jar, (also good on chocolate graham crackers).  I am so pleased to be able to buy this for such a great price on Amazon.com.  At my local grocery store I pay 1.50-2.00 more per jar.  Will purchase again (and again, and again).

Vegan. Natural. Kosher. High quality. Rich, creamy, & smooth. Nice chocolate flavor note. Great for adding a choco-peanut butter layer to anything. Love it on crackers or as a yummy topping on otherwise more "dry" peanut butter cookies. Also great for baking, for homemade peanut butter cookies or for a chocolate peanut butter variation of any layered bars. 170 calories per 2 Tbsp [32g]. Highly caloric, like all nuts and nut butters. Consume in moderation, as an occasional extra bonus treat. Great energy for kids. Made with peanuts, evaporated cane juice, cocoa, cocoa butter [from cocoa beans], palm fruit oil, vanilla, lecithin (from sunflowers), & salt. This is the most amazing thing I've ever tasted. I'm a total peanut butter fanatic but this takes things to a whole new level. It's kind of like the peanut butter version of Nutella but with way less sugar and more of a nutty taste. I seriously can't get enough of this stuff. I've been eating it on toasted whole wheat pita bread with cut up bananas on top...it's also really good mixed into oatmeal or (lets be real) straight out of the jar. Bought this for $5.25 at a local supermarket but it's WAYYY cheaper here on Amazon, especially with prime.

Very delicious (scrumptious). I also used "White Chocolate Peanut Butter" or "Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter" from "Peanut Butter & Co." ([...]) with the "Milka White Chocolate Bars". They both went well together as well as separately.

I enjoy the occasional use of peanut butter (especially between chocolate)... But I picked up a jar of this peanut butter at target and in less than a week I have eaten almost the entire jar! The chocolate and peanut butter work together to give you a satisfying taste without either flavor overpowering.

column9: soooo goooood. great with ice cream!
column10: tasty by itself, but not much more sugar than regular peanut butter. this stuff is delicious, especially for those who love the salty sweetness of chocolate n peanut butter. ive used this as if it were a sort of fudge for ice cream. heat up one serving for about 30 seconds in the microwave, and then throw the ice cream in and enjoy. very yummy.
This is pretty much my favorite food. It's all natural, vegan, no-stir, and a super-delicious combo of pb & c.
My kids love this!  I'm not a huge PB fan, but I think it's pretty great, too.  We make "monkey" sandwiches using this with a banana on a whole wheat hot dog bun.

We bought a 6 pack variety of peanut butter from this company at the NYC chocolate show. The Dark Chocolate Dreams is by far my favorite. We tried all kinds of peanut butter from this company and so far their flavors, texture and recipes are to die for.It is great by itself, on bread or in a variety of reciples.It has become a new staple in our house.

I am in awe of this peanut butter. It is seriously delicious. And I could seriously sit down with a spoon and consume an entire jar of the stuff. In fact, all products from PB&Co I have enjoyed immensely. They simply know their way to a pb-lover's heart with all these amazing flavors. My advice: go out and buy this peanut butter right now! I take pleasure in using it as a dip for apples and bananas, spread on a whole wheat tortilla with strawberries, or eaten straight. You'll never look at peanut butter the same.

column9: One of the most delicious things ever
column10: This is seriously one of the most delicious things I've ever eaten.  I don't really know what the other reviewers are talking about when they say it doesn't taste like chocolate--maybe it's just because I eat some type of peanut butter at every single meal or something but you can very obviously tell that this is not normal peanut butter and is definitely very chocolate-y and dessert-y.  It tastes really good plain and with fruit; the concept of eating it on bread like a sandwich seems a little strange but whatever to each their own.If you are taking the time to read the comments, you should definitely buy this.  It's amazing.

column9: WOO HOO!!!!!! THIS ONE'S A KEEPER!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
column10: Listen people, you've got to try this one! Try it with marshmallow creme! Try it with bananas or apples! Or, you can just eat it out of the jar! YUM!!!!!!!!!

I got this for my family and the people who enjoy a peanut butter sandwich enjoy a dark chocolate peanut butter sandwich even more.  It has more sugar than my regular peanut butter but I think it has a perfect sweetness... would recommend.(From label)Ingredients:  PEANUTS, EVORPORATED CANE JUICE, COCOA, COCOA BUTTER, PARM FRUIT OIL, VANILLA, LECITHIN (FROM SUNFLOWERS), SALT,SERVINGS SIZE: 2TBSCOLORIES 170FAT:  13gSODIUM:  35mgSUGAR:  7g

I have this chocolate peanut butter on auto-ship in order to receive the price break. This is my little guilty pleasure product which I keep on hand. To my taste buds, this product is more flavorable, darker, and smoother than the better-known, highly advertised chocolate hazelnut product. Give it a try, you will not be disappointed....

column9: I WISH I HAD NEVER FOUND THIS STUFF!!!
column10: THIS IS CRACK IN A JAR!  THIS STUFF IS WONDERFUL.  IT'S SWEET, A LITTLE SALTY AND VELVETY SMOOTH.  THIS STUFF NEVER MAKES ON IT ON BREAD BECAUSE IT IS BEST BY ITSELF WITH A SPOON!  THIS IS A MUST TRY!!

I love this peanut butter. It lets me indulge without actually eating anything worse than normal peanut butter. Since I'm a calorie counter, I need things that taste like an indulgence but are actually nutritious enough to keep me from eating a leg and this is my favorite indulgence. I eat it on bread, fruit, pretzels, (broil marshmallows on bread and put this on the other side for an indoor smores!), and use it to make my own "granola" bars that are healthier and yummier than store bought!

This Dark Chocolate Dreams peanut butter is amazingly good.  Initially, I was anticipating it to taste like Reeses'-in-a-jar, and I was disappointed that it wasn't.Then I tried it again, on a spoon, and it knocked me over.  It is not as salty as Reeses', and actually tastes more natural.  The texture is sensuously smooth, and the taste is sublime.

Based on reviews, I decided to try Dark Chocolate Dreams, mainly because I love dark chocolate.  Generally, I eat regular peanut butter a few times a month, certainly not every week.  However, I eat this almost every day, usually on toast in the morning, but it's great for a snack also.  I signed up for the regular shipments which give a price break.  If you like dark chocolate, I definitely recommend this!

This is the most addicting food substance known to man.  We ordered it on subscribe and save and it is about half the price of local grocery stores.  And with Amazon's amazing shipping, we received it 5 days before the estimated shipping date.  Delicious, good value, and fast!  What more could you want?

Dang it, I bought the six pack.  For just me.  It's so much cheaper here than at the grocery store that I thought, (shrug) better go for it since I pick up a jar every time I'm at Sunflower anyway.  Silky, high quality peanut butter with a rich chocolate undertone, this thing is the best treat I've had in years.  As others have said, don't buy it expecting dessert or candy or frosting as it is, in fact, a jar of peanut butter.  But WHAT a peanut butter!  I keep it in the fridge to make it nice and thick, then just eat it straight with a spoon.  I haven't been able to bring myself to clutter it up with toast or banana or anything else, it is too incredible in its pure form.  I have tried one other gourmet brand of chocolate peanut butter and thought it was good, but it just didn't live up to Dark Chocolate Dreams.  I will never stray again.

This peanut butter tastes like a Reese's Peanut Butter cup...it's absolutely to die for!  I like that it only has 12 carbs (minus 2 grams of fiber), so it's perfect for my lower carb life.  I will definitely be ordering this 6 pack again.  I plan on using it for my no bake oat cookies too!
Fantastic combination of dark chocolate and peanut butter. Excellent right out of the jar, as well as on ice cream or other uses for regular peanut butter.  My favorite PB

this product lived up to my expectations.  the shipment was fast, but the product is amazing.  we have finished 2 jars already- working on 3rd.  have told alot of friends and family about product!!!will reorder soon!
I am one of those people who believe there is no better pairing in the world than chocolate and peanut butter.  So for me, this is heaven in a jar.  Absolutely delicious!!!
If you like chocolate and peanut butter then you must try this, absolutely the best! Keeps my chocolate cravings satisfied with protein instead of a not so healthy candy bar.
this is the best peanut butter I've ever eaten..I save it for dessert.  I know that I"ll try very hard not ever to run out..recommend it to every peanut butter lover there is!

We've been putting this dark chocolate peanut butter on whole grain waffles for years. We fill the crannies with crushed flax seed before smearing on the peanut butter and everyone loves them, including the kids. They taste delicious and they're a healthy start to our day!

Writing Amazon reviews are far and few between for me, but I got so excited that I can order this peanut butter online, shipped right to my door, and free with PRIME nonetheless!  I eat this with sandwich rounds for breakfast and sometimes again for lunch with slices of bananas.  Oh so good.  Only downside, if any, is that my dog can not lick the spreading knife when I'm done making the sandwich.
This chocolate peanut butter tastes great and is useful in many ways.  I use it to frost cupcakes and cookies in addition to eating it plain.

This stuff is absolutely amazing. I love it so much! It is really addictive. I have been putting it in sandwiches with whole wheat bread, banana and agave... delicious! Within one day my boyfriend and I have already eaten half a jar. Seriously, everyone needs to buy this. You won't be sorry. It's my new favorite food!
Very good stuff. I've had the dark chocolate and the cinn. and raisin flavors. It's also sold at Target locally.
I was used to P.B.Loco dark chocolate peanut butter and really loved that..This is almost as good.

I had to try this product just in case it was heaven in a jar. I mean...I LOVE chocolate!  Plus I eat PB all the time.  However....this just taste kind of weird to me.  It's a mouth of strange with every bite. Maybe I was expecting to much. I like plain old PB better.  Maybe this would be good in PB cookies or something. So, it is edible.  I'm not going to throw it out but it's going to take a while to use this up. I guess I can use this as an emergency food item that maybe I can resist eating until an actual emergency.

When my friends recommended me to try some peanut butter & chocolate, I didn't know it would be this tasty. I ordered a pack (6 bottles), I thought I could eat for a long time. However, I find I really love them and in one week only, I eat the whole bottle. I always eat them with bread. Hope you like them. The only disadvantage of this product is that I don't think it is healthy because, you know, butter, chocolate...those kind of things.

column9: Good and healthy but not my idea of dessert.
column10: As several other reviewers have mentioned, the "chocolate" aspect of this peanut butter is seriously more mild than expected. I couldn't even taste the cocoa at all until I had a scoop of this stuff immediately after a scoop of regular peanut butter. I was hoping for a sort of Reeses Peanut Butter Cup flavor, but I was disappointed in that regard. However, this is the PERFECT peanut butter for those who perhaps don't like the overtly nutty taste of regular ones. Just don't go buying a case of this stuff expecting it to taste like frosting. Nutella is much more of a treat in my opinion.

I have had both Nutella and this and would give both 3 stars.  Nutella because it's too sweet and this because it isn't sweet enough.  I just don't get the full chocolate flavor.  Maybe if I mixed them together.  I prefer the White chocolate PB from this company.

column9: I found it cheaper at the local grocery store
column10: I was going to have this delivered, but I saw it at the grocery store cheaper and then I saw a recall for so many peanut butters, I decided I would just get it after the recalls. I am not saying this brand was recalled, only cheaper at the local stores

I love peanut butter. I love chocolate. This stuff is absolutely amazing. I am on a diet so I am always looking for variety to a dull boring calorie count. One apple, sliced and 2 tbsp of this chocolately pb is only 215 calories! It's very filling and lots of protein! I can easily make a lunch of this every day. It's much more expensive in my grocery stores and what a deal for 6 jars. This stuff is so addictive and so good!!

This is my absolute favorite PB.  I love PB & Chocolate, but as a dietitian, am always looking for healthier ways of eating it.  I love this spread on buttermilk multi-grain pancakes & topped with fresh strawberries or spread a tablespoon on a Van's multi-grain waffle for a wonderful snack.  I hope they never stop making it!
My brother gave me a jar of this and I loved it so much that I ordered some for myself. I love it.
Love it.  Tastes like a peanut butter cup in a jar!!!!!  I hide it from my son so he won't eat it all.
This is the reason being human is great... wonderful product. I had my doubts before ordering, but not after tasting... and tasting... and tasting.

column9: I dare anyone who loves PB and DC to not sign up for monthly deliveries!
column10: I first bought this on sale (3 bucks) at the local market (it's now 5 bucks). It was like crack in a jar! I ended up proclaiming to the rest of my family that this Dark Chocolate Dream was off limits to EVERYONE including my 6 and 3 year olds. I stashed the jar so far out of reach that I couldn't find it. Buy it once, be prepared to buy it for life! (now thanks to Amazon, my addiction will not cost me 5 buck anymore, thank you Amazon...and the Peanut Butter & Co!)
It is way to good. I love to throw some bagels in the toaster in the morning, plain bagels, and smear this on them and go.I know...not the best breakfast, but so yummy!
Absolutely love this peanut butter! Can't get much better than peanut butter and chocolate together. I will definitely be buying it again!

column9: Dessert disguised as a jar of peanut butter
column10: I expected very little when a friend gave me a jar of Dark Chocolate Dreams as a gift.  I have tried other peanut butter concoctions and have found all to be, well, miserable.  I first tried my DCD on a slice of toasted pound cake.  I called my husband over.  He loved it, too.  We quickly hid the jar, so the kids wouldn't find it.  The next night, we put some on vanilla wafers and, oh wow.  After hiding the jar again, I went to my computer and found DCD on Amazon.  I ordered a case to give out as Christmas gifts.  I've yet to find someone who doesn't just love it.  I can't wait to try the other flavors!

Absolutely decadent!  It tastes like ... well, chocolate and peanut butter.  How can you go wrong with that combination?!  Makes a mean chocolate PB & banana sandwich ... especially if you add a little apricot preserves ... Mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm ;)

I tried it by itself and thought it wasn't as sweet as I would like, but with jelly, it is perfect!! It is pretty chocolatey but not overpowering. It doesn't have any more calories than ordinary peanut butter either, so how can you not love it?

I ordered this 6 pack to make gift baskets for co-workers and have 1 for myself. DISAPPOINTING. I opened my jar to try it before gifting it..RANCID RANCID..Now I have 5 jars that I am afraid to gift and surely cannot eat/AND is ineligble for return. Cannot even feed to the squirrels because of the chocolate What a waste.Will not order again from this company.

column9: I Don't Eat Anything Else But This!
column10: I am so glad that I have found and tasted this product in the grocery store. The mixture of dark chocolate and peanut butter is amazing for me. It's just a perfect blend! It's rich and delicious! Sometimes I can't take my hands away from this thing. Anyway, the product can be an equivalent replacement for Nutella. This has more of a peanut butter taste with a taste of dark chocolate, while Nutella is more of a chocolate spread. I feel that this is more nutritious compared to Nutella since it's an actual peanut butter spread. I have this item on continuous order every two months. I can't get enough of it.

Not what I expected.  Not bad, just not as good as I thought it would be.  Sweetness is a personal thing, I found the product a little shy in that area.  Which is funny really, because I usually find foods too sweet for my taste.

Let me just say, this peanut butter is amazing.  It has an awesome peanut butter flavor that, instead of being overpowered by chocolate, is complimented by chocolate.  The texture was somewhat of a surprise for me.  There were tiny (like grains of sand) chunks of peanut in it, which isn't really a bad thing but not what I expected.  It's very easy to spread.  I eat it on fruit for a filling breakfast, but it's delicious enough to eat plain.  In fact, you will probably have to restrain yourself from eating it plain if you want it to last more than a day.  My mouth is watering just from typing the words "eating it plain."  No joke.The reason I only gave it 4 stars is because of the evaporated cane juice.  They say they do not use sugar, but cane juice is just a fancy word for less-unhealthy sugar.  White sugar loses its color and nutrients during the refinement process, whereas evaporated cane juice does not.

column9: Meh, I think I like Justin's better
column10: I wanted something like Reese's peanut butter cups, but this has neither enough chocolatey flavor nor peanut buttery.  It needs to be both saltier and sweeter.  It's just like a sort of bland peanut butter w/some unsugared cocoa powder thrown in.  The cocoa powder makes it drier and less oiler, which definite decreases the mouth-feel pleasure for me.  Seems like diet peanut butter w/choco added to make people feel less deprived.  I won't throw it out, but I went back and got Justin's Chocolate Hazelnut Butter instead. I know it's like oranges and tangerines - not exactly the same, but I still think Justin's has a better concept for the heft and creaminess needed as well as a better level of salt. The search continues...

column9: It is basically thick chocolate frosting
column10: What I am saying is that if I gave you a spoon of this stuff and said "Friend, taste my homemade chocolate frosting," you would say "Oh my, that is a tasty chocolate frosting, but it's a bit thick."They say "no sugar added!" with pride, but note "evaporated cane juice" is the second most prominent ingredient.  It's just thick frosting.

My first taste sent my mind back to that moment where you try a Reese's cup for the first time in a couple years, remembering it as delicious from childhood (or maybe the commercials), and instead think it has a kinda stale taste, chocolate and peanut butter somehow managing to drown each other out into a grainy mush.As I ate more, the cocoa flavor took over, but more as a sharp edge than a "rich" flavor.That said, I bet it *does* go great with bananas, and I mainly got what I was looking for: a compact, high-calorie sweet fix that stores well (got in February 2011; use by date Nov. 2012--well over a year).The texture is light, almost mousse-like, and definitely easily spreadable. I'm thinking pancakes.I'm unsure whether I want to get used to the taste, though: it's got enough chocolate to induce cravings.So, if "spreadable peanut butter cup" sounds good to you, go for it. If you're more used to "real" food, think twice about the perfect reviews.

This is good peanut butter. Healthy (from the label: no high fructose corn syrup, etc.) and reasonably priced. I must have been spoiled by Nutella! I wasn't expecting it to be Nutella, But I just couldn't taste the chocolate. Probably I could tell the difference in a blind taste test with plain peanut butter. I wonder how my Nutella-crazed grandaughter will like this? Anyway it is good, and reasonably priced for healthy vegan food. I had just hoped for more of a chocolate flavor.Update: Child can't taste the chocolate either, despite the chocolatey appearance. She won't touch this. (spoiled, I know, but that IS my job :)

column9: Warning - Amazon put bad information about the sugar!!
column10: This product is 21% sugar!!!!  I told Amazon a long time ago and they have done nothing about it.

column9: I ask you, what is the point?
column10: Seriously.  My wife nabbed this at the store the other day because our girls are in love with Nutella and she thought this might be a nice change of pace for them.  The idea of chocolate peanut butter is not a new one.  Just open your eyes and look at the cookie aisle in any grocery store.  They are lined wall to wall with chocolate peanut butter flavored cookies.  It's like the most popular flavor on the market.  I, honestly, am not always a fan and wish that there was more variety out there, but whatever.  The masses have spoken and `chocolate and peanut butter' are a `thing' that just won't go away anytime soon.  This product though, doesn't utilize that flavor very well.  In fact, all we are left with is peanut butter that is the consistency of melted chocolate.  I don't taste the chocolate at all.  Instead it's like really sticky peanut butter.  I guess the only real taste difference is that it is a cloyingly sweet variation of your standard peanut butter.  I don't like this.  My kids liked it, sure.  It is basically dessert, and if you like peanut butter you won't be offended by this, but I don't see a point to this product at all.

column9: best of the bracing English teas
column10: There are two classes of English tea drinkers, I am told: those who love English Breakfast and those who love Earl Grey.  Usually, one does not care for the other tea.  This tea is one of the best for the English Breakfast lover.  It is strong, bracing, full of character, and (caution) caffeine.  It loses nothing of its pleasing depth with the addition of milk.  I add honey, also.  American English Breakfast teas pale in comparison.

column9: Okay for some but will not support a standing spoon...
column10: I am not very good at using fancy words like "caramel" or "fragrant" but I'll use my commoner voice to write a review.  I grew up drinking english style tea with milk.  I have a penchant for strong breakfast tea with my ham and eggs.  It has always been difficult (although not impossible) to buy good english tea here in Texas. For a while I was able to find Taylors "Gold" in 8oz sizes but then it was discontinued.  SO I was excited when Amazon started carrying groceries and offering a wide selection of teas.Based on another review,  I ordered this Harrogate Tea Room blend thinking it would have that same bite to it as I was hoping to savor. I also ordered a case of good 'ol Typhoo Tea and the Taylor Harrogate English Breakfast tea, which has that strong - I guess that is the caramel or maybe "woody" aroma to it, similar to Taylors Gold. Whatever, it tasted like that first cuppa I drank when I was 7.  But the Tea Room blend struck me as rather bland and non-eventful.  And so it has sat there getting out of date while I savor through my supply of Typhoo and Breakfast blend.  I think if you want a black tea that is, shall I say, "neutral" and plain,  go for the Tea Room blend.  I suppose if you must cater to all comers, that is the safe route.I had to resort in the past to buying tea from Indian grocery stores which offer a wide variety of cheap teas that always have a musty aftertaste.  I guess that this type of brew is better served what I call "middle eastern" style - served without milk and heavily diluted with just a bit of the brew at the bottom of a cup (or glass) and then alot of hot water added upon serving.  This renders a very watery blend which I consider lousy at cutting through my heavy english breakfast.  I need something stout and tannic to cut through all that protein (and fat).So I'm rating this tea room blend 3 stars based upon expectations for ordering something I think offers nothing more than plain old Lipton.I must also add that I only drink loose tea.  Having always drank it this way,  tea bags to me just taste funny and are like what a frozen TV salisbury stake dinner is to grilled steak lovers.Anyway, I've recently ordered a bag of the Taylors Scottish blend, which I read as being stronger yet.  And I'm reading reviews that claim the Irish blend to be strong enough to stand a spoon up in the cup.  I can't wait.

My wife and I love this tea, and have been drinking it for years. We are disappointed that we are unable to locate the tea in supermarkets, but are happy to have found it with Amazon. The tea is a nicely balanced full-flavored tea, which we drink in the morning, adding honey and milk. We recommend it.

Imagine that you are sitting  in a delightful British  tea- room , after a  busy afternoon .  The waitress arrives at your table with a tray , laden  with scones , sandwiches and cakes. In the middle of the tray is a steaming pot of hot tea .  Taylors of  Harrogate Tea Room  Blend  is exactly what would be served . Robust , hearty and full of flavor ,  this is just the  right  pick -me-up for the middle of the day .  I highly recommend it.

column9: Tea Drinker from 'birth' one might say!
column10: It has been a long and thirsty search for a good cuppa now I am no longer in the UK and until I found this I was getting very disappointed very quickly at how bad most of the tea available is.  Once I had decided to order this there was no going back, and damn the expense.  My philosophy being that as I hardly ever 'treated' myself it was about time I had something I really wanted...hence the subscription order for a constant supply on a regular basis, I was in heaven.  I was that is until it stopped!  My substitute is Yorkshire Gold, but it lacks the full-bodied taste I had grown fond of with the blend. YG is infact a better quality tea but none-the-less I still prefer the blended tea best.  Please, please please oh please bring the 1kilo bag of loose Tea Room Blend back to these shores, I really wouldn't mind a few bucks hike in price if it has to be so, but bring it back soon...

column9: Simply the best of the British blends
column10: This tea is sometimes known as Betty's Tearoom Blend. Betty's  is a wonderful tearoom in Harrogate, Yorkshire.It's great to know that we no longer need to smuggle several kilos home with us.Be aware that this tea is a very fine blend and it takes a little practice to brew it properly. One reviewer commented on the tiny piecesin the bag. It was supposed to be that way.
Complete bag of very small tea leaf pieces that normally fall to the bottom of the larger leaf pieces and end up in the bottom of a container of tea.

Wow!  My dog has jaws of steel and can crack deer antlers, so I decided to go with this antler (and my dog is the size of a border collie).  I got the Amazon Prime delivery to my work... I work in an elementary school.  This antler is so big and heavy that I couldn't help laughing a little when I unwrapped it and showed it to my students.  They suggested perhaps I use it to smack them when they are naughty (I wouldn't...this was their suggestion).Anyway, it's about a foot long, an inch and a half in diameter, and must weigh about a pound and a half.The only thing one might worry about is that the thing feels like a piece of concrete.  A dog with a strong chew might break a tooth on it if he bit down the wrong way.My dog really chews on this, although he tends to lose interest in it unless I occasionally slap some peanut butter on the cut ends.  He'll chew on it when he gets bored, too, but he's mostly a chewer who likes to chew for a purpose, and he can't do too much damage to this.  Fortunately, he knows to not bite too hard, so no tooth damage has occurred.Keep an eye on your dog when he chews it, and avoid giving it to dogs who bite down too hard on things, especially if they have a history of chipping teeth.  Great for dogs with strong jaws.Oh, and don't throw this thing.

I have tried antlers from different companies; my dog loves them all.This last order from Chasing our Tails had one as big around as my wrist. She typically  carries them with her just about everywhere when she's working on one, so keep that in mind. This very large antler lasted about one week; she lliterally  ate it. She is a larger than average English Bulldog, and a very strong chewer, but  it was down to 1 1/2" in days and had to be taken away. This one also smelled  really bad there at the end. It was leaving red ooze from the marrow- it was just unpleasant. I'm sure that's why this larger one lasted less than the typical 2 weeks; it was fresh and smelled strong.I'm going to use them again, but just a warning to keep an eye out- some of these are softer than others and get small fairly quickly.

column4: Eric R. Hale "Just a regular guy"
column10: This is awesome bone.  We have a 60 lb chocolate lab and she went nuts over this thing when we gave it to her.  It is her favorite chew toy.It's very durable and looks like it will last for years.Since it is a natural product, it has "wild" scent to it that dogs are attracted to by instinct.  We play hide and seek with it.  She always sniffs it out.(Don't worry, it doesn't "stink" like cow hooves or pigs ears.  But, your dog will love it just as much.  It's just a subtle smell and it does fade after a week or so.)I probably could have gotten the smaller version.  But, this one is fine for our pooch.It is pricy, but I expect that this will out live my dog.

column9: Survives the Chocolate Labrador Jaws of Life!!
column10: I was giving my 60lb dog these huge 12" rawhides but she would chew them up in a matter of a few hours. I also read that rawhides were dangerous as a big dog can bite off big chunks which can get lodged in their throats or stomachs. The other downside to rawhides are they get smelly, slimey and can stain carpets. The antler will not allow any of this. This extra large elk antler has survived her constant chewing for 3 months now and still looks almost as good as new. I will have to say at 1st she was a little wary of it, I do believe it is because it has a natural smell (Undetectable to my wife and I) but our dog was cautious when we 1st gave it her. Be aware this thing is heavy, it showed up and must weigh at least 1.5LBs! It is the best investment for a dog chew toy yet.

column9: "Jacob" the exuberant rescued Weimaraner says: "Sometimes size  does matter..."
column10: Length:: 0:31 MinsOur rescued Weimaraner ("Jacob") is 21-months old, and during daylight hours he is all fast-twitch muscle and is a dog in motion nearly all the time. He's enjoyed the smaller ("large")version  of this product in the past, and we get about two months of interest in it. The periods of time he's engaged with it are times when he is not being sneaky, stubborn or hyperactive.This XL size version got his attention even more. Out of the package, he was engaged in chewing it non-stop for more than 20 minutes. We expect this one to see us through from summer solstice to the autumnal equinox.When he chews this, he's not counter-surfing, cat-chasing or trash-stealing!Great choice for active dogs.

it appears expensive, but for $24, it's the biggest antler in terms of both girth and length than anything i could ever find at a pet foods or specialty store. well worth it to keep my big chewer occupied and happy! plus it doesn't smell bad like some of the other antlers, and this one is cut just enough to give them a little hint of the "marrow" but not cut so much that it gets destroyed too quickly.

I've gotten my boxer/pit antlers before, but they were always undersized. I tried this company and figured the 10-12 inch antler would be on the thin side. WOW was I wrong. This thing is a MAMMOTH and my dog absolutely loves it. He's a strong chewer and goes through rawhides like they're nothing, but hates nylabones. He works on it for 10-15 minutes, walks away, then comes back to it. He's definitely enjoying it. Thanks!

Like most dog owners we had not found a dog chew that would last for any length of time (that was not made of a synthetic polymer). We want to give our dogs something natural to chew on so that they were not constantly digesting plastic but we could not find anything in the market that would last.One weekend were up at a family mountain cabin when one of our dogs brought back a deer antler and was going nuts chewing on it. He chewed it the entire time we were up there and the antler barely lost any shape! So as soon as we got home we started doing some research and came across these elk antlers. We bought one to try them out and quickly learned what a mistake that was. Our dogs (one Aussie & two Shiba Inus) were constantly trying to take it away from on another. We quickly ordered two more and now the pack is happy!These antlers are fantastic.#1 our dogs love them#2 they are a natural chew#3 they last (we have had our for 3 months and even after heavy use they are still in great shape)They may seem expensive to some customers, however the fact that they are natural and last as long as they do makes them a great value.

column9: Fantastic Natural And Healthy Dog Chew !
column10: I had reservations about giving our dogs Elk horn - something about it just rubbed me the wrong way.We have two Old English Bulldogs our six year old Harley and his partner in crime, a seven month puppy named Elvis. Both are extreme, hardcore, aggressive chewers - these guys go through Kong's and Nylabones like a beaver buzzing through a 2 x 4.A dog lover my entire life - I was researching dog food long before there was an Internet. My better half and I of 25 years share a passion for our dogs that's hard to describe. They are in every way family and we indulge them to the same extent we watch out for them.Having been making my own dog food for 35 plus years, I've learned that research should never stop because there's always more to learn about keeping your dogs healthy and happy.
