According to one study by the Canadian Veterinary Journal elk horn is a healthy and wonderful addition to any dogs well being.Elk Horn offers a powerhouse of benefits:* Fights Arthritis* Replaces Joint Fluid* Effective in reliving pain from joint disorders and arthritis*  Natural preventative an treatment for osteoporosis* Easily digestible source of calcium and trace minerals* Cruelty Free - Elks naturally shed their antlersThe list goes on - but that's a brief summary of the advantages. I ordered two of these and at first both Harley and Elvis took a while to play with them, lots of sniffing and walking away and then back to the horn for more sniffing and the occasional slurp. Then BAM! they couldn't get enough of these gigantic dinosaur bone sized chew toys.They spent hours chewing and gnawing away. Unlike deer antlers which dogs can crack their teeth on, this is much less likely with elk horn. Even when we tossed the both of  them on the bed to call it a night they each had their prized new elk horn in their mouths.Where they continued to chew and gnaw until they passed out.These things are huge! over 10" long and very heavy, the last thing you'll want to have happen is drop one on your foot.These make amazing toys for your dog - and considering how long they last they're an excellent value to boot.

column9: one of the best pet investments
column10: I have two English Mastiffs that can chew through anything. When the put their minds to it, they can knaw through Nylabones with no problem. My male is very energetic and only ever wants to play fetch. The first day I gave these to them they chewed on them for over four hours! Nothing ever entertains my male for that long. Both chew on these daily. They are heavy and durable- definitely worth the money. I even purchased the smaller sized ones for my parents lab puppies. The labs chewed for hours as well. They are a big hit! I would definitely purchase them again.
Our dog loves these antlers.  It keeps her busy for a long time and they also last for a while.

I bought this for my lab about a week ago and he LOVES it! I had bought a few of the smaller ones at my local pet supply store but he was able to chew thru those pretty quickly. This is a great size, it's about a foot long and really heavy (don't let them drop one of these on your foot, it hurts!). he's been chewing on this for a week and has barely been able to make a dent it. Happy to spend the money on this since it lasts and he looooves his chew toys. I've been buying Nylabones for him, which he also loves, but I like that these are natural and offers him vitamins and minerals at the same time. Definitely worth the money and I see this lasting for a few months before it needs to be replaced.

We have 2 German Shepherds that need very durable toys/chews.  We bought the large size elk antler a couple months ago.  They loved them and chewed on them every day.  We recently took the antlers away because they had gotten smaller.We ordered these XL antlers for Christmas.  They are pricey, but not bad when you consider how much enjoyment they get from them and how long the antlers last.  The XL antlers are huge, not only in length, but also in diameter and weight!

The product arrived quickly and it is exactly how it is pictured in the item description.  This is the perfect size for a large dog.  Our 80 pound german shepard loves it, great size and shape for an aggressive chewer.  The price is reasonable as well.  Very pleased with this product!!

Picked up an original when vacationing in Maine and it was much smaller for $20 and our "grand-doggy" loved it!  I decided to picked her up a second one because she is an extreme chewer and thought this one would last much longer for her. The one we ordered arrived as described at 10 inches long with nice width as well. VERY HEAVY so watch your toes!!! Great value for the money! Thank you!

I have a 107 pound German shepherd and he loves these things! I love them because no smell, no mess and no gastric upset!! Excellent chew toy! Lasts a long time ... much longer than any other chew toy! And when the package arrives he is so excited because he knows it his "after dinner cigars"!

My dogs LOVE these. I had bought a smaller one in January and decided to go with a bigger size this time. I figured the smaller one is still going after 6 months so the bigger one should last years. My dogs chew on this everyday and barely make a dent. It keeps them occupied for hours and is definitely worth the money!!!

After reading the reviews, I purchased this elk antler for a 100 lb golden retriever.  She is quite the expert chewer!  I FINALLY found something that 1)she couldn't chew in 30 seconds 2) kept her interest 3)didn't stink like bones from the butcher and 4)is safe. I was also very suprised by the massive size of the antler I received.  It's the diameter of my wrist and the length of my forearm!  I cannot recommend this product highly enough!!

column9: Nice antler, my dogs aren't interested
column10: As others have noted, this thing is huge.  If your dog likes it, it could be a good investment, because it's clearly indestructible and could last forever.  It has great ridges and shapes, things dogs usually like to chew on.  So why three stars?  My dogs don't chew it.  I have three dogs and one foster dog, of different sizes and breeds, so I'm surprised that not one of them likes it.  Especially since they loved deer antlers, which I stopped giving them because I had problems with splintering.  One dog - who will chew anything - nibbled on the edges a few times to get at the "marrow," but gave that up when it was clear that there was only so much marrow you could get.This seems like a good product IF your dog likes it, but in my house, four dogs say "meh." $30 down the drain.
I ordered this for our dog hoping I'd found a long lasting chew. Unfortunately, he has shown very little interest in it.
May have been pricey but the wolfhound LOVES this thing.  I'd definitely get it again. It holds up well to heavy chewing.

Our 1 year old boxer/pit-bull "pup" loves his antler! He is 70 lbs, and has a big old head with an alligator-like mouth.  Despite the fact he gets a lot of daily exercise, he still has plenty of energy and loves to chew in his spare time.  I ordered him the 10" size, which is perfect.  There is no odor, does not leave any mess, and has provided him hours of chewing fun already.  He prances around with it in his mouth, and prefers it to his other chew toys.  Would recommend this item to anyone with a dog who has big, strong chompers and loves to chew.  He has a synthetic nylabone which is said to be okay for dogs to ingest, but I am still leery about the shards that break off due to his gnawing, and also the rough edges that are created.  This antler is dense does not seem to splinter into pieces, and as it is all natural, I do not have any worries about him eating any pieces that my break off due to chewing. I plan to order another one for him, as well as a smaller one for his boxer cousin.
This bone is expensive, but my dog really really likes it...nice horn for a golden retriever.  I would buy more if they were cheaper.

I ordered the antler with the hopes it would be large enough..after reading about other antlers that were  really smaller than promised from other vendors. This antler was so big about 11 inches long and 6 inches around.This really is for a large dog. My 67lb. puppy has not put it down, nor made a dent in it. I saved all the info so I can order more. Well worth the price and the vendor is really reliable. Do your self a favor if you have a big chewer on your hands. No odor no mess all natural. Quick shipment. I can actually leave the room and do something else and come back and my dog is still holding the antler and gnawing away.
My dog is crazy for this elk chew.  Very sturdy and substantial; should last a long time with no splintering.

I bought the chef master food colorings because I am in charge of making hard tack candy at our church as a Christmas fund raiser.  I like this coloring because I can get a variety of colors and the colors are true.  McCormicks has a very limited selection of colors and we have to mix colors which aren't very accurate when we make more batches of the same color.  The generic food color avaible in the stores are never accurate and the colors arent clear.  I am thankful I fould the Chefmaster food colors.

column9: Best Peanut Butter EVER.  Natural, no hydrog. oils, taste like WC REESE cup!
column10: Best Peanut Butter EVER.  Natural, no hydrog. oils, taste like WC REESE cup! The stats are the same, 180 cals, per Tbsp, as reg peanut butter, but it is blended with some flavorings that make it OH SO delicious!!!  It is all natural, just crushed peanuts, really, with some flavoring, and homogenized so it doesn't really need to be stirred, which is often a turn off when buying the natural stuff.  I got a case of 6 for like 24 bucks on amazon, but now it is out of stock.  Wish they would get it back in, as I will go through about a case a month of this stuff.  Like to eat on a piece of toast after a hard workout.

I was looking for something peanut buttery but not just the usual thing and this fits the bill most excellently. The white chocolate flavor is decidedly an undertone to the peanut butter but it's there if you savor it a bit. Which is always a good way to have some of the nutty buttery goodness. Texture is nice and smooth, firm creaminess as it were. I'm going to have a sandwich of this for lunch today and I think a good, multigrain, thick-sliced bread would be just the ticket for a great PB sanny experience.I'll definitely buy this again.

Peanut Butter & Co made a great product here without all the mess of chemicals and nastiness in alot of non organic peanut butters.This is a much lighter taste then the dark chocolate. It does seems to hold together and not separate as easy as the dark chocolate. For some reason it reminds me a little of a cookie dough

column9: Best Way For A College Student To Consume (Delicious) Protein
column10: I bought this flavor of peanut butter after trying the Peanut Butter & Co. Peanut Butter, Dark Chocolate Dreams, 16-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6) flavor I found at Target. This flavor is good, but not as good. The flavor was a little sweeter than I expected. I'm still giving it five stars, because if I had not tried the other flavor first I would think this is the best peanut butter out there! I cannot penalize pb&co because they make amazing peanut butter and I love one flavor the most. :)
The whole family loves this peanut butter. The white chocolate makes it sweet, but not too sweet. The texture is smooth and creamy. It has all natural ingredients and is very yummy.

I purchased the Peanut Butter & Co. Peanut Butter, White Chocolate Wonderful, 16-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6) by Peanut Butter & Co., directly from Amazon, in July 2011.  The expiration date stated Jan 2013, which is plenty of time to go through 6 jars of this tasty peanut butter.The listed ingredients are as follows:Peanuts, evaporated cane juice, vanilla, cocoa butter, palm fruit oil, lecithin (from sunflowers), salt.The packaging also states that it is gluten-free and certified vegan.  This product doesn't require mixing, as some of the more natural peanut butters sometimes do.While I personally can't discern any white chocolate flavor, it is a very enjoyable peanut butter.

Aside from being made from natural ingredients and no crazy fillers or preservatives, this stuff has an excellent flavor.I am a white chocolate lover, and I will say that this does not really taste like white chocolate (to me). Instead, it actually reminds me more of a fluffernutter flavor, which I also like very much. The best thing about this is that you can give your kids a peanut butter sandwich made with this stuff in lieu of a traditional peanut butter and jelly/fluff sandwich, and it has FAR less sugar and is made from superior ingredients.Works great as a snack straight up on a spoon as well. The kids consider it a dessert treat to get a spoonful ... but considering that is only 3-5 grams of sugar and made from peanuts, it's a healthier dessert option than all of the processed garbage that is out there these days.We also really enjoyed the dark chocolate dreams, we ordered a 6 pack of each.

My favorite peanutbutter EVER.  I cannot say enough good things about it.  This is the first time I've ever bought food online and this was worth it because its too hard to find in stores.  Amazon was quick and it got here when they said it would.

column9: The greatest thing since sliced bread
column10: Tastes like Awesomeness or Reese's Pieces! A God-send if you are allergic to soy or just don't eat genetically modified food.

column9: I don't know how I feel about this.
column10: So I'm a nut butter junkie, usually I make all my own nut butters, except for PB because with it so cheap at the store it's usually not worth the hassle. I went to Target this baby was on sale so I decided to splurge and treat myself. I love white chocolate and I love PB.So here's the review:Pros:Great texture, easy to spreadNo mixingVeganFew and good ingredientsTaste gets better the more you eat itCons:Doesn't really taste like white chocolateSo freaking sweet!Tastes a little waxyOverall I consider it a good product, especially for anyone who usually eats commercial peanut butter. I think I'll stick to more natural peanut butter personally, but I'd wanted to try it for a while and was glad I did.

We have this stuff on subscribe and save.  With Amazon Mom subscribe and save it's cheaper then buying at Wal-Mart.  My 2 sons under 3 love this stuff as well.  No junk in the ingredients so it's healthy.  I eat this on bananas, crackers and for a honeyP&B sandwich.

If you are into seeking healthy foods and really want to eliminate the caffeine in even  small amounts  that is found in any kind of chocolate except white...then you will enjoy eating this peanut butter. It truly is like eating a whipped Reeses peanut butter cup without the additives, the caffeine or the other chemicals.  Yes, it does have calories and fat.  But if you are seeking just a taste of something really, really tasty you will love this peanut butter.  But be careful not to use a spoon the first time or you may very well eat the whole jar in a very short time.  This peanut butter makes me sigh and smile.  Veggies and fruits and whole grains and lean proteins are the essential diet we all should follow but if you are inclined to cheat or treat yourself once in a while.  THIS is THE peanut better to eat.  Ordered the first 6 jars last month and now I  am back for more. Hopefully my self control is back in line. Yummy beyond words.

column4: Jamie "Sleeplady: lover of dogs, zombies and ...
column10: I love this peanut butter! Everyone I have ever suggested taste this peanut butter has also loved it. Last August I went on a medical mission to West Africa.  I'm a vegetarian and so I brought a jar of white chocolate wonderful with me.  I shared the jar with some friends on the mission and they loved it as much as I did.  They asked if they could have some every night for dessert.  For some reason I am having a hard time finding this flavor at my local store, but luckily my savior Amazon has fixed that problem for me.

This is my favorite peanut butter! The white chocolate and peanut butter go together just so perfectly in this product. I like to alternate eating this and Dark Chocolate Dreams (another great flavor by this company). Since I've eaten several jars of this, I will say that sometimes with PB & Co products, the consistency of the peanut butter can vary from jar to jar. It doesn't bother me, but it's something I've noticed.As usual, this company cooked up a winner with this fantastic peanut butter!

I'm a white chocolate fan and if you are too, you will love this peanut butter.  This is my favorite peanut butter, it's sweet but not overpowering.  I was surprised that this peanut butter looked like regular peanut butter, unlike most "natural" peanut butters in which the oil separates.  This looks good and tastes great.
I had to hide the jars of peanut butter as the kids were gobbling it up. Need I write more?

After having lunch at the PB&Co store one day, I fell in love with this flavor.  I usually buy natural pb with no added sugar, but it's worth it to me in this.  It tastes sort of like the peanut butter filling in a Reeses cup.  So delicious on a banana or in oatmeal.  I'm not a big fan of white chocolate, but this is tasty.  The texture is fantastic, and I can't keep my paws out of the jar!

This peanut butter is addictive!  I love the taste and it's very good anywhere you put Jam.  For another taste sensation, try putting it in the microwave for a few seconds to melt into peanuty goodness!

I purchased a case of this peanut butter a few months ago and it's absolutely the best peanut butter I've ever had! The flavor is really great, nice and peanut-ey with a sweetness to it that isn't too overpowering. The texture is really good, and the fact that's natural? Well that's just the icing on the cake! We went through 5 jars of this stuff in less then 6 months which was very unusual before. Coming back for my second batch!

This peanut butter is nothing short of perfection (in my opinion).  I'm not a peanut butter snob...Jif is perfectly fine when I need my peanut butter fix--be it on a sandwich or straight out of the jar by the spoonful.  Let me tell you that this White Chocolate Wonderful is WAY beyond normal peanut butter!  It is heaven in a jar!  I seriously ate half of my first jar last night...one delicious spoonful after another!  I didn't think it could get any better but once you spread it on a warm piece of toast and it melts a little bit it is even BETTER!  I don't really detect much white chocolate flavor...but it's got a noticeable hint of vanilla and a creamy-ness that is beyond description.  If you like peanut butter and vanilla you will LOVE this product!  My only problem is going to be not eating all 6 jars immediately :)

This peanut butter was amazing. It is a little on the sweet side because of the white chocolate, but when paired with a tangy jam (like blackberry), it balances really well for peanut butter and jelly. I also used it as a cake filling for a recent cake order. No extra sugar needed. I just warmed it slightly to make it easier spread on my chocolate cake. The client loved it.

White Chocolate Wonderful is an understatment...more like White Chocolate Heaven! Tastes like peanut butter cookie dough. It does taste a little sweeter than regular peanut butter but same amount of suger grams and 2grams less fat...its a win win!

You don't need jelly, honey, or any other condiment to go with this peanut butter.  It is fabulous just by itself on bread or for dipping.  I buy the pack of 6 and share a few jars with my grand kids and keep a couple to serve at home.  It is the best tasting ever!

column9: First jar gone within a week....hide this stuff from me!
column10: The title of my review says it all.  I found myself unable to pass the cupboard without getting a spoonful of this stuff.  I would get up to let the dog out and stop by the kitchen for a spoonful of this stuff.  I don't even want to think about the fact that I have 5 more jars, I think it's best to leave them out in the garage on the shelf for a while, lol.DELICIOUS.  It really does taste like a white chocolate Reese's cup on a spoon.  SO good to dip sliced apples in.  Just...yum.
This peanut butter has the perfect amount of white chocolate blended in. It has great flavor and is not too sweet. An added bonus is that it is gluten free!
This peanut butter is delicious and very addictive. Give it a try, very glad I decided to try it!

this was very good, i will only eat white chocolate and the dark chocolate one, i will never eat any other peanut butter again, love this stuff, i eat it with everything and made cookies from it too and they were just delicious, this is the cheapest i found anywhere, i love putting it on everything, i have been eating it non stop and still not sick of it

column9: Do NOT buy unless you're willing to eat the whole jar.
column10: We loved this so much it ruined regular peanut butter for my kids.  Yes, it's the sugar but DANG is it good!  I am not a huge peanut butter fan but I could literally eat the whole jar.  It is fantastic, addictive stuff.  I even bought some to send to my mother because I knew she would love it too.  I have tried the other versions but I think this is the best in the entire lineup.

Very happy to find a yummy peanut butter that is still healthy. Shopping for groceries used to be fun, now I have to check everything I buy for gmo, or harmful ingredients. The whole family loves this peanut butter, so win win!

Oh How I Love...this peanut butter. It's just so good. It really is no stir, not any higher in carbs than other PB, and soooo tasty. I would be sad if they stopped making this PB, so order lots of it so they keep making it, but not so much that I can't still get it :)

This product is a yummy, non oily alternative to traditional "natural" peanut butter.  It's smooth, with just a hint of white chocolate.  The weird thing is that I greatly dislike white chocolate in general, but I love this peanut butter.  It's all natural, but you definitely don't have to stir it, and it doesn't separate in a gross fashion like other brands.  Plus, if you order a 4 (or is it 6?) pack like I've been doing, you save a TON of money overall (vs. purchasing it at Whole Foods, etc.)  I'll definitely be re-ordering it as soon as I run out!

column9: best peanut butter in the world
column10: no trans fat and this taste like heaven.  i send this to my grandaughter in college, my daughter in houston, another grandaughter and of course me.  my husband eats this with a spoon,  makes great cookies.  always on auto ship

column9: This has converted me to a peanut butter lover!
column10: I did NOT like peanut butter before trying this. I didn't even eat PB & J sandwiches as a kid. But my hubby loves PB and will put it on almost anything. So in his quest to convert me into a peanut butter advocate like him, he bought me a jar of Peanut Butter & Co White Chocolate from Walmart. I tried it and love it! I finished the jar by myself and have been fiending for more. I was putting it on everything: pancakes, waffles, crackers, fruit, bread, veggies (and bla bla bla). I'm currently out of town and have went to several stores looking for this PB because I am really craving it. I can't find it anywhere! So I came on trusty Amazon to see if there was any hope of finding my new love and Amazon has a 6 pack of this stuff! I can't guarantee my hubby that I'm ready to eat regular PB just yet but I'll be buying this PB until it goes out of production (which I hope is never).

This peanut butter truly is white chocolate wonderful in a jar.  It tastes like eating a white chocolate Reese's cup.  We love this in oatmeal in the morning, on sandwiches, in cookies/pancakes, and just plain on the spoon!
I absolutely LOVE this stuff! BEST peanut butter I have ever had! I highly recommend trying it. I am not a peanut butter eater by any stretch, but this stuff...I can't get enough of.

No hydrogenated oils, no transfat - and tastes BETTER than regular peanut butter.  Stays smooth, the oil does not separate either.  I agree with other posters who said the taste reminds me of cookie dough.  Yum!
Good deal, great peanut butter! Tastes like a reeces peanut butter cup in a jar! Love it! Would purchase again from Amazon.com

This is my absolute favorite PB. I've been a PB lover for years, and this product tops them all! It's creamy and the hint of sweetness makes it a great breakfast, lunch, snack or even dessert! It's lower in sodium than Smucker's Natural, and less sticky. This is a great deal as well, one jar retails for $6 at the grocery store, which is a little fetchy for my budget. Now with Amazon, it gets delivered to my door at a great discount!
This Peanut Butter & Co. white chocolate wonderful is the best peanut butter I have ever tasted.  I am totally hooked, have it for lunch every day on cinnamon raisin toast.
Good stuff.. was buying all natural Jiff and wanted to switch it up. Found this and I'm sold. Great for baking also.
Purchased this peanut butter, hoping it would not be to sweet.  Wow! This stuff is terrific.  Not too sweet, just right.We've had it on crackers, english muffins, etc. It really IS wonderful!

This peanut butter is what should be in every cupboards across America. Very fine taste, that can be eaten in a multitude of ways.Edit: Feb 11th 2011. I just bought 2 more 6 packs of this WONDERFUL peanut butter. Seriously folks, it's that good. I have told everyone about this stuff, and they are all hooked on it.

column9: Super yummy, but I've found it priced better elsewhere.
column10: This is some good stuff!  It's sweeter than regular peanut butter, but not too sweet.  I love that it does not contain hydrogenated oils and it is sweetened with evaperated cane juice, rather than granulated sugar or corn syrup.I've only bought this once, so I don't know how much it usually runs.  My local grocery store doesn't sell it, but just recently I went into a store called "Christmas Tree Shops," and they had this pb priced at $2.99.  It sounded like a deal to me, since I thought it was more expensive.  I bought one jar of this and one jar of the Bee's Knees flavor.  Haven't tried the Bee's Knees, yet, but my family loves this flavor.  I just hate that the store is 45 min. away.  I was kind of hoping that Amazon would have just as good of a deal, so I could order it in bulk and have it shipped.  I wish I would have bought more than one jar.
I really enjoyed this peanut butter, especially since it does not contain hydronated oils. However, it really just tastes like super sugary peanut butter.

column9: Not really worth it, white chocolate taste lacking
column10: I purchased this from my local Target at a comparable price.  It basically tastes like a slightly sweeter peanut butter, no white chocolate taste whatsoever.  For the price, I wouldn't bother with this product.

I eat a lot of peanut butter, particular while pregnant because it happens to be one of my cravings.  This product is okay but not great.  It is a little sweeter than regular peanut butter and a little waxy.  I was given a gift of Peanut Butter of the Month Club and the white chocolate peanut version from that was better I thought and probably more appropriate for making Christmas candies and other things because the white chocolate flavor was a little stronger.

I really love sweet things but this peanut butter taste too sweet as a result the peanut taste is not that strong compared to other brands like Smuckers with honey. It taste like candy rather than Peanut Butter!

I was actually looking forward to this product but once I tried it, I was a little disappointed. The taste wasn't as rich as I had hoped, and I prefer the Chocolate/Peanut Butter product made by the same company than this White Chocolate/Peanut Butter product.
Cinnamon raisin swirl is absolutely terrible. } literally crunched sugar between my teeth when I took a bite. The taste is lacking and the tezture is horrible. Don't waste your money.

I'm glad I tried out the Chocolate Dreams before I sprang for the whole jar--there is no chocolate taste whatsoever--it sure is dark like dark chocolate, but my tastebuds aren't fooled by color,it just tastes like sweet peanut butter.
Pirates booty is the best.  Others just dont pass the test.  My children mob the box when it comes in the mail, and I know ita actually not that bad for them.  Way to go!

Unfortunetly I cannot find this flavor anymore.  I do not care for the white cheddar(too salty.) I can eat an entire bag of the bbq though. A little disappointed that when the box did arrive, the "best by" date was only just over a month away. Since I am the only one in the house that likes this product, there was no way I could eat a 12 pack in a month & a half. I ended up giving a lot away.
Very good. And a great price by the case compared to the $3.50 a bag at the store. Not to mention this flavor is hard to find in stores.

column9: Great snack for food-allergic child (or adult)
column10: These are great little snacks to have on the go.  They are light, so you don't have that heavy feeling as you might with regular barbeque chips.  There are limited snacks my son can have due to his food allergies.  So it is nice to give him options...that are tasty.  My husband and I sneak some from time to time, too!

column9: A must for the home bar
column10: While bitters are getting easier to find, I still have to drive across town to get a good variety.  Fee's Brothers is one of the best and the West Indian Orange is becoming a "new classic" called for in many updated cocktails.  Considering the drive you'll save, Amazon is a great place to shop for bitters.

column9: The Best Alternative to Diet Sodas With Artificial Sweeteners
column10: Whenever I drink a soda at home, it is always a Zevia soda.  Zevia has a refreshing cola flavor, while not being exactly like either of the big-brand diet colas.  I have noticed very little aftertaste from Zevia soda, much less than from regular diet soda.  From the reviews I've read, it's clear that you either really like this soda or you don't.  I really like this soda.  I was a big consumer of both big-brand diet colas for many years.  I really didn't like the artificial sweetener in the average diet soda.  Thank you to the people who make Zevia soda.  It is more expensive than regular soda, but I think it's worth it.  It is great to be able to enjoy a diet soda that tastes great and contains nothing artificial.  My only negative comment would be about what happens when you pour Zevia soda in a glass over ice.  The carbonation seems to dissipate very quickly when poured over ice.  Not to worry.  Drinking it right out of the can works fine for me.

FedEx Ground is AWFUL.  Please stop shipping goods that can be easily damaged via FedEx Ground.  They're careless with the packages.  The package itself only has padding on the top of the case of soda and not on the bottom.  The last case I received had 8 cans bulged out (from being dropped) ... 4 of them were so bad that they had ruptured and were almost entirely empty when I opened the box.The soda itself is great.  I get a case every month...but that will change for sure if I keep getting them damaged.  Switch back to UPS.  When I got them delivered UPS the boxes weren't dropped so hard the cans broke...

I am not a big soda drinker but I like to have a coke zero with lunch to help with the carb crash. I like coke zero better than diet coke as it has less of a bitter after taste and i like zevia cola better than coke zero for same reason. It's also carbonated a little lighter and the cola flavor is a little more subtle. I guess its kinda like a coke zero lite. I did my wikipedia research on it ingredients and if you are gonna drink sodas this is probably the least bad for you of anything out there. I won't be buying anymore coke, that's for sure.

My doctor just told me no more diet drinks and then I found Zevia.  It is good.  Will take abit of getting used to because I love fountain drinks but I am so so excited to have this alternative!!!!!!!

column9: My Favorite Zevia -- Has Caffeine Though
column10: This is the fourth Zevia flavor I've tried.  Orange was first, which I didn't like much.  Black cherry was next which wasn't bad but wasn't great either.  Next was root beer which I really enjoyed.  Finally, cola which I think is the best of the bunch.  I had tried to order the cola flavor earlier FedEx sent it back to Amazon after getting to the truck hub that services my house.  I don't know why it was sent back and my inquiries to Amazon were unanswered.  A lady on Amazon's 800 number wanted to reorder it for me but I had to explain that she couldn't due to stock and high shipping prices of third party sellers (more on that later).  But I finally got a case of it on my second try.  I love it and so does my wife.  The only problem with it is that it is the only Zevia soda that contains caffeine.  On the list of ingredients it says "caffeine 45mg from coffee".  That amount of caffeine is comparable to the amount you'd find in a Coke or Pepsi product.  That's not a deal breaker for me though.  I try to avoid caffeine as does my wife, but for a lot of people that would be a deal breaker.  I will continue to drink the caffeine free root beer flavor most often while treating myself to the cola flavor on occasion.  Out of the four flavors of Zevia I've had, cola is far and away better than orange and black cherry, while root beer is close behind in second.There are two major problems with ordering Zevia products.  First, they're expensive.  At just over a dollar a can they are pricey, no other way to describe it.  The second, is availability.  Amazon is really having some issues with keeping Zevia flavors in stock with Prime shipping.  The third party sellers all have exuberant shipping prices bringing your case of soda to over fifty dollars.  I've emailed Zevia about this and did get a response from them.  I hope Amazon can keep it stocked and Zevia can keep them supplied.  It's a good product but it's been frustrating trying to order due to Amazon's stock.  Due to the high price tag I put it on a monthly schedule to save 15%.  It helps but I wonder if Amazon will have it ready to go each month.The Zevia Cola is an great tasting soda.  I will be purchasing it again but not as often as I'd like due to the caffeine content.

column9: Great Idea but Fell Short of Expectations
column10: I like the idea of a "naturally sweetened" diet soda, but the after taste was worse than diet pepsi or diet coke.  If you are determined to drink a more natural diet soda then this is your best option.

column9: Fresh tasting calorie free cola with nothing artificial
column10: I am so thrilled that there is finally a soft drink option that is not bad for you and is also affordable. The sweeteners used in other diet soft drinks are too risky to consume on a regular basis as they have been shown to cause health problems in some people. Stevia, which I have used in my coffee for years, is tasty and now has no bitter after taste as it did in its earlier days if you used too much. Since it is a plant and has not been fooled with by chemists converting it into something molecularly different, then I feel very good using it and have even gotten my 4 kids hooked on it. They just can't drink as many sodas since they are a bit more expensive, but definitely worth it.

I have been waiting for years for soda with stevia. I like the cola best, then the rootbeer flavor. Orange is ok, but then I was never big on orange. I haven't tried the citrus yet. I hope they come out with grape and cherry too. :)

I'm utterly baffled by the positive reviews for this product.Now I've been using Stevia for the past year to sweeten my coffee. I have no issue with the Stevia.I used to drink a lot of soda, and then a few years back, a lot of diet soda. Since then, I've been able to give up soda altogether. But my Dad who is diabetic, is absolutely obsessed with diet coke. I've been trying to get him to lessen his diet coke intake (which is 1-2 a day) but he just waves me off. So I did some research, read the reviews, and bought 2 packs of the cola and lemon flavor each. I tried both to see how they tasted and was totally confused by this tasteless carbonated water. There was no taste! It literally just tasted like carbonated water with a vague hint of some flavor. I can't imagine anyone WANTING to drink this stuff, let alone rave about it.Did I get a bad batch? My Dad will never be able to transition from diet coke to this stuff, cause this stuff is truly awful.So disappointing. :(
i got this thinking it would be a great soda to replace coke and diet coke with, but i was wrong, this tastes so disgusting, i will just stick diet coke, which is ALOT cheaper than this

column9: Next best thing to popular brand diet soda
column10: Diet sodas contain ultimately a bunch of chemicals not meant for human consumption. This soda is all natural, with an all natural sugar substitute, Stevia.  Much safer for the body!  Personally, I don't care for some of the other flavors of this soda.  But their cola is delish in my book!

This a very delicious soda.  I recently went on a very strict diet that didn't allow for sugar or know sugar subs.  But it allowed stevia.  It is very nicely tasting, almost like drinking a diet soda with lemon but better.  It is a bit expensive but totally worth it.  I highly recommend it.  I have read other reviews about it causing headaches, I have suffered from migraines since I was kid but I have not experience one yet after drinking this product.

column9: Great diet soda substitue but expensive
column10: Tastes great and seems to be more healthy than diet soda.  The only down side is the expense.Have tried this flavor and the root beer (which is good as well).If you use the subscribe and save feature this helps lower the price.

column9: The cola is bitter, the ginger root beer is great.
column10: I've only tried the cola and root beer, and the cola was nasty, but I like the root beer very much. The cola has a bitter wang to it. I always like diet Coke, so I like a bit of bite in the cola, but this all got poured down the sink.

The cola has a funky taste.  The lemon-lime is HORRID!  It tastes like hair product.  I'm not kidding.  The Dr. Zevia tastes like it should, a refreshing and sweet beverage.  I'm going to pass in the future.

I bought mine from a grocery store, so no comments on shipping, which I assume shakes it up pretty bad.I was pretty excited to hear about this stuff since I started watching my blood sugar. I hadn't had soda of any sort for about a month at that point and frankly, I missed it. Enough that I drove across Arlington Texas in some traffic, just to snag some of this. As it chilled in my fridge, I thought about how it would taste. Would it be some kind of miracle Coke clone that proved God truly loved the world? Would it be revolting?Well, of those, it was the former, but add "Diet" before Coke.Yes, this soda has a distinct 'diet soda' taste to it, a kind of understated but sharp bittersweetness. So while it is pretty not bad, it is definitely diet.Should you buy some? If you're used to Diet Coke, absolutely. But if you insist on regular pop or nothing, try another flavor. I got root beer in the same trip, which is pretty good. But honestly, I don't know that I'll get another pack of the cola for a while.
This is a GREAT product!  No artificial anything. Wish it wasn't so pricey - that's why I gave 4 instead of 5.  I would recommend to anyone trying to avoid sugar and all the artificial sweeteners.

If you're the Canada Dry kind of soda drinker where it's not too sweet, you may like this. For me it's "EHHHHHHH!" Stevia is one of the many healthy alternative sweeteners especially for diabetics on the market but there are others that I personally like better. It's a preference thing.

I drank 3 of the drinks, one on 3 different days to realize that the feeling of high level heartburn and a low level general nausea that did not go away for days, was due to this cola.  I didn't recover from the 3 drinks completely for about a week.  The taste was only good if the drink was ice cold.  I did receive a refund.

column9: Most expensive drink I've had in a long time...
column10: Today I was excited to try a natural cola with no calories.  The 6-pack of cans I purchased was $4.99.  I took one sip.  Dumped the can and will not be trying the rest of this stuff.  In other words I paid the equivalent of $49.19 an once.  (Based on how much I was able to stomach...)

column4: A. B. MacDougall "Fat Bottom Girls You make t...
column9: Very good, plus it won't make you a FATTY FATTERSON
column10: Hello Ms. Fatty Fatterson... that was what I used to say when looking in the mirror. I would sip those Diet Cokes (mmm don't you love the taste of fresh asphartine in the morning?!), whilst rotting my brain out with chemicals.What I like about this is that it is ALL NATURAL. And uses a friggin plant (Stevia) with a zero-glycemic index(no sugar, to all you other piggies out there).Woot girls! The answer to office soda pop is finally here.

I knew I had to do something to get away from my diet coke habit; the artificial sweetener was causing health issues for me.  Zevia was recommended to me so I tried it.  The best change I ever made!  I am a Zevia drinker now and there is no turning back! (Ordering from Amazon and having it delivered to my door is a big plus too!)

I am so horribly disappointed in this product. I've looked forward to trying it for months, and finally ordered some online when I found a good deal. I try really hard to limit the amount of sugar in my diet, but also avoid artificial sweeteners at all costs (I'd rather just have the sugar). As soon as this arrived, I cracked open a can, poured it over ice into a glass & took a whiff. It smelled great--like a regular cola! It looked right--perfect color, lots of carbonation, etc. But that's as far as it went with the positives... as soon as I tasted it, I shuddered--literally. It tastes like an extra sweet version of Diet Pepsi (my most HATED soda, ever). The sweetness is sickening, tastes NOTHING like a sugar-type of sweetness, and leaves a really metallic taste in my mouth. I tried several times to choke it down, thinking that maybe I'd get used to it after a few sips--but no, I ended up dumping the rest down the drain. I wish I had tried just ONE can instead of ordering a 24 pack! I'm so bummed out--guess it was just too good to be true.

This product has been a life saver for me! I was recently diagnosed with gestational diabetes during my 6 month of pregnancy and one of my man cravings is coca cola which is an absolute no-no. Zevia cola over ice satisfies my craving without all the harsh harmful chemicals of mainstream diet soda.

Zevia All Natural Soda, Cola 12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)I'm all for Stevia. It's my sweetener of  choice, and I just ordered another bottle of "Pure Stevia  Extract". I even have a few Stevia plants growing outside. HOWEVER, this drink is something else. I foolishly ordered a whole case of the stuff, and I'm now trying to figure out what to do with it. Drinking it is definitely "not on the table", but it might be good for washing the driveway. We'll see. Anyway, not wishing to waste any adjectives, I'll just say that, despite the unbelievable positive comments above, it's not something that any normal person would be willing to try more than once. It's not vile. It's not a nasty of the spitting-out kind, but it's just something you would never want to try for more than one sip. Don't buy it.Addendum:  I failed to describe its taste. Well, as I've said, it's not nasty, but the thought that occurs to you during the first sip is, "Why am I drinking this?" It lacks effervescence, it doesn't taste good, and it doesn't even have the sweetness you'd expect. It does have some kind of taste, but the closest I can come to describing it is to have you think of brewing  a weak tea from some weeds in your garden. I haven't done this, but I think your brew wouldn't be too different from this stuff.

****Update****I have continued to try with this product.  I hated the thought of spending the money and just tossing the rest of these....  I will admit it gets easier to drink the more you try.  (Maybe I'm starting to get used to it?)  I will say the aftertaste still is awful, but at least I'm more used to it.  It taste much much better if you drink it ICE COLD.  Once it starts to lose the 'coldness' I'm finding that I can't really stomach it.My friend purchased the Dr.Zevia instead of the cola.  (She's in love with diet Dr. Pepper.)  I tried one of hers and it truly tasted (and smelled like) cough syrup.So, at least I can say that the Cola is better than that.I will keep trying......I hope.======================================================I am almost in awe at some of these perfect reviews....Let me start by saying, I've been having a mad love affair with Diet Coke for several years.  I figured since it has zero calories, then no harm done.  However, I recently started a 40 day purge diet that requires no Diet Coke.  However, my doctor said that I could have this instead.  After researching Zevia, I found that a couple of their sodas have caffeine (yea!)  Since I love Diet Coke, I decided to give Zevia Cola a try.The verdict?....It's not the worst soda I've ever tried....but close.  At first, it's not so bad, but the aftertaste is TERRIBLE!  Way way way too sweet!  (If you are used to Diet Coke, you will definitely not be a happy camper.)  If it weren't for the fake sugary aftertaste, it wouldn't be too bad.I realize that Zevia isn't Diet Coke....but I was still disappointed.  When you calculate the cost....it's just too expensive to keep buying, especially if I won't drink it.  If you have a local specialty store, try buying one there to 'try' before you end up buying a whole case that you may or may not like.I was thinking about trying the Mountain version (also has caffeine), but since trying this one, will definitely have to reconsider.

This is my favorite soda, the Cola is delicious and it really wakes you up if you're tired. I like the taste of Zevia sodas better than other Stevia sodas. My favorite is the Root Beer, but the Cola is a close second. There's even a caffeine free version of the Cola if you cant have caffeine.

column9: Best alternative to standard diet cola
column10: I have been on a low carb diet since July so I am already over the sweet craving.  But I wanted to get off of the chemically treated diet colas.  This is a great tasting cola and helps me achieve all of my long term goals.  Do your body a favor, just try it.

column9: The best soda I have ever had.
column10: Zevia Natural Diet Soda is exactly what you would expect from an outstanding beverage.  It is void of artificial sweetners that cause all kinds of problems for the body.  There is really nothing diet about the flavor or drinking experience.  It has every sense of a regular cola with sugar, without the sugar.  There is no after taste or lingering strange feelings after consumption.  It is purely a great beverage with no strings attached.  I see Zevia as a strong mainstream beverage of the future.  I believe in this product, and would invest futures into this company.

Bought a case of this tough to find cola.  One can arrived punctured, but fortunately the hole was near the top and there wasn't a huge mess.  This soda is good if you're staying away from both sugar and artificial sweeteners.

Zevia was highly recommended as an artificial sweetener substitute...  but as I found out the hard way, the sugar alcohol it contains is not compatible with a lot of people. Let's just say I was grounded for a day.  Very nasty side effects.
Finally, my life is complete... a Stevia-based soda pop! And as the can says, No Calories, No Sugar, No HFCS, and NO Caffiene!

column9: Glad I only bought one can.
column10: I was at Whole Paycheck today and saw this cola. I almost bought a case, but decided to try a single can first. I'm glad I did, because I hated it. I don't expect any diet cola to be as good as "The Real Thing", but it should taste like cola and not be bitter. This stuff is very bitter, and I would not have known it was a "cola" if it was not labeled as such. I think the makers need to do some taste tests and fix their formula.

I love Truvia sub sugar which is made from the Stevia plant, so I thought Zevia, the drink made with Stevia, would be good. But on the contrary _ I opened one can and could barely finish it. It's grossly  and sickeningly sweet with a horrible after taste and next to "no carbonation" in the can. GOD AWFUL..whoever let this on the market should be fired..

I've just recently started using liquid stevia (SweetLeaf SteviaClear Liquid Stevia, 4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 2)) to sweeten iced teas, lemonades and other juices that I make at home, and while it is not sugar, it still has a pleasing taste once you learn how much a beverage needs.I saw these on the shelf at my local supermarket the other night and decided to take the plunge. What a waste of $4.99: This stuff is awful! The cola is sweet, yes, but it has a horrible aftertaste, not anything like the liquid stevia that I am used to using, and tastes a lot like drinking black pepper.Just for the record: I don't mind diet cola, and will drink lots of it if it is on hand. I find regular cola a bit sweet for my tastes, but I am a fan of the cane sugar colas that have gotten popular recently. This stuff is expensive, and doesn't even taste much like cola, even if you were to disregard the aftertaste. I might give one of the other flavors a try, but imo it's not worth the expense.I'd say save your money.

Because I read so many good reviews I thought I'd finally found a healthy replacement for cola drinks, and was very excited. Much to my disappointment I found the flavor to be Horrid. The best way I can describe it is...Medicine, with a twist of the old natural food flavor...heavy on the old..Ugh!

column9: I couldn't even finish one can
column10: I have always been a huge Diet Pepsi fan, but I have recently decided to give up aspartame.  So I searched online and found this product.  So you've heard the saying "If it sounds too good to be true, then it probably is."  Well that is definitely the case with Zevia Cola.I honestly had a hard time getting it down.  I can't believe people are giving it 4 and 5 stars.  They must work for the company or something because it is nasty.  There is an awful after taste.  Luckily, I only bought a six pack at the grocery store and so I only have 5 left over cans instead of 23.  I would honestly be embarassed to offer them to guests (even my little nephews).  However, I did read one review that said it was okay mixed with rum.I also tried the ginger root beer and it was delicious.  However, it doesn't have any caffeine so it's not really a substitute for Diet Pepsi.  I'm going to try the Dr. Zevia and the Mountain Zevia since they are the only two other Zevias that contain caffeine.  Then I'll give up and go back to my Diet Pepsi.  Maybe I'll just cut back on the number of cans I go through.

column9: You people are nutz, this stuff is awful
column10: You organic types can fool yourselves into all sorts of B.S. Zevia is gross, tastes unnatural, not sweet.  If you want to be orgnaic, GREAT, drinks some water, it certainly tastes better than Zevia (so bad, I can not believe the postive reviews). If you want a diet soda, get something from Dr Pepper/Snapple (A&W, Ginger Ale, etc.), they are the best.

I will be honest. I have never tried Zevia and am hesitant to do so because if I do indeed like it I will not be able to AFFORD IT!!!! My husband drinks soda like water and I am trying to steer him in a more healthy direction; hence my wanting to try Zevia. Why is it that everything that is better for your health is so expensive?! I mean $24.00 for a case of soda is astronomical when you can buy a case of the popular brands for no more than $8.00. With the economy the way it is I will just have to wait until I land a better job so that I can afford to be more healthy!

column9: I can finally have soda again!
column10: I'd been hearing about Zevia and finally got to try some of each flavor.  Due to an inability to process sugar (can't "cheat" because I get instantly sick), and headache problems from aspartame and sucralose, I've been unable to drink soda for several years.  I figured I'd rather be healthy, feel good, and drink water or tea than have a drink of pop and feel awful, so I abstained.So I was excited to find Zevia.  Zevia is nothing short of wonderful.  When I could still drink pop, I'd tried all kinds of artisan types like Jones, Virgil's etc. so it doesn't bother me a bit that it's not a Coke clone (but it's not far off either).  It's still got a wonderful, true cola flavor--a fantasia flavor of vanilla, citrus, and cinnamon, like all true colas.  Plenty of fizz that lasts the whole can.As far as aftertaste goes, I've never tasted a soda that didn't have some kind--and that I couldn't get used to.  This probably has less aftertaste than anything I've tasted, other than straight cane-sugar.  If anything it's a sweet, rather than the usual acidic, aftertaste.The opinions of the others in my family are similar.  My husband, who is very picky when it comes to diet cola, loved it and claimed my second can of it.  He's been trying to get away from his diet Coke addiction for a couple of years.  My kids loved all the flavors they tried. They're not normally allowed to drink soda at all, and are thrilled there is finally something out there I'll allow them to have once in awhile.It's selling for about $1 a can, which is less than the other "stevia-supplemented" soda out there (Virgil's is around $2 a bottle).  I imagine that as this takes off, that price will come down.  And it should take off.  It's just as good as the not-so-good-for-you sodas.

column9: Zevia Cola - My second experience with stevia sweetened soda
column10: Zevia Ginger Ale was my first experience with a soda sweetened with the natural sweetner Stevia. As a result of my good experience, I bought a six-pack of Zevia Cola from my local natural foods store.  The associate told me they sell out very quickly. I will be purchasing other flavors to try as well.Taste: 3 stars- I used to be a huge fan of Diet Coke. There is a definite after-taste created by Stevia, and it will take a little getting used to. However, this is the case for any diet drink.  Someone that is not used to diet sodas might not immediately enjoy them.  After continuing to drink Zevia, the after taste becomes less noticeable. This soda seems a tad bit sweeter than a regular Coke and not quite a sweet as a Diet Coke.  The cola flavor could definitely be stronger.Calories: 5 stars- No calories! Can't argue with that.Ingredients: 5 stars- It's all natural. If you aren't familiar with Stevia, look it up on your favorite search engine.  The sweetner has no calories and is natural, unlike the Aspartame found in a Diet Coke.Overall Rating: 4 stars- When it comes to no calories and natural ingredients, I'm willing to accept a slight decrease in taste. That's why I'm giving Zevia Cola 4 stars. Unfortunately in this case, the cola taste is not quite as strong as it should be, and the Stevia seems to overpower the cola flavor.The only way to know if you'll like it is to give it a try. Amazon sells these for a better price than you will find in stores, but if you want to try it first, you can probably purchase these in smaller quantity at a natural foods store.

column9: Great Flavor and Not too Sweet!
column10: I usually hate diet soda - ones with natural sweeteners, ones with artificial - anything diet.  This is the first soda with 0 calories that I have tried and loved!  Their root beer flavor is fantastic as well!  Don't expect this to taste like Coke or Pepsi though - it is definitely more in line with a cola flavor you would get from Big Sky, Knudsen's or another natural brand.  I also like that it has a clean sweet sort of flavor - not a sickly sweet or with any sort of metallic aftertaste you get with other kinds of diet drinks.The only con I would say is that it is very carbonated - unless you really really like carbonation, I would recommend not drinking this straight from the can - pour it over ice.  The positive to this though is that if you don't finish a whole can, you can put it into the fridge and come back later and it is still fizzy.  I have left an open one in the fridge with no lid or covering only to come back the next day and find that it was still drinkable and not totally flat.Great product!  Glad Amazon has finally started carrying at least one flavor!

I am so grateful to Zevia for this product.  I couldn't drink anything but water.  As a diabetic, no sugar and I have an allergy to 'man-made substitute sugar', probably a very good thing.  Coffee and Tea upset my stomach (I'm getting up there in years).  And then I stumbled upon the Zevia site.  YES!!!I was already using Stevia (the natural sugar that is actually so harmless it is GOOD for diabetics!!  And here was a drink I could actually have and pop!  I hadn't had a pop in years!!  How absolutely delightful!I purchased some to try, hoping I would like it, as it turned out I love the taste of it.  I cannot do a comparison by taste since I haven't had regular soda's in forever but Zevia Rootbeer is way, way too sweet for me (considering I haven't been able to have granulated sugar).  I worried at first that I couldn't have the rootbeer flavor  because it like all 'rootbeers' may have licorice root which raises blood pressure...HA!  Zevia rootbeer is made with ginger root and tastes exactly as I remembered rootbeer.  I have some but keep it for times when I have an upset stomach or dizziness.I drink the cola and Twist all the time and as yet haven't had a chance to try the Orange, but I'm looking forward to it.  Diabetics with a sweet tooth can drink this and it will cut down their craving for sugar.I drive quite a ways to get it because the shipping is bit steep on the Net but I manage to keep plenty in my pantry.  I've become a very big fan of Zevia!!!I really hope more and more people learn of Zevia and will begin to drink it, because once your health is damaged there may be no return to good health.  Life becomes "What if" and "If only".  So if you get a chance to try Zevia go for it.  To your good health!

Wow, my prayers have been answered!  I asked for a full flavored soda pop, zero calories, no artificial sweeteners like Splenda or Aspartame and what do I get, ZEVIA.  There is Natural Cola - bonus no Phosphoric Acid, Natural Twist and Natural Orange.  This is really good stuff.  This is the soda pop that everyone should be drinking!

I recently purchased a case of Zevia.  I was anxious to try out this product.  It arrived today, much to my delight.  After drinking just a half of a can, I came down with a terrible headache.  I couldn't believe it.  The culprit...ERYTHRITOL, a sugar alcohol, the second ingredient in the product; not STEVIA, the fifth ingredient. Also, the product is purported to have -0- calories.  Erythritol contains 2.6 calories per gram.  There are 12 grams of erythritol in each can.  Most erythritol is made from fermenting GMO corn.  How healthy is that? This beverage is VERY expensive and would be well worth it if it were truly an all naturaldrink, sweetened only with stevia, which is what I thought I purchased.

column9: Zevia is the 0-cal HEALTHY soda option!
column10: Faithful customer here!  :)  I am so happy Zevia exists.  I gave up all soda years ago, but honestly... I missed it.  Two year ago I learned about Zevia, and have been purchasing it ever since.Zevia comes in an assortment of flavors that are all quite tasty... natural cola, natural orange, natural ginger-ale, natural root beer, natural black cherry, and natural twist. My favorites are the black cherry, orange, and root beer.I have never tasted an aftertaste with Zevia. All the flavors are delicious. My favorite things about Zevia are that they are sweetened with all-natural stevia and don't contain any harmful chemicals.  Also, I love the fact that there are no calories in it.  Truly guilt-free!The only Zevia flavor I've seen caffeine in is cola.  All the others are caffeine-free.I deducted a star from this product due to the pricey price point of Zevia. I still continue to buy it, but not as often as I would like to due to the cost.I have emailed the Zevia corporate team and they are responsive, professional, and friendly. I trust this brand.I hope you give Zevia a try. I think you will be pleased!

column9: Not what it's made out to be, unfortunately
column10: I purchased this soda from my local health food store, thinking that because it came from a health food store and claimed to be 'natural', that it didn't use GMO ingredients (yes, I know, I was naive, lol) . After reading some of the comments here, especially the one about the ingredients not being as advertised by the company, I decided to do some research. I ended up emailing the company and asking them why they used erythritol and where their erythritol source came from. The response that I received appears below. I don't appreciate marketing that is designed to mislead consumers by throwing the word 'natural' around like this product does. I have enough labels to sift through to try to remove GMO from my diet. Figured I'd pass the info on.Hi Joanna,Erythritol is 100% natural. It occurs naturally in grapes, melons, pears, corn to name a few sources. It is made through a fermentation process like yeast. Erythritol has no calories and no effect on blood sugar levels. The reason we blend stevia (hundreds of time sweeter than sugar) with erythritol (only 70% the sweetness of sugar) is because the combination yields a natural sweetness that tastes like sugar. Using either sweetener alone would not please the palate like Zevia does.------------------Hi Joanna,Zevia is always considering ingredients that are safe for personal safety and health and that of our environments. Our erythritol is not certified Organic by the USDA and is not certified GMO-Free and is made from corn.  Zevia does seek out suppliers of GMO-free ingredients when they are available in the market and when it is a viable alternative, but we cannot make the claim that all of our ingredients are GMO-free. We promise that we will continue to explore ingredient alternatives when available and will always choose to do right by our customer and the environment.

Personally, I love the taste.  It is a bit different, but all diet sodas are.  The folks at Zevia are great too.  After doing a lot of research on Stevia, I had an opportunity to deal with the people at Zevia via their contact links on their web site and they not only answered my questions but went out of their way to "reward" me for my input!  It's nice to know the people making the products you use are good folks.  I highly recommend this product.

column9: Good, but sweetened with ERYTHRITOL too
column10: I like this soda very well, but it's because I like Erythritol as well as Stevia. There's 12 grams (1 Tablespoon) of sugar alcohol in each can. Strange how they don't tout this in the blurb on the side . . . .

LOVE, love, love it!! I was a Diet Coke addict for years (over a decade) and probably did unspeakable damage to my health with all the artificial sweetener and sodium benzoate...but I have a new habit, and I'm not worried about my health at all! I haven't stopped telling friends about my discovery of Zevia. The only stinker is that none of my local stores carry it, so I have to have it shipped. My two favorite flavors are Cola and Root Beer.
I love these, but I have to limit them because of the caffeine. But they taste great! Way better than any artificial diet soda!

I love, love,love,love zevia !!! thank god for its existence daily !!! It tastes great, it is good for you, and mother earth too ! Wow Zevia is a refreshing supplement and I will be a life long customer, I hope they come up with a DR Z flavor...hint... hint...Thanks Zevia,Natasha

I'm a big fan of stevia -- in its un-messed-with form, that is.  I use the liquid type from my local health food store.  I try to avoid the other types that have been mixed with various powders and crystals and so on.  Stevia in liquid form is so sweet it only takes two drops to sweeten a glass of iced tea and leaves no aftertaste.I tried several cans of Zevia on different occasions, really trying to like it.  But it has an awful aftertaste, no matter how cold it is.It's over-priced and bad tasting.  That it gets so many good reviews may be more because people are so desperate to find an alternative to HFCS-laden drinks they'll like anything.  But to each their own.I won't buy any more Zevia or recommend it to anyone.

column9: Not All Natural, Not that Tasty - Contains Sugar Alcohol
column10: Disappointed in this drink.  I chose Zevia because I wanted to get away from my diet coke consumption and I love carbonation.  Well, no.  This isn't the answer.First off the taste -I've tried Zevia, Dr. Zevia and the gingerale.  All of them have this artificial sweetness that can't be overriden by the different varieties.  It's nothing like Diet Coke or Pepsi, Dr. Pepper, etc.  I thought I could get used to it but after a couple of weeks, it's just nauseatingly sweet.  The other varieties don't change that.Second, the ingredients -This is the listed ingredient list.  I have a sensitivity to sugar alcohol (zylitor, splenda (sucralose), etc) so I use stevia in my coffee.  No problem.  With this drink, I started having gastrointestinal issues common to sugar alcohols.  I didn't know what was causing it so I changed some things in my diet to no avail.  Then I looked at this ingredient list.  Stevia is NOT the primary sweetener.  Ingredients are listed by the most prevalent first - erythritol is a sugar alcohol.  It's the same chemical family as splenda.  Um.. no thanks.  I wanted a NATURALLY sweetened drink - not another chemical one.I feel this company is being dishonest in its product.  I've discontinued use of this line of beverages while my system settles down from the sugar alcohol and will not be drinking them again.  The taste is inferior and artificial and the ingredients cause me to have problems.IngredientsCARBONATED WATER, **ERYTHRITOL**, CARAMEL COLOR, TARTARIC ACID, REB A (STEVIA EXTRACT), FUMARIC ACID, CAFFEINE, LIME OIL, LEMON OIL, NATURAL FLAVORS, CASSIA OIL, NUTMEG OIL.

column9: After the second can, you'll never go back!
column10: I cannot say enough good things about this soda.  It is expensive, but worth every penny.  I tried to lose weight by drinking diet soda made with those horrible chemical sweeteners like Nutrasweet.  They left me dry-mouthed and cranky, and hungrier than when I started!Zevia is sweetened with Stevia, an all-natural sweetener.  Drink two cans and you'll never go back. I say drink two cans because Stevia does taste a little different, and it is intensely sweet like the high-fructose corn syrup sodas are.  After the second can, you'll be used to the taste and you'll also be amazed how much better you feel.This soda actually curbs my appetite.  My system doesn't rebel against it, like it does with those "frankensweetener" diet sodas.  I also don't feel bloated and sugar-crashy, like I do when I drink the corn-syrup sodas.  I suspect the non-chemical sweetness of this drink tricks my body into thinking that I drank a regular soda. Zevia finally enabled me to stop drinking regular soda entirely!You've gotta try this stuff!

column9: Not bad for a Natural Soda
column10: I am on the HCG diet and I am a soda lover. I just don't like coffee or tea and only getting to drink water was a drag and then I found this soda. Not bad for a natural soda. It is not like soda that most people are used to but after a day or two it can grow on you. It's OK and gets me by. I would recommend this product to anyone that has to has a soda and is looking for an alternative.

Really enjoy this soda...it took me a while to ween myself off full-sugar sodas, but once I did, it was pretty easy to transition from name brand diet sodas to Zevia. The taste took a little getting use to, and it tastes far better chilled, but I'd take it any day over diet or regular brand name sodas.

column9: Zevia, lower your price, and I'll give you FIVE stars!
column10: I HAD to stop drinking Big Red (if you're from Texas, you'll know where I'm coming from ...it's practically pure sugar with a fairly good kick). But I'm terrified of Aspertame and the other dangerous sugar substitutes in diet sodas.Can't say I had a Eureka! moment when I tasted Zevia cola, but each can of the first six-pack tasted better and better (especially when it was ice cold). That was several months and many six-packs ago. These days I even get a craving for the stuff.

I thought all hope was lost, when I bought a 24-pack of Virgil's Diet Cola (for $48!), which is sweetened with Stevia.  The stuff was AWFUL!  I ended up throwing out about 9 of the bottles.  I just couldn't take the taste.  I tried Zevia, reluctantly.  I was expecting another abysmal tasting Stevia-based Cola but I was pleasantly surprised!  Zevia is great!The taste reminds me of Diet Soda from the 1980's a little bit.  A little bit medicinal tasting, but very drinkable, and refreshing.  All I was asking for, was a Diet Soda that's reasonably drinkable.  Well, I found it!  I refuse to put Aspartame or Sucralose in my body, so this is a glorious treat.I suppose the taste could be improved upon slightly, but I'm still very happy with it overall.  And the price is great!  I paid $2 a piece for that Virgil's garbage.  Zevia is $1 a can, about what you'd pay for a Coke out of a vending machine.  Not bad at all!

column9: Excellent Product with a bit of a high price
column10: As a lifetime diet cola drinker I eagerly waited for someone to roll out a soda with Stevia.  At first I was a bit concerned when a non "name" brand soda came out, especially with a premium price.  However I am incredibly pleased with the Zevia cola soda.  It tastes far closer to regular Pepsi than any diet soda.  I find no after taste, rather a sweet and refreshing flavor.  The only reason that I gave it four stars was because of the elevated price.  I would highly recommend this product.

Originally, I was very excited to find this product. It started out tasting good, however recently they've changed something and the taste isn't the same as before. The can ingredients show different ingredients now. I wish they had left it as is. It's too expensive to order something that is just mediocre. Will look for another natural brand.

As this is the only "diet" soda currently available in my area that I can feel comfortable with, I had to give it a try. Naturally, if you're used to the flavor of your favorite soda, switching can be difficult, but it was worth it for me--no more Aspartame! In a very short time, I have grown to absolutely love this soda. It is very fizzy and this one is my favorite of all their flavors. When I first tried it, I put a little cherry flavoring in it, and gradually did not want the cherry anymore. I am enjoying a Zevia right now!

If you are sensitive to all the chemicals in regular and typical diet soda..then this stuff is for you.  I know some Celiacs have trouble drinking soda whether it is allegedly gluten free or not. I peronally get muscle burning/stiffness, headaches, and irritability from the dyes and chemicals in coke and pepsi products. I have had not had one symptom from drinking this soda and it taste great!!!It is most comparable to Pepsi One but I think it is better. It is a little pricey but if you have limited choices for beverages that make you sick..give this a try.

I just tried the cola Zevia today, to impressive results.  I was expecting a bitter aftertaste since pure stevia is sweet at the beginning, then turns bitter towards the end, but this stuff was not like that at all!  Now, it certainly doesn't taste exactly like Coca-Cola, so if that's what you're looking for, this isn't it.  It has great cola flavor though, and is more palatable than artificial sweeteners, both on your tongue and for your health-mindedness.

Today is happy day because I found this product at a health store and sense Artificial Sweeteners isn't working anymore for me I went to Truvia and I had to give up pop both regular and diet :-( will no need to thanks to Stevia there is diet pop I can still use and plus it tastes more sweeter and more real than those yucky chemicals plus I had no problems with it I was happy that I did not have to give up pop :-)  Once again cheers to Stevia for pop and Truvia for being a enhancer taste of stevia and plus making are life's sweeter, happy and finally healthier.Thank you for reading and you are more than welcome to leave a cheers comment to cheer for Stevia.

Often times a diet soda has a terrible bitterness because of the artificial sweeteners used. This is actually quite acceptable. Be aware though that Zevia contains Erythritol as well as Stevia, so it's not just Stevia that is sweetening the flavor.I'll be honest, the flavor is nothing drastically superior to standard diet colas, but it is more the natural method of sweetening that got me to buy this soda as opposed to its flavor. The flavor is subtle, but it's still good. I am going to try their Root Beer flavor next since Root Beer is by far my favorite beverage.

column9: Zero Calorie, All Natural Cola That Tastes Great? Yes!!!
column10: I am a cola junkie. I can't get enough Pepsi, Coke, or even RC Cola. The problem is all the extra calories. I cannot tolerate aspartame or sucralose (poisons!) because they both make me extremely naseated. Now I can drink "diet" soda. It's guilt-free bliss!As a non-diet soda drinker, I really don't mind the slight aftertaste of Zevia cola at all. It's sweet and lingering for the first few sips, but it's barely noticeable after that. From what I remember of Diet Coke and Diet Pepsi, they left a very chemical-tasting coating in my mouth. Not only did they make me physically ill, they tasted awful! Zevia actually tastes good to me, someone who doesn't normally drink diet sodas.If this miracle beverage was a little cheaper, I think everyone, diet and non-diet soda lovers alike, would be enjoying it. I can't wait for the price to drop. That's really the only complaint I have about the product.

column9: This stuff is great!! Too bad no Prime shipping..
column10: This stuff is just as good (to me) as regular diet soda and it's actually not full of artificial crap. Only major drawback is the price. Now if it were eligible for free Amazon shipping I'd be SUCH a happy camper (hint hint hint)..My husband thinks it's awful, so I suppose it's not for everyone, but it tastes great to me. And since he thinks it's so awful, more expensive soda left for me!

When I pay this much for soda, i certainly don't want it to have ingredients derived from genetically modified corn.  The company could easily source non-GMO products, but it refuses to do so.  Probably doesn't want to spend the extra money, but they have no problem charging more than a dollar a can for this swill

Zevia has a sweet after taste like honey rather than a chemical after taste like regular diet drinks.  I was hooked on diet soda until I found Zevia.  I feel so much better about drinking Zevia.  I do like Zevia best when it is ice cold straight from the can rather than chilled with ice, but I also prefer other sodas that way.  I wanted to change what I was drinking and had an open mind when I tried it.  I wasn't expecting it to taste like diet, so I think this prepared me for its sweeter taste.  I prefer it to diet soda now and will continue to buy this as long as its offered!

Zevia Cola Taste Great and doesn't contain those nasty artificial sweeteners.  I'm drinking soda again for the first time in 5 years after tasting it, comes in ZEVIA Natural Orange - With Stevia (Case of 24) and ZEVIA Natural Twist - With Stevia (Case of 24)
I really love this product.  I have yet to taste a Zevia flavor I don't  like.  You can't go wrong with this soda!!

column9: BPA in can liners = I can't drink
column10: I love Zevia Cola, I really do. It doesn't taste exactly like regular cola, but it tastes better than diet (and doesn't have sweeteners that give me migraines). However, I had to stop drinking it because of the BPA in the can liners (which I guess all sodas have). The amount is very small according to the company but I must be sensitive to it because it affected my hormones. So I can't drink it which is a bummer, especially in this heat!

I used to drink diet sodas but they started having unpleasant side effects for me, so I gave up.  I would periodically have a regular soda, but they had HFCS.  So, we started making our own root beer.  Yummy, and with organic sugar.However, today I was at our local grocers and noticed Zevia in the natural foods aisle.  I picked up several different cans to try.  My first one was the grape.  I noticed it wasn't colored purple.  I liked the taste.  I can't wait to try their cola, 'dew', lemon/lime, ginger ale and grapefruit citrus.  I am used to Stevia so if there is any aftertaste (I wasn't aware of any) I am used to it by now.I intend to buy more of this product - love it!

column9: Thrilled to have cola again - what a treat!
column10: I have been using a stevia sweetened drink powder mix and it occured to me that there must be a soda out on the market by now.  Sure enough, I found Zevia at the local Whole Foods.  I started off with the Cola and have been absolutely thrilled by the great taste.  I haven't detected any after taste like some of the other reviewers and I'm usually pretty senstive to that.  The Black Cherry flavor is just incredible.  A very strong cherry flavor that is balanced well with the level of sweetness.  The Ginger Root Beer is quite pleasant, though it doesn't have a "creamy" taste like some sugar sweetened Root Beers.  The Lemon-Lime is fantastic.  I had to give up soda a number of years ago because Aspartame tends to give me heart palpitations and GI upset so Zevia is a real treat for me.

Just got first order of the Diet Cola. It dose taste real sweet at first. It is pretty good soda. Just take a couple cans to get use to the taste. I would buy it againUPDATE I changed it from 5 stars to 3. It has a funny test compaired to regular soda and is really really sweet. After a couple cans you can get use to it. Have to admit for the price I think the name brand stuff is much better.

column9: Helped Me Get Off Diet Coke
column10: I've tried and failed many times to get off of Diet Coke. Only recently, when I switched to Zevia, was I finally able to break the habit. I used Zevia as a substitute until I could get used to drinking teas and water instead, and still have one on occasion if I have the urge for something bubbly. If you're used to Diet Coke, the taste difference is an adjustment, but over time I preferred the Zevia. We've also tried the orange and ginger root beer flavors, and my family enjoys them.I did have one bad shipping experience, where a case was damaged, but this is rare.

These sodas are AWESOME. Yes, they have a slightly artificial flavor, but so does any Diet Soda. They are not as sweet as a Coke or Pepsi and they have ZERO calories. They list the caffeine content: 45mg. There are two others with caffeine: Dr. Zevia (a little less caffeine) and Mt. Zevia (a little more caffeine). Love em!
I like this product! I can't have sugar , have been drinking about one a day for last 3 months, have last wieght and had no sugar problems.

I have Barrett's Esophagus, a pre-cancerous condition.  Phosphoric acid, which is in most colas is on the Barrett's forbidden list (ever notice how well it works for gitting rust of chrome?).  Anyway, before I started drinking Zevia cola, I did some research on fumaric acid, which is what is in Zevia instead of phosphoric acid.
