But, this Amazon delivery system sure beats going to the supermarket and lugging them home, as well as regular savings on the price, instead of having to watch for specials.

Wheat Chex has been a favorite of mine since I was a child (along with Cheerios).It is full of flavor and is nice and crunchy.  It does taste better with milk that has some fat (I use 1% over skim milk).It is a very healthy cereal but diabetics beware...it does have a nice glycocemic spike to it...With that being said, buying it here is a great idea.  It is cheaper than in the grocery stores and you don't have to go anywhere for it...by all means, go on auto ship ever month or two...this reduces the price even further...Enjoy this cereal...it has a nice combination of healthy ingredients along with good taste!
Husbands favorite cereal. The price is very good. An easy and economical way to buy it.
I make sure to get this cereal every time Amazon has it on sale, as everyone in my house loves it.  The little ones can eat it right from the box and it is healthy for all!
I consider this one of the "healthier" choices, among processed breakfast cereals.  I was happy to find it at Amazon.com, since it has become more difficult to locate in grocery stores.

Around the mid 70s Ralston Purina sold the chex cereal collection to General Mills, due to creative accounting and other cost saving measures they changed the formula to the carboard breakfast food it is today. The Old wheat chex R.P. cereal was hearty, nutty and healthy. My grandmother use to fry them up with other things like nuts to serve at bridge games. I remember the old ad campian " so good it was banned in Boston"

column9: Great sugar and a great price
column10: If you're looking for a well priced raw organic sugar with a good flavor you won't do much better than buying this from Amazon.  I really like the flavor of this sugar and while I like some of their Fair Trade sugars a little better (their non-organic Turbinado from Malawi is hard to beat) I've got little kids so I'm trying to stick with organic products when possible.Someone in a previous review claimed this is bleached.  They may be mistaking this for a "brown" sugar (which isn't bleached but it is refined into a white sugar [often using an acid] and then the molasses is added back in).  As the name makes clear this is a raw Turbinado sugar.  That means it is raw cane that is spun in a low speed centrifuge (i.e. "turbine") just enough to remove most of the cane plant detritus.  While this version is raw you can find plenty of Turbinado sugar that has been baked or steamed.You can use this sugar pretty much anywhere you've been using regular white sugar.  If you've got a recipe that calls for bakers sugar then this will probably be too coarse.  This won't melt as easily as white sugar:  I find that around 375 degrees it caramelizes nicely but at 350 I still get crunchy bits of sugar.  I kind of like the crunchy bits but if you don't turn the heat up a notch.  If you are putting this in cereal it won't dissipate as easily as plain white sugar but this isn't something that ever bothered me.  I like that is has a more interesting flavor than white sugar and that lets me use a little less of it.  Anything that helps the waste line is a good thing in my book.Incidentally if you are shopping around and see something called "Demerara" sugar it's just the English name for sugar made in pretty much the same way as Turbinado sugar (there are text book definitions of these things but most of the sugar makes aren't reading them so don't get too worked up about the name).
Turbinado's Raw Sugar is the best out of the many other brands I've tried...This product adds a natural sweet taste, especially whith coffee...Not overpowering, just a smooth natural flavor...
We love turbinado, and this particularly good mix tastes good in everything.  I just wish it came in bulk packaging.

Been purchasing this product for years. I have enjoyed it's dark color and molasses like taste. I opened a new shipment this morning and immediately noticed that the color of the produce has changed. Instead of the usual dark amber color, the sugar is almost blond. Upon tasting it I found that along with the loss of color it has also lost much of it's unique taste. It's almost like using white sugar. I think this will be the LAST order from this supplier for me.

column9: Gosh Darn, This Stuff Is Good!
column10: The title says it all.  Adds so-o-o-o much body and flavor to coffee, baking--anything that you'd could possibly need sugar for.  Moreover, it's actually nutritious.I cook for hunters at our deer camp every fall, and last year I took a half dozen pouches of turbinado raw sugar to use while I was there.  The hunters were skeptical of the stuff at first, but they were game; they gave it a try.  And just raved about how much better their coffee tasted!  Even wrote down the name of the product so they could get some when they went home.  Those guys were so funny in the mornings, lining up for their coffee and discussing the merits of this sugar as if it were going to revolutionize the universe.It doesn't dissolve in cold liquids and takes a few seconds of stirring in hot ones.  Smells kinda funny when you open the bag, too, but, boy oh boy!  This stuff wakes up everything I've used it in.  I've been using this sugar for going on two years--and it's been exactly that long since I bought refined sugar.  Coincidence?  I think not.And with Amazon Prime, it ships for free.  Fantastic product, great price.Nuff said.

I make the crunchy shortbread cookies from the recipe on the bag constantly.  This is a clean tasting sugar but it won't melt in brownies.12 packs is a lot but I am nearly half way through this order and have no regrets buying in bulk.
As the title states this is a great product for any type of sugar replacement and the Amazon price is Great!
We are really in love with this sugar and the price is good. You quickly get addicted to the slight difference of taste in your coffee.

This is my favorite sugar for my morning cup of coffee. It's sweet and has a nice bit of molasses flavor without being too dark or too flavored. It doesn't overwhelm the flavor of my coffee, just adds to it.It's also wonderful on top of sugar cookies hot out of the oven, sprinkled over farina, or just a few crystals sprinkled on homemade chocolate candies. It adds something special. One of my daughter's favorite treats is simply frozen phyllo dough thawed, brushed with a bit of butter and sprinkled with this and baked until golden. It looks very special, and if you fill pockets with Nutella and  a good jam and bake them with a bit of this sprinkled on top you have a very easy dessert that looks and tastes very special.

If you are looking for natural sugar- then end your search right here. I have tried a variety of raw sugar products, I finally found the taste that I ve been looking for in this product. Also this is the least expensive deal I could find for this product so far.

This is the best sugar for taste that money can buy. I use it in all recipes and it makes the best sweet iced- tea! I will use it as long as it stays on the market. Give it a try, you won't return to white sugar again.

When I was a child an annual tradition in the Fall was to buy stalks of sugar cane at the local farmers' market. Our parents would strip the husk and slice the middle into bite-sized pieces for chewing. What a treat!This sugar tastes like that fresh sugar cane juice. It's wonderful.Yes, the crystals are large and don't dissolve as easily as refined white sugar. But hey, you are burning calories for the few extra stirs it takes, and the flavor is worth it!And it's just nice to know that the nutrients are still in there and haven't been processed out.
This sugar is great for coffee and tea, but needs to be stirred a lot in order to dissolve. Also works well sprinkled on top of muffins before baking as a nice sugary coating on top for added flavor.

I have purchased this item and brand several times now, usually in bulk. It is a much healthier alternative to white sugar. We love this in baking, recipes, over oatmeal, really with anything. We use it cup for cup compared to standard sugar and the best deal on it in bulk I have found in our area is through Amazon. I do a lot of baking and making most things from scratch at home to save our family money and eat healthier. This product is a big part of me being able to achieve this. I did have trouble with one order where 1 of the 12 bags had an issue. I contacted Amazon and they replaced the whole order for me. Very very nice and generous. I can not recommend this product enough, very happy with it each and every time I have purchased it!!

I am not a huge sugar user...but I don''t like using white processed sugar at all.A much better alternative - appears to have a lower glycemic index.  I have given some to a few other people who now prefer this, too.
This is a great product & so glad I found it on Amazon-thanks for the good service.

Turbinado, not even organic, sugar runs over $4.00 per pound in our local store. Hubby won't use any sugar replacements and likes the taste of turbinado sugar, so it's the lesser of the evils, I guess.This is truly a fabulous price, especially when using Subscribe and Save. This is enough for almost a year for us.

We love organic raw sugar at my house, but it's so expensive to buy the little boxes at the grocery store.  Not only is this sugar better tasting, but buying bulk brings the price down to a manageable amount.
The sugar is great bit I can't seem to get the "self-sealing" packaging to seal. Twice I've taken a bag from the shelf and spilled it all over! I recommend transferring it to another container.

Looking at the picture on this website, I envisioned a thick curry dish with large slices of bamboo shoots and whole baby corns, but it pours out of the can with the consistency of a thin soup with stringy bamboo shoots no more 5 inches long and 1/8 inch thick. The bamboo shoots have an interesting texture but they are tasteless.  They derive taste from the curry.  For baby corns, you have to fish for them.  I counted five to six pieces of fragments, each for ¼ inch to 3/8 inch long.  They have the texture of dried wood.  The can was labeled 15.4-oz net weight; I estimate that more than 2/3 of it is the watery curry.  It is mildly sweet from the coconut milk and has a pleasant curry favor.  I poured the curry over macaroni and it made a good eat.  Overall, this green curry is okay but not what I expected.

My company had a celebration where this was one of the snacks served. I had one of them and was excited because these are a lot of my favorite nuts in one pouch, which is hard to find. The first thing I did after the celebration was go on Amazon to subscribe to get these regularly. However, I should have looked at the picture more closely before I ordered because when they arrived I was disappointed to find out that the hazel nuts had been "replaced" by walnuts. Everything is exactly the same as the ones I had at work. The package looks the same, they both say "Heart Healthy Mix" on them, except walnuts have been substituted instead of hazel nuts. Unfortunately, hazel nuts are my favorite.Otherwise, these are very good, just not as good (in my opinion) as if they had hazel nuts in them. So minus 1-star for Planters having two versions of the same thing without changing the name.What Amazon is selling (look at the picture of the box closely): Peanuts, Almonds, Pistachios, Pecans, & WALNUTSAlso available, just not on Amazon: Peanuts, Almonds, Pistachios, Pecans, & HAZEL NUTSOne other thing, the "per ounce" price that Amazon is showing is incorrect. This is a "3-pack" (3 separate boxes) of six 1.5 ounce pouches, so there are 18 X 1.5 ounce pouches total. This is a total of 27 ounces. Amazon is doing the calculation as if it is only 4 total ounces, so disregard Amazon's "per ounce" price.

these tasty packets contain peanuts, almonds, pistachios, pecans and walnuts.  high calories, 250 and low carbs 7g.  i do enjoy the size of the packet as it seems to be enough to satisfy a snack craving.  the nuts seem fresh and varied, meaning there is not a lot of one and few of another.  overall a good snack treat.

You would think not much could be said about pouches of nuts, however...Many of these packs had really top quality nuts and a good mix so these are super fresh which is not always the case in "quick grab" packs.I am constantly on the road and usually try not to grab the $1 value menu "heart attack" meals this is a great way to tide me over...here is the other problem with the big tin of nuts, while you are driving you just keep reaching into the tin, with the measured one serving pouch you can just eat one normal serving.Try em out...

column4: James C. Ward "horror and sci-fi fan.."
column10: in the mood for a snack, but don't want to damage your health with ice cream or potato chips?  Then this is a great choice- not only is this mix heart healthy, it comes in convenient pouches that are easy to carry (in your car or office, for example).perfect for a mid-afternoon boost at the office.  Satisfy hunger and give your body nutrients.

Very fresh and great flavor. This is a three box set (18 pouches in all).  They are great to keep in my drawer at work to keep my metabolism from crashing in the afternoons. I also like keeping these on hand for my daughters (for lunches and afternoon snacks).

This particular product is not available at the store I usually use for grocery shopping so I'm thankful it's so easy to get from Amazon.  It's a very good mix of nuts / flavors and very convenient for carrying so it's easy to take with

Bought these for a heart healthy snack for my husband. An admitted "salt-aholic", he was disappointed at first that this mix is salt free, but he has gotten use to it now & seems to enjoy these as a good snack alternative to some of the unhealthy stuff he was indulging in! RECOMMENDED

Not funny hah-hah. Funny peculiar. This stuff tastes old, or rancid. Like oil that's sat around too long. They're not expired, but they taste funny. Putting them in yogurt might mask that, but they shouldn't taste like that to begin with.I won't go to the trouble of returning them, but I won't be ordering them again.

I've bought a couple of boxes of these Planters Nutrition snack packs and both times they were fresh and tasty. They package a good mix of various nuts and for me, they put just the right amount of salt on them.  I also think the portion size is just right. Overall, a great product but they are a little pricey.

The Planters Heart Healthy Mix tastes great.  The bags are a serving size, so you don't have to think about portion control.  The whole nuts are lightly salted and taste fresh. I did the subscribe and save, so I'll always have them available. A great deal for an excellent product.

I used to buy a pack of 18 Planters NUTrition from Sam's club.  They didn't carry them any longer so I tried these.  They are much better.  I do not like hazelnuts and this package doesn't have them.  It has quite a few peanuts, but still a good variety.
Either the reviewers here are Planter's employees, or I got a bad batch.  Each type of nut tasted exactly the same as the other, which is the taste of PLASTIC!!!  Absolute worst nuts ever.
These were good, but I would have liked a more even flavor mix. By far the majority of the drops were lemon or lime. Some bags had no orange or grapefruit at all.

it's a great substitute for other drops I used with too much sugar and god knows what else in them. don't have too many at the same time though, it's real vitamin c in there and peels too much of the skin in your mouth and can get painful! I had 15 in one day and it didn't work out too well :) but overall I'm happy with the product. both adults and kids around me love them too.
Such fresh, fruity flavors, with a nice tartness so they don't become cloying.  Really delish with true fruit taste.  Some of the best hard candies I've ever had!
YummyEarth products taste good.  I am cold free thus far so maybe these vitamin C drops help.

column9: tastes great & the kids love um!!
column10: I try to buy organic and was browsing through the grocery section of amazon when i saw these. i decided to try them because of the price and because cold & flu season is here. hoping with enough vitamin c the family will stay healty. my kids LOVE these. they are fairly small, smaller in size then a dime, maybe @ the size of a wide kids marker( not the tip). for my 1 yr old, i bit it into pieces while the wrapper was on. of course when my older boys were eating them, he wanted some too. i was going back to order more, but they were sold out. i ordered the lollipops this time, they were on backorder. we are going on an airplane in a few weeks and i'm going to try & get as much vitamin c in my kids as possible. they really liked these and all 6 packages were gone in no time. i brought a pouch to work with me too, they really are good!

These country-specific Cachet chocolates are, in my opinion, the best available anywhere. Costa Rica and Uganda tie, for me, as the best darks. Each has its own personality (Uganda's has a bit more of a fruity bite to it), and when you let it melt slowly in your mouth... outstanding!

We had been buying this same dark chocolate under the label "Hägeland" for a few years now.  Under that name, it was limited to a well-known big box store.  They stopped carrying the product recently, which I don't understand because this chocolate is sooo good.  When my mother-in-law called the number on the Hägeland label to ask where we might buy it, she was told to check Amazon under this name.I am far from a chocolate connoisseur, so I can't use fancy words to describe color, aroma, texture, or flavor.  I just know tasty and not tasty.  This one is quite tasty.  The thing that set this chocolate apart for us was the lack of soy lecithin which is used as an emulsifier in most other chocolate bars.  To me, the soy lecithin gives other chocolates a bit of a waxy consistency.  (Don't get me wrong, if it's chocolate, I'll eat it happily. However, this one is our favorite.)  If you're looking for simple, reliably delicious, dark-but-not-too-bitter chocolate bar, please give this one a try.  I'd love to see them do well on Amazon.

This is the best dark chocolate for the price that I have ever had.  I just called the company on the back of the bar and they told me to check Amazon.com as well.  I was buying it under the Hageland label from Walmart and then all of a sudden it was unavailable. :(  My favorite is the Costa Rica.  You can't go wrong with this chocolate.

I don't think I'd be a girl if I didn't love chocolate.  I don't think anything could be better than matching raspberry with chocolate.  My sister-in-law buys these chocolate covered raspberries (in bulk!!!) and so I ordered this matcha hoping that it would satisfy me enough so I wouldn't steal her stash and become 400 pounds!  I opened this matcha and was pleasantly surprised to smell chocolate!  I couldn't seem to smell the raspberry in it.  I put it into a tin to keep it fresh, if it'll make it very long.  The small size fits perfect in the tin with a little wiggle room...enough to be able to get the measuring spoon in.I really wasn't sure how I wanted to prepare this matcha.  First I prepared it with just 1 tsp matcha and 16.9oz of water.  It was ok, but not really what I was looking for.  I seemed to get more chocolate from it this way and not enough raspberry flavor.  SO, next I heated up some milk, added a bit of sugar and frothed it up into a latte.  Now here is where I get more of the raspberry.  It's a nice creamy truffle.On a side note, I'll be learning to make truffles from tea as a local tea shop this week so maybe I'll be able to use what I have left in making a tea truffle!  You can never go wrong with chocolate and raspberries that don't make you gain weight.THANKS again Red Leaf for another wonderful matcha creation....keep'em comin'!To get your own tasty Raspberry Truffle Matcha from Red Leaf Tea - GO HERE NOW!!!![...]

So I just have to say this matcha is delicious!  It tastes like a rasberry truffle and the lingering taste after you drink it is exactly like the lingering taste that is left when you eat an actual truffle.  Besides the great taste Red Leaf has terrific customer service!
This reminds me of summer. Just picked berries on the vine paired with a sweet matcha and chocolate. Did I mention the chocolate?  Yum!

column9: Wow how do they do this?
column10: My daughter picked this one out - she LOVES truffles and of course raspberry is one of her favorites. She has not got to try it yet as she is at work but I had to sneak a bit since I was putting my matcha powders into their tins.So this one has a very nice raspberry flavor, although I seem to be missing the chocolate flavor, not that I taste no chocolate but its not like the chocolate matcha flavor.  However truffles have a very distinctive flavor to them - which for me is difficult to describe, but this does taste very true to an actual truffle and not simply to flavors of matcha mixed together. So its not just some chocolate flavor with raspberry flavor but however this was blended with whatever ingredients it is true to that truffle aroma and flavor. I wish I could explain the flavor I am talking about maybe it is some kind of special nut oil that is used or something but there is just a flavor to truffles that is different and this matcha absolutely has captured it!So today I began with the preparation of the matcha and was going to do my typical latte but last minute before adding the creamer decided to use a scoop of natural vanilla ice cream hubby was so lovely to pick up for me. So my blend included the prepared matcha along with some ice cubes, a quarter cup of milk, and a small scoop of ice cream. It was not that amazing of a plan since the ice cubes and ice cream wanted to be stubborn but I took a long tea spoon and mixed it up and ate it something like a float.Mmmmm absolutely delicious! The raspberry truffle flavor popped along with the creamy ice cream here and there in a milky frothy treat!The lingering after taste is what is most astounding! I had this matcha latte shake concoction over 15 minutes ago and I am still tasting raspberry chocolaty goodness in my mouth!Of course as always Red Leaf Tea's matcha base is outstanding!

As I was considering which flavored matcha I would try next from Red Leaf Tea, I was stumped. There are so many amazing flavors! However, this Raspberry Truffle matcha caught my eye fairly quickly and I knew that I had to give it a try. I am a sucker for all things chocolate, particularly super rich truffles of all flavors. I had very high expectations for this matcha and I have to say that it more than exceeded my expectations! You can find out more about this matcha here: [...]Once again, I was very pleased by the intense aroma as I opened the package. I could have sworn that somebody just opened a very expensive box of raspberry truffles somewhere in my kitchen. The matcha was a very bright green color despite being flavored. I first tried this traditionally as a hot bowl of matcha in my chawan. Initially, the slight bitterness of the matcha hits your palate, but it is followed by an intense and slightly sweet raspberry flavor with the chocolate aspect occurring more in the aftertaste. I love how the aftertaste lingers several minutes after your last sip and I also appreciate that the matcha was very easy to whisk with no noticeable clumps. While this is a super awesome way to drink this matcha, I just had to try it as a cold latte since it is so unbelievably hot here in Texas.For the cold latte I added a healthy scoop of this Raspberry Truffle matcha and milk into a blender bottle and shook it all up. Once again the matcha blended beautifully without any clump which is something I've noticed in other matchas when preparing them with a cold liquid. Although I didn't add any sweetener, the matcha seems a little sweeter now, but not by any means overly so. I also think that the flavor profile is a bit more balanced at this temperature. The bitter edge of the matcha is almost non-existent and the raspberry and chocolate flavors are more unified as a raspberry truffle would be. It is quite refreshing on this hot day and I was impressed that it didn't settle out even after being left on the counter for 10+ minutes.Overall, this is another big success from Red Leaf Tea! Not only is the tea quite tasty, their customer service is amazing. My order arrived within 2 business days! If you haven't tried anything from this company, you are missing out!
This is very tasty, makes  a bland burger have great taste, just with a simple turn of the grinder. I will be ordering this again in the future!

Usually I skip writing reviews for my purchases, but this time I was really impressed by the great service.I've ordered this tea as a Christmas gift for my mom, I've paid standart shipping and recieved my package the next day of my order.I found it really cute that the sticker on the packaging said "Hand Blend Irina" ( Irina being my mom's name)I haven't tried the tea yet, but it passed the sniff test, and it has real black currant berries and leafs in it.Lately it was really hard to find Black Currant loose leaf black tea, and I was really glad to find this seller who has it and provides such a wonderful service.Great Job!!!
I used this tea to make a black currant ice cream from the Perfect Scoop book. It tasted great! The tea has a beautiful smell.
Great tea with a full body flavor.  Much better than other currant teas that I have tried.  Would make a great iced tea as well.
It is a great replacement for rice. Tastes good. Very easy and quick to prepare.

These large boxes offere more than we can eat at one sitting, I like the plain version because I can add my own spices.  The texture is perfect, the taste is great, the price is right.  Great change from rice.

This is an absolute yum!! It will be different from the curds and jams you may already enjoy... but spread this a warm, fresh scone and you will be hooked! I hope it will be available soon as I have scone baskets in mind for gift giving this season.

column9: An excellent alternative to candy or other snack bars.
column10: These bars are fantastic tasting.  They do have 7g sugar per bar (for a 36g bar that's nearly 20% sugar).  For people with a sweet tooth like me, these are a great alternative to other chocolate, candy, and less healthy snack bars.  Sure, there are plenty of things out there that are better for you, but I've yet to find any that taste like this.These bars are great, but the Kellogg's FiberPlus Bars, Dark Chocolate Almond, 5 Bars, 6.3-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) are even better!Here is the full nutritional information per 1.2oz bar:120 Calories (40 fat calories), 4g Total Fat (2g saturated fat), 0mg Cholesterol, 55mg Sodium, 26g Total Carbohydrates (9g dietary fiber, 7g sugars), 2g Protein.10% Calcium, 4% Iron, 20% Vitamin E, 20% Zinc.

column9: VERY tasty, but BEWARE THE AFTERMATH!
column10: These fiber bars are so tasty. My favourites are the peanut butter and the coconut chocolate ones. The coconut ones taste like Samoa Girlscout cookies. So because my husband loves them too, we were buying them in bulk and eating them every morning for breakfast. However, several weeks into this routine I noticed I was experiencing higher than normal gas activity...and REALLY stinky gas too. I couldn't understand what was wrong and was actually considering seeing a doctor because it was really getting out of hand and embarassing. However, due to a lack of sale prices on the fiber bars, they were unavailable to me for breakfast for about a week. After 3 days of not eating them anymore, I noticed my gas problem COMPLETELY disappeared. So, as with most things, enjoy these delicious treats...only in moderation! If anyone else if having the gas issues and can't figure out why - try cutting these out for a while!Eek!

I'm a guy with stomach problems and need more fiber in my diet so i switched over to fruits and vegetables and these. These are really good and have a substantial amount of fiber, and its a good price. So these are not just for women as the commercial usually only includes women while advertising these.

column9: Kellogs Fiber Plus Bars! My new Favorite Candy Bar
column10: I found these at the grocery store about a year ago and thought I would try them. I need all of the fiber I can get and they are 120 calories. The first time I ate one I was shocked at how good it was. They are better than any candy bar that I have ever eaten. My daughters even love them. Needless to say I am addicted to them. It also helps knowing that when I eat one it is not nearly as bad for me as a candy bar. I would definately ecommend that everyone ty thse bars. They come in Chocolate Chip and Clocolate Chip with Almonds.  Hope this helps

With subscription it comes to 2.50 per box or 50 cents per 1.2 oz bar.  A reasonable price and I do not have to remind my wife to get them for me at the store.I keep these handy at work.  If I get hungry and do not have time to eat, these tide me over quite nicely and are very tasty and handily satisfy my chocolate cravings if I am under a lot of stress (which I used to fulfill with Fastbreaks which, per oz, have 40% more total calories, 60% more fat calories and 1/7th the fiber).I actually prefer the chocolatey peanut butter, however it seems to come and go from Amazon's offerings: FiberPlus Antioxidant Bars, Chocolatey Peanut Butter, 5-Count Bars (Pack of 6)There are many alternatives out there, but I find that these have the best ratio of taste, cost and nutrition out there right now.Warning 1: Some people have trouble breaking down chicory root fiber and may wind up with more gas than they'd like, but like beans, there is a good chance it will go away with repeat consumption.Warning 2: There are a lot of man-made ingredients and many would not consider that to be "healthy".Another big bonus with Amazon subscription is that they are probably a LOT fresher than the stuff you buy in the grocery stores.  It may be coming directly from the factory as it arrives in a Kellogg box, not an Amazon box (tho it does have an Amazon return address).

I used to bring one of these tasty bars to school with me every day for a little snack. I realized that I had been more gassy than lately but didn't think too much about the cause. Then my grandma would comment on how they made her gassy all day & I thought maybe these were to blame but wasn't too sure. I just had one again for the first time in a while & was passing gas all day :/... Now I'm sure these things are the cause. I'm sure it affects everyone differently though. But for taste, these are delicious especially if you're looking for a little extra fiber in your diet. Next time I eat one of these bars I'll be sure that I'm staying home all day.

This is a great way to get your daily fiber intake, and satisfy your sweet-tooth in a guilt-free way at the same time.  I take two or three of these to work every day, and particularly enjoy them with a hot cup of coffee around lunch time and mid-afternoon.  I am getting my daily fiber intake and enjoying a chocolately cookie/cake/candy bar (and it tastes like it can pass for all three), which doesn't make me feel deprived of my love for chocolate.My husband, who normally turns up his nose at anything that remotely sounds like healthy eating, just loves these bars (we get the chocolate chip, although I like the almond dark chocolate as much, but he doesn't).  In fact, he's the one who insisted we get these on auto-ship, and we look forward to receiving these once a month.We tried the Fiber-One cranberry bars, but they were hard and brittle, and reminded me of something a person could break a tooth on.  I got about a third of the way through one and threw the rest away.It takes a little adjusting to at first, if your system is not used to a steady intake of fiber.  Just increase your daily intake of water to keep things moving as they should.  Eventually, you'll adjust to this change in your diet.Try a box at the supermarket, and if you agree with my review, get them on auto-ship from Amazon.  The price is great and the convenience can't be beat!

Fiber plus is delicious for breakfast, or anytime.  The only thing I did not like about FP is the 10 grams/sugar per bar!  If they could make it with Stevia, or some good artificial sweetener, it would be a five-star product.

I barely incorporated fiber into my diet (so you can imagine how hard it must have been on me). I started out eating the Fiber One bars. Boy, it was really really harsh on me. They tasted a bit dry and somewhat hard to swallow. Then I saw the Fiber Plus bars. They are so much better! Softer, more chewy, and much easier to eat (even better because of the huge chocolate flavor). And the digestion wasn't as harsh as the Fiber One bars. I highly recommend these to fiber starters. They're easier to eat than other fiber bars (in my opinion).

column9: Great source of fiber and tastes even better with peanut butter!
column10: As someone who is supposed to get 30 grams of fiber into my diet everyday, I know what a challenge it can be to find foods with more than 2 or 3 grams per serving.  I actively search for good sources of fiber and this is one of the best ones.  I eat one bar a day for a snack in the afternoon.  This bar, plus a bowl of a high fiber cereal I like, helps me to reach my goals.Also if you like peanut butter and aren't counting calories, try slathering some peanut butter on this fiber bar.  Tastes awesome!

The Chocolate Chip FiberPlus bars are delicious.  I have found that I must hide them from my kids.  My 15 year old son has his friends over and they all like to steal my FiberPlus Bars.  There is no funny after taste and they are soft but not too chewy.
I love these bars. They are like a dessert, yet they are chock full of fiber and other awesome things.

I was looking for a granola bar that I can grab and go in mornings when I don't have time for breakfast. I came across this box and thought I'll give it a try since it's low in calorie, relatively healthy, and the picture looks appealing. When I tried it, I didn't like it at all. It was the chocolate part that made the granola bar taste kinda synthetic. In my opinion, the chocolate doesn't even taste like real chocolate. However, the granola part tasted fine. I'll have to go back and look for another brand of granola bar.
We are trying to make some healthy changes in our diet this year.  These bars are so tasty....I eat them as a snack and as a substitute for dessert.  Try them...you will love them!
I ordered this and received the box with a bunch of the product boxes inside.  These will last me for a long time at my pace of two bars a day.  They taste great and are an excellent source of fiber.

Well... filling enough to at least get me most of the way too lunch.  Trying to cut back on junk food and these are a decent way to help fill gaps and have the chocolate sweetness i crave. OVerall a good choice

column9: Best tasting way to get fiber. Though not health food
column10: First off I think these taste really good. Much of it has to do with all the chocolate that is in them.  I like them better than Fiber One bars which use Chicory Root extract as the main ingredient vs chocolate.  For me they taste like candy bars but have 35% of the daily allowance of fiber so you do get something from these you don't get from candy bars. They are the best tasting way of increasing fiber in your diet I know of, even if not the most healthy.  Just be aware that they are essentially "candy bars with benefits" with all the chocolate and sugar and limit your intake accordingly. They are most certainly not health food but if you need to increase your fiber intake and are finding it difficult these will do the job.  There are other healthier ways of accomplishing that, I generally eat very healthy food and incorporate cracked flax seed in to my protein shakes for example.  But these are fast easy and taste good and sometimes it is OK to take the easy way out once in a while. Just trying to present the facts as I see them, you make the decision. These are small bars comprising of 120 calories that taste like a candy bar, a pretty easy way to get that fiber.  No real secrets here, they have a lot of chocolate in them and you can see that in the picture and in the description.  And it is true that you do get a lot of fiber in a small package.  It is easy to add vitamins to anything and claim they contain vitamins and minerals or antioxidants.  Even the most sugary cereal made for children will have vitamins and minerals added to help their image.  So these are definitely NOT in the health food section.  So again, bottom line these taste great, have a lot of fiber in them, especially for their size, but otherwise are about as healthy as a candy bar.As for price this has fluctuated on Amazon, historically they have been significantly less expensive here but not always.  Typically buying these on Amazon in a 60 count which is either six 10 packs or twelve 5 packs (check both to find the best price, sometimes they are different) I have purchased these in the past for around $.40/bar.  In the grocery store, when not on sale I find they usually cost $50-$.65/bar.

column9: Delicious! like a candy bar but BETTER!
column10: So a delicious treat, portable, and only 120 calories! I love them. I also like the coconut fudge (i think that's the flavor) because it tastes like the girl scout samoas (or caramel delites depending on region). Such a great snack.Keep these on hand if you ever find yourself in a pinch or get snack attacks that require something sweet--guilt free indulgence!

For anyone who has ever tried FiberOne bars and broken a tooth, I highly recommend these instead.  They taste great and you physically eat them.  I can't say the same for FiberOne.  I can't even eat one bite of a FiberOne bar.  Not sure what they're made out of but it isn't edible.  FiberPlus is fantastic.

column9: Very Yummy!  This is my 3rd order
column10: I ordered these after receiving a sample in the mail.  They were delicious!  My husband and I were looking for ways to increase the amount of fiber we get in our diet and this fit the bill.  It also works perfectly for those chocolate and sweet tooth cravings.The chocolate is very rich and you would never know you were eating something healthy.  We order them by the case through Amazon via subscription because it is much cheaper than in the stores and it's much healthier than running to the store for a Snickers!![...]

column9: Great alternative for a sweet snack
column10: My family loves these bars. My father in law is addicted to chocolate, so the last time I saw him stuffing a three muskateers in his mouth I swapped it with one of these; we're trying to get him to eat a bit healthier.  Unfortunately he stole another one while I wasn't looking and two hours later was on the pot! Needless to say, he likes them.  Yet, be careful not to over indulge, these little bars have more fiber than a serving of most cereals.
I've been munching on these for over a year. Love the taste and ummmm....the fiber works! I also chop them up and mix them into my morning hot oatmeal for a double dose of fiber and yumminess.

column9: Better than Fiber One bars, better than any high fiber treat out there!
column10: So if you want a candy bar, but want to eat well, grab one of these and prepare to be impressed!  These really do taste just like a candy bar, such a healthier alternative to a grocery store candy.  I eat one of these after lunch as a treat to provide a fix for my sweet tooth.  I find it is less gas inducing if I treat it like dessert and eat it after a meal.  I do get a bit of bloating if I eat it on an empty tummy.  A friend of mine who turned me onto these says the gassiness goes away once you are used to eating more fiber in your diet.  I have started increasing my fiber with more fresh produce, so I anticipate better digestion of all things in a few weeks.  I highly recommend these!NOTE: I would like to add that if you normally eat candy bars, cookies or pastries and switch to eating one these instead -- that is a great choice.  However, I am not saying to choose one of these over a piece of fruit which is clearly better for you.  These are healthier "junk food" that provide a nice shot of fiber and less sugar than most temptations out there.

column9: Items are very fresh. Important in a 10-Pack.
column10: These 10 packs of fiber plus boxes contain 60 bars. I was worried about a nearly approaching expiration date. But these are far better than the grocery stores! Purchased in February, Expires in September! That's 8 months of freshness for a 1 month supply. Great deal! Fast 2 day shipping when I ordered them.Subscriber.

These have quickly become one of my favorite breakfast products.  They have an excellent texture and consistency and a great flavor.  The serving size is appropriate (although I usually eat two if I that's all I am eating for breakfast).  In comparison to the similar FiberOne bars, I would pick FiberPlus bars everytime as they have the feel and taste of a traditional chewy granola bar (the supplemental fiber is not pronounced as I found it to be in the FiberOne bars).In terms of portability, FiberPlus bars are excellent for slipping in a bag or a pocket without having to worry about ending up with a pacakge of crumbs.  I recommend FiberPlus bars for anyone looking for a healthier alternative to the traditional granola bar.

column9: Great Tasting Fiber Rich Bar - Highly Recommended
column10: The Kellogg's Chocolate Chip "FiberPlus Antioxidant Bars" are surprisingly good tasting and are very filling. My wife bought me these to use as snack bars since I try to keep my total Carb intake as low as possible, and the high fiber content gives these each of these about 17 Net Carbs. They also have 120 Calories and about 2g of Protein.The flavor is a lot better than most of other high fiber snack bars I have tried and these will become one of my regular treats.Highly Recommended! I also like FiberPlus Antioxidant Bars, Dark Chocolate Almond, 5-Count Bars (Pack of 12).CFH

column9: My Kids LOVE This Granola Bar

column9: The "Elegant" Soyabella? Let me save you some pain!
column10: My family and I have been drinking soy and rice milk for a number of years and this machine seemed to be a good solution as I wanted to cut down on our grocery bill. After learning more about the problems with tetra-pak containers, I was completely turned off.I purchased the "Elegant" Soyabella and wanted to share my own personal experience. I was initially excited to receive my machine and begin making my first batch of milk. Overall, I found the Soyabella to be very problematic.I read the manual and followed the instructions carefully but when I made my first batch of milk it continued to boil over leaving my counter a sticky mess. After 3 unsuccessful attempts, I did finally get it to complete a batch of milk where I encountered even more undesirable results.To begin with, the milk screen was very difficult to remove as the handle on the bottom is so small that you have no hope in ever getting a finger underneath the handle let alone actually grabbing it to take off the cup. The milk turned out quite pulpy as the milk screen holes are quite large and it didn't grind the beans completely.When I cleaned my machine I found that I had to be extra cautious as the blade is very sharp. Although it is an advertised benefit, I found that having the heater in the base of the milk jug was more of a pain as when the jug has milk in it, it is quite heavy. I also found it difficult to clean because the mess from boiling over each time created a hot sticky mess all over the machine. The jug contains a lot of electrical stuff and obviously it is not made to get wet but in order to clean, it is nearly impossible and time consuming.I realized my hour of efforts yielded less than 1 quart of milk. I found the manual very vague and surely not helpful. I tried making "rice paste" expecting to get rice milk and let's just say, I am not even going to go there!!Thinking that my errors where a result of my own mistakes, I did some research online and found that I was not alone. To my relief many others have experience similar problems. I returned my machine and although discouraged about making home made milk, my continued research led me to buy the new SoyQuick Premier. I am completely amazed by the difference between the two machines. I am not going to go into details but I highly recommend the SoyQuick Premier for anyone looking to make trouble free milks. Here is the link: SoyQuick Premier Milk Maker 930P I have already posted a review as I am really impressed.To summarize; I would not recommend buying the Soyabella at all. I hope that my review and experience will save others a lot of time, effort and the extra money to ship back your Soyabella.

Erythritol is the bulk sweetener that the sugar free food manufacturers should be using. It has many advantages over the ones most used by the manufacturers such as maltitol, sorbitol, mannitol, lactitol and xylitol. First, Erythritol has only 5 calories per ounce while the others have between 40 and 90 calories per ounce. Also, Erythritol has a glycemic index near zero while the others can be as high as in the 50's such as maltitol syrup. A low glycemic index is highly desirable as it does not cause an insulin spike which is a problem for those of us who are prone to overeat. Also, and most importantly, Erythritol has a far better laxation threshold than the others. For the uninitiated, this means that one can eat twice (or three times) as much erythritol as the others before having to go to the bathroom. Some of the candy makers used to use Erythritol in their sugar free candy bars but they stopped and substituted maltitol. Hershey foods in particular should bow their heads in shame as they had the best product made with Erythritol and ruined it with maltitol. The new maltitol laced product has more calories and is more likely to cause the "Runs." I sometimes think the candy companies are in league with the toilet paper companies. I use erythritol to make my own sugar free candy along with a good brand of unsweetened baking chocolate (e.g. Callebaut, Valrhona) along with some fiber such as inulin or polydextrose. If you do not wish to make your own candy with this product you can find some excellent ones on the internet that use Erythritol such as choco-perfection bars or chocolite bars.

Hi, I have a son with Candida (severe yeast problem) so we have run the gamut as far as trying alternative NATURAL sweetners that are ULTRA LOW on the glycemic index. Erytritol while containing NO calories is more like 1/2 the sweetness of Xylitol, I know they say it is 1/3 less but you really, REALLY need two times as much in our experience. While it does NOT have any funny aftertaste as some stevia brands do & we LOve the fact that it is ZERO calories, we find that a home made blend of all 3 works the best. Stevia also has no calories & xylitol has 2/3 of table sugar. So if you are dieting or have blood sugar issues this is a good viable alternative with no negative effects like the UNnatural products like sucralose AKA Splenda & Nutrasweet have.., howbeit a PRICEY one!

I'm giving this five stars because it does everything an alt sugar should. It tastes wonderful (I had no objections to its so-called "cooling effect.") In fact, the stevia/erythritol combo is what you get with Truvia, only here it's without Cargill's creepy secrecy about its methods and "natural flavors."HOWEVER. If you have Crohn's or severe IBS, think twice before ordering erythritol. There isn't enough written out there, but you may find it triggering severe symptoms, including intestinal bleeding, as it has for me. Below a certain threshold, I don't seem to feel any effects, but even the modest amount contained in two brownies was enough to cause a night of bleeding, nausea and overall misery. I wish I'd known about the IBS connection before -- although I will say my husband tolerates this beautifully, as do most people, and if you can, it's an excellent way to mollify your sweet tooth without packing on the pounds.

I've been using Erythritol for a little over a year now.  The added bonus to this particular brand is that they assure it's non-GMO!  I had been using Truvia, which is extremely expensive, especially if trying to bake with it!  I found a recipe for how to make my own Truvia with Erytritol and Stevia.  SO easy to make at a fraction of the cost of Truvia, and again, I know all my sweetner is non-GMO too.Not sure if everyone knows though that Erythritol does not melt like sugar.  In order to make it work in recipes, you really need to "powder" it if using in recipes.  Just put it in your coffee mill, Ninja, Vitamix....something that has a high processing speed and just blend it until it's powdered.  DO NOT open the lid until it's all settled though.  Otherwise, your kitchen will be coated in sweet white powder!!  Anyway, am posting the blend to make your own Truvia and the conversions for sugar to the homemade granular Truvia and also the powdered Truvia conversions.  Hope this helps some of you bakers out there.  It sure has been great for my own cooking/baking!Homemade "Truvia" SweetenerMakes 1/4 cup sweetener substitute1/8 teaspoon good tasting stevia extract (I use NuNaturals pure white stevia extract)1/4 cup erythritolAdd ingredients to plastic baggie. Shake baggie well to mix sweeteners.**To replace 1 cup of Truvia, mix 1/2 teaspoon of pure stevia extract with 1 cup erythritol. Enjoy!TRUVIA CONVERSION (spoonable)2 teaspoons sugar = 3/4 teaspoon Truvia (1 1/4 teaspoons powdered Truvia)1/4 cup sugar = 1 tablespoon plus 1 1/2 teaspoons Truvia (2 tablespoons plus 1 1/2 teaspoons Powdered Truvia)1/2 cup sugar = 3 tablespoons Truvia (1/4 cup plus 1 tablespoon powdered Truvia)1 cup sugar = 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons Truvia 1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons powdered Truvia)
This works for me...........about 1/3 less sweet than sugar,so you use a little more, but it bakes well, cookies, biscotti,muffins, tea, coffee
