For a long time, I had trouble making myself use olive oil for cooking or on salads...I knew I ought to, but couldn't stand the flavor of the oils I could find. After seeing this reviewed by Cooks Illustrated, I ordered it from Amazon and tried it....so very glad I did! No off flavors, never rancid tones...Excellent on green salads, with a bit of vinegar or roasted garlic....also, delightful for a flavorful--but not overpowering--addition in cooking, on pasta, grilled vegetables, etc. I keep it on hand now and use it frequently. As I open the last bottle, I get ready to order another so I won't run out!

After reading the excellent Tom Mueller book Extra Virginity Extra Virginity: The Sublime and Scandalous World of Olive Oil - I decided to explore some...real olive oil. Far from the supermarket brands I've had for $8 a liter, this Columela costs 4x as much, so I was a bit nervous. Silly me. It's so superior to generic olive oils that I fear I've been ruined for life. No longer will I be able to dip my bread in the schlock from the local Italian restaurant. Nay, I may need to carry my own.Words of warning - this is delicious, and you will find yourself using a lot more than you used that garbage before. You will also be tempted to pair it with good bread, good vegetables, and good pasta. It may entice you to cook more at home. Do not taunt Columela olive oil. It's delicious. Try some.

column9: Tastiest (easy to buy) EVOO for the price.
column10: I bought this because of Cooks Illustrated and do not regret the decision.  I use it less for sauteing and more for salads and dipping, but when I do use it for sauteing it works well.  It is really good, tastes clean with a real nice olive taste.

This Columela olive oil tastes like it must have crack in it.  It is so damn good that my inclination is to drink it straight out of the bottle while the pasta is still cooking!!  Columela is too expensive to do an every day stir-fry, but it is BY FAR the best EVOO that I have found for "fancier" pastas and meals.Fast shipment, and the bottles were very well protected.  You've got yourself a repeat customer.
The best EVOO I've ever tasted. Try THIS with your dipping spices  - you'll never go back to the cheap stuff...

column9: A good work a day olive oil
column10: Taking the review of this olive oil from Cooks Illustrated, I wanted to evaluate their recommendation.  I found it to be a good everyday working olive oil.  It is fragrant without overpowering weekday ingredents,and its price makes it reasonable for day to day use.  I found it to be a good oil for saute in tomato and light sauces.  I recommend it for cooking purposes rather than for dipping.

Not sure I can find 20 words to describe the flavor and aroma of this olive oil.  Great for bread dipping and salad. Have used it for short frying, sauteing and is excellent for that.  Can't say enough about it, both my sons and their respective families enjoy it too and would not use any other.  The Company is very responsive and responsible, quicker delivery than I would have expected.

Totally delish!  Have never had an olive oil that tasted this great...love it, and to be able to get it shipped to me is an added plus.I use it for salads and it's very good with hummus sprinkled on top along with some pine nuts.
Highly rated by Cooks Illustrated.  I concur, this is wonderful oil. Ok, I will add more words.  Now I have 20.

Received this very soon after ordering, can't remember now exactly how long.  It was very well packaged.  I had a birthday party soon after, serving Italian food, and did some crostini with this and various toppings, some garlic oil, and also used it in the salad dressing.  Everyone said they liked it, and this is my family, they wouldn't hesitate to say otherwise.

This olive oil is the best value for the money.  I have purchased other more expensive brands but none matched the flavor and quality of this one.  I highly recommend this over anything else out there.I will be buying this for Christmas presents this year.

I like this oil very much.It has a distinct flavor, strong enough to be enjoyed but not overwhelming.I have not encountered another olive oil that I prefer over it, and I've tried other brands that many recommend and claim to be superior.  It's simply the best olive oil that I have tasted.I purchased the two pack as a gift for my mom, and now she is hooked too.

When I read my Cook's Illustrated review of this olive oil, I just had to try it. Low and behold, my local grocery store actually had it! They never have things I need/want, so I grabbed 3 bottles of it and it's true...this olive oil is phenomenal. It has a very mild flavor. No bitter aftertaste either. This is the olive oil you use on salads and dipping bread. It's truly fantastic stuff! I am running low, so when I was at my grocery store the other day I went to grab 3 more bottles AND THEY DON'T HAVE IT ANYMORE! That's why I'm here...to buy more on Amazon...my go-to-store-when-my-USELESS-grocery-store-stops-selling-things-I-must-have. Amazon ROCKS. I knew I would find this here. If you're looking for some very good olive oil, look no further. This is it.

This is an excellent EVOO. Wonderful as a plain salad dressing or with pairing with low fat crumbled blue cheese to make a  healthier version of blue cheese dressing. Also excellent when combined with Lucini Balsamic vinegar.As some reviewers in a popular cooking magazine have said: "it taste like olive oil should". It has a very clean and fruity taste.

This is the extra virgin olive oil that won the taste test at America's Test Kitchen. That's where I found it, and decided to give it a try. Well, this is a terrific extra virgin olive oil. This is what you want to dip GOOD bread into with good Italian food, and what you want to use to make a good salad a great salad. Don't waste it on throwing it into the frying pan on high heat.I will definitely buy it again.

I bought Columela because it had gotten such praise from other reviewers and on other websites.  I did a blind taste test of the Columela against my favorite olive oil from O&Co, which is, admittedly, somewhat more expensive.  I did not like the Columela.  My bottle does not have a fruity taste.  Instead, it is somewhat bitter, and I found the taste somewhat unpleasant.  I would much rather pay a little more and get a much tastier oil from O&Co.

Great product for it's superb fruity flavor paired with artisan bread to induce perpetual bread dipping bliss.  You like Rosemary Artisan Bread?  You like that shit dipped in olive oil goodness?  Yes!?  Put a bit of Balsamic Vinegar in there with some ground peppercorns and you got yourself a snack to end all snacks.  Pair it up with some cured meats, grapes and wine.  Or take it to the ultimate level = Italian salami, prosciutto, kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, Swiss cheese, roasted red bell peppers, pepperoncini, fresh sliced roma tomatoes, fresh soft mozzarella & fresh basil, sprinkle some Parmesan to finish her off... drizzle this Virgin OO all over that palate.
This is  great and fruity tasting olive oil.  It is wonderful as a dipping sauce, and adds depth of flavor to salad dressings.

column9: The only olive oil I buy
column10: At first I was a bit put off by the price. Then I got to thinking about all the money I'd spent on EVOO that didn't taste good. I took the plunge and wow what a difference. It also was recommended by America's Test Kitchens. The taste is very mellow at first- then the slight grapefruit taste (to me) kicks in. It is a surprise, but not an unpleasant one.

My son and I love this EVOO.  I am even sending out two packs as XMAS presents for my siblings. As advertised it has a very light texture with a floral nose and notions of fruit on the palate. I am writing this review even as I have another two pack in my shopping cart.

I found out about this olive oil on the American Test Kitchen website. They rated it the best so I decided to try it out.  I really love the taste and try to use it spareingly. I would highly recommende to anyone looking for a really good Olive Oil.
Top rated by Cooks Illustrated, my trusted equipment and ingredient authority.  It's certainly a full flavored olive oil.

Full, round, rich, delicious taste.  Smooth with absolutely no bite or bitterness.  I use it only, and always, when the taste of olive oil will be a major part of a dish ... i.e. on fresh bread or toast, over a simple pasta, over fresh tomatos and mozzarella.  No comparison with any of the many other olive oils I've tasted.  And no more expensive than mediocre oils.
Bought this as a gift for some olive oil lovers.  It was a hit.

after reading about this product i had to give it a try.I was trying to find out what the top end extra virgin olive oils were and if there was a real difference.ok, there is a big olive flavor i was missing.really good stuff .the only problem is what other evo's are as good as this?well i will keep this in the pantry for sure.

This basically tasted like the other much cheaper EVOOs at the grocery store. I've had better, slightly cheaper brands from my local organic outlet that were much tastier. I may not have used it to its full potential, but I definitely will not buy this again. I was on a diet that required high levels of olive oil and this was just as overwhelmingly acidic(fatty acids I know) as the cheap stuff. I'm writing this review now because I just found and threw away the second bottle that I had placed somewhere inconspicuous during a move.

column9: Columela olive oil good for price
column10: This olive oil is pretty good for the price. We use it for salads and dipping with bread.I would recommend for those special uses.

column9: i'm still looking for the perfect bottle
column10: i'm a tough critic, so don't think this isn't good olive oil, but i'm still not satisfied that i am getting the best that europe has to offer. i lived in italy for a year and had oils that were far superior for half the price.

Embarassingly easy to cook.  Hard to ruin.  Tastes great.  Can make it firm or soft by varying the amount of water.  Gives an interesting, rustic twist to an otherwise lackluster entree.  And, it's good, wholesome, healthy food.

I've been concerned recently about the reported dangers of drinking soymilk. Though these dangers are widely debated, I felt I should err on the side of caution. I had tried Pacific Foods oat milk, but there are also; again widely debated, concerns about carrageenan. I finally discovered Pacific Foods organic 7 grain beverage. It is organic; soy and carrageenan free; and much better tasting to me than soy or almond milk. It's slightly sweet and very smooth. I drink it with all the traditional "milk partners", e.g., cookies ,pbj, and cereal. Especially good on cereal, I like to heat it up and pour it over granola. Whenever I'm asked about milk alternatives, which, I grant, is a rare occurance, I recommend Pacific Foods 7 grain beverage. It is the complete package for me, and I recommend it highly for this review

column9: Just what I've been searching for
column10: I've been lactose sensitive for over a decade and searching for a nondairy, non-soy, naturally sweetened/low sugar milk alternative has been a real challenge. On a whim I tried this one and it is exactly what I've been looking for: thick, smooth, naturally sweet, good tasting, dairy- and soy-free. I am so grateful!
Very good taste. Much better than soy milk.Healthier then cow milk.Smooth vanilla, not too sweet.My kids love it,they drink every morning.

Our toddler cannot drink cow's milk or related products and we were not happy with him drinking too much soy everyday since new research shows it breaks down into estrogen-like components. He drinks a lot of Almond Milk but this has the most protein of the non-dairy milk substitutes and tastes good. It also has a very adequaate amount of calcium and even fiber. Very good all around nutrition.

column9: OMG ~ Heaven in a little chocolate cup
column10: I was given these as a gift a few days ago. The box was devoured by my work mates in minutes~!  My personal favorite was the Almond Salt flavor. I didn't get to even taste the Mocha or the Crispy Cup. But I am tell you they are worth EVERY PENNY~!TOTAL YUM

This is one of my favorite K-Cups out of the 20 or so we currently have on hand.It just has a very satisfying flavor, not too strong, not too weak, not bitter.I put about 1/3rd of a teaspoon of sugar and about 3 Teaspoons (one tablespoon) of 1/2 & 1/2 and its just perfect.I personally buy this from Bed Bath & Beyond because amazingly it is cheaper there.I get 20% off coupons from them about every 3 weeks, in fact get 2 because I have my wife get them at her work also so we get 2 a month plus sometimes a $5 off of $15 coupon on top of that.So I pay $8.15 (after tax) for a pack of 18, that works out to $24.45 for 3 packs (54 K-Cups) so much better deal than $38 for 48.

No matter how many different types of coffee I try for my Keurig, the Sumatran Bold is always one of the ones I come back to.  Flavorful, rubust, rich but not bitter.  This is the one I go to when I want a nice strong cup.In milder times, I enjoy the Columbian Supremo from Timothy's and Breakfast Blend from Green Mountain.Give this a shot!

This is just wonderful. Full-bodied and very flavorful. #2 in my top five. After trying dozens of blends (yes, dozens) - Green Mountain has distinguished itself as the leader of the k-cup pack. I'm not much for "flavored" coffee (though I do appreciate the aromas), but Green Mountain coffees (especially the bolds and extra bolds) are very robust and just plain taste GREAT.

This is the best coffee available for a Keurig machine.  By far, IMHO.Since getting my Keurig brewer I have tested 30+ blends (keeping a spreadsheet with a ranking system of all things), and of all the K-cup varieties that I've tried this blend stands out as by far the best.The coffee is bold and strong, but not at all bitter or overpowering, and it stands up up well to cream and sugar.The flavor is woodsy but smooth and mellow, with a slight hint of citrus and a mild nuttiness.  The balance just works right.Every day I brew this K-cup first thing in the morning and although I love to experiment with new blends, this one consistently tops the charts and every other blend is simply a comparison.One more thing, if you are new to k-cups, please do a little research into the fair trade and organic origins of this coffee and that alone should be enough to make one a dedicated fan.

I am always on the lookout for a good strong cup of coffee and this product serves up just that!  I brew it on the "large cup" setting and it easily stands up to the addition of cream.  My mug is rather large, so 2 k-cups fill it to the brim.  At this price, it only comes to 80 cents a mug -- much less than what I would spend at my local coffee shop!  I will purchase this product again (and again)...

column9: Great coffee, but why 24 instead of 25?
column10: This is one of our favor KCups but I wonder why Green Mountain chose to put only 24 cups in the box instead of the original 25.  Seems pretty petty to me.Otherwise, it's a great flavor...particularly with larger cups of coffee.

I like this coffee very much.  I recieved a Keurig B40 Elite Gourmet Single-Cup Home-Brewing System as a gift and recieved this as well as Newman's Own Special Blend.  I have to say they are both great, extra bold, organic coffees.  The K Cup system assured cup after cup of great coffee.  I like fair trade and organic for both of these two.  I truly have no preference between the Green Mountain Organic Sumatran Reserve and Green Mountain Newman's Own Special Blend.  These are my favorite extra bold coffees available in K Cups.

I recently purchased the Kerig coffee maker, and have been buying different coffee's to find the ones that I want to stay with and re order. I love a strong coffee, but not bitter .. this coffee is very nice, I make it by the mug, first I brew 6oz and then just add another 8oz. all with the same K-cup. and it is still nice and favorful.also has a nice mild lingering smoky after taste. Don't know for sure if I will re-order or not. still experimenting.. I have shopped for the k-cup coffee at other sites, and I feel that Amazon is still the best price.. If you don't have the Kerig maker then get one, as it makes the best coffee anywhere..

We really enjoy this coffee - even my hyper-analytical, super-coffee-critical spouse likes it, which is really saying something. While I lack the specialized vocabulary to express, in foodie-speak, what makes this coffee so satisfying, I can point to its flavor and boldness ... and batch-to-batch consistency. We've not been disappointed.
We drink lots of coffee and prefer the Green Mountain Dark Magic extra bold.  The organic Sumatran is not as flavorful.  We definitely enjoy the K Cups.
This is my favorite flavor for the Keurig. Very dark, rich flavor(but not a burnt flavor). Just smelling it would put me in a better mood. Highly recommend.
Good packaging but slow delivery. Full of flavor & bold taste.  Not as strong as Black Tiger or Jetfuel. Very good product by Green Mountain - one of my favorites!
I tried a lot of different kinds and flavors, but Green Mountain bold is as good or better than any, including Starbucks.

This coffee is a wonderful coffee--I love strong coffee, and this fits the bill nicely. It is very strong, but not bitter--it has a nice, bright aftertaste. It is my regular morning brew. You might want to buy a less bold one, just for the changeup--this is probably not what you will want every time, but it is certainly well worth the purchase.Not to mention it is fair trade, which in and of itself makes the purchase a smart one.

I keep reading reviews that complain about the Keurig and weak coffee. I suppose if you try to put something made for 7oz in a 16oz mug it's going to get watered down.I found this coffee to be strong and rich with no aftertaste.  Love it.

column9: One of my favorite extra bold k-cups.  A winner!
column10: Like my coffee strong but not bitter.  Have tried a lot of extra bold k-cups searching for that blend that says "yes, that's the one..."  The Green Mountain Sumatran Reserve and the Van Houtte Bold Eclipse are the winners so far.  Strong, rich, great-tasting coffee.  Wish Amazon was offering them at the same price as the cheaper more popular k-cups!

I've tried at least eight different kinds of k-cups not including all the horrible free ones you get in the box.  Normally the coffee is weak.  THIS one finally comes close to that Starbucks flavor -- if you like a more pungent, burnt flavor that you get with European dark roasts.Highly recommended.  And they sell it at Target now!

column9: This is an excellent bold roast with a nutty finish
column10: I was very pleased with this order!  Finally a very bold blend but I was surprized by the definitely nutty finish.  This is a great departure from the other coffees that taste the same from start of sip to end.  With the Sumatran Reserve, you get an excellent strong coffee taste while sipping but a great nutmeg-like aftertaste.Another thing, this has to be the highest caffeine blend I've tried so far.  It really wakes me up in the morning!  But I move to a milder blend like Kona or Dietrich for the afternoons.A big thumbs up for a non-flavored coffee.
These are my favorite k cups!  They coffee is bold and rich, never bitter and it is organic which is very important to me, coffee is one of the most heavily pesticide products

Green Mountain "Sumatran Reserve (Extra Bold)" K-Cups makes a very good cup of coffee in my Keurig B-40 B40 Elite Gourmet Single-Cup Home-Brewing System. This is a very strong tasting brew that has much more flavor and kick than the Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) [Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging] I generally drink in the morning.While I really enjoy this coffee, my wife finds it too strong and bitter for her liking. She prefers Emeril's Big Easy Bold Coffee for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2) made on the machine's "large" cup setting for her "Bold" coffee.Highly Recommended!CFH

Green Mountain Coffee Fair Trade Organic Sumatran Reserve, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig Brewers This is a real treat for a coffee snob! Not only is this a great coffee overall, but even compared to other Sumatran coffees and Sumatran blends this one can hold it's own against most other roasters. I enjoy it better than both the Sumatran offerings from Starbucks. I would say it is right on par with the caribou Sumatran product. only ones that I have enjoyed even a little more were products from  Cats Ass Coffee harvested from animal droppings (Kopi luwak)at over $150 a pound 0.o and the Sumatran offered by S&D... But the S&D product is hard to find or discontinued/seasonal. I would tell friends and Coffee people all over to try this! (And yes, I grew up in Portland and Seattle so I just may know better than you)  :P  LoLEnjoy!

column9: This is probably my favorite K cup
column10: I'm a big fan of very bold, very dark coffee and have tried literally dozens of bold k cups.Timothy's Midnight Magic, Rainforest Espresso, Emeril's and Tully's French Roast are also dark coffees that I will buy as well but this one has the best flavor for me. It is not bitter and muddy looking, it's smooth. Most importantly, it gives a flavorful, not weak cup of java on the 9.5 ounce setting. Not many k cups do that. They become coffee flavored water at the 9.5 ounce size.
This coffee is very pleasant, not acidic neither bitter. Could have more aroma, but overall it is a good one.

This is my idea of the best coffee in the world. In order to get to the 20 words required, I will also say that this is the only "Extra Bold" coffee from Green Mountain that is at all palatable to me.
The coffee in the box varied from a great, dark and complex brew to a really funny smelling, weird flavor.

This is the most delicious K-Cup that I have tried yet!  It is smooth, bold, smells great, tastes amazing.. and really wakes me up!  I recommend this to those of you who like extra bold flavorful coffee with a kick.  It's great and trust me.. I'm fussy with coffee and it tastes awesome!
This is a great cup of coffee at a great price. I've bought this a few times now and its always been good.
It's been a long search for a Sumatran K-Cup (at least for me) ... at long last, here it is! Creamy, rich, with chocolate aftertones .. this is the best K-Cup I've found to date.

I purchase this coffee for my husband. He love to drink a good cup of coffee but too difficult to drive to buy Starbucks especially on the weekend. We love to stay home and I like to eat at home because I know my food at home is much better than anywhere else in the world (according to my husband). Actually I don't drink coffee or tea on a regular basis, I prefer to drink water or fresh juice. BUT I love the smell of coffee in the morning and having my husband enjoy a good cup of coffee. So... for mother's day as a gift to me from me I purchased the single serving coffee machine. It is easy to use, looks good in my kitchen and brew a perfect cup of coffee every time. We purchased the sampler first and try many different kind and he decided he like the Sumatran coffee the best.
Great coffee, bold flavor.  If you like Starbucks style coffee, this brand is as close as it gets.  Smooth but not bitter.
I found this coffee to be a great wake me up cup of coffee.  It is bold, strong, but still smooth.  I drink it with cream and splenda.
If you enjoy strong, rich, dark coffee with a smoky, complex flavor this is for you.

I've been going through many k cups, primarily bold, for some time. After finding a couple that I like, I ran across Sumatran Reserve... WOW! This is what I was looking for. Great, bold flavor, but without the bitterness. This one ranks my favorite k cup.

First the Keurig coffee maker is great. Make one cup anytime you're in the mood and you get great, hot coffee without the mess. My favorite bold coffee is the Sumatran Reserve. It has a nice strong flavor. If you like your coffee light with plenty of milk or cream this is not for you.

Taste in coffee varies, just look at the reviews.  :)I drink my coffee black and lean toward the dark roasts. Keep in mind that this is "Extra Bold" The "Bold" and "Extra Bold" K-cups will make a good 9.25-11.25 oz. "mug" of coffee. Some may be using the lower settings and that could explain why some think it is too strong and others get 2 cups of coffee from 1 pod.This was shipped by Amazon and service was great, as always.
Great coffee.  There's no reason to spend $4 for a cup of coffee when you can get a great cup of strong coffee for about 40 cents.

For reference, I have tried The Puck sumatran and the Diedrich. This Green Mountain sumatran was bitter and lifeless. It tasted stale and old, even though it was well within the sell-by date. For further reference, I also roast my own sumatran at home. I rate that a 10, starbucks would be a 9, the Puck k-cups would be an 8 as the best of the k-cups. I give this a flat 1. Very disappointing, will not purchase again. I wrote this about five minutes after finishing a cup, and I still have a terrible, bitter aftertaste. A true sumatran will have an earthy, almost tangy flavor, but with no bitterness. I would say they used coffee beans that had been sitting around for a while.

I would give his product 4 stars but becase of the price, I'm dropping it to 4. The price of all k-cups over the last year have risen ridiculously in price! But the is a good, bold coffee without tasting like you're licking dirt!

I tried this blend with a bit of skepticism; I thought that it wouldn't be as good as Black Magic, but it is just about as good.  The Sumatran has a slightly harsher (in a good way) taste that leaves you wanting more!  It has Anice aroma and a strong after-taste (which I like!).  I will buy this again!

column9: A must-order for me every time
column10: I like my coffee strong, bold, and dark. Of all the varieties I have tried, this is my hands-down favorite to fit the bill. Its consistently good with a robust, smokey, complex flavor. I have noticed that it also does not have the bitter tinge that many of the Dark Magic varieties have (which I like, by the way... but not if you're drinking more than one cup at a setting).A word of warning: many of my family members and friends who have tried it find it too strong and dark for their tastes. If you want a little dark and bold, you could go with something like the Coffee People Black Tiger (also a favorite of mine) which is similar in my opinion, but a little less intense. If you dig the big bold flavor, however, you won't be dissapointed with this one!
i am very pleased with the coffee it was a very long time getting to me but worth the wait the coffee is great and i really like the potions out little cups i will reorder

I've tried just about every extra bold K cup available and this by far is my favorite. The rich syrupy flavor is just right, has no aftertaste (not sure what the one person who said there was an aftertaste was drinking but it must not have been this coffee) and is drinkable on a daily basis (not too over the top for everyday).

column9: A very satisfying cup of coffee!
column10: If you like a bold cup of coffee then this is the one for you.  Highly recommended.
The bold cffee tast a lot better than the usual light burnt Americanb Coffee

This is an excellent coffee but unlike Amazon's usual great service whoever they use to fulfill the coffee orders is terrible.  I ordered several boxes of this coffee from Amazon but they were shipped to me just thrown in a box.  Anywhere from one-quarter to one-half of the cups were damaged and unusable.  Worse yet Amazon won't take a return since it is a food item.In summary, buy this coffee, just not from Amazon.

The taste of the coffee was very bitter and smelled horrible.  Though the capsule concept is more convenient the product quality has to deliver and this does not at all meet expectations.  The flavor was 'off' and tasted under-roasted and foul.
I AM LEARNING HOW TO MAKE HUMMUS. AND THIS IS A PRODUCT THEY CALL FOR IN THE RECIPE. IS GREAT. I LOVE SESAME SO GAVE IT A TRY. WE LIKED IT.

fresh and great tasting. quick shipping. ALL GOOD. good price as well. ive made hummus with this product, and i use it as a spread for my toast and bagels. it only takes a little because it spreads out. make sure you stir the tahini before using as any regular user knows that the oils settle.

*****Stash's Licorice Spice Caffeine Free Herbal Tea has a the sweet flavor licorice teas are known for, along with several nice spices that complement the licorice in a lovely, more-subtle-than-chai way. Licorice Spice Tea contains licorice root, cinnamon, orange peel, star anise, sarsaparilla, natural vanilla flavor, natural orange flavor, natural clove flavor, natural cardamom flavor, and natural cinnamon flavor. Sweet and delicious!You don't need to add anything at all to Licorice Spice Tea, even if you normally like your tea sweetened. It is perfect just as is. It also has a very smooth taste, despite all of the flavorings. The tea bags come stamped with an expiration date, which I like, so that you can be sure the tea is fresh. The date on mine is 26 months away, so you can take your time :)Definitely recommended.*****

My husband and I both love this tea. Caffeine free, so nice to drink at night. The flavour is so vibrant, not your regular tea. I love it though, I can't get enough. We couldn't find it in our local grocery store, so we buy it online now. Worth a try!
If you love black licorice and tea this is the best tea ever made.  It is not too strong but just enough licorice flavor.  Perfect on a chilly evening with milk.  Yummy!

This is delicious.  Is there really anything esle one can say in a review of a food product?  The Amazon reviewers didn't accept my first review because I guess I didn't say enough about the product.  Well, I mentioned it has less than half the fat of mayo.  That's a good thing.  It tastes great on pretzels.  It would probaly taste great on the right kind of sandwich, and I'm sure it would be great on a burger. Delicious, yummy, creamy, thick, not runny, but not too thick, comparatively low in fat.  Have I talked about the quality or properties of this food product enough to pass Amazon review muster?$9/ jar is pretty darned pricey though.

column4: J. Bonifazi "José del Frijole de Cafe"
column10: In my opinion, this is not a good roast for espresso.  It is described on the package as a medium roast, but it looks and tastes like a very light roast.  For taste reference, I actually prefer a dark roast.It also tastes very old, however, as there is no date on the package I have no way to tell the age of the roast.I will not buy this particular variety again.

Mike and Ike lovers have the chance to sample some exciting new fruit flavors in this special seasonal "Mummy's Mix" box, a combination of five fruit flavors in the same box - lemon, orange, grape, lime and raspberry. Fruit flavors are authentic with overall sweetness and just a touch of sourness to make your mouth water. Fresh and chewy. We would have rated this 5-stars but the fact that the box is not resealable is a negative factor. But then maybe you are supposed to finish off all 5 ounces while enjoying the movie with no need to seal the box closed again!
I am not a candy person, but these are my weakness, dark chocolate and hazelnuts.  I stuffed some in a Christmas stocking for a friend; now he's hooked too.  These will go in is Easter basket.

Not incredibly hot but very good. A nice blend of heat and some other flavors I can't fully Identify, a nice oily, sort of buttery thing going on with just a bit of salt. The Corn is a very light hulled and popped large and fluffy, with very very few duds. I will be having this again, a great find.
Very fruity and tasty - my personal favorite acai tea. Expensive as all Teavana teas are, but well worth it.

column9: The espresso pulls an amazing Crema
column10: I received this Espresso Blend as a present last week.  We pulled a few espressos and were blown away by the flavor profile.  This is amazing coffee and makes the best espresso I have ever had, and I drink a lot of Espresso.

I love grapeade it is my favorite one to get but I am a bit dissapointed that its taken 2 weeks for it to ship and I just got word that it shipped yesterday even tho it was supposed to get here 3 days ago but when it gets here I cant wait to put it in my fridge and have an icy cold drink.

my friend from Ukraine is a huge fan of hot sauces, so i was very happy that this sampler comes in bottles smaller than 3 oz (i never check in my luggage). he liked the 'temporarily insane' sauce the best, he said it was really hot. great product!
This is a fantastic little teaser for those chiliheads that are just cutting their teeth.  It also makes a great gift.

column9: Great Results with Miltons and Consumer Alert
column10: I purchased a box of 12 packages (the only amount offered) of Miltons Baking Company Whole Wheat Sesame crackers on Amazon because i was desperate to find a reliable source.  I love these crackers!  As a whole wheat cracker, Milton's are the very best...crispy, flavorful and delicious!  However, when i received my crackers from the distributor(not Miltons) they had a mere 30 days left on the pull date.  It's hard to chug-a-lug twelve packages in 30 days! They were already stale and oddly chipped as if mice had been nibbling along the edges. Yuck! When i contacted the distributor, they refused entirely to back the product and left me hanging with a costly mistake, useless crackers, and a very bad taste in my mouth for Miltons and them.  Frustrated, i contacted Miltons Baking Company directly.  What a pleasure!  They let me know that the "mice nibbles" were from pins holding the crackers during packaging and were below their acceptable product standard. And, in a really generous gesture, they let me know immediately that, although the crackers were beyond the pull date, they would be happy to replace them under the circumstances!  Every aspect of my experience with the Milton Baking Company was amazingly warm and responsive -- and quick.  I'm looking forward to my deeeelicious crackers.  They are the best!  And i am very grateful for a company that really stands behind their product guarantee of full satisfaction.  Yes!  Thanks, Miltons!

I have lived in and visited Korea off and on for the last 20 years.I have been cooking Korean food (over 100 recipes) during that time.This is a good sauce.  It isn't as complex as making it yourself, but it is a good, no time substitute.I have tried about 10 different bottled sauces and this is by far the best on the market.  It is not sickly sweet, and by using a little more than suggested it can be as hot as you want it to be.I guess the best compliment I can give it is that it is the best of all the bottles sauces available.
This is a great marinade for chicken. I bake my chicken in this sauce and it flavors it fabulously. It gets thicker when it bakes and adds a nice sauce to flavor rice as well.

Fantastic marinade for all meats and even mushrooms. The sauce is sweet and spicy but not too hot, and has a taste of sesame oil as well. Unlike so many bbq sauces, this one does not burn up and turn black, even on the grill, and for stir frying we use this with no oil in the wok, as the sauce seems to have a touch of oil, and does not need it. Great stuff, and I have had korean bbq in Japan, where they love the stuff. CJ is the real deal.

This is pretty spicy. As soon as I opened it, I got the spicy smell of peppers. I did not use it as a dipping sauce. I used it as a marinade and then as a topping for several different pork flavors. I think it could be a bit stickier and glazier (if that's even a word) My issue was that it didnt stick well to pork to create a crust/glaze but ran off to the sides and burned. Not bad over all.
i've made them once like directions said but i think they would've better by adding egg and milk. TASTE WAS JUST OK.

While this was an economical way to purchase a 'Large Serving Size' (not available in stores) I was disappointed with the condition the box arrived in and the poor packing of the product. Instead of the bags being lined up and covered with a protective cellophane wrap, they were tossed into the mailing box without any protective wrapping. Individual bags were all crushed. Chips were not as fresh as they are when purchasing them directly from the store.

column4: D. Mikels "It's always Happy Hour here"
column10: One.  Single.  Solitary.  Singular.  One is the loneliest number that you'll ever use.  Uno.  Einz.The marketing folks at Lay's got it right.  No one can eat just one.  Nor should they.  LAY'S POTATO CHIPS, the consummate snack of Americana, are not designed for solitary servings; they are here to be consumed prodigiously--by handful after greasy handful.  Crisp, fresh, salty spud nirvana, these are chips to munch not in solitary discipline, nor one per serving (egads), but in numbers too high to count.  Wherever there are hamburgers or hot dogs being grilled, wherever there are tailgating parties, wherever there are social gatherings of casual consequence, bags of LAY'S POTATO CHIPS make their tasty presence known.  We munch, we crunch, we scarf a bunch in a hunch.  And--always--we come back for more.So banish the thought of eeking out an existential existence of snack food discipline; treat yourself to wholesome goodness that transcends generations of hearty crunchers.  Become, like moi, a master magician.  See how fast you can make one of these bags of spud nuggets disappear.  Chow, er, ciao!--D. Mikels, Esq.
My family loves the small bags of chips,  I wish the experation date was not a month and a half after they were shipped.  Thank you.

Lay's Potato Chips Regular, 1.5-Ounce Large Single Serve Bags (Pack of 64)I haven't had chips in the house for over a year! When these went on an AMAZING sale I decided to satisfy my guilty pleasure. I ate THREE bags before I moved them to the pantry. Oh, to have either ice-cold beer OR root beer would make this heaven. NEXT guilty pleasure coming right up =)These are better than I remember them. The great price reduction is because their use buy date is AUGUST 10, 2010. We can handle it though.

These are some of the crunchiest ,golden, potato chips with good oils. For an individual with multiple food intolerances, including  peanuts, and soy proteins, these became a favorite. Having these for parties, to fit in with the other children is huge!Now, they even have an organic variety, full of good taste!

I buy these animals in bulk and take 5 to 10 bags to work each week as I found that the dispensing machines are more expensive and unreliable. Occasionally I turn out empty pockets and it is nice to know I have a stash at arms reach.I know that now days many people like the heaver chips. But I grew-up on the thinner Lays's. I consider these chips one of the basic food groups. I also like bulk delivery as it is like Christmas all year around.

column9: very good taste & it's the right size AND quantity for me
column10: howdy y'all,when you can get this from amazon with free shipping [can't do that right now, unfortunately] it's a dang fine deal. i got the regular flavor and one package is just the right amount to take the edge off my craving. it's really too salty for me to have often, but _wow_ is it good. [*grin*]my big box of 64 packages has lasted me quite some time - since 2010-10 - and it will last a few more weeks. yes, it's past the use-by date. it still tastes fine to me. none of the packs i received were crushed, either.rated a FOUR cuz this item is actually better than i had expected.take care,lee

I have tried 4 different brands of wasabi peas on Amazon. (Fasig's Barry's, Hapi's and Kasugai) These are the best tasting. Having said that,your tastes may not be the same as mine:1) They are hotter than the others2) They are less sugary than the others.3) They are very crunchy.ENJOY!

This is the first kind of Wasabi Peas I have ever eaten and I must say that they are so very delicious. I went in, expecting them to be unbearably spicy, but I found them to be spicy at first and then delicious and crunchy. Thing of them like a very spicy Sour Patch Kid. I would recommend them to anyone looking for a spicy snack. They leave no crumbs when eaten and I think they might be good for you.As a side note, when I ordered, I thought 4 ounces wasn't going to be much, but now that I have them, 4 ounces seems like quite a bit.

These are so yummy.  Such a great snack for everyone.  So many of the rice cakes these days come in bigger bags and are hard to finish in one seating. I say this because after rice cakes are exposed to air, they just don't taste right to me.  This bag is the perfect size!  I love this bag because it's enough snack for satisfying that need for a "crunchy" snack. And they are even a bit sweet, so they help to off set the sweet tooth after a salad for lunch!  Ok so they are for kids, but I bought them for my daughter and ate some, and now I'm eating them with & without her!  She doesn't notice she's eating carrot and brown rice, and I forget about that piece of pie I want after lunch!

I do not recommend this product for all babies. My baby is 9 months old and on several occasions choked on the rice cake. She does have two teeth but the rice cake on one circumstance was stuck to the top of her mouth. I had to stick my fingers in her mouth to remove it if i hadn't done so i don't know what would have happened. Not all babies may be ready for this product and mine started at 81/2 months old and the starting age is 7months. I think it should be different. I hope this does not happen to anyone else. It was definitely scary for me to experience.

This product is amazing. My baby loves it to eat it, I love the fact that it dissolved in their mouth, it is also large enough for him to hold it and it helps him while he is teething. The flavor is awesome, it doesn't taste like regular baby food. I would totally recommended this product for any parent regardless of their age. This product is for the whole family.

column9: The munchies give me the munchies!!!
column10: My family is a bunch of snackers.  As a result we have tried to make snacking healthier.  When I came upon these rice cakes -- I was sold.  The serving size fills them up, but I know its healthy food.  It great for after practice, trips in the car, movie time ... any time a you need a snack. Trust me -- these don't disappoint!

We CAN NOT get enough of these in my household. Between my 1 1/2 year old, my 3 1/2 year old AND myself. Every time we have guests over, all the kids devour them too. All of my Mommy friends ask me where I got them. We're huge fans of the apple flavor too. BEST HEALTHY SNACK for entire house hold! Gluten-Free too.
My son was a big fan of these for a while and couldn't get enough of them! But oh how the fickle wind blows!!! Now not so much. I'm glad we got them in while we did though.

The new Happy Munchie rice cakes are delicious-they are soy and dairy free, and non GMO-which is hard to find in many kids snacks these days.  We use these rice cakes to make mini sandwiches with nut butters or cream cheese.  Or they are lightly sweet and good to eat on their own.  The bag is the right size for snacking!

I decided to expand my horizon with the Happy Family brand and also tried this product with my little one.  She really enjoyed them and I loved them too...so much, I had to restrain myself from eating the entire bag!  This product is the perfect size for snack time with the kids, but also just right for mom's late night snack attack.

My kids (2 yrs old) can't get enough of these rice cakes. I love that they are the perfect size for little hands, fit easily in snack cups for on-the-go snacking, are not messy, and one bag is the perfect amount for my two toddlers to share. These are a lifesaver when we need a quick, healthy snack!

My children (ages 4 and 7) devour these pouches! They love all flavors of the Happy Tot Plus pouches, especially the Kale Apple Mango. Yes, Kale! I know, right?! Who would have ever thought? But they do love it and it makes me happy to know they're eating a snack that is organic, high in protein, vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free, and with no added sugar!

My 15 month old son loves these! They are a great healthy crunchy snack. I enjoy eating these as well, they are much tastier than regular rice cakes. The carrot adds a sweetness to it so it doesn't taste too bland.  They dissolve very easily in the mouth so I would feel fine feeding them to a younger baby that was use to eating solids. They are a great size for little hands as well. I also love the fact that they are gluten free!

I love crunchy foods and I am always looking for an alternative to yucky potato chips! I love these Happy Munchies Rice Cakes. They are the perfect size and with just a touch of sweetness and crunchiness...yummy! I have no guilt having a bag of these in one sitting. My kids love them too who are ages 6 and 9! We love to bring them to the park and on hikes in the mountains. I highly recommend this product! 5 stars for sure!
What I mean is...it doesn't taste like Styrofoam, at all. It's very similar tasting to salted popcorn, with little nuggets of sweetness every now and then. Very tasty~
This agave nectar is smooth, good flavor with no bittersweet taste. Taste great and delicious in cereal, fruit smoothies, and over french vanilla ice cream.

column9: Celestial Seasonings Red Safari Spice Tea
column10: The tea arrived promptly and it just so happens that I =love= this tea!! Red Bush (Rooibos) Tea is supposed to be higher in antioxidants than green tea, =plus= Red Bush tea doesn't have the caffeine!

column9: It's the best tea I have ever had
column10: It's the best tea I have ever had.Unfortunately I have not found it yet for sale in Australia, so thanks to Amazon I can buy it from the US.

column9: Tasty!  Low in Sodium.  Low in Calories.
column10: We love this stuff.  We order it by the case.  It's flavorful, and it's the lowest in sodium of any salsa that we know of.  It's also low in calories.

this item shipped quickly and tastes pretty nice.  I have had better iron goddess oolong, but this stuff is definitely a good deal for the price.  It is subtle and is good for more than one infusion.  very satisfied.  As i am a constant oolong drinker, i might order this product again.

column9: be careful, moldy product, USDA now involved
column10: My baby enjoyed this flavor when I purchased it at a store.  I ordered a case of it from Amazon.  the whole case arrived moldy.  Each jar popped when I opened it too, showing that it was properly sealed.  I contacted Earth's Best.  They said they would look into it but would not follow up with me.  Given what is going on in our food industry, I will not purchase any more products from this company.  It is to scary when feeding a baby.  Amazon refunded me but did not take it any further.  Be very careful and inform other families too.  UPDATE: I was so disappointed with the lack of concern from Earth's Best and Amazon.  I contacted the FDA, they referred me to the USDA because the product contained meat.  They took it very serious and had also received several complaints.  They have come to my house and written a report.  If anyone else noticed this problem please contact the USDA (1-888-674-6854).to report your claim/problem.  They will investigate the problem and the Earth's Best Plant to make sure they are following regulations.

column9: My Babies Liked This One Right Away
column10: I tested this one on my twin 10-month old babies and they liked it immediately.  It was their first beef and their first spinach.  I had already given them chicken and they really like it so they are not vegetarians yet anyway.  Mostly I wanted this product for the spinach and the higher iron content.  Somehow they made this particular flavor brand tasty for babies.I like getting these by the case rather than buying them a jar at a time at the store since 2 babies eat so much.  It's good to keep several flavor brands around too I think, to give your baby a variety.  I'm sure I'll get another case when this one is finished.Ingredients per the label: Water, Organic Carrots, Organic Finely Ground Beef, Organic Spinach, Organic Garbanzo Bean Flour, Organic Tomato Paste, Organic Whole Durum Wheat Flour. CONTAINS: WHEAT.This has 110 calories, 31% protein, 100% vitamin A, 8% vitamin C, 4% calcium and 4% iron.  I've been informed that the percentage of daily needs met is based on an adult.

They will investigate the problem and the Earth's Best Plant to make sure they are following regulations.

I ordered a flat of food (they were on sale) that contained Chicken Apple Compote Dinner. It contained 3 of this variety and he liked the first one but the others, although properly sealed, were solid and moldy and stinky.One of the Turkey dinners in the flat was also improperly sealed; the lid popped. We were lucky because I just happened to check that one. Now I'm so paranoid that I check all of them several times. I called Earth's Best and they assured me that they haven't had this problem before and that I shouldn't worry about it. I'm so suprised that this got passed QA/QC inspection at a baby food manufacturer. Why would a company take the risk of bad publicity when baby food manufacturers rely so much on a reputation of safety?!We also recently opened 5 other jars in this flat after my son refused to eat them and realized that they were rotten.  3 of them were completely solid and domed at the top!  We poked a toothpick down to the bottom of the jar and it was dry throughout.  Shortly after eating his last dinner of this box, my son started vomiting and refused to eat.  We have contacted the USDA about this.  If this happens to you, please same your jars so you can give them the information they need.  It may prevent other babies from getting sick.I'll never buy anything from Earth's Best again!

column9: Glad I gave this a try; good product, good nutrition, other reviews are outdated
column10: Yes I read the other reviews. And given the review dates and my other experiences with Earth's Best I was not too concerned that the problems mentioned would still be an issue. And they were not.We have tried almost all of the gourmet line of Earth's Best and these are great for adding protein to your little one's (LO) diet. Google the Earth Best's website for complete nutrition info. Most 2nd stage food have between 2 and 3 grams of protein a serving. This one has 5grams of protein and only 2 grams of sugars. Our LO likes the taste and we like the ingridients and nutrition profile. Recommended.
I don't think it's EB, I think it's Amazon. I buy EB from Babies R Us, Target and Whole Foods, and haven't had any problems. It's only the shipments from Amazon that come moldy.

column9: The best for picky skinny babies
column10: Organic, and loaded with calories, fat and protein, this the ONLY baby food with meat that my picky little one will happily eat.  I've found that very few groceries carry this near my home (and I live in metropolitan Seattle) and so I've resorted to ordering it by the case from Amazon.  The free 2 day shipping Rocks!

When I saw some of the Earth's Best jars offered as a Gold Box deal, I remembered that I needed to offer a caveat to other parents.  My children have previously enjoyed many Earth's Best flavors, which in general taste quite good, so in February when there was a promotional offer through Amazon, we ordered two 12-packs. When they arrived, one of the 12-packs seemed ok, but the other 12-pack contained several broken jars and was leaking. It smelled and looked like there might be mold under the plastic that surrounded the second 12-pack.  I noticed that the shipping box holding the two 12-packs had air-filled padding on only the top side of the box, which meant that there was no padding protecting the bottom side.  I don't know whether some of the jars had broken at the warehouse or during delivery, but either way, I was afraid to use the unbroken jars too, because what if the seals had broken or what if there were small pieces of broken glass inside the intact jars too?For more durable items, I still order from Amazon, but I canceled my subscription of the Earth's Best jars and from now on will buy jars at a physical store where I can check them first.

I also ordered a flat of food (they were on sale) that contained The Turkey and Wild Rice Dinner.  One of them was also improperly sealed; the lid popped.  We were lucky because I just happened to check that one.  Now I'm so paranoid that I check all of them several times.  I called Earth's Best and they assured me that they haven't had this problem before and that I shouldn't worry about it.  I'm so suprised that this got passed QA/QC inspection at a baby food manufacturer.  Why would a company take the risk of bad publicity when baby food manufacturers rely so much on a reputation of safety?!

column4: Jillian A. Tate "los angeles sociologist & di...
column10: We had the same issue with this product. Half the flat was improperly sealed, and resulted in an expired food issue.  But you can spot the unsafe jars because they have dried up & turned solid, resulting in a different sound when shaken.  Also, when opened, these "bad" jars are mounded up in the middle and have a rotten smell.  It may be that the product was frozen in shipping, and the expansion caused the seal to break.  I have requested a refund from Amazon.Our baby did love this meal though - it was like Thanksgiving dinner.  The ones that were still edible were delicious, and are one of his favorite foods.

This jar of baby food has 7 GRAMS of FAT and 110 calories - thats triple the fat and double the calories of most baby food!  I highly recommend for babies needing to put on some lbs - as well as picky eaters.  I have to offer my son a variety of 7-8 foods each meal (cheese, avacado, chunks of meat...etc) b/c he turns up his nose at so much (and I can't just say 'well too bad' b/c he desperately needs the calories!) But this is one of the foods he rarely turns down.  I highly recommend.

column9: Had No Problem.  They Like This One a Lot
column10: I wondered why my 10-month olds liked this one so much when the other reviews weren't so promising.  Then I noted that it has twice the calories as the green bean casserole and sweet ingredients that are proven winners with my kids.Here's the ingredient list: Water, Organic Carrots, Organic Mango Puree, Organic Finely Ground Chicken, Organic Whole Grain Brown Rice Flour, Organic Yellow Split Pea Flakes, Calcium Carbonate.Anything that starts with carrots and mango is going to be fairly sweet, and this one is sweet.  The consistency seemed very normal, perhaps because it has plenty of water - that's the first ingredient.  Unlike most Earth Best flavor brands, this one has calcium.  The stated amount is 35% of their daily needs.  I've been informed that the percentage of daily needs met is based on an adult.I recommend this particular one, Chicken Mango Risotto, because I think babies will tend to like it as mine did.These cases are being delivered to my home constantly, different varieties of Earth's Best subscriptions.  On occasion a case will arrive in a mess with one or more broken jars. Over time I figured out it would cost the vendor too much to package these jars well enough to ensure no breakage. Now when a case arrives with one or more broken jars, I report it and can get credited for the broken ones only. Of course it's messy when a jar is broken, but I don't have a store nearby that sells this product except one that lists it at a higher price.

The other reviews are very outdated & old. We never had any issues with the quality of this product. My daughter loved it; I loved the fact that she was getting good protein. Most of the other earth's best baby foods have carrot/squash/sweet potatoes, which is fine, however my daughter was turning orange from so many orange veggies. I liked that this one had NO orange veggies in the ingredient list. Slightly more expensive than other meals, which I think is due to the fact it has a lot of meat in it.

My daughter thinks this tastes nasty, and I agree. She is sensitive to carrot, so I was looking for a food for travel that delivers protein but doesn't contain carrot. Though she eats homemade turkey and peas all the time, she wouldn't even take a full bite of this. I tasted a little bit, and I can see why.

column9: baby loves the tender beef spinach!
column10: If baby likes that's what matters! Happy baby! Happy mommy! Only thing is the color of food that stain anything, but, oh, well, just washed right the way!

column9: Grainy and a Little Oily but Thick
column10: I've read other reviewers comment on the calorie content of this flavor and it must be high because when I was trying to wash the dish I served it in in was quite oily.  Also, it has a bit of a grainy texture and I think my 6 month old son finds the spinach a little difficult to digest.

column9: Even a fruit hater likes it!
column10: My 7 mo old despises all things fruit-related (we think it's too sweet for her) yet she likes this one just fine!  I'm perplexed that so many other reviewers say their baby hates it, although I must admit I haven't tasted it myself.  For us it's a tasty way to get her to eat a little more fruit every day.

I purchased this product from B-R-US when it was on sale and my son seems to like it. I was scared of previous post of mold and I ALWAYS double check the food before I stir and serve. He seems to like it, but I recommend the Chicken Sweet Potato dinner.

column9: Small Jars and a Little Runny - like most commercial baby foods
column10: Let me start by saying my 7 month old son, who is used to my home prepared baby foods LOVES this, as a once in a blue moon convenience meal! I've tried it and it tastes pretty good to me too. Rare in the baby food industry.I am following a weaning guide that I used for my daughter, and it makes you pretty wary of commercial baby foods as babies easily get used to the bland, watery taste and sometimes take a lot of coaxing to go back to home made, healthy meals, resulting in picky toddlers and children. My daughter is now 3 and has never refused a home cooked meal yet, and I attribute that to the hard work I put in in the first year. Another problem with commercial baby foods is that they are usually so padded out with water that nutritional needs aren't fully met during the day and babies can start waking in the night due to genuine hunger.I'd love to ask, who came up with the magical 4oz measurement for all stage 2 baby food jars and packets, though? My son takes more like 6oz of my home prepared meals which are much "fuller", so I've had to add a little sweet potato to this to increase the volume. And it does seem really quite runny and padded out with water, so I add a teaspoon or 2 of rice cereal to thicken it up a little. Before long, I'm sure he'll just be on 2 full 4oz jars when I give him this.All that said, I'll reiterate, it is really quite tasty for a commercial baby food, and I have no problem giving it to my son once in a while. I do recommend!

column9: Twice the protein of other Earth's best and baby food in general
column10: The Earth's best 'grourmet' line is heavy on the protein. And as far as I know adequate protein is important for babies and they need, like the rest of us, good iron levels.The beef and spinach contains 5 grams per serving. You can check your cans, but most of the other's we use the protein is 2 grams. Our daughter likes it. It is also the least expensive of the 'gourmet' line and this is not something I could find in local stores. Recommended.

He will suffer through half a jar, but will not finish a whole one. I guess it was a little too exotic for his 9 month old taste buds.  We will keep trying.He loves, loves, loves the beef and spinach and will almost cry when the jar is gone.

This was NOT a hit!  It's bitter, like maybe the carrots were not sweet and/or not peeled?  and the main ingredient is carrots! (amazon should include the ingredients for all items) Quality control seems to be an issue. This is the second "gourmet meal" flavor with this issue. I had never had a bad experience with the EB products before, very disappointing.

Where we usually just wipe their faces gently, you really have to clean them.  It simply turns their skin orange.  And the bowls and spoon end up crazy oily, even after soaking.

My 9 mo. old daughter only eats earth's best products and loves all of them - that is, except this. I can't figure out what it is, but we finally concluded that it smells a little like catfood. I tried feeding her this mango chicken flavor a few different times and she would only eat a few bites. I gave up and donated the rest to the food bank hoping someone else's child would like it. I have had a good experience with the "subscribe and save" products in general, no broken jars and the quick delivery is great. I find that it is cheaper than whole foods (even with the coupons). This is the only flavor of earth's best baby food that my daughter dislikes. For what it's worth, I suggest skipping this one or trying it in a variety pack first.

My picky eater LOVES this flavor.  Each jar is 110 calories & 5 grams of fat so this momma LOVES this flavor as well.  I'm ordering more because it's the one flavor (besides green beans) that I know my son will eat.
This is a terrific baby food.  It has beef and spinach AND tastes great!  It was the first meat baby food my son would eat.  I tasted it myself and it's quite good.
My baby is 8 months and I purchased the gourmet meals pack. She really liked this one best out of all of them.

column9: Great taste, nutritious, and organic all in one!
column10: My daughter loves this!  She is picky so she doesn't always eat as many healthy foods as she should.  This flavor gives her the vegetables and protein that she needs.  It is a little bit grainier than other stage 2 foods but still very usable for babies over 6 months.

I have never had a problem with anything from Amazon.  I have ordered about 30 cases of Earth's best baby food.  This is the most tasty and nutritious variety they offer.  5 grams of protein, and 15% iron! I have it on my subscribe and save.  He can't get enough of this, he eats it everyday!

column9: Does not look appetizing, and baby would not eat it.
column10: Earth's Best is supposed to be one of the best baby foods, but apparently my son does not have a palate for their food.  Maybe he did not like the texture of this stuff (it looks gritty).  He normally eats anything but was very sluggish with this food...turning his head after a couple of bites.

column9: It gone bad before we open
column10: It was bad before we open them. I saw them when we got. I did open. It had some spot green color. I did not know what it was. I was very upset. Do not buy this product.

When I saw some of the Earth's Best jars offered as a Gold Box deal, I remembered that I needed to offer a caveat to other parents.  My children have previously enjoyed many Earth's Best flavors, which in general taste quite good, so in February when there was a promotional offer through Amazon, we ordered two 12-packs. When they arrived, one of the 12-packs seemed ok, but the other 12-pack contained several broken jars and was leaking. It smelled and looked like there might be mold under the plastic that surrounded the second 12-pack.  I noticed that the shipping box holding the two 12-packs had air-filled padding on only the top side of the box, which meant that there was no padding protecting the bottom side.  I don't know whether some of the jars had broken at the warehouse or during delivery, but either way, I was afraid to use the unbroken jars too, because what if the seals had broken or what if there were small pieces of broken glass inside the intact jars too?For more durable items, I still order from Amazon, but I canceled my subscription of the Earth's Best jars and from now on will buy jars at a physical store where I can check them first.

My children have previously enjoyed many Earth's Best flavors, which in general taste quite good, so in February when there was a promotional offer through Amazon, we ordered two 12-packs of the tender beef spinach.
