The flour was good, but because of the weight (50 lbs) they could have done a better job in taping the box shut. The box was banged up a bit, only one strip of tape was used.
Unbleached flour should be no more then $0.50 per pound.Walmart sells gold medal brand for 2.38 per 5 pound bag.

I ordered a box of these from Butler and made our first meal with them last night.  I rehydrated them per the package directions with 4 1/2 cups warm water with about a 1/2 cup BBQ sauce, for flavor, stirred in for 10 minutes.  Then I drained them, carefully pressing out the excess water.  Moved them to a pan and simmered with remaining BBQ sauce (what was left from the bottle - about 3/4 cup) for about 20 minutes.  Served them on crusty hoagies.  YUM!  The texture was SPOT ON.These are the best vegan meat replacement I've had since becoming vegetarian.  If I had to say one negative about this product, it would be that they are pretty sauce/seasoning dependent (so you really need to get your sauce/seasoning right!). My normally picky vegetarian teen had two servings!  These are definitely going to be a staple in our house!

my mother gave me a bag of these with the sweet & sour recipe.  I made it and it was soooo good.I love these curls. I was  hoping they make other options.  Well worth trying if you are vegetarian or Not.
This product was hard to find and it was more than I expected it to be. If you are vegan you will love it.

Since my roommate brought home a bag of these, they've been eaten nearly daily in our house! They've got a great texture and can satisfy a meat eater without being so overly meat-like which might bother some vegans and vegetarians. We use them in stir-fry and fajitas, but I'm sure you could toss them in just about any recipe that would call for something meaty. We use Better Than Bullion No Chicken Base in the water and the curls soak the flavor right in to them. They're great. They're loved and eaten by the two vegans in our household AND by all of the meat-eating family and friends we have over!

column9: Found This Item Cheaper At Butler Website
column10: I have not personally tried these Soy Curls, but I wanted to let everyone know that the Butler website sells them for 6 bags (8 oz.) for $19.95. That works out to $3.33 a bag.

I've been looking for a meat/tofu substitue but didn't find one I like till I tried these.  The texture is just like meat.  They pick of the taste of your sauce or season really well.  They have become a permant item in my pantry.  My friend (a life time vegetarian) tried them and imediately had me order 24 bags of them for him.  Excellant product!

column9: Real food, good taste, good tooth
column10: These were quite a surprise to me. They are very useful in many vegetarian dishes, as all by themselves they have a good tooth--satisfying texture, and a definite flavor. They kind of do "taste like chicken," only in that they have a good flavor that is a bit nutty, a bit savory. I have used them in place of TVP in recipes that call for that, by grinding them in a food processor. They are also good whole.And best of all, unlike TVP and other kinds of highly processed soy products, these are a whole food. They are the whole soybean, not a milled, defatted, extruded, overcooked product. They steam and roll the whole bean (a process somewhat like that which produces rolled oats), so you get everything, not an isolated component from the bean.

I took a chance and bought 6 bags of these, and I was not disappointed!  I really like tofu and mostly like tempeh and seitan (depends on the preparation), but soy curls are most definitely my favorite "fake meat."  They are easy to prepare and can be used in a variety of recipes - from soups to tacos and fajitas to curries.  One the easiest and tastiest ways to prepare them is to reconstitute them (10 minutes), drain them, and then dump into a crock pot along with your favorite BBQ sauce.  4 hours later, you have amazing "pulled pork" that you can serve up on a bun or over rice.  When I made them this way, a few of my kids asked if I was *sure* they weren't eating meat.  :)  The texture is just right, and since they don't have much flavor on their own, they don't compete with the flavors you pair with them (as I find seitan does, for example).I honestly can't imagine anyone not liking soy curls.  They are just amazing!

column4: Karen A. Griffin "I'd rather be reading"
column10: I ordered a case of these from Butler and they are amazingly good. Wonderful meaty texture and no strange off taste. They can be seasoned/sauced a million ways and they pick up the taste of the seasoning. They are dehydrated and last a long time. And in larger quantities they cost about 2 bucks a pound. The best food find of the year for me.

Was very disappointed to open the box and see that the ingredients include sulfur dioxide (and salt).  I am returning them.  I just want to tell anyone else who doesn't buy food with sulfur dioxide so they don;t have to go thru the same thing.  It would have been nice if that ingredient had been listed on the Amazon page, so I would have known in advance.

I was very happy with both the caviar and the company. The shipment arrived next day well packaged and with wonderfully reusable freezer packs. The caviar was fresh and extremely tasty. I would certainly order from them again.
It may have been just the one we had, but it tasted bitter. I'm hoping it was just that caviar and not that it was spoiled. It wasn't awful, but it wasn't worth it.

column9: HORRIBLE doesn't begin to describe this product!  Very disappointed!
column10: The product description says: "Keta Salmon Caviar is from the select roe of the Keta Salmon, which has very large eggs with a color that can range from bright red to brilliant orange."The caviar I received consisted of really small eggs (about half the size of those at a sushi restaurant) that are mushy, and taste awful. Also, the caviar comes in a can like that of tuna fish or sardines. (Wish I would've known that before placing the order).The worst part of all is the mushy, bad-tasting mess that's inside...probably the result of its ingredients: salmon roe, salt, vegetable oil, sorbic acid.I am NOT happy with my order and feel I just threw money in the garbage.  The *reality* of the product bears *no resemblance* to the photo posted on Amazon.I have three cans of this stuff and don't know what to do with them. I had a "taste test" with my cat and dog, who *love* caviar) and they both turned their noses up at it. NOT a good sign.  :-(

Few months ago, I bout salmon roe caviar in three different variety ( American salmon caviar, Canadian salmon caviar, and Russian salmon caviar) for try from GourmetFoodStore . They are delivered via express mail in cold pack. The products are all fresh and good condition. They are all taste as it should be, how ever the American product was better than Canadian product in my taste buds but the Russian product were even better for my taste buds.In view of these, I recommend all of the product equally, but Russian is my choice for my taste buds. Ian Hammie.

Ordered malossol salmon caviar, received some orange mess in a regular green tin. Brave soul that I am - I have actually tried this nonsense. It does not come even close to resembling what a fresh, properly handled caviar should taste like. If I am still alive in 2 hours I guess you can call it "edible".

The Red Caviar is very fresh and melts in my mouth in the way it is suposed to do.  I don't know how they can improve the packing, the can came all slime.It was send well packed (refrigeration) and it came on a timely manner.

I love my Galangal powder from Whole Spice, use it in many recipes instead of black pepper since I cannot have black pepper. I like the economic bulk package from Whole Spice.  I keep a glass jar of the powder handy for cooking and refill it from the bag, as needed.  I do keep the open bag and the jar in the fridge but you may not have to do that.

column9: A nacho cheese that everyone will like!
column10: This is the best nacho cheese, and tastes great with chicken & beef! It's got a slight heat to it, but still mild enough that my kids will eat it. It's become impossible to find in AZ, so I was thrilled to find it on Amazon. The price is almost as good as I used to pay for it in stores. Definitely recommend!

column9: Not impressed - tastes like a soup
column10: i bought this hoping this would taste like commercial nacho cheese.  To me it tastes like and has the consistency of  soup - though nacho flavored.  for a nacho cheese soup, i'd give this 4 stars.  i wanted to use this as a chip dip, and i'd have to recommend something else.

We lived in Indiana and got hooked on Fiesta Nacho CHeese soup to top our at home Nachos, enchilladas, and even sometimes just a regular old taco, recently moved to CT and they do not sell it here (at least we haven't found any) So happy someone sells it online! Much better than any other nacho cheese around! Yum!

I have found this cheese hard to find in most grocery stores. Shelf space being taken up by store namesd products. I was happy to find it at Amazon, quick delivery and a price point comparible with store prices. The cheese is wonderful with Nachos and cooking. We enjoy it very much. Thanks Amazon

After every store we checked stopped carrying this product i desperately searched the internet for it even trying to order it directly from Campbells. Amazon.com was my hero. I was able to buy a case of it and have it sent right to the house. We like to use this for nachos. Im sure with the right recipe it would be great for cooking with chicken. Now it is available in our local WalMart again, so we are pleased to be able to pick it up on shopping trips.
This stuff is awesome! I use it in a lot of recipes including Tater Tot Casserole and Mom's Mac'n'Cheese. Getting a case or two shipped to my house every month makes planning dinner that much easier.

This was a really nice surprise as far as taste goes, not too spicy, actually JUST RIGHT. I'm usually quite picky when it comes to cheese products.  I read the previous reveiws on this and said, "Hey, sounds good to me", so I proceeded to order a case.  My boyfriend is really much more "pickier" then I, and  EVEN HE liked it.  So here I am, ordering yet another case before it disappears from Amazon (as things sometimes do).  Great price too, free shipping too (when you become a member of their club).  I highly recommend this item.  Great for nachos WITH FLAVOR.  Thanks for the recomendations previous to mine.

The packaging was perfect.  After opening the shrink - wrap around the 12 cans, I found that 9 out of 12 cans had damage.  75% of the cans were put in the shrink wrap damaged.  I am disappointed in this.
Thanks for the convenience or purchasing the fiesta nacho cheese.  I do believe I ordered one day and it appeared the next.

Not only does the taste of this nacho cheese leave something to be desired,(I purchased a recommended brand along with this one for comparison) but it also contains yeast extract. In short yeast extract is a substance the food industry has turned to in light of the consumer response to MSG. Like MSG yeast extract also contains free glutamic acid. I have a sensitive metabolism and will usually develop an allergic reaction to most of the unsavory chemicals that appear in processed food. I sampled half a serving of this cheese and sure enough I had the same response to MSG (the recommended brand of nacho cheese I purchased along with this one did not produce the same results and tastes better too, it does not contain yeast extract). Caveat Emptor

column9: Low sodium and good with blueberries
column10: Perhaps it is because I had low expectations but I did enjoy the mix. It was convenient and low in sodium. Other mixes add way too much salt. I'd also suggest adding fruits like dried blueberries and a pinch of cinnamon and vanilla to the mix. I think the dash of spice helps enhance the flavor. As for texture, I used a griddle and the result was light and fluffy pancakes. If you want.need even more rise though, just fold in a whipped egg white.

I tried this despite the poor reviews because I really miss pancakes and with the low cost, thought, what the heck. But I took one bite and had to throw it away. I thought it would have a nice sugary flavor but it just tasted gross. I can't even describe it. Synthetic, maybe? Also, the serving sizes they list on the box are a joke. For example, the box says that 1/4 of mix with 3 tbs of water will make four pancakes. Maybe four nickel-size pancakes. MAYBE. I had to use a whole cup--which probably left only about a cup left in the entire boxI--just to get a pancake a little bigger than a saucer. know this is cheap but do yourself a favor and save your money. Just search online for recipe and do it yourself (you can buy zero sodium baking powder and lower sodium salt).
this was not my favorite, kinda tough and size is very small.  I would like to have known the size.

I might have missed the nutrtional information, but just as a warning to other - this is not a low carb food.  One serving has over 30 grams of carbohydrate.  Even if you subtract the 11 grams of sugar alcohol and 1 gram of fibre, you're still in the 20 gram range for each serving.  I'm not sure what the point of this product is, but if you are trying to find food for a low carb diet, this is not your product.I can't rate the taste or ease of preparation as we're not going to eat it.  Because, you know, even though it says it is sugar-free, it still has over 20 grams of carbs per serving!!!!
the offer was great! the no postage was great! it got here fast! the seeds didn't sprout!! i will try another sprouting, lost three weeks. bought some plants at home depot.
I received the item as described. The seeds germinated quickly. Surprisingly, almost all of them! I was pleased with this purchase.

I am a low carb dieter and was worried this bread was "to good to be true" when I ordered it.  The bread came out very bitter and I could not finish the loaf.  I must admit I am not much of a cook or have much experience with baking so there is a chance the bad bread was a screw up on my part.
I made the decision some time ago not to buy bleached sugar ever again. I was thrilled to find this product: fair trade certified natural sugar at a good price.

column9: Great sugar, not a great price
column10: I didn't realize it when I ordered, but this is the same brand and size I could have bought from Costco down the street & it would have been about $8 cheaper.  The sugar is really good, though, even in lemonade.

If what you're looking for is the most organic sugar for your buck, then you'll want to look elsewhere.  Whole Food's has bulk organic sugar for around ~$1.60/lb.  And by 'bulk,' I don't mean like Sam's Club or Costco's.  You scoop/pour the sugar into your own jar (tagged and pre-measured at customer service) or a bag there.If you're looking to help your fellow man out a little more, than this isn't too bad once in a while but it's steep increase at ~$2.80/lb.  This is in contrast to the Wholesome Sweeteners Fair Trade Organic Sugar, 16-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12), which is the same exact product but around ~3.56/lb, and at best (with Subscribe/Save) $~3.03/lb.To be completely fair, there have been arguments made against Fair Trade and whether or not it truly helps the struggling farmers that it markets itself as protecting.  I won't link out to anything specific but you can Google "Fair Trade Debate" and find a good amount of criticism against it.I like to think that it does help.But I also won't pretend that I don't also get the standard organic sugar in bulk.
This tastes just like normal sugar. This also dissolves just as rapid as normal sugar. It also looks like normal sugar. The bag can be resealed time and time again after you open it.

column9: Corn Free, Gluten Free and Grain Free
column10: If you are corn or gluten intolerant like I am this is the product for you.  I am very sensitive and this product has worked out wonderfully. Their brown sugar is also corn and gluten free. Only draw back is the shipping.  Try getting the smaller packs or getting Amazon prime if your going to use this regularly.  That may save you cause the price for the product is right but the shipping is tough. As with any recommendation any manufacture can change what they do.  I hope these guys don't but I as a responsible corn and gluten victum would say double check with the manufacture about this product before you buy as of Christmas 2010 it was corn and gluten free.

This is great sugar. It has a beautiful blonde color and tastes like great sugar. I love that it is organic and fair trade. This is the best price I've found so far and the 10 lb bag will last me a long time. It also nice that it comes in a resealable bag too! Happy customer. Will buy again when I run out.

This is good Ti Kuan Yin (Oolong) tea. It's well packed, and the leaves are clean. It's not in the league of the truly select Ti Kuan Yin teas out there. It's a bit more subdued on the palate, and doesn't have the deep, earthy aroma that the very best of the variety have.Still, I give it 4 stars. 1) Because it's a pleasant tea, easy to drink daily. 2) The price, especially considering that it's organically grown, is terrific.  It's a great value!I doubt that it's "slimming" at all.  If you want to get slim, eat less and move around more!  But it's a nice tea, if you enjoy Oolong.

I feel that this Ti Kuan Yin tea has more of a toasted flavor than most. I prefer my Ti Kuan Yin to taste much closer to a green tea.The price is great for this tea, just not exactly what I am looking for.

Please understand: I'm NOT expert on the varieties of Oolongs but this is my ordinary favorite -- delicious, satisfying, always.I gave up drinking coffees about 35 years ago when news reports said scientific studies (since refuted) showed that people who drank more than 5 cups of coffee a day had double the risk of heart attacks.  Because my coffee intake at the time qualified me for 2X double, I switched to teas.For many of these years, I've loved many loose leaf tea varieties (I HATE tea bag/tea container teas)--especially various estate Darjeelings, Keemuns, occasionally Lapsang Souchongs, often Assams when I wanted a 5 hr. energy boost, more often Gunpowders, Oolongs.  But over the ensuing decades, my preference has gradually drifted to teas with less (theobromines) kick -- to especially the Keemun, Oolongs, and green gunpowders.Over those years, I bought all my loose leaf teas from Murchies in Canada. Only recently, since the Murchies company has changed hands, have I bought from other sources.I AM well pleased with THIS Oolong. It's as good as any I've ever had from Murchies.

I have to agree with the last review.  It is a pleasant tea but I prefer it to be a little darker and less green.  It is better than the Ti Kuan Yin that I got from Numi but it doesn't compare to what I get from Wegmans.  Wegman's Ti Kuan Yin is 50 per pound.  It is a good value but I feel I have to use more of it to get the flavor that I want.  I tried to give it 3 and a half stars but could not.

I think it is one of the best values for organic oolong.  I have been using this tea as oolong tea is recommended to boost the metabolism at a higher rate than other teas.  I drink several large glasses a day and can tell the difference in feeling less bloated and am loosing inches.  On the days I don't have any, I can feel the difference.  I started drinking oolong after reading in "the Younger Thinner You Diet" by Dr. Eric Braverman that it will increase one's metabolism.  It has a mild taste and love that it is organic.
I've tried a number of oolong teas and this is one of the first that actually is slimming and has a great taste. you can't go wrong with this brand!

I've been drinking tea in the morning for over 30 years.  Taylors of Harrogate Tea is just about the best I've tasted thus far.  The tea itself is flavorful and the bergamot flavoring is strong enough but not overwhelming (and made with real oil of bergamot).  I recently had to buy Twinings Earl Grey when I ran out of the Taylors and was pretty amazed by the difference.  Twinings doesn't claim to use real oil of bergamot and you can taste the difference, it tastes like fake lemon flavor and the background flavor of the tea itself is pretty bland.  I have to say that not much compares to the quality of the Taylors of Harrogate tea.

Two interesting diametrically opposed viewpoints below. One likes Taylor's the other Twinnings. I can't weigh in on that because if I had Twinnings before it didn't make much of an impression on me. Another reviewer somewhere said that Taylor's didn't have enough Earl Grey taste.I've had a lot of Taylor's Earl Grey and it is a mild tea. Right now I'm drinking a very strong Earl Grey and the bergamot overshadows the tea. So if you want a mild Earl Grey, Taylor's is the one you want.You should never buy a tea just for it's brand nor for it's price. Once I bought the most expensive Earl Grey I could find, and it wasn't better than a cheaper one. Having said that, don't buy a cheapo Earl Grey that's made from bad/poor tea leaves, so you should stick with something reputable.The one I'm drinking now is a loose leaf organic Earl Grey from Whole Foods. My wallet thanks me because it's not expensive (it's loose leaf), my body thanks me because it's organic (probably fertilized with poop rather than commercial fertizer), my conscience thanks me because it's probably free trade/living wage, my thrifty subconscious thanks me because it's a lot of bergamot for the price, and my eco-snobbery is appeased because I shopped at Whole Foods.However, Taylor's EG is not bad. I've had many Taylor's teas, don't like many of them, love some of them, but I think Taylor is a reputable company and produces good quality teas.I echo two comments from the other reviewers.1) This is a really good deal if you like it. Low price and free shipping. If you've previously bought a can of the stuff, you can use the empty tin can to hold a small amount and keep the rest in a cool dark place.2) You better try and like this first before buying a kilo of it.Good drinking!

I thought I would try the Taylors of Harrogate Earl Grey Tea and I purchased the 35.3 ounce bag. To my mind, and I have been drinking tea for35 years, the product is just fair. In fact, today I ordered 500 grams(16 ounces) of Twinings Earl Grey and 125 grams of Twinings Lady Earl Grey. To some extent these will be a replacement in the morning for the Harrogate. I guess this means I am putting my money where my mouth is.Twinings is more famous, and to be honest, you might like the taste of this standard brand tea better.Also, I like the German brand, Messer, Old English Tea, Earl Grey.  However, it is very difficult to get this in America. I usually have friends from Germany bring me this or I ship it to myself in the summer.One of the best of all is the French Fauchon Earl Grey tea, but at $13.50 a tin (125 grams), this is a little expensive for my needs.My suggestion is not that you should not purchase the Taylor's tea. I think only that you should purchase a little tin first and compare the taste with Twinings Earl Grey before ordering 2 pounds of the product.

column9: Great Tea, distinct flavor, poor packaging by Amazon
column10: I love this tea, has a great aroma, flavor. I'd have given it 5 stars were it not for the poor packaging by Amazon.After the first shipment I blamed the tea for having too much small "dust" fall through a high quality infuser basket.  Then the second shipment arrived (Subscribe and Save is a a great deal) and I found the outer box too large, with not enough padding to prevent the 1kg tea bag from moving around freely - so the tea breaks in shipping.

column9: LOVE IT! WAY better than Twinings!!
column10: Superb tea! And you can buy it in the kilo - just like bulk coffee. Excellent and consistent flavor. Twinings has a horrible after taste to me. But, WHERE IS IT?? I haven't been able to get ToH Early Grey or Kwazulu for 3 months!!! I'm running out. Can anyone help! ewiniarczyk@gmail.com

NO EARL GREY TEA THAT I HAVE DRUNK OVER THE PAST 60 YEARS HAS TASTED PRECISELY THE SAME AS ANY OTHER.  TAYLORS BRAND EXACTLY SUITS MY TASTE.  IN ADDITION, IT IS REASONABLY PRICED, IT IS WELL PACKED, IT KEEPS WELL.  I WOULD BUY NO OTHER UNLESS I COULD NO LONGER OBTAIN TAYLORS.  rosy lee

We very much like Earl Grey tea.  We have usually consumed Twinings brand, but recently tried Taylors of Harrogate, mostly due to the very good price and the fact that it came in a kilo, not lots of little cans...  On first opening the bag, we found the bergamot scent to be almost overwhelming.  We were amazed at the freshness, but thought it might be too strong for our liking.  During the first cup, we were still undecided, but after many cups over more than a week, we like it!  Very much!  The scent has dissipated slightly and this tea brews into a very smooth, pleasant cup of Earl Grey.  We like it more and more as the days pass.  The quality of the tea, itself, seems far superior to Twinings, which we've noticed seems to be of lower quality the past year or two.  We will be ordering this tea again!

column9: Excellent tea at an amazing price!
column10: I have not been able to find Taylor's amazing Earl Grey (loose leaf) at this price anywhere else. Free shipping is just cherry on top. This tea is sublime - the best Earl Grey out there, bar none. It blows that Twinings swill right out of the water! Try Taylor's and you will never go back to any other Earl Grey again.

column4: Jacki Gunter "good movie or book lover"
column10: These are great.  Of course I am a nut for chocolate Pop-Tarts.  You get so many of them at one time that you always have them there and by the time you have finished them you are ready to leave Pop-Tarts alone for a while. This is a terrific way to get them.
Great breakfast with a glass of milk. No fuss and no mess. Not to mention that they are a great value...
Can't go wrong with pop-tarts, especially with the discount that was being offered at the time!

When I buy these in the grocery store, I have roughly a year before the expiration date. These however, expire less than 3 months after I got them. I have to somehow eat 144 poptarts in 3 months!?! They came packaged well though.

These are pretty good junk food for those times you need a pastry, though I was surprised at the calorie count. They are packaged two pastries to a foil packet and it lists the serving size as one pastry at 200 calories. Yikes... is this why we have an obesity problem in America? These should come with a warning, "Open packet at your own peril".  I recommend keeping a sandwich bag handy to whisk away the other pastry once you open that foil packet or 400 empty calories will be eaten in the blink of an eye.

column9: Half the price of xanthan gum.  Works really well.
column10: If you are new to gluten-free baking, you should be aware that you only need 1 teaspoon of this binder to each cup of gluten-free flour.  That means that if you were to buy this in this volume, and you are baking for one person, you would never use it up before it went bad.On the flip side, if you are cooking gluten-free for a family, this is a bargain, not for the price, but for the availability:  guar gum can be hard to find in stores.Guar gum itself is a bargain for another reason: guar gum is 1/3 the price of xanthan gum, and yet it's one of the standard binders, xanthan gum and pre-gel starch being the others. (For those of you less familiar with gluten-free baking, you have to have a binder, kind of like an extra required flour, to make up for the lack of gluten.)Finally, hats off to Bob's Red Mill for selling this cheaply and in bulk.  The celiac community is somewhat hostage to vendors who sell what they can eat--and there are those who take advantage of that.  Selling guar gum at this price is another example of Bob's Red Mill having integrity.  Yay!

column9: Better Option for us than Xanthan Gum
column10: I use this product as a "binder" in gluten-free baking as a substitute where recipes call for xanthan gum.  Xanthan gum is much more expensive.  I use it 1:1 as a replacement & works great (& has no corn derivatives).

This product is great for thickening smoothies.  Whey powders blend to a thin consistency.  Adding a level teaspoon of guar gum gives it just the right thickness.  Makes you feel that you're getting a "healthy" milk shake.

column9: High Mountain Magic.  Food of the Gods.
column10: Even though I write reviews mostly on my favorite types of escape novels, I was sparked by Amazon's enthusiasm, to take part in the grocery store and gourmet food expansions here.  My first purchase (of products beyond books) included a grain called QUINOA (Keenwa.The product arrived in very good order and within perfect timing.In that maiden purchase I also added lavender and clove essential oils to my shopping cart, along with powdered cloves, and lavender tea.  See my Listmania on Essential Oils (which indicates which items I've reviewed) for info on the values and uses of lavender and cloves, available from various vendors here.I consider Quinoa to be the most valuable food available on the planet, a food which meets my standards for luxury gourmet in flavor (and culinary versatility), in addition to being baseline healthy with full-spectrum nourishment.If I had to be limited to only 4 items or food groups (in addition to water, of course) to eat or drink, those would be Quinoa, Coffee, Dairy Products, and a variety of greens, spices, & nuts.  Yeah, okay, dairy products; and greens, spices, & nuts may be considered more than 2 items, but, for me they're two categories.I'm not a vegetarian because I love meat, chicken, and fish, but if I'm working with limitations, I'm making do with the most basic of basics, while still having enough food items to concoct satisfying flavor (yeah, yeah, and nutrition, too, though according to my beliefs, "nutrition" dims and deteriorates, unless it's in the living presence of "yummy.").Quinoa, I believe, would take care of all (or at least many) basic nutritional needs.The way I simplify my use and preparation of Quinoa is to think of it either as rice or oatmeal, and then to "gourmet it" accordingly.-- As "rice" I add savory herbs like parsley, basil, marjoram, garlic, onions, etc.  Actually, most types of herb concoctions or side foods which could be blended with pasta would also work with Quinoa.  Think of what Lidia's Italian Table does with "noodle heaven"; then substitute Quinoa for pasta (I like pasta too, of course).-- As "oatmeal" I add sweet or rich ingredients like fruit (including raisin and date types), brown sugar, molasses, maple, creme, that type of thing.As far as cooking instructions, to me they're basically the same as rice:- Add water or liquid in a 2 to 1 ratio.  2 cups liquid ( water, broth, vegetable, or fruit juices) to 1 cup Quinoa.-- Instructions are given on the bag for boiling the water then adding the Quinoa, covering the pot, and simmering for 12-15 minutes.-- I've also successfully prepared Quinoa in the microwave.  You can heat the water to boil in a bowl then add Quinoa, cover, and cook.  Normally, a microwave cooks 4 times faster than "outside-the-waves" cooking, but, of course that time varies with larger amounts of food.  For example, 1 potato cooks (on average) in 4 - 8 minutes, 2 potatoes require double that, or 8 -16 minutes.-- For a single serving cooked quickly in the microwave, I might use 1/4 cup Quinoa with 2/4 (½) cup liquid.I have actually simplified the process for myself by placing those single serving amounts (Quinoa and water in a bowl) in the microwave, and cooking it on high, maybe 3 minutes, till the liquid bubbles.  Then I cover the bowl with a plate "lid"; zap it for another minute or half, then let it "steep" in the microwave, without opening it, for another few minutes.  (Since microwave ovens and tastes for texture differ, you'll have to experiment with your own microwave processes to get results which work for you, or just use the sauce pan method described on the bag.)In the microwave, Quinoa seems to cook easier than rice.But, I also cook rice in the microwave in a similar method.  I don't use minute rice, since my microwave method works easily and fairly quickly, and if I cook it in a serving bowl with a plate "lid" I can just place it on the table for family style "digging in."I love the nutty, barley flavor of Quinoa.  Thankfully, so does my husband!In the past I've purchased Quinoa from Bob's Red Mill, and White Mountain Farms in Colorado, in the San Juan mountain area (have always been satisfied with those sellers, when/if the products are available on Amazon).  Having used many different Now Foods products, I'm very confident in ordering any item from them.Recently, Eden Quinoa (sold by Amazon), Alter Eco Fair Trade, Berry Farm, and Angelinas have been added to my list of healthful, gourmet food purveyors.  The reviews on Quinoa Red buying pages were helpful. In addition to the most common golden grain, I've only seen black Quinoa, which is also appealing, and is reportedly the oldest variety. Well, actually all the reviews I've read on Quinoa have offered something of value to the info I've already gathered. The extra details of info on the Alter Eco Fair Trade buying pages were appreciated very much. (I used to sell Quinoa in my CITY CHEF kitchen store, which is no longer open; I spend all my time writing now, with a little cooking on the side.)Quinoa has an iteresting history, including the development of a saponin coating on the grain:--  The genetics in the Quinoa seeds, after eons and ages of growing, had developed the saponin coating as a very effective protection against insects and burrowing varment's, like worms or parasites.-- Knowing what saponin is and does, I began a habit of saving some of the water used to rinse Quinoa for watering my plants, or pouring on the ground where I might want to discourage insects.-- Once the saponin is removed, I'm not sure how long the "naked" grains will be able to protect themselves again parasitic invasions.  Certainly, Quinoa (being a very strong, wise-old-grain with high integrity, for many reasons) would be able to do so longer than other similar, eons-younger food offerings.  I'm not concerned about this, and will usually order either pre-washed grain or saponin coated, whichever is readily available.Quinoa grows only above a 7,000-foot-elevation and requires a certain growing climate, which can be found only in certain areas of the world.  Some parts of the Rocky Mountains are one of those areas, not tested until fairly recently (in terms of the eons and ages associated with this ancient grain from the Incas).Interesting stories about Quinoa's long history are bountiful, but I won't get into those.  A large assortment of books and pamphlets are available to read on it, and of course, many are offered here on Amazon.I remain ever thankful for magical foods (which are both gourmet and healthy in quality), especially in our era of being told by some authorities that we need to remove the life, magic, wholeness, and flavor out of most everything.  For the sake of "health"?Here's an interesting question to ponder:Why and how, for a while (eons), did we lose Quinoa seeds, which had "lived" long enough to develop saponin.  Why and how did we find them again?For an easy, exotic recipe using Quinoa, see my review of Virgin Coconut Oil (Certified Organic) 12 fl.ozLinda ShelnuttAuthor of several books, including:Molasses Moon

column10: I first purchased this product for $28.00 and that was a good deal, but they just had to raise thereprice to over $32.00 for (6) 16oz packs and they are now to costly.The Bob's (4) 32oz packs at $32.78 is a much better deal and I believe a better product.You get a total of 104oz with Bob's, and only 96oz with Eden.USE A RICE COOKERForget the directions and use one part Quinoa to two parts water. (Like you are making oatmeal)It will then be a better replacement for rice, much healthier, and with the added benefit of adding fiber which will definitely clean you out.I also don't wash it as directed, as you would have to do with red Quinoa, and the washing can loose a lot of the product down the drain.
We are only 2 but I prepare a serving for 4 and keep it for a long while in the refrig and use it in several of the recipes that I find on line.

I started buying quinoa when I was exercising religiously. Even though I don't exercise like I use to I still keep quinoa in my diet, because of how versatile it is; not just with its nutrient content, but also with its cooking. I use to buy this product from a local health food store. I'm paying a lot less by buying it here. Definitely worth it.

I recently discovered Quinoa. I wish I knew about it sooner. It is delicious, cooks up like rice and is much tastier then rice. This brand is Organic and they do not "wash" it to remove the shells, they grind it so their is no loss of nutrients. I just bought it on the auto shipment as it is a much better rice then in the grocery store.

column9: Excellent source if fiber and protein!!
column10: I love buying quinoa because it is such a healthy grain but it tends to be very expensive at the supermarket. Buying in bulk is definately more convenient and saves me a ton of money.
Tasty and good for you. I just wish that it was prewashed so I did not have to rinse it before putting it in my rice cooker.

First of all, quinoa is a great and versatile grain.  If you are looking at this grain, you know how nutritious it is.  Aside from that, it goes well as a rice type grain as well as a porridge or oatmeal type grain.  I have had no problem with the rinsing, one rinse does fine.  I will warn you though, this quinoa requires a strainer with VERY small holes.  If you have that it is a piece of cake to make.  Only 15 minutes, which is extremely quick for a whole grain.  It is particularly good with cinnamon, cloves, and Edensoy.  As far as the Eden brand, this is the company you can be happy supporting.  Essentially all of Eden products are sourced from family farms in the United States.  This isn't the case for quinoa, but other products such as Edensoy and their beans are all USA family farm grown.  Unlike conventional products and big organic products, Eden cares about where the food comes from, how it is prepared and how it is shipped.  They are the ideal small organic agricultural company to support.

We love quinoa and use it many ways in our culinary selections. We've had quinoa from various sources, and while it is all nutritious, I'm sure, Eden Quinoa is really superb. It is well packaged, competitively priced, and very tasty. We'll be buying more as soon as our supply begins to dwindle, which won't be too long.
This stuff is SO good for ya, and tastes really great.  Amazon has the Best Price I have seen so far, AND the shipping is free if you order $25.  Good quality.

This was my first time eating quinoa so I'm not sure how good of a help I will be.  Overall I think I may prefer the taste of couscous because quinoa doesn't really have any flavor by itself.  I only bought quinoa because of the price.  I hope to try it out with more recipes as I'm only on the second bag.

I have just discovered this magnificent berry (at least, I think that's what it is scientifically). I love pasta, but I've been converting to whole wheat versions as of late. Then, I had dinner by someone's house and they put this instead of rice inside a chicken capon. Soooooo gooooood.Even though there were some diehard lovers of farfel in my house, this is made instead, with sauteed onions and mushrooms, salt and pepper mixed in. No complaints, from either the young or old. I feel good after eating it, and it's so versatile - it can be added to soups, as a side dish, for salads - bless the guys who resurrected it.Plus, it's kosher for Passover - Ashkenazim no longer have to be jealous of the Sephardim and their rice.

column9: goog service and a good product
column10: I have always had good service with any products I have purchased through and from Amazon.com Keep up the good reputation you have built so far and i look forward to shopping with you in future
Quinoa is very healthy and deliscious. Eden quinoa is especially tasty.  Can be prepared like risce or couscous.

column9: Excellent brownie mix, perfect for long-term storage or camping
column10: I think Marie Callender's brownie mix is every bit as good or better than any of the leading brands, but one of its great advantages over all of them, in my opinion, is that it comes packaged in a heavy plastic sealed bag, not in the usual cardboard box containing the typically flimsy plasticized paper pouch inside. Consequently, I feel much more confident about storing it in my pantry long-term, because I know the contents will be utterly impervious both to pests and to weather. These bags are also quite convenient to take camping (yes, with a camp stove you can make brownies out in the wilderness! That's what silicone brownie pans are for, isn't it? ;) ) because, again, in its sturdy sealed plastic bag the mix is impervious to pests both large and small and even more severe weather than in my pantry, plus the plastic bag, while sturdy, is much lighter and easier to cram into odd corners of a backpack than a cardboard box is, and if it rains heavily or the canoe takes on water, there's no need to worry about the mix being ruined!

column9: Best mustard on the planet - PERIOD !
column10: You can try the rest, I tried them all. The Pommery Moutarde du Lion is THE best mustard in the universe (and then some). It was a bright flavor and a kick to it. All others seem to taste like chemicals when compared. This is the real McCoy. Absolutely phenomenal ! Is there a 6 star ?

I like these limes. Since they are VERY hard I crushed them in the mortar and then made a fine powder with them in the blender. I then mixed in some sea salt and use it in soups, on meat and with hard boiled eggs and stuff. Great stuff!

This salmon roe caviar is both affordable and delicious.  Each little pop of salty roe atop a blini or water cracker is devine.  Also good paired with raw quail egg, ponzu, sake, scallion, sea urchin roe and tobiko for an "uni shooter"...Yummmmm...

I've been eating these, one a day for a year. Yes, I have to ration them. I love them. I've had the dark ones too, but like these a little better. Great coupon deal at Kostco (about $6.50 for 21.2 oz, 50 pieces). The one they're having this year is for assorted, hope I like them all.Edit May 4, 2011. The last two years Kostco's coupon deals on these appeared a month or two before Xmas. They stopped offering a choice between milk and extra dark chocolate varieties and now stock variety packs with extra dark, dark, milk, white, and milk chocolate with peanut butter. I really like them all. I stocked up with a year's supply of these variety bags of 50 the last two years, last time being Nov. 16, 2011. Just like before, I allow myself one a day, but two on Saturdays!
Bought a 24 pack of this, I had been using Pop Secret Butter.  I immediately noticed it was soggy, and left a thick coat of grease on the roof of my mouth.Yuk!

The Maruchan "Roasted" Chicken and Beef Instant Lunch is the best soup that I've tasted of this type of instand soup.  The "Roasted" flavor is great, it is must better than just the regular Maruchan Instand Soup.

The items in the easter pail were not up to par to cost $39.95 ,I feel I got ripped off and won't buy something like that again,everything in it is junk I don't even want to give it to my grandaughter.Thanks for letting me get out my frustration.

If you enjoy pairing tea with honey then the Le Grand Miel might become the favorite honey for French Vanilla Tea. The Bigelow tea has a distinctive flavor and the smooth perfection of creamy rich Le Grand Miel blends effortlessly to create a tea experience.Tasting a spoonful of this honey is truly a revelation. This is how honey should taste. All too often honey is syrupy but mild and lacking in any texture. This honey has a unique creamy almost melted caramel texture with a smooth melting quality that is reminiscent of fresh breezes over open fields.The insightful use of a pail makes the use of this honey a dream. No longer do you have to worry about honey dripping down the sides of plastic bottles or glass containers.The honey is safely stored away in a sealed container inside the pail and travels very well through the mail. I will be ordering this again!Le Grand Miel is not just honey, it is an experience of perfection! If you love using honey in your tea, this is the one to buy because it enhances the flavor and adds a delicate perfume to tea drinking pleasure.~The Rebecca Review

column9: WITH OUT A DOUBT, THE BEST HONEY I'VE EVER TASTED !
column10: I HAD THIS AT A FRIENDS HOUSE AND WAS AMAZIED !! I HAVE NOT BEEN A BIG HONEY FAN, BUT THIS IS TOTALLYTHE VERY BEST....PLEASE TRY IT., YOU WILL BE WON OVER.
I'm not even a honey-afficionado, but I can tell you this honey is special... The fragrance of Provencal flowers comes through in every drop... Lovely

Even though it says nothing on the box, but this tea is a CTC, meaning leaves have been crushed into tiny, irregular balls that resemble coffee grounds; I consider this very low quality tea.The picture on the box leaves you to believe that it contains long and good quality leaf. I received mine a few days ago and I was very disappointed to see that it contains exclusively broken small CTC coffee grounds balls type of tea. Other than  that the aroma and the taste do not disappoint.Also lost trust on this brand not knowing what I would really get since they neglected to mention a very important peace of data; that this was a CTC tea.

I wasn't sure whether the maple syrup will be good since there were no reviews on it. It is delicious! It has a wonderful aroma and is very good on pancakes. It is lighter than the syrups you get in the grocery store but much better for you!

this is the best, most flavorful maple syrup I have ever tasted!  The price beats any atthe grocery store. the only diwn side is the plastic bottle. I lrefer not buying any plastic if I can help it. I will pribably buy the more costly organic brands at the store because they are in glass.  what a shame.It was shipped almost next day, is organic and I hope they start using jars or glass bottles soon

I ordered the Bellagio hot chocolate for favors at my wedding.  I tried it ahead of time to make sure it was going to taste good.  It was well worth it.  I recieved many compliments from my guests on how much they liked it.  The price was perfect, as was the product!

This cocoa, Bellagio Chocolate Truffle Cocoa Mix, is this chocolate lover'sdream.  A topping of whipped cream (mit schlag) and I'm transported to the Vienna of my imagination.  I can't wait to try the other mixes from Bellagio.YUM!!!!
I love Hot Coco and this is by far the best I have tasted.

I usually do not feel mislead by reviews but this is one of the few.  This is very mediocre cocoa powder but nothing mediocre about the premium price.  Not the worst thing I have had but will never get it again.

I purchased the product for a Christmas gift and assumed that coming from Bellagio it would be perfect.  The person I gave it to tried one packet and gave the rest away.  She said it smelled great but tasted chalky and wouldn't drink any more of it.

column9: I got the 2-lb Bellagio Chocolate Truffle!
column10: Hey, every culture has their ideal preference in cocoa. Look at the humble Nestle Milo or even Ovaltine---every nation has variations. Made in Singapore or anywhere in Asia is sweeter than their Latino counterpart. Mexicans or Colombians like that strong cocoa taste.Ive also tried Neuhaus, Chirardelli and other store brands, but I prefer Bellagio because there's no need to mix in milk for that smooth Belgian taste.Belgium or European chocolates are different from America's Hersheys brand. Their chocolate mix is not overpowering.Bellagio Chocolate Truffle reminds me of Starbuck's Signature chocolate drink with less calories (thhe company phased out this brand because of high caloric content -- 700 calories for the venti)So if you're on the go or a busy mom like me, Bellagio choco is the best comfort drink this cold season.

I keep trying to find a hot chocolate I like better, but I haven't found one yet.  Traditionally, I am dark chocolate fan but this is an excellent, rich chocolate drink.  It is also my mother's favorite and she is very direct with her hints that it's time for me to send her some when her stock gets low.I read a review that someone thought the Bellagio brand had a chemical taste.  The reviewer might have been referring to other flavors.  There is a different taste that seems perhaps spicey, but not chemical.  I also like the fact that it contains non-dairy creamer because I do not drink milk.
This chocolate is wonderful! I prefer the Belagio Sipping Chocolate, but for people who aren't as keen on dark, rich chocolate, this mix is great!

I use hot chocolate packets to stir into my coffee.  I normally use Land O'Lakes hot chocolate, but I've had trouble getting some of my favorite flavors, so I wanted to try something new.  I ordered the Bellagio Chocolate Truffle flavor, and I suppose that it gets the job done.  But to make my coffee taste chocolatey enough, I've been having to mix in the Bellagio cocoa with a K-cup hot chocolate.  The flavor's a little flat, and the texture is pretty watery when compared to Land O'Lakes or even regular Swiss Miss.  I don't hate it, but there are better options out there, so I won't be ordering it again.

column9: My boyfriend LOVES this hot chocolate!!!
column10: Every year for Christmas I have given my boyfriend different gourmet brands of hot chocolate as stocking stuffers. However three years ago I got Bellagio hot chocolate and that is the ONLY brand he wants. He especially loves the caramel praline and the chocolate truffle. They are smooth and wonderful in warm/hot milk! It's never an over whelming or under whelming flavor. Always delicious. Whether you are sipping it reading a book or having it with friends after a great meal. I highly recommend it!!!

column9: Bellagio French Vanilla Hot Chocolate review
column10: Excellent taste and decent price until Amazon hiked it several months ago by 50%.  Other chocolates are comparable to this one.  Very good.
I got this for my wife, she really likes it!  I've had a cup myself and it is very good!  The vanilla flavor blends well with the cocoa.  Give it a try!
This hot chocolate does not have the strongest flavor, but it is incredibly creamy and smooth. Definitely worth the price for that much.
This is a great hot cocoa - dissolves quickly and fully - great flavor, very rich and creamy even with just hot water. Far better than the typical hot cocoa.

column9: This Hot Chocolate is Horrible or maybe it is the batch I received...
column10: I am a true lover of hot chocolate and this chocolate is not that great.  The taste is flat and does not taste that chocolaty.  I was truly disaapointed so I shared it with a co-worker and she stated that she did not like it either.  Her exact words were, "This has a unusual taste...not good".

What offends me most about this product isn't just the ingredient list that sounds like it comes straight from a mad scientist and takes a lot of reading to even reach anything that sounds remotely like food: I've come to expect that from today's mass market food. What offends me is the blatant misleading marketing. Not only does the package look fancy and have a fancy name, and not only does it say "A European Classic" (this is an American product), and not only does it say "Gourmet Hot Cocoa" (because at an expensive restaurant I always ask the chef for "corn syrup solids"), but worst of all "Savor the flavor of old world style chocolate": because I'm sure in the old world they mixed a nice helping of partially hydrogenated soybean oil and silicon dioxide into their hot chocolate.Someone gave me a package of this stuff and I'm debating whether or not to eat it, so I can't comment on the taste. But the misleading advertising alone, combined with this chemistry lab of ingredients, deserves one star no matter how it tastes.

Very tasty Special K cereal!  They MUST be lying about the calories; how is it that this cereal has less calories than the original Special K?  Anywhoo, that won't stop me from eating it......it's almost like having a Nature Valley Oat & Honey granola bar in your cereal bowl!

We really like the Special K Vanilla Almond and Cinnamon Pecan Cereals.  They have been the only cereal we have purchase lately.  I especially enjoyed the cinnamon pecan flavor.  I recently tried the Multigrain Oats and Honey flavor.  I like it even better. Good flavor. Stays crispier. The flakes don't get as soggy the other two varieties. I will buy the Multigrain Oats and Honey cereal again.

Always been a big fan of Special K.  I really don't know why.  I'm a 27 year old male in decent shape but cereals are my weakness.  Not the overly sugary kind, but instead the sweet-but-healthy kind.  I'm usually all for Blueberry Special K, but I thought I would give this a try and I'm a fan!

I don't often eat breakfast, but I am trying to eat healthier and need something quick before work, this Special K with oats and honey is a bit sweet for me, but once I start, I can't stop eating it up, so that's a very good thing!

We bought this using Subscribe & Save to try out the program, and we are very satisfied with the product AND S&S. This cereal is a great low calorie option that tastes probably twice as good as regular Special K. My husband and I happen to like regular Special K, but several of our friends think it tastes like "air" or "cardboard." I recommended the Multigrain Oats and Honey to them as an alternative, and everyone seems to like it.One thing to note is that it's pretty sweet. I used to use sweetened almond or soy milk, but I highly recommend unsweetened almond milk. I also love to top smoothies with this cereal; as you make your smoothie, though, you might want to leave out any sweeteners like honey or sugar. I also often add a little extra spinach or kale when I'm doing this because the bitterness is counteracted by the sweetness of the cereal. Your mileage may vary, of course.
My girlfriend and I love this flavor. It also has a good amount of fiber which I need in my diet to stay regular. With S&S it comes out to a great price.

I'm a little obsessed with breakfast cereal, so when I saw this I had to pick it up and give it a try. Today I finally got around to it and I'm really impressed! I normally stay away from all things of this brand because they taste like soggy cardboard, but this was actually really good. It was just the right amount of sweet and grain, didn't go soggy in milk right away and left the milk tasting good as well. The only reason it didn't get five stars was because I think it could benefit from including raisins or some kind of dried fruit in it. I'll be having it several times a week for sure, working it into my rotation. Yummy!

I haver cereal every morning before going to work with lite vanilla soy milk. I usually prefer the plain Special K cereal but tried this one for the fiber. There isn't that much fiber - but better than the plain Special K so it's still a fiber upgrade if thats what you're going for.The cereal doesn't taste bad like the other reviewer says. If you're expecting something like Honey Nut Cheerios - then no, it is not that Honey-like nor as sweet. It tastes just like the other special K flakes but a littler nuttier because of the multigrain.

column9: oats & honey, but ingredients have sugar listed 3rd; honey listed 7th; artificial flavor -11th
column10: I picked this up (on sale at local store) for a trial, quick breakfast or snack. Usually I'll read the ingredients first. But i was in a rush. Besides, box says, "whole grain, good source of fiber, Oats & honey..."But the taste? Awful (I know taste is subjective. Very sweet, but... not "honey" or even "natural" tasting. ugh.). So what else is listed in ingredients? all the grains, sugar (3rd after whole grain wheat & rice), salt (140mg/serving or 6% of RDA), "natural & artificial flavor", "malt flavoring", BHT (preservative), and a slew of added vitamins. I gave it "two stars" vs. "one" because it has some fiber ( 3GM or 10% RDA per serving) and the vitamins. Now I have find out which of the friendly animals or birds will eat this stuff- maybe the deer? hope it doesn't hurt them.

column9: The best cold brewed green tea I have tried so far
column10: I recently got bored with Twinings and Celestial Seasoning cold brewed teas and started looking for something new. I'm so happy that I found Swirl on Amazon. The box you get with this purchase contains 6 zip bags(packs) with 10 tea bags in each pack: 3 packs are 'original flavor', one mango, one mint and one peach. It is good way to try all flavors -- then you can switch to the favorite, 1-flavor packs if you wish.I usually prefer flavored cold teas, but 'original flavor' (=plain green tea) is surprisingly nice and mellow. Since I have 30 bags (3 packs) of this flavor, I plan give away some to friends to encourage them to try this delicious tea.I enjoyed mango flavor that I tried next, but peach flavor that was next in line exceeded all expectations - perfect balance of tea and peach, rich but not overwhelming. This one will be my favorite...Mint flavor can 'kill' green tea if overdone - Swirl version is quite mild, but still refreshing. Probably the best flavor during or after the exercise.Please note that it is real green tea, so if you leave bag in the water for too long, bitter taste can develop. Manufacturer recommends drinking it within 4 hours and I must agree: I sipped the last drops of 'original flavor' 3 hours after brewing and it was still good, but you could taste some bitterness that was not there within the first hour. I guess it could be worse after one more hour. Of course you can remove the bag from the mug within the first hour, but it may be difficult in case of water bottle.

I love the idea that I can brew my own green tea away from home or when hot water isn't available. In fact I found cold brew tea more refreshing, and no sugar is needed to cover the bitter aftertaste, making this product a healthier option than some granule drink mix products.My favorite flavor is peach and mint. I will definitely buy those single flavor cases when they become available.

column9: Simple to make, smooth and delicious
column10: Glad this product is on Amazon!  I like the Mango and Peach the best.  So easy to make and does not get bitter even after sitting for an hour with the tea bag in the water.  Also was surprised at how large the tea bags are.  the resealable bag is great for keeping a bag in the glove box or at the office.  Helps deter me from buying sugary drinks but I still get the fruity flavor I like.

column9: Swirl tea has become my new favorite
column10: While searching for quality green tea products online, Swirl tea caught my attention with its all natural ingredients and easy brewing instructions. It turns out Swirl tea didn't disappoint! Not only it comes with a variety of flavors but the brewing process is effortless. Now I can either enjoy it at home or pack the brewed bottle on the go. Flavor-wise, all of them are great with the original being my favorite since I'm used to having green tea without other ingredients. Nonetheless, do not sorry about the added flavors like peach or mango. They're not overpowering at all. Again, this is a highly recommended product for tea lovers.

This product is honestly amazing. First off, the taste isn't overpowering; it's very refreshing. Also, it is very convenient. I can take a tea bag with me anywhere and prepare tea on the go. I have tried many different brands of tea including Lipton and Snapple, but this is definitely the best. You get an all-natural, home-made drink that tastes wonderful. And it smells good too!

This cold brew product is so convenient for me and my family.  I could put the bags in a water bottle and authentic green teas are ready in minutes.  The tea tastes just as good as you may brew.  In one incident, I made tea for a party of 50 and this saved me tons of time.  No need to wait for the tea to cool down.  I put several units in a gallon water container, add sugar and ice cubes, wala....authentic green tea on ice is ready in a minute.  You definitely need to try this awesome product if you are a tea lover.

I'm a heavy green tea drinker and bring my own brew to work everyday. In order to do that, I have to brew green tea in advance, whether it's the night before or in a morning rush. I'm so glad I found this product! It's so easy to make a fresh cold brew that I simply put the thin tea bag into my own water bottle and when I arrive in my office, the tea is brewed and ready to drink. No more boiling water first and then ice cubes! Really can't be any more convenient than that.I also found the flavor very smooth and not bitter at all, even after the tea bag sits in cold water for a few hours. Guess it's because of cold brewing. Now I'm a fan!

What a joke, instructions say to shake well for a minute. You could shake for a year and not get any flavor from these. Stick to powder tea packs, you will save money, and prevent carpel tunnel from setting in from all the shaking!

I bought this tea thinking it would be so convenient to add to a bottle of water or to a reusable water bottle to take with me when I'm out and about or at work. It has almost no flavor!!  The peach, mint, and mango flavors have a slight flavor, but none of them has any tea flavor.  It's not returnable to Amazon, so I wrote to the company. The only suggestion they had was to leave it in the water longer. The did not offer a refund or any other compensation.  DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!

Swirl green tea has me hooked since my first cup. I could really tell this is what a cup of enjoyable tea should be about with its quality tea leaves. Besides its easy brewing steps, the packaging, in my opinion, is what also sets it apart from many green tea products on the market, including many popular brands.The bag is sealed without any staples unlike many tea bags I've tried, and who knows what a staple could do to affect the overall flavor in hot water? I'm quite sure that once you give it a try, it'll be very difficult for you to get distracted by other inferior tea bags.
Really convenient and easy to prepare. Also, great taste and awesome for if you're on the go! Recommend for everybody, even non-tea lovers!

column9: Give Energy Pear Apple Cherry, wonderful for my focus!
column10: I really enjoy this drink! I feel like it helps me focus better and keeps me alert without any undesirable side effects and unhealthy, useless ingredients. I wish I could find it a lower cost to make it a more regular part of my diet. I currently buy this product at Earth Fare in Huntsville, AL.
Best Ive had and Ive had em all! Great tasting, great focus, great energy, great EVERYTHING!! Not to mention its all natural, you get no crash and they help out with sustainable energy.

The other reviews have to be fakes. I have been trying different Energy Drinks on Amazon these past few months and this stuff is by far the nastiest of all. The smell and initial sip is okay, smells like pear...but once you actually swallow it something is off. No words to describe it. I took one sip and dumped the rest out of my work truck. Will give the other 11 cans to someone else who wants to suffer...or I will just dump them down the drain and recycle them.

Everyone in my household uses this. It's great that it is sugar free and zero calories.  It has totally replaced kool-aid in my household.  Has a great flavor.  We even use it more concentrate for making snowcones!!!!!

column9: Crystal Light On The Go Raspberry Ice.
column10: I love this product. It's really a great way to make your plain water really tasty with low calories, low sugar etc. It's red and the flavor is really good in your bottle of water. The box contains little tubes of product which is supposed to be 2 servings. You just open it and pour the powder in the water. The whole tube is 10 calories. The smaller the water bottle the stronger the flavor which is OK cause it's good. You might want to get a small box at the grocery store and taste it. You are buying 60 little tubes. These are a fantastic replacement for soda. Kids will like it.

I am not a lover of drinking water, but when I found Crystal Light, I was hooked! My absolute favorite flavor is Raspberry Ice, there are 4 other flavors I love as well! Crystal Light is a refreshing, light tasting drink, that actually makes you drink more water! It is also only 5 calories per packet! How can you not want to drink this delightful product!

I purchased these as a change-up to our inventory of teas, coffees and cocoas my wife and I drink during the cold winter months.As for the cider k-cups themselves, I am pleased with them overall. As with some of the cocoa k-cups, the larger setting on the Keurig machine produces a more watery result but this doesn't seem to affect the hot cider flavor as much as it does the hot cocoa.Flavor-wise, I'd compare the largest setting flavor to a green tea. Light and not overpowering, but the flavor is there.With the smaller Keurig settings, the cider has a more robust flavor and is perfect for being creative and mixing in other things. My personal favorite is a dash of cinnamon and a dribble of Irish wiskey.I'm giving this 4 stars because I think that these K-cup makers should be able to produce a K-cup that creates a consistent product at the larger Keurig settings, but I can't knock it too much because the lighter, more diluted tasing cider can be very enjoyable at times too.
The Green Mountain hot apple cider k-cups I ordered are soooooooooo delicious...just the right blend of all flavors.  Will be ordering more.

This was very good for the most part. I like to drink it in the chilly mornings we've had lately (in Vermont). The only bad thing is sometimes if I don't drink it fast enough, I end up with the residue which isn't that good.I appreciate it being sent to me in a timely manner.

Easy to make, just stir in water + vegetable oil and microwave. One pouch is two servings for me, set half of the dry mix aside in a covered bowl if you find it to be the same. I am allergic to milk and gluten intolerant. Pamela's products are dairy free when they are labeled that way. (Not everything is, so read the label.) It's so nice to have a treat to eat when everyone else is having brownies!
Pamela's chocolate brownies are delicious. At least 100% better than other gluten free mixes I have tried. At the present time there just are not any better gluten free mixes than Pamela's.

It is so simple: kids or mom can open a packet, pour in small glass baking dish, mix in 2 T water and 2 T. oil, microwave 60 seconds and a fabulous warm, chewy brownie comes out, big enough for two to share. My daughter doesn't even notice it is GF. I am ordering a box of 35 to have on hand!!

These brownies had an excellent texture and the taste was pretty good. I wouldn't say they are the best tasting brownies I've had but then I didn't have any oil other than olive oil on hand to try it. I purchased a few packs and plan to freeze them until I have need of them. They will be great for those days you have a chocolate craving but don't have any other chocolate on hand. They would also be great for traveling. They only require 2 tbsp of oil and 2 tbsp of water and a microwave safe bowl.

Had to share, I was running low on oil when the brownie craving hit, so I found a bottle of lemon infused olive oil hiding in my pantry and used it for the oil component. It was AWESOME!!! I may never make them plain again, I wonder if lemon or orange zest would do the same thing? I'll be experimenting! The basic mix is great, a wonderful way to satisfy a sweets craving without making a whole pan to tempt you. Better than any microwave brownie I remember, I agree with others that it make enough for two servings.

These little pouches of gluten-free brownie mix are a wonderful product. I think it is more like two servings, rather than one. It is so nice to have a GF treat that can be whipped up in just a couple of minutes in the microwave but tastes like you spent an hour in the kitchen. A lot of GF products have an odd texture, this does not (the same goes for Pamela's regular bake-in-the-oven GF brownie mix -- yum!). I always try to have gluten-free cupcakes or cookies stocked in my freezer to send with my kids for a treat at a birthday party or event when their friends are going to be enjoying desserts that they can't have. But sometimes I get caught without something in the freezer and this makes an excellent alternative. I highly recommend these small-serving brownie packs!

My daughter has gluten and dairy allergy, and these brownies have the flavor, texture and feel ofregular amazing brownies. They smell wonderful and have a super taste, not weird or pasty... reallyworth the price... and the convenience of instant...priceless... really...

Pamela's individual brownies are scrumptious.  It is fun to have a brownie in a little more than a minute. It is gooey and the best gluten free mix I have ever had.  It is perfect to take to a friends house so that I can enjoy a delicious dessert along with everyone else.  In fact, once they get a whiff of my desert they want the gluten free desert.  I love this mix and highly recommend it!

I just got a free sample.  I cooked it for 1 min 20 secs in my micro.  The kids and I are enjoying it very much.  Not too sweet.  Kinda has a walnut-y flavor though there are no nuts in it.It will be perfect for me to send the pouches to school for a day when the teacher's forgot to tell me there was a birthday.  No more need to keep cupcakes in the freezer at school. Now all we need is mayo packet sized frosting to go with it ;)

For our family this is the perfect milk.  We like the taste and it does not need refrigeration until you are ready to use it.When we get a box of 12 the experation date is 8 to 10 months ahead and that means we don't have to continually worry aboutbuying milk.

I have recently decided to do something about my acid reflux and other health issues that are troubling me by rethinking my dietary needs.With that in mind, I bought a nice little inexpensive blender and decided to try some more natural drinks instead of dumb carbonated drinks you can buy everywhere. I just needed some fruits and some milk. Well, I saw this one on Amazon and since I have Prime membership, I decided to give it a try.Here are my findings.PROs:* Nice taste* Healthy* GLUTEN FREE!!!* CheapCONs:* None!In short - if you're on gluten-free diet, if you have acid reflux, if you want to improve your dietary needs, go for it!

I ordered this because I love soymilk and was looking to get some in Bulk as I am trying to lose weight and love soymilk for weight loss reasons.Now on to the problem I had which is why I am giving this one star. Just grab it from your grocery store.When I got this item it was busted and there was soymilk all over in the packaging(inside the plastic, the box was all bendable from soaking) in fact the soy must have busted early in the process because it all smelled really bad from it rotting in the heat and packaging. If you want to take the risk go for it, but I am staying away from ordering soymilk on Amazon any longer.I also must commend Amazon on the quick refund and amazing customer service with help in this matter.
I order this because in my honest opinion, this is the best tasting soy milk. This 12-pack lasts over a month with two people using it every morning. Great deal. Great taste. Thank you Amazon.

I bought this one thinking, hmm, larger box, less waste.  But the subscribe and save option was discontinued.  Pffft.Also, the box weighs a ton--I forgot to read that on the shipping...lol!I guess the 8 oz. will do fine for now.

The Online Candy Shop was awesome because the candy was not only fresh, but packaged with care as well. The shipping was very fast and reliable and I did not have to wait long for the product to arrive at my door! Thank you all at the onlinecandyshop for your honesty in the item description and for providing fast and speedy shipping and fresh boxes of candy, not old and stale like other places that I have shopped at!

We used this product for our puppy's first year.  She never had an issue with any type of adverse reaction and seemed to enjoy it very much.Actually, she liked this product even better than the adult food we are now using.  Our puppy would eat this straight from the bag!!!! No need to mix anything else into it...It kept our little girl healthy, bright and beautiful! Helping her grow into the strong doggie teen (she will be 2yrs old in june) she is now!!!Kept a nice coat, good breathe and healthy teeth...Really liked this product.

Last time I was at my local Fresh and Easy store, I picked up a box (41g) of Koala's March cookies filled with chocolate creme. The cookie itself was very crisp and had a flavor somewhat like a fortune cookie. It was light and delicate and quite tasty. Inside was a delicious mix of soft  dark chocolate creme. Delicious. Very good combination. The box is listed at one serving and 220 calories. I noted a small amount of trans fat in the ingredients, if that bothers you any. These are quite delicious. A box goes fast!Gary Peterson

I am a big fan of peppermint hard candies and I'm always looking for a good deal.  These are big chunks sweet peppermint and better than expected.  At first I was a little disappointed but after awhile I was plesantly surprised at how flavorful these are.  Give these a try.

I have purchased numerous different varieties of Dr Oetker's desserts (mousses, cakes, icings, whip topping & Creme Brûlée) and every one of them are DELICIOUS! Myself, my children, grandchildren, other family members & friends give rave reviews. Their cakes are moist and tasty and their icing mixes remind me of my grandmothers recipe she always made that had fine sugar crystals. These are NO FAIL products that I Woukd definitely recommend to everyone!
It is very strong and pure! you just need a little bit to get a great flavor. Helps with digestion but the smell is strong!!

Ghirardelli's Chocolate Flavored sauce is a thick and rich chocolate sauce that uses cocoa and unsweetened chocolate for an intense taste.  While I love Fox's u-bet 22-Oz. Original Chocolate Syrup, Ghirardelli's works better as an ice cream topping because it is thicker.  I also like that it is less sweet, so it's easier to make a rich but not overly sweet chocolate milk.  The taste is closer to hot fudge than most chocolate syrups.Ghirardelli also makes a Sweet Ground Chocolate and Cocoa syrup available in bulk (64 oz and up) that is more bittersweet.

column9: Does not have full chocolate taste I expected from Ghiradelli
column10: I ordered this because I  am a chocoholic who appreciates true chocolate flavor, not watered down as you get from the brands in the supermarket. This was disappointing, as it tastes no different than the high glucose types found in the supermarket. Expected more from Ghiradelli.
I bought this to use in my morning cappuccino...it is great if you love a rich chocolate taste, but note that it is NOT as sugary sweet as Hershey's or Nesquick sauce, FYI.

I'm what you may call a cream soda buff.  I love it, it's always been my favorite flavor... and no soda will taste quite as good as the cane sugar varieties, but I'm sort of on a caloric budget, and cannot afford to go drinking all my calories.I love this stuff.  It's great, perhaps it's an aquired taste, but I've been drinking naturally diet sodas for over a year, and I was so excited to try the cream soda version.  I prefer it over all the other flavors (I haven't tried grape yet, that's my next priority).I tried a few other brands of stevia and xylitol flavored cream sodas and none of them match up to this one.  I say it's definitely worth a try.****UPDATE (8/8/2011)***  I'm irritated.  I'm not mad at the product, it's still delicious; but when I got the package I ordered from Amazon.com, it had been through a lot.  It was smashed on one side, and sure enough, 3 of the sodas were ruined, had exploded all over the other sodas, and many had been deformed due to some horrific accident.  Amazon... I have never had such a horrible problem from you before, but this is my first food purchase.  It makes me very unlikely to order another food ESPECIALLY beverage package again, and I'm a pretty frequent customer.  I wish you would make it right.  I realize it may have been the mail carrier, but perhaps Amazon needs to package the beverages better or put a Fragile sign on it or something.  Just a suggestion.  Sad day for my delicious cream sodas.

column9: I'm now a cream soda convert...
column10: I've never before been that crazy about any cream sodas I've tried...and I've tried quite a few.  So I just gave up on them altogether.  Started drinking Zevia and fell in love.  I drink the Dr Zevia, ginger ale, ginger root beer, twist and love them all.  Came across the cream soda and decided to give it a try...WOW!  I love it!!!  It's my new "go to" soda, the best cream soda I've ever tried, way better than the full sugar ones even.  GREAT product!

Well, I have to say that I have been drinking this brand's sodas for a couple of years now, and I am always up for trying one of their new flavors. I liked the cola, the ginger ale is good too, and I really have enjoyed the Dr. Zevia enough to have it delivered in these cases for the past year or so. I recently tried the grape, and that was okay. HOWEVER, I AM TOTALLY BLOWN AWAY BY THIS NEW OFFERING. It didn't really hit me until I had my third or fourth can over the course of a couple of days, but I am really impressed. After you get used to it, THIS NEW CREAM SODA FROM ZEVIA HAS ME HOOKED. I strongly encourage potential customers to try a six pack, then buy a case. The only way good products like this one will be around is if we, as consumeers support it. What's not to like. It is a bit expensive, but I'm sure the price will come down the more stores pick it up and the more distribution of the product. Tell your friends. It's not only healthier than diet drinks, it is absolutely delicious!

column4: Suzy Dodson "Give me something I can sing to!"
column10: I discovered this product while reading about the Fat Belly Cure by Jorge Cruise. This soda is sweetened with stevia, a natural sweetener that Jorge endorses. I love cream soda so I thought this was worth a try. Having this on hand helps me avoid drinking sugared colas and diet pops with harmful artificial sweeteners. It is so good that I haven't even missed my Dr. Pepper. If you like A & W Cream Soda, you'll like this. The price is a little more that what I spend on a can of soda, but it's worth it knowing I am taking one step closer to better health.

column9: Solid Cream Soda without poisonous corn syrup and aspartame!
