column10: Another winner from Dr. Zevia. We have tried all of their flavors, and this is at the top with the Ginger Root Beer and the Dr. Zevia. This is not as good as Virgil's Microbrewed Cream Soda (the best cream soda ever, and they also make the best root beer and ginger ale ever), but this is calorie-free and a superb soda. Still five stars. We will definitely be buying and drinking it again many times.So glad to finally be rid of nasty GMO corn syrup and all the other nasty bits they put in regular sodas.

I only drink Natural Sodas, mostly diet. Zevia is my favorite in the diet category and I find that their Cream Soda is a great alternative to the sugar packed or artificially sweetened options. It taste great over ice cream (natural sugar-free chocolate is my favorite with this soda) or on it's own straight out of the can. It's very refreshing and it's really nice to be able to indulge in a treat without undoing long hours at the gym or any of the other negative effects of consuming too much sugar.  I'm amazed at how they were able to capture the sweetness and creaminess without the sugar, calories or chemicals. After tasting it for the first time I thought I must be dreaming that something could be this good without any of the guilt. I hope that you enjoy it as much as I do!!!

column9: Even better than I had hoped
column10: I wasn't sure what to expect when I ordered this soda. I grow stevia in my garden so I'm familiar with the flavor, but I've never experienced it in the form of a drink, much less one of my favorites. I've only had it around for a couple of days and I'm already hooked! Zevia is exactly what I was looking for in a caffeinated beverage. It's not as cloyingly sweet as other cream sodas, and is refreshingly bubbly; To friends, I've described it as a drink between sparkling water and regular cream soda in terms of flavor and texture. I look forward to trying out the other flavors!
I love these sodas.  I feel like I can enjoy something that is not bad for my health like other sodas. Stevia is actually healthy for your teeth. Pleasure without the guilt.

I love cream soda but can't find the diet version in any local stores. A&W diet Cream Soda was available for a while and it was good. I use Stevia as a sweetener all the time, so I thought Zevia diet CS would be good. Its absolutely terrible. It has a bitter, lingering aftertaste, and it tastes different than any other cream soda I have tried. I was excited about this purchase, but after one swig I realized it was bad. So now I have 23 cans that I can't return. I also ordered a case of a different brand which is yet to arrive. I'm hoping it will be better. It can't be any worse. I know people taste things differently, but for me, this was really bad. Be careful buying this stuff.

Maybe I got a different batch than everyone else, but mine tasted nothing like cream soda. It basically tastes like a packet of stevia poured into some carbonated water. It's probably not something I'd buy again

I bought some of these, for they sounded delicious (cream soda! Mmmmm!) and they have zero calories. These have a weird aftertaste - what I would imagine a cream soda would taste like after you brush your teeth - and they seem to lack flavor; I guess they taste flat. Maybe I received a bad batch? I don't think I'll be trying these again, they were kind of expensive to try another batch and possibly dislike them as well.

I had tried some early Zevia flavors a while back, and was not impressed.When I saw Zevia on sale at a local store, I thought it might be worth trying some newer flavors, including the cream soda. And how delightful it was!I used to drink a lot of A&W cream soda, but now try to avoid both sugared sodas and aspartame. I wouldn't say this Zevia cream soda tastes just like A&W, but it comes close enough for me.

i have ordered prevously many cases of zevia cream soda and they have been perfect!Just received a new shipment of 2 cases. the sodas tasted totally off and very strange...sampled 5 cans from each box...each tasted the same way..NOT RIGHT! While Amazon graciously is going to refund me the cost of $54.00 for these two cases..I am wondering what went wrong? There is no expiration on the cans..they still fizzle..but the taste is definitely off...I question whther I should reorder or just purchase from the local market?Any one have any thoughts? Would be appreciated!

If you're about to try out a zevia product start with this one! -- My favorite ever. To me it tastes like real cream soda and 0 calories...um...what's not to love? I drink about 3 -5 of these a day when I have them on hand.

I don't enjoy writing really critical reviews and I'll say in advance that Zevia makes other flavors I do enjoy.....but good god not this one. Zevia uses a combination of Stevia and Erythritol to mimic the taste of standard table sugar. It takes some getting used to but mostly works for the other flavors I've tried (the fruit flavored ones). The initial impact of this flavor for me is....eh, ok. Not bad. The aftertaste though, is absolutely heinous to me. It's especially terrible when not chilled. Obviously you should drink it chilled to begin with it, but you are completely out of luck if that happens to not be an option at a given time. I've read other reviews (here and elsewhere) that state its use as a mixer in other drinks as a compliment rather than standalone drink. This makes more sense to me as the aftertaste could be cut. Also, let's be honest, this stuff is pretty pricey-over a buck a piece when bought online and in bulk. Zevia is somewhat unique, mainly because of their sugar alternative combination, but there are similar types out there for less. I wouldn't hesitate to try their other products when all is said and done; this is just a miss for me.
This creme soda flavor is my favorite flavor by Zevia.  It tastes like other creme sodas on the shelf and doesn't have the HFCS or artificial sweetners.  It's always in our fridge!

This is the best stuff.  I understand that not everyone has the same palette, but I just love this soda.  It actually has the flavor of Cream Soda.  2 of my 3 kids just love it.  The other one has that palette that tastes an after taste.  It is truly an individual palette thing.  I must say though this is the best No Sugar No Calories soda I've had.  Unlike a previous review, I looked at the ingredients and there is Carmel color, but at least it is listed as the last ingredient.  I just can't say enough good stuff.  I've ordered the Grape and hopefully it tasts just as wonderful as this.  I tried the Dr. Zevia but there is not even an essence of Dr anything...but still a good generic soda taste.  Hope this helps you decide.

Cream soda is now my favorite Zevia flavor. It's delicious and I love the fact that it's sweetened with stevia rather than some artificial sweeteners. Some of my other favorites are grapefruit, root beer, and orange.I recommended these to my sister and she loves them as well!

column9: Tastes great! One of my favorites.
column10: This cream soda tastes really good. I think I've tried every flavor Zevia has come out with so far and this one is one of my favorites. I love the fact that is all natural, sugar free, and still tastes great. Sometimes I mix this with their Root Beer flavor which gives it a "creamy root beer" taste. =) I highly recommend this flavor if you're a cream soda fan, but don't want the calories of regular sodas.

This is one of my favorite Zevia flavors just by itself, but try mixing 50/50 with the Orange Zevia and you get a creamsicle flavored beverage that is quite good!I do find all Zevias have best flavor nice and cold, or over ice.

The Cream Soda is my favorite of the Zevia drinks.  I have not tried them all.  The Cream Soda is really sweet, but most Cream Soda is.  We also love the Ginger Ale.  When I want caffeine, I drink Dr. Stevia.  The coke Zevia is awful.  The black cherry is good, but we wouldn't buy it again.

After my first swallow I noticed that this has a pleasant vanilla flavor to it.  It tastes smooth.  There is a very slight aftertaste to it, but it's not overwhelming. I've never had cream soda, so I'm not comparing this to any other products.  I gave it 4 stars only because it's not a flavor I'd go out and buy on its own - I got it as part of a variety pack.
Love the vanilla taste. Tastes natural and not like any of the other splenda options available at the super market.Will definitely buy again.
My husband and I love Zevia and get a few cases a month. The new cream soda is our favorite! We will be increasing our outo ship on this one for sure!

column9: One of the better Zevia flavors
column10: I should preface this by saying that I haven't had a can of Cream Soda from any brand in years, so my comparison of this is based off a memory more than something I drink regularly.That having been said, I think it tastes great.  Definitely one of the better Zevias by far and something I can imagine drinking when I have the urge for a Cream Soda.

column9: vanilla soda... good mixed with other flavors...
column10: I just received this Creme Soda yesterday, so this review is a first impression. Not sure if I will buy more, but it is good for mixing with other flavors like Blue Sky cola (which I don't care for by itself and am just trying to use up), and Zevia grapefruit citrus (just for the heck of it).

We have been drinking Zhena's teas now for several years, so obviously we are fond of them. Of the several flavors we have tried, the Coconut Chai stands out head and shoulders above the rest as our favorite. Now I should qualify my statement as we are lovers of nearly all things 'coconut' but that aside this tea is absolutely wonderful. We tend to choose it daily over other options in our tea selection. If you are a tea drinker and you are fond of coconut-try this tea, I am confidant you will not be disappointed. I have been buying it in cases of 6 canisters of 22 sachets for months now from Amazon and intend to continue buying it this way, as my local store charges more for it and don't always have it in stock. TRY THIS TEA SOON!

column9: A delicious twist on the traditional Chai blend.
column10: This is my new favorite Chai!I've tried dozens of brands and blends over the years... from cheap supermarket boxes of bags, to pricey organic loose blends. Until now, the Vanilla Chai Spice loose tea from Tea Guys was my favorite. But then I tasted Zhena's Coconut Chai and instantly fell in love with it. The extra little hit of coconut in this Zhena's blend really takes the taste to another level for me. Yum!Try it with a splash of milk and some honey... a cup of pure happiness!

Clearly I am a big fan of this tea, so I ordered a six pack! The idea was to have a continuous supply for the next few months, gift some and get a lower price per tin. However, surprisingly, the tea, in this particular order did not taste as wonderful as it usually does. Wondering why, I looked for the expiry date. On the box that they came in, it said, best by 2015. Which is great. However, under each tin, there a date stamped, which is February 2001.I am very confused. The date marked under the tins...are they expiry dates? They don't say so anywhere. And I know from my past experience of purchasing these (the black tea sampler tin for instance), that the bottom of the tin is where they put their expiry date. I am disappointed. After going through about half of the product (I am on my third pack), I don't know that they are returnable. I kept consuming them thinking, well, the next pack (tin of 22 sachets) will be different, better. They are not. I wonder what to do with the three unopened packs.

column9: Can't Taste The Coconut; Tastes Unlike Any Other Chai
column10: I bought a canister of this tea to try it.  I like most chais that I try, though most not nearly as much as masala chai in a good Indian restaurant.  I took several sips, but I couldn't finish the tea because I didn't like the taste.  I could not taste even a hint of coconut.  It's possible that the ginger and black pepper dominated, but I'm not a professional taster.  I like ginger in curries, but I'm not a fan of tea with a strong ginger taste.  I couldn't finish the cup of tea.

This tea, while packaged beautifully, has no taste at all. Perhaps it is because I love a good spicy chai, and I love coconut, but this tea did nothing for me on either level. Save your money on this stuff.

column9: A slice of heaven on earth!
column10: First of all I have to say that I'm not a tea expert.  I've been a diet coke addict all of my adult life and two years ago I started drinking green tea for the health benefits and to reduce my diet coke intake.  During the summer, I discovered Chai cremas at the local coffee shop (oh, I don't drink coffee either) and really liked them so a few months ago I decided to try hot Chai.  I started drinking black Chai and then green Chai; I have graduated to such a large cup that now I can do a bag of each per 'cup'.  I quickly moved on to vanilla Chai.  I drank the normal store brands and then discovered Stash teas, which I really do like (although I don't think they make a black vanilla Chai w/caffeine).  This afternoon I ran to the grocery store and discovered this tea and picked up a canister...it was on sale for $5.87 at a large chain discount grocery store.  I brewed up a cup and added a little warm frothed vanilla almond milk (which is standard for me when drinking Chai).  Oh. My. Goodness.  SCORE!!  This is simply the most amazing black tea I've yet to drink!  The coconut flavor isn't overpowering and it meshes splendidly with the other flavors:  organic cinnamon, ginger, cardamom pods, whole cloves, orange peels, nutmeg, org. black pepper, organic cinnamon essential oil.  I don't add any sweetener, probably because the splash of vanilla almond milk makes it sweet enough for me.The price on Amazon is better than any I've found so I'm going to subscribe and save TODAY so I can SHARE with my friends. The canister is lovely (perfect for gifting), the little tea sachet is really cute (although there is no string) and the aroma is incredible!  Everyone deserves to indulge in this tea!  I believe this tea is organic.  The company is certified fair trade, they are environmentally conscious and a portion of their profits go to feed impoverished children...double SCORE!As a side note, I've been drinking several cups (4-6) of Chai daily for the past two months - w/caffeine in the morning and w/out caffeine at night.  My intake of Diet Coke has shrunk to one can a day (I used to drink at least 6).  Amazingly, in that time frame I have dropped six pounds...6 lbs!  I'm not a huge person either so dropping from 136 to 130 without changing anything but my daily intake of Chai is significant (to me).  Not sure if that's what is doing it (I haven't changed anything else) but I'll take that added benefit anyday!

This tea is really, really good! Think of chai with a hint of coconut added to it. It's a very comforting tea. My husband has two favorites, and this is one of them. Amazon was a life saver when our grocery store stopped carrying Zhena's Gypsy Tea. Very good price for 6!
I love this tea! Zhena's tea is the only tea I drink and the coconut chai is my favorite. This is also the best price for these teas.
Why would you pay $13.50 for 10 Caps, when you can buy them on the Nespresso website for less then 1/2 of that?$6.00 on Nespresso.com

column4: R. E. Twigg "... initial success or total fai...
column9: You would be insane to purchase from here
column10: I have no idea why anyone would pay $13.50 from a second hand place when for $6.00, you can purchase from the manufacturer Nespresso, directly. Am I missing something here?

I ordered this as a gift to my friend in the US.The basket arrived on time and the chocolates delights my friends and her family,not to mention it includes 2 specially designed GODIVA mug,the packaging is beautiful and elegant.Overall, i think the hamper worth the money spending as fits its value.

just the right amount of hot.  just the right amount of spice.  just the right amount of vinegar undertones.  the best words i can use to share the taste of this sauce with you is that it is like a-1 had a baby with worcestershire sauce and that baby had an affair with a bowl of mild-hot peppers and, before being bottled, asked balsamic vinegar to join the dance.  for years i had to sweet talk different restaurants into selling me a bottle and usually just ended up taking advantage of the mercy shown to me as they slipped me one without charge.  the day i discovered amazon and roland and mexgrocer joined forces and made my bottle of yummy available to buy directly, i felt like a child on christmas morning.  it is nothing less than one of the best sauces from a bottle i have ever tasted.  while i enjoy making many sauces from scratch (i.e. black bean sauce, tsuyu, ketjap manis, etc.), i readily admit that my counter would not be perfect complete without my beloved tabasco, cajun power garlic sauce, red boat fish sauce, sambal oelek, zingerman's oils and vinegars, mitoku organic mikawa mirin, organic bluegrass soy sauce, dragonfly super premium flavored oyster sauce, koon chun hoisin, sriracha, made in mexico or made in france maggi sauce, lea & perrins worcestershire, and finally a continuous supply of...  drumroll please... roland balsamic hot pepper sauce.  yes, i know i just went a bit overboard on you with my counter list"ing", but now you see how the simple thought of re-ordering this sauce pushes me into the way-too-excited hard core foodie stratosphere.  :-)  thank you one million times over amazon and roland and mexgrocer!

column9: Wonderful, but can be ordered for cheaper at the official site
column10: This was the most incredible soda I had ever drank, it still goes by the original 1800's medicinal recipes, & tastes amazing & seems healthy compared to most sodas. However two days later I found you can order 12 bottles for only 10$ from the official website of the maker of the product [...] & felt ripped off that I paid 6$ for 3 here on Amazon when I could have gotten 12 for 10$ at the KutzTown website.
My husband and I really enjoyed the flavor of this Birch Beer and it came in just the right size for us to share a bottle at a meal together.  We like it enough that I'm reordering.

I absolutely love tea, especially hot tea in the winter months.  I like to try different varieties, but my favorite has always been white tea due to its lighter flavor as compared to the bolder black or green teas.  Uncle Lee's White Tea with Lemongrass and Jasmine is one of my favorites.  It combines the faint white tea flavor with jasmine and lemongrass to make a delicious tea that can be enjoyed anytime!
Doritos speak for themselves with flavor and satisfaction! Buying bulk is a good way to save money against shipping cost. Cure the munchies with Doritos*****

column9: weak coffee not good for a premium product and price
column10: This coffee supposedly is premium, it tastes watery--very thin.  Not good at all.  Maybe old??Not sure, it was a waste, and I'm using it line the bottom of my sitting shoes and trash cans and rained-on luggage, to absorb the smells.  So I used it, but not to drink.  Do not buy.

For folks who like a lighter roast like Starbuck's Veranda or Willow Blondes, this coffee has a tasty, but mild flavor and that extra kick of caffeine that comes from less burnt coffee.  Ship and save trims the cost down, making this affordable for organic coffee.  (Plus, I love the Mayans of rural Guatemala!)

As a newly diagnosed pre-diabetic I have been looking for products that taste good and don't affect my sugar levels adversely.  This product seems to be doing the trick.  I can tolerate the taste but wish it tasted a little more sweet.  I know this is diffult for a diabetic diet but just thought I'd mention it.

column9: Yummy, and good for me, too!
column10: My doctor has me monitoring my blood sugar level, so when I saw this was supposed to have a low impact on blood sugars, I thought I'd try them.  To my surprise, I enjoyed them and they worked as advertised!  I hope everyone else who enjoys them has the same guilt-free experience.  Granola Gourmet Very Berry Granola Bars, 10-Count Bars (Pack of 2)
The Very Berry bars are my favorite, followed by the chocolate.  These are great fresh granola bars.

The very berry granola gourmet bars are my favorite flavor. They taste wonderful, and are easy on your stomache even when you're ravenous.  =PThey are a great snack to keep at work. They also keep well over time, so you don't have to eat an entire package in a couple of days.  =)

I received a few of these as a sample a couple weeks back.  They are yummy, portable, and great for a quick snack.  I like that they are fairly low in calories and still provide energy to power through the rest of day.  The other flavors are yummy too, but this is my daughter's favorite!

These taste great!  I have been happy to have them through the winter when berries weren't in season, I felt like I was eating a bit of spring & summer.  I have been keeping a box in my car so they are readily available during my commute.

These bars are just terrible.  I am an avid exerciser and eat right to maintain my size 8 dress size.  I am used to eating healthy and diet food so I am not hard to please at all.  These are horribly dry and have the consistency of sawdust.  I got the cranberry orange spice flavor and also the mocha expresso flavor and literally could not eat them; they went straight into the trash.  I loved the story of this company and hate to give them a negative review, but I have to be honest:  their product tastes terrible, even to someone like me who is used to eating healthfully.  Don't waste your money.

For me, these tasted far to healthy!  For health nuts, these are probably great.  They are slightly sweet.  They are not individually packaged, so if you don't eat them at a decent rate or rewrap them, they get a bit hard.  I bought 2 boxes and maybe because I don't hang out with the healthiest folks, I couldn't even give them away.

this tea surprised me its very smooth, and richer than other oolongs it almost looks like a black tea when brewed but its really really good, it really took a long time to find a decent tea company since the one I used to buy from went out of business, this is the best oolong I have had in ages, and you can never compare this to any crappy box tea so if thats what your used to this stuff will knock your socks off! its just good all around and yes slightly more pricey than your Se Chung say but this one would be a good morning tea.

column9: Not awful but not worth buying over other flavors
column10: Not nearly as good as the cinnamon roll bars by Labrada.  Not awful but will not buy again.  There are far better protein bars out there that taste a lot better like Quest.

column9: Its a good bar but sweeter than the other favors
column10: I've tried many of these bars which I really like since they have high protein content.  In general, the chocolate mint tastes good but seems a lot sweeter than the other ones like the cinnamon roll (which continues to be my favorite favor). These are great to have with you on the go just in case you are in a situation where you might miss a meal (I'm on Body for Life).

These are great tasting and provide the highest amount of protein than any bar I have tried.  They are not low in calorie so I would not recommend them for snacking.  They are great as a meal replacement as the product states.

column9: Jell-O Instant Pudding & Pie Filling, Coconut
column10: This coconut pudding is a favorite in my family. I cannot find it in any of my local stores, I thought they had discontinued this flavor. I was thrilled to find it in the Amazon grocery store. This pudding is the best!

This is one of my favorite pudding flavors.  I use it in recipes and sometimes just eat it plain, but it is nearly impossible to find in local grocery stores.  Being able to buy it on Amazon just made my day!
THis is so hard to find in the supermarkets.I use it for pies and trifles .Very easy to prepare great flavor and arrived quickly

I have my own dip business and it is hard to find certain jello flavors.  Luckily this doesn't seem to be an issue with Amazon!  Honestly, I hate coconut, but my customers rave about my dip so they must be doing something right!  Thank you for always having the ingredients I need to make my business successful!

I use this product, Instant Coconut Cream Pudding, for an original recipe and for some odd reason none of the groceries in Albuquerque carry this particular flavor of Jell-O pudding.....therefore I found it necessary to order it on lineAs with all of the JELL-O products, the results are perfect every time.It's good to know that you never have to worry about the quality of the products you are using and that the results are going to be perfect.

This pudding is great, and tough to find.  I buy it at a local country store and get it in bulk there.  I use it to make coconut cream pies and to eat as a sweet treat.  This price seems high, but if it is the only way for you to get it, I guess you will do what you have to do to buy it.  Amazon's price is cheaper then other online ways of buying it in box form.  There are ways to buy it in bulk as well, but those are priced by the pound.  My store sells it for 2.59/lb.  The cheapest I can find online is 3.57/lb plus shipping...good luck figuring out how many boxes a pound equals! (going by box size doesn't work unfortunately).  My best estimate is that there are between 3 and 4 boxes per lb. (a recipe calls for 2/3 of a cup to 2 cups milk and 2/3 of a cup weighs 4-5oz.I hope this helps!

my picky pom loves this brand.  I rotate between 3 flavors (he won't eat same flavor more than 2 days).  I love that they are grain free, organic, and small enough for his tiny mouth. He has rejected several other "natural" dry or dehydrated raw dog foods -- Orijen, Addiction (he liked this for awhile), Canidae, Stella and Chewy's, etc. No digestive problems, no stinky breath (why would I want pizza or even fishy dog breath?).  I have tried all the Acana dry foods --I order the trial size so they stay fresh -- and the price is reasonable for the quality.

I just started my dogs on this food 3 days ago and they love it. No trying to add things to get them to eat, they clean their plates.I have used Orijen in the past and my dogs have always enjoyed that food. It is a bit too expensive for me since I also have to buy very good quality canned for my diabetic dog.My daughter decided to try this since it is made by the same company as Orijen. With all the food recall scares lately, this company has a very good reputation, uses quality ingredients, they have their OWN factory and they have had no recalls.

I disagree with the other reviewer.  I've tried the Stash brand lemon and ginger tea, and it is very tame in flavor.  The Twinings lemon and ginger tea, on the other hand, has a strong spicy flavor.  The ginger bite is quite pronounced, and the tea actually tastes spicy and zingy.  It's delicious, though the flavor might be too strong for some.

This is the bigger pack of these teabags than you can get in the store and is a great value. The ginger gives a bit of a bite to the lemon tea. I love it with some honey. It is very tasty hot and is even good when it cools off. The Twinnings version of this flavor of tea is definitely the best tasting one that I have found. I have this on automatic delivery and I know I will be drinking much more in the cooler weather. Nothing better than tea when it is cold out!
This tea is so good that you do not need to add honey or sugar. It is great to help you out on those early mornings at work.
We found this tea to be the perfect caffeine free beverage when a hot drink is warranted.  Tasty and refreshing and uplifting.

column9: Doesn't taste as good as Stash one
column10: Ginger and Lemon flavor is too light and can barely tasted.  I bought Twinings and Stash for the same flavor and Stash tastes way better.

Great product !!!Color,smell,tasting all indicate to a great product.Sliced very thin this is the way to eat it on a platter with some cornichons,small cipollini onions,marinated mushrooms and of course some nice cheese.Will definitely reccomended it keeps very well in the fridge !!!Just note to be fair and honest that this product, although rich in history and food culture in Northern Italy (Valtellina) and Switzerland ,is currently been produced in Uruguay

Like the first reviewer, I thought it wasn't working for the first two days, so much so that the "fly trap report" became a family joke.  Turns out the "lure" material had to have a little time to work itself up to smelling like--um--like something that flies would like? Goes without saying that this isn't a smell we humans would like, so don't hang it near or in your house.  We have ours in the garbage area, where it works wonderfully. It isn't a strong smell, but it is noticable if you are within, say, three feet.  And occasionally I get a whiff of it on the breeze.  I'm happy to live with that minor inconvenience for the number of flies it collects, literally hundreds in a short time.

I purchased this item to put near my chicken coop.  At first I thought it wasn't working.  No action for a few days.  Within a week the thing was half full.  It's so easy to use.  Add water and hang it up.  The best part is that there are no poisons to deal with and the chickens won't be eating poisoned flies.  Excellent product!

This really works. We were overcome with the little black deer flies that bite! We put up two of these fly traps and, within a week, most of the flies had been caught or disappeared allowing us to enjoy our garden. However, after a short amount of time these traps stink. But, that is the lure that attracts the flies. So it's best not to put them too close to a sitting area. You'll be amazed at how many flies are trapped. And, it has no effect on bees or other beneficial insects.

I tried this flytrap because my store was out of the Rescue brand (Sterling NFT-D Disposable Fly Control TrapWith Attractant).  This Victor has not caught one fly in four days, while my existing Rescue trap has and is catching 50+ flies per day.  Yes the Rescue does smell bad - you have to put it 10+ feet from your porch, but it works!  I place one in the trees approx. 20' away on 'each' side of the house.  I recommend buying the Rescue flytrap - Amazon search "rescue fly trap".

Purchased this trap after ordering and using their smaller version first.  This trap works extremely well.  Up for 4 days and almost half full.  It does have a very potent smelling bait that you definitely do not want right near your area your sitting.  We have our trap hung about 20 ft. from the porch and we don't have any flies where we sit anymore.The trap is easy to set up...  all you do is lift the lid,  add water to line and re-adjust lid to expose trap's holes and hang.The reason I gave it only 4 stars is because the shrick-wrap holding the trap had split and the item was delivered on a very humid day and by the time I opened the package you could easily smell the bait....  not pleasent...but we got it outside fast and set it up and now the flies are loving it!!>>>>>>>> one month later  >>>>>>>>>>>>>we have since used 4 traps and have had our first failure!  Went out today to se that the "bag" had separated and fallen off the top.  The bag had been about half full and we have had twice as many flies trapped in previous uses.  I will keep shoppers informed as we think the traps are good but if your going to have a failure 25% of the time is it worth it....  going to order more will keep everyone updated.......

I followed the directions  and hung this in my garage. I left it up for 2 to 3 weeks and all I caught was 1 fly. AND YES I saw a tons of flies flying around it through the weeks, but they took no interest. All it did was smell up my garage. Don't waste your $$.

I bought a Victor fly trap and hung it from a post.  Two weeks later both my dogs were very sick.  I then realized that the glue holding the bag of bait to the plastic lid had let loose and dumped a bag full of stinky bait ant dead flies onto the ground.  My dogs ate this concoction and became very sick.  Now I've got a $235 vet bill because of a defective fly trap.  Do not buy this brand.

At start it didn't do anything, the flies ignored and continued hovering around the house focusing on the outside trash can.Two days later there were a few dead flies inside, but no other effect.And then on the third(or was it fourth?) morning there was an inch of dead flies on it, and more kept coming. by the afternoon it had more than two inches of dead flies, and the trash can didn't have a single one

column9: Don't bother ours just caught every fly on earth.
column10: As stated elsewhere it takes a day or two to get going, and it does smell but it did not smell as bad as we were prepared for it to. It has lasted all of a week and has caught thousands. I have to throw it out as there is no room for flys to go into the bag.My only recommendation is if you have a lot of flys go for the quart(M380) or gallon(M383) product that is reusable and can be re-baited.

The best product for easily catching and killing outdoor flies in summer. Using it will also cut down on future flies. I see some one- and two-star reviews and the only explanation for the product not working is that the instructions were not read and followed. I have to buy it through Amazon because my local stores can't keep these in stock. Add warm water to the plastic bag, and give a little light shake to mix the powder solution into the water, then hang up outside.  You will be shocked at the number of flies it catches and kills.  Also, in my yard, because so many flies were exterminated it cut down on the future fly population that would have resulted from reproduction. The product does stink, and that's what attracts the flies so don't hang it near the BBG grill.  The hanging catcher also is easily disposed of - be sure to snap down the yellow plastic top into the holes and the bag will be sealed for throwing into the garbage. Also be sure to replace with a new fly magnet at some point because there will be too many dead flies in the liquid for the scent to still be attracting new flies. Most importantly, Read All The Instructions. Buy the fly magnet, and take back your backyard.
I have this fly trap up for over a month and a half and have caught maybe 5 flys.  This was a waste of money and I not be purchasing this item again and I would not recomend it to anyone.

Works amazingly well in catching flies. I buy a few every year.The only problem is that plastic develops leaks after it is half-full of flies (which is a lot). Designed obsolescence, I suppose. But then you simply toss in the garbage. Great in controlling fly population.

I don't know if this product is going to rid my yard of flies but I put out two traps yesterday and they have caught 100's of flies aready.  I plan on going to get a couple more today and spread them out in the yard.  People say that this product smells but I haven't been able to smell it at all.  The bait when you first put it in the contianer doesnt smell too great but once you add the water that smell goes away.  Maybe it starts to smell if you leave the dead flies in there too long?  Anyway, it really does work and it is fun to watch.  I wish someone would post a video on YouTube!  I just might have to do it myself.
Put the trap right where the flies were, but it only caught  1 fly in one month while the other flies hovered around.  It was easy to set up though.  Maybe it only attracts certain flies.

column9: Great product- if you don't get a damaged one.
column10: I've purchased several of these fly traps.  Most are in great condition when I receive them.  You'll catch a crapload of flies and it's totally disgusting.  But I use these things to keep the flies away from my dogs.  Well, it catches flies, but not all the flies.  My only complaint is that some of them come slightly damaged at times, and they're not as effective.  But for the most part, they are very effective and very good for the money.

column9: Don't know how we lived without this!
column10: Stinky, but worth the smell!  I wish I'd have found these a long time ago. Setting the trap up is very simple and it lasts about a week here in Ohio. I will continue to purchase these traps form Amazon.com because this is the only place to get a great deal.  Very pricy through other retailers.

column9: The Magnet of Death for Flies
column10: This thing is absolutely great.  Just don't hang it anywhere near human habitation; IT STINKS! We hang ours from a ten foot high tree branch twenty feet away from the house on stout cord. But it will draw flies to their death in short order and should interrupt their breeding cycle, stopping those annoying critters from hanging around your outdoor festivities.

I'll give it 3 stars just because most other reviewers said it is effective, but I am here to tell you that this thing smells VILE!  I had it on a large screened/open air porch and had to (carefully) move this thing to the garage because I couldn't sit on the porch within 15 feet of it.  The smell is so repulsive I couldn't be in the same outside space with it (and believe me, I've made it through skunked dog, everything).  Now I can't work in the garage and just run to the car to get the heck out of there as fast as I can. I haven't noticed any flies getting anywhere near it. The only reason I still have it is that I can't imagine how to dispose of it.  I mean, it wouldn't be fair to my garbage man, would it?

column9: The worst product i ever purchased. Cheap and useless.

I bought 3 of them, first one broke while it was hunging the first night i put it out.Second one, lasted 2 weeks and trapped about 20 flies.Material looks and feels cheap. Why did i ever buy this thing. Can't return the 3rd one because shipping will be more that the actual unit.What a waist of time and money!
I had this 5 days and only cached  one fly i live in NC theirs a lot flies here. This is waste a money don't buy it.
This tea makes the best refreshing ice tea!  My wife puts 4 bags of Constant Comment and 4 bags of regular orange pekoe in my ice tea pot. I beg her to make a pitcher for me daily!

This tea has just the slightest hints of orange zest and a little spice. It reminds me of when I used to go to Seattle to my grandmother's house and we would have tea and her famous apple pie. This is a relaxing tea you can drink with honey or with milk and stevia. Orange Blossom honey is recommended with this refreshing tea as it enhances the flavor significantly.~The Rebecca Review

I got this from our friends in the UK. We passed it around as a conversation piece with great hilarity. Finally opened it up after 6 months. It is quite good..a little bland..but warm it up in the microwave and it tastes better. Its a mix of crumbly cake and raisins. We don't take it seriously enough for the quaility of the contents only for the funny name.I'd recommend Heinz sticky toffee pudding way over this. when you dump out the sticky toffee pudding on a plate, the sauce covers the top and sides like a creme caramel pudding. Nuke it in the microwave and we put it in the middle of the table and we all dig right in with vanilla ice cream on the side. YUMM-O !

column9: a treat for fans of Patrick O'Brian
column10: Take from can, pop in microwave, serve, eat, enjoy."Spotted Dick" was one of the few non-nauseating shipboard foodsdescribed in author Patrick O'Brian's nautical fiction,in the series beginning with "Master and Commander".

column9: Pretty good cake for a canned product
column10: Bought this can of spotted dick from a local European shop. I don't know if this is authentic or how it compares to something in a restaurant in Europe, but as a canned sponge cake, it was surprisingly moist and fluffy. It's very easy to make and it definitely has a better cake texture than Twinkies or other packaged snack cakes. Unfortunately, despite the picture showing the custard icing on the cake, the can does not contain any custard, so you would need to buy that separately. So if you like raisin cakes, this is definitely a good one to try.

column10: I work for Heinz and bought this as a funny item to add to a gift bag for a co-worker; however, the packaging pictured here is not the same as what I received.  Pictured here, the name stands out and has a funny impact; the cans I received were slightly re-worded so the phrase "spotted dick" was lost in the middle of the phrase "Taste of Home Delightful Spotted Dick Pudding" with all words having the same size and style of font.
