In sum, for less than half the price of Starbucks or Peets, these beans are a great value and I would recommend them to serious espresso drinkers (although true coffee snobs won't be happy with spending so little, I'm sure!).As for the five pounds, I filled a cannister with about a week's worth, then divided the remainder into four sealed plastic storage bags, put them in the original bag the beans came in, wrapped the whole thing in plastic and stuck it in the freezer, so I can easily remove a cannister-portion at a time.

column9: Above average coffee for below average price
column10: This is the coffee that I purchase for the office's coffee fund. I've tried several different brands from Amazon, several local brands, several from stores, and this is the stuff I keep coming back to.I believe that this coffee is comparable to some other high quality coffee, but you cannot beat its price. I would compare this to the italian roast from Peets, and that is a good solid blend in my opinion. With subscribe and save, its really hard to beat this stuff for the price.Just as an idea, we go through a couple of pots a day between 5-6 of us, so we are regular coffee drinkers, and we appreciate a good brew. I think if you pick up a bag you won't be let down. There are other coffee brands that are out there that are better, but for the price this stuff is hard to beat. If you want some coffee that I really  enjoyed, I'd go with some of the Kicking Horse stuff.

Not a coffee expert. But if you are looking for a great tasting coffee that is not bitter; this is it. The price does not break the bank. You could spend twice as much money buying a fancy brand of coffee, but all you're doing is throwing money away.Every time I serve this to family and friends, they rant and rave. And when guests come over to the house, they always want me to make a fresh pot of coffee.You can grind this for espresso, french press or drip and it's going to taste great every single time.

The beans were fresh nice looking smelled very nice.  The brew if made to strong had a bad bitter taste.  The coffee did not have a true itialian roast flavor as I know it.  For a daily cup it was ok and I made it thru the 5 lb in about 7 weeks.  I was happy to have finished it and probably will not order again.  I would rate it about a 4 on a 10 scale.

column9: Took one sip and added this to my subscribe and save list
column10: Fabulous - very nice dark roast, not at all bitter or with that "burned" taste that many dark roasts have. I'll be putting this into my french press and drinking this for a long time.If I had anything critical to say, it would be the packaging. Why in the world do they not make these resealable? It's 5 pounds people, I'll have this bag around for at least two months. If anyone has suggestions about storing this, please let me know. There has to be a better way than a rubber band around the bag that often breaks in the freezer.

column9: Great espresso at a reasonable price
column10: Excellent everyday espresso. Dark oily beans. Quality has been delightfully consistent - we've been getting 5 lbs. every 2-3 months for quite some time now. The blast of aroma when you open the vacuum seal bag is amazing.
Bought this for my husband and his co workers.  They like coffee and this is great they all love it!!  We plan to order more.

I have tried numerous coffees. I have tried every brand on the grocery isle, numerous web purchases, I have even tried roasting my own (which turned out quite decent, just time consuming). That brings me to this coffee; It first arrived at my house and I immediately check the packaging. The aroma was seeping through the packaging giving it just enough air to continue the roasting process even in the packaging and delivering stages. A true Italian espresso is a nice dark, oily black. After cutting open the bag I found this to be true with the Coffee Bean Direct Italian Roast Espresso. There was no chass in the beans (the chass is the outer layer of the green bean which crackles and falls off during the roasting process). Something that I found with other online vendors. The grinding process was as expected, after numerous grinds the oils tend to cause the grounds to stick and clog any chutes they come in contact with. This is not a fault of the beans or the quality of the beans simply a price I pay for enjoying a cup of dark roasted espresso. The flavor of the product was amazing. It has every hint of nuts and coffee flavor that I love. The product is simply amazing. The cost is a plus too. With the item shipping monthly I can not find a better deal on such a great product anywhere!I have also tried the Six Bean Espresso, it too is simply amazing. There are a lot of different flavor profiles found in the beans. When I want to switch things up I order a bag of it. :)Six Bean Espresso, Whole Bean Coffee, 5-Pound Bag

column9: Gourmet ona Budget--A Better Coffee Bang than the "buck"!
column10: Best Value Period! Grocery bean coffee has now become too pricey, especially when you consider it is not fresh! And forget ANY coffee in a can;I could mention numerous celebrated name brands here that have no more quality than "Direct" and cost sooooo much more,nevermind. This is my third outing with Coffee Bean Direct, tried other grinds and was very satisfied, the Italian Espresso lives up to the other reviews here, just finished my morning cup, black with sugar,[no froth for me] made with the approved Melita method, science IS a part of this mix, as is GOOD water--believe it! This espresso has a rich clean taste with a great after taste and NO acid. Do a Google on the Melita coffee making method and give it a try with any olde bean your are drinking, there is a difference. BTW, if there is any downside it could be that 5 lbs last a good while, so keeping a very tight seal on the bag while using 1 pound containers[poured off]at a time helps preserve that "fresh" taste. We have always refrigerated[not frozen]and have been pleased with the results. Are there better coffees, probably so, but you are gonna pay about double, the law of "diminishing returns" kicks in at this point! C'mon, you can almost buy 2 bags of Direct to their one for the same money! Do the Math!

I grind these beans by burr grinder and use Capresso Machine to make an espresso. I like it very much! The taste is better than the Starbucks Espresso, and the price is friendly. I highly recommend this coffee.

This is a nice dark roast. We normally drink a French Roast as we like our coffee strong, but tried this and really like it. Probably will still order the French Roast, but this is a nice change every once in a while. Beans were fresh and the price was right.MH

Great expresso coffee! It's strong with lots of flavor. I used to buy Italian Roast from Starbucks, but this product is so much better. It's fresh, aromatic, and delicious. It has this creamy strong flavor. HIGHLY recommend this!

I really like this coffee!  Not having to going to the store to figue out whatkind of coffee to buy and at what price is great! As coffee prices continue to rise, bulk buying isthe way to go. If you like dark, rich coffee,this could easily double for a Starbucks bag ofbeans. With free shipping, I can not imagine getting coffee any other way.

The title says it all!  No more high dollar Illy espresso for me.  Saving money on my espresso habit was 1/2 the reason I bought an espresso maker, and it was not making any sense to spend all that $ on Illy beans.  These beans are just as good!

I'm VERY particular about my coffee beans and like my coffee dark and strong.  Before their pricing got ridiculous, Starbucks French Roast was my go-to blend. This coffee is as good and comes at half the price. You can't beat that.

column9: Smelled Great But Coffee Lacked Flavor
column10: I bought the Italian Roast Espresso after reading all the great reviews.  I like dark roast, bold coffee so I was prepared to like this coffee.  Unfortunately, even thought the coffee looked and smelled great when I opened the bag, I felt it lacked flavor.  The coffee is definitely bold but and was very bland in flavor. I rarely use flavored creamer but had to with this coffee to add a little something.
I have been buying this brand of coffee bean for 5 years and always have been satisfied with it.

This Coffee arrived on time and was well packaged.  Taste is individual, but I found this coffee to have a "burned" taste.My guess is that it was either over roasted or roasted at too high a temperature.It leaves an aftertaste on the top of the tongue and, for me, it tastes burned.As many people really like this coffee, I may have gotten a bad batch, but I will not risk a second try.

With the  latest rise in coffee prices at the local coffee shop I decided to look elseware and I am happy I did. The Italian Roast Espresso is as good as most other produces simular at a much lower price.

I am a coffee connoi-sewer.  :)I say sewer because I drink a freaking large amount of coffee!!Oh, and I am particular.Since I drink so much coffee, I was looking for a coffee roaster withgood prices who sold in bulk.  Enter 'Coffee Bean Direct'.  I first wentto their website, but didn't like the costly shipping.  Then I noticed Icould purchase from them, through the great and powerful Amazon, with freeshipping!!I bought the 5-lb Italian Roast Espresso, whole bean and French Roast.Expecting the worst, I was pleased when I opened the bags.  The coffee wasfresh and still had the coffee bean oil on the beans.I ground some up and brewed it.  The aroma is incredible and full.  I can smellit coming from the kitchen, in my bedroom upstairs when I wake up.The flavor is rich and full, but smooth, without much acidic bitterness.  TheItalian Roast has just a touch of sweet aftertaste, as it should.  Very similarto Star Bucks, but much less expensive.The French roast could be a little bit richer flavor, but as it is, for the price,you will be pleased.I've ordered more than twice now.  And have just ordered the Peruvian Italian Roast.My phalanges are crossed.  Now if they would just make a German or Turkish roast.But then, I'm just dreaming now...Enjoy
Great price. Mediocre taste (made with Bodum French press.) It was worth a try. Tastes vary though, so don't discard this one.

This order was returned and refunded after I waited nearly thirty days.  I reordered again and we are waiting patiently.  I have received your products and items to military POs before using an FPO (USMC.)  Now, the APO AE address I have provided was not accepted.  The refund went through right away to my credit card.  So, not only are we disappointed, we are without coffee.  I ordered three five pound bags.  We love the French Roast and Italian Roast both and we are now trying Brazilian Santos.  I have also enjoyed the chocolate before.  All are great products, well packaged and at a reasonable price.  I would hope the orders can be filled by adapting your order form for military postal deliveries.

column9: Coffee is good, but I like the decaf espresso better
column10: This coffee has a reddish hue when ground.  It has a certain taste that I don't like as well as the decaf espresso I purchased previously, but it is good.  Everyone has their own tastes and I don't mean to discourage anyone from buying this coffee based on my personal tastes.  This is good coffee, at a price you can't beat.

We recently purchased ourselves a home cappuccino maker and our use of expresso beans increased dramatically.  We were seeking a more cost effective and efficient source for our coffee so we gave this product a try.  Wonderful aroma.  Great taste.  Reasonable price.  We have now subscribed to the product on amazon so it will just automatically appear at our doorstep just before we run out.  Highly reccomended product.

I like this product. The price is right and it tastes good. I've got a self grinding coffee pot and this works well in it. I only have to clean out the grinding area after 1/2lbs. of beans have gone through. I do put half of the 5lb. bag into a gallon freezer bag and freeze it until needed. This seems to work well and the beans don't go stale.
We have very picky tastes on italian espresso's and it's hard to find one we like without paying a fortune. This product was very good and I would recommend it!
I am a coffee snob and used to only buy Starbucks beans, but there are just as good and a lot less per pound!
its cheaper in bulk but i does not have the taste of a robust as i exspected, be that as it may others charge three times as much so use ones exspence account to gamble on flavor!!!!

This is good espresso, I buy in bulk and then repackage this into smaller more manageable sizes for my personal use. My espresso machine holds about 1/2 lbs at a time and I like it fresh so this is great for me.This showed up fresh and sealed with no blemishes in the packaging. Ive had issues with other brands showing up and the package was expanded meaning that it was damaged and air got in.

I bought this coffee to use in my espresso maker and I don't like it at all.  I find the taste to be quite bitter with not a lot of other flavors in it, just bitter.  Now I have a five pound bag of the stuff that I'm going to end up throwing out because I just can't force myself to drink it.  Starbucks, which I don't even think is that good of a coffee, is better than this.

As other reviewers have said, this is a dark roast but doesn't seem like it at first, I guess because we're used to some 'burnt' flavor along with it. This is very smooth with no hint of bitterness. Packing and delivery was excellent, too. I'll definitely buy this brand again, but maybe try another dark roast next time.
The beans are rather old. They appear oily on the surface. but are feather light when you grind them. Not the flavor that I expected.

Have been buying this for several years now and won't go back to anything else. Hints of rich depth and fresh chocolaty bliss waft through the air upon opening this bag. Won't find a better brew anywhere! A damn good way to start the morning!

I have purchased Coffee Bean Direct 5 lb coffee in the past and I think it is a good value for the price (slightly above average).  Thinking I'd economize, I recently ordered using "subscribe and save".  Unfortunately, the USPS in my area (Maine) has changed it's delivery approach.  The mail carrier does not stop or attempt to deliver a package, but instead leaves a slip requiring me to drive to the post office to claim my package.  With gas at $4 per gallon, any savings is wasted.  It's actually cheaper to use the Amazon Prime delivery as Fed Ex and UPS have no problem actually delivering.
jet black, "greasy" beans, very rich and not expensive. I purchase one of these bags every six weeks my family.

column9: Good, but not as good as loose tea
column10: One of the cool points of the Keurig brewer is the capability to brew both coffee and tea.  Although I use it mainly to brew coffee, I got a box of this Earl Grey, and use it in a rush.I drink most of my tea using loose tea (Adiago Tea's Earl Grey Bravo is wonderful), and nothing beats loose tea for having a tea with some body and full flavor.  Tea brewed with a K-Cup is brewed too fast, and is slightly more bitter than other good teas, and doesn't have the same mouthfeel.Still, I've been drinking this regularly, especially when I'm running out the door and would rather have tea than coffee some mornings.  It's quick, and it's a reasonable cup.

Earl Grey is my favorite, and this is a decent one.  I'd say it's good, but not great.  It seems to be missing just a little something, but I can't quite put my finger on it.  It does have the basic Earl Grey flavor though.I do give it kudos for its convenience.  It's great to get a nice, hot cup of tea so quickly.  Although the flavor isn't fantastic, it's more than adequate.
The Earl Grey tea is a little on the bitter side.  Interested to find out if it is just the brand, or if it is due to the brewing process.  Still hopeful, but also, Still enjoying my Earl Grey!

I've gone through about 12 cups of this so far. It is not a bad tea at all. But it is not an Earl Grey in my opinion. I much prefer Twinings to this one, I'm afraid. Not a complaint mind you but rather a preference.

I have been drinking this tea for over two years.  It is my favorite Early Grey.  I prefer it not only for it's convenience but find it to be less flowery than other teas in bags or K-cups.  It is with some disappointment that i will discontinue use since the price has risen so drastically that I can no longer afford to drink it.

Landed cost, at my door, was the best price I could find on the net. I had thought EBAy auction site would be a good shopping site but what with unreal shipping costs and having to wait until the auction was over, I found this was undesireable. Amazon buying is straight forward and you know what you are getting and when you are getting it. All my future buying of this type will be done on Amazon. The quality of Kuerig cups speaks for itself. No additional kudos are needed.

I bought this coffee from Amazon on a whim because while I love gourmet coffee, I don't always like how much it costs locally. I was delighted to find that this whole bean coffee is absolutely delicious, with a fresh, rich, robust flavor. In fact, I just visited this page to buy another bag, it's that good! Highly recommended.

Over the past several years, we've been buying our coffee through Amazon's Subscription Program, and although we still think that's a super way to get coffee, we've been forced to change our chosen coffee many times because the prices have simply gone nuts - each time we found a nice coffee, eventually its price would climb 25 or 35% causing us to reconsider our choice.  So we'd look for another one that had not yet reached such lofty heights.  Our most recent shift brought us to this French Roast Peruvian coffee.  We've never before had Peruvian coffee, but hey, why not?I'm not going to tell you that this is the best stuff I've ever had in my mouth - but I will say that it pleases most of my 'coffee taste buds' and makes my mornings happy.  It may come up a little short on richness and depth, and frankly, I don't think its roasted dark enough for a French roast - but for my taste, it makes up for those weaknesses with its price - it's a quality coffee at a low end price - so what's not to like?

I bought this coffee from Amazon on a  because while I love gourmet french coffee, I don't always like how much it costs locally. I was delighted to find that this whole bean coffee is absolutely delicious, will buy again and again.

I'm having a difficult time deciding how to review this coffee. Here's why...I have no complaints about the condition or quality of the product in the bag. As is typical of previous orders of other varieties of coffee by Coffee Bean Direct the beans in the bag were of good quality, uniform size and roast and reasonably fresh. Properly ground, these beans provide a nice crema when pulling shots of espresso and the beans, while certainly a dark roast, are not overroasted and therefore not so oily that they clog the burr grinder every few cycles like some beans. Also good for drip and press pot if you prefer those methods. Now here's the difficult part...I don't really much like the flavor, acidity or mouthfeel of this coffee. There is nothing wrong with it per se. It just doesn't fit a profile I like. First, I prefer my coffees to be low to medium acid. This roast of these beans is quite acidic, or at least the bag of beans I received was quite acidic, and not something I want to sip much of or for long. Second, the flavor isn't bad, it just isn't appealing to my tastes. And finally when it comes to mouthfeel, for me there isn't really that much. The brew is thin tasting and watery even when brewed quite strong.Now there is a saving grace for me with a dark yet acidic and thin-feeling coffee like this, and that is that it makes a great dessert coffee with everything from cheesecake to pastries and chocolates. The acidity and dark roast flavor helps cut through the sweetness of desserts and provides some balance. I just don't eat that much dessert or have dessert often enough to justify five pounds at a time of this particular coffee.Bottom line: Good quality beans, well roasted. If a dark roasted, acidic coffee suitable for serving with after dinner dessert courses is what you're after, I think this may be it. It's just not for me. Consider my three star rating of this coffee to be neutral. That's as fair as I can be.
This coffee is very tasty and so smooth it's like liquid satin. The beans have just the right amount of oil. High marks for the seller, too.

I've been buying coffee in 25lb batches from CoffeeBeanDirect since only a few months after they started Internet orders in 2004.  In the intervening 8 years, I have never had a bad bean.  I buy direct and get free shipping, which makes the savings even better.I buy mostly purchase their darker roasts-- French, Italian, yet sometimes I'll thrown in a City-Roast.  This particular Arabica from Peru is nicely roasted.  They get it right every time, for real.Only when I can't make a large order do I buy locally and when I do the results are rarely as good as when I buy from this outfit.  They roast the coffee within 24-hours of shipping and as I said, I have always received freshly roasted coffee.  Only when I roast green beans, which I get from these folks do I get a fresher roast and then it's really hard to know the difference unless I am taking the coffee directly from my roaster.I realize there are some great coffee sellers/ roasters out here, Sweet Maria's is one, but CBD has proven reliable over the short and long-term.I write this review because CBD earned it.  I do not work for the company nor ever received anything from them except great coffee-- I wouldn't mind it if they did send me something additional, but it's not necessary.  I get what I need.
Awful tasting coffee... should have known better that the price was too good to be true. Don't but this coffee!
I had this at my friend's; she microwaved it and put it on ice cream.  Yum!  I'm sending a few to my parents as gifts.

column9: Pretty good, but not worth the price
column10: This is pretty good, but it tasted like a slightly salted dulce de leche, which costs a fraction of the price. To me it did not have a true salted butter caramel flavor, such as you'd find in Bequet Celtic Sea Salt Caramels (which I melt down with a bit of water to make a sauce, and save my teeth...).

I got this before my husband who loves salted Carmel on his ice cream.  This is a very tasty spread and good enough to buy again.  However it is not as good as the jar we got in Las Vegas that made him crave more so I am only giving it 4 stars.

This is my favorite snack!!  They are no longer available in the stores in my town so I was thrilled to find them on Amazon. I was concerned they might be out of date freshness-wise, but was delighted to find they were not and I am ordering another box today!

Good price for these.  Very fresh for the 2 sets I've purchased so far.  Now I am "auto-subscribed" to getting theses every few months.
Very satisfied with product.  Great quality, entire family enjoys them and best price anywhere.
They are a very good value. Package size is just right. Great on salads, but we like them best to snack on.

I must have received the packages that were filled with the last of the stuff in the bottom of the bin at the factory.The problem is that because I received one case from one specific packaging period at the factory - they are ALL like that. column9: This is the best seasoning I have ever tasted
column10: I came across this product at BJs, and fell in love. Food have never tasted better. It smells so sweet and smoky at the same time, I am drooling on the keyboard while writing these lines. This srub is so good I stocked enough for a few years, just in case it will be hard to find later.Get it! it will change the way you eat.

Very good blend of seasonings for pork and chicken.  I think it will be good on fish as well but haven't tried it yet.For doing ribs I would recommend accenting with a little brown sugar.The maple and smoke flavor comes across very nice without being too much or tasting like imitation type seasonings.McCormick does it again with a great product!

I used this product this past summer while fishing across Alaska for anything I could catch that was legal at the time. I learned to use smokehouse maple seasoning sparingly since it is awfully powerful if too liberally used. By default, since it was the easiest way to cook inside my camper I braised my fish fillets.  I'm just earning how to live by truck-camper.Braising is a method of frying and poaching, or steaming, at the same time. One simply places a bit of olive oil in a skillet, places the seasoned fish into the skillet then puts the lid on using low to moderate heat. It fries on the bottom and the steam created cooks from the top down. One can take the lid off and turn the fillets if desired while turning the heat up for a few minutes. It takes experimentation to get a result you will be happy with. No additional salt is needed. Garlic powder works in conjunction with this method as does placing diced onions a green peppers in the skillet with the fish.At first I used an entire fillet with the skin on. Then I migrated to cutting the fillet vertically (belly to back) and away from the skin before braising it. It gave a more consistent product and it was easier to control the cooking uniformity this way. Also one did not have to wrestle with fish skin on the plate later.Now, nothing else seems to come close to the appeal of this seasoning. I'm now hooked and spoiled on it - not necessarily a good thing since it denies one a host of other tastes from other seasonings. I gave some to another fishing couple and now they want to buy it.

My family uses the grill most of the summer months so I purchase the bigger containers of seasonings for our meats. This seasoning is a mix between sweet and salty with just the right amount of smoke flavor. My marinade for unthawed chicken breasts and pork loin: In a gallon ziplock bag use 1 tbsp sugar, 1 cup italian dressing and 4 tbsp of the smokehouse seasoning. Mix well and let marinade over night in the fridge. I also use the McCormicks Montreal for steak/burgers and buy it at a Warehouse store where it is cheaper but they do not carry this flavor. Of course, I buy this flavor from amazon because it is only two dollars more and I get free shipping without having to drive to different stores searching for it...

I use this seasoning to make the greatest beans ever. I needed a way to start eating a little healthier and since my girlfriend is trying to be a vegetarian I thought I'd give this a try. Suffice to say, it worked. A half bag of red beans in a rice cooker with 9tsp of Smkokehouse Maple and a bunch of water and I've found myself a very tasty entree.

column9: This is the best rub ever!
column10: I just wanted to chime in on this product. Everyone here has raved on how it tastes on chicken and pork. This stuff makes everything taste better! We use it primarily on steak. Rub it in, let it sit for about ten minutes then grill as you like yours done. I like my steak medium to medium rare and others in my family like theirs well done. The rub holds up and doesn't get bitter on the well done steaks. No need for sauce or anything else on these. Makes the best steak ever. My Ribeye's are coming out so good we haven't been out to a steak house in over a year. I can make them better at home.

I found this at Costco (for quite a bit less than here on Amazon) and purchased it. It is absolutely delicious (subjective, I know--I'm not sure how else to present a review on a food item) and has been great on chicken and fish. It is definitely sweet (not candy sweet by any means) and not comprised of the healthiest ingredients, but if that doesn't turn someone off, it's definitely worth a try. I ordered from Amazon after Costco stopped selling them in my area and my supply started to run low.

My family loves this spice mix.  It is not spicy (hot) - it is a mild flavor with a definite emphasis on sweet.  First couple ingredients are sugar.  Be careful not to burn your food - sugars burn easily.  I use pre-mixed spice rub as well as make my own.  Great on pork chops and hamburgers.  I am sure it would be great on ribs as well.

This seasoning makes the best pulled pork.  Use lots for lots of flavor.  We used this when we were cooking pork in a crockpot and my mom had just bought this seasoning so we used it.  It was so good that I had to go purchase my own at Amazon so I could get a larger package of it.

I found these cookies at a retail store but then could no longer find them.  My friends and I love them so I looked on Amazon and found them at a great price with free shipping--how could I go wrong?  Love em!
The cookie flavor was great, but more than half of the cookies in each box were broken into small pieces.

What I like best is the ease of ordering and delivery. Then it is the delicious just right portion wrapped in shiny purple foil with a happy jingle printed Inside to make you smile. AND I saved money buying 4 packages.

I use black sesame seeds for one particular salad recipe -- a recipe I like a lot. When I found I couldn't buy them from my usual local source, which had been a pain to locate initially, I turned to Amazon.com. Not only was the selection online broad, but I was able to find just the product size I wanted. Delivery was timely and I'm sure I'll be back online when I run out.
The company I work for gives these as housewarming gifts to employees when they move.  Everyone loves them!  They're apparently the best brownies they've ever tasted.  :)

column9: Cat loves this and the turkey & giblets!
column10: My cat loves this one and the turkey & giblets(dark purple). The cups are great, much easier and much safer than cans in my opinion. My cat is very picky and lots of times will only sniff foods once and walk away, even other flavors of this kind, but goes nuts for these two and the beef but decided beef was weird since I couldn't see my cat eating a cow in the wild. Great food!

column9: Run, don't walk from this jam!!!!
column10: My boyfriend, who is diabetic, purchased this product from a local grocery store. We both tried and hated it. There is an awful chemical taste during and after ingestion. Not a hint of strawberry flavor to be tasted. Plus it spreads like jello, not jam. Completely horrible!

column9: Simply the best tasting tea I have ever drank...
column10: I am addicted to this tea. Maybe because as an ex Starbucks employee I use to make, serve and drink it so much. I have tried many other teas which are suppose to be better then Tazo Zen.( Numi, Trader Joe's etc. ) and I still go back to Tazo Zen. If you go to Starbucks on a regular basis to purchase their iced green tea and want to save some money...Starbucks uses this exact tea. A box of 20 bags cost around $4.00. The instructions state to use two bags for every 8 oz. of iced tea. At Starbucks they do not follow this. To cut costs they use one tea bag for every 8 oz. of water then they double the steeping time indicated on the box. I make well over a gallon of tea out of each box that I buy. And yes...it tastes exactly like the Starbucks ones. If you like it sweet DONT add honey or powdered sugar because it will have a totally different taste then Starbucks...instead just buy a bottle of the Starbucks classic syrup available at all Starbucks. They go for about $7.00. They are usually out of pumps but Ebay has plenty of Starbucks pumps. Enjoy!

After first experiencing this tea from across a table in NYC, I had to taste it myself.  The aroma starts the relaxation process before the first sip.  I am NOT a green tea drinker in general, as I find them to be somewhat tasteless.  But this tea relaxes and refreshes with it's subtle mint and lemon flavor.  If you don't experience the flavor, you aren't steeping the bag long enough.  I find it to be the perfect every night tea just before bed.  I only wish I could purchase it in larger quantity.

I find the spearmint in this tea to be very refreshing mixed with the green tea.  Not the best, but certainly a good tea for those on a budget.  I drink this daily, and have some better, full-leaf green teas on special occasions.  Good, expensive brands of green tea are: Ineeka and Two Leaves and a Bud.

column9: Best green tea for someone who doesn't like green tea!
column10: I hate the taste of green tea, but want the health benefits. Celestial Seasonings makes a decent mint green tea, but this Tazo one is far superior. You can't even tell that it's green -- it just tastes like really good, minty herbal tea.

****Tazo's Zen Green Tea has a subtle, mild, light green tea taste, not bitter at all. I don't taste any of the additional flavors Tazo puts into this tea; maybe my palate isn't developed to this point. However, it still is one of their better teas, and has less of an artificial taste than the others I've tried. Maybe the flavorings are just too mild in this tea, but when it comes to flavorings, I prefer them this way; I like a natural, real taste with real ingredients sans vague "natural flavors" and sans flavorings, sans essences, etc. It is not a strong green tea, so it would definitely appeal to people who enjoy herbal infusions and milder teas.The ingredients in Zen  are: green teas, lemon verbena, spearmint, lemongrass, and natural flavors. Zen contains caffeine.Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "an enlightening blend of the finest green teas and rare herbs available in this world." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Zen as "smooth, lemony, earthy, refreshing". Tazo describes the aroma as "lemon, mint".  The web site also says, "Select pan-fired green tea from Zhejiang province in China, artfully combined with lemongrass, spearmint and a hint of lemon essence. Zen's distinct green tea flavor accented with lemon and mint is impossible to express in words. Best simply to experience its sweet, lingering aftertaste." I don't taste the lemon or the mint or the sweetness; still, it is a nice green tea. It is relaxing and enjoyable to drink.I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as very good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as Numi. I'm soooooo spoiled by Numi teas, which is why Zen gets only four stars.****

I was a little skeptical when I bought it, green tea, lemon verbena, spearmint and lemongrass?Sounded a little funky!But I went ahead and said what the hay, and forked over 4 bucks for a box.. I just brewed myself a mug and I LOVE IT!I've been looking for some non-fruit tea flavours to try because I haven't had much luck with the fruit teas.(They all have such strong fruit flavor.. no tea!)This one is the perfect blend of flavors, not too strong, not too weak.Will definitely be a tea I will purchase again!

column4: JamesT ""What We Do In Life, Echoes in Et...
column10: Okay, let me start off by offending most tea lovers by saying that, as a regular coffee drinker, I've always disliked drinking tea. I never understood it...until now.  Trying to live a healthier lifestyle, I began looking into the different types of teas I could try out and was drawn into purchasing the Tazo Zen Tea.  Once it came, it sat unopened in my pantry for about two weeks, when I decided to make some while reading a book outside. I KNOW understand why this tea received so many good reviews!  The taste is somewhat minty, and although I can't explain it too well, it makes you feel really good. Call it the aroma, or the hot minty flavor going down your throat, it is a great tea. I look forward to purchasing more in the future.

This is my favorite green tea, Tazo Zen.  It has a stronger flavor than Bigelow, Twinings, and other good quality teas but it is not as strong as some of the Asian or Japanese Green Teas.  It is "j-u-s-t r-i-g-h-t!I can use 1 bag for a 24 oz cup of hot water and that is powerful enough for me.  A cup in the morning helps to jump start me so I can be on my way to work.

i tried a differnt TAZO tea, AWAKE, and did not care it at all.  It was bitter & pooky tasting in my opinion. i also tried another tazo tea in a yellow box but i forget the name of it. once again, i didn't care for it. I was going to give up on TAZO But then i tried this particular flavor (ZEN) and it is quite good.  i really like it a lot. It has a very mellow & sweetish flavor, no bitterness that i can detect.

There's nothing more pleasant than sipping a cup of Tazo zen tea.  Notonly is it good for you, but the taste is wonderful.  With all of thebad news in the world, break away for a quiet, peaceful moment with yourfavorite book and a cup of zen.  You'll be so glad you did.

I know people are going to rate my review not helpful but I can't help it... I think this tea is one of the worst I ever tasted. I grew up in a place where everyone enjoyed green tea, so this flavored green tea thing tastes just horrible to me. At Starbucks they serve this tea with boiling hot water, so naturally the green tea flavor is killed (like always as they never tell customers that hot water kills green tea flavor and make it bland). If you want herbal tea thats good, but if you are looking for "real green tea", I recommend you get once that don't have funny names like this one or Samurai, Sakura, because they usually arent real green tea but something people who haven't had real green tea thought would sound oriental and cool.
Very good product. No too sweet and the lemon taste is very good. I use it in 24ounce bottle and works ok.

After having pup on Taste of the Wild and Solid Gold Barking at the Moon, did some research to find another premium grain-free food but at a lower price and found this.  Excellent stuff.My year and a half old chihuahua has been on it for a few months now and couldn't be doing any better.  Both he and our two cats (who are on Purina but steal the Epigen, which they seem to prefer, out of the dog's bowl) seem to love it. And pellet size is just right for them all, very small.Just purchased a second bag and will continue purchasing this. Very happy with the product and it's price!

This is the first grain free food all 4 cats like.  AND it is starch free to boot!  Looking forward to having them try the fish and the venison. My cat with EGC is 90% clear of issues and has stopped chewing on his fur/skin. We are all SO happy!

My cat loves it!  I think I have him convinced that these are treats and not actually 'food'.The pellets are a quite small.  So if you use treat-balls (as I do) try to get one with a smaller or adjustable opening.
kitty says she likes it. it also prevents her from becoming a fatty since it's starch and grain free. why do cats need starch and grains? they don't.

With an enormous range of essential ingredients, including krill oil, a super-antioxidant rarely found in other pet foods, this product is ostensibly ideal for both cats and dogs. THE PROBLEM is that it contains so many NON-ORGANIC ingredients, including corn protein. Newer studies just released point to a greatly increased risk of tumors in animals that are fed corn, simply because ALL of the corn grown in the USA has been genetically modified (courtesy of one very large multi-national corporation whose name is familiar around the world.) You can't escape it. So until Wysong decides to produce an all-organic version of their Epigen WITHOUT any GMO ingredients, we won't be buying it anymore.
My 3 big dogs and my cats love this food.  And, I like the ingredients that it contains.All my pets always like all Wysong products.  They have a sort of variety with good ingredients.
i was amazed at how quickly my order arrived. also, i was pleased that the product was packaged in small easily managed bags. both cats and dogs like this food.

The best find ever; I love cooking with this salt.  Great deal- have purchased this product twice and not disappointed!

Eggcellent! I just cooked one bag of these noodles to test them out and I think they are really delicious. I just received my order and I wanted them to be good and they were. No regrets. These are even better than authentic kluski noodles I buy at Polish food stores every now and then, and they're suitable in a number of recipes. They're not certified for Passover, a minor inconvenience.

This is the chocolate I loved when I lived in Europe. It is so creamy that it melts instantly when it hits your mouth and with lot's of Hazelnuts it makes it all the better. If you love milk chocolate, then you will not be disappointed with these chocolate bars.

Milka and its famous purple cow, recently purchased by Kraft, is an eastern European chocolate originally produced in Switzerland and is available in Germany, Austria, Hungary and other nearby countries. With hazelnut, the crunch and flavor has a pleasant exotic texture.Distribution is still weak in the United States, but can be found increasingly in larger cities. Usually, then, it is found only in international grocery stores, though it pops up in eclectic grocers from time to time. It has been around 100 years. Whether or not Kraft will change the recipe has yet to be seen. For now, the texture and taste are better than Hershey's and Nestle. It is a smoother, creamier basic chocolate, although they also make varieties which include yogurt, nuts and a version with Oreo Cookies. Buy a case of the hazelnut Milka and enjoy!Anthony Trendleditor, HungarianBookstore.com
These were so good and creamy.  I would love to have just the chocolate without the nuts, but still very good.  I can't decide which is better, Milka or Ferrero Rocher...

column9: What about expiration dates when buying online?
column10: The cholocate itself is delicious.This review deals more with the no availability of expiration dates when buying online... I just got 10 bars of chocolate that expire sooner than I would like.It would be great to have this information when shopping.

I had my doubts... but I will say that the Milka bars with whole hazelnuts really IS the world's best chocolate.  Smooth... not so sweet it hurts your teeth, but VERY satisfying when you want a bite or two of REALLY outstanding chocolate.  And the hazelnuts add just the right amount of crunch...  I couldn't be happier with a chocolate purchase.

I bought a few of these bars when I was in Germany and was hooked!  I was so glad to be able to find these here at a great price.  They are so delicious and I plan to keep a supply of these on hand.  They also make a good gift to give along with a gift card or greeting card.

This chocolate is delicious and so smooth, and there's ample hazelnuts for every bite.  Word of caution: once you start eating, the entire bar disappears!

column9: Yum Yum - One of the best
column10: This Chocolate is made in Germany. Where they (by Law), have to tell the amount of Coco that is included. Please, try calling Hershey and ask them how much Coco is in their product & they will tell you that they DO NOT have to tell you. Milka chocolate bars are pure bliss and a little on the creamy side, which I like sometimes. This is how a Chocolate Bar should taste like, but in America it is only possible when you eat a foreign product.Please note, this is all about mass produced Chocolate. Yes, of course there is superb Chocolate in America but, NOT from the mass producers...

My wife suggested that this was better than most other local brands, and the sale price made it sweeter. Amazon often has very good prices for some of their goods for a very short period of time. So, keep watching and act fast.

This was pretty good hazelnut chocolate..but my favorite still has to be this:http://www.amazon.com/Lindt-Chocolate-Hazelnuts-10-58-Ounce-Packages/dp/B002RBTX80/I find milka's to be a bit too sugary and not as milky

I was very excited to see Milka finally for sale in the US, but this is the only place I could find the whole hazelnut variety. All Milka chocolate is great, and if you want to try another very good European brand, check online or World Market for Kinder (made by Ferrero).

column9: Who needs Godiva when you have Milka?
column10: This thing is addictive! I wish I'd bought more.  But then it's getting expensive since I have to buy larger pants every month.

I was really excited when I found these. On paper they look great and I really hoped they would taste good too. Unfortunately that is not the case. They look like rice krispy cakes however when you chew them they turn to a powdery gloop in your mouth. I actually had to force myself to swallow it as it was so vile every instinct told me to spit it out. I am forcing myself to choke down the rest of the box because a) they were quite expensive and b) despite the taste they are good for me, however I will never buy these again and with the remaining bars I can only face eating half a bar a day as they make me feel sick if I try and eat a whole one. column9: Are we all eating the same bar?
column10: I don't often take the time to review a purchase, but I couldn't NOT share my incredible displeasure with this product. Perhaps it will spare someone else the agony of consuming these bars. The experience is most accurately likened to eating a salty, chalky Rice Krispy bar. Healthy, maybe, but tasty? Absolutely not.

Vegan and gluten free!  It's easy to eat healthy on the go with Simply bars.  I feel good about what I'm doing for my body when I choose these bars over other less healthy options.  Thanks for making it easy to be discriminating!  And the taste will win you over, too.
These are so high in fiber lo cabs and delicious! I eat one everyday! I've already lost twenty pounds! I use them as snacks our meal replacements. So filling!
Being a vegan its hard to find a delicious and nutritious bas. Simply bars hit the spot! I'm so glad I discovered them. They give new the protein I need.
Perfect snack for athletes and anyone...!Great tasting too!I look forward to my Simply Bar everyday.Highly recommended.Grab some!

Low sugar, high protein and FABULOUS taste.  This is bar is by far the best protein bar out there.  I am not gluten-free so there are many choice out there for me but hands down I would take a caramel peanut simply bar over anything else!

column9: Perfect for Vegans and Weight Loss Surgery patients!  Gluten free, good source of Protein, low sugar, healthy!

Used it for the first time...love it!!!! Locally, red food color is $1.78 an 1 ounce! Crazy! You have a shopper for life, Ozbo!

column9: McCormick Large bottle of red food coloring.
column10: At the cost of $2.89 per ounce at the store, this was a much better price for a baker like me. The cost was very reasonable.
Nice product like the 1 oz bottle but a lot more for the money. We bake a lot of red velvet cakes and it gets expensive buying the 1 oz bottles. This large bottle goes a long way for the money.

There is nothing like the look and taste of a homemade red velvet cake! Box versions or bakery knock-offs will not do. You can make the cake at home without the color. But who's ever heard of a tan velvet cake? But the cost of the tiny bottles of red food coloring sold at grocery stores adds over $5 to the cost of each cake. So what are you to do? Get this big bottle and make lots of cakes for a fraction of the cost. A feast for the eyes and the mouth. Enjoy! Mmmm!
This is a great tasting sugar free candy.  My 6 year old even likes them.  Some flavors are more prevelant in the bag but still a good mix.
my doberman and lab love the pedigree Jumbone snack....they get one everynight after they have their evening run.....All I have to say is do you guys want a chewy and they come running.

column9: Not nutrional but dogs love them
column10: I let my puppy eat these all though they are not intended for puppies. She is 25lb. giant breed so bigger than most dogs. She loves these because she can chew and chew since she is teething.The ingredients are very poor and these do not contain meat, even though they say meaty center on the front. Also they are not a good source of vitamins and minerals although they say that too. Dog food is a better source itself.My dog likes these probably because they are made mostly of sugar and meat flavoring. She also likes the fact they are chewy.Conclusions: These treats are alright for a treat. Something used once in awhile. I wouldn't recomend giving them more then once a week. Do not assume they are a healthy treat full of vitamins and minerals...mostly sugar.

These are some of my dog's favorite bones.  The reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is because they leave a white residue wherever he eats the bone.  Be sure you put a towel or something down if your dog eats this on something you care about - it washes right out of a towel or blanket.

I bought these by mistake at the grocery store--I usually buy the Mini Dentastix, which my two Bostons love with no problem.  I gave each of them one Jumbone about 6:00 pm, and this morning they both vomited it up.  They didn't woof them down whole, they were chewed, but came out this morning in solid chunks. I like this tea a lot, I just wish it had a bit stronger prickly pear flavor. But it is a great tea on its own, a little goes a long way, and it was a great price. I'll buy it again.

column9: Great Alternative to Pricey Prescription Food (for my cat and his condition)
column10: So my male cat developed a urinary/bladder problem.  Long story short(and 2 grand later)the vet said he should be on Hill's Prescription Diet C/D canned food.  We started him on that, but each can was substantially more expensive than other canned foods.  That's when, thanks to looking around on various sites, others have said they used Friskies Special Diet.  Cat enjoys the taste, and it always gets mixed with a few ounces of water to increase his water intake (cat does not drink water at all from his water dish).Using Subscribe and Save (discounted price and auto monthly shipments) along with Prime membership (free shipping), the price beats going to the store so it's a no brainer.This is working for my cats health, but I am not a vet nor should you blindly follow this review if your looking for an alternative to Hill's or other Prescription canned foods.

column9: Good for Diabetic Cat, Low Carb
column10: This is one of the low carb cat foods that work for a diabetic cat.  My cat likes this food and is willing to eat it which is a relief since she doesn't like wet food in general.  Since going on this food, she has stablized and is doing well.  I recommend it.

Well, my cat seems to like this stuff... but he isn't really picky about his food. We just have a few different flavors on staggered shipping schedules to mix things up a bit, and it's the cheapest price around.

column9: Smells and looks like the 'non special diet', but cats won't eat it
column10: My cats love the regular version of this flavor. One of them got crystals when we switched their dry food, so she had to be put on special food for that.We also tried to give them this, but none of the cats were very fond of it. Two of the cats would still start eating it, but none could bring themselves to finishing it, and they'll eat just about anything/ not picky at all.So, it's a nice idea, smells and looks the same to me, but don't expect your cats to eat much of it, or at all.

I purchased this to replace another brand that has been discontinued. Am I ever glad it was! I just thought my cats were saving some for later.... They absolutely love this brand in every flavor!!! I have one cat with special urinary tract needs so they all get the special diet food. I am very happy to have found Little Friskies Special Diet!!! Please don't ever stop making this canned cat food!

This food might be better for my cats over all health, but my cats prefer the regular Friskies Whitefish pate.As I said to my three cats, just yesterday.... Sorry, The regular whitefish is on its way.

My kitty didn't notice when we switched the the special diet, he gobbled it right up!  He loves ocean whitefish flavor!

Have used this product before but being able to order it from Amazon and have ample supplies on hand is great.  The product is just the same as bought in the pet food or grocery store and the price is very good.

The best description for this product is in the title. The incense is light and slightly sweet with musky overtones. Reminds me of lavender growing in a field. A true experience, recommended for anyone who likes lavender, or incense.

column9: Great brand we buy it all the time

I enjoy burning incense daily, and this smell is so peaceful, and very light. The box has lasted for about 2 months, and I burn 3 or 4 at least 5 days a week.

column9: Great Value For A Great Product
column10: Was pleasantly surprised at the quality of these incense given the low price. They are from Bangalore and are very aromatic and long burning. Perfect for anyone that has allergic reactions from burning cheap incense - the only thing cheap about these are the price. Attractive packaging, too.

column9: Yikes, smells like an ash tray
column10: Save your money, unless you don't mind if your house smells like a mixture of nasty perfume and cigarette smoke.

we live in heartland American and have to make do with homemade Indian food. Condiments are essential, and this tamarind comes through.It is very thick, so we finally figured out to thin it.It is very good, and there is a year's worth for a couple of bucks.
Nigella Lawson's recipe for Keralan Fish Curry calls for tamarind paste: I chose this one and made the recipe. It was beautiful, simple to make and delicious.

When I try to describe the taste and sensation to friends, the best I can come up with is that it tastes like lime and molasses. Wonderful flavoring agent for broths, and I also use it quite a bit with sweet potatoes, tomato dishes and anything with chicken. I use it in much higher concentrations than what they suggest. There are some instant soup mixes using tamarind, and if you are new to the condiment, you may want to try them to experiment with how best to use it. I also looked to Madhur Jaffrey's excellent "World of the East Vegetarian Cooking" for inspiration.

column9: Nice Tart - Sour and sweet addition
column10: I like this because I can add some sour without adding a lemon or lime flavor.If you can imagine tasting something which has the tart flavor of lime juice without any citrus flavor (to me anyway) this is what you get.Also has a natural sugar cane kind of sweetness to it.hint: i sometimes put a dab on my finger and taste it just for fun.. it's a nice candied flavor!

This paste was an item I needed to make chili sauce. I cannot comment on the quality of the paste, I have not tasted it any where else.  It was perfect for my recipe and provided a unique tartness I expected from the tamarind.  It is thick, quite thick, as I would think a paste should be.  I will always keep it on hand, now that I found it.  I can think of several uses for it.  Thanks for the product and for the large list of specialty ingredients available on Amazon.com.  Tamarind is not to be found in my small town in any medium.  Rather than travel to the nearest city and find an ethnic grocer, I chose to buy it here.  Shipping costs are always a concern, so I looked for the item with Super Saver Shipping and grouped this item with others.  Free shipping makes ordering grocery items on-line a pleasant experience.

column9: Good quality product.  A little goes a long way.
