I've not explored that possibility.Anyway, this product is fresh and tasty.  Eight ounces will last you a long time.  This brand is cheap, too, and that is always nice.

This arrived today. The packaging was sealed but after opening the package I found that the cheap plastic cover was totally off the Tamarind Paste and the seal was even broken. Obviously I won't be eating it.

I love lime.  I keep some in my frig most of the time.  However, this is one wasted use of this versatile fruit.  I also love OS Diet Cranberry Drink.  I drink it every day...the original one, not the one with lime.  The lime ruins it!

column9: Perfectly good cheese! No grated finger.
column10: Yes, you can make your own.  Recipies abound.  Simply buy an armload of cheese, open a bottle of wine, chop some garlic, pour in your kirsch. . . .what - you're tired of this project already? You say you just wanted some cheese? there's no-one to impress tonight? the state liquor store is closed? you can't find your grater? what the heck is kirsch? You'd rather keep your $27 and not have to drink the rest of that white wine?OH, then pay $10 and buy this box.  Zero to bubbly cheese in 5 minutes.  Cut bread.  Dip.  Still drink the wine because that is totally awesome.

I've been a fan of Swiss Knight fondue for years, but have only been able to find it at home in Vermont, not where I live now.  It is so delightful to be able to order this treat anytime!  BTW, I agree with the suggestion to heat the fondue before putting in fondue pot--microwave works fine, so does melting in the top half of a double boiler.
This product is excellent tasting and easy to use.  I've tried to make my own cheese fondue and it just siezes up on me.  This stays creamy and is excellent on crusty bread.

This product is wondeful for a "In a hurry" fondue. I have used it at several of my own parties only to recieve compliments. It's important to melt it BEFORE you put it in your fondue maker in the microwave on high for about 3 minutes. I think it is very good and if used properly and not just heated over a wimpy flame can be a hit at any party.

We live in a remote area and cannot find this type of product anywhere. Company quickly filled my order and we were able to enjoy.  Product is MUCH BETTER than a lame substitute I found in an Asheville, NC supermarket... this is tasty (altho I knew to add white wine to make it smoother - the package never mentioned that !) and you will enjoy a quick fondue meal...

I have been eating Swiss Cheese Fondue since the mid-seventies when it was "in vogue".  Swiss Knight Fondue is one of the two premier fondues that has survived the "test of time" and is of the highest quality.I am in my sixties now but still enjoy this premiere fondue as long as I exercise to get the calories off and the LDLs out of my system!!!  That aside, I truly look forward to having this savory dish at least once every several weeks.Back in the seventies, a lot of New York restaurants (especially those that were Swiss, of course) offered fondue. The prices rose from the tens to the twenties for a delicious pot of fondue and bread as the time expanded from the seventies into the eighties and eventually the nineties.The price that Amazon offers is on the low-end and allows one to savor the exquisite taste of a marvelous meal for a fraction of what it would cost at any restaurant on the East or West Coast, or, for that matter, in-between.I live in the Central States now but I can attest to the fact that a pot of Swiss Cheese Fondue in lower Wisconsin at a popular Swiss restaurant costs $22+ ... twice the purchase price of Swiss Knight fondue from Amazon !!!

column9: Swiss Knight Fondue is the greatest
column10: This was the first time I used this product.  I have used other prepared cheese fondues in the past, but Swiss Knight was superior to all.  Even better than I have had in Fondue cafes.If I had bought the cheeses needed to make my own it would have cost twice as much.

Swiss Knight Fondue is something I remember fondly from when I was a kid--fondue was popular in the 70s and 80s, and we had this from time to time.  I was pleasantly surprised when I found it's still available--it even still has the same packaging it used to!  But best of all, Swiss Knight turns out to be one of those few things you remember from your childhood that turn out to be just as good as they seemed at the time.  It's not cheap, especially when ordered online with shipping charges--but you'd be hard-pressed to find a substitute of equal quality.The fondue pack is also easy to use.  Cut up some bread, maybe steam some vegetables for better variety--and nutrition--in dipping (I find broccoli works very well for this, as it absorbs the cheese and goes well with the flavor).  Then empty the packet into your chafing dish if you have one (use a small saucepan if you don't have one), and melt the cheese at low heat directly on the stovetop.  That may sound wrong, but I've found if I use the fondue set's built-in burner to melt the cheese, some of it burns to the bottom, whereas the stovetop gives better control and allows a lower heat.  Then transfer to your fondue set (or a hot plate), and dip away.

Yuck! Melting cheese is not that hard, just make your own. There are good recipes everywhere. Try 1/2 pound gruyere, grated, 1/2 pound emmenthaler grated, tossed w/2 tbsp of corn starch. Simmer 1 cup wine, slowly add the grated cheese, stirring in a figure 8, adding more when the last batch is incorperated. Add 2 tbsp Kirsch. Not hard!And yes, I have tried this specific fondue, it does not taste right.

column9: Don't  Get Too Excited About Ice Cream of the Month Club
column10: I received 3 months of Ice Cream from this Club as a gift. I was very disappointed with the Ice Cream I received and the giver was unhappy after seeing the choices I was sent each month. The first 2 months included a duplication of black walnut, a very bland vanilla frozen yogurt, some type of caramel,that didn't taste at all like caramel(I tried,but couldn't give it away), also 2 peppermint in one month. I emailed them after the 2nd month with my complaint,thinking they might want to take a second look at what was being sent. I did receive an immediate response, with an apology and an offer of an extra month of ice cream. They also told me they spoke with their shipper and was told my 3rd month was really going to be scrumptous. I just received it. May be somewhat better, but there is only one pint with higher butterfat then the average grocery store brand, 2 frozen custards, and 1 "neopolitan"(how exciting)in a square cardboard carton and from a company not even mentioned in their ad. We have a number of Ice Cream stores in our city and thus far I have only received 1 pint each month that might compare. I felt I should write this review because the person who sent this gift had no reviews to read and had no idea that I might receive duplicates, along with the vanilla custard and neopolitan.

I knew from previous experience that this candy is small and not the greatest for blowing bubbles.  However, the flavor is simply delightful even though it lasts little more than 10-15 seconds.  My personal favorite by far is the strawberry flavor.  I bought this "variety pack" because I'd never tried the orange or melon flavors.  I didn't think they had as good a flavor and the flavor wasn't as intense as the strawberry or grape. Anyways, I think y'all should try this at least once in your life!

This is very good tasting gum and has a very nice texture. It was definitely enjoyable. How ever the packs of gum are about 1 inch long and contain 4 microscopic pieces of gum. Just a warning for any potential buyers out there.

I used to buy this gum when I was little, but hadn't been able to find it for a while.  Great to find it here!  This gum has a different texture then regular gum, more "bouncy" in the mouth.  Great flavors, too!

These are really great and super easy to prepare but add some garlic and parmesan to make them perfect.  Very light and good for camping/hiking.  I buy them for $1 per pack myself at a major drug chain store.

column9: No better salsa in the world
column10: I love salsa and chips.  I don't like sweat salse.  Love the flavor of Habanero.  My test for a good salsa is if you can dip the chip in the salsa and take it out without scooping, just that salsa that's left on the chip, and if that has enough flavor to hold its own, that's a great salsa.  Most salsa's seem like they start with ketchup, yuck.Mrs. Renfro's Habanero Salsa is the most perfect salsa on the market.  Salty and tangy, tangy is the word.  Full of flavor.As to the heat, Habanero can be very hot.  My tolerance is very high.  This is not a very hot Habanero salsa.  It's probably closer to a medium for those of us that like a good burn.  My kids can eat this and that's proof enough.  Even so, it has the Habanero flavor and is just exceptional.Thank you Mrs. Renfro!

column9: She looks like such a sweet old lady on the bottle.
column10: In reality Mrs. Renfro is a mean old biddy than wants to burn your o-ring out. This salsa has a really great taste with some serious heat. The heat, despite some intensity, doesn't last too long, you can go one and actually taste other foods in a shorty time. Great stuff.
My Corgi absolutely loves Canidae Platinum. He has chronic urinary tract stones, bad kidneys, so he is on a special diet. These are the only treats he can have, besides fresh veggies and fruit.

My dog loves these!!  He will do just about anything for one of these Canidae treats.  I use them any time I have to do something he won't like.  All I have to do is promise him a "cookie" and he will let me trim his nails or clean his ears etc.  Before, as soon as he saw the nail trimmers he would go hide, now he will come to me.  Nail trims and ear cleanings have become positive events thanks to these "cookies".

I have 3 small dogs (weights range from 11 - 30 pounds) and these small bite-size treats are perfect for smaller pooches.  They love the flavors and gobble them up like candy.  Really love Canidae products -- I give my dogs their dry and canned food as well as treats.

This is the best Champagne vinegar I have found.  Most are so intensely sour, but this has a nice flavor.  Just add a package of Stevia Sweetener, and the juice of an orange, and have a lovely fat free salad dressing.

column9: There is nothing else like it!
column10: Sensitive to wheat & yeast?  Lots of folks are and don't know it.  Our family has been off both for seven years (much better health, lost 30 lbs too) and this bread is the only thing we can consistently rely upon not to cause any reaction.  And it is shelf stable, so even if our store doesn't stock it, ordering it online is quite manageable in bulk.  Taste?  Well it isn't a bagette in in the sun on the Cote d'Azur, but few things are.  Well toasted, with butter, jelly, or in a sandwich - great.  (Especially when compared to air - also gluten and yeast free.)
I've tasted worse things but I would not buy this again. Dull flavor. Does not satisfy bread craving for the gluten free.

This is the best spinach linguine that I have ever eaten.  I ordered 12 packages and will send some to my Grandson that is a sophmore at WVU along with my recipe.  I also gave my neighbor a package and will share some more with my daughter.  This is how I like it and you are welcome to try my recipe.2 zuccnini2 carrots1 package of spinach linguinesalt to tastechivesKraft Parmesan & Romano cheeseMushrooms- optionalCanned breast of chicken- optionalOnion - chopped - optionalWith a slicer-(I use a hand two inch slicer) slice the zucchini and carrots in long thin strips-down the length of each.  Bring the water to a broil, add a touch of oil, salt to taste.  Drop the thin slices of zucchini, the carrots, and the spinach linguine and broil FOR THREE MINUTES ONLY.  Drain, place on a serving dish, sprinkle with the chives and cheese-mix.  ENJOY!  If you use the mushrooms and chicken, I like to braise a chopped onion, add the mushrooms and chicken just until hot and then add to the linguine.  This truly makes a striking meal.If you like pasta- then try this one.  You will not be sorry!

I ALWAYS THOUGHT OF LINGUINE AS BEING WIDER THAN REGULAR SPEGHETTI BUT THIS PASTA IS ABOUT THE SAME SIZE OR THINNER. I DON'T CARE ABOUT THAT BECAUSE THE TASTE IS GOOD. IT IS DIFFICULT TO FIND GOOD SPINACH LIGUINE IN OUR AREA SO WAS HAPPY TO FIND THIS ON AMAZON AND IT WAS WORTH A TRY. SUCCESS.

The whole family loves this product.  Especially my 4 and 6 year olds.  We call it "green pasta".  It's fun.  I buy it in two case shipments and there is no shipping!  To buy this product in the grocery store would be double this price.

This is truly a light pasta that tastes like something you would eat at a very good restaurant! And "the price is right"! In fact, it is an excellent buy. I agree with the other reviewer, even though this has real spinach in it,it doesn't taste strongly like spinach. While it was cooking, the aroma seemed to indicate the opposite. Nutritionally, you have a top notch pasta,with restaurant quality that is very easy to cook.The only thing I would ask for is the packaging to be changed. I haven't found a way yet, to cook only a part of the bag at once. As good as it is, I am only one person. Amazingly, it reheated very well.

As a macaroni lover, living in Florida, I can't seem to get the kinds of vareties of pasta I enjoyed in New York. Al Dente is a nice light noodle; great in soup or with Alfredo sauce or just butter & cheese.  The pasta arrived in a case, and was not stale.  Overall a good product.

column9: Excellent Maldon quality enhanced with delicate smoke flavor
column10: Having used Maldon salt flakes for many years; I was intrigued with the idea of smoke flavoring added in. I was hopeful the flavor would not be overwhelming as so many smoked seasonings and salts are. Maldon did not disappoint me; the smoke flavor is very light; perfect for some dishes which need just that extra "something".I find it enhances grilled Salmon and Tilapia (I use a gas grill and don't always want to use a smoke box or wood plank). It also does well with bone-in chicken breasts (takes longer to cook so more flavor absorbed) poached on top of the stove or baked in the oven. Excellent tossed in with vegetables being served with grilled foods, etc. The uses are limited only to the imagination.If you are looking for something to add a lot of smoke flavor, this is not the product for you. You might look into Liquid Smoke or Spice Islands Old Hickory Smoked Salt.
Use Maldon  on everything as a salt substitute.  Makes anything you eat taste better. It also makes a great gift for people who love to cook. The smoked salt is the best. Try it first on eggs--yummy!

I'm a big fan of smokey foods, so I was eager to try smoked salt, hoping it would add complexity and intrigue to food that isn't, itself, smoked.  When I opened the pack and a lovely, subtle wave of smokey scent rose up, I was optimistic.  Sadly, the salt itself does not actually taste that smokey.  I have tried it along with olive oil as an accent on ciabatta, and on vegetables, and in soup. If the smoke taste was even there, it was essentially overwhelmed by anything else in the same mouthful.  Even bread.  Desperate for smokiness, I even tried a few grains directly on my tongue.  Too subtle for me -- that smokey punch just wasn't there.Still, the salt itself is Maldon, which is lovely. And it smells terrific.  If your tastebuds are more discerning than mine (and they very well may be), you might find the degree of smokiness to your taste.  Me, I'm still looking for my Perfect Smoked Salt.
This is the best onion powder on the market. It is very fine and tastes great. Much better than the chunky granulated onion powder of most other brands.

I bought this for my husband who is dieting and can't have his beloved peanut butter.  I used sparingly at first use thinking that it might be too strong and only tasted chemicals and it wasn't peanut butter.  I increased the amount to my baking and couldn't taste any peanut butter. It smells like peanut butter but that was the only peanut flavor I got.
I thought for sure this would contain more than 1 spray can, but it did not!!! DO NOT BUY THIS!!! It says .23 per ounce.  It's a lie! I have tried to contact the company, but no answer.
Website states item is 6x5x4; item is actually 4x1, and only slightly larger than a tube of lipstick.Item is also supposed to be .23c per oz, but is actually $10.94 per ounce.
Feels like cardboard and tastes like cardboard.  I am so disappointed.  What a waste of money!!! I have bought other brands and they are moist and thick.  Don't buy this product!

column9: Most delicious healthy alternative to a brownie
column10: I can't believe the couple of negative reviews!  Of course I would go for a juicy brownie or a cheesecake instead if I didn't care about the calories, sugar etc.  But for a healthy snack, this is very good.  I ate it in the car and had no problems with crumbles; just open your mouth and stop eating like a fish.  Take a couple of good bites and be done with it.  Besides, eating with a glass of milk would be even better.

I thought they were really tasty. They are crumbly but it's not a brownie. More like the love child of a granola bar and a brownie. Both my 4 yr old and my 16 mos old loved them. My local grocery store doesn't carry them, which is unfortunate since the kids have been requesting more. I bought them as a treat for myself and only got to eat 1 and a half.

column9: Yes it's chocolatey, but the texture is awful, nearly inedible!
column10: I like a lot of the kashi line,but these new soft baked chocolate squares are less than appealing. The chocolatey flavor is there, but no matter how badly you may want a chocolate treat, I doubt anyone would really find this satisfying because it's impossible to move past the grainy/gritty texture. This tastes nothing like a traditional brownie, and is unbelievably dry. It falls apart so much that you can barely eat it, and when you do it's like sandpaper in your mouth. Sadly, I would stay clear of this item unless you actually like very, very grainy/dry food.
Other people says its dry, but it wasnot for me.It not sweet as other brownies which I liked.I give five stars, becauce its tasty, organic, and good nutrients in here.

I bought mine at the local supermarket and they are fresh & delicious! Maybe the people that ended up with dry ones had a box near the expiration date end? I dunno but i got a box of these & another flavor and both are moist, yummy, and just all around fantastic!

Yes, these are healthy, they're Kashi for heaven's sake. So obviously they are not going to taste like a gourmet brownie. However, these little squares do fill a need for me. Often halfway through the morning I get a little craving for chocolate. Instead of wasting my allowance of snack fat grams/calories for the day on a mid-morning indulgence, I have been trying these. They are pretty tasty and not overly sweet. They seem to satisfy my chocolate need until I can chow down on some real dessert after dinner time. My kids think they are great and love having one for a little dessert with their lunch. Yes, they are a little dry feeling in the mouth but have it with a glass of water or milk or some hot tea. These little squares serve a purpose for me and my kids and that's good enough for us.

These are a Godsend!  They are chocolatey,  but even as you bite into them they just "feel"  healthy!  And as a dieting chocoholic with PMS these have been a major life saver.The only downside is that they give you a little dry mouth.  Nothing getting a drink won't fix.

The taste for these is okay to me, but they are really, really dry and crumbly. They are so dry, parts of them always get stuck in the back of my mouth when I eat them.  If you are like me and prefer brownies a little mushy and moist, you will NOT like these.  Sure, they have natural ingredients but they are not much healthier than other BETTER brownies on the market. If you are gonna eat a brownie, eat a brownie for God's sake! They just aren't meant to be anywhere close to health food.

column9: Disgusting - but Not as Disgusting as the Clif Kids Bars
column10: These chocolate squares are like an extra sad version of cheap cake from a box. The cake is dry; it only looks moist because the outside is spritzed with something to make it smooth but the inside crumbles like a cookie when you break apart the square. The "chocolate" flavor is chalky, like licking powdered hot cocoa.Not worth the $5 they charge for the 5 squares you get.

OMG I got a sample in the mail, I was all set to taste a delicious brownie, man was I wrong, it tasted like the box it came in, it was horrible, it tasted like cardboard or worse, was not sweet at all and very dry, how can they sell crap like this? and you know how usually when you get a free sample or anything really it is usually good?  not these! save your taste buds and avoid this crap

I picked these up in the store a few weeks ago thinking that maybe they would be a decent healthy snack for the whole family.  We normally eat healthy anyways; we rarely indulge in sweets or junk foods so I wasn't expecting to compare this to a box of Ghiradelli brownies or even the cheap dollar mixes for that matter.  I had bought them during my lunch hour and decided to try one while still at work.  I cannot describe how horrible this product is.  First, like others have mentioned, they are very dry and crumbly so be prepared to make a mess. Secondly, the flavor is very odd... not even a hint of chocolate, but more like cardboard mixed with something I cannot put my finger on. As you're chewing the brownie (or whatever it's supposed to be) it dissolves and leaves a weird film across the roof of your mouth, and I had to drink lots of water since I couldn't remove it with just my tongue. And be prepared to chase away the awful after taste with a big piece of gum.  I would never buy this product again, there are too many other healthy things out there that taste way better than this.  Even my co-workers, all 12 of them, tried this and agreed that these aren't worth wasting money on.  Sorry Kashi, but your mission has failed.  I don't want to eat this.
Dry. Will crumble everywhere so don't eat without a plate. Actually, don't eat them at all, they taste like cardboard. Not worth the carbs.
Received order faster than the prediction on Amazon. Very tasty almonds too... Way better than anything you will find at the store. I think I have found my favorite almond supplier! Thanks!

We've been looking for almonds that were raw and not seasoned; perfect almonds! they come in 10 1 lb. bags, and my mom loves them so much, we've already gone through 4 lbs. of almonds in matter of a month or so.  You'll definitely be getting an order from us again. :D

column9: Target and Trader Joes are better
column10: I like raw almonds and I think the ones from Target (in the big 12 dollar 2 pound jar) and Trader Joes (1lb pouch) taste better.These aren't that bad though so if you don't have access to Target or Trader Joes I recommend them.

column9: These almonds won't make you glow in the dark!!
column10: Thank you, CAalmonds.com - you GET it! Americans are tired of things being soaked in DDT, boiled in chlorine and zapped with radiation just to make the USDA happy. This company has done its research and stays away from toxic chemicals and damaging radiation while still keeping the gummint boys off their backs - and what WE end up with is a nutritious, delicious health food that can be ordered over the net that will still actually SPROUT if you put it in water. I know - I sprouted several of these almonds after I received them. FYI - the process CAalmonds uses is a short hydrogen peroxide "steam bath." And - if they still sprout - they're good for your tummy, too! Good ON ya, CAalmonds!!!! The only problem is the whole darned 10 lb box is GONE.

Great product and great value for buying in bulk! I recieved this shippment in a very short time and the packaging was great. I'm delployed to Afghanistan and this product makes my life just a little bit better!

These almonds are fresh and delicious. They are smaller than I'm used to (I used to religiously buy blue diamond) so it is difficult to determine how many is a serving size, per se, however the quality and freshness make this a great product. Paying 10 bucks for shipping is annoying but for 5$/lb i'm quite satisfied with my purchase

Purchased these in March and they went pretty fast, eating and giving some away.  These were great, water sprouted and were delicious when dehydrated both peeled and with the skins left on (prefer peeled).  Compared to almonds ordered from another California farm (Fancy Grade #1, size 22-27 nonpareil) there really is no noticeable difference other than they are slightly smaller in size.  On a side note, the almonds I purchased elsewhere were very hard to peel once sprouted.  Being hard to peel might be an indication of freshness or lack of, I don't know and if anyone does, please tell?Bottom line, aside from the slightly smaller size compared to a more pricey raw almond, these almonds are a great deal even with shipping, have a great taste, water sprout, consistent in quality, and are an overall great almond!I'm ordering more, don't hesitate to purchase.
These are an excellent snack and the price is right!  So glad that they're portioned into smaller bags, too.  Makes them much more convenient than a large "bulk" order!
These almonds are outstanding! Every single nut was fresh and crunchy. Almonds are really good for you and these are a great bargain. I'll be buying these often!

column9: Tasty product at a great price!!
column10: it's hard to beat this price and get this type of quality for raw almonds! i bought this 10lb selection to share with a few friends and family and i can't get this price or quality for raw almonds (free shipping on amazon prime) anywhere else--$3.99 a pound!! unlike other similarly priced products, where you have to sort the bad almonds from the good, these almonds were all universally good in size and taste. the almond size is medium (some might say it verges on the smaller size) and they are very flavorful. i normally soak my almonds overnight before using them/eating them and these have a deliciously rich taste, so much so that i couldn't stop snacking on them. yum!

10lbs of almonds arrived promptly in nice resealable 1lb bags.  Quality is better than what is available at BJs where I used to get them with the added convenience of being shipped to my door with no yearly membership fee. :)  Good price/quality/convenience and will buy another 10lbs after we are done enjoying these.

I was skeptical when I bought these but I had a gift certificate so I figured I would risk it. You can't beat the price first of all, but keep in mind that there is a 10$ shipping charge even if you have prime. That being said 50$ is STILL an excellant price, less than 50% of what I normally pay per pound. The shipping is fast 3-4 days, and the almonds are stored in quality packaging and each package holds 1lb. They stay fresh, and they have excellant flavor. Highly recommend this product.

I'm on a raw diet and use almonds on a regular basis so decided to try these almonds.  I made some almond milk and it turned out so creamy...best I've ever made!  These almonds are even great right out of the bag.  Will definitely purchase again.

After receiving my 10 (1 lb) bags of almonds, I assumed they would last months and months.  However, after making my own granola with the almonds and toasting them for snacks, they were gone in no time!  Excellent taste, larger that grocery store stock, and very fresh.  I am ordering more today!
My son and I love almonds!  I bought them and split them with him and store the rest of them in the freezer.  They're awesome and super affordable.  Thanks!
Took a chance ordering this product and was pleasantly surprised.  The price was more than a third cheaper than I found elsewhere, delivery was quicker than promised and product was fresh.
Product was of very good quality, and shipment was fast. Besides, it is cheaper than those store bought. I would certainly buy it again.

Looked around for a long time until I came across this supplier of raw almonds.  I eat approx 1 oz a day so 10 pounds will last me 5-6 months.  I keep them in the bottom of the fridge and they still taste good after 3 months.  I will buy again when my supply gets low.

These almonds came very quickly, and they are of great quality.  I prefer them roasted, but I like to do that myself, and so these are perfect.  Indeed they come in 1 pound bags.  this helps in storing them.  I'm likely going to buy again soon.

Well... they're almonds; nothing special there. I don't really know how 'bad almonds' or 'good almonds' taste, but these taste like the generic almonds I've had all my life. They are split up into smaller bags, which makes it really convenient- I can keep a small bag at the office, one next to the bed, etc. Paying extra for shipping makes me sad, but as far as I could see, they were still the cheapest ones on amazon. I've just been eating them raw, so I guess I'll try cooking with them and see how that ends up.
I just read that it is the law that all almonds grown in the US must be pasteurized. I am not sure how these ones from california are raw or if they sprout.

FYI, unless you buy directly from a grower, ALL almonds (even if they say raw) are irradiated by law. So if you just like the flavor of raw almonds, great. But if you want raw almonds for the health benefits, contact a grower.

I am just learning about raw foods and in a workshop I went to, we were told that ALL almonds from California do have to be pasturized by law, but that it is only in California.  We were told that you can buy truly raw almonds from out of state, which of course means buying online.  They also do not have to lable the package that the almonds, or any other nut from California, are pasturized.  We were also told that you cannot buy directly from the grower because they cannot sell nuts without going thru their process.

For a few years, I have been buying the Numi Golden Chai in individual bags and just recently went looking on here for bulk teas. I was pleased to find my favorite tea, and Chai tea, in bulk. The price seems a lot for tea, but compared to what I paid for the bags, it's a bargain. Plus I'm not throwing away anything (until I kill the bag) each time I make a cup. The bag is the standard foil interior bag, and seems to keep well, and has a ziplock top.As for the tea, it smells so good, and I love the blend. Some chai that uses green tea adds pepper, and is a bit "spicy," so on most occasions I prefer a black leaf chai. It has a stronger taste, but isn't overwhelming since it only adds cinnamon, cardamom, ginger and anise. I can go through 3 cups/day and will vary how much I use depending on how strong I want it (1.5-2tsp), but I could still see one pound lasting me close to two months.Like all Numi teas, it's Fair Trade, which is a big plus for me. Organic ingredients is good too.If you like Chai, you should be pleased with Numi's Golden Chai, whether or not you prefer green tea or black tea. Buy a box of bags first before you invest in the 2 pound package though.

This is one of my favorite chai teas!  Since I hadn't seen preparation instructions either here or on Numi's website, I thought I would leave mine as a guide for first time chai preparers.Makes 1 cup in less than 10 minutes:1. Add 1 tsp of this tea to 4/5 of a cup of water.  Slowly bring to a boil (medium-high heat, should take a few minutes).2. Add 2 Tbsp of sugar which should lower the temperature a bit, allow tea to come back to a boil for another minute or so.3. Add 2/5 cup of milk (I use 2%, but whole is the best), allow tea to return to a boil (should take several more minutes).  NOTE: Keep an eye on this part, if the temperature is too high, the tea will easily rise up out of the container and make a giant mess when it returns to boiling :-).4. Turn off the heat just as the tea starts to rise, and allow the contents to simmer for another minute or so.5. Using the finest strainer you can find (there are some excellent stainless steel ones here on amazon), strain the loose tea from the drink and serve.There are all kinds of tricks to getting chai tea to taste the way you want ranging from adding fresh grated ginger during preparation to a little honey just prior to serving.  It's awfully hard to go wrong when you start with this tea but if it doesn't turn out exactly like you want, just tweak the ratios until it suits your tastes.

This is an incredible deal/price for the subscribe and ship, for the quantity and quality of good ol fashioned organic Numi chai. Need I say more.... Some whole milk, some agave, a cup of chai to lighten your heart and day!

column9: A Great Spiced Tea and I've Tried Many...
column10: Great flavor from bold Assam tea coupled with flavorful spices. No powdery stuff here. Excellent for traditional chai (with milk) or brewed dairy-free. I've tried many spiced teas and this is the best for both flavor and price.

This is a good, full-bodied chai. I prefer a loose tea and this is a great value as well as being fair trade. I think this tea tastes a bit more earthy than the other chai teas I've sampled and it has a nice balance of spices. If you're serious about chai, definitely give this tea a try.

Unlike other chai teas, you can see the spices are plentyfull.  When you look at the loose tea it seems to be at least 25% spice.  The tea tastes good assuming you like a lot of cinnamon since that's the predominate flavor.  Personally, I like it but I like Tazo Tea Chai Organic 20 Bags better but I can't find it loose.  Numi's chai is very good and reasonably priced considering the high quality.  You can probably make a couple of hundred cups of tea instead of paying $4/cup at Starbucks.  The next tea I'm going to try is Harney & Sons Fine Teas Chai, Indian Spice - 20 Tea bags.
This is one of my FAVORITE teas. Great discount from price in stores. Chai is good with milk or just on its own. The amount given will last a long time.

column9: Your coffee will be heavenly with this extract in it!
column10: Fact #1: I looove toasted marshmallows.  I keep a bag of marshmallows in my kitchen, pop one on a metal skewer and toast it to golden perfection over my stove's gas flame.  I eat it, then repeat the process.Fact #2: Toasted marshmallows are heaven in a cup of coffee.  With cream.  And sugar.  Ain't really proper coffee at that point, but if you're reading this review on marshmallow extract, I'll bet you probably like your coffee the same way. :-)Fact #3: As of this writing, all the toasted marshmallow syrups available on Amazon were too expensive to bother with.  Monin, Torani, DaVinci, I checked them all and nothing was under $9.  Plus I wanted the option of flavoring my coffee without adding sugar.Then I found this marshmallow extract for $3 with free shipping, so I took the plunge.Pros:- It tastes and smells like marshmallow.  It's exactly what I wanted.- Great if you want to add marshmallow flavor without a syrup- It's efficient: in 6 oz of coffee, I'd suggest about 3-4 drops.  This bottle will last long enough.Cons:- I was hoping for more of a "toasted" marshmallow, but for the price, I'll live.- Don't add too much or you'll feel the extract dry out your mouth.  I used about 5-6 drops and it was too much.  I got greedy. *hanging my head sadly*

this is my second favorite Atkins bar, the first being sweet and salty almond crunch. But this bar rates higher in one category: you can use it in phase 1. It is chewy and peanuty. I love it! It arrived quickly and well packaged.

I was skeptic at first, but decided to try honey crystals because they have a fraction of the sugar/carbs/cal of regular honey.  ALL the flavour is there!  Its a great substitute, and it lasts a long time.  A little goes a long way.

This product is okay, takes somewhat like honey, but not like I was wanting.  However, I haven't tried any other honey substitutes so I have nothing to really compare it with.  Also, I'm a little skeptical about it since it comes from China, not made in USA.

column9: Just ried, but so fat I like it
column10: I received this yesterday so I haven't had time to really test it. We are being told that artificial sweeteners are not good for us. Sometimes I eat cereal , Special  cinnamon & pecan. It is almost sweet enough , but need just a little, and I would add a packet of Splenda . Regular honey is hard to get mixed in, so I ordered this. I think it is a little expensive, but maybe it will go a long way. I tried for the first time this morning, and it took just a little maybe a teaspoon. It was really tasty. Also I have been told that honey is a lot better for us than white sugar. So, so far I am happy.

i love Powerade as much as Gatorade.  i like this flavor a lot.  the good thing about them is that they are inexpensive.  and they are great at keeping you hydrated.  if never tried powerade try it at least this one time.
How is this fairly priced at $96 when the same thing can be ordered direct from manufacturer online at $41???

column9: Buyer beware, Proctor & Gamble has ruined this food!
column10: My girlfriend and I have been rescuing, fostering, and adopting out (through a rescue group) cats and kittens for over 10 years.  We also have a number of feline companions that live with us and bring us a lot of joy.  So we're very experienced in all aspects of cat care, and we always try to feed our feline companions high quality foods.  The foods are more expensive, but worth it for the health and well-being of our beloved companions!We had been using Innova Cat & Kitten Dry Cat Food for several years, once we discovered that it included no by-products, corn filler, or other junk ingredients.  Our cats loved the food, which we mixed with another high quality dry food for variety.Fast forward to our experiences over the last few months.  We heard that Proctor & Gamble, manufacturer of IAMS and other junk cat foods, had purchased Natura Pet Products, maker of the Innova, Healthwise, and California Natural brands, among others.  Proctor & Gamble reputedly still funds experimentation on domestic dogs and cats, so we naturally never buy their products and do not want to support the company in any way.  So we were very upset about P&G's purchase of Natura, but we stuck with the Innova Cat & Kitten food for the short run, hoping we could later find a better alternative.Well strangely enough, for the last 10 or so 15lb bags of Innova Cat & Kitten that we've purchased, something has changed.  The food is much more "crumbly", i.e. there is a lot more "food dust" in the bags, and the kibble looks a little different.  We didn't think much of this change until our cats, which had previously LOVED the Innova food, lost interest in it and really didn't want to eat it.  In the dry food mix we make, we noticed that very often, the cats would eat the other part of the mix, and leave the Innova Cat & Kitten behind.  Clearly there is something different about the way P&G manufactures this food, as opposed to how it USED to be made by Natura Pet Products.This is EXPENSIVE food, and for the money you pay, it should be TOP QUALITY.  Well, it ISN'T anymore!  We finally reached our boiling point one day when we looked around at all the cat food bowls (which are usually totally empty after feeding time), and saw that much of the Innova part of the mix was leftover, unwanted.So that was it; we returned our last 3 large bags of Innova Cat & Kitten to the store we'd purchased them from, and will never buy this food again.  In fact, we've now decided to never buy ANY Natura products, which include Healthwise and California Natural.  We did find a good quality alternative cat food called "Simply Nourish", and when we tried it with our cats, they LOVED it.  There is no longer ANY food leftover in their bowls, and we know the new food we are feeding is good quality.WARNING:  For anyone currently purchasing "Innova Cat & Kitten", or planning to buy it in the future, P&G appears to have changed the way this food is made, for the worse.  We can only assume that this large company was trying to save money, and in so doing have ruined one of the formerly best brands of food on the market.  AVOID this food, it does NOT appear to contain the same formula/ingredients as it did before P&G bought Natura Pet Products, and ruined it!

Before I embarked on (frozen) raw food and grain free wet/dry, my cats enjoyed a bag of Innova Cat & Kitten Dry Cat Food. P & G had just acquired Natrua Pet about the time of purchase and I was very impressed with how much my cats seemed to like this stuff until I noticed the kibble was turning to dust - literally disintegrating - in the food bowl within just a few hours of being poured in. I've never seen anything like it before. I switched out the glass dish for a Durapet stainless bowl and I still had the same problem. The kibble was whole coming out of the bag, but exposed to air in just a few hours it turned to dust. I never considered the food to be bad, only extremely dry. I'd recommend this food for good nutitional content, but I'd also keep an eye out that P & G didn't change the formula resulting in a ready-to-crumble kibble. You can't do much with kibble dust other than sprinkle it on wet or raw food.

column9: Watch out for my Ninja Kitties!!!
column10: A couple of years ago I found some little gray babies while cleaning out the boat for the season.  They weren't even two weeks old. At the time I was just breaking in a new puppy and feeding him Innova dog food.  I have followed suit with the kitties with awesome results.  For one, everyone asks if my boys are Prussian Blues.  Now I'm not much of a snob when it comes to animals (mostly saved strays when we were children) but apparently my little rescues resemble some elitist thorough-breds!  They're coats are nothing short of spectacular.  Smooth, sleek, shiny.  I attribute all of this and the rest of their excellent health to the food they eat.  They're also extremely athletic.  Most cats are, I know, but I have grown up with cats for my entire life and I can say of the multitude of cats I been around and helped take care of these guys are ninjas!  I also give a large amount of that credit to the food that they eat.  Most folks probably are reluctant to try feeding their animals the "healthy" food because their little friends might not like the taste.  Not to worry, because it seems my ninja boys can't get enough of this food.  I have to measure out what I feed them so they don't gorge themselves to the bursting point.  They would eat this all day if they were allowed.  Wouldn't imagine this to be the case if it didn't taste well.  Needless to say I am keeping the boys on this regiment.  They have responded beyond my expectations on this diet!

My cat is healthier and more energetic since I started feeding her this. She's put on muscle too.The day I brought it, she zeroed in on the bag and started trying to rip a hole in the side to get to the food. And she'd never even had it yet!I just wish it were a little cheaper. But it's of such excellent quality.

This food is great because it's made with natural and fresh ingredients. I have 3 cats and they love it. They are very healthy as well and I credit this food for it. The only thing that I can say is that the price here on amazon for a 15lb is ridiculous. It's over $44 and the pet place I buy it from(in Culver City, California)is about $30.99 plus tax, around $34. I end up saving around $10 per bag by buying it there and not here. Great product equal to and cheaper than Lotus which is what I was feeding them before and could only buy at Centinela Pet &  feed.

column9: THIS IS TRULY THE BEST THERE IS IN DRY CAT FOOD
column10: I am the loving owner of seven indoor cats and take care of one feral.  My cats love this food!!  I started second guessing myself when I heard about grain-free being better and decided to incorporate Halo brand to gradually switch them.  They HATED the HALO!! It was so obvious that towards the last of the Innova I couldn't believe how they almost stopped eating the dry completely and were sustaining themselves on their morning wet food.  After requesting my PETCO store to stock Innova Prime, which is grain-free, I was able to give my five younger cats the grain-free which they ate gratefully and left the others on the original Innova.  This is wonderful food and I have seen my cats enjoy it, that's enough for me.

column9: A great food the cats love
column10: I stopped buying grocery store cat food after several experiences that happened nearly simultaneously: I learned what is contained in them (what is actually in fish meal, for example). I learned about other additives- that are not food- and how they effect an animals organs. I learned about the recall of foods from China killing pets nationwide, if not worldwide. I learned about the national recall lists of pet foods and all kinds of foods and products published online everyday of the week. So I made the switch to organics with ingredients labels that will make you smile instead of shutter. These foods are more expensive, but you love your pets so you'll be buying peace of mind and their continued health.This food can also be purchased in pet stores, dry, low-fat, senior, and canned are all available.

After researching non processed cats foods on the web, Innova came in at the top 5.  I decided to start my cat on this food.  I'm not sure what this cat was eating before, but he loves this food compared to the cheap crap you buy at your local grocery store.  I adopted this cat a few months ago.  I highly recommend this food if you want your cat to live a long healthy life.

Our cat  MOJO has been eating Innova  for five years.  It arrived all crumbled and the cat no longer liked the food. I was getting ready to buy some more when I read the other reviews. My dog loves Blue Buffalo so I decided to order their cat food instead. The review process at Amazon is very helpful.

column9: Wonderful and healthy at a good price. Cats love it!!
column10: My cats love this stuff! Nothing else to say really. I've got one who actually prefers the dry food over wet food...everytime...pretty funny stuff.
This is the vet recommended food for my little buddies.  I am pleased with the delivery, ease of ordering and price.
This is the best tasting Kettle Korn I have had, I have a 4oz popper and make 1/3 of a  bag at a time for the best results.
Never used this product before and was surprised that there were no instructions in the package.I will try experimenting assuming one of the contents is lard instead of oil.

I'm surprised this flavor has so many negative reviews.  This is one of my favorite flavors, it's not overly rich like some of the others.  I love the coffee flavoring, it seems to mellow these cookies out.

I looked at the ingredients of this mocha cappucino breakfast cookie, and saw that it is made with ground espresso. You can taste it as well. Depending on whether you like espresso or not, that's either a good thing or a bad thing. I call these "caffeine patties", because they certainly perk me up after eating one. Just keep in mind if you do not like coffee, you probably won't like these very much.

column9: Very different from other Erin Baker Breakfast cookie flavors
column10: Let me start with:  this is one of my favorite flavors of Erin Baker's Breakfast cookies.  That said, my daughter disagrees with me 100%.The flavor of the mocha cappuccino in the cookie is distinctive.  You will either love it or hate it.If you are a sweet chocolate lover and a sweets lover, this might not 'row your boat'.  If on the other hand, you enjoy your cappuccino without sugar and like dark chocolate, you will find that this cookie is THAT flavor combination in solid form.  Not too sweet, not too moist, very flavor-ful and excellent when eaten with a cup of coffee.

I love Erin Baker's and decided to try this mocha flavor. The taste is strong, exactly like eating coffee. At first I hated it but it grew on me as i eat it pre early morning workout. But I think I'll stick to the normal floors from now on

I purchased these for hubby for the times when he doesn't find a few minutes to be able to eat lunch or breakfast. I don't drink coffee but tried a bite of one of these and didn't find any strong coffee flavor. We both agree that the cookies are very dry tasting. They will work for what he needed them for but they aren't something he would enjoy just to have a snack, just too dry.

I love mocha, cappuccino, coffee, chocolate and everything that I think went into making these cookies - but was dissatisfied with these cookies.  They were dry and just a bit chalky - that's the best word I can think of to describe the texture and mouthfeel.  If you want to try Erin Baker's breakfast cookies, go for the Chocolate Chunk, Double Chocolate, or Oatmeal Raisin (or the peanut butter minis!).

Yep!  Wow, I was really impressed with these cookies.  I was afraid when I bought them they would taste extremely "meh".  But wow.  I look FORWARD to getting to eat one for lunch or breakfast.  I'm impressed w/ the truly delicious taste and w/ all the nutrition it packs.  15% of your daily iron, 4% of your calcium, 6 grams of protein, plus vitamins A & C.  I can't believe healthy tastes SO yummy, is made with whole grains, and ISN'T made with anything you can't pronounce.  Everything in here is natural!  I'm totally sold. This will become a staple in my household!

These taste great and are super easy and healthy. I pop one in the toaster before I head off to work and I have a nice breakfast on the go. These were also great right after I had my babies because I didn't have time to make any meals. Cappuccino is one of my favorite flavors!
I like all of the Baker breakfast cookies I've purchased from Amazon, but the Mocha Cappuccino is especially tasty, A healthy way to start the day!
The 12 individually wrapped cookies came in good condition. The Mocha Capp is not my favorite flavor, but is a nice change and smells great out of the toaster oven.

These are one of the few breakfast bars that actually fill me up and get me ready for the day until lunch.  The flavors are outstanding, and the consistency is that of a home made cookie.  All in all, a great start to the day.

column9: A bland but healthy and filling pick-me-up
column10: The first cookie I had crumbled into many smaller pieces once I opened the package and the taste didn't impress me much.  I tasted oats, mocha and molasses. There was no pronounced sugar aftertaste, which many may find appealing.  The dough is chewy, but it does fall apart easily.  The second cookie the following morning tasted better as I had gotten used to the taste.However, the packaging allows for quick conveyance in a purse, backpack or jacket pocket which is a nice convenience for those on the go.  A single cookie is also filling enough with a cup of coffee to get one through the morning.So, in short, the taste is rather bland but the packaging allows for easy transport.  Just be careful when opening the package that you don't toss your cookie!Each cookie is 85g (60 fat calories) with 300 calories total.Each cookie contains whole grain oats, unbleached wheat flour, prune puree, evaporated cane juice, chocolate chunks, lecitin, water, brown rice syrup,expeller, molasses, ground espresso, vanilla extract, baking soda, cinnamon,sea salt, soy lecitin,dried egg whites, baking powder.I will continue to buy these for those mornings when I can't take time out to eat a decent breakfast.

I have never considered cookie as a choice for breakfast, but the ingredients in this cookie are healthier compared to other breakfast items my kid normally eats. Now, these cookies are on my breakfast menu for my kid and myself.

column9: Love Baker's Breakfast Cookies-this flavor is OK
column10: I mean what I say in the title, I always love Baker's Breakfast Cookies. On most work days I have no time for oatmeal, so I eat one of these, an Odwalla or Cliff bar or Fiber One toaster pastries. These cookies fill me up, are healthy, and really keep me satisfied til lunch.  However, this flavor is rather bland. I think it just tastes like the regular part of the cookie, no special treat of fruit or chocolate in there. I really don't taste any mocha or cappuccino flavor in it. So I would recommend Baker's but not this flavor. My favorite two are the peanut butter and the cherry chocolate chunk (seasonal).
I was very disappointed in the taste of these cookies. They seemed dry and did not taste as yummy as I thought they should.
have one for breakfast, have one for lunch, it'll fill you up or have one for snack in the afternoon. Great treat. Very sweet.
Naked Crunchamame is Simply Perfect. It is nice to have other spiced Crunchamame, but in my opinion, nothing beats the simplicity of naked Crunchamame.

This product is a huge hit with my almost 2 year old - it's always her first choice for snack.  I love giving it to her because it's so much more nutritious than some other choices she enjoys, like crackers. This is loaded with iron, calcium, and protein (things I'm particularly conscious of since we don't eat meat), and doesn't have any added salt.  Personally, I also like that it's non GMO.  It comes in packets that are easy to toss into my purse or her diaper bag for when we're out & about.I also love taking these along as a healthy snack for myself on days that I work - a good alternative to the coffee shop treats surrounding my office, especially on days when I haven't had the time to put together anything homemade to bring with me.The only things that would make me like this snack even more are: if it was organic (or non-certified but grown as-though), if the packets were made of a recyclable or biodegradable material, and if they sold boxes of larger quantities than 8 packets.

The product itself was fine- light, healthy and tasty whole beans (not crunchy like soynuts though). My real complaint was with the delivery. When I ordered this product, the web indicated that they were "In stock". And so I waited, and waited... it took two weeks for me to get the order and I have Prime Membership. I would have appreciated some prior notification from the seller but Amazon was very good about dealing with the delay once I made the initial complaint. As for the nutritional stats: 90 calories: total fat:4g; carbs: 7g 2%; fiber: 3g protein 8g; iron 10% calcium 4%. Not too bad for a convenient snack on the go.
My family loves this snack.  It's delicious, and great for snacks on the go.  Full of protein and tasty.  I'm so glad we can buy this on Amazon!

Vety good for afternoon snack. Some of my co-workers don't like it as it is kind of tasteless.My wife don't like it as this product is from China. We prefer local food over import but nowadays choices are so limited.

Sauce Goddess Moroccan Twist Rub is fantastic!  Good on everything from chicken, steak, salmon, ribs, pork, etc.  Very easy to use, stores well, and keeps well in the packaging.  Also great to use for grilling anything on the BBQ.  Definitely recommend you try this as well as the Latin Heat rub.

Been using Moroccan Twist and some of the other ones for a couple years.  Use them on steak, chicken, salmon, etc and am always pleased with the results.  Must be true if I keep using it.Give it a try and you will be happy you did it.R

column9: If you're sick, this is the ticket to feeling better!!
column10: I recently had a bout with a nasty little sinus-infection & strep, and this tea was the only thing that got me through the day!!Serve it up hot with a teaspoon of honey and it will instantly clear your head and soothe your throat. Even if you don't like tea, if you feel miserable, you need to drink some of this!I prefer the decaf version so that i can drink it all day and night, but the caffeinated version is just as tasty and effective.

I never imagined I'd be writing a glowing review for tea bags, but this Lemon Lift tea is FANTASTIC.  I have been a life-long tea drinker, usually plain old black tea, but decided it was time to break outta the box!  (Or bag!!)Finding interesting-flavored decaf tea can be a challenge, but this Bigelow Lemon Lift solved that.  I was lucky enough to find one box @ a local retailer, but when I returned to buy it again found that spot on the shelf empty. Week after week, same thing--no Lemon Lift decaf! After scouring all my local retailers with no luck, I figured I'd try Amazon.com.  Sure enuff, Amazon had it!  I purchased a pack of 6 boxes, and every nite my ritual is to brew a delicious cup before settling down with my current read.  What a nifty ending to my day.The special spice Bigelow uses makes a HUGE difference. If your local retailer doesn't stock this tea, Amazon does!  You won't be sorry!
I have been finding difficulty locating the decaf version of LemonLift at the grocery stores near me.  I was delighted to find it at Amazon.I will order again; it is so convenient.
This is the best lemon decaf tea. I make it all year and people always remark how good it tastes.
This is the best tea ever!  I drink it all day long as iced tea, after one cup of hot tea in the morning...
Lemon Lift by Bigelow has been a favorite of mine for many years.  The foil packaging keeps the tea fresh.

The lemon Lift tea is one of my favorites.  It has a very pleasant, mild lemony flavor that tastes great without adding any surar to it.  I love that with Amazon's price I can afford to enjoy it on a daily basis.
We love this lemon tea, but we cannot find it in our area. Excellent flavor!
This tea has a wonderful taste.  It is nearly impossible to find at grocery stores anymore, so had to buy online.
I have been ordering Bigelow decaf Lemon Lift on-line for a couple of years now. Local stores don't carry it, so it is a good deal for me.

We love these.  I thought I'd do some browsing after becoming a "prime" Member and see if it would be better to order some food items from Amazon.  Well at this price we wont be getting these when we can get them from Sam's Club for $6.98.  Other than that these taste great and have good texture....they are the "grown -up" preferred fruit snacks!

Basically it's a very solid snack, and while it's not certainly cheap, I find it's worth the cost easily. I don't think I'll ever go back to grocery store brand name fruit snacks again.

I've eaten these fruit snacks for years (the cherry flavor is my favorite).  They are DELISH and have a firm consistency that I love.  Yes, they are a bit more expensive, but they taste better and are a little better for you, so it's worth it to me.  The downside is they're hard to find in grocery stores (though you can usually get them in bulk stores like Costco and Sam's Club).

I've eaten fruit snacks since I was a little kid and these are my favorite I've ever had.  There's a lot of fruit snacks in each bag, making them great for adults who want a relatively filling snack, and they taste great while being pretty good for your.

My daughter could not get enough of this product. So I went on line and ordered a lot so that she could have them when ever she wanted a healthy snack. My order came promptly, in time for the start of school and I could not be more pleased.
Kellogg's Fruity Snacks are a delicious way to get your Vitamin C!  Very tasty product, and I recommend it highly.
I love these fruit snacks and found it cheaper to buy them in bulk to pay a dollar for such a little one.

I bought these from Costco when they no longer carried my favorite gummy snacks and even my kids won't eat them.  They have an awful texture and the taste, well they just taste horribly artifical.  Hated them.

Kellogg's products are full of GMOs (Genetically Modified Organisms) which are linked to many health problems including infertility, cancer, auto-immune disease etc... Please research GMOs before deciding to purchase any products from Kellogg's. I would NEVER feed this to my family!

My first review on Amazon, and It's a real downer. Ever since I walked over the the vending machine here in the office a few minutes ago and dropped my last 75-cents on Kellogg's Cherry Flavored Fruity Snacks, I felt compelled to log on to the first website I can find that sells these and give them a horrible review, and warn everyone and anyone about this poor excuse for a food product. They taste somewhat like plastic, and the "cherry flavor" is worse than the worst tasting cough medicine you can think of. These don't taste ANYTHING like fruit. These are supposed to be cherry flavored, but the word cherry appears no where in the ingredients (apple puree concentrate is the only fruit item listed), and the word "fruit" doesn't appear anywhere at all. They also pull that bait-and-switch telling you 70 calories per serving, but there's 2.5 servings in these dinky little 2.5oz bags. These are disgusting. It's been 60 minutes and I still can't get this taste out of my mouth. Next time I want something fruit flavored, I'll just eat a piece of fruit. Don't give these to your kids unless they did some horrible thing and you're planning on using these disgusting "Fruit" snacks as some form of punishment.

I bought this mix for Halloween and it was great deal for fun sized Baby Ruth, Butterfinger, and Crunch bars! The kids loved it and the candy was fresh not old whatsoever. I even had leftovers for the rest of the week for my family to eat. I used the rebate and got $15 off my candy purchase which was even a better deal! There is nothing`to complain about! Thanks amazon!
THE HEADLINE SAYS UT ALL. THE CHOCOLATE IS VISIBLY OLD AND THE BABY RUTH WAS AS HARD A A ROCK.THIS IS TERRIBLE, BUT I GOT A REFUND AND GAVE THE CANDY TO BEGGARS.

EVERYTHING WAS GOOD, THE SELECTION OF CANDIES WAS GOOD, SIZE OF CANDIES WAS OK, BUT THE COST WAS TOO HIGH.  TO PURCHASE THINGS OF THIS NATURE AT A LOCAL SUPER MARKET WOULD ALLOW GETTING MORE CANDY FOR COMPARABLE PRICE.

column9: A LITTLE ON THE BLAH SIDE
column10: I used to live in Philadelphia and was a big fan of Bookbinder's, especially for their lobster bisque.  I was hoping that the canned version would bring back fond memories. column9: Great tea, great value for money
column10: This is a great tea. I highly recommend all Poabs Organic teas and I am really glad I discovered them for myself and my family

YUM!This is very good S/F PB! We had to return our Peter Pan to the local store in the recall and had found no other that we liked locally. I do not like to stir or store in fridge, cold PB ...bleh! This is PERFECT!lives on the shelf, Sugar free, tastes good too!
very good product. great price. this is what a healthy peanut butter should be. will buy again.. and from amazon. thanks!

--Love it.  Tastes so good, natural.  And I mean no sugar added.Great supplement for any vegan diet needing additional sources of healthy protein.--It's oil does not separate which is a plus.  I'm sure many of us have stirred some peanut butter up once before, that's a workout in itself.--Can't see a mention a mention for "refrigerate after opening", so I'd imagine it doesn't need it.  If anybody knows please tell me.  I'll check with the company too.
This is a great sugar free option for peanut butter fans cutting down on sugar.  The only one better was Carb Options Skippy that has been discontinued.  Comes in Creamy, too.
Ingredients in relation to other peAnut butters most glycemic in nature!  Also seems to taste better in relation to others.

The other benefit of this product is that it does not require stirring (contains rapeseed, cottonseed, and soybean oils). That's a real plus! Good quantity for the price. I left comments on packaging with Amazon, but am unable to get a refund for the broken jar for this product.

I had never had this stuff before. It stinks, so I keep it double bagged and it's fine. When you cook it in a pan with oil, it smells much better and tastes delicious. It's really easy to use, I think it adds a lot to dishes like rice or vegetables, but it could be used with anything. It has sort of an onion-like flavor, but way better. I'll never go without this spice again.

Unfortunately, this is the only asafoetida (hing) that is readily available in the US. It is preground and mixed with edible adulterants to make it easier to handle. Unfortunately, due to this processing, the quality is not high. While it will certainly work for your recipe, it is nowhere as good as the chunks of pure sap that are harder to find in the US. Search out the good stuff if you know a reputable spice merchant.If you're in NYC, I've found better quality hing at Dual Specialty Store in the East Village. It's still not as good as the super stinky chunks of Afghani asafoetida that I picked up in Varanasi, but it will do.

Asafoetida is sometimes called "Devil's Dung," and the name is appropriate (and explains why "foetid" is a part of its proper name).  If you're not prepared for the use and storage of this product, you may be surprised by just how pungent and vivid the smell is--but the flavor it lends your curries and other dishes is totally worth the exposure.  As the Asafoetida interacts with butter or fat, the odor disappears and the flavors really come out to play.The only downside about this product is that the container is somewhat difficult to open.  I actually cut a new hole in the plastic in order to get the product out, and even when I re-sealed the container the smell permeated the whole kitchen.  I ended up resolving this issue by sealing the container within a second--glass-container.  Glass seals the smell in and saves you the embarrassment of having to explain to your housemates why the house reeks of something devilish.

column9: Not exactly a substitute for garlic and onion
column10: I am allergic to garlic and onion, among other things, and found this product after researching on the web for substitutes, as I am tired of bland food! column10: I went to a Japanese resturant 3 weeks ago, and had a cup of this tea.  Every other cup of green tea I have had since then doesn't come close.  If you like green tea, try this one, you won't be disappointed!

column10: The products are fresh and great tasting. I recommand them for anybody who likes tart dried fruits.

This is an awesome peanut spread. I'm on a very limited diet (HCG) so it is just wonderful to find something I can have and that still is sweet, yummy, and satisfies my cravings.The texture of this is not like other regular peanut butters. column9: Simply the Best Fiber cereal, period
column10: I've tried just about every "fiber" cereal on the market, and this is the only one that is all natural and offers a ton of fiber.  All of the "commercial" brands of fiber cereal are loaded with artificial ingredients.  Read the label on this one, there are only a couple ingredients and they are easily identifiable.The flavor of this product is excellent.  They also make it without the cinnamon, but the cinnamon definitely "makes" this product, and also may help control your blood sugar.I usually eat this with another cereal mixed in, but it is quite edible on its own.  I just don't need 25 grams of fiber first thing in the morning.You could also use this cereal as a fiber supplement and eat a small amount periodically through the day.

Even the dog wouldn't eat this. Seriously. I wanted something healthy, free of corn syrup, MSG, soy this-and-that, and all those multisyllabic mystery ingredients that only the FDA could love. This cereal gains a star for that. The ingredients are "Wheat Bran, Whole Grain Corn Flour, Whole Grain Wheat Flour, Corn Bran, Cinnamon". (The nutrition panel does mention that the cereal is produced in a facility that also handles soy, dairy, and tree nuts.) But there's got to be something natural that can be added to pick up the flavor a bit. As it is, it tastes like pressed sawdust. Any cinnamon included is so subtle as to not be noticeable. Nature gives us fiber in flavorful packages - vegetables and fruits. If fiber is the main goal, there are tastier ways to get it.The texture is pretty much pressed sawdust too. There's got to be a way to at least make it texturally interesting. The drab color is fine, that means the product has no artificial food dyes. I don't care so much about visual appeal but it is a little disconcerting opening a box and seeing contents that are formed like snail pellets.With a name like "Simply Fiber" the appeal is going to be for old folks seeking the grail of an expeditious digestive system. The absence of typical ingredients may also appeal to those who find themselves allergic to many processed foods. My interest was more in just the general "healthy" appeal.To give the manufacturer their due, it's probable that some of nature's flavoring agents might not last long on the shelf. Next thing you know there's the temptation to dump in a bunch of preservatives, and that's not necessarily a good trade-off. You know how breakfast cereals typically liven up the front of the box by populating the cereal bowl with colorful fruits or berries? In this case I think it's not just decorative, it's a good idea. Reasonably expect the cereal to be a little dull, and compensate by slicing in some strawberries, blueberries or bananas.On the bright side, this is only 100 calories to a 3/4 cup serving, according to the side panel. That serving packs 14g of fiber. At first bite I was tempted to toss the box but I'll probably keep it on hand and toss a baggie of this stuff in with my lunch for that hand-to-mouth grazing a person does for a mid-morning snack. That's certainly less fattening than what passes for granola.In sum, the product isn't calorie-heavy and it will appeal to aging boomers with digestive issues. It may also be a product of choice for those with certain allergies.

I first encountered brewers yeast when pregnant.  It kept coming up again and again as the perfect food based nutritional additive.  Since it is food based and not a suppliment, it is easily absorbed.  However, it is known for its unpleasent taste.  A serving is two heaping tablespoons, and at first I could not find something to mix it in that I liked well enough, so I gave up on it temporarily.  It kept coming up in my researches for a healthy pregnancy, and so returned to it and it has remained part of my daily routine.  The mix I found I like quite well is the two heaping tablespoons mixed into about 5oz of Pom pomagranite juice.  This mixture is actually quite pleasent.I have tried a few different brands, and I am fond of Twinlab for the more palitable taste and the balance of the B vitamins.  The "subscribe and save" deal on Amazon puts it at a very good price.

The Brewer's Yeast is for my cats. Every day I sprinkle a little onto their food. They like the taste of the yeast and regard it as a special treat. The yeast provides them with extra B vitamins.One of the vitamins in the yeast is vitamin B1, thiamine. Many people believe that thiamine repels fleas. This has not been proved. However, since the cats like the yeast, they get in on their food. One 18 ounce bottle seems to last forever. Also, they do not have fleas.

column9: Hold the beer, just give me the yeast!
column10: I ordered this as what is said to be a more bio-available source of chromium and B12, as well as essential amino acids, vitamins, minerals and trace elements, vs most of the peddled chromium supplements. I haven't tried sprinkling it directly on food but I have enjoyed adding it to my shakes and the flavors it imparts. A blender helps when adding to liquids as it seems to mix about as well as powdered cocoa.

I have always like Twin Labs yeast.its a little different tasting, but if you like experimenting you might get into this one.KAL is still tops on my list for taste.This one is second on my list.Now here is a heads up, do not get the green label Twin Labs,which is fortifide.It has dairy in it.

column9: really horrible taste when added to a protein drink
column10: I was looking for a brewers yeast that I could add to my protein drink so as to be able to get the amazing health benefits of brewers yeast also.  This yeast, while I am sure is quite healthy and a huge health benefit, tastes horrible.The taste so changes the taste of the protein drink, that I found that I actually skipped drinking my protein drink rather than have to endure the taste of it with this brewers yeast.Epic Fail.  Now on to try to find a brewers yeast that doesnt make me shudder.

I started taking brewers yeast because the large amount of chromium in it is supposed to be very good for your skin, especially if it's acne prone. I've been taking it since the end of January and my skin still breaks out a little bit, but I stopped taking it for a couple of days and my face broke out a lot so I suppose that it is having some sort of an effect. An online review I read said that most people's skin cleared after eight months in an study, so I am staying positive.I started out by taking Swansons' Brewer's Yeast Powder, and mixed it in smoothies and grapefruit juice. I tried mixing it in orange juice, which was pretty bad, and even just having it with water, which was horrible and made me gag. Because I wasn't crazy about the taste, I read some reviews and decided to try this product next. The taste is much better, it is much less noticeable, especially if I add a little bit of peanut butter or grapefruit juice to the smoothies. The taste is also not at all noticeable in warmed apple juice. I don't have the courage to try it in plain water, though.What I dislike about this product is that it does not dissolve well. I cannot stir it in any cold liquid without getting clumps (hopeless when stirred with a spoon or knife, somewhat works when stirred with a fork but little clumps remain), I can barely dissolve all of it in warmed liquids, and if I put it first in my blender when I make the smoothies, a lot of it remains at the bottom. In that respect, I liked Swansons' Brewer's Yeast better. This one is a little bit high maintenance because if I want to just have it in grapefruit juice, I have to put it in the blender first and when I make smoothies, I have to make sure that it's one of the last things to go in. I would, however, buy this product again if I can't find a brewers yeast that has the taste of this product with a better solubility.

this stuff is ok.  I was hoping it was the flakes but it's a very fine powder, like a flour consistency.  Which makes it kinda turn pasty when sprinkled on veggies or sprinkled on popcorn.  The taste isn't bad, not really great either, but not bad.  I think the yeast flakes would be better, more texture.  But since it only comes in the 3 bottle package, I have 3 bottles to get through now before I can buy the flakes!  If you're not sure you'll like it, try to find it in a single bottle first.
