column9: Add a zing the crab cakes
column10: If you are looking for certain something to add a zing to crab cakes then look no further than Old Bay Seasoning.

column9: Add it to your homemade potato salad for rave reviews!
column10: My family has always used Old Bay Seasoning for steaming crabs and shrimp, and I also add a small amount to other fish dishes.  A few years ago, however, I discovered what would be my favorite use for it...potato salad.I have never liked deli potato salad and am pretty picky about homemade.  My sister-in-law made some for a party, and it was the best I had ever eaten.  I asked her what her secret was, and she ran down the usual list of potato salad ingredients.  Then she told me she added Old Bay Seasoning.  Bingo!  That was it.I went straight home and made my homemade potato salad, grabbed my can of Old Bay, and sprinkled away.  I can't say exactly how much I use, because I never measure ingredients when I'm making my own recipes.  Just add some, stir it up, and taste....add some, stir it up, and taste till you like it.  The seasoning does not overpower the salad flavor at all, just enhances it.  Don't be concerned that there is going to be a crab or shrimp taste to your salad; it isn't the Old Bay that makes crabs and shrimp taste like seafood.  Old Bay just makes seafood taste better, and now potato salad too.  Try it on your homemade potato salad; I think you'll love it.
use it all the time when I am cooking crab or grilling fish.  excellent product.

This has become my favorite seasoning to use. It pairs beautifully with seafood of course, but it's also great on meat and all kinds of soups and salads. We also love it on potato salad, deviled eggs, omelets, baked potatoes, mac&cheese- just about any savory dish. And if you want to make the Red Lobster Cheddar Bay Biscuits you have to have Old Bay. It adds just a little kick of spice as well without being overpowering. LOVE it.

Great seasoning for all seafood, poultry, and even steak.Anyone cooking fish needs to have this spice. I've been passed down the knowledge of this from my parents who in turn got it from their parents who got it from their parents who, learned of the spices from a neighboring fishery - two states away!Needless to say, it's awesome.

I love Old Bay seasoning! I use them in fries, chicken, crabs, and shrimps. Bought it without any mistake. Got it as expected. Don't listen to negative reviews that say too spicy! it's delicious even though it's spicy. Buy it!
I just paid $3.00 for the 6 oz tin so watch the pricing....you can still get it for a bit cheaper here but only if you purchase the large multi pack

column9: No substitute for fresh ground pods, but inexpensive for quick beverages
column10: When I am making chai or Turkish coffee for friends I always grind whole pods (a quality product is Indus Organic Green Cardamom Pods, 3 Oz). Sometimes, though, I want to quickly brew a chai or a fast Turkish coffee (or even flavor regular coffee when brewing). This ground cardamom does the trick.Turkish coffee with cardamom is both easy to brew and delicious to my taste. Just add cardamom to the grounds and make it your preferred way.Cardamom is also a key ingredient in spiced chai (masala chai). I Normally grind a pod with a part of a stick of cinnamon, clove and a single black peppercorn. I mix it in a half and half water and milk mixture that I bring to a boil, add black tea and grate a piece of ginger).  When I am lazy, use powdered ginger and this ground cardamom. Not quite as good as freshly ground pods (and grated ginger), but significantly better than most chai mixes you can buy off the shelf.This spice is also used in sweet dishes and pastries, but I must confess that I have to forgo sweets for health reasons so know little about how it's used in that respect.For sweetening coffee, chai or even desserts I recommend using one of the following in lieu of processed sugar: Goya Panela Brown Sugar Cane 1 Lb - Redonda, known as "jaggery" in India. A convenient alternative is Turbinado Sugar - 1 box, 1 lb. Either is especially superb with chai.
ADD TO YOUR MORNING COFFEE BEFORE YOU BREW IT!  THE AROMA AND TASTE IS THE BEST! LOOK UP RECIPES ON LINE, LEARNED FROM A MID-EASTERN MARKET.

This is less of a review of the actual cookies; though I rated them 5 stars.  The real merit of this "review" is to provide  information that may help others avoid the confusion that I experienced when I received my order.I stumbled upon the product page on Amazon for "Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream."  The Amazon product image clearly said "Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream" and I had never seen that product description or package previously.  I had seen regular Chocolate Cream Oreos before and even original Double Stuf Oreos (with the white filling) in local grocery stores but never the Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream.  I put my concern about the potential need to buy new pants aside and I ordered a case of 12 boxes, which is the minimum order.I received the case promptly from Amazon.  When I opened it, I found 12 boxes that simply said, "Chocolate Cream Oreo".  I uploaded a picture of what I received.  I called Amazon and told some nice representative in India that I received the familiar regular stuf Chocolate Cream Oreos that I have seen in stores and not the Double Stuf Chocolate Cream I had been expecting.  He apologized and shipped another case.I received another case today and it was the exact same product that I received a few days previously: "Chocolate Cream Oreo".  Instead of calling Amazon, I decided to call Nabisco (Kraft Foods, Inc.) for clarification.  The number is listed on the package 1800-622-4726.The following is probably the real virtue of this review.  I was told that the package now for the Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream does not say "Double Stuf" anywhere.  As I mentioned, I uploaded an image of the Double Stuf product package that I received.  According to Kraft, the only way to tell is the UPC and package weight.  The package weight for Double Stuf Oreos is 1 pound 1 ounce.  The package weight for regular or normal stuf Oreos is apparently 15.6 oz.  The UPC for Double Stuf Oreos is 04472700.  The UPC for (regular stuf) Chocolate Cream Oreos is 044000025298.  Since the package does not say Double Stuf anymore, I am not even sure what my local grocery carries.  I need to check the package weight and UPC at the grocery store.Therefore before you jump, head-long, into buying 12 boxes of this magical Double Stuf Chocolate Cream, you may want to check what your local grocery store carries.  I really do not see the logic in having 2 different products with the same package, but there you go:  that is apparently the case with Double Stuf Chocolate Cream and regular stuf Chocolate Cream Oreos.  I will also mention that it would be interesting to see a side-by-side comparison of Double Stuf and regular Oreo cookies.  My guess is that the difference is not as significant as you might expect since I initially thought my cookies were regular stuf.

So yummy.RECIPE2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips2 tablespoons shortening1 package Oreos*optional: 1 cup white chocolate chips and 1 tablespoon shortening**Before you begin, make sure everything is absolutely dry. Even a drop of water will ruin your creation.**Melt the chocolate chips with the shortening in the microwave for 1 minute. Stir until melted. If needed, heat another 10 seconds at a time until melted. Be careful not to burn the chocolate.Place one cookie in the chocolate and coat. Use a fork to scoop it out, tapping against the bowl and scraping the bottom of the fork on the bowl to remove excess chocolate. Place on wax paper and let it set. Store refrigerated.Optional: To make it pretty, melt a cup of white chocolate with a tablespoon of shortening at 70% in the microwave for 1 minute. Dip a fork in the white chocolate and let it drizzle from the fork onto the semi-sweet chocolate covered cookies. If done neatly, your cookies will look beautiful.Hint: I do one batch in semi-sweet chocolate and one batch in white chocolate. Then, I drizzle the cookies with the alternate chocolate. Plate them together for an eye catching presentation.

I'm on weight watchers, so I'm "counting" everything that goes down the hatch, and this is the best mid morning and/or mid afternoon snack.  An entire bottle of this is only 1 point on their plan... it's filling, totally satisfying and gives me just enough of an added boost to power me through the rest of the day.... and did I mention it tastes amazing?
Bai's Ipanema Pomegranate is one of the best flavors. Their pomegranate is better than most because its tart but not bitter and sweet but not overwhelming... and only 5 calories per serving!

I love bai! My favorite flavors are pomegranate and dragonfruit, but all the flavors are tasty. The drinks are hearty, healthy and unique. Best served cold. And so cool that bai has found a way to utilize a previously discarded portion of the coffee bean!

Well...This drink is SUPERB! Bought a few cases my favorite is the pomegranate. I do love the dragon fruit too. It is refreshing! I am not a hot coffee drinker so this is my drink of choice. My advice...go BUY a BAI!
Tasted this over the holidays.  Loved it. Full flavor and low calorie, and a good source of antioxidants!  What a winning combo! Cannot wait until I can get it in Seattle.

O.M.G. I am OBSESSED with Pomegranate Bai! It is so refreshing and a great low-cal product to refuel the antioxidants! It is a great drink to get me through my 3-hour classes each night! It is locally-based so I get really excited to see it in other places! I can't get enough of Bai!

Bai 5 Pomegranate is hands down my favorite drink right now. I love that I can get all of the anti-oxidents without having to consume many calories. Best of all, it tastes delicious! My fridge is stocked with these on a constant basis!!

Watch out Snapple, there is a new Juice in town... I was a little taken back how great of a juice this is. After reading the ingredients I was very skeptical. Then I tried it. It is absolutely the best tasting fruit juice drink, loaded with a ton of good ingredients on the market, hands down. It very rich and satisfying without feeling overly full. My two kids love the juice and as a parent, i'm very happy to give it to them. The most impressive thing is the Calorie content, most drinks in this calorie range come up short, not with Bai. It's full flavored and Very satisfying. Five stars.

column9: The Food Scientists Got Me On This One
column10: I'm not big on food science. (Remember when eggs were bad for you? Now they're good for you? Or are they?) However, the one food claim I think will stick is that eats and drinks full of antioxidants are good for your health. All the proof I need is the 1982 Volkswagen Scirocco I owned in college. That sucker rusted so badly, it was leaking GAS by the time I had it towed away for good. Rust, of course, is caused by oxidation of iron (learned that in 10th grade chemistry), so I can only imagine the kind of stuff oxidation is doing to the pipes inside my body. So, I only have to believe that antioxidant rich foods do a little bit of good - any good, really - for me to load up on them. I can buy into that much food science.Anyway, the point of this ramble - I picked up a bottle of Bai because it seemed like a good way to sneak a ton of antioxidants into my diet. As it turned out, the stuff was damn tasty too. I've been drinking it for about a year now, and it seems to get better with each new flavor. I'm writing here because the pomegranate, which I believe only recently came out, has zoomed to the top of my list - so fast that I've actually stopped caring whether it's good for me and just enjoy drinking it ... which makes everything easier because, like I said, I'm not big on food science.

Bai5 Ipanema Pomegranate is amazing. The flavor is delicious and really rich and flavorful for being low calorie- and with only 1g of sugar I don't think I'll ever go back to another pomegranate drink. I get the pomegranate flavor I love plus the antioxidants I need - thanks superfruit! :)

bai5 ipanema pomegranate is hands down the best flavor of bai EVER (even though I probably say that about all of them!) But this one really takes the cake ... the coffee-super-fruitcake! Ipanema pomegranate has the perfect amount of big sweetness and bold tart flavor - without any of the big or bold calories. With only 10 cals in a bottle and 2 grams of sugar, its clearly the smartest choice out of all the pomegranate drinks on the market. Even with just a mere 5 calories per serving, ipamena pomegranate doesn't skimp on antioxidants (4,000 ORAC units per bottle!) or quality - the ingredients in every bottle are 100% natural, and naturally delicious.

column9: look, mom, i'm drinking pomegranate without plugging my nose!
column10: hands-down, the most drinkable pomegranate beverage on the market.  and only 5 calories!i've been drinking pom for years, but i've been forced to resort to cutting it with water, seltzer, dishwashing detergents.. anything to water down that viscous flavor and mouthfeel!  bai5 ipanema pomegranate is the alternative i've been waiting for.  the coffee fruit (60x as powerful as pomegranate, gram for gram!) provides the antioxidants, and the pomegranate juice delivers the flavor... boom. the health benefits of a pom with the drinkability of a (juicier, tastier, all-natural) vitaminwater.and it's sweetened with the perfect blend of stevia and erythritol, so it's only 5 calories and 1 gram of sugar per serving (10 calories, 2 grams of sugar per bottle)!!

This is THE best Coffee Masters flavor I've tried so far!! Coffee Masters Flavored Coffee, Cinnamon Nut Swirl, Whole Bean, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)  Full-bodied (as usual) but with an excellent cinnamon flavor with a hint of hazelnut.  I love cinnamon; so, if you do too, then this is the coffee for you!  I highly recommend it and will definitely continue buying it.

I love this coffee and have it shipped on auto delivery.  I was always searching for a substitute for "Snickerdoodle" and this is the closest I have found.  The Cinnamon Nut flavor is wonderful and doesn't taste artificial.  The four-bag purchase also affords me the benefit of giving some as a gift, which I like to do as a hostess gift and also stocking stuffers at Christmas.
This is a nice meduim blend of coffee, that has a smooth, but not bitter flavor.  This coffee makes your house smell like cinnamin for a few hours.

This product met my expectations very well.  The flavor wasn't quite what I expected, however.  I expected a cinnamon flavor with subtle hints of hazelnut and vanilla.  Instead, I found that all three flavors are pretty evenly distributed.  The end result is a cacophony of flavors which is very powerful and distracts from the natural coffee flavor.The beans themselves are rather small.  Because of this, I think, the coffee is rather weak.  I find myself having to use 30% more coffee per pot than with my traditional coffee beans.  The cup, when poured black, has a very weak color to it, if you add creamer the look is very reminiscent of tea with milk.When I first tried the coffee I was very unhappy with the results.  However, after tweaking the amount of grounds I use (as well as increasing the coarseness of my grounds) I found a product that was palatable.Would I buy it again?  Probably not.  However, I can see many people who dislike strong coffee truly enjoying this.
i love these gummies and so does my son and his friends its great as a treat for school and for sharing with his friends the better part is that my sons pediatrician aproves them!

Wick Fowler's 2 Alarm Chili Mix is the key ingredient in the Filet Mignon Chili Recipe from the Mark & Brian radio show (also known as FinnDog's Chili recipe).  My boyfriend couldn't stop talking about wanting to try that recipe, so of course I wound up ordering the chili mix and the rest is chili making history!  I didn't follow the steps on the box, I've been making the chili from the FinnDog recipe, which involves a bottle of Newcastle Brown Ale as a replacement for some of the liquid called for.  Even with that substitution, you get such an incrediblely flavorful, complex and spicy result, you know it's not just the beer!  I've made it with the aforementioned filet mignon, ground beef, kidney beans and various combinations and it's always an enticing, brick red pot of chili nirvana!  I'm keeping it in the pantry, it's become a staple around our place.

My family was in the grocery business since the 1920's.  My father met Wick Fowler and he autographed a book for my father.  We love the Chili mix and have used it since we used to sell it in our grocery stores.  When my father died I got the book with Wick's autograph.  The best chili mix ever!!!
no problem if I get the promisted charge reduction. As a single person the amount recieved is suffient for quite a while so no problem with the shortage from what was ordered.
I used Filet Migon instead of ground beef.  This is a great product and I got rave reviews from everyone that ate.

The only thing special about this product is the fact that I used fillet minon.  I put full amount of all packets, but WAY too much paprica (? or maybe chili powder, the large orange one).  Too ovepowering and spicy for a wimp like me. I had a horrible time trying to mask it.  I did LOVE the individual packets though so I can easily modify paprica next time.  This was used for a chili cookoff at my work.  I did not win :(  but crowd loved the steak!

column9: Australian Candy Bars Are Da' Diggity Bomb!
column10: This morning I was blessed to have my very first Tim Tam experience. An Australian colleague of mine, Tim, gave me a Tim Tam as a belated Christmas gift. He also provided detailed Tim Tam eating instructions. I have provided them below so you too can have an absolutely amazing Tim Tam experience.1. Prepare a warm cup of delicious hot chocolate/coffee/milk tea (I had coffee). 2. Open the Tim Tam pack and take it out. 3. Take a very small bite from one corner of the Tim Tam. 4. Rotate the Tim Tam and take another small bite from the corner diagonally opposite as shown: a picture was provided. 5. Insert one of the bitten corners into your drink and use the other end like a straw. Keep pulling until you feel liquid come up through the Tim Tam. The chocolate will keep the Tim Tam in shape, however depending on the temperature of your drink...you have 2-5 seconds before the chocolate melts and your Tim Tam falls into your drink (a tragic fail). Therefore, take a bite quickly as soon as you feel liquid arrive through the Tim Tam; enjoy.My only complaint about Tim Tams are they are too small. I'm thinkin' I could go through 25 of these guys right now. I highly recommend ordering you some Tim Tams. They are da' bomb!

I am an avid tea drinker, have almost tried all the best brands and thought this might be one of them hidden treasures. BUT.......this is not even close to a dark black tea. It smells different, taste different and is NOT even black in color.You can fairly call it a good Green tea. It tastes more like Persian broad leaf green tea.As a green tea I will give it a 2 star, and as a black tea it gets ZERO.

Love, love, love the syrup, but don't buy it here!  You can get it direct from DaVinci Gourmet for only $7.99 a bottle, and three bottles is only $4.95 in shipping.  One of the few things Amazon doesn't have cheaper than everyone else.

I bought this to make Christmas candies and cakes. It arrived well packaged and was very fresh. You couldn't ask for a better deal on a very good quality marzipan. The only downside is that nobody in the house can stop eating it (before it's used for the intended purpose)!!!

I ordered the pecan tin as a Christmas present for my secretary December 7th. The product was never delivered to me nor did anyone contact me. I called Taste of the South the first week of January to inquire about the status of the order and was told that I would be called back when they figure it out. No one ever returned my call. Finally, I called the sales representative again and she confirmed that my account would be credited for the error. Today is January 24th, 2004 and still no credit has been applied to my credit card. This is a very small and completely disorganized business, avoid the mess and buy from someone else.

Picture shows candy in a container.  I bought this expecting what the picture showed however candy came in an envelope.  Was very disappointed and cannot return since it is a Christmas present.

column9: Spanked by the Golden Monkey - 4.5 stars
column10: Imbued with a signature hoppiness and a 9.5% ABV that numbs the senses, this triple golden ale is one of many excellent brews associated with the Victory brewing company.  If I was going to eat a meal with this ale, I would probably chose a spicy chicken Thai or Indian dish.  This is an excellent American microbrew worthy of praise.  Moreover, at $7 for a 750 ml corked bottle, you can't go wrong!  Highly recommended...

Greenie pill pockets are the best things for giving pets pills.  I was using them for my dog that needed to take arthritis meds daily, and he would gobble them down like a treat.  When I had to start giving one of my cats pills, I decided to try them, and low and behold, the cats love them too!  What an easy way to give your pets pills!  I will never again try to give pills without these... they save so much stress and time.  The dog and cat pockets are the same, it's just a matter of the size.  If the pills are small, just use the feline pockets, there are more in the package for the same price.
I was happy with the product and the timeliness of its delivery.  I only wish it had worked. My little dog quite eating and the pockets don't help.  Thanks though,
Bugs Marie, her mama and daddy all LOVE Pill Pockets b/c they make giving and receiving epilepsy medicine a joy instead of a dread for everyone.
These pill pockets are great for getting a fussy dog to take pills. They are a godsend.

column9: my dog loves greenies pill pockets
column10: These are the best things in the world to give medication to a dog.  Mine sit by the cabinet waiting for their "treat".
Wow, I've tried peanut butter, cheese, and other tricks, but this is the first to work.  Great product, great idea.

These seem to be a good idea for medicine for dogs. Haven't had to use them yet but I think the little ones won't have a problem taking them. If they do I will just put them in peanut butter. If you haven't found that trick, they are so pre-occupied with getting the peanut butter off the roof of their mouth they don't know they've taken any medicine.
Great product! Giving my dog his daily meds has never been so easy. I wish I was the one who developed these.
Best gummies.  Really great that I no longer have to resort to ebay to purchase these delicious gummies.  If you like Sour Patch, you will be blown away at how much better these are!
I grew up in the UK and these were my favorite candies.....They still are and I am so pleased I can get them through Amazon.com

These are really good with cheese, or jam, honey or perhaps best of all, with homemade lemon curd!  Yes, they are crisp, very dry and rather crumbly but that is exactly how they should be.  I have never been able to find proper Scottish oatcakes in my part of the USA so it was a thrill to be able to get these through Amazon.  I was impressed by how fresh they tasted and that they arrived intact.  I now have them on my Subscribe and Save list.I just wish we could also get the thicker style oatcake bannocks (about 1/4 inch thick and generally shaped in farls (a farl is a quarter round) from Amazon!
If you have any Scottish blood in you, treat yourself to some of these fine oat cakes. They can turn a bowl of soup into a meal. Amazing with your favorite cheese and sliced meats.

I've lived and worked in Scotland, and sought a piece of it to chew on; one can't just imbibe peated malt. But these delicious oatcakes are a bit risky, like running about Scottish crags with a kilt and no unders. Tiny hard bits might impede your bite. Maybe sturdy extra-strong Scottish chompers can handle this. The oatcakes are delicious with wild honey, or unadorned in their simple goodness. Just be careful.Best accompanied by: Hamish MacBeth: Series 1-3 Collection, Vera, A History of Scotland, and Monarch of the Glen: Complete Collection.
The product purchased was delivered in a timely fashion & for a reasonable price.  I've purchased these snacks before through Amazon & always with good results.  Thank you.
I love the taste of oats and I am addicted to these things.  Delicious with a Cranberry Walnut cheese spread.  Like a mini-cheesecake!

column9: So extremely mild-flavored as to be almost tasteless
column10: It looks like those who have been to Scotland love this product. I came from a different POV: I was just curious what they taste like, and took advantage of last summer's 50% off deal to try some new-to-me products. And I love Walker shortbread.I first tried one straight. Very dry, and except for a little hint of salt, essentially tasteless. (Of course, cooked oatmeal is pretty tasteless until you add the butter and brown sugar!) Not awful, but kind of like eating cardboard. Then I tried a slice of Brie on an oatcake; again, not awful, but not as good as the Brie tasted by itself. I tried it with a little butter on it; same result. I wound up giving the rest of the package to my husband to eat; he routinely eats rice cakes so doesn't require his food to have flavor.I can't imagine wasting jam on these. It would be interesting to try in soup, when I find the other three packages, but even in soup I prefer flavorful crackers. (Town House is my favorite.)I can easily believe the other reviews who praised these as authentic and reminding them from Scotland. But lacking those positive memories myself, the best I can award them is "okay."

column9: Is this the most perfect food?
column10: Well, probably not.  I can't remember if palm oil is OK or VERBOTEN. But here's how it's perfect:  oatmeal is so good and nourishing, and it goes with so many other good foods, that it seems the perfect food.  One time our dog was hit by a car, late on a Sunday afternoon.  We had to rush her to the emergency vet, 45 minutes from our house.  We put her in the car, loaded the car with oatcakes and poured some white wine.  Yes, we drove while drinking the wine, but we got there, etc., etc., and weren't starving when, hours later we got back home with our poor bandaged-up but surviving dog. Oatcakes are filling as well as delicious.  Oatcakes and orange juice seem to be a perfect breakfast, if you're on the road or taking to the air. For a plane trip, take oatcakes, cheese, maybe some thinly sliced ham, grapes, and your drink of choice.  And, as the package suggests, you can, for a party, top each biscuit with cream cheese and fruit -- the versatility is remarkable. And:  just remember:  oatmeal is remarkably nutritious.  Just think of all those race horses!

It was a pleasure to see this hard-to-find item offered by Amazon.  Oatcakes make an excellent addition to a light lunch.  We are unable to buy them locally; and are delighted to be able to secure them from Amazon.  While Walker's shortbread products are found on virtually all supermarket shelves, finding the unsweetened oatcakes is a much more challenging proposition.  I'm glad to have access to a dependable supply

I absolutely love these, but I could see how some people might not.  They sort of look like cardboard coasters and they're dry and crumbly.  I love how dense they are, though, and they have a good subtle flavor.  They also have no additives and are basically just oatmeal in cracker form.  I think they taste better plain than with toppings.  A traditional cracker tastes better when topped with cheese, etc.

These are wonderful plain or with almond butter and mascarpone cheese.  Very wholesome, wonderful flavor.  We reorder these time and again don't seem to get tired of them.  (trying to eliminate refined carbohydrates from our diet and these oat crackers are so much more satisfying than a regular flour based cracker).  I'm hoping Walkers will continue to make these indefinitely!
They are as good as they have been for years.  I'm glad to be able to get them here in Arizona.

column9: Back in Highland Heaven - just need a bowl of good Stovies
column10: Ahhh nothing like Stovies and Oatcakes to get you rolling over the glen! These are just what I needed to compliment my canned Haggis from Caledonian Kitchens. Not exactly Scotland but hey, it's good! These oatcakes slightly warmed will make you feel all happy inside - maybe it's the Scot in me but even with some corned beef hash and warmed oatcakes I can ride out any bad weather or a bad day. Yep, these will do quite nicely and a whole lot cheaper than a plane ticket![...]In case you'd like some haggis - yes they have vegetarian.
Glad to find this hard to get product.  Quick service and easy to work with company.

Walkers Products. Their shortbread line is wonderful. But the Highland Oatcakes ... really, really dry. And there is no compensation for the dryness ... like taste. Thought I was trying a new thing based on the Walkers brand. Guess I'll stick with what I know ... the shortbread.Walkers Highland Oatcakes are nothing to write home about. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone.

column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column9: 18 BARS- it says 'pack of 8' , but you get 18 bars-GREAT
column10: These Payday Peanut Caramel candy bars were very yummy. I don't know why the first description of the product says 8 bars. A bit further down in the details it does tell you 18 bars. $17.51 for 8 candy bars would be a rip off. But you get 18 King Size candy bars, which equals 36 regular size. So the price, with the free s/h is a good deal. I would buy again.
I love this product rich in taste and if you love a lot of peanuts,they are theremixed with creamy nougat center.

column4: Jen "Mom of a Wonderful Little Munchkin"
column10: Totally what I expected and totally delicious! I shared the box with family and friends and everyone was so surprised that I was able to order these online!

This is a great candy bar for those who just can't get enough of having peanuts in their mouth.  When you peel back the wrapper you see a coating of peanuts, and once you take a bite you get a tasty peanut buttery treat in the center.  Held together with delicious caramel, you won't be able to get enough of this sweet, nutty masterpiece of snack craftsmanship.  It's not your run-of-the-mill chocolate-coated candy bar, but so much more.  It also has a salty taste, which gives makes it stand out.  For nut-lovers, it's nirvana.  For everyone else, it's just a darn fine snack.

column9: Almost as good as pay day!
column10: I bought the jumbo-size bars and love being able to help myself to one at home whenever I'm in the mood.  It's that combination of sweet caramel center and salty, crunchy peanut coating that does it for me.  The boxful arrived promptly and the contents were fresh and delicious, but since every bar is wrapped in plastic, they stay fresh too.  Really a fun buy.

column9: know what you are getting, very unhealthy ingredients
column10: If you are ordering you probably already  know what this is. I thought maybe because it had a lot of nuts it would be a healthier type of candy bar, but its not. aside from being pure sugary caramel, the nuts are salty. i dunno who would combine salted nuts with pure sugar like this, but it doesnt taste that great and makes me feel ill after eating it because its just not healthy ingredients. I read that they used to have a high protein version of this called payday pro, but i cant find that. dont think this is any healthier than your average candy bar like I did.

This is my favorite granola.  Crunchy and sweet, very healthy, and taste is awesome.  I eat this, Kashi Go-Lean Crunch and Kashi Honey Sunshine.  I like them all, and enjoy the variety, but find I always come back to this granola.  I especially like the apple blueberry over the plain granola.  The pieces of dried fruit are a perfect mix in the granola.

This granola is really yummy stuff!  The taste is fantastic, a nice vanilla flavor with a hint of apple and a lighter hint of blueberry.  It is healthy and most importantly for me, free of additives and preservatives!!  I love eating it as a cereal with milk, mixed in my yogurt, right out of the bag as a snack or I use as a topping for my apple crisp.  The price is reasonable for the quality and quantity and the nutritional value is good.  The only criticism I partially agreed with that I read from another reviewer was that it barely had a trace of blueberries in it, which I agree but hey - adding a handful of fresh berries (any kind) is pretty simple and delicious!

I bought this for my son who has food allergies because all the ingredients were identified in the label, and it had none that he couldn't eat.  It has now become the favorite granola for my family.  I love the fact that it tastes so good, but has no fat.  Believe me, you won't miss it at all.  The same with the minimal sugar content.  It makes you wonder why all that other granola that is sold in boxes in the grocery store needs to have all those extraneous ingredients added you can't pronounce, or why they needs are so much more unhealthy in terms of added sugar and fat (and I am not talking about the fat that may come from nuts added to some granolas). This Bob's Red Mill granola is great straight, for baking, in yogurt, or with milk.

This is a great granola food.  Nice and pleasant, with that great apple touch.  There is the hint of blueberry as well.I tried this straight out of the bag like a dry snack, very convenient.  I haven't tried it as a hot cereal or cold cereal but I'm sure it'll be nice either way as well.

This granola is great to bake with, or eat out of the bag. I haven't tried it with cold milk yet. It is quite good hot though. There is a slight blueberry taste to it, nothing strong. These make great gifts as well. I've gifted out a couple bags already. The price is unbeatable, plus the shipping time is prompt. They come to you packaged in a nice box. The granola itself is not too sweet, has a hint of vanilla flavor & slight blueberry. It is very good & this is a great place to order, especially the subscribe & save that delivers on schedule or earlier if you run low. I'm trying all the other flavors too, but this one is my favorite. Everyone I have given a bag to is hooked on it.
This granola is very tasty.  It is a bit sweet, however makes for a nice snack or topper on plain yogurt.  Would recommend.

column9: Very tasty and a great breakfast/snack
column10: I bought this on a whim after it made it to the Gold Box deals. I had seen the stuff before at Whole Foods and a few other places, but never really gave it any thought until i saw it here. I have been considering just how unhealthy my diet has become since moving back to Salt Lake City and reflecting upon my great physical condition prior to my move. Anyway, I've decided recently that there is no reason not to get back to that lifestyle and conditioning. A big part of that is what you eat and when. This item is a clear winner for getting back on track. It is very tasty, and while sweet, it is not too sweet. I particularly like the little bits of apple and blueberry, which is where the bulk of the sweetness comes from. Anyway, it makes a great and fulfilling breakfast for me, either by itself, or mixed with some yogurt. It also makes a great snack when you just need a little something, and is a great tide me over for just after a workout, but before you've had a chance to eat an actual meal (which i try to do about 45 minutes after a work out).I'll buy this again.
I found this product to be very tasty, but due to my age, a little hard on my brittle teeth.
This is one of the best cold cereals I have experienced. A great product at a good price.

This is a great granola. It is very fresh tasting, with wonderful ingredients. It has alot of crunch, which I like but if you find it a bit too cruchy just let it soak in some milk for a few minutes to soften. This good on its own, as a topping for yogurt and fruit or with milk and fruit.

This is a great, healthy snack that I share with my co-workers,  and they share the costs of the subscription order with me!  It's good dry, by itself, or mixed in with yogurt for breakfast.  Just as good with milk poured over a serving, too, but I generally keep it in my desk drawer for snacks.
Product arrived in a reasonable amount of time.  Granola was fresh tasting and crunchy, but I am not detecting any apple or blueberry flavor, it tastes like plain granola to me.
If you've been looking for a simple less-sweet granola, this is it!  Very nice in a bowl with some milk.  I'm very pleased with this purchase.

What a wonderful product, even my kids love it. Low in calories, especially calories from fat, compared to other granolas. I have tried all three 'fat-free' varieties and they are all great. I will continue to purchase them from Amazon since it is so much more expensive at local stores IF you can find these varieties of Bob's Red Mill at all!

As I said for another flavor and it goes for this one to, We order this on subscription, we like it so much. It has always been fresh and crunchy, has good flavor. We try others from time to time but Bob's is so good we keep coming back.

column9: Good taste, very crunchy, high fiber...
column10: This granola has great ingredients and is very tasty.  I need to let it soak in milk for about 5 minutes to make it less challenging to chew (very hard and cruncy, and I'm not all that old...).  The funny thing about this granola is that it must be VERY high in fiber, if you know what I mean, so I have to eat it at strategic times.  I ate a bowl before getting on a two-hour airplane ride, and well, let's just say it made for a rather uncomfortable trip.
This granola is delicious and has no added fat unlike most granolas. We love it as a breakfast cereal, snack, even as a yogurt or ice cream topping. Another excellent Bob's Red Mill product.

This granola was so tasty, I couldn't stop munching on it after I opened up a bag. I gave 3 of the 4 bags away to friends and all of them agreed it tasted delicious. I tried it in hot water (like oatmeal), milk (like cereal), and straight out of the bag (as a snack) - all three ways were still great! Highly recommended!

column9: Never mind the low ratings others have given
column10: This granola is literally the best I have ever eaten.  Too often, people become accustomed to the packaged stuff and over-sweetened granola out of the supermarket.  This has become a standard in America's pallet which is just a bunch of sweeteners and fillers.The Bob's Red Mill stuff is just great and simple.  The taste is amazing, not to mention this is crunchy and simply flavorful.  I have 4 kids and each one of them can't get enough of this stuff so that says something about how good it really tastes, but you can be rest-assured they are eating a snack where you know EXACTLY what is in it.I would give more stars if they allowed it :)

column9: Great combination of Healthy and Tasty
column10: After visiting a nutritionist, they recommended that I eat foods that were high in fiber and low in sugar.  I like Granola, but found that most Granola offerings were very high in sugar content.After researching lots of options, I found Bob's Red Mill Granola to be the right balance of fiber and sugar.  This is the only flavor I have tried so far, but the Apple and Blueberry flavor is delicious.So far, I have eaten this granola plain, with milk and mixed with yogurt.  Like all granola, if this sits in liquid too long it gets very mushy.  I don't like mushy very much, so I eat quickly after adding to milk or yogurt.Overall, I am very pleased and will be trying other flavors soon.

Must admit that if I hadn't read that this Red Mills had apple and blueberry I would never have noticed it, taste-wise. There are a few dark flecks in the package which I presume are the blueberries but you would never know.Prior to this I had the Back To Nature blueberry granola (that particular variety not sold at Amazon). You can smell the blueberries when you open the package and the blueberries are very noticeable. I have milk on mine and it actually turns blue from the berries. These packs are also resealable whereas the Red Mill are not. Probably won't be buying it again.
I don't really like eating this granola on its own, but I love it mixed with some vanilla yogurt!

I've been looking for a nice granola to use everyday with my yogurt.Hoping that the Red Mill would be chewy but it is definitely not - it's quite bland and has a cardboard like texture.I definitely wouldn't recommend this if you plan on using it to add a kick to your morning yogurt.Maybe it's best to get something with a little fat - but I've had non-fat granola that is much tastier than this red mill.The one redeeming quality of this product is that you do get quite a lot for your money - unfortunately I ended up giving it to friends because I wasn't a fan.

column9: Not bad but there are better products
column10: These tend to be a bit chalky/fibery for my taste.  But nod bad if you eat them as something to put lots of meat and low carb sause on.  (I.e a garnish rather then a main meal)
This is a great sub for low carb eaters.  it does not have the same texture as regular spaghetti but it doesnt have the carbs!!!  :)

These had an almost crumbly dry texture to them.  Very gross.  My hang up about low carb foods are textures and this one ended up being pricey dog food as that was the only one who would eat it.  I had it with garlic and olive oil on it so I cannot tell you if the pasta had a good taste or not.  I suggest dreamfields if it does not spike your sugar as it is dead on perfect.  I am thinking of giving carb-nada a try.  I really like a lot of Dixie's products (even their faux potatoes) but not this one!

This oat bran is as finely ground as Quaker's and is less expensive. Finely ground oat bran is best for baking. (I use the recipes in The Oat Bran Baking Book by Nancy Baggett & Ruth Glick which you can find used here on Amazon.)Mother's Oat Bran also makes a smooth and delicious hot cereal. Make it with  milk instead of water for better flavor and creaminess.

This oat bran is delicious.  I use less oat bran and more water than recommended, as it is very thick, and I prefer it a little thinner.  Smooth, very quick cooking, and delicious, I eat it with maple syrup, currants, and a little skim milk or rice dream.  You will love it.
Mother's oat bran is not only very nutritious, but also very quick to make and my kids love it!!  And Amazon has the best price!
We have tried other oat brans, but this one has the best taste and texture.  Yet we cannot find it our local grocery stores anymore!
Mother's oat bran is much more finely milled than any other brand I have tried.  As a result, I can add a couple of tablespoons worth to a variety of foods and still end up with a smooth texture.
I have tried many oat bran cereals over the years and this is the smoothest of them all.  DCP

This is the best oat bran cereal.  None of the others matches it. It can be hard to track down and Amazon hasn't always carried it.  So I'm always so relieved when I see it here and buy a 6 mo stock.  Great to have it on Prime too.My 94 year old mother has been eating this for breakfast for oh, the last 30 years or so.  She started it when her doctor told her she had to reduce her cholesterol.  And she did.It's been her daily breakfast ever since (w 1/2 banana sliced,  a sprinkling of wheat bran, and a tblspn of yogurt).It also makes The Best Muffins (add raisins) - they have a kind of creaminess because the bran is so smooth.  My mom baked those almost daily when she was working at getting the cholesterol down.  They're simple but yummy addictive - and good for you.I think her oat bran cereal combo breakfast has helped keep my mom alive and healthy all these years.  That plus her daily chocolate and sherry!
A tasty and healthy combination of whole grain, dried fruit, seeds and nuts. I mix it with plain yogurt and let it sit overnight to make a great lowfat, healthy, low-sugar treat.

This is a very good muesli that is my wife's favorite breakfast or snack. Generous portions of cranberry and cherry. Would be five stars if it was cheaper. But hard to find except on Amazon and usually more expensive elsewhere.

column9: AMAZING and my dogs love it!
column10: I raise red toy poodles. My first one was a boy who will be six next month and is the pickiest eater EVER!! The first 4 years, we tried at least 50 different kinds and I could NOT keep the weight on his little bones. Since switching to Halo, he's gained 2 pounds and is super healthy!! I feed my pregnant momma's and our 3-week old puppies Halo and again, they are super healthy! I love that I can pronounce every ingredient in the list! When I feed the canned, I can actually see peas and carrots and meat!  AMAZING!! even as a first food, puppy tummies digest it easily with no complications! I doubt I will ever feed anything else!
I have been using Halo's Wild Salmon Puppy food for about 5 months now. My 7 month old Golden Retriever loves it, and has had no problems from eating it. I highly recommend it.

I ordered these for a themed birthday party for 6 year olds. I contacted the seller the same day I ordered them, because the arrival date did not look like it would be in time for my daughter's birthday party. Not only did the company personally call me back, but they shipped the product the same morning. The Bobas arrived a day early, and were absolutely the biggest hit at my daughter's party. They are delicious and kids just love them. I would highly, highly recommend this product and this company. I also found out that these do not need to be refrigerated until they are opened, so next time I will order them much earlier. Thanks!

These are an excellent topping to ice cream/frozen yogurt.  You can top any flavor ice cream with Boba Balls for a burst of fruit flavor!  They are fun and light, and add an exciting touch to an ice cream bar.  You can also pop these in tea for an extra fruity enjoyment.
I didn't buy these from here... a bit to pricey... but they have them as a topping at YogurtLand and they are absolutely awesome tasting! I love how they pop when you bite on them.

column9: Milk not packed well; arrived leaking.
column10: This is a good product, but Amazon can't seem to figure out how to ship it.  In two shipments, I had four leaky milks.  On one hand, it may not be Silk Milk's fault--may be an Amazon shipping issue--but I still wouldn't recommend ordering this product because it may get to you leaking and unusable.  Also, the price keeps going up making it less worth it to order online.

Silk is great stuff, and these aseptic packages are supposed to be good for a year.That doesn't do much good when there is less than 2 months left on the product when received.I stocked up for the winter in case we can't get to town to buy fresh.Ordering Silk via Amazon is a bogus shopping experience; they can't be returned because 'technically' there is nothing wrong with the product.5 stars if you're drinking it next week.0 stars if you're stocking up for 6 months from now.
I just paid less than half that for the exact same product at a local competitor. And they want more words!!!

These are the best bars out there..I was told my cholesterol was high and Ineeded to eat more fiber and flax...A friend recommended these bars when wewere on vacation...What a difference...They sure provide what I was told to doand they taste Great...Would definitely recommend these to all my friends.

It's hard to find loose leaf tea around here so I ordered it and am well pleased. This is tea like Mom used to make, full of flavor but light and satisfying on those hot summer days as iced tea, and the same on those cold winter days as hot tea.Loose leaf tea is also less expensive and that's a bonus!
make this tea with a basket percolator for an perfect tea.great for iced tea or hot. This is the only one we will drink at home now

column9: Loose tea is getting harder to find!
column10: This is a very good general loose tea.  Nothing fancy.  Clouds for iced tea, but that doesn't affect the taste.

column9: Very tasty, but not healthy or nutritious
column10: Think of this as a candy/snack bar rather than a granola bar and you will not be disappointed. It's very sweet and tasty, but there's little or no nutritional value in here, despite being made from oats. The product is heavily processed and definitely what anyone would call healthy. Made with natural and artificial flavors, the ingredients list is very long (see bottom of review). It's loaded with sugar and not something you want to give yourself or your kids on a regular basis. Note how many times sugar or its variants appear in the list (glucose, fructose).Each bar is 1.23 oz. Daily value: Fiber 1g (5%), Vitamin A (0%), Vitamin C (0%), Calcium (10%), Iron (2%). 150 calories per bar (40 from fat), 11g of sugar. I'm giving the product 4 stars based on taste and texture. It's chewy, but not hard like Nature Valley granola bars.Ingredients: granola (whole grain rolled oats, whole grain rolled wheat, brown sugar, sunflower oil, high fructose corn syrup, dried coconut, honey, sodium bicarbonate, natural flavor, whey and whey protein concentrate), yogurt flavored coating (sugar, palm kernel and palm oil, whey protein concentrate, yogurt flavored powder, soy lecithin, natural flavor, artificial color, citric acid, salt), corn syrup, high fructose corn syrup, brown rice crisp (whole grain brown rice, sugar, malted barley flour, salt), brown sugar, glycerin, vegetable shortening (canola oil, palm and palm kernel oils), corn flakes (milled corn, sugar, salt, malted barley extract), whey mineral concentrate, oat flour, rice flour, sweetened dried strawberries (glucose syrup, strawberries, high fructose corn syrup, modified potato starch, sodium alginate), corn syrup solids, sorbitol, salt, sugar, modified food starch, soy lecithin, natural flavor, malted barley flour, sodium bicarbonate, BHT (a preservative), citric acid, water.Made in Canada.

My kids and the kids at the party raved about the Lego candies! They absolutely LOVED them! Not only do they look like the real thing, but you can actually snap them together and they taste great! They taste just like sweet tarts. I only ordered 1 lb bag of them, because it was my first time ordering them. I would suggest going for the 3 lb bag, because they went over so well. :) I definitely give these 5 stars!!

column9: Perfect Gift for a Gallbladder Patient!
column10: My boyfriend had gallbladder surgery a month or so ago, and I knew he would be severely limited in what kind of food he could have post-op.  He's also been a fan of Legos since childhood.  I ordered a pound and hoped for the best.  The pieces are standard two by one pegs, two by twos, and two by threes.  Very few even showed mild chips, and all snap together for building.There are four flavors in the box:  Blue raspberry, green apple, cherry, and banana.  The flavors are on par with Sweet Tarts, as someone else mentioned.  Unfortunately, the banana kind of perfumes all the other blocks, so if you're really not into banana, this may not be the best candy.  Surprisingly, these are not excessively gritty like many Sweet Tart knockoffs.In this size bag, there's just enough for two people to play with and enjoy over a week. If you had a couple children, I'd recommend buying Ziplocs and dividing them that way.  A pound of this candy is roughly a filled quart-sized bag.Nutritionally, of course, the only thing this candy really has going for it is the fact is that it's low fat, which was one of the reasons I purchased it.  The chalky texture also insures you're not going to let it lie against your teeth to rot like a slicker, harder lollipop.I would absolutely buy this product again, though in this case for a child who has everything and whose mother doesn't want to have to put away another toy. ;)

My son wanted to have a lego party for his 9th birthday. These candies were the hit of the party for the kids and their parents alike!  The flavors were delicious-pineapple, banana, strawberry.  Definitely would recommend them.

column9: Yummy candies and stacking them is fun!
column10: These candies are fun to stack. And they taste great. My sons really like them and look forward to sharing with their friends.

These were perfect candies for our Lego themed party.  They were cool looking and actually fit together like actual Legos.  The kids seemed to like them and compared the taste to Sweet Tarts but the adults seemed to think they were more like "generic" Sweet Tarts and lacked a bit on flavor.  Good choice for the novelty though!

Purchased these to top a cake for a Lego themed birthday and received many compliments on how cute they were.  As other reviewers had warned, they were pretty hard to chew.  Was concerned that the kids would have a tough time with them but they absolutely loved them and begged for more.  They spent equal amounts of time eating the candy and building with it.  They made a great cake decoration and were a huge hit.  They stack well and are suprisingly tasty too!
I used these to decorate a cake for my son's Lego themed birthday party. The kids liked it. It tastes a bit like Sweet-Tarts. It's pretty hard, and may be a little tough for little kids to chew.

column9: great tasting candy for Lego lovers!
column10: We had a Lego party for my 7 year old and these candy blocks were a big hit with the children and adults.  Sometimes you need to sacrifice taste for 'cuteness' although not with this candy.  Not only did it taste close to 'Sweetarts' neither being excessively sweet or sour, it was very appealing visually and the kids loved playing/eating these candies.  I wish I had bought a larger amount as I only bought 1 bag not knowing how they tasted or their quality.

My son loves legos as well does his friends. We bought them to put in treat bags at his birthday and kids thought they were impressed and loved them. Kids were still asking for more after the party! Would totally recommend them and they can actually build things with them!
My thanks to this company for getting me exactly what I ordered in a very timely manner. The product was exactly what I was hoping it would be and much better tasting than I was expecting.

column9: A big hit at my son's birthday party
column10: I purchased these to decorate cupcakes, and the birthday cake for my son's party, and I am very pleased with them! Nice, vibrant colors. They taste really good, too. kids loved that you can build with them. I must have had half a dozen moms inquire about where I got them. Fun, cute, and unique candy. I definately reccomend!

I purchased this as part of a welcoming gift for a visitng friend from out of town.  She has always loved this candy, but it's difficult to find.  It was just as she remembered.  The packaging was good, and the candy arrived unbroken.

The kids loved them! They helped decorate cupcakes for a school b-day party. Other kids at school were quite impressed and kept asking my kids where they got them. It's neat how the stack like real legos, "but they don't lock". They come in a plastic bag that is not too appealing. But the product was not effected by this.  I would recommend this!

column9: Perfect Candy for A Lego Fan
column10: Santa put this candy in my son's stocking, and I don't know which he enjoyed more, eating them or stacking the blocks together to make things. They were also quite tasty, very similar to Sweettarts, but extremely hard. I wouldn't recommend them to a child younger than 5 or so because they are so hard (my son is 6).

came as described but in a bag so many of the tops notches were broken off. none of the kids could bite into them without chipping a tooth but all of us adults really enjoyed the taste after sucking on them for a while. Used them for sons lego party and they were mainly a cute decoration. I would buy again..
This is my favorite candy and can honestly say this order was just like the ones you would get at Dylan's Candy Bar. Will definitely order from again

I was worried  they would come in broken but they weren't. They taste very good. You CAN actually build with them!!! Which is why I chose these and not the ones at the candy store. I will be buying these again!

These candies are shaped just like the real legos and you can even build withh them like real legos!  I bought them to use on a Lego Birthday cake and they could also be used for giftbags after a Lego Birthday Party!!!  Awesome..thanks!

We had a lego birthday party for my sons seventh birthday.  These candy blocks were fun, as you can build with them. however they were very hard.  I overheard more than one adult guest make a comment about not breaking a tooth.  Maybe they need to be that hard in order to build with them?

I bought this item as a stocking-stuffer for my daughters at Christmas. They came packaged in small plastic bags that looked like they had spent some time in a hobo's sock. There wasn't even a label on the bags, and they had a variety of small, obviously not designed, holes in them. Unfortunately I didn't open all my Amazon boxes until Christmas eve, so by the time I discovered their condition, I was forced to either not use them or put them in small plastic containers. I chose the small plastic containers, but Santa's credibility took a hit.The candies themselves are a bit stale, but otherwise OK. I decided to feed them to the girls to prepare their immune systems for any coming apocalypse.  Neat concept, but they obviously don't care about packaging.

column9: Check out my Do It Yourself Lego Chocolates
column10: I made my own mold and made my own Lego Chocolates.  You can check it out here:  carnoustielane.blogspot.comThey turned out great and the kids loved them.  I am by no means a great chocolate maker but these were super easy!

column9: Great product, but buy them elsewhere
column10: I love these chips. They are the healthy indulgence- dark chocolate.  Good enough to eat straight from the bag as a little snack. Melt well for baking.  But don't buy them here.  Check Walmart- they are less than 2.50 a pack.  Much better value than this 12 pack deal.  I usually find Amazon to be a great deal, but this time it just isn't.

I love these chocolate chips.  They are the highest cocoa content chips that you can buy at a regular store.  Most other chips are in the 40-50% range.  They taste amazing whether you eat them plain or use them for cookies.  The only thing better is criollo chocolate which is significantly more expensive.The only downside is that they put a small amount of milk fat in them (1-2% of the content according to my telephone call to Ghirardelli), so they are not vegan. Otherwise they are a significant upgrade over the old Ghirardelli double chocolate chips which were around 54% cocoa.Occasionally a bag of chocolate chips will get grainy and taste bad.  I'm not sure if this is due to shipping or storing it in a place that is too warm (or too cold). Fortunately, in my experience this is rare.  This has happened when I tried ordering 3.5 pound bags of these chips. That is unfortunate as buying the 3.5 pound bags can be 30% cheaper.In supermarkets, as of 2010, these retail for around $3.50 per bag.

column9: Convenient way to buy the best dark chocolate
column10: Here in El Paso, Ghirardelli Chocolate 60% Cacao Bittersweet is almost impossible to find.  So I was so pleased to find it on Amazon.  I make the best fudge ever with it, but we also eat an ounce or so of these chocolate chips for dessert most evenings.  Thanks Amazon for having baking stuff, too!

I've been buying these for years but Ghirardelli reduced the bag size to 10oz without any notice.  That's a sneaky way to increase the price without people noticing.  I only recently caught the change after being repeatedly ripped off thinking I was getting 11.5oz.  Companies will do this until we consumers step up and refuse to do business with companies that cheat.  Shame on you Ghirardelli!
I normally prefer Lindt over Ghiradelli, but these chocolate chips are great. We've been using these to make superb chocolate oatmeal cookies.

Warning: you will never go back to Nestle or any other chocolate after getting used to these. Very chocolaty and not too sweet.Costco carries the very similar Ghirardelli Double Chocolate Bittersweet chips for a way better cost than here. (3.5 lb bag for under 9 buckss.) But only during "baking season" (Nov through early January).The food faddists are saying chocolate is good for you. Enjoy now before it changes again!

Ok, let me start by saying I'm an avid chocoholic and am EXTREMELY picky about the quality of chocolate I consume. I would like to commend Ghirardelli for being the first chocolate company to offer a beautiful fruity, tangy, yet richly rounded chocolate flavor at it's deserved bittersweet cocoa content to the average consumer using the average grocery store. I can even find these at some Targets! I was so impressed and relieved to finally find a useful size of chocolate, with an all-around excellent profile in a truly affordable package! (note to bakers- why pay 4 dollars for a 4 oz baking bar when you can pay 4 dollars for an 11.5 oz bag of the SAME CHOCOLATE)What's more, this chocolate is MUCH better than any expensive Callebaut, Cacao Barry, or Scharffen Berger chocolate at equivalent cacao mass.HOWEVER, Ghirardelli has really disapointed me as of late. I used to use these almost exclusively for the NY Times Jacques Torres Chocolate Chip Cookie Recipe, the BEST out there, which requires a specifically large and flat shape in the chocolate chip used (feve). Ghirardelli USED to offer this shape, WITHOUT milk fat, and it was the PERFECT size and shape, and melted beautifully into my ideal chocolate chip cookies. NOW they've made an ugly, NORMAL chip shape that is stiffer when melting and totally RUINS my perfect Jacques Torres cookie dreams.GHIRARDELLI!! WHY ON EARTH DID YOU CHANGE YOUR CHOCOLATE CHIPS???????

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column9: i wish it came out of the tap like this
column10: This water has pretty much spoiled me for any other. It's a little too expensive for me to drink it exclusively but I've been trying in vain to get my day to day drinking water to taste just like this. I've tried other more expensive brands like Fiji which just tastes flat, and cheaper brands which are just "meh"; I've also gone through several home filtration systems and still no luck getting anywhere near the clean, refreshing taste that Dasani has. I had heard/read that Dasani is actually super-purified municipal(=city) water, not from a mountain spring or similar natural source but it's the taste that people buy it for and IMO there isn't any other brand sourced from anywhere that has a better taste.Maybe it's that there is a slight addition of salt in this water?Minus one star for expensive. This is likely available locally for less.

I use this as my 2nd choice for bottled water in case I can not find the Nestle pure life I always drink. I has a good water taste & no funny smells or taste. I still think Nestle is better. But I can not always find that in single servings. And sometimes I need an extra bottle & can usually find this in seperate bottles.

I love Dasani water-have been drinking it for years. What I am appalled at was the price I had to pay for 48 - 16 oz bottles - almost $100 ! I can purchase 48 bottles at my local supermarket for $14!! I am in my 90s and I thought this was the answer to stop my lugging of water. Needless to say I won't be ordering it again.

Not sure what to think -- they sounded soooo good, but they turned out to be surprisingly bland.  Not waxy, not unpleasant, just not very tasty.  I gave them to my Dad for Christmas, and he generously shared them, and where I had assumed they'd be rather irresistable, (they were quite expensive, so I figured a splurge, plus a captivating product name, would mean they'd be utterly delicious), they were decidedly so-so.

I ordered these when they went on sale. At the sale price, they were about the same price as the "Black Almonds" from Trader Joes. I liked these almonds better, even though the TJ ones are really good. These almonds have been roasted and it makes the almonds more flavorful. The chocolate is dark so they are really chocolaty, and not too sweet. I also found it helpful that the product is labeled gluten free since my daughter has problems with gluten. I hope these go on sale again, because they were a treat!
Makes a great cup of coffee in my Senseo. Strong enough to add a dash of water and has great flavor.

column9: Smells of Christmastime, Flavors of hmm... where's the flavor?
column10: I purchased this flavor from Baronet as I enjoyed their Nutty Irishman flavor. Cinnamon Stick smells nice, but I found the flavor lacking. I can drink Nutty Irishman black, however Cinnamon Stick black tasted similar to gas station coffee. Not particularly strong or full-bodied, and even after adding my own ground cinnamon and tasty creamer it still didn't make much of an impression.To be fair, I would not consider myself a Cinnamon aficionado. Perhaps I would enjoy this flavor from Baronet more if I were.

I was expecting a wonderful cinnamon aroma while brewing, and a nice bit of cinnamon taste while drinking it.  With this and the other flavors I purchased, I am extremely disappointed.  With a single pod I did not get any cinnamon aroma or flavor.  With two pods it is barely detectable for me, yet there is some type of odd flavor I can't quite describe.  Drinkable, but definately not the "to die for" cup of coffee I was hoping for.  I'll probably add a dash of cinnamon to each brew, so that I can use these up.  But, I won't be purchasing any more of them.

column9: Best coffee brand for a senseo machine
column10: These are my preferred pods for my senseo machine. These are the SUPER pods.. I use the single pod holder and I use the double cup button on my machine but turn it off before it finishes filling up the cup. This way I get about 1.5 cups of water in my cup and with ONE Pod its very strong coffee.I like the Baronet brand coffee better than any I have tried and its far superior to the Senseo pods and much stronger coffee.I have had the cinnamon, hazelnut, french vanilla and so far love them all.I did try the Almond and did not like it, it was a strange taste, too overpowering.This is a great value for people who love their Senseo machine but hate the price of the pods...great coffee!

I was very pleased with my order. First it arrived very quickly.All of the lemons were in great shape and nice size. Nothing tocomplain about. And last but not least, since they were broughtfor the Master Cleanse they were not put in the refigerator. Theylasted several weeks without going bad. I highly recomended thisproduct and will reorder.

column9: Yuck. Diet taste in a "normal" container
column10: From the very first sip I looked at my wife and exclaimed, "this tastes like saccharine." Sure enough, looking at the ingredients' list there is indeed Sucralose included. What's wrong with plain old sugar? I tossed this in the garbage, where it belongs, unless you're a diabetic. Fake, artificial, laboratory, imitation sweetener? Are you kidding me? I can taste the artificial sweetener 30 minutes afterwards. The garbage. It belongs in the garbage. Screw Swiss Miss from this day onward!

This tea is very inexpensive for the quality and flavor it brings to the table. A little flowery but possessed of deep flavor and strong overtones. I liked it better than many boutique "mall" teas that cost a lot more. Develops good dark amber color during brewing.

I was disappointed in this tea.  I've struggled to find a description of the flavor of this tea . . . a little more floral than fruity, but rather astringent.  Certainly not what I am used to in Lychee-Black tea. I prefer Golden Sail and Tao of Tea.  I'm not sure I'll even be able to finish one canister of this.

Litchi/lychee is a hard flavor to explain to someone who is not familiar with it. This tea has a nice mild litchi flavor to it, almost like a floral or honey like flavor, but the litchi flavor is definitely there. I have been enjoying this tea hot and iced with equal and a splash of lemon when iced. There are no brewing instructions, I have been brewing 1 tsp per cup, boiling water for 5 minutes and it has been turning out great.

This product is a very health snack for your pup as it is made of 100% beef liver. My puppy does all of his tricks to get this treat. It is a little pricy but the container is large so it should last a long time as long as you don't overfeed.

My girls love these. I cut them up smaller and use them for training. Definately able to keep the dogs attention when they know something yummy and tasty is coming their way. The price was right too for the amount. As long as the price remains perfect I plan on having a steady supply of this great product!
This is 2.5 oz larger than what you can find in pet stores and less expensive. Shipped day the it was ordered and arrived 2 days later with prime.
I have one dog that is a picky eater. I crumble this liver treat into her food bowl and she loves it. If you have a dog that doesn't eat, try this, you won't be disappointed.

My Golden can get picky and eating is not a priority for him. I was worried during training he was going to be too anxious to not eat any training treats. Well...these he will eat and I am very great-full! However, they do not have the best smell (definitely not something I would eat). :) Will be purchasing more.

We cut these up into small pieces for our Corgi pup (so each treat actually becomes 8-10 mini treats) to prevent throwing off his diet.  This allows us to give him multiple treats for going potty outside (like 3-5 mini treats each time).  We also use these whenever our puppy meets a stranger -- we make sure all four paws are on the ground before we give it to him and he has already learned to inhibit his desire to jump up on people!  These are amazing and I appreciate that they are made in the USA -- no weird chemicals to worry about -- and our pup loves to work for them!
Yes, they are a bit expensive but, they are high quality, and pure nutrition.  Good training treat and not too high in calories.  Highly recommend this!

I have two German Shepherds. I use these as training treats. I also use them when I brush them, which they don't enjoy so much but know they will get treats. We have tried every treat available. These are the best.
Extremely big bucket of yummy treats for training! This is a great value. The pieces are large, but I cut them up into smaller pieces for regular training purposes.

These liver chunks are like crack for dogs. The niblets are magic for training dogs because the critters will do anything for these. Although freeze-dried liver is pricey, you can cut the chunks into tiny chinks and use while training, rewarding, or just saying, 'I love you, my good dog.'
all natural,dogs favorite treat. Don't give too many because it will constipate dog. My dogs will do anything for these treats!

My dog trainer recommended this to our obedience class. I found the best price here on Amazon, and my puppy LOVES the treats. Great training treats if used in moderation (too much organ meat isn't good for anyone). Also excellent if you put some of the treats in a container with non-liver treats/cookies. Use the container as a shaker to help train your dog to come, and the other treats get a liver flavored (dust) coating that makes your dog love them even more! No limit on liver dusted treats!Two paws up for this stuff!

column9: Excellent Product and Made in U.S.A.
column10: My three very finicky dogs love this product, and I like the way I can cut them up into small pieces for training.  There is only one ingredient in this: liver, all sourced within the United States, so I feel confident and safe giving this to my dogs.  I buy this on a regular basis.  It's priced better than any pet supply store I've seen, even the larger chains.  Qualifies for free shipping, which is also nice.
My dog is not enthusiastic about food.  She enjoys these treats which are light weight and easy to carry.  Number of treats per day must be limited.

If you have children you may recall the scent of spit-up milk from an infant--that's the flavor. It's hard to palate! This is likely the result of the processing method. This may be a "traditionally-processed" (Philippine method) oil, in which the chopped coconut is allowed to ferment in order to separate the oil. Other cold-processing methods avoid this fermentation step and extract the oil mechanically. Both result in a minimally-processed, truly "virgin" product (as opposed to a refined oil which is further processed with heat and solvents to remove flavors and other natural components). Also this has a grittier texture than I'm accustomed to.Two stars for overall quality (and I'm just a big fan of coconut oil), but beware of the stronger and unpalatable smell and taste.

The container suggests that it be used as a substitute for butter. I think it will work well (although haven't tried it yet). I recommend this product. Priced well.

I've been using Now Foods Organic Virgin Coconut Oil since 2010 for a variety of uses. I have a medically fragile son that was born severely disabled and had frequent, life threatening pneumonias. Since I started using Now Foods Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, he has not been hospitalized for pneumonia in 18 months. His doctors are amazed at this. I melt 1 tbsp per day and give it to him through his feeding tube (be sure to flush with really warm/hot water or it will clog the tube). It helps prevent colds, flu and pneumonia and I use more (up to 4 tbsp a day) if any symptoms are coming on.  I tried other brands (Nutiva, 365 brand) and they didn't work as well. The Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil didn't work at all on his symptoms so now I only use Now Foods Organic Virgin Coconut Oil.It is also fantastic as a beauty treatment. I put some in a glass dish with a plastic lid and place it in my bathroom. It diminishes fine lines and wrinkles, reduces pore size and makes your skin look amazing. I cleanse my face, dry it and then put it all over my face and leave it on overnight. My skin has never looked better. It's also the best makeup remover you will ever use and it's organic and all natural. Excellent for eye make up removal. I also use it as a moisturizer in the winter under my foundation. Use a much smaller amount (versus what you use at bedtime) and then apply your foundation as normal.It's also great for cooking-I use it to make organic popcorn and use coconut oil instead of oil. Perfect for pie crust, grill cheese or anything where you would use oil. Plus it has a higher set point than other oils so it won't burn.It's great too for burns of any kind. A fantastic product.

I got this NOW virgin coconut oil when my usual brand (Tree of Life) was not available.  Comparing the two, NOW is more gritty and not as smooth (in solid state) as ToL. Now also has more of a coconut flavor.  Both are fine for cooking, adding to smoothies, using on skin, and eating from the jar, I guess it just depends on personal preference. Both products are good for you and backed by well respected companies. I personally like ToL better.

I go through a lot of coconut oil so I was happy to find a 3 pack for a great price.  I have a tablespoon or so a day and also use it on my face.  It is great to cook with and has a mild taste.  I will keep getting this brand!
This stuff is great. It adds a very subtle flavor whenever I cook with it. I did some research on it and found that it is really good for a person's physical health.

column9: The filling is more viscous than molasses.
column10: Don't get these if you value your teeth. The tartlet filling is very viscous. It will stick to your teeth and you could probably use it to glue pieces of plywood together.
roland tartlettes are difficult to find, particularly as i am partially handicapped. it is really good to find them on line at amazon.com.

I have tried a fair number of teas and drink tea pretty often.  My favorite used to be Twinings though even with Twinings tea, sometimes it just does not come out well.I don't usually drink loose tea, but I received this tea as a gift.  When I tried it I was very pleasantly surprised!  This tea is the best tea I've ever had.  Every time you make it it is always good.  It is just delicious with milk and sugar.  LOVE IT!!

Of the numerous black teas I've sampled, this is by far my favorite. It boasts a rare combination of extreme richness and unusual smoothness. I recommend brewing it strong (almost as dark as a cup of weak black coffee) and adding sugar.
I'm so glad I found this tea, because it's one of the most enjoyable I've tried. It's smooth and bold taste is just to my liking.

I had tried other scottish breakfast teas but they were too smokey or too bitter.  This is a wonderful tea which makes a nice strong yet smooth cup of tea.  Ordering was easy and shipping was quick. Overall a bargain for a tea which is hard to find in markets.

I have to say that Scottish Breakfast is my new favorite goto morning tea. The flavors are rich and deep without being bitter. It stands up well to sugar and cream. Since I have switched to tea for my morning jolt, I have looked for a robust tea and this one fits the bill.I does not matter if I am having a piece of toast with peanut butter, pancakes with fruit or syrup or a plate of bacon and eggs, this tea is a welcome addition.
