Love this tea...awesome with just a little sugar. Tastes better than many more expensive teas. I'm sure you will like it!!!!

column9: Love it with fat-free 1/2 and 1/2 plus a little sugar
column10: I am normally a coffee drinker but had some great tea while on the isle of Bermuda and have added nightly tea to my day.  I have tried quite a few teas but nothing beats this one.  Thanks for the previous reviewers for causing me to try it...I'm now a very loyal buyer via Amazon of this loose tea.
This tea is delicious and it's hard to find it at any stores here in Southern California. It's a great gift idea for fans of black tea, too. I love to have it with a dash of milk.

I'll preface this by saying that I have always like Naan bread - when it is done correctly.  However, I have often been disappointed with the usual commercial offerings; too tough, soggy, flavorless, etc.This Masala Flat Bread / Naan, is just about as good as any I have tasted and certainly as good as the batches I have made at home.  Heated as directed, it is tender with perfectly balanced flavor and excellent as a base for the toppings or fillings of your choice.  Since I received this order I have used these to make pizza, wrapped kebabs inside with labneh yogurt, chopped cucumbers and tomatoes.There are too many ways of using this product for me to list here.  I have just begun to experiment.

column9: They don't say this but these are hot and spicy when they arrive
column10: I had to throw them away, because when they arrived they were not plain. They were "hot and spicy" meaning they have green jalapeno peppers baked into them and red chili powder on top. I tried one bite and my mouth is still burning. I will try to get a refund.

I love this date sugar!  Not sticky at all, quite tasty and works perfectly in baking.  Date sugar doesn't dissolve in liquids, however, so it's not for use in drinks or recipes that require melted sugar.  Great stuff!

I ordered this date sugar because I had a recipe for GAPS-legal brownies that called for 2 3/4 c. date sugar.  The first time I made the recipe I bought dates and put them in my food processor--I didn't realize you're supposed to dry them in the dehydrator first!  So I ended up with a huge sticky ball of very sticky date "sugar" that I used.  Some portions of the date got stuck in the sticky, sticky ball of stickiness without totally being blended so I got little chunks of date in my brownies.  I had trouble blending the sticky date ball with the butter and cocoa, and it was tough to mix into the rest of the recipe.  It wasn't the end of the world, and the brownies were good, but the texture was a little off.SO, I ordered this date sugar and I've made the brownies again.  Holy smokes, it was so much easier!  Instead of buying this date sugar, you COULD buy a bunch of dates, dry them out in a dehydrator, and put them in a food processor.  I won't do that again though, because that takes a bunch of time, and it cost me more to use dates from the store than it cost to buy this already turned into date sugar.The texture of this date sugar is uniform enough that it works well in recipes, but the color and size of the granules varies enough that you know it comes from real food instead of being some sort of chemical product.  The date sugar is quite sweet, and very easy to work with.I will definitely continue to buy this date sugar.

My little dogs really like these.  I like that they are a light formula so it isn't quite as guilty a pleasure for them.  Also, these treats are just about the right size.  They aren't large but are big enough my dogs can make 3-4 bites out of each.

I ordered the light roast, but received a collection of different flavors.  My husband does not like flavors.  The description did not say different flavors and the picture here does not match the picture on what we received.  Ours says includes coffee house regular, chocolate glazed, cinamon and decaf. column9: Light Roast. Mild Blend. Smooth Flavor. Not Acidic. Not Full Bodied.
column10: This Donut House Blend is a light roast coffee. It is not bitter & has a mild flavor.  I brew this in an 8oz cup & find it in the "not too light, but not bold" category.  It works well with a splash of milk.I would categorize this blend in the breakfast coffee category - coffee that you sip during breakfast that will not compete with your food for flavor.  It also works well as an afternoon "pick me up" coffee.If you are looking for a mild blend with no bitterness, check out this blend.

Tried this coffee and think it's a really good flavor.  Reordered the pack of the variety coffees and all of my guest say they really like it.  Even my daughter, who is a real coffee lover, said she thought it was a good coffee. I'll stick with this one.
This is not the same as the 'Donut Shop' coffee that comes with the Keurig Brewer.  It is not very good tasting coffee.
Have received several favorable comments from people in our office who say this is really good coffee.  I intend to keep it in house as our regular, non-flavored choice.

I usually like a milder blend of cofffee having said that I decided to try  something different. This coffee is smooth but has for me a stong taste if you like a strong cup of coffee that you can put creamer on and still taste the coffee you will like this one. For me it was to strong for my first cup of black coffee in the morning. I will admit I love this coffee in the evening with some Bailey's Irish Creme in it.
Good, light roast. Great early morning coffee with a bagel. Good for people who don't like the dark or extra dark roasts.

i really have been enjoying my keurig experience. i am a light roast fan and i am very pleased to have found Donut House Coffee light roast kcups. after many experimentations and numerous flavored kcups later, i have come to the conclusion that this flavor with any flavored syrup or creamer, if any desired, really suits me.  it is a delicious smooth enjoyable taste which i look forward to  every morning and throughout the day.i buy it for only .42/cup at wholesale club.

Not thrilled with this coffee unfortunately. I chose extra bold for a reason, and this coffee is definitely not an extra bold coffee. I was really kinda bummed when we tasted the coffee. I'm not even sure I can say I taste "MUCH" of a "coffee" flavor really at all.Bummed out in New Gloucester, Maine
Donut House Collection is a pleasant tasting coffee but a little weak.  I think Donut Shop Xtra Bold is more to my taste.

This tastes like a coffee house. Very smooth blend. Price is fair and with the Prime it comes in 2 days. I would reccomend this. I use only the Extra Bold K-cups as the regular ones only make a small cup and it comes out too weak on the 10oz setting.

This product is not bold in flavor at all. The package is different than what was pictured on the website. I called and was sent a new box but it arrived same. When I returned the product I did not get a refund. The product I ordered did not say it was a light roast.

column9: Weak - get Emeril's Big Easy Bold!
column10: On the middle or 'mug' setting of the Keurig B-70, Donut House didn't hold a candle to Emeril's Big Easy Bold k-cup.  Emeril's is superior - truly robust, full and velvety without any hint of a burned, smokey or earthy taste whatsoever, but has a terrific depth and complexity.  Donut House falls short of being an 'extra bold' coffee and is more a medium bodied blend.

column9: Did I get a bad batch?
column10: Donut Shop is one of my favorites. Though it is also the blend I get the most failures with. So I decided to pick up a box of this Donut House flavor at my local Bed Bath & Beyond. To me it is awful! No flavor at all and hardly any color. I normally buy bold flavors/variants and pump the 10oz mug size. I had to lower this one to 8oz to not totally wash it out. This coffee was just something that I figured I would try. When it came I had mild hopes towards it just being ok.  I was surprised to taste a fairly strong flavor, a bit on the bitter side but quite full of flavor to say the least.  I plan to order more.

column9: Bitter like a lot of Keurig brews...

column9: Great Bold Smooth Kup of Coffee
column10: This is Green Mountain's response to the Coffee People's Donut Shop coffee.  Many people actually confuse the two which isn't difficult to do: donut house and donut shop -- both are extra bold in flavor, and both are excellent.  Since Donut Shop is my favorite, I decided to conduct a taste test between these two rivals.  Side to side they are very similar, very little acid taste, no bitterness which is what I look for in an extra bold roast.  Head to head Donut Shop edged this coffee, Donut House, out by the slightest of margin.  Donut Shop had slightly more body to it but frankly, it took me drinking a half cup of each before I could declare a winner.  This is why I also think this is a 5 star coffee -- excellent choice if you want a simple, great tasting cup of coffee that you will not get sick of.

column9: Not like drinking a donut, but great coffee!!!
column10: I was skeptical of this blend. I like my coffee dark and bold. But this one is really REALLY smooth, dark and rich tasting. My other fav is Caribou and this one is similar to that. Not bitter, not biting, just smooth and rich and consistant. A great daily brew for my Keurig. Try it. I bet you will like it.
This is now my favorite.I drink coffee black and the taste of Donut House is excellent.

I really like the Donut Shop coffe so I tried this one. It is not nearly as bold, which is what I like. It does have a good flavor tho. I have found that Costco sells this and several others for only $36.99 /80 count.

I decided to try a box because Costco carries this and they haven't had my favorite Tully's Kona for a while. It lives up to the "light roast" description and brews one of the lightest (you might also say 'weakest') cups of coffee I've had in any K-cup. Even using two k-cups didn't help much. It's way too light for my tastes; glad I didn't buy the box of 88 at Costco.So, if you like a lightly roasted and somewhat weak cup of coffee, you'd like this. The flavor is good. But, k-cups run a little on the weak side in general and this one is simply too light for me.Amazon did ship fast and had a good price.UPDATE: Some reviews here don't seem to understand the terms being used."Light Roast" is a description of how long the coffee beans are roasted. Light roaster beans do not have the strong and sometimes bitter flavor of beans that are roasted for longer times, but they retain more of the subtleties of their flavor.  It does produce a `lighter' cup of coffee."Extra Bold" is a term Keurig/Green Mountain uses to describe a K-cup that has more coffee grounds in it than normal K-cups.  More coffee grounds makes for a stronger cup of coffee. The strength of the coffee also depends on how large a cup you brew.You can have a "light roast" coffee in an "Extra Bold" K-cup, but the result will still be a coffee with a lighter flavor.Personally, I like a medium roast; a nice balance between good coffee flavor and that strong coffee bite.

That was the case with my donut shop yesterday. IT WAS GONE!! Replaced with donut "house". I figured for .42 a cup I would give it a try. I am not disappointed at all. It is just as good as the donut shop I used to drink. Perhaps ever so slightly less strong, but an excellent cup of coffee, and cant beat the price at Costco. The only thing that is a little confusing on Amazon is the price?? That is really high. Anyway. If you are a donut shop drinker you will love the donut house every bit as much. Don't hesitate to buy it...but make sure you check the price. Great price available form Costco....this week

column9: Drinkable, but rather bland, not full-bodied, will not buy again
column10: I have been a Keurig user for several years, have one at home and one in my office. For at least 4 years I have been using the Green Mountain Columbian Fair Trade K-cups, been very happy with them. Recently I saw the Donut House flavor offered at my local warehouse club and it piqued my interest, problem is that the warehouse box contains 80 K-cups, didn't want to buy 80 of something I may not like. So, I picked up an 18-count box at my local Walmart, I'm so glad that I did!First, let me say that I'm not a fan of Starbucks coffee's, I think they are too strong, too bold, too bitter. I like a flavorful, medium roast but full-bodied cup of coffee. The Green Mountain Columbian Fair Trade K-cups fit this bill, whenever I would make a cup at my office, everyone would comment, "Wow, that smells so good!", it tasted just as good.I tried the Donut House coffee this morning, no inviting aroma when brewing, very bland in taste, I don't know how they get away with calling this "Bold". It says right on the box, "light roast", I don't know how a "light roast" can be called "Bold"? I was expecting a very full-bodied flavor, but without a bitter after-taste. Well, there was no after-taste, no taste period, just very bland!FYI, I usually use 16 oz. "to go" cups when brewing K-cups, I use 2 K-cups per 16 oz. cup, I brew the first K-cup on the middle button (8 oz. setting), the the second K-cup on the lowest setting (I think it is 6.5 oz. setting), this allows room for a teaspoon of sugar and some half and half to a golden color. I have been doing this for years with my Columbian K-cups and always get a great cup of coffee, did the same with the Donut House blend, drinkable, but not remarkable in any way. I will be sticking with my Columbian Fair Trade blend that never fails me.I will use the remainder of my Donut House K-cups, but I will not buy them again.

column9: Worth trying out this bold blend
column10: Very good cup of coffee.  Not as strong as some of the expresso or french roast brands which I also enjoy; so when you want something that has some body too it that's not that strong, then this is an excellent choice.

column9: The only decaf coffee my husband has ever liked
column10: My husband is a very picky coffee drinker. He actually uses a peculator and brews his coffee on the stove most days (from 8 O'Clock fresh ground beans). He produces outstanding coffee, but it takes a lot of time and energy on a work morning for me. I love the Keurig he purchased me for Christmas. He has never found decaf beans he likes, and even in Starbucks or other coffee houses, hates decaf. He actually likes this decaf a lot. It is our favorite k cup thus far.
I bought a box to sample and have come back to Amazon.com to purchase a new shipment.  This is a delicious, smooth cup of coffee.  It is a flavorable coffee but not bitter.
This is my absolute favorite K-cup. It is strong, but smooth. I take it with just a drop of cream or a flavored creamer. Absolutely delicious. By the way, it's a great coffee to dunk a donut in!

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: I'm a big fan of Keurig cups, so I ended up picking a box of this up at Sam's Club the other day to bring to work. (If you have a membership already, this is cheaper there. If not, then this is probably the better deal unless you absolutely want a membership to those types of stores.) It was worth the purchase, in my opinion.Taste-wise, this was pretty nice. I was a little worried about whether or not the cup would be too watery due to the type of machine we use at work (it has a water reservoir that it draws from rather than the one I have at home, where you add your own water), but this brewed up nicely. It was a little mild tasting, so if you're more partial to teas since coffee tastes too harsh then this will be a good alternative. If you're the type that likes the darker roasts, then you'll want to skip this one. (Although be aware that the lighter the roast, the more caffeine the bean has! The darker it is, the longer it's roasted and the more caffeine is roasted out!)I'm fairly happy with this product and I'm pretty psyched that you get so many per box. The smaller boxes are good for individual use, but for larger crowds? You have to buy in bulk just to save money, otherwise you'll go broke.

This is the best Decaf Coffee on the market.  I have always enjoyed coffee but because of health issues I have been restricted to decaf.  I tried many many other decaf brands and have determined that Donut House is the best.

I have found this decaf coffee to be the best of the K cups and I really like my Donut House coffees.  I find them to not be bitter and some of the other brands of decafs are very bitter.  This one is not.

column9: A good, great-smelling cup of coffee.
column10: I bought 80 of these for $33 from Sam's Club when I got my new Keurig B60 there as well.  After trying all of the coffees in the sampler, I think this is by far the best so far.  It is a nice, medium, very smooth and totally non-bitter cup of coffee.  I like it a lot, but I haven't really even started trying out the 100+ varieties available so we'll say it's the best "so far".  Still, a good cup of coffee.

column9: Fantastic decaf - but it's a light roast, not "extra bold"
column10: This is by far the best decaf I've ever tasted.  It's better than most regular coffee.  But, the picture included here indicates "Extra Bold" and the K-cups I received are Light Roast.  In truth I don't think that Donut House makes an "Extra Bold" decaf.  I would recommend this coffee, but I wouldn't call it "extra bold".  Bold compared to other decafs maybe!

This coffee is one of the best of the "donut" style brands that are on the market. It is a smooth coffee that has a nice body, and no bitter aftertaste. It is not acidic, and in fact has some notes of sweetness. It is more flavorful than donut shoppe, and better than the timothy's similarly named variety. Highly recommend. Although it is listed as a light roast, I would describe it as almost a medium body coffee.
This tastes like old fashioned coffee shop coffee -- exactly as it's advertised to be!  I think it's an excellent buy!
Costco has these for 42 cents a cup. Amazon used to have good prices for these and other K-cups, but those days are behind us.

Love this Coffee, it's just right for my taste. I tried several different brands until I tried Coffee House and then I knew this was the best choice for me. If your a Starbucks fan don't even waste you money because this coffee doesn't have the smokey or strong taste that Starbucks has. This is lighter and smoother. column9: DONUT HOUSE-DONUT SHOP EITHER EXCELLENT CHOICE
column10: I was up late ordering from Amazon and got the Donut House instead of the Donut Shop because of senioritis!!  When it came, I first thought..."what the h... I did not order this coffee".  After checking my orders, I confirmed that it was me!!! HA!  Anyway, I too did a taste test comparison and can say that I could not tell the difference between them.  Both excellent flavor and body.I have a Saeco Royal Professional espresso machine that I use every morning to make coffee fresh from Italian or French roasted beans.  I hate to admit that I like this Donut House better as a coffee for the lasting taste.  No, I did not stop drinking my morning espresso, I just added a couple of cups of Donut House or Donut Shop..forgot again...what was I saying!!!  Only kidding. 5 Stars!

I have bought the donut shop blend many times and it is great!  Smooth light flavor.  Got a great deal on a 24pk for 14 bucks!  When i am out on the road and stop and your typical chain coffee places it doesn't taste as good after owning the kureig machine.  I love my kureig coffee maker! Best christmas gift that I have got in awhile!

I am giving this coffee a 5 star excellent rating.  It is absolutely delicious and has a perfect medium level balance that I assume is the result of the light roasting.  I am only a few weeks into my Keurig B40 and of all the k-cups I have tried so far this is the best.  It you want a mid-strength, delicious, "everyday type of coffee" this is the one for you.

I was expecting a plain old cup of coffee when I popped this into the Keurig; Imagine my surprise when it turned out to be a party in my mouth.  This coffee was delicious.  I will definitely buy this again.

I have never been a fan of decaf as it always seems to have an aftertaste for me.  This blend seems to circumvent that as there is no tinny taste of decaf (at least for my palate).Donut House just serves a great, mild blend, suitable for all.

They tapped into that need with their Light Roast version, which has has much wider availability that the venerable DD store brand.Check prices in brick and mortar stores (especially big box/club stores), where you might be able to do a little better (IF they have it in stock).This is by far the favorite K-cup choice in our house, which never goes a day without drinking coffee.

We have about 20 different varieties of coffees and teas at our house now that we've bought a Keurig.  Cuz you can.  This has become my favorite. Not too strong, not bitter, not flavored or sweet but not too weak.  Just a medium cup of joe.  Impossible to find in the stores.  So here I is.
GREEN MOUNTAIN DONUT HOUSE COFFEE LIGHT ROAST COFFEE 80 K-CUPS KEURIG- is one of the best coffee's I've ever had. I will purchase again.

column9: Great coffee that's not quite so strong!
column10: We have ordered this coffee several times now and it is our favorite.  It isn't as strong as some others are and we enjoy it every morning.  We highly recommend it for those who don't like the stronger coffee.
I always liked this Donut House coffee in the morning. It really does have that Donut Shoppe taste that gets my day going.
According to my taste buds this falls into the medium category. Good flavor, smooth. I like this for my day-to-day morning coffee. This is the first cup I have to get my day started.
The regular Donut House coffee is great. It is a light blend, like Dunkin Donuts. The flavored version though, cinnamon roll, was terrible.
Fast ship. Great cup of coffee, strong yet not bitter. I am from NY so for me the stronger the better
I have tried at least a dozen different kinds of K Cups and this one is my favorite. Five stars!

column9: The Best Old-Fashioned Coffee Shop Cup of Coffee!
column10: .Donut House blend is my favorite K-cup.It's a tried and true consistent cup of just about the best old-fashioned American coffee shop coffee you've ever had.Big thank you to Green Mountain Coffee Roasters for perfecting this classic cup.(If you're Costco member, this is one of the K-cup blends that my local Costco warehouse stocks in bulk cases of 108 for less than 45 cents a K cup.)
This is one of the better K-cups.  I usually don't like bold coffee, but it takes a bold k-cup for me to get a good cup of coffee.
I did like the extra strong coffee, it was not bitter like some coffees are.  Yes I would order again and so far amazon has the cheapest price.  Thank you

The coffee is excellent and I am a repeat buyer.  Problem this time was with the UPS delivery.  They left the box in front of my garage door in the middle of the driveway. Because of this odd delivery location, my wife ran over the box when she backed out of the garage and did not see the box.  we lost half of the cups.  Thius is the third time I have written about this matter to Amazon with no results.  Hopefully someone will respond to me.fred santaniello

In the past, the Donut House K-Cups have been of the highest quality & would have been rated 5 stars. However, even tho the quality of the product is still there, the last time I received the 80 pack, several of the K-Cups were broken & the coffee missing. SO FAR, This is the BEST K CUP coffee that I have found. It is not too bitter & not weak. To me, IT MAKES THE PERFECT CUP OF COFFEE.

this is a great second choice coffee. i live out in the boonies and cant get to a dunkin donut store very often (the only online source is a bit pricey )so i buy a lot of this product.this is the only other k-cup that i care for.
This makes a great cup of coffee and is not too strong. It's the perfect morning brew to get the day started.

This is my favorite coffee.  I drink a cup or two each morning.  To me, you cannot tell a differencebetween the decaf and caf flavor.  I prefer Donut House Coffee brand to others I have tried.  Nolingering aftertaste, no irritability caused.  Thank you for an enjoyable product.

column9: Light Roast: Bitter for this gal...
column10: I hate calling out an entire brand, but sadly, I must. I accidentally ordered this thinking it was a different, very similarly named brand, and didn't realize it I brewed a K-cup. It was so bitter, typical of this brand (this is my third attempt with this brand). And of course, I just had to accidentally buy the jumbo 24-count pack. Even with a 1/4 c of cream or a whole packet of hot cocoa, it still has a big bite to it. Anyway, it's just not for me. Good price, though, and arrived on time.
We've tried a lot of coffee cups and I find this one the best tasting.  I hit the "biggest" cup button and the coffee still has a lot of flavor for me.
I am very pleased with the Donut House K Kups brew.  It is good from the first cup to the last.  It must be good I am ordering another case right now.

The packaging is great since it has a perforated U-shaped slit at the front so that you can leave this box on a shelf and access the little k-cups through the perforated opening. When the box arrived intact; all the k-cups were intact. (We have ordered/used at least 4 of these boxes now).
It is OK, if you are in a hurry for a cup of decaf but I won't rave about it.  I bought it for my decaf drinking friends and family.  I guess I prefer decaf Folger's in my reusable Keurig cup.
I buy these for my dad...they are his favorite.  We normally buy Caribou Blend for ourselves, but these are a close 2nd.

column9: Not bad for a light roast!
column10: My father-in law purchased this coffee as an 80 count box at Sam's Club, and since he really likes it (and so does my mother-in-law, I thought I'd also give it a try. My preference is actually a darker (medium) roast, and I also prefer an extra bold amount, but for this coffee, if the water setting is on medium, then it's a good flavored, moderate wake-up coffee with only a very small amount of bitter aftertaste. In short, it's not bad for a light roast!

This ooffee is great it's not too strong but not weak. It has a nice flavor to it, and the price is right. I love the Keurig machines and am always on the lookout for K-cups and these are some of my favorites... great with a bagel and cream cheese or cereal in the morning or iced in the summer. A definate repurchase for me.

My family has owned a Keurig for about 6 or 7 months now and we have been buying this specific k cups since then. They have a very good flavor. It is also a plus that they are decaf.I would recommend this product  for anyone who loves coffee.

column9: Donut House Collection Light Roast K-cups
column10: The coffee is delicious.The problem is every time we try to brew it ,it clogs my Cuisinart k-cup brewer.I had the same problem with this brand in decaf.It doesn't happen with any other brand so I know it is the grind of this particular coffee.I will be throwing it out.

For some reason, I keep getting grinds with these K-Cups. I haven't had a problem with anything else in my Keurig. I'm not sure if the issue is with a bad lot, or the shipment. Regardless, I've gone through a few cups and plan to toss the rest of the box. Money wasted!
This is my favorite light roast.  Any flavored creamer goes in it tasting great.  As always, ordered $25 worth and got Free Super Saver Shipping!!

The Donut House Decaf has a great coffee flavor and seems to be near acid free. A great alternative to people who do not like the dark robust European flavor. I love them both and alternate between the Green Mountain Robust Magic and Donut House. Having tried most of the brands on the market these 2 stand out to me as having the best coffee flavor.If you don't like to drink "brown water" (stay away from the organic Newman's Own Decaf - horrid!) the Donut House is for you!

My mother really enjoyed this coffee.  Most other coffees are so strong but this she could drink it without watering it down. We received it a day or two earlier than I thought we would, so we were able to start enjoying earlier than planned.

This has become our go to decaf coffee.  we brew this one on the middle setting and it produces an aromatic and flavorful cup of cofee.  THe coffee is smooth with no bitterness.  Wish the product was availble on a subscribe and save.
I BOUGHT THIS COFFEE FOR MY BROTHER IN LAW AND HE LOVES IT. IT IS VERY REFRESHING COFFEE AND IT TASTE DELICIOUS.

column9: perfect for those who don't like strong, bitter coffee
column10: Don't buy this if you like Starbuck's coffee.  I love this because it is mild.  In the past, I bought Green Mountain coffee, but I always added water to dilute its taste.  This is a perfect mild taste.  K-cups are expensive, but these taste good, so it's worth the cost.

I purchased this coffee product for my wife.  She hasn't found another decaf k-cup brand that she prefers over this donut house product.  She loves this.  I prefer a deeper, more robust french roast flavor.
Love this coffee. Am a big fan of K-cup coffee and when I ordered this coffee I didn't know what to expect but it's wonderful!
This coffee has a good flavor, its just a little strong for my taste. I added some creamer and it tasted good, but I prefer Donut Shop.
THE DONUT HOUSE LIGHT ROAST COFFEE IS VERY GOOD.  IT WORKS WELL WITH THE KREIG COFFEE MAKER, AND THE COFFEE HAS VERY GOOD FLAVOR.
This was bought for my wife who loves coffee. She says the taste is good. It had a good mild flavor, not bitter but smooth. She says it is a good pick me up in the morning.

I purchased this product by accident for my Mom, but either way we were going to drink it. We ended up loving this coffee. Has a good bold taste. To me it almost tastes like Starbucks, but this is way better and cheaper!

If you own any of the Keurig K-Cup Brewers then you should definitely get this package. Its filled with 24 count K-Cups for your Keurig. Get a nice cup of coffee fast. They also have other flavors but this is for the Regular which we bought for ours. Nothing better in the morning than a nice fresh cup of coffee and I love the taste! Its not just a generic bland coffee blend. Please try!
The Donut House coffee is wonderful!  My husband wanted something lighter for the mornings - and he loves this!!!  The price is amazing via Amazon and the free shipping made it even better!!
Good flavor if you want a light brew and smells great when brewing.  I usually order 2 boxes so I get free shipping.

After shopping around for some K-cups that were affordable, I decided to give Donut House a try.  We don't like the heavier French roast types or flavored coffees, so this brand and type are a good one for us. We like a light  to medium roast coffee.

This blend has got me hooked. I was an avid DD fan but 11.99 for 14 cups. I even was grinding my own DD and using the adapter filters. Definitely cheaper. Still the convenience of the k-cup is nice.  Then I tried this blend. Not only is it comparible in taste...its actually better. Much better.  Sorry DD.  Since each even cheaper in quanitity I wonder how fresh the cups stay? This is,a great product .received it very quickly with no problems and would buy again. If u own a kreger you should try this it is good stuff.
THIS WAS A GREAT GIFT TO MYSELF THE COFFEE IS GREAT THE TURN AROUND TIME IS OUTSTANDING THE PRICE IS BETTER THAN MOST PLACES AROUND TOWN.

Diedrich Coffee, Dark French Roast, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2) is usually my coffee of choice, but I'm trying to find a lighter roast I enjoy. I'm still debating just tossing it out or letting it collect dust in the event I need to use it if I'm out of all other k-cups.This coffee made it to my "Do not buy again" list.

It was REALLY light - basically colored water, very little flavor if made on the recommended 8 oz brew size.  Not much better on a lower setting either.  If you like a very, very mild coffee, then this is for you.  I'm not a fan of strong coffee, but this was WAY to mild and I'll be making sure I'm getting the Coffee People Donut SHOP coffee rather than Donut HOUSE in the future!

Sure to please all with its flavor. I recommend it. The other fancier coffee are for those moments when you want to have the fancy stuff. Now, back to my cup of Joe.
I've been buying this product for over a year.  Nice taste, not too strong or weak.  Having tried a few different flavors, this one has been my favorite choice.
I don't like the burnt taste of Starbucks, so we ordered this coffee.  It comes out perfect on the 10 oz setting!  We are ordering more today.

column9: If Only it Didn't have BHT...
column10: This is a delicious cereal I enjoy with or without milk.  The big problem, and why I don't buy it...they add BHT (a preservative with questionable effects on the body).PROS:- Crunchy, holds up to milk well getting soggy slowly.- Great flavor, not too sweet, but sweet enough to be flavorful.- Makes a tasty snack when eaten dry, by itself.- Packed with whole grains, which I try to get a lot of in my diet.- No high fructose corn syrup.CONS:- Contains BHTOVERALL OPINIONThis is a very flavorful cereal.  Reminds me of Honey Nut Cheerios in a different form.  The flavor is similar.  Nicely sweetened without being over the top, and a great crunch.  Does make a good breakfast to start the day, and I've also eaten it dry as a snack.  Good snack in the car, at work, or wherever.  If they remove the BHT, I'll start buying it again.

I was left feeling as though I were trying to identify an unknown ingredient, instead of enjoying a familiar and well-loved flavor.  While most cereals don't last long in our pantry, this one has not been touched since we first tried it.

column9: Rolled Wheat Hot Cereal: Where are you??
column10: I was raised on Fisher's Zoom, then a popular rolled wheat hot cereal. They still make it, but you have to buy it on-line in case lots. Oatmeal is everywhere, but just try to find rolled wheat on the retail shelves. I was in Houston last week on business, and figured H.E.B. would carry it -- they have just about everything else... Nope! Bob's Red Mill Flakes Rolled Wheat is the closest thing to Zoom, but you'll never see it in the grocery or health food stores. You have to buy it on-line, four bags at a time. (But that's better than in case lots, and unlike Zoom, Bob's never cooks up lumpy.)Now, don't just pour milk and sugar on it. (Yuck!) Grow up and eat it British style, with butter (or your favorite margarine) and plenty of salt and pepper. (YUM!) If you have an aversion to butter, etc, try it with olive oil. (Mamma Mia!) Bob's cooks up in about 8 minutes on the stove top (yes I know, an eternity these days) -- 1/2 cup water to 1/4 cup cereal for one serving.If you mistakenly cook up too much, don't fret. Just press it into a 1/2" slab onto a buttered cookie sheet, cover with waxed paper, and store in the refrigerator over night. Next morning, cut the slab into strips and fry 'em up with your eggs and bacon. We called it "fried mush" when I was a kid.Anyway, try Bob's Red Mill Flakes Rolled Wheat cereal! You'll love it, and will forever be as regular as night follows day. Bob's Red Mill Rolled Wheat Hot Cereal -- 16 oz

I bought this as a birthday gift for my teenaged son, whose favorite food has always been bacon! He uses the baconnaise on every sandwich, and we have sampled the different baconsalts on just about anything that bacon would compliment! What a great idea, and I am thinking about buying these gift boxes for the guys on my Christmas list this year.

column9: Great idea for any bacon lover
column10: I got this for my friend who we jokingly call "the pork princess" because she has an amazing way with cooking all things pork.  It looked/sounded right up her alley.  It was a big hit!  I haven't tried anything made with it yet, but everyone loved the package (the box is printed with "bacon ribbon"), and kept asking me where I found it!  I have been promised some potato salad featuring the Baconnaise, and I'm looking forward to trying it!
Absolutely love the bacon Mayo.  Very natural bacon flavor, great on hamburgers!  The salts are great too!

These are great products.  The Baconnaise is a little strong for everyday sandwiches, but that is easily remedied by adding some plain mayo to it.  Not to mention it will stretch the amount you get for the money!  You will reach for it first.  Add a little full strength to sour cream for a baked potato topping. The seasonings are great on vegetables and anything with eggs.  Use it to season soups, and your guests will be trying to guess the ingredients.  Tomato soup with bacon seasoning, YUM. The seasonings would also make a great gift idea for your vegan friends. Christmas will be here before we know it. I thought the idea of bacon-flavored lip gloss was icky, but it is mild and I got over it.

Have not tried all of the salts, but the ones we have tried are excellent. Hubby sprinkles the original on fresh steamed green beans with butter spray and the bacon salt. DEEEELICIOUS.I tasted the Baconnaise plain and the bacon taste is authentic tasting. Have used it in tuna salad and POP! DEEEEEELICIOUS.

Awesome product.  Baconnaise is out of this world.  Still finding food items to try it on.  The different flavored bacon salts are excellent and work well with breakfast, lunch and dinner selections.  If you haven't tried this product, you must be living on another planet.  One of the best new products to come along in a long time.

I recently purchased this on a Gold Box deal, I was waiting for there to be an incentive before I took the plunge, but now that I have these delicious products, I realize it isn't worth waiting for a deal to pop up.  As soon as I run out of my bacon salt, I'm buying more!All the bacon salt varieties included in this set have their own subtle variations in flavor, my favorite being jalapeno, and without having a least favorite.  They all have a little bite to them that I attribute to black pepper, but aren't really spicy.  I'm not really sure if they truly taste like bacon, I have heard that the bacon flavor needs fat present to manifest itself.  I do know however, that it is so good, Ill just sprinkle some on my palm and lick it off.  Gross?  Maybe, but I bet you would lick my palm too :PI have never been a huge fan of either Mayo or Miracle Whip, but after trying the Baconnaise, I think my hierarchy is Baconnaise > Mayonnaise > Miracle Whip.  I can only imagine making some delicious baconized fry sauce! (typically mayo and ketchup mixed together, try it and be blown away.  Its almost a religion down here)If you have been waiting to buy this stuff but haven't quite been convinced, just take my word for it and buy.  If you don't like it, just send it my way!  That probably won't happen though, unfortunately for me.

I am so thankful that I took the time to purchase the Bacon Lover's Gift Pack. I cannot get enough of Baconnaise. I look forward to every sandwich they I get to it with it spread on it. I am a vegetarian and use it with veggie burgers and chik patties. The Bacon Salt included definitely enhances anything you are eating. I also have enjoyed using the Bacon lip balm. It's a nice idea.  Unfortunately, the fake bacon flavor just isn't convincing.  It tastes of salt, smoke and chemicals, but not meat.  They should have used real bacon, finely ground, instead of artificial flavorings.
Great product for the bacon lover, did not know that it can also be a used by the vegetarian family member.

My Mom bought a 3 pack from one of the TV shopping channels a few months ago. After watching the hosts "salivate" over the stuff, she ordered it.The result...BLECK! Horrible! Tastes fake and like chemicals. And the salt level...forget it. We had 5 different people taste all 3 and we all agreed, awful.I sent it back within a couple days. If you want bacon for heavens sake, buy some real bacon and forget this fake junk.
We didn't like these products at all. They all taste like very salty fake bacon, nothing at all like real bacon. My advice is to skip it - a big waste of money.

Just got these on Friday and they are awesome! Crisp, clean and refreshing! It was like drinking straight from a freshly cracked coconut. I've tried all the major brands and this is by far the best one out there.I had one after going to the gym and it was perfect. This thing has over 700mg of potassium and it's only 35 calories. That's the most potassium and lowest calories I've seen from any coconut water on the shelf. There is no added sugar. It's just naturally sweet. I can give in to my sweet tooth without any guilt!

column9: Best Coconut Water on the PLANET!!!
column10: There is SO much coconut water out there, it's like Oprah...it is everywhere!I'm just glad that after trying Zico (pretty good) and Vita Coco (a bit strange tasting/too sweet), I was open to trying another one.  I don't know how Harvest Bay does it, but their coconut water tastes as close to drinking fresh coconut water as you can get.  It is absolutely delicious.

In my household, we drink coconut water every day;  we did a taste off last summer between Zico over Vita Coco, finding Zico to taste natural while Vita Coco tasted artificial and sweet.We recently discovered Harvest Bay coconut water, and it's our new favorite.  It truly brings to mind the taste of fresh coconut.  We still enjoy Zico, but Harvest Bay seems to have a little extra something, and is now the reigning champ in our fridge.The slightly slimmer box is nice too;  although it contains less liquid, it's nice to hold and also contains more potassium.

I have tried almost every coconut water out there.  I wanted to try this product because it is the lowest calorie coconut water I have seen out there and I read about it in several other media sources.  I have to say that this coconut water is great.  It really does taste like it's fresh out of a coconut. It is very refreshing and has a great nutty aftertaste. I love to drink this after a workout because I just feel like it replenishes me.  I would say this is one of my favorite coconut water's that I have tried based on the taste, that it is organic, and low calorie.  I would recommend this to anyone looking to find an authentic coconut water.
Harvest bay coconut water has low sugar, is not too sweet and tastes great! One of the better brands of coconut water.

I must admit I was surprised to see food available on Amazon.  I decided to see what happens when coconut water comes from UPS.  It was very easy, 12 little bottles came right to my door.  Harvest Bay is very good and has a lot of potassium.  Definitely will buy more.  You should too!!!!

column9: Taste is closest to the fresh stuff
column10: We have tried a lot of coconut waters. If you like the taste of real fresh coconut water, this brand comes the closest. My husband grew up drinking the stuff right out of the coconut and this resembles it the most. If you are new to coconut water, you may not like this at all though. Fresh coconut water does NOT taste like coconut flesh. It is a taste that you may have to get used to or may not ever like at all. If you like the nutty flavor of the coconut, go for Nirvana (and to some extent Zico) which tastes like the white coconut flesh. Of all brands we tried, Harvest Bay Coconut water's flavor tastes the most like fresh coco water and the least like coconut flesh.

column9: Delicious, but 8.5 oz containers are too small!
column10: I typically drink Vita Coco, Zico, ONE and Nature's Guru instant coconut water. These are truly green, somewhat tasteless Central American coconuts. When Harvest Bay came I immediately tried one and was pleased by the full flavored 'nutty' taste of Thai coconuts. It's like drinking light beer and then trying regular. Now light doesn't taste so good anymore. The only draw back is the containers are very small, less than nine ounces.

column9: Why This  Tastes Better than Zico or Vita Coco
column10: I am a coconut water aficianado if not connoisseur and this product tastes better than almost every other one I have tried with the possible exception of Nirvana in the glass bottles.  Why?  It has to be the quality of the coconuts.  When I say taste better, this has the solid finish of higher quality produce, like a fine wine...it doesn't go down a little sour, like most coco water (reminding some faintly of urine, unfortunately) but it has a nice robust coco-nutty finish that just tastes fabulous.  This is the real deal.  Imagine how good it would taste in a glass bottle!  The analogy I would use is that Harvest bay is to most coco water as fresh squeezed unpasteurized OJ is to store bought pasteurized OJ.  Enjoy!

I noticed it says it's product of Thailand maybe the coconuts taste different there. So maybe that why some people like the flavor of this one. I prefer milder tasting coconut water.

column9: most natural tasting coconut water and less sweet than others
column10: I've tried several different kinds of coconut water and had settled on Vita Coco for a while, but it was always hit or miss.  Sometimes it was really good, sometimes it was sour and off tasting, and it was always ALWAYS way too sweet, so I could only drink about a third of a bottle before putting it back in the frig.  Inevitably, whenever I went back for more, the once yummy coconut water would have already begun to taste "off," leaving an odd aftertaste. Browsing the selection of coconut waters at my local health food store, I came across Harvest Bay coconut water, and it is, hands down, the best and most natural-tasting I've ever had.  There isn't the strange sourness that is in other coconut waters that often have added vitamin C or citric acid (such as Vita Coco).  Harvest Bay seems to be 100% pure coconut water - or at least it certainly tastes like it, and the only ingredient listed on the bottle is coconut water.  There is no aftertaste whatsoever - very refreshing!  Keep in mind that the bottles are on the small side, which is fine for me because I can only drink coconut water in small amounts.  Also, it seems to have a lot less sugar in it, although that could simply be from the small 8.45 fl oz amount (Vita Coco has 11 grams per 11 oz serving, if I remember correctly, while Harvest Bay only has 6 grams of sugar per 8.45 oz serving).  Either way, it tastes way less sweet than previous coconut waters I've tried, which equals perfection for someone like me who doesn't like super-sweet anything. Much of this probably has to do with the location of the coconut and/or the ripeness.  I've read that these can factor into taste and sweetness.  If I remember correctly, Vita Coco is a product of the Philippines, while Harvest Bay is a product of Thailand (or at least that's what the bottle states).  Apparently I prefer Thai coconuts, or whatever it is that makes this product less sweet.

Just purchased a case based on the latest rave reviews and am very disappointed. It is sour not fresh and has unpleasant taste like muddy water.After tasting Amy and Brian(the best so far IMHO), Nirvana (not bad but taste is too overpowering for me) , Zicco (ok, not bad) , Naked (sour) and Vita (not bad) I feed that it almost tastes spoiled by comparison to brands I mentioned.

column9: Dog went from flabby to fit
column10: My dog had a good result with this food, but it wasn't what I expected. My veterinarian wanted my dog to lose weight because my dog had no indentation at his waist or under his belly.  I tried Blue Buffalo Longevity Dry Food for Adult Dogs, 24-Pound Bag, but his physique never improved and his weight never went down. For both weight-loss foods, I used a calorie-determination formula instead of the feeding guides. For both foods, the feeding guides on the bags recommended a lot more food than the formula (see formula at end of review.)Many dogs will not drink enough to process a very high protein dog food like Premium Edge (49% protein) even when fresh water is offerred. I suspect dogs may limit their drinking to accommodate a potty schedule.  At  my dog's 2 daily feedings, I add  enough warm water to just cover his kibble. (When I first added the water, my dog had accidents because I feed him after his morning exercise walk.  I had to change his feeding to 30 minutes before his walk.)  I let the food it soak on the counter for 2 minutes, and then I stir in 2 heaping table-spoons of low-sodium canned green beans (10 cals.)  My dog eats the food with gusto and seems to feel full after he eats. He begs less and is happy with small treats. On the other weight-loss food, he was acting full at first but, after a few weeks, he began begging for food right after he ate, even with the water and green beans.I also should say that I walked my dog about a mile per day on both weight-loss foods.When the vet saw my dog 6 weeks after switching to Premium Edge, I though he was going to tell me to go back to my dog's old food because, on my scale at home, he gained 3 pounds.  I was so frustrated.  To my surprise, the vet told me that my dog was in excellent condition.  The weight gain was due to higher muscle mass! His waist and belly were not flabby at all anymore. I guess the high-protein levels in this food are giving my dog what he needs to grow muscle, and the increase in muscle mass enables him to burn the fat more efficiently. He may have been so hungry on the other food because he needed more protein. I am so happy with the results that I am continuing to feed my dog the same food at the same amount indefinitely. He is still very satisfied with his food.If you are not willing to exerise your dog every day, I don't know if you will get this result, but I think it is a fabulous food if you are committed to walking your dog a long way each day, rain or shine.  It is an economical yet high-quality food.At 49%, this is the highest-protein in a dry dog food I have ever seen. Not even Blue Buffalo Wilderness Grain Free Dry Dog Food, Salmon Recipe, 24-Pound Bag, which is grain-free,  comes close to this food in protein.  To get this much protein, I ordinarily would have to feed wet food.  There was no way I could afford wet food for my dog--it would cost $120 per month to feed my dog a quality, high-protein wet food. For a low-quality (and lower protein) wet food, it would cost $45/month, whereas Premium Edge dry food costs me about $25/month.In addition, this food is high in fibre, grain-free, low fat, and contains omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids, probiotics, and chelated minerals (which are more bio-available than minerals that are not "chelated" to protein.) At 347 calories per cup, it is it is as low in calories as Blue Buffalo Longevity Dry Food for Adult Dogs, 24-Pound Bag, but Premium Edge has more than twice the protein and no calories from grains.As with every dog food label I have ever read, the feeding guide on Premium Edge over-feeds the dog.  If I followed the instructions on the Premium Edge bag, I would be feeding 2 1/4 cups per day. According to Waltham Centre for Pet Nutrition, the calories a dog should consume to lose weight is computed as follows: (1)Determine your dog's "ideal" weight with your vet or by looking up your dog's breed (or predominant breed) with the AKC. If your dog ever appeared to be a healthy weight, you can use that past weight as an ideal weight. Convert his ideal weight in pounds to kilograms by dividing the pounds by 2.2. For my dog, 44 lbs over 2.2= 20 (2) Multiply her weight in KG by 30. For my dog 20*30 is 600. (3)Add 70. In my dog's case, 600+70=670 calories per day. This food is 347 calories per cup, so 670/347 = 1.93 cups per day is the most my dog should be fed. The Premium Edge feeding guide recommends 2 1/4 cups per day, which is 781 calories.  A small difference in serving size makes a difference of over 100 calories.  Ironically, my dog is well-above his 44 lb "ideal" weight, but he is at a new "ideal" weight with heavy muscle mass.

After reading the product claims and ingredients on this product, I was intrigued by the promise of weight loss, but concerned about the presence of corn gluten meal as the #3 ingredient.  I contacted the company's staff veterinarian, who assured me it was a good source of protein.  With some misgivings, I placed my miniature schnauzer Cicero on this diet to assist in his trimming down about 2 pounds.  We had previously tried Wellness Weight Management, with no weight loss result and too many trips outside due to the high fiber content.  (Cicero had been raised on Innova prior to the Wellness effort at diet).  Not only did my pup not lose weight, he gained a pound in the two weeks he ate this, and developed a yeast infection which presented symptions in his right ear and on his back.  My readings confirm the suspicion that this was a direct result of the corn gluten meal, as he had never before had a food with any corn ingredient.  I immediately suspended feeding this product, sent the company proof-of-purchase verification for a refund, and conducted an exhaustive search of all-natural high protein foods without grains or filler ingredients which I would feed in controlled smaller portions, rather than another "lite" or "weight management" formula.  Am delighted to report that Cicero is doing beautifully on a combination of Innova EVO and Timberwolf Organics, and that Premium Edge refunded my purchase price in full.  To their credit, the manufacturer was immediately responsive to my emails and sent the refund check within a week.

column10: I was looking for a high quality dog food which is affordable for my two dogs. I liked the ingredient list as well as the nutrient content on this brand. I haven't really heard of the brand before but did a search on it and found some favorable reviews. My dogs really love it and it seems like the amount listed on the package to feed (based on weight) seems to satisfy them.  They are not extremely active so I have to watch their weight. Also there seems to be not a lot of waste (yard clean-up) associated with the food which tells me it doesn't have tons of fillers. Overall I think this is a quality food and a great buy.

My dogs really seem to love this stuff, but we're still transitioning from a combination of Blue Buffalo Weigth Control and Purina Beyond.  Not sure if they "love" it just because they're on diets and want more food or if they really enjoy the flavor :)  I switched to this after reading several reviews, including the dogfoodadvisor.com 5 star rating.  We needed a food that had fewer calories per cup so that we could try to give the dogs a little more quantity without increasing the total caloric intake.  I was ready to stick with the Blue Buffalo Weight Control, but decided to go with this instead.  No problems with the Blue Buffalo, they really seemed to like that too, just needed lower caloric density to help us achieve our weigh goals for the dogs.  Each time I up the ratio of Premium Edge to the Blue Buffalo/Purina Beyond mix, their stool gets a little mushy - but this is to be expected as you're adjusting your dogs diet.  I expect it will be a full month before I've fully transitioned them to Premium Edge.  I tried to find this at a local pet store and the best I could do was an offer to special order it for me.  Being able to buy this on amazon and have it delivered straight to the house is really convenient.

over the years our 4 dogs have put on weight, Dog Food Reviews online rates this kibble their highest rating.  you can smell the salmon in it so our dogs come running when you open the bag and eagerly await filling their bowls. I can feed them less as it is more filling.  they have all lost a few pounds. I have had no problems with switching them to it either.  I highly recommend.

He gained the extra weight gradually after he slipped a disc in his back (as this breed very commonly does) while jumping off the couch. Extra weight is dangerous for any dog, but especially so for dogs with long backs and even more so for those with previous injuries. So, with all that in mind, I clearly had to choose his food carefully. I relied heavily on the advise of [...] (awesome website) and I could not be more pleased with the feed I chose: Premium Edge Healthy Weight. He has lost 5 pounds since November (5 months) and is continuing steadily with controlled caloric intake based on his daily activity. I highly recommend this feed for this particularly vicious combination of permanently limited activity and necessary weight loss. I also recommend the website I mentioned above that helped me choose it, as they are very easy to navigate as well as being highly informative. Now that he has lost most of the extra pounds, I can tell that his back is much healthier than when he had to carry all that excess weight around. He plays longer and runs farther and is just a happier dog all around- a very good thing.

column9: Best dry dog food available for the price
column10: I did a lot of research before trying the Premium Edge dog food. This high protein dog food was ranked at the top of just about all dog food commercially available at this price point. My two blue ticked beagles have lost almost 8 pounds total (a little over a year time period). They love the food and I know I am providing the best dog food I can for the money. I mix a little of the Healthy Hips can dog food just to dress it up and the dogs love it. You CAN NOT switch dog foods in two weeks when using this product. It has far more protein than most dogs will ever get in a commercial dog food. I highly recommend a VERY SLOW transition that takes place over a minimum of two months, an eighth of a cup per cup at a time when replacing another dry dog food. It also contains chelated vitamins for easier absorbtion, omega 3, and other essential ingredients for a healthy diet.

And for this recall you have to have the bag to be certain that your batch is or isn't involved. Without the bag, nether the manufacturer or distributor will do anything except to tell you, "when in doubt, throw it out." My feeling is that the manufacturer, knowing that I ordered during the time in question, should offer to replace my food, but that was not the case. My chubby female dog lost around 2 inches already. she was getting bigger so fast that she had to get a bigger harness!!!Now she is better. Hope she loses a little more. Also got newman's own organics beef canned food. They're super high in protein and super low in fat and carbs. The dogs LOVE THEM too!! :)

My dog Maxwell has been on this for about three months and has lost 7 pounds. I mix a half cup with greenbeans (per his vet's instructions) and a tiny bit of Cesar Gourmet Fillet Wet food. He loves it. It fills him up and he is losing weight well.

Bought to try and get my Chihuahua to loose a little weight.  At first he liked this food, but after a week of slowly switching him to it - he now seems to be eating it reluctantly.This is the best site to buy this item from - quick shipping too.

My dog ate nothing but this food for 3 months. I gave him the recommended amount and everything. Not only didn't he lose weight, he gained 6 pounds!!! Not worth the money or the trouble although he loved the way it tasted. Smells very strong because it has salmon in it.

We decided to try this dogfood because it was a few dollars cheaper than the Iams weight control that we normally buy.  We have spent FAR more than those few dollars in paper towels and cleaning supplies.  I guess because of the name, we thought it was a premium dog food.  If it is, it is the worst stuff we have ever tried.  I would go back to a cheap brand before ever buying this stuff again.  The dogs may lose weight, but if so, the dehydration from the diarrhea is a much worse consequence.  I expected some digestive problems with the change, but it has been almost 2 weeks, and no change in the problem.  I had to go to the store and buy our usual.  I wont even set this stuff out where stray dogs can get it.  Lesson Learned!
I expected this assortment to be a little larger but the products in it were of good quality. The vendor had a quick shipping turn-around time.

column9: I used to love this gum.
column10: I remember when Stride first came out. I was amazing how long the flavor lasted!With this new 2.0 Stride Sweet Peppermint, it just doesn't last as long. I like the foil wrapper (they don't "sweat" like the old ones). The flavor and consistency are great too. However, the flavor just doesn't last like it used to. So overall this is a step in the wrong direction.
I hate the NEW and IMPROVED Stride 2.0, which I purchased for years.I Do Not like the foil wrapper, or the taste of the gum.(Flavor DOES NOT LAST.)I have switched to Orbit White bubblemint. YUM!

I was hoping this was the original version of Stride Sweet Peppermint like everyone else.  They need to change the picture!!~  The new version is rubbery and loses its flavor very quickly compared to the original.  STRIDE, BRING BACK THE ORIGINAL!!!!!

column9: If this is Stride 2.0, this is very misleading
column10: This is misleading and Amazon should attempt to correct this problem. This ad shows the packaging for the original Stride Peppermint Gum and the various reviewers state this is actually the NEW version.I was considering ordering this (old) stock as I have tried the new Stride 2.0 and was very disappointed.Bottom line - I won't purchase Stride 2.0 as it has an unpleasant taste and (luckily), the flavor doesn't last.

column9: this is the 2.0 version..not the original sweet peppermint
column10: this is the new sweet peppermint stride gum..version 2.0. the item picture is not correct. it is not the original sweet peppermint gum that you can't find anywhere!!

I became a fan of Stride gum the first time I tried their Winterblue flavor; I've since tried their spearmint and sweet peppermint.  I like all 3, depending on my mood, sweet peppermint is my favorite. Other times, I enjoy spearmint the most. Sweet Peppermint tastes like those round, hard, red & white striped candies; only it's a tiny bit sweeter.  The flavor lasts a long time, just as advertised.  I can even blow small bubbles with it!

With Amazon Prime and the price of this 12-pack of gum, you'll be out Costco, Walmart, Sam's Club, and BJ's in price.  And you won't have to take yourself to the store, or have a membership card to reap the benefits here.  Definitely a good buy if you like this type of gum.NOTE: This is a box of 12 packs of standard Stride 14pc.gum. If you think it's anything other than that, it's your mistake.

I chew this gum pretty much constantly (occasionally other Stride flavours too, but I prefer this one - just the right blend of mild sweetness and mint). I take a prescription that makes me really nauseous and sensitive to smells, and chewing gum helps to combat that. I've tried a ton of different brands, and so far, this is the only one that doesn't give me horrible cramps. I suspect it's because most other sugar-free gums contain maltitol, but anyway, Stride's the only kind of gum I'll buy, particularly this kind.As some reviewers have pointed out, if you order this on here either via Subscribe & Save or as a single order, you'll still get the Stride 2.0 version, not the original Sweet Peppermint (RIP, and they really should change the photo). It's not as good as the original was, but it's still a pretty decent flavour and just as long-lasting. The sweetness does sort of wear off, after a while, and it becomes a bit bitter (but if you're like me and like bitter stuff, it's all for the better!).

I don't write a lot of reviews... but I had to try to combat all this hate on my favorite gum.It is true that they changed the flavor with V 2.0. The new wrapper did impart a strange taste on the gum at first. I considered switching for a bit, but being as lazy as I am, I waited it out and they fixed whatever had gone wrong.Give it a go, see if you like it.The flavor lasts just as long as it ever did.
I loved the original Stride, but they changed the recipe or something and it is now rubbery and loses its flavor quickly.  I hate the new change and won't buy anymore.  I plan to find another brand.

The combination of minty refreshing-ness with a hint of sweetness is great, and the gum lasts a really long time. When it finally loses its flavor, it doesn't have that gross empty gum taste like a lot of others. I've chewed on one piece for probably 12 hours, and it didn't get annoying or gross.
It is bubble gum. The flavour is supposed to last for much longer, but to my taste, it lasted no longer than any other gum! End of story.Mrbluenun
This is one of the best tasting green teas I have found and I have been drinking it several years now. I can always find it on Amazon at a reasonable price.

Bought this for my dad so he could experience the taste of Buffalo! Having lived in the midwest where buffalo meat can be easily purchased at every grocery store, I wanted to make sure my dad wasn't missing out. Buffalo meat is so lean and healthy, not to mention VERY expensive, so this set is a good deal overall. He thoroughly enjoyed the sausages with crackers and shared them with many friends, who also enjoyed. A great variety and size - perfect for passing around the camp site!

Great stuff. Not only healthy, but keeps you going for a long time...must be a different type of natural caffeine or something. Just be careful about drinking it too close to bed time or you'll be up very late at night. Anytime I drink it too late, I wind up doing alot of stuff around the house...with bleary eyed pets (i.e., cats) staring at me and wondering when I'm going to sleep.

This green tea has a very smooth mellow taste. I have tried different green teas and this is the best I have every tasted. I have been ordering this product for a couple of years now. If you love a good green tea, this is the one!

I know my green tea, and every single tea that I've had from a bag has been horrible..  So I was really scared to try this, but based on the reviews I gave it a go.  HOLY impressed..  I could swear I'm drinking freshly brewed $100/lb Gyokuro... only slightly more bitter.  Great stuff, and especially for the price!  Hands down the best bagged tea I've ever had!
The box has Japanese written on it, but this tea is actually made in China, not Japan.Be aware of the pesticide residue in all Chinese agricultural products, especially tea leaves.
Simply the best green tea ever...always go back! Smooth, never bitter and is a nice mid-afternoon 'pick-me-up' at the office before tennis time! Good stuff. KB

I first tried Yamamotoyama green tea at a Japanese restaurant.  I was enjoying it so much, I asked the server if she would tell me what brand it was, and she brought out a box of this tea, and told me that is all they use.  I usually make 2 cups with each teabag, since I like mine mild.  The flavor is wonderful, and the price is good, very good actually for the quality. I highly recommend this product to anyone who enjoys a great cup of green tea.

Maybe I'm not the greatest tea connoisseur, but I'm pretty picky. This is the best green tea from a tea bag I've ever had. They also have very good oolong. Every tea bag is individually sealed in an aluminum wrapper, which helps to keep it fresh. I just started buying it recently -- I get it at a local store (Berkeley Bowl). It's definitely better than the stuff that costs 5-6 times more.By the way, nether the box nor the packets say where the tea is actually from. Another reviewer thinks it's Chinese.

I've drank a few boxes of Yamamotoyama's green tea and I must say I haven't gotten tired of it yet. It's really refreshing in that it is very neutral tasting with not a lot of `bite' to it (I suppose you can also describe it as bitterness). I've even disregarded the 1 to 3 minute steep time and left the bag in for a stronger green tea and it hasn't disappointed me. The tea steeps to a nice green color (hence the green  , tastes ever so slightly earthy. It's hard for me to give an accurate description to a newcomer, but there are no surprises in this tea. It's just a solid basic green tea.I would say if you're new to green tea, then this is a good starter tea to go with. It's friendly in the sense that you almost can't oversteep it and it's very light, even for a green tea. It's also accessible and `upgradedable,' because once you've had enough of their green tea, they have a wide variety of more expensive premium teas to choose from. If you want a tea to drink on a daily basis, I give this tea my full recommendation.

column9: The best tasting green tea I've found so far
column10: I've been drinking this tea for a few years now, occasionally trying other brands for comparison. I keep coming back to Yamamotoyama. I just love the flavor, never bitter.
I drink this green tea by Yamamotoyama for almost three years already. I am impressed by the quality and the taste.  Highly recommended

Yamamotoyama Green Tea was given to me by a friend when I was trying to ween myself off coffee and I've been drinking it ever since! It's got a slightly heavy, distinct flavor that's hard to describe, but as many other people say, it is extremely smooth. I generally have it with a little honey and it's great. I've also found that when I drink a cup after I eat it helps my (very fickle) stomach lol! Try it and you will most definitely be hooked.  ;)

This brand of green tea no where in taste like the wonderful and refreshing flavor I've tasted in many Asian restaurants.  There is nothing fragrant or enjoyable about this tea...the strange, dull flavor is indescribable.  I'm going back to my Bigelow faves.  What a wasted purchase!
I was looking for an authentic tasting green tea.  I lived in Japan for a while, so I really wanted something that tasted like "home."  This did it.  Very good.
Yamamotoyama is the best sencha green available in individual packets. For taste and quality it beats anything else I have tried.

I had just enjoyed this tea at a restaurant this evening. I enjoyed 6 or 7 cups with my meal. It does not have the bitterness that most green teas have, after leaving the bag in too long. I like to leave the bag in to get as much from the tea as I can, for the health benefits, of which there are many. I believe everyone should drink green tea, and this one tastes great. Maybe a slight bitterness but not much, it was a very smooth, fresh tasting green tea. It had that classic green tea flavor that I enjoy. As I don't care much for black or oolong teas. This was one of the best brand name green teas that I have ever had, so much that I looked it up when I got home and am now posting this review.

I had this tea at a Japanese restaurant and loved the flavor. I didn't feel like I needed to add anything to it. Every other brand I have tried has a bitter taste. There is just no comparison; this is the best green tea I have ever tried.

Our son-in-law, Japanese by birth and heritage, strongly recommended this brand of tea to us for its overall excellence.  We have found it to be delicious, clear and just right whether served hot or cold.  It is now our substitute for sugar-laden breakfast drinks.

Not good. Heard many good things about Yamamotoyama.  Maybe their higher end tea lines are much better, but this one is not. It is so bad, that I will not even give their other products a shot.  Too bad, because I drink a lot of tea.

I haven't seen these since I was a little kid.  Used to find them in Hi-Health stores.  All-natural, preservative free and you wouldn't believe it.  The red packages are plain honey and VERY sweet.  They will give you a sugar buzz for sure.  Milk and honey are my favorite.  Don't know how you would describe "milk" flavor but whatever it is, it softens the honey flavor and makes them great.  I don't like menthol so I'll leave the description of those to those who might like them. :)These are made by a company in Italy and again, they are probably the best candy I've ever had in my life.  They are hard coated but after a bit become soft and they are filled with honey or 'milk and honey' centers.  Not something that will break your teeth.  These are well worth the price, and without all the extra gunk in all the other candies out there these days.  Get some!

Oh, these candies are INCREDIBLE!!- Now i don't have to scavenge around Times Square in search of them (and then hoard them away) - Calories be damned, i can eat the entire little packet in one sitting! - Love them!!! - Pure creamy, honey deliciousness!

I love this candy! Its sweet and creamy, almost like toffee when it gets soft. Def a favorite and all natural to boot! I like to use these on my kids when they have a sore throat. They don't like minty menthol candies, but like these and honey is a natural antiseptic, so it gives some healing and relief.(I bought the eucalyptus as well for coughs, but I don't like it as much as these).

Last year I had coronary bypass surgery and my daughter came to stay with me. She went food shopping and ran across these little gems. She remembered me eating them from when she was a child. Well, now she is hooked on them too. I love the milk and honey the best, and the older the better. I love it when the hard part of the candy becomes soft and the whole thing is chewy. I purchased a box, but the expiration date is 2014. They will be long gone before they get chewy.I can always count on Amazon to have whatever product I am looking for.
I bought these after getting addicted to the Honees Honey candy, I prefer the plain Honey over the Milk and Honey, but these are ok.

Tony Luke has made a name for himself here in Philadelphia with his sandwiches. The Roast Pork sandwiches are a favorite of many. Now his company is marketing a frozen version of the Pork Sandwich, which I recently tried. (1) the meat tasted oldish--not quite bad, but not fresh. (2) The method of heating the pork (boiling bag in jus) means the pork does not have a "roasted" flavor, and the "Italian seasoned jus" does not hide the off flavor of the pork. (3) The bun is cheap, nothing special. (4) There were actually two pieces of bone in my sandwich. My impression was that big bucks became more important than quality.His fresh made sandwiches are probably better, but the frozen variety is a rip off.
I can't believe how good this is! I added mushrooms - ground beef and a full meal was born.  Try it.
This is one of the tastiest meals I have ever eaten. You won't believe how tasty until you try it.
I usually don't care for packaged potatoes, BUT, this is truly delish for a quick, easy meal!Cannot wait too try it with added beef  (or even chicken!) as suggested here! Yum :)
Great candy to fill a cookie jar.  Even with shipping the price can't be beat.  I have orderd about 6 times so far and will until my teeth fall out.

There was a mixup in our order. After calling the company we found out it was an honest mistake. We were told to keep the product and were refunded our money the same day. Any company that stands behind what they sell is A+ in my book and won't hesitate to do business with them in the future.
Are you seriously looking for a review of Hershey's miniature candy bars? Yeah, they're still chocolate and yeah they're still super yummy. Duh!

It was just a little too spicy-hot for me. I sold both bottles to people at work who have tried it before and love it. I think they buy it by the case! Also, the service and quick shipping from this seller were A-1+. I recommend buying from them.

This is a great hot sauce. Lots of fire, but not to the point that there's no taste. (When sauces get too hot all you can sense is the heat. The trick for a great hot sauce is to stop before you get to that point.) The blend of chilies gives a nice, rich flavor in a hot, but not overwhelming, sauce. But look for a good price--what's here at the moment is way too high.

I bought this cheese sauce for a fundraiser.  The price was good, especially since Amazon delivers it right to your door.  The cheese sauce tastes just like you would expect cheese for your nachos to taste.
As long as you know when to take it away (once they have worn it down to bite size) You should be pretty happy with this product. It keeps your avid chewer very busy!

I bought this bone for my 2 dogs- a greyhound who is an aggressive chewer, and a border collie who's more interested in taste (he likes to just lick rawhide.) I had hoped this would prove a longer lasting alternative to rawhide for the greyhound, and if not, I thought at least the other dog would like it. Well I bought this weeks ago and so far I can't convince either dog to be interested. As far as they're concerned, it's a flavorless hunk of plastic.

column9: Not the reaction I was going for.
column10: I bought this for our big time chewer/border collie but she wanted nothing to do with it. I think it's the hard plastic-y look and feel of it that she's not crazy about. She'd much rather have some rawhide, pigs ears and more natural chew toys....or my flip flops inadvertantly left on the back porch.

I bought this bone for a neighbor dog because it was just like the big Nylabones I buy for our dogs.  They just pick them up to gnaw on them throughout the day.  The bones may be left lying around because they don't leave a residue on the carpets.

Bought these for my teething 3.5 month old Wheaten Terrier and she went to town on them. Last quite a while and pass through my dogs system pretty easily without causing any heavy diarrhea or making her sick. Def recommend this for a teething dog or just a dog who loves to chew (which is pretty much ALL dogs). My silky terrier finds these extremely uninteresting, but she's a picky brat. If your dog will chew on anything with even a slight flavor, these will work out well.

column9: Durable Nylabones are Less Durable Lately.,,
column10: These durable Nylabones seem to be somewhat less durable in the past couple years.  I have an older Nylabone in the same flavor  & size that my dog is still working at, and it's still in good shape. But I've purchased two more in the past year, in this and another flavor, and each time the pieces of plastic come away too easily & quickly.  By 20 minutes into chewing, there are too many large pieces coming off, and I have to take it away. Swallowing this stuff is not good. I think Nylabone might be intentionally making these LESS durable so that we'll have to buy them more often, since the old ones lasted a lifetime.Also - note that this item is indeed the newer, textured version of the toy.  I was hoping it wouldn't be, but I couldn't find it in this flavor and size in the untextured, and the description didn't mention it either way. My dog didn't seem to care either.As for all the Souper sized Nylabones, I wish they'd make the same thing just a bit longer in length. My dog is very tall but with a long narrow snout. He doesn't like anything that's too big to easily get in his mouth, like the "big" dog Nylabone toys. This toy is almost long enough for him to hold it well with his paws while chewing, but not quite.

column9: For very small dogs and puppies only
column10: I purchased this product for my puppy when she was 8 weeks old. It was an appropriate size for her at that time (Boston terrier). It appears well made, but it was not enticing for my puppy. She would rather chew on a bully stick or pig ear than this bone.
