I didn't understand the sizing of "wolf" as being a medium bone. My dogs need large bones, but they love it anyway. It just won't last as long.
I have 3 dogs ranging from puppy to 3 years, all different breeds and sizes- and all 3  sniffed this and then walked away. Waste of my money :(

column9: Absolutely no baon flavor in it
column10: I bought this bone for my two beagles.  But they don't chew this bone often. If this bone has bacon flavor, I bet they will not only chew it everyday, they will finish the bone in several weeks.  This bone has only bacon color.  This is just an ordinary plastic bone.

column9: My dog choked on the Edible Bone
column10: Warning to other dog owners: the edible Nylabones are extremely dangerous for dogs with a big & greedy appetite.  My dog swallowed it whole within 30 seconds of giving it to her and choked on it.  She was fully unconscious before I could dislodge the bone and breathe into her nose to bring her back to life... We almost lost her over this bone.  If your dog is a greedy chewer or eater, then please don't buy edible Nylabones.
Unfortunately, my 6 month old Weimaraner loves to chew on everything except this bone!!!  I was hoping this would distract him from destroying my son's toys, our furniture, etc., but no such luck.

My Lab has always been an extremely aggressive chewer, to the point where we don't dare get him any plush chew toys any more because they'll be shredded on the first day. We got this for him when he was about 4 months old and he showed no interest in it. He much preferred the Nylabone Dura Chew Wishbone Wolf instead. This was simply too big for him and he preferred other chew toys that fit his smaller jaws better.He's now 7 months old and he's grown to the point where he LOVES this Nylabone. It's super hard so it'll last a very long time for even the most aggressive chewer. As with any hard plastic chew you need to supervise: throw it out before it gets too small.

The Nylabone Souper is the best product I have found for my aggressive chewing dog, a lab mix. Nylabones give her a safe and very effective outlet for her chewing needs, and help keep her teeth clean. Highly recommended.

If I didn't have nylabones my pitbull would get bored and eat everything.  I can leave her home for hours and know that she isn't getting into trouble around the house. They are also great because it takes her atleast a month to chew through it, nothing I have ever brought home has lasted even a week.

We have two smaller dogs, 13 and 14 pounds.  They both loved to chew on these bones.  They would chew for hours--until there was nothing left!  Then one day one of them got sick.  Within 36 hours he was gone!  We are devastated!  A piece of nylabone broke off and lodged in his intestine.  It did not show up on X-Rays since it is a plastic substance.  Always supervise your pet with their toys.  You never know when something like this can happen.  We have found that this is not an isolated occurrence.  You can read other stories at this site:  [...]
Nylabones last forever and a day and all four of our dogs, big and small, love them.

We have two smaller dogs, 13 and 14 pounds.  They both loved to chew on these bones.  They would chew for hours--until there was nothing left!  Then one day one of them got sick.  Within 36 hours he was gone!  We are devastated!  A piece of nylabone broke off and lodged in his intestine.  It did not show up on X-Rays since it is a plastic substance.  Always supervise your pet with their toys.  You never know when something like this can happen.  We have found that this is not an isolated occurrence.  You can read other stories at this site:  [...]

This is truelly the nylabone you want to buy.  Others that are out there to buy for your dog are not the same as this one is.  If you have a chewer, this is the bone for you.  It looks like plastic but isn't.  they can chew and chew and it does not splinter or break apart.  We have a 60 pound lab/greyhound mix and she chews everything to shreds.  The only thing that comes close is a real bone.  This does not get all yucky like a real bone.  It doesn't make a mess on your floor.  It is the real deal.  If you are looking for a bone for a heavy chewer or just a little chewer, this is the bone for you, hands down.  This is what you are looking for.

column9: I highly recommend nylabone for tough chewers.
column10: These things last at least 20 times longer than a typical rawhide chew toy.  The base material is not digestible but the pieces that break off from the toy are small flakes that pass right through my dog.  In other words, the nylon material does not break or fracture off; instead, it slowly wears down in a controlled manner.I did not have very good results with the softer, clear nylabone rubber bones -- my dog was able to chew off medium-sized pieces, which could easily get lodged in his throat.-Protect internet privacy.

I initially started my dog off on these as the gummy version was too easy for her to tear apart.  A few months later during my vet visit, she noticed my dog had two slab fractures on her molars.  Granted, my dog would tear into these, but now she has ruined her teeth and may require a root canal.  I now use kongs with treats that I replace once they start to look worn.

column9: The only chew bone durable enough for a sled dog.
column10: I have an old Alaskan husky, and he eats even the large Zoe and Greenie chews within a couple of minutes. This is the first commercial chew bone that he actually chews on (as opposed to tearing it apart and swallowing). It's not terrifically attractive, in fact he ignored it completely for a couple of days, but now he chews on it regularly, and it's definitely reducing tartar.

column9: not the same as the picture!
column10: I ordered this product thinking I would be getting the nubby white bone.  Instead I got a completely smooth off-white stained-looking bone.  I'll still try it out with my dog, but I feel deceived by Amazon.

I love the nylabone durachews.  For some reason, I've never found the bacon flavored in the store.  I gave it to my dog yesterday when I got home from work and he wouldn't put it down!  He chewed on it for 2-3 hours... this will definitely be a repeat buy from me!  The only thing is I find the bone a little too small (which is my fault, the product dimensions were clearly stated on the website).  I have a 21 pound dog and it looks a little too tiny for him, so I think I'll get the next size up next time I purchase this.I've also tried the other variety nylabones, which don't fair well with my dog (edible chews, etc).  The softer ones get gobbled up by my dog to quickly, which is why I stick with the durachews.  For those powerful chewers, it's the best!

My dogs love the Nylabones! They last forever....When I first give them the bone I rough up the ends on the concrete and then run water over it. Doing this seems to get them going. In fact, they don't show much interest in the Nylabones unless I do this. I think maybe because when the outer layer is roughed up it releases the smell and encourages chewing. I will never buy a different brand of bone for my dogs!  Thank you Nylabone for making such a wonderful product!

column9: No This Will Not Kill Your Dog
column10: I just want to see that the "Most Helpful Critical Review" is NOT what you should go off of. At the time of writing, this person claims warnings and that your dog can die. If you read your review, she states her dogs chew at these until nothing is left. For the record, the instruction manual in the packaging and common sense say that if large chunks are breaking off or the nubs on the end get too worn, then THROW IT AWAY. Not doing so can very well kill your dog, but thats because hes not using it properly. People die from ladders too, doesnt mean I'm gonna stop using it so long as I follow instructions.On to the item itself. I love Nylabones. My Husky loves Nylabones. I usually get just the regular basic ones, but my dog is coming up on a year old, weighs 43 pounds, and chews like crazy. So I purchased the Dura-Chew Large, rated for dogs over 50 pounds. I looked at pictures, read reviews and thought "I can't wait; he'll actually be able to use it for more than a week". The item arrived, and by the next day large gashes were on one side, and the other was already bristling (it's supposed to, see my above paragraph if you don't read instructions). By the middle of the next week, I threw it out.So I give it three stars. It's a great product, my dog loved it, and he used it. However, I certainly would not call this "Dura-Chew", nor rate it at 50 lbs+. Perhaps the weight rating is only for the size of the bone. A good product, but powerful chewers look elsewhere.

My lab loves just about anything nylabone makes. These chew toys are a little more expensive than others but they last for a considerable amount of time and they dont make a mess. Personally, I wont give my dog rawhide treats, besides the safety warnings, I also find them to be very messy, leaving white, pasty residue where ever my dog takes them. The nylabones do not leave a mess and my dog seems to enjoy the flavors. The material they use doesnt shatter or form sharp edges, so it has a safety advantage over rawhides or real bones, too. Needless to say, I've been very pleased with the nylabones I've purchased and will not be switching brands anytime soon.
I have a pitbull and these are her favorite nylabones. I wont give her anything else. These nylabones last a very long time. She's a very happy dog everytime I come home with one. Keeps her busy too.

My dog is a serious chewer. He actually eats bedding we put in his crate so we had to purchase a high quality Kuranda bed that he can't get his teeth into. Toys can be a problem. I've found Nylabones work very well for him. He has several styles, including this one and loves them. I give him one at night when he is put in his crate and also when he needs something constructive to do during the day. He will often go to his crate, pull out the Nylabone to carry it to where he wants to lounge at the moment. I would definitely recommend this for heavy chewers. We haven't had a problem with Regal breaking off pieces to swallow, but it's always a good idea to supervise any new toy with your dog before giving free access to it. All dogs are different. For Regal, this works and has lasted well.

column9: Nice and Durable, But Be Aware of The Size Guide
column10: I feel confident that my puppy won't destroy this bone anytime soon but do beware of the size. "Petite" is just that. This variety is for dogs up to 15lbs (not mentioned in the product description) and is VERY small.

My extreme chewer loves this chew bone toy. It's really holding up to her aggressive chewing; the only down side is that it leaves little bits of sharp-edged fragments as she chews...certainly not at all a concern unless you walk on them with bare feet.

My three golden retrievers love this toy.  My puppy is not aggressive but a relentless chewer and eater.  He will eat anything and has almost died despite my best efforts to keep him away from harmful things.  I find he loves this bone and will go to it at night when we are watching tv and he gets bored.  He likes the thunk sound it makes when he drops it on the tile floor.  I highly recommend this toy for anyone dealing with an "orally fixated" dog with a high energy level.
I have 3 large dogs and any other type bone is gone in minutes. These are long lasting and the dogs love them. It's the first thing they grab in the morning. And the price is fair.

It says don't give it to dogs that have permanent teeth. My Schipperke has not suffered any dental damage, and loves chewing on it instead of sheets or pillowcases, shoes etc. Loves the chicken flavor, and it lasts a few months. I can say it's a good substitute for houshold goods.

I bought these for my dog and my daughter's dog for Christmas gifts. They are a hit. The dogs would switch off and steal each other's bone. They last months and months - even with my pit bull. They must taste good, too.

We have four dogs ranging in size from medium to large.  All four of our furry friends love Nylabones!  Our largest dog has some stomach issues and our vet recommended Nylabones as a chewy toy/treat that our Golden's tummy could handle.  She loves them and they haven't caused her any tummy troubles.  These are regular stocking stuffers for our pooches.
My dog loves the nylabone bones and they aren't messy, so I don't mind giving it to him.

column9: Quality product but smaller than expected
column10: One of the best pieces of advice I received when I got my puppy was to expose her to Nylabone products.  They are one of the few dog toys that, 6 years later, she doesn't destroy within  5 minutes.  This item was much smaller than I expected, making the price, along with shipping, not such a great buy. The term "wolf" was misleading. Could of purchased same item in pet store for this price.  Better for a small, maybe medium sized dog.

My dog is a very aggressive chewer, but when I bought this product in the store it lasted him a long time so i bought it again on line so save some money but for some reason the one I bought off line barely lasted 2 weeks and the one I had bought in the store lasted him about 6. I'm not sure what the problem was with durability the second time but I wouldn't buy it again.

column9: Boxer and Lab didn't see the point
column10: I have a one year old Boxer and a nine year old chocolate lab.  Neither one was impressed with this nylabone.  Supposed to be bacon flavored but I couldn't smell anything resembling bacon.  (I would have tried it to be sure, but I figured that was too much to ask of me just so you could have an accurate review!)

My dogs and I love nylabones. They are a safe chew toy that keeps my dogs entertained and last a long time. I like that nylabones come in different flavors; it keeps my dogs more interested. I was very satisfied with the shipping of this product. It came much sooner than expected

column9: Nylabone Dura Chew Bone, Chicken Flavor, Souper
column10: I bought this bone hoping it would last a while. I still have my fingers crossed as I understand the white bones are not as tough as the darker colors of the same type. At least she loves to chew on it! Little piecesof the bone are evident where she enjoys her Nylabone Dura Chew Bone, Chicken Flavor, Souper Nylabone Dura Chew Bone, Chicken Flavor, Souper

We purchased this just before adopting a 45pound, 6-month-old blue heeler mix. It took him a couple of days, but he will now chew on it for a few minutes at a time. It is perfect for redirecting his chewing - when he grabs something he shouldn't chew, we replace it with the nylabone or his kong to show him what he is allowed to chew on. He doesn't seem like a super tough chewer, so far the nylabone shows no wear and tear, but I might worry with a larger/stronger dog.
My dogs love these chew toys and I cannot keep enough of these in the house!  They are hardy and my dogs cannot destruct them to the point of hurting themselves.  Highly recommend!

column9: Nylabone is reliable in product quality
column10: I have three dogs.  Two of them are nearly 50 pounds and one of them is just over 20 pounds.  Regardless of their sizes, all three are STRONG chewers.  This means only the highest durability dog toys can be given to them and this one passed the test!This bone is a very good size (Souper) and the chicken flavor seems to really draw my dogs to it.  Usually those flavorings appear to wear off over a couple of days, but we've had this one for a bit now and the dogs still pick it over their other toys.  Of course, that may also simply be because it's currently the newest of their toys and therefore the most awesome and amazing and fantastic in their eyes.Bottom line:  I recommend this to any strong chewers and the length is perfect for my dogs to wrap their paws around it/prop it on their arms while really chewing down into it.

My dogs jumped on these! I've purchased the Souper bones for years. They've loved the Soupers but deviated with the hope of providing at least a small change for them. The reaction was positive, to say the least. Maybe it's the texture but my Chessie was very happy. He mauled his on the first day, an unusual reaction for him. It's still usable, it just bears thorough "Chessie marks". My GSD loves his too.I've not given any dog a rawhide chew for many, many years. Some may report no problems but a Lab chewed off the end of a rawhide chew; I lost him due to that darn thing. Good luck to you if you furnish those to your dogs. I sincerely hope that you never face the same tragedy. Oh yeah, ONLY NylaBone chews for my guys. I love them too much to see them foolishly lost.
My dog loves the Nylabones.  They last forever and much better for her.  I will never get a soft fabric toy again

My nine month old golden retriever acts crazy at times. When we give him this toy, he will lay by our feet and chew on it while we watch tv and relax. He doesn't seem to bore of it as he does with other toys. He has chewed on it quite a bit and it is still in good shape. Highly recommended and only $10.

column9: Puppy is happy with his new chew  bone
column10: Our new puppy loves this chew bone toy.  He's 10 weeks and mouthy so this is perfect.  I would buy another one.

column9: Nylabone is the best for heavy chewers
column10: If you doggie is a heavy chewer, like mine, I highly recommend this Nylabone for his/her.  The nubs feel good on their gums and it's a great size for larger dogs 50 pounds or more.
This bone is really durable and gives my dog a good chewing workout!  It does not leave little plastic pieces all around the carpet like I have seen some similar products do.

I ordered two of these bones for my two pitbull mixes. Both of the bones together, shipped, on amazon cost what one of them was in the pet store. These bones hold up well to my strong chewers and they're only able to get little shaving pieces off at a time. To the people who have trouble with these bones because their dogs ate them, These bones are NOT edible! It states it directly on the package. If your dog swallows large pieces of things or chews large pieces off these are NOT for your dog. ALWAYS supervise your animals when they are chewing on toys. All in all these bones are great for my two big mushball pitters. :)

column9: My heavy chewer loves this toy
column10: One of my dogs is a heavy and constant chewer.  She loves these toys.  They hold up pretty well.  She has worn the first one down so that it's no longer the shape it started in, but it hasn't cracked and has held up to her crazy amount of chewing.  We've since purchased a second toy and now she alternates between her old favorite and her new favorite.  I would highly recommend these for anyone with a dog who LOVES to chew!

column9: Doesn't just take a lickin', it holds up to the heaviest chewer
column10: Our two dogs are heavy chewers and these bones just last and last. They chew them down to a little nub of nothing, but it takes many months. I can't even remember when we bought the last one, now that it's finally time for a new one! Good stuff! Ruff!
Item was as described and arrived on time. I Would buy this item again and would also recommend that other dog owners purchase this item.
This Nylabone is pretty much indestructible. My German Shepherd has been chewing on it for almost 9 months, and it's still holding up. She loves chewing on it. Great purchase! Will be buying more!
I have a 7 pound dog and she likes this. She is 5 but likes to chew it. Not sure how they get bacon flavor in there cause its hard plastic, cant smell it.

column9: The only thing that stands up to powerful chewers.
column10: These are the only bones that my Mastiff and beagle can keep around for their chewing needs. Most bones end up in rubber shreds on my carpet within ten minutes. These last a long time, and the dogs simply LOVE them.

column9: You Can't Go Wrong With This
column10: I have a 100# weimer that is a big chewer and he loves this product.  One of the things I loved about it is the product has a money back guarantee and the seller sent a sample of another product they have. I wish I would have bought this product much sooner and it would have saved me some damage to the outside of the house.

column4: G. Proulx "Up to my Neck in Tech"
column9: Dog loved it, didn't last too long
column10: We got this for our black lab puppy. She is an aggressive chewer. She loved this bone, so much so that she destroyed it. I don't recall exactly how long it lasted, but only a couple months. We upgraded her to the Nylabone Galileo Bone Dog Chew Toy, Souper which is very durable, but has some if it's own drawbacks (mainly it is very hard plastic as noted in my review of that product).I was going to give this bone 4 stars, but I guess the fault can rest on my dog. I'll give this 5 stars and recommend it to anyone who things their dog isn't an aggressive chewer. If they are, this won't last very long. The Galileo bone lasts, but is a little too hard. I wish there was a bone similar to this in texture, but a little more durable. But if your dog is a moderate chewer, I'm sure they'll like this bone.Hope this was helpful and that you find the right bone for your four-legged friend!

I bought this after reading the reviews and I am so glad I did.  Our puppy loves it!  It is a little costly for a bone but it has stayed in one piece and she is a chomper.  It's definitely less expensive than buying raw-hides or any other bone she can eat.  If she ever breaks this one apart I will definitely purchase another one to replace it.

This is the only chew product I have found that my 25 lb terrier can't destroy in a matter of days. She seems to love this product ( bacon flavor?) , though it is so hard that I have to be careful that it doesn't damage/cause excessive wear to her teeth. I can't recommend this enough to those dog owners who are concerned about living with a mad chewer!

Our dog is an aggressive chewer and loves this Chicken flavor Nylabone. It cleans his teeth and he never seems to have any bad breath. I do have to pick up the pieces that he's chewed off but it satisfies his chewing urges. Since the price was reasonable and shipping was free, I bought 4 of the to keep on hand.

This is perfect for fulfilling the chewing needs of my very active Jack Russell.  He's never had a problem digesting the tiny pieces he chews off because of how durable the bone is.  Lasts a very long time.

I have two weims and they destroy toys in a matter of minutes, but with the nylabone they take their sweet ole time! I like it because it lasts really long, I have not had a single nylabone product that they have destroyed.

Our three Dobermans and Bulldog love this.  However, it is not the same on in the pic.  The one I received had raised bumps and grooves, which I think they enjoyed on their gums/mouth even better.  I highly recommend this product.
One of our Danes has eaten the couch (and various other items).  This is a very good chew toy and he chews it when he feels like it.  Our little 14 pound mix likes to carry it around and chew on it.

Bought these for my teething 3.5 month old Wheaten Terrier and she went to town on them. Last quite a while and pass through my dogs system pretty easily without causing any heavy diarrhea or making her sick. Def recommend this for a teething dog or just a dog who loves to chew (which is pretty much ALL dogs). My silky terrier finds these extremely uninteresting, but she's a picky brat. If your dog will chew on anything with even a slight flavor, these will work out well.
Nylabone is still the best option if you want a great dog chew toy without the splinter dangers of real bones or a mess on your furniture and floors.

I bought this for my sweet Boxer girl and she loves it. If you have a Boxer you know that they love to chew and this fits the bill. I think this may be the 3rd one we've bought in the 2.5 years she's lived with us.
This is the best Nylabone I have bought so far my pup (1yr old Shepard mix) has been chewing on it for months and it still holds it shape.

Perfect gnawing toy for my Rottweiler. entertains herself for hours with it and while it is chewed on one end, it's still in one piece and hasn't broken into pieces (yet, anyway!) Consistent quality with Nylabone products.

I like Nylabone products because most, if not all, are made in the USA.  After all the recent scares with dog products, I at least hope that the products made in the US are safe.  This company has been around for a while and is recommended by my vet.I have an extremely hard time finding something that will last beyond a day or two for my black lab.  Even though I buy products that say they are for aggressive chewers, they never last long.  This one seems to have lasted a tad longer.  Not as long as I wish, but certainly more than some others I have purchased.  It is the right length for my dog to grab and hold too.If anyone out there knows of a product for a strong chewer that can last a long time...I'd love to know.

My Pit bull loves them! She is an extreme power chewer and they last about a month with her, then her Chihuahua sister steals them once they become smaller for her to chew on :-) It's so much more reasonable than all the money I was originally spending on bully sticks. I still keep them around but more so as treats since I now have something else to occupy her on a daily basis. They help keep her out of trouble and she's not destroying all the other toys in the house to satisfy her teething urges.

Not sure why my dogs love these hard plastic chews so much, but they do and they're the only thing I allow them to chew indoors.  They're clean, don't smell and can be easily washed if they start looking a bit "funky", as dog chews often do!
I get these bones for my 2 pit bulls because no other bone will hold up more than a few minutes. These usually last about 2 months before they need to be replaced. My dogs love them!

My 22 lb Frengle (half Beagle, half French Bulldog) will devour almost anything rawhide or "gummy" like the other nylabones.  This one is perfect... he chews on the bone for at least an hour a day and it doesn't wear down much.  I've also purchased the cylinder shaped hollow bones which are just way too heavy and dent my floors... these can be dropped from couch height and they're light enough where they do no damage.  I will buy no other dog bone (besides the bacon flavored version of this).

column9: Tiny sized Nylabone; but my 80 lbs. puppy likes it.
column10: This is a tiny Nylabone; but my 80 lbs. puppy likes it. He is over two feet tall; yet he still likes to play with this little Nylabone. He does not chew on it; but holds it in his mouth and moves it around. I'll probably get him a larger sized bone. This was a nylabone he found.

Fake bones don't work on all dogs, but this one has kept my 2 year-old yella Lab atomic-chewer entertained for over a month and is still going strong. I'll always keep one on hand. You gotta wonder, though, about the side effects of ingesting all that nyla.
My dog is a golden retriever and a HEAVY chewer! She chews through most Kong toys and the smaller Nylabones, but this thicker option kept her busy much longer! Love it!

Nylabones have long been my favorite chew toys for my big German Shepherds. The dogs love them, they last a long time and don't make a mess on my carpets. If my dogs take them outside, they can be washed and reused. The souper size is great for big, strong dogs and last several months even with daily chewing. I highly recommend Nylabone durable products. These are a bargain because they last so long and Amazon's price is the best anywhere, even over pet supply discount sites.

Nylabones have long been my favorite chew toys for my big German Shepherds. The dogs love them, they last a long time and don't make a mess on my carpets. If my dogs take them outside, they can be washed and reused. The souper size is great for big, strong dogs and last several months even with daily chewing. I highly recommend Nylabone durable products.

This bone is absolutely awesome.  We bought this in November 2010... It's been 7 months and our dog still chews on it every single day.  It's his absolute favorite toy, and hasn't lost any of its appeal in months!  We had tried giving our dog rawhides and bully sticks and all kinds of other things, which all gave him diarrhea.  This is the only thing that he has loved to chew that doesn't upset his stomach.  We LOVE this bone!!

We have bought Nylabones at Petsmart and Walmart before.  We already knew we loved the products for our two large breed dogs (lab/husky mix and rott/german shepherd mix) and were delighted to find them cheaper on Amazon.  The dogs are still enjoying them and when we need more, we'll be ordering them from here again.

i bought this product for my two dogs, a pomchi & a minpin/chihuahua mix. i got it mainly for the minpin because she was chewing up all the wood in the backyard. i got the bacon and chicken flavor and hoped to heaven that they wouldn't reject the toys. my pomchi isn't much of a chewer, but i would find her under my bed chewing it once in a while. hardly made a dent in the bone. the minpin however is a BEAST at chewing. after 3 days with her nylabone, there was severe wear on one end. after a little less than a month, both ends of her bone have been pretty much destroyed. don't get me wrong, its a great product and it can withstand normal chewing, but this one in particular is not durable enough to stand the jaws of my monster minpin. but she really enjoys it, and i'll keep searching to the perfect nylabone that can hold up to her powerful chewing habits!

column9: Ok, but a little too soft for our dogs
column10: I don't know what it is about the white colored nylabone material; it is just so much softer than the yellowish material. Even though both are labeled "Dura Chew" The dogs have not yet taken off sizeable pieces of this bone, but they can leave pretty clear tooth markings. This chew needs closer monitoring than the other nylabones we have bought.*************UPDATE: It is a little more than a year since I first put up this review and I just bought a liver flavored Nylabone that is also made from this white colored material. I'm uploading a customer photo to show the difference. If you have a dog that is an agressive chewer, you may want to stay away from the white nylabone material.
I have a very aggressive chewer, and Nylabone products are a favorite in my house.  This one isn't one of the best, but still a toy that will last a long time.  Just what we need here.
Out of all the nylabones I ordered, this one seems to be my dogs favorite.  Great product for a strong chewer.

I buy these bones for my dogs to chew on and play with when outside, unsupervised.  They are durable enough that pieces don't break off and there is minimal risk of choking.  They seem to last forever but are soft enough that the dogs want to chew on them.  I bought the largest size because I have medium and large sized dogs.  That also minimizes risk of choke and/or other injury.  They are also easy to spot in the yard when mowing the grass.  If you do accidentally run one over, they break or splinter and leave sharp edges.  I would remove them from your dogs yard in that event.  Otherwise, the dogs seem to like them (are willing to pick them up, take them from you, and carry them around) and chew on them quite often.  They are great for mildly interactive toys but do not provide a lot of exercise - other than chewing.  Good "keep your dog busy so you can get stuff done" toys!  :)

column9: Good product but I was expecting the Wolf size to be bigger
column10: The product is very good.  It is the type of bone I was planning to get for my dogs.  They don't seem to chew on it much.  I am not sure why, they both love to chew and have chewed on the previous nylabone dura chews.  I love the fact that this product lasts so long and it is hard for them to destroy.When I ordered the product I couldn't find what size the Wolf bone was - dimensions ect.  I just assumed that wolves are fairly large animals so this bone must the the same size as the long one I purchased last year.  I was wrong.  Wolf is the medium size as far as I can tell.  There is nothing wrong with the product.  I just wish that the size would have been a little more clear when I ordered it.

Have had this bone for about a month now.  My dog loves to chew on everything.  She worked this bone over good the first few days.  Now she uses it about 10 mins a day.  The bone is probably worn down to about 80% its orginal size.

My 60-lb golden/lab mix loves these bones -- but only the chicken flavor. She wouldn't touch the liver or "original." She's the first dog I've ever had that likes these really hard bones. She's done a good job of chewing down both ends over a period of a year or so, and I've already got a replacement for when the little knobs are completely gone. For now, they are nice and rough and probably scour a lot of tartar off when she gnaws on them.

column9: big enough for my 17  pound dog
column10: Scout can chew on this while grasping it in his paws. It's his favorite flavored chew toy. No dental damage has occurred and he loves chewing on it at bedtime. If he doesn't have it, he chews on bedding or pillows. He has adult teeth.

Our two boxers love these bones. They are "aggressive chewers" and we have had the same two Nylabones for over a year. We always give them new ones for Christmas (yes, they are spoiled) but we keep the old ones since they are still chewable.We usually go for the large or giant size and they seem to work for 65 and 85 lb dogs.

Our two boxers love these bones. They are "aggressive chewers" and we have had the same two Nylabones for over a year. We always give them new ones for Christmas (yes, they are spoiled) but we keep the old ones since they are still chewable.We usually go for the large or giant size and they seem to work for 65 and 85 lb dogs.

Rusty is a 60 pound American Dingo mix with jaws like an alligator. He's an extremely powerful chewer who quickly destroys most toys, but not his Nylabones (we have several). I hope everybody who buys one of these heeds the warning on the label: toss it when they chew through the thick knuckle end so large sharp pieces don't break off. The Nylabones last for a long time until the knuckle is chewed away, so it's not worth a short time of extra use to risk our dog's life and health.Besides the Nylabone, we give Rusty raw cow shank and knuckle bones or raw turkey or chicken wings and necks as daily treats*. He's 4+ years old, but his teeth and gums look sparkly clean and healthy and his breath is sweet.* NOT COOKED, cooked bones splinter, raw bones don't. Dogs' digestive system can handle bacteria found on raw meat, not to mention the bacteria on cat poop, rotting carcasses, and whatever other disgusting things they eat. Gotta love them!

I would not be without several of these for my lab mix.  She seems to need to use them several times a day so we keep them within reach.  I tried a larger version but it makes dents in the floor when she drops it off the couch and hurts if she drops it on a person.  These are large enough and tough enough for a dog that needs to chew but light enough not to be a concern.

column9: A life saver for my chewer!
column10: These are great for big dogs! They last my Pit Bulls about 3-4 months and then they get too small and we pitch them. The pieces that come off while chewing are very small so it's safe for the dogs. These are a life saver for me, the only thing that my Pit Bull puppy can't destroy in 5 minutes!!

Worth their weight in gold!!! ....that is, if gold was $14 per oz.  These things are great for settling my 4 dogs down when they are inexplicably losing their minds.  Everybody take a bone and pick a corner! Go!  :)  Another tip my wife figured-out is when they start to get bored, just do a little swap and since they have each others' drool, they become even more delicious!  *yuck*

column9: Best chew toy aside from Kong
column10: We purchased this for our little Australian Kelpie mix dog, bought this when she was about 3 months old 12lbs, now she's almost a year and just over 30lbs and today we purchased her a second one because the first one was finally worn down to under 3/4. She's a very aggressive chewer and will rip everything else to pieces within minutes but this is the only thing that lasts.Definitely recommend this toy and a frozen Kong for your dog's chewing habits! The ONLY downside is that the plastic gets a little pokey-stabby after it's been through some tough love.
my dogs love these bones.  they are long lasting and very durable for rough chewers.
My dog takes time to chew and she chews these the most.  She's a pitbull and has worn 2 of these down halfway in 1 year's time.  They last a long time.

I was not expecting much from this container of Kool Aid, but I was pleasantly surprised.  This container holds already-sweetened powder so you don't need to add sugar.  It is convenient to be able to mix just one glass of Kool Aid at a time by using a tablespoon of powder with 8 ounces of water.  It has a fresh, peachy flavor without any strange aftertaste, which some flavors of Kool Aid seem to have.  It is actually my new favorite flavor.  Highly recommended.

I expected this to super sweet, like Kool-Aid usually is, but was pleasantly surprised by it's flavor.  It's a lighter flavor than other Kool-Aids, very tasty.  My son (who is 6), did not like it, but the adults in the house did.

Hey, Kool-Aid! Kool-Aid was a fondly remembered part of my youth. It wasn't until later that they came out with the already sweetened version.Sweetened Kool-Aid is quite easy to make, just scoop it into the jug of water, give it a stir, and it's ready to drink. The peach mango is quite an interesting flavor, and is a good addition to the Kool-Aid line. It's nice and refreshing, and I like drinking it as much as my kids do. We all highly recommend it!

I'm a big fan of mix your own drinks, especially drinks like tang and Kool-Aid. This drink however, is an acquired taste. The first time I mixed a drink with that I thought it tasted kind of weird. However by the end of the container I was really starting to enjoy this drink I would definitely buy this if I seen it in the store. Also as far as convenience goes this is just great.

Kool-Aid Peach Mango Sugar Sweetened Drink has avery refreshing natural taste. Peach and Mango make for a very refreshing taste. Kool-Aid has been around for a lon time and has stood the test of time. Kool-Aid is still a refreshing alternate to soda and taste great. I have tried a lot of different flavors of Lool-Aid and there was not one I didnot like. This drink is already sugar sweetened so there is no need to add additional sugar.

Peach Mango seems to be the liquid flavor trend as of late. I'm seeing this combination regularly now when just a few years ago it was almost unheard of. Now Kool-Aid has jumped on the bandwagon. My wife loves Kool-Aid and Peach anything (I wish she had gotten to try Peach Twizzlers Pull N Peel when they were around). I on the other hand am not a fan of artifical sweetners or fruit flavoured products that are mostly long polysyllabic chemical compounds disguised as food. So I wasn't expecting to like this.Imagine my surprised when we both loved it. We finished off a pitcher quickly and really could taste both peach and mango flavors, even though there was none of either in this mix. Even better, there is no high fructose corn syrup in the mix! Yes, there are artificial colors and flavors but the fact this had no HFCS or asparatine was a double win in my book. One glass is only sixty calories, has 18 grams of sugar and even a smattering of vitamins C & E. Not bad.The only real problem is that Peach Mango Kool-Aid seems to be exceptionally hard to find. No supermarket in the DC metro area seems to carry this. It's definitely the first time since Ecto-Cooler where I can honestly say I have a KJool-Aid craving.

What can you really say about Kool-Aid. It's basically flavored sugar water. Definitely not something you'd want to drink or serve your kids everyday, but every now and then it is ok, I suppose.This is actually the first time in over 10 years that we have even had Kool-Aid or any similar sugary juice drink in our home. I just try to stay away from these types of products in general. It was nice to have something different on hand.This drink is definitely sweet and if you try to use less mix, well, it is just less mix and doesn't taste very well. Overall the flavor is pretty good if you like peach mango flavors in general. It isn't a natural taste of course..it definitely has that artificial Kool-Aid taste to it, but tastes good anyway.If I was in the habit of buying these types of juices/mixes, it is one that I would buy based on the flavor alone. We tend to stick to milk, water, orange juice, cranberry juice etc though - all the  boring stuff :/It mixes up quickly and fully dissolves. You can mix up a single serving or a whole pitcher, so it is pretty convenient to have on hand.

I grew up with Kool Aid, during an era where you were never more than a few minutes from Kool Aid Man busting through walls during after-school / Saturday morning cartoons. A generation that can identify two-quart containers from twenty paces.So, what's up with this Tang container claiming to be Kool-Aid? And Peach Mango?Well, in terms of convenience, this kind of Kool Aid is the wave of the future, compared to mixing scads of sugar with a packet of Kool Aid in a two-quart container. Like Tang, it mixes really easy, and it doesn't separate unless you leave a mixed cup of it out for a long time.In terms of flavor, though... I don't know if it's the sweetener that Kool Aid is using in this product, but it tastes a lot like Crystal Light On The Go Metabolism Plus Green Tea Peach Mango (without the flecks of green tea). It's got kind of a diet taste to it, and upping the amount of powder you use just makes it sweeter, rather than having a more robust flavor. Even Tang gets more orange if you add more powder!Kool Aid Man isn't busting through anything over this flavor, that's for sure.

One, I like Kool-Aid. Two, I like fruity drinks. Three, I love this Kool-Aid. It's sweet enough without being cloying and it's fruity enough to be light and refreshing when you want something other than water but not as sugary as soda. As to the flavour of this Kool-Aid it's definitely more mango-y than peachy in my opinion. I also needed to use a bit more powder than the recommended amount to get what I would consider a fully flavoured drink instead of just mildly flavoured water, however that's not that unusual with Kool-Aid. (Except for maybe the Fruit Punch flavor. I can usually use a bit less of that than recommended.)Overall, I do enjoy this flavour and would definitely buy it again.

column9: A New Tasty Flavor From Kool Aid
column10: It seems like Peach-Mango is the new flavor de jour as I have seen it popped up everywhere lately and now it is the latest Kool Aid flavor.  If you ever bought the 19 oz Kool Aid container, the Peach-Mango flavor is no different, same size, same measuring instructions as the rest of them. If this will be your first experience, it is extremely easy to make and the lid even doubles as a measuring tool to help you make one or two quarts worth at a time.  The Peach-Mango tastes exactly how I would expect a Peach-Mango Kool Aid flavor would taste, but it does taste slightly more watered down than other flavors.  But I would still it is my top five Kool Aid flavors and it add it my rotation whenever buying Kool Aid.

column9: I liked it, the kids didn't.
column10: When mixed, this new Kool Aid flavor looks more like Sunny D than it does a typical Kool Aid drink.  It's more opaque.  And, even though I used icy cold water, it dissolved completely with a few stirs.  I really liked this new flavor, but I love mangoes.  I preferred it over the typical Kool Aid flavors, but when I let the kids try it, they didn't really care for it at all. I guess I'll have it all to myself.

column9: Good flavor.  Packaging not so great.
column10: I like the flavor of the Peach Mango Kool-Aid.  The flavor is not too artificial and I can definitely tell that the flavors are peach and mango, however mango is much stronger.  I found the drink to be too sweet if mixed per instructions.  I used 4 teaspoons per 24 oz of water (slightly less than 1/2 of the recommended amount) and I thought that it was sweet enough. However, I used cool water.  I am sure that if I used ice-cold water, the drink would taste less sweet.I think the packaging is not well thought through.  I think the opening is too narrow, and not very convenient for reaching in with a spoon.  Also, the outer colorful layer is a shrink wrap.  When the jar is first opened and the lid is removed, the portion of the wrapper that goes around the lid falls off.  That portion contains both the name of the flavor and the instructions in English.  I think the container could have been designed better.In my opinion, once you figure out water-to-mix proportions, this is a good product that both adults and kids will enjoy.

As a kid, I loved Kool-Aid and still to this day, the tast of Kool-Aid Lemonade brings back memories of Summer afternoons. But I'm just not digging this new Peach Mango flavor. It was quite peachy in flavor, I couldn't really taste the mango part of the drink. Apart from the easy to read and understand directions, I don't have too much to say about the drink. It just wasn't to my taste but others may enjoy the flavor a lot more.

I'm old school when it comes to Kool-Aid flavors --- lemonade, orange, lemon-lime, cherry, grape -- but I tried this peach-mango flavor with an open mind.  The only way I knew it was Kool-Aid was because the packaging said it was.  I don't particularly like fruity tasting beverages, and this seemed extremely sweet for my tastes as well.  I drink lemonade and iced tea powdered mixers sugared or with sugar substitutes, and they are all just fine (not Kool-Aid brand), so it could just be me.  This is not a flavor I think kids would like either.  In fact, I've offered the remainder of this container to kids up through their teens and so far, no one has touched it.

I really enjoyed this. I'm not a Kool Aid drinking person at all but I am a huge mango lover so I tried it and it is really yummy. I preferr mine not too sweet with tons of ice and it is so refreshing. I did not really notice the peach flavor-but the mango influence is strong, you should give this a try it will be a great summer drink.

column9: Great peachy flavor, not too sweet
column10: This Kook-Aid has a really nice flavor - sort of reminds one of a peachy TANG. While peach is a dominate flavor, you still get a really good hint of mango as well. A really refreshing sort of flavor. Its not too sweet and definitely could hold its own as a fun summer punch with fruit slices or blended with vanilla ice cream for a great dessert. It has a more mature flavor than most Kool-Aid drinks, but the kids still really enjoyed it. Would definitely get again.

I love a good peach mango beverage and was excited to find this flavor in Kool Aid. Unfortunately, my adult taste buds found the drink to be overly peachy with no real discernible mango flavor. I also found the drink to be not quite sweet enough when made according to package directions.On the other hand, my children (3 and 4 years old) absolutely loved this flavor. We're talking actual begging for a refill. Having less sugar than the other juices type drinks they love and containing some vitamins, I was pleased they were so happy with it.

column9: Kool-aid is for kids... and adults
column10: This is a great new flavor of Kool-Aid, a non-carbonated drink which I have enjoyed all my life. This particular product contains a little less sugar than the old Kool-Aid but I couldn't taste the difference. This flavor is very refreshing and it's incredibly easy to mix. I often make it a glass at a time to avoid clogging up my refrigerator with yet another pitcher.Highly recommended.
This new Kool-Aid flavor is awesome! Love the blend of Peach and Mango! It has a nice tropical flavor without being too sweet. My toddler and I both love it!

column9: At last!  A new Kool-Aid Flavor!
column10: I was a bit skeptical about the taste of this drink.  The smell of the dry mix wasn't too exciting.However once I mixed up a glass I was pleasantly surprised.  Good peach-mango flavor.  Not overpowering and a perfect mixture of the two.Being a Kool-Aid drinker for many years, I was delighted to finally see a new flavor.  This one is perfect.Thank you!MEF

I decided to make a gallon of this. For making a gallon of Kool-aid you have to dump in two lids full of powder. That seemed pretty excessive. At first I did just one lid, and it was too watery. Then I added a half a lid and tasted real good. When I was younger, I remember just using those small little packets and then a bunch of sugar, but with this one the sweetener is added so you only have to add the powered. Using a gallon, takes up nearly half of the powered in the jar though.Both my boyfriend and I liked the taste a lot. Not too sweet, very refreshing. The first flavor you get is the mango flavor with a sweet peach flavor aftertaste. I am sure it would have been stronger if I added the second half a lid of power to it. But I liked it with the amount I added. I remember as a child when using the small packets I never used as much sugar as it said because it was always to sweet for me.My boyfriend really likes koolaid, and we don't drink it much, but after tastings this one we are most likely going to go out and buy other flavors and maybe even this flavor again because we liked it so much. Very easy to make, just dump in the amount of powered per size of container, add water and stir. Not messy, but a little powdery, it puffed up when I added the powder and I had kool aid smell stuck in my nose for awhile.

This new peach mango Kool-Aid flavor sounded interesting so I decided to give it a try. It really does taste like peach and mango, with the sweetness that you can expect with any Kool-Aid. I think this is a bit more sophisticated flavor than a lot of the Kool-Aid I've tried before - a kid would still probably love the stuff, but the flavor doesn't have the overly artificial fruit character that a lot of drinks of this nature do.

Unbelieveably I've never had a Kool-Aid drink until now, therefore I was looking forward to a new taste experience when I received this item. I added two teaspoons of the mix in cold water, added ice and enjoyed a very flavorable drink.Overall, I enjoyed the fact that it was tasty but not over powering with sweetness. Although the mix says it contains peach, the mango flavor was certainly more overwhelming.

While Kool-Aid isn't the most nutritional drink out there, it is great as a little treat.  This new flavor is delicious and my new favorite.  No need to add anything but water, this mix is already sweetened.  Not so great if you like to use something like Splenda instead of sugar, but convenient.

Well, this was pretty decent. I may have to doctor it up next time. I wish it was a little bit sweeter. Usually, when I make Kool-Aid from the packs, I usually make it more on the sweeter side. So the next time I try this I may put some sugar in it or a little bit more Kool-Aid mix than what was suggested in the directions.However, it was still good. My roommate was not really into it, though. I doubt I will ever buy it, because I prefer the Kool-Aid packs and their variety of flavors.

column9: It's Kool Aid ... You Know You Love It
column10: Let's be honest: I'm not sure how many people need to read a review of a new flavor of Kool Aid, but if you're on the fence about trying Peach Mango Kool Aid you can rest easy. This tastes exactly like the typical red fruit punch Kool Aid (well, it actually looks orange) but with ... wait for it ... a hint of peach and mango flavor mixed in.Honestly, if you like Kool Aid (and I do since I grew up drinking it) then you'll like this new flavor of Kool Aid ... provided that you don't hate peaches or mango. The peach and mango flavor is pretty faint but I personally taste more of the peach flavor than mango.Still, we're talking about Kool Aid here folks; it's sugar water with a hint of fruit flavor. The basic concept hasn't changed in decades and the new Peach Mango Kool Aid is no exception.

I was actually really excited to have a chance to try this Kool Aid since mango and peach are two of my favorite flavors.It was a great idea, but the actual product is just too sweet and is lacking the slight "tang" that a real peach has and the mango flavor is almost missingOn the bright side, my son loved it, but then again it contains sugar, and he is addicted to sugar.My recommendation, if it is on sale and you have kids, go ahead and buy it, if it is the same price as cherry, grape, or fruit punch, buy those instead

I was a bit scared to try a drink with mango in it because usually anything with mango has an odd flavor to it to me, but my teenager talked me into getting this so she could try it too. Ok, so we got it and tried it and it really was much better than I expected. More of the peach flavor comes through than the mango. My teenager really liked it. I like buying kool aid like this as you can make as much or as little as you want right from the container to the glass.

And that's about all my family said!  With five boys, I admit it, I buy kool-aid.  And on a hot summer day, who doesn't love a glass of ice cold Kool-aid?  I know I sure do!All five of the boys like grape and fruit punch, so when they heard about this new flavor, they agreed to give it a shot.  We received it, and I made immediately.Their responses:"hmm....tastes sort of weird.""It's alright.""I want the purple one."Ok, so it wasn't a huge hit.  But it was pleasant enough.  I LOVE mangos, and I LOVE peaches, so I was psyched, but I didn't get a real clear taste of either.  One thing I wasn't a fan of, was the sort of strange after taste.Bottom line-the kids will drink it if I buy it, but it isn't their favorite.  And though it does have less sugar than soda (the label says 33% less) there is still a decent amount in a serving-14g in an 8 ounce glass.

I haven't had Kool Aid in awhile, but have a 6 year old daughter who is always asking for it, and this sounded like a promising flavor combination.My little family of three was weirdly excited about trying the Kool Aid, so as soon as I opened the package, I made a glass for each of us. We all took a sip, then another, then another. We all looked at each other in agreement... this is good stuff!! It's peachy and mango-ey, without being over the top, and not too sweet either. In fact, it tastes like surprisingly like juice. Very, very drinkable. I will be looking for other new flavors by Kool Aid, as it seems that they are catering to not just kids any more. Great stuff.

Coming from someone who has tried many different Kool-Aid flavors since I was a kid, I have to say the Peach Mango flavored Kool-Aid is definitely a good choice! The flavor was very refreshing and different then your typical Kool-Aid flavor. My husband mentioned that it tastes like a certain juice he had in South America. I will purchasing this flavor of Kool-Aid in the future.

I gave this to the grand kids and they loved it. It's all gone (one 19 ounce)and it was all gone in just a week. They loved the fruity flavor it had and not too sweet, with just the right amount of a little tartness to it. The only problem I see with it is they love it so much it will never last long when you get it so you might want to buy it by the case if it's cheaper that way.

Who couldn't love Kool-Aid no matter what the flavor? This one though is awesome and my personal favorite. It does taste exactly like peach and mango and is a great refreshing drink any time. I know sugar is not good for you but this reminds me of Tang, just add water and gulp that addicting sugary sweet yumminess down! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED only for decadent indulgence only and not for healthy reasons LOL.

I have not had Kool-Aid in such a long time! But I was very surprised on how great tasting Peach Mango Kool-Aid is! A very nice combination of both Peach & Mango but not overpowering in either flavor. I do remember having to add a lot of sugar to past Kool-Aids but in fact I didn't have to add very much sugar at all, which makes me very happy! True is not the healthiest mix in water alternative but it is a nice refreshing treat to have at home. Easy to mix plus you can do other things with it that other healthier smaller packages are not able to. I froze some and made ice cubes and pops for hubby since he has such a sweet tooth. He loved them and it was such a nice sweet flavor. Perfect to have at home when you just don't want a glass of water or when you run out of the more expensive alternative water mix ins.

Kool-Aid Peach Mango is a tasty flavor. It's been a long time since I've had Kool-Aid; it was much sweeter than I remember. That being said my 2 year old son loves this flavor. If the sugar content was lower we would give him Kool-Aid more.My only complaint is the packaging. The mix recipe is printed on the plastic wrap around the jar which tears easy and could be lost.

column9: An okay tasting flavor from Kool-Aid
column10: Kool Aid Peach Mango Sugar Sweetened is a new flavor from the makers of Kool-Aid.  I really didn't care for it.  The taste wasn't bad but it wasn't the kind that will make me go out and buy it.  I really like the plastic container it comes in.  The top serves as a measuring cup allowing you to make either one or two quarts of Kool Aid,  If you're looking for a new tasting flavor of Kool Aid and if you enjoy the taste of Mango or Peach then you'll want to try this flavor out.  But, if you're not a fan of either flavor or the mix of the two then I advise you to try classic Cherry.Wow, I didn't know that Kool-Aid is going to be 85 years old.

It's Kool-Aid! It's peach mango flavored, and it tastes great! Since it's already sweetened, you just add water, stir, and start pouring. If it was just me, I'd use slightly less than the recommended amount for 2 quarts, since I find it to be a little bit sweet. But for my girls, even at the recommended amount, my 6 year old determined that it was missing just a little bit of sugar, and that with that added sugar it would be perfect.We don't drink this often, but it's great for a treat every so often. And since it's premixed, my girls could actually make it themselves.

Our family doesn't drink Kool Aid often so when we do it better be good! This new Peach Mango is fantastic! It is full of flavor and tastes more like a fruit juice than a soft drink. I find it very refreshing with just the right mix of mango and peach. We will be buying it again!

Okay, so there's no juice here, and it's basically just flavored sugar water, but Kool-Aid is great for pepping up water and making it taste better than just plain old tap water. This flavor is Peach Mango, and it's heavier on the peach than the mango, making it a refreshing, sweet drink. I like to mix the finished product with real juice (whatever is on hand) to make the juice stretch further without having a watered-down flavor.This product is nothing new in the world of Kool-Aid, of course. It's sugar-sweetened. No bad-tasting aspartame, sucralose/Splenda, or other artificial sweeteners in here, thank goodness! Just good old sugar.You can't go wrong with Kool-Aid, especially if you use it as a way to make real juice last longer. It's certainly better than loading yourself or your kids down with high fructose corn syrup!Worth the price. Bring your own water.
I haven't had Kool-Aid in ages. Although I've moved to low calorie drinks, the children tore this up. I even caught one of them licking it out of their hands. Kool-Aid is still a classic!

column9: It's pretty tasty and downright convenient, don't even need a measuring cup
column10: I admit I haven't had Kool-Aid in many years.  I remember it being in powdered form in small foil lined bags with simple flavors like lime or cherry.  This is leaps and bounds away from that stuff.  It probably has less sugar too since you don't have to add your own.  What I like about this product is that the cap doubles as a measuring cup.  It works good yet you have to knock all the mix into the pitcher and make sure it is all in there or else the mix particles will get caught in the tracks of the cap and it won't fit as tight as it once did.  So far, no problems with that though and the cap isn't too loosened but if a person wasn't paying attention, it could be a mess.  The taste of the product is very good.  I could imagine this would be even better in the summer, then drinking it now.  The peach and mango flavors taste natural.  I would recommend it to people who want an easy to make drink mix they don't have to add sugar too or even find a measuring cup for.  Just get a pitcher, add water and ice, stir and it's done!  I wanted to say I mixed this with the suggested amount of product to water and had a good, sweet but not too sweet, result and a good tasting peach mango drink.  I could taste the peach and the mango.  The product does leave "ghost rings" of white on glasses sitting out too, but I find that amusing more than anything else.

column9: A tasty...just sweet enough and just tangy enough...drink mix
column10: The peach mango flavor is tasty.  It is a good balance of sweet and tangy.  A nice need addition to the Kool Aid flavor options.  Generally a user of sugar free options, I go this one for my son to use in his magic slushy maker which works better with sugar-based juices.  I tried this one out and liked the flavor enough that I hope it comes out in a sugar-free variety.

column9: Another great flavor from Kool Aid!
column10: I've been drinking Kool Aid since I was a little kid decades ago. I wonder why it took so long to get to this flavor.  Maybe it wasn't easy to replicate the artificial peach and mango taste?  Still they have it right now, and it's not like the real fruit, but it's not bad, certainly no worse than other Kool Aid.  Real sugar is the way to drink Kool Aid since they took Sodium Cyclomate off the market in the 60's because some rats they pickled in the stuff got cancer.  Cyclomate was the best non-sugar sweetner for taste ever, I'm surprised they've not brought it back, but until then sugar is the way to go. I'm a bit disappointed I only got one jar of this instead of the four promised, but that's the way they work with food products for Vine reviewers, a can instead of a case typically.Standard Kool Aid stuff here, pre-measured scoop for a pitcher or a glass and dissolve the stuff in very cold water.  Very drinkable.  I tried it with sliced peaches and some pineapple as an alternative to drinking it straight and it blends well.  Might save you a bit on fruit juices if you have a lot of thirsty kids.  I don't think they'll complain about the taste, I'm a lot more discriminating at my age than I was as a kid.  Now where do I get one of those big Kool Aid pitchers, I've looked for one for years!

column9: More of a MANGO flavor ... and NO, it is NOT healthy.
column10: I grew up on Kool-Aid ... orange, cherry, tropical punch, and strawberry flavors.  I don't drink it anymore, but do buy it on occasion as a treat for my kids.  It's still KOOL-AID, which means sugar (even if it is 35% less than sodas) and, of course, those infamous "artificial colors and flavors."  This particular variety has more of a MANGO taste than a peach taste.  It does taste good, as far as Kool-Aids go, if you like mangos (which I and my kids do).  Again, I cannot recommend this as a "healthy" drink for your kids, BUT I do believe it is better than drinking sodas (which can become addictive).  I still prefer (and push) my kids to drink water and milk as their primary means of hydration.  We leave the Kool-Aid mixes for parties or special treats.

Peach Mango Kool Aid, when added to water, has a pretty color and good flavor. Even though I am partial to their tropical punch flavor, I love mangoes, and this drink mix has wonderful mango notes with the subtle peach. Yes, I'm aware this is not wine, but I liked it.The label also boasts 35% less sugar than soda, but let's be honest. Kool Aid equals sugar, artificial colors, and flavors. And we would not have it any other way. I made a single serving glass (medium sized) for myself the first time I tried this and was hit by a mouthful of sweetness. It left a bit of an aftertaste which I had to chase down with water. Since then, it's a balancing act between the right amount of water and about a third of a tablespoon of the drink mix to get a good glass.If you get past the stigma of having "less sugar," you'll probably enjoy this nostalgic drink more. Cheers!

When you see the Kool Aid name, you know what you are getting - lots of sugar, artificial flavors, and artificial colors. I like mangoes, and the mango flavor really comes through in this drink. I don't really taste the peach. Many people said they thought the drink wasn't sweet enough, but I followed the directions and thought it was a little too sweet and added more water. My husband tries to avoid artificial drinks in general and didn't care for the flavor. I noticed that the bottom of my pitcher had a white film coating it after the drink was gone, and I found that to be a little off-putting. It seems like the chemicals they use don't completely dissolve and that just helped remind me of the drink's artificiality.One of Kool Aid's claims is that this drink has "35% less sugar than the leading regular sodas." Knowing how sugary Kool Aid usually is, I figured they were fudging the numbers by comparing their 8 ounce serving to a 12 oz serving of soda or something. I did a little research and compared some "leading regular sodas" (7-Up, Coke, Dr. Pepper, and Pepsi) and found that this Kool Aid drink actually has at least 35% less sugar than the sodas. I was surprised.Overall, I liked the flavor of this drink but I don't plan to buy it.

Kool Aid has been around for so long - it's probably been a part of almost everyone's childhood in some way shape or form, and I'm sure everyone has their favorites.While I appreciate that Kool Aid is trying new things, this flavor is not one of their best offerings.  When made according to the package directions the flavor is weak.  I added a little extra powder to my glass and while it did strengthen the flavor to what I thought it should be, it still just wasn't that appealing to me, it still tasted a bit blah unlike favorite Kool Aid flavors such as cherry and grape.If you're looking for something different or more mild perhaps you'll like this, but overall it's not something I would recommend if you're looking for traditional Kool Aid taste.

We made this KoolAid as directed, and the flavor was watered down and quite weak. I like KoolAid, but this flavor is perhaps my least favorite of all the flavors I've had. I can only say that my kids enjoyed the drink more than I did but we all agreed that this is not our favorite flavor. We will stick to the our favorite- cherry!

column9: Kool-Aid Kool-Aid, tastes great! More mango-y than peachy
column10: Kool-Aid is a sugary kids drink, no doubt about that.  It has the same calories and sugar content as Country Time lemonade, but while Country Time only has Vitamin C, this Kool-Aid has added C and E, for what that's worth.  Instead of the jar containing a scoop, the lid is a large measuring cup with lines for 1 or 2 quarts and you pour in the mix from the jar, much less messy than scooping. There's a little powder "cloud" but it dissolves easily.Kids and I both liked it. I felt there was a more mango flavor than peach, which gets points from me because artificial peach flavoring can be pretty bad. In fact, I bet they could sell this as just "mango" flavor.

I haven't drank Kool Aid in probably 30 years. Kool Aid Peach Mango tastes pretty much exactly how I remember Kool Aid tasting though. Just like the old fashioned flavors of Kool Aid, you'll have to use your imagination to think you're drinking something tasting like the actual flavor it is supposed to be. With that being said, it isn't bad. If you like sugary soft drinks, it tastes pleasant. It's loaded with sugar, artificial flavors, and artificial colorings. A health drink it is obviously not, but it is no worse than any other sugar or high fructose corn syrup soft drink.

This is great refreshment with mango and peach flavor. It tastes great and I love the flavor. It is easy to make, just add water and ice to the measured amount and stir. I would make this drink a little stronger by adding more of the stuff. Although this is a seasonal product known for spring or summer, you can also use this to make a great punch anytime of the year.1. Kool Aid Variety 48 Packs2. Kool-Aid Twists Ice Blue Raspberry Lemonade Unsweetened Soft Drink Mix, 0.22-Ounce Packets (Pack of 96)

My kids enjoy most Kool-Aid products, this one included, but I am not a fan of this one. My husband and I found it bland and these containers that include sweetener do not make much and we prefer to make the packets with our choice of how much sugar we like it with. Even though I did not care for this flavor my children did ask for it over other flavors of beverages until we used it all.

First of all, this is Kool-Aid.  So right off, you know you are basically getting a surgar fix with some artifical flavoring.  Those desiring something healthy should go elsewhere - this is not it.  Given that we are talking about Kool-Aid and not something that will make some governmental food pyramid or whatever polyhedra they are using at the moment, the only thing worth discussing is the taste.Back in the day (and I am old enough to remember "the day"), Kool-Aid came in pretty basic flavors:  cherry, orange, grape, etc.  It was in a bit of a competition by a johnny-come-lately competitor by Pillsbury called "Funny Face" that had such flavors as "Choo Choo Cherry", "Rootin Tootin Raspberry", "Goofy Grape", and "Jolly Ollie Orange."  Kool-Aid won and now rules as the sugar drink of choice.It now seems the choices are a lot more varied these days.  I guess all the competition from other those squeeze pouches with their unusual flavors have made Kool-Aid keep up with the trends.  No one would have imagined there would ever be a "peach mango" Kool-Aid or that it would actually taste like anything other than sugar water with some fake flavor.  But this stuff tastes pretty good - even fruit like.  It makes me wonder if the rest of the stuff has changed over the years as well.  In summary, this tastes pretty good for sugar water.  Isn't modern science great!!

column9: Great Kool-Aid, but prefer other drinks
column10: The flavor was good and it tastes like real fruit juice and dissolves quickly, but it's just sugar, artificial flavors and colors. So, I'd say it's fine for a once-in-a-while drink, but not for regular use because of the questionably healthy ingredients.

column9: Actually does have a mango flavor
column10: Growing up my mom refused to buy Kool Aid so I never had it as a kid at my parents house but had it at my friends whenever I had the opportunity to go there. As an adult I don't buy Kool Aid either for my kids but when given the opportunity from Vine to try this new flavor I decided why not? Personally I wouldn't buy it again but if you're a lover of Kool Aid then this definitely delivers. It does have that mango flavor that you can actually taste. The kids actually enjoyed it as well. Whoever said this isn't a drink that kids would enjoy as well probably doesn't have kids.We recently took a trip to the Caribbean and the kids got the opportunity to actually eat hand picked mangoes and my 11year old son said "this taste like the mango we had in St. Vincent" and he was right. It states that it has 33% less sugar and has vitamins C & E combined. As far as the sugar content I can't really state if this is true or not but it's good to know that it does have a few vitamins that's good for you. In my household we drink more water than juice but if given again I'd definitely drink it since it makes a great thirst quencher for hot summer days.

Not bad for a kool-aid beverage.  The flavor is not too artificial.  It is a bit too sweet for me so I watered it down (not too much).  It didn't lose the flavor! Nice change from the simple lemonade, water, or tea.  My husband likes this drink with some Chinese and Mexican.  I think it will make a great popsicle for those summer days.  My teen daughter is enjoying it very much though.

I let the kids have this one.  It came right out of the shipping carton and became Kool-Aid right away.It's a little bit sweet for grown-up tastes, but the kids really love it.  They finished it off in a couple days.  They usually drink Gatoraid and G2, but this ruled the house for as long as it lasted.It's easy as ever to mix up.  No need to add sugar because the sweetener is already in there.  And it really tastes like Peach-Mango!So, Easy to Mix, Tastes great, and took the place of their favorites!  All good!

I'm not much of a peach-mango fan, so I went into drinking this as a skeptic. So when I say "I did not dislike it" that's a compliment. I usually can't stand any kind of peach drink, but I didn't mind the Kool-Aid. My girlfriend, who likes MiO's Peach Mango flavor, gave this high marks, as did her best friend.Note that this Kool-Aid is pre-sweetened, so you don't have to add sugar unless you like your "sweet" the kind of sweet you find in Southern sweet tea.You can also vary the amount of water you add here to great effect; unlike some lemonades, where it tastes "wrong" unless you get the mixture just so, here it varies from a full-bodied fruit punch to a refreshing, slightly fruity thirst quencher.

column9: I have a love/ hate relationship with Kool Aid
column10: While my Mom made just like I love it, my Grandmother always forgot to add any sugar. And being a dumb kid, I would always take a big drink  Yuck!I really wish they made this kind back then. It is pre-sweetened, so no worries, take a big drink. The flavor is Peach with a Mango aftertaste. There are no "bad" or "artificial" tastes, just a nice tropical blend. It makes a great Breakfast juice first thing in the morning.And while not my favorite flavors, it is still very nice when you are thirsty. The mix comes in a container where the lid is your mixing guide. My one complaint is that it that the label that holds the lid on also has half of the instructions.

column9: A Sweet Flavor of Kool-Aid that you and your Kids will Enjoy!
column10: Kool Aid has come out with a flavor called Peach Mango. It's a wonderful flavor that you and your kids will enjoy. The Peach Mango Kool Aid is already been mixed with Sugar so all you have to do is add the amount of water that is necessary and drink it. This is a great low calorie juice option at only 60 calories per 8 fluid oz. As for how it tastes, the peach enhances the mango flavor giving it a soft non overpowering sweet taste. This is a great new flavor from Kool Aid and I can't wait to try other combinations in the future!

column9: Thought I Was Drinking Fruit Punch
column10: When my wife gave me this stuff, it tasted like fruit punch, only slightly watered down.  She said she put more water than the Kool-Aid recipe called for, since Kool-Aid usually tastes too sugary for her.But it's an interesting Kool-Aid flavor, and I couldn't even tell it was Kool-Aid.  It's actually pretty tropical.  I think Kool-Aid did a good job.  But this drink probably is better with more water in it than they recommend.

column9: Would love to see this flavor offered in the juice pouches!
column10: The only Kool Aid products I usually buy are the juice pouches for school lunches. My kids usually drink water when at home. This was a nice little treat for them.  The flavor was delicious.  Not as good as my all time favorite lime Kool-Aid that I remember as a child. But, it was really good.  I mixed this both as directed and a bit watered down.  I preferred the watered down but either way, it tastes great and had some trace vitamins.  If the juice pouches were to come in this flavor, my kids would be happy. Great new flavor.

column9: Great beverage, taste as good as real fruit.
column10: Our family loves mangos prepared in a variety of ways.Even our favorite salsa is 'Chachies' mango peach.For us this Kool-Aid drink is a welcome departure from classic flavors.Robust mango is predominate, but there's also a solid peach influence.This peach-mango Kool-Aid is refreshingly differentwith the flavors tasting as genuine, as if they were real fruit juice.It's quick to make, the granules desolve and blend immediately.This Kool-Aid contains 35% less sugar than leading sodas.The cap is a measuring cup marked for one or two quarts.We'd rather the Kool-Aid didn't contain yellow and red food coloring.But they got the color right, it looks and smells appealing to drink.Overall we think this is a great beverage.

There is no question that Kool-Aid has been putting the smiles on so many people over the years. But they definitely have had a lack of strong tropical flavors. Their Peach Mango drink mix gives a nice, mild flavor combining the elegance of peach with the tangy twist of mango which blends in very nicely. I was a bit mixed at first, but overall pleasantly surprised at how good it tastes. It honestly is better than those tiring cherry and grape flavors after awhile, and definitely a nice change of pace for the kids. Overall, I definitely recommend that you give Kool-Aid's new Peach Mango flavor a try, and simply drift into a twist on sweet peach and tangy mango madness.Price: BTaste: BOverall: B

We are Kool-aid drinkers in our home so I was really excited to try Peach Mango Kool-aid. I love peach and mango flavors so I was sure this would be a hit with me. It was just okay for me. The peach and mango flavoring is very light. Also the sugar was a bit too much. I found myself having to add more Kool-aid than was suggested to get the fruit flavor to be stronger. I could taste the sugar no problem but I really wanted to taste more of the fruit flavoring. Even my kids, who are sugar fiends thought the sugary taste was too much. They also agreed that it needed a stronger fruit flavor. The Kool-aid does mix well and the sugar does dissolve well. It was an okay flavor.

It has been a while since I have had koolaid. I remember when I was younger my mom didn't like to buy it, because they only sold the packets that you had to add sugar to and she didn't want us drinking all that sugar. Now that Koolaid comes in the tubs with the sugar already included, it is much easier to deal with. We now have the option to make just one glass at a time, rather than having to create a whole pitcher because we have to add sugar.I am a big fan of peach flavor, and this peach mango Koolaid is no exception. The taste is great! There is the perfect blend of mango versus peach. I love that I can add the amount of powder that I prefer and someone else can make a glass at the same time and add the amount of powder that they like.
