column9: ...like sipping a glass of pure Sunshine. :)
column10: Kool Aid Peach Mango Sugar SweetenedKool Aid is easy!  just measure, mix with water, stir, add ice and drink.Kool Aid Peach Mango Sugar Sweetened dissolves quickly (with no dry lumps of product floating on top of water). A not overly sweet drink with hints of mango and peach -- and, an aesthetically pleasing color that is sure compliment most glassware and table settings.The perfect refreshment for Spring and Summer, Kool Aid Peach Mango Sugar Sweetened is like sipping a glass of pure Sunshine. 'nuf said! --Highly Recommended!  --Katharena Eiermann, 2012

I can't say I'm all that crazy bout this flavor. It tastes a bit flowery and not tangy at all.I like that it has no high-fructose corn syrup and supposedly less sugar. It's also very easy to mix into water and to make it less sweet by using less powder as well.If you are a big fan of mango and peach, this may just be the Kool Aid for you.

Kool Aid Peach Mango is delicious.  While the flavors, according to the package, are artificial, it doesn't have that "fake" taste.  It mixes easily and, in my opinion, is fine if made a little more dilute than the package recommendation.Yes, the primary ingredient is sugar, and this beverage is not a choice for those who prefer to avoid sugar.  However, as an alternative to other sugar-sweetened beverages, it is economical (almost two quarts for a dollar) and convenient, because you're not bringing big heavy bottles home from the store.

Kool Aid's been around for 85 years and most folks have tried it at some time so I'm reviewing the flavor not the idea that it is Kool Aid versus other drink choices. The flavor is called peach mango but it is the mango that dominates the drink. As a family who loves peaches and likes mango, it seemed like a good fit but it really should be called Mango with a hint of Peach.  So, if you love mango-flavored foods and drinks you'll enjoy this. If you are looking for the peach flavor to be equal (or more because it is first in the title)to the mango then you'll be disappointed.  Also, using the directed amount exactly made the flavor taste a bit "thin"; adding a couple of teaspoons to the directed amount improved the richness of the flavor but didn't change it from mango to more of a peach-mango pair.

column4: Shana "That's my opinion- I could be wrong!"
column9: Can't get more USA than Kool-Aid
column10: Usually, I don't drink sweet drinks at all, but, I love peach and mango, so I decided to try this Kool-Aid flavor. It is actually really tasty. Not too sweet and more of the peach flavor comes through.As usual, this Kool-Aid is easy to make, just fill up to the line on the top cup and add to a gallon or so of water. Or I use 1/2 tsp for a tall glass. Mix then chill and enjoy.

column9: I'm not a fan of Kool Aid, but this isn't too bad.
column10: I kind of like the flavor of this stuff.  But, I don't think *kids* would care for it.  To me, Kool Aid has that distinctive flavor to it that reminds me of other kids' houses growing up - coming in from playing outside and their mom gives you some red Kool Aid that turned your lips red.  (We didn't have this stuff in my house growing up.).  This stuff - the "peach mango" version of Kool Aid, tastes to me like a more of an "adult" drink.  I don't think kids would like "peach mango" anything.  I didn't mind it - but I didn't think it was amazing either.  It was sort of like a more flavorful version of Crystal Light.I'm not a fan of these drink mixes, even Crystal Light.  I don't trust the chemicals they use, the sweeteners, even the "natural" flavorings used.  You'd be surprised where those actually come from!But, overall, I liked the flavor, but I wouldn't think kids would like it, and I wouldn't buy it again for myself.

column9: Excellent new Kool-Aid flavor Mango.  Even though aritficial is has a natural fresh mango flavor.  Our New Favorite.
column10: We loved the new Peach Mango Kool-Aid. We normally only like grape Kool-Aid but this is our new favorite flavor. Used as directed you get a delicate fresh mango flavor, but if you use too much it just taste like Kool-Aid. I love Bolt house Mango Peach, and this is gives me good light fresh taste similar to the fresh mango flavor, sort of like if you diluted the Bolt house. If you like Mango you will love this. You can add fruit to this if you prefer. Refrigerate rest of Kool-Aid.Party time place in punch bowl (optional 1/2 gallon pineapple sherbet and) frozen mango Kool-Aid.  Pour remaining Kool-Aid over top. Next add 1(2 liter or 6 -12 ounce cans) of sweet ginger ale. Are any that start with s:shastaShasta Ginger Ale, 33.81-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 15), segramsSeagram's Ginger Ale, 12 oz Can (Pack of 24)) or if you prefer 7UP you can add more soda to taste. Remember sherbet is optional punch is good without it.

I was an instant fan of this product. My kids? Even more! The only downside is the same downside as the rest of the pre-sweetened koolaid products... I couldn't control the amount of sugar in it. However, if you're in a pinch and need something quick, this will certainly refresh kids and adults alike.

I served this as a treat to a bunch of ten year old boys who LOVED it.  The pitcher was gone before the ice had a chance to melt. I snagged a glass before it was gone and I didn't have the same reaction as the boys.  Maybe because I am a product of the Kool-Aid generation?  Nothing sends me into flashbacks of happiness like the original.  This one was just "ok" and since we are a healthier family I would rather enjoy the classic flavor as a treat.  The boys were split 50/50 on who liked the Peach Mango flavor better than the original.  Either way, I don't think it is disappointing or off-the-mark, rather a taste preference.
I wasn't sure how I would feel about "peach mango" flavored Kool-Aid, but it is a very refreshing flavor. Recommended.

I thought this was a great new flavor blending peach and mango flavoring.  The Kool-Aid folks always have a quality product and this did not disappoint.  Anyone familiar with with cannister Kool-Aid kow how easy this product is to use.  Another winner.

Hesitant at first, I ordered the new Kool-Aid peach mango flavor. I'm not a big fan of peach, but the mango looked appealing. When you open it there are little yellow flecks mixed in the mix, and that looks like it's the mango flavoring.Works great with some "medicine."

This isn't bad.  I used to like Kool-Aid when I was a kid, especially the red flavors.  Or mixing a red with grape was also quite good.  I'm just not sure about the Mango.  I like mango flavor, and this does taste like mango to me, but it doesn't do it for me as a drink.  I also tried this with my Sodastream Fountain Jet Soda Maker Starter Kit, but it's not much better carbonated.  It's too sweet.  Perhaps the packets where you can add the sugar yourself would be better.

Obviously not the most healthy drink around, but I like to have some on hand for when we run out of other, more healthy alternatives.  Quick and easy to make.  The Peach Mango flavor is tasty, refreshing with ice.  My husband even liked it and he's extremely picky.  So, I'd buy again, to use once in a while.
The new Peach-Mango Koolaid rocks!! I'm actually thinking of turning this into a daquiri or some sort of mixed drink!...lol. Just because I really like I am sure they won't keep it around long.

column9: A hit with the kids and the parents

column9: The most delicious jam on the market

I use these to decorate my cinnamon coffee cakes and its always a big hit.  After applying the icing in a criss-cross fashion I put one at ever intersecting line and it turns out beautifully. This delicious eel is packed in soy sauce and is a good substitute for fish when I don't have any on hand.  It works well with sushi.  Tuna and salmon in the can tastes so terrible these days.  I bought this eel for a great price in quantity of 8.

the best. had a 2009 exp date! just as i remember. i love this stuff. dont buy it tho save some for me.

Let me just say that this tea is about average. I feel like the tea wasn't made to high standards, but then you have the fact that they're whole leaves. I think this creates a weird situation where you have a bad product of high quality. I'm a supertaster, so I will describe the product as best as I can. It has your typical oolong bass notes, but the higher notes are very grassy (sometimes oolong is sweet, bitter...etc etc etc, this is grassy). It has a fair balance between bitterness and boldness. Incase you aren't gathering what I'm trying to say... it's a very neutral flavor and doesn't really 'wow' me at all. The grassy flavor taste exactly like wheaties cereal (no frosted).... and that sounds stupid but when you try it you'll instantly make the connection.So, in conclusion it's a plain tea that I won't really hold up high on my tea shrines, but it does have one last unique quality. It taste odd, but I can't stop drinking it. It's like raman noodles... you never say "man I can sure go for some raman", but when you are actually eating raman you make sure you eat every last noodle. It's like that.12/10/11 EDIT: After drinking a few of these, I can say that it's a great tea to drink without anything added. I normally add sugar to most of my teas in some way or another (honey, sugar, guava), but I find that this tea is actually really good without anything added. I'm not going to officially change my 3 star rating, but I am tempted to bump it up to 4 stars.

This final adjective, however, doesn't describe Sunridge Farms' Organic Sunflower Seeds.  I opened the first bag.  Took a couple of bites and then spit them out.  I tried a second bag.  Same reaction.  I wondered whether or not there was something wrong with my own taste, so I offered them to someone whose sense of taste I respect.  She had the same reaction I had.  In short, these sunflower seeds are inedible.  It's like chewing on rancid, tasteless cardboard.  I threw out the entire shipment.  There are far better options available.

column9: I had no idea I would like these so much!
column10: No need for roasting and salt! This is great on its own! I am amazed! The taste and texture are great and it will make you feel good after the first bite! I am so happy to have bought this! Great value for all organic, too!

I wanted organic raw sunflower seeds to use in making homemade granola. These were perfect - a nice crisp, tasty, nut-like addition that really complement the other flavors. You can also toast these in the oven or stovetop for a crunchy healthy snack. I originally thought a pack of 12 would last me a long long time, but after snacking on these and seeing how delicious they are, I'm pretty sure I'll go through the 12 packs much more quickly than I thought!

This is the only way to go... buying the raw seeds. You can roast them yourself and have fresh seeds all the time. I like the taste and will always buy this rather than any other products. I keep them in the freezer and take out a little each day to roast, they taste wonderful!
These seeds taste OK but after soaking them they did not sprout well and so I wonder how fresh they are. The sunflower seeds I get from my natural foods store spout very well and cost about the same.

column9: allergens not listed correctly on amazon
column10: I think the allergy statement on this page is REALLY MISLEADING.  It only warns about peanuts and tree nuts, when actually the package also mentions a number of other allergens that these sunflower seeds were exposed to.  If there was no allergen statement, I would have contacted the manufacturer to find out the allergen statement for this product.  But because there is allergen info in the description on Amazon, I assumed that it was the complete list, so I went ahead and ordered these, only to find out that actually these "may contain" wheat and other allergens.  My family is very allergic to wheat.  So now we've got a ton of useless sunflower seeds.  I think the description of this product should contain either a current allergen listing, or no allergen listing, but not an incomplete one -- that's misleading.

These might mean well, but I found the seeds to be very bland.  NO SALT is added, which I did not realize when I bought them:( Also, you should note that they need to be refrigerated once opened. Not very convenient when taking them on trips or to the beach.  These may be good on salads , but otherwise, I found them to be less than desirable. I guess a real health food nut would like these.  I try to eat organic, all natural foods as much as I can. But, I can find much better tasting stuff than these seeds. On a positive note, sunflower seeds are among the healthiest foods you can eat.  VERY good for you. I ended up giving almost all of this shipment to the food for the poor.

column9: I love the flavour of black rice.
column10: Now I won't eat any other kind. Black rice is a natural anti inflammatory which is very evident to me since I have multiple food allergies and intolerances. I handle black rice better than any other grain. Lotus foods black rice is of very good quality. I once ordered from another source and the grain wasn't as good, slightly lighter in color and with some loose hulls. Shipping from Amazon was prompt.I'm very happy I discovered this rice.

column9: STOP, Read my review before consuming this product
column10: Ask a Chinese friend about "forbidden rice" (禁米), unless they are history buff like myself, they will give you a puzzled look.  The term refers to an obscure trade policy during Manchurian dynasty, not an exotic rice.  I will not going to bore you  with history here.The story about emperor depriving commoners of red rice is a hoax made in America, like the legion of fortune cookies. Most fortune cookies are made in a wholesome factory near Atlanta.  We trust that fortune cookies are safe to eat.  "Forbidden rice?"There is a red rice in China, dark red, close to red bean.  The color varies from gran to gran. Its thick bran provides a pleasant nutty flavor and al dente texture.  The color does not come off easily.  You can get them from Chinese grocery store.What is sold as "forbidden rice" at Amazon and Costco has a uniformed black to deep purple color.  It appears to be rice over-milled, dyed, and polished.  Drop a few grains in water, you can see color coming off.  And the color tent to sink to the bottom. That is a easy tell tail.  When cooked, the favor and texture of bran are absent.  If they use red rice, they have milled away its bran to make the rice easy to dye.There is nothing wrong with using food coloring.  But is the ink FDA approved?  We do not know.  The label does not say.I am returning mine to Costco.  I will ask Costco to pull it off the shelf.

I purchased not only the cherry syrup from "Back to Basics" but 3 others syrups along with the "Slushie" machine before two of my grandsons had their tonsils removed.  They loved the cherry syrup the most, it had alot of flavor and it was the one flavor they asked for the repeatedly after they had their surgeries.  Most children do not want "all the ice cream you can eat" that the doctors tell them they can have post-op. Children and adults alike must drink to prevent dehydration after a tonsilectomy.  This syrup and the slushie machine was a wonderful way of getting my grandchildren to drink something cold to soothe their throats, but also something sweet so they felt they were getting some kind of a treat after going through the surgery.

We enjoy this syrup, but there is still room for improvement. Obviously, it is sugary, which is not good for health concious folks. I imagine that the sugar free kind probably is not as tasty, but we might give it a try this summer. I will let you know if I do! The other downside is that you need to use a fairly large amount each time; otherwise, as the ice melts, your slushy or snow cone becomes watered down. You can easily go through this small bottle after just 6 uses. That being said, I'd rather hit the Dairy Queen drive-thru and let them do the work for me. It really does not cost much more to do so (about $1.69 for one arctic rush where I live), and it saves time and effort. If you are determined to do it yourself, though, this is quite delicious!

I ordered this product to make white, strawberry-flavored icing for some cupcakes for a wedding. since it was so expensive, i did not test it to make sure it actually tasted like strawberry before baking day. My Mistake! It smelled like bad bubblegum and tasted like Windex or something - just a terrible, chemical taste. i made the icing, then tasted it and thought "what was on my finger!? nail polish remover or something?" well I hadn't done my nails, it was the icing! i could not serve that. I had to start over and use vanilla at the last minute. Thankfully the bride was very understanding. I DO NOT recommend this product. (Also, when I contacted the seller to try to send it back, they would never reply. Obviously they don't stand behind what they sell. Money Wasted.)

I started taking this, because my mornings are so crazy. This gives me the daily fiber I need as well as the important Omega fatty acids. I have felt wonderful since taking this and am ordering more in the next day or two.

When I think of Lindt chocolate, I think of silky-smooth richness. No matter how true the chili-chocolate combination is to chocolate's New World origins, it doesn't quite match my impression of Lindt's reserved elegance.Well, I'm wrong a lot. Lindt pulls it off beautifully. The chocolate flavor is all you might hope for, but with a high, thin note of tingle in the aftertaste. It hints at chili's fire, but only just warms the mouth. Delightful!-- wiredweird

My family loves this mustard... when we have dinner that might require condiments we don't even put the 'regular' mustard on the table anymore.  It is not very spicy (to me...) but it does have a distinct flavor of jalapeno.

I had been buying Silver Springs Mustard, Jalapeno, 9.5-Ounce Squeeze Bottles (Pack of 9), but Amazon stopped carrying it. This mustard tastes almost identical to the Silver Springs and, because of the larger bottle, it is easier to squeeze more of the mustard out. Like another reviewer, Amazon sent me only one bottle instead of the case of 6, but when I notified them of the problem they shipped me a case overnight. This mustard is so good that I need to find things to put it on... a nice hot pretzel would be perfect.

This Jalapeno Mustard became hard to find locally, so I had to order it by the case of 6.  Well worth it, because it's a great, versatile product.  We love using it in our potato salad as it adds just a little zip to anything you add it to.  It tastes like typical yellow mustard but with a kick of jalapeno.  We don't find it too spicy though, just right.
This is Jalapeno based mustard so be prepared! It is very GOOD! Buy a case and take a bottle to BBQ/tailgate parties and leave as a gift!
Use a little mustard with a bit of spice and you'll never eat plain mustard again....not too hot, just right.

For my taste its the BEST jalapeno mustard made.  I love jalapenos & you definetely get the jalapeno flavor.  The only drawback is I can't find it locally any more - but I stocked up at Amazon.com & got free shipping too.
This Woeber's product is also very delicious. I bought three Woeber products and I like all three of them. They are very delicious and I am very happy with my purchase of all three.
This stuff ROCKS!!! I am so glad Amazon carries it. If you like a hot flavored mustard you will probably love this one. Not too hot either. Great price and free shipping too!
Best flavored jalapeno mustard that I've found.Very hard to find a store who carries this product.
This jalapeno mustard is great! We use so much we have to buy it by the case!
Could not find it in the stores ant more was glad to find it on the WEB. If you like hot Mustard but not too hot this is your choice. Great with anything that you like Mustard on.
You can't find this particular item anywhere else.  Great taste and spicy.

BEWARE - I WAS SENT ONLY ONE BOTTLE FOR THE $14. I CONTACTED AMAZON, THEY SAID THEY WOULD CORRECT AND RE-SEND THE ORDER -- ONLY TO SEND ME A SINGLE BOTTLE AGAIN. ORDER NOW CANCELLED. NICE PRODUCT -- BUT WATCH OUT.
I don't know how they do it - this dressing is low in calories, not loaded with sugar or fat and is delicious.
I love not having to make my own, yes, I am lazy :)  Wishbone also has a fat free version that is good, but this tastes fuller. It brings out and enhances the flavor of your salad ingredients.

column9: Try this with crumbled Bleu Cheese
column10: My favorite dressing is this Red Wine Vinaigrette with crumbled bleu cheese.  The combination of the sweetness of this dressing along with the robust bleu cheese make an awesome combination.  Try it, you'll like it!

This wishbone salad dressing is becoming one of my favorites! I primarily use it as a dressing on vegetable salads, like cucumber, pasta or bean salads. I prefer the Red Wine Vinaigrette over any of the other vinaigrette versions by Wishbone, which just aren't as good as this one.Home-made vinaigrette is best, but this Wishbone is the next best thing! I purchase the 36-ounce size from Sam's which I find to be the best price. Yet it tastes much more expensive than it is.Pass on the yucky fat-free versions and use this one in moderation. Enjoy!

This product has MSG in it. I felt stupid because after all the " Naturally helps absorb vitamins A & E; Naturally rich in Omega 3 ALA**; No High Fructose Corn Syrup", they still use Mono-sodium Glutamate- MSG. I hate Wishbone now and will tell anyone who loves salad to avoid them at all costs.PS I checked the website for their explanation for this and read, "WE only use MSG when we feel it's necessary for taste"--- Isn't that why everyone used it, before health experts found it to be toxic!Do whats right for yourself and your family--- Avoid this Company!!!

I picked these up one day at PETCO and was amazed.  My two dogs went NUTS over them.  If they even hear the bag they come running.  Whoever came up with this recipe knows what dogs like!  One of my dogs is older and can't chew as well and the softness is particularly great for him.

I have a JRT who is very picky about treats.  He loves these.  I like that there's no corn syrup here as in many soft treats.  The best thing about these is they're soft enough to mold around his pills and he just gulps them down!

I have a 10 year old, rescued, toy poodle and apparently his previous owners taught him to beg for people food. I do not feed dogs people food but I feel so bad when he sits in the floor and begs while we eat dinner at the table. So I bought these to give him when he begs. He also has tooth issues, so I needed them to be soft. He liked it and wanted more, but he seems to like another one (of the same brand) better that is chicken liver flavored. My only issue is I paid 8 dollarsish for these on amazon and found them the day before my delivery arrived at Petsmart for less than $5. Will be purchasing there from now on.
Peanut Butter is one of my English Springer Spaniels favorite treats!  And these are the perfect size for rewarding him for good behavior!

My Havanese puppy (5 mos old) loves these treats.  We have used them for potty training.  When she goes out side rather than inside we do a clap and she gets a gooberlicious--actually its about 1/3 of one becuase we cut them up for training at home.  I do not use them for obedience training because the cut up ones are too crumbly to keep in my pocket.  For a larger dog you could probably use the full size treat.  They last well in the bag provided.

column9: My dog did not flip over for Gooberlicious!
column10: I first bought this because my puppy never had any peanut butter flavored treats and it was on sale at petsmart. I was expecting small pieces but the pieces from the 10 oz. pack were the size of a real peanut. He ate the first 4 to 5 pieces but afterward he ignored it entirely. He refuses to do tricks for this treat. For the longest time I had no idea why. I did some research on dog treats and food. What's healthy and what's not. I soon realized that this is made with Chicken By-Product Meal...which is a BIG NO NO.On top of that it doesn't smell good. Every time I touch it my hand it would reek of this treat. Not a pleasant experience for me and my puppy.

column9: Hubba Bubba Squeeze Pop, Assorted Sour Lollipops, 4-Ounce Tubes (Pack of 18)
column10: As a 30 year type 1 diabetic, I have had, more than I care to think about, many occasions of low blood sugar. Like 25,28,35,46....  This can kill you.  At times like that, I need some glucose IMMEDIATELY if not sooner.I have the glucose tabs...dozens of them, but sometimes when you really need them, none can be found.These Hubba Bubba squeeze tubes work FANTASTIC..for me. They are resealable with the cap, so I can take the amount I need and save the rest for later. They last a long time, I mean they aren't going to melt or spoil. I carry them in our cars, within reach of my bed...scattered throughout our home...in the pocket of my cargo pants....everywhere.When I need them...I NEED THEM.This product has saved me more times than I can remember...and they taste good too.I've noticed that many people just plain like them for their intended purpose.  Sour or sweet candy.Locally at a gas station, I pay $1.29 + tax for each tube and have seen them at $1.59. I save a bit and buy this box of 18 at Amazon. Many have stated that this product can be hard to find. Well - go to Amazon.com and buy a box and save a little over buying individually.I rate this product 5 stars, because without them, I might not be rating anything....ever again.  :-)
Hard to find product that seems to make 15 year-olds ecstatic. Good price, shipped quickly: who could ask for anything more?

This is a great product and worth the money.My order shipped out very fast.The Sour Squeeze Pops are deliscious.The Squeeze Pops have lasted me about 2 Months.I will definitely make a purchase with them again.Hope this helps!

These are a lovely light crunchy dessert-y snack.  They are perfect because they have no added sugar and no weird manufactured fake sweetening.  Very satisfying for that little sweet craving you have for a cookie.
I just purchased; i will leave them at my job because i will eat the whole box. Lol

It is hard to find anything with spelt and this cracker is so delicious. Some time ago I bought another flavor with onion and seeds which I also like. But the sweetness of the Cinnamon Raisin really satisfies my palate. I will order these again. And with Amazon, you know they will arrive post-haste.

When cold season comes I would'nt be without these little pine drop candies.  The flavor is subtle and not overpowering like some of the cough drops I've tried. (Halls for one) They also make a pleasant little candy, not too sweet.  I really like these a lot.
I have never heard of pine drops so I tried them.They do not taste like pine but more like a menthol cough drop.
The honey mustard sauce is delicious!  It sure makes the life of a chronic dieter a lot more interesting.  I stir-fry turkey or chicken in it, then throw in some veggies for an easy one-pot supper.

This isn't just healthy pasta (although it is that).  It's delicious!!!  My husband, who totally hates whole-wheat pasta (he'll eat whole-wheat bread, if pushed against the wall, but absolutely holds out against whole-wheat pasta) adores this.  He prefers it to any other pasta.  Now, if it's out of stock at the store, he grumbles and won't buy his old favorite brands as a substitute.  I love that it tastes so good that we can serve a healthy spaghetti dinner for unsuspecting company without anyone asking what on earth we did to the food.  We're thrilled to see that it will soon be available on Amazon so we can stock up!
I choose to eat multigrain pasta because it is better for one's health than the traditional pasta.
This by far the best pasta out there.  It's healthy and cooks really fast too.
Tastes terrible and contains High Fructose Corn Syrup.  Would never have purchased this for my family had this information been listed.  Additionally 2 of the jars arrived damaged.

column9: Probably the best tasting instant coffee around!
column10: I have tried Member's Mark 100% Colombian instant coffees (both the regular and decaf version) and all I can say is WOW!!!  This is how instant coffee should be!  No bitter, astringent, chicory or corn-like after taste. In fact, no bad or nasty aftertaste at all that lingers in your mouth much like all the other instant coffees I've tasted and tried--- and I've tasted many, including the more popular brands like Nescafe Classic/Gold/Taster's Choice House Blend/Taster's Choice 100% Colombian, Yuban 100% Arabica Instant Coffee, Maxwell House, Folgers etc.Those used to popular commercial brands of instant coffees will probably initially perceive this coffee as lacking in bitterness or strength but don't be misled by the 'bitter = stronger/more concentrated' deception of many popular instant coffee brands! This coffee is far from 'diluted' in taste. It has simply the best flavor and aroma in any instant coffee I've ever tried!  If you want a stronger or weaker coffee, just add more or less teaspoons to a cup.  This is one instant coffee that will never make your cup too bitter so as to become undrinkable.  Simply the best there is in instant coffee!  Made from 100% arabica coffee beans with no inferior, bitter-tasting, robusta coffee added whatsoever.  You owe it to yourself to try this coffee and taste the difference 100% arabica coffee makes!  This is the taste that you've been missing for from your instant coffee. Now you don't have to drink brewed coffee all the time just because commercial instant coffees taste so bad! Also available at a much cheaper price at Sam's Club and Costco membership stores.

I love Columbian Coffee made from the highest quality Arabica Beans.  However, this product seems to have been made from the very poorest quality bean and then burned in the roasting process.  And the price was outrageous given the poor quality of the product.  Would never purchase again.  I am usually never disappointed by an Amazon order, so this was a first.....

this is a delicious, fresh fruity jam. it would be hard to duplicate it yourself. it's great on pancakes, english muffins, and pb & j sandwiches. try finding it in the grocery store. you never will. there are lots of different berry jams in the grocery store, but no huckleberry, and it wouldn't be as fresh and richly flavored as this if you did find it. i highly recommend it!

Trying to get a good Huckleberry Jam with lots ofberries and the right tartness is hard.  So many jamsyou take a sample of it,  and it is like biting into a sugar cube.This had a lot of berries and the taste is exquisite.I will re order plus I would highly recommend this to anybody else.
This Huckleberry Jam is So good, we enjoy this every morning on our toast or fresh bread !will be back soon to order more.
The huckleberry jam was good, unforgettable, wonderful, and delicious. I have really enjoyed eating this jam. I will buy it again, and recommend it to others.
This is the greatest jam you have ever tasted.  The huckleberry flavor isn't hidden by sugar and syrup like others I have tasted....just great.

column9: best coconut taste yet and good for digestion
column10: Best tasting coconut milk I have enjoyed so far (by my taste, you may prefer others), Aloe adds body without being intrusive. Have not experienced GERD or upset stomach since beginning to drink CocoAloe - it must provide balance to the digestive system - I have been plagued for years with GERD. It is expensive, especially at the price on Amazon. I can get it for half that at my local health food and country stores.Why is it not on "subscribe and save"?

I bought this variety pack in order to sample the Chebe products.  I will buy these products again, though I had a little trouble with gumminess.  These products must be baked thoroughly.  Some of the doughs could use a little salt as well.  My family's favorite way to eat the cheese rolls is like  a flatbread, grilled on the bbq.  Living gluten-free is tough, but these products are worth using on a regular basis.
Fastachi makes the perfect gift!! Everyone I've given a tin to has loved it! The nuts are fresh and the dried fruits are unlike any I've ever tasted. I highly recommend them!!

We took in a starving little ferrel kitten almost 2 years ago that we eventually discovered has digestive problems and allergies to corn, wheat, soy and fillers.. We live in a rural area where we don't have a lot of choices in pet foods. We kept trying all kinds of natural foods available at Walmart, Kmart, etc., trying to find one that worked for him, but nothing worked. We finally found Diamond's natural's at our local Tractor Supply and decided to give it a try.. It's the one that worked! Our little "pew" kitty is now pretty much gas free, his cat box isn't full of it (if you get my drift) and he's doing beautifully. He's a huge cat with silky smooth long hair. On the plus side, Diamond Natural's are made in the USA! We also switched our dog to Diamond's natural because he also has allergies to corn, wheat, soy and fillers.. His fur is thicker and softer and he isn't chewing non stop like he was before.. Plus he loves the food! We use Diamond Naturals Lamb and Rice formula for him. Don't confuse the Diamond's Maintenance with the Diamond's Natural's, though.. The Maintenance formula's do include corn and fillers... If your pet has allergies, make sure you purchase the Naturals!

I had previously been feeding my three kittens the Trader Joe seafood formula which they have liked with no complaints. I noticed however that it was mostly corn based and wanted to try something healthier and more natural for my brood. I started acclimating them to the new Chicken & Rice Formula by mixing the old and new half and half. My siamese, who is very fickle, decided she liked Diamond Naturals the best and refused to eat anything "mixed" preferring to switch immediately to the new food. My shorthair and manx love it too. In the big 18lb bag at a great price, I have no complaints and have been very pleased.

column9: Closest thing to species appropriate in a kibble
column10: Until I see a feline plucking berry's to munch on I'm sticking to a high protein dry food without all the fruits, vegetables and chemical additives. This is my top pick as far as kibble. The kittens are thriving on it. I've tried all the expensive foods that appeals to the buyer with fruits and veggies and they'd rather starve then eat it. The most marked difference between this food and the foods with lesser protein is they eat less because their daily protein requirement is being fulfilled.

I bought this to feed a few feral cats.  They absolutely dislike it.  Before buying this food, I'd have to refill their bowls with their usual brand at least twice a day.  I now fill the bowls in the morning and there is still food there at night.  The ingredients look decent, it doesn't have a bad odor but for some reason they just won't eat it.  I gave it two stars instead of one because it also temporarily solved a problem I had with racoons.  The racoons didn't like it either and stopped coming around to make a mess on my back porch.
This food is very good for your cat, high protein, low carb, and my cats love it. It is also non toxic, it's the only food I feed my cats.
Diamond brand is the best deal I've found on high quality dry food that my cats like.  Simple as that.

I have relatively mixed feelings about this cat food. For one, the food itself has a stronger smell than some other cat foods I've bought before. I suppose that's not a bad thing since the cats can smell it, but I personally don't really care for the smell.Our cats seem to like the taste of it and don't voice any complaints. However, one of our two cats has a more sensitive stomach - and after eating this food she's had litterbox issues a few times - deciding to do her business right outside the litterbox in a rather non-solid mess. Our other cat has done fine, but the smell in the litterbox has been nothing short of awful when she forgets to cover up after doing her business.Overall, I don't really care for this product and probably won't buy it again. But it seems like a better choice over store-brand and other cheap dry food that's full of fillers.

Consumers may also go to a special website, diamondpetrecall.com, for more information. If left untreated, pets may be lethargic and have diarrhea or bloody diarrhea, fever and vomiting. Infected but otherwise healthy pets can be carriers and infect other animals or humans. If your pet has consumed the recalled product and has these symptoms, please contact your veterinarian.Individuals handling dry pet food can become infected with Salmonella, especially if they have not thoroughly washed their hands after having contact with surfaces exposed to this product. People who believe they may have been exposed to Salmonella should monitor themselves for some or all of the following symptoms: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or bloody diarrhea, abdominal cramping and fever. According to the Centers for Disease Control, people who are more likely to be affected by Salmonella include infants, children younger than 5 years old, organ transplant patients, people with HIV/AIDS and people receiving treatment for cancer. Don't waste your money.  Cats hate this food and I have now wasted my hard earned money. Also, it smells awful.  I wouldn't eat it either.

column9: Cats still skepticle, though I am firm.
column10: I have been giving this to my cats for nearly two years on an off and on basis. I feel this is healthier than some of the other foods, I can afford. Both cats seem to be thriving on it with glistening coats and no illnesses whatever.

column9: A Savory Sweet Spice for your Crab & Shrimp Dishes
column10: This wonderful spice makes it easy to put a different spin on your seafood cooking because it's an incredibly easy spice to use. It contains wine solids and very little salt (yeah!). We've bought these small 1-ounce packets for years, so we were very happy when we accidentally stumbled upon the big restaurant/institutional-sized jars Cajun King New Orleans Style Barbecue Shrimp Seasoning Mix, 20-Ounce Plastic Containers (Pack of 2). They were a great bargain compared to the packets, but we wondered if the ingredients were the same? Turns out they're slightly different (e.g., jars have sauterne wine, packets have chablis), but thankfully, the tastes are actually identical.Both the jars and the packets have cooking instructions that recommend completely covering the seafood with a layer of pepper. (Maybe to make it 'cajun hot'?) Yikes! No thanks, here's our recipe; toss your crab, shrimp, scallops, vegetables, etc...into a baking dish. Melt 1 stick of butter and pour it over the seafood. Generously sprinkle on the spice. (Additional seasonings are optional; salt, pepper, garlic, onions & lemon slices). Bake for 25-30 minutes at 375 degrees. Done & Delicious! Enjoy...If you're going to make this dish often, get the big jars and save big money!Please check out the photos we've uploaded.

I have been eating seaweed since I was 5 years old.  I was a picky eater, but now I am not.  Nori has great nutrients and is low cal and has high protein.  It is a perfect food.  This is just another great way to taste it and consume it.  I can eat more of the nori if I have the msg variety.  Nori is a good thing to eat a great deal of.  This taste is good.

column9: Pleasantly Disappointed, and Then Very Please.
column10: Seeing the good reviews on this page, and hearing of the health benefits of this product - I decided to try it out. This page suggests that the product has a spicy flavor, and I was mildly disappointed to find out that it did not. However, I am still very pleased with the product. It is very delicious. I intend to get this product again in the future and recommend it to everyone.

column9: Great snack, the kids love it!
column10: This roasted nori has a lite, spicy flavor that our kids love.  We take lots of packets with us when we go out just about anywhere, because they're healthy and we don't mind letting the kids have as many as they want when they ask for a snack - especially compared to nasty, processed, non-nutritive kids' snacks like chips, cheese puffs, cheese crackers, etc.  If you've never had nori, this is the same stuff that sushi rolls are wrapped in - it's just served crispy here because it hasn't absorbed any moisture from the rice and sushi roll that it is otherwise wrapped around.There are lots of health benefits to eating nori, and the light spicy flavor in the Ajitsuke brand is just right - give it a shot, you'll like it!

I purchased this in late Oct and thoroughly enjoyed it. I quickly ordered 2 more packages in early November and received what was absolutely disgusting and tasteless. I can say the consistency isn't always the same, so beware. I've been quite satisfied with Sea's Gift which I would highly recommend to everyone.

I really love these seaweed snacks, although every one else that I have given them to try has disliked them.  I think they are a real "love it or hate it" sort of item.If you like the seaweed in sushi, then you would probably like these strips.  They are more like dry paper because they are very thin.  The strips are quite salty with a little bit of spice.  At first they are crispy, but they become soft when chewed.  I usually eat two packets (8 strips total) at a time.I do think the price is high, so I'm not sure when I will buy them again.  Right now, I'm eating them every day and they are a great little snack.  Love it!

This is my very first time tasting seaweed and I must say that I'm very disappointed.... that they are gone so quickly.I found that after eating them almost every day for a week, my body began to crave for it. And I cannot blame it, they are delicious and very good for you. These are a great snack if you are constantly on the go and fall prey to snack cravings, though it may take quite a few. They are great with rice, ramen, and soups. 200 may feel like a lot, but they will not last for long.  C:
My husband was so surprised that he is eating healthy snack! Very tasty and can not stop eating it!

These seaweed snacks are very tasty and addictive. They're chewy with just the right amount of spicyness, and great as a snack for watching TV or movies -- a much healthier alternative to potato chips or buttered popcorn. It's 1.3 calories and 15mg sodium per packet, according to the nutrition label. Each packet has 3 pieces.You can eat these as is, or cut the strips horizontally into very thin pieces and sprinkle over rice, ramen, salads, and even pizza. Sprinkling shredded seaweed over food is a common topping style in Japan such as JFC - Nori Fumi Furikake (Rice Seasoning) 1.7 Oz..100 bags is a lot, but don't be surprised if you find yourself eating 6-10 or more packets at a time. If you like seaweed snacks, you may also like Korean roasted and seasoned seaweed, though they are often much higher in sodium. Two very tasty brands I like are: ChoripDong Korean Seaweed Snack (Kim Nori), Roasted w/Olive oil & Sea Salted and Roasted Seasoned Seaweed: 3 Individual Packs.

It tastes "weird" and not in a good way. Like fish-tankish...There was tons of it...luckily my dogs love it, so I don't have to throw it away, and they get the minerals. I usually buy Sea's Gift. I tried Amy Chung's and it was waaaay too salty. I went back to Sea's Gift toasted and that's what I am sticking to.

My entire family, including my 7 year old daughter, absolutely love this product.  My kids take it in their lunches, and at first their friends were grossed out by the seaweed "ick" factor... until they tried it!The serving size of 3 packets is a satisfying (and healthy!) snack that contains pretty much the fewest calories of any snack I've ever eaten, yet is full of flavour.

Nori is a tasty healthy snack.This nori comes in 100 individual cellophane packets. So you can put a few packs in a pocket or lunch box and have it with you when you want a snack.Why eat nori? Because it has all lots of trace minerals that your body needs.Best of all a serving of this nori has only four little calories. And this will not destroy your diet if you are on a diet. And you will be providing your body the minerals it needs any way.I have eaten nori that tastes a little better such as the nori by Annie Chung.This nori tastes good, very low in calories. And prepared In single serving packets to protect the nori from contamination. It is deffinately highly recommended.
I don't really like these.  I really like Annie's and Trader Joe's dried seaweed and was looking for a cheaper alternative, but this is not it.  It is not salty nor crunchy enough.

column9: I can't believe I put this in my mouth
column10: This was GROSS!!! I dont know what all you people are eating that you rated this so high. To me this tasted like a mix of dead fish, chemicals and greens. YUK!

column9: If you've never had seaweed snacks before, you might enjoy this.
column10: As a frequent buyer of Sea's Gift Roasted Seaweed Snack wasabi flavor, this seaweed had an appealing price so I thought I'd try it. However, I was quite disappointed with the flavor once I tried it. I have 99 packs remaining and hope to find someone who I can give them to.

In spite of the fact that this has a Japanese name and a picture of a Japanese woman on the package, it is not Japanese.  The reason I know this is not my seaweed expertise, but the fact that "Product of China" is stamped on the inside packages.  Of course, English being what it is, the "Japanese" could refer to the seasoning as well as the type, but......  It's my understanding (from Wikipedia, I think) that Chinese seaweed is cheaper and lower quality than Japanese.It tastes OK if you're a fan of roasted nori, as I am, and it's certainly the cheapest.  However, I prefer Sea's Gift and that Japanese teriyaki-flavored one that comes in a jar. Both of these are also available on Amazon.

column9: Good, but not my favorite seaweed
column10: This seaweed is good, but not very flavorful.  It has a mild teriyaki-type flavor but no spiciness, as the product describes.  Becasue it isn't fried in oil (which is why it's fat-free), it's not light and crispy, but rather chewy, like nori naturally is.  The packaging is convenient, you'll get your vitamin burst (which is why I eat it), and you'll get a low-calorie snack, no-fat snack, however.  My favorite nori is the stuff roasted in sesame oil (the perfect compliment to the fishy flavor of seaweed), like Seas's Gift, but seaweed roasted in oil is not a low-fat snack.  Just be aware that low-fat seaweed = chewy texture.  I probably won't buy this again - I'm going to try Yamamotoyama Teriyaki Nori Seaweed next.

First, let me say, I love seaweed so It's not like I didn't know what I was getting.  I've tried several brands, but hadn't tried this one.  The 100 pk sounded like it would be a good value, but it's not.  Overall there isn't much I like about this product.  The flavor isn't very good and is fishy compared to other seaweed.  The texture is a little chewy.  The calories see a little high for the serving size, they're not a lot, but compared to the size it seems a little high compared to other seaweed snacks.  Each serving has 16 calories, no fat, and 1 protein.  The carbs seem a little high considering there's a carb for each piece and the pieces are only about 1x3".  You get 100 total pkgs of 3 pieces each.  Each pk is in a strip of about 6. When I first looked at the product I thought that seemed like a lot of seaweed for the price, but it's not since pieces are so small.  You're getting a lot of packaging for 3 scrawny pieces.  I didn't like this product at all.  I think I'll stick to Annie Chun.

Annie Chuns is the best; Sea's gift the next best and Ajitsuke last.  Annie chuns is too expensive because I eat a lot of seaweed for snacks.  I'm on a diet.  I don't like these individual packs because I ended up with dark green flakes all over my clothes since the strips are so fragile.  And they don't brush off if it's a sweater.  I do like the spice in them.  Kids probably can't eat these very well because you have to be careful opening them so they don't completely fall apart. So, I ordered Sea's Gift again after trying these out.

Decent tasting seaweed.  I have several Korean friends who have prepared Korean meals for me, often including seaweed.  I tried this hoping it would be the same thing.  It tastes decent, but not as good as what I am used to, and not as crunchy as some of the other stuff I have tried.  My biggest frustration is the packaging.  If you are trying to eat a few packets in the car, the numerous small packets leave a lot of extremely light/thin plastic that won't just stay in a cup holder or other trash holder.Pros:  Good price, large quantity, fairly good tasteCons: Packet size (trash left after opening)

Unpleasant taste, very fishy.  Clearly low quality.  Ate one and am eager to give away the rest to someone!  I did get the product promised, but the taste was really unpalatable.  Also didn't seem very fresh.

I ordered these seaweed snacks thinking it was a neat idea with the packaging making it easier to take to work and munch on but not sure if my item was old or packaging compromised but it tasted old wasn't crisp.

column9: Pretty good, but sort of sticks to the mouth
column10: As mentioned in various seaweed reviews, it sort of leaves a weird melting of seaweed in your mouth for awhile. I suppose this is just the nature of seaweed, but I feel as if it is more pronounced here than with other brands I have tried.Pros: Flavor is sharp and enjoyable.Cons: Melts strangely.

If you don't like seaweed at all, don't bother.But if you, like me, have enjoyed a really good seaweed salad in your life you will find these little strips strangely addictive. Tasting like their deep green color, soy sauce and maybe just a hint of sesame (the "spice" is more flavor, not heat), these guys will go fast if you don't slow down.I'm not going to claim they are "healthy" - they pack a lot of salt in a little space - but they certainly are less guilt-inducing than other salty snacks. At 4 calories for three packs, your tongue will go numb from saltiness before you can ingest enough to put on a pound.I love them - and if you are a fan of Japanese food, you might too.
Of all the different kinds of seaweed that I've tried, this is the worst by far. It's supposed to be a "light spicy flavor," but it's not. It's like eating paper. I do not recommend getting this.

Well it's my own fault - I've never been a fan of seaweed but this sounded like it may be spicy and I love spicy.  This stuff definitely tastes like seaweed and for many of us that's an undesirable flavor.  I didn't notice much spice to it - slightly salty is about all I would say, but that does not take away from the gross flavor I call seaweed.It's not a total loss.  It makes for a fantastic prank - so far everyone of these I have given to someone has invoked a prank worthy reaction.  Just don't give it to drunk people - odds are high they'll spew.  Even after they spit it out the taste lingers, and if they swallow any of it they'll have fish breath for hours.Of course if you already have a pallet for seaweed all the others say its great!  But if you're searching for that seaweed product that changes your mind on how gross seaweed can taste this is not your product.  I won't rank it zero despite my tongue wanting me to - it's just not for everyone.

Based on the previous review and some web searches this sounded like an ideal product to replace salted peanuts, chips, whatever as a snack.  I took one bite from a packet and forced myself to chew the styrofoamy like texture and rotten off-fish smell.  Later that day I tried to see if my dogs would eat them and got nauseous opening a packet for them.  No, they were smarter than me and just sniffed them and walked away.  This product may be wonderful for your health but I hope there is a tasteless pill that can do the same thing if we have to get health from this.  So if someone likes this stuff I have 198 packets that I would be willing to send free of charge to the first one to email me via amazon.

column9: have to melt before use, strong smell
column10: I wanted to use this as a non-smelly hair oil. It is not easy to use because before each use, you have to melt it. Plus it has a strong but natural smell of coconut oil. I should have expected that. It does not have any added fragrance, hence the "fragrance free" claim. But the natural smell of coconut oil is itself significant. A good product I am sure but not appropriate for my intended use.

column9: Smells amazing and it's the best makeup remover I've ever found
column10: I absolutely love this product. I've tried every makeup remover (almost!) out there, and this works the best and is 100% organic and natural. Plus, it smells incredible. I'm telling everyone to buy it. Check out [...]
Thanks! It is nice to be able to get this through TSA. Extra Virgin Coconut oil keeps me looking 10 years younger...xoxoxooo

column9: I never knew there was a third type of chowder
column10: This "chowder" claims to be neither New England nor Manhattan -- i.e., no milk/cream and no tomatoes.  As an old clam chowder fan, I'm willing to try something new, but this was not a success.  Most disastrously, they brag about using sea salt but they use too darned much of it.  The salty taste lingered throughout dinner.  We still have five cans of this, so next time will make it with milk or half-and-half and see whether it converts into a decent New England chowder.  The clams and vegetables seem okay, if only one could taste them better.

I bought this soup in Bar Harbor after having a wonderful lobster dinner. Expecting it to be a least a little better then from a supermarket. What a waste of money and effort. Smells and tastes terrible. I threw the rest of the cans into the garbage.

Blue Crab soups are an excellent product. Unfortunately, the cans were in clear plastic, with no packing in the box. When they arrived, it looked like someone had used a hammer on many of the cans. We had planned to use them for Christmas, but they were so damaged we had to use them ourselves.We will not purchase them again this way.Blue Crab Bay Co. My mother cooked with it, and I regularly cook with it -- when I can find it.  It's the perfect addition to roasts, to stuffing, to skinless chicken, to stews, and any meat dish that needs a pick me up.

column9: use it on all your steaks and burgers
column10: My wife is from Texas and introduced me to this stuff.  I now use it on basically everything I put on the grill (especially beef).  Adds a nice subtle flavor and makes the meat look even more appetizing from the nice browning after you pull it off the grill.  Fortunately this sauce doesn't require refrigeration after opening or you'd be in trouble because you only need a couple of drops per burger (about the same amount as if you were using Worcestershire sauce).  So this bottle will probably last me YEARS.  But that's okay... since I've never found it in any supermarket north of Richmond.  Enjoy.

I paid for the product and the shipping and i paid to return it as the bottle was open and part of the foil top had loosened as (i guess) it had not been packaged well, there was kitchen bouquet everywhere.  I contacted them and luckily i had saved the sticky box because they wanted it back.  So i sent the whole mess back asap.  At my expense, no apology or refund of my money for return postage nor even a darn coupon......hmm not even an apology.Rosemary Blazek

I've used the product of some 50 years now. The bottle is basically the same except it is plastic now. It has somewhat of a browned flavor although there is no meat or meat products in it. Straight for the bottle it has about the same taste as Worcestershire Sauce without the vinegar and chili pepper taste. Cant live without this! It is more economical buying it it a large bottle.I use it for gravies, meat sauces,stews etc. fantastic product

column9: Maxwell House coffee is a hit
column10: Thoroughly enjoyed the Maxwell House toasted hazelnut flavour, it is delicious with powdered or liquid creamer. I also mix with Mountain Peak (Jamaican coffee) or Nescafe for a stronger brew when I need one. Received the package within two to three days from Amazon and the ordering process was hassle free.
I love the maxwell house international coffees, especially the toasted hazelnut..it is a smooth creamy tastingcoffee. I keep several different flavors in my cupboard at all times

column9: My fave coffee for the Keurig Vue
column10: If you like strong, dark coffee, the Barista Italian roast for the Vue cup is excellent. I make it on the STRONG setting for 8oz and it's perfect. In fact, it's better than what I make in my regular pot unless I have very fresh coffee just ground from beans. The color is a rich, blackish brown, the roast is dark but not burnt-tasting and of all the coffees for the Vue I've tried, this one wins hands-down. I have the same blend in K-cups (for the office, where the K version sits) and they are not as good, for some reason. The Vue is not the most economical way to make coffee (that would probably be a plastic Melitta filter with a paper cone and a mug or a French Press) but the Keurig is fast and convenient. And I get the coffee the strength and temperature just the way I like it.

column9: Best of the Vue coffee. Imo
column10: Im on an ipad so Ican't type much, but the overall flavor of the Italian Roast is much more enjoyable than the othe coffees that I have tried from the Vue. If anything, it's worth at least one try. If you aren't too sure, look for a sampler pack. I hope others enjoy this as much as I did, because I'd hate to see this get discontinued.
I have two strong chewers and this product keeps them busy for two days. Best long lasting chew I've tried. Also bravo products have little smell so they can chew in the house.

this mint too is so refreshing! such a good pick-me-up especially in the morning and a great alternative to coffee! you will love this flavor- it's one of my favorites :)
These honestly, are like Rubber! I ordered them because I love marshmallows, but these things are impossible to chew. I sure wasted my money.

I had my doubts, as these were being shipped from Europe (took 8-10 days) and the price was significantly lower than other offerings, but the quality of the product - and the price - are the very best.  Fresh, tasty - so good in fact that they bear little resemblance to your average oily brazil nut.  A delicious, nutritious bargain!
I recieved this order intact in a timely manner. I don't know about the taste....I bought it for someone else.Betty

The Gevalia Morning Roast is a good coffee to start out the day. It is rather heady, with a good smell, and just wakes up the taste buds. I can sit with a cup for hours, if it weren't so good I just drink it right up!

In the two years since I have had a Tassimo, numerous new coffees and teas have become available, including Seattles Best and now Starbucks. But only set of T-Discs is specifically formulated for big cups of coffee, Gevalia Morning Roast.This coffee is smooth and mild, and it produces a full twelve ounce cup of joe. column9: Good Coffee, Just too Weak for me.
column10: I like the Big Cup of Coffee for the Morning as well.But I like the Darker Roasts generally.This Coffee I cannot taste.I give it a 4 because it is not Bad coffee, especially if you enjoy milder brews. I just require a little more Kick from my Morning Coffee.If you like the "Extra Chunky" Coffee Like me then this one is not for you.
Great coffee.  I wish more products were made to brew a larger cup of coffee.
Well done marmalade in small bottles - enough for two-three pieces of toast. Uses grape juice as sweetner. Lots of orange.

column9: The best marmalade. All natural. No Sugar
column10: All of the Dalfour "Conserves" are top of the line.  Imported from France.  All natural. No high fructose corn syrup, no sugar, no preservatives.  This is a delicious and healthy alternative to the unhealthy jams and jellies found on the shelves of most supermarkets.  Plus as a bonus, you get 48 wonderful little jars that have lots of uses.  Great product. Great Price.

column9: Fischer & Wieser Razzpotle Roasted Raspberry Chipotle Sauce

Wonderful and easy quicki hors d'voures for unexpected guests.  Will be ordering more!!
Normally, I can't take food hotter than a chocolate chip cookie, but the chipotle is subtle and understated. My daughter confiscated my first bottle. I'm glad I bought two.

column9: It has 202 cals and 53 carbs per cup. Great sweetener, but their marketing is misleading!
column10: I like this sweetener a lot. But it is not a NO sweetener like the label claims, it is a LOW calorie sweetener when you do the math.The company says on their website that are 202 calories and 53 grams of carbs for a cup of Ideal. So it is 12.5 cals/3.3 carbs a tablespoon, and 4 cals/1.1 carbs a teaspoon. So not an actual NO calorie sweetener like the bag says. They list 0 calories because they can since it is under 5 calories for the serving size they have listed, but on a large pouch meant for baking you would use way more than a teaspoon -- especially if you wanted to make any of the sweet items they have pictured on the front of the bag! The label should be changed to reflect its intended purpose. It's like saying a can of regular soda is calorie free if you list it as being 42 servings.That said, I will still be using it since it has less than a third of the calories of sugar, about a quarter of the carbs and tastes very good. Their shady lack of disclosure on the bag leaves a bad taste in my mouth. But while it's not a no calorie sweetener, but it is pretty close to ideal.Rating breakdown:Product claims = 1 starProduct taste = 5 starsOverall: 3 starsCalorie and carb info from their own website.

column9: Ok in a pinch, but make your own
column10: I thought this product would be vastly different from all the other 'brown sugar replacement' items on the market. It does taste better than Diabetisweet or the Steele's.Ideal has become my new favorite sweetener. There is no aftertaste, unlike what many of us experience with Splenda. However I did not find this Ideal Brown Sugar sub to be so much different that it's worth the higher cost. It's just Ideal sweetener and molasses, packaged for convenience with the higher premium for convenience's sake.I make my own 'brown sugar' out of Ideal using about a teaspoon of blackstrap molasses to 1/4 c. of Ideal regular. You can adjust the molasses to suit your need for light or dark brown sugar in your recipes, or to suit your taste. (And your pocketbook will thank you)

column9: A Product I Had Been Waiting For, Lived Up To the Hype
column10: The regular kind of ideal was already my favorite sugar substitute. I've been doing a lot of diet baking lately, and knew as soon as I saw this product existed that it was going to be cutting a few calories and a few carbs out of my recipes.In addition to baking, I have used this product as a mix-in to oatmeal (blended with some cinnamon and a drop of vanilla makes a healthy breakfast taste like candy. I think my favorite use so far was broiling some sliced plantains dipped in this product. It caramelized perfectly.

column9: Simply the best sugar substitute available
column10: For health reasons, our family has searched for an adequate sugar substitute. Over the years we have tried them all and found each product wanting - until we found Ideal.This sweetener has the taste and texture of sugar without any of the issues surrounding other sugar substitutes. It avoids the question of health risks attributed to aspartame. It does not have the 'grassy' taste of Stevia; the 'cold' sensation of erythritol; or, what we find to be, the after-taste of Splenda.For baking, it is unparalleled. Even our friends who eat sugar cannot tell that we use Ideal. We bake custards and crustless cheesecakes with Ideal and no one knows that they are sugar free. We use it in confections such as fudge and chocolate truffles with exceptional results.Like many other sugar alternatives, Ideal will not caramelize. This is not a fault of the product but rather a chemical dynamic of sugar alcohol based sweeteners. However, this seems is a small price to pay for a sweetener that is otherwise indistinguishable from sugar.Whether you choose to use the brown sugar substitute (which does not have the actual sugar found in Splenda's brown sugar blend) or the white sweetener, we are sure that you will find Ideal a wonderful alternative to sugar. We recommend it to our friends who are diabetic or who are looking to cut out sugar for other reasons. They all agree that it is the best tasting alternative to sugar on the market today.

This product is excellent in baking.  I have made several Blueberry crisp, and pumpkin custards,no one can tell the difference. Best product out there for baking with.  The Ideal sugar, and powder sugar products is great too!  No after taste from this product.  Great in your coffee too!
Great product & sweetener for every day use. I usually substitute half in baking recipes and it works great.

I was skeptical that I would like this sweetner. I like to use brown sugar in my oatmeal and I also enjoy baking with it. I ordered this on a chance that I would like it. I've been hearing all the horrors of sugar in our bodies and decided to really search for a substitute for my whole family. Well, I've found it...this sweetner was very good in my oatmeal along side the cinnamon. I was a little more hesitant to use it in my favorite cookie recipe. Well, this evening I used it in my recipe and it was fantastic! I didn't miss the sugar at all and it had no after taste at all. My husband even couldn't tell it was sugar free.So if you're like me and trying to get away from sugar, try this. It might surprise you too.

Finally, a really good substitute for brown sugar! I've only used it in three recipes so far, but it tastes great. The really good recipe was for Carolina Pulled Pork, and the accompanying vinegar barbecue sauce. Splenda's idea for brown sugar is to use their sweetener along with sugar-free maple syrup. Doesn't sound like brown sugar to me. This really does taste like brown sugar, though. It's not moist and clumpy like brown sugar, but the taste is there, and that's what counts.

I don't like 99% of the sugar substitutes on the market, because when baking with them they give the baked item an after taste.  But this product does not do that.  I can bake for the whole family now only having to bake one item for the ones wanting/needing sugarfree.

I have purchased this delicious product twice in the last month, for about $5.50. Suddenly today it is $15.00. What's up with that? Has it been discontinued? I'm not happy about this, which is why I only gave it 1 star. If I could order more today I'd give it 5 stars.I didn't think anything could replace brown sugar in my latte, but this did it. It was good while it lasted I guess.Updated 4/26/12Ok, they must have filled up their supply at Amazon because today it's back down to around $5.49. I get cranky when I run out of stuff I like, so this time I'm ordering 3 bags of it. AND raising my rating to 5 stars.BTW, this stuff is made with zylitol which my dentist promotes like crazy. He says it kills bacteria that cause tooth decay AND is a great anti-inflammatory.

column9: Better than Splenda Brown for baking
column10: After doing lots of research regarding the best sugar substitutes for baking, I decided to try the Ideal brand.  I try to adhere as much as possible to a South Beach Diet eating plan, but I love to bake, so it was important for me to find something that fits the plan and still tastes good in baked products.  I had been pleased with Splenda Brown, but it still contains more sugar than I wanted to use.  I've been substituting Ideal Brown for brown sugar in my cakes and cookies and have been very pleased with the results.  There is none of that strange, artificial taste that often comes with sugar substitutes, plus Ideal Brown is much easier to measure.

I have been extremely satisfied with the quality of Ideal brand white and brown sugar.  I have used the brown sugar in everything from syrups, to pies and caramels and couldn't be happier.  The taste is fantastic and is indistinguishable from the real thing in cooking and baking!  No one has even questioned the taste of foods I have prepared with it.  I only wish Ideal sold larger bags of their sugar products!

I cannot find this at a local grocery store in Colorado.  I tried a sample in the mail.  I loved it and ordered through Amazon.  Once I run out of this, I will reorder.  I use it in my homemade granola.  No calories, tastes like brown sugar, and you can bake with it.  I also have their white sugar, and individual packets.

This is an excellent product.  For so long I have tried to find suitable replacements for the processed sugar in baking.  This one does it PERFECTLY...and is super healthy xylitol to boot!  I put this right on my oatmeal with some cinammon...YUM.Highly recommend!  And the price here on Amazon is great.  It is difficult to find this product elsewhere too.
This is a wonderful alternative for regular brown sugar. Noone could tell the difference in taste or texture in the chocolate chip cookies.

I am strictly low carb and finding a brown sugar substitue that actually tastes like SUGAR is wonderful.  I wouldn't use this outside of baking as it has an aftertaste that way...but in cookies, cakes, even Thai Curries, perfect!  The white version is not so wonderful.  Still works for cooking but nothing like pure Xylitol in my coffee or used like sugar.

column9: use just like reg brown sugar
column10: Only problem I had with this product is that it came with a large cut in the bag an about 1 c of the product was lost.  I didn't return it since I needed it asap for a recipe. I noted it to Amazon on rating the packaging for this product but no answer. This stuff is too expensive to waste like a cut in the bag. Amazon or who ever packed it should check better.

I've been a low-carber for 15 years.  Up till I tried this, my brown sugar-alternative sweetener of choice was Canadian Brown Sugar Twin, which is made from cyclamates. American BST is made from saccharine, as is Brown Sweet 'n' Low, both of which are so-so in taste and becoming harder to find om stores.  But the taste of the brown Ideal sweetener was WAY superior in taste to any of the other brown artificial sweeteners!

I'd had no luck finding a gluten-free brown sugar substitute until I found this on Amazon - and checked the manufacturer's website, which assured me it is gluten-free.  AND mostly xylitol - the sugar substitute I prefer anyway.  So I order one bag to try it, and quickly went back to order more.It's great stuff - more like light brown sugar than dark brown, so I need to add a tad of molasses in some of my baking.  And of course like plain xylitol, it's much drier than sugar, but adding a little applesauce to whatever I'm baking helps with that.But mostly I use it on my breakfast cereal - sprinkling cinnamon in the bottom of the bowl, adding Bob's Red Mill Gluten Free Whole Grain, Rolled Oats, 32-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4) and a handful of raisins, microwaving it, and topping it with Ideal Brown no-cal sweetener.  Yum.

I am diabetic and have certain recipes calling for brown sugar - so far I have used Ideal in my morning oatmeal and plan on using it  measurements are equal basically. I don't want to resort to using Splenda brown sugar blend because it has some sugar in it.So far so good!
Im very pleased with this product and highly recommend giving it a try.  ive ordered it before and will again.
I really wanted Sugar Twin the brown sugar subsitute, but would have had to order 12 boxes! This product is not bad and is 0 Weight Watchersspoint, but not a really strong brown sugar taste.

column9: Great no calorie sweetner especially for baking
column10: I have been trying to eat healthier which involve ingredients that I can not find at my local grocery store. I found and purchased this sugar in both brown and white sugar blend for a recipe in which it was called for.  It worked great for baking. Not as sweet as splenda so my taste buds had alittle getting use to but now i love it!

This is a great sugar replacement.  It is sweet and you can use it in hot and cold foods and for baking.  The main ingredient- xylitol-is good for your teeth.  If you have dogs you need to use caution though as this is dangerous for them.
Tastes great in cooking diverse things like Kung Pao Chicken and Oatmeal Cookies. But what's up with the new price. I only paid just under $7 with SS Shipping a week ago not over $14!

I love this stuff. I've tried them all, and by far, this is the best tasting low cal sweetener I have found. And it doesn't have a bitter aftertaste like most. BTW, I have lost 45 pounds by keeping my calories down.

column9: Great Substitute for Regular Brown Sugar!
column10: We are a family with food allergies and we had to find substitutes for the usual sugar replacements.  This was a perfect choice, and when a recipe calls for brown sugar, this is what we use.  It measures just like sugar and has no aftertaste.  I highly recommend this when other sugar replacements won't do.

I made peanut butter cookies using 1 cup pb (Skippy Natural Creamy), 1 cup Ideal® No Calorie Brown Sweetener, and 1 egg. My cookies turned out perfect and taste great, especially with a glass of Calorie Countdown milk.According to my calculations, there are 24 grams of carbohydrates in a cup of the brown sugar substitute (I don't count sugar alcohols). I got 20 cookies from my dough so that's barely over 1 gram of carbs per cookie from the Ideal. The egg had less than 1 gram of carbs and the Peanut Butter had 32 grams of carbs in a cup so that's 1.6 per cookie. Total carb count for my cookies is less than 3 grams per cookie. I'm real good with that!
great stuff. used for baking. I mix it with cinnamon then coat almonds and roast them.  a sweet delicious treat with calories only from the almonds.  use it instead of sugar in any recipe.

column9: Ideal Brown no calorie sweetener excellent product.
column10: My husband is a newly diagnosed diabetic, controlled by diet. I am glad we decided to try this product for him. I made oatmeal cookies using the recipe on the package. They are delicious and did not cause him any problems. Thank you fo this product.
This is the first brown sugar substitute I have tried.  It has more of an after taste than the plain Ideal, so it isn't as good in beverages, but it works fine for baking.

this is the best sugar substitute I have tried. really tastes like sugar and can be used in cooking just like sugar. I use it in oatmeal, pies, and on baked sweet potatoes. I really like it. It is a natural plant sweetener, not a chemical.
I use this to cook with and feel better that I am not eating sugar, and this is supposed to be healthier than other sugar substitutes.

Ideal has the best product when it comes to sugar free sweeteners! I can use this in baking or just for topping sweet potatoes. It is excellent tasting with no bitter after taste. It measures like sugar so be careful not to use too much.

I love ideal brown sugar substitute. Because it is from sugar alcohols it is natural, and unlike sorbitol or maltitol based substitutes, it doesn't affect my stomach. I use it on oatmeal and in baking to cut down on carbs. There is no aftertaste. My only complaint is that it is not clumpy like real brown sugar and that can sometimes affect baked goods, but so far I have had no problems with it!

Have started to use this in my baked beans and a reciepe for brown sugar syrup, which is my husbands favorite on pancakes. He likes it better than regular brown sugar.  I like the way it pours and does not lose it's texture and get hard like regular brown sugar does.  Works great over those yams at Thanksgiving also. No after taste just like Ideal sweetener.
I love this product, though it's not as easy to find where I live.  Only one time did I feel it had an odd taste...could've had a bad bag.  I've been waiting a long time for something like this.
Tried to make chocolate chip cookies with this.  My son said they tasted like a camel's behind.  Don't really want to try baking with it again.  Went on their website and used their recipe.

When I first tried this product I loved it and used it in my baking (I run a small online bakery) and would have given it 5 stars for sure. Now in less than a month they've hiked the price up from just under $6 per package to $8.99, and no long offer Super Saver Shipping, and charge nearly another $8 for shipping? Save your money. This is just ridiculous.

this is not what i expected, the bag is big but it looks heavier than it is. this product doesn't have much weight to it at all, and you have to use so much just to notice any sweetness. they say this compares cup for cup with brown sugar, i'm going to have to disagree with that.I also bought the small 50 packets by ideal. and had the opposite effect. I think it is an excellent product. it seems like there's hardly anything in the packet but to me one little packet compares to 2tsp of sugar when i put it in my coffee.
Don't buy this unless you want decaf.  Information as well as packaging all said regular K-cups.  When we opened the box, every K-cup was decaf.  Incorrect information and packaging.
I am a fan of all the varieties of Green Mountain coffee. Particularly like the breakfast blend and the dark magic.
The variety K-cups for Green Mountain is the best I have tried.  I do not think you can go wrong on any of these.  I have tried many, and I keep ordering the Variety.

The Green Mountain Co. has a great assortment of different coffees and teas, and many are my favorites.  This variety box has many good ones, but there were about half that are in the stronger, dark roast category, such as the dark roast and french roast. I find these a bit stronger than I like, so I make a 12 oz. mug using two sixes. Overall a good product, I would just prefer a few more of the light and medium roasts like Donut Shop.

The box says decaf, but they have a "REGULAR" label over top the decaf with a barcode. I ordered 2 of these, both had to go back. Amazon assured me the product would be taken out of inventory until resolved. Guess not.
like dave says, this package is a decaf variety pack.images should be a bit clearer.lickily, i passed this on to an in law...

We'd just bought a new Keurig coffeemaker and wanted to try an assortment to see what we liked.We love Green Mountain blend coffee, but the Breakfast Blend was a big disappointment. It is a light roast, but it tastes as though something was added to make it bitter. Maybe it's chicory. Whatever it is, the aftertaste is unpleasant.Dark Magic was okay for a darker roast, but we have found other dark roasts by Green Mountain that we like better.If you are looking to try different kinds, it is much better to find a local grocer that sells k-cups individually.
