column9: Great product, with a little effort. Here is the 1 . 2 . 3 . .
column10: This product will save you a lot of MONEY! I love my Kurig machine but I don't love the cost of the K-cups. I saw these lids online and immediately started saving, and cleaning out, my used K-cups. Tear off the foil top, dump out the grounds, rinse out the cup and leave them to dry. The lids were a bit of a challenge at first, but I stepped back and thought about it. The lids seemed to be to big for the old cup, but they need to be very tight to withstand the injected water pressure. Solution: 1)Put some lids in a cup of VERY hot water for a few minutes to make them pliable. Remove them as you sue them. 2)Take an EMPTY cup and carefully press the lid on. Hold the cup by the top edge, thumbs under the edge, and GENTLY press the hot lid on like it's very tight Tupperware. DO NOT press on the body of the cup because they crush easily. You may mess up a couple but you will get the hang of it. 3)Let the cup sit for a while, empty. 4)Pop off the lid, I use the edge of a spoon to help with this as it is very tight. 5)Fill the cup with your choice of coffee. Remember, the coffee you took out was used and puffed up, don't over fill or you will waste coffee. 6)Snap the top on, gently, it will be a "snap" now. 7)Pop it in your brewer, turn the cup until it drops in the original hole in the bottom, close the top and enjoy your lower cost, personal choice, coffee! I have re-used the lids, and refilled the same cups, six times and counting. It will take a while to run through 100 lids, but I will re-order when I need them again.DisposaKup Lids - 100 Disposable Replacement Lids for Use with Any Keurig K-cup - BOX of 100 LIDS

On a whim I picked up some Ghirardelli chocolate brownie mix at the store and haven't looked back since. Like all brownie mixes it's a box of powdered stuff to which is added oil, water, and egg.After that it's totally different from any box mix, or made at home brownie. The brownies have a delicious flavor, no fake or nasty taste. They are thick and dense and chocolate. Of course, being Ghirardelli I would expect the chocolate to be good, but these are great. I felt a little miffed to be honest and began making brownies left and right from some pretty famous chefs and gourmet cookbooks and finally, about the fifth time my family said, "these are good, when are you going to make the Ghiardelli again?" I gave up. I even take these to events and always get compliments.

We discovered Ghirardelli Double Chocolate Brownie Mix several years ago and now almost always buy this product; I say almost always because we have been know from time to time to buy the Dark Chocolate Mix as well.If one simply follows the directions one gets absolutely fabulous brownies. If there is ever a special occasion and my wife wants to treat the guests to something they will love we prepare these brownies.Should you want to enhance the brownies you can top the warm brownies after baking with a layer of unwrapped Dark or Milk Chocolate Hershey Chocolate bars and allow to cool to room temperature before cutting. Either of those combinations should provide a baked desert that will bring enthusiastic compliments.

Ghirardelli makes the greatest brownies.  I am a brownie fanatic and these are by far the best I've ever had!  Really delicious, rich, and chocolately!The shipping took 5-9 business days as promised and the brownies were pretty easy to make. If you are a chocoholic like me, I highly recommend these.

Ghirardelli Chocolate Brownie Mix, Double Chocolate, 18 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)  I have been using this product for years - have also tried many other brands but nothing compares to the rich chocolate flavor of Ghirardelli; so much so I buy it by the case.  Amazon.com offers a great price and needless to say their delivery service far surpasses all other companies.  I am 78 years "young" and the fact that I've used their product  FOR YEARS  is really saying something.  The texture of this product is so silky and ease of making a pleasure.

column9: Best boxed mix, better than made from scratch
column10: I've tried a lot of brownie recipes and love to bake. Ghirardelli brownie mix is far, far better than any recipe I've tried (and people love my baked goodies).The recipe is easy to follow, and the results are just fabulous- the perfect texture and flavor. There's a reason all the other reviews that have been posted so far are all 5-stars as well.There is a walnut brownie mix from Ghirardelli, but I like to add chopped walnut & add them to the double chocolate one instead, & then top with large pieces.I've taken them out of the oven 10 minutes before they're done, piped swirls of Nutella on top (and a few times topped that with chopped hazelnuts), and then put them back in for the remaining time. Delicious, but very rich.

Prepare for a chocolate overload with these brownies!  Scrumptious brownies with chocolate chips inside ensure you get an overdose of chocolate with every bite.  VERY simple to make.  You just beat an egg, add 1/3 oil and 1/3 water then the brownie mix.  Beat with a spatula about 40 times, then pour into a baking dish sprayed with oil.  Cooks in about 45 mintues.  Doesn't cool fast enough especially because the house fills up with yummy brownie smells and you just about go insane waiting to pop them in your mouth!Hint: Line a glass baking dish with aluminum foil prior to spraying with oil.  That way, once the brownies are cooled, you just lift out the foil and peel away from the brownies easily without anything sticking to the bottom of the dish, and you can just transfer onto a plate once they're cooled and cut.

Every time I make these, they disappear quickly.  And every time I take them to parties, I get asked for the recipe.  I have not been able to recreate anything like them from scratch, but they taste like they're homemade.  So yummy!

I always bake from scratch, but decided to make an exception with Ghirardelli brownies. These are delicious, and quite a difference from Ghirardelli's "Dark Chocolate Brownies," which are horrid. I thought both mixes would be close, since the ingredients are very similar, but nothing could be further from the truth. These taste great, while the "Dark Chocolate Brownies" taste like burnt coal.

Whoever invented the modern-day brownie mix: God bless your sweet, sweet soul. I am completely and UTTERLY hooked on these. As a native San Franciscan, of course I support Ghirardelli but wow. These are fantastic brownies even without those feelings of being obligated to support your local peeps. Simply delicious, I won't try another brownie mix so long as I have these bad boys in my arsenal of pantry offerings. I love that I can get them delivered to my house in bulk through Amazon too!

column9: Chewy, rich milk chocolate taste, and moist!
column10: I saw this at my local grocery store and decided to give it a try. I like baking, and though I've baked brownies from scratch, I've not had the best results - some turn out too hard, some turn out dry, and the other brand mixes had not yielded great results either.Well, Ghirardelli has truly outdone itself. This mix turned out a great batch of brownies, earning high praise from my husband and daughter, and it was so easy! The brownies have chocolate bits in them which add to the already rich chocolate flavor, and they are deliciously chewy and moist, even after I stored them in the refrigerator for a couple of days. I also tried out the Ghirardelli brownie mix with walnuts and they were great too. I'm sticking to this brand to satisfy my family's brownie craving from now on!

My boyfriend and I have been trying various boxed brownie mixes to find the one. He hates cake so brownies are the compromise. We tried an organic healthy mix, which was the second worst brownie I have ever had, next to a gluten free brownie, as well as all the typical Betty Crocker stuff. Then at Winco, I decided to splurge, because he was buying, and get the Ghirardelli Double Chocolate Brownie Mix for $2.75. We both agreed they were the BEST brownies we've ever had. These brownies are the reason anyone would even like brownies. An added plus, something I strive to look for in all processed foods, is that it has absolutely NO Partially or Fully Hydrogenated anything. About as close to measuring the ingredients out at home as you can get without actually having to do it. I'll be sure to subscribe for Ghirardelli Brownie Mix deliveries every month! Also, the triple chocolate and dark chocolate brownies are also awesome.
I don't think it's possible to like brownies and not love these. They're our go-to dessert if we're short on time because they're easy but very delicious.

The chocolate flavor is just amazing.  The texture is soft and slightly gooey (but not runny) - basically perfect.  Infinitely better than any other brownie mix I've ever tried.  More expensive than the cheap $1 box, but you get what you pay for.  For me, its more about the calories than the price.  If I'm going to indulge I want it to be worthwhile.  If you're tired of hard, crusty brownies with a stale flavor, try these.  I get these at my local Target and the price is (surprisingly) better than Amazon.

Ghiradelli makes the best brownie mixes.  I've tried every one they make and you can't ever go wrong with buying this brand name as they are easy to make and very satisfying anytime.  Need a great brownie today? Grab the double chocolate brownie mix and you won't be disappointed!

The first time I had Ghirardelli chocolate was last year, when I bought the Ghirardelli Chocolate Premium Hot Cocoa Mix, Double Chocolate, 16-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4). I loved it it. But for the price I only  So I decided to buy that again, along with this. I had an idea when I bought these that these would be amazing, and they were. I pretty much ate half of one box to myself, I could not stop myself from eating it.If you're looking for something to feed that chocolate craving than these brownies will surely do it.
It's a piece o heaven that fell on my plate.It's rich, flavorfull, perfection for me!I'm really in love with these brownies.

column9: Best brownie mix - friends think I make it from scratch
column10: Best brownie mix. I can't even eat other brownie mixes anymore, they taste like they have no chocolate and are plastic-like after eating these. I use milk instead of water to make them even more rich. Everytime I take them somewhere people think they are from scratch because they are so rich. You can't go wrong.

I'm normally a bake from scratch kind of gal, and almost never use cake mixes.  I find most too fake tasting, and can always detect when someone else uses them.  This brownie mix is the DEFINITE exception!  It is delicious!  I haven't baked a brownie from scratch since trying these.  And, of course, you can't beat how easy they are to prepare.  Buy a bunch so you can whip these up when last minute guests arrive, or you just need to make a low-stress dessert.

Absolutely the most delicious brownie mix. Sometimes I like to add chunk of peanut butter to each section of the batter, push them down a little but leave them showing then bake. Then cut them so each piece has a gooey peanut butter center. Heaven

O.M.G. these are so good.  probably the best brownie i've ever had.  made these on christmas of last year and they were gone in no time.  someone asked me just yesterday when i was going to make them again.

How can you go wrong with Ghirardelli chocolate? These make the best brownies ever and I've had so many compliments when I make them for anyone. I get them at a better-than-grocery-store price with subscribe and save and they just can't be beat.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"

column10: ....because after just a couple of bites I realized that I would not be needing it anymore. The level of sweetness is medium to high but well balanced with the chocolate so it's not cloying or grainy,  like a really good Godiva truffle. These have a texture halfway between fudgy and cake-like, both dense and moist. The chips add a subtle bit of extra something that is gooey and delicious when warm and adds a tiny bit of creamy crunch when they are cold. The top has that delicate crust to it when they cool which to me is the hallmark of an utterly perfect brownie.Not a thing I would change about this mix - except maybe the price - but still worth it.
No need to make brownies from scratch anymore.  Deep chocolate flavor without being over powering and chewy crusts.Will keep a box on hand.Yummy.
Perfect sauce pumps for caramel and chocolate, this is pretty much the only place I can get them for our coffee houses.

When the treats are presented to the three girls, each assumes her position apart from the others and commences chewing. Between five and ten minutes the Stix are history, and three happy girls are searching for some fortuitous crumbs. Our pooches seem to prefer the Beefeaters brand.No matter which flavor we choose, the girls love their Beefeaters Munchies.

column10: Initially, I started buying this product because it is not made in China which had so many recalls.  I also was looking for ground raw hide chews that did not have chicken or beef since one of my dogs is allergic to that.In addition to all of the other premises, my dogs seem to enjoy these chews so much!  They're totally safe also since they desintegrade in their mouth while, at the same time, they help keep their teeth in good shape and clean.

I'm a sardine purist in that I typically prefer my sardines with little more than olive oil and perhaps a hint of smoke. I found myself in the canned fish section of the local supermarket and was tempted to try something new. While there normally would be something off-putting if not downright scary about anything that comes in a "sweet and tangy sauce", I figured what the hell and took home a tin. I'm glad I did. The sardines are filleted completely without and bones. The texture was middle of the road. The could be easily picked up with fingers without fear of breaking, but just as easily given a quick mash with the tines of a fork. The meat was a little darker than most, probably from the sauce, and has a nice robust flavor but without smelling fishy. The sauce was thin and clear, mostly oil obviously, but tinted brick red. There was an ever so slight hint of heat but a definite but once again not overpowering vinegar tang. It's the perfect oil flavor to complement the bread for the active dipper. I've purchased these many times since.

column9: Refreshingly different take on canned sardines
column10: The Season product line of canned sardines I think is one of the best, but even so it took a bit of courage to order these sardines in a "sweet and tangy sauce".  What will they be like?  Will they be super hot?  Will they be sardines packed in salsa?  What will I get.Well, I was pleasantly surprised at the understated taste of the sauce.  You can still taste plenty of sardine, but the sauce offsets the fishyness substantially.  In fact, as far as I can tell the sauce is clear with the exception that it leaves the fish itself a shade or two darker than canned sardines would usually be.At first I thought it tasted rather strange but sort of good, but the taste grew on me and by the time I finished the can I wanted more.  So, if you're getting bored with your usual canned sardines, these may be your ticket to some variety.

column9: Good for an occasional change of pace
column10: The subtle, light broth in which these sardines are packed is neither sweet nor tangy to me. There is some sugar and a little salt in the flavor, but it is really underwhelming. The fish is quite good, but I'm not happy about all of the fat including the saturated fat.
These are handy to have around when I feel guilty about my dietary habits. They are firm, tasty, good for me, and the sauce is delicious.  I will buy these again.

column9: A pleasant change from the usual
column10: I was surprised by these-they've got a lively flavor, & they're also fairly low in sodium, so they're pretty good if you're trying to lower your salt intake.

column9: Quality product, unique flavor, but messy access
column10: If you are someone (like myself) who normally only eats sardines in tomato sauce and would like a change of pace, this is a product to seriously consider. I have never seen this exact product in any stores in my area, so it is thanks to Amazon that I can get them at all.  The reason I gave only four stars instead of five is, really, the can.  Whereas Season's sardines in tomato sauce now have the convenient peel-open lid, this variety still comes in the old-style pull-ring can.  Given that the base of these is very oily, it is about impossible to open the can without squeezing it somehow -- and out comes the oil.  So if you do try these, and I recommend you do, you may as well open them over the sink and have a dish ready nearby to avoid a substantial mess.  They are good paired with buttered (yes, I said buttered) whole-wheat toast.

column9: Best cup of coffee in a long time
column10: I like Keurigs and Senseo coffee pots.  Unfortunately, I do not always like the available k-cups and pods.  This particular pod, however, is really really good.  And I think price-wise it came in pretty reaseonable.  I hope they continue to make it and that the name doesn't indicate only a seasonal availability.  Overall, I think I prefer the pods to the k-cups which are generally stronger tasting with possibly more caffeine.  But I fear that some of the more generously packed pods are hard on the Senseo which must properly close down on the pod to prevent overspills.  Nevertheless, this pod will remain on my buying list as long as it is available and I will just be careful with the Senseo.  Incidentally, I do use a Solofill and can use these pods in my Keurig/MrCoffee pot (smaller imprint on limited countertop).  I gave my larger Keurig to son/grandson and bought the MrCoffee/Keurig pot and love that too.  You all have gotten three reviews in one, all positive, MrCoffee/Keurig pot, Solofill for pods used in Keurigs, and best tasting coffee in a long time.

My wife enjoy this wonderful full bodied coffee.  It maintains a great balance and smells so good during the brewing process. Although, i may need to invest in a turkish coffee pot and try this blend for its namesake........

column9: Stopped the Spit-Up!!!  I HIGHLY SUGGEST THIS PRODUCT!
column10: My son began spitting up A LOT around one and a half months.  So I tried other formulas thinking maybe the regular formula didn't sit well with his stomach - none of them worked!  Then I recieved a coupon in the mail for the Enfamil AR - and I went right out and got some.  It worked great!  He didn't really spit up any at first - he does spit up a little more now but I think that is due to him being on his belly alot (he is 5 months now and working on crawling).  But it isn't nearly as bad as it was!  I am greatful for that.  The only problem I have with this formula is that I have a hard time mixing the powder so I use the ready-to-use can.  It is perfectly fine for at home.  I just pour the 32oz. of formula in a plastic bottle/container and keep it in the fridge.  When he is hungry I pour some into a bottle and warm it up.  But when I am going somewhere it is a hassle to take the cold bottles and stuff to warm the formula up.  So I am getting some of the 3oz. nursette bottles that I found at the Enfamil website.  They are stored at room temp so I can just use 2 of the 3oz. and pour them in his bottle and won't have to worry about heating up whenever we are out somewhere.  I hope this helps someone!

column9: Traditional Christmas Cake but a bit too dry

column9: This is the chocolate equivalent of heroin.

column9: You may need to do a little math to ensure the Amazon quantity is a good deal
column10: The product gets 5 stars.This review is more of an FYI.  The product amount is not the same as what is typically found in grocery stores (see uploaded image).  In the grocery store, you can usually find the 1.8 Oz can that contains 6 packets that makes 12 quarts.  That is not what you are getting here.  You are getting four 1.2 Oz cans that each contain 8 packets that make 8 quarts.The packets of the store-bought can make 2 quarts each.  The Amazon-bought can packets make only 1 quart each.  It may take a little math to ensure you are getting a decent value.  At the store, it is about 25 cents per quart based on a 3 dollar sale price.

If I'm able, I always like to order items I use in bulk through amazon - good prices, free shipping, and home delivery. Triple win.I'm a huge fan of crystal light, with all the caffeine I drink I know I should be drinking more water, but can't get myself to crave the bland taste. Enter Crystal light. There are a ton of good flavors to choose from, but my criteria was as follows:1. A flavor not so extreme that I would get sick of it after a week. A mix of tart and sweet, neither one too strong.2. I could purchase in bulk and not have to think about restocking for a while3. Great priceThis product fit the bill perfectly. The lemonade is a burst of tart, but the raspberry brings it back down to a more neutral flavor. So whether you want lemonade or juice, the raspberry lemonade can do the trick.As for the packaging, the shipment came with 4 canisters that hold 8 extra-large packets. The packets are exactly double the size of the standard crystal light packets - so you're essentially getting 16 packets per canister. The directions advise 1 quart water per packet and since I tend to use CL in cups, water bottles, and glasses, I am able to use about half the packet each time I use (1 regular packet).Overall, this is a great buy and I will be purchasing again through Amazon.NOTE: It looks like Amazon increased the price of this product significantly. I see it now at $19.99. I purchased for $6.62. Obviously Amazon prices change constantly, so I would keep a look out for a deal before purchasing. I would personally just buy the cheapest one since they all essentially do the same thing anyway, and I have yet to come across an awful crystal light.

Crystal Light replaces soda in my dieting efforts, which is a big help.  Just like another reviewer said, each canister has eight packets, each of which only makes one quart instead of the two quarts you expect when purchasing from major grocers.  I didn't notice this until after it arrived.  I'm okay with it since I have a jumbo Bubba mug that holds approximately a quart, but the buyer should be aware of what they're getting, especially if you're trying to calculate your savings versus store pricing.
Its taste really delicious and good substitute of soda. my 4 year old son really like its taste and always want this yummy water and it make me easy also to convince him to drink more and more water.
This stuff taste good. I use half a packet per a tall glass. I tasted a bunch of flavors and i think this one is very drinkable and low calories.
I do like to drink water but not as much as I should and this really helps. I like this flavor, one of their best.

I believe i caught this item as they are changing the packaging. So i got a really great deal. I love the flavor and i find i've increased my liquid intake and haven't had a soda in 3wks since i started drinking crystal light! i'm a happy camper!

Ok so we all know we need to drink 8 glasses of water a day. That number varies with who you talk to. But the point is it's recommended that we drink a good amount of water everyday. Problem is water is boring and I find it hard to drink that much water in a day. That's why I bought this. This gives water a better taste and I can drink more of it. And this stuff doesn't have all the junk soda has. Mixes well and tastes great.

Raspberry is not a subtle flavor. It is an overpowering one. As usual, the Raspberry side of the equation dominates and abuses any second flavor. In this case, lemon; which can barely be detected.Pretty nasty stuff.

I am not a tea drinker, just do it for the health benefits. I add this to my Traditional Med Green Tea to mask the taste of the green tea which I do not like. This chamomile tea is sweet and smells great. If I am bloated or have a tummy ache, I make a cup with 2 bags and it really helps. Subscribe and Save saves you tons of money with this tea. Love that it's organic and USDA labeled too.

I've been a fan of this kind of tea ever since I was a kid -- it's perfect for late nights, since it doesn't have caffeine and keep you up. I worried that the pack of six would be overkill, but it's so good that I haven't regretted it.

column9: Best quality, from a company with conscience
column10: I cannot drink coffee, and I use herbal teas for beverages, wellness elixirs, and home remedies for illness.  Chamomile is one of the best, most gentle, most versatile herbs--it helps with sleeplessness, digestive upset, nerves, grumpiness, cold/flu symptoms, etc.  I drink it every day along with other teas because I love it so much.  Traditional Medicinals is a great company.  You know the herbs you're getting from them are certified organic, the company uses high post-consumer recycled content in their packaging, they use pharmacoepial strength herbs, and their plant runs on wind power.  It's a win-win-win...good for you, good for the planet, good for the company, when you buy their teas.  Highly recommended.

I drink this w/another tea for easing digestion and the combo is working. Sometimes I have the Chamomile by itself, so can say the taste is very mild, really close to bland, but it is soothing...well, I haven't blown a cork while drinking anyway.The tea bag floats, which may not bother other people; but, I do prefer my tea bags to sink into the water...so I know I'm getting maximum brew.

column9: You have to smell it to get it
column10: The aroma that comes from this pouches is to die for. It is so real and intense, that speaks itself for the quality of a product. I drink those anytime of the day,this kind of tea might calm you a little. I have also the ginger and chamomile combination it is just as good. The package of the product is well designed as result  the product will stay fresh longer.
This tea was "prescribed" by my mom's nutritionist, and its been helping her a lot in getting a good night sleep. Highly recommended, plus it is organic!
Love this tea. Taste good and it's organic. If you like stronger tea, steep the tea bag for 5 more minutes. This can also maximize getting the ingredients from the herbal tea.

Chamomile and organic, what more is there to say.  This Camomile does the job without having other additives in the tea bag, only the flower.  It calms wonderfully, relaxes in a few minutes.  Also can be used as an eye flush if you have allergies or other eye irritants.  Tradition Medicinals is a good brand and I recommend it to anyone looking for a great tea.  Add some honey or lemon to make it even better.
Love it! What can you say about tea?? I just buy here because I save $$$ and have plenty for whenever I need it. Love tea!
The tea was very sweet and the tea bags full.  Other tea companies make it difficult to get even a small cup after a lot of steeping so I'm a loyal Traditional Medicinals customer.
I drink this tea to relax and for stomach and digestive problems. It works every time. Very calming and a good all-around tea time.

I really like this chamomile tea because it has a nice chamomile flavor without any added ingredients, plus it's certified organic.  If you're looking for a chamomile-only tea, you can't go wrong with this product.

I have enjoyed this tea for about a year now, and find it to be an excellent blend. It never seems to create any bitter taste, if I leave the bag in the cup. It makes great iced tea too.I am so happy that Amazon has this service, especially because I could no longer find this tea in my local supermarkets.

I've been buying this locally, but this weekend there were no boxes in three different stores from the one chain that carried it. Looks like its time for Amazon Prime since I can't do without my Safari Spice.This is a fragrant tea with a very smooth flavor. I love to make it as iced tea. I keep telling myself I need to try it as a hot tea sometime, but haven't done so yet.

I find this tea a bit strong but my friend loves it!  Of course, as soon as we found it, it was discontinued in our usual stores so thank goodness I have found it on here (I plan to put it in her Christmas goody bag).

I tried this tea as an experiment.  It has a spicy flavor and has become a hard-to-find product after my local grocer discontinued its sales.  Not only does it taste good, it leaves a pretty good aroma after brewing.  You'd think there was incense burning somewhere with the amount of spices included in the tea. Thanks Amazon for carrying this tea!

Before I tried this tea I couldn't imagine a tea with red pepper in it and now this is one of my favorite Celestial Seasonings blends. The red pepper has a fruity rather than peppery taste and along with the other fruity flavors, I find it a very enjoyable blend.

column9: Great Tea for Cold Weather Time
column10: Since this tea has a little red pepper spicy touch and it is decaf, we like to drink it for winter time as after dinner/before bedtime dessert tea.  Its taste is also rather unique so I am not surprised why some people don't fall in love with it.  I took a chance and I am glad I did!

I'm a tea drinker exclusively--in the morning it's black tea, and in the afternoons and evening, this is my #1 favorite herbal.  The perfect blend of spicy with just a hint of sweet, it's delicious on its own, and fantastic with a cinnamon cookie.

Since our family has discovered Red Safari Spice it became an instant favourite!It's a great "comfort drink". With it's gentle mixture of spices it is relaxing and caffeine free. There is a soft flavour which blends wonderfully with the spices and lingers on the tongue. We were surprised to discover that this was created with a touch of banana - softening the spices without giving it a fruity flavour.  Our family enjoys this tea with a bit of sugar and milk. It is a drink that can be enjoyed by all ages. The obvious aroma in the kitchen of the spices of the steeping tea is an added bonus. The health benefits of Rooibos Tea has been a blessing to my husband especially. For years he has suffered from stomach cramps, etc., if he eats dinner too late - which happened frequently due to the length of his commute home. One of the several benefits of Rooibos Tea is it's ability to soothe stomach cramps. My husband has not experienced this once since we have been drinking this tea. I try to welcome him home with a cup of Red Safari Spice or serve it to him with supper. Try it, and hopefully you will enjoy it as much as we do!
Of all the different flavored teas we purchase, this one is my favorite, either alone or mixed with other tea flavors, it adds spice and layers of flavor to other teas.

column9: It has too much going on for me
column10: When I first saw the list of flavors in Dr Pepper Jazz, I said, "That's way too many flavors. Dr Pepper already has 23..." Which is about the same reaction I had when I tried this tea. I don't want to bag on Celestial Seasonings (that's a little tea pun), because they make a quality product, but I only bought Red Safari Spice because my local store was out of Celestial Seasonings Madagascar Vanilla Red. I'm not a fan. It reminds me of mulling spices, and I'm not a fan of mulled cider. So it's not a "bad" tea; just not my cup of it.

I love Celestial Seasonings rooibos based teas--in particular their Madagascar Vanilla Red, and Moroccan Pomegranate.  Red Safari Spice tries to do too many things and creates a busy blend that did not grab me. The combination of fruit and spice was just not tasty--and I am not a fan of banana flavoring in tea.Celestial Seasonings gets extra points for their packaging: they utilize 100% natural recycled paperboard in their boxes and they don't package each tea bag individually. Instead they use a system of a waxed paper bag inside the box that stays shut when you fold it. It keeps the bags fresh and utilizes less packaging than individually wrapping each bag. The art they use on each box is beautiful as are the quotes and information they put on every surface.Quote from the box: "In all things of nature there is something of the marvelous."  Aristotle.
I have celiac disease and these are Gluten Free.  I made a veggie mix spring roll and they worked great.  They rolled well and held their shape.  I would purchase again.

Bought these to make gluten free eggrolls for my granddaughter and they worked great.  Tried to fry them but the rice wrapper gets bubbles in it and they absorb a lot of oil.  Since everything inside the eggroll is already cooked it is better to just roll the eggroll in a shallow dish of water(to make the wrapper a little softer)just before eating.  I personally think they taste better when they are not fried.  Dip them in some sweet and sour sauce and enjoy. yum! yum!

I tried making eggrolls with these, and they just totally don't work if you're going to fry them. The rice paper sticks to the papertowels, and to the other eggrolls, and they fall apart when you try to remove them. When they're first wet and wrapped, they're really flimsy as well. They easily fall apart. Not good for real eggrolls. I'm dumping these things, as I have no use for them.

These wrappers are great for spring rolls, however I tried to use them as a gluten-free substitute for wonton wrappers and I do not recommend them for this purpose.  They just don't quite work for wontons.  But, I would definitely buy them again when making spring rolls!

the product is listed as a 150g 6-pack.Traditionally, when US companies do a bundle-pack they list the size of the individuals...so a 6 pack of canned soda would be a 12oz 6-pack, we would never see that listed as a 72oz 6-packI foolishly assumed I was getting a real bargain, 6 150g bags, for about $8!Oh so wrong. It's a 6-pack of 25g bags, 150g TOTALSo you're getting about the equivalent of one bag of chips for your money. Still, not a terrible deal for something a little exotic.The chips themselves were good, though! I only took stars off for the somewhat deceptive descriotion and the fact it took a couple of weeks for them to arrive.

These are amazing chips but they just cost too much for the little amount that you get. They come from England so I suppose they have a way to travel. Hey just bring them to the states and I would be most happy!

On Oct 9 I ordered from a different vendor the same product 1.2 oz- 6 pack.  That order was 6 packs of 1.2 oz ea.  When I saw this item I decided to order it.  it read the same as my first order 1.2 oz- 6 pack & the price was approximately the same.  I received the order today & what is it but 1 large bag of small packs totaling 1.2 oz.  I call this deceptive not curious as another reviewer put it. I think the descriptions should be more specfic. The 1 star rating I gave is because of the description not the product itself.  The chips are actually very good.

column9: Makes me drool just thinking of them
column10: The Brit's have out done us. The flavor is supreme,they satisfy my hunger for steak and onions...Get them while you can...  Their other flavors are great tooo

column9: Awesome Crisps!!! Arrived in just 8 days in Texas from England!!!!
column10: These crisps are my favorite.  I ordered these expecting to get them in a month or two, and to my surprise they arrived in just 8 days!!!I immediately ordered 8 more 6 packs, as my entire family wants these crisps.Fantastic company I ordered from.  I am more than pleased!!!!Walkers Worcester Sauce Crisps 6 Pack 150g

These are the best flavor chips, my daughter and I love these, taste like real bacon. Also they arrived quickly especially considering they shipped from england to california usa. I just ordered more. I ordered from Olieshop UK.

Okay, I jumped the gun, because they were sending me the review information, before I received my chips, so I thought I would be honest, and indicate that I have not received them, and I wasn't happy about not receiving them. However overall, the service is not bad, and my chips are on the way.Sorry guys, they really are not bad people, I am just an impatient buyer... there, is that better?

column4: d wilson "Visitor from a Perpendicular Universe"
column10: I had a bag of these during a trip to London. I was looking for Walker's Frazzles but this was the only bacon-flavored chips I could find at the Tesco. The taste is very similar to Frazzles if not better. It tastes just like bacon! Even suitable for vegetarians.

This chips kind of reminded me of bacon bits. The six small bags were the perfect size and there's no MSG. They were a little expensive, but considering they came from the UK it's understandable. Half the price was in the shipping. They are well worth the indulgence once in awhile.
If you like salt and vinegar crisps (chips), but would prefer the vinegar to lighter, you should love these.  Salty and slightly tangy and yummy!

This could possibly be the best tasting chip I have ever eaten. It has a nice smokey bacon flavor. I would make sure this item was always stocked in my pantry if the price was not so high for the amount you get, or if they would sell this "AMAZING" chip here in the states. I would highly recomend someone paying the price one time just to try this.
I loved the chips they were AWESOME!!! but that's just me. It arrived Earlyer than expected in the mail so that was even better, no crushed chips yay!
The crisps are awesome. Give me English crisps over american chips any day! I recommend them to everyone. The smoky bacon are my favorite but the cheddar bacon are almost as good.
Item came promptly however the crisps were 3 months past their freshness date. Was told I would get replacements.  Still waiting.
Bought these the other day while I was in Canada, they are delish! If they were available here in the states I would buy them.

I had these wonderful chips in Ireland a few years ago on vacation and was sad that I could not find them in America.  Now that I have I will be in so much trouble ordering them all the time.  I love these chips!!!

I ordered this product on Amazon to get some of the flavors we can't get in the US, namely, bacon, worcestershire, and prawn cocktail.  The photo of the product was so small and the description was so vague that I didn't realize until it came that what I was getting were actually 3 flavors of crisps that I can get down the street from my house:  cheddar cheese and onion, salt and vinegar, and regular flavor.  I was VERY disappointed.  Instead of trying again to order online, I will ask friends in the UK to shop and mail them for me.

Well, we finally found a treat without byproducts and corn productsthat our cats both like!We've tried all the flavors now. This is their second favorite one.Both of our cats are poultry-lovers, so this made perfect sense.(Their favorite is the weight-control one. Not sure why specifically,but they love it.)I was very happy to find something that wasn't full of junk off the factoryfloors. I was so tired of Purina treats, which seemed to be as full of junkas they could make them. All kinds of grains and cheap fillers! Our catswere addicted to them though, just like people get addicted to junk food.So, very happy to recommend the Evo Wild Cravings treats.Good job!Be sure to try them for your kitty cats.

My 9 year old cat can be a bit of a picky eater. I wanted to try some different treats that didn't have the loaded by-product most anything made for pets seems to have. The thing I like most about these is they're not just treats, they can be used to supplement or even replace your cat food. A little pricey to replace considering my cat gets 1/2 cup of food a day, but not a bad thing to have around when the stores run out of your grain-free food.

Actually they were not real goose liver,they are pork liver pate.Of course goose liver is more expensive!Taste's OK for me though delivery fee is too high!Unacceptable because they're from NY(inside US);

I tried the Goose Pate. This was my first time trying pate and I must say I was pleasantly surprised. I tried it with Wheat Thin crackers and it was very tasty. The pate was smooth and creamy with a nice subtle flavor. I definitely will try new flavors.

Honestly.............I used to buy this frequently before they stopped caring it in my grocery store.  So I was actually quite excited to see its availibility online!  I'm not exactly sure what's up with it, but it has absolutely NO taste whatsoever......very big disappointment :o(

I fell in love with Stash chocolate mint tea two years ago.  I am thrilled to be able to buy it now in an economical and environmentally friendly way.  This is used for my private use and I've felt uncomfortable with all the many boxes I've gone through in order to have my six bag a day tea fix.  If you are a tea junkie and care about our landfill situation then go for broke and purchase this way and save yourself a couple of hundred bucks.

I have tried many OOlong teas and this is by far the best.  It has a wonderfully light coconut, mango flavor.  The two flavors blend well together, neither one overpowering the other.  I will definitely buy again.
really nice tea, and smells wonderful. I enjoy it with a teaspoon of "sugar in the raw."  Stores well as is wrapped in foil. I usually buy the box of 100 teabags since it is an excellent value

column9: A ginormous box of 1,000 tea bags
column10: Stash Chamomile Herbal Tea is tea bags with dried, crushed chamomile flowers.Honestly, as far as I'm concerned, chamomile is chamomile. I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.If you really, truly like chamomile tea, or own a restaurant, this ginormous box of 1,000 single-serving tea bags is a good choice.
Fast shipping. Smells good when you open the tea bag - tastes like watered down coffee with a faint mint aftertaste. Not recommended.

column9: Why pay for organic soup that has BPA in it?
column10: My daughter loved this soup, but I was disappointed to discover that Earth's Best uses a resin liner on their canned foods that contains BPA - a toxic chemical for children.  While the company says the levels are low and within acceptale government standards, BPA is known to leech even more into acidic products like diced tomatoes, or tomato soup.  So, until Earth's Best moves to glass jars, we'll have to refrain from eating this yummy soup.

According to the breast cancer fund, two samples of this product contained the BPA levels below.Calif.  Earth's Best  Organic Elmo Noodlemania Soup, USDA Organic  42Calif.  Earth's Best  Organic Elmo Noodlemania Soup, USDA Organic  34
all my kids love this soup!  they eat it all the time.  It has some veggies and I've tried it myself and it is very tasty!

I love this soup for my children, but I'm not sure about ordering it online anymore.  8 of the 12 cans had major dents.  I mean 2 to 3 INCH dents that were 1/4 inch deep.  This is unacceptable quality.  Since the price has gone up drastically since I started ordering online a few years ago, I will now go to the store and pay the same price for undented cans.
My son loves this soup. The large noodles are great and the soup is filled with carrots and celery. It is fast and convenient, a great meal to bring on a trip with you.

What's the point of putting organic food in a toxic can? Get with it Earth's Best. Use a pouch. Parents, please be aware that food in cans contains BPA. Also, Earth's best uses BPA in the lids of their baby food jars.

column9: great for a quick easy meal
column10: my son loves this soup and i love the busy days when i don't have to think about making him something from scratch.  just open the can and throw in a pot to cook.  he loves both the noodles and the carrots and celery [which i will say i wish there were more of.]shipping was fast [and free with amazon mom] and cans arrived in perfect condition.  if you sign up for subscribe and save the price is a lot cheaper than BRU prices and even our food store.pros:easy, convienentfastlow saltorganicum...it's elmo!noodles are large enough for a spoon or fingers to grabcons:needs more veggies

column9: Difficult for a child to chew
column10: The overall flavor in this soup is not bad, however it's extremely difficult to chew.When my daughter tried to chew it, she seemed to be having problems so then she kepttrying to swallow it, and continued to choke each time. I had a few bites myself, andI found that even I had difficulty chewing the beans--they were SO HARD! For a toddlerto eat this was next to impossible. I definitely wont ever buy this again and wouldn'trecommend it for a child or an adult.

this soup sells for way more at every other place i've bought it.  so happy to see amazon carries it, really what don't they have?  you save a lot if you sign up for the subscribe and save!as for the soup itself, i love the ingredients the vegetable choices and of course the pasta.  my son loves the taste and seeing elmo.  this is a great option for busy days, or days when you can not think of anything else to make.  there are carrots and celery for veggies, beans for protein, and pasta for starch.  the low sodium is also a plus.a great choice!

column9: Great soup! Both Kids Loved It!
column10: Both of my kids loved the soup and I thought this one had a good balance of vegetables and noodles. They love the Elmo noodles. It is a quick, healthy lunch for my kids.

column9: Lots of Noodles is a huge plus!
column10: The kids loved that there was lots of noodles. I wish there was a little more vegetables though and added some of my own.
This was a great value. My kids ask for this soup everyday and so it was a no brainer to buy in bulk. Couldn't beat the shipping cost either!!

My 3-year old has been eating this soup since she was about 1 year old.  She absolutely loves it, and so do I. It's organic and very healthy (with lower sodium than just about any other canned soup on the market).
Not many vegetarian kids soups on the market and we were very glad to find this!  The kids love it!
I was very disappointed that half the cans I received were dented very badly.  The soup is great but for the price, you should be able to enjoy all twelve cans.

column9: Awesome tomato soup with big Elmo shaped noodles. Kids, Grankids & adults all love this organic soup.
column10: Delicious organic tomato soup. All of ours were half soup and half noodles. Even though this made for kids, the elmo noodles are about the size of nickles, so i suggest the need to cut up or squish for the smaller ones. My whole family loves this soup.OrganicAn excellent source of iron, zinc and six B vitamins2-3 grams of protein per serving1 gram of fat per serving360 mg or less of sodium per servingFun Elmo shaped pastaEarth's Best Sesame Street Organic Soups are a nutritious and convenient way to warm children's tummies. Made with fun Elmo-shaped pasta and a garden variety of organic vegetables including tomatoes.These soups provide one full serving of vegetables as recommended by the USDA Food Guide Pyramid for children 2-5 years of age. Not concentrated, they are ready to eat right out of the can--just heat and serve.

Almost all of the cans in the case arrived smashed and dented. The 4 that were not smashed, I was able to press in using my hand so I did not end up using them. It was a waste of money. I like the soup it is  shame the cans are not a good quality. I wonder how safe the soup is to eat if the can is so easily dented and smashed. I reported this same concern to the company. I will never buy soup via mail again. I found that the cans do the same thing if bought from the local store so I will not be purchasing this product in the future.

Aunt Sally's Chewy Pecan Pralines are chocked with pecans!!! Love that..... The praline is not too sweet and very creamy as you can taste the pecans and the carmel like praline. I ate 6 within two weeks and did not realize it. Great product.
These pralines are delightful and without a doubt worth the the wait! They arrived on time and ready to eat!

column9: The only place to find it is on amazon!!!!
column10: I served in the U.S Army in the Iraq war. While there I found that I loved the tea the Iraqi people had. Once I returned to the U.S I was unable to find this tea anywhere. I happened to find it here on Amazon and I have started ordering it regularly. Ahmad tea cardamon flavor is exactly the same as the tea they served in Iraq and since this is the only place I can get it I think it's a great deal as well as being some of the best Chai tea I have ever had. I would recomend it to anyone that is looking for a great Chai tea.

column9: Same formula ,but improved taste  ; competitively overpriced...
column10: Had to shave a star b/c of inconvenience of sealed btl cap & heavy glass ~ at least 50% of sports enthusiasts use these shooters on the go (walking ,biking ,hiking) ,so weight(plastic)/replaceable cap significant ,similar to old '"hitman"' style container ~Had to shave another star (3 vs 4)due to being non-competitively priced anymore !! ($65/case !!!)

I have been buying these in a local grocery store for double the price listed here. This is a real deal. The taste is worth the extra price, as these are the best tasting energy drink that I've had. The taste is exactly like a Jager-bomb - that is Jagermeister and Red Bull. Exactly.

This coffee came with the "starter pack" for our Keurig coffeemaker and was near the last of the pack to be sampled.  It rated 5/5 and #2 of 25 by Dad and #3 by Mom.Brewed/reviewed using the largest (automobile tumbler) water size.  As stated, a "bold" taste with a heady toasted coffee aroma.  This is a medium-body coffee, despite the implication on the packaging that it is a dark coffee (it is not a dark or french roast).  Finishes clean with little or no aftertaste and no metallic taste whatsoever.  (People's coffee all had metallic finish for us.)  This is our winner for "anytime" coffee.The big winner was Van Houtte single-source coffees.  Absolutely perfect, but alas, not carried by Amazon, and twice the price of blended beans.Timothy's Morning blend was our winner for a lightly toasted coffee.  Gentle, smooth, and goes well with afternoon snacks or light lunch.All of the teas were perfect, but at the price we'll stick with teabags.

I am writing this as I sip my first Newman's K-cup, and it's fantastic.  OK, not the same as a fresh cup from my local Caribou Coffee, but it's bold and dark, full of flavor, and not burnt tasting at all.  I have found most of the K-cups I tried to produce dishwater, just not enough coffee in them to make a full-flavor cup.  I have been drinking Timothy's Midnight Magic Extra Bold, also very nice--just ran out, and picked up the Newman's at Costco (no time for shipping).  It's a very worthy competitor, very very nice.

This is my favorite rich coffee.  I prefer a dark coffee, but I don't care for Italian or French roasts.  This is very smooth and has none of the acidic bites that some coffees have.  This is deep and dark and smooth and rich.  Highly recommended.
I take my coffee without sugar. The bitter after-taste of this blend is very noticeable.

Having tried a number of the different coffees available for k-cups I am often disappointed, Newmans however does not disappoint.  Its a good coffee.  They are all priced usually pretty similiar but Newmans is clearly a better blend than many others. If your getting K-Cups and you want a good coffee, not a bunch of different flavors just good coffee, get Newmans Own.

I purchased the 80 pod Newman's Own box.  I have always greatly loved aroma and taste of unflavored Columbian coffee, and had enjoyed unflavored coffee pods that came with machine, including the the extra bold pods.  However, though the Newman's own pods are not indicated as being flavored, they alas are.  I've once in a while gotten same aroma and taste at truck stops and restaurants, but don't know what the flavoring is.  Hate the aroma, hate the flavor; what I want is UNADULTERATED PURE COFFEE.  Trying to find someone who likes Newman's own pods so I can give them away.

column9: Great coffee at a great price
column10: We go through so much coffee at our house, that we might as well become coffee shop! The bulk Newman's coffee is fresh, tasty and reasonably priced. A winner for my family!

I have been accused of going over-board on some things and my K-Cup obsession has been no different. I have tried almost every bold K-Cup on the market (really, my kitchen is full of those little boxes). Many of them are very good, and some (like Timothy's Rainforest Espresso) are excellent. Still, for day to day drinking I always go back to this blend. I find it to be smooth and satisfying. I use the second to smallest setting on my Keurig B70 (7 1/4 oz.) and I usually enjoy three to four cups in the morning (I never reuse a K-Cup, but if it works for some people, fine). If I want more or a cup later in the day I switch to the decaf version, also very good.I miss my Newman's Own so much when I travel that I have started packing a Keurig B30 with me so I can enjoy this coffee on the road. I now also drink Coffee People's Organic blend, as a matter of fact I have grown to prefer it but that does not take away from how good of a coffee this is.Coffee People Organic, Extra Bold K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) [Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging]

column9: Awesome product -- now it's easy to add quinoa to your diet
column10: Each of the containers has a large serving of quinoa (but only 170 calories) that is already perfectly cooked. I am not much of a cook myself and cooking dry quinoa, particularly just a single serving, didn't work for me.  Since it is already perfectly cooked, but totally plain, I can use it as a really quick and healthier base for many things where white rice or brown rice would work.  It can also be stirred into any strongly flavored sauced dish that needs a little toning down or extra hardiness or texture.  I use it most often as a nice substitute for rice in what used to be a "rice bowl" with meat and other ingredients on top.  I have now bought this item 3 times.  As far as I have found, this is a completely unique product and no one else makes anything as flexible and convenient with quinoa.

Quinoa is a relatively new grain to the North American market, but it's an ancient staple in South America.  And I'm really glad it's finally gotten popular, because it is an INCREDIBLE source of vegetable protein -- there are six grams of protein in each of these meal-size servings.  It has a mild taste, just as rice does.  It's a natural grain, and can be the equivalent of rice or potatoes in a traditional meal.  But, there's so much more you can do with it!  I've scrambled it into eggs, to provide more protein and volume.  I've added it to soups, I've just heated it, thrown in blueberries, and had it with a little hazelnut milk as a breakfast cereal.  I've had it warmed for lunch with a little salsa and avocado on it.  I've added it to recipes for breads, muffins, health bars.  I've used it to thicken casseroles, it's just a great, all-purpose pantry item.  And, it's organic, and fully prepared.  I like to mix a pack of this quinoa, with a pack of the McDougall's Lentil Curry that Amazon also carries -- and then I spoon that mix into romaine lettuce leaves, with a dollop of salsa, to make great tasting lettuce wraps for a fun frisky lunch.  This ready-to-serve organic quinoa gets five stars and two thumbs up from me.
