column9: Delicious for the Non-Herbal Tea Lover
column10: I had this today at a wonderful restaurant in Delaware, The Rail, for the first time.  I usually only like tea with cream and am not an herbal tea lover.  This may just change my mind!  It was delicious and needed no lemon....or cream!
We love this flavor of tea and cannot find it in stores.  These large tea bags make more than one cup of tea.
Best tea ever! If you add a little bit of honey after you have poured the water to brew the tea, it is so good. Just like liquid amber.
These are one of the most flavorful tea bags I've ever tasted.  Each tea bag is individually bagged to maintain the freshness of the product.  I highly recommend this product!
The shipping was fast!!  This tea is the best tea I have tasted from a Box...LOVE IT

I didn't realize this had chocolate in it when I ordered it.  Normally I don't like teas with chocolate.  It has become one of my two favorite flavored teas.  Just fantastic flavor hot.  I haven't tried it cold yet.It does have a faint earl grey flavor, along with a fruity flavor.
The quality of the tea is good, but I didn't care for the flavor.  I'm more of a cinnamon girl.  I ended up giving it to my sister.

column9: INSURANCE WILL PAY for hypoallergenic formula!!
column10: Hypoallergenic formula was necessary for our daughter's acid reflux.We found out from a friend that most insurance companies will completely cover the cost of hypoallergenic formula, either by reimbursing you what you've spent on it, or if you get it as a prescription through your pediatrician. Ours did!Many doctors don't know this, so they don't know to give a prescription for the formula. Call your insurance company today!

column9: Do not give to dogs with sensitive stomachs!!!!
column10: I am a registered dietitian who ordered these for my black lab who has a sensitive stomach. I am a big fan of this line's other treats. They usually have very few ingredients and so I ordered these for our pup thinking they would be fine. BIG mistake!! When the package arrived I read the ingredients list and it has sorbitol in it...which is a sugar alcohol. This gives humans diarrhea very often but I tried giving her one just to see anyways. Huge huge huge mistake. She had diarrhea for 2 days straight every 20-40 minutes. I would not recommend these to any dog owner.

This is an excellent product that I tried through our local wal-mart store.  My dogs love them.  It is one of a very select few that my dogs will eat.  We have tried every treat that comes out on the market but this one of a very few they like. I just wish they came in a larger amount.
Our little teacup yorkie just LOVES this ducky treat!  It is worth trying for your dog...
Ideal for small dogs.  Easy to chew & can be easily torn into small pieces for a delicious, all-natural training-treat.  Mini dachsie LOVES them.

column9: Delivered on time and the dog likes these sausages
column10: This is one of my dogs favorites, and as usual it was delivered on time so she is happy again.It's really easy to shop from the Amazon web page and their suppliers.
My puppy seems to like them. They worked well to assist in training. They seem to be fresh and kept well over a couple of weeks.
Bought this along with some other treats for new puppy. Took me a while to get to these. Puppy isn't a big fan of these. He will eat them, just not with the same gusto as others.

My Bichon really loves these and the reason we started using them is because they were made of entirely duck meat.  He has bad allergies and the duck jerky & sausages were a treat he could have.  Recently they have reformulated the product (sausage) and now they are using chicken liver in it.  I'm disappointed in this because we usually won't feed him beef or chicken.This supplier is great and received my order in just a few days.
My dog loves these and it is very hard to find treats for him because of his sensitive stomach
Never received it. Sent to wrong address. I corrected it but it fell on deaf ears.
I have a very spoiled dog and she won't eat most of the treats we get for her.  She loves these and that is such a plus for me!!!  I will continue to buy these for her.
DOG LOVES THIS STUFF CAN'T FIND IT ANY PLACE IN OKLAHOMA CITY WE BUY THEM 10 AT A TIME

column9: Best cheese curls - UPDATED: overpriced and poor quality
column10: I won't say I'm an expert in cheese curls, but these sure taste great. Slightly milky flavor, and a touch of blue cheese give these an edge (literally and figuratively) over the competition. It's great that part of the ingredients are organic (I wish of course that they were all organic at this price). Don't be surprised when you open the bag, they fill just under a third of it. I guess the empty space keeps them in shape! Now the bad part, when you buy 12 at once you expect a discount. The Amazon price of $2.58 each is the same as at my local high priced natural food store. Still, nobody comes close flavor wise, although flavor is, of course, subjective.UPDATE December 11, 2009Could I have been more disappointed with the makers of Cheese Curls? I stopped buying the baked cheese puffs from the same brand because the quality varies from one batch (by the expiration date) to another, and the last batch had too many puffs without cheese. Back to the curls, the previous batch (November) was just excellent (good flavor and crispiness as reported by my wife), but then came the one I bought just a week ago...there is not a single curl with proper cheese flavor in the bags. So why not complain? I am complaining, but the company doesn't care. I told them last year that the quality of the puffs varied from one batch to another, and it only got worse. The retail price has increased to $2.95 since then. At that price I expect a very good product, especially when I buy 12 at a time. Notice that it says on the back of the bag "freshness guaranteed." That's right, they don't care whether we're happy with the product, just that it's fresh. Thanks Michael Seasons, I guess I'll have to start making my own cheese curls (there is no other product on the market that uses (partially) organic ingredients). I'd give this one star today if I could.

column9: Five stars for the cheese flavored puffs
column10: I'd give it three stars for the approximately 50% of puffs that have little or no cheese on them, and five stars for the ones that have a lot (maybe too much?). I have been eating Michael Seasons puffs and curls for at least two years and can't help but notice how their production has shifted from full-flavored to light-flavored (after which I wrote the company) to mixed-flavored. It seems they produce one batch of light and one batch of full flavored and then mix the two. Are they expecting nobody to notice? At least my wife loves to pick out the light flavored puffs leaving me the full flavored creating a kind of bonding experience if you will, but if I were eating this by myself I'd be annoyed. Still, because they contain at least partially organic ingredients, and because they taste so well overall, there's no other brand that beats them so I keep ordering anyway.

I am so disappointed- this product is NOT eligible to return, but the items I received were outdated!  The use by date was even BEFORE I submitted the order, and the seller sent product they should have seen were beyond the best by date- at least 6 weeks before they processed the order.

column9: THE BEST CHEESE PUFFS OUT THERE
column10: These are so intensely cheddary, they're addictive. I love them, they are everything I want in a cheese snack, very cheesy without being greasy or tasting artificial

column9: Tastes like cardboard with a little heat.
column10: I had so hoped they would be close or better than Cheetos Flamin' Hot but they aren't. They were NOT past the expiration by  3 months but they did taste stale and almost flavorless even though you get a tiny after burn. I gave the rest of the case to the food shelter.

column9: STAY AWAY IF YOU KNOW WHAT'S GOOD FOR YOUR THIGHS!!!
column10: These are the best cheese puffs I have ever had, a sentiment shared by my coworkers and boss.

My husband and I went Gluten Free earlier this year due to a health condition.  We stumbled across this product at Whole Foods and decided to try it.  These were incredible...  so cheesy and spicy!!!  So much so, we decided to buy a case on Amazon.  Once our original case was depleted, we re-ordered, and though the product looks identical, the new case contained cheese curls with little to no seasoning.  They were so bland that we had no desire to eat them.  We opened each bag in the case hoping some of them would be good like the first case we purchased, but to our dismay, we ended up tossing the entire case.  We will not be buying these again.  What a letdown...

column9: Michael Seasons Baked Cheddar Cheese Curls
column10: This was my first purchase of any gluten free cheese curls and I was pleasantly surprised by the taste and the crunch.  My husband even likes them and he is very picky about his snack foods. To me they taste better than the other name brand cheese curls and with less fat and calories.

Michael Season's baked cheese snacks are in. I don't care if they may be inconsistent with the distribution of cheese on their product, big companies are inconsistent too. Your basketball players don't make every shot, your football players don't make every touch down. Are you whining at them or their coach? No. You deal with it, because despite the flaws, you like them. Natural Snacks LLC from Illinois is providing us with a healthier snack free from glutens and hydrogenated oils, and I'm thankful for that.
Can not be beat. They are simply addictive. Cheesy, spicy crunchyOur family can not stop eating them You have to order these
forget cheetos! these are the best ever!  same price (or less if on sale) and better for you.  I could eat a bag by myself but the kids beat me to it!
I was very satisfied with the price and quality of the product. I could not find these gluten free cheetos in any store so I was happy to find them online.

I try not to each a lot of processed food, but occasionally I indulge. These are the very best cheese crunchies and gluten free too! I have found these at New Seasons in Portland Oregon every once in a while, but wish they were more readily available. Very good!!!!
The best cheese curl we've found, but we stopped looking once we found these!  Did not think we could consume a case - but, we've back for more.

My local grocery store had to stop carrying these because the distributor dropped them. I tried other stores with no luck. These are the only cheese curls that really taste like cheese and don't taste like you're licking salt. I'm so glad I still have a source to get them.
Addictive. IMHO these are simply THE best cheese curls. I used to get them at a local whole foods market. Ordering by the case is a wee bit cheaper, oh-so-convenient and terribly dangerous.

I tried many times to find a replacement for Planters Cheeze Curls (now they discontinued it). And I think that is a perfect replacement. May be not only perfect but better than original from Planters. So, there is lot of cheeze powder on it and size is right and it's so delicious that when you'll put one curl in to you mouth you will involuntarily draw the next two.I'll recommend it for everyone who loved old time Planters Cheeze Curls - it's good and probably better.P.S.: I love them so much so I order them to Russia - total cost with delivery is about 75 dollars!

I'm a secret Cheeto addict, but these baked cheese curls are even more flavorful and addictive than the original.  And they are healthier, which makes them the perfect snack. No artificial cheese flavor, excellent crispy texture and sharp cheese taste.  I'm on my third case now and will continue to order this gem of a snack.  Worth a try if you love cheese curls.

column9: OMG These are the Best Cheese Snacks!
column10: I found this brand of cheese snacks at a Whole Foods store in Manhattan and I've been hooked ever since. Unfortunately, WF started carrying their own brand of cheese puffs and stopped selling Michael Season's. Thank goodness for Amazon.com!I like these so much that I ordered a case and had them delivered to my office. Now all my office mates are getting hooked. These taste amazing for being "lite", and they have a decent amount of fiber per serving (and relatively low fat/calories). They are all natural, and highly addictive!I've tried the regular variety of Michael Season's Cheese Puffs, and I do not recommend them because they're too rich. The Lite variety taste perfectly cheesey without being too buttery in flavor.Makes an awesome afternoon snack!

This is the cat's meow for all soup cooking. I've had great results with this one, the lobster, chicken, and turkey Better Than Bullion bases. I now by them by the case. You will not be disappointed and you'll never go back to those boxes of stocks and broths at your local big box grocery store!!

We bought the clam, chicken and ham bases and they are superior to other similar products we have tried in the US.  In particular, they deliver a true flavor and are not salty.  We have been having friends from France bring over wonderfull products that we used when we lived there, but that is no longer necessary.  These products are really good!

This Clam Base, besides being expensive, is not the best but it does the job intended, which is add clam flavor to culinary creations. Bought it because of the price but when I discovered it was only 8oz I realized why the low price tag. Worked fine on several dishes, a little intense in the sodium content but overall it delivered more quality of flavor. I normally buy Minor's Clam Base because it helps me to prepare a really fine seafood chowder. As of late I use the very same ingredients that go on a Boston Clam Chowder but I add lots of fresh seafood. It comes out creamy white, with diced potatoes, celery, onions, peas, carrots, corn and it taste very nice.I used the Better than Boullion Clam Base for pasta dishes, soups and more, and it delivered to a certain point that special flavor that clam juice or base can only deliver. More like a 3.8 I settled on 4 Stars.

column9: We love most of the BTB's but...
column10: Okay, I am a fairly new recruit to the "bases" for cooking.They have some MSG, but no added/additional MSG, so the amounts have beenlow enough to not cause problems. (My husband gets migraines from MSG.)We love most of the flavors, and I was anxious to try this one as well.They don't carry anything but beef and chicken in our local stores, so allthe other flavors have to be purchased online. That makes them very expensive to use,since the shipping is never cheap for these heavy little glass jars.I made a batch of New England style clam chowder last week and used the clam base.I was looking forward to a real clam-intense flavor from the base that would be morethan the milk/cream combo. It was VERy disappointing. I used enough of the product, butI would have had to double it to get any taste, in my opinion. I didn't want to do that,since I don't know what other flavor tweak it might have caused to have double the recommendedamount.Over all, I love all the bases (the chili is amazing!), but the clam leaves a lot to be desired.I also have a lobster, so the next time I make the chowder, I'll try it with lobster base instead.This one is just too "blah" to be useful for very much.I don't think I'll buy it again.

column9: Sets up a fine base for clams
column10: If it wasn't for this product, my clams would have been completely overrun during the final Zerg Rush. Well done!

The quality is what you'd expect from a pickling salt. I prefer using this for brines as it dissolves in cold water.4lbs of pickling salt is quite a bit, so if you're doing a lot of canning or pickling from summer-fall this is a good way to make sure you don't run out.There's not much bad to say about it, it's pickling salt. If you don't know what it is you probably shouldn't order it. If you do, it's the same you get from the grocery store, just in larger amounts.I'm happy with the price and the purchase. I still have quite a bit left and I don't see myself running out any time soon.

Like others who have ordered this, one of the boxes arrived open and I had salt all over the front entry.  Thank goodness I was able to salvage what had spilled in the box and so it wasn't a total waste.  I'll try to find it at a specialty store locally from now on.

I have used this salt for years, but recently my local groceries have stopped stocking it.On the one hand, it has a fantastic grain size for party mixes, popcorn, spice blends, and deserts. No iodine, and little anti-caking made is an easy choice for many recipes.On the other hand, this is not a specialty, gourmet salt. $11 for 8lb, is over TWICE the 2.11 per box I was paying at Safeway. Add shipping, and I'm sure there is a better choice.Just grab any pure salt ( not Sea Salt please, unless it time traveled back from 50,000 B.C. ) and grind it by hand until it is very fine. Volia!

Alright not much to say but if your looking for some salty salt that is pure this is as good as it gets unless you work in a lab, if you came here because you're a Peat-a-tarian--you know what to do--find this review helpful.

I received the 2 x 4lbs boxes of canning and pickling salt edges of boxes worn some of the side split and salt spilling out into packing box onto counter, and floor.  The packing of the items was great which leads me to the care of the boxes prior to shipping was mishandled.
After having Amish rolled butter on my toast, bagels or anything else, I'll NEVER buy store-bought butter again.I'm hooked...it's great!!
Home-churned flavor that can't be found in the grocery store! This is just like grandma used to make from her own cows' milk. It's in one solid block, not in quarters like the store bought stuff.

column9: Minerva Dairy Amish Hand Churned Butter Blocks
column10: I shipped 2 lbs. of this butter in the block form to my father who wanted me to find "old-fashioned hand churned butter like they used to make." I like coming to Amazon b/c of the reviews which help me make better purchasing decisions. Sure glad I came across this product. My Dad absolutely loved it and wants me to order him 10 more lbs. of it!! It did my heart good to hear the excitement in his voice - the rediscovery of something nice from his childhood. He said it was creamy, had a really great flavor - just like butter used to be - not like the tasteless stuff they sell in the grocery stores. It spreads so easily - even when cold due to the higher fat content. The blocks have just the right amount of sea salt. Thank you Minerva Dairy for making a wonderful product and for feeding the cows all of the good food which produces such flavorful milk which translates into good old-fashioned tasting butter. Yummy! You won't be disappointed if you try this butter!

In my personal opinion, this butter is an excellent way to put essential fat into your diet, deliciously!  The value of good quality fat and oil in the diet is not only underrated, it is touted as 'bad' for you...that it will make you fat.  But it is far from the truth...the body needs good quality fat for proper functioning! It is the hydrogenated and heat processed fats that the body doesnt know what to do with so it is stored as 'fat'.  The movie "Lorenzo's Oil" had a profound effect on me regarding the healing power of natural oil, particularily in neurological conditions...and having a son with Asbergers (mild autism) again shows me how natural oil works in healing, though in his case it was with cold pressed Castor oil.  But less I digress further, let me just say this butter is wonderful!

One who appreciates real food and real food cooking is the individual of taste and fine discernment of choice.This is the Butter to get.Once you've had it ya don't want to go back to anything else.  Really.

Good product, just inconveniently packaged. Given that I live in Texas, shipping something like butter could be a problem, but arrived in good shape. Just not sure it was worth the extra cost of shipping a staple that could be purchased locally.

column9: Just what it says on the tin
column10: As promised, this is one pound of granulated xylitol, ready to be used like sugar for all your mix-in and baking needs. (Just don't make yeasted bread with it; the yeast won't feed.) Xylitol is available from a variety of sources; this NOW Foods brand comes from cornhusks.Xylitol is a great alternative sweetener, especially with regard to oral health. The bacteria that harm your teeth can't feed on xylitol, and in fact they bind to the xylitol and it starves them, so it's not just harmless to your teeth, it's actually good for them. This makes it especially great for cooking snacks with or using it in coffee/tea/lemonade, or anywhere else that you might now be exposing yourself to cane sugar between toothbrushings. It's not as sweet as stevia, the other exceptionally tooth-friendly alternative sweetener, but it looks, tastes and behaves more like sugar, so it requires less adaptation (I keep both in my kitchen).I also highly recommend the xylitol-based Spry Dental Defense products (mints, gum, toothpaste, rinse).

Xylitol is available from a wide variety of sources.  It is a form of tree sugar, originally found in willow trees.  It has less calories than sucrose, and metabolizes differently.  You would need to consult with your physician if you are diabetic.One of the main attributes of xylitol is that is protects against tooth decay by changing the ph level to suppress bacteria causing both tooth decay and bad breath.  Rubbing xylitol against a tooth can give temporary relief from a toothache (but see your dentist).Xylitol is usually available in both granules and powder form.  Publications are sold separately giving directions for use in baking.

Marzipan has always been my favorite treat, but it's not easy to find in this country. When my grandson expressed the same preference and his birthday approached, I knew what I wanted to get for him. And Google made it so easy, just a few clicks, and there they where, Marzipan to choose from. It's not easy to choose food by description alone, but reviews helped, and when it promptly arrived and tasted it, I was thrilled. And so was my grandson. The price is reasonable, and being packaged in six individual rolls, makes it easy to store and share. It's excellent marzipan. Since I'm a writer, and thinking requires calories, I now treat myself to some marzipan too. Roswitha Mcintosh

column9: Not the marzipan for the fine candy connoisseur
column10: My intended purpose for this marzipan was to enjoy plain or chocolate dipped.  My first impression when tasting this product was that it is too sweet.  The almond flavor is there, but is secondary to the sweetener.  This is a cake decorating or cooking marzipan, which it appears from the packaging is actually the intended purpose.

This marzipan is moist and delicious.  It tastes much better than the German brand ( in the red foil paper ).  I use it just as marzipan or in chocolate treats.  When rolling it out it is good to use a little bit of powder sugar to prevent it from sticking onto the rolling pin.  Because of it is not too dry you can re-roll it out if you are cutting out or needing to roll a thin layer for a cake.This is also the cheepest place to get the marzipan, it is about 5.50 to 6.50 a tube out in the market.
Amazon sells it cheaper than regular grocery store.  I love it in almond cake.  I just add it to regular Trader Joe cake mix.  I also use it to make India butter chicken.

column9: tastes great straight from the tube!
column10: Ever since I had my first taste of marzipan at the age of 4, I've been hooked. Each Christmas, I'd get a little tray of fruit-shaped marzipan - once a hotdog, etc. The foil wrapping inside the cardboard package helps to keep the marzipan soft enough to mold or eat. I chop out little 'coins' of the tube and drop into a bowl of strawberries, cantelope and creme - nice little confectionary add-on. I'm not much into sweets at all - but this is just the right flavor - almond and a hint of sugar without the overwhelming over-sweetened pre-made treats sometimes have.

This is authentic Scandinavian marsipan imported from Denmark.  This is one of the best brands.  If you have ever had a truly good marsipan cake with the marsipan rolled out in a thin layer like dough to cover the cream, this is the type of marsipan used.

I've tried many brands of marzipan and found this one great to eat plain or use in making cake decorations or candies. It has a nice, natural almond taste and isn't too sweet. It's soft enough to roll out or shape for making fruits or other decorations, but still holds its shape as it dries out. It stores well as long as you wrap it tightly in plastic wrap and a bag and also can be frozen up to 3 months. The 7 oz. tube is fairly small and I wish they made a larger size, but the multipack is a nice option for this reason. I'll be buying this brand again.

column9: Stay away if you expect the taste of real marzipan
column10: If you've never had marzipan, you might perhaps like the hint of almond flavor in this item. But if you know what good marzipan tastes like, thenyou'd do best to stay away from this. The paste tastes like cardboard, the good flavor is not there . For some reason, this product contains wheat, and that might account for the weak, cardboard-y flavor. Good marzipan uses organic almonds, sugar and rose water. It is also more expensive than this cheap imitation, and it tastes heavenly.

We compared this olive oil to the regular olive oil we buy at the grocery - the difference was amazing! This olive oil is fresh and very flavorful.  It is absolutely delicious.  Better olive oil does cost a little more but we now know it is worth it.

I ordered these because they advertise as LOW SUGAR...these are rolled in sugar and are high carb high sugar....bad!I threw them out, since they are opened, I did not thing returning them would get me a refund. Do not recommend.

This was actually the "hit" of the delivery!!  These cigars were ordered to pass out after the birth of our first grandchild, and what a hit they were!!  Everyone loved the idea of a 'chocolate cigar,' and they tasted wonderful!!
Good-quality chocolate (better than Hershey's, more like Lindt or other European chocolates).  Arrived quickly, were packed well and were not melted or broken.

When I bought this product it was sold by Amazon and now it isn't so keep that in mind when reading my review.This granola is drier than some other brands I have tried but it is like that whether you buy it from here or in the store.  I have tried many flavors of this brand of granola and they're all really good.  I really like this one in particular - it has apple pieces, walnuts and a hint of cinnamon.  I typically eat it plain as an afternoon snack.  The best part about this granola is that it is gluten free (most brands of granola aren't)!

I love this granola! I picked it up on a whim at a Marshall's in their specialty food section and now buy it online because I can't find it anywhere else! To me, this is what granola should be - big, crunchy clusters, lots of fruit, not too sweet, just a hadful of nuts. The ingredients list can't be beat, either - only whole, natural foods, ingredients you can pronounce, no GMOs, no HFCS, no refined sugars. Just tasty ingredients. The recloseable bag makes it so easy to just keep stashed in my bag to snack on throughout the day.

Nutrition label says all the right things.  I neglected to read the full ingredients list before ordering, and was surprised to see lots of large coconut flakes (I don't like coconut). I picked most of them out. Great texture with large walnut pieces.  Bland, though.  Would LOVE these if more apples and no coconut!  Check out Bear Naked granola products.
I love granola for breakfast, for lunch and for desert. This granola doesn't disappoint. It's a great flavor and just the right crunch and flavor. I have recommended this to all my friends.

I don't think I have ever had such fresh celery seed before.  Most celery seed that I have bought in the grocery stores has tasted only vaguely like celery.  When I use this celery seed in my cooking, the whole house smells as if I was cooking with fresh celery stalks.  I will definitely buy this product again.
these big jars are fantastic.just pop the lid and start chuggin.they do seem to get really lodged in the teeth thoand if you eat more than 1 cup at a time they make you a tad gassy
Don't know WHY this stuff is so horrendously expensive in the grocery stores, for a fraction of the amount you receive from this company.  The price/quality/quantity is a very great value.

column9: Be careful! Jars may not be full.
column10: Be careful. The product picture shows a FULL jar of Celery Seed, but what I received was only about 75% full, so you are actually paying ~25% more for this product! :( The tamper seal on the jar was unbroken, so I have to assume that this is how it is packed, so why the picture of the full jar? The product is Marshall Creek Spices, and seems to be hit or miss, since I also ordered a jar of Pickling Spice that was a bit over 90% full.  So ok, some settling may occur, but 25%?  I think not!I have not used the product itself yet, so cannot speak as to quality, flavor, etc., but will update this review if there are any issues with it when I do use it.I have added a photo in the photo section to better show what I am speaking of.
I forgot to review this when I got it. What a great deal! I use alot of celery seed in different things I cook and am very pleased with this. I saved so much money!!! Great taste and value for you!

column9: Fresh smelling celery aroma, great price
column10: Just used it an a soup.  Have to be careful, the flavor and aroma are strong so not to overwhelm other spices. Never had this problem with celery seed from the grocery store. Must be fresher or more potent. Great buy.
All the spices and herbs ordered from this company were excellent.  A great bargain when you use large quantities which I do for pickling eggs.

I couldn't remember what I brought this for. I read a lot of Amazon reviews while looking for other things. I have tried this on simple receipes and in my hand and tastes nothing like celery and is dry and nonflavorful. I will just throw it away since I have enough simple spices like black pepper, garlic...

These cookies have incredible flavor. They're so good the flavor is addicting. But the cookies are crisp so they're crumbly to the point that you need a plate to eat one without getting crumbs all over yourself. One bite and the cookie disentegrates all over the place. If you don't have a soy, egg, milk or peanut allergy, these would be the ultimate cookie if it weren't for the crumbles.

These cookies have the same old great Pamela's taste, however the box that I received contained 50 packets of broken and smashed cookies.  The cookies are packed two in a foil pouch, 50 pouches in a cardboard shipping box.  Every last one of the pouches was damaged (I assume during shipping) with damage ranging from both cookies broken into two pieces to the more common extreme of opening a pouchful of crumbs.  Still edible, but oh, so annoying.  Had the cookies been packed or shipped to avoid damage I would have given this product 5 stars for their excellent flavor (mild peanut butter, good chocolate wallop) and sweet tooth satisfaction.

The peanut butter cookies are very good but some of the packages the cookies were all broken up.  I had gotten the other cookies by "Pamela" and on the whole they were not broken up like the peanut butter ones.  They are very good so I will buy them again.
If you like cookies, you may have problems stopping at just a couple. These are gluten and wheat free. Great taste and texture.

column9: Simply the BEST gluten-free cookie EVER!!
column10: When you eat these, you will forget they're gluten-free because they are the best tasting cookie ever!!!! I dont know about the other cookies that Pamela's Products offers, but this peanut butter choco chip is the best!

If you do not eat gluten, and you love peanut butter cookies, you HAVE to try these cookies! They are so superly delicious! They are somewhat crumbly in the box, and at least one cookie in every box will be broken into pieces. But they are so good you will not even care! Definitely try them, you'll love them.

I enjoyed the flavor of these but they were a bit dry and therefore very crumbly. The flavor reminds me of the peanut butter cookies my mom used to make with the Hershey's Kiss on top. I have a whole package so I may try microwaving the cookie for a few seconds to see if the crumbliness and dryness disappear. Will report back when I do.

These cookies are gluten and wheat free, but do contain dairy products. They are very good for the kind of snack that they are. I find them a little dry and out of three boxes, (they come as 12 packs of two cookies in a box,) only the first came with the cookies intact. A lot of them were almost all crumble with very little cookie. But if you need to stay gluten free, then you would probably enjoy them anyhow.
As others have noted, these don't arrive as cookies.  They arrive as crumbs.  And, on top of that, the crumbs I received tasted stale.  Customer lost.
Yes, it is usually comes in crumbs form. Like 40% of it. But it is really good gluten free dairy free crumbs. Probably the best.

column9: Crumbs - Product was not as ordered
column10: I ordered cookies, but I received crumbs. I don't enjoy eating my cookies with a spoon. I'm never buying these online again, just local. I enjoy Pamela's Products, but I am gravely disappointed with the shipping/handling methods for this product.

column9: Was: Whole Cookies! Now: Still arrive as mostly crumbs
column10: Update 5/19/12: Enough of the crumbs already. Guess Pamela's has no interest in fixing the production. I'm canceling, there are better cookies.Update 3/20/12: My latest shipment arrived with no damage to the box, but some of the cookies were completely reduced to crumbs. Odd thing is in some cases a single 2-pack would have a whole or nearly whole cookie, and the other was totally crumbs. The manufacturer's production quality must be inconsistent, and it just takes a certain amount of shipment vibration to crumble the 'weaker' cookies. Odd thing is this is the first batch I've had that were so thoroughly reduced to tiny crumbs. Pamela's needs to tweak their manufacturing.Update 11/7/11: Ditto. Great product arrives intact. Keep shipping them in the display pack via USPS.Update 10/9/11: Ordered the 12 pack of 2 packs again, arrived in the same shelf display package, with intact cookies. Keep it up Amazon, this is working.Update 10/1/11: I took a chance and ordered another package. This one came in a long 'shelf display package', which was shipped USPS. If they stick to this packaging and shipping, I'll order these cookies regularly. So far every 2-pack has had whole complete cookies with minimal crumbs. Way to go, Amazon! I'll attach a picture under the 'customer pics'.Update 9/26/11: a second attempt resulted in larger cookie pieces, and one of the packages contained two whole complete cookiesOriginal review: The 12 pack of 2-packs was delivered in a plastic bag. They must travel around Amazon in this fashion, and are reduced to crumbles as handled by Amazon. The bag was packaged in a large box along with a 6-pack of cereal boxes; there could have been more filler around the cookies bag, but I doubt it would help much if the cookie bag is tumbling around Amazon before shipment packaging.The cookies themselves were okay, not as good as nutter-butters. Can't really judge them as cookies when most all of them were broken. There were a few almost 'halves', but they were coated in crumbs. Some of the packages had melted chocolate. Basically you have to pour the packages out into a bowl and eat them with a spoon. I agree with the last reviewer, except, I'm willing to reorder in the future if Amazon can send a replacement shipment that arrives mostly or all intact.

column9: Cookies taste great, IF you like CRUMBS!
column10: I LOVE these cookies, but I have ordered them several times from Amazon, and EVERY time I get them, 80-95% of the cookies are broken.  They are not just broken in half, many are mostly just large crumbs ! Since they are a bit costly, and appear not to ever arrive intact, I will not be ordering them anymore. :(
These cookies are very rich, oily and smell so strong that you can smell them through a ziplock bag. We won't buy these again. They didn't taste very good.
The cookies are delicious, but they did not survive their shipment well. At least two-thirds of the cookies had been reduced to crumbs by the time I received them.

Pamela's Products Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies are tastier than their gluten counterpart. The flavor is spot on and the dough is lighter than regular wheat products. Shipping did break a few of the cookies. But I ate the pieces all the same.

column9: Great Cookie, But Buy It Local
column10: As everyone has noted, these cookies do not travel well.  They will arrive as crumbs no matter what.  I highly suggest buying them locally, not online.  They have a great nutty flavor, balanced well with the chocolate and a slightly salty dough.  Really good combo of flavors.

column9: Tasty but Crumbly - Eat them with a spoon!
column10: Like many have said, these cookies are really tasty.  I love the flavor.  I'm only rating 3 stars because I got six boxes and every box had approximately 75% of the cookies broken/crumbled.  The recipe abviously needs to be tweaked.  That being said, I too find it difficult to not eat a whole box in one sitting.  I eat them with a spoon! They'd probably be very good sprinkled over vanilla ice cream - gotta try that.  I love the flavor of these cookies, but hope that Pamela's fixes the recipe so they don't crumble in transit (or upon the first bite if you are lucky enough to get a cookie that is completely intact). I've tried several of Pamela's cookies and this is the only one that was COA (crumbs on arrival) :-)
These cookies taste good but were in pieces so it was just eating coookie crumbs not a whole cookie.

OMGThese cookies are perfection.  They're healthy and taste better than any other cookie (healthy or not) out there.  So goooooood with a cold glass of any milk.It's a shame I can't get these shipped internationally since stores are always out of them.... No other cookie comes close.
A crunchy delicious peanut butter cookie with chunks of chocolate buried throughout. Slightly crumbly but not dry. Perfect for the gluten free diet, kid or kid within. Enjoy

This is my favorite store bought cookie. Crumbly texture, great flavor and gluten free. The only problems are not eating a whole box at a time, and sometimes they arrive somewhat crumbled from shipping.

These cookies were a real gluten-free surprise; however, although we are used to gluten free cookies breaking apart easily, the pack of 6 was so poorly wrapped by Amazon that every cookie arrived crumbled in pieces.  Try to find these cookies in a store instead.

I got this pack of cookies for my mom she cant have gluten she loves them so much she will buy more and she says she can tell they honestly are gluten free. It can be hard for people want to eat well or have special diet needs to have treats so I am happy I found these.
For all you Gluten Free people out there, this is the best buy for the money.  Excellent product.
Pamela's products are incredible!  These cookies, specifically, taste great!  Kids and adults alike will love them Celiac or not!

To be fair, I should say that I haven't ordered these cookies from Amazon.com yet, so I can't speak for the condition they arrive in. I sampled them recently and was looking for an online source for family in another state.In any case, the cookies I tried were surprisingly delicious! I picked up a sample packet at a local health food store, and didn't have high expectations. I bake the vast majority of my own goodies, I'm a very experienced baker, and I don't normally eat gluten-free products. I was happily surprised to find that these had a good peanutty flavor, pleasantly crumbly texture, and lots of little chocolate chips. Unfortunately, I think that the crumbly texture is probably what makes these less than ideal for loose shipping.

My husband is gluten/casein free and misses yummy sweets.  I ordered these cookies for him for Christmas thinking they would be fabulous.  They came in handy individual packets full of completely crushed but delicious cookies.  I should have called for my money back, but I don't want Amazon to discontinue the product, I just want the shipping problem fixed.
I AM SO DISAPPOINTED BY PAMELA'S PRODUCTS ORGANIC PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIS. ALL THE COOKIE SMASHED WHEN I RECEIVED IT.
I will never buy Cookies OL again. What I got was 5 boxed of cookie crumbs.Not one full cookie in the shipment.

I love the taste of these cookies but they were mostly just crumbs. I bought the dark chocolate  as well and thet hold together like a normal cookie. I got a second box of the PB and they were still just crumbs and flour rather than cookies.
I ordered these cookies recently. When they got to my home every single cookie was crumbled in a million pieces. And they tasted awful. The worst cookie ever!! :(

column9: Nutro Lamb & Rice is a favorite in our house. (for the dog!)
column10: Our dog loves this food.  It is easily digested, apparently tasty, and never lasts more than a few minutes in the bowl.  Shipping was reasonable, though a lower cost would be helpful.  Also, this item is not consistently offered through Amazon and not eligible for Amazon Prime discounted shipping.  Prime shipping and a discount for scheduled deliveries would make this a 5 star item.

column9: Great results - great alternative to all purpose flour
column10: I have used this flour in place of all purpose flour in cake, cookie and pie/tart crust recipes. Usually whole wheat flour has to be used in conjunction with AP flour because baked goods are too dense with just whole wheat. With this whole wheat pastry flour, you don't have to worry. It can have a more nutty flavor in crusts but it gets rave reviews from those eating the baked goods.

I make homemade bread every other week. I decided to pick up this brand at a local market, instead of using King Arthur's flour like I normally do. It was Kosher, so I decided to give it a try.The flavor of the wheat is superior to any I've used. This flour is wonderful in honey wheat bread. The flavor it gives is so good, and my kids love it. I don't think I'm going to use any other wheat flour again. This is definitely worthy of it's reputation.I used 3/4 of the wheat flour, and 1/4 of organic bread flour, and the bread was awesome. I thought it would be really dense and heavy, but it actually came out lighter than expected without a heavy taste. You can only achieve that with high-quality wheat. Spring wheat is known to have more protein, so you can probably get by without the bread flour during the Spring and Summer months for your bread.Overall, I am so happy I found a high-quality flour that all of us can enjoy, while being able to receive the nutritional benefits of stone-ground wheat. It's relieving to accomplish both with one product, as it's hard to do this with 3 kids. But, they all loved it to my amazement. As did I.I think you'll be really happy with it.

"We use and believe in stone milling because no machinery has yet been developed that grinds grains into flours, cereals, and meals quite as well as the flint-hard quartz stones used by master millers since early Roman times." ~Bob's Red Mill SiteThe 100 % Stone Ground Whole Wheat Flour is my favorite flour for use in a variety of whole wheat bread recipes. It is all natural and doesn't contain any preservatives. You can use this flour for bread machine baking too and it produces superior results. I've used the recipe on the back of the bag and adapted it by using a mixture of whole wheat and regular bread flour because I didn't have any "gluten" as called for in the recipe. If you substitute 1 ½ cups of regular bread flour for part of the whole wheat flour you don't seem to need the gluten.Bob's Red Mill products remind me of my childhood when my father took me to the Graue Mill in Oakbrook, IL where we watched corn being milled. It is now the only operating waterwheel gristmill in Illinois. While Bob's Red Mill products don't arrive in a cloth bag, the paper bags do have an old fashioned feel and have a string-sewn closure. I love the crinkly sound of the high-quality paper bags.Bob's Red Mill uses slow turning, 100-year-old millstones to naturally grind together the bran, endosperm and germ that contains the nutritious oil. This is a "cool stone grinding process" which preserves nutrients normally lost in high-speed, high-heat milling.This company produces more than 400 products. Look for everything from hot cereals and mixes to flour milled from a wide variety of grains. If you love making natural breads in your bread machine, the flours are superior and produce deliciously nutritious breads.Whole Wheat Oat Rolls1 c. water, warmed to 110°F5 T. fat-free milk powder2 T. clover honey2 T. salted butter, melted2 1/2 tsp. active dry yeast1 lg. egg2 c. bread flour1 c. Bob's Red Mill whole-wheat flour1/2 c. Bob's Red Mill thick-rolled oats2 T. wheat germ1 1/2 tsp. saltMelted butterOatsThe dough may be made in a bread machine or by hand. Bread machine method: Place the water, milk powder, honey, melted butter, yeast, egg, breadflour, whole-wheat flour, oats, wheat germ and salt into a bread machine pan. Set bread machine for whole wheat, dough and large loaf cycle. Form rolls.Hand method: In a large bowl, whisk the water, milk powder, honey, melted butter, yeast and egg. In an extra large bowl, mix the flour, whole wheat flour,oats, wheat germ and salt. Stir in the yeast mixture.Place dough on a well-floured breadboard. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, turn once, then cover with a damp cloth. Turn oven on to 200°F, when you can feel the heat on your hand, turn the oven off. Place bowl in the warm oven and let the dough rise until double.Punch the dough down and cut into 16 pieces. Form rolls then brush with melted butter. Sprinkle the tops of the rolls with the oats. Let rise for 45 minutes or until double then bake in a preheated 400°F oven 10-15 minutes or until lightly browned.Makes 16 rolls~The Rebecca Review

column9: Recommended by Tim Ferris, I second it!
column10: I read about this in the Four Hour Body by Tim Ferriss, and though I doubted nut oil could be a winner with my salmon & scrambled eggs (I don't eat them together), he was right. This is great. Not only does it work great with eggs (as I already mentioned), the salmon doesn't stick to the pan!Go for it. Good stuff!

column9: Great macademia nut oil -- the real deal
column10: This really is Macademia nut oil -- the reviewer who says it isn't is mistaken. Mild nutty taste and high smoke point make this a great replacement for canola oil when stir frying and other high temperature cooking requirements.

I use this as my stir fry oil.  It appears to be healthy.  I have been using it regularly several times a week to enjoy stir fry.  I have been on a weight loss life style for about 15 months.  I have lost about 68 pounds and between this and coconut oil I eat fried food averaging about 1.5 times a day.  I have gotten off all my meds except Warfarin and my blood work came back last week mid normal range normal.  for 20 years before this I had tried to avoid fried food.  I was on blood pressure and cholesterol meds and things were getting worse instead of better.  Macadamia nut oil and Coconut oil have worked better than olive oil for me.  It's not cheap but it works for me. I am also eating more and walking 5-7 miles at least 5 days a week and I eat several pounds of black beans a week along with lots of lean pork, beef, mixed vegetables and salad from my garden.  The salad (and 2 past DVT's before this lifestyle) are the main reason I'm on warfarin.

Read about this being a great healthy and tasty alternative to olive oil. Tastes more buttery than most oils while maintaining a very healthy balance of unsaturated fats. Great tasting and healthy, high quality for a great price. Recommend to any chefs out there.

This oil was okay. I thought it would have a more buttery taste but it didn't. It was fresh, so that was good, but I expected it to be more flavorful. Perhaps I'll try a different brand of macadamia oil but for now I'd pick the Roland grapeseed oil over this or some Nutiva coconut oil, or maybe some peanut oil that hasn't been refined too much.
The product is good. This is cheaper than I can get at the grocery store. Macadamia nut oil has a slightly sweet tinge to it and a high smoke point. I use it for pancakes and pizza dough mostly.

From the front of the package (and the only image shown), you'd think it was 100% macadamia nut oil, but it's actually olive oil "flavored" with macadamia nut extract when you read the back of the package. So if you're looking for any of the health benefits or the high cooking temp of the real thing, look elsewhere.

Really hard to chew at first.  You need about 2 pieces to feel like a stick of gum and it doesn't even taste like spearmint.  I know there's not a high demand for this kind of gum, but for the price I expected better.

column9: Simply the best we have had.
column10: We started buying Lavazza's blue caps a few months ago and have not looked back.  It's perfect every time, no change every time ya make it.  Intense taste with a nice high toned aroma.  I know I should not be but some days I find myself making 5-6 cups!
Not a strong flavor. I didn't like it because it was very weak in flavor. Do not buy this product!

column9: Nice smooth choice - Lavazza Blue Dolce
column10: This Lavazza Blue espresso flavor has a nice smooth flavor with a long-lasting crema.  It is my son's favorite for making cappuccino.  You cannot beat the Lavazza Blue system for espresso. A perfect cup every time with no fuss! The sealed capsules guarantee a fresh result everytime.

I rec'd the package today! Not only did it come quickly, they sent me 6 containers instead of 3.  Not going to complain!!  This sugar is so good!  It has an almost brown sugar scent and taste, nothing like store garbage sugar.  I will be infusing it with vanilla beans and botteling it as wedding favors for my guests.  They are going to love it!!!

column9: Um Um Good Great Tasting Sugar
column10: Florida Crystals is the best tasting sugar I have ever had.  I was looking for a natural, less processed, and great tasting sugar for canning and I found it.  Also great in coffee.

column9: Great Product, but overpriced on this site
column10: I have been using this product for over a year now and it works for our family very well. However, I noticed that the priced listed here is well beyond what I pay for it at my local supermarket. I can get the same volume listed for $15. Just thought I'd let you all know.

I have issues with most artificial sweeteners causing headaches and stomach problems. I'm not a fan of high fructose corn syrup either. So I'm back to natural cane sugar for sweetening things. I like the plastic storage container this sugar is stored in compared to the cellophane bags each pound in wrapped in by a competitor. However I'm not sure the plastic is the healthiest method.This cane sugar on sale usually is a cost effective option at around fourteen bucks but still more expensive than plain old granulated sugar at the local store some of which is cane or beet sugar. I'm not sure if my sugar-gobbling kids were always at home I'd be buying this... 10 pounds every two weeks with them vs 10 pounds a year for me. Although most times I drink my teas and coffees without sugar, when I do crave something sweet adding a spoonful or two hits the spot and seems to last forever. Just do your comparison shopping as there are some WILD price ranges.

I am so glad that I have found Taste of the Wild. This dog food is made by Diamond, which is a well know, good quality dog food. Taste fo the Wild is a grain free formula for all life stages. I've been trying for a year now to find a good quality dog food that won't break my bank. I tried Nutro Max, Nutro Ultra, Nature's Recipe, and even the highly claimed Canidea (which he did not do well on at all). I found Taste of the Wild (among other high quality foods) at a local feed store. I placed 5 different high quality dog foods down, and even his current dog food, to see which one he would go to first. He went to the Taste of the Wild first and went between this and another brand. What really got me was that my parents' very picky pomeranian went straight for this food, and ate it without wet food on it!So I brought Taste of the Wild home and have been switching it, slowly, over. PLEASE make sure when you switch your pet's food you mix it slowly and gradually over time or else your pet may get an upset stomach.Overall he's doing much better. His coat is shiner, he has more energy, and he gobbles up the food. Taste of the Wild costs about as much as some name brand foods at Petsmart and is a much better quality food. Email them and they will send you samples so you can have your dog try it.

We've been feeding Taste of the Wild (TOTW) to our puppy for 6 months. He is thriving on it. We have tried the Salmon and Lamb with tons of success but the Fowl was a little too high in protein for his young body and gave him some loose stool. While we haven't tried the Bison, I would assume that would be the case as well since they're similar in their guaranteed analysis. If you're shopping for a younger dog, I'd stick with the Lamb or Salmon formulas for now. All of the formulas are all life stage (ALS) foods so they can be fed from weaning puppy to senior pet. I can do nothing but sing this food's high praises. Not only does my dog LOVE this food, but it is affordable, grain-free, and has good ingredients. I have yet to buy this food on Amazon.... I just don't understand the extreme mark up on the Lamb formula ($58). It is available locally at many pet food stores and at Tractor Supply (on sale usually for $37.99, best price that I've seen!) If you're looking for a new food, this is one that you should definitely try.

column9: Great single protein dry dog food
column10: My dog has alergies to some proteins (chicken and beef) and for the past year, I have been trying different brands of food with single proteins.  During that time, I tried her on the TW Salmon, and she ate a bag or two and quit.  I did notice, however, that when she was on the TW food, her stools were perfect and her coat was like velvet, so I was sorry she stopped eating it.  Last month, I went into the pet store and was so happy to see this new single protein flavor from TW.  We are on our 3rd bag of TW Lamb, and she loves it.  Had her bloodwork done last week and the vet said it was beautiful.  Thank you TW for a great product, and finally one that has a single protein.  I wish you would do the same with the venison so she could have some variety.

Exceptional noticeable results! Have used Taste of the Wild Lamb for 4 weeks. All six dogs(an Aussie, Standard Poodle, Minature Poodles, and Chinese Cresteds) have experienced improved teeth/gums, coat/skin, digestion, alertness and energy.  The 'quality' dry food(s) used prior are no match for the improved quality of life for my animals! An Aussie breeder introduced the food to me but I was unable to locate it locally.  I ordered the first bag online and my local feed store now carries it. Our pets depend on us to provide their quality of life/health. I thought I was doing that until I tried Taste of the Wild Lamb.  Intend to try their cat food on my Sphynx cats to see if the same results improve their life.  This is the first time I have ever experienced such a noticeable difference in dry food and seen such results. Thank you Carol of Lorac Aussies! We would have never known the difference had you not introduced us to Taste of the Wild! Truly an exceptional quality product!

column9: Still Too Much Fat, But Less Than Some Flavors...
column10: Tried this, recently, (in all dry flavors) for my German Shepherd Dog. At first, he wouldn't touch it, but after about a week, he decided he absolutely loves it. The biggest problem is within the first month, he had gained 3 pounds, even though he was eating less than the recommended amount and less than he was previously used to eating. Also, he had soft, oily looking stools while eating this. He is an active, very healthy, well-exercised, older dog. He did seem to be more "chipper" and health-wise, he seemed to do fine, except for the softer stools and weight gain, but reluctantly, we had to stop feeding this, exclusively, as we were feeding less and less and he was still gaining weight AND seemed hungry all the time, looking for any other food to eat. Since he loves the taste so much, we have decided to give him only a cup or so a day, in his Kong, with his other food or as training treats and have switched him to another food. I'm not sure I agree with the "good for all life stages" philosophy either. In the old days, that was what one did, but now that we know much more about nutrition, I believe that different life stages do require different nutrient levels. Much as humans do. Sadly, for our dog, this can not be the only food he eats, but it will remain a part of his daily diet, since he loves it and did well, except for the fat content. Nice to have a new flavor for variety.  Hope this helps!

With the past 17 years of owning dogs I have gone through several types of dog foods for all my dogs. I currently have a 10 year old Labrador Retriever and a 4 Year old Bloodhound, both females. Mia (our bloodhound) has always had big problems with yeast infections in her ears due to allergies. We have tried 4 different foods for her trying to get rid of her problems. One of these foods was Blue Buffalo grain free duck flavor dog food, she still had her ear infections and her coat was quite greasy and off came a white residue and her stool was runny after about a month on the food straight when it was not mixed with her other food. So it wasn't helping at all, only making it worse. But then I heard about TOTW and I saw it was grain free and we went and got a small bag to try  it out. Figuring out later she loves this flavor best and less calories without the fish. It's now been a 1 1/2 year/s and those $100 yeast infections in her ears are nearly gone. We haven't been to the vet for that in so long. It's an excellent food that keeps both of my dogs healthy. My 10 year old lab tends to gain weight more but she is as healthy as she ever has been and active. I strongly recommend this brand of dog food. I'm very impressed about the outcome that is has on my very active dogs. Keeps them a healthy weight.

column9: Found this through a local pet store
column10: I was getting Authority Lamb through Petsmart online because I moved and there isn't one near me.  It wasn't cheap with the shipping and not so cheap even without, but my 20 pound shelter dog was doing well on it, so.... Well, I ordered two bags of Authority, one a few months ago and one recently, both came poooorly packaged and were battered and I got a refund on shipping.  BUT this last batch had BUGS in it!  I didn't notice at first, must have been larvae, but opened up my dog's vittles vault today (only put in there about a week ago) and see bugs crawling in it and the vittles vault had been securely closed. (but as the bag and box got here battered, I'm sure it was a bug buffet before even reaching me).  Needless to say, didn't want to feed to my dog and found a pet store open near me on a Sunday and they recommended this brand (my dog has a bit of a sensitive tummy and does best on lamb).  He loves it!  AND it's really quite comparable in price AND packaged so much better than Authority.  It also has a much sturdier bag to keep nasty things out until I can get it home and put in a vittles vault.  This will be my dog's dry food from now on.

I am sorry to hear that TOW gave your dog such severe problems but I must add my own view to the mix because my dog has been on this brand for two years now with no difficulty at all.  My 100 lb Labrador has an allergy to grain and does just fine on this food and likes all varieties of it.

I came across this at tractor supply originally and looked it up on dogfoodanalysis.com.  It's rated very well and so I decided to pull the trigger.  The food smells like most kibble.  The pieces are small, so you could feed it to a small dog or a big dog.  My dogs absolutely love it.  Their coats have become so soft since we switched them on this food.  They don't poop a whole lot compared to cheaper foods because there is less filler and more nutrition.  I highly recommend this food as the dogs love the taste, it's good for them and their health and coats have greatly improved since switching them to it.
G'Day, we have been using this food taste of the wild for over a year now and our Catahola hound Bodie Dog is doing great with it,with far less body waste a good sign.Cheers Joseph

column9: Don't know why I ever stopped feeding this.
column10: We started feeding the Taste of the Wild Salmon formula to my dog when she was a puppy. For some reason, she wouldn't eat it anymore so we began our long (about 8 months) journey to find the perfect dog food for her. We finally found Canidae and while it's a good quality food, she started having digestive problems with it because of the grains or because there were too many proteins, I'm not sure. She had disgusting yellow, mushy poop that was impossible to even pick up. Finally, I felt too bad for her to even continue feeding the rest of the bag, so I went back to Taste of the Wild. This was definitely the best decision. Literally after two feedings, her poop started looking normal again. I can tell she feels better too. She absolutely LOVES the taste as well. Love this stuff!
My dogs love this food.  I like that it is good for them, not a lot of by-products or a lot of grain.

I've switched back and forth between TOTW, Prairie, and Blue Buffalo for the past sixteen months or so, with an older shepherd mix and now a puppy goldendoodle.  Really, the only reason I've switched is because this brand is still hard to find in some stores and I don't always plan well enough to use Amazon!  I'm very, very pleased with the food because of the ingredients and price-per-kibble.  Very underestimated food.  I do, sometimes, have to mix some wet food in it for a finicky dog, but I can live with that.

column9: Another Successful Launch of a Great New Dog Food Product
column10: Both my two Shiba Inu pups and my older Shiba Inu can't get enough of the wonderfulnew roasted lamb. As a result all three dogs are simply thriving in good health and alohain Hawaii.

column9: Not a favorite at our doghouse
column10: I purchased Taste of the Wild with roasted lamb along with two other Taste of the Wild flavors as a variety treat for my two dogs (51 and 75 lbs). Used solo, the food set in the dish for a couple of days until I mixed it with another brand (C&P). I then started filling their dishes with half and half and noticed that they would always eat the other brand first and then finally come back and eat the ToW lamb as a last resort.We have not tried the other two ToW flavors yet, but hopefully, they will like them better.

column9: This Has Cost Me $437. At The Vet In Less Than 2 Months
column10: I changed my dog from "California Natural Lamb & Rice" to this because the California Natural caused him such constipation and weight gain. I have made a gradual transition in foods, and over 2 months have only gotton him to 60% 'Sierra Mountain Taste of the Wild' because he has developed such severe bloody diarrhea that has landed him in doggie hospital 3 times in the last 6 weeks. The vet kept wanting to put him back on Science Diet, but I had taken him off of that corn based dogfood in the first place because it destroyed the health of my dogs, with all of them having developed very early serious health issues. And, their eyes were dull and dead looking long before they even developed cataracts, so I certainly do not want him back on that stuff.I must say that 'Sierra Mountain Taste of the Wild' has given my dog bright shiny eyes and his lab testing (according to the vet) is some of the best she has ever seen - EXCEPT  THAT suddenly he has quite advanced kidney disease, and he has  again developed very thin hair (as he had on Science Diet) and to boot has had the severe intestinal issues  from the 'Sierra Mountain Taste of the Wild'.It has reached the point that it has entered the picture of putting my dog down because he was so ill and in misery for so long. The vet has looked at numerous issues that could cause his rectal bleeding (both with normal stools and with his very frequent severe diarrhea), but the only thing that comes up is that it has to be a food issue.I am going to quickly transition him back to the "California Natural" and get him off of this before he dies from being on `Sierra Mountain Taste of the Wild`. Then I will do some research of what food I can put him on / or mix with the "California Natural" so that he doesn't have the weight gain and constipation that food caused. But, even if he has constipation and weight gain it sure beats the absolute misery he is going through with 'Sierra Mountain Taste of the Wild'. This stuff has been a disaster for his system!UPDATE: I put him straight back on 'California Natural', and within a day or so his bowel issues completely cleared up, and have not returned. So it (was) the 'Sierra Mountain Taste of the Wild' dogfood that caused his problems.I initially thought it cost me about $250. in the past 6 weeks, but I got a tally of all the bills from the vet, and it actually cost me $437.

Looked everywhere and couldnt find the food In my home town, finally decided to look on line luckly.found it on amazon.com, my picky dog Corona, loves this foods, n shes more active,coats is shinner, n beter for here digestive system. After going though many bags n brands, finally found the keeper, only dowbad thing was when I arrived home the box rapping n the bad was ripped n ants were starting to get in, overall 4stars Coron(blue-healer) approvrd.

I've ordered and reordered these.  They're dried banana chips, and that's what they look like and taste like.  I'm puzzled by the bad reviews.  I eat them for snacks, and mix them in with my muffin batter, too.  If you don't like dried bananas, you won't like these, but there's nothing remarkably unpleasant about them that I could see.  I hope Amazon continues to stock these!  I think they're fine!

I purchased these because the website states that they are made from 100% Bananas and Honey.  Read the fine print and you will find that they also contain added sugar, banana flavoring and coconut oil.  They don't even taste like bananas....with all the added ingredients, what can you expect?
No one liked them. they had an aftertaste and were too hard to eat.

labeling says one serving has 11 grams of fat but less than one gram saturated. since most of the fat comes from coconut oil the saturated fat should be quite high like in comparable banana chip products. i called them and emailed them about this. they said they'd get back to me but never did. i  love their banana chips but the labeling is definitely incorrect about the saturated fat content.

This snack is scrumptious beyond words!!! But it deserves words,so here I am reviewing it. All the different flavors of Snyder's of Hanover Pretzel Bits are good, but this one, the Honey Mustard and Onion flavor is my favorite--and it's one that you should definitely try at least once in your life if you haven't before.These pretzel bits are, after probably healthier than potato chips--the only remotely negative about it, is that they're so tasty it's hard to stop eating them! I find it's good to divide the 10 oz. snack into zip loc bags--otherwise, the whole bag might as well be one serving.Make sure you try out these pretzel bits!!

I liked these pretzels, but some may say that they do not have enough flavor. My roommate says that they just taste like pretzels.I like that the taste is not overwhelming, but I guess it's not for people that like snacks with really strong flavors (like Doritos).

I purchased this product from Amazon on a regular basis. My husband and yes, my dog love them as do i. THis past case i ordered however came with an expiration date of a month out. This is my only complaint with this product..if you order a case it should have a longer expiration date than one month out. They are usually very fresh and come delivered in good condition and the price is good as well.

column9: I agree I could eat em all day though
column10: I love these things they have a perfect flavor. I wish I could just eat these and eat em all day long!!!!!!!!!!

I buy these as often as I can at my supermarket, as they usually sell out ridiculously fast. If SoH sold the honey mustard they coated these pretzels in, they'd make so much money they wouldn't know what to do with it. These honey mustard pretzels are really that good. My only problem is that once I open the bag, all the pretzels are gone (I inhale them). Damn them for being so tasty!And finding them on Amazon is a steal, as these sell for $3 plus; you can just subscribe and save, and then oh-so-slyly, unsubscribe. You save $9 doing this, rather than buying 12 of these at $3 a pop at the supermarket. That makes this snack all the more satisfying. <3

This is a great-low fat snack that I eat between lunch and dinner almost every day. It has a good flavor and fills me up after just a few pieces. Buying them in bulk like this has saved me a lot of money versus buying them one or two at a time from the grocery store, and the free shipping to my door is a wonderful perk.I do wish there was a little more seasoning on the pretzels, something between these nibblers and the "pieces" would be my ideal amount of seasoning, but that would add to the fat content. Other than that, I don't have any complaints.

column9: As good as factory pretzels get
column10: There's no way to package soft "street" pretzels in a bag you keep on the shelf(though they do come frozen).  For handy salty snacks, the factories have made so-called "hard pretzels" for decades, and these are the best.  The proper blend of sweet and salt, blandness and tart, they hit the spot.  As a snack, their only handicaps are that they are very hard(only original teeth please), and they are very salty(they deliver a "wallop" of saltiness that potato chips just don't, due to the fact that their salt is on the surface and concentrated in large salt grains.)  But if you like old timey pretzels like they used to sell in the general store or your local bar, these are for you.
This seller i highly recommed. Have purchased from them twice now and each time they arrive in great condition and are super fresh. Good buy..great product.
love these bite sized pretzels.  can't find them in the stores in northern michigan.  thanks goodness for amazon.
I'm not a big pretzel eater, but I love this little bitesize nibblers.  I like the low fat snack and how it fills you up.
My better half and I are totally addicted to these things. We like to eat them while watching movies or anytime we're hungry for a low-fat snack. Highly recommended.

column9: Love the taste, but they break off your teeth!
column10: That said, they are the best tasting things around so if you love a hard, cruchy pretzel, this is your brand!  They just taste superb but they really play havoc on my teeth so I really cannot eat them.  Or, just soak them in a glass of Coke like the children do and well, you get two treats in one!  Highly recommend!

Snyder's of Hanover Pretzels are great!But, when I received these they were almost out of date.Since I ordered a fair size supply, most expired and were stale before we ate them.Our goats and wild birds had a feast though!

column9: Peanut Butter and Jelly Filled Rawhide Bone-AWESOME!!!
column10: I have 2 Shih Tzus and they are the pickiest dogs on the planet when it comes to treats and bones.  I found these and WOW!  They FIGHT over them!!!  They LOVE the filling and actually dig it out and eat it first (somehow) and THEN eat the rawhide!  They carry them everywhere, even to bed, and one just likes to hold it in her mouth forever until she is ready to eat it.  I would recommend this Bone to anyone!
I can't stop eating these things.  They're awesome.  I get them at a local candy store called Rocket Fizz.  A lot of root beer barrels can be too spicy or weird tasting.  These are perfect.

Great flavoring for any dish.Lots of compliments on the flavor when used in cooking.Good to throw in when you do not know what else to use or do not have much on hand.Originally bought it in New Orleans and could not find it locally.

Great like cakes from Ferrero, I grow up eating those and every time I go in Italy I find the fridge full of them, thanks to my mom.... the shipping was fine, perfect condition, not melted, a little expensive but hopefully if people like me keep and buying them the price eventually will go down.For the people they never tried Fiestas , you need at least once, there is nothing like them in the States and they are very addicting because of the liquor cake inside...
These cakes have a flavor not available in the USA.  I believe it is from the chocolate alcohol.  Reason for the 3 stars is that it is overpriced; but, it is a must try product.
They are delicious, used to eat them when I was a kid living in Italy. They are so tasty and moist, ordered 2 cases. Will reorder again and again.

column9: Good Product but too high of a price!
column10: I love these orange cakes but I think they're overpriced. We can always get away with Nutella instead ... Maybe if more people buy it they could drive the price down.

Ok, to be fair, I bought this at the store, but I suppose that doesn't matter in the long run. See, I ran out of the water enhancer that I normally use and happened to see this close by. It was cheaper than the generic mio I was going to buy, so I figured what the hey and bought it.Instead of mixing a packet in a 16.9 oz bottle, I mix it in a 1 ltr bottle. Two in my bottle made it almost taste like peach-mango juice. I find 1 per 1 ltr bottle works well enough to cover the "flavor" of the water. I also happen to like that it's fortified with vitamins AND caffeine.

I purchase the strawberry version of the Crystal Light Energy line usually, but decided to give peach mango a try.  It was very good!  I drink this stuff everyday, and having a different flavor was an excellent change.  120 mg of caffeine per packet, and all the water you can drink.  No more of that canned energy crap for me!

I was hesitant to try this because it has aspartame and I don't usually care for any drink that contains it. The idea of caffeine lured me to try it. I'm glad I did! I don't taste the artificial sweetener at all. The caffeine is a bonus for anyone trying to cut coffee or soda from their diet. It also contains B12. This is a very sweet drink, almost juice like. I added a packet to a 16 oz. bottle of water. Definitely will buy more this!

I use the Peach/Mango in a vanilla protein drink.  Add crushed ice and you think you're drinking a dreamy, rich ice-cream drink.  The peach/mango flavor is a refreshing way to perk up a morning or afternoon snack.  Try it... you'll love it!!

Say goodbye to coffee.  Crystal Light Energy has just the right amount of caffiene.  It is portable, easy to use (just add water) and it tastes delicious and refreshing.  No queasy feeling from acidic coffee.  I highly recommend this product.
The chocolate drops are an excellent product and we always look so forward to their arrival. I have noticed that they do not stay long.........

column9: Great cookies at an amazing price !
column10: I love these cookies. I have not been able to find them since I moved here. They are the perfect size for a quick snack or in my case ~ breakfast. They are very fresh. I am not an expiration date decoder but I know freshness when I taste it. They are not too sweet which is something that ruins perfectly cookies in my opinion. As good as the strawberry are, the boysenberry are even better. At $ .37 a package this is a heck of a deal. The boysenberry as a few dollars more but well worth it. Especially for Prime members. I used to buy these for $1 from the work vending machine in 1999.

I love these cookies, but I am very disappointed at Amazon. I bought 2oz package (Pack of 32) and chose Two-Day Shipping. When I got the cookies I found out the expiration date is coming soon. Only "23 days" left. The label is AB091910. If my understanding of expiration date is correct. Can Amazon sell food to people like this??  I even have no right to return it. Very disappointed!!

I had ordered the cookies to be served at an office meeting. Had I known there were 8 cookies in a 2-ounce package, I would have ordered less.  But I'm not really complaining because the extras, I get to share with team members who did not make the meeting.[My best-guess --- the expire-date on this shipment is December 2011.]

column9: Another great product from Knott's BF
column10: I ordered the Boysenberry Shortbread cookies from here.  And I've tried to raspberry from my local grocery store, but they stopped carrying them.  Both were awesome.  They are small, so they make for a great light snack.  The shortbread is perfect to me; it isn't overly sweet or overly buttery.  The only thing I wish Knott's would change, would be the amount of the fruit center.  I know the cookie is small, but I think if the fruit center were larger, it would balance out the cookie nicer.  Plus, without each cookie being individually wrapped, the shortbread crumbles & sticks right to the fruit center, so it covers up the taste even more.  To me that would make it perfect, but as is I'd still highly recommend these to anyone.
Love these cookies. Perfect 3 oz size bags at a great price. I just wish the boysenberry and blueberry varieties were also available in this size.

Qudos to Amazon once again. I have been unable to find these little gems on any grocers shelf in the southeast US. Now, with one click of the button, they can be delivered to my front door. Happiness reigns!

This is a really neat addition to my cutout cookies.  Makes the snowflakes and stars look really good.  Adds nice color to a plate of Christmas cookies.  I enjoyed using it.  Absolutely no problem with purchace.  Excellent!!!
Got this for my parents for Christmas. They love it thus far! Definitely the economical solution for Christmas this year and will buy again in the future.

The Peanut Chews brought back memories of my favorite candy. The quality is the same and the taste is as I remembered. The only disapointment was that the item did not come in the original wrapper.
