The price was very reasonable and was delivered quickly by Amazon and in perfect condition. Thanks for the memories!

I reviewed this product in regards to delivery and packaging but we just tasted it tonight at dinner.  It is fabulous!  A smooth yet tangy cheese.  Perfect with a glass of wine and some figs or in pasta with pesto.  Unbelievably good and I will be ordering it again!  Yum!
This is the BEST Feta I have ever eaten, in fact I can't stop eating it!  It's just the right amount of salty, creamy and tangy. Love, LOVE, LOVE it!

I like this cheese to make open faced tomato sandwich when they're in season. Lighter than most, not as salty. Toast the french bread, use unsalted butter, and a fresh, never refrigerated tomato straight from the garden, still warm from the summer sun, and a nice-sized hunk of this cheese.You will be in taste bud heaven.The point is, you get the tangy feta taste without a huge overload of salt. If you want to go wild, add BACON!!!1111!!! It won't be too salty, like an ordinary tomato-feta sammich.Thank me later.
I like cream cheese but it is too heavy. This Valbreso feta cheese tastes great though. It is not heavy. I tried it in Salad, with toast for breakfast, with Pita bread. They all taste good.

You can count on Valbreso to be always creamy and a bit less salty than other fetas.  Reliably wonderful!  Good for when one has guests who dislike very strong flavors.  And the goat is a very cute goat!

If you are looking for a protein fill drink, full of good karma, this is for you.  I love Chai.  If you love Chai, that spicy, sweet goodness in a glass, then you are going to go nuts for this drink.  I like their other flavors, but this one is definitely the best!
I love chai teas.This is a wonderful high protein drink that's so creamy and satisfying and not too sweet. It's keeps me from being hungry in the afternoons when I drink it for lunch.I love it.

All of the CalNaturale Svelte protein drinks are good.  The Cappucino flavor is actually great.  But the chai flavor is absolutely fantastic.  It reminds me of the iced soy chais that I used to buy at Starbucks.  I don't buy them there anymore now that I can drink these instead.  You obviously have to be a fan of the chai flavor - a little spice behind the sweet - but if you are then YUM.  I only knocked off one star because I tried to buy a case of these from Amazon last week and the case was $42 - but only the chai flavor had such an inflated price.  I came back to check this week and it's $30.  It annoys me that there is such wild fluctuation in the price - particularly when just one flavor is affected by it.  It makes no sense.

Well, since some other user decided they'd paste their review on to each flavor allow me to give my short but sweet review:MiO is delicious. I like that I can just put in the tiniest of splashes in my drink and just have a hint of flavor... or splash a lot in and get a real flavorful experience. It's a quick and easy thing to use. It's also fun to watch it splash into the water. I've also found it's good to flavor different types of alcohol.In regards to the criticism by other reviewers for it containing propylene glycol - don't be in a panic like them. propylene glycol is harmless unless ingest massive quantities of it. Using a canard like "it's considered harmful to pets so humans shouldn't ingest it!" is just alarmist behavior. Chocolate is harmful to dogs. Better not eat that then!Lastly, in regards to it having so many "food colorings" - well, if you don't like anything that flavors your water to have anything artificial in it, squeeze a lemon into it. Put a dash of sugar. Or just drink the water plain. You know what you're getting into when you buy this stuff.Bottom line: This is my new favorite drink flavoring. I will be buying from them again and again.

This stuff is great. I'm on a diet that includes superhydration - meaning I drink 5-6 liters of water a day - and anything to make that easier is worth it! Aspartame is a migraine trigger for me so I am always on the lookout for alternative low calorie water flavorings and this truly fits the bill. As for the chemical haters, if you don't want it in your body, don't put it there! I don't believe this is any more dangerous than the preservatives and additives you'd find in a bag of chips. Most things are OK in moderation and if that thing helps you drink more healthy water without a bunch of sugar and caffeine, consider it a blessing. And if you do find out that you have a negative reaction to any of the ingredients, like me to aspartame, just stop using it.Now, on to the review. I've tried this (strawberry watermelon) and the berry pomegranate flavor. This one gets 5 stars on flavor; berry gets 4. Both have a little aftertaste that's kind of sticky sweet and noticeable but not unpleasant. The berry flavor tastes a little grapey to me and it's just a personal preference that I don't like it as much. I bought mine on sale at Target for less than they are listed here, but even for the Amazon price I think they are worth it even if you add more than 1/24th of the bottle to your drink. Consider the powdered drink flavorings that come in single-serve packs and are priced comparably. Less servings, more waste packaging, no customization of flavor intensity. MIO is the clear winner. Five stars on value!My only improvement would be to have less or different dye in the product. I don't care if my drink is hot pink or purple but the first time I used it, I got a couple of drops on my countertop and it left a stain that was a pain in the you-know-what to get out. I'm guessing that it wouldn't come out of clothes, either. Just keep that in mind and be careful.If you're curious about MIO, I would suggest you go to your grocery store, buy one, and try it. If you love it, come here and get a case! It's a neat, novel idea and I hope it sticks around because I'm a big fan.

I love the Mio line. The portable package is sleek and stylish. The concept behind using as much or as little as you like is wonderful and for the most part the flavors are awesome. I don't like this flavor as much as I do some of the others. But taste is subjective and even though I found the flavor to be off, I am still giving this a good review because the idea is a great one.

Don't bother buying this here, it is WAY overpriced.  Stop by Wal-Mart and pay a bit over half what these people are selling the stuff for.Anyway, we have now tried all the flavors.  Like any other flavor, some we like better than others as it is a matter of personal preference... but all of them were good.  We really like all but the Fruit Punch and will cycle through all the other remaining flavors again and again.Kraft Foods are not claiming they have invented a new major food group here, it is water flavoring.  They came through with that just fine.  Unscrew the cap, squirt into the bottle, replace the cap and shake.  Can't get any easier than that.  Using tap water is fine too.As for the guy whining about "chemicals", everything we eat contains "chemicals".  Get over it.

column9: A Suggestion For My Fellow Cheapskates.
column10: A few months ago I picked up a small container of MiO Liquid Water Enhancer. It was a new item and the only one the store had was the Berry Pomegranate Variety. Well, I must say, it enhanced San Diego tap water and gave it a very mild pleasant taste. This time, when I went back, the store had two kinds and I opted to try the Strawberry Watermelon flavor. Maybe I like it a little better. There are a lot of other flavors available online, I should add.This stuff seems to work best when the water is cold and first enhanced by ice. So, I was thinking that I might us it in restaurants. You can always ask for water with your meal and the water always comes with ice and is free. Typically, I ask for water because I don't particularly like most soft drinks and I don't like drinking too many of them. So I just ask for water and then add a little squeeze or the water enhancer to give the water a very slight, almost imperceptible, freshening zest. Well, let's see. There are 24 squirts in one of these little plastic thingies, and I save about $1.50 every time I ask for water, so they pay for themselves in almost instantly. Okay, so I'm a cheapskate and I enjoy it. Plus, and most importantly, I prefer the enhanced water taste over almost any soft drink.Gary Peterson

My son has Type1 Diabetes and must avoid all sugary drinks as they go straight to his bloodstream and send his blood-sugar sky-high. Whenever we go out to eat his only options are plain water or diet coke. He's not partial to either. Now we have more options. The Mio bottle is small enough to fit in my purse, has zero carbs, and he loves the taste. I only give it 4 stars because we haven't tried the other flavors yet.

The strawberry watermelon is absolutely delicious.  I think you can save money going out and putting a squirt in your ice water for 10 cents a serving.  The container does not leak or drip.  I have not tried other flavors yet.  It only costs $3.48 each at Walmart, less than Amazon.

Like many people, I'm off sugar to try to lose weight but aspartame triggers headaches, and I can't stand the taste of plain water so I'm looking for something no-cal to make drinking water tolerable. Mio offers me several choices.This product works fine. (BTW, I have no doubt that the low-star reviews are legit too; people perceive sweetness and flavor differently. I'm just grateful that I taste sucralose as sweet and don't get the aftertaste some people do.) The flavor is clearly artificial but pleasant. Like other Mio flavors, being able to add as much or as little as suits you is a huge advantage. I tend to like a pretty strong flavor. I keep several flavors around to enjoy whatever I feel like on a given day.

I'm on diet that requires drinking 8 glasses of water per day. I couldn't do it without MIO flavor enhancers. With them I can down a glass pretty quickly, whereas I can only take in a smaller amount of plain water at a time. Strawberry Watermelon is my favorite, although Berry Pomegranate is very good too. I love ordering them from Amazon because there's always one or more on hand when I need it and it's easy to see when it's time to order more. Because the containers are opaque, it's easy to run out if you buy them one at a time from a grocery, and not all stores carry them.

After finding out that I cannot have many of the powder drink mixes because some have caffeine in them I discovered MIO.  It is extremely convenient and easy to take with you on the go. Best of all, it is delicious!Yes it does have propylene glycol in it, and one reviewer compares it to anti-freeze used in automobiles.  Non-food grade propylene glycol is what is used in car anti-freeze to protect the environment and animals. I think she may have been thinking of ethylene glycol, which has killed many dogs.  Food grade propylene glycol however is not what you put in your car.  Food grade propylene glycol is found in everything from some skin creams to pet foods and is used as preservative as well as preventing solutions from freezing.  The amount used in MIO is not considered harmful to humans unless you decide to consume a gallon at one sitting.  I've found that just a small squirt is more then sufficient.

I love Mio but I am confused as to why a pack of 4 costs $22 on amazon.com and people are buying it.  They are $3.65 each at my local Target store.  That would mean that it costs just under $15 for me to go and buy four.  Why are people ordering it online?  Unless I am missing something and you really get more than 4 individual bottles.

column9: Great idea. Great Taste. Great Value.
column10: The gist of MiO is that it's a concentrated syrup you add to water to give it flavor. It's zero calories (with no aspertine) and zero carbs so what you get for that extra flavor is essentially the same things you get from water. That also means MiO contains no nutrients or vitamins either. So don't expect it to replace your sports drink if that's what you are looking for. Another thing to note is MiO is almost made entirely of artificial ingredients, so don't consider this drink some all natural alternative like some other flavored water out there. What you do get is a way to enjoy a no calorie drink that ends up costing a lot less than the standard alternatives to sodas.The Strawberry Watermelon flavr is so far my favorite. It's just enough sweet from the strawberry while giving that refreshing feeling from the watermelon all at the same time. Even a tiny bit of this with just a tiny, tiny hint of flavor in my water makes it better.One of the selling points of MiO is you get to choose how concentrated you want your drink to be. Just one quick squirt can give you a glass loaded to the gills with flavor. As other reviewers have said it doesn't take long to figure out how much you need for your own tastes. Me? I like my drinks a bit light. Before I started using MiO I was getting 32 oz. bottles of G2 because it was a low calorie alternative to the regular Gatorade with a lighter flavor. It was also a pretty good deal at an average price of $.99 per bottle. So far my litle MiO bottle blows that away when it comes to value. Two to three good squirts will fill up a 32 oz. bottle, and so far I have been able to fill that bottle six to seven times easy (likely more as I stopped counting after that). In comparing price with the Gatorade poduct I'm definitely saving money. If you are into those 20 oz. bottles of Sobe or Vitamin Water (sold around here at a dollar a bottle on average) then you are definitely getting a good deal.MiO is a great way to enjoy your water without adding calories to your intake. It's also a better deal in the long run with you being able to save up to 50% or more in costs. Not to mention this flavor is a nice and refreshing way to enjoy your water.
We were not able to find this flavor in any of the grocery stores where we live and loved the flavor.

My review is not regarding after taste or the ingrediants as some people have complained about.I am strickly talking about the strawberry watermelon flavor.  out of a few flavors i've bought i would say this is my least favorite.... I would not recommend this flavor.thanks

I don't like to fly in the face of so many positive reviews; clearly there are many people who like this product.While I get absolutely zero aftertaste from so many artificially sweetened products (Dr Pepper 10 and Coke Zero being my favorites), MiO leaves an aftertaste that reminds me of the sweeteners of many years ago.The fruit flavors are very good, but the aftertaste ruins it.  Your mileage may vary...I give this two stars instead of one because I really appreciate the idea of a liquid flavor-to-taste product.

column9: My name is Jeff and I am a MiO Addict!!!!
column10: People always look at me weird when I say I DONT like the taste of water.  Unless I am working out or doing some physical task, it is NOT a good flavor for me, and when I just try to sit down and drink it, I HATE IT!!  This caused me to drink a LOT of gatorade, sodas, juices, and other calorie filled drinks.  And considering I could go through as many as 12 cans of soda a day, I KNEW this was a problem.I tried crystal light, fruit2O, propel, and a BUNCH of other products that are supposed to make water taste better, and they ALL disappointed me, and I was right back to where I started.I saw a commercial and thought I would give it a shot.  Started with fruit punch and was BLOWN AWAY!!!  So I went and tried all of the other flavors, and EACH has been good.  I am not a tea drinker, so sweet tea and peach tea do not appeal to me.  But Orange Tangerine, Mango Peach, Berry Pomegranate, Strawberry Watermelon, and even the energy flavors Black Cherry and Green Thunder all have me drinking water by the gallon!!!!I only have ONE problem.  I brought 8 of them to work (I work on offshore drilling rigs).  I decided to let my coworkers try them, and NOW I have them addicted too!!  In 7 days, all 8 are now empty, and we are all DYING for some more!!!I definitely suggest trying this product!  You can use a little, a lot, or just add until you find the taste you like.  I really think you will NOT be disappointed!!!

Don't buy this from Amazon, it's WAY expensive! Get it $3 per bottle at your grocery store--any more than that and it's a rip off.However, this is delicious. I've been looking a long time for cheap water flavoring packs, and this is exactly what I've wanted.It also helps me that it comes in a liquid because I enjoy light flavors in my water, and it's a pain to keep half-used flavor powder packets around. And what a mess if you bump it! But this let's me choose how much I want and safely store the rest.
I gave up drinking soda and now all I drink is water and I use the Mio Strawberry Watermelon. I am always hydrated and feeling better.

love it bought one botel at my local market and it is kindof expensive for such a small amount but teasted great with just one squze for a just a hint or alot makest it almost tast like punch cant wate to try the other flavors and maybe this will help me drink more water than coke

I have grown to hate soda because it's awful for you and it tastes dreadful after you have avoided it for a while. I have been on a water only regimen for a 2 year period to lose weight but every now and again something fruity is in order. This stuff is great whether you want a small hint or a blast of strawberry. Put some in Pellegrino and it's almost like strawberry soda only better for you. I have it stockpiled at home and at work because it's really tasty and you never know when they are going to discontinue something.  It's my new favorite thing to have around!
This stuff is really good, but you don't need a lot. I put in too much, and it was too fruity. It tasted OK. Only add a few drops, or it will taste too fruity. Otherwise, two thumbs up!

I really like Mio. I can add just a little to my water and make a great drink. I don't like super sugary drinks that are the norm in the US, and Mio has no sugar. So this fits perfectly with my lifestyle. And, it's much cheaper than buying pre-made drinks like Sobe.This is a great product which I hope stays around for many years. I hope they come out with some new flavors, like Cherry, my favorite flavor.
I love Mio! No after taste and love the bottle and liquid method for dispensing. No more powders and trying to get them open and then having to throw the packet away.

So, I just tried one of these out.  It's not overly sweet (depending on how much you add to the water, of course), but it doesn't have that grainy overly sugary taste or the "splenda" fake sugar taste some drink mixes have out there.  It's very easy to squirt just a little bit of the mixture into water and try out different amounts.  Squirt, shake the bottle, sip.  Repeat if wanted.The only problem that I really have is the price.  I'm looking at the price tag for just the Strawberry Watermelon as 23.50 for a 4-pack.  This may not be what it costs on average in a grocery store, but I currently do not have any grocery store available to me at the moment (deployed).  That's almost 6 dollars for a single bottle.  Now...  It may be *worth* that much, but I'm not necessarily going to pay that much for it.  Maybe if a bottle this size was 1.50-2.50 I might be considerably more inclined to buy these commonly.All in all, I think they're fantastic.  Tastes good.  Very compact and pocket size bottle for what it provides.  Feels sturdy so this could be a potential plus if you engage in semi-rigorous activity (i.e. biking, running, etc) and it's healthy (at least, as far as I can tell from first glance).5-Stars, minus one only because of the price tag being substantially out of the range I would be comfortable with spending on a product like this.

Really love Mio :)So far all the flavors have tasted really good, like the control of how strong your drink is, mixing the flavors and ect...But the biggest thing I love about Mio, is my family was drinking way to much soda..and this product replaced the soda and the 10 year old batted and soda freak hubby didnt complain.Buy it, and give it a try.(just Not from amazon right now..they really need to fix that price these are running 2.50 to 3.50 in the stores)

Mio's are great for adding true flavor to bottled water or just water in a glass.  What I like most about them is the flavor.  I've bought other zero calorie mixers before but they all had that synthetic taste, you can tell they are zero calorie/zero sugar.  I don't get that with these.  They are very handy too, you can take them with you along trips, in a back pack, camping etc and they do not leak.  I leave one by my sink downstairs to flavor the water directly from the tap and I've taken some on long trips.  It's a great way to save money and get yourself to drink more water.Some useful hints:-Squeeze the drops into a glass first, then add water.  The flavor disperses a lot better that way.  If you go opposite you'll need to use a spoon to stir it.-For water bottles that are filed to the top you should drip a few sips to make room for the added drops and room for the water to be shaken in the bottle.-The prices here seem to vary alot, ever between flavors.  I got a four pack here of Strawberry Watermelon for 12.38, with super saving shipping, but I haven't seen a deal that good since.  At most grocery stores they are $3.99 each, at Walmart $3.49

Love the taste, but a 'squeeze' is hard to measure. A quick squeeze, a full squeeze, a short squeeze, a long squeeze?I bought MiO to flavor the occasional water bottle while hiking. I'm glad I tried it at home first. The directions state one 'squeeze' ( ½ teaspoon) per 8 oz. Even if you can perfect your ½ teaspoon squeeze (or carry a ½ teaspoon with you), another size glass or bottle adds difficulty. I use the little-squeeze-then-taste method, adding more little squeezes and sips until I have the perfect taste. I sure would prefer a less trial-and-error approach, but this method works for any quantity of water where the pre-measured powder packets don't.Once you perfect the amount of MiO to add to your water, it does taste great. I actually like having the water colored so I know which water bottle is flavored and which isn't.The label recommends use within one month of opening, which may be a few too many servings (24) of one flavor for an individual, but great for sharing with family or others. For my hiking and other more solitary uses, I'll go with the longer shelf life of individual serving powdered mixes for variety.

I just bought some Strawberry Watermelon MiO yesterday and I really like it. It's got a good taste to it and unlike most of the powdered brands I've tried, it dissolves in your water perfectly so you don't experience that unpleasant grainy consistency.It's also nice being able to put in as much as I want to suit my tastes.

We came across these at our local grocery store. We grabbed a bottle of the fruit punch and tried it and before long we have tried every flavor! Mango Peach is my favorite flavor out of all of them, but each one is exceptionally good!I only got to try this one once, because my daughter somehow managed to fine the bottle and used it to paint the kitchen with. This DOES stain counters and floors, so keep out of the reach of little kids. In case of a spill, use a Mr Clean Magic Eraser. That saved my kitchen.

column9: My Fav Flav for sure! Perfect for College dorms to
column10: I sent this to my sister at college, one last so long that I figured she could give some away to her friends.  Perfect because she doesn't have a kitchen or anything so she can turn her water into something sweet with flavor fast and easy.  This is my favorite flavor and hers out of the ones we've tried so far, but they are all good.My only complaint is that I do detect a hint of fake sweetener which I hate, but I guess that's how it goes.It does last FOREVER, so if you want to try several flavors might be better to go to Target and get one of each.

column9: Don't let it get on your skin
column10: I tried it for the first time today, the fruit punch flavor. When I opened the container and turned it over, nothing came out. So I gave it a squeeze and a small stream came flying out, landing on the counter top and splashing onto my hand.  The counter top is not porous, so I was able to clean that up easily enough.But the MIO that got onto my skin created such a stain that it would not come off my skin with normal soap. Even the 'orange' soap that normally gets grease and dirt off my hands did nothing. Finally I used the Simple Green all purpose cleaner on my hand and after much rubbing it finally came off.Kinda makes you wonder what stains it is making in our mouth, throat, etc.
After one sip, my child had a severe allegic reaction with throat swelling and difficulty breathing.  Take a good look at what they put in this junk.
These taste like chemicals and seeing that there isnt any sugar  thats exactly what it is... GROSS dont buy taste revolting!

column9: Great flavor + cute and practical packaging
column10: I haven't purchased this from Amazon, but I was able to try Sempio Youndoo earlier this year, before it was available here. When I first got it, I really thought the packaging was aesthetically pleasing, and the cap/spout is well-designed (which seems like a stupid thing to note, but I have spilled more than my fair share of soy sauce from badly-designed spouts).I'm not much of a cook, nor do I have a distinguished palate, so this tastes to me like a more complex soy sauce, with a nuanced, savory flavor that makes dishes stand out. I originally thought "liquid seasoning" meant that it was a sauce to be generously used, but it's really concentrated so a little goes a long way. I guess it's meant to be used in place of MSG (which I've never used), but I honestly use it in place of soy sauce.I've recommended it to my friends and family, if they can find it. I don't cook often enough to justify buying a pack of 8 for myself, but I think it'd probably be a worthy investment to share with fellow cooks.As for any declared conflicts of interest: I did win this in a drawing for a sponsored event, but I certainly wasn't paid to write this review or anything.

column9: This is just made for someone like me!
column10: i was able to try this from my friend... i tasted youndoo before i cook and it was lil salty and sweet. i recenlty gave birth to baby and i asked my mom to add youndoo on soup and it tasted really good! i made steamed egg with youndoo,i loved it! we also used on many side dishes. we dont even have to add salt on sided ish because youndoo has right amount saltiness. also this is good for dipping sauce, my family ate grandma's mandoo and it was better than just dipping on soy sauce. resturant should use this instead of msg!!! this is really a true flavor enhancer!im so happy that they are selling online!!

I had the opportunity to try this product through a give away contest being given on a Korean Cooking Website.I thought I'd provide a copy of the review I posted on the cooks site because I really loved this product and I'd love to see it become more accessible to people who enjoy it. So yes...(knudge, knudge) give it a try!AROMA- smells similar to soy sauce, but folks don't be deceived (I'll tell you why in the next section)FLAVORI took a little plastic spoon and dipped it in.I was really surprised. Since the scent is very similar to soy sauce I thought it would taste the same, and it does but only for a tiny moment, but then the flavor expands to reveal a very deep and wonderful flavor. The after taste is closer to shitake than soy and it really does taste beautiful. The wonderful part is that it does taste like a great replacement for MSG. The fact that it doesn't have MSG made me very happy and I feel like Sempio is setting a great example for Asain products. No MSG makes me feel prouder to use it in my kitchenPACKAGING- Packaging is important to me. Not sure if I would always admit that but it's true. It's charming and the shape is wonderfully conducive to just grabbing a hold.So there you have it my unofficial review...now I just have to decide what to make with it. I have the feeling it's going to be wonderful in JapChae, whatever I decide.I must of used it in everything since I'd gotten it. It's hard to find at the moment and I keep asking my korean grocery if they're planning on getting any in, so as you can probably tell I'm pretty thrilled that it's here in Amazon.

column9: The perfect asian food flavor enhancer
column10: I have tried the Youndoo & the Youndoo light and both are excellent. Try using the Youndoo in all your ASIAN food as a flavor enhancer. Dishes like: fry rice, satay & kabobs marinade, stir fry and Pad Thai. Also, pour it on top of all your BAKED FISH dishes. It's all so flavorful. Try replacing sauces﻿ like Worcestershire & fish sauce with Youndoo as well. Try what I wrote with Youndoo and you'll see what I'm talking about. Now I'm hungry and will go have some "dry" Ramen noodle with Youndoo sauce on top..seriously It's ummm yummyyyy!

column9: Youndoo is so versatile, I can't do without it!
column10: I use Sempio whenever I can get it. ﻿ Soy sauce, kim, sweet potato noodles ... many more but one of my favorites is youndoo. I love to make muk but I like to add just a little flavor to the jelly in addition to the sauce. When I'm heating the mung bean powder and water, besides salt, I add a little sesame oil and Youndoo. My muk is so delicious with the Youndoo!

I made gamja tang last night and at the end of cooking I poured a little soup in a bowl, then in the pot I added the some of the youndoo sauce. My regular bowl of soup was tasty but a little bland but the youndoo sauce was so flavorful. It wasn't just a salt-like taste (which is how I would normally season soup, or soy sauce) but it had a "all day long" cooking taste. I was quite impressed. It had enhanced the flavors that had been boiling and I didn't need any salt! I was quite impressed. Normally I have to add quite a bit of salt to soups that I don't have time to cook for a long time.I am very healthy and picky about what I put in my food and I'm very please that Youndoo doesn't have MSG. I really love that it's made from vegetables and can be replaced for fish sauce/salt/soy sauce. I also noticed a little goes a long way, so that means one bottle will last me quite a bit!Sempio was so generous sending two bottles to me and I am thankful! I believe this will be part of my everyday cooking. I can't wait to try this out with other recipes. Thank you Aeri and Sempio... I really enjoyed cooking with Youndoo!

Before I used the product I tasted it. It has a well rounded salty flavor some where between soy and fish sauce. So I decided to use it in a salad dressing.I mixed 1 tablespoon lime juice, 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1 teaspoon YounDoo. And it was really good!We have been using it for about a year now. We mostly use it in salad dressings and soups. But it also good in fried rice as a replacement for soy sauce. If you have a recipe that calls for MSG or an MSG product use this instead.

I just tried the Youndoo seasoning and like it ALOT. I like it as a dipping sauce for my Mandu's. I added a little bit in my bulgogi and decreased the amount of soy sauce and the taste was phenomenal! Love it!

I think the product really completes the taste.I would like to purchase again once I use up.One thing that I don't feel good about is the container.Although I like its cute container, I wish that there was a bigger container to save the earth. :)

column9: are you ready to make some good food?
column10: this is a product that you can put in any kinds of food and it will give some great taste boost.not only i use this for korean food like kimchi soup/miso type soup but i also use this for american food such as a corn beef, beef stew, chicken noodle soup! this is made naturally from mushroom and other natural ingredient but only down side will be this has preservatives in it.i don't mind about putting this like a half spoon to my food but if you are super earthy people you probably wouldn't want that.well i love this!

Hello,I have once again put my Youn Doo to work for me! I created a chicken dish with chicken breast pieces, Chinese cabbage my husband grew in his winter garden, scallions, mushrooms, Chinese Five Spice, garlic powder and a finish of "magic sauce", Youndoo, at the end, and it was quite delicious...also quick and simple!

I added to some kongnamulgook that I was making and it really improved the flavor gave it more smoother taste to the soup. For lunch today I made nangmyun and added a little to the sauce my husband who is Korean made the comment that it had a better taste. I did not tell him that I tried something different in it. He loves the korean food I make but rarely comments on it so this made me want to tell you thanks a bunch will try it in other dishes and let you know. But so far plan on buying it instead of msg. Thanks a bunch.

column9: NY Egg Cream Stable but get the Kosher product!
column10: Great item and a memory from childhood but be sure you get the Kosher variety and not the one made with Corn syrup

If you're from Brooklyn there's really only one chocolate syrup for your milk or egg creams. Fox's is THE cult favorite dating way back maybe even before trolley cars and the original TROLLEY DODGERS! No bona fide Brooklynite or ex-patriate, such as myself, would ever consider a substitute. Hershey be da----!This is the real deal; accept no substitutes. My only regret is the shipping cost from this purveyor. It's cheaper to get on a train and visit the nearest NYC Gristede's; and you get a day in Manhattan to boot! 5 stars plus for this wonderful, unbeatable product. Zero stars for the not to be believed cost to get it home. Demand it of your local super market manager.

My husband and I recently took a 1 day trip to NYC and while there we tried to get the best NY dining experience, so we ate at Carnegie Deli, where I had to try the "egg cream" - I loved it!  When I got home, I tried to replicate the drink with hershey's syrup - it was horrible!!!  I went on line and learned that true New Yorkers used only fox's u-bet, so I ordered some.  It did not disappoint!  This syrup is not gritty like Hershey's tends to be, has a fudgy taste and best of all stays emulsified in the milk and doesn't settle to the bottom of the glass.

column9: Fox's chocolate syrup is the best chocolate syrup I have ever used.
column10: Fox's chocolate syrup is by far the best chocolate syrup I have ever used. I saw it in the local grocery store here in Pittsburgh, PA and tried it. After using it for about six months, the local store here stopped selling it. I briefly tried the "other brands" and there's no way I can even go back to them after using Fox's.

column9: The Best Chocolate Syrup in the World
column10: To know Fox's U Bet is to love it!!  Nowadays, you generally can only get 'Chocolate Flavored' syrup.  But not this one, oh no, nothin' but the good stuff in here!!  Great on ice cream, milk, and oh yeah, Egg Creams!!!

As a born and raised NY'er, chocolate egg creams ( which contain neither eggs, nor actual cream) are a beverage delight. A true egg cream can onnly be made properly with U-Bet Syrup and since I am now in the Pacific NW, i can find neither egg creams, nor U-Bet (actually I have found one true NY deli that serves them), so this was a find and a treat for me. My fellow transplants from NY are delighted as well....when they drop by, I can offer them the real deal egg-cream and tell them where to find U-Bet. Thanks!

Full disclosure - I'm a New Yorker living in the south. I was raised on chocolate egg creams in the heart of Brooklyn. There was no better chocolate syrup for Chocolate malts, ice cream sundaes and egg creams. In the old soda fountains at Woolworth,s and local candy stores, U-Bet was the chocolate syrup of choice. It's still the best, and it's still in Brooklyn.

I ordered this syrup to try an egg cream. Excellent! Then I tried it to make plain chocolate milk. Also excellent! Since I live in northern Minnesota, and hot chocolate can be a year round drink, I tried it to make hot chocolate. Superb! The next step is to try it in coffee for cafe mocha. I'm also not ashamed to admit it tastes good directly from a spoon.

The only acceptable chocolate syrup for a Brooklyn-style "Egg Cream." I own an ice cream shop in Riverside, Illinois and have visitors from the East coast who are amazed to find egg-creams this far west of Brooklyn. If I didn't use U-Bet, I would be accused of being a charlatan.
Fox's u-bet chocolate syrup is great on ice cream or in milk.  Great taste!

I was born in Brooklyn and directly across the street from our apartment was a candy store with fountain.  My dad would always take in for a chocolate egg cream.  We moved to MA and unfortunately Fox's wasn't available.  My mom tried to make it with other syrups but the taste wasn't the same.  I now live in PA and had my friend bring me a bottle from NJ on her last visit.  Pure Heaven!  I thought I was a little girl again!  She now brings me a couple of bottles each time she comes to PA.  You don't know what you're missing until you use U-Bet chocolate for an New York Egg Cream!!!!!

An eggcream made with Fox's U-Bet...pure bliss! Nothing else even comes close. One sip and I am six years old and back in Brooklyn. Which considering I am pushing 50 and living in North Carolina is no small feat. Got me through law school!

column4: D. M. heintz "A man of letters"
column10: I heard of Fox's chocolate syrup in a discussion about the best chocolate syrup.  I was on a cruise and our dining companions were discussing the merits of various chocolate syrups when one of them remarked about Fox's.I told them I was partial to Bosco, the one I grew up with, but couldn't find where we live. She offered to send me a jar of Fox's when we returned to our respective homes.  She sent it, I loved it and so when the jar ran out, I ordered more.  Thank you!

This is the best chacolate,I order it on line every couple months. My husband grew up in the Bronx's and he loves to make egg cream's with it, just like he had at the soda shops. You can not get this brand in Pennsylvania so the postage is worth it,if we ever make a trip to New York I will buy him a case. He's been dying for a knish!!! So maybe we be making a trip soon.

I bought this product for chocolate milk.  I found it neither better, nor worse than any old store-brand chocolate syrup.  It's perfectly acceptable but not worth the huge online markup.  I think a lot of regional nostalgia is driving the raving 5 star reviews.

You can believe what everyone here is saying....for an Egg Cream, Fox's U-Bet is the BEST.  I have never been to New York - but - there is a soda fountain located at the Beach Club Hotel in Disney World which I have visited "many" times and on their menu they have the "Original New York Egg Cream" and the taste cannot be duplicated with any syrup other than Fox's U-Bet.  You can make a good egg cream with just about any chocolate syrup, but if you want it to taste like the ones you get at a soda fountain "this" is the syrup you need.  And it's sooooo easy to make.  I've been trying for years to make an egg cream at home that tastes like the ones I get at Disney World and I am finally able to do it.  There's just something about this syrup - the taste is unique - and it can't be beat.  You won't be sorry if you order it because it's good just to put on top of ice cream too!

This is 'the one.' Being a born and bred Brooklyn girl, still living in NY, and having attended the 1964 world's fair where this supposedly originated, I am all over this.  I remember going to the local 'soda fountain' as a young girl sitting at the counter and ordering egg creams with friends. I didn't realize then it was a "New York thing."  It's even waistline friendly to make; 1/4" of choc. in a glass, then add 3/4" of whole milk above that, then add up to a cup of seltzer. Mix vigorously to froth and drink. You can kick this up a notch by making what my dad always called a "black and white" ice cream soda.  Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream to your chocolate egg cream...although that will add a few more calories!  This is sold in some but not all grocery stores at under $2.50; so if you can't find it, you can buy it here--albeit at a bit more cost.
The syrup was a big hit.  Unfortunately,it cost 3 times as much to ship as the actual price of the product so won't get it again unless shipping becomes cheaper.

After living in New York most of my life (50 years)my wife and I moved to Maine, there are only three things from N.Y. that I'm having a tough time living without. good pizza, good Italian bread and Egg Creams, I have been going back to the city for these things for ten years now to get my fix, It looks like I'll never get the pizza or real italian bread up here so I'll have to live with that, but I pick up the U-Bets in the city so I can make egg-creams except seltzer in a store bottle doesn't compare to the real pressurized seltzer bottles, somebody tell me where I can get a real seltzer bottle - PLEASE
As a Brooklynite transplanted to Chicago, I really miss my Egg Creams.  Thanks to Amazon, I can now have my Fox's shipped right to my house.  Now if only someone could sell me a real Seltzer bottle.

column9: Seeking a West Coast egg cream
column10: Good stuff, I got it to make egg creams and find it good for everything else you'd use chocolate syrup for. Reminds me of Hershey's, but Brooklyn egg cream die-hards say this is the ONLY one to use. It's good, tastes like chocolate syrup, nothing strange or different about it.

Fox's syrup is  for egg  creams=most prefer  chocolate but i  find the  vanilla  makeas an even  finer  drink-ice  cream!!  you can use anything  for that  but to waste this  marvelous syrup on anything but an egg  cream is a  crime!!
Hassle free transaction.  Product arrived ahead of schedule and in good condition.
I recently purchases fox u bet chocolate syrup.It was awesome. thamk you for prompt delivery*****

column9: The best tuna that I have ever had
column10: I wanted a really good quality tuna.  I tried the raincoast tuna and waswell pleased.  I make it into a tuna salad with one can tuna, celery seed,black pepper,mayo and tobasco sauce and keep in the fridge at all times.It makes a real good snack on crackers and sometimes I just have it with a meal.  This is an easy way for me to eat the omega rich cold water fishand this tuna is far better than anything that I can buy in the local grocery stores.  The tuna meat is in large chucks.  I live in south Georgia and the only other time I had really good canned tuna was whenwe visited family in Oregon.  I recommend this product.Anne from Georgia

column9: Raincoast Trading Company's White Albacore Tuna
column10: I really loved Raincoast Trading Company's white albacore tuna. I thought it was delicious and I would purchase it again. I also love the fact that it is wild caught and is in low mercury.

This tuna is hand packed, excellent quailty, cooked only once in the can, these are cans not pouches, as advertised. The only difference in the 5.3 ounce can, I think is the water content you normally get in low quality store brand tuna. The juice in the can is from the fish and thats it. You can also visit there website raincoasttrading.com. You will not be dissapointed.

This is the best commercial canned tuna I have ever gotten. They have canned it correctly and haven't cooked out all the nutrients, flavor, or natural coloring of the fish. They put in a chunk of fish, seal it up and cook the can, and the result is great fish. In my opinion it is worth the extra money over other mainstream brands on flavor alone, if you use it though, use it in something that will accent the flavor of this tuna rather than cover it up like tuna fish sandwiches do.

This albacore is just the best! It's moist and rich in natural juices, ....good enough to eat right out of the can with a squeeze of lemon and a little pepper.But it sure makes a killer tuna salad sandwich, as well......because it's so moist it takes only a little mayo to bind it with the usual suspects for tuna salad. Makes a wonderful Salade Nicoise, as well, but you'll never miss the olive oil from the traditional oil packed tuna. This is really great.

column9: So Moist and Full of Natural Oils It Doesn't Need Mayo
column10: Don't be surprised if you find yourself checking the label to be sure this tuna is not packed in oil -- i'ts NOT -- because it's that flavorful and moist. The opposite end of the spectrum from Star-Kist tuna which tastes like "bleached sawdust" after your first can of Rain Coast.
I am trying to eat healthy and love a great tasting tuna.  This product fits the bill.  Yes, it is more expensive than the off the shelf varieties found at local stores.  It is worth it.
This is one of the best apple butters. Delicious. The pecans give it a great taste!
Quality fruit, great texture not a brick! on the top of my reorder list! Highly recommend to all who love a lite fruit cake

The best honey ever!!!  I have hated honey all my life...used to gag on it as a child when my mother would try to give it to me for a cough or sore throat.  This stuff is different, totally.  First of all it is not a syrup.  It is a creamy pale yellowish mass of ecstasy....finely crystalized goop almost custardlike that I have found myself eating spoonful by spoonful right out of the jar.  It is that good.  And it is the purest of the pure and most nutritious.  So it pleases the senses as well as the mind.  Delicious stuff.  Try it.  Buy it before all the bees die due to Monsanto's Genetically Modified crops which are killing them off world wide.  Hurry buy cases of it.  You won't regret it.  Can even be used on wounds.I have some that I let sit in a storage bin where it got too hot and must have cooked it.  It is now melted and darker and somewhat separated between a lite syrup and crispy crystals.  It is still the best though with a little more of that traditional honey flavor.  I use a teaspoon of it in my hot oatmeal.  Ummm yum. A little goes a long way.

I am so happy to have found a quality cat food without grains or potatoes, both of which can cause inflammatory conditions and other problems for kitties.  The use of some starch (tapioca) is necessary to make the kibble, but this is the best formulation I've found of all the brands and flavors I have researched.  I've heard that sweet potatoes can cause or exacerbate urinary and kidney stones, even though they are not actual nightshades, like potatoes, which can lead to numerous other illnesses, such as arthritis (See the excellent book, Nightshade Free Pain Free by Michael Fowler for amazing info on nightshades for people and pets - it helped me and my family enormously!).So, finally a cat food which is acceptable and yummy!  All my cats love this food, and that is a rare thing around here.  They tend to have very particular and individual tastes, and rarely do they all agree on any one food.  This is the exception.  They love it!  And to note, they were not as fond of the Instinct chicken formula without the 'raw boost'; one liked, but the others were not so interested.For my smallest kitty, the raw freeze-dried pieces in this are a little too big, so I just crush them between my fingers and she eats them right up.  They also seem healthy and their coats look nice after a couple of bags of this food.

This is major comfort food for me.  It's a little like kids' macaroni & cheese out of a box, in that it's filling and takes about 20 minutes to make, except this is usually only eaten on Passover and it's amazing.  Children aged 2 and up will have fun squishing matzo goo into balls, and then a responsible adult can put the balls in the heated soup broth (and clean up the mess).  My mom was the responsible adult in the above situation for years.  One box = roughly half a dozen dinners.

I have been using this soup for years, use it as a base and add my own chicken (boneless chicken breasts), carrots, celery, and onions. I make the mazto balls after the soup is made, following the directions on the box. This makes a wonderful soup every time and I don't have to worry about seasoning.
Made this last night, and it was super easy (and I hate to cook, so believe me, it was simple) and it was delicious! I added some carrots and onion.;-)

Shame on you Hansen's. Your item description says "Country of Origin: USA" but the bottles are all stamped with a code that states that the apple juice concentrate is from China. If I had known that you import your juice concentrates, I'd have purchased another brand of juice. Perhaps you could update your product description to more accurately convey to the consumer just what it is you are trying to sell. I will be calling Amazon to try and return this juice and hope that I'm not stuck with this stuff because I'm certainly not going to give it to my kids. I'll stick with Knudesen's juice. Sure it's a little more expensive but it's an American product and it's the real deal; it's not made from a concentrate.
The product description is incorrect. Although the description says the country of origin is USA, the bottles are clearly stamped to indicate that the product contains juice concentrate from China.

I really wanted to try this world famous chili so I ordered it. It was a good meaty chili that reminded me of the chili we used to have at an old restaurant chain called Doggie Diner. It was very tasty but was way more fattening than some other chilis around. It wasn't so special that I would go out and buy it again and take the calorie consequences. When I'm feeling nostalgic - and skinny again - I might go ahead and order another.

I ordered this as a gift for a family member who is struggling in this economy. Excellent meats, with excellent service,  to bring a smile for holidays or any day.I really appreciate this company's quality, and prompt delivery. I will order from them again in the future.

column9: Other retail outlets for 8 oz Horizon Milk
column10: For anyone who has a Whole Foods Grocery chain in their area, this same product sells for $12.99/case(18 cartons).  I discovered this after I paid Amazon's high price of $25!  Maybe they will adjust their price downward if more customers share competitive pricing!

column9: Horizon Organic Reduced Fat Milk is a Favorite, but pricy on Amazon
column10: My kids love this milk.  Admit it is on the expensive side, but it travels well and the kids will drink it (they won't drink other milk.)Note:  Just went to BJs wholesale and paid 12.99 for the 18 pk.  Won't buy from Amazon again when there's such a price difference.

My son loves these milks and we used to get them for him when we went to Starbucks.  I was familiar with the Horizon brand and thought that the vanilla flavor would be fine.  I began to notice a few times after drinking this he would say his tummy hurt or he would act sick(really tired) shortly after drinking them.  I read the label and saw 29g of sugar...yeah holy cow!When we serve him a flavored milk I give him Gerbers smart sips, they have vanilla and mild vanilla flavor with 11g of sugar, I think the mild vanilla has even less grams of sugar.  He still loves the taste too!  I find them in the babyfood aisle at the grocery store.

We have been customers of the reduced fat version of this product for 7 years.  Our son is now 8 and a very picky eater (which is why he was drinking this product in the first place).  He is also on the thin side, so he was getting about 800 calories a day from the milk, which he really needs.  But the formulation has changed from a reduced fat (2%) to a low fat (1%) version.  The taste is noticeable and he will no longer drink it.  It seems ironic that a company who sells whole milk, half and half and heavy whipping cream would eliminate a 2% milk product.  I applaud them for coming out with a lower fat, lower sugar variety- but they could give their (very) loyal customers the option of buying the original version.  I have contacted Horizon and suggested they still provide the 2% product, but they said they "were not taking suggestions at this time".  Nice, eh?

column9: Used to love these little boxes....
column10: I buy these religiously for my kids lunches...until today.  From now on I will not buy these ever again.  For a quick dinner tonight I put in a pizza and pull out 2 milk boxes for my boys.  My youngest takes a sip and shakes his head dramatically.  I don't think too much of it (he just turned 2 yesterday), then 10 minutes later he takes another sip with the same reaction.  I take a sip out of curiosity and race to the sink to spit out the sludge/liquid rancid milk before I vomit.  Now I'm anxiously waiting to see if he gets sick.  I used to work in quality control and I now have no faith in Horizon's quality assurance/control practices.  Never will I buy this again!

This is almost one of the only ways I can get my daughter to drink milk. They sell it at Starbucks (much cheaper to buy it on Amazon!), so my caffeine addiction has put her into a lot of contact with this product. I recommend it for anyone trying to get their kids to meet the three daily dairy standards; because it's portable, it's easy to slip into the daily routine. Get a different straw, however, because the ones on the boxes are not very good.

column9: This price is a rip off!
column10: My daughter drinks 2-3 of these each day.  I was buying this from Amazon prime until they racheted up the price.  I used to pay $14 which was competitive with Costco.  Now- it's just a COMPLETE RIP OFF!! I will buy it anywhere but Amazon now.  Unreal that they are now charging $6 more for the same milk!! Go elsewhere- even Whole Foods has it cheaper!

My kids have been drinking this milk for years. My older son is essentially a vegetarian, and we have relied on this milk for a big percentage of his daily protein and calcium. He is also a very picky eater, so he noticed immediately the change to low-fat. I know, it has less sugar, but that's a deal-breaker for him. We're willing to let him have that extra sugar, if that's the price we have to pay for him to get his protein. Needless to say, we will be looking for a different brand.BTW, I know I'm not alone. I started buying this milk on Amazon because it would sell out at all the stores in the city I live. Now there's a glut of the new low-fat milk at all the stores.
yummy and convenient and without all the stuff you don't need. Great for on the go and good vanilla flavor- can't go wrong.

An absolute favorite in my house. My son would drink ten of these a day if we let him! He even prefers them to the chocolate variety, to which my daughter is partial. This price on Amazon is crazy. I got a pack of these this morning for $13 at my local Acme!

There is a national boycott of Horizon products as they are not organic.  This company was sold to a large conglomerate a few years ago.  Horizon is practicing "Greenwashing" - where a company claims to be sustainable, green, and organic but really is not.  Many Co-ops and local health food stores are boycotting Horizon products, including PCC Co-op in Seattle (largest co-op in the country)Please do some research before paying organic prices to a bogus company.

Amazon abruptly canceled my subscription.  I used to received two packages a month and the price steadily raised about %40.  It's not too bad since my son now drinks regular milk with Quik chocolate or strawberry.  I save some money as well so it's worked out for the better.

column9: Sad it is no longer available
column10: Great product for lunches, car trips, plane trips, visits to park or zoo.  I am really sorry that Amazon no longer has this product available.  I hope they will have it again in the near future.

column9: Very Short Expiration Date!  NO RETURNS!
column10: Use caution when ordering more than one case at a time (unless you have an army of kids).  The expiration dates may be very short.  I ordered 5 cases on September 27, 2011.  The expiration dates on all cases were November 19, 2011.  Since it's a food product, Amazon does not allow returns.

column9: BEWARE!! Double the sugar of regular milk
column10: We used to think this was a healthy product until we noticed the sugar content. This is almost liquid ice cream... If you want to avoid the extra added sugar buy only the PLAIN milk boxes

They recently redesigned the packaging for these; instead of a foil tab that you pull up or punch through, you have a foil-covered hole just barely big enough for the straw.  Want to pour it into another container, such as a glass or a sippy?  Find yourself a pair of scissors.  Your child pushes the expandable straw in?  Find those scissors.  It's a horrible design, and when I pointed this out to them I was brushed off with "our testing showed this was better."  I'm wondering if anybody who works there is a parent of a little kid.The milk itself is good, but this packaging just makes it a royal pain.

Sometimes it's hard to get my little guy to drink milk so we would give him this as a treat once in a while. I've been buying this milk for a while with the subscribe and save option but really it doesn't seem like a good enough deal.

these milks have nearly as much sugar per ounce (and in volume) as a can of regular coke.  each small drink has just under 75% the sugar of one larger 12 ounce soda. this is not a good 'snack' or even a replacement for milk.these items while they are labeled as organic and as milk, are basically melted ice cream.

My daughter loves to get these at Starbucks whenever we go to get me an overpriced coffee.  I feel good about giving them to her because it's Organic, however, there have been more that a few times that she has gotten a rancid one that had not even yet past the expiration date!  I know these don't have to be refrigerated... but maybe they should be?  Anyway, these are great, but give em a sniff test before handing them over to your child.
put them in your kids lunch boxes - a great alternative to juice boxes.  they have a long shelf live too!

My daughter will not drink white milk at preschool, so I send this for her for her lunch.  She likes it and it is very convenient.  Kept it in the diaper bag when she was little.  Great for on the go and travel.  Amazon is PRICEY though.  I can get this at BJ Wholesale Club for around $13 for 18 pk year round.

I buy these little Horizon milks for my kids, though I drink them too.  I get them on the subscription plan (which you really should do, it saves money, and it keeps a steady stream of milk coming for your kids).  Try every flavor, they are all great:  Horizon Organic Reduced Fat Milk, 8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 18), Horizon Organic Reduced Fat Milk, Chocolate, 8-Ounce Cartons (Pack of 18) (the best chocolate milk, ever, not gross and thick like grocery store chocolate milk), and Horizon Organic Reduced Fat Milk, 8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 18).  And also let me add a shameless plug for the beta version of the subscription program:  I LOVE IT!

Organics consumers should know that Horizon is owned by Dean Foods, at $10 billion of annual sales and controlling about 50 different dairy brands in the country, the largest dairy processor/marketer in the United States.A large percentage of their milk comes from their corporate industrial-scale dairy, with 8000 animals, in the desert-like environment of central Idaho.  They say that 80% of their milk comes from "family farmers" but some of those "farmers" are also milking thousands of animals.There are serious questions as to whether or not these farms are meeting both the letter and spirit of the organic law.

column9: BLECH! Honestly cannot stand these now.new formula.
column10: my parents had been buying these from Costco since I was in 6th grade(just now graduated high school ) they were really delicious and we would go through the crates quickly.About two or 3 years ago, I noticed new packaging and a horrible new taste,it was like they watered it Down.We couldn't even finish the rest of the case and were really disappointed to learn that they changed the formula.we never bought another one.Maybe it is less sugar,but that's what I liked and will not be purchasing again.I also remember them being pretty expensive for cased milk , it was worth It then but not now.

First off, We travel a lot with out Toddler. We live over 40 from a gas station and 160 from a grocery store or big box store. We only serve organic milk to our daughter and have found these to be invaluable for our needs. This is not her everyday milk, nor would I recommend it to be due to the sugar content. But it serves as a great traveling milk and a back up when we run out of regular milk. Or as a special snack. (Our very small local store and gas station do not carry organic products) My Daughter loves the taste. I love that it is shipped to my door for free and a competitive price. I have found all of the Horizon Products to be delicious and good quality.
My kids love these!  I like to buy these when they are a decent price because my kids to enjoy them so much.

As I stated with the Strawberry, this is a very healthy and quality drink.  I give these to my 4 yr old Grandson (about 2 per day) and he loves them.  Strawberry seems to be his favorite currently but he likes vanilla also.  It must be good if it is organic, healthy, and the FAVORITE drink for a 4 yr old yes?  By the case is much more cost effective.  BTW, these do not need refrigeration for storage, but I always keep 6-10 chilled for my Grandson....
My Kids love it and I found it cheaper buying in bulk (pack of 18) rather than from Walmart or Target. Plus you save more when you subcribe.

column9: Horizon always good milk... priced a little high
column10: Horizon can always be counted on to supply good/great milk products. And from what I have heard about how they treat their animals, it sounds like they do their part for the health and well-being of the animal and the environment. I do have two legitimate gripes with my purchase though... first, the price is a bit higher than it need be... but OK, I could have chosen not to order... secondly, the expiration date is not far off enough for this to truly provide you with a "back-up" source of milk on hand. My batch is only good for 4 months. Of course I can use it within 4 months but that wasn't necessarily the idea. It was more intended to provide a "red cross pantry" type product for when we unexpectedly ran out or could not get to the store, etc. So I *REALLY* wish they would extend the shelf life on the product they are shipping. This is not the first time it has happened. It happens on each order I have placed. If Amazon and Horizon could collaborate and get a much more extended shelf life... this would be even be worth the extra cost just to have the peace of mind. But they really need to work on that aspect. Enjoy your milk!
My son is a bit of a picky eater, and I had tried so many brands of milk and this one he loved so much and as an added bonus is organic. Even my husband likes it, he said it tastes like milkshake.

We always buy organic/no hormone milk for our girls. My preschooler fell in love with these milks from Starbucks, so I started buying them in bulk for her to have at home. Like another mom mentioned, she would get a tummyache if she drank a whole box in one sitting (maybe just too much milk at once or maybe due to the high sugar content?), so I started giving her a glass of half this milk and half regular milk: no more tummyaches! Now our toddler is drinking the same mix and loves it, too. Due to the expense, especially with two kids drinking them all day every day, I will be cutting them about 2/3's regular milk + 1/3 vanilla Horizon milk.
My son didn't like drinking milk but these cartons made it very convenient and are tasty as well.  Now my son loves to drink milk.  the switch was easy!

As I have said in other reviews, I enjoy eating healthier yet have little time to eat at work. I have been trying to move myself away from fattier, oily snacks during my day and sugary sweet drinks to wash them down. I thought Sun-Chips were pretty good, and buying chocolate milk from the Cafeteria filled it in. I wanted to do better, though. I have now been drinking a lot of Vita Coco to help fill the void, but it can be so expensive and sources which are decently-priced are endangered. This was a questionable purchase at first, since I have been drinking skim milk for 15 years now, so I am used to and prefer the cold, crisp, lighter flavor. I am glad I went for it!Pros-Love the packaging! Does seem to keep flavor better than traditional small milk cartons.-Smooth and rich flavoring. Chocolate is richer in flavor than vanilla. My wife says the vanilla has an after-taste, but I disagree. So it is apparently subjective. I have yet to try the strawberry, but if I were a betting man, I would say the same is true for it.-Better sugar and fat contents than generic milk packages. I have read other reviews that criticize this, but I am not sure what they have been drinking instead. All regular milk has sugar. It is really not that much.Cons-You might be of those who think the sugar content is too high.-The flavor is different than any I had had before. Any new flavor can be a tough adjustment. Sometimes, that adjustment never completes (I think this one is worth it, but I adjusted very quickly).

I'm a milk lover.  Usually, I buy non-fat milk, but this low-fat milk is perfect for traveling or taking to work.  It's great to have in the car for emergency hunger (prevents fast food gnashes).  Love it.

column9: Love it! And cheaper than smaller packs at Target!
column10: My daughter had some trouble adjusting to regular milk unless we mixed the whole milk with this! Halfing it or 2/3 whole to 1/3 Horizon helped her start drinking milk! At other places, a pack of 3 was about $3 so finding a larger package and being able to use some discounts on Amazon made it less pricy considering how much we use. If Horizon made a whole milk version that would be nice but for now mixing gives her both what she needs and what she likes.

This has long been the only milk my 4 year old would ever drink. We had been buying it on subscribe and save for a few years now. Our last shipment had the new formula and my daughter took one sip and said "yuck!" She won't even touch it now and I have a whole case of milk that she won't drink.  Such a disappointment. I have to say that although the old formula had 1% more fat and a few extra grams of sugar I don't think the minor nutritional improvements are worth the sacrifice in flavor.  I tasted as well and the new formula does have a chalky taste to it. Bring back the old formula!!

My kids have been drinking this milk for years in their lunches and loved it. We bought it by the 18-pack in both chocolate and vanilla.Unfortunately, the most recent shipment was flatly refused by my kids who are not horribly picky. They wanted me to throw 2 cases out!The worse news is that after checking with Horizon Dairy to see if we got a bad batch, we found out they CHANGED THE FORMULA! After confirming our UPC numbers, etc. this is the response we received in March of 2011:"Thank you for your recent e-mail to Horizon Organic®. We appreciate your interest in our products.We tested the new versions of Horizon Organic 1% Flavored Milks thoroughly and received strong consumer results, specifically related to the improvement over our prior formulas.While we've received positive feedback, we're sorry you're not completely satisfied with our new recipe changes.We value you as a consumer and hope we can help you find another Horizon Organic product to meet your needs.Thanks again for contacting the Consumer Affairs Department."What's worse is after asking for a refund from Horizon Dairy, on the 18th of March I was told Amazon doesn't buy directly so I have to ask Amazon instead.  Took over a month to get a definitive answer.  Now hopefully Amazon can still help us!Buyer beware!Regards,KAM

I am partial lactose intolerant and this the yummiest and healthiest milk for my body that doesn't disturb my stomach.  It tastes great and at a fair price. I love that it is offered in a variety of choices and has low fat options.  I also love how you do not need to refrigerate it and I can bring it in my lunch bag for lunch.  It's my favorite flavor.  This is a bit expensive compared to the other sellers, but if you watch out for the prices you can find it very affordable.

I buy this on Amazon when it's on sale for my 2 nieces - they love it. I've been known to sneak a few cartons for myself every once in a while which I like to put on cereal as well. It's very practical - it doesn't have to be refrigerated until opened, doesn't expire as fast as regular milk, it has a lot of vitamins and calcium, it's organic, low fat and sweet. It has a nice light vanilla flavor - not too strong.

My son was allergic to milk the first two years of his life and when he was finally able to drink milk, he only liked vanilla milk and the only place that had it was Whole Foods which was expensive. $14 for a box of 12. when I found this, it was a God sent. I pay $28 for 36 with free two day shipping!now he gets to drink as much as he wants without me having to worry about cost and with autopurchase options, i dont have to worry about re-ordering it every month. Thank Amazon!

My granddaughter goes through this stuff like crazy, so the fact that it's organic, low-fat, stuffed with vitamins and doesn't have to be refrigerated until it's opened is a major, major plus. We can stick a box in her diaper/snack/toy bag when we go somewhere and it's ready when she wants it. She seems to feel that it's fine at room temperature.  Amazon's price is good (on sale, this is usually $1 a box). This last time that I ordered it, it came two days later. If this is a product that you use a lot, I can definitly recommend buying it through Amazon.

My 14 month old would NOT drink milk.  Anytime I tried, he would gag...and sometimes even throw up.  He is a breastfed baby, so I believe that turned him off to the very UN-sweet taste of regular milk.  I tried mixing chocolate, strawberry....tried regular milk (although I am happy he did not like that because I would rather he drink organic!), organic, soy....everything!  Stumbled upon these little cartons and figured I would give it a shot.  He LOVES it.  It is the ONLY milk he will drink - maybe it is as close to breast milk as it gets?  I am slowly mixing the regular Horizon Organic milk, we will see what happens!

column9: A great product; a disappointing distribution channel
column10: My daughter has loved Horizon's organic milk boxes for several years, so I was excited to find them in cases through Amazon and ordered vanilla and chocolate. Both arrived promptly, yet I was greatly disappointed that the vanilla case had a Jan. 2011 expiration while the chocolate had one for June 2011. The vanilla had obviously been "aging" in a warehouse.I have these on a bi-monthly subscription service, so I'm hoping the next delivery in November has fresher vanilla product. And if not, I'll have to find a source elsewhere.

My kids love this milk! Not only is it organic milk, which is super good for my kids, but they really love the taste, too. My son loves the vanilla and our daughter loves the strawberry. They taste great on cereal or straight from the box. I love being able to throw the Horizon milk into our diaper bag and go without worrying about them needing a sugary drink as soon as we get where we're going. They make wonderful snacks, too! I often pack one for myself as well!

column9: Buying by the box is great!
column10: My son loves this milk as a snack or in his lunch, but buying the individual cartons can be expensive. Amazon offers the box price and delivers on a monthly basis, it is great!

Both of my sons LOVE this drink.  It is VERY sweet and sugary, so I serve it in a sippy cup, one quarter horizon vanilla and three quaters regular organic whole milk.  They still get the yummy vanilla taste and not all the sugar!!!

column9: Most affordable monofloral raw honey I've found anywhere; has health benefits
column10: I truly searched for affordable monofloral raw honey.  White Gold is the least expensive one I've found, taking into consideration Amazon's free shipping for this product - barely over .51 ¢ per ounce.  I've already placed several orders for it, not only for myself but as gifts, because it's a real treat.  It's over 40% more expensive at my local Whole F**ds.White Gold, owned by Continental Systems, is real raw honey. I've talked with the company representative on more than one occasion.  First, they don't heat this honey whatsoever - it is cold packed.  It's raw.Wikipedia defines RAW HONEY as honey that is exists without adding heat above 120 °F.  Wikipedia goes on to state: "Local raw honey is sought after by allergy sufferers as the pollen impurities are thought to lessen the sensitivity to hay fever."  White Gold is not heated at all.Monofloral honey is somewhat hard to find and always has a distinctive flavor since it comes from one plant species' nectar.  Monofloral clover honey is pale white, but a lot of polyfloral honeys are labeled as clover honey for the retail trade.  There are many different types of monofloral honeys so you can experiment and find out which is your favorite. Keep in mind that heat processing darkens (browns) honey.Further, White Gold is hand-packed and not whipped (aka, creamed).  That's significant because honey manufacturers often whip honey to make it more spreadable, but White Gold is already highly spreadable without this extra processing.White Gold is a logical beginning when you are trying to discover your favorite raw monofloral honey.  It has a unique fragrance that will probably be totally unfamiliar to you.  You'll probably like it very much right from the start and recognize the clover taste.In my opinion, the comparison of this raw pure clover honey to pasteurized standard table honey labeled clover is akin to comparing Grade A maple syrup to Grade B maple syrup.  And then in addition, one must consider that raw honey has health benefits that pasteurized honey completely lacks.

If you want spreadable honey, this is it!  Very mild and spreadable on toast and breads.  This is actually too mild for our family; we prefer a much stronger, intense and flowery smell.  Since this is a matter of personal taste, I can only give this a 3 star.  For side by side comparison with comparable priced products, I'd much prefer certified organic raw honey from YS Organic Bee Farms or Wholesome Sweeteners.  If you add this honey in tea or water, it doesn't have that distinctive honey smell, just sugary water.

This honey is great tasting, which is not too unusual; what sets it apart is the consistency. It's thicker and not as runny as most honeys, so it's easier to serve without making a big mess. With most honeys you leave a trail between the jar and the destination, but the White Gold honey comes out clean, without dripping everywhere.

If HFCS listed as an ingredient on any product I pick up at the grocery store I place it back on the shelf and walk away.  I'm sure that's EXACTLY why corn producers and HFCS manufacturers do not want regulations that require it being listed in the ingredients on products that contain HFCS...if we only knew.  Sadly, some bee farmers use HFCS to supplement their bees diets...could this be part of the cause for bee colony collapse?  I wonder.I'm stepping off my soapbox now and want you to know that this White Gold Raw/Unfiltered Honey is absolutely the best honey I've ever tasted.  It's mild, buttery, and aromatic all at the same time.  It just melts in your mouth and has a clean, yummy aftertaste.

The flavor was less overwhelmingly sweet like other honeys that I've tried. I like it, and for the value of two containers plus free super saver shipping I'm going to reorder when I'm out. My mother hates honey spoonfuls but this mild clover honey was enough to sway her aversion to the beneficial sweet stuff. Raw honey has a load of health benefits (enjoyed in moderation of course!) and this is monofloral which is another great attribute.
The taste of this is so sweet and delicious. I use this in my coffee among other things, especially plain. This will last me a while. I will buy again.
It is very tasty and is useful. I recommend to drink with tea, is with porridge for a breakfast. Honey is very useful especially in the winter. I use it instead of sugar.
T thought this product was pretty reasonably priced and the taste is heaven.  I like the spun texture better than normal honey.

I've purchased various types of honey from Amazon and other sources, so far this is the best tasting.  This honey is not runny at all, so you can spread it on toast or bagels. I will definitely be buying more in the future.

This is by far the best honey I've ever tasted. It's not hard to see why it is called  "The Worlds Best Tasting Honey". I highly recommend it.
this is nice mild spreadable honey, you can also use this honey for Tea instead of sugar and does not alter the taste of tea. Great Product, Highly recommend it. the product arrived very quickly.

This is a must have for avid tea drinkers.  Excellent on toast as well!!!  This raw honey literally melts in your mouth. I highly recommend White Gold Raw Honey for its value and double grade A quality!!!

I'll surely use this to replace it since it's half the price (please don't double the price like the other honey did!).  It goes very well with tea too. White Gold is the BEST honey ever!  It's smooth and have a distinctive taste that's mild enough for anyone.  I've never tried honey that's as superior as this one.  Please try it, you will not be disappointed.
