Maybe, this is because the only sources for this honey are red and white clover blossoms. Also, being more thick than other honeys, it makes it hard to control intake: one tends to consume more, because it spreads as thick layer. Not a perfect dietary situation...

column9: Very sweet honey. I like the fact that it's crystalized.
column10: I bought this honey based on the good reviews here on amazon. Arrived quite promptly. I like this crystalized white honey.

A little pricey for honey, but it's an occasional indulgence.  I originally heard about this on the Dennis Prager radio show.  I don't consider myself a honey fanatic, so I could not understand why the radio guys were waxing poetic about the honey, comparing it to devon cream and reviewing it like wine.  After I tasted it, I understood a bit better.

Hands down, I prefer white honey with tea over traditional honey sold in grocery stores.  Prior to this purchase, I was buying white honey from Teavana, but this was inconvenient as they are usually out, and it's quite expensive.  I found this product on an Amazon.com search for an alternative and decided to give it a shot.  For the price, it is great a quality white honey.  I don't even think I can taste a difference between this and the expensive Teavana-sold White Gold Honey.  Will definitely continue with this product.
In my opinion, this is the "best" raw honey in the world!!!Try it once and you'll be addicted.  It's like eating candy.Also raw honey has a lot of health benefits.

This honey is easily fermented during shipping if you order it on a hot month. When I opened the first jar, I could tell it was affected by the heat due to the excess white, gooey foam at the top. It also smelled slightly off and had a salty taste to it. I couldn't eat the honey past the first day of opening the jar.From what I could tell, it tasted a lot like powdered sugar and I'm sure the honey has a wonderful taste when it hasn't been ruined by the heat. It had a salty garlic aftertaste to it (definitely caused by the fermentation activating.) It was edible until the second day, when the yeast and fermentation process was taking over. Those first spoonfuls were good despite the aftertaste, and it would work well with a tea because of how sweet it is. You'll need less to sweeten, and that means the jar will last longer. It is unfortunate that it was too hot when I ordered this honey.The same thing happened when I ordered a jar of rata honey. Heat makes it begin a fermentation process and bam -- it tastes like spoiled milk, or in this case, garlic. This hasn't happened to me with any other type of honey (i.e: a naturally yellow or dark honey.) These 'white' honeys are just way more susceptible to fermentation. It could also be the plastic jar, and the seal, because the rata honey also had a plastic jar and seal. By the way, the rata honey came from Wedderspoon and they never replied to my e-mails, which indicates incredibly poor customer service (so, I don't recommend buying directly from Wedderspoon like I did.)Order this honey when you know it won't get too hot during shipping.The jar is BPA free and has a seal between the honey and lid.

I was disappointed in the quality of this white honey. At the top of the bottle was a thick layer of gooey foam, the consistency of melted marshmallow, which I had to spoon off and discard. Beneath that layer was the honey and I found it grainy and not as firm as expected. Although not the highest quality for spreads, etc., it will do fine as a sweetener in tea.

I really wanted to like this honey...  It has an amazing flavor, tooth-achingly sweet and creamy without any strong floral or fruity tones.  It would be perfect for cooking with or adding to tea when you want the goodness of honey without any distinctive flavors interfering.But it separated and arrived with a granular texture instead of a creamy one.  The replacement was the same way, but not as bad after being shipped with one-day shipping instead of two-day, which leads me to believe the problem might be shipping it in the summer heat.If you're going to buy this honey, I recommend ordering it in the winter so that shipping conditions are better.

column9: Rich, sweet, full-bodied coffee from a k-cup
column10: Despite giving Emeril's Big Easy Bold five stars, I think it only fair to open with a couple of negative points. First, if you're looking for authentic New Orleans style coffee, you'll likely be disappointed by the lack of chicory root. Frankly, I doubt that most coffee drinkers will mourn the lost chicory. Second, this coffee is a concentrated dark roast; if you're fan of light roasts and mild coffees, this variety will probably taste ashy and too strong.We just started using our Keurig B40 last week, and the first few k-cups I tried were disappointingly watery. The Emeril's Big Easy Bold is one of the few blends I've found that provides a full-bodied cup of coffee without any harsh overtones and without any nasty, bitter after-taste. Made with a single varietal (Colombian-grown arabica), Emeril's Big Easy Bold brews up with a rich cocoa aroma and a thin trace of crema. The flavor includes caramel, chocolate, and fruity notes with a hint of pepperiness, but the chocolate note lingers in the finish.I don't add sugar or cream to my coffee, but I doubt that either addition would detract from the overall experience. Excellent with scones.

I am disappointed with this coffee and am not looking forward to finishing it before I get another bold variety. It does make a bold cup of of coffee-- which is hard to find with a lot of k-cups, but it has a very bitter aftertaste.

if you love a bold cup of coffee you will not find a better product than this one. The only problem I have had is with the availability, and the lentgh of time it takes to actually recieve my order. In fact the last time I tried to order they postponed shipping twice, so I ended up canceling the order via amazon and ordered the same product from coffeegiant dot com. They seem to be able to ship in a timely manner and the cost was equivalent.

This is not terrible, but there are better k cups out there. This does have a "bite" to it, is a bit bitter for my taste.  We prefer the Coffee People's Black Tiger or Timothy's Midnight Magic for a strong cup that is less bitter.  Also, these are labeled here as 25 packs, but they are 24 packs.

Note: I use a fair bit of milk in my coffee, so that colors my interpretations.I tried Emeril's Big Easy Bold since I am constantly on the lookout for 'bold' coffee.  It does not disappoint. If you like that Parisian roast taste you will like this coffee.  It is not for the faint hearted!

I found Emeril's, Big Easy Bold K-Cups a little too bold for me; even in the morning. I also did not care for the smoky taste. It is not the worst coffee, I've ever had, but I have to alternate with other varieties as I could not drink this one every morning. I will not be purchasing this one again.
We have a new Keurig coffee maker.  We found there is a very big selection of coffee available.  We picked Emeril's Big Easy Bold andit did not disappoint.

column9: Not Bad but certainly not good
column10: While I like bold coffees this one was so strong it left me with a bad after taste. Bold does not mean bitter.
Good, but the "bold" version could stand to be a bit stronger, not the typical of what you would expect from a New Orleans type Big flavor coffee which they are known for.
This coffee had a bold, strong flavor.  The other coffees I have tried are too weak. (I like strong coffee). This is perfect.

column9: One of my all time favorites
column10: Not a long review. Just wanted to add my 5 star recommendation. We all know taste is subjective.  I have gone through several box's of k cups, several of them stating bold. This is by far my favorite. I look forward to sampling the decaf version.

My top 3 k-cups are Timothys midnight magic, Tully's French roast, and number one is Emerils. It is both bold and easy.....a perfect cup of coffee.The de=caf version is great too....just a little less bold.

This is a great Bold coffee.  I am an avid Starbuck's drinker.  I prefer the darker roasts.  This one fits the bill for me.I also like: Timothy's Midnight Magic,Timothy's Rainforest Espresso, Coffee People Bold Black Tiger, and Gloria Jeans Black Gold.

Emeril's K-cups, Big Easy Bold, 24 Count, 0.85-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 2)FINALLY!  This is the one K-Cup where you can actually use the 9.25 ounce setting on the B-60 (3rd option) ... didn't think I'd ever find one.  This coffee is true to its word ... BOLD, but not overpowering.  If you like a Strong, but tasty coffee, this one is for you.

This coffee is for you if you are a BOLD coffee drinker.  Rich and robust with no bitter taste.  I drink my coffee black and the stronger the better.  This is the best single cup coffee I have been able to find and I have tried them all!  Gloria Jeans, The Coffee People, Newman's, Timothy's do not hold a candle to this one.  The aroma comes out of the kitchen when this is brewed making anyone who does not have a cup in hand want one too!  We brew so many cups of this blend that I had to decrease the time between shipments.  This coffee is good enough to keep me out of the local coffee shops.
This coffee has turned out to be one of my favorites (Newmans Own Organic is the other). Rich, not too acidic, flavorful.
A really good cup.  Made by Timothy's so you know it will be nice and bold, in the scheme of Keurig that is.
This coffee is great! I found it to be strong and smooth, not bitter at all.  Great for those that have a hard time moving in the morning.

column9: By far the best k-cup coffee I have ever tasted!!
column10: I am constantly on the look out for good tasting coffee; but it has to be bold, strong and retain the taste, even after adding creamer.  I stopped using a sweetener a long time ago and I find that I enjoy my coffee more now.  This coffee, in my opinion, is the best I have tried so far in a k-cup variety.  It rivals even the coffee of my youth, made by my mom back in Puerto Rico.  My husband, who usually drinks pots (not cups :-)) enjoys it too!!

At first sip it's not that bad.  But after I finished the cup I had a horrible bitter taste in my mouth for a long time after.  I had to chew a peice of gum to get rid of it.  I won't buy this one again.

I am a coffee snob, let's face it. I am very picky, and I usually grind my own and use the adapter for my Keurig. I like my coffee bold but not bitter. This is the perfect Keurig style coffee for me. I've had my Keurig for a year now, and until this product came out, I was very disappointed with the bold types available. They are either too bitter or not bold at all. This is PERFECT. I brew it on the medium strength stetting. It's perfect for work and for when I don't want to mess with my barista. I buy it through the auto delivery subscription service.So now it's a clearance item? What - are they going to discontinue it??? NO!

I've had my Keurig for about two years and love the Bold coffees.  As any Keurig owner will tell you, with the Keurig, you have to buy Bold to get a decent strength or flavor to your coffee.  I usually buy the Newman's Own Bold (unfortunately no longer available on Amazon) or other similar flavors like Green Mountain's Nantucket Blend.  Unfortunately, Green Mountain isn't yet available on the Subscribe & Save program.  I was very excited to try Emeril's after reading the glowing reviews, in particular because there were several mentioning how smooth and non-bitter it is.  Many of the Bold K-Cup flavors tend to be bitter.  My excitement lasted until my first taste where I discovered a bold coffee with sour and bitter undertones.  It's not so bad that I won't finish it but I will not buy it again.
Very Convenient and at a good price.ThanksJim B

This is the first K cup that I like using the largest setting. It would be nice if they had chicory root but it is mostly true to the flavor anyway. Clearly one to try if you like bold coffee. It has a little too much of the  burnt flavor to be my favorite but close.
Emeril's Big Easy Bold is our new favorite, I just had to order more. It is very bold but also smooth with a smokey taste. We Love It.

column9: Big Bold Dark Roast Flavor for your  Keurig
column10: Emeril's Big Easy Bold is currenly my favorite Dark Roast K-CupIt makes a very Bold Cup of Dark Roast without the bitterness.It's Great on the 7.25 Oz cup size but also holds up well on the 9.25 Ozwhen I want slightly less bold cup
I'm a BIG K-CUP coffee drinker and I like it STRONG - but with flavor - not bitter. Emeril's is the best !!! Rich, flavorful and satisfying...

column9: Emeril Big,Easy Bold best coffee k-cups on the market today!
column10: Emeril's Big,Easy Bold best coffee k-cups on the market today!  This is what a great cup of bold, rich, earthy coffee is supposed to taste like.

column9: a bold flavor for those who like a stronger coffee
column10: If you look a bold flavor this K-cup is for you.  My husband, who likes a really strong coffee, thought this was the best.  We have used both  regular and the decaffeinated and enjoyed them both.
Good stuff.  It packs a punch and has a smooth but intense coffee flavor.  It's one of the K cups that I grab for  first lately.

I really like these k-cups. They are fairly strong and not bitter. They have a smokey flavor to me kind of like starbucks. These are not as strong as dark magic but do have good flavor. I got these on a one day sale at $5 a box and couldn't be happier. Highly recommended!

I like strong coffee and have only bought "bold" flavors since getting my Keurig (the best invention since sliced bread). I must say that this is the strongest one I've found...really like the flavor and boldness. Again, I like strong coffee, but this is the first time that I've bought a k-cup flavor that stands up to a normally brewed cup of coffee -- bravo!

A really strong cup of coffee, just like it says...BOLD! I love rich, strong coffee. This one is definitely an eye opener. Not quite s good of a flavor and aroma as I would like, but I'm very particular. It's a little bitter for my taste.

Just received my K-Cups.  Don't even have my brewer at home yet -- so had to bring them to work to try them.  This is a full bodied cup of coffee -- even at the 8 oz setting on the B3000.  It is not at all bitter -- and unlike STAR****s -- it does not taste burned.I managed to catch this at what must have been a sale price -- 2 boxes for 10 bucks.  Couldn't be happier.
These exceeded my expectations.  Very bold and strong, which is what I like.  I've found a lot of K-cups to taste watered down.  These were better than most.  Price was right too.
I found this bold selection to have a very bitter aftertaste . It is bold , but it is way too bitter .

This is a nice bold cup of coffee without bitterness - a good way to start the morning. Every 4th or 5th k-cup leaves sludge in the bottom of the mug, though. Without the quarter inch of coffee grounds in the bottom of my mug I would give this coffee 5 stars (for bold coffee lovers)
The box contains 24 not 25 cups like the rest of K-Cups sold by Amazon.

Not only do the dogs love these, but they last them a very long time. I had one teething pup that worked on a knuckle bone slice for a couple of days. The only drawback (preventing me from giving the full 5 star rating) is that they're a bit stinky. I do take them away from the dogs when they get to a small enough size that the dogs might try to swallow it - - they're quite hard and could certainly be a choke hazard.
the joyva marshmallows were stale  could not eat them  i threw them away iwould like a refund  purchased thru amazon

column9: Tasty little things; also good frozen
column10: I had an order quantity get mixed up once, but that was easily resolved.  The candies have always arrived in good condition.

column9: Eight O'Clock Coffee, Mocha Ground, 11-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
column10: I would highly recommend this product. The Mocha flavoring isn't over powering as is the case with other coffee distributors.We enjoy this coffee, can't get it in our local grocery stores, we always purchase it here.The shipping was fast, arrived on the scheduled day in an undamaged container. I love opening the package when it arrives & sit & inhale deeply as the aroma fills the air.I would recommend this product to family & friends.

This will make your kitchen smell wonderful and draw the rest of your family downstairs in the morning.  It smells chocolatey but just tastes like coffee.  It is good coffee but without the expected chocolate taste.
I really disappointed for this coffee. It's OLD and NO FLAVOR AT ALL.Eight O'Clock Coffee, Mocha Ground, 11-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
This is very good tasting coffee.  Having a cup of Mocha Ground is a nice way to start the day.

Unfortunately I found the Cafe Escapes excessively sweet and had a strange aftertaste,  I actually threw them out after my husband and I tried them, particularly after reviewing the ingredient list.  I recommend the Green Mountain "Hot Cocoa" K cups as they taste  much, much better in my opinion.

I got the hot cocoa k-cups for my kids and my son said to me "mom yours is better"!  While they enjoy the novelty of it they don't really enjoy the taste of it and my version of hot cocoa is swiss miss!!  Wouldn't reccomend, may have to try another brand!

I was so excited to get the Keurig Brewer for my staff (They have been hinting for months). I ran out and bought an assortment of K-Cups to surprise them in the morning.  I just tried the Cafe Escapes Hot Cocoa, milk chocolate.  It was awful, watered down, too sweet, and left a terrible artificial sweetener after taste.I hope to have better luck with the coffee.

This is my first review. Usually I am too lazy to leave feedback, but this product taste so horrible that I have to say something to warn people who want to try it. If you want to try it, don't! The taste is so artificial and it leaves strange taste in your mouth after you drink it. I don't know what to do with the rest. Worst buy ever.

column9: This is delish!  I don't know what people are talking about
column10: No funny after taste for me! Rich and SO MUCH BETTER than the green mountain coffee which is watery and artificial tasting.  Not as good of course as a cafe hot cocoa but best one I've found for the keurig.

I was looking forward to receiving this hot milk chocolate in the mail but should have known better. The half cup that I was able to drink tasted more like hot instant milk with a hint of some other flavor (I didn't recognize it as chocolate.) I would not recommend it.

These do NOT taste like Not Chocolate, not even a little bit. I'm not sure what they taste like to be exact...but I do know I dumped my whole first cup of this down the drain. Now Im going to see if I can bring it back to BBB for an exchange.  HORRIBLE!

column9: Not As Good as the Grove Square Hot Cocoa Kcups
column10: We didn't care for the taste of Cafe Escapes Hot Chocolate as much as the Grove Square brand. It had a slight artificial taste to it. It also left an aftertaste in my mouth. It is way more expensive than the other brand. We'll drink them, but I won't be buying this brand/flavor again.

Palatable for kids but that's about the best I can say about them.  On par with the more mediocre generic instant hot chocolates, but at the cost per cup for these should be much better.  Making a 4oz cup and bolstering the flavor with 2% milk is required even to get a child to drink them.  My advice is to pick up an alternative brand's seasonal premium hot chocolate for the K-cup makers and skip this Green Mountain/Cafe Escapes variety- as these are disappointing at best.Avoid if possible, but not a total waste.  Consider my 2 stars as "generous."

column9: It's OK, my kids love it
column10: I think it has a diet taste to it, like a fake sugar taste, however my kids really enjoy it and they are the reason I bought it anyway.

The key to enjoyment with these:  Use a keurig that has a small/large cup setting. Microwave/stove-top heat a 3rd of what you want to drink of milk to a boil. Put the milk in the mug, and brew the hot chocolate directly into it. Top with whipped cream.IF you drink it this way, its perfect, otherwise there's a slight after taste(just like every other cocoa mix if you ask me).

column9: Cafe Escapes Hot Cocoa, milk chocolate
column10: Good, but not sweet enough for my taste and it seems more watery than instant brands. If you put a few large marshmellows in the cup before it brews this helps a lot.
This is the best one we have found for our Kuerig Brewer........everyone loves it. Kids, husband, and me!

I hadn't thought about trying any brands of hot chocolate for the keurig, after all, I did buy it for coffee.  Ended up receiving a free sample and really enjoyed the milk chocolate flavor.  Th negative reviews confuse me, because I found it had no bad aftertaste, and didn't taste watered down.  I will be buying more.
Those are good and delicious. Whenever I am at work, at play or anywhere else; I keep this item  CAFÉ ESCAPES Milk Chocolate in my bag for use as drink, and I enjoy it.

By itself, it tends to be a little watery, choose the next size down for brew selection. That is why the 5th star isn't there.Otherwise, I use it for combo drinks w/ the coffees because it's the only one that tastes great and isn't combined w/ artificial sweeteners.I have bought a few cases here as well as some local

I love chocolate everything and have purchased and used three brands of hot cocoa, from Amazon, in our Keurig K-cup brewer which was a 2011 Christmas gift. The best milk chocolate flavor consumed was Cafe Escapes followed by Grove Square and totally unacceptable Green Mountain Coffee, Hot cocoa, which went to our local refuse hauler. I feel that you get what you pay for as Cafe Escapes was the highest cost and Green Mountain the cheapest and worst. I noticed that both Cafe Escapes and Grove Square were labeled Milk chocolate flavor,Hot Cocoa, Green Mountain was not which may account for it's strange flavor. I wish there was a means of securing product samples rather than purchasing two boxes of some products like green Mountain.

This is by far my favorite kind of drink to make in the Keurig.  It has the perfect hot chocolate taste, and if you have a large cup (like I often do), you can put a large and small/medium from the same k-cup and it still tastes great.  Definitely recommend!

column9: How could you give this stuff a 2
column10: This stuff doesn't deserve even a 1. Just tried the Milk Chocolate Hot Cocoa - absolutely terrible taste. One drink was all I could stomach.

We were given a sample box of Cafe Escapes (4 count) with our Keurig brewer.  They do not taste good.  They have a very strong chemical / plastic taste and the chocolate flavor is difficult to distinguish but it does taste artificial.  It had a decent mouth feel and brewed well but the taste is not worth it.

column9: Flavor is ok, but watch out for the aluminum!
column10: We have only had the Keurig coffee maker for a couple of months (yes, it was a Christmas gift) and my wife is the main user.  So, it's possible that the problem I'm having is common to other coffee/hot chocolate cups in addition to these Cafe Escapes.  At any rate, unlike many of the other reviewers, I think the hot chocolate flavor is pretty good.  My problem is that at least half the time I find a tiny piece of aluminum -- sometimes two tiny pieces -- floating on top of the chocolate in the cup.  The Keurig works, of course, by punching a small hole in the chocolate/coffee container.  I assume the tiny piece of aluminum is from the whole punched in the container.  I would guess that if the cups were properly designed, this wouldn't happen.I would also guess that there are times when the aluminum drops below the surface and I swallow it.  Probably not a major health risk ... but it can't be good!  At any rate, I won't be buying this brand of hot chocolate again.Edited on May 26:  Since I wrote this review, we have used a number of other brands of chocolate and coffee k-cups without encountering this problem.  Another user in commenting on this review notes that he or she has not had this problem with Cafe Escapes.  So perhaps it was just a defective batch.

These were terrible. I do not recommend at all. Has a very artificial taste. Nasty after taste. I thought it was old or nasty water in the machine since all other k-cups i have used have come out at least reasonably. Was not the water, just a terrible product. I would say to try anything but these, don't waste your money.

column4: Sharon P. Gerdik "City Gal Loves Country"
column9: So Easy and Tasty Hot Cocoa
column10: Love my new Keurig machine even though I don't drink coffee. I love hot cocoa and this Cafe'Escapes Milk Chocolate is delicious. Nice mild chocolate creamy flavor. My grandkids love it as well. One uses whipped cream and the other adds mini marshmallows. Any way it's a comforting drink to have anytime.

TOO SWEET (from artificial sweetner) and not milky/rich enough!!!!Luckily I had gotten a whole box as a complimentary gift from facebook or something else.  I suppose for people who like sugar substitute, it'll be tolerable.  However, it doesn't have the rich chocolatey taste.  All I taste is the fake sugar and the taste won't leave my mouth!!!  Gross!!!  YUCK!!!  I can't drink this stuff even for free!

New to the world of Keurig, I bought these K-cups in a large package for my husband and I to share.  Unfortunately we were very disappointed.  Hot chocolate K-cups are designed to quick-dissolve (compared to the regular hot chocolate packages you buy from the store) and it tastes like chemicals.  The milk chocolate is no different than the dark chocolate when it comes to chemical taste.  After playing with different water level settings, I eventually just had to throw them out.  Now we buy normal hot chocolate packets instead.
It's very tasty!!!!!!! I love drinking this stuff but I often put too much in my cup and it gets a bit watery....No problem, though! i just sprinkle some Equal into it and it tastes great!

I was excited for a good cup of hot cocoa, but this product just did not meet my expectations. I have used the three smallest size settings on my Kuerig and the cocoa is always too watery. Very dissapointed!
This is my personal favorite of all the hot chocolates I've tried. I mix it with Dark Magic coffee for an awesome mocha treat!

Well I guess it's just a matter of taste, because I really like it.I use the largest cup setting and add mini marshmallows, delish!This is my 3 box now.  With all these bad reviews, I'm afraid it will be discontinued.  I hope not!
This is a huge hit at our house. Kids love this in the morning before school. Great flavor! AND easy easy easy!

My 7 year olds says it tastes really good, has no aftertaste (I have no idea if he even knows what that means), and has no grinds on the bottom.  I set my K-cup maker to the biggest drink setting and actually split the hot chocolate into two servings for my boys.  They love it!  You will too.
Bought this for visitors to the house who don't drink coffee.  Overall it is pretty good.  I would like it to be more creamy, but still it tastes nicely chocolaty.
This hot chocolate is very delicious and a nice alternative for those who do not drink coffee.  Good taste and easy use.

Of all the varieties of K-cups I have tried, I can say this has been the worst.  Don't waste your money.  It does not taste anything like real hot cocoa and I did not detect any milk chocolate flavor.  The Swiss Miss are a considerably superior product, although still your making it with water so it will never taste as good as home made.

I just loved this Hot Chocolate. It was creamy, smooth, tasty, and just plain perfect. It reminded me of whipped Hot Chocolate like you'd get at Dunkin.I bought Swiss Miss for Keurig to compare and wound up returning it. That tasted just like the envelopes.I don't know where there is any chemical taste like some have mentioned.I'm very picky with what I drink and this is just smooth and creamy!  Don't hesitate to try it.
Best hot cocoa mix I've ever had.  Only aftertaste I have is a pleasant chocolate one -- maybe the other person got a bad batch or hadn't cleared their machine.
My husband got this for our family gift when he was deployed.  The kids loved it.  It was great to share it.

These may be the best pretzels I've ever had. They're tasty AND healthy (bonus: They're organic). Good alone or with salsa, guacamole or a non-fat dips. Or add some apple or pear slices, a dollop of yogurt or some fresh veggies for a quick and healthy at-home or on the go snack.I first came across them in a desperate attempt to wean myself from baked white cheddar chips. Looking for something crunchy yet non-fattening wasn't easy. You get 15 pretzel sticks at only 130 calories and no saturated or trans fats. Works for me!Best of all, there's 4% dietary fiber in a serving. (About 8 servings to an 8-ounce bags, so we're talking about a week's worth of healthy snacks.)The honey wheat flavor is great and best of all, it's a satisfying snack, too.If you buy in bulk, be sure to hide away those other bags and count out portions. Otherwise, it's way too easy to overeat these pretzels.

We love these pretzels!! They have a unique taste--not like a regular pretzel. The multigrains combine to form a distinct taste with hints of rye, poppy seed and molasses. They are not as salty as regular pretzels. And they have 3 grams of fiber per serving. I have reordered several times since I cannot find them locally. They always arrive promptly in perfect condition.

I started buying these pretzels in the grocery store and then when I went to buy them again I couldn't find them anywhere so I decided to go online and whala Amazon had them, for alot less money too, although theyhave gone up about $3.00 since the last time I ordered them 6 monthsago.  Our whole family including my kids 9 and 5 love these pretzels!!The favor is wonderful and you actually get 3 grams of fiber per sevingand they are pretty low in calories 120, low in fat 2grams, and we lovethe slight sweet with the slighty salted flavor.  I can't rave enoughabout these pretzels, and to boot they don't have partially hydroginatedoils or high fructose corn syrup, no artificial colors/flavors or preservatives for which they wouldn't be in my houseif they did :)
This product gets a mixed review in our house.  Some of us love them because they combine sweet and salty; others think they are too sweet.  They could be a bit saltier, and we'd all like that!

The pretzel sticks are "starchy" tasting (just like all other pretzels), but with just a little bit of sweetness to make them delectable. They're not salty at all, which is good--I personally don't want the extra sodium. Every once in a while eating these you get a punch from the taste of sesame seeds which make these pretzel sticks that much better.

column9: If you like the bread....you'll love these!
column10: These pretzle sticks are fantastic. They have a very deep robust pumpernickle flavor and color with just a hint of onion. Make an inside-out ham sandwich by wrapping a thin slice of baked ham and a slice of swiss cheese around one of the sticks.

column9: It's not too good to be true
column10: They are the greatest low-fat, organic snack that I have ever tasted!!!! It taste just like pumpernickel bread from the holidays and I love it! It only haves 1.5 grams of fat for  14 pretzels which is a hearty snack. I can not say enough great things about this snack.

The problem with most pretzels is that they are white-flour bombs.  Lots of carbohydrate and not much else (other than a ton of salt).  Consequently, I have been looking for a good whole-grain pretzel.  These are pretty good.  The multiple grains add a variety and depth of flavor not found in plain pretzels, and you sure don't miss the extra salt.  Although they have a crunch, they are not so hard that my wife won't eat them.  They have only three flaws.  First, they are slightly sweet.  Although it is a subtle sweetness (which I suppose some folks like), I could do without it.  Second, white flour remains the number one ingredient, notwithstanding the multiplicity of whole grains.  Third, although they are low fat, they are not fat-free.  I am not sure why the bakers find it necessary to add oil to a pretzel.  Despite these shortcomings, these are a good--and healthier--alternative to standard prtezels, and much, much healthier than most other salty snacks.

I ordered these expecting them to be like other honey wheat pretzels but they are not.  There is something about the flavor that is not thrilling me but now I have a whole case.  I think I might just donate the rest of the bags.

I was ordering these pretzels from Amazon and they are wonderful.  Couldn't find them in the stores any longer so Amazon was my savior.  Unfortunately, Amazon doesn't carry them any longer either.  But it was great while it lasted!  Wonderful product.

BEWARE of the warehouse deals - many of the products are near end of shelf life and often there is no way to ask about that, so you end up with a case of food items that you might have hoped would last a few months that require being consumed in a month or less.The case I ordered was near its shelf life expiration and the product is moderately tasty.
We use the auto ship for these.  I've tried other brands, Trader Joe's, Fresh and Easy, bulk from Sprouts; but the hubby says these are the best.

column9: My favorite snack...and now it's history
column10: Why did Snyder's drop this product? Was I the only one who loved this snack? I really hate it when I find something this great and then it gets dropped from production.
The Hanover Pumpernickle & Onion Pretzels are the best. Use to find in the Grocery store but now only over the internes. Love these treats, YUM!!!!!!!!!!!!

These are my favorite pretzels.  I like the whole-wheat flavor and rough grain texture.  They are also a good size for snacking.  I can never find these in the store so I buy them online.  I have bought several cases and had one off-flavor/stale bag.
Excellent pretzel!  Can't find locally so I order in bulk - and they don't last long.  My daughter even asked for a box (12 bags) for her birthday.  Go figure!

Wonderful pretzels! I purchased these last summer in New Hampshire which started an addiction that has been hard to fulfill because I can't find these pretzels in Missouri. Hence my online purchase. A really good pretzel that's not overly sweet, and packed with flavor.

These pretzels are light and very tasty, plus they are not as salty as other snacks.  The fact that they are a healthier alternative to most other pretzels or chips and, I believe, they taste better, is a very rare combination.

column9: Good tasting Organic Pretzel sticks by SNYDER"S
column10: This was a great tasting organic snack food, buying it through Amazon in bulk, it costs less, stays fresh and delivered to my door. It is priced a lot better than in the stores, if you can even find it in a store! It is a good product that myself and husband enjoy. If you like pretzels want organic and are looking for a slightly salty/sweet taste, then this is one you will enjoy too! This is an edit of my review as my last shippment of this product was not very good... the pretzels in this latest shipment have an odd taste to them...sad as they were so good tasting in prior shipments...I also see that you can not get this organic Pretzel anymore as it show as unavailable, this maybe is due to the problem I am having, perhaps someone else found this odd taste that wasn't there before soI'd change my rating on this product now after the problem w/ this shippment I hope they fix the problem.

I'm making some healthier lifestyle choices.  I ordered these pretzels because they were multigrain and I want to add more fiber to my diet.  I love them, but the real proof of the pudding is that my husband loves them too.  He typically complains about other whole wheat products I buy. As a matter of fact he eats them more than I do. Great product, I put them on automatic shipment.

These are so yummy. My son likes the Oat Bran, hubby likes the Honey Wheat and I love the Pumpernickel & Onion. It makes me happy to find an incredible ingredient list for something so yummy. Amazon has the best price if you want to buy in bulk.

column9: These little beauties are killer, no onion breath afterward
column10: Snyder did it all right. (you used to be able to get these in the big pretzel size in my grocery store, but they are no longer available where I live) The pumpernickel is delish, the onion is very faint, but distinguishible, and the salt is just enough to get you all excited, but not too much to overpower the pumpernickel. The sticks are a fun shape to munch, and if you have company that likes to dip things these are a good size for that (no double dipping). Sticks are about 3 inches long.

column9: an acquired taste, then it's good
column10: it's not your typical pretzel. I don't eat much pumpernickel, so it took me half a bag to get used to. after that, I liked it. I don't like that it comes in a pack of 12; these are regular sized packs. I was hoping for snack size packs. Anyway, the best thing about this is that it is good fer ya and has a different flavor; it's always good to play with the palette a little. world peace!
The basket was the perfect sympathy gift when trying to express how much you care and really provide resources to assist in the healing process.

column9: Delicious and quick and easy to make!
column10: I've used this product for years.  If only the salt content were lower...it would be a perfect side dish.  I love that it has sooooo much flavor and is so simple to prepare.  Pour contents into a large bowl, add 2 to 2 1/4 cups of purified water and a tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil.  Cook on high for 10 minutes in the microwave and you've got a delicious meal companion.  The flavor is always outstanding.  Quality control with this product is fabulous!  I've tried other pre-packaged pasta mixes but I always come back to this one.  It's just DELICIOUS!!  Now if only they would use sea salt!!  Of course, it's pasta so nutrition is not like a fresh salad or a bowl of broccoli but it really does taste great!

column9: I'm so happy to see these on Amazon!
column10: Warning, they DO NOT taste like hot dogs. They are merely shaped like hot dogs. I grew up with these and hear they are a bit of an acquired taste. (One of my friends didn't like them at first but I stubbornly kept feeding them to her. Finally she admitted, "They grow on you...like mold." And now she wants Big Franks whenever we see each other.) Wonderful cut up, fried, and added to omelets, diced potatoes, or macaroni. Shred them, mix with mayo, and have a tuna sandwich substitute. Or just eat them like hot dogs.I just about had a happygasm when I found Loma Linda products on Amazon. I live overseas with the military and, as you can guess, it's difficult to find my childhood foods here.
These cannot be directly compared to hotdogs, so I won't do that, but compared to the regular Loma Linda Big Franks these taste exactly the same, but with less calories and fat. I'm for it.

column9: Low Fat Big Franks are Great
column10: I have had a hard time finding a vegie hot dog that I like.  I have tried them all.  I loved the Big Franks that were not low fat, but getting them was a problem.  This is my first try of the low fat ones and I do think they are just as good, and now getting them is easy too.

I have eaten Big Franks for years. They are lower in fat and more digestable than beef weiners.  The flavor is pleasant, the texture is very meat-like.  They are precooked so they can be warmed in the mocrowave for about 2 minutes for four franks.  They are very versatile and can be carried without refrigerated if they have not been opened.  Soy is the major ingredient and it is the only plant protien which is a complete protein by itself.  Patricia Neely-Mississippi

column9: Not the same as regular Big Franks
column10: I grew up on Loma Linda products and was excited to see them available on Amazon.  The bad news is that these low fat big franks are way different than the normal ones.  I was excited to have my newly vegetarian girlfriend try them out, but then I was embarrassed because they weren't nearly as good.  They actually made us both a little sick.  They're just too dense and strange.Stick with the linketts or find normal big franks somewhere else.  I don't think they are on Amazon.

column9: OK....but the Big Franks and Linketts are MUCH better!
column10: I like eating these hot dogs grounded up with onions and salt. But frying and eating them just like that, does not taste so good like the original. In fact, I like the Big Franks and Linketts much better than this fat free version.

I was very excited to find Worthington/Loma Linda now being sold on Amazon.  We live about 40 miles outside Loma Linda (or La Sierra) and stores around here either don't carry the brand or they are just plain too expensive.  We've always like buying the cases to save a bit of money, and because we don't get up there that often so we like to stock up.The prices here on Amazon using their Subscribe & Save feature, can be quite competitive with these stores, however, Big Franks are a VERY expensive even with S&S (I can get them for fifty cents less at my local Stater Bros a can at a time and La Sierra had them for four thirty nine a can), so I decided to try the Low Fat Big Franks which are much more reasonably priced.That being said, this review is coming from someone who's not a big fan of Big Franks (I like the Diced Chik and Vegetable Steaks), however, as far as Big Franks go these are just as good as the regular (full fat) ones.  My son and wife really like Big Franks and they really couldn't tell the difference.EDIT:  Amazon's price on all Worthington foods has skyrocketed!  Nearly SIX dollar a can is ridiculous.  Check your local supermarket and ask if they have a case discount or check with your local SDA church and ask when they're having their next campmeeting.  Campmeeting time is a perfect time to stock up because they normally have huge sales on veggie food.  For example, 2010 Phoenix area campmeeting sale had regular BigFranks for FORTY dollars a case.

I bought these after seeing the other reviews and I am very pleased! I cooked them on the stove with green peppers and onions (like Polish sausages) in some of the broth from the can and they turned out great! Also, I was very pleased with the nutritional facts - not too much sodium or fat, a good-sized serving and some fiber. I like that they are shelf-stable and will keep for a long time. It is too bad that these are not more widely available.
These are ok if you want something lower in fat. They are half the fat of a regular Big Frank, but they have a different texture and taste.
These go up  big in price every time you order. Better to find other brands of food. There is no good reason but greed.
These are delicious in a Hot Dog bun.  they are a good size and don't fall apart when cooking.  i've tried other veggie sausages but these are the best.

These are GREAT.  My wife and I have been eating them for years.  Love to roast them over the fire or just microwave them for 30 seconds.  As a life long vegetarian I can not compare them to real hot dogs but I think these taste great =:D.

With the rich creamy taste of chocolate, I wonder how it contains kale, beet, spinach, carrot and tomato.  While drinking fudge I get bluberry, banana, acai, apple and rasberry.  It is delicious and it's all orgaic. I drink one at work and get energy without caffiene so there is no crash.  Can you believe it even curbs your hunger with 16 grams of protein? column9: Good mid morning pick me up
column10: This is my favorite mid morning snack. I set the whole container inside a coffee cup because I have had them flip over in the microwave. I nuke mine for 90 seconds,stir and go. I especially love the flavor of this brand. I also have had a hard time finding this product in the stores so I started ordering it from Amazon and have regularly scheduled shipments. Now I don't have to run to all the stores around town looking for it.

I've been buying these soups as a matter of cheap thrills and convenience. They are probably best used as a no-fuss and light lunch st work and school. Not all of the flavors are created equal, however. I rank the ones I've tried as follows:1. Tomato Parmesan2. Cream of broccoli3. New England clam chowder.The first two are very tasty. The third is a bit bland but still pretty decent.I can think of three advantages of going with this product:1. Cost. Bloom charges me $1.89 a can for this soup. Amazon's subscription plans often make the soup significantly less expensive.2. Ease of preparation. Just shake, microwave for 90 seconds, and you're ready to go. No other cooking utensils or preparation is required. The metal rims on the containers do not cause sparking. Pretty neat.3. Ease of consumption. Just sip from the container, which seems to be a foam material or plastic that doesn't conduct much heat and is easy to hold. It fits easily into car cup holders. No spoons or bowls are required.Anyone on a low-salt diet should think twice. The soups have 30+ percent of the RDA. The fat content is a bit elevated. These things are to maintain the flavor. Calories don't go above 220 or so.All in all, these soups have turned out to be an unexpected winner. I expect to be buying more.

I was pleasantly surprised with the taste of this soup.  It really has an excellent flavor and it is so easy to heat and eat.I have always known that I couldn't go wrong with the Campbell's brand.  This soup proves it once again.

The flavor of it is so clean and nice.As for price, it is cheaper at Shop Rite, but you have to get it in a huge bottle. A delicious hot sauce. And a great price for what you get. Perfect for hot wings and hash browns also.

column9: The label says "Extra hot" - and it's right!
column10: One wide-nostriled whiff of this stuff and you'll know how it felt to be gassed in the trenches during World War I, so when it arrives, use the same technique as chemists do which is to waft it towards your nose. (If you want to play a very horrible practical joke on someone, ask them to smell it without telling them what it is).Once it's inside your mouth, the vapors immediately travel up your nostrils and down your lungs and sting like hell. As you gasp for breath, it only serves to draw more vapors in, compounding the problem. My wife and kids, who refused to go near it, were in fits of laughter the first day I tried it. I'd periodically convulse at the dinner table as the fumes burned the lining of my respiratory system, unable to speak.If you enjoy the burning sensation if spicy foods you will love this. Obviously horseradish/wasabi are a different kind of heat to a chili pepper, but it adds a bit of variety.My favorite meal with this is to mix the sauce with sour cream, then serve over grilled steak, cherry tomatoes and arugula in warmed up French bread.  Delicious!  Don't forget the gas mask for your dining companions, and the video camera.
I love Horseradish! This was not as hot as I expected, but it is so much better than you can buy in the grocery store!

Amazing flavor and will knock your socks off. My family loves hot eats and this stuff on some prime rib fit right in. As an example...My sister in law didn't read the label fully and took a big whiff just a few inches above the jar. Her screams could be heard from our kitchen to the neighbors house. We came running fearing, something bad had happened, only to be greeted by her teary eyed, coughing and leaking from nose and mouth. Nuff said.

Found an oyster bar outside of Vegas one night and had Atomic horseradish for the first time.  Wow.  Sure it was hot (which I love) but it had the best taste of any horseradish by far, and I've even made horseradish from scratch.  This stuff was so good that we drove back to Henderson, NV to go to the same restaurant last time we were in Vegas for oysters on the half shell and Atomic horseradish.

This stuff is awesome! I just ordered my second jar. This makes the BEST tartar sauce and steak sauce on this earth. I have tried fresh horseradish but it is messy to grate and this product goes farther and doesn't spoil as fast as fresh. This is a welcome kitchen staple!!

.As one who loves coffee, I have been testing various coffees for many months.  Although I enjoyed light and medium roast coffees, I learned that dark roasts were much better for my tastes.  I learned that dark brews are more gentle on the digestive system as the increased roasting removes some oils that do not interact well with the stomach.  Additionally, dark roasts tend to have a richer, more full bodied flavor.So, I have tested many dark roasts.  My favorites have consistently been French roasts and Italian roast coffees.  I have been using Italian roast for some time.  Recently I noticed that Boyers Coffee decided to feature "Boyer's Select",  a brew that is the favorite of their employees.Boyer's Select features coffee beans that are grown at high altitudes and includes only quality Arabica beans.  The company advertises this coffee as a blend of Costa Rican, Samatra Mendeheling, and Colombian Suprimo beans, and claims it has a full bodied flavor.  This coffee tantalizes my taste buds and calms my soul.  This is my new favorite.  Boyer's Select is quality coffee.  It Is rich and flavorful.I am a person who enjoys my time in the mountains regardless of the season.  Having a cup of this coffee is like awakening to a refreshing warm breeze while camping on a remote snow filled mountain meadow.  I highly recommend this coffee.

column9: Great stuff, always been an oatmeal fan
column10: I have been eating oatmeal for quite a while now. maple too sweet for my tastes but like Goldilock this flavor is JUST RIGHT! I eat it once a day. Sometimes for breakfast, sometimes for supper and sometimes for both.
